title: Cozy challet in the back garden of a country house
text:
Set in the back garden of a private residence is a pair of chalets.  These are fairly small units but big enough for a king size bed etc and with an over-sized shower room attached.

Adjacent to the pair of chalets is a covered area which serves as an outdoor kitchen/dining area for the guests.  Supplies for a continental breakfast are provided.  

Rosy is a great host, ready to chat and advise on the local area and equally happy to leave the guests alone to enjoy sitting on the terrace in her garden enjoying the fabulous view.

Only slight negative was that there doesn't appear to be wifi available.

title: Homely and Rural with Great Views
text:
This B&B was a great find and one of the highlights of our trip where accommodation is concerned. Our host Rosemary was warm, welcoming and wonderful and was able to advise us on all things local. Talking to her at breakfast in her own dining room about her family, the farm, the business and her departed husband was a delight, whilst walking around her garden with her later discussing her home-grown produce made us feel at home and included - what a wonderful and inspirational lady.
The two rooms available are semi detached chalet-style cabins in the garden and include a very comfortable bed with a smell of the cleanest and freshest linen I've ever sensed. Add to this a very large en suite shower room (no bath) and we had everything we needed for our stay, including a nice little veranda to sit on while we had afternoon tea overlooking the valley below.
A peaceful, beautiful location with stunning views and the loveliest hostess you could ever wish to meet.

title: Alpacas, Alpacas, Alpacas
text: Rural B and B on the main road out of Cambridge. The B and B is just off a very busy divided road. If you want to go back to Cambridge you have to travel away from the town and make a tricky turn back. The Band B is a little shabby. A huge breakfast was provided in the room, enough for a snack and a meal. The alpacas were a highlight of the stay. I would recommend staying if you would love alpacas in your garden.  otherwise perhaps chose another Band B.

title: Fun place to stay
text: Comfortable and clean room with everything you need. Lovely host. Continental breakfast options in the room were plentiful and welcomed! Quiet even though it is right next to the highway. This is a working farm — we enjoyed watching the alpacas munch on the grass and flowers right outside our room. This was a perfect stop for us during the road trip through the north island. About 1 hour northwest of Rotorua and under 2 hours from Auckland.

title: Gorgeous country location
text: We booked a junior suite, and considering the great value, we were not expecting much….how wrong were we! The room was HUGE, and included a huge sofa / sitting area, as well as a massive bathroom, with excellent shower and vanity area. We woke up to llamas sitting on our terrace, such a treat. The BnB is surrounded by beautiful mature fruit trees. Wifi was complimentary and fast. A great stay.

title: Loved the breakfast!
text: Beautiful view! The room was comfortable, located in a separate building from the house. The alpacas and sheep wandered around during the day, so we were pleasantly shocked to see an alpaca looking at itself in the window at one point. All the animals are rather shy, so they tend to run away if you get too close. The little kitchenette station was lovely; each morning we had toast with jam, cereal with fresh milk, and yogurt to eat outside.The bread seemed to be Volare, nice stuff! We went blueberry picking nearby one day, so these were a nice addition to the cereal. The bathroom was beautiful and newly updated. My only wish was that we could have had more interaction with the animals. It was fun to see them around! I wish we could have fed them carrots or helped the host set out their food in the morning. The host was wonderful! He gave us some great tips for fun things to do during our stay in Cambridge. He gave us lots of space, not the kind of place where all the guests come to a common breakfast, for example. It was a little hard to the entrance see from the highway, and we took several attempts to make that turn. Beautiful entry-way with cows, alpacas, and purple flowers to greet you as you drive up though! The orange, lemon, and grapefruit trees out back were very impressive!

title: Gorgeous Views, Convenient
text:
Pouring rain, middle of the night, and jetlagged from a long flight, we were new to the country and thought it would save time the next day by driving closer to our destination for our stay. A flight delay changed these plans, but thankfully the owner of the Homestead B&B was understanding and helpful from start to finish. Homestead is located among farms and a major road; if you arrive in daylight you should have no issues finding the place, but be aware GPS directions are off.

The Homestead is an old family farm house divided into separate rooms. They all look and feel different. You will not have a private bathroom, but during our stay we never saw the other guests. Our room was a big bed, thick blankets, and was clean. The restroom was clean, with a nice large shower and clean towels. The common areas were even more comfortable with a big table and lots of built-in window seats overlooking the mountains and farms around. 

The owner keeps alpacas, chickens, and other animals on the grounds (be sure to watch where you step). They're friendly and picturesque. Breakfast is provided in the form of cereal, toast, jams, drinks, and other simple foods. Above all else, this place is convenient for trips to Hobbiton, Rotorua, and other tourist sites in the area.

Thanks again for meeting  us outside in the middle of the night! We enjoyed our stay!

title: In Two Minds
text:
We stayed here for one night to be close to Karapiro for a rowing regatta.  The owners are lovely and it is nice to share the house with the family.  A couple of things to know though - booking.com advertises this B&B as 'not needing a credit card to book' but what they should say is that you need to pay cash to stay here as credit cards are not accepted.  
Also the walls are thin and you can clearly hear other guests snoring and the ever-present Waikato road noise.  It is a lovely spot with visiting llamas (although this meant that we had to get out of the car to open and close two gates) and we had a big room with a couch and a desk.  The shared bathroom is a pain but very clean.  Room decor could be modernised and the bird song clock has to go because noone wants to hear bird calls on the hour through the night.

title: Perfect for Hobbiton
text:
This B&B is just 18 minutes from Hobbiton and five from Cambridge.  We stayed in the budget twin room which was very spacious and well furnished.   The wallpaper in the room is shabby though and needs replacement (the owner is new and I'm sure this is on the radar).
There are a few surreal elements like the cute bunny hopping around the carpet, the long walk along the corridor between room and shared bathroom and the beautiful smells of the owner's Thai cooking
Breakfast was fit for a king and overall our stay was very pleasant and excellent value.
Recommended, especially when visiting Hobbiton.

title: Quiet, peaceful, and pleasant stay
text: Clean, new, and lovely home. Only 10 -15 min drive from the city center, and ideal for someone like me who enjoy tranquil and peaceful setting.  Great value for money and the Chinese hostess is very accommodating and trying very hard.  Quiet and peaceful setting. Bread for toast and beverages included. Limited cutlery (dinner knife) and no bottle opener.  But,  I'd go back to stay.

title: Mrs
text: The hostess is very pleasant and tried very hard to help me.  She doesn't understand much English but we managed to work it out.  Very nice room and bedroom.   Great value.  It is out a way from Hamilton but is peaceful.   Would stay again.

title: Good location
text:
A beautiful house with vast views.  We stayed in the Rua Suite which I believe is the only one with a private bath.  It's a huge room with comfortable seating, 2 balconies and a very large private bath with two vanities, tub, walk in shower and a separate toilet room.  This is also the only room I believe that has air conditioning.  Ponies, goats, llamas etc. are all around and come to the fence by the parking to get attention.  Also has 3 outdoor cats.
There are lots of stairs just to get into the house.  Once inside there is a long staircase to get to the second floor where the Rua Suite is located.  Not easy if you have much luggage!  A sign tells you to remove your shoes upon entering the home and the entry is filled with shoes.  There is air conditioning in the Rua Suite but we were stopped coming back from dinner the first night and told that the owner had entered our room while we were gone (to get something from a closet) and saw that we had left a couple of fans on and had the air conditioner on.  She told us they had turned it all off and let us know that electrical costs were 4 times what it was in the US.  It was incredibly hot so we turned it on again.

title: Comfortable stay with great views over Waikato
text: We were in the Rua (Harmony) Suite for our stay. Very spacious and comfortable. The property looks like an Italian or Spanish villa and is situated, with great views, atop a hill on the outskirts of Hamilton. A generous breakfast is provided.

title: We would happily return.
text:
Our stay at Rua Resort was truly exceptional. The accommodations were above expectations—a beautiful taste of luxury set in a stunning countryside location with rolling hills all around, yet conveniently close to town.
From the moment we arrived, we felt like family. The hosts were welcoming and made us feel completely at home, creating a relaxed and personal atmosphere that made our stay even more special.  
Breakfast was exceptional—top-notch and clearly chef-prepared, with great attention to quality and presentation. It was the perfect way to start our day.
Rua Resort was a wonderful place to finish our travels and vacation. Peaceful, comfortable, and memorable—we would happily return and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the Hamilton area.

title: Outstanding, Wonderful, Inviting
text: My family and I stayed only for 1 night. However it was amazing. We had a very comfortable stay. Hosts were friendly and inviting. Our children loved the animals especially the 3 outside cats. The breakfast we had in morning was wonderful. The views from the property were outstanding. We will definately be back again, and highly recommend to anyone who is visiting the area. It felt like a home away from home.

title: Great overnight stay
text:
What a great stay, it was a shame it was only 1 night. 
The beds were incredibly comfy, the horses, cats and alpaca friendly
Great personal breakfast service
Wonderful host

Lots to love and the kids really loved it to. 

We will be back!

title: Warm and quiet BnB
text:
Warm welcome in this comfortable, very quiet and tidy BnB. The (shared) bathroom is massive and very convenient.
We enjoyed the opportunity to have a chat with our hosts and other guests. 
Our daughter loved to be offered a pack of carrots to feed the animals. 
We will certainly return.

title: Good kiwi hospitality
text: We got what we wanted and more at this most hospitable B&B… We came as guests, found we we were friends, and left feeling like family — Colleen and Clive are wonderful hosts, as is their family also [we loved the Sunday Japanese breakfast Coleman served up]! We loved that we were able to catch up at the ‘family’ table for a cuppa and chat with them on occasion. Being ‘Field Days’ in Hamilton with the bad luck of the Irish we were fortunate to secure a last minute booking when a their international continguent cancelled. Nonetheless the place was full and busy with single guests and families with young children. Such is the grand size of the lodge itself none of the comings and goings of the guests proved an inconvenience or disturbance to us over the four nights my wife and I and sister [all in our 70’s] were lodged at Rua. Our room and ensuite in the ‘River Suite’ was luxurious, and the vista of the nearby mountain and Waikato region, the heartland Aotearoa, magnificent. We fully recommend staying here for the all that it offers, both in lodging, and as a good Kiwi experience of hospitality and friendliness.

title: Amazing Tuscan Villa just outside Hamilton.
text: We booked this place at the absolute last moment, and they were so accommodating and kind. We had the honeymoon suite which is enormous with two verandas overlooking gorgeous vistas. The room is big and comfortable and well appointed, with a huge bathroom. We could not have asked for more!

title: No responee and refund after cancellation request
text: I booked in their offical website and I have notified the owner few weeks before I have to cancel my booking due to personal issue. The confirmation email was received from them and accordingly to the cancellation policy I should have get 90% of my refund, but I have not receive after a month, and there is no reply from them no matter I ask repeatedly via email, whatsapp and so......very disappointing, please be careful when you make the booking

title: Great experience!
text: Beautiful property with amazing views of the countryside from any side of the property. Ponies, Llama, Goats, Cows and chickens to see, and the hosts are fantastic (excellent breakfast, clean rooms, all with great views). Highly recommend it!!!

title: Beautiful, clean and friendly
text: Two of us stayed for a B&B visit in the country while driving through New Zealand.  We booked the master suite which was simply amazing! The 360 degree views from the large balconies on both sides were gorgeous. There is a small farm with mini ponies, alpaca and sheep. We brought carrots to feed the horses and sheep which was fun.  Colleen was a fabulous hostess with a friendly sense of humor and sets up a nice breakfast. There were other couples staying in other rooms, all friendly and quiet.  Our suite had a very large, private bathroom.  Some rooms have shared bathrooms.  Everything is very clean. I would absolutely stay here again - especially in a suite room.

title: Average B & B
text:
Colleen was outwardly very pleasant when my husband went to check in. After I introduced myself, she asked both of us where we were from and we told her that we were from the US and as part of the conversation asked us how long we have lived there. My husband replied 45 years to which her answer was “you don’t have an American accent”. Are all her customers subject to such remarks or is it just us?

Her website indicates laundry as available but we could not use it as we had no idea where it was and Colleen was nowhere to be found. When we enquired the next morning, with another gentleman who I think was the chef, he said he had to ask Colleeen as it was not available for guests to use. 

If you have big luggages there are a lot of stairs you have to carry them through. Something to keep in mind. Shared bathroom and toilets were awkward. Breakfast was decent.

title: Absolute gem in a beautiful rural setting
text: Staying at Rua Lodge made the perfect start to our weekend, we were extremely lucky to been given the Rua room aka honeymoon suite, absolutely delighted with the room and the size of bathroom was amazing.  Rural views were so relaxing to look out at.  Breakfast was a lovely experience and you felt part of the family setting.  Our hosts Colleen and Clive and their family make you feel very welcome.  We will definitely be back to book that room again.

title: CRAP, WORST EVER
text:
Would not do it again. Exclusive HIRE! means one person hires the entire house and there is no one there. My family and I had booked the RUA Resort for 4 days over Christmas. It was already doomed from the start.
 Once arrived I was informed that there was another gentlemen staying at the property in the house. Only access is through the house. Then im informed by the owners that they are also not going away because their mother is ill so they are moving out of their room inside the house and moving into the Garage where they will stay.

There was 20 of us in total. we decided to let this all slide as it was Christmas and we are not heartless people. what I didn't realise is that the owners would continue to come in and out of the house with their internal access way. after one night of this we spoke to the owner and explained that this was not normal and that we hired the house exclusively. 'Your exclusive and my exclusive a two totally different things. We are a Bed and Breakfast not an AIRbnb." to which I replied well I would have not booked this place knowing that you would be in and out all the time. We had several young ladies in our family and unfortunately we don't know these people and were made to feel uncomfortable with people walking in and out. She came back to state that we had been given a significant discount. Yes, that is correct but with payment due the next day after the booking so that they could build cabins. this was agreed.
There is only 2 bathrooms and one toilet downstairs, not sufficient 4 family with children and teenagers.

We were celebrating birthdays on our first night and couldn't even enjoy that as she came up and asked us to be quiet. we kindly asked her to leave.

There was nowhere for us to put our food.so we had to put it on the benches. Dishes were sitting in the dish rack, oven was filthy. the kitchen was filled with bins for the rubbish of different types. 

Overall Worst Experience EVER but we had to make do as it was CHRISTMAS. we were going to leave but with such a large group the day before Christmas we decided to stay. WOULD NOT BOOK THIS PLACE AGAIN!

title: Shared Bathrooms
text: This is a lovely large inn in a remote, exquisite property.  The owners are delightful and the inn is decorated so beautifully.  But be clear of the type of property it is—almost all the rooms share bathrooms.  Our error in not catching that the room we booked was this type.  There is a large kitchen that also is shared and while we were there most people were preparing their dinners. Spotlessly clean, good breakfast.  Just awkward sharing bathrooms.

title: Great find in Hamilton
text:
This is a great place to stay. The hosts were friendly, helpful  and made all of their guests quite comfortable beyond what I would have hoped for!  Coleen even helped plan my next spots as well as bailing me out w a conversion plug that I couldn’t find on a Saturday/Sunday arrival
     Their decor is beautifully coordinated and the surroundings are peaceful and with nice views. The breakfast they provided was home cooked for each and as extensive as I’ve ever experienced w teas, coffees, multiple cereals, fresh fruit eggs,local bacon and other extras that impressed! Wow

title: Fabulous
text: This place is wonderful! It is a beautiful building with scenic vistas from every angle. The rooms are well appointed and clean. Although it is a shared bathroom, the room is spacious with two showers and a bathtub. The best part is the hospitality of our hosts who made us feel truly welcome. Colleen and Clive were gracious and charming. Their son, Coles, made perfectly cooked pancakes and bacon for us, and there was cereal, bread, fruit, and yogurt in addition. They were all fun and hospitable. There are alcapas, sheep, and horses on the property. This is a wonderful place to stay- don't miss it!

title: Do Not Do It
text: DO NOT STAY HERE! Once upon a time I stayed in a hut in Africa on a straw mattress. Half the straw was missing. This was worse. Don't stay here unless you love to be disappointed. It's absolutely beautiful from the outside. So are display cakes... but it's just frosting.

title: Stinky, tired and creepy
text: It’s difficult to even give this place a 1. From the moment we opened the front door, we knew we’d made a terrible mistake. It was smelly, the rooms were tired and the hosts were very very strange. Despite booking a room with two beds, Colleen gave our room away and replaced it with a double bed. I was travelling with my mother who did not want to share a small cramped bed. Colleen suggested they put a futon on the floor in the cupboard for me to sleep on. She was not pleased when I requested a refund. I have yet to receive a refund. It’s been a week and I have phoned, text and emailed to no avail. Do not book here. You will be disappointed.

title: 10/10 wonderful stay!!!!!
text: Rua Resort is such a gem! The hosts are very kind, friendly, and welcoming. They made our stay very comfortable. The house is beautiful and the views are stunning! We had a delicious home cooked breakfast, and great conversation and laughs with the hosts. We were so happy with our stay, and wished we could have stayed longer!

title: 10/10 wonderful stay!!!!!
text: Rua Resort is such a gem! The hosts are very kind, friendly, and welcoming. They made our stay very comfortable. The house is beautiful and the views are stunning! We had a delicious home cooked breakfast, and great conversation and laughs with the hosts. We were so happy with our stay, and wished we could have stayed longer!

title: Loved this B & B!! Would definitely return.
text: Amazing B&B.  The setting is unequalled.  An Italian Villa on a hill, surrounded by pastures and views.  The family went out of their way for my vegetarian granddaughter and even offered to help us get to the FIFA World Cup game if needed.  Would absolutely, definitely go back.  A wonderful experience.

title: A very good place to stay
text:
The hosts were very welcoming and easy to chat to. Lots of room. We were the only guests there at the time so pretty much had the run of the entire floor. They went out of their way to make us feel at home.
This was the first time we stayed at a B & B so didn't really know what to expect.
We would stay again if the situation arose.
Tame animals to visit and pat.

title: Perfect combination of home and hotel feel!
text:
Absolutely wonderful stay! Kids loved feeding the animals and having access to a huge range of toys and games. The hosting couple are lovely and really make you feel like you are old friends they just hadn't met before. The premium breakfast is just that, and the kids loved the range of fresh fruit and cereals. 
We stayed in the River suite and it had everything we expected and needed to make our stay relaxing and stress free.
We definitely will be coming back!!

title: Lovely little getaway.
text: Very welcoming and helpful. Lovely host who was easy to chat with and open to answering any questions we had during our stay. The supplied breakfast was delicious with a wide range of things to choose from. The rooms were well kept and felt homely. We look forward to returning for another stay.

title: Italy Revisited
text: This was the most amazing B & B accommodation we have experienced.      The Italian inspired mansion is spacious, gracious and gorgeous in every respect.   Bedrooms well appointed with outside balconies,  and a huge family bathroom.   Downstairs a huge lounge and dining area.    Clive and Colleen were welcoming and made our stay so pleasant.      We are looking for another excuse to visit Hamilton and stay again with them.

title: Excellent
text: I’ve been there twice or thrice and I could say it’s always been same top notch and perfect hospitality. I am so touched that how they care each and every guest like their own related. Last time me and my husband been there and he personally enjoyed the view and staff’s hospitality. 😊

title: Absolutely stunning!
text: Where can I being. Rua Resort exceeded our expectations. Clive and Colleen are remarkable hosts, with such an warm and inviting energy. The grounds are lovely and well kept and the house it's self is stunning and spotless. Heaps to keep the kids occupied as well. Can't say anything negative about Rua Resort.

title: Comfort PLUS!
text: Colleen was lovely and inviting and took care of all of our needs. The house is very luxurious and comfortable with varied room options to suit different needs. Hosts were very genuine and good people. Would highly recommend.

title: THE BEST VIEWS !
text:
What a nice experience.  I didn’t plan to stay in a B&B in Hamilton for business, but good rooms where in short supply.

This place reminds you of all that is great about this style of accomodation.  The BEST rural views, nice breakfast, relaxed atmosphere, peace and quiet and great hosts Colleen and Clive.  The room was well appointed and very clean. 

I only wish I was on holidays!

title: Top BnB experience for families who like country living
text: We have had wonderful experience while we stayed in Rua resort, Colleen, the host, is super friendly and very pleasant to deal with. The rooms are decorated very nice with its style, everything are kept in orders with thoughtful details, really appreciate the enormous efforts Colleen and her family have been contributing to this BnB accommodation business, the complimentary breakfast is so nice and it really went above my expectation ... for families with young kids, my daughter really enjoyed feeding the animals and the farm tour, we are planning to stay as a group perhaps later this year, it would be great! Collen thank you so much for having us and we would love to come back again for sure!

title: Amazing Home!
text:
Rua Resort is an incredible home and offers fantastic accommodation. 

The rooms and the establishment itself are nothing short of luxury. It is a space where you feel truly looked after by the hosts, and if you want to treat yourself the scrambled eggs and bacon were delicious.

Can’t wait to be back!
hotel_response:
Perhaps you can try my mini bacon and egg pies next breakfast? Thank you for your kind review.
Cheers,
Colleen

title: 10th year anniversary celebration
text: Booking with the lovely lady host Colleen over the phone was quite direct and persist, she was very polite and offered me two different rooms, though the honey moon suite would have been perfect but is not ready till later in the year, This is a very lovely warm old style resort that could do a little more modern renovating in the suites especially if they are there for romantic experience, offering us bath rock and free cooked breakfast was so 👌  of her, lovely family and it is children friendly also with all there fam pets on site to visit beautiful views and a perfect silent piece of paradise, just a very lovely home I would enjoy coming to stay again some time maybe with our children too.
hotel_response:
Hi Tessa and Trojan,
Thank you for your comments. Can you be more specific with suggestions on how you think we could “modernise the suites, especially for romantic experiences?”.
We frequently upgrade the furnishings so would love to hear your ideas. There is always room for a fresh perspective.
Regarding the Honeymoon suite, it is regularly in use. 
I am sorry if you misunderstood. It was already booked on the night of your recent stay. Jump in early and request that suite when you plan to come next time. 
Kind regards,
Colleen

title: A Hidden Gem in the Countryside
text: A quiet, tucked away and relaxed stay in what's closest to a stately home as is possible in NZ. Close enough to Hamilton but far away enough to preserve a real country feel. Our almost 5yo had a blast here, plenty of cool toys for her to play with and miniature horses to engage in meaningful discussions with. An extremely comfortable room accommodated all three of us, and decent WiFi meant we were in touch with the outside world when we needed to be. Colleen and Clive are terrific hosts, we'll most certainly return at some stage!
hotel_response: And you will be very welcome!

title: Awesome countryside location
text: It’s like heaven on earth, nice place to stay cozy and attractive feels like home. Highly recommend to those who want some family time. Also a great chance to explore countryside life and Can see some cute farm animals.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind review. 
Colleen

title: Not good if you have children or a personality
text: I'm unsure if the good reviews are even genuine for this B&B (hardly a resort..) I could see potential in the house, but realistically it was rather dirty with cobwebs and bugs galore. Colleen was a very strange host indeed. I would not recommend paying a premium to sleep in these bedrooms.
hotel_response:
Wow. Never seen a report like this before. I would very much like to know what I might  have done to appear strange. We are in the country where bugs and spiders abound. I don’t use sprays inside the house, for healths sake, so I apologise if we missed catching any insects inside the house. As far as children go, we welcome them and more often than not, the parents report that they don’t want to leave. They love the giant bathrooms, the friendly animals outside and the large toy and games cupboard in the lounge. Please feel free to write back with specifics so we can improve on the awful impression you left with. Would love to know your name also, so we have a chance to analyse what displeased you. 
Regards, 
Colleen

title: Amazing time in Rua
text: The past few weeks we had an amazing stay at Rua resort in Hamilton. Our room was spacious and very clean and the view was amazing. Breakfast was very extensive and for lunch and diner we could use the kitchen. There is so much to experience if you stay at Rua. They have little horses, an alpaca, 2 sheep, a bunny, chickens and a goat with 3 baby goats! It is so nice to walk around and feed al the animals. On a rainy day there are a lot of options for games and in the room we had TV with Netflix. The shared badroom has 2 showers and a bad for relaxing moments. And the best part were the hosts! We felt zo welcome and like home. They are very friendly and helpful! Thanks a lot Clive and Coleen for the wonderful time and experience!
hotel_response:
Lisa, 
It was our privilege to have you and Mike in our home. Though we are now at opposite ends of the world, we hope to meet again one day. 
Love, 
Colleen

title: Outstanding experience
text: An incredibly beautiful home with just as incredible hosts. Served eggs and bacon for breakfast along with coffee, cereal, fruit and yogurt. Comfortable beds with water by the bedside table. All round amazing experience and outstanding service

title: Wonderful place to have a rest
text: Location and house are superb. We stayed at spacious room with en-suite bathroom. The place has a great outdoor area with lots of farm animals. Hosts are very nice and welcoming! Thank you very much for the experience.

title: Real experience, kids loved it
text: We enjoyed our stay very much (2 adults and 2 kids (2 and 4) and had everything we needed and even more! There were a lot of toys, games, dvds and books available, so kids were so happy and we didn’t need to spend energy entertaining them. The breakfast was great and hosts were amazing and very welcoming. We stayed in the room with big bath, so kids enjoyed the bath before going to sleep. Feeding ponies were another good entertainment for kids. We in our term enjoyed peacefulness and great scenic view.

title: Weekend away
text: Wow what an amazing place to stay. Clive and Colling were the most gracious hosts we have ever encountered. Beautiful surroundings, a wonderful breakfast we recommend this place to all travellers! Love all the animals.

title: Amazing location to stay with wonderful hosts, Beautiful place and people!
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Rua Resort in Hamilton. The location was beautiful and remote but still close enough to all our planned activities on the North Island of New Zealand. The hosts Colleen and Clive went above and beyond to make the place feel like home. They helped all the guests with any questions they had about the area and provided a delicious breakfast each morning. What a fittingly beautiful establishment to stay at while visiting this amazing country. Could not recommend more!

title: Nice house and lovely hosts
text:
Stayed for 2 nights between Christmas and New Year 2019, Made to feel very welcome in Colleen and Clive’s home. We had a large family room with en suite facilities, exceptionally clean tidy and well decorated. 
Outstanding breakfast with plenty of choice.
Mike and Sue, UK

title: Wonderful location, views, and people!
text: This was a fabulous place to base out of for a few nights!  First and foremost, the hosts were absolutely lovely - great people dedicated to ensuring that all their guests had a great stay.  They showed our children their animals - including the chickens, alpacas, and ponies.  The breakfasts in the AM were delicious!  We really enjoyed the conversation - both with the hosts and with the other guests.  Lots of thoughtful touches throughout, like games for children and lots of extra toiletries in the bathroom.  Good for a day-trip to Raglan and the "Bridal's veil" waterfall.  There are several different room options available - ours had a double and a single bed.  Shared a bathroom with other guests - no issues.  Amazing views here & nice place to go for a walk/run, or just drink coffee and enjoy the solitude!

title: Wonderful place, wonderful hosts, quiet and relaxing!
text: If you wish a quiet, relaxing place that is in the center of beautiful countryside this is your spot.  It is a short drive to anything you need but is nicely at the end of a road with rolling meadows, horses grazing and views in all directions.  The breakfast is perfect and their well equipped kitchen is available to use to if you wish to make dinner instead of go out.  Colleen and Clive are wonderful hosts.  I will be back!

title: Castle on the Hill!
text: My family and I needed place to stay after long drive from Wanganui towards Auckland and found Rua Resort in Hamilton. The hosts in the resort welcomed us with open arms even arriving to the resort well after midnight. We normally stay in major hotels and were a bit sceptical to stay at B&B resort. We had no choice as the hotels were full due to a major event in Auckland. Thankfully were so relieved to see the resort like a castle on top of the hill with bright welcoming lights on middle of the night. title: The low point of the NZ Trip.
text:
We were travelling as a family group of 9 adults and 3 children and stayed in various Airbnb’s during our NZ trip.  All were fantastic except this stay.  We choose this house due to the size.   This stay might work for you … it did not work for us.

The Pro’s – The house is large, spacious and clean.

The Forgivable – When we arrived the toilet was blocked, there was no working door on the main on suite, the Iron worked intermittently, the TV in the main bedroom was not connected.  This was all rectified except we were blamed for the iron and they are making us pay for it.  

Different Expectations – We thought we were renting the home.  It turns out we were renting rooms in the home the family live in.  Ok, we can deal with that – there were no other guests anyway,  however, this is someone who wants to do AIRBNB, but does not really want you in their family home.   E.G. We were asked to turn off lights,  the main bedroom had AC heating but we could not turn it on – to deal with the cold we were told to close the curtains,  kids were told off for making noise in the stairwell, we were accused of exercising in the living room (???) we were lounging on the floor.  We don’t drink and don’t party, but we made too much noise playing cards at 8pm!  Oh and the grandson of the owner was filming us with a Gopro??  This is advertised as a luxury stay but we were directed to use the public laundry in Hamilton city.    Yeah, we felt like the out of town cousins no one wants around!!

The Bad – While driving to the accommodation from Auckland the owner rang us and asked us to change our booking at an additional cost to us of $500, so they could accommodate other bookings.  Huh?? We declined.    14 days later they said they were keeping some of the bond due to lost income???   The owner sent us a copy of the electricity bill and said they were keeping some of the bond due to excessive electricity charges.    Have you ever stayed anywhere where that has happened??   Further the owner is claiming we damaged the property by scuffing the leg of a chair in the dining room and chipping a flooring trim.

title: Uncomfortable
text: I am really surprised this place has received any positive reviews. My entire family ( my parents, brothers and sisters and our kids) stayed here for several nights and for those several nights we all felt uncomfortable. She insulted my son because he didn't know how to read (he is 5).The house is big and looks great but don't be deceived "It's big for nothing". title: I didn't feel welcomed by Colleen
text:
As Colleen and Clive have pointed out in a prior response, there may have been some disagreement or miscommunication regarding the nature of our family booking at RUA Resort, however no amount of miscommunication justifies being rude to paying customers. 

From the moment my husband and I, with our two children, arrived at the resort, we were made to feel uncomfortable and unwelcome. We arrived at 4.30pm, half an hour after check-in time, and Colleen asked us to leave again in the rain, with two children under 5, to play at the park for an hour, as she wasn't ready for us yet. We were good-natured about it at the time, although I think it warrants mentioning as I found it somewhat unprofessional. 

From that time, and for the remainder of our stay, Colleen was unfriendly and unwelcoming in her behaviour and attitude. It has been suggested in another reply from Clive and Colleen that they were all made to feel uncomfortable by us, which I am not only very sorry to hear, but also quite shocked. I had multiple positive interactions with Clive, as well as with their son and grandson. If they were uncomfortable, it certainly wasn't apparent, and for that I am grateful. It was difficult enough to endure Colleen's cold and dismissive nature, so I appreciate the efforts that her family went to in making us feel welcome, I'm just sorry to hear that they didn't feel the same way about us.
hotel_response:
Hello Sally, 
I am sorry that your impression was one of not being welcomed on arrival. I recall when you first came by that my only hesitation was that Penny, who was in charge had not yet arrived so I didn’t know which room to show you to. However I said that you were welcome to hang out in the lounge until they arrived. Your response, as I recall it, was a suggestion that you would wait until Penny arrived, so at that point I suggested the park at the end of the road, or the museum around the corner, if it rained. I have just finished paying $3000 for a rain shelter for the ponies in the front paddock, because I feel sorry for them in the rain. I am not likely to send a family with two small children out in the rain. When you did return, still ahead of the main party, we welcomed you in to the lounge and opened the doors to our massive toy cupboard which your boys enjoyed. When I heard that they were hungry I gave them a little gingerbread cookie. I cannot think what I might have done to make you feel unwelcome because that is not in my nature, nor is it reported in any other review, except from these few from you and your extended family. The problem goes right back to the misconception that by paying for four rooms, Penny expected the whole house with the four residents to move somewhere else. The questions put to Clinton and Dean in particular reflected that the actual booking arrangements were not passed on to the group.
That would result in unfulfilled expectations on your part. Sad really.

title: AWFUL!
text: If I could give a rating of 0 I would. Never have I experienced so much drama in my life. We spent thousands to stay here to only be tricked and conned. We thought we had booked the entire house to only have rooms rented and other people there. The owners made rude comments to my family and even left their underwear out in the lounge room one morning. They came into our rooms when we weren’t there. They did not return our bond for reasons that were 100% false. The house is beautiful but the drama is NOT WORTH IT.
hotel_response:
To anyone reading this ‘awful’ review, please scroll back and look at the last 10, 20 or 100 reviews and you will recognise that with our average of 9.6, this 1 is an anomaly, a distortion. Hannah has hit the nail on the head in saying that, “We thought we had booked the entire house”. Nowhere in any recorded exchange was that impression given by us. “Other people there” refers to my husband and I who live in our own home, run as a boutique hotel, and our son and grandson who live in the basement. I explained to Penelope, the mother of the group, that we are always onsite. We run our business here, we have farm animals to care for and need to be on hand to cater for guest’s needs.She actually invited us to join them in their family activities, but I wrote back that that was not necessary and that we were very good at staying out of the guests way. The problem is clarified with this review, that Penelope failed to inform her family who were staying or the many extra guests who visited, that we lived here in our home. Instead, our son, and our grandson, who is of a different race, were made to feel uncomfortable each time they came up to prepare their meals. They were interrogated rudely to the point that towards the end of this visit they chose to eat out, at extra expense. On the third day, Penelope told me that if I didn’t leave my house, they would demand their money back. I left. I had no desire to return until they were gone. 
To address the rude comments, I believe Hannah, you refer to my surprise when I walked through the lounge at the end of the first night and I was hit with a terrible smell of sweat. My honest reaction was, (my exact words) “Oh, it smells like a gym in here, has someone been working out?”. The lady pointed to the two young men who were still in the lounge. They were red faced and their clothes were wet with sweat and they looked a bit sheepish at my comment. I then added, “We will have to open the windows”. We like our guests to have fun, but I still consider it thoughtless to exercise to that degree in a newly carpeted lounge that is open plan to the dining area. The other possibly conceived as rude comment was when I called Penelope aside to suggest that the parents of the several babies in diapers wrap them in something before placing them in the swinging lid rubbish bin in the kitchen. Not a pleasant odour around food.
With regards the underwear, that was an oversight on my part. The night before I had carried my clean clothes for the next morning shower from my room through the lounge to the staff bathroom. In the dark, I inadvertently left my top, long pants and bra draped over the edge of a sofa. I am a 65 year old lady and we are not talking about anything racy. I did apologize to Penelope. I find it ironic that this was a problem, because Penelope objected so strongly to my accepting another guest in a separate wing on the first night and her statement was, “We want to be able to walk around in our underwear”.
From the day of arrival, the attitude and demands on this family were such that we turned down two bookings, losing over $400 in revenue. 
Addressing “They came into our rooms when we weren’t there.” I explained to Penelope that this is a safety issue. We have avoided house fires by walking through the rooms as soon as guests check out or leave for a day of activity. We have found clothes hanging over heaters, or wet towels over quality wooden furniture etc. so it is our policy to do a quick walk through, much like housekeeping would in a hotel. We also check on toilet roll and towel supplies. In particular Penelope was angry that we had turned off a heat pump in one of the suites as one of the children in that family has asthma. It only takes a few minutes to warm the room with a heat pump and that does not call for 6-8 hours of wasted power.
Addressing the thousands spent. For a five night stay this family paid $700 a night for 9 adults and 5 children. Their actual usage is valued at $1351.25 per night. They requested five rooms but we have seven, two of which became unusable as we could not subject other guests to their attitudes and misconceptions of exclusivity.
We gave them a free upgrade from a $200 family suite to the $300 Honeymoon suite, we did not charge the $25 extra person fee for any of the children, we allowed an extra family one night in the family suite in lieu of self-catering for breakfast (to give them further privacy and a further saving), 
we forwent a charge for a luncheon event they asked for. That was to be extended family for a couple of hours at noon. Instead it went late into the evening with loud party noise until around 11pm. They asked for another family to bring their camper van on site, which we also granted free of charge. This didn’t happen but it is worth mention as just another concession we made after Penelope appealed for a reduced price during negotiations, as her children were returned missionaries and attending University. 
Aside from business income lost and extra cost to us for a place for me to ‘escape’ to for two nights, and not being able to use our own kitchen, there were four items of damage, each of which I sent photographic evidence for which they continue to dispute.
In 12 Years of hosting we have had three negative reviews. The first was a woman for whom English is a second language. She arrived one Easter weekend with a van-load of friends to stay. She had bought a coupon on Grab-one and thought she could roll up without booking. We had full house. She yelled and screamed at the door. She threatened to call lawyers, the police and finally to destroy us with bad reviews. She tried. 
The second was a wedding party who returned at 1am drunk as skunks and loaded with boxes of booze which they planned to carry on drinking throughout the night. We had another guest and no one could sleep as the party continued despite my pleas to call it quits. I explained that we are not an all night party venue, rather a country bed and breakfast offering a quiet and comfortable nights sleep. Around 4am one of the group had collapsed on our lovely Italian sofas just outside our bedroom. I heard the awful sound of him getting up and relieving himself inside our entrance. That was negative review number two.
This family from Australia is number three.
I rest my case.

title: Rua Resort was our 1# Story from a two week NZ visit!  Amazing place and people.
text:
Rua Resort
For our New Zealand adventure, we did not book a single night in advance for the two weeks we visited.  We drove around the two islands and stopped when we wanted to!  One night however it almost backfired.  We went to Hamilton on a last minute change and everything in town was sold out. We tried walking into places and looking for cancellations, but nothing.  While begging a hotel manager for a room, my wife finds the Rua Resort on the Air BnB or other travel site.  You ask why I even mention this, but note that my wife has NEVER booked a hotel in our many years together.  So, when she think he has pulled this rabbit out of a hat, I see the pictures and know it is a scam!  But as always, she proved me wrong! Haha. 
The drive takes you out of town and through a modern nice area before driving back a single lane country road. The house is as beautiful as it looks. There was plenty of parking in the front for all the visitors.  The night we arrived there, they were hosting 5 couples from all over the world (e.g. Japan, Ohio-US, California-US, and Sweden). Everyone was friendly and glad to be there.  You enter the home and immediately it feels comfortable.  People kicked their shoes off in respect of the owners, but also because you were “Home”.  Rua Resort managers - Colleen / Clive made our experience a night to remember. Colleen greeted you like Mom does, when you come home for a visit.  Welcomed us and showed us to our room.  Our room was perfect and as advertised.  Bathrooms were clean and ready.  Beds were clean and fresh with plenty of extras (TV, cable, Netflix, air conditioner, towels, bottled water, comfortable bedding, etc.). Colleen gave us a good nearby suggestion for a casual unique dinner (the brewery that makes the beer for  Hobbiton). After returning from dinner, we got comfortable and relaxed for the night.   
Morning was amazing.  We arrived in the dark, so to awake with views out all windows of the valley and the local farm land was great.  In fact, Rua Resort has numerous animals of their own.  Alpacas, horses, sheep, birds, ponies, cats, and somewhere there were chickens.   It was just totally relaxing.  Colleen showed us to our table.  Sitting beside us, was a nice family from Japan already enjoying their breakfast. Colleen dropped off Coffee and proceeded to their table.  We were impressed to hear her fluently speaking to the family in Japanese. We later learned that she has grandchildren and other family members that lived in Japan so she learned to speak the language.  She is an amazing person.  Our wonderful breakfast included eggs, asparagus, fruit and bread.  It was delicious. We talked to Clive about American Politics and football/rugby for a while. Both of them were so interesting.  They have a very talented (musical) family that was amazing to hear about. It was my birthday, the day we were there, so Colleen shared one of her son’s CDs he release while in Japan – it was impressive.  Great start to our day.  So we finished our wonderful breakfast and then Colleen had a little gift for us – bag of carrots to feed the alpacas and horses.  We could not wait and ran outside to try and see if we could feed them.  She suggested putting a carrot in your mouth and leaning over the fence very still and one of the alpacas may come up and nibble on it.  “An Alpaca kiss”.  It worked for my wife and I.  The alpacas, horses, and ponies were so friendly.  But the little kitten following us around was the friendliest of all as she was sweet and playful.   It really was like visiting your child hood home and being so relaxed.  I wish I could visit more often.  If you are in the area, this is a must stop for you.  The price is perfect and the accommodations clean, spacious, and beautiful and the conversations were enlightening.  Say Hi to Clive and Colleen for us, and tell them we sent you.    Thanks Colleen!!!!

title: Best place to rest in Hamilton
text:
We're extremely happy to had the opportunity to stay in this resort. We felt like in home! The owners are lovely, they were very sweet with us.  The breakfast is full of options, the bedrooms and bathrooms are in perfect conditions, super clean. You can  feed the sheeps and alpacas and that's cool

Thank you very much!!
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind words Francesca. It was our pleasure to meet some new members of our International circle of friendship.

title: Simply lovely.
text:
I stayed at Rua Resort very recently with a group of friends/co-workers, and the experience was overall quite lovely. Colleen and Clyve are warm, generous, and accommodating, and Colleen's sense of humor was much appreciated.

The house itself is large and comfortable--our first night, we got bumped to a first floor suite with two bedrooms, a lovely balcony overlooking the drive up to the house, and a very pleasant bathroom. Our second night, we were moved to the originally booked, which was comfy and had an equally nice bathroom. The breakfast selection was very nice---lots of cereals, breads, crumpets, coffee, and accoutrements, and Colleen made some very cracking bacon and eggs for my group.

The house itself is gorgeous, surrounded by lush green lawns and the owners' cavalcade of ponies, sheep, alpacas, goats, and a very friendly cat. (Colleen let us tag along our third morning before left and let us feed/pet them and get some great photos. If you are traveling with children who love animals, this is such a fun perk.) It is a GREAT central hub for exploring the northern half of the North Island -- my pals and I were able to make a trip to Hobbiton (40-minute drive), Bridal Veil Falls (45-minute drive) and the absolutely stunning Raglan (1 hour drive) in one jam-packed and magical day. Hamilton itself is very quiet, but the 80-minute drive makes it a much-welcomed escape from Auckland.

On a clear night, Rua Resort also offers an incredible view of the stars. Stunning. Would definitely stay here again if I was in the area.

title: Splendid, comfortable and right at home
text:
I can't say enough good about this wonderful bed and breakfast and its gracious hosts, Colleen and Clyve. They are ever so warm and friendly. From making sure we were happy and comfortable, to giving us advice on the best places to visit, letting us feed the alpacas, horses, and chickens, pointing out the southern cross, and feeding my endless breakfast appetite. 

The resort was the perfect place to come back to away from all the bustle of the tourist attractions. Just down from the beautiful New Zealand temple, we found the resort to be a wonderful midpoint for many of the places we wanted to go: Rotorua, Lake Taupo, hot water beach on the Tasman Sea, Hobbiton, Waitomo Caves, etc. 

I have been dreaming about visiting New Zealand with my family for over thirty years and had big expectations for a great experience. Rua Resort did not disappoint. A big part of what made New Zealand so fun and memorable for me was staying in a place that made me feel right at home.

Thank you Colleen and Clyve!

title: Fantastic home for our large family group
text: Colleen was a fantastic host and took in our large family group of 22 with ease.  It was so wonderful that we could all stay together in the land of the long white cloud!  Breakfast was delicious and so fun to be introduced to different foods that we ended up buying to take home with us. She was also excellent to take care of some gluten free needs we had in the group as well. Each room was stylish and unique and the house was wonderful. The animals were an absolute favorite of all the kids (and adults too for that manner).  Colleen was extremely helpful with all our questions, requests, advice on places to go and things to do.  We were delighted with our stay and enjoyed the incredible setting of the home, it was like an absolute dream come true  every time we drove up to it!
hotel_response:
Wow. Thank you Alex. We are still basking in the warmth that your wonderful family brought into our home. We will remember your visit always.
Regards,
Colleen and Clive

title: Great Time!
text: I stayed in the sunshine room with my buddy and his girlfriend. We enjoyed our stay very much, had a nice tour of the property and fed some of the animals, we were referred to a great brewery for drinks and dinner and had a wonderful breakfast by Colleen in the morning. Highly recommended!
hotel_response:
Thank you, James. May your life continue to be a great adventure.
Colleen

title: Amazing!
text: It was absolutely wonderful to stay there. Had a private bathroom, walk in closet, a dobbel bed and 2 single beds, ac and tv with Apple TV, all in the room we stayed in. Breakfest was fantastic every day and super friendly people. Great, big house on an amazing property. Would of stayed longer if it weren't for us having to continue travelling. Do highly recommend!
hotel_response: Joakim and his family were our first visitors from Norway and what excellent ambassadors they were.

title: Wonderful stay
text:
We really enjoyed our stay at the Rua Resort and were only sorry not to be able to stay longer.

Colleen is very friendly and we really enjoyed meeting and feeding her alpacas.

Our room could only be described as luxurious with beautiful views over the surrounding countryside. Breakfast was also delicious. 

We would highly recommend staying here.

title: Piece of Paradise
text: Colleen is an amazing host taking great care of her guests. Thank you so much for the fantastic stay we got. It was such a joy to be there and get the opportunity to pet the animals and see the truly beautiful views. We really recommend this place where you get treated so kindly.
hotel_response: Thank you Peter and Anni. It is not hard to be kind when we meet such nice and interesting folk like yourselves. You are now officially our two favourite people from Sweden!

title: Great Family Stay
text:
The negative first: this is out of town so you need a car to get around.  

The rest are all positives:

- you feel like you are staying with family, in the best possible sense. The friendly hosts are clearly opening up their home and, as a guest, it makes you feel very privileged 

- the rooms are comfortable/luxurious

- the hosts are active grandparents so there are toys and games for children

- the farm animals and space are a source of delight for children

- the vistas are a source of delight for the adults

This is NOT a typical "hotel experience".  This is a unique B&B experience, which your family will remember for a long time to come.

title: all well
text: Felt safe. There are alpacas and a goat, and some ponys on this 5 acre block. The setup is simply a very large house. Everyone has their own ensuite bathroom, but you share a large well, equipped kitchen, dining room and lounge. The family who runs it are also fluent in Japanese.
hotel_response: What a pleasing concept that our guests can feel safe. I have not heard this voiced before, but I realise that this is important. We are glad to have met Dave and Honey and we appreciate their comments.

title: Birthday weekend
text:
We found this great B&B on GrabOne and decided to stay here on our weekend in Hamilton. We were greeted by Colleen on our arrival and were showed two different rooms we could chose from. 

Once checked in, Colleen showed us around and informed us about some nice places to visit and dine in Hamilton.

When we got back after our first day's adventures, Colleen told us we could stay our second night in the luxury suite for no extra costs, since it was our birthdays.

Both rooms, the breakfasts and the whole experience was fantastic. 

The place is very quiet and picturesque. We felt very welcome and would definitely be coming back here again.

Thanks for making our birthdays special.

title: Very Pleasant Stay
text:
My husband and I stayed here for 2 nights during our NZ Honeymoon visit and had such a great experience! This was our first time ever staying at a BnB so we had no idea what to expect. We chose this location because it was the perfect distance between visiting Hobbiton and exploring in the Waitomo Caves, both an hour away. Colleen was very inviting into her home and we had a wonderful time chatting it up. The room was very clean and inviting, we slept so well on the comfortable bed and enjoyed the big bathroom. We really enjoyed spending time with the animals on the property and were able to feed some of the alpacas and ponies. Breakfast was included- delicious and more than enough to fill you up!

We are both very grateful for such a wonderful experience and would really like to suggest this to anyone else that would like a nice, low-key place to sleep.
hotel_response:
Hey Ashley and Aaron,
It was fun for us to have a young vibrant couple like yourselves in our home for a while. We are happy that you enjoyed our sweet animals and the comfortable bed. I like your expression, 'low-key'. That seems to denote the relaxed atmosphere that we hope our guests can enjoy.
Stay safe for the remainder of your travels. 
Kind regards,
Colleen and Clive

title: Great place and Great hosts
text: Very obliging hosts who went out their way to provide us accommodation at very short notice. The rooms were great and the views were outstanding  along with the lovely decor of the home and furnishings it made for a most pleasant stay. Breakfast was included and they seemed to be everything that one could want for breakfast including freshly squeezed juices.
hotel_response: Well, thank you for your kind response. It was our pleasure to have you stay.

title: Excellent Breakfast Service and Very Comfortable Stay
text:
The Rua Resort was a very lovely stay. The room me and my wife stayed in (the Kowhai Room) was very comfortable for us. The bathrooms are very nice, and the hosts very warm and welcoming. The breakfast service was absolutely wonderful. There are also some friendly alpacas and ponies to look at. 
Overall an enjoyable stay.
hotel_response: Why thank you Brandon. It was a pleasure to host your fine family. I shall pass on your compliments to the chef!

title: Mrs. Going

hotel_response: We would welcome this gracious family back at any time. Thank you for finding us!

title: Excellent to stay

Kind Regards, 
Colleen and family

title: Excellent stay - a most impressive family place loved it, fantastic location
text: Clive & Colleen are the best I thoroughly enjoyed my stay in their most comfortable, clean and spacious home; I travel a lot and this place has easily gone to the top of my favorite list. The stunning views from the balcony of my room was a wonderful bonus  - a help yourself breakfast bar provides all one needs to begin the day in a very well taken care of dining area, this home spotlessly clean and a pleasure to stay in, and I highly recommend a visit for family, business and friends also as I was a solo guest I felt secure and safe. The 5 acre garden is also glorious to look at with rescue alpacas, chicken and horses in the fields all well attended. Thank you to this lovely couple and family.

title: Wonderful Stay
text:
You will not be disappointed. Colleen and Clive are wonderful hosts. They were very friendly and made us feel welcome. Their home and  the setting are absolutely beautiful. Breakfast was delicious and very substantial.  They have provided their guests with everything one might possibly need and then some.
We stayed in the room with the ensuite bath. Lovely views from balconies both front and back. Very spacious with sofa and TV. We felt like we were in a villa in the Mediterranean.  Would definitely recommend this to out of town guests as well as locals who might want an enchanting getaway.
hotel_response: Thank you Terry for your kind words. We are happy that you were happy!

title: Beautiful rooms, food and hosts!
text: We only ever stay at Rua Resort when we come to Hamilton to visit the temple. Colleen and Clive are warm, delightful people that couldn't be more accommodating for our family's needs. We have stayed in a couple of the different rooms there and each one is tastefully decorated with luxurious and beautiful furnishings with everything we could possibly need in a room (including a relaxing atmosphere with a touch of class and sophistication). The bathrooms are my favourite - with large showers or bath, open spaces and mirrors - the shared bathroom is gigantic! Our privacy is respected but we also feel we can make it our place too during our stay. Colleen showed our 20 month old daughter to their expansive toy cupboard last time to help her feel welcome! It is so close to the beautiful LDS temple but then also close enough to supermarkets and Hamilton city to make it convenient to anywhere we may need or want to go. We love that it is a bit further out from the noise and bustle and our daughter loves the animals and open surroundings of the beautiful property. The breakfast in the morning is always delicious (one of my other favourite things about staying here) and last time I was treated to waffles with cream and berries! Why would you stay anywhere else?

title: Amazing & Relaxing Stay!
text:
we really enjoyed our stay, very welcoming hosts Colleen & Clive and their wonderful home was amazing...our daughter loved the farm animals. highly recommend.
close to Hamilton CBD, bridal veil falls is a must to explore and its just spectacular.

text:

title: Highly recommend, wonderful stay!!
text:
We have stayed here before as a couple which has always been lovely, this was a new experience bringing our children here too. They had a fantastic time helping feed the animals and collecting the eggs from the chickens (which we had the next morning for breakfast- delish). 
We took advantage of the large bath ensuite and had a relaxing soak in the evening. Waking up to such a beautiful setting was amazing! 
The owners are friendly and helpful, make a delicious yummy breakfast (lots of options for picky children!).
It's a unique b'n'b in a rural setting, with a 5 min drive to Temple View. Yes there are a few bugs around, and bird droppings here and there - thus is life on a farm, and I wouldn't expect anything else in such lush rural surroundings. 
Our room was spacious, clean and very luxurious compared to other b'n'bs we have stayed in. 
Would highly recommend to anyone, especially couples and families, looking for a unique getaway in beautiful relaxing surroundings. My kids keep asking when we can go back to the 'mansion on the farm', thanks Clive & Colleen!!

title: Fantastic experience!
text:
My family stayed at Rua resort for two nights and had an excellent resort experience. Our rooms were clean and comfortable with such a beautiful scenery of green hills and the mountain.
