hotel_response: Thank you Kind Sir. It is our distinct pleasure to meet you. Clive said tonight that you are one of the nicest gentleman he has met.

title: Thank goodness we didn't pay full price
text: Booked for a romantic getaway through a deal website, I think we payed around $180 which turned out to still be far too much. Dirty cluttered outside entrance way greeted us, then inside was around 30 pairs of shoes piled at the door even though we were the only guests there. We were shown around by a lady in her PJ's and the kitchen was absolutely filthy with a mountain of dishes (told they were breakfast dishes, but we checked in after 5pm..) the room hadn't been vacuumed and the bath had a heap of dead bugs in it. The room patios were really grubby and the furniture/outside of windows were covered in thick cobwebs, im not usually fussy but there was no was I was sitting out there. The hosts kids were so loud, we could hear them from the 3rd floor. The bed was comfortable at least. We didn't bother staying for breakfast and I wouldn't visit again unfortunately. It was a shame as my partner had been away for a month and I was excited to find this hidden "luxury" in the waikato but it was all a big let down and I think the owners should invest in a more experienced host to keep the place as good as the pictures suggest it used to be.
hotel_response:
Katie, 
It is a shame that you did not stay for breakfast. We make a very nice meal and enjoy warm conversation over breakfast. I am sorry that you were disappointed. Your comments are duly noticed and we will endeavour to take extra care on the things you mentioned. Forgive the semantics, but after nearly 3 decades of teaching English, I could not help but notice that there are a lot of words that you used however, that could be considered exaggerations? 
(a statement that represents something as better or worse than it really is)
' around 30 pairs of shoes '
' kitchen was absolutely filthy '
' a heap of dead bugs '
' furniture/windows covered with thick cobwebs '
I would contest these descriptions. 30 pairs of shoes highly unlikely - 6 or 7 pairs more likely on that day counting the number of guests.
I know that you did not enter the kitchen. You viewed it from the dining area. I think you would need to get up close to determine that a kitchen was 'absolutely filthy'. 
We had had a full house for breakfast and there were some dishes remaining that were waiting their turn to go through the dishwasher. After the guests leave each day we start a cycle then get busy with the rooms, which, by the way, we never fail to vacuum. 
Re the bugs, I think you refer to those horrid little teeny tiny sandflies that are a daily issue at present. I am hoping this is seasonal and that they will stop coming soon. As we clean each day, even in one of the 5 bathrooms that have not been used, there is always between 2-6 of the little blighters in the bottom of the baths. 'A heap' is a big stretch. Having lived outside of NZ for most of the last 25 years, I have forgotten what a hassle spiders are in the countryside. I now go around the outside of the house with a broom, reaching all the windows I can to wipe away cobwebs from the very places I wiped them away the day before. I am guessing you are a city girl and do not have to deal with the large volumes of creatures 'looking for a home' on a daily basis. There sure are a lot of windows and nooks and crannies for such creatures in a 560 square meter home. I choose not to use insecticides out of concern for their side effects. Your comments have prompted me to seek out some natural resource to help combat the spiders, as to be sure, the broom and the vacuum are not 100% foolproof methods.
Lastly, at our age, we do not have noisy kids, but to be sure, there were some happy little children of guests that day who were playing inside at some point on the floor below. ( By the way - you mentioned that you were the only guests - did you not notice the full dining room the next morning? ) This can be a problem from time to time. It is not much fun listening to other people's children at play when you want some quiet time. We normally make a special effort to have the parents keep them quiet come the evening. Most of our adult guests spend their time out to dinner or at some attraction. I am sorry I did not realize their noise disturbed you.

title: Owners need to take heed of paying customer's feedback
text:
I booked this place through a Treatme or Grabone deal and it was for a promised night away with hubby and it was on the way for his superdrive at Hamptons Down.  I emailed Rua Resort and Chrissy responded confirming our booking but twice I asked in two separate emails for the check-in time and breakfast menu as breakfast was part of the deal. While she double checked the date we wanted and confirmed it was available, she never actually answered  the two questions. 
On arrival at 3pm as most places check-in is 2pm, after walking up the messy front steps and patio, which had brooms sitting around, I could hear children inside and after knocking on the door was greeted by a suprised looking couple, Chrissy in pyjamas folding sheets. She said they had a previous party of 76 the night before and had a late night. I asked what the check-in time and she said " 4pm its on the website " and before I got to say that she never responded to that question in my 2 emails her husband said we could go for a drive for an hour or were welcome to go up to the room but if we could keep activities to a minimum for an hour. (seriously?)  I went down to get my husband out of the car and I could see he wasn't impressed and that was just from what he had seen of the outside.  We went inside (and as read in other reviews, the current theme of Chrissy disappearing happened also) so the husband showed us to the room (I booked the most expensive Rua Suite because I wanted a separate private room with the luxury spa bath). On first viewing it looked great and when he left he offered to make us coffee soon unless we wanted one now and it wasn't until he left I realised there were no tea/coffee making facilities in the room!? I needed a tissue and could I find one? At what is normally $375 per night I'd expect basic items such as a box of tissues and a basic thing like tea/coffee making facilities at hand!  There were no toiletries for the spa bath (which again...you would expect).  There was a tile in the bathroom wall that had fallen down and you could see the piping behind. The shower door I thought was frosted until you noticed it was clearer towards the top and that is just unacceptable. There was a packed of children's lollies under the tv cabinet.  After hubby frustratingly worked out the tv to get poor quality and looking at the surrounds of the building which is obviously in need of some good repair and maintenance - we chose to leave.  Nobody noticed us leave.  We then looked at other accommodation in Hamilton and chose Camelot - fantastic!  But we ended up paying extra of course and my husband sent an email to Rua Resort on our return home.  He was so disappointed that I didn't get what I had expected and felt I deserved so much more for my night away.  They didn't even bother to respond.  How rude is that and what poor business practice.  So, haven given Rua Resort ample time in which to have responded...I have no choice but to put my review out.  The  worst thing is that my husband put in his email that we are not expecting a refund but would rather see this money go towards the obvious maintenance issues and what we brought up as well.  Very poor that we never even had a response from them.

People work hard to get ahead and these days for most people, just to survive!! So to be able to spend some of your hard earned money on a bit of luxury = Rua Resort certainly fell far short of what they claim to be - Hamilton's luxurious resort.  A lot of people in Rotorua  will certainly never stay at this place now.
In fact on walking up to the front door, the first concrete step was loose and as my weight went on one side, the other side lifted. I am sure there are more health and safety issues to be found. I would expect that is a very important issue for businesses such as this.
To have taken our booking (for a couple for one night) after such a busy night before, maybe choosing to put quality service before taking numerous bookings that you obviously couldn't handle would be a wiser choice for business people.
Rua Resort is a let down to other quality well run B & B businesses.
Extremely disappointed and I am someone who is pretty hard to disappoint.
My next step from here is to advise the site that I bought the voucher from.  Don't want fellow deal buyers to fall into the same trap...thinking they are getting a great deal for some luxury.  We ended up paying less than the deal we got...for much better service in the lovely well done fully equipped (with huge spa bath) room at Camelot in Hamilton city run by a young couple who certainly have their customer service and customer expectations in the right priority.

title: Great stay
text: We arrived in the evening and were greeted warmly by the host. We booked through Air B&B and had a seamless check in. The rooms were clean and comfortable. The host was full of great information about the area and gave us a great recommendation for dinner. The location is great if you are in the area exploring Hobbiton and the Glow Worm Caves (about 50 min to each)

title: Better than bad reviews
text:
I had booked at stay at Rua Resort for the end of June, as I had business in Hamilton. I booked through Air BnB. I then read reviews of the place on Trip Advisor and got worried. I'll just say that my experience of the stay and Christy, the host, was completely opposite of the negative reviews below. The home is nice and clean, the views of the NZ pastureland are fantastic, and Christy was personable, friendly, and fun to be with and talk to. She really made the stay great, and I can't say that enough.

There probably was a problem experienced by the one party below, but platforms like trip advisor and other review sites give people with a gripe a chance to harm other people's livelihoods with gravity undue most situations, as I feel happened here. 

I am glad we kept our reservation here, and we will stay here again the next time I have business in the area.

title: A great Experience.  AWESOME VIEW.
text:
I stayed here for a week at the beginning of May.  My room was immaculately made, and comfortable.   Had a great week of sleep, and the bonus of waking up to the view in the morning.

You leave your shoes off at the door, which is a Japanese custom about leaving outside energy outside.  Christy (the host) is very personable and also knowledgeable about Japanese culture.  Very accommodating about breakfast times.

I highly recommend this to friends and family.

title: AWESOME VIEW
text:
My family and some friends whom we invited, stayed over for two nights at the resort. Except for some hiccups we with the initial bookings, the experience was really awesome!!
The view is just wonderful... I can not help but share the pics of the beautiful sight which greets you in the morning upon waking up. It was just fantastic.
The staff are very friendly. Christie herself  is very much accommodating. She even shared us the history of the place. 
Truly, one of the best experiences we had in all of our family holidays.
Highly recommended!!

title: Dissapointing
text:
We stayed here last night on a half price special and am glad not to have paid full price. Good stuff first: friendly (if inept) staff, lovely furnishings including a comfy bed and gorgeous setting. 
Niggles: 
* gaggle of (non paying) girls entertaining themselves in lounge area and taking up limited car parking. They had started to arrive at 2.30 when we dropped off our bags and were still here when we returned at 6pm.
* having to take our shoes off at the door. As it was a full house looked more like the entrance to a backpackers than a luxury resort
* broken and decrepit lawn furniture, this is what you see when you first arrive
* having to deal with the sizeable spider living around around the smoke detector right above our bed. We were able to remove it with the fly swat which had been left/provided (which you will need as we had 5-6 flies for company). The ants on the deck got to enjoy the spider anyway.
* no soap or personal hand towels provided (a must when sharing bathroom facilities - the hand towel was soaked by the morning
Big No No: the Karaka room has a lovely deck with spectacular views but this was marred by the amount of bird poo, feathers, cobwebs and dust on it, even the table where I had told them we were going to eat that night.
All in all, a not so luxury experience, the proprietors need to lift their game, particularly around customer service.

title: Disappointed
text: We previously had a good experience at Rua Resort, but this time we were very disappointed. Our booking was confirmed in an email, however upon arrival it was changed. We were in no mood to argue the point, so we accepted the situation only because there was no where else to stay.

title: Worst Service Ever!
text: What a disappointment! They screw up twice with my bookings. When I first booked through the phone, first I was told there's rooms available. Rang them again to make deposit payment and was told the bookings I made isn't in their system now it's already fully booked. They rang me back and said there's availability so I made bookings for 5 bedrooms and paid deposit a month in advance. We all turn up at the resort on the day that I booked and (Christy)person in-charge wasn't professional at all said she couldn't find the bookings she made and the resort was fully booked. She's the one that book me in and she didn't handle it well. She sent her husband Jack who was so happened to be visiting to deal with the situation. Such a shame! It was Easter Holiday and nothing was available. Trip was a disaster as it was meant for my babyshower and I was due next month. It wasn't about the money even though money was refunded because there were 2 pregnant women and 2 kids in the group. We had no where to go. I had the worst experience with Rua Resort. PLEASE DO NOT STAY HERE!!
hotel_response:
My daughter Christy was the in-house manager during this time, while we were living overseas. My husband and I recently returned to NZ and found Christy desperate to leave the hotel. Following your visit, she would jump with fear each time the phone rang or the doorbell sounded. Your actions traumatized her to the point of her being diagnosed with PTSD ( Post Traumatic Stress Disorder ). Your screaming and threats to her had her 6 and 8 year old daughters crying and distraught in the next room. They tell me that they were afraid for their mother. Fortunately their father Jay (not Jack) was visiting and though it was not his place, he had to come to the door and hand you $900 in cash in order to have you leave. He had brought that money from the US to buy a car for the family. I hope that anyone reading this will have a balanced view as they read the quotes below by you. I have witnesses to what you said, including the guests who were in the house. You yelled at them to leave as you stated that you had more of a right to be there than them. Fortunately, they later provided comfort to Christy throughout their stay. And I quote:
You will never be able to have Chinese people stay here again.
I am a famous Chinese travel blogger with 100,000 followers. 
I will go on Trip Adviser and I will ruin you.
I will have my friends all write bad reviews about your place.
You are criminals. I will call the police right now. I will sue you through my lawyers.
You won't know how much damage I can do.
You might think I am nothing now, but wait and see what I damage I can do.
unquote
As owners we have never aggressively advertised. Most of our guests are repeaters and in fact we have a lot of wonderful Chinese people amongst them. We have two big guest books of glowing reviews, but nobody sees them. I heard about your vindictive action just days ago and so I went on this site for the first time. I read the rules extensively and this is clearly a case of blackmail. I have sent reports to the site managers and I trust that you and your friend's reports will be taken down soon. 
To be sure, the computer appeared to have a glitch around that period which may have resulted in some confusion with the booking. Regardless, despite Christy's best and sincere efforts to take care of you and your group, your actions were outrageous and calculated. You walked away with a nice bundle of cash. Jay produced that in order to have you leave so as to protect his children and out of concern for Christy and for the nice guests who were subjected to your screaming and demands for them to vacate the rooms to accommodate you and your group. Christy did all she could to help you. She offered for you to come back in the future at any time of your choosing for four nights instead of two, free of charge. She found some rooms at another place for the weekend, but you tried to make her pay for the most expensive hotel in Hamilton. As another alternative, she also offered to make up sofa beds in the media room, the office and the library. These are comfortable beds which we prepare for large groups from time to time. You told her to go ahead and do that and that you would come back, but you did not return. Thank goodness.

title: Just… wow 😳
text:
Absolutely shocked at just how bad this accomodation was… to the point all I could do was laugh until I almost cried.
ONE towel in a room that sleeps
5ppl, no milk in the fridge, something in the toilet when we arrived, poorly repaired holes in all doors, bed in the lounge with nowhere comfy to sit and honestly, just rugged asf (and I’m the least fussy person I know about where I stay).
I actually can’t even express how bad it is… AND it’s $200 per night 🤣

title: Do not recommend
text: Extremely rude staff, made me and my partner feel unwelcome the moment we entered the premises. Also noticed one of the workers fishing some ‘stuff’ out of the pool, so don’t even want to imagine what that was - do not recommend.

title: Tired and in need of some investment
text:
We went as a group of two families with three children 5 and under. We camped in tents at the hot pools. The facilities are looking tired and in need of some investment. The hot pools were great but in the three days we were there we didn’t get to use the slides which was part of the reason we stayed here.

The initial only bathrooms we found were outside, full of cobwebs and freezing. Thankfully a member of staff pointed me in the direction of another shower and toilets upstairs next to a tv room that I would never otherwise have found.

The owners were friendly but must be well past the age of retirement. I would stay again but would hope that they spend some money on the place.

title: Waingaro Sewer Pools
text:
Went to these hot pools after a day of dirt biking.  How they are open is beyond me? We were charged $33 for an adult and 2 children.  I see now why they take the money at the gate, as if you saw the state of the place you would not go in! 
The main pool was luke warm, the hydro slides were closed and there was particles floating in the hottest pool.  My 14 yr old got out after 10 minutes as found himself gagging at the floating skin in the pool.  He then wanted a shower to wash the place away, to find they were freezing.  He still had a shower as he was desperate to feel clean. The changing rooms were very old and the accommodation looked disgusting.
Do Not Go Near the Place.....

title: Very poor value for money
text: We went yesterday on our way to Raglan. We asked for admission for one adult and two children. We were charged $33. The 'slides', there was only one, would have cost $6 extra each. Normally it should cost $13 for an adult and $7 for a child. My husband didn't swim and still was charged $13 for 'use of the facilities' when we questioned the price, the owners suddenly seemed to lose their command of the English language and said they should have charged us for our extra child. We actually had initially asked for pool entry for 1 adult and 2 kids, so perhaps they had some problems with listening too. Our local pool charges $4 for our kids hydroslides, and they are also open for longer periods of time. Disappointed.

title: Break away from the city
text: Absolutely loved this place. The flat we rented was situated straight across from the thermal resort. Bit run down but we weren't their to be living luxuriously. My boys enjoyed the outdoors and swimming. There is also a pub on site for those who like to unwind and camping. If you're not fussy this place is a great day or night away

title: a great slice of provincial nz served up with hearts of gold
text: We took our family here as a winter base to explore the area.  It is a great slice of provinical nz.  We were able to explore the area by day - and play in the hot pools in the afternoons and after dinner.  if you are looking for flash or a wet and wild gold coast experience - a motel with minimalism design, huge tv and sky - this is 100% not it.  But if you are after a genuine provincial nz experience with a great family feel - a bit shabby but warm, family friendly, and heart of gold staff - this has it in bucketloads.  It was a great place for a winter break.  There are no shops in the vicinity - so come with food and snacks (although the pools have a few bits and pieces in their shop).  Entrance to the pools is free if you stay in the motel.  The stars at night as you lie in the hot pools breathing steam in the feezing cold night air simply cannot be beaten.

title: breath of fresh air
text:
Previously booked a self-contained 1bdrm motel, on arrival they gave us a 2bdrm unit (kwei) 

Unit was spacious, clean, tidy, fresh bed linen & lots of bath towels. Double bed in 1 room, 2 singles in other. C/w small kitchen, microwave, fridge & stove, private ensuite. BBQ area outside motel, located in a quiet area.

There are other accommodations available at the Hot Pools tourist flats, happy campers area etc

Motel unit across the road to Waingaro Hot Pools excellent price for motel includes free entry to pools on arrival & departure day. Extra cost for bumper boats, slides & spa. Toilet/shower facilities onsite

title: Wonderful home away from home!
text: This was the second time we have stayed and can not say enough about it. The accommodation is lovely - exceptionally clean and very comfortable. Renata and Dave are wonderful hosts and our breakfast was delicious.
hotel_response: Thank you for your lovely review and words. We thoroughly enjoyed meeting up with you both again. Best wishes Renata and Dave

title: Perfection!
text:
Cambridge is a lovely town and it is also fortunate to have such a nice BnB run by a lovely couple.    

Situated within walking distance of the centre of Cambridge with its great restaurants, Grosvenor House was a fitting final stay on our latest New Zealand adventure.

So quiet, so,comfortable, so clean; there was nothing to fault.    The breakfasts were great, cereal or cooked, we had both! 

Renata and David were lovely hosts, so friendly and welcoming.   We were sorry to leave!
hotel_response:
It was so lovely to meet and host you both. Thank you for your kind words 
Best wishes Renata and Dave

title: Beautiful short stay in Cambridge!
text:
We were warmly welcomed and felt welcome from the beginning. The whole house as well as our room were modern, spotlessly clean and very well appointed – there was really nothing missing for a pleasant short stay in Cambridge. The location is excellent: just a few minutes from the center and many restaurants.

The host was extremely friendly, accommodating and always open to questions. The breakfast he prepared for us and the other guests was excellent and left nothing to be desired. He also gave us great excursion recommendations for the area, which have enriched our stay even more.

An absolute insider tip for anyone looking for cosy, modern and centrally located accommodation in Cambridge. We would definitely come back!
hotel_response: Herzlichen Dank fuer die Review.  Es freute uns Sie kennen zu lernen und bei uns Willkommen zu heissen. Wir wuenschen noch einen schoenen Urlaub und gute Heimreise Renata und Dave

title: Great way to finish our 3 weeks in NZ
text: Everything was great especially: the warn welcome, the homemade home cooked breakfast, the quality of the furniture & fittings, notably the bathroom & bed. A craft beer pub/restaurant and other good restaurants a pleasant 10 to 15 minutes walk

title: Highly Recommended
text:
This is everything a good B and B should be and David and Renata are clearly very experienced hosts, who enjoy having guests to stay in their very comfortable home. Our room had everything we needed with access to the family fridge for milk, and a most comfortable bed. The breakfast selection was wonderful, the home made preserves being a highlight. The property is situated just out of the main town, within easy walking distance, so once there you don't need a car to access restaurants etc.
Highly recommended!

title: An exceptional experience !
text:
An amazingly good B&B.
It is difficult to find fault with anything. Exceptionally warm welcome, a beautiful room with a very confortable bed. We were even offerred a full cooked breakfast plus cerreals, toast and a wide range of home-made preserves.
Very highly recommended !

title: A Wonderful surprising find
text: Booked by chance not knowing the Accommodation or area, but it turned out to be Amazing accommodation and area of New Zealand. The owners gave us a very warm welcome and were very helpful  and friendly with great advice on where to go and what we could see. The accommodation was in an ideal position with easy access to be able to walk into town.

title: A hidden gem in Cambridge.
text:
Renata and David make you feel at home and provide an amazingly warm experience. Water pressure in the ensuite is amazing! Too often we stay in hotels/B&Bs with dismal shower pressure which makes your experience unsatisfactory but not at   Grosvenor House! 
David also cooks an excellent breakfast.

title: Very enjoyable visit
text: Lovely stay.  Very nice facilities, great hospitality, central location - and, oh, those breakfasts!  Home-made everything, and great coffee to start the day.  Room was very nice, quiet and private, and very comfortable.

title: Perfect
text: Great stay with Renata & David being the perfect hosts. Lovely Breakfast couldn’t want for more. Very comfy bed in nicely appointed ensuite room. Very easy access and completely private. We will return.

title: Great B&B
text:
Very comfortable B&B with a great breakfast. We only stayed one night, but enjoyed a good meal in the town on the hosts recommendation. 
Also a very convenient place to stay when visiting Hobbiton, just 1/2 hour away by car.
Thanks Dave and Renata.

title: High quality experience
text: Home from home! Excellent accommodation with a fantastic breakfast. Dave and Renata take pride in providing a great service. Easy walk into town means you can leave the car and have a few scoops.  Thanks guys we'll be back when next in Cambridge
hotel_response: Thank you both for staying with us and your kind review. We enjoyed meeting and hosting you both. Best wishes for your exciting plans. Renata and Dave

title: Immaculate B&B
text: David and Renata are charming hosts, They provide a spotless and comfortable accommodation with a delicious breakfast in tune with dietary needs. Easy location close to the centre with on site parking. Highly recommended

title: Excellent B&B
text: Excellent room, lovely bathroom and shower, nice breakfast and very nice and helpful owners. It's walking distance to the town centre and there is a 4 Square mini market nearby. We do recommend a stay here..

title: A lovely modern B&B in a charming town
text:
Renata and David run a lovely B & B in a quiet street of Cambridge within easy walking distance to lake and town centre. We had the deluxe room which was lovely, well appointed very clean and quiet. Nice shower 👍
We felt at home and enjoyed chatting and tips they shared for touring the area.

title: Great accommodation in Cambridge
text:
This B&B provides very high standard quality ensuite rooms. The owners share the kitchen dining, outdoor lounging space and will accommodate guests needs. They also provide a very good breakfast. The location is walkable distance from the large reserve containing Lake  Te Ko Utu and is a short (approx. -15 minutes) walk into the Cambridge township. We stayed in the front room, there was plenty of on site parking.
Would recommend.

title: Centrally located, excellent facilities, comfort and friendly, attentive hosts.
text: We appreciated the attention to detail and thoughtfulness that went into creating a B&B that blends a high degree of comfort with hosts who are  friendly, helpful and very generous with preserves and great breakfasts. We will certainly stay here again.
hotel_response:
Thank you Richard and Joy for your great review and it was a pleasure having you stay with us.
Look forward to catching up with you sometime soon.

title: Lovely Stay
text: The room was very clean and modern with a very comfortable bed. Particularly liked the bathroom and the shower which had good water pressure. Dave was such a pleasant person and we enjoyed chatting with him. Love Harley his dog and the garden. Excellent value for money and would stay again.
hotel_response:
Thank you Helen for your very nice comments. Was lovely having you stay with us and we look forward to seeing you again sometime.
David and Renata

title: Friendly and inviting
text:
My sister and I enjoyed one night here and were well taken care of. 
Dave cooked and served us a breakfast fit for a queen. Harley the dog and Caesar the cat were friendly too. 
Our room had heating fortunately as the beds  did not have electric blankets, which I am used to and I was cold after an evening out in town.
I also like a soft pillow (must be a softie) so I found the pillows a little firm. 
There was a TV in our room and the bathroom was sparkling, like new. 
We were very happy staying there.

title: Very good value for money. Very high standards of comfort and amenities.
text:
The premises were attractive and comfortable, the bed particularly so. The full breakfast was very good and nicely presented; just as many good b&bs used to provide.
The hosts were friendly and helpful. We enjoyed our stay very much and highly recommend Grosvenor House as a place to stay.
hotel_response: Thank you for staying with us. We take pride in presenting a clean and comfortable B&B, as well as sourcing local produce and making thinks ourselves. We like it when guests tell us that they felt comfortable. Warm wishes

title: Fantastic place to stay
text:
Wonderful hosts, lovely house and a great central location, fantastic cooked breakfast.  The rooms were very comfortable and private
We highly recommend Grosvenor House and would certainly stay there again
hotel_response: Aww thank you Trish, we loved meeting and hosting you both. Warm wishes Renata and Dave

title: Immaculate Home in Cabridge
text:
Grosvenor House is an immaculate home in lovely Cambridge. Renata and Dave are fantastic hosts, nothing was too much trouble. We had a very high standard room with on-suite. Dave served us a cooked breakfast each morning while Renata made coffee from her amazing coffee machine .
We had off road parking and was able to put our bikes in their garage.
We walked into Cambridge township for dinner and is an ideal location to cycle to Karapiro or other tracks. We had a very nice 3 night stay.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your wonderful review. We absolutely enjoyed meeting and hosting you and are very pleased you managed to travel before the latest Covid scare. All the very best until we meet again Renata and David

title: Lovely place to stay
text: Had one night in Cambridge, the choices of accommodation were many, but we chose Grosvenor BnB, and weren’t disappointed, it was lovely, modern and clean, with high quality amenities. Our host was very courteous, thanks for a nice stay.

title: Gorgeous B&B
text: Our room was very comfortable room with every need catered for. The house is immaculate and we had a lovely breakfast. The hosts were very welcoming and helpful. We loved the  location too, only minutes from town.
hotel_response: Thank you very much. I enjoyed meeting you and wish you all the best with your plans. Renata

title: Lovely B&B with pleasant hosts
text:
Really enjoyed our two night stay here with Dave and Renata - very friendly people and they made us feel right at home.  Dave’s breakfasts were great, and I couldn’t get over the selection of six home made jams which were offered - I tried them all!  Breakfast was served on the deck one morning and inside the next as the temperature was a bit cooler - nice to have the choice.
Our room was lovely, immaculate with a lovely ensuite and a hairdryer with grunt, unlike so many places. We particularly liked the baggage stand, much better than trying to unpack on the floor or messing up the bed with grubby bags. 
We would definitely recommend Grosvenor House and will stay there again should we return to Cambridge.

title: Fantastic over nighter
text:
Renata and David couldnt have done a better job at welcoming us to their gorgeous B&B.
A warm welcome, beautiful rooms with eco shower products and being greeted in the morning to an outstanding breakfast was just what the doctor ordered.

A must stay for friends or couples looking for a quiet, european style getaway.

Cambridge is a gorgeous town and great location if you're heading to the field days or concery at Mystery Creek
hotel_response: We very much enjoyed meeting and hosting you. The chats over breakfast are very enjoyable and we love hearing about our guests lives and adventures. You have a nice website. All the best until we meet again.

title: Masterclass in hospitality!
text:
We spent 2 nights at Grosvenor House on our visit from the UK and can wholeheartedly endorse all the positive comments made by other guests - this place is exceptional! 
Renata and Dave offer a masterclass in hospitality - everything you need is available and offered with great warmth and charm. 
Situated in pretty Cambridge with lovely places to see, good shopping, cafes and restaurants - it’s a great base for Hobbiton too. 
It was exceptionally hard to wrench ourselves away having been so spoilt! Huge thanks to the delightful Renata & Dave!
hotel_response: Thank you for your wonderful review. We thoroughly enjoyed meeting and hosting you. Wishing you a wonderful time in New Zealand

title: Lovely place to stay
text:
If you're English like me, the term B&B conjures up all sorts of indifferent memories. If that is the case, make sure you stay at Grosvenor House to banish them! 

It's a lovely place to stay, quiet, close to the town center, nicely decorated and our room was clean to a standard that was better than some 4 star hotels I've stayed in. Ensuite was great, and tea and coffee making facilities a bonus.

Our host David was in fact the perfect host, and Caesar the cat an amusing and talkative visitor. Breakfast really hit the spot, with an excellent selection of home made preserves that were bang on.

Overall, a great place to stay.
hotel_response:
Thank you so much for your kind review and we are pleased to hear you enjoyed your stay and felt comfortable. 
Best wishes
Grosvenor House B&B

title: Well appointed
text: Excellent and well appointed accommodation with a warm and friendly host. Clean and modern.  Breakfast was great. It was a welcome bit of luxury after touring in our campervan. We thoroughly recommend it.
hotel_response:
Thanks again for staying with us Jeremy and Phillipa and thank you for your kind review. We look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit to New Zealand. Best wishes for the rest of your travels.
Dave and Renata

title: It’s all true!
text: When reading all the wonderful reviews for this B&B, it’s absolutely all true. Such a welcoming couple, great accommodations, yummy breakfast and they even helped us plan our time in Auckland - where we were headed to next.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your kind review. It gives us great pleasure to assist our guests in having a great experience, not only with us, but in our beautiful country. We hope to meet again

title: Perfect B & B.
text: Modern and perfectly equipped accomodation, Absolute cleanliness. Very quiet. Lovely people, very kind and helpful. Good breakfast. Nice terrace. Location near city center,  ideal for shopping or dining out. We will be happy to be back again. Even visiting nearby Hamilton you can stay in this B & B as well.
hotel_response:
It was an absolute pleasure hosting and meeting you both, thank you for your kind review. We look forward to our your next stay with us and wish you all the best.

Warm wishes
Renata and David

title: Beautiful B&B
text: Renata and David were lovely hosts and their home was beautiful. We had a twin room and had coffee and tea making facilities. The en-suite bathroom and huge shower was a real luxury.  We didn’t want for anything and breakfast was amazing, with so much choice, including David’s super cooked breakfast, Renata’s home made jams, fruit, toast. We would definitely recommend staying here while visiting Hobbiton and the local area, all are close by. There was also road parking, which was a real bonus.
hotel_response:
Thank you so much for your lovely and kind review and words. We endeavor to make people feel at home and it is very nice when we hear we have manage to do this.

Warm wishes and kind regards

Renata and David

title: Perfect home away from home
text:
Previously we have  only stayed at motels, we didn't know what to expect from a B&B.
Grosvenor House was wonderful, we were greeted by hosts  Renata and David, who warmly invited us inside.
The bedroom was perfect , lovely mattress  and pillows and the ensuite was very beautiful and practical. 
Breakfast was our choice from toast , cereal, or hot breakfast,  by the way there IS vegemite for us Aussies.
Great stay and we will stop there next time we trip over to NZ.
Thanks 
Karen and Peter
hotel_response: Thank you Karen and Peter, we thoroughly enjoyed meeting and hosting. Hopefully we will meet again in the not too distant future. Warm wishes Renata and Dave

title: T. Routhan
text: Grosvenor B & B is a very comfortable place to stay, very tidy, The hosts were very welcoming, the cooked breakfast was great my eggs were perfect. Nothing was a problem, would recommend staying there.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for choosing to stay with us. It was a great pleasure meeting and hosting you. We hope to see you again sometime in the future. Best wishes Renata and Dave

title: Lovely B&B with perfect hosts
text: We stayed here in late March on route between our Waitomo cave visit and returning to Auckland.  The property was easy to find and had off road parking. On arrival we received a very friendly welcome from David and Renata and were shown to our room. The property has been very tastefully decorated and our room had a very comfortable large bed, tea and coffee making facilities and TV, with our own en suite bathroom with toiletries provide. There is also a small lounge area and outside patio area for guest sole use and free wifi throughout the property. The property is situated within a five to ten minute walk of many local restaurants. Breakfast in the morning was excellent with cereal, toast, homemade preserves and David putting together an excellent cooked breakfast. It was unfortunate that we were only there one night as we felt very comfortable in the property. I would definitely recommend staying here.
hotel_response: Dear Peter, Thank you very much for your kind words. We enjoyed meeting you, albeit briefly. It is always our aim to make our guests feel welcome and at home, and it is nice to hear we succeeded. Sending you warm wishes from wintry Cambride Renata and Dave

title: Lovely hosts, beautiful rooms. I would be happy to recomend place this to anyone!
text: David and Renata were lovely hosts and could not have been more helpful. The rooms are beautifully furnished. The beds were extremely comfortable and the place was spotless. I would be happy to recommend place this to anyone!
hotel_response: It was lovely meeting and hosting you. We look forward to meeting again one day. Warm wishes Renata and Dave

title: Great B&B
text: Great hosts in Dave and Renata.  The breakfast provided was top-notch.  Her hot-cross buns were delicious! The room was comfy, had our own private bathroom and the wifi was outstanding.  Renata was flexible in our check-in.  We'd definitely stay with them again.
hotel_response: Thank you Cecile, it was nice meeting you and your son. I hope you both had safe journeys back to your destinations. Warm wishes Renata and David

title: Really comfy B & B with perfect hosts
text: Grosvenor House is a newly built home and is beautifully fitted out. It was clean and comfortable with a lovely breakfast. We booked last minute at the Tourist Information office but that was no problem. David and Renata were friendly and helped us to find a nice restaurant for the evening.
hotel_response: It was wonderful meeting you. Happy Easter and warm wishes Renata and David

title: Overnight stay
text: The room was lovely and comfortable . There is a separate lounge room available and patio area. David and Renata were very friendly and helpful. Breakfast was yummy and there was lots of choices. Restaurants are only a 2 min drive
hotel_response:
Thank you for choosing to stay with us. It was nice meeting and hosting you and we are glad you felt comfortable.
Warm wishes Renata and David

title: Superb welcome and great value
text: Stay here this is a gem. The house is beautiful and you have full access to a shaded patio. Beds are comfortable and breakfast is divine. Muesli was excellent and home made. Jams and preserves were also homemade. Coffee was great. Eggs for excellent. You get to picture breakfast was superb. The owners were helpful and friendly. Stay here it's great.
hotel_response:
Thank you very much for your wonderful feedback. We enjoyed meeting and hosting you very much.
Warm wishes
Renata and David

title: Truly a home away from home!
text: The hosts Renata and David truly made Grosvenor House feel like a "home away from home" for my son and I. Their house was immaculate but yet we were made to feel comfortable and were encouraged to use the open areas and their beautiful patio to relax after a day of hiking or exploring.  Their beds were the most comfortable of those we slept on during our 2 week NZ trip and the breakfast served was both substantial and well prepared.  The town of Cambridge is small, relaxed, yet had everything a traveler needs. This B& B is centrally located to Hobbiton, blackwater caving, bird sanctuaries, and hikes and the hosts were knowledgeable about travel times and recommended tours. We had a wonderful stay.
hotel_response:
Thank you sooo much for your nice review. We are glad you enjoyed your stay with us and in Cambridge. We look forward to meeting you again sometime in the future, hopefully you can bring your wife along. 
Warm wishes
Renata and Dave

title: Arrogant and greedy owner
text:
I booked two rooms to stay in August 2017 at this place. We had one 12-year-old child with us. I didn’t know that they don't allow children at their place. But when we arrived there, they were so rude and impolite. Lady of the property shouted on us when we were standing in their house. We end up going out and stayed that night at another place. After all that,  they charged our credit card for stay,  which we didn't.
My advice to all international visitor to avoid this place and to meet this kind of  rude and greedy owner.
hotel_response:
When these people arrived there were 5 people in their party, one of them being a child. It CLEARLY states in our terms and conditions that we do not cater for children (adults only). It also CLEARLY states that we cannot cater for more than 2 people per room. We tried to explain this to them but they were not prepared to listen. We then offered them 3 suggestions for alternative accommodation in Cambridge where children are catered for. They had booked 2 nights with us and we only charged them for one night and not for 2. At no point in time were we impolite or shouted at them. It seems very unusual to post a review on TripAdvisor 5 months after the booking. A review they posted on the original booking site has been removed. It was deemed unfair and inappropriate as there was no fault on our part.
We would like to invite anyone who reads the above review to scroll down and read our other reviews from very happy and satisfied guests, who adhered to our very simple conditions to stay.

title: Fantastic
text: Central, great hospitality. Very friendly and great rooms. I would highly recommend to other guests who want to stay in central Cambridge. David was a great host who provided a nice breakfast and coffee in the morning.
hotel_response:
We are glad to hear you enjoyed your stay with us and felt comfortable. Thank you for your nice review.
Renata and David

title: Fantastic B&B - a real home from home
text: David and Renata are fantastic hosts, nothing is too much trouble. They made us feel so welcome and part of the family. We could not have expected better. Their home is immaculate, it is absolutely spotlessly clean. Our room was perfect, fantastic bath and shower - bed was so comfortable that we did not want to get out of it. Air conditioning and very well appointed. The al-fresco breakfast was lovely, superb. Tasty bacon and a wide selection of home made conserves and other produce. All made by Renata clearly with a lot of love. Gluten free items as well. We cannot praise them highly enough for the wonderful 4 night say and we would HIGHLY recommend this B&B to anyone. It is just a very short walk into town and it's ideal as it is by a large lake, lovely friendly town with great coffee shops and eateries. We didn't want to leave. And boy have we come down to earth with the dump of an apartment we have rented through AirB&B in Auckland.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your review, we are very glad to hear you felt comfortable in our home and enjoyed your stay. On our part we got great pleasure from hosting you and getting to know you a little bit. We hope you had a safe return journey. Hopefully we will meet again. Best wishes Renata and Dave

title: Pristine accommodation run by wonderful hosts
text:
David and Renata have created a beautiful, contemporary B&B that oozes style and comfort. 

My daughter and I stayed here at a particularly difficult time, we were visiting for a family funeral and David & Renata created a warm welcoming stay for us with friendly conversation and accommodation that was perfect for our needs.

We chose to stay in a room with two twin beds. The linen was crisp, the beds comfortable, the bathroom was immaculately clean and provisioned. 

Breakfast was divine. 

I couldn't recommend this B&B more highly or David and Renata as hosts.
hotel_response: Thank you very much for choosing to stay with us. We very much enjoyed meeting you despite the sad circumstances surrounding your visit. It would be lovely to meet up with you both again and carry on our wonderful chats. Wishing you a peaceful festive season.

title: Clean, modern & friendly B&B in great location
text: Very clean, modern and friendly B&B only a short walk from the shops and restaurants.  Location is very quiet and the breakfast was very nice. Great amenities and big en suite complemented the room very well. Highly recommended.
hotel_response:
Thank you Ben for your review. It was a pleasure meeting you and we hope to welcome you again in the future when rowing brings you back to Cambridge.

Renata and Dave

title: FIrst class
text: Stayed twice in last 12 months: first class accommodation only bettered by first class people.  Rooms and bathrooms very clean and warm; breakfast made to your specifications; owners Dave and Renata really suited to the service industry - Antony
hotel_response:
Dear Antony,
It was lovely to see you again and thank you for your kind comments.
Best wishes and a happy festive season
Renata and David

title: Immaculate accommodation, warm hospitality and special breakfast
text: One of the cleanest, tidiest guest houses I have ever seen. Renata and David are kind hosts and made us feel comfortable. It is difficult to decide what was the best feature of our stay; the wonderfully comfortable bed, the modern, clean bathroom or Renata's fantastic granola breakfast. Clearly a new guest house with very tasteful decoration, warm hospitality and many special features. We can highly recommend Grosvenor House.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your lovely comments. We enjoyed having you stay with us and hope to welcome you again in

title: The perfect introduction to New Zealand
text: Having recently stayed for 5 nights during a business exhibition, Grosvenor House could not have been a more perfect base! Not only was the room lovely, the breakfast delicious but the hosts Renata and David added a personal touch which made me feel completely at home. Perfect hosts during a perfect stay! Looking forward to return.
hotel_response:
Thank you so much for choosing to stay with us and for your review. We very much enjoyed meeting and hosting you and are glad that you felt comfortable in our home based B&B. We hope to see you again in the near future and wish you all the best.

Renata and David

title: It's all about the detail
text:
We recently had the pleasure of visiting Cambridge, what a gem it is, and staying in the Grosvenor House B &B. Firstly I can't recommend Cambridge highly enough, a great location central to the area and allowing visits to Tauranga, Rotorua and Hamilton very easily. 
Now the Grosvenor House, I could talk about the quality of the accommodation (top notch), I could talk about the cleanliness (spotless), I could talk about the facilities (marvellous) but that's not really the reason we stay in B & B's is it. Renata and David were the perfect hosts, so thoughtful and caring. But more importantly and their point of difference, the breakfast, was amazing. I will never forget all those homemade preserves, it was like going back to my childhood. 
Do yourself a huge favour and when you're next in Cambridge stay with this lovely couple, I'm sure you won't be disappointed, just don't eat all the lemon curd, I might be arriving the next day!!!
hotel_response:
Thank you so much for your fantastic review. Please come and stay again soon, and we promise we will have a fresh batch of lemon curd waiting for you. It was lovely getting to know you and spending time with you. 
Best wishes
Renata and Dave

title: Highly recommneded, a very restful sanctuary in Cambridge, NZ
text: My partner and I had a wonderful stay at Grosvenor House whilst we competed at the World Masters Games nearby at Lake Karapiro.   Renata and David were superb hosts, very welcoming and accommodating of our various needs (e.g. varying breakfast timings, need to wash clothes etc.) and helped us find our bearings in the neighbourhood.   Their property is ideally situated within walking distance of Cambridge centre, yet it is wonderfully peaceful.  We slept really well.  The rooms are very clean, modern and comfortable, and the breakfasts' were tasty and sufficient.  We highly recommend Grosvenor House to others, and definitely look forward to staying again when we are next in the area.

title: Welcoming B and B
text: This B and B is lovely.  It is in a quiet street within walking distance of the town.  There is a little lake at the end of the street.  David and Renata are perfect hosts, friendly and helpful.  The house is immaculate and our room was cosy and we loved having an en suite.  The breakfast was perfect, homemade cereal, fruit and jams.  There was also an option of a cooked  breakfast in addition, nicely cooked by David.  We have no hesitation in recommending this lovely B and B.
hotel_response:
Dear Wendy, thank you for your nice review, we enjoyed hosting and meeting you and hope to meet you again sometime in the future.
Best wishes
Renata and David

title: Excellent!
text: Renata and David were wonderful hosts. The room and ensuite were impeccably clean and well presented. Quiet and convenient location. Hearty home cooked breakfast with the best home-made jams and spreads. Will definitely stay again next time we're in beautiful Cambridge. Highly recommended.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your nice comments, we enjoy making our guests feel welcome and at home
Renata and Dave

title: Excellent B&B
text:
We stayed here on our way down to Napier, arriving after a trip from Auckland a little later in the evening which Renata and David were very good about accommodating.

A really fresh, clean and modern B&B with super friendly hosts and a great bedroom that had all the amenity required for our stay. The bed was very comfy and the extra blanket came in handy too.

Breakfast was a really relaxed affair and David did a great job with the bacon and eggs and, overall, very welcoming hosts who made the stay a real pleasure and I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a B&B in the Cambridge area.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your nice review. Whenever possible we accommodate special requests from guests.

title: Clean, comfortable B&B in quaint town
text: We really enjoyed our stay at Grosvenor House B&B. The room was beautifully decorated and quiet for sleeping. The house is close to town which has several options for dinner spots. It's also near a pretty lake with nice walking trails. Renata and Dave were very welcoming and provided a delicious breakfast. Can't go wrong staying here!

title: Highly recommend

Bed and bathroom all first class and homemade granola , preserves etc made for a delicious breakfast 
Lovely hosts would definitely recommend
hotel_response:

Renata and David

title: Purpose Built, and Functional
text: Renata and Dave are naturally talented as hosts, and do everything to make your stay enjoyable.The house is obviously built to purpose and very practically designed. Renata is also a 'home cooker', and her jams etc are delicious. Breakfast was (in my case, only a continental by request) a very satisfying experience, with lots on offer. I would have appreciated some further 'furniture' in my room to house my overnight and daily on-the-person bibs and bobs; otherwise, a wonderful place to stay, either overnight or for a lengthier stay.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your review. We take great pleasure in offering our guests home preserves and produce and are pleased to hear you enjoyed it. 
When furnishing the guest rooms we took great care not to make the rooms cluttered and over full. All our guests have a guest lounge, dining table and outside deck available for their use, which gives them additional space and comfort.
Thank you for choosing Grosvenor House B&B

title: Comfortable and quiet B & B
text: We stayed one night for a regatta;  friendly hosts and very modern, clean and comfortable with delicious continental and cooked breakfast.   Very close to Cambridge town centre and just 15 mins to Lake Karapiro.
hotel_response:
Thank you very much for your nice feedback. We always appreciate hearing from our guests. We are pleased to hear that you felt comfortable and enjoyed your stay.

Best wishes
Renata and David

title: Warm welcome and hospitality in North Island

title: Immaculate
text:

title: Boutique accomodation

Wonderful warm welcome and stay. Appreciated the careful attention to

title: New B&B gem in Cambridge - beautifully-designed home and charming hospitality
text:
Stayed for two nights in Room 3 (king-size bed) while on personal business in Cambridge. Located in quiet established part of town, plenty of street parking, close to everything as well as routes north and south.

Dave and Renata have elegant yet practical taste in the way they designed-built their home to be a small B&B; it appears to be an ideal combination of sound Kiwi judgment (Dave originally from Dunedin) and efficient European elegance (Renata who is Swiss). The rooms are located in one 'wing' and you have guest use of a separate lounge area as well as the kitchen/dining space. Wonderfully luxurious bedding for sleeping comfort, tea/coffee facilities but no fridge in-room, Wi-Fi that works each time, quiet inset gliding doors, overhead reading lights that generate proper light for reading and the list goes on.

The generous breakfasts (continental with range of cereals, fresh fruit and all manner of local jams and spreads -- followed by optional hot breakfast) set me up for the entire day. The hosts are flexible, adaptable, available to share local information and culture about the region, but discreet if you don't need them.

A great new B&B addition (completed house is about a year old) and with only 3 rooms at reasonable daily rates, you will have to book early if you want the Grosvenor House experience!

title: A splendid place to stay
text: Grosvenor House was designed by Renata and David for B and B guests.  It is most elegantly decorated and presented.  Beds very comfortable, coffee and tea supplied in rooms, easy to access safe and roomy shower in ensuite.  Comfortable lounge and also outside patio available for guests.  Breakfast room alongside open plan kitchen.  Superb breakfast.  Whole facility sparkling clean.  Renata and Barry pleasant and helpful hosts.  I thoroughly recommend Grosvenor B and B - I would dare anyone to be disappointed.

title: Delightful B&B
text: Immaculately clean, beautifully furnished, comfortable bed, wonderful breakfasts and warm, welcoming hosts.  I was made to feel completely at home at this beautiful B&B and highly recommend it.  Should I return to Cambridge, NZ, I will most definitely look to stay at Grosvenor House again.

title: Charming home, great hosts
text: We stayed here during a one-night stay in Cambridge for a rugby game. A beautiful home with cozy accommodations. Renata and David are great hosts and they prepared a lovely, full breakfast. David's eggs and bacon were delicious.

title: Lovely B&B
text: Very quiet, clean and beautiful home with wonderful hosts and close to everything. I would recommend this place to everyone and I would be happy to stay again. David's breakfast was great. The rooms are beautiful and very comfortable.

title: Peaceful stay in a peaceful town
text:
We were supposed to stay in a hotel during our stay in Cambridge but our reservation got messed up and the week before arriving, I found this location. I was skeptical at first because why would this still be available. But after reading the previous reviews and seeing the pictures, I was confident that this could be a good option. 

However I was wrong...it was a great option. 

Renata and David were the kindest hosts and made sure that our stay was as pleasant as possible and that all of our needs were met. Breakfast was a hit and much better than if in a hotel.

It really felt like living with a family, which taught us more about the town than if we just stayed in a hotel. I am glad that our previous reservations fell through and this option became available. A return to Cambridge would definitely include a stay here.

title: Superb B & B in Cambridge NZ
text: Room superb and very clean. Hostess Renata was wonderful and very knowledgeable about the area. Breakfast was fantastic with ample food. Highly recommended. We will be back. Very close to the township of Cambridge and Lake Karapiro. Great for cyclists, walkers and rowing.

title: Brillant ambience and welcome
text: Great place to stay! Super welcome and very good breakfast with beautifully conceived interior decoration in both private room and public areas, all done with immaculate attention to detail. Excellent location for exploring middle of North Island.

title: Great place in Cambridge

Would recommend this to anyone looking to stop off in Cambridge.

title: Like at home
text: It's a very nice place with a cozy, clean and modern room. The hosts, Renata and David, are very open and friendly! We higly recommend this B&B to stay! There is a kettle in the room so you can drink tea or coffee at any time.

title: Fabulous hosts
text:
Lovely quiet central location 5 mins to town Exceptionally well presented. 
The new purpose built home is high standard accommodation, tastefully decorated and pristinely clean, with all modern conveniences.
 Hosts Dave and Renata managed to meet our every need, including a fabulous cooked breakfast, in a very unobtrusive manner.

title: Great spot
text: Thanks, David and Renata.  Our group of 3 couples really enjoyed our stay with you.  The rooms were great, and we appreciated your restaurant suggestions.  Breakfast was very good - so nice to enjoy it outside!

title: Great
text: David and Renata were extremely friendly and welcoming when we arrived. We were tired from traveling and the room was quiet and very comfortable. They fed us an amazing homemade breakfast the next morning and helped us with travel tips for the rest of our journey.

title: Great hosts - Lovely accommodation
text: Dave and Renata were very welcoming and helpful, they went out of their way to ensure we had a great stay. The room is very modern with a comfortable bed, it was a nice surprise to see the complimentary toiletries and we enjoyed the cooked breakfast.

title: Beautifully appointed
text: This classic homestead is located on the outskirts of Cambridge in the peaceful countryside, but is only a short drive to town, or to Hamilton. My room with ensuite was immaculately presented and tastefully decorated. The room was very spacious with access to an external deck (but unfortunately it was raining!), a small fridge and tea/coffee facilities. The biscuits and chocolates were a nice touch!  Parking is a breeze and the free wifi worked well. The breakfast was very simple (cereal and toast) with 3 choices of fresh fruit (blueberries, strawberries and kiwifruit).

title: Lovely B&B
text:
We booked this B&B mainly because it was well located for Cambridge and Cambridge was a convenient stop-off on our way to Wellington. It was more than ideal for that purpose. We found it to be a very good location, close to a very pretty lake which we walked round twice in order to stretch our legs after our journey. We then went for dinner in Cambridge and walked back to Grosvenor House.

The house itself is almost new and is immaculate. The bed was very comfortable, there were good quality amenities provided and the breakfast was lovely - home-made muesli, fresh fruit, bacon and eggs, toast and home-made preserves. 

It was also good value. The one thing which would have been a disadvantage if we had wanted to stay longer was that the room was fairly compact and there was no fridge. This didn't matter to us for one night but may have put us off staying longer. I would suggest a mini fridge would be a useful addition?

But all in all, would highly recommend.

title: 5 star B&B in Cambridge
text: A great B&B run by Renata and Dave within a very modern home. Alot of thought has gone in to the very well appointed rooms, and with your own ensuite, very comfortable bed and tea and coffee making facilities it's like a 5 Star home away from home. A lovely breakfast was offered in the morning and the only downside was that we weren't able to stay longer to enjoy their hospitality. Would highly recommend to any looking for accomodation in Cambridge.

title: Fabulous B&B
text: Lovely new house, tastefully decorated and very comfortable rooms with ensuites. The hosts were friendly but were also happy to leave you to do your own thing. Breakfast was a highlight, lovely fresh fruit and eggs made to order! More than happy to return.

title: First class B&B

Immaculate home very welcoming and helpful lovely room that was spotlessly clean with everything a traveller could want. Great breakfast with all homemade extras.

Breakfast covered everything - continental and cooked. We especially liked the homemade touch.

It is definitely our place of choice should we return to Cambridge!

title: Excellant accomodation

On departure the breakfast was excellant well done David.

title: Exceptionally friendly hosts and lovely room.

title: Warm, friendly and accommodating hosts.

The next day we were offered cooked and continental breakfast which were both top class, and wonderful conversation with two very friendly hosts. For a young couple staying at a B&B it was really nice to feel comfortable in this setting.

title: Friendly place to stay

title: Exceptional in every way!
text:

We arrived early afternoon and the hosts Hillary and Jeremy had popped out, but they had left us a wonderful welcoming note with clear directions to which room was ours. We dropped off our things and made our way to Karapiro which was the purpose of our visit. Karapiro is a short easy drive from the accomodation. When we returned late afternoon, we met Hillary and Jeremy and they were both very friendly and welcoming. Hilary got us checked in and settled in and showed us the breakfast room and explained how breakfast worked.
We were in the garden cottage which was really neat. It had a bedroom, bathroom and small living area with a kitchenette. The room was situated at the back of the garden and had a lovely veranda looking out to the garden. The room was really well presented. The bed was very comfortable. There were lots of favourites for us, but highlights were, the great choice for breakfast, the attention to detail - lots of neat little touches, the perfect balance of friendliness and checking in from the hosts, while still feeling like we had our own space and privacy and finally the incredible hospitality of Hilary and Jeremy - nothing was a problem (Hilary even offered to wash and dry my sons paddling clothes when he joined us on the last day of his competition). They really do go above and beyond. I couldn’t recommend this little gem more highly and we will definitely be back.
hotel_response:
Thanks for your great review!
We are pleased that you enjoyed your stay with us.
The villa is also an easy 15 minute walk into the centre of Cambridge.
We hope you will be back next year.
Smiles  Hilary

title: Wow just wow. Just like home
text:
I arrived very late and I went to the main house. April had stuck a message to her front door to tell me that my room was unlocked. I was shocked at what I encountered - not in a bad way but in a good way. I had booked ‘Much Ado’ and it was amazing. It was well decorated; everything looked fresh and it was homely! I originally booked one night but then I immediately booked a second online. 

I couldn’t recommend this place any higher!

Have a look at my pictures because the standard of this room was brilliant. Just make sure when you speak to April, don’t allow her boy to slam the door shut on her because he was locked in and I had to break in to open the house as April was pregnant.

title: Superb!
text:
A beautiful colonial house has been beautifully restored and extended to provide luxurious rooms and suites close to this pretty NI town.
Our hosts were completely delightful and went out of their way to make our short stay completely wonderful.
The accommodation is supremely comfortable, spotlessly maintained and quietly tucked away from a fairly busy road at the front of the section.
Absolutely no hesitation in recommending this lovely accommodation and warmly, friendly hosts to other travellers heading to or through the neat town of Cambridge, New Zealand.

title: Relaxing and elegant with dollops of imagination!
text: Beautiful accommodation set in large green lawned gardens. The hosts went out of their way to make us welcome and the rooms are Shakespeare themed and exquisite. It was quiet at night and offered something other than even your above average motel room experience. Attention to detail with black out curtains and charming bone china crockery. Children enjoyed frisbee on the lawn until it landed on the roof and we enjoyed relaxing breakfasts on the veranda. Highly recommended.
hotel_response:

Thank you for your lovely 'dollopy' review.  We enjoyed having you and your family staying with us.  We didn't know there was a frisbee on the roof - it hasn't appeared yet!!!!  Hope Maman arrived back in France safely
Smiles  Hilary

title: Loved it
text:
A great place to stay. Hillary was very welcoming. The Rooms felt like home. Hillary also provided us good info for local places to eat and for coffee.. 

When I come back to NZ I will definitely stay here again.

title: A real little Gem
text: We stayed in the Midsummer Room, which was absolutely gorgeous! Perfect for our 2 night stay in Cambridge.  Room was warm and cosy. Bed was super comfortable.  Everything was just perfect. This bed and Breakfast is a real little gem. Highly recommended.

title: Comfortable stay in Cambridge
text:
Had a great stay here for 3nights while attending a family wedding. 
Nothing too much trouble and we stay in the cottage which was very comfortable.
Hilary was very friendly and even offered to do some washing for me!
Thoroughly recommend.

title: Loved staying there
text:
This place is literally a gem, the pictures dont do justice to the place. We got a room that was totally perfect and felt like home, bathroom was newly renovated. Totally spotless bathroom and bedroom. All necessary items were there. Wifi speed was really good, and best we got in any hotel/motel in NZ. 

It is 20 mins away from hobbiton movie set. Hosts were very welcoming and friendly. Loved the place. Totally recommend it.

title: Loved staying here
text: Stayed in cottage for four nights, lovely, spacious and clean. Well set up and very comfortable. Hilary and Jeremy were lovely hosts, really friendly, accommodating and couldn't have done more for us. The location is close to town but private and quiet. I would highly recommend staying here and would love to come back.

title: Private with character and charm.
text:
Signage was great outside on the street. Drove up a private driveway. Plenty of parking. Hillary met me at the door. Showed me the accommodation choices of the Cadiz which is a luxury English caravan well equipped for 4 people priced at $105 per night for 2 people situated in the garden. Next I was shown inside where they are doing some renovations making another ensuite in the main villa. Beautifully presented bedrooms. Interior design luxury spacious rooms. Unfortunately the romantic cute garden cottage which is the most popular choice was already taken that night.Normally $140 for 2 people, it alos has a sofa bed for 2 more.
Yes breakfast is an extra $18 pp, but you can walk along the road to Scott's cafe for breakfast or the bakery or cafe nine. The hosts Jeremy and Hillary are wonderful and accommodating.

title: Villa Shakespear
text: Most of the accommodation seems to be campers, but we stayed in a little cabin.  It comprised of a bedroom bathroom and living room/kitchenette.  The accommodation was tasteful and comfortable.  Although it is advertised as bed and breakfast the breakfast is not included in the price.  It is $18 per head extra.  We didn't have breakfast.  Cambridge is a pretty town and worth a visit

title: Compact Jewel
text: I will start with the fact that I don't camp and I have never been in a motor home.  We booked the motor home situated outside the main house.  Absolutely charming.  We stayed for one night and loved it. It was stylish, comfortable, and filled with every necessary item.  The hosts were gracious and welcoming. My kids (15, 13, 10) and I fit snug as a bug.  The younger ones fit in the single beds.  My tall daughter and I fit comfortably in the double bed made out of the couches. The location is walking distance to Main Street, cafes, and restaurants.  It was a 15-20 min drive to Hobbiton Movie Set.

title: Great hospitality
text: Stayed for two nights. Greeted at the door on arrival. Premises are clean and comfortable. Breakfast is a wonderful "family" affair. Tasty food and excellent company. Close to town where there are some good cafes. Hamilton is 20 minutes away, but we preferred the village feel. Villa Shakespeare is set in a nice garden setting, full of birdlife. Highly recommend.

title: The perfect compact accommodation
text: I arrived in Cambridge to attend the Cycling World Cup and hired one of Villa Shakespeare's "glamourvans". Hilary and Jeremy's hospitality was exemplary. The caravan was designed as a compact space, but all requirements were catered for. I'd gratefully seize on any opportunity to stay again.

title: Little Gem
text: I rarely give a 5* rating but this one is well deserved. Situated just 10 minutes walk from the centre of Cambridge, this property is within easy driving distance of the new Velodrome,  Lake Karapiro rowing centre and Sarnia Park ( popular wedding venue). The owner Hilary made us feel welcome and comfortable from first arriving to the end of our three night stop. Our room was excellent and the facilities first class. The house is set back from the road so no traffic noise. Breakfast selection was varied and very tasty. Would certainly use again.

title: Very Friendly host and the best Bed and Breakfast in Cambridge
text:
Really enjoyed my stay here. I had a separate villa, which was very large and clean and the bed was extremely comfy. The room also included a large TV, tea, coffee,  and free (fast) wifi! Breakfast was included and there was LOTS to choose from, such as cooked breakfast, cereals, fruit, etc. Highly recommended! 
Thanks Hilary and Jeremy for hosting us. 

Janelle O'reilly
Huntly I-SITE

title: Tranquil and Friendly
text: I had my reservations prior to arrival as I am not a BB person however, Villa Shakespeare converted me completely. Accommodation was lovely and the breakfast was to die for. The family running the place are wonderful and friendly and made my wife and I feel very at home and I WILL DEFINITELY BE VISITING THEM AGAIN for a stop over.

title: Special Request noted and acted upon.
text: There were no cars in the large car park but obviously a huge coach brought in a big bus load. Typical motel room with tea making only.  Plenty of food outlets within walking distance though. Easy walking distance to main town.  I requested a downstairs room with no spray and both these points were acted upon.

title: Nice
text: The place is nice and cozy with friendly staffs! Room is good and bed is comfortable. I would highly recommend this hotel when you visit hamilton. Easy access to grocery stores and restaurants. Quiet and peaceful area (all over in nz is peaceful and quiet though.)

title: Retro motel Hamilton
text: Had a great stay pool and hot tub were beautiful and crystal clear, friendly staff, very today and clean room, was dated but that’s the whole retro side of it! And like I said very clean and tidy! Will definitely book again. Thankyou

title: Noisy
text:
Actually the hotel itself was fine, the staff nice and the room very clean and reasonably comfortable.
However due to its location there was significant road traffic noise which meant a poor nights sleep.
I would not return.

title: Great location with excellent staff
text:
Spotless main room containing a double and a single bed which was perfect for a couple staying one night. Nice little kitchenette but only mugs available for tea/coffee making, although there is a fridge as well.  Room contained a heat pump so was lovely and warm on arrival and SKY TV was available too. The bathroom was very tired though.  Wallpaper peeling off, white sticky tape on the wall, damaged sink and the grouting around the bath was quite mouldy. Time for some TLC in this area.

Motel itself was in a great location for walking to the centre, had ample parking, a pool for warmer days and excellent, friendly staff throughout.

title: Very Basic

title: Perfect for us
text:

Pros
Great Value for our size group for a 2 bedroom apartment
Location (has supermarket and several eateries across the road). We had a puncture and were able to find someone down the road that could repair it within an hour on a Sat late morning.
Pool / hot tub (though the pool is not heated so it was freezing but the kids were happy to spend some time in the hot tub on an Autumn evening)

Bathroom (could do with better window treatments for privacy and have a shower curtain that goes all the way around the bath)

Overall we were happy with our stay here, thank you.

title: Perfect
text:
We only had one night here but were pleasantly surprised by how good this place was - especially for the price. Fabulous deal online for 2 adults and 2 kids and at short notice.

The hotel is ideally located - short walk to rugby stadium. Across the road from Pak n Save grocery store, with Countdown also just another block away. And the city centre within easy walking distance
Perfect. Will definitely be back here. Be fabulous in the middle of summer with this pool!
