title: Old but ok
text: As the name suggests the place is old and retro not in a fashionable way it really is just old. Pretty clean and well located for business in Hamilton if you are on a budget. Staff are friendly. Includes Sky TV and self contained kitchen.

title: Terrible.....
text:
Checked-in....then check-out...
Room was dirty. Rotten wood and paneling in bathroom. Lose ranchslider (my 2yr old easily unlocked this and was headed out into the carpark...scary!) 
Kitchen needed a good clean.  Small stains on bedding.  Big hole in wall behind master bed.
My four year old found a lighter (nude woman picture on it...) in the sofa, I found him trying to figure out how to use it.
Cheap'ish, but for only a little more $, there are much better places to stay... (see my other review)

title: Needs some work to say the least
text:
Whilst they've made a bit of an effort by papering a wall and adding colourful cushions you can't hide the depressing state of these rooms 

Where to start!?
Stains on the ceilings
Bare patches of plaster all around the place & no caulking around sink in the bathroom, enamel on the bath is missing in places and there's mould in the corners.
 
Ants in the kitchen, smelly cupboards with random stuff just shoved in there.  A very 'retro' fridge. The kitchen is completely overlooked by another residential building and has no curtains, the 'dining area' was too depressing to sit at and way too small for 5 people (6 beds in our appt) 
Only 1 wifi docket was issued so you couldn't connect more than 1 device. (Every place we stayed at which had this popular wifi access system offered 2-4)

No local maps available at reception. 

Staff at the onsite restaurant 'Retrospect' were LOVELY and Judith Sophie went out of her way to look after us but dinner was sadly barely edible. 

Location is pretty good, 15 mins walk to the local cinemas and eateries

title: Good value for money
text: Good value for money, plenty of space in the rooms for a family of five. Thebkids loved the pool and hot pool, all the sky channels one would need, couch could have been a bit more comfortable but good value non the less

title: Cheap overnighter
text: Another overnight stop. Place was very busy due to the All Blacks v Pumas Rugby match. Room was simple but comfy and modern. Easy walking distances to shops and the stadium. Excellent meal in the restaurant with a very "growing up in the 70's feel". Very friendly staff. Thanks for the stay.

title: Not worth the money.
text:
Where to start.. . The ranch slider door was broken and required alot of effort to open and close.  It didn't lock. The bathroom had a leak in the ceiling over the window so when it rained and you wanted to use the toilet you got a free shower. The proper shower was  poor over the bath and the water temp went up and down on its own. No bedside lights, double  bed old worn and saggy in the middle. Only one small 2 person sofa in lounge to sit on, not sure where the kids or if you had other guests would sit. Perhaps the floor ?  

Overall condition of room, very run down and in need of repair. Nothing Retro about the place at all.  When I mentioned the leak in the bathroom ceiling they just looked at me. Could have at least faked some concern or interest. 

Left feeling very ripped off. We won't be back.

title: We will be back
text:
I was pleasingly surprised how clean the units were and especially the linen was crisp and clean.

I was under no illusions that when booking the Retro section that the units could be dated and they were, but like I mentioned they were clean along with the linen.

An added bonus was the swimming pool, spa, kiddies pool and cafe, these were beneficial.

title: Good value
text: Okay room, defo a 3 star but decent for the price. Staff were friendly. Large room with balcony and a comfy bed, shower was okay however the whole thing could do with being done up as it was falling apart. Wifi ok.

title: I won't be back!
text:
Stayed for 2 nights here and chose it because it was so central. That's definitely the best part of this hotel. I think they call it retro so they don't have to do any maintenance or upkeep in the room. The room wasn't serviced, they tried to charge me again for breakfast (which I'm sorry I ordered in the first place). Cold greasy bacon ughhh! Although paid for, we didn't bother the second morning!
When I went to reception to pay for the dinner we had the first night, the guy on duty told me breakfast was still outstanding, then once pointed out to him it had been booked and charged for online, he said "You got this room so cheap" REALLY? 
Apart from location, I'd say the best part was the service received from Callum and Deanna in the restaurant.

title: Don't stay here ever!
text: Noisy rooms and the staff couldn't have cared less. I would never stay here again and strongly recommend that you find somewhere else that is quiet and has staff that actually care a tiny bit about providing customer service! The staff member I encountered was extremely rude and unhelpful.

title: Good value
text:
Because we required a quiet and private room, we found this hotel ideal as it perfectly met our needs.  Nice and comfortable also.
We found it very convenient that we could park our car in the basement and either walk up the stairs or there was a lift available.
There was no need to require assistance from anyone if perferred.

title: Good room size
text: Rooms are spacious and beds are clean and very comfortable. I spent four nights, they made my bed and changed towels but never vacuumed the carpet. It really showed! Wifi is free but you need to enter a code that gives you 1GB, however the connection fails several times and you need to re-enter the code, but for unknown reasons you can't do this for a while. If you are watching a movie, this is extremely annoying. Staff is friendly. It has a pool but I didn't try, it was too cold.

title: Nice hotel!
text:
My two friends and I stayed at the Ambassador for three nights! We were upgraded to a larger suite which was very cool! The free Foxtel and 1g of data were also great! 
The house keeping didn't make our beds or clean the floors or anything whilst we were out each day but apart from that it was great! We really enjoyed our stay here! Thanks again!

title: Perfect for a short stay
text: We stayed in The Ambassador for one night on our way back to Auckland. The staff at the reception was very friendly and the checkin was straightforwardly. The room was equipped with a ref, AC, Flatscreen and other things you need to feel comfortable. Everything was very clean and we had no single complaint. Thank you for the pleasent stay!

title: Overnighter
text: I stayed in the tower/dorm it was comfortable and warm and well equipped it wasn't so out dated. I found there was quite a lot of road noise but your right next to a main road. I would stay again though.

title: Damp and Disappointing
text: Stayed the weekend in this motel in two bedroom unit.  Just so disappointing, cold and damp.  certainly the down point of our special weekend away.  The bathroom was worse than the bedrooms as the walls were stripped with no finishing on them....we would certainly not recommend this accommodation.

title: nice!
text: we stay only for one night, because we were just passing through, but it's well located, just 15 minutes walk to Hamilton Central Bus Station. The staff is very helpful and nice. they even have a bar/restaurant kinda retro, and the food is really tasty. The only thing to have in mind is that breakfast is not included.

title: Just old, not "Retro"
text: Stayed here for one night for a business trip thinking it would be funky judging by the pictures shown online but it turns out this place is just incredibly dated and old. You can't claim its "retro" when it actually just has been left to rot. Good location but certainly wouldn't stay here again.

title: Great Experience
text: I met Some friendly guys at the reception. Josh and Mitchell were very helpful and flexible.  We initially had a minor issue with keys to the room. The guys did a great job with looking after us. Then we enjoyed a fantastic.meal at the bar next door at the Retro Bar and Grill. I really enjoyed the vegetarian dish that the chef did a great job with. Would definitely recommend a visit hotel and restaurant.

title: Good for a overnighter
text: The place is looking a little old. However our room was clean and tidy.  Location is quite noisy due to two busy roads either side of the complex . All necessary amenities are within walking distance.  Reception staff were helpful and friendly.  If you are budget conscious  and need a place to put your head down for a night that's cheap and relatively cheerful this would be a good option.

title: Left me stranded at 2:00am
text:
My wife contacted this Motel to see if they could accommodate me during my late international flight arrival in Auckland then drive to Hamilton ready for a meeting the next day.  They assured her that this wasn't a problem and that a key would be in the locked box and provided instructions with access pin via email and took payment from our credit card.  Once I arrived at 2:00am I opened the locked box to find no key.  I called the after hours number provided with no answer.  After waiting around for half an hour I decided to drive back home (another 2hours drive) as I could not find anywhere to stay. I arrived home at 4am very tired after been put into a very dangerous position as forced to drive home as I had no other options.  I had to reschedule my meetings and travel back again to Hamilton the next day at a cost to my company.  
I am still awaiting reimbursement and a direct apology from the owner.

title: Beware
text:
We booked this hotel for a one night stop over, going by the pictures on Booking.com. When we arrived we were told that we had been upgraded to a one bed apartment!
Nothing like what we had booked, it was up stone steps (no lift) so had to carry cases up ourself, apartment very poor, not clean, no air con, nothing like what we had booked! had we been staying longer I would have complained and aske for what we had booked, if this was an upgrade goodness knows what the other rooms etc were like!
hotel_response: Thank you very much for your review, we really appreciate your feedback. We truly apologise for the bad experience you had when you stayed with us recently and are grateful for you bringing it to our attention so we can quickly work to ensure this doesn’t occur again.

title: Quick Stopover
text: This was booked as a basic stopover, paid $127 for 2 adults and one child including breakfast.The room was clean with good quality bedding and towels. For budget accommodation good value. It is however near a main road which was a little noisey. Also worth a mention is the chef who was quite happy to cook me some lovely poached eggs despite the buffet breakfast being available.

We weren't in the room much , so it was comfortable for the nights rest. The kids enjoyed the pool and spa. Grounds well kept and it is central to everything. Pak n Save and petrol station directly across the road. Plenty of take out options just a minutes walk. Mall 5 mins drive. Restaurant for breakfast/dinner on site, however we did not get to try it.

title: Beautiful place to base yourself
text:
We were pleasantly surprised when we drove off the main highway just south of Cambridge and within 2 minutes we arrived at this beautiful B&B in a quiet area full of homes instead of businesses.  The house feels a million miles from anything but the location is so central to all the major attractions. You can easily do a day drive to Taupo, Rotorua, the rugged beaches on the west coast and the beautiful beaches on the east coast. Cambridge with antique shops, boutiques and great restaurants is only a few minutes drive and for a LOTR fan like me being only 20 minutes drive from Hobbiton through amazing rolling countryside was a bonus. We had only booked for 2 nights but wish we had booked for more and based ourselves there for our travels.
The host Robyn is gracious and full of interesting suggestions about places to visit, back roads to take for the best scenery and good places to eat. 
The house is fairly new, large and spacious with a wonderful garden complete with a few sheep, goats (all fenced away from the house) and rabbits. The 3 B&B rooms are in a separate wing and private from the main house with a separate entrance. Our room was not large but beautifully decorated, the bed was very comfy and the very modern bathroom with heated floor was appreciated in some unseasonably cold and stormy weather. I did miss having a guest lounge where we could sit and maybe read and enjoy a glass of local wine when the weather was not so good or of an evening, but the room was supplied with crockery and cutlery and there is a lovely courtyard with chairs and tables just outside the rooms which would have been a nice place to sit on a sunny day.  We loved the special touch of homemade biscuits each day and the coffee press in the room. 
Breakfasts were delicious with excellent coffee, fresh fruit salad, muesli, smoked salmon and cheeses, fresh juices, breads and homemade jam and the view from the breakfast table was beautiful. Robyn was happy to adapt to any dietary restrictions if needed. 
We had a wonderful stay – thank you Robyn for making us so welcome. We will definitely be back.

Highlighting the vista of Karapiro Willows and just how central our location is will help many a traveler to base themselves here while they stay and play and avoid dragging those suitcases in and out of the car quite so often. It is my delight to have made you a nutritious breakfast to top up your energy reserves for the days exploring. Lovely having you stay with us at Lake Karapiro, we certainly hope to see you again.

title: Lovely friendly place to stay
text: We had a really lovely relaxing stay at Karapiro Willows, so friendly, clean and the most amazing breakfast! Robyn and Vince were very welcoming and helpful with advice for things to do in the area and places to sneak a quick run in on our flying visit. We would definitely return and would recommend them if you need a place to stay in the area.

It is my delight to have made you a nutritious breakfast to top up your energy reserves for the days exploring. Lovely having you stay here with us at Lake Karapiro.

title: Recommend 100%
text:
Last night we stayed at Karapiro Willows following a wedding near Cambridge.  We had previously booked a motel but decided to upgrade. So glad we did. The place is light and so well equipped.  Comfortable bed, modern en suite, clean and tastefull throughout. Even a coffee plunger and ground coffee in the room.

Do we regret upgrading to Karapiro Willows?  No,  it was the best decision to do so.  Sorry not to meet Robyn who had been so helpful when we booked but Vince was super and the only change I would have made would have been to stay longer.
hotel_response: Kind, caring, Grandparents such as yourselves need a bit of quiet relax when away for sure! We were delighted to help you do just that. Vince certainly can concoct a good breakfast and is very pleased to see others enjoy it. I hope I will get to meet you when you pop down this way again some time.

title: Delightful
text: Loved our stay here. The room was super cosy and warm, beautifully appointed, had a comfortable bed, fantastic shower and bathroom with heated flooring and wonderful toiletries. It is very private and in a gorgeous country setting yet super close to see Hobbiton. Robyn was so welcoming, she made the most beautiful healthy delicious breakfast.
hotel_response: It is a delight for us to have overseas travelers such as yourselves discover us here in Lake Karapiro and our pleasure to provide a comfortable place to lay your head for the night. Preparing a nourishing breakfast when you love to eat it brings joy to my heart. Come again we would love to see you. Thank you for your review.

title: Top tier B&B
text: This very modern and spotlessly clean b&b is located in a beautiful, willow-filled neighbourhood 7km from the lovely town of Cambridge and is only a few minutes drive from Karapiro Lake and the international rowing centre. Robyn, the proprietor, made us feel immediately at home, even offering to pick up a take-away dinner for us as we had arrived after dark following a long day driving in the rain. She provided an excellent breakfast the next morning that included fresh fruits and her own homemade nut bread that was both filling and delicious. Our room was comfortable and well designed. We were pleased with our short stay at Karapiro Willows and would highly recommend it to anyone staying in the Cambridge area.
hotel_response: Thank you for writing a review in support of our business, we really appreciate you taking the time and a review coming from an such an experienced traveler as yourself. Thank you too for your helpful suggestions. It is my pleasure to provide a comfortable bed and a nourishing breakfast to send you off well equipped for a day's adventure. We hope you will make it down this way again some time.

title: One of the best BB I have stayed in
text:
Chose Karapiro Willows as accomodation for 2 nights to explore the nearby attractions. Was very impressed by the rooms as well as the breakfast! The rooms were well furnished and even the bathrooms have underfloor heating. 

The location of the BB is just nice. A short drive to the town center and yet located in a peaceful area where there is not much buzz which is what we are looking for!

I would definitely choose this BB should I ever return to Cambridge and will highly recommend it to people who seek luxury and tranquility.
hotel_response: Thank you taking the time to write a review. It was a delight to offer you exactly what you were looking for... some peace and tranquility... yet close to the places you planned to visit. We would love to see you again on your next adventure.

title: WOW - Luxury, privacy, lovely hosts!
text:
We stayed here for 4 nights this last week - and I can not rave enough about how lovely it was.
Very luxurious rooms, each with their own bathroom (yummy underfloor heating, beautiful fluffy towels) and full coffee / tea making facilities etc.
Very private as rooms are in their own separate wing of the main house with their own access.
Hosts Robyn and Vince are the most lovely people you will every meet and the breakfasts were absolutely beautiful - the best I have ever had (even compared to top hotels).......
All I can say is if you want to feel pampered, have privacy and luxury in a gorgeous house and a lovely location then this one is for you!
hotel_response: Thank you Rachel for taking the time to write a review in support of our business. It was such a pleasure having you and your colleague stay with us during the Field Days week and glad to have been able to provide a bit of comfort after those long days. I enjoy preparing nutritious food for people who love to eating it!

title: Outstanding - everything you want from a quality B&B
text:
Recently stayed at Karapiro Willows when in the region on business. From first impressions during the booking process, right through to our departure, every aspect of our stay was outstanding, and most certainly everything you want from a quality B&B.

The 3 ensuite rooms are located at the rear of the property with a separate entrance and parking, giving you the privacy often lacking at other B&B's. The room was spacious, immaculately clean and complete with finishing touches including Lindor chocolates and freshly baked cookies on arrival. Each room also had tea and coffee facilities (including plunger coffee), big screen TV, hi-speed wi-fi and a spacious bathroom with eco-products and large fluffy towels. All led to an extremely comfortable and quiet stay and a great nights sleep in the huge bed.

If that wasn't enough, in the morning we were welcomed into our hosts kitchen for freshly squeezed juices, array of herbal teas, coffee, home made muesli with home made spreads and preserves, yoghurt, freshly baked local breads, cooked egg, cheeses and salmon - too much choice! And all enjoyed with good conversation, local advice and the sun streaming in to the breakfast room.

It was a shame our stay was so short, but I hope to return another time, and can most certainly recommend Karapiro Willows to anyone seeking quality accommodation in the Cambridge region.
hotel_response: One of the charming aspects of being a B & B host is meeting people like you who delight us with  interesting stories of their travels both in leisure and business and who have an appetite for good food! Thank you for taking the time to write such a long informative review in support of our business, we look forward to taking care of you when you are down this way again.

title: A hidden treasure
text: What an incredible place to stay. You instantly feel at home as you step through the front door. The breakfasts are amazing an there are lots of healthy options to choose or you could indulge in freshly baked muffins. A stay I will never forget and a place I will definitely return to.
hotel_response: You are so very welcome! Thank you for taking the time to write such kind words in support of our business. We look forward to seeing you again.

title: Fabulous Setting
text: Excellent place to stay, quiet and relaxing, rooms were very clean and comfortable and breakfast was very healthy.  Robyn (the host) was very helpful, friendly and had great sense of humor.  It was our wedding anniversary and upon Robyn finding this out she gave us a gift of a box of luxury chocolates.  Very thoughtful.   We would definitely recommend to anyone this was a place to stay.

title: A Perfect Overnight Getaway
text:
This was our first B & B stay ever (what a great decision), and Robyn and Vince of Karapiro Willows exceeded our expectations.

Our room was beautifully appointed with everything we could possibly need including thoughtful extras such as fresh flowers, moisturiser in the bathroom and a box of beautifully packaged Valentines Day Chocolates. The linens and towels were of the highest quality, and the king size bed was extremely comfortable. Our room had private entry and parking which made sure we never felt like we were intruding in any way into their main home, and had a ranch slider which opened from the bedroom out to a patio with table and chairs where we enjoyed our dinner. Another added bonus was free Wi-Fi. Robyn also checked if we had any dietary requirements, and went out of her way to accommodate this.

We found plums off their tree in a bowl outside our room door when we returned from our outing, and also got a bag of them to take home - so delicious!

Breakfast was spectacular - on offer was home made muesli, organic yoghurt, toast, butter, spreads, boiled eggs, avocado, tomato, cheeses, the most amazing home made fruit salad paired with herbal teas, orange juice, tea and coffee. We ate like kings!!

Most impressive was the warmth of our welcome from Robyn and Vince. They are the most lovely people, as well as caring, thoughtful, generous and understanding hosts.

The whole experience was perfect, and Robyn and Vince's B & B is the perfect place to go to get away from it all and recharge. This is the only place I would recommend to family and friends should they be down your way. I hope we will be back again soon!!
hotel_response: You are so very welcome, we are glad that in the midst of your busy schedule we were able to help create a much needed time away to finally enjoy your canoeing adventure with friends. It sounded so awesome I will be checking it out myself with The Boatshed.

title: Undiscovered gem less than 10 min easy drive from Cambridge
text:
If you want the peacefulness of a quiet village community, walking distance to Lake Karapiro Dam/rowing activities, that is on the outskirts of Cambridge and a base for exploring Waikato, try this new luxury gem. 

Robyn's generous organic breakfasts offer an amazing spread that sets you up for the entire day - freshly-squeezed OJ, homemade organic muesli, feijoa yoghurt from Puhoi, European-style platter of cheeses, tomatoes and avocado and the most moist muffins I have ever tasted. We stayed in the king-sized room: crisp linens/luxury duvets, modern contemporary design and strong water pressure in the shower. For our longer stay, we appreciated having the in-room TV, mini-fridge to store our drinks and snacks, plunger coffee and mix of teas (no kitchenette but dishes are cleared away and cleaned promptly).

The private key access and car parking space allowed us to come and go as we liked without disturbing Robyn and Vince or any of their visitors. Just an ideal base. We took early healthy walks and appreciated the birdlife and flora and fauna in this lovely village.

Very welcoming and flexible hosts - makes travelling a relaxed pleasure.
hotel_response: We are delighted that you were so pleased with your stay here at Karapiro Willows, a central place for your adventures. We hope to see you again.

title: Fabulous !!

The suites are in a separate wing to their living area so with a key to come and go to your own area, we never felt like we were intruding and nor were they. A hidden gem !!

We were welcomed to a heated room, Martin was very knowledgable on the area and updated us on the local attractions and good places to eat etc. Included in our stay was a continental breakfast which made mornings a breeze for on the go travellers. We will certainly be back! Such a great experience - thanks Martin!

title: Great B&B in Cambridge
text: We were looking for a comfortable and welcoming overnight stop in Cambridge on our way to the Coromandel and found the ideal B&B at 73 Milton. We were a family group of 2 children 2 parents and 2 grandparents and booked two separate rooms on 10th January 2015.  Martin arranged for each double bed unit to have an extra single bed made up in it and, since the units are reasonably large, this worked out well.  The rooms are comfortable and stylish, with large glazed sliding doors leading out to the verandah and parking, making the rooms bright and attractive, and the bathrooms at the rear of each are modern and clean.  Martin and Angela invited us all for a swim in their pool before we went out for dinner in Cambridge.  Breakfast buns, toast and coffee is self-served in a separate unit which is also stocked with books and magazines.  My wife left her shoes behind in the unit and it was a week before we realised this but Martin had already retrieved them and sent them on to us in New Plymouth in time before we flew back to the UK.  We have been visiting New Zealnd regularly for the last 12 years and this is one of the best places we have stayed at.
hotel_response:
Thanks for your positive review and we look forward to seeing you again.

Martin

title: B&B hospitality plus!
text: We enjoyed 3 nights/days at 73 Milton in Jan 2015. The B&B's location was pleasant and quiet, with a beautiful pool and charming gardens. Our host, Martin, was fabulous! Friendly and very helpful. We very much enjoyed sharing a laugh with Martin. Our room was in the middle of the three guest rooms. (It did not take long to find the complimentary chocolates - quickly winning the hearts of the weary travellers.) The room was well set out and stylishly (if not luxuriously) furnished. A bit crowded with the addition of a rollerbed for third person, but manageable. Very comfortable beds, but sound travels between rooms a little too much for the light sleeper (me!). Might book earlier next time and go for the end room. En suite bathroom was great.  A tasty continental breakfast was available in the dining/common room, which we continued to use during the day as a comfortable extra space out of our room. Music, board games, books and useful travel info was also available here.  Would happily stay again!
hotel_response:
Thanks. Sounds Awesome and we will always do what we can to ensure our guests have a great stay with us.

Martin

title: Friendly staff, good location.
text: Stayed here after finding a deal on grab one. Good location, walking distance to shops and cafes.  Staff were very friendly and helpful. title: very average
text:
We stayed in a studio which was very roomy, and had good kitchen facilities. title: A No Frills Motel
text: This motel is good value for money, clean, comfortable and fairly peaceful, with full kitchen facilities, but has none of the "little extras, " such as complimentary biscuits. We had stayed there once before, over ten years' ago, and it hadn't changed much. We found that the hosts were friendly and helpful, and their little dog was really cute. There are supermarkets very close by, though the main shopping area is a distance away. For Senior Citizens watching the dollars, though, $108 per night for a large studio unit was very reasonable.

title: very clean and quiet
text: we stayed here to go to the Rugby finals.  the room was huge with a seperate bedroom, seperate bathroom and full kitchen.  staff very very friendly and helpful, the room was exceptionally clean and i told them so.  we had a room towards the back so had no road noise at all.  would definetly stay here again.

title: Decent Enough
text: Good sized room with good facilities.  Reception was off hand and indifferent - not welcoming.  Location is some way from central Hamilton which necessitates driving to restaurants, but it is close to supermarkets if that is your choice. Room was clean and tidy and appeared well maintained.  Bathroom and toilet facilities were OK. Expect some noise from neighboring rooms.  Parking when the place is busy is an exercise in driving excellence!  It is very tight and requires quite some maneuvering to get in or out of a space. Overall an average motel experience, but value for money.

title: Very roomy
text: Found ourselves needing somewhere to stay near Auckland. Booked this direct with the help of a Jasons directory. We booked 2 one bedroom units, with a bed in the living area. Both bedroom and lounge were huge. There was also a separate kitchen, with full oven and decent size shower room. Lounge had table/chairs and sofa and even with bed, there was loads of room. Very clean and breakfast delivered to our room by owners, who were very friendly. We drove into town for a meal and had excellent meal at 'The Crazy Farmer'. There were steaks, pasta, curries and fish on offer. Very friendly service there.

title: Comfortable stay in Hamilton
text:
Stayed at Ibis Hamilton for a night travelling back towards Auckland. Centrally located in Hamilton with lots to see and do around. Carparking is a bit sparce - you can pay for the valet park or take your chance on the surrounding streets which have variations of fees/charges - we arrived late and left earlyish so wasn't really an issue. Nearby casino, riverfront and shopping centres with lots of eating options as well.

Rooms are reasonably spacious and comfortable - lots of mention of noise from trains on other posts but didn't really notice these. Room was clean with all amenities as listed available.

Easy and quick check in process - reception is on the first floor. We didn't use the bar area but used the breakfast in the morning - great range of breakfast options to get started for the day.

title: Awesome hotel
text:
What an awesome stay at Ibis Hamilton. I have stayed at a few Ibis hotels around the world over the years but this one is unlike the others. It has a very modern and fresh feel and firstly I was greeted at the door by the friendliest valet parking team youll ever meet. They were thoughtful and considerate with their questions and it was a real pleasure to have a genuine conversation and that was  before I'd even checked in!

Reception were quite friendly as well and I was checked in in no time having been given all the info I would need about how to get to my room and the restaurant. Note reception is on 1st floor but there are lifts available. 

The room was a king and it was quite spacious compared to Ibis hotels of old and would comfortably fit 2 people and their luggage with room to move around. 

The bathroom was not the usual 'cabin' but a nice bathroom with a normal shower. They had nice thick towels and hand towels which was very nice. The bathroom mirror also had a backlight which helped to see what you were doing. Shower had decent pressure too.

The bed was medium soft and comfortable, slept like a log. Pillows comfy too. The air con was one of the better ones Ive had a hotel. You could control the temp up or down as far as you wanted and it would auto adjust. You could also control fan speed or leave on auto as I did. The fan is much quieter than other hotels so it doesnt disturb your sleep. It also maintains a consistent temp.

They have two sets of blinds, one is semi transparent and the other blackout which helps when sleeping. They have thought of other things like plugs and usb ports by each bedside, good beside lamps and low wall lighting all controlled separately  from bedside. You can even press the top of the alarm clock to turn off the display so the light doesnt shine at night.

Tea and coffee kettle supplied and small fridge. Iron and board complete the amenities. There is a drawer as well for items plus plenty of hangers for clothes and a spare pillow if needed.

Hotel location is central which is handy. Parking was $40 valet and my car was waiting for me in the morning as planned. I didnt have time for breakfast so cant comment on restaurant. 

Overall a thoroughly pleasant stay and will stay again next time I'm in Hamilton.

title: Room was comfortable with a view over the river
text: We stayed here for one night. Room was comfortable with a view over the river. Good location near the main street and very close to a nice Italian restaurant. Initially they gave us a room with the wrong bed configuration but this was fixed (not without some grumbling by reception though which made us feel like it was our fault). Breakfast at the hotel was very nice.

title: Terrible go to the Novetel
text:
Got there to be told parking was $40, the booking said parking and wifi available, not quite true. Could have been more transparent up front about the cost even including it in the rate like breakfast. As soon as keys were handed over got asked when I was leaving as they had a lot of guests and needed time in the morning to get the car, ok took that into consideration but no idea when I’m leaving so no I can’t rebook a time for car retrieval. Rude reception did not explain anything about the hotel it’s wifi password and its amenities, and then told me I misheard about the parking cost, how about speaking clearly, in my country (New Zealand) we go out of our way to be helpful, so please do the same for visitors. Reception is on the first floor, no help with luggage, so you’re dragging it in and out of the lift for one floor, then up to your floor. Housekeeping was nice should hire them for the reception they were more helpful. After the car goes to the $40 park for the night then you can’t drive anywhere. Bed was lumpy and bumpy, sheets were scratchy and itchy, three pillows only. One bottle of soap to use for hands, shower and hair. Shower had nozzle stuck to the wall up high, was it to expensive to buy the slide one. Expensive hotel with nothing plush about it, felt like it was a box with a bed only in the room, no plates, so no taking food back there. Bin had no rubbish bag in it, yuk. Worst experience could not have been more disappointed, especially when you go out of your way to treat yourself, ruined the end of my holiday.  $300 a night with a holding fee of $50, prepaid by the way, and coming from Auckland where it was way cheaper, should have paid the extra $20 to go to Novetel. 
So embarrassing to have a chain like this in New Zealand what must our visitors think, as they get ripped off.

title: Excellent stay
text:
The staff and hotel are impeccable, we had an issue with our booking through booking.com however the staff managed this without fuss

The venue itself is located in the heart of the Hamilton CBD and is well presented, comfortable and well priced

The kitchen staff are friendly, and breakfast is fresh, tasty and set us up for a great day

title: Great central location
text:
A great hotel in the centre of Hamilton. The room was very clean and comfortable with a small en-suite shower.
The buffet breakfast was very good with selections of hot and cold buffet items.
There is valet parking for an additional fee.
I would recommend this hotel.

title: Far superior to UK Ibis hotels
text: If IBIS hotels in the UK were this quality I'd stay in them rather than opting for Premier Inns. The rooms in Hamilton are not large but clean, bright with new furniture and bathrooms and we got a comfortable bed, air con, tea,coffee,  hot chocolate and a fridge! Breakfast was good and included eggs cooked to order if requested.  Staff were friendly and helpful. 24 hour guest laundry for small charge also a bonus. Re complaints about parking - in the UK we would always expect to pay to park in a City Centre hotel so maybe a cultural difference.  We stayed in the  hotel 16 years ago and it has improved no end! A lovely stay  - thank you!

title: Good value for money and quiet
text:
Stayed here for one night. 
Excellent experience - staff were fabulous. Rooms good especially as I had one overlooking the river. 
Had a drink before dinner on the balcony which was excellent. 
Breakfast in the morning was fabulous - there was lots of choice for everyone!

title: Ok, not great
text:
The room had a great view of the river and the bed was comfortable.  It was an ok place to stay for 2 nights.

On the downside they only offer valet parking for an extra charge, there's a train that uses the roadway bridge next to the hotel that might keep some people up, one of my bath towels had a 2 inch hole in it and a clump of hair stuck to it (ewww), and when I went to checkout someone had charged their bar drink to my room, but the staff did void the charge since I hadn't even visited the bar and was adamant that there had been a mistake.

title: Decent hotel - bring ur own shampoo!
text:
Good enough hotel. 

Positives:
-gym
-location
-friendly staff

Negatives:
-no proper shampoos or soaps offered (instead, a large bottle of ghastly ‘face wash/shampoo/body wash’)
-parking is $38 extra

title: Good stay in Hamilton
text: Really solid stay, especially for the more budget Ibis brand. Nice and modern hotel, staff were great, rooms were a decent size. Onsite breakfast was good - not great. My only quarm would be the typical NZ budget hotel shower / bathroom that were small and felt a little cheap.

title: Would stay again
text:
I stayed one night, the hotel is super nice, front desk staff incredible and rooms are just what you need for a short stay away.  The room was not huge but well appointed and the bed was very comfortable 

Parking is limited to valet parking only and was quite pricey.

title: It's Hamilton, so be happy with this one.
text: Ibis hotels are fairly-priced. The other big brother next door from Accor Group is just as unremarkable as Ibis, but overpriced. That is why I prefer Ibis. Nice, comfortable, clean, lovely service at reception, not overpriced...but nothing special. And the water temperature is all over the place. It travels all across the range between the steaming and the freezing point several times in the minute. Not prepared to give it a very good 4 stars, but I'd be happy to come back here. Probably the best and most fairly priced to be found in Hamilton.

title: Brilliant and Very Helpful
text:
Stayed one night prior to departure home to Australia. Shortly after I checked out I received a text and phone message to say I'd left my iPad in the room. Unfortunately my Spark travel pack did not work (a common complaint about Stark) I did not receive them until I arrived in Brisbane, so I was then able to contact Ibis Tainui by phone and email and asked to pack and send my iPad to me.  Customer Service Agent Marie organised this (my expense naturally) and my iPad arrived safely less than a week later. Brilliant service and greatly appreciated. 

My actual one night stay at Ibis Tainui Hamilton was also excellent. Dinner in the restaurant was delicious (gnocchi then squid) and the breakfast, although typical of many hotel breakfasts, was very good with a few extras that I haven't seen in other Ibis breakfasts.

Room - very comfortable and clean.

Service - outstanding

title: Unexpectedly delightful
text: Although someone else checked in under my name, the team quickly sorted the issue and made sure I had a lovely room and stay. I really enjoy the understated comfort here, with simple but fresh decor and facilities that work.

title: A great place to stay in Hamilton
text: Since the refurbishment after it was a MIQ (Covid isolation) hotel I have always stayed in the Ibis when I am in Hamilton 3 or 4 times a year. It is a perfect location beside the Waikato River in the city. I eat my breakfast sitting on the deck overlooking the river and trees which is a great way to start the day. Breakfast (hot buffet and cold continental) is very good with everything I could want to choose from (scrambled eggs, bacon, mushrooms, sausages, tomatoes and hash browns  as well as fruit salad, yoghurt, cereals, coffee and teas). At the reception on the first floor there is a bar where food and drinks can be ordered throughout the day, and a lounge area and the deck to sit in. My room this time was on the 7th floor with a great view over the river and the city. The room is has everything I need for a great nights sleep. Comfortable beds, pillows and good bed linen. There is a desk and chair for working at and gazing out over the river!  There is tea and coffee making facilities in the room along with bottled water. An iron and ironing board is included which is handy for me. The bathroom has a good shower and good towels and a hair dryer. Finally I always find the staff very welcoming and seem to remember me! I will keep coming back here.
hotel_response:
Kia ora Kirkmaal.

So pleased to learn that your recent stay with us was a breeze just as your previous ones with us. That Waikato river view from the ibis balcony is stunning and is popular with our other guests at any time of the day. So glad the team looked after you well. See you soon in Kirikiriroa again.

title: Brilliant stay at Ibis Tainui Hamilton
text:
Upon arrival was treated wonderfully by reception.  An hour later I popped down to reception to ask for a taxi to be booked for the next day and Candy (who is on reception) remembered my name.  Her great attitude and personality brightened up a stressful trip for me (was in Hamilton for hospital procedure booked for next day).  5 stars out of 5.  If I could I'd give her a higher score.  She was wonderful throughout her shift as I kept popping back to reception until after dinner.  The other reception staff were also extraordinarily wonderful, but I forgot to write down their names.
When I ordered dinner I had some  special requests.  I have dietry restrictions, Reece, the bar manager went above and beyond to make sure I got my meal editted to suit my dietry problems.... and I could tell when the meal came out that he had told the chef about my problems as the meal had been prepared and plated wonderfully for me.  So 5 stars each to Reece and the Chef.
The room was clean and well stocked with everything the average visitor could need and the bed was comfortable enough that I got some sleep even with my health and mobility problems.
If you want a lovely place to stay while in Hamilton with awesome staff then I highly (happily) recommend Ibis Tainui Hamilton.

title: Small room close to restaurant row
text: The room is the size of a dorm room (except no closet). We had a king bed overlooking the river (small window). Luckily we travel light (from the US). So only carry on bags. No room for luggage. The room was clean and the bed comfortably. The hotel is close to a lot of restaurants and shopping. It’s good for one night

title: another great visit.
text:
Great friendly greeting from check in until we checked out. Refurbished rooms since we last stayed and they are lovely.
breakfast as usual great!, special mention to the hostess (been there for 16 years!),

title: Above average for an Ibis hotel, excellent restaurant.
text:
This is a very nice Ibis hotel. It is in the cbd adjacent to the river. It's sister hotel Novotel is next door. We only stayed one night, were upgraded to a river view room on the 7th floor. I liked the recent refurbishments which reflected the maori (indigenous) heritage of the area and there were lots of nice touches in the decor.
We slept well on comfy and firm beds. Our accor gold status was recognised at checkin.

We arrived in in the evening and parked on the street which was free after 6pm. Noted other reviewers comments on the valet parking charges which we didn't require. The first two hours are free during the day. See parking meter photo for details.
We enjoyed a fabulous meal in the Ibis restaurant, using our Accorplus discount. The food was excellently prepared and well above the standard expected at Ibis properties. The breakfast was included in our rate and very nice.  

I would stay again if visiting Hamilton. NZ is not a cheap place to visit now post covid so I thought this property represented reasonable value for the room rate.

title: Fabulous for social events
text:
Had my husbands 60th birthday meal here along - the food and table decorations were superb. The staff were fantastic and extremely helpful. The buffet breakfast the next morning was excellent - too many choices. 
Would highly recommend a social event here.

title: A better view
text: Would totally recommend this hotel.  A wonderful hotel with wonderful staff that you can almost hear say welcome home. Laid back and relaxed atmosphere. We had a lovely room with a river view. Everything is clean and well maintained. A very big thank you for a lovely stay and a warm welcome. Food and drinks also awesome.

title: review of our stay in June 2023 hotel has valet parking and nice restaurant though the selection could have been better
text: this hotel I would thoroughly recommend, staff were friendly and helpful and the room was modern and clean and bed was comfortable and the restaurant was modern  though there could have been a better selection on the menu

title: The best yet…
text:
The whole experience was fantastic. .I’m not a very good sleeper but I slept the whole night the beds where so comfortable…
The staff where magnificent, specially Amanda , polite professional and nothing was a problem..made our stay great…will definitely stay again…

Stayed here for one night as my partner had heights training in Hamilton the next day. 
I do recommend advertising it better on your website that you charge $32 for overnight parking as we were told that the casino “down the road” had free parking, We had been parked for 10 minutes but ended up getting charged $8 for trying to park and look for someone to speak with to get help at skyline as the ibis staff just point directly down the road with no instructions. 
As someone not from Hamilton this was extremely exhausting at 12am. 
We finally make it back to our room just to be told the person next to us is complaining about how loud we shut the door. 

As a staff member of Accor this did not give me the heartist feeling of being at any other and actually made me feel quiet uncomfortable. 

One of the face towels in our bathroom seemed like it was already used because it was wet. Food rubbish under the bed. 

On a good note the house keeping lady and maintenance crew are extremely friendly and welcoming and I do want to thank the overnight person for finding us a park so late. Slept well just didn’t get enough of it. Disappointed with the stay

title: Good enough
text:
Not a bad place to stay overall, though I never entered the restaurant etc. Room clean enough. No compendium was annoying, I had to figure out the WiFi myself, and too bad if I was wanting any other general information. 
The valet parking should be optional, as I was not at all pleased or comfortable leaving my car and my keys who knows where. I would have checked straight back out but it was too late in the day for a 6 hour drive home.  I wouldn't stay again for this reason.

title: Room wasnt serviced.
text: This Hotel reopened on the day I checked in with a colleagues for 11 room nights. We were attanding Fieldays so early starts and late nights. On my second evening I returned to my room at 7pm. It was not serviced. I went to reception and was told there is a lack of staff in NZ. No excuse. Not only had housekeeping overlooked it but also the managerial staff. What was strange was the airconditioning had been chaned so someone had been in my room. I raised it at check out with the manager wh said he had read my complaint but did not contact me or leave a hone message. I checkout four days ago and still no contactas he promised. Not a good start IBIS.

title: FRESH
text:
My stay was only a matter of a few days after the re-opening after a massive refurbishment. We will know what to expect from a Ibis Hotel but this would now have to be one of their flagship properties.
It is very fresh, well furnished. Fresh new paint. Great linen and soft bath towels. The new covered balcony overlooking the Waikato River is great and well appointed. Staff are very friendly and appear to love their jobs.
Certainly would stay here again. Great work Ibis with your refresh

title: Not where you want to experience MIQ!
text: An MIQ experience not to be repeated. The room was clean with a huge bed but the shower room was tiny and the food was, with a few exceptions, horrible. The staff were all pleasant but the whole experience was horrible. The window didn't open so I was limited to recycled air and portable air units dotted along the corridor. The irony of this was watching a "freedom" protest parade outside through my non-opening window.  The two exercise areas were limited in size and I didn't feel were large enough to be safe or separated sufficienly from others. The hotel did offer a limited snack/drink service but this wasn't great.

title: Pleasant 4 night stay.
text:
Two average things about this hotel - cleanlieness and noise. 
 bathroom was a bit unclean around the shower joints and had chipped paint. Shows its age.
 Bread crumbs on the pullout thing above the fridge was a bit yuck.
Walls are thin I could hear people showering, slamming doors etc but this is to be expected at any hotel. Also there was no way to keep air con on throughout the day without your card plugged in so stinking hot when returning from a day at work.
Two great things about this hotel- the incredible breakfast buffet, and staff member Poppy. We had to get up early for work, I would not have survived without Poppys incredible coffees. She also offered a lot of great advice on places to see during our stay in Hamilton.
My bed was always made lovely and tea/coffee/soap topped up daily. That was nice to come back too after a long day.
I felt safe at this hotel (although a smokers area so I could vape would have been nice) . it was in an excellent location in the centre of town close to work and many eateries, also right by the Centre Place mall. 
Overall, I really enjoyed my stay at Ibis and would stay again. From Kat and Amanda rooms 689 and 5(74?)

The breakfast was also an extra 25NZD per person each day but it was a much wider variety then expected. The staff at the Ibis were excellent and very helpful.

title: A nice surprise
text: We stayed at the Ibis Hamilton Tainui for 2 nights. We were treated to one of their themed rooms (thank you Elton) so we slept in what resembled a glow worm cave.  Room was comfortable and quiet.  Breakfast each morning was on good quality.  Valet parking is available at $25 per night - there is no free parking in the vicinity.  It is close to the Novotel which has an excellent restaurant.

title: Good hotel to stay in
text:
Good hotel to stay in, which is centrally located alongside the river in Hamilton.

Quite clean rooms, with a good bar/restaurant area available.

Close to CBD and Starcity Casino. 

Parking available on site for $25 per night, alternately parking is a short walk away at the Casino.

title: Dumbfounded
text:
I'm not a fussy person, but this was next level ridiculous.

For two hours + when the housekeeping staff arrived (a Saturday morning) they were making conversation with each other at the top of their lungs. Talking about how they couldn't wait to start drinking, banging and crashing around, and being downright rowdy.

My partner and I had a long drive ahead of us so we needed to sleep in and had a late checkout booked. Waste of time. 
Couldn't even begin to sleep.

They were even looking through the peephole in the door because we could hear them laughing about how they could just see feet hanging off the bed. Then my partner put a post-it note over it. They were later heard to be saying "they've put something to cover over the hole!"

Amongst all this was joking/yelling "wake up!" and calling out our room number.

The front desk called us to confirm the checkout time (despite us doing so on booking and check in), so it appeared the housekeeping staff had not been notified so thought it was hilarious to make noise to wake us up.

There was a point where they played an alarm sound on a phone or something right outside the door.

I don't really know what else to say.. It's beyond appalling that staff (and humans) like this are in a hospitality environment..

The room wasn't amazingly made up upon arrival but that was the least of our worries.

title: Comfortable Stay
text: Was booked in a Superior 1 King Bed Riverside Room, expected a room with a River view, however the room overlooked the car park on the city side of the building. Comfy bed and quiet made for a good night's sleep.

title: Beware of extra breakfast charges!
text:
Stayed here February 2019. Overheard the couple in front of me disputing $25 breakfast charges on check-in (they had booked the $1 breakfast special online) so remembered to keep an eye out for this when I checked out as I'd also booked the $1 breakfast special. Sure enough, on check out they gave me an invoice showing a $25 breakfast charge AND a $1 breakfast charge so I pulled them up on this. I didn't even end up having breakfast in the end either so I don't know how this happened. Be sure to check...

OTHERWISE a great stay. Very comfortable big bed. Small bathroom but it was just me staying for the night so it was fine. Good TV and range of channels. Two minute wall from the Centre Place mall so it's in a great location. Will stay again but will be conscious to check for no sneaky charges on check-out.

title: Budget Stay Good but nothing great.
text: Staff is helpful.Rooms are small.View is excellent,we were there for Ind vs Nz match,could see the round from our room.River flowing right alongside the hotel.Located at the centre of city.Drawback no free Wifi-these days all hotels have this.

title: Hamilton Gem
text: Very friendly and helpful staff, comfy bed, clean room. Great breakfast with lots of options. Awesome location, short stroll to restaurants, cafes and shopping. Highly recommend, will be back for sure!

title: No frills comfort
text:
Agree with previous review. If you want luxury, this isn’t for you but bed was comfy, room was clean and overall stay was fine. Great central location and staff helpful and friendly. 
Haven’t eaten any meals there so can’t comment on food

title: Ibis Hamilton Excellent Location
text: Great location in middle of town close to local attractions, good value for money, breakfast/dinner great with excellent service,reception staff very friendly and professional, room very clean & quiet overlooking the river

title: don't waste your money, a hotel that cannot deliver what promised with poor health conditions
text:
Fellow travelers, especially those traveling with kids, please think twice before booking with this hotel. Just want to share with you all my recent staying experience:

1/ a baby cot was requested during booking, and phoned the hotel weeks before check-in to confirm the baby cot, additional confirmation has done when actually check-in, however, when open the door for our room, not seeing a baby cot at all.

2/ room filled with dust which was accumulated over months, you can see a layer of quite obvious dust on the furniture and wardrobes, plus a half bottle of shampoo has been left in the wardrobes.

3/ after a night sleep, my infant daughter got about 8-10 red bites on her face and arms.

4/ after our complaining on the following morning, they clean the room, but what I still can see that the Bible on the fridge still have a layer of dust on the cover.

5/ manager told me that there should be no bed bug in their rooms as they checked 3 months ago, and all of there rooms were full in the last few weeks, what a joke!

6/ if fully booked in the last weeks, is that means all the guests were stayed in the room full of dust?

7/ another small thing, curtain is jammed, not able to fully close.

This hotel is simply just not worth your time to considering, no mention to spend your hard earned money with them.

title: No-frills comfort
text: Convenient location and excellent service. This no-frills offering from the Accor group gets the most important thing right - a comfortable night's sleep. Forget the rest of the furnishings and fittings, if the bed is right, everything seems right.

title: Two night stay
text:
We booked here for two nights visit from Sydney to visit relatives.  We found the bed comfortable, but very soft pillows which were changed for us without any problem.  I was surprised, and disappointed NOT to have a safe in the room, as this hotel appears to be aimed at business men.  We were also surprised with the size of the hanging wardrobe.  which we thought a little small.  The design of the room could have been a bit better thought out, with the door of the bathroom hung on the other side..  At the moment, when one or other uses the bathroom at night, the door opens into the main room, and the light shines directly into the sleeping area.  For those of us who are light sleepers, this is annoying.

We enjoyed the breakfast although at $25 it was not cheap.  During our visit the hotel was hosting a large number of groups who were there for the rugby sevens, and large areas of the restaurant/bar area were reserved for them, making us feel somewhat like extras on a film set.  

It is a budget hotel, and as we have a four star guest house ourselves in the Uk, and travel extensively ourselves for holidays, Im not too sure that I would choose to return, although it did the job for this visit.

title: Quick trip to visit the Hamilton Gardens
text: I have stayed her before and even though basic, its great value and in a perfect location.  The boardwalk along the river is a great way to start or end the day and the rooms are comfortable.  We had two rooms interconnecting, my husband and I had the king room and my mother and daughter had the other room which consisted of a single bed and queen bed.  We paid $278 for the two rooms on Jan 1st 2019.  They were basic but clean, shower was good, bathroom is small but had everything you needed.  Bed were very comfortable (the beds have toppers on them) view of the river was lovely.   We ate in the restaurant and were very happy with our meals of Steak (melted in your mouth), scallops (big ones from Northland - yum) and Mexican Chicken Salad (Big but good).  Will stay again, great value!

title: Don't ask for room 478...
text:
The fridge is so noisy you have trouble sleeping every time it goes through its cooling cycle!. The roof in the bathroom was falling down because the sprinkler was leaking and there was electrics from the light involved...
Breakfast where do I start - "crispy bacon" is what was advertised - what you get is warm at best and soggy - it may have been crisp in another lifetime. The scrambled eggs had about 1/2 an inch of water at the bottom of them - not great and not sure I would spend the $1 on it again. On checkout this morning there was about a 20 minute wait because there was not enough staff on - about 8-10 people queueing. Overall a disappointing stay. Ibis you need to lift your game.

title: Great location, great service...

title: Reasonable stay
text:
The hotel overall is clean and tidy. Bed was firm but comfortable enough. Room was quiet and clean. Staff were fantastic, very knowledgeable, helpful and polite.
Buffet breakfast overall was good but I would have just stuck to continental if I was paying. Cooked food was very average. The way the bacon was cooked was unpleasant and almost waxlike without flavour which was disappointing. 
Valet parking was helpful without convenient self parking facilities available.
The fridge in the room is also very noisy almost unbearable when at full volume.

title: Lovely!
text:

Super central location. Quiet. Comfort. Valet parking. The staff are attentive and friendly which is great! Lots of positives.

A negative, for me, was the cooked breakfast buffet. It just wasn’t nice. The bacon was super over cooked and terrible. The egg were not nice and undercooked. The non cooked options were good and fairly tasty. But I’m not sure how you manage to mess up bacon and eggs two days in a row.

title: Easy to find, great breakfast

Room is typical Ibis, tiny, functional and clean.  Breakfast buffet spread was excellent -- 6 hot food choices, many choices for cereal/muesli, yogurts, fresh fruit and bread.

title: Poor value

But the food was good and not unreasonably priced. Next time ill eat in the restaurant it will be easier!

title: Always reliable

title: 1 night stay

The bed was comfy and shower pressure fairly good, so the things you want out of a short stay- wouldn’t want to stay longer in the single room, but was food for what we needed.

title: Comfortable bed, good service
text: We stayed at the Ibis for one night (Friday). Check in was quick and easy (Accor member), our booking included breakfast however this was not registered with the hotel. Situation was sorted quickly once I showed the confirmation email. Our room was very clean and was a good size for a one night stay. I asked for an extra towel (there is rarely an extra one for hair washing/drying), no hand towel was provided. The bed was very comfortable as were the pillows. We parked at the casino as this was cheaper/free as a Skycity member. All staff members we encountered were friendly and helpful. Breakfast was a pretty standard buffet; no complaints tho. The Hamilton Ibis is overall a good quality hotel in a central location; great if you are planning on going to the casino and CBD. One of the better Ibis hotels in NZ. Would stay again.

title: Little Gem
text: Great location in CBD.  The bed was one of the best we ever slept on.  Although the room and bathroom was not huge, it was big enough and very clean.  As an Accor member, I had to complain.  I booked in on line and the counter where we can book in fast after that was unattended and I had to wait in line.  Again, as Accor member we got free WIFI and it was nice and fast.  The breakfast was excellent and totally worth the price. Parking can be a problem as they have valet parking or you can park at the casino. This place was in total lovely to stay at.

title: Overnight stay
text: Stayed here for one night while on a rugby trip, the staff were attentive to get me checked in but then failed to provide any information as to room location, restaurant , breakfast. I had to ask for  valet parking. The room was standard Ibis style with small bathroom. There were far to many room cards scattered all over the place advising on different policies and the like. Facilities in the room were comfortable other than the pillows which lacked any sort of loft.

title: Excellent stay
text: We booked a 3-night stay at the hotel online and took advantage of the discounted pre-booked meal offer. The 2-course meal plus drink was excellent value and delicious. The location of the hotel is central - an easy walk into the centre of Hamilton as well to the beautiful Waikato riverside walking path. The room was clean, tidy and comfortable. The breakfast buffet (also part of the online package) was good and we enjoyed the option of sitting on the dining area's outside balcony and watching the commuters come across the bridge into the city.

title: not to bad
text: the room was what you would expect from any hotel....but was dirty in the bathroom. the guest card had been filled out by the people who stayed before us and the welcome pack had food stains/ maybe blodd on it

title: ACCOR Should be Ashamed
text:
First, -- let me say that most of the staff at this hotel are lovely and most helpful. 

So, all the more shame that this property needs HELP. So many fundamental things are wrong w/ this Ibis Hamilton Tainui that need NOT be. 

#1 The elevators in this hotel look like grungy elevators in a urban blight project. Change the crappy carpets, fill the holes, paint the walls!

#2 The florescent lights in the rooms are OTToo much light by far. And there's no way to turn on a nice in-room night-light that does not make the room look like a Toledo Dunkin Donuts @ 2am.

#3 I went out for the day and when the room was cleaned and the air was left on at a chill temp. Upon my return my room was ice COLD. I could not for the life of me get the thermostat to turn to heat. I got under the blankets.

#4 After a long day, I simply wanted room service...there is none. Guests come down to pick up their own trays...REALLY?? -- and my sandwich and fries were the most unappetizing looking, and tasting meal that I have been given from a (supposed) restaurant kitchen in years. I was appalled. After looking at it for 15 minutes, I took it back downstairs & absolutely embarrassed whomever was on duty by giving it back.

ALL 4 of these negatives could be dealt with & managed. SO, why not?

title: Weekend with the girls fail
text: I hate to say it but it fell very short of what was to be expected of a hotel of this reputation, some helpful staff but not many, the room not too clean and the breakfast was quite bad . The valet took well over 30 mins but there were other guests waiting a lot longer than us .

title: One night in Hamilton
text:
My company booked me in here for my 2nd Night in Hamilton I spent the night before at the sister hotel the Novotel, pricier and bigger.
I checked in and left my bag earlier but was told I could check in my room as it was ready The room itself was smaller than the novotel but that didn't bother me. The first thing I noticed when I walked in my room was the freshly laundered bedding. Very nice! Never smelt that before in any hotel room.
The bed was comfy enough and I had a pretty good sleep. My view overlooked the river, so a nice view. Very quiet.
Ordered room service when I first arrived in my room. I was explained I had to pick up my food which I didn't have an issue with. When I did return to my room however my card had stopped working. Luckily one of the cleaners let me in.
The food was very tasty. Had the nachos earlier on and in the morning had the breakfast.
I parked my car downstairs however it wouldn't start when I tried to pick it up. Battery had died. Not a problem for the helpful guys on the desk. They all quickly came to my aid to get my car going. Thanks for the help boys. 
Overall a pleasant night and I have to say out of the two hotels, I actually preferred the IBIS over the Novotel anyway the staff seemed friendlier and the service was better.

title: A 3 night stay for business and pleasure
text: The staff at the Ibis are committed to serving the clients who walk through the hotel's front door.  Each staff member greets newly arrived clients with a smile and any issues are handled in a professional manner.  The presentation of the rooms is first class and the food presented in the dining room is fresh and tasty.  The hotel is beside a beautiful scenic walk along the Waikato River.  The natural pathway is so refreshing with native foliage and large trees beside the river.  I also enjoy dining on the open verandah above the walkway as the air is so fresh and cool.

title: A good place
text: Good location if you want to be in the CBD. The staff were friendly. The room was clean. It was great to have blinds that made the room pitch black. The bed was alright to sleep in, although the pillows weren’t very comfortable. The buffet breakfast was yum, although I thought a bit expensive.

title: Average
text: We had a double with a comfortable king size bed. Lovely to have a view of the river. Bathroom more like a cubicle it was so small but adequate for our needs. Large people would find it a problem. Good tv with lots of Sky channels. No chair/sofa in room. Personally I found it expensive. Valet parking is extra and you have no choice because if park in the street you also have to pay and why would you be running down and updating the parking fee. No gym in the Hotel - for the price I would at least expect a gym or breakfast included. Have travelled extensively in UK and Europe and NZ is very expensive when it comes to decent accommodation. A negative is the railway line under the bridge, right below our room. Trains come through during the night and wake you up with noise. On arrival our reception lady was ok, I am not a fan of being asked if I had a nice day - yes - oh so what did you do?  I'm checking in - not interested in a full blown conversation with a stranger about what I did during the day. New Zealand hospitality staff need to know when to stop asking people about things like that - you can be perfectly pleasant and professional without inquiring about strangers lives.

title: Poor service, bad sleep, lousy pricing
text: I was surprised on arrival to discover that I owed an extra $20 per night for mandatory valet parking.  And when I didn't eat one of my pre-paid breakfasts, there was no refund because it was a "web deal" = same price as if I had not paid in advance.  The fridge right next to my head buzzed loudly, the bed wobbled on its legs, and my key kept failing, so I had to go get it re-set three times, and when I mentioned that, the receptionist rudely told me that "most people" know to keep the key away from their cell phone.  I didn't sleep well, I didn't feel welcome, the breakfast was not interesting.  Never go here.

title: Perfect location

title: Budget hotel...good location...very hot room
text:

I would not stay here again as it felt like a hot prison cell.

It is near all the restaurants though...which is a positive and has parking available for 20 dollars.

title: Surprisingly good
text:
I have been visiting Hamilton once a month for the last 5 years and usually stay at the Novotel around the corner from the Ibis however it was full when I went to book so I booked a room at the Ibis.
I was expecting a second rate experience compared to the Novotel however I was pleasantly surprised, yes the Hotel rooms are smaller and yes the overall feel is a little less stylish however it was still very good.

The bar has $5 beers and wine from 5pm to 6pm, definately worth visiting after a hard day working.
I will be staying here from now on.

title: Good food but ...

Not sure we would be back as prices were high but portions so small, not offering value for money (unless you book using a First Table discount)

I was looking forward to this meal but I can safely say that I will never eat here again.  Very disappointing. I expected much better quality of food. It seemed very cheap.  I expected much better.  I went home feeling like eating something nice to make up for the horrible meal I had just had.

title: It is what it is
text:
If you're looking for short term budget accommodation then this is your spot, kinda like staying in a hostel- pretty much just a basic room to lay your head but no extras like a gym or pool, although you can use the Novotel gym across the road. I did do that daily and was surprised at the difference. The Novotel is a much higher calibre accommodation for a similar rate.

We stayed in a deluxe Riverview room which I'd recommend forking out the extra $ for.  Nice and clean and a super comfortable bed! Was disappointed that there wasn't a mini bar to waste our money on. What is it about those $10 chocolate bars!  Other than that the rooms are pretty basic and the bathrooms tiny, with only one towel provided per person and no robes. 

With the absence of a mini bar, we attempted to get a snack from the vending machine but it was cash only which seems a bit irrelevant in this day and age. Failing that we decided to make use of the 24 hr room service, despite there being no menu in the room, but over a period of half an hour there was no answer from the room service extension and so, third time lucky, we ended up down in the bistro.

Luckily this turned out to be a great choice. Lovely relaxing view of the river and the cocktails weren't half bad. Food was basic but surprisingly good. Breakfast the next morning was your usual buffet fare. The wait staff were a delight and quick to clear tables and chat with us.

My only disappointment was that the website describes their cuisine type as "healthy eating". And yes there were a couple of "healthy" options available but no more than you'd expect from any standard restaurant so think they could probably lift their game in this department if they're going to advertise it in that way.

But like I said earlier, it is what it is and I guess you get what you pay for. Although I would prefer to pay a little more, or in the case of the Novotel the same or not much more, for a far superior experience.

title: Comfy Bed, central location
text: We booked a one night stay and weren't quite sure what to expect. They have a very central location which is good. We parked at the main entrance and walked in to find reception on the first floor so a walk upstairs following the signs to find it. The smells that greeted us were a mixture of stale alcohol and food. Not nice. The reception desk is at the side of the bar. Checkin was quite slow. Be aware when you book online that the charge for the room does not include parking. Valet parking is offered for $20 extra. Also they charge a credit card surcharge. The room we got was on the city side I would say if you can have a choice I would ask for a river view room. The room was clean but not flash. The bed and pillows were very comfortable and we had a good sleep in the super king bed. There is an onsite restaurant and bar. We went down for early drinks after seeing the advertising in the lift for $5 beer and wine between 5-6pm. Be aware you have to order the house wine or house beer otherwise like us and you don't realise then the drinks are full price. We then had dinner at the restaurant. The service was good. I had the salmon with coconut rice and wilted kale. The salmon was cooked perfectly but the meal was quite tasteless so a bit disappointing. Not sure if we would stay here again.

title: River View King Room
text: I was attending a conference at the Novotel but stayed at Ibis. I found the river view king room to be quite nice. Lovely view of the river and with a long desk right along the end of the room which meant there was plenty of space to work on my laptop and have all my junk spread out. A bench seat from the desk to the bed which was great for my suitcase. There was a block out blind to pull down for complete darkness which I love. The room was very sound proof to neighbouring rooms but you can hear people out in the hallway. Bed was very comfy for sleeping, a bit spongy for moving around on but the sleep was great. Yes bathroom is small but it has what you need so it's fine. The basin has plenty of bench top space to spread out all your things. Great airflow so the bathroom doesn't steam up when you shower.There isn't a shelf or caddy in the shower to put shampoo etc but it's a minor thing. Good air-con & lighting. Room has tea & coffee making facilities and a little fridge with a small freezer box. There is a modern TV also but I did not use that. The only plug on the side of the bed I used was inside the side table cubby hole and is really difficult to get to. My charger which fits multiple usb cords would not fit the space but thankfully I took a junction box which has a small normal size plug and fitted the gap and then I plugged my charger/laptop into that. There is however easy to access plugs up by the desk. I'm pretty fussy but overall I was really happy with the room. Valet parking is $20 per night which I thought was okay and they are fast at bringing your car around when you need it. Buffet breakfast was great, has all the yummy things you need for breaky and staff are always about if you need assistance with anything. Also had a meal in the restaurant which was delicious. You can order food for your room but they call you when it is ready and you have to go down and get it. A bit difficult if you are by yourself to carry a tray and get back into your room but at least it's an option if you want a quiet meal in your room. I had the beef burger which was super delicious. There is a snack machine on level 2 but it was pretty empty, not many choices and the sugar free drinks were all gone but there's a superette further up Victoria street if you feel the need for snacks. The staff were all really friendly and helpful, if you need anything just ask them. No point complaining later if you are not willing to ask for what you want or need help with, the staff are incredibly approachable. When you first get there it seems a bit weird as reception is up one level but here is a lift there so you just pop yourself and your luggage in the left and up you go, not so bad. I would definitely go back! Thanks for a great stay!
