title: Good for the business traveller
text:
I have stayed here twice in the last couple of weeks as it is accessible to where I'm working, reasonably cost effective, clean and tidy.

Finding the location for the first time visitor is slightly challenging as it sits off a side street but the location is right but the river and would be very pleasant in the summer.  The Reception is located on the first floor, along wiht the restaurant and bar.  Seating is both inside and out on an extensive balcony overlooking the river and a nearby road bridge.  There must be a set of train tracks close by but you don't really notice the noise.

My first room overlooked the river, had a large kingsize bed plus a smaller single.  The room provided all the basics, was clean and tidy and I didn't get much noise from adjoining rooms.  There were tea/coffee making facilities, a fridge, internet (not included in room price), a good selection of tv channels and a good work desk & chair .  The bed was very comfortable the sheets really felt clean and fresh.  The bathroom had the usual facilities in a tidy contained space.  Not hug but adequate.

The second stay I was located on the other side of the building, overlooking Hamilton township (and the next door car park).  However, the room was designed for a wheelchair bound guest so had great use of space plus a wonder big bathroom.  Again usual facilities and the lack of view didn't offend as I was there for business and not the views.  A light bulb had blown in the bedside table, so I removed the bulb and handed it into the reception when going out to dinner.  The counter person was more than happy to get a replacement and take it back up himself while I was out for dinner - a good sign for the hotel that their staff take ownership of the small things.

I have read the negative reviews about the restaurant and wanted to try it to see for myself.
While the menu isn't inspiring, it is tasty and the options good.  I was looking for more salad and light meal options as opposed to fat fried type food. I settled on a light entree and small main.  The service was quick, non intrusive and friendly.  While the main wasn't what I had ordered I didn't comment at the time as the option provided was actually better than what I'd ordered.  I could see it was a genuine mistake with two similar items on the menu.

Another area that has received poor reviews in the reception area.  I found the team behind the counters to be very efficient in moving people through the check in and out process, they were professionally friendly and to their credit they didn't get stressed when the queues backed up around to the lift.  

My only comment is about wifi and is common across most hotels.  Wifi should be included in the room cost.  So many business travellers work at night and it is a nice extra to have free wifi, one less hassle and expense line to complete.

I will be staying here again and would recommend to others.

title: Theft during stay
text: Stayed here the weekend of Dec 3-4 and not even an hour into our check in an item goes missing in our room. Checked in at around 12:30 in the afternoon with only a small paper bag from the mall a block away from the hotel. My husband was in a meeting and he had our luggages in the car still so all i had was my wallet my phone and something i bought at the Centre Place Mall. Few minutes after check in my son decided he wanted to buy food from the mall again so we went leaving the small paper bag. Made sure door locked behind us as you can never be too sure. Anyway after maybe 30-35 mins we were back and i noticed some things were moved around the room like the glass i used for drinking was back in it's original spot on the desk,etc. i assumed it was housekeeping so i didnt think much of it until i peeped into the paper bag as it was also moved from where i put it. The item was gone! And this was barely an hour after checking in!!! Called reception was told they'll look into it after few hours of back and forth was told as per their records i was the only one who entered and exited the room. I got really upset as i was pretty sure it wasn't my imagination that my property had gone missing and things were moved about, reception then admitted that actually housekeeping had been in the room and they'll look into it and update me.had to go to reception myself around 7pm to check what was happening and was told item was in fact already in reception reported LOST by housekeeping. They claimed it was just sitting on the bed so housekeeping brought it to reception. I mean what kind of lame excuse is that?!?!? First of all the item was INSIDE the paper bag when i left, I hadn't even taken out of the bag since buying it! Second if it has been there reported as lost the whole time then why didn't they tell me that in the first place. Lastly I was checked into my room still, whatever I leave lying about the place if i did decide to leave whatever is my business and shouldn't end up in lost and found!i did not even get any apology just this lame excuse which i find so lame and unacceptable. I have emailed accor hotels and sent a feedback thru their automated feedback form but NO RESPONSE! What a crappy hotel, ruined my whole weekend!!! I will keep posting my complaint in all travel sites as they seem to be turning a deaf ear about the issue maybe then they'll listen!!!

title: Disappointed
text:
On entering the Ibis Hamilton you are met with the smell of a public toilet...there's no reception on the ground floor and confusing signage. On following said signage to what I thought was the reception, I found myself in the aforementioned toilets! An elderly couple took pity on me and directed me to the lifts and the first floor reception (they admitted to doing the exact same thing as me when they first arrived at the hotel).

As a woman travelling on my own I felt slightly intimidated walking in to a rowdy "happy hour"...the reception desk is an extension of the bar. The two blokes working the reception desk were polite but not overly welcoming.

My room was on the second floor...as you get out of the lifts you are greeted by a series of huge stains on the carpet and a hostel-type snack machine which obscures the room number directions so it takes a minute to figure out how the room numbering works.

My room was clean and had everything you need for a basic single night stay, the bed was big and comfortable and there were no issues with the room temp. The paint on the walls in the bathroom had lifted away, particularly around the sink, cracked in others and the carpet in the room was both stained and threadbare in places.

I ordered an evening meal which was problematic as I wanted something without dairy products and the person on the other end of the phone really didn't have a clue about the dishes on the menu (incidentally, the one in my room was ripped and stained with what I assumed to be coffee). There's no room service as such...you have to go and collect your meal from the restaurant and then wrestle it back to your room. My meal was decidedly average and I think if I was forced to stay here again, I would order in from a local restaurant.

I have stayed in several Ibis hotels around New Zealand while travelling for work and while you definitely know you are in a 3 star hotel, they have never disappointed me like  the Ibis Hamilton did. If I need to go to Hamilton again for work, I will look for somewhere else to stay...this hotel is a tad nasty!!!

The room itself was OK a lot smaller than others we had stayed in, but had the basics, a mini fridge, tea & coffee making facilities, iron, etc. The reception is on the first floor which is unusual and meant that we had to lug our bags up a flight of stairs. The room manifesto claims that the staff undertake a stringent training program & whilst they were pleasant enough, we found them a bit lax in their attitudes and level of service. We were unable to access the pay to view movies, when we rang for assistance they tried to help over the phone but then could not be bothered to actually come to the room to fix the problem. There was a party in the venue with a lot of loud revelry, which is not usually a problem, but it went well into the wee small hours meaning we did not get much sleep. We ate at the bistro & the food was nice enough though they forgot to bring our bread. We also let them know at reception that we were intending on leaving early so we could drive to the glow worm caves in the morning. We had valet parking and wanted our car by 7:15am so we could head off. We checked out and waited, and waited, they brought out 2 cars that they assured us were ours but sadly wasn't. It took them an hour to get our car back to us, so we could be on our way. You would think that when they offer & charge you for a valet service that they would not loose your car! Basically it did not live up to the hype of their brochure which was disappointing.

title: Business not pleasure
text: The Ibis is consistent no matter where you go. I wouldn't stay here unless it was for work. There is nothing pleasurable or luxurious about it. There is no room service or other guest facilities which make your stay enjoyable.  It's really just a place to lay your head. The shower is so compact that I'd hate to imagine how to pick up a dropped soap without backing my butt back out the door. Also, the empty fridge was so noisy I had to get up in the middle of the night to turn it off. It's fine  as long as you know what you're getting.

title: Good Ibis
text:
Having stayed in a few Ibis hotels I was not excited to see I was booked into another.
However this Ibis wasn't at all that bad. The room was your standard basic hotel room with a small bathroom. What makes this Ibis a little bit special is its location. Sitting on the bank of the river it is a great place to enjoy a beer in the evening or a nice breaky in the morning. 
It's smack bang in the middle of the Hamilton CBD.
I had no problem with the staff and found them polite and friendly.
For those wanting a bit more of everything I note there is a Novotel right next door.

title: Annerversary

title: All you could wish for and great value
text:

The reception staff were exceptionally helpful and friendly, giving us great value options for parking our car, upgrading our twin room - nothing too much trouble. Our room was most comfortable, quite small, but everything one could want.
Breakfast was to a very high standard with a lovely eating either inside or outside on a large balcony overlooking beautiful trees, the river and stunning bridge.
A modern very well run city hotel, and would certainly stay again on future visits.

title: Reconfirm your booking!!
text:
We had a booking with this hotel which was booked & paid for 5 months prior to our arrival. It was the only place I did not reconfirm as it was paid in full. When we arrived, they had no record of our booking or payment & I was made to feel like an idiot, was told I may be booked elsewhere! After showing my booking confirmation & proof of payment to reception they suddenly found my booking and asked me if my name was John! Don't think too many females are called John!! No apologies, nothing! After we got the booking issue sorted, it was down to business! We were told check out was at 11am & requested a later check out & agreed on 12pm & were told it would be noted. Next morning, because we didn't need to rush we went out for a walk & on our return to our room around 11.30am received a call from reception enquiring as to when we would be checking out & were met with surprise that we has a late check out. Obviously no note had been made! To be perfectly honest we couldn't wait to leave!
On top of this, we were meeting a friend at the hotel on the day of our arrival & were running a bit late, he went to see if we had checked in & was abruptly told they had no booking in our name (go away), he was left completely confused as I had emailed him a copy of our booking details! They have huge signs everywhere telling everyone how wonderful they are at solving problems - obviously not!! We did ask on checking out what they would of done if they did not have a room available, unfortunately we didn't get a response! Customer service is certainly lacking. They did waive the parking fee when we were checking out, big deal!! Very disappointed!

title: Police action threatened!
text:
Thoroughly disappointed with our recent stay at the Ibis which turned a celebratory weekend sour.

After attending our close friends wedding that day we (two couples) returned to the Ibis around midnight and sat in our room chatting about the day. Within 2 min of being in our room we received a call from reception stating "there is no talking allowed in the rooms at night, if you want to talk you must come and sit in the lobby". Utterly shocked i apologised but asked if this is the case then why are there TVs in the room that? I stated we were talking at a normal volume and not at all making a nuisance. When we went to retrieve our room service snack 15min later (2x extremely expensive sad pizzas) we were again warned that room talking was not permitted and if we continued the "police would be called" and "we would be arrested and have to leave the hotel"... At this stage my shock was full blown. I made it known to the gentleman that my companions were in fact being very quiet, not at all causing a serious problem and that threatening police action was an utter embarrassment to the Ibis hotel. After this second threat we decided to disband. 

In the morning, my husband and i were awoken at 8am to several children running up and down the corridor playing with the key cards. It was at this point i realised there is not a shred of soundproofing in the rooms. This was further confirmed by our friends who heard their neighbours having ahem 'relations' and using the 'facilities' several times during the night.

The utter lack of soundproofing in a hotel is disappointing and the threats of arrest were ridiculous and offensive. We will never stay at an Ibis or recommend it. We took a chance on a cheap room rate and we're thoroughly disappointed. 

Two thumbs down.
  
One star for room cleanliness.

It was a good location in Hamilton, with several great restaurants (like Scotts Epicurean) just down the street.  Wi-Fi was limited, but adequate, as is the case through most of New Zealand.

title: Excellent location, friendly staff, comfortable if basic rooms.
text:
I'm learning that the Ibis brand is more basic than I thought; but the Ibis staff sometimes make up for it.  Here, I arrived tired and a bit dishevelled, travelling with too many bags on my way back to the UK - and was greeted as if I looked fresh as a daisy and was just the person the staff had hoped would turn up!

The room has what you need and nothing more. It's understandable, but does feel a bit 'mean' somehow.

The restaurant had a limited set of options, but the waitress was happy for me to make up a slightly odd meal of starters and sides that was just right for me.  And the bar area looks out over the river, so I waited for my onward connection in the morning, sitting out on the balcony with a cold drink and a seriously cool view.

There's a rail track and a main road past one side of the hotel; if you are on that side, I can imagine it might get noisy so if that matters to you, ask to be away from there or on an upper level.  And, of course, there is the option of a river view; though I would expect that to come at a premium.  There is an elevator so you don't have to fight with heavy bags, and they will hold baggage for you on departure day.  
This hotel puts you in easy walking distance of the city centre if you want shops; and right on the riverside if you want a walk.

title: Exactly what you'd expect
text:
There's something to be said for the consistency of the Ibis properties.  No matter where you go in the world, you know exactly what to expect from the properties, so there's no surprises, nasty or otherwise, with the stays.

Absolutely ample for what I required from the property - i.e. somewhere to sleep while attending a conference at the local Claudelands conference centre.  The room was clean and tidy, with the expected amenities.  Good water pressure in the bathroom, the blackout blind always helpful.

On top of this, the location is superb - a 15min walk from the conference centre, right in the middle of town and close to the cinema and restaurant strip.  The restaurant and bar area also looks out over the Waikato River, and is an ideal place for a glass o' vino after work or before heading out for dinner.  

The service received was also prompt and friendly throughout the stay.  There were a few niggly little problems - -my reservation wasn't 100% on check-in, my key stopped working on two separate occasions, and on the second wasn't easily fixed (didn't matter I was checking out anyway), and on the second day the wireless network crashed completely throughout the property, although once again not a big deal as I had data on my device anyway.  But the staff dealt with these with grace, so they can be overlooked.

Overall, if you're looking for a nice, neat tidy room in the middle of the city with friendly staff, you could do much worse.

title: Great for business travel.
text:
I stayed on business over two weekends in May 2015.
Rooms are compact but clean and the decor new-ish. The bathroom is very compact but usable. The beds are very clean, crisp and comfortable. The TV is a tiny wall-mounted 17 inch screen, you'll have to go to the bar if you want to watch the game. Parking is $20 per day and cars must be parked by the valet (reception staff) and you need to give 15 mins notice to have your car brought back. There is no room service although you can go down to the restaurant to pick up and take food back to your room. The restaurant is disappointing. One staff member takes your order, serves your meal and clears plates, whilst simultaneously manning the bar and the coffee machine. All well and good unless there is a traveling sports team in the bar in which case you'll have to wait for your waitress to pour ALL their drinks before coming back to you. The bar is next to the restaurant and reception in an open plan area so a quiet dinner will be out of the question once the team gets a few drinks under their belts. Mains are good - I've tried the sirloin and lamb shank, but the desserts very small portions for your $15. The chocolate mousse was the volume of perhaps two shot glasses. There was more of the shortbread garnish than of the chocolate mousse, but the brownie was good. 
Clean, functional with good service. Great for business or couples, but not a family holiday kind of place. The accommodation is good value, but eat elsewhere if you can.

Three things that impacted the stay negatively was the parking cost, which was $15 and located over at Skycity. The other negative was the fridge in our room was really loud and would make quite a bit of noise at night which interrupted my sleep a bit. Overall, it was a good hotel. Good value and a reasonably pleasant stay.

title: Business trip to Hamy
text:
I travel often and stay in Hotels all over New Zealand. The Ibis Tainui is well situated with a great view over the river (if you get a room on the river side - otherwise you get a view of the parking garage building) 
Its situated smack bam in the centre of down town so easy to get to anything really. The rooms are not extremely large but comfortable and clean.  The rooms are light tight adding to a good night’s sleep.  Of the 3 pillows I couldn’t find one that I liked but I still managed to have reasonable nights rest. The bathroom is small but practical but I would have preferred a shower attachment opposed to the fixed shower head - that’s just a preference though.  The staff are really friendly and the valet service for vehicles is a nice to have.
The TV in the room is tiny and does not have a clear picture - it’s very fuzzy like in the days when we had tube TV's and worked of an antenna. The menu also isn’t particularly easy to navigate, probably because you can’t really see clearly what’s on the screen.
I have stayed here before and recall the dinner in the restaurant wasn’t worth the price so I went to one of the close by restaurants for a great dinning out experience.
I tried breakfast. The continental breakfast is OK and well-priced - with that said you can’t really stuff up a continental breakfast.
The full breakfast on the other hand was not good to say the least. The quality really bad. I had to fish the odd bean out of the baked bean sauce, the scrambled eggs looked like shlop in bowl grrr . .  The bacon looked like it was cooked the night before and without love - clomps of bacon stuck together. The sausages didn’t look any better. The hash brown on the other hand was the star of the full breakfast - really crispy and tasty. Was the full breakfast worth the money - No. 
You are better off having breakfast at one of the nearby cafes. I wish to add that the setting for the restaurant is really beautiful overlooking the river. Great for afternoon and evening drink. Talking about drink - Happy hour drinks at $5 between 5-6pm.

All and all a good stay - But I would eat at the restaurant. I’d rather patronise the restaurants and cafes in the area after have a few dinks on the relaxing deck. I would probably stay here again 

title: Daughters Birthday
text:
We travelled to Hamilton from Auckland, 

Check in was a breeze as was dinner. 

We went to our Daughter's birthday and returned back to the Ibis at about 2.00 hours! 

To our surprise no one was at the check in desk (we needed to drop the car keys in), after waiting for 20 mins someone finally turned up. 

We asked where he was to which he replied ''I was busy'' 

We then asked for room service, Firstly asking for hot chips, which he said they can't do; which was fine so we opted for two ham and cheese toasties. 

It took over 40 minutes waiting before we finally called and asked where our food was ''we are waiting on hot chips'' was the reply, once again we were disappointed as having previously being told they cannot prepare hot chips! 

Overall a 8/10 stay, Lack of communication looses the 9/10 rating

title: Reasonable value good location

title: Holy Hell
text: Chose the Ibis on location - wanted inner city accommodation - yep it was good.  Reception - Young Sara was lovely.  Bad things,  Room too small, not enough bedding, really cold and no electric blankets.  Two people in the room only one drinking glass and one spoon.   Room was clean but needs Jiff taken to the walls to take off the marks.   Parking - there was none, you had to pay either $20 a day for parking with Ibis staff parking your car.  Or you could park under the Novotel Motel which was a short work but $15 for everytime you came in and out.   Wi Fi $8 an hour - really expensive when most motels offer free Wi Fi or charge $4 an hour.   We paid $119 per night, with $20 a day parking.   So if you think you are getting a cheap room be warned.  Tainui you need to spend some money on the interior, paint chipping off the wall in the corridors, cobwebs in the entrance way.

title: Stay spoilt by credit card commission on charge
text:
We stayed due to location although I have stayed many times with my previous employer and knew it to be acceptable.
Our stay was ok but our room very noisy.
Staff were polite but quite uninterested.

Our stay was completely spoilt on leaving by being charged 1.5% because we paid by credit card. This is unacceptable and I was not even told until it was being processed and I questioned the price change. Customers understand if you do not take certain credit cards as the commission is high but a MasterCard is only 2% - if told I could have switched to Eftpos. I own a business and would never consider on charging the commission - my customers would stay away if I did.

I expected better from Accor - it is the principle of the thing !

title: Was an ok stay for one night
text:
The Check in staff was not overly helpful and the set up to get to reception is really weird. You walk in and then either go up stairs or in the lift up one level to get to reception. 

The room was nice and tidy but the TV was tiny so we didn't bother using it at all as you could barely see anything from the beds. We used the stairwell as we were only 2 floors up however again a weird setup as you can only exit the stairwells on level 1 or ground; you can't walk up them to your floor. They were also really dirty and had a bad smell in them. 

The Valet parking was full so we were told to park at Skycity down the way a bit and we would get a validated price of NZD15.00 for a nights parking. I was told this was on the basis that we had to leave our car there for the night so once it was parked we were stuck in that area not allowing us to go out and view the city really. Also if you go to the casino they validate the parking ticket for only NZD5.00 so this would be a better option instead. 

Overall, I've stayed in worse places but this was definitely not up to the standard of Ibis that I know.

title: Perfect for a quick stay
text:
My 'very good' rating is definitely taking the price into account - I got a good deal that included a $20 voucher that basically paid for breakfast, through their website.
Checkin was a bit slow, due to the two reception staff having to deal with a number of things at once, but once I actually got someone, it was nice and smooth.
The standard rooms are small but perfectly functional, especially if there's just one of you. For two people for more than one night, it might start to feel a bit crowded. There's no free wifi, but I've yet to stay anywhere in NZ that has free wifi, so that's to be expected.
The major downside would be the noise - I don't think I've ever stayed anywhere where the guests bang around so much. However, this isn't really the hotel's fault - it's a cheap hotel near the casino and it was still technically holiday time for a lot of people. I've stayed here before and not noticed the other guests at all. Also, the fridge is pretty noisy - as I often do, I ended up turning it off when I wanted to sleep.
Breakfast was again at the level you'd expect for an Ibis - good without being particularly outstanding in any regard.
I know from previous experience that parking can be tricky - this time I just parked on the street, and that was fine, because I was out before 8am.
Both reception and breakfast staff were attentive and friendly. I'd recommend the standard rooms at the Ibis Tainui if you just need a place for a night or two, and especially if you like a central location.

title: Intruder in Bedroom
text:
We booked into hotel room 284 for 2 nights.  I was going for a heart operation on the second day and we thought we would save the stress of traveling to Hamilton on the actual day. We had a meal in the restaurant and what a disapointment.  The chips were dumped on the plate the steak with mushroom Jus on top of them then the petite salad on top of the steak. Hence the chips were soggy the steak was overcooked (medium should have been) and the salad was wilted because of the heat.  They forgot to bring my husbands vegs and they had quickly cooked in a microwave dry as hell.
There was an adjoining door into the next room.  At 11 o'clock that night I heard a strange noise light scraping or rats or something.  The next minute the adjoining door opened and a man was standing there.  I screamed and my husband woke up.  There was no light coming from the adjoining room when the door was opened.  My husband opened the door still no light in the other room while I phoned reception.   It took them a while to answer.  When I did the man said he would come up.  He obviously went into the adjoining room as we could hear him twisting the lock.  He then knocked on our door without introducing himself came in said he was sorry but he had just booked the gentleman into the room but had shifted him to another (how he could have done this in 10 minutes I don't know) and housekeeping must have left the door unlocked.  He locked it with the key from our side and when I told him I was having a heart operation the next day.  Just said goodnight and walked out.  Didn't enquire if a may have needed a doctor or if we were alright.  The next day I went down to reception to speak to the duty manager and she was about as helpful as the night guy.  Said they were looking into it and it was a housekeeping error as the room had been used as an adjoining one the night before.  Even when I said that  I was having a heart operation that day still no genuine apology.  She looked at our bill and said she would credit it. Whipdy Do $37.00 as we only pay half with our A Card.  We definately would not stay there again or at another IBIS.   We have been members of the A-Club for many years and this would be about the worst experience we have had.  If I hadn't woken up goodness knows what may have happened.  I wish now I had phone the police on the night as housekeeper error or not it was an intruder in our bedroom.

title: I only stayed for 1 of 3 nights
text: I arrived at the Ibis to attend a 3 day conference.  After a 5 hours driving and a late arrival I was totally ready to check in and get my room to freshen up. After nearly 20 minutes trying to find somewhere to park the car in the very awkwardly located and narrow drive I ended up driving back onto the high street and lugging my suitcase back to the hotel in the pouring rain.  Valet parking was at the 'special' rate of $15 per night.  My other option as told by the tired looking receptionist was to drive to skycity and park there at a rate of $5 per night.  I opted for sky-city as I refuse to pay for valet parking when every other aspect of the hotel is self-service. After leaving my suitcase at reception I went back to my car and drove 1 minute to skycity.  I found a free parking spot on the last floor of the basement car park (I think there are 6 levels). I  then anxiously navigated my way through the car park and back up a moderately steep hill to the hotel reception which is located on the first floor. After a speedy but unwelcoming and uninformative check-in I was given the key to my room.  I got into the lift and pressed the button for my floor, after what seemed like an age I came to realise that the lift hadn't actually moved.  I pressed the button again expecting to move but again nothing!  The door opened and another hotelier stepped inside.  To my amusement it became apparent that the lift needed to be activated with a room key before it would start. The corridor looked tired and the room doors looked like the entry to a  prison cell.  The room itself was basic but clean and tidy.  The décor was neutral.  The bathroom was tiny with nowhere to lay my belongings.  The water pressure was terrible. All in all I could well have tolerated these things and stayed here for the additional nights if it wasn't for the bed which was rock hard and lumpy.  The ingredients used for breakfast the next morning (included in my booking) were of a very low quality.  The chefs did their best with what they had. The dining room is bright and airy with pleasant views over the river from some angles.  Public internet access is available free of charge for 20 minutes from the reception area.  Room internet access rates are available but extortionate. The in-room menu was minimal and expensive.  I ordered a cheese and onion toasty and chocolate brownie with ice-cream. I had to laugh when told that I would be able collect my order from reception when ready.  45 minutes later I received a call telling me that I could collect my food.  I went down the stairs which were closer to my room.  Again, in order to get out of the stairwell I needed to use my room key this place has better security than most prisons.  Back in my room I emptied my carrier bag of items finding two Styrofoam burger boxes and two set of plastic knives and forks.  The toasty was by now soggy and cold and bent at odd angles having been squeezed into the box.  I took one bite and decided I wasn't that hungry after all. The brownie (quite dry) and ice-cream were OK.  The ibis tainui reminded me of the YMCA in Wellington! OK if your back-packing but if your looking for something nicer for less money and better customer service I'd recommend staying at the Victoria hotel suites which has free parking but no dining service and free but terrible in room internet connection.

text:
This is an excellent hotel. We've stayed here a couple of times and really like its location, the facilities and the room we had this time met our modest needs really well. In the past we've arrived in the afternoon by which time the sun has come around to the city side of the hotel and all the rooms on that side become bathed in sunshine - great for relaxing after our drive from New Plymouth and for taking a nap before getting prepared for a night out. This time was our first time on the river-side and we were greeted by a brilliant view overlooking the river plus a neat wakeup call by the sun the following morning.
It's not all excellent though - we've marked the services side down slightly to a "good" because everytime we've arrived there we have had to wait in a queue. They seem to only ever have one person serving at reception. Staff are always very good so it's hard to be too upset about having to wait. They're really attentive to everyone which can be time consuming and when it was our time, they were equally attentive - but I didn't enjoy the waiting time.
The other thing is about parking. This time they arranged with their sister-hotel located about 300 metres away to allow patrons to park with them as their carpark is bigger. I could see that for older folk, in the rain; having to walk back to our Hotel from over there would be a chore.
We'll be back though and as long as I remember to build in an little extra "waiting at reception" time I'm sure we'll be well catered for.
Oh, and before I forget, breakfast is great, plenty of variety and they start early too enabling us to get away early to return home.

title: Everything you'd expect from an Ibis
text: Stayed here during winter for a week-long conference and found the Ibis to be a great hotel. title: Business stopover
text: Ibis Hamilton is good for a single traveler on business. The rooms are typically very small but this is not an issue for a single traveler. The location is brilliant as you are right in the heart of the city.

title: Great Motel and setting
text:
Nice and clean, bed great the only problem is not being warned that we couldnt get parking at the motel before we arrived - outside the front seemed to be jammed with cars - trying to drop off and find somewhere to park that would be close. 
Magnificant view - the resturant was lovely - would stay again if Im looking for soemwhere in Hamilton

title: Wont stay there
text:
The good - location. Lots of good food and small quaint cafes around. Shopping (if that turns your crank) is reasonable.
The bad - hotel.
Room - really?? - they may call it a room - I call it a hole in the wall.
Bed - two singles to make a queen - really know how to make your tired guest comfortable :(
Bathroom - clean and truly bare. We came from a motel in the middle of nowhere the night before that had better bathroom items. All that was there was soap, shampoo and conditioner. Nothing else.
Internet - NO WIRELESS - in this day and age. And you have to pay an arm and a leg for it. Oh yes, there was FREE internet for 15 minutes - whoopty doo!! After two minutes I was logged out because I ran over my 8 meg limit. And this is supposed to be a business hotel????
This hotel NOT get my business.
Food - way too expensive when there are far more reasonable places within 2 minute walk away.

title: Was this really an Accor Hotel?
text:

What we found very upsetting was the differing stories we were told regarding the costs of breakfast between the night and morning staff and whether our Accor advantage card could be used in conjuction with other offers. What was most concerning though was that the dining staff did not initially recognise my accor gold card, saying it needed to look like the silver card they produced, and then left us standing to go and check if our card was valid. We left the hotel and had breafast downtown.

title: Perfect location with excellent accommodation
text: My Husband and I just spent the weekend in Hamilton and chose to stay at the Ibis. We couldn't have picked a more perfect place to stay!! The location was fantastic (close to the casino and right in town) and the room was the best for price! The staff were all so friendly, helpful and willing to go the extra mile.....especially when we arrived back at the hotel after being at the casino and wanted to get a bite to eat as most of the restaurants and pubs in town had already closed their kitchens. The kitchen staff were happy to help and cooked us a meal even though they had already closed for the night and were in the process of cleaning up. The room was very clean and warm with a king sized bed, coffee making facilities, iron/ironing board, and spotless bathroom. I would highly recommend the Ibis as a place to stay and would definitely book to stay there again next time we choose to stay in Hamilton. Thanks to all the staff - we had a great night away!!!

title: Cheap, good hotel - poor service
text:
I required 2 nights accommodation for business at the last minute and needed a no frills good quality hotel - IBIS seemed to fit the bill.
Arriving late in the evening after a long days journey - all I wanted was to get checked in and have a quick meal.  Most hotels could deliver this - you do expect a competent level of service from the staff but sadly I was let down.

STRIKE ONE - On check in I requested valet parking and they filled out the forms and told me the charges etc... being tired I forgot to give them the keys. No request was made for the keys and I awoke the next day to find my car had been left outside the hotel reception and had a note under the wiper saying leaving cars outside the hotel without valet services was unacceptable and the car may be towed.

STRIKE TWO - The Hotel restaurant and room service is slightly different and requires you to pick up the food when ready - no biggy - but their service staff again failed me.
I ordered a simple Burger and chips over the phone and was told it would be 20 mins, then they would ring me back to pick up. Over 1 hour later I chased them up - and was told sorry sir you told us the wrong room, the room number given didn't exist so we could contact anyone and we had to dump the food.  FACT I did not tell them the wrong room number as it was PRINTED in large letters on the phone, they wrote it down wrong.
Another 20 mins and the food arrived. 1 hour 20 mins and bad attitude to boot is a long time to wait for Burger and chips.

STRIKE THREE - On leaving the room the next day I found staff cleaning rooms, I left on the door knob - please clean room note. Returned to find it had been removed and a note placed under the door saying "due to your request for privacy you room was not cleaned - for towels ring reception".  I rang reception and was told - sorry sir we have no staff available for cleaning the room presently, you could come down to reception and we can give you some clean towels. I mentioned this to another client in the lift and was told the exact same happened to him - sounds like lazy cleaning staff to me.

All up a frustrating and annoying experience, Hotel rooms good, price good, location good. SERVICE - shocking.

title: Exactly what we wanted.

The valet parking adds to the price at $18 a day, but you can park at Sky City for $13 per exit from the carpark if you get a card from hotel reception. We didn't bother to hunt for free parking but you might find some behind the Centre Place Mall which is very close, just across Victoria Street. We didn't find out about the $30 breakfast for two deal until too late but had a good value Big Breakfast for $12.50 each at Ronnie's cafe just down Victoria St to the left.
Had dinner at the hotel restaurant where one poor chap was maitre d', waiter, barman etc, but he did an excellent job and the service was fine, as was the food.

Breakfast in the morning wasn't the biggest buffet I'd seen but it's not a huge hotel and it had pretty much all the bases covered (including hotcakes, yum!) so no probs there. 

The one issue - There was a constant noise we could hear from somewhere in the building.  And by constant I mean that if it wasn't 24 hours a day it can't have been far off.  We couldn't work out what it was - thought at first it might have been a laundry room as it was a consistent pattern and kinda machine like.  As it seemed to never stop I can only conclude it must be to do with the whole building's air conditioning system.  It wasn't loud and it wasn't right next door and we were tired enough that it wasn't an issue for sleeping, but if there were other rooms hearing it more loudly I wouldn't have wanted to be in those rooms!

text:

title: Excellent stay - will stay again next time we're in Hamilton
text:

The guy on reception took the effort to understand what we were looking for and to help us find a great restaurant (Gothenburg), making sure we had a map plus locations for other places if we didn't like the look of the first choice.

Whilst we didn't have time to use the pool, it looked well kept and a fellow guest seemed to be enjoying it.

The hotel is over the road from the stadium, so perfect if you're there for an event, but if not then if one is on it may be impacted by event noise (there wasn't an event on when we stayed).

Michelle & Alexei
Park View Motor Lodge

title: Great people and great service

title: An honest, clean no-frills offering
text:
Motels and motor lodges are the standard accommodation options for Hamilton, and this will have to be one of the better ones of the available options. It is clean and unpretentious.  The location is also within easy reach of the town centre and adjacent to the FMG Waikato stadium. The rooms are serviced with fresh linen and sheets available everyday, and car parking is plentiful.  Perfect for a drive through short holiday in Hamilton, but perhaps not for an extended stay.  

The reception is unattended after 9.00 pm, so if you are arriving after 9.00 pm you will need to make alternative arrangements to gain access.  We stayed in a 2 br suite; the AC did not make it into the second room, a relatively minor inconvenience given the weather was not extreme.

the noise from the residents using the pool facilities in the morning can be disruptive to those who appreciate a little lie-in especially after a late night engagement.

For those considering this place for a short stay it is recommend that you stock up with bottled water, milk and decent coffee and other breakfast items to get you through the morning.
hotel_response:
Thanks for your review.

The heated covered pool and spa are a real feature of the motel. Guests have access to these amenities from 8am until 9pm each day. Outside of these hours the gate is locked to prevent access which might disturb our guests.

Guests like the fact that we are walking distance to 2 supermarkets which makes shopping for those extra provisions really easy. 
The complimentary milk provided on check in usually keeps guests going until they can get to the supermarket. With this in  mind all units have a selection of teas (including herb teas) as well as plunger coffee, instant coffee sachets and a hot chocolate option. 

An alternative to preparing your own breakfast is to take advantage of our breakfast service. This is an additional cost with breakfast delivered to your unit. There is a choice of a continental or 2 cooked options. 

Thanks again.

title: Dont judge a book by its cover this is a beuty
text: From the outside just looked like a standard hotel. Well! Inside was absolutely amazing. Near new fit outs. Lovely large comfy beds, New TV, Aircon, Large rooms easily catered for our family of 5. The best place we have stayed so far in our 5 days in NZ. LOcation close enough to shops and take away options. Lovely staff and pool was heated and had a toastie spa. By far the best motel I have ever stayed in.
hotel_response:
Hi Justin
Thank you for your very positive review.  It is always nice to know our guests have been happy with their stay.  We replaced the beds last year and they have been much appreciated by all our guests. And yes our 2 bedroom family units are quite spacious.  No doubt your children enjoyed the pool area as much as you.
We look forward to seeing you again when you are back in NZ.
Regards
Jude

title: Very pleasant stay
text: Stayed two nights.  Good-sized room, very comfortable bed, hot shower and good amenities for cooking.  The road noise was a bit intrusive, but not all units face the road.  Plenty of off-road parking and friendly, helpful staff.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your review.  We are very pleased you enjoyed your stay with us.  We get a lot of comments about the comfortable beds as they were replaced recently.  We hope you managed to enjoy the heated indoor pool while you were here too.  We look forward to hosting you again.
With thanks
Jude

title: Highly Reccomend
text: This place is great! Location is good, The rooms were clean, Spacious & comfortable. All the staff were friendly & accomodating, The free WIFI & easy parking was a big plus for me. Thank you to all the staff for a great stay
hotel_response:
Hi Bree
Thanks for the complimentary review - it is much appreciated.  We take pride in the friendliness of all out staff so it is nice to know they all looked after you well.
Hopefully you got to enjoy our indoor swimming pool, spa and sauna complex while you were here.
Thanks again.
Jude

title: Best Bed ever slept on in motel
text: Stayed here by default as our camper van failed. OMG the bed was amazing - Im in the process of buying a similar one on our return to Australia. Rooms were good, as was the spa bath. Hosts were very gracious.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your positive review.  Yes our new beds have been much appreciated by our guests.  So pleased we could help you out when your camper van failed.  Hope the rest of your trip went well.
Thanks
Jude

title: A good night's sleep
text: Final night of a week long holiday, so thought we'd treat ourselves, but prices very reasonable and the room was fantastic. Heaps of room, spa bath, and best of all: decent beds, which is essential before and after long drives.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your positive review.  We are pleased you enjoyed your stay and appreciated the comfortable beds.  We replaced these last year and have nothing but positive comments about them.  Hope you also had a chance to relax in the heated indoor swimming pool and spa complex.
We look forward to seeing you back again.
Thanks
Jude

title: Perfect.Fabulous,Immaculate,Wonderful location
text:
Location is second to none.Easy access and not a lot of traffic.
Immaculately clean and luxurious.Spacious and lovely spa bath to relax in.
Great outdoor pool too!!
Lovely friendly genuine hosts..made to feel very welcome
hotel_response:
Hi
Thank you for your wonderful review.  Being off the main road is certainly an advantage with regards to the traffic noise.  We are pleased you enjoyed the spa bath in your unit - these are in all units in the complex and are enjoyed by many as is our swimming pool, spa and sauna complex.  We look forward to welcoming you back some other time.
With thanks
Jude

title: Very nice accomodation
text: Close to city and restuarant options nice clean accomodation very friendly staff everything you need is available in rooms quiet location opposite rugby park. Free parking on site but we did have a major problem with  no Internet  connection which was not fixed until checkout time. Not a problem unless you have work to do like I did. Rooms are large and well equipped with everything needed plus spa bath.  Would definitely return in future.
hotel_response: Thanks for your comments.  Sorry to hear you had an issue with the internet.  Unfortunately we did have a technical issue (as is sometimes the case with technology) and can only assume you were staying then.  We have upgraded this year to hi-speed fibre which is normally very reliable but we also have a broadband connection as a backup.  Hopefully next time you come there will not be any problems.

title: hard to find but worth it
text: I think they'll have to change to Stadium View at some point, there's a big one being built right outside their front door.  Because the street that the GDS likes is blocked off, we had to do a few recalculations to get here.  It's a great motor lodge.  Normal size rooms, a little dark, but good beds, good tv and lots of channels, outdoor sitting area and good kitchenette with coffee/tea.  Bathroom was new and spotless.  Plenty of parking off street.  Manager was a great help with recommendations for eats and sights.  Loved it.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your positive review and we were pleased you were able to find us.  The stadium you mentioned  was where the Lions played the Chiefs and for this event they extended the grandstand.  This was only a temporary stand and has now been removed.  Unfortunately while it was being constructed and until it was dismantled there was restricted access.  We attempted to contact all guests who were staying with us over that time to explain access but it was a little confusing.  Access has now been returned to normal so the GDS would have no trouble finding us.  Hopefully we will see you again when access will be a little simpler.
Thanks
Jude

title: LOVE, LOVE, LOVE
text: We stayed here on the 2nd, and it is one of the best motels we've stayed in. It was clean, great facilities and amazing, warm welcoming receptionists. We really enjoyed our stay here and would defiantly come back if we even need to stay in hamilton again!
hotel_response: Thanks for your positive comments.  We look forward to hosing you again next time you are in Hamilton.

title: Best stay ever
text: We travel to Hamilton a lot and haven't really found a place we enjoy very much. Well things have changed! This was by far the best place we have stayed in Hamilton. The room was spotless, well equiped and very comfortable. The room felt and smelt brand new, it was like we were the first guests to stay there. A very nice welcome on reception made our stay faultless. Thanks and we will definitely stay here every time we are in town from now on.
hotel_response:
Thank you so much for your positive review.  We are pleased you found our accommodation so comfortable - I am sure the new beds purchased last year helped.  And we believe our housekeepers do a wonderful job.  Our close proximity to town is also a bonus.
We look forward to welcoming you back.
Thanks
Jude

title: Lovely
text: This was a really nice motel to stay in spa in every room. Very comfortable, very clean, pleasant owners pool, spa, sauna and a nice environment. May be a little different if there's a football game going on as it is straight across the road. All in all a really nice place to stay.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to review our motel.  We endeavour to keep the place clean and create a relaxed comfortable environment.  When there is a game on across the road at the Waikato Stadium the atmosphere is different but the guests who stay seem to enjoy being part of the buzz that surrounds the game.  The crowd disperses straight after the game so the noise is generally not too much of an issue.
Thanks
Jude

title: Practical and clean
text: This was a great hotel with everything you could need for a stay in Hamilton.  The rooms are large and comfortable, with good beds and little kitchenettes with basic supplies and a microwave.  There is a Countdown within walking distance.  There is a small but attractive heated pool, a hot tub and a sauna.  Although there is no gym on the premises, the hotel provides some (limited) passes to a nearby health center.  There is an affordable laundry on site and lots of parking.  The hotel does not have room service per se, but includes a list of menus from recommended local establishments, some of which had charge back facilities.  There are also restaurants in the city area a short walk away.  The hosts are helpful and knowledgeable.  The rooms and bathroom were spotlessly clean.  I have no complaints at all.  Highly recommended.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your positive review.  You have summed up our place very well with regards to the facilities, location and services we offer.  It is nice to know that the housekeepers work is appreciated and we enjoy passing these comments on to them.
Thanks
Jude

title: Clean and comfortable Motel
text: The owner was very welcoming and helpful with local information and the room was clean and had everything we needed. The motel is located right beside the football stadium but no football was happening that night. Not sure what it would be like if a match was scheduled. It is possible to walk to eating places and a supermarket but it is not right in the centre of the city. We would stay here again.
hotel_response:
Hi and thanks for your comments.

It is always great to hear that guests have enjoyed their time with us.

We look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit.

title: Wow. Fantastic. Superb. Definitely a high scorer
text:
I had the pleasure of being able to stay here but only for one night. I felt I could happily have moved in.

The rooms were a fantastic size, nicely decorated, well appointed and felt really plush. 

Air conditioning given the warm summer evening was a welcome relief. 

The bed was AMAZING. So comfortable. High off the ground which would mean that people with back issues could comfortably get it and out of them. I slept like a log in a quiet comfortable room not impacted excessively by outdoor night lighting. 

Sky TV with a wide range of channels. Free wifi. Plenty of off street parking. Cooking facilities. Plenty of pillows and cushions to prop me up and support TV watching. Bathrobes in the wardrobe too if you wanted them. Makeup remover wipes and a selection of shower "condiments" to use.  A large mirror in the bedroom area was a great addition as often there is only a bathroom mirror. A built in suitcase rack made life easy too. 

I could go on and on about this property. 

Donald was a delight making checkin quick easy and pleasant and checkout just as pleasant. 

I will be requesting this property through our corporate travel agents when I am next through this way for work. It just makes me regret I don't have a reason to visit Hamilton more frequently!
hotel_response:
Hi and thanks for your comments.

It is always great to hear that guests have enjoyed their time with us.

We look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit.

title: Clean and modern room
text: A very enjoyable stay here. Friendly host when checking in and out. The room is very clean and modern with small kitchen. Very comfy bed and fluffy pillows! They seems to be fairly new, with good quality sheets. Spa bath was divine and nice spacious shower.
hotel_response: Thanks for your comments.  The beds, bedding and pillows were all replaced under a year ago and have been extremely well received by our guests.

title: Excellent choice of motel
text: We could not have chosen a better motel, having stayed in quite a few in Hamilton, over the years. The hosts were very welcoming and especially helpful as one of our party had taken ill on the journey.  The studio room we booked was very comfortable and despite being on the ground floor of 2 storeys we had no disturbance from other guests. The bed was superb and probably the most comfortable hotel/ motel bed us frequent travelers have ever had. The motel was very easy to find despite Hamilton's lack of street signs. Facilities include an on site laundry and clothesline if required and a superb indoor pool, sauna and spa. The parking away from the street is excellent. The Park View was fully booked out during our stay. We will definitely make this our motel of choice for future trips to Hamilton. Just one regret that we did not find this gem ages ago!
hotel_response:
Hi
We are pleased you enjoyed your stay despite the unfortunate circumstances on arrival.  We always endeavour to ensure the needs of our guests are catered for.  As you point out the units are well insulated from noise from the adjacent units. We look forward to welcoming you back in happier circumstances.

title: Great Motor Lodge
text:
Stayed one night at end of school holidays in January.

Great room, very clean and tidy with Sky which is great for kids.

Pool and spa as pictured and again very clean and warm.

Very good value for money.
hotel_response:
Hi 
We are pleased you enjoyed your stay.  Having  Sky 50+ channels available for viewing in every unit has certainly be well received by our guests.
We look forward to seeing you again.

title: Best in Hamilton?
text: Yes! Certainly the best in this area of Hamilton. (You only have to go for an early morning walk to see the difference - Park View is full,always, it seems, while others are not. That always tells you that something good is happening.(And there are so many choices in this area. Great hosts, great position, comfortable units... The place has a great feel to it and that must be the key!
hotel_response:
Hi Brian. Thanks for your comments. Since we took ownership we have been endeavoring to create a comfortable and welcoming environment. We are pleased to hear that it has been noticed and appreciated. We look forward to seeing you again in the future.

Thanks
Jude and Donald Southee

title: Fantastic stay
text: Great stay, new beds which are top quality!  Only negative is that the pool closes at 9pm but with day light savings there was still plenty of wasted light time we could have used it in. Traveled with 2 adults and 4 kids aged 11-3
hotel_response:
Hi Rebecca

Thanks for your comments and we are pleased your stay with us was a good one.
Replacing all of the beds in 2016 has certainly provided plenty of positive feedback from our guests.
The heated covered pool , spa and sauna facilities are always popular with our guests especially as they can be used all year round. In consideration of all our guests we do need to put reasonable time frames around access.

title: Amazing services
text:
Airline lost our luggage during our Seattle to Auckland flight so we spent extra time dealing that at the airport.  
Then we realized we would arrive much later than the normal business hours.  So we called the hotel, and Edward was most kind and accommodating and said that they would wait for us.  They also called around to find a restaurant for us that opens late. 
They also gave us 2 nice big towels for free for us to take on the black water rafting the next morning since we lost our luggage.
Room was modern, clean, huge jacuzzi tub with separate shower.
Very nice stop over after a 20+ hours flight.
hotel_response: Thank you for the positive review. Pleased to hear you enjoyed your short stay with us. All guests have different requirements and we continually strive to meet these whenever it is possible. We trust you caught up with your luggage at some point and enjoyed your NZ travels. Hopefully we might see you again in the future.

title: Perfect place to stay
text: Up for a few days on a course nearby. The motel is very well appointed with great facilities. The staff are excellent, extremely helpful and the cook a lovely breakfast. Would stay there again - perfect for the rugby too.
hotel_response: Thanks for your review. Pleased to hear you enjoyed your stay. We pride ourselves on customer service and our quality breakfasts delivered to your room. Yes the location is perfect for rugby being just across the road from the stadium - but remember to book early!!

title: Great Motel
text: Just spent two nights here attending a training event nearby. It doesn't have the 'polish' of a 5 star luxury chain but it does what it does very well. There had been a mix up with my booking (not the motels fault), but they were great at sorting things out and very helpful. I got a larger unit as a result but I suspect other than size, much the same. Spotlessly clean - and I'm picky! As has been said the bed was really comfortable and once in the bedroom I heard absolutely nothing. Had breakfast both days - just the basics, but more than adequate and served exactly as requested. Service was efficient, friendly and felt genuinely warm and welcoming. Excellent motel.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review.  It is nice to know that we are doing things well - particularly cleaning and service.  We look forward to welcoming you back in the future.

title: Great motel
text:
Excellent stay for work. Have stayed before and liked it. This time I loved! Also Jude went above and beyond when I left my computer cord behind to get it to me. Couldn't have been more helpful and I totally recommend them to any one!!
Thank you so much for helping
hotel_response:
Hi Donna
So pleased we were able to get that computer cord back to you.  And pleased you also enjoyed your stay.
We look forward to welcoming you again soon.
Regards
Jude

title: Great Motel
text: There were 5 of us (including 1 child) staying in a 2 bedroom apartment. The furnishings were comfortable and stylish. The beds were fantastic-everyone enjoyed good sleeps. A nice bonus to have a TV in each of the bedrooms. Spacious bathroom with spa bath and separate shower-excellent pressure from the shower too. The heated pool, spa and sauna were excellent. Check in and out was a breeze. Handy location for whatever you happen to be in Hamilton doing.  Best place in town I'd say!
hotel_response:
Thank you for the great review.  Pleased to hear you enjoyed your stay.  We find everyone loves our heated covered pool, spa and sauna complex in both winter and summer.  And yes we are handy being in walking distance to a couple of good restaurant/bars and two supermarkets and easy access to both the centre of town and a short drive to The Base.  We look forward to welcoming you again.
Jude and Donald Southee

title: Best beds ever!
text: Very difficult to fault! Great location, modern amenities, very clean, friendly staff.  The owners mentioned the beds were new and to be honest I had the best sleep I've had in ages.  I have decided when I get home to buy a new bed!
hotel_response:
Thanks for the wonderful review.  We are getting many similar comments about guests wanting to change their beds once they have slept here.  Yes, the beds are new and were replaced in June of 2016. We are also pleased to hear the the cleanliness and the amenities.  We always try to maintain high standards and we believe our housekeeping staff do a wonderful job.
Thanks,
Jude and Donald Southee

title: The best beds ever - Great Motel
text: We recently stayed here as a big family group in town for a wedding.  So many different accommodation units are available.  We personally had the two bedroom unit and really appreciated the large lounge dining area for everyone to gather for a shared evening meal the night before the wedding.  The best beds we have slept in  motel accommodation with such crisp linen.  Tastefully furnished, spa bath, Sky TV and wonderful shower pressure. The other family members also fully recommended their smaller units as well. Great indoor pool complex.  Well recommended overall. Many thanks for a great no fuss stay
hotel_response:
Thanks for your comments. We are very pleased your group enjoyed your stay.
We replaced the beds in May 2016 and our guests have been providing lots of positive feedback on their comfort.

title: Great pool complex!
text:
Very friendly owners, hot pool and spa was fantastic, rooms very comfortable and nicely furnished, beds super comfortable. I was hoping for electric blankets on a cold Hamilton winter night, but actually they were not needed!
An enjoyable stay. Good location, not far from centre of town
hotel_response: Thanks for your comments. We are pleased you made the most of the covered pool area.  This is always an attraction especially for families. Good to hear the new beds and bedding is proving comfy. Hopefully we will see you again sometime soon.

title: Friendly staff, spacious and clean rooms
text:
Stayed here for a week (studio room), the owners were friendly and relaxed as well as the housekeeping staff. The rooms were very well equipped and spacious as well as very clean. The kitchenettes are well equipped with lots of utensils and storage space. 

Its about a 20minute walk into the town centre or a $10 taxi ride, located opposite the FMG Waikato stadium and would therefore make for a brilliant place to stay on match day! Plenty of parking also available. The spa/pool area looked very well maintained although did not use it myself. 

Would highly recommend if staying in Hamilton.

title: Great place to stat
text:
Stayed 2 nights to attend a wedding. Room very well appointed and spotless. Super comfy bed and good shower. Free wifi and all sky and tv channels.
Highly recommended 
Central location very handy to city and right opposite rugby stadium.
hotel_response: Thanks for your comments Gerard. The housekeeping team work hard to ensure that the units are super clean for each arriving guest. We are pleased you made the most of the free, unlimited wifi and the 50 plus TV channels. See you on your next visit.

title: Fantastic value!
text:
We only stayed for 2 nights, but could have comfortably stayed a lot longer. The owner was incredibly helpful, providing suggestions of where best to eat, visit etc with a young family.
The room was clean, well appointed and had a few bonuses like NZ made toiletries and a DVD player to borrow free of charge.
Would definitely recommend for families as the configuration worked really well (kids in the bedroom with two single beds).
hotel_response: Very pleased you enjoyed your stay.  We are always looking for add-ons to improve the guest experience.

title: Very comfortable stay
text: The room we were given was spacious, clean and comfortable. The manager was very helpful with providing information about Hamilton, places to eat and the local area. The bathroom was in good condition and didn't feel cramped. The motel was located in a quieter area which allowed for a good night's sleep. Overall, it was value for money.
hotel_response: Thanks for your review.  Very pleased to hear you enjoyed your stay.

title: Great introduction to New Zealand
text: Lovely motel with very friendly staff (office waited for us to arrive before closing), room was excellently presented, clean comfortable, top class amenities provided in bathroom, more like a posh city hotel than a country motel, would definitely recommend  - wish we could have stayed longer :)
hotel_response: Thanks for your very positive comments.  It is so nice to hear that our guests are happy with the service and amenities we provide.  We look forward to welcoming you back if you are ever back in New Zealand.  Thanks, Jude

title: Nice motel, Excellent service
text:
We had a studio room, which was very nice, quiet and comfortable.  It had a spa bath and nice personal accessories.  The welcome on arrival, the really awesome breakfasts and the staff and service was outstanding.  
If they were to make any improvements, it would be to the water pressure in the shower.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments.  We are so pleased you enjoyed your stay and the breakfasts!  We will look into the water pressure and see if there is anything we can do to improve it.  We look forward to your return in the future.
Thanks, Jude

title: Wonderful staff and hotel
text:
Stayed here one night and could have stayed more only on a tight schedule. Wonderful staff at reception and so helpful. Bonus free laundry for those that have been on the road a while. Thoroughly enjoyed the refreshing pool after a long drive.
Our room was perfectly clean and toiletries, honey/ Manuka and were amazing. There is nothing to fault about this motel, would return. Thank you
hotel_response:
Thank you so much for your positive comments.  Our covered pool has been particularly popular over these hot summer months and is also enjoyed in winter when we turn the temperature up. We will pass on your comments to our housekeeping staff who pride themselves on their work.  We look forward to seeing you back again.
Cheers, Jude

title: Great staff and very nice room
text:
Stayed here for 2 nights and have no complaints. We were greeted by very friendly owners and were quickly made to feel at home. Kitchen very practical
Lodge is in a great location with supermarket and restaurants close by.

title: Great, Affordable Luxury Hotel
text: We pampered ourselves here for Christmas Eve/Christmas day by staying here. The owners were incredibly friendly (it was raining and they got us umbrellas for when we went to the gardens, they told us good places to park, and even got us a box of chocolates when we left). There is free laundry on site, which we badly needed to use, and it didn't ruin our clothes (like some travel laundry places). Our room was nice and clean, and we enjoyed the hot tub and pool (but couldn't figure out how to turn on the jets in the hot tub/maybe they were broken).

title: Excellent Accommodation
text: We stayed for 2 nights and found this Motor Lodge to be very convenient right across the road from Waikato Stadium. Our room was spacious and we loved how the doors opened right up to allow the breeze in. We needed the air conditioner which was provided. Bathroom was huge with a spa bath and shower. Would stay here again.
hotel_response:
Thanks so much for the positive comments on your stay with us.  As you know it has been very hot in Hamilton so we are pleased you were able to cool down with the door open and the air conditioning.  We hope you were also able to make use do the pool to cool down.  We look forward to welcoming you back sometime in the future.
Jude and Donald Southee

title: Great location - very firm bed
text: We stayed here for one night. Location was close enough for us to walk 30 minutes or so into the CBD for dinner and back home again. The unit was clean and tidy. Road noise, which we thought might have been an issue, was not a problem at all. The only downside was that the bed was a futon base and therefore very firm so not particularly comfortable.
hotel_response:
Hi Delwyn
thank you for taking the time to review our accommodation.  Just thought we should let you know that we are currently pricing beds and intend to upgrade them in the very near future.  Hopefully next time you stay we will be able to offer you a more comfortable night..
thanks for choosing to stay at the Park view Motor Lodge.

title: luxury made affordable
text:
we got what we could dream of- centrally located, big gracefully designed two bedroom suite with kitchen and hassle free check in
add to it superb aircon
though the pool is just for namesake but definately adds value to it
strongly recommended if the whole family is travelling and wishes to stay together
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments about our accommodation. We are pleased you enjoyed the pool so much - and you are right the two bedroom unit (and the pool) are great for families.  We look forward to welcoming you back to eh Park View Motor Lodge again soon.
Thanks, Jude

title: Very comfortable and modern rooms!
text: This motel took us by surprise!  On arrival we thought it looked a bit dated but were pleasantly surprised on entering our rooms.  It looks as though they have been given a recent upgrade.  This included a spa bath as well as shower and a small kitchenette.  Very happy with this accommodation, particularly for the price.  Only drawback would be, if there happened to be a game on at the stadium opposite.  Luckily for us, this was not the case during our stay. The staff were also very friendly & helpful!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments on the Park view Motor Lodge.  We are pleased we were able to "surprise" with the quality of our rooms.  We like to deliver more than expected to our guests.  As you noted we are very close to the stadium which of course makes it very convenient for anyone coming to Hamilton for rugby (or other) games.  Although it is noisy when the games are on we are pleased to say that generally the crowd disperses very quickly and it is usually quiet soon after 9.30pm even when there is a game on.
Thank, Jude

title: Everything you need; clean and comfortable
text: Our room had everything we needed for a night's stay. It was clean and comfortable, and the bed was huge! There was a big spa bath - unexpected, but most welcome. We arrived late at night, and the manager had kindly arranged for us to be able to access our room without having to check in. There was a bit of traffic noise, but we realised in the morning that one of the windows had been partially open, so I don't think the noise would have been as much of an issue if the window was closed.

title: Comfortable, clean and well equipped
text: We stayed 2 nights here. Was a great room. It's a 10-15 mins walk to the Hamilton Transport Centre and very near to the park. There's Domino's Pizza and Speight's Alehouse within 5 mins walk too. For groceries. Countdown is also within walking distance. We hired a car to visit Rotorua and was able to walk to Avis (10 min). Use of washing machine and dryer was free. You just need to purchase the detergent for $2. Our unit has a mini jacuzzi too. Good value for about $140 per night.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to review the Park View Motor Lodge.  We are pleased that your stay was enjoyable.  You are right we are very centrally located - close to the CBD, a couple of good restaurants, two supermarkets and also walking distance to Waikato Stadium (opposite us), Founders Theatre and Seddon Park. We trust you enjoyed the rest of your time in New Zealand.
Thanks, Jude

title: Value
text: stayed 5 nights. Right across the road from the stadium. Quiet area and a short cab ride to town. Walking distance to pack and save. Rooms very clean and the staff made it a really pleasant stay. Nothing was too much trouble including a couple of last minute changes to our booking. Well worthy of a recommendation

title: Spa, pool, Sauna, service.
text:
Great friendly service, anything asked for done straight away and without hesitation. Very clean tidy room and amenities, made you feel great and warm in Hamilton. 
Right next to the stadium and I do mean right next to it. Close to town but away from the main road.

Have already rebooked for another night when in the area because I found it so relaxing and accommodating.

title: Great Service
text: The motor lodge is in a great location but NOT during game season when there is a game at the stadium. Luckily for us, there was no game. Maybe we were there on a Sunday. The motor inn was okay but the owner was very accommodating and let us use the staff area for gathering. We had our group get-together there and each room cooked a dish and shared our meal. It was cold and he let us use the outdoor heater.

title: One night stop over
text:
We stayed here for 1 night and wish we could have stayed longer!  We are currently touring the north  island  and mostly stay in 4star hotels, however this motel is the best accommodation we have stayed in so far.  The owners are very friendly and only too happy to help. 
Hopefully we will see you again when we make our move permanent.

title: Excellen one bedroom unit
text: Our family of four stayed in a one bedroom unit at Parkview last weekend. We found it suited us very well for our needs. It has a queen bed in the lounge and two singles in the bedroom. The kitchen was well equipped with the usual appliances. The unit has a spa bath and separate shower. The weather was really poor in Hamilton that night very cold but the unit was warm enough we didn't even turn on any heat pumps or heaters. The wifi in room was free but signal was pretty weak we had to position ourselves in certain parts of the room well before we can get any strength. No biggie though it worked and it was free. We didn't use the motel pool but lots of others did we noted so it must be alright. Parking was very popular the night we stayed the carparks were all filled luckily there was one left for us by the time we got back at 7pm. The motel is in a very good area right next to the Stadium and close to CBD. Overall a very good experience we will likely return for another stay.
hotel_response:
Thanks for your great comments.  With regards to the Wifi we are just about to install additional devices to ensure a strong signal gets to all rooms. On your next visit we should have alleviated that issue.  We are pleased you enjoy your stay and look forward to welcoming you back next time.

Jude and Donald Southee

title: Good Location for the stadium
text: Opposite the stadium so make it ideal place to stay if you are visiting for a sports event. The room is nice and comfy. Not that well sound insulated from outside noise but nothing that annoyed me. Great double person spa bath. Clean and modern. Free wifi

title: Maybe it should be 2 out of 5 - cold room with a noisy heat pump
text:
I wondered whether I should give this a 1 or a 2. It isn't that all bad it was just very cold. Even with the heat pump set at 29 deg C it could not heat the room. I'd estimate it was only 16 deg inside. Even worse is that the heater cycled on and off every 5 minutes AND it was so noisy compared to any other heat pump I used in other motels/hotels/flats.
There wasn't a spare blanket and only a thin duvet. I found it cold and I'm used to having my house at 18 deg at night but with a thicker duvet. The room only had a summer duvet (ca 5 deg outside). Maybe I should have got a blanket for the second night - but it wasn't as cold outside on the first night.

I gave it a 1 because I couldn't sleep (I woke up freezing but couldn't get back to sleep with the noise) and I think it is unreasonable to have a badly insulated room with a noisy heater than cannot be used during the night.

I couldn't tell them at the time (middle of the night) or when I checked out (person was on the phone). Although there wasn't much to do at that point.

It doesn't justify the good rating on TA. Room 23 - maybe others are better. Stayed in 10 different places in NZ over the last month and this was the worst because it was cold and noisy.

Also the loo could do with a proper clean. It was badly stained with grey scale - probably due to the local water conditions rather than anything else.

Décor was OK/representative in the photos
hotel_response: Hi John  we are very disappointed that your stay at the Park View Motor Lodge was not as good as it should have been but thank you for pointing out the issues with the heat pump in room 23.  We have had a contractor in to test the unit.  They found the heat function working perfectly so can only assume you had it on an incorrect setting.  However, they did discover that the fan motor was noisy and have since replaced this part in the unit. We do appreciate constructive feedback that we can action.

title: Great location and wonderful spa and pool area
