text: We stayed one windy wet wet night - being able to jump into the perfectly heated and spotlessly clean spa and pool was a joy!  The unit was clean and pretty functional.  We had a 1 bed roomed unit but would have preferred if the main bed was in the bedroom - not the 2 single beds.  The reception staff I couldnt speak highly enough of - went out of their way for our special requests and super friendly and helpful.  I wished they had double glazing in the windows as the main bedroom/living area was facing into the courtyard area and the noise was quite bad as their was several large inconsiderate groups in that same night - and even though we were at the other end of the block - we could hear the noise from the pool very clearly with our windows and door shut.  Apart from that a great place to say - right across the road from the stadium.  Great value too.  $145 we paid for our room.

title: Everything we needed.
text: Very clean, quiet. Staff helpful - extending our stay last minute & late check out. Free Internet, parking & washer/dryer. Lovely modern room. Ensuite large. Decent amount of milk, enough for cereal & tea in the kitchenette each morning. Microwave, hot plate & bar fridge. Only 5min drive from Main Street.
hotel_response: Very happy that we were able to help you out by extending your stay.  We look forward to seeing you back here some time soon.

title: Great Location and Handy to town
text: Lovely tidy units with very friendly staff.  Right next door to one of the local stadiums so great if you are going to the game.  Straight off the by-pass route into town from Auckland.  On the main route so access to the city centre is easy.
hotel_response: Thanks for your feedback.  Pleased you enjoyed your stay with us.  We look forward to welcoming you back again in the future.

title: Great find!
text: We recently spent time in New Zealand and stayed in five different hotels over that trip.  This one was a our favorite by far.   It was charming, clean, and comfortable.  I felt the most at home when we stayed there.

title: Best place to stay In Hamilton
text: We have stayed in many places in Hamilton and this has been the best. My husband and I stayed for 1 night to watch the Chiefs play the Crusaders. The room was very clean, there are cooking facilities and everything you need. The extra's in the bathroom were very much appreciated. Great view of the Rugby ground and close to 2 supermarkets. Staff were very polite and helpful. Looking forward to our next stay there. Bonus was the Chief's beat the Crusaders.

title: Clean comfortable quiet
text: As long as nothing is happening at the Stadium, this is an nice alternative motel for a quiet night's sleep. Well managed, clean, comfortable, with basic but good facilities and free wi fi. Small kitchen sink and microwave and toaster and some extra cutlery make it more useful than your usual motel facilities. If you wanted to be close to the Stadium, this is your motel because it is directly across the road. Bed was firm and comfortable.

title: Really nice, modern room
text: I really liked this room. It was very well appointed, modern and spacious. The kitchenette had everything we needed, even champagne flutes! It was located close to shops etc and right opposite a stadium so not sure how things would be on game days! Didn't find Reception very  freindly but otherwise would highly recommend.

title: Excellent accommodation
text: I stayed at the Park View Motor Lodge recently for two nights on business. Having tried several other motels and hotels in Hamilton prior to coming across this one, I can say with confidence this is the best. Location is pretty good, right next to Waikato stadium, near the top of Mill Street and about a 5 min drive or 15-20 minute walk to Hamilton's restaurant district on Victoria Street. Plenty of room for parking, nice big spacious rooms with modern fittings, and good air conditioning. Very good value for money.

title: great place to stay
text: We stayed two days in order to go kayaking at Waitomo.  It is a lovely, well-appointed hotel, easy to find and clean, quiet and friendly. Loved the convenience of a fridge, hot plates, hair dryer - even makeup remover pads, plus the luxury of a small pool, spa and a spa bath in our unit.  Reception was very helpful when we at first couldn't use the wifi.

title: Spacious rooms
text: We stayed in Hamilton for the last night of our nz trip. This hotel was nice and clean, spacious rooms and not a bad location across from sports stadium. The spa was not working when we were there, which was a shame, however pool was nice.

title: Great overnight
text: A very clean spacious room with a kitchen, jacuzzi, comfortable beds & indoor pool. Next a rugby arena. Quiet neighborhood and easy access from state highway. Close to restaurants on Victoria street. A very helpful and friendly staff. We enjoyed our stay.

title: Great Hospitality, location and sauna.
text: We stayed for 1 night and chose Park View because it’s off the main drag in a quiet street and peaceful at night unlike the multitude of Ulster street accommodation in Hamilton’s “Motel Alley”. Its also central and close enough to the bars and restaurants. The room was a good size, clean and modern and the Hosts friendly. The sauna by the pool was a nice surprise. The WiFi was free as expected nowadays but also fast which is often not the case. All in all a pleasant experience, I will stay again.

title: Fantastic stay
text:
We spent one night here as we were passing through Hamilton. We had a one bedroom unit and it was everything you hope a motel is. Clean, quite, comfortable and spacious. The spa bath helped ease my aches and pains from sitting in the car.
We decided to take a walk into town for dinner (about a 5-7 minute walk) and found a mixture of restaurants that suited us. We chose a lovely little Thai restaurant.
I used the guest laundry to wash a heap of clothes as we had been travelling for a bit. Very convinient!
We did not get to use the pool but it did look very inviting.
The King sized beds were a welcome plus. Very comfortable.
The hosts were very friendly and accommodating. They suggested we go and visit the Hamilton Gardens. We visited the gardens on our way out of Hamilton and were very glad we look the time. Very beautiful.
All in all, a good stay. Will definitely be returning to this motel. 
Thank you for the wonderful stay!

title: Great Motor lodge in the city of the future
text: I stayed here for 3 nights on a business trip. I really like the fact that places like this have great little kitchenettes that you can cook meals and store food in a decent fridge etc. It had a LCD TV, heat pump and a little table where you could sit and eat your dinner. Free Wi-fi is a bonus and is becoming the expected norm for a business traveller such as myself. It had a Spa bath and my room had disabled facilities in the Bathroom. There is also a great sauna here and plenty of parking. The bed I feel let the place down a bit. And the walls are very thin. I recommend earplugs, as I was woken up at 6am by a baby crying next door and then again 15 mins later and at 8am by people next door banging doors :( Also, due to the courtyard design of the place you can hear people talking if they are having drinks in their rooms late at night and it echoes around the facility. I had the window closed the whole time to limit noise pollution and so I had no fresh air.

title: Clean and comfortable
text:
The first plus: how easy it was to find the place - nothing worse than driving around in a city you don't know looking for your destination. 
The second plus: the room was lovely. We stayed with our kids and we all loved the spa! The beds were super comfortable, the noise minimal and the service friendly.

title: Excellent stay
text: We stayed one night recently. Very happy with location, reception staff were very helpful with all enquiries. Perfectly clean and comfortable. Kitchen well appointed too. Pool area very clean and inviting too with pool nicely heated. Free WiFi was much appreciated too. Will be back!

title: Nothing special, and they don't know what is good service
text:
Stayed there for 3 nights. Was meant to be just a relaxing time away from home. (So we were hoping to be able to sleep in). Well, there are no "Do Not Disturb" signs - and no "Please Clean My Room" signs to hang on the outside door handle. So we were woken at 9 am every day by the cleaners, and then again at 10 am. And on our first morning, they came again .... and then disappeared. The Motel information book says the cleaners are there from 9 am to 1pm. So that first morning, on our way out, we went into the reception to ask for the room to be cleaned... and were told that the cleaners were already gone. When questioned, the guy said he couldn't pay their wages to just sit around. The conversation continued for a while, but it was all about the cleaners wages, and no word mentioned about customer service.  He didn't offer new towels, didn't offer anything.
Oh yes, about the towels, you get three - one small hand towel, and two medium sized bath towels. No spares.
The room was reasonably clean, but it was not vacuumed at all while we were there.
There are all the standard HD Freeview channels, plus Sky Movies, CNN, and 3 Sky Sports. But for all the Sky channels, you have to put the volume full on, and even then it is not loud enough.
We will not be returning to this motel.
hotel_response: Dear DavidR.  It is unfortunate that your stay at Park View Motor Lodge was ruined by avoidable circumstances.  Firstly, there was clearly a breakdown of communication between yourselves and our housekeeping staff. Secondly, it is sad to see that you have turned an innocent discussion about the service of your unit around in such a negative way. At no time during the conversation or during the three days did you ask for additional towels, which we are happy to provide....along with "do not disturb" signs if requested. Our reviews on this site generally testifies of great customer service. On your other points, it is pretty hard for the cleaners to vacuum your unit if they are denied access to the unit in the first place and as for the TV volume settings, I am not too sure how load you were expecting the TV to be???  The volume settings are of such that it does not disturb people in adjacent rooms, but is still rather load on full volume. Harry

title: Great Location
text:
Hubby & I booked here for one night as we were going to a concert at Founders Theatre. It couldn't have been handier being a 10  minute walk away. 
This is a very comfortable motel with well equipped modern rooms.
We fully recommend the $20 per head cooked breakfast delivered to the room exactly on time ordered. Well cooked & generous portions set us both up for our journey home.
hotel_response: Dear Cadgiebin. Thank you for your review posted on your recent stay at Park View Motor Lodge. Our location is indeed ideal for any event at Founders....saving you the hassle to find parking. We are also just a five minute walk to the closest restaurant. Hope to see you back soon! Harry

title: Beautiful Room, Convenient Location
text: My family and I stayed at the motel overnight and we were very impressed with the room and facilities.  The room was clean, lovely and surpasses our expectations.  We went swimming twice and both times, the pool was well heated. The spa was a real treat too.  Good communication when we made reservation and everything went smoothly at check-in even though we were 2 hours later than what was originally stated.  Service was warm and friendly.  Kitchen was clean, tidy and well fitted which is a real bonus because we could prepare simple meals for the kids.  It had a stove, microwave and even a coffee plunger.  Coffee, tea and milk are provided.  Highly recommend this motel and we will definitely visit again.
hotel_response:
Dear Toon001
Thank you for the fantastic review on your recent stay at Park View Motor Lodge. We are so happy that you enjoyed your stay and that the service and facilities surpassed your expectations. The pool is indeed heated and especially popular with families with children. Thank you so much for the great recommendation.
Harry

title: Nice Modern Motel
text:
We stayed here one night recently and thought the Motel was very nice and modern - just a short walk to Waikato Stadium, so it is ideal if you are going to see a game there, but if you don't like Rugby it may be a bit noisy if you are staying there during a game..
We found the room to be spacious, well laid out with everything you would need.
The bed, although comfortable was quite low, so I am not sure how elderly people would get on getting in and out of the bed
There were plenty of channels on the TV and free wifi was a bonus.
The pool area was good, clean and the spa was nice
We stayed upstairs and didn't hear anything from the room underneath - some motels you can hear people in the room above or below you 
Only downside was the toilet was not 100% clean, when we got there, but upon checkout the owners said they had been having trouble with their cleaners recently, so hopefully those problems have now been been fixed.

We would happily stay there again
hotel_response:
Dear Muffinz
Thank you for the review on your stay at Park View Motor Lodge recently. Our close proximity to the Waikato Stadium does make it ideal for attending the games. The heated pool on site is certainly a winner in everyone's books and having spa baths in every room is a huge bonus. Our housekeeping staff work tirelessly in maintaining high quality standards and I think that you may have misunderstood our reply to your complaint of your toilet. We do not have any trouble with our cleaning staff, but pledged to make the housekeeping staff aware of the problem that you experienced to make sure that something similar does not happen again.
Harry

title: All you need, check the reception hours though
text: Really all you need for a roadtrip stop, clean spacious rooms and good location. One downside that we experienced, which we thought to not be acceptable for an 'overnight only' type of hotel catering to people on a road trip, is that reception closes early (I remember 9pm) with no chance to check in later. This could stress you a bit when you are on the road and e.g. Want to make a dinner stop or run into a traffic jam...
hotel_response:
Dear Georg H
Thank you for taking the time to write a review and we are happy that you enjoyed your stay.  Even though we close reception at 9pm, arriving outside office hours has never been an issue, we only need a phone call or an email from a guest to make the necessary arrangements.

title: Modern, conveniently located
text: My family and I stayed in a family unit for one night over Easter.  We were impressed with the well appointed rooms, modern decor and service.  The motel is located just on the outskirts of the inner city area, and restaurants and entertainment just a short distance away.  Apart from the wifi signal, which was a bit patchy at times, all the mod cons were great.  It's certainly a good reliable choice for Hamilton accommodation, and I would wholeheartedly recommend.
hotel_response:
Hi Condwana80
Thank you for your fabulous review. We truly appreciate your kind words and recommendation.
Harry

title: Great Place
text: We recently stayed for the Waikato Balloon Festival and found the room to be clean and well appointed and the beds very comfortable. Unfortunately we left our pillows behind when we left but the owner very kindly offered to bring them up with him when he came through Auckland last week.  Even though it was a detour it was never a problem and I am very grateful to him for the extra effort he made to get our pillows back to us.  As we had such a great time in Hamilton, including visiting the Gardens and Zoo I am sure we will be back and will definitely stay again.
hotel_response:
Dear Suzanne G
Thank you for staying with us during a special time of the Balloon Festival. Going through to Auckland to drop off your pillows was no problem at all as we were on our way north on our holiday anyway. We were very happy to save you the hassle of trying to get them back. 
Harry

title: Very very nice.....
text: We were recently in Hamilton as my wife was in hospital. We arrived late and the owner was very accommodating and left the room open for us so when we arrived we went straight in.  The room was fantastic, very well presented, clean and very comfortable. I would highly recommend this motel and I will definitely take my wife there now she is on the mend :-)
hotel_response:
Hi Charles B. 
Thank you for your great review. The issue of late arrival times have been mentioned by other reviewers and your review is testimony of the fact that with prior arrangement this is no problem at all. We are very happy that you had a comfortable stay during a testing time with your wife in hospital. We are certainly looking forward to welcoming you back to our motel.
Harry

title: Very good location
text: Location was great for Hamilton and the surrounding area, quiet road - except if there is an event on at the Waikato stadium opposite. Not a problem as the owners were very helpful and we went to the rugby match that night! Rooms very good, comfortable and clean, heated pool as well and a spa bath in all the rooms. Will stay there again next time we are back in Hamilton.
hotel_response:
Dear Norton H. 
Thank you for your review on your stay at our motel. Our units are all fitted out with spa baths and the lovely heated pool is certainly a very popular attraction. Fortunately, on those game nights most people staying at the motel actually attend the game. What you have done was really remarkable. Instead of allowing the game day situation to affect you, you went along to watch the Chiefs play. Welcome to the Chiefs Supporters Club!!!!!
Harry

title: Very Pleasant
text: I arrived at the hotel late in the evening and was told that there were fully booked, so they had put me in a two bedroom suite, which I did not need. They were really pleasant and the room was very nice. I am not sure if every room has a hot tub, but the one I was in did. The room was well equipped and the internet coverage was fine. The location is right opposite the Chiefs stadium, so it might not be the best place to stay when there is a game on, as it could get noisy, but I do not know that for a fact. There is a nice restaurant / pub in walking distance, and a grocery and liquor store that is also walkable. The hotel is not near the center of Hamilton so be aware of that.
hotel_response:
Dear Nomolos. 
Thank you for your review on Park View Motor Lodge. All our units are indeed fitted with spa baths and the internet provided is free of charge. We were also very happy to accommodate you in a larger unit as we did not have any studio units left for the night. 
Harry

title: A cut above the average
text:
A typical motel appearance hides the fact that the Park View Motor a Lodge provides a level of comfort and facilities that would put many more aspiration all hotels to shame.

The carton of milk handed over with a welcoming word and a smile set the tone. Our room was very well equipped and the king size bed really comfortable. There was a small kitchen area with full-size sink and fridge. The spacious bath/shower room had a bath with spa-style jets.
hotel_response: Dear Savik.  Thank you very much for your great review.  We do believe that our facilities and the level of comfort provided by the units would satisfy most guest's expectations.....and our commitment to customer care would not be matched by anyone.  We are blessed with fantastic people that stay at our property and that makes our day even more enjoyable! Harry

title: Excellent motel.
text: Arrived at the motel about 4pm for an overnight stay and checked in without any problems. Reception very helpful. Room VERY clean and tidy.Everything  you could want in a motel. Bed very comfortable, TV tuned in properly , unlike a lot of more expensive hotels. Breakfast was brought to our room and was excellent. Highly recommended.
hotel_response:
Dear Albo70.  Thank you for placing your feedback on your recent stay at Park View Motor Lodge.
Our goal is to exceed our customer's expectations regarding service and housekeeping standards.  We are truly delighted that you enjoyed your stay and we hope that we will be able to welcome you back again one day.   Harry

title: Convenient, clean and well appointed
text:
We wanted somewhere convenient between Auckland and New Plymouth, as we were flying up from Christchurch the same day.   Hamilton is a couple of hours' drive south and there is motorway most of the way.

The motel lies opposite the Stadium (very handy if you're a rugby fan!) and I was at first concerned that we might experience some disturbance, but was reassured when I discovered there was no fixture on the date of our visit.   It turned out to be a good choice - we received a warm welcome and liked the unit we'd booked, which had separate sleeping and facilities for self-catering.   Shops are also close at hand.

Highly recommended!
hotel_response: Dear Australophiles.  Thank you for taking the time to place feedback on your recent stay at our Motel.  Our location close to the Waikato Stadium is indeed very handy for anyone attending a game....especially if your are wearing the correct colors of red, yellow and black!!!  It is only a short stroll across the road to the Stadium entrance.  There is however, only a few local games played during the season and if you are not a rugby fan, make sure you check with us for those game dates.  Outside of game days or other events, the Stadium offers no disturbance whatsoever and our Motel is conveniently situated away from the noisy main roads, yet close to the CBD, grocery stores and restaurants. Harry

title: Great place to stay
text: The apartment was up to a great standard and very clean. Very modern and well thought out, it had everything we needed. Beds were very comfortable. Owners extremely friendly and helpful and the cleaning staff are obviously fantastic judging by the apartment. The pool was actually heated and wonderful. We will stay here whenever we are in Hamilton.
hotel_response: Dear KimtOmokoroa.  We are delighted with your feedback on your recent stay at Park View Motor Lodge. Our cleaning staff work very hard on maintaining the high standards we have set and they were extremely happy when we shared your feedback with them.  Thank you again and we hope to see you back again soon.  Harry

title: Ideal place to stay in Hamilton
text: When choosing somewhere to stay in Hamilton it was pretty much a pinstick but I was glad we stayed at Park View - especially when we realised that New Zealand were playing a one day cricket international just down the road well within walking distance. I did ask for an early check in if possible as the game was due to start at 2pm and would more than likely finish after the last check in time of 9pm - I was emailed to advise that this might not be possible which is fair enough if all the rooms have been occupied the night before - as it happens our room was ready early enough which was great and we were even provided some milk on arrival - we then got a phone call telling us that as we had booked so early on in 2013 we were due a reduction in price which saved us 50 dollars - not something you would get in the UK !! Room was pleasant and clean with a spa bath and toiletries provided ( always handy ) - could not really fault it to be honest and if we do ever come to Hamilton again we would certainly stay here if it was available.
hotel_response: Dear footballhells.  Thank you for the fabulous review you placed recently on your stay at Park View Motor Lodge.  We are very proud of our Motel, our staff and level of service standards they deliver.  Our commitment to the wonderful people that stay at our property does not end there.  We are available 24 hrs a day and pride ourselves in our working ethics, credibility and the reputation we have built up over 18 years operating various properties around the globe.  Thank you again!  Harry

title: unfriendly welcome
text:
Reception was cool, and unfriendly.
Expensive for what it offered. 
Bed was hard. Air conditioner noisy. Dirty carpet. Toilet w/c  area cramped to accomodate large bath.
Management should monitor and control  noisy guests who congregate late at night in the noisy courtyard where their voices echo. Sleep quality poor because of this.
Annoying.
hotel_response: Dear Bulwell13.  We are very disappointed after receiving your feedback on your recent stay at our Motel.  We commit ourselves every day in exceeding our customer's expectations and we  apologize that we did not do so in your case.  I do wish you had given more info on your reception during check-in, which would have assisted us in training of our front desk staff.  Our price, however, compares favorably on most nights with properties with much lower star ratings than ourselves.  We have addressed some of your housekeeping concerns with our housekeeping team, but we do feel that your problem with the noisy guests could have been sorted if you alerted us to the noise at the time.  Our after hrs number is on the phone in the room and every guest has the right to alert us to anything that disturb their comfort during the night, in fact we insist on it!!  Our commitment to our guests is for you to have a memorable stay, but you have to give us a fair chance on delivering that promise by communicating any issue you experience that negatively influence your stay at our Motel. Harry

title: Great Hotel... But...
text: A great place to stay. Nice size rooms and very clean. Has everything you need from cutlery to a hair drier. Has a washing machine and drier on site and an indoor pool and spa which are both heated. Every room has a separate shower and spa bath in them. Only thing wrong was the duty manager (Harry) He was not very helpful and when we went to order breakfast for 5 people in 2 rooms, he said he can only cook 2 meals at a time. times were 8, 8.15 and 8.30. We have stayed at a lot of places and never been told this.  Said he couldn't even do 3 for 1 room and 2 for the other room 15 minutes apart. At $20 pp for breakfast he turned down $100. So if you don';t plan on getting breakfast for more than 2 people at a time, great place to stay.

title: Great  Hotel but not friendly manager
text: We stayed 1 night with two rooms. Arrived a little early 40mins and were told to come back after 2pm. Not would you like to wait as your room is half an hour. Go away and come back!!  The rooms were fantastic, roomy and clean, the pool and spa were great for a quick dip. Decided to order breakfast for the following morning however as there were 5 of us got told they could only do 2 breakfasts at one time!! This meant 2 being delivered at 8am, 2 at 8.15 and 1 at 8.30.  Not great service from the manager. Shame as the hotel was perfect.  However when the booking was made the staff member was very helpful.
hotel_response:
Dear Steve N. 
Thank you for your review on your stay at Park View Motor Lodge.  Check-in times are explained when reservations are made and they are there for a reason.  A early check-in can be arranged prior to arrival but can not always be guaranteed.  It will all depend on how busy we were the night before.  As for the breakfast delivery, with a number of other rooms that had already ordered breakfast for the same time, it was impossible for us to do an additional 5 at the same time that you requested......and the only way that we could accommodate your breakfast request did not meet your requirements.  We do however appreciate your feedback, and we are glad that you enjoyed your stay regardless.  Harry

title: great place for families
text: being a family of five (3 teens) finding rooms to accommodate us is challenging.  We loved our stay and were very comfortable in these clean new rooms.  was a perfect, quiet location just close enough to Hamilton attractions.  we did have a car.
hotel_response:
Dear Mcgben5.
Thank you for your fabulous review.  We are so glad that we were able to provide you with the facilities that fit your requirements.  Accommodation for families are hard to find, as most of the city motels cater for a large corporate market.  We have a selection of units that will satisfy most criteria and having the heated pool on site, makes for great entertainment for the kids!  Harry

title: Not for us
text:
Once we were inside our room it was ok, however the location is a bit dismal. I thought we were going to have a view of a park, but actually our room faced the rugby stadium. Even with no game on and minimalist stadium  lights on, our room was very light with all drapes closed.
In reading other reviews, it appears that this was not suited to our needs and was glad we were there only for one night.

title: Excellent stay
text: We recently stayed one night in Hamilton on our way to points further north and had an excellent experience.  Our room was very nice - well appointed, very comfortable and spotless.  All of our needs were anticipated and catered to, and we really couldn't ask for anything more.  It is hard to imagine a nicer place or better value for money, and we would highly recommend the Park View.

title: Perfect for families
text: Our family stayed in a 2 bedroom apartment recently and we were very impressed with the cleanliness and layout of our apartment.  The swimming pool was excellent.  This is a perfect location for anyone staying in Hamilton who is up there watching rugby as the grounds are just across the road.  Would definetly stay there again.

title: Great for Families
text: We had a one bedroom suite.  It was very spacious and comfortable for our family with two teenagers.  The bathroom was spacious with a spa.  The room was clean.  The kitchen was well equipped and there was free WIFI, free laundry, and a swimming pool.  The front desk/reception area was very small with very little area information.  The staff did their job adequately.  The one catch about this property is that it is immediately across the street from a big rugby stadium so the experience at the property probably varies on dates when there is a game at the stadium.

title: Always pleasantly surprised
text: I stayed for 2 nights in Hamilton for business last month.This was my 3rd time at the Park View Motor Lodge. I keep forgetting how friendly and helpful the staff always are, and how clean and organised every room has been. The heated pool is a favourite as well. I really couldn't see how it could be improved - PVML really sets my benchmark for everything I expect in a home away from home, for anywhere in the world. Why can't every hotel be run this way ? Thanks again guys. I'll be back again.

title: Last Minute Booking
text: I was stranded without a vehicle and happened to need a last minute booking in Hamilton a few weeks ago, and found the fairly new  Park View Motor Lodge on google. The studio unit I stayed in was excellent overall, and had everything I needed. Very clean and comfortable it was also well appointed with good linen and even a robe. It wasn't the cheapest on offer but it was well worth paying a tiny bit extra for this standard of accommodation. I would be happy to stay there again anytime.

title: OK
text: The bathroom was strange, great shower and bath BUT I defy anyone to be able to sit on the loo straight as the hand basin and vanity were positioned so they were on your lap if you tried. Maybe a hobbit would manage the rest of us had to sit sideways with knees on the edge of the bath. WHY when the bathroom was actually quite spacious! Also there was a stench of sewerage which seemed to come and go. When reception staff were notified in the morning that it was very unpleasant, total indifference was the response. "oh, maybe it was the drains, you knew we had hot water problems" Since when did hot water problems cause that kind of reek! Had there been an apology  or perhaps "I hope it did not affect your stay" we may have been more sympathetic. We realise maintanence problems can occur. Expensive considering.

title: Great Modern Motel - Central Location
text: We had a family function in Hamilton and chose the Park View as it was central and modern. If you are a rugby fan it's opposite the rugby grounds so very convenient. We were a family of 5 so booked a 2 bedroom unit with a queen size pull out sofa bed. The room was clean and tidy and had seating for 5. They had a good quantity of towels and glasses, quite often motels never have enough cups and glasses - this place did. They also have free wifi. We needed an additional blanket for the sofa bed and front office provided one very quickly. We were on the  top floor (2 levels) and the complex was quite for being fully booked. They do have a small heated pool and spa even though we didn't use it, another family were so definitely warm enough for a June winter. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Excellent Property
text: This is an excellent motel. My partner and I stayed for one night in a unit on the first floor and I certainly cant fault the property. The rooms are spotless, beds comfortable and it was very quite even though the property was fully occupied. Its a great location and I would love to stay again. Congratulations to the owners/managers for doing such a great job.

title: Great room & great service
text:
We were greeted by the owners on arrival who were really friendly and helpful.
We stayed 3 nights over a busy weekend and our room was lovely and quiet.
A big thanks to the great service from the cleaning/servicing crew, we would definitely stay here again.

title: Great stay as always
text:
I have stayed here on a number of occasions and have always found it clean, comfortable and convenient.  The units have nice spa baths, and showers with good pressure.  The decor is modern, and the beds comfortable.  They have a good selection of TV channels including two Sky sports channels.  I have never had a bad experience here.
If you want a motel near the Waikato stadium this is a great pick.  Even if you have business in the CBD, it is still very convenient (a 5 min drive to Garden Place).

title: at last good accomodation in Hamilton !
text: Had a large bus so needed somewhere that i could park it ,all the larger olaces were booked so ended up here , plenty of on street parking and a bus stop directly across the road , reasonable quite , tidy and modern , close to town , staff were helpfull and freindly will definitely stay here again
hotel_response: Dear Graig H.  I guess it can get a bit tricky sometimes finding accommodation when you are travelling around in a big bus.  Great to know that you enjoyed your stay with us.  We hope to see you back again soon!!  Harry

title: Amazing Accommodation
text:
We spent one fantastic night in a premium suite complete with a big shower, comfortable spa bath and amazing King-sized bed.

Wi-fi was fast and free, plenty of facilities free of charge and optional room service. Really wish we could have stayed much longer. 

The owners are very friendly and know exactly how to make their guests feel welcome and at home. Would happily recommend this Motor Lodge to anyone, it completely exceeded high expectations and made the trip memorable.
hotel_response: Dear Logan P.  Thank you for your fantastic review of your recent stay at Park View Motor Lodge.  We are delighted that you enjoyed your stay with us and hope to welcome you back again soon!!  Harry

title: One nice night.
text: Very nice room with A/C, huge bathroom with spa tub and full kitchen.  Free internet and laundry.  Pillows were way hard - bring your own!  Hosts were great with directions and tourist stuff.  Overall, well worth the ~$170 NZD or so we paid for the night.  I'd stay here again.
hotel_response: Dear whmiller.  Thank you for your great review of your recent stay.  We do offer soft alternative pillows, available from reception on request.  The availability of the softer pillows is noted in the compendium in the room.  You would also have paid a lot less if you booked directly with us, saving yourself the agent's commission.  Harry

title: Fantastic accommodation
text: We stayed one night and were sorry that we couldn't spend more time here but we had to be at Auckland airport the following day. As soon as we walked into the room we knew that this was quality accommodation.  The bed was great, the bathroom was big and spotless with a spa bath as well. The small kitchen was neat and clean with a small stove top which would be handy for longer stays. There was plenty of tea, coffee & sugar provided as opposed to some hotels we had stayed in. Free Wi-Fi was included which is a big plus. A pool, spa and sauna were available for use by the guests. The town centre is not very far away but there is no public transport in the area so a taxi would be the way to go and wouldn't cost much. This motor lodge is directly opposite Waikato Stadium so if there was a game on the motor lodge would probably be booked out by football fans. Very pleasant owners, very accommodating.  Would definitely stay here again.
hotel_response: Dear SAK06.  Thank you for yor great review of your recent stay at Park View Motor Lodge.  We truly hope you enjoyed your trip and also sad that you could not stay longer.  We hope to see you back one day.  Harry

title: very nice one bedroom unit
text: had a one bedroom unit with two single beds (in separate room) and queen bed for family of four adults.  nice motel, was quiet but then it is opposite the stadium and dont know how quiet it would be then.  was clean, tidy and comfortable,  would recommend the stay
hotel_response: Dear jacksinthehouse.  Thank you for the great review.  It does get a bit noisy during a game at the Stadium, but then again, most people that stay with us on those days are actually attending the game!!!  After the game, the Stadium empties out within about 20 minutes and peace and quite returns.  Everybody heads into town to the pubs and that is where the real noise is.  Here, half an hour after the game you wouldn't know there was a game on!!  Harry

title: Excellent accommodation
text: Stayed 4 nights on business trip. Modern, clean motels.   Excellent WiFi - good work space and lighting.  Nothing too much trouble for management.  Supermarket and shops within walking distance.  Not the cheapest motel, but value for money.  I'd stay again.
hotel_response: Dear John S.  Thank you so much for the fantastic review of your recent stay at Park View Motor Lodge.  We hope to welcome you back in the near future.  Harry

title: Comfortable, clean and quiet
text:
Our room was excellent, spacious and clean. It had a good size shower with excellent pressure and a spa bath.
It is a quiet location well away from main roads.  Hosts were welcoming and friendly.  Free Internet and good parking.  We will be back next trip North
hotel_response: Dear PGNZ.  Thank you for your great review.  We will certainly be looking out for you and be ready to welcome you back to Park View Motor Lodge!!  Harry

title: Top Accommodation
text: Spent 2 nights out of 14 during North Island trip at Park View. The 2 bedroom unit was the best we stayed in- spotlessly clean and the servicing of the room timely and well executed. The facilities included (within a modern design) a spa bath, a good sized TV, a small kitchenette, good quality large beds and good access to the internet. Very accessable to the city and restaurants. Very good breakfasts sent to room. A quiet location. We would recommend this accommodation.
hotel_response: Dear Stephen H.  Thank you for your great review of Park View Motor Lodge.  It was an honor to have you with us during your trip to New Zealand.  We are truly blessed with wonderful staff that maintain the property in top shape...and fantastic guests that appreciate the hard work!!!!  Thank you again!!  Harry

title: Fantastic Hotel
text: Stayed for one night, but it was one of the best we had encountered in the north island.  Wonderful modern facilities, and very helpful receptionist.  Great view, modern spa bath and easy internet access.  Would highly recommend staying at this facility.  Very clean, and good parking facilities.
hotel_response: Dear Jeanette P.  Many thanks for the fantastic review.  Hope you enjoyed your trip to New Zealand.  We just had the best summer ever this year!!!  Truly looking forward to welcoming you back one day.  Harry

title: Modern, clean motel with lovely spa bath
text: I stayed here for 1 night with my girlfriend. The room was spotlessly clean, had a nice flat screen TV, and a huge bed. The bathroom was big and had an amazing spa bath. We used the sauna and spa down stairs too. Would stay here again.
hotel_response: Dear Caroline W.  Thank you for your fabulous review.  We are so glad that you made use of the facilities while staying with us.  We truly hope that you enjoyed your trip to New Zealand and that we might be able to welcome you back here one day!!!!  Harry

title: A Good Stopping Off Point Whilst Visiting Hamilton
text:
Nice clean rooms with good up to date facilities

Free WIFI which was great

Good sized heated pool and spa

Located in a good place to strike out and visit the city and all it has to offer

The Hamilton Gardens are a must
hotel_response: Dear Amdale.  Thank you for your great review.  We are idealy located close to the CBD with restaurants only a short walk away, but away from the main street that may be noisy at night.  Thank you again!!!  Harry

title: nice place to stay
text:
great place to stay, would stay again.  Quiet place, which gave me an excellent sleep, well fitted out, and clean, I mean what my wife would call clean (really really clean).
Nice to make breakfast in the room, not eating tired, oily, overpriced hotel buffet food. 
If you want to use the sauna, you need to book with reception first, the pool is great for a quick dip after dinner.
hotel_response: Dear Mike S.  Thank you for your review of Park View Motor Lodge. Our housekeeping staff are excellent and work very hard to produce quality rooms.....and we are thrilled that our high quality standards impressed you.  Thank you again!!  Harry

title: CoMfY sTaY!
text: We checked in the the evening, and were able to go for a swim before dinner. Small pool & hot tub, but our 3 & 5 year old loved it. We even got a load of laundry done for free at their facility. We had ample space in our 1 bedroom unit. Loved the huge tub! The toilet is in a cramped space, but all you have to do is turn to the side. Had a bit of trouble figuring out the air conditioner, until we realized that it was a remote, not thermostat. The bedding seemed newer and crisp clean. Also had bathrobes available to use. It is directly across the road from a rugby stadium, and around the corner from a Pack n Save, great easy location for cook your own meals. Had a great stay there.
hotel_response: Dear TheSchu's.  We are so happy that you enjoyed your stay with us.  The pool is very popular being heated and indoors....especially with the kids!!!!  Thank you for a fantastic review.  Harry

title: Clean, Newer Motor Lodge
text: The Park View seems to have been recently constructed and maintains a “new” feel to it.  It is a true “motor lodge” with the room access from the parking lot and the registration desk and lobby accessed separately.  The room was very modernly decorated with contemporary furnishings and fresh paint (the pictures on their website are accurate).  The bathroom had a shower with a separate, very large spa tub, and clean towels.  Although I didn’t use the kitchenette to its full potential, it was handy to have use of a microwave and refrigerator.  The bed was not the most comfortable to sleep in (no apparent box spring), but the sheets and pillows seemed clean.   The Park View is directly across the street from the Waikato Stadium, which is very convenient if you were going to a game, not so much if there’s an event going on there that might otherwise disturb you.  I had a car, so the drive into the downtown area was only a matter of minutes, but I would estimate it to be a 15 minute walk.
hotel_response: Dear BMcChicago.  Thank you for great review of Park View Motor Lodge.  It may surprize you to know that the motel is almost 10 years old and it is thanks to the dedicated team that all work together in keeping the property in such a good state.  Harry

title: Great place to stay
text: Extremely well kept, clean & tidy. The rooms have everything you need to make your stay enjoyable. The rooms are nicely decorated, the beds are comfy, the shower is excellent & the spa bath is a bonus! The lodge is obviously convenient for the satdium but it is also really close to town too.
hotel_response: Dear B10d.  Thank you for your great review.  The team work very hard in upkeeping of the property and it is fantastic that people notice the result of everyone's efforts.  Harry

title: Great accomodation!
text:
After being welcomed by a friendly and helpful staff,we stayed only one night in a downstairs room,got a good sleep(we were not bored by the daylight) in a large comfy bed.The room was spotless with plenty of storage,We were amazed by the bathroom with a good selection of toiletries, spabath,handy shower and overall Grohe plumbing fixtures!We didn't used the kitchen and the heated indoor pool.
The free wifi and AC worked well
We had a good dinner in The Thai Classic restaurant 783 Victoria street

Highly recommended!
hotel_response: Dear bernard69.  Thank you for your fantastic review.  We truly hope that you enjoyed your trip to New Zealand. Harry

title: Family Holiday stay in Hamilton
text:
The first part of our family holiday, we stayed in a few places during our month long trip to NZ.  of all the places we stayed, the Park View was our equal first wchoice with the Grand Chancellor at Auckland's viaduct, which is saying a lot as we were VIP guests at the Grand, so Park View really flexed it's muscles in that regard.
The location of the Park View was excellent, the rooms were looked after every day by the staff and are hosts were very very nice.  
Within cooee of Pak n Save and the cdb, so everything was near by and travelling in and out of Hamilton was a breeze.  
Of our whole trip, my personal favourite activity was walking out the front door of our room, crossing the road to the stadium and watching the Chiefs defeat the Waratahs ...while eating a sausage on a stick..YAY !!!!

I will be staying again.
hotel_response: Dear Dain K.  Thank you for the excellent review......you totally blew us away with the comparison to the Grand Chancellor!!!!!  Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for choosing to stay at Park View and we truly hope that you enjoyed your trip to our beautiful New Zealand!  I really like your comment about the Chiefs wipping the Tahs!!!!!!  Harry

title: "Amazing RnR Stay"
text: Park View Motor Lodge was highly recommended to me by family members who've stayed before so I thought why not!  First impressions last so my first impression was that this motor lodge is very well presented professionally and Mandi the host was inviting and helpful. The decor of my room was tasteful, well presented and inviting. The bathroom was spacious even with a great big spa bath, the room had an air con although the room temp was perfect. There were great facilities for cooking etc, a comfortable king bed and overall spotlessly clean. The motor lodge cleaning staff were also very friendly and made sure that their service was just that, so I could just relax!  It was amazingly quiet too which was what I hoped for. The best part of my stay however would've been the heated pool and the awesome spa pool right next to it with loads of towels on hand. I loved every minute of my stay and would definitely recommend to all. I no doubt will be visiting again in the future, thanks Park View Motor Lodge :)
hotel_response: Dear Maxine M.  Thank you sooooooo much for the great review!!  We really enjoyed having you here with us and are so pleased that you made use of the heated pool and spa.  We hope to see you back at Park View Motor Lodge again soon.  Harry

title: Fantastic!!
text: I had a fantastic stay here at the Park View Motor Lodge. We're going through a crazy bathroom renovation at home and I just couldn't take it any more! I needed comfort, quiet, space and an actual bathroom! The Lodge was all that and more. The room was so inviting and the shower was superb! The owners are just amazing - super nice and helpful. All of the staff are wonderful. I had the peace and space to get a lot of work done. The room was extremely comfortable. I was very sorry to check out. I would not hesitate to recommend the Park View Motor Lodge to anyone needing a well presented, comfortable, clean and friendly place to stay, even if you actually live in Hamilton and just need to escape! I booked directly with the Lodge - I certainly got value for money. Their rates are cheaper by booking directly with them than any website deal.
hotel_response: Dear Brigitte M.  Wow, thank you so much for the fantastic review.  We are delighted that you enjoyed your stay and that we were able to provide you with the comfort and support you needed during the testing time you experienced.  We hope that you are enjoying your new bathroom at home!!!  Harry

title: "FIRST CLASS"
text: I stayed at Park View Motor Lodge recently for a two day business meeting and found the Lodge to be well run and the rooms well presented and clean.  The staff were very helpful and advised me of  various places of interest to visit in the area. Unfortunately I did not have time to visit much of Hamilton but do intend to return on a pleasure trip. Highly recommend this Lodge for either business, family or just a trip away.  Well deserving of 5 stars.
hotel_response: Dear Kevin F.  Thank you for your great review.  You are certainly most welcome any time you are in back Hamilton.  Harry

title: Fantastic Location
text:
A group of us stayed whilst playing in a golf tournament in Hamilton.
The location of the Motor Lodge was perfect, the staff efficient and the rooms suited perfectly.
When I next travel to Hamilton, I will stay again.
hotel_response: Dear John M.  Thank you very much for your excellent review.  We have some great golf courses around Hamilton and having a good choice of excellent Motels to cater for your accommodation needs also helps.  Nothing like soaking the sore muscles in the spa bath or the heated pool after a day out hitting birdies!!  Hope to see you back at Park View Motor Lodge again soon.  Harry

title: Always my preferred accommodation!
text:
Love it here, have stayed many times however have only just found Tripadvisor and thought I had better say something!

Lovely place, great hosts, clean, clean, clean, very modern and quiet and the indoor heated pool is just the ticket!

See you again soon!
hotel_response: Hi Kiwi888Auckland.  Thank you so much for the great review.  We truly appreciate you taking the time to place a review.  We are looking forward to welcoming you back next time you are in Hamilton!  Harry

title: A motelier that understands the hospitality industry!
text: I stayed at Parkview with a business group, using the conference centre by day and rooms by night. What stood out was the motelier; someone who knew (or has been trained in) the hospitality industry. As a result,everything about our stay was pleasurable. Nothing was too much trouble. Five stars well deserved.
hotel_response: Dear Steven M.  Thank you for the kind words.  For those who know, the hospitality industry can be an exhausting business.  Those who prevail are the ones that make their jobs of looking after the every need of their customers a lifestyle, rather than just a career.....the smile of a happy guest the ultimate prize!!!!!  Hope to see you back at Park View Motor Lodge again soon.  Harry

title: Two Day Summit
text:
For a two day business meeting the Park View Motor Lodge proved to be an excellent venue. The conference room and the facilities were excellent. Quiet and well appointed we were able to get on with the reason we were there and accomplish our objectives without interuption and in comfort. 

The rooms were comfortable, spacious, clean with good quality linen and towels... and a complimentry newspaper delivered to the door is always good to wake up to. 

Staff were very proffesional and obliging, nothing seemed to be a problem. Certainly I would stay at the Lodge again and would highly recomend it to visitors to Hamilton for business or pleasure.
hotel_response: Dear Peter J. Thank you so much for the excellent review.  Our quest for service excellence here at Park View Motor Lodge is never-ending, your comfort and well-being our ultimate goal. We are looking forward to welcoming you back again soon!  Harry

title: Outstanding business venue
text:
I stayed at the Park view for a weekend conference.  Fantastic venue.  Well equiped conference centre with white boards, flip charts, coffee on tap etc.  Couldnt fault the premises or staff.  Also the rooms were very nice - very modern and comfortable.  The only complaint was the weather - it rained all weekend (which is not really something they control).  However, to be fair there was no need to go outside at all as everything we needed was there.

Unforunately, I didnt get to use the heated pool and spa - too much business to be done.  This will be something I will definitely utilise next time though.

I would highly recommend the motel as a conference venue or for a holiday.
hotel_response: Dear Richard W.  Thank you for the great review.  Pitty you did net get around to using our  heated pool.....everyone just loves it.  Our conference venue is pretty handy and it is nice and quite here, away from the noisy main roads.  Plenty of parking available and we have some great caterers!!  We are delighted that you enjoyed your stay and we hope to see you back again soon!  Harry

title: Highly recommended
text: I recently stayed in this motel for the first time on business.  I would highly recommend it to other travellers.  The staff were friendly, welcoming and very flexible.  I needed to check in well before their normal check-in times and they were able to accommodate this.   The room was attractively decorated, extremely well equipped and very comfortable.  The motel has very good facilities and is in a handy location in Hamilton.  Rooms have a spa bath and separate shower.  The furnishings are clean, modern and tasteful and the bed was extremely comfortable.
hotel_response: Hi Faith1000. Thank you for your great review!  We do try and accommodate everyone's special requests as far as possible. Hope to see you back again soon! Harry

title: First class!
text: An immaculate and well managed establishment which I stayed at for one night on a business trip. The rooms were really well presented, very clean and comfortable and staff were friendly and proffessional. It is located next to the Waikato rugby stadium, but away from the busy main roads, so its also nice and quiet at night. There are plenty restaurants, cafe's and take-aways within walking distance or just a short drive away and Hamilton city centre is nearby. I also found the rate for my studio room very reasonable and can only recommend Park View as a great place to stay in Hamilton
hotel_response: Thank you Markfor for your excellent review.  We hope to see you back at Park View Motor Lodge soon! Harry

title: Excellent, friendly and close to everything
text: Stayed with two kids, 12 and 14 for a week.  Host Harry and Mandy were awesome, very friendly and  Services provided were outstanding. Rooms were lovely, modern and clean.  A large bathroom with shower and spa bath. I love the fact you are doing your bit for NZ with your recycling process. Stayed in a self contained 1 room with double in lounge/kitchen area, kids had own TV in their room as well, great view of Waikato stadium and was lovely sitting outside on veranda having a wine watching the world go by, very quite and relaxing. The  Kids loved the pool and spa, was great after a hard day training.  Sauna also for guests use.  Great to see a FREE laundry for guests to use as well.  We travel alot with the kids and I am so pleased we found this motel, will certainly be staying again,  Highly recommended!
hotel_response: Thank you Fiona3025 for the great comments.  We dearly hope to see you back soon again!  Harry

title: A Great Easter Break
text: We chose to stay here mostly beacuse it was close to the town and restaurants.  The moteliers were friendly and helpful.  The room was spotless and compact.  GIven the motel is opposite the Waikato Stadium and we expected the road to be noisy we were not disturbed at all.
hotel_response: Dear SteffAuckland.  Thank you for taking the time to comment on your recent stay at Park View Motor Lodge, we truly appreciate the positive feedback!!  We are looking forward to welcoming you back on your next visit.  Harry

title: A great choice!
text: My colleague and I stayed in a self-contained 2 bedroom apartment for 5 days whilst in Hamilton for business. I could not have made a better choice for our accommodation! Harry and Mandy were lovely hosts and nothing was too much to ask. Working in the accommodation industry ourselves, we know a good place when we see one. The room was great, with modern features and a well appointed kitchen, and the beds extremely comfortable. The curtains blocked out the light so much I found it hard to get out of bed in the morning - now, that's a good sleep! All in all, it was an excellent stay and Harry and Mandy can be proud of the service the deliver. Thanks guys, and if you're ever making your way over to Brisbane or the Gold Coast, give us a call.
hotel_response: Hi BrisHolidayVillage.  Thank you so much for the great comments.  It was such an honor to meet you and accommodate you during your trip to Hamilton.  Thank you for choosing Park View Motor Lodge and we are surely coming over to Australia for a visit soon!!!!  Harry

title: excellent
text:
what a lovely place to stay,
lovely clean and comfy rooms with spa bath, cooking facilities and tv's in all rooms 
lovely location especially for the rugby stadium.
lovely hot swimming pool spa and sauna
free guest laundry
excellent service 
very helpful staff
hotel_response: Hi NewzealandCat.  Thank you so much for your great comments.  We appreciate the time and effort to place your feedback enormously!!!!  We hope to see you back again soon.  Harry

title: Exceptional service, very clean & comfortable accommodation!
text: Thanks to Harry, Mandy and team at Park View Motor Lodge for a very comfortable stay and for their exceptional customer service. We stayed in a 2-bedroom fully self-contained apartment complete with spa in the bathroom. It was modern, very clean and comfortable. A laundry with free washing machine and drier is available for guests to keep their washing up-to-date. A new pool and spa area ... and all new bedspreads will compliment their already wonderful facilities. All items in the apartment were exceptionally clean and in good working order. Close to the Hamilton City Centre yet away from any traffic noise, if you book a holiday or business stay at this property, you can't go wrong!
hotel_response: Hi AshmorePalms.  Thank you for the fantastic feedback.  Wow, it was such an honor to have you here with us during your stay in Hamilton.  Thank you again and hope to see you soon......will visit you next time we are over in Aus.  Harry

title: Excellent Accommodation
text:
We stayed in a two bedroom unit which was exceptionally clean, spacious and had the added 'extra' of three T.V's (one in living & one in each bedroom) & a spa bath. Nice view over to the stadium and being slightly out of town there was no traffic noise.  
Our girls LOVED the heated indoor swimming pool and rate this one-of-the-best (& cleanest) they have ever swum in whilst away.  Hosts were also extremely helpful with directions and local attractions.  Would definately stay again - & have tried on several occasions but has always been booked out  :-(

title: Good, clean and comfortable motel
text:
This motel is in a handy location in Hamilton - very close to the Waikato Rugby Stadium, but not right in the middle of the CBD where it tends to get quite noisy at night.

Good sized kitchenette, bath room with spa bath and air conditioning. The real bonus is the free broadband during your stay.

Very tidy and clean and the property is well looked after.

I have stayed here twice and it is very likely that I will stay here again in future.

title: Really Nice Motel
text: We stayed here on our way home from Auckland.  We arrived late and had mixed up the bookings.  The hosts were very accommodating and nothing was a problem.  Rooms were very comfortable and clean.  Hosts were very friendly and professional.

title: Pretty good
text: We had a nice break and enjoyed staying in Park View lodge. The housekeeping service is great. The room is nice and well equipped. We also like the spa bath. The free internet, plunger coffee and newspaper are big bonuses. The only problem I had is also about there was no "do not disturb" sign, and the house keeper walked into our room while we were sleeping.
hotel_response: Dear ShashaCD.  Thank you for taking the time to comment on your stay at Park View Motor Lodge.  We regret the fact that our housekeeper walked in on you, as the issue of "Do not disturb" signs have been a difficult one to deal with.  With external entry doors to rooms at Motels it is not always practical to have these, as the wind blows them off the doors.  We have a system in place that housekeeping only goes to rooms once we have indicated to them that the guests have checked out.  We regret failing on this in your case and hope to see you back here again in the future.  Thank you for the good feedback and kind words, regardless of the problem you experienced. Harry.

title: No blackout curtains equals no sleep
text: Comfortable and clean but there were two issues I had.  One; this property is rated 5-star but there were no blackout curtains in my room.  I was up late working and went to bed at 1.00 am only to be woken at the crack of dawn by the daylight coming through the curtain - which on first appearances looks like a blackout curtain but is not - and lighting up the room.  Two; there are no "do not disturb" signs.  I'm someone who often goes to a hotel when I have important work to finish and don't want to be disturbed - I unplug the phone and put out the "do not disturb" sign.  As previously mentioned I am often up late working and do not want to be woken or bothered in the morning by house-keeping.
hotel_response: Dear Caroline.  Thank you for commenting on your stay at Park View Motor Lodge.  We regret the two issues that you experienced at the Motel, this after we went to great lengths to make your stay as comfortable as we could, with you having a broken foot.  We are a bit dumbfounded by the comment about the curtains, as they are supposed to be blackout curtains.  As for the "Do not disturb' signs, we have mentioned it in another reply to a comment, that with our external entry doors exposed to the elements, it is not always practical to have these as the wind blows them off the door handles.  We hope that you are recovering well from your foot injury and would be out walking your dog again very soon!!!!  Harry

title: Nice place for business trip.
text: Comfortable bed, non-smoking big rooms, kitchenette was good, big jacuzzi tub, free wifi, tv and sky tv for extra channels.  Right by the stadium (awesome if you want to go to a game!)  My room had a deck with a small view of the field.  Clean, mostly quiet. Had good coffee in the room (not instant).
hotel_response: Dear kinx81.  Thank you for the great comment on your stay at Park View Motor Lodge.  We hope to see you back again in the near future. Harry.

title: Great Hospitality!=)
text: We stayed their for the friday and saturday night!Had a great time!Very Flash and great service!will be coming back next year!
hotel_response: Dear Melissa C.  Thank you for taking the time to comment on your stay at Park View Motor Lodge.  We are delighted when we get responses like yours.....we hope to see you back again soon.  Harry

title: Perfect location for sports fans
text:
We stayed at the Park View Motor Lodge for a night as part of a work trip.  Service at reception was very friendly, and the rooms are well appointed.  As others have mentioned, we received a complementary newspaper and there is free wifi (although I found it very slow).

The room I stayed in was a good size, with plenty of storage and I was quite surprised to find a small kitchenette.  The room was well equipped, with a 32inch TV, a spa bath and a heat pump.  The room also had great views of the Waikato Stadium - in fact, I could see parts of the pitch from my room.  

As others have also mentioned, the Speights Ale House is very close (and is recommended), as are two supermarkets.

One thing to bear in mind for light sleepers is that the room has bifold doors opening up to a balcony . . .which would be absolutely fantastic on a summer's day, but boy, the wind does whistle through it during a southerly.  However, units that don't face southerly shouldn't have any problems.

The biggest disappointment for me about Park View was that on checking out, the resident tabby was far more interested in being fed and refused to let me pat her.
hotel_response: Dear weta.  Thank you for your great comments on your stay at Park View Motor Lodge.  We learn so much from people's experiences and sincerely hope to see you back again soon.  Unfortunately, Max our cat, has a mind of his own and would only allow someone to pat him when he is in his "cat coma" as I call it..........on his back sleeping on the chair!  Thank you again!  Harry.

title: is now our 'preferred' accommodation provider for Hamilton
text:
Our group of five arrived late at night and were absolutely delighted with the beautiful rooms, and that Harry/Mandie had turned the heaters on and closed the drapes.  It made for a cosy and welcoming arrival after a long drive.  

Booking was a breeze and again Harry and Mandie were accommodating when rang to make changes along the way.  Nothing was a bother and this is a true sign of great customer service.  Consequently they are now our preferred accommodation provider for our organisation.

10 out of 10!!
hotel_response: Dear Allie H.  Thank you for taking the time to comment on your stay at Park View Motor Lodge.  Our commitment is to make your stay as comfortable as possible and no effort will be spared in ensuring an enjoyable stay every time!  We are so happy that you would be coming back regularly and we can't wait to welcome you back to our motel!!!!!!  Harry

title: Exceeded all of our expectations
text:
My wife and I stayed 3 nights when I was working in Hamilton. We were not expecting the little touches - the complementary newspaper, free laundry, daily room service (certainly were not expecting the dishes to be washed by the time my wife returned from dropping me to work), free and unrestricted wifi. The indoor heated pool and spa were awesome.

I would have to say it was the best out-of-home experience ever, including some so-called "luxury resorts". Everything was fresh and clean, and the hosts are fantastic. Would certainly recommend to anybody staying in Hamilton.
hotel_response: Dear Nathan H.  Wow, you have just blown us away.  Thank you so much for the comments......it was great to have you here with us and surely hope to see you back soon.  It is such a pleasure to have wonderful people like you staying at our beautful motel which we are so proud of!!!   Harry

title: Clean, warm and convenient
text:
We stayed on Friday night after battling the Auckland traffic, and arrived in Hamilton around 6:00pm.

We stayed in Unit 6, and it was lovely. 

The main living area as soon as you walked in had a kitchen along one wall, a desk area with two chairs, a TV mounted on the wall, a mini stereo, a small dining table with two chairs, a smaller table with two chairs, and then the king size bed and built in drawers beside it. It sounds like a lot of furniture but it didn’t feel overcrowded. 
There’s a heat pump in the main area, and this was brilliant – we turned it on as soon as we arrived, and the whole unit was warm very quickly. We fell asleep while it was still on later that night, and I ended up turning it off about 1:00am as it seemed quite noisy in the middle of the night – room stayed warm though. 

The kitchen area had a sink, cupboards, microwave, under bench fridge and a couple of hot plates, and the cupboards were well stocked with plates, saucepans, glasses, cups, a coffee plunger and sachets of tea, coffee etc. The small table had a selection of chippies and nuts, and the fridge had standard mini-bar items in it. 

It’s a one bedroom, with twin beds in the bedroom, and a king size bed in the lounge area. We’d requested a porta-cot, and it was provided with all of the bedding and sheets. Our girls (2 and 4) slept in the bedroom, and we slept in the lounge area . The bedroom was a good size, and had built in drawers and wardrobe, and a TV.

The bathroom was a hit with our girls – with a triangle-shaped shower, and a spa bath. The basin had a good selection of toiletries – including a couple of packets of individual make-up wipes – I was impressed with this!

The spa bath was brilliant – the girls loved it -  it’s amazing how many bubbles you can get from a small bottle of shower gel when you turn the spa bath jets on. 

The in room compendium was useful – it had a selection of menus from various restaurants in Hamilton, and gave contact numbers and noted which ones delivered. Very useful. We ended up ordering from another local motel which has an onsite restaurant – it arrived within about 20 mins, piping hot, and we just charged the cost to our room. 

We didn’t get to use the spa or pool as this was just a brief overnight stay.

I’d recommend this hotel – it was new and clean, and suitable for families (we could have stayed in a 2 bedroom but this was fine for us). We will definitely stay here again – thanks Mandie!

Sarah.
hotel_response: Dear Peaches8.  Thank you for your very positive comments on Tripadvisor.  It was great to read your observations of everything inside the One Bedroom unit that you stayed in.  This is the wonderful thing about Tripadvisor.  People that travel go to this site and want to read about people's experiences and observations.  We appreciate the time and effort you took to place your comments and are surely looking forward to welcoming you back to Park View Motor Lodge.  Hope you have time during your next visit to take a splash in our lovely heated pool!!!  Mandie

title: Thank you.
text:
Harry and Mandie
What wonderful hosts you both are. From early in the morning until late at night, you both always had a smile to share just like true kiwi's.Your home cooked breakfasts are to die for. Thanks so much for making our stay away from home just that much more homely. To your staff, I compliment your high standards and wish there were more through out NZ just like you. Great location, excellent amenities, warm rooms , all with a friendly smile. I look forward to coming back again.
Kind & Warm Regards
Raewyn Lawson
hotel_response: Dear Raewyn.  Thank you so much for your kind words.  We are blessed and very fortunate to have such special people that regularly stay with us.  Your comments mean the world to us and surely motivates us to do even better!!!  Hope to see you again soon. Harry.

title: Great 3 day stay with children
text: We stayed in a 2 bedroom apartment here at the Lodge.  The layout suited us tremendously - 2 young children in the twin beds of one room, a portacot (provided) for the baby in the other, and the Sofa bed in lounge converted to a double for us.  A high chair was also provided for us free of charge.  Fantastic!  We all know how much luggage takes up room in the car, and to not have to worry about a portacot or high chair was appreciated!  Everyone had their 'space' and we had a comfortable stay as a result!   I was expecting an ensuite for some reason (think it's stated on the info) but it was not off the main bedroom.  It was a stand alone bathroom - but that was ok, it had a beautiful spa bath to  make up for it!   My only negative - which really isn't a negative for everyone - is that the pool is too deep for children.  My nearly 8 year old could not reach the bottom (and myself could barely).  It was a depth of 1.6m which is pretty deep.  Although we still enjoyed the use of the pool and realise we should always monitor our children in it, we know our nearly 8 year old would have liked to have moved off the 'steps'.  Otherwise tho, we had a great stay and appreciated the After Dinner Mints on our departure!  We would happily come back again.  Free WIFI is a bonus and the location is great for being near supermarkets and town.  I'd imagine it could be noisy in the early evening should there be a rugby match on, but the noise would die down afterwards once the crowds moved on.  We stayed during the week days.
hotel_response: Dear Noacy.  Thank you for the great review.  We are so happy that you enjoyed your stay with us.  The Two Bedroom units are ideal for a family and with the heated pool, the kids will never be bored!!!  Yes, as our warning signs in the pool area states, it is a requirement that children are supervised by an adult while using the pool.  We would like you to remember Park View for all the right reasons and not because of a tragedy.....hence the safety measures.  We wish to thank you for choosing Park View Motor Lodge and hope to see you back again soon!!!  Harry.

title: Absolute Gorgeous and great Service
text:
After reading the review some other guests have been posting - I decided to add my own 2 cents.  We stayed over the Queens Long Weekend and as per previous occasions when we stayed at Parkview the service was absolutely great.

We arrived late - as usual and still we were welcomed with friendly warm faces!

I have no idea why some people have been complaining about service, the management team are excellent and don't mind going the extra distance for any of their guests.  The rooms as before were immaculate!  Bundled in a unit with a teenager, normally is any parents nightmare, but with wi-fi, spa & pool we had a wonderful time.

Thank you Harry & Mandie - great to have you back - keep up the good work and we will see you soon.

Will recommend this accommodation to any one!
hotel_response:
Dear OlicoNZ
Thank you so much for the great review.  Mandie and I have recently taken over the management of Park View Motor Lodge again, after being away from the property for almost a year.  It is so good to be back and as we did before we left last year, wish to pledge our commitment towards exceeding our customer's expactations.  We are looking forward to welcoming you back to Park View Motor Lodge on your next trip to Hamilton......thanks again!!!
Harry

title: Really enjoyed our stay and will definitely return!
text: Had a lovely stay over the Queen's birthday weekend.  We were very pleased to with the rooms, very clean, comfortable modern and fresh and the kitchenette with fridge, micro-wave and stove top more than covered our needs.  Our children loved having use of the  pool and spa.  Internet access was definitely a bonus too.  We also found the staff to be very welcoming and gave great customer service.  Many thanks for a great stay and we  will definitely return if we are in the Hamilton area.
hotel_response:
Many thanks for all your kind words. We are glad you enjoyed your stay and look forward to seeing you again soon!

Best regards,
Greg

title: Not a 5 star hotel. Poor Value
text:
Sites like expedia show this motel as 5 star. This is very confusing as the 5 star rating is not a 5 star hotel rating, but a 5 star rating for self catering accommodation ie apartment style. The motel qualifies as an apartment as it has a microwave oven and 2 burner cooktop. At a guess it would be a 3.5 star or 4 star motel, in my opinion. Consequently expecting 5 star service and facilities I was let down

There is no elevator so upstairs rooms are via stairs. The location would be great for the rugby stadium but there is some road noise and windows and not double insulated. I found the bed small and uncomfortable. The pillows they provided were rock hard and I found I had very poor sleep. The curtains are not 100% blockout and let light through.

Apart from that the free internet was a big plus, medium size LCD, microwave oven was a bonus. There is very basic service here, not 5 star and rather cold and clinical. NO "Thankyou for staying here" or "How was your stay" .

For the rate I paid I should have saved money with a cheaper rate at the likes of the Novotel. The motel was less than 25% full when I stayed here and I think that speaks for itself.

I think this motel is going to struggle with an identity crisis whilst it still lists as a 5 star hotel on many websites. There's nothing wrong with this place as a motel, but that is all it is. Its a basic motel - no bar, no restaurant or room service.

title: Didn't stay - no service
text:
Did not actually get to stay here. I rang the motel as we were visting someone in the hospital, I realise it is V8 week, but my freind didn't have the privileage of getting sick at another time, but the girl was so rude who answered the phone, she basically laughed in my ear that of course we don't have anything, and there won't be anything in town.
Well I found something, I am very happy here. 
I don't think this is 5* service when I come back to Hamilton I won't stay there. I will stay at a 4* with service
hotel_response:
My sincere apologies that you felt that we didn’t provide a 5 star service on the telephone. No excuses, if we were lacking, I apologise. We do try and provide a high level of service and friendliness at all times.

Also apologies with regards to being unable to accommodate you. We sell out for the V8's weekend a year in advance. Also as we are within the secure area of the track, if you weren’t coming for the V8's, you would have been inconvenienced due to the event, it is quite crowded and a little noisy.

We do hope that if you are coming back to Hamilton you will give us another chance. Also we wish your friend well.

Best regards,
Greg

title: Great Hospitality and great location
text:
My husband & I recently stay at this motel and loved every minute of it, the hospitality was excellent and the room was everything you would want.

We went to Hamilton for the rugby so location to the ground was perfect right accross the road was the stadium.

title: Ok accomodation - pity about the service
text:
Again, like some others I am unsure why this is No1 in Hamilton.  
Location wise on a positive it would be excellent if you were in town to watch a rugby match, and overall, could not really fault the decor.  On the negative side our flight was late into Hamilton on a Monday night (got in about 8.45pm), with a last minute decision made by the office that day to head up to Hamilton.  Myself and my colleague were famished so went and had dinner.
