We arrived at about 9.45pm at the hotel, and we were aware that we were late, and were ready to be very apologetic, however when we buzzed through to reception, we were met with a very rude woman who sighed a lot and told us that all check in was completed at 9.00pm (which we would not have made anyway even if we had not had dinner) - she said someone would get dressed and be down in a minute - not even 30seconds later a fully dressed, and rather awake looking man turned up, and checked us in.  When I inquired about breakfast, I was told orders had already been taken (again I felt the insinuation was that we had missed the cut off time because of our own tardiness - but on check up later on, the breakfast orders were closed well before our plane had even landed at the airport), he asked us if we would like a paper in the morning, to which my colleague said yes, we were then informed that there would be a copy at reception if we wanted one in the morning (then noted the next morning everyone else had one outside their door) - no idea why he asked really if he was not going to have it delivered?
The wireless internet that was apparently available was impossible to find any strength to the signal, and when you could, it would not accept the password that had been left printed by the phone, so was unable to check any work emails etc.
There was a lot of road noise, so I can only imagine that there would be very little sleep for anyone had there been a game on.
The following morning we had to check out early (had to go find breakfast before our meeting started at 8.30) and when I dropped the keys off to reception the woman politely inquired if I had enjoyed our stay, I said it was fine, then she entered our key room numbers into the system, and I can only imagine saw who it was, as her entire demeanor changed, and she seemed to get very grumpy with more heavy sighing and thumping of keys onto the bench.
The ironic thing is, that with the world cup coming up, they will only be charging more, and inevitably, if they could not handle the intrusion of a couple of people turning up late for business, then heaven help any person who is wanting to stay for leisure and being treated pleasantly.  If this is what you are looking for, you will not find this here.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your feedback. The management and owners of the Park View Motor Lodge take  all feedback very seriously. We have noted your comments and apologize that we fell short of your expectations of our service standards on this occasion. 

We have already implemented procedures to enable us to avoid the situation in the future in regards to late arrivals (including the ordering of breakfast and newspapers). 

Again I apologize for the treatment that you received and can ensure you that the matter has been dealt with, as well as these procedures in place to help eliminate this situation occurring again. 

We do hope that we are able to accommodate you in the future.

Sincerely,

Tim & Shelly
Managers

Greg Young
Owner

title: Great view of Waikato stadium
text:
For a 5 star motor lodge I must say I was a little bit disappointed. The bed was excessively firm and the pillows uncomfortable. The building is directly opposite Waikato stadium which isn't the greatest view and something I should have paid much closer attention to when I looked at it's location. Thankfully for us there were no rugby matches on when we were there, but I would strongly suggest checking that before you book in case you're not a rugby fan and would prefer a good night sleep otherwise I could imagine noise/access could be a real pain. The room itself was an adequate size and overall I would say nothing flash. The buidling itself could do with a little TLC with a number of cracks on the exterior plaster work and stains on the mats that made the place look a little tatty.

The bathroom was a reasonable size and had a decent sized spa bath which was a nice touch. If only the rest of the room was done to the same level. The room had an LCD TV and a seperate stereo, both were modern and reception was excellent.

Front desk service was rather sterile and while efficient I didn't feel welcomed.

My rating has been done on the basis of this being a motor lodge.

title: Not for Leisure
text:
On the positive side the reception was fine, it was quiet and rooms clean. The accommodation we found functional but depressing with a pokey poorly lit kitchen area and decor that may have looked good in the 70's. We had a depressing outlook over the parking lot. The Motel was not near anything of interest and was opposite a rugby stadium, at least no rugby was played during our stay.

How this rates as No1 in trip advisor I do not know.  Probably fine for those on business but a real disappointment for us on our 40th Wedding Anniversary trip - pleased to leave after one night.

title: Beautiful Motel, great location and facilities
text: stayed in a 2 bedroom unit for one night.  Fairly small proportions, but nice and modern and clean.  Indoor heated pool was great - didn't use the spa pool at the time as it was colder than the pool.  Kitchen area small, stovetop, microwave and fridge, but no oven.  Bathroom had a spa bath, but we didn't get to use it.  Pak n Save supermarket just around the corner.  Would recommend. Would be great place to stay if attending a rugby game at Waikato stadium, is right opposite the gate.

title: Great value for money
text:
This was our first night in NZ and were pleasantly surprised with the value for our dollar (compared to Australia)   Arrived in pooring rain, but was warmly welcomed  by the owners.  We appreciated the small touches, especially the QUALITY tea, coffee, etc  (not the run of mill labels)   Beautiful beds, great TV etc.   Considering the budget cost for our room we were impressed that there was a HEATED pool and spa.     Lots of children around so it is popular with families.   Lovely towels, soaps, etc.   Very thoughtfully furnished for such a reasonably priced room.   The room of course was spotless.
We congratulate the owners on providing a high quality room for such a low rate.
Ate at the Hamilton Casino which once again was amazing value for money.
If however one cannot cope with stairs make sure you ask for a ground floor room.

title: A tent in the park opposite may have been a better go.
text:
1. Beds were hard, uncomfortable, which complemented the awful pillows.
2. Neighbouring guests were obviously going to be trouble, and that proved the case They were drinking when we arrived in the afternoon and the noise only stopped when they went out on the town around 11PM.  They made sure everyone except for our blissfully sleeping hosts, obviously, were alerted to their return and carried on partying from 3 until around 4:30AM..
3. Service from the hosts was not up to standard. Got told in the morning, "We told everyone we had a phone with us and to call if there were any problems." Seems like they forgot to tell us and other guests we spoke to... 
The place is new, nicely furnished and clean, but our experience doesn't make us want to go back. A great place to visit if you're a low-life bogan.

title: Fantastic Stay
text: My husband, daughter and I stayed at the Park View Motor Lodge for two nights and I must say we had a wonderful stay.  We stayed in a one bedroom unit and it was just right for the three of us.  We enjoyed all of the facilities and must say that the location would be excellent if you are planning on attending events at the Waikato Stadium.  It is also around the corner from Dominio's, Liquor store, Pak 'n' Save, KFC and The Helm Restaurant so the location for me was really good.  The only thing I would suggest is tables and chairs for the balcony and a bigger spa bath.  But otherwise I cannot complain we had a fantastic stay.

title: Would not recommend....mystified why it is number on here?
text:
We tried Park View because of ithe reviews and shows as Number 1 on tripadvisor..so gathered it would be great...not so I'm afraid..have to be truthful and this is the first netral feedback have ever given.
1.  No view whatsoever
2. Bed was as hard as an ironing board..so much so our sides hurt the next day
3.  Lots of light coming in at night...we had to put a towel over the back window !
4. Very small spa bath  compared to other motels we have stayed at and we stay at heaps...travel all the time
5. No balcony or patio area outside the room as other motels have to sit and relax outside
would recommend the Speights Ale House and Japur Walla Indian Resturant and The Londoner

title: Best medium priced accommodation that we've ever encountered!
text:
We booked a night here to rest and recuperate following a serious illness and it was so lovely we immediately booked for two further nights. It was everything I needed - a complete oasis. Spotlessly clean, spacious, modern and comfortable. Our room had a huge bed, table for two, desk and even a small kitchenette with fridge, hob, microwave etc. The shower was incredibly powerful and there was a huge spa bath and even bathrobes! If we could have moved in we would have. We also loved the free broadband (wifi) and offstreet parking. I can't recommend this place enough. The owners were lovely too. The only thing counting against this place is the location directly opposite a rugby stadium. There is some noise on game nights although games don't go late and the rooms are very well sound proofed with the windows closed. 

I have travelled all around the world and stayed in countless budget hotels/motels and this one easily beats them all. In fact, it was better than many of the expensive hotels I've stayed at. Why can't all places be like this?

title: comfortable, modern and clean
text:
We stayed here for 1 night as an overnight stop on the way to Auckland.  The motel was lovely to stay in.  
Staff were friendly and helpful, providing information on shopping and restaurants. (Def try Speights Ale House around the corner - great food!)
Rooms were a little bit small, but suitable for a quick stay.  Very clean rooms, colourful and modern with more than enough provisions!  Bathroom lovely!
Pool was lovely and warm.
Laundry facilities were free!!!!
Fantastic location if wanting to go to an event at Waikato Park, but not sure that I would want to stay there if there was an event on and you weren't attending it, as you are right across the road!
I would stay here again.

title: Perfect place to stay in Hamilton
text: We enjoyed a great stay at Park View Motor lodge.  Our room was right beside the lovely warm pool and our 5 year old daughter literally spent hours swimming.  The staff were friendly and helpful - providing suggestions for activities and walking maps.  I had forgotten my cellphone charger and they provided one free of charge for me to use.  The units are well appointed and the location is great.  Would definately stay there again.

title: An outstanding executive motel
text:
This is probably the best appointed motel I have stayed in for many years. The two bedroom units were very well appointed, TV's in both bedrooms and living area, the bathroom was equal to five star hotels and  included a fantastic spa bath.
While the kids watched tv my wife and I were able to surf the net using the motel's free wi-fi service.

The conference facilities also appear to be well appointed, I will consider using the Park View for our next Central North Island conference and maybe catch a game at Waikato stadium located directly adjacent to the motel.

title: We will definitely be back!
text: Fantastic place, modern, and wonderful hosts.  Good old fashioned service here.  My kids thoroughly enjoyed the pool.  Great nights sleep!

title: Can't be faulted!!
text:
Stayed here for 2 nights n Dec 2009 and found it to be perfect.  Rooms are spotlessly clean, spacious, very well apponted bathroom with spa bath and small well equipped kitchenette.

The motel is situated just out of the town centre and is very quiet - but may not be te same when there's a rugby match on in the stadium opposite.  Excellent value for $100 per night.  Recommended.

title: Best value for your money!
text: We booked the Park View for 2 nights in Hamilton, NZ.  We were greeted by new managers who had just taken over the property.  All the staff were pleasant and accomodating and the property is well maintained.  The free wi-fi internet access, kitchenette and whirlpool bath made the room very comfortable and enjoyable.

title: OK hotel for an overnighter in Hamilton but location not great.
text:
The Park View Motor Lodge is located across the road from a sports stadium so hardly a Park View really.  Ideal for sporting fans when there is something on, but a little out of town for a family passing through.
Room was neat, clean, well appointed and spacious.  Free Wifi and laundry facilities were available and staff were very helpful.

title: Smashing little motel with pool and sauna
text: We had picked Hamilton as a destination and then heard that there wasn't anything to do there and then saw lots of bad reviews of hotels. We paid a little more for this motel than we did in other cities to ensure that it was a decent one and it sure was.  The receptionist was absolutely lovely, even lending me an umbrella when we went into town.  The two bedroom suite was lovely and roomy with all the facilities you needed.  It has a super litle swimming pool that was lovely and warm, a hot tub and a sauna (which you need to book so that they can heat it for you).  Its a bit of a walk into town but pleasant enough.  The river walk is lovely.  Would def. stay here again if we went to Hamilton.

title: Awesome accommodation - just perfect
text:
Arrived Friday pm, kids & I jumped straight into heated pool - just lovely after a 4hr drive.
Spa also great.  Not too busy, so had pool to ourselves. Went to the rugby on Saturday night, just a walk across the road!  Rooms spacious, kitchen could be a little bigger but bathroom with shower & spa bath great.  Beds very comfortable and Sky TV in lounge, kids bedroom & our room - very impressive.  Would definitely recommend to other travellers.   Short walk to Pak N Save around the corner.

title: Shame about the Pool and Spa
text:
Strayed here in early Feb 2009. Nice rooms bit I bet it would be noisy if the rugby was on in the stadium accporss the road. Our room was on the road side and subjected to noise of drunken teenagers and road racers, it was a Saturday night. Using the air con would help here. There was a SKY TV team staying at the Hotel and as they wanted to smoke they were outside with booze until quite late and making a noise which we thought the management should have handled.
The spa was not working and the pool was freezing and shortened my life by about two years.
Rooms were very comfortable though

title: No worries in Hamilton
text: This is a terrific spot for families. The room was spacious, the facilities were easy to access and didn't seem to be in huge demand at any given time.  Although walking distance to the main street, the lodge was tucked away against the ovals and had no traffic noise. Everything was clean and well kept and the hosts were obliging and friendly. Self catering was made easy with the provision of kitchenware in the 2bed units and 2 huge supermarkets within a couple of blocks.

title: Loved the great Service
text:
Our weekend based a the ParkView Motor Lodge was awesome. All made possible by the very friendly and extremely accomodating operators of the hotel.  I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone and plan to return to stay on for my business trips.  

The rooms are great and quiet. The facilities are excellent and the positioning in relation to town and other activities is great.  

Thanks for a great stay.

title: Couldn't be better
text: A group of 12 of us stayed here from Friday night to Monday morning.  The rooms were very modern and extremely clean.  Almost seemed too good considering all rooms had spa baths.  We were able to book out the massive conference room for the entire time which was used for table tennis, poker and watching the All Blacks play England with the Lodges projector.  The spa was fantastic and the heated pool was the perfect temperature.  A small walk in to town, over looks the Rugby Stadium and the owners were very cool. If there was anything I'd change it would be the website.  It doesn't do it justice. I'd highly recommend this to anyone.

title: Great Room for a Great Price
text:
We were really impressed with the quality of our room.  It was clean and of a reasonable size, especially considering we were staying in their cheapest option, studio room.  We were easily able to fit our baby and portacot in there too.  

The bathroom was fantastic - a lovely double spa bath - which is unusual for a cheap studio unit.  There were also bath robes provided in the wardrobe.

A complimentary newspaper was provided in the morning.

The motel also has a heated swimming pool and spa pool which we didn't end up using.  They looked good and felt warm and "swimable"  when I paddled my feet in them to check the temperature.

We booked using the hotel's website.  It cost us NZ$109 per night which was cheaper than we found elsewhere.  This rate only showed up once we had put our dates in.

Highly recommended.  We've stayed at a few places in Hamilton before and this is the best so far.

title: Nice room, but......
text:
We stayed here after booking on the web site, as we liked the sound of the plunge pool and spar pool(very handy after travelling for hours). On arrival we found that the Spar pool wasn't working, and hadn't been for some time, and the plunge pool was was so cold that you couldn't stay in it! The manager admitted that they were unable to repair the the spar pool and it hadn't worked for a while.  Not good.
The room was fine, no problems, but we felt misled by the web site and the fact that nothing had been said when I called to confirm the booking.

title: Excellent modern motor lodge, shame about the owners
text:
This motor lodge was fantastic. It has very modern, attractive decor and bedspreads. The beds were very comfortable. It was wonderful to have a spa bath and the teenagers had their own attractive bedroom with a TV in it, which kept them occupied and out of our hair!

We were very pleased with the motel room itself. The service from the managers was also wonderful. However, one of the main reasons we booked this motel was for the free broadband internet access, which was essential for our business on the trip. The internet access went down and the husband and wife managers worked tirelessly to try to correct it. The owners who live in Auckland would not allow the managers to spend money to bring in a technician which is what needed to happen to fix the problem. (My husband knows enough about computers to know that the system was wired incorrectly)

I cannot fault the service the managers gave us, however they were put in a very difficult position by the owners, and put a damper on our stay in Hamilton. We were very close to moving to another hotel with internet access, but stayed because we liked the room so much and so did the children.
hotel_response: As normal we always appreciate feed back from our guest and in fact have customer feed back forms in all rooms. As can be seen by the complaint, we as managers did all that we could do to satisfy our client. The problem needed specialist attention and all attemps to rectify the problem were taken at the time Unfortunatley a new part was required and this was aquired asap, but unfortunatley too late for our custumer. One piont to note is that our guest did stay the extra night after the problem as he pionted out quote"because of the service he recieved and the quality of the rooms" we take all compliant seriously and do all in our power to fix them asap

title: A good place to stay
text: I was in New Zealand for the Southern Man Tour and we ended our trip by staying at this motel.  It was a well maintained property at the time, as I haven't returned since that time.  The people who ran the place at the time provided great service, even washed clothes for us in their commercial washing machine/dryer.  The rooms at the time were very nice, with little kitchenettes, well appointed for a motel.  I would return there based on my prior experience and hope Phillip was still running the motel, because it would likely be the same experience.

title: Great for a quick stopovver
text: Nothing special in terms of grounds or outdoor facilities but great for a quick stopover. Parking outside the door and a very clean room with all the amenities and excellent sleep quality. Was taken aback by the need for a damage deposit but the refund came quickly, though i lost a few bucks in the transactions. Might be a bit boring for a long stay but fine for a stopover. Nothing within walking distance but only a few minutes drive to dining options.

title: Beware!
text: Nothing like the advertisement or reviews. I had to use wet wipes to clean finger marks and food stains off walls, door handles and the kitchen bench and appliances. The chairs around the table had food stuck all over them and the couch was completely broken with springs sticking out of the base. Sheets were clean but the towels were well worn. We found hairs stuck to pillows and to the tv cabinet top. The receptionist was very apologetic and helpful. We checked out that same day and went somewhere else. She organised with the manager to refund us the other 2 nights we had booked.

title: Actual Scam. DO NOT STAY.
text:
Was moved to Victoria Apartments through our booking at Hygate. Victoria Apartments is down the road, you can look up the reviews for Victoria Hotel and see has a very different review rating than Hygate.

Issues included 
1. No access. Key card not working, stuck outside our room at 11.30pm.

2. Ants in the bed in the lounge.

3. No hot water at all. Never was able to shower.

Bonus round:
4. Rude staff. Thought they were there at 9am to fix our shower, turns out they were trying to get us out an hour early.
5. Kettle cord doesn't reach the plug. No milk. Just annoying...
6. No extra blankets, nothing in any cupboards. Was cold.

When we drove to Hygate reception to check out we were told the only way to get a refund was to speak to a manager. But managers don't work on the weekend. But they also don't work during the week. But they also have no phone line. And the only way to contact them is to email our complain to info@hygate.co.nz. I'm sure I'll hear back...

title: Motel Dodgey as F@^%$
text: Absolutely disgusting and when booking in asked for $100 bond. We had already paid $150 for the room, which by the way was disgusting and the other people staying there seemed very permanent and dodgey, decided not to stay, as I can probably say if you ran a blue light over the bed ..... DO NOT RECOMMEND unless you're a drug dealer.

title: Absolutely shocking stay!
text:
My self, my wife and our 1 year old daughter stayed here for 1night. We were staying from out of town, to do some shopping in Hamilton.

On our arrival we were shocked to see most rooms were occupied by people from ministry of social well fare.

Outside our room was covered in smoke buds.

We didn’t get any sleep, people from outside our room from 10pm to early hours were playing music in there rooms, in there cars. Yelling and screaming, kids running outside up and down, cars coming and going, then at around 5am someone knocked on the door demanding cash that we apparently owed them. We didn’t open the door.

We couldn’t wait to leave in the morning. We felt extremely tired and exhausted when we left and will never ever return.

title: A Dreadful Experience
text:
We had the unfortunate experience of staying here on 22 Oct, a Tuesday. We arrived early evening having had a huge day of travel to get there and another big day with business meetings and travel the next day.
The first warning was on checking in when we were expected to give our credit card details in order to cover a $200 bond in case we "damaged our room". We have NEVER encountered that before.

title: 'Company Policies"
text:
seems that guests have to follow too many 'company policies'. this place used to be great. not any more.
the room had a horrible cigarette smell; so they sprayed air freshener upon my complaint. 
the brown bathroom linen needs to go.

title: Feels unsafe with unsavoury characters around
text: I had previously stayed here and it was fine. This time around, accompanied by my family, was terrible. Kids playing everywhere outside unsupervised by parents. Other guests sitting around smoking. Room not cleaned after first night. Unit was clean but it did not feel safe here with dodgy looking cars pulling up at all hours. It seems as though people are living here full time, people that I would not choose to spend my holiday around. Maybe winz housing? If this is the case, a note should be put on website. Not happy at all and not a good look for your business.

title: Basic but clean
text:
I stayed for a night with my partner on a short trip to Hamilton. While pulling in to the motel car park, we were surprised to see so many children playing in the car park. It seems that families actually live there long term. 
Our unit was large and very clean with parking directly outside. The unit had a combined sleeping (queen bed)/eating/cooking/lounge area, a separate 2nd bedroom and a bathroom. 
The only window was facing the car park (make sure you close the blinds!). We didn't hear any noises after 10pm and slept well.

title: Weekend away
text: Came over to Hamilton for the weekend & was a little disappointed with the motor lodge. It seemed like people/families were actually living there & it didnt feel overly safe. Kids were all over the driveway & i had to be extra careful as they were always playing behind the cars in the carpark. Even 1 young girl on her bike was directly behind my car when I was reversing & her mother was on the phone. On the plus side the rooms were spacious. Dont think we will stay there again though.

title: Cleanest motel I've been in for years
text:
Nice large unit (family unit). Crisp, white bedsheets and washable blankets that were white as well. Very, very clean. Bathroom was spotless. Water pressure in shower was amazing. Love that they had refillable bottles in the bathroom of shampoo, etc. instead of wasteful throwaway ones. 
Very friendly owners. Some noise from other units (just people walking by) but a really good sleep overall. 
Will come back.

title: Not bad
text:
Positives - it was a very quiet place to stay given we saw the amount of people who were staying there. This was good for us who was a couple only needing a night passing through Hamilton.The place was clean and spacious. Staff was friendly, but was hard to see around the place.

Challenges - the bathroom was quite dated in comparison to photos. The rooms are very close together which meant parking was a bit of a nightmare going out after check out. The room also was very dark, barely any light in the rooms being that the rooms are quite close together and narrow but long.

Would come back to this place if needed a cheap place to stay in Hamilton again.

title: Terrible! Blood on sheets..
text:
So.. we attempted to stay here, but after discovering dirty sheets with blood on,  then confronting the staff about it,  who was so argumentative and incredibly hard to deal with,  we left,  no refund,  no effort to deal with our concern,  just rudeness.  
I've never dealt with such an issue,  it is clea, the sheets had not been changed. Disgusting! 
Shower was terrible, price was $175, we had to pay extra because we went in 2 hours earlier,  not worth it,  brown towels and bad bad management,  staff didn't speak the best English,  was shocking to be honest... 
Please be aware.   
We tried to work with staff to come to an agreement,  but they blamed the sheet company.  Ridiculous.

title: Great motel
text: I stay here monthly for work and love it. Rooms are clean, spacious and the spa bath is amazing. It is close to town with heaps of parking. Staff are so friendly and it is a great motel to visit in Hamilton!

title: Comfortable rooms at a good price
text: We stopped off for a couple of nights and had a family room. Rooms were clean and comfortable with a nicely appointed bathroom. Although the hotel is on a main road the rooms were also quiet. Staff were friendly. The Stadium is only a short walk away.

title: Good quality motel close to town centre
text: I stayed at this motel several years ago when it was part of the Best Western chain and was very happy to return.  The quality of the motel had not changed - it was still a very good place to stay.  My room was large and comfortable, the kitchen area was very well equipped, and the bathroom was immaculate with a wonderful rainfall shower.  The wifi signal was strong and consistent.  The manager who was on the front desk was very friendly and the check-in and check-out processes were quick and efficient.  Although the property is situated on a fairly busy road, my room was far enough away not to be affected by traffic noise.  The town centre is a few minutes drive away.

title: Not what we expected
text: O.K so I maybe wrong but I thought booking a 2bdrm unit means that there is 2bedrooms separate from the living area. This unit had a queen bed in the lounge/kitchen/dining area with 2 single beds in a separate bedroom. This makes things hard when there are 4 people staying people want to stay up to watch tv while others would like to enjoy there queen bed. Also as we were there for 2 nights we were told our room would be made up the following morning ready for our second night. This would have being great if they had completed their job not just making up the living area and forgetting the bedroom and leaving the windows wide open. Could they also deter the people (maybe homeless) from stopping outside our door to take cigarette butts from the ashtray every morning  and at night.

title: Comfortable, clean, modern
text:
I stayed here for two nights.
My room was huge, plenty of space and a good-sized clean modern bathroom.
Full kitchen, handy for self-catering. The way the room was set up it seemd like a good place for reps to stay, and it was indeed it was busy every night with what looked like reps/travellers to me.
The location was quiet though, not much street noise.

title: A busy motel is a good motel
text: Very clean and tidy room, larger than normal size bathroom though signs indicate some TLC in order, eg mould developing on the bathroom ceiling, shower leaking underneath glass panels. The addition of a Sky Decoder and multi channels being available is great. It is a busy motel, fully booked for the 2 night duration I stayed.  Windows have security stays allowing fresh air circulation rather than air-conditioner.  Comfortable bed and good night’s rest though pick a unit further away from the busy road out front. Ample parking though tight when fully booked.

title: Unexpected delight
text: Due to diet restrictions I needed self catering facilities. Not having high expectations before I arrived this accomodation has exceeded all my  expectations. Clean, comfortable, spacious and quiet. It has free wifi so great for business users. It's in a really convenient location. Great access to other locations in the area.

title: Never judge a book by its cover
text: First impression I thought oh no what have a come to. As my last place of stay was just fantastic But once I had my first nights sleep on a great bed shower + spa bath both great room clean fresh towels each day room cleaned each day apart from wifi not that good great place to stay. Please note it. This is not going to be a Best Western for much longer but will still be called the Hygate.

title: Very comfortable
text: Very friendly host. Very comfortable and clean unit. Great shower pressure and lovely spa bath. Only spent one night while attending a family reunion but would definitely stay again. Close to City and Waikato Stadium.

title: "Nothing out of the ordinary"
text: It's a typical motel nothing out of the ordinary, no pool, no spa but you can get a room with a spa bath. The cooked breakfast was small and cold, the poached eggs were hard and it's not nice having rubbery toast had trouble cutting it. The beds was not comfortable for us but might be great for someone else who likes hard beds. The relieving host was helpful I needed something printed and she done it free of charge I was so great full.

title: Good Option, worth considering
text: Have stayed here a few times and it has been consistent every time.  The rooms are spacious with a good size bathroom. What we have noticed here is that the rooms are very clean even to the point that remotes for TV are clean and placed in cloth bags. It's this kind of detailing which we often find lacking in a number of other hotels etc. It has the basic facilities for the kitchen, so overall it has always been a enjoyable stay. It's located on a busy road but we have always stayed in one of rear units and have never had any issues with noise.

title: MotelStay
text: Motel was OK and clean, large enough room with all the necessary furniture and bath room. No problem to check in before 2 PM. Just did not feel comfortable because of missing nice outdoors to look at, sort of dark not enough windows and privacy issue.

title: Very pleasant premises
text: Although not especially appealing from the road, this motel is spotlessly clean with good-sized rooms and comfy beds. The hosts are friendly and charming. Decor is modern with clean lines. There is a guest laundry and rooms are very suited to disabled folk as they are spacious and offer shower rooms rather than stumbling in and over a bathtub. Nearby is a huge supermarket and very good bars and local, fair-priced restaurants (try The Helm for very good food).

title: Excellent Motel
text: One of the best motels we've stayed in lately.  Fantastic sized room, warm, and very clean.  Receptionist was very nice, especially when our 8 year old locked us out (be careful with this as once the door is shut you need your swipe card to re-enter).  Only negative is that there was no coffee for the plunger, just one coffee bag & instant coffee (if you're not obsessed about your morning coffee this wouldn't be an issue).  Highly recommend staying here.

title: 1st night great, 2nd night not good
text: Easy check-in, modern clean room. 1st night was great. 2nd night not good - hubby got a cut on his wrist from a broken glass bedside table when he reached down to plug in his phone charger. Then when I got into bed under the covers I sat on a screw - random! And as an added bonus noisy people in van pulled up outside our room at 3am, made a raquet, their headlights lighting up our room. Couldn't get back to sleep after that so feeling very tired today. Tonight is our 3rd and final night. Hoping for no more surprises otherwise not sure I would come back.

title: Clean and tidy and the staff are very helpful.
text: Great motel - stay every time i visit Hamilton. Clean and tidy and the staff are very helpful. The motel is not far from town where you can venture out for a drink or something to eat. The rooms are very large which is great.

title: Always Top of the Class
text: We have been staying at this motel off and on since 2007. The decor, furniture and kitchenware have constantly been kept up to date, rooms are always beautifully clean and excellent facilities are always provided. The rooms are very well laid out, very practical for travellers with lots of bags and gear and are presented superbly. The staff are very friendly, helpful and always willing to go the extra mile. Our repeated patronage over a long period of time has not seen any drop off in any of the above. Bookings need to be made early as they are very popular.

title: Exactly what we asked for.
text: Everything was organised via the Internet and on arrival from Auckland (via an overseas cruise) we were met by a warm family of husband and wife, precious cat and rather intrigued golden retriever. A wonderfully homey feeling and such a warm welcome. The room we had was immaculately clean, bright and airy and very comfortable. The bed itself was just what we ordered after two weeks at sea on a rocking ship and the clean crisp linen put the ship stewards to shame. The bathroom was lovely, private and quiet. The heatpump (on air con for us) was quiet and easy to operate and we appreciated the TV with sky. The room was serviced beautifully each morning we left and i will certainly be using Best Western Hygate again. Thank you to the owners, job well done.  Jeni & Mike, Christchurch

title: Wow amazing accommodation
text: What else can I say but wow.  We were impressed from the second we stepped into our room.  The service was warm and friendly and our room was the best we have ever stayed in.  Everything was clean and comfortable.  Thank you for having us, we were super  impressed.

title: Great place for a quick stay
text: We passed through Hamilton on our way south from Auckland Airport. The Hygate Motel was perfect for our one night stay. It's a functional motel on a strip of many motels, but the service was pleasant, the 1 bedroom family room was immaculate and newly decorated, room was quiet and in a decent location.

title: Base for Day Trips
text: Conveniently located on the edge of Hamilton centre a short drive from a wide range of restaurants.  Studio of reasonable size, comfortable bed, shame about the pillows.  Lodge offers standard Best Western facilities with two of everything in the bathroom and kitchenette.  Also offers continental breakfast with a reasonable selection and an option for a cooked meal all at reasonable prices.  No air-con but fan provided.

title: Most enjoyable
text: Our first stop on our trip around North Island New Zealand and not sure what to expect as it was so reasonably priced. Well we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and the lovely spa bath was a bonus. If we are lucky enough to come back we will definitely stay at the  Hygate again.

title: Excellent place for overnight stays
text: This is a very practical motel, not a resort type place.  My room and the bathroom were both spacious and very comfortable.  There are no views but my room was quiet and had its own carper.  Breakfast was available on request but there is a supermarket down the road, the cooking facilities are excellent and there are plenty or restaurants handy.

title: Better Than it Looks
text: Don't let first impressions fool you. This motel provides good value and a location near shopping and restaurants. Not a lot of parking but still adequete. Like most New Zealand motels, it includes a small kitchen area and teas, coffee and milk.

title: Very good value
text: We stayed in a 1 bedroom family unit. It was in very good condition, newly decorated, very spacious and comfortable. The kitchen was very handy, and all very clean. Staff were also friendly. This motel is very good value.

title: Simply superb
text: What a welcome relief to stay at an immaculate and modern place. Karen was so kind and friendly - a true credit to the motel. Little extras like a variety of tea, spring water bottle, plunger coffee and 50 legitimate sky channels were appreciated. This place is great .

title: pleasant
text: Only stayed for one night. Really nice place has a spa and a great shower. We got a family room which was laid out weird because the queen bed was in the living room. The two single beds had there own rooms. They offered a breakfast deal. Would recommend this place.

title: Comfortable stay
text: Clan rooms and surroundings. Good location not far from city. Operators  went the extra mile to get our newspaper even when not asked to do so. Price was reasonable but varied when bought with different booking agencies. Walls are thin so noise will flow thru. However we did get a good sleep. Will come again when next in Hanilton.

title: Very nice clean room, huge shower, modern bathroom
text: We stayed for 1 night at the Best Western Hygate Motel in Hamilton NZ  and couldn't fault it. The room was very clean and spacious. Bed was very comfortable, bathroom was large and very modern and the staff couldn't be more helpful. The owner showed us personally to our room and explained TV remotes etc and delivered a newspaper to us and a local New Idea magazine. They also provided a very nice cooked breakfast of eggs bacon and toast for only $10 each which was delicious. 10/10.

title: Great, friendly staff, beautiful clean rooms
text: Stayed here for a friend's wedding and loved our spa unit which we enjoyed. Well appointed and very clean room. Very friendly staff.  Comfy bed which gave us a good night's sleep making it a romantic night away.

title: Great place & good value to stay in Hamilton
text: Clean room with a comfortable bed, good bathroom with clean & new look. 24 hours Mc in just 5mins drive.  Friendly staff help us in late check in at midnight & welcome us with all heating air conditioner on. Nice & warmly. It is a little bit noisy from the main road cause we are in the first room near the road if you need late wake up please ask for the inner one.

title: Extremely Satisfied
text: We were extremely satisfied with everything from the moment we checked in until we checked out. Extremely clean and tidy, I would say that this experience would be one of the best Hotels we have stayed at ever and we travel a lot, I would give this a four star experience

title: Overnight getaway
text:
Amazing accommodation, clean, large room that was very welcoming and very comfortable.

Bathroom is huge and spa bath a definite must!

I was especially impressed with the friendly and helpful staff + owners! Couldn't have done more for us....highly recommend!

Definitely raised the bar !

title: Comfortable bed
text: Clean room with a comfortable bed, good bathroom, I didn't hear any road noise however I was in the middle of the complex, there were many others staying but again no noise from the other units. The room had a big TV with all sky channels. Handy to good pub and supermarket 5 -10 min walk away. Owner was friendly and very pleasant to deal with.

title: Great place to stay in Hamilton New Zealand
text: During my saty, I found all the staff friendly and helpful. The level on accommodation was great and the location very handy. I will stay there again if I need accommodation in Hamilton New Zealand in the future.

title: Perfectly adequate
text:
Not as flash looking from the outside as some of the other nearby motels. Room and bathroom spacious and clean.  Kitchenette fine. 
On one side (rooms 1- 8?) parking right outside door parallel to walls and a bit awkward.  Front desk staff friendly enough.

title: Modern, clean and friendly
text: The rooms exceeded our expectations. Features included everything we would have wanted and the owners were super friendly. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend and would certainly stay there again. Great value for money!
hotel_response:
Dear Kim
Thank you for telling us about your recent stay with us while visiting the Waikato. I am pleased you found everything to your liking and we provided everything you required and represented good value for money. Hope to see you again in the future 
Kind regards
David GM

title: Newish motel.
text: Good motel unit with kitchen facilities and large bathroom. Free parking onsite and nice to have opening windows. Hosts were very hospitable and more than accommodating with different requests. Rooms were comfortable but lacked an inviting ambience. Would stay again
hotel_response:
Hi Melz65
Thanks for telling us about your stay with us last year. Pleased you found our staff friendly and hospitable, I have passed your comments on to them. Free parking outside your room is a bonus  especially if you have luggage to get from the car to room. 
We have done a number of upgrades and refurbs since your stay and added more colours to the rooms.
Look forward to welcoming you again in the future
Kind regards
David GM

title: Clean and Tidy
text: Whenever we are in Hamilton to visit relatives, my wife and kids always insisting on staying at HYGATE and they are never wrong. The place is clean, tidy and close to the city proper. HIghly recommended
hotel_response:
Hello Eddie
Thank you for the nice review, great to hear that your family always want to stay at our property and again you found everything to clean and tidy, our housekeeping staff put a lot of pride into what they do.
Hope to see you again soon while visiting relatives
Kind regards
David GM

title: Well appointed
text: We stayed for 2 nights last weekend and found the rooms to be very nicely appointed, well looked after. The towels were lovely and clean, beds comfortable and linen in very good clean condition too. There were plenty of good quality utensils, and everything worked. There was nothing to fault. Road noise wasn't an issue to us and it is handy to town. Are staying again in April and looking forward to it.
hotel_response:
Dear Paula
Thank you for the fabulous 5 star review. We put a lot of effort and take a lot of pride in ensuring that everything is functional and in good condition, Since changing linen suppliers 18 months ago the standard of linen and towelling is much higher level than previously
Look forward to seeing you again in the future
Kind regards
David GM

title: Great nite stay, No issues what so ever.
text:
A little on the pricey side, however enjoyed staying here.
Spacious room
Everything was clean and tidy
No noise from other rooms (good insulation)
Modern decor, and bathroom

This is what some hotels should lead by.
Would recommend

title: One night Stay
text:
Arrived on a Monday afternoon and was greeted by very friendly owners. The unit was in two sections, with the large comfortable bed, kitchen, couch, table and chairs in in one room.
 The second room consisted of a spar bath, very large shower, toilet and basin.
Also included was a heated towel rail.
The whole unit was very clean and well presented.
We would have no hesitation in recommending this Motor Lodge to other travellers.

title: Hygate Motor Lodge, Hamilton
text: The room was very big .Good size for our family. The  Beds were very comfortable and Unit was very clean.  The host were very helpful on arrival. you do hear people talking in the next room or their tv. But as we were out most of the time it didn't worry us to much. Plenty of hot water . There were 4 of us having showers in the morning and we didn't run out of hot water.

title: Exceptional Service, Comfortable, Clean and Relaxing
text:
Stayed one night and was pleasantly upgraded to a Queen Unit with Spa - this was bliss and just what I needed after a big weekend and day before a three day work conference. I'm not sure if I can name staff - but Fran was delightful, happy and so helpful. I had a lovely sleep and the unit was very clean, calm and comfortable. Would recommend this place to everyone! Thank you Best Western 
RENEE
hotel_response:
Dear Renee
Thank you for taking the time to tell about your stay with us earlier in the year, I ma pleased to hear that you found our staff helpful you enjoyed your stay. Look forward to hosting you again in the future.
Kind regards
David GM

title: Another lovely stay
text: Once again I enjoyed my stay here.The management go out of their way to make you feel welcome with a friendly smile and chat.The rooms are big and spacious and very comfortable to stay in.After a long hot drive from Gisborne it was wonderful to arrive and be told that they had turned the air conditioner on in my unit.I have no problem in recommending anyone to stay here
hotel_response:
Dear Bill
Thank you for the lovely review, our managers go the extra mile to ensure everything is taken care of. A nice cool room after a long drive is very welcoming and ensures you are able to relax on arrival
look forward to hosting you again in the future when you return to Hamilton
Kind Regards
David Smith CEO

title: Stayed one night - very happy;
text: Stayed just one night after visiting the Hobbiton. Everything was very pleasant. Room was very nice; and at a very reasonable price (paid NZD 140). Really enjoyed a river walk and adjoined memorial park.
hotel_response:
Dear Dmitry K
Thank you for taking the time to tell us about your recent stay with us during your recent visit to Hamilton and NZ. I am please to hear that everything was to your liking. Hobbiton is a very popular destination for visitor to the area and a fabulous asset for the area
Look forward to hosting you again in the future should you return to the Waikato
Kind regards
David Smith

title: Always consistently good
text: This establishment is well run (both the pervious and new management), spotlessly clean, quiet, affordable and comfortable. This is my 8th stay here this year; could have done a lot worse. Well deserving of a 5 rating.
hotel_response:
Dear GladiatorDelWino
Thank you for taking the time to review your recent stay with us, glad you have found our new managers continuing to keep up the high standards.
Look forward to hosting you again in 2015
Kind regards
David

title: Clean comfortable and friendly               owner
text:
We stayed here while visiting family around the Waikato area and found this motel perfect for our needs.  The owner happily printed some google maps for us to find our way around the outlying area, this made our trips into the countryside so easy to navigate    The unit we had was spotlessly clean  and had everything we needed to be very comfortable.  We were quite close to road,  being next door to the reception but found the unit extremely quite and we slept very well. If we are back in Hamilton again this motel will be our first choice.   
Thankyou to all staff for a great stay
hotel_response:
Dear Susan H
Thank  you for the fantastic review, I am pleased you enjoyed your stay. we pride ourselves on the cleanliness of our property and all staff make this a priority. Trust you enjoyed catching up with family and found the directions helpful. 
The road noise has reduced dramatically since the by-pass went in making for a quiet nights sleep.
We look forward to seeing you again in the future should you revisit Hamilton
Kind Regards
David

title: very happy
text: couldn't more happy with my stay, room was nice and spacious meaning you didn't feel cramped up.Staff were very friendly and very helpful.I had a back unit so heard no traffic noise.Would definitely recommend this motel to anyone coming to Hamilton
hotel_response:
Dear madbill
thank you for taking the time to review your recent stay with us. I am pleased to see that you enjoyed your stay and found my staff friendly and helpful, I have passed these comments on. We do have spacious rooms making longer stays more comfortable.
look forward to hosting you again in the future
Kind regards
Dave

title: Great motel, comfortable and excellent service!
text: Stayed here for a sports trip and booked three family spa units.  The owners were fantastic to deal with and nothing was an issue.  The rooms were large, modern, clean and beds were very comfortable.  Easy to find and close to supermarkets, food outlets and only a short drive to town.

title: Comfortable and clean, great for families
text: The room was large and comfortable. There was a kitchen for those who wanted to cook and better yet, laundry facilities for families in need of clean clothes. We were placed near the back away from the road traffic. The owner was very helpful in making sure we were happy with our stay.

title: Pleasant Experience
text: We found the owner who checked us in very pleasant helpful and proud  of her business. She created a very positive environment .The room was more than adequate for the type and she was considerate in placing us far from the road noise.

title: Great place to stay
text: This is a really nice hotel and the couple the run the hotel are fantastic.  The rooms are very clean and the beds very very comfortable.  The location is easily accessible to travel around the area and you are only about an hour from the Glow Worm caves.

title: Best accomodation in Hamilton
text:
Modern, clean, quiet and comfortable. It is an absolute pleasure to stay here. I frequently commute to Hamilton for work and have been in most the rooms the Best Western have and they are all really good. They have everything you would need for a relaxing and comfortable stay, whether it is for work or a holiday. 

The mattresses are comfortable and they have a selection of pillow sizes and firmness. Their kitchens are modern and well facilitated with cooking utensils which gave me the flexibility to either cook a full meal or to eat out. Good selection of complimentary teas. Bathrooms are modern with a lovely large shower and hair dryers. There is a full length mirror in the closet! The easy to work air conditioning/ heating system really meant I always had a comfortable sleep in a room at my preferred temperature. 

The highest praise for Carolyn and Dave, the owners who are absolutely wonderful. A perfect home away from home.

title: Clean, comfortable and convenient
text:
Lovely one night stay at the Best Western Hygate for a family of 2 adults and 2 children.  Room was spotless, beds were comfortable, the bath and shower fantastic.

The receptionist was very helpful, friendly and polite.  Will definately recommend and stay again!
hotel_response:
Dear PureNZPA
I am pleased to hear that you and your family enjoyed your recent stay with us during your time in Hamilton while visiting New Zealand. We put a lot of effort into keeping our rooms clean & upto date, the spa baths are popular particularly with families. I have passed on your kind comments to our front office staff
Hope to see you again when visiting Hamilton & NZ
Kind regards
Dave

title: Standard
text: Standard Motor lodge, rooms tidy and clean. Owner lady was nice and helpful. Not to much street noise from the busy road, handy eateries nearby that deliver and charge back to your room, shower had good pressure
hotel_response:
Dear Cameron K
thanks for choosing to stay with us while in Hamilton on business. The rooms service and restaurant chargeback facilities are a very popular service for the business traveller. Your kind comments have been passed on to Carolyne
look forward to welcoming you when you are in Hamilton on business in the future
Kind regards
Dave

title: Spotless and Quiet
text:
Great value, helpful staff, very clean unit. No traffic noise. All the main Sky channels. Very good heat pump heating. Good decor.
Didn't get the breakfast but it looked like good value.  We will return..
hotel_response:
Dear Pieter_Janice
Thank you for choosing to stay with us recently and taking the time to tell us about your stay. The SKY Guest Select is very popular with our and gives you over 50 channels to choose from. The heat pumps are efficient heating during winter and also provide plenty of cooling with the warmer summer months coming along
Look forward to welcoming you again in the future
Kind Regards
Dave

title: Always a pleasure
text: Have stayed here many times and always find them friendly and accomodating. We will always stay here when we go to hamilton. Good sized rooms, the kids love the personal touch of a few lollies when we arrive. recommended to all
hotel_response:
Dear Joy V
Thank you for the fantastic review, we do appreciate the repeat custom and try to keep adding a few new little personal touches. 
Look forward to welcoming you and your family again in the future
Kindest Regards 
Dave Smith GM

title: Good night
text: We arrived on a Tuesday night after a very long trip from Minnesota. We had a large room with an extra bedroom which worked well for us (couple traveling with young adult son).  The room was very clean and quiet, even though the road by the hotel is fairly busy. The staff were very courteous and helpful.
hotel_response:
Dear Linda B 
Thank you for posting a review of your recent stay at our property, glad to see you that you enjoyed your stay and found our staff courteous and helpful (I will pass these comments on). Our rooms are quite large in comparison to some hotels which does make things more comfortable when travelling as a family
We look forward to welcoming you again in the future should you venture back down to this part of the world
Kindest regards
Dave Smith GM

title: Modern, Neat & Tidy
text:
We arrived on Saturday, having booked online for a four night stay.
The Staff were helpful and pleasant to deal with.
Of all the seven Motels we stayed at during our stay in New Zealand, this was the newest with the most modern décor.
We stayed in their family accommodation which included a separate bedroom with two single beds, the main bedroom is also the main room of the motel including kitchen, television (with Sky) dining table and two lounge chairs.The bathroom was large with a spa bath.
Having read others comments stating a lack of soul, or character these may perhaps be a result of the design of the room which has a more Hotel feel. 
The décor is neutral and may not suit those looking for a quirky holiday experience, however if you are looking for a nice room, and a good night sleep, then this is exactly what you will find here, we enjoyed our four nights here and this accommodation served it's purpose for our family.
Essentially we spend our days out exploring and return to the motel for the evening.
hotel_response:
Dear WAPerthFamily
Thank you for taking the time to tell us about your recent trip to NZ and your stay in Hamilton, a lot of effort goes into keeping the decor modern. Nice clean rooms and a good nights sleep is what we endeavour to provide to our guests. Hope to see you again  should you return to Hamilton 
Kind regards
Dave Smith GM

title: Always go back
text:
Great place to stay, friendly owners, clean well appointed rooms.
What more could you ask for? The rooms are modern & offer everything you need for a short or longer stay. Air con, all the sky channels, leather couch, kitchen with cooking facilities, big bathrooms with large shower...
Nothing bad to say, I stay there every time I am in Hamilton for work & have also stayed when passing through on Holiday. I highly recommend Hygate.
hotel_response:
Hi Stowaways
thanks for the fabulous review , we do try and cater to the requirement for the business traveller like yourself as well as the families. The SKY decoders in each room with 50+ channels have certainly been a big hit and air-conditioning makes the humid Waikato nights more pleasant. Look forward to seeing you again on your return to Hamilton
Kind Regards 
Dave Smith GM

title: A clean but characterless motel
text: We stayed here 1 night on route to Taupo.  Whilst this was a large and modern room offering all the facilities you would need and in fact would want in a stay, the decor was so bland in shades of grey, black and white, you had an immediate sinking feeling of glumness come over you when you entered the room.  I could not fault the cleanliness of the room, the shower or the helpfulness of the staff, but sadly some personality in the decor was much needed to bring this soulless room back to life.
hotel_response:
Dear KrystyneS,
Thank you for your review, which mirrors that of your travelling companion Framps69. Great to hear that you liked the large, clean rooms and our cheerful staff. I’m sorry you like more colourful décor but I’m hoping we’ll see you again sometime in the future.
Kind regards,
Dave

title: Clean, but lacking soul
text:
Well located a short drive from the centre of Hamilton and local supermarkets, on the face of it, our unit was clean and contained everything we needed, with a well stocked kitchen, comfortable bed and decent bathroom with shower. It was quite modern in décor, but really lacked any personality, and its black and white theme was just rather bland.

OK for a one night stop or as a business stopover, but would not recommend a lengthier stay.
hotel_response:
Dear Framps69,
Thank you for your review. We are very pleased that you liked our location, cleanliness and comfort. We have tried to make our decor classical and understated so I’m sorry you were looking for something more colourful. However I do hope we might see you again the next time you are passing through Hamilton.
Kind regards,
Dave

title: Very nice motor lodge
text: The motor lodge is either new or completely renovated. Bathroom large, modern, clean.  Bed and furniture good quality and comfortable. Air conditioner top notch  Very quiet area even though located on one of main roads into town.  Very convenient to Waikato Stadium (5 minute walk). Overall a very good experience.
hotel_response:
Dear Dsbrown
Thanks for taking the time to tell us about your stay, our bathrooms are definitely a feature that gets a lot of positive feedback particularly the spa bath ones as you had & air-conditioning is welcomed during the humid summer months.  
Kind Regards 
Dave Smith GM

title: Hygate
text: We based all our accomodation based on ratings and comments on tripadvisor.  This was the first time we have done this and I am pleased to say, we were not disappointed.  The Hygate was up to the high standard that had been recommendated by others.  Not too far from supermarket and a great pub.
hotel_response: Hi Peter, thank you for taking the time to tell us about your recent stay with us and your nice comments. We are glad you enjoyed our hospitality and had a good time at the local 'pub' We at Best Western Hygate look forward to extending our hospitality to you in the future should you return to Hamilton. Kind regards Dave

title: Everything you could ask for in a motel
text: The Hygate is a modern, clean comfortable motel and the owner's Dave and Carolyne are helpful and genuinely friendly and caring people. My room had a spa bath, a separate bedroom and a large flat screen tv with all the Sky channels. The unit had everything I needed to make my stay away from home comfortable. It is within walking distance of good restaurants and though it is on a main road I did not notice any road noise at all.I would highly recommend this as one of the best motels I have stayed at.
hotel_response: Dear Coralea, thank you for taking the time post such a nice review, I am so pleased you enjoyed your stay with us and the spa bath relaxed you after a long day in the car. We look forward to being of service to you again in the future. Kind regards Dave

title: Nice and Tidy
text:
Staying two nights the room was roomy, clean and service by managemnt very good.  Location is with all the other Motels in Hamilton, so was expected and suited us for where we needed.
Only down side was thin walls, and room next door coming back at 4.30am and slaming doors and then snoring extremely loudly, and the next night the alarm going off in middle of the night, and left to run for a while befoer occupant turned it off.  A problem I suppose with beds back to back in rooms. 
Rated as a 4 star the rooms are but wouldn't hurt to do something outside to spruce up the complex as it is simply two rows of units and nothing else.
Still good value.
hotel_response: Dear AucklandDevon11, thanks for taking the time to tell us about your recent stay with us, we are sorry you got disturbed by the neighbouring guests late return & snoring. The exterior of the property is due for an update in the coming months. We look forward to accommodating you again in the future. Kind regards Dave

title: Awesome Place to Stay
text:
I had a nice, quiet stay at Hygate. The place is lovely. The people are attentive and helpful. the rooms are large and really well cleaned. Oh and the internet access is fast and there were no connection problems.
I would highly recommend staying there.
hotel_response:
Dear GSoffe
Thank you for taking the time to tell us about your recent stay. We are pleased to hear you enjoyed your stay with us and look forward to welcoming you back in the future.
Kind Regards
Dave Smith

title: Top end of average
text: Located some distance from central Hamilton, so need to drive to restaurants.  Rooms are large and appear well maintained.  Interesting configuration with a long window spanning the kitchen area looking directly onto the car park.  Don't know if others can see in, but it gives a feeling of lack of privacy.  There is a lot of noise between rooms, so if the place is busy, don't expect a quiet time.  Reception was ok.  Overall an Ok experience without drawing me back.
hotel_response:
Dear PedroNP,
Thank you for your review. We are pleased you liked the rooms. I can confirm that the window tinting and/or the blinds do give you 100% privacy and that we are just over 1km to the city centre. You did stay over the weekend of the V8 Super Car event so I suppose some guests may have been a bit noisy, but usually we are a very quiet and relaxing place to stay. We hope we might see you again if visiting Hamilton
Regards
Dave Smith

title: Location and service
text: We were only in Hamilton for one night for the Super15 rugby in July. The motel was walking distance to the rugby ground.  As a best western we thought it would be good quality and it certainly was. The owners were really friendly and helpful, providing good suggestions about where to eat and things to do. We would recommend the walk along the river.  The motel room was excellent and included a small kitchenette which would have been great if we had been staying longer. We had the front room which was a family executive suite. Although the room was on the main road we did not hear any street noise. The room was large, light and spacious. We would definitely stay here again next time we are in Hamilton. And Waikato stadium is a great place to watch the rugby!
hotel_response: Dear Tiel, Thanks for taking the time to inform us about your recent stay with us. Your comments are appreciated.  We are please you enjoyed your stay with us. With kind regards Dave

title: Highly recommend conference room
text: I stay here and hire their conference room every year, It is a really nice place to stay and the hosts are lovely. The conference room is lovely and has doors to a private courtyard which is really nice for breaks and fresh air. They let you do your own catering and tea and coffee which helps keep my course costs down tho they can provide it if you want it. I really like how eco friendly this place is too. It is probably the most eco friendly motel I have stayed at in NZ.
hotel_response: Dear Yoyo. Thanks for taking the time to inform us about your recent stay & conference with us. We appreciated your return business and look forward to being of assistance in the future. With kind regards

title: Great Location, Lovely Modern Motel
text:
I stayed in the Hygate Motor Lodge with a couple of friends in February for a rugby game. The rooms are really spacious, clean and modern. They have been well decorated and you feel like you're staying in apartment and not a motel. The shower worked well, the beds were comfortable and the room was really quiet as it is set back from the main road. 
The hotel is in the best location, not far from the main town centre and in the perfect position for the rugby. The motel was really well priced for the facilities and I would definitely stay again in the future.
hotel_response: Dear Nikki_numpty. thank you for the great review, glad you enjoyed your stay with us and the rugby. yes we are handy to the stadium and no need to take a car. Look forward to welcoming back you should you return to Hamilton. Kind regards Dave

title: Very pleasant stay
text:
Stayed here over Easter......very enjoyable. Friendly, approachable hosts. Our family room was spacious, clean and functional......kids really enjoyed the spa bath & the big TV. Would definitely stay here again. Probably more a hotel for the business traveller but we enjoyed our stay. Theres a great mini - putt / golf driving range next door. 

Just a bit too far to walk into town but its only a 3 minute drive to the CBD.

I note that some past reviews have said it was a bit noisy, thin walls etc but we didnt hear a thing, possibly 'coz my mob was possibly the loudest at the hotel.

A bedside lamp & a dresser in the twin bedroom would be good & also a bottle opener.
We definitely recommend this place.
hotel_response: Hi Toddsta, thanks for the review of your stay with us earlier in the year. Kids certainly do enjoy the spa baths, not sure why your room had no bottle opener but these should be in the rooms, we would have been carrying out maintenance on the bedside tables during this time. Yes we are a heavily a corporate property during the week but do welcome families also. Kind regards Dave

title: Excellent, clean motel
text: We were 2 couples travelling and needed something with 2 bedrooms. Only thing with the rooms we got was that one was right in entrance...i.e no sitting/living room and had a large bed instead and another separate bedroom. Although its not such a big deal, it definitely means you end up disturbing someone sleeping in the living room(bedroom) when using the toilet or even coming and going out of the room. Apart from that, it is a clean and spacious motel, definitely one of the best budget ones to stay in. Easy to spot and get around.

title: ONE OF THE BEST
text:
One of the best motels we have stayed in. Spotless sums it up perfectly. The studio room was very nice and comfortable and the bathroom was a delight. Yes, we did hear the people next door get up at 6am and we did hear the cars leaving a little while later. A lot of the guests were in Hamilton for the junior swimming nationals and had to be at the pool early so we expected to hear cars leaving early. Noise from the main road was minimal and we slept well. Oh, and the fridge was silent! They usually drive us mad in studio rooms.
Well done Dave and Carolyne

title: we loved it
text: we stayed here for the weekend three familys taking three units we were really happy with the modern decor ultra comfortable bed and cleanliness of the place as well as the friendly hosts we will be staying there next trip

title: Nice and Decent Motel
text: Nice decent motel on "motel street". Good, clean, relatively new and everything works. Owners are friendly and helpful. Recommended.

title: Disappointing
text:
Stayed here after reading the good reviews and found it to be ok but disappointing. On checking in we found the host very welcoming and were impressed with the clean, modern and well furnished rooms which were priced well.
Two problems though. Firstly the room and motel layout is strange. The front end of the rooms as you walk in have a kichen area with a long narrow window which looks out onto the car park and its hard to expalin but o me, this isnt good design and it just feels wrong. The walls are also not well sound proofed and I was rudely awoken at 3am by someone moving around in their room and probably unaware I could hear everything they did.

title: Fantastic Motel
text: One of the best premises I have stayed in. Room was lovely and the bathroom was absolutely fantastic with both a jacuzzi bath and large walk in shower. The housekeeping was second to none, not to mention the motel offering all the little things that really make it specially such as make up removal wipes etc. Staff were also really friendly and helpful. Cannot rate this motel highly enough and would suggest that anyone looking for accomodation in Hamilton would do well to go for this one.

title: Excellent place, excellent service
text: The place is very clean. Free internet and parking. Free paper every morning. Bed is very comfortable. Kitchen is complete and well equipped. Staff are very friendly and helpful. I highly recommend this place

title: OK - but paperthin walls
text:
The rooms are very large and clean, bed comfortable etc, Located on the Hamilton Motel strip. Reasonably well located. Not overly expensive. Including wireless internet access would help.

Bathroom is huge. Decent middle grade motel. Nothing more  or less

It is very noisy. The walls are very thin and you can hear TV's etc from adjacent rooms. Car parking is also very close to the rooms, so the traffic noise is signficant.

title: A real gem!
text: We drove from Auckland and the motel was easy to find, just a short drive from the centre of town.  The 1 BR unit was comfortable, spotless and HUGE!  Heaps of space in the living area and a large bathroom.  Even though the motel is situated on the main road into town, it was very quiet (Sunday night) and we had a great night's sleep.  Hosts were very friendly and helpful with information on the local area and other parts of New Zealand that we were heading for.  With all the usual amenities and free internet, this was one of the nicest motels we stayed in on our 4 week trip of the North Island.  Would have no hesitation in recommending it to other travellers.

title: Bad Design; Too Noisy
text:
The rooms are large and clean with a fairly well equipped kitchenette area but with nowhere comfortable to sit and watch the large TV.  This has the Freeview channels plus some sports and movie channels and there is also a DVD player.

The bathroom has a nice large walk-in shower and a reasonable size spa tub.
There is an (expensive) “corner shop” close by.

However, there are two serious demerits with the motel:

1)	The design of the motel means that you hear all the car movements; plus the noise from neighbouring units can be disturbing; and
2)	The painfully slow internet (in two days I was able to send only two very short e-mails).

title: EXCELLENT
text: This is the best accommodation I have stayed at whilst travelling the North Island of NZ. Rooms are clean and spacious with great kitchen facilities. Staff are friendly and helpful. Good value for money!

title: Nice people Nice place
text: We stayed in Unit 11--very large room with kitchenette.  IThe N$123.50 was a fair price.  Carolyne and Dave were helpful with suggestions and directions.  They even kept some luggage for us after checkout time.  Would gladly stay there again.  The location was pretty central; the GPS had no trouble finding it.  The free, spacious, and themed-areas Hamilton Gardens are well-worth seeing.

title: Spacious, modern room, pity it was the weekend.
text: We only stayed 1 night as we wanted to see the gloworm caves and were en route to Paihia, so we were hoping for a good nights sleep. Unfortunately it was Saturday night and a few wedding guests were staying here. They were not rowdy and drunk, but very noisy until 2am. I couldn't find an after hours number for the owner, at 1.30am my partner went to the door and asked them to be quiet, it took a little while but they were, after half an hour. When I mentioned this the next morning he said that I should have rung the administration number, silly me I didn't think that anyone would be on the desk at 12.30! Apart from that we couldn't fault the room. Clean, comfortable, spacious and modern. Located well for central Hamilton.

title: A Good Experience
text: We stayed one night before catching the Overlander to Wellington. The owners were very friendly and couldn't have been more helpful. Bed very comfortable. Modern, very clean units.

title: Clean, but basic
text: Very clean & modern, very friendly helpful staff but rooms are very basically decorated and poorly equipped.  Bare minimum of cutlery and crockery etc. Not cheap

title: It was great, clean, spacious and a good choice.
text: I am very fussy and this was clean, modern, spacious and I would happily stay again. The only downside, which they could rectify, with a little BBQ area , was the lack of outdoor seating...but this is just a personal opinion,.

title: Just what we were looking for
text: Very clean, modern room.  Kitchenette is perfect for what we needed.  Staff was very helpful, couldnt ask for anything more.

title: Didn't disappoint
text:
We booked this motel based on the reviews of others and were not disappointed. Very clean modern accomodation. Well kept. We booked a spa unit which was spacious and more than meet our needs. We found staff friendly and helpful. Nothing we really didn't like.

We plan to return to this motel on our next trip to Hamilton in Janaury.

title: Wonderful Family Experience
text: We stayed in Hamilton for the first time in order to go to our first Super 14 Rugby game. Chiefs vs Lions. It was our youngest son's  7th birthday suprise. We have tavelled quite extensively in the north island and this was our first stay in Hamilton.  We were very pleasantly suprised by this motel. We booked a spa unit for two adults and two children 11yrs & 7 yrs. This was a spacious unit which looked very modern and clean. The kitchen facilities were very good and the tinted glass on the windows helped to maintain privacy. It does not look great from the street but we would say this is a hidden gem. The motel backs onto a huge playing field which can be accessed by a rear gate which can be opened by your room key. Great for the kids to run about with a ball. No swimming pool or spa which would be wonderful. The motel is ideally situated within walking distance to the stadium and is close enough to Pizza Hut and Pak 'N' Save for convenience. The motel owners were very friendly and welcoming and were helpful in directing us to Hamilton Zoo on our departure, (which is better than Auckland zoo), so we would be happy to return to this motel.

title: Outstanding
text: This was an outstanding place.  It is new, clean and fresh and a wonderful place to stay.  All rooms include free internet access, which was greatly appreciated. The staff were very kind, helpful and friendly and nothing was too much trouble.   The room was large and included a huge LCD tv, modern spacious bathroom  and kitchenette - all well designed and useful.  It was very quiet overnight, although it is on a busy road.  Excellent option if you are staying in Hamilton

title: Needs to work on customer service skills!
text: We were furthest studio room from the main road but still felt at night that we were in the middle of a grand prix circuit, it is like boy racer central. we booked the room on the basis of having free internet usage but if you own a mac with os x or a laptop with windows vista  don't expect to use it, I went to ask why it wasn't working and the owner who seems to have no customer service skills didn't really care, gave the impression it was my fault for having a upto date computer. Also found 1 cockroach in a drawer in the kitchen and although i got rid of the problem myself I mentioned it to the manager the next day and he blamed the motel next door with no apologies or discount for the room, then went round our block with a can of spray trying to cure the problem himself. The motel was ok, but look elsewhere if you can.

title: Fantastic rooms, awesome service!!
text:
I stayed at the Hygate Motor Lodge recently for a romantic weekend away. We were spoilt silly by the owners & staff - we had a spa room, with a very comfy bed and modern, brand new furnishings. They'd laid out a special package for us because it was our wedding anniversary, some bubbles and choccies in the room. 

We were intially concerned about the location being on the main road but when we got there we didn't even notice the road - the rooms are very quiet.

We had a yummy breakfast in bed the next morning, then a stroll in the park out at the back.. Bit of a novelty for a city centre motel.
