We're already planning another weekend back there. I'd definately recommend the Hygate to anyone wanting a luxury relaxing break!!!

title: Beautiful
text: We love coming to the gardens every year and it's more beautiful each time. We're really impressed how much it's improved this year. The walking trails are a perfect place to stroll. And at the bottom of the trails you have a beautiful view of the lake.

title: Tired, grimy budget accommodation.
text: At first glance the rooms were okay. But soon we saw the kitchen was tired and grimy. The bedding was stained. Gross. The curtains need a wash and some de-moulding. This business doesn't deserve to use Hamilton Gardens in it's title and is a discredit to the Gardens and the city. We do not recommend this hotel.

title: Quiet
text: An older style motel. Quiet location. Cheap rates. Nice feel. Nothing modern. Adequate. Extremely helpful owner, who was happy to offer books and additional milk, and much information on Hamilton City attractions.

title: Clean and tidy
text: Hamilton Garden's Motel is a bit like stepping back to the 70's - but so what!   I happen to like old hotels and motels and enjoy the retro feel of years gone by.   This motel isn't the flashest in town, but I can't fault it for friendly service and cleanliness.  The bed in my unit was the most comfortable bed I have slept in for the a very long time (including my own bed at home).  I was by there myself and felt very safe.  It was good value for money.  I'd stay there again - and would request the same unit so I can sleep in that bed again :)

title: Another unhappy customer
text: Upon arrival we were spoken to rudely, told that if we had been 5 minutes later we would have been locked out (9:25pm after driving in the dark and rain forn 4 hours). The rooms were appaling, the place hasn't been touched since the 70s by the looks. The room we had booked was not given to us, there was no WiFi even though it was advertised, there was no hair dyer for my wife to use (again advertised). By the next morning we had decided enough was enough and so booked out by 9:00am but still got charged for the following night. If your only other option is to sleep in your car, I reocommend the car!

title: will use again
text: We have now stayed twice and going there again twice in the next two months. It is a older motel but clean , and the price is right. The owners great and the two little dogs not a promlem.Sharon and family from Whangarei

title: Good Value for money,  and very clean.
text: My friend and I stayed there for the Spring Rose Convention.  Although it is an older style motel, we found it very clean, comfortable beds, with the linen changed daily, what more could you want than a comfortable bed, clean linen daily and a nice hot shower.  It also obviously being updated.  It was handy to our venue.  I would stay there again.

title: An absolute joke
text: A work colleague and I stayed here during the annual Mystery Creek Field Days (120,000 people visit the city at this time).  Only accommodation we could get near the city at this time due to a late decision to go.  The motel booklet states how the current managers have not had their lease renewed so no more upgrades would be made. Talk about in a time warp - shower from the 70's with a curtain, motel until could sleep four and the bathroom had to be accessed through the bedroom which was hopeless for those sleeping in the lounge area. Heat pump was ineffectual, oven didn't go, batteries in tv remote were flat (not a major, but they shouldn't have been), two yapping dogs in the office area. Can't say one positive thing about the place.

title: Ok for a one or two night stopover
text:
+
Good Host
Roomy

_

Oldish
Low pressure shower
Extra charges for local calls (not used to this in N America)

title: A good one-night stopover
text:
This was a good location for me as I was travelling back towards Auckland airport from the Mount Manganui peninsula and needed an overnight stop.  The motel is situated on the edge of town, less than 5 mins from the main highway, so you can avoid all the town centre traffic.  Also, it is only 5 mins from the Hamilton Gardens which are certainly worth a visit if you have 2-3 hours to spare.

The motel has basic facilities - nothing outstanding, but is clean and comfortable.  The apartments are all ground floor, and the lounge has a separate dining area, fully equipped kitchen, and the bedroom is a bit small.  Bathroom area has shower and toilet.  There is a Pizza Hut ,and McDonalds & other takeaways within 5-10 mins walk, but other restaurants are downtown.  But I found this OK for one night.  There is a very small swimming pool, which is not heated, and was available, but as the spa pool was being renovated and evidence of the work in process, e.g tools, I chose not to use it.

title: Relaxing getaway!
text: Our family of 3 spent a lovely nights accommodation in a large suite so clean and well equipped with comfortable beds, tvs in both bedrooms, 2 luxurious bathrooms and a private spa pool right outside our back door! We will definitely be back!

title: Excellent accommodation at a fair price
text: This motel is one of the best we have stayed at. It is roomy, well appointed and serviced, and reasonably located. Pricewise it is not the cheapest nor the most expensive but as is often the case, you get what you pay for. A very comfortable option.

title: Will stay again
text: Very clean, tidy and quiet.  Stayed 2 nights in a one bedroom.  Room serviced daily. Good heating and air conditioning.  Easy to get to with good parking. Short walk to supermarket or The Base.  Surprising quiet considering the closeness to busy roads.  Would stay again.

title: An excellent thoroughly enjoyable short stay
text:
An excellent thoroughly enjoyable short stay at a very well appointed motel and a big thank you to John for making our stay a little more special.
We look forward to a return visit.

title: Really good room
text: Really good and everything in the room is great and up to standard and will be back in June next year again for mystery creek fieldays

title: Pleasant Stay
text: Comfy rooms with massive bathroom, shower has awesome pressure with extra water jets. Heaps of room in the studio unit with  kitchen supplies, just a shame housekeeping moves personal possessions when unnecessary and is too impatient to get in the room.

title: WORST MANAGER SERVICE EVER
text:
Management: Rude, dismissive, could  not or pretended not to explain payments schedule or read his bookings, demanded we show proof of payment, tried to take visa payment without permission, refused to give complaint details of his supervisors. We have been loyal patrons for 15 yrs, this is the worst treatment we have ever received.
Cleanliness: Bathroom basins not cleaned, Rubbish liners not replaced, mud left on floors from outside (not ours), old smoke butt left in bin (I am a non smoker). Made us vacume our own rooms. Chipped plates, and rubbish behind couches & found a spare key, told us $50 for lost keys, people before us would have been charged from poor cleaning.
Will be looking elsewhere next year, my company book at least 8 to 10 rooms a year for at least 6-8days. No more.
hotel_response:
Thank you for review. Being asked to leave an hour after check out ends is never a comfortable situation. 
You were the guest of our guest, not the main booker. We had to chase the booker for money every day as the payment card declined several times and the multiday stay was pay day by day against our policies. You should choose an accommodation supplier that better suits your budget in future.
The way you treated the property is so shameful that we are grateful you will not return. We run the top motel in hamilton, and our reviews show this consistently. 

During the stay the office staff was asked for a vacuum, we assumed this was for a spill. Our cleaners do not enter rooms when a do not disturb sign is on your door. 

Thanks

John

title: Beautiful clean rooms, quiet complex made for a great overnight stay.
text:
Arrived to a Beautiful clean and spacious  motel unit with kitchen and even a spa bath! Complex was quiet with parking at door. 
Close to kmart and supermarket. 
Easy to arrange late check-in thank you so much.
Lovely owners /managers made for a great overnight stay.

title: My go to for accommodation in Hamilton.
text: Nice, tidy accommodation.  Well appointed and close to The Base.  Not far from town.  Nice and helpful people.  A recommended place to stay but you need to book early because it's very popular.  In a commercial retail area but private and don't get bothered too much with the surrounding activity.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to Comment. See you next time.

title: True Waikato Hospitality
text: Without a doubt, this was one of our best experiences. We had the pleasure of staying a few nights in early January, with friends who are visiting from the UK - we could not fault a thing. But, what really shows the superb hospitality John and his team turned on for us, was when we had to do a last-minute booking to stay again (late at night) because our friends had been in a car accident and been discharged from hospital. Not only did we get a bed, but John went over, above and beyond to help us in our hour of need. If we ever need to stay in Hamilton again - this will be our first choice. I highly recommend Quantum Lodge to others. Thanks so much John, you're a champion :o)
hotel_response: Hope your family is safe and well.

title: Very comfortable overnight stay
text: Stayed here en route from Auckland to Taupo. Lovely welcome and well-appointed room. It was 'disabled access' which amused us as we're both able bodied - maybe our ages had something to do with it (68 & 73 😀😃). Easy walking distance to local supermarket for breakfast groceries and close to good selection of eateries.

title: One of the best…
text: One of the best motels we have stayed at. Unit was beautifully appointed, warm and super comfortable. We had the best nights sleep in the super comfortable bed and the shower and bathroom were fantastic. We will definitely be back!!

title: An outstanding hotel
text:
We stayed at Quantum Lodge for 8 nights in April 2023 with a sports team of approximately 48 people comprising of couples, families and team-mates. The accommodation was booked through Orbit Groups and Events in NZ. 
Prior to our arrival, my contact with Robbie about the after hours check-in process was efficient and timely. All the staff that I had contact with during my stay were very helpful. 
The housekeeping staff did an amazing job, especially on check-in day. Turning over the entire establishment to be ready for a large group booking was no mean feat. I witnessed the level of care and cleaning that was put into getting the units ready. The daily servicing of the rooms was also very thorough and to a very high standard. 
My husband and I stayed in a one-bedroom apartment and we were thrilled with the accommodation. The apartment had a separate bedroom with a very comfortable king size bed. There was ample storage.
There was a well stocked kitchenette and a large spotlessly clean bathroom. The bathroom had a stand-alone shower , a spa bath and a good sized vanity. 
The lounge area was well proportioned  with a comfortable couch, single chair and desk. Satellite TV was provided.  
The hotel facilities included an outdoor spa, pool, barbecue area (which we used for team get-togethers), swimming pool, gym and a shared laundry.
Parking is available right outside the unit. Wifi was reliable. 
The hotel is located within walking distance of large shops and restaurants and is about 6km out of the CBD. 
The hotel is on a reasonably busy road. Although we could hear some traffic noise it stopped early in the evening and we were not disturbed by it overnight.
I would highly recommend Quantum Lodge and I would love to stay there again when I return to Hamilton.

title: Awesome place to stay in Hamilton
text:
We are former Hamilton locals, back in town for a holiday.  As Americans by background, I am always a little wary of the road-side motels.  In the US, this generally signals a lower quality and standard of service.

But don't let that way of thinking have you miss out on this gem.  We considered several Airbnb options nearby, but ended up booking here because it frankly seemed like a better value.  I have not been disappointed one bit.

We arrived at Auckland airport around 5:30 am, and made it down to Hamilton by around 9:30 am.  Now, of course, that is before even the check-out time of the night before.  So, while I wasn't hopeful, we went into reception and explained the situation (that we'd traveled overnight from the US, were exhausted) and asked if we could store our luggage in.  To my surprise and relief, the hostess said there was a room like the one we'd booked nearly available.  She said to come back in 20 minutes.  She gave us the key and had the housekeeper's prepare the room.  We did a little shopping at The Base and came back around 11:00 am.  The room was ready and we were able to crash out.  Super gold star for customer service!

We have a 2-bedroom family suite.  There are two full bathrooms (one tub, 2 showers).  The beds are incredibly comfortable and the pillows make my head happy to lay down.  The kitchen is plenty big enough to have some simple meals in, which we have done.  There is a mid-size fridge, a cooktop, a microwave and dishwasher.  Oh, and did I mention the spa hot tub on the small private patio?  We just pulled up the cover and it was warm and ready to enjoy.  Bliss!

For those in the know, the downstairs lounge has a heatpump and both bedrooms have their own as well.  This is great for temperature control (as we are here in winter and you know most of NZ does not have great winter warmth and dryness indoors).

We have not utilized this, but you can order ahead breakfast to be made here, for what seems like generally reasonable prices compared with eating out.  We have had a great stay already and will be back in a couple weeks for the tail-end of our travels.  I can't wait!

This is a great location on the north side of Hamilton.  It is very near a Countdown grocery store, K-Mart and The Base shopping mall (stores, theatres, restaurants, playground, etc.).
hotel_response:
Wow, thank you Rachel and we always do our as best where we are able to accommodate requests especially for those travellers that have come from afar, do know how that feels.  Also thank you for your great feedback re our rooms, we think that they are pretty good and try to cater in everyone that we can.

Enjoy your holiday!

Kitchen has no oven but does have a microwave, dual element stovetop and is well equipped. You wouldn't want to cook a full evening meal, but breakfasts etc would be fine.

title: Quality accommodation in out skirts of Hamilton
text:
The Quantum is situated near the shopping mall Te Awa the Base, its location is probably the only downside for this property as its on the corner of a fairly busy road and even a road over gives the rooms road noise.
Not really walking distance to many places other than the Mall but close to Horsham downs golf course 10min taxi drive $20 approx.
The rooms are spotless and have great beds and a nice big TV to watch with sky, standard coffee making facilities. Offers breakfast but we didn't bother on this occasion.
Average studio price around NZD$155 up to $260 for a two bed unit.
At the front of the property is a small swimming pool if you need to cool off.

My only negative comment would be the host/manager might want to be a little more friendly with an occasional smile......it goes a long way.

title: Everything you need with spacious rooms
text:
Great motel on the outskirts of Hamilton, close to supermarkets, restaurants and shopping centre.

Rooms are extremely spacious, heat pump, kitchette with microwave etc.

Bathrooms are lovely, tiled and one of the best showers i have had at a motel.

Bed was a superking, and was ok, i like a bit softer bed, and softer sheets.

Great table work table, set up very well, large screen tv, with sky tv
Free unlimited internet was great, good speed and no worries about running out of data during the night.

Really comfortable leather couch.

Road noise was not a big deal.  Very small swimming pool and gym, but enough if needed.  Nice BBQ and spa area out the back.

title: Great service and clean!!!
text: The staff really go the extra mile, and make sure you are comfortable and well catered for.  The rooms are kept clean, and the property managers are helpful and friendly.. The venue is close to great shops, too  I would thoroughly recommend a stay!

title: Quantum Leap
text:
Stayed here for a night recently. Had a lateish check-in , smooth process with the host also organising us a Taxi as we were already an hour late for our evening do. Rooms whilst not the 5 star it bears everywhere (however they do have a signed Sonny Bill All-Blacks rugby jersey framed in the reception office - does that make it 5 star ??- the rooms are very well laid out , with good space - nicely decorated - nice little kitchenette and a  wonderfully spacious en-suite - fully tiled with a very nice roomy level entry shower. The room was very clean and tidy - nice touch to have fresh milk as well. Another sign of almost 5 star is the good quality toilet paper - better than most hotels. Had a very comfortable stay - only smallest gripe would be is its proximity to the S H'way 1 and across the road from the BASE shopping centre 
- so there is some traffic noise if you are in the far back rooms closest to the main drag. The location for this trip suited us and if we were out this way again and needed a motel - we would choose this one , on ya Quantum

title: Great Place (as always)
text: This is our 'go to' place in Hamilton. Rooms are always clean & tidy. Owners are friendly and helpful. Great location if you want to do some shopping at the base while your in Hamilton. The 2 bedroom spa units are great if you have kids with you (and they even have a spa pool and private outdoor area).

title: Great place to stay!
text: Very nice layout, modern, warm and great facilities with a fully equipped kitchen.  I stayed in the 1 Bdrm Deluxe and found the underfloor heating was great and I loved the spa bath so much so I decided to stay on but this time i stayed in the Family Unit with my 4 children and this was even better. Of course more room two stories.  Bdrms upstairs, bathroom with a bath & shower. Dwnstairs an extra bthrm  which was very handy for after using the spa which by the way was the best. Fully euipped kitchen , modern and warm like the other room only more space, perfect for families.

title: Enjoyed our stay
text: Lovely place nice and clean modern rooms we had no issue at all with anything when we stayed everything was excellent  its in walking distance of a supermarket and the Base shopping centre as well as a brand new Kmart plenty of food outlets

title: This is the place to stay..
text:
Stayed thru Wotif and have to say I was so impressed with the accommodation the room was so modern awesome bathroom and cooking facilities King size bed and a spa that got a lot of use.
The parking is great and staff were friendly we ended up staying an extra 3 nights instead of going back to Auckland.
Highly recommended.

title: Just lovely
text: First visit to Hamilton and we stayed here the hotel staff were friendly and took care of our room . We had a hotel minder couple taking care of the place and were just lovely helped me out alot with transport and advice . Would recommend this place to all also close to the Base shopping centre 😊

title: You won't regret it.
text: This motel was suggested to us as a 'get out of Auckland/first stop after jet lag and before the rest of your holiday' haven.  It met that expectation and much more. It was perfect.  Modern, reasonably priced, clean, well appointed, good location and quiet. The staff was friendly, service oriented, and they served lovely hot breakfasts.  We had a room with spa tub, sitting room and enclosed bedroom. We liked it so much we stayed an extra night! Only drawback was Wifi was a bit sketchy.  Will stay here anytime we are in Hamilton!

title: Excellent stay
text:
We stayed here the weekend of the Eagles Concert. The owners were extremely helpful and friendly. 
We had a one bedroom spa unit which was very clean, modern and comfortable. The room was very reasonable priced as well.
We will
Definitely come back again sometime. Highly recommend.

title: We always stay here
text: Whenever we are in Hamilton or travelling through to Auckland we make this the place to stay.Very well appointed rooms and it is set in a quiet area with easy access to the expressway both north and south.

title: This will be our place when in Hamilton
text: This place has everything you need.  It is spacious, modern, comfortable and well equipped.  The beds were comfy and it was spotlessly clean.  It is also within a short walk of a supermarket and major shopping centre.  The spa was also lovely. Ticks every box.  As our Hamilton family grows, we will be visiting more often and will most certainly stay here.  Only small gripe was no Wi-Fi included which I believe is a must these days.

title: Best we have stayed in
text: We only stayed one night at this marvellous Motor Inn and wish it could have been longer.  We were greeted in a friendly manner and the book in process took only a few minutes.  Once we entered the room we were immediately at home in the pristine cleanliness.  The shower..... Oh the shower was something else! Never have I enjoyed a shower as much as that one , what pressure and water piping hot.  The couch was comfortable and the King Size bed so comfortable.  It was also Air conditioned which made for a good night sleep.  It was extremely quiet despite being at such a busy intersection!  Wifi was free and fast!  I would definately stay here again.

title: Family Fun @ Quantum
text:
Stayed here with the family this weekend just past.
Excellent family unit, clean, great TV - HDMI !!! Spa was great and awesome Power Shower!
Staff were excellent, fast, efficient and friendly.
Our Daughter broke a glass and they shot over with their own vacuum cleaner, very understanding.
Could not fault this place at all - Even better than the big Auckland hotels where we have stayed - Family holidays in Hamilton from now on @ Quantum!

title: Quality, modern motel
text: I have stayed a number of times over many years. The rooms are very generous in size and well equipped. Close to a big shopping centre and food court and lots of fast food options nearby. 10 - 15 minute drive to Hamilton city centre. Always provided with fresh milk for tea / coffee

title: Great place
text:
We had training @ a local dairy company just around the corner. 
8 rooms booked total for 1 week. 
Just fantastic. 
We was a bit noisy in the spa the first night with all our duty free JD but no issues there, enclosed out door area. 
Then every morning 7am sharp our bacon & eggs would arrive. 
5 star all the way

title: Really Pleased
text:
Had an overnight stay here in June and could not fault our Unit. Had a one bedroom Unit which had a huge bathroom, lovely comfortable bed, good kitchen facilities and ALL the Sky channels which is most important in our household!
It was a cold night in Hamilton but Unit was lovely and warm.

title: We have a new favourite
text:
I need to start from the beginning.I was unable to book the room with my Credit card and I emailed the owers who promptly booked me into a room for two nights (family unit with private spa)
GOOD BITS:
*LOADS of towels for every single member staying there
*Super clean,modern and warm(heat pumps and underfloor heating)
* 2 (full) bathrooms
*Salt and pepper shakers (Its the small things which make a trip run perfectly)
*Ample plates/cutlery/glasses/mugs/utensils in kitchen
*Friendly check in
*Free paper on Monday morning

No bad bits,we will definitely be back to stay here.

title: Family unit exceeded expectations
text:
Quantum Lodge was recommended to us, and although it was far above the budget we had spent on rooms during our trip, we were staying only the one night in Hamilton and decided to treat ourselves to something a little nicer.

We booked the two bedroom family unit. On the ground floor was a small lounge with 2x two-seater lounges, a bathroom with toilet and shower, and a small kitchen with fridge, microwave, oven, kettle, and cooktop. Outside in the small, enclosed patio was a hot tub that we unfortunately didn't use (the weather was too chilly for us to consider the trip into and out of the hot tub!). On the top floor there are two generous bedrooms, one with a massive king-size bed, wardrobe and dresser, and the other with two single beds. There is a bathroom with a shower and bath that can be accessed from both bedrooms. 

There was wifi access, however we could only access it from the living room, as there was obviously too much interference to get reliable wifi access from the back of the unit.

There was a television in the bedrooms as well as the one downstairs, however SKY was only available in the downstairs lounge.

The bathroom facilities were excellent, however there were no towel racks, only two small hooks, which wouldn't do when we needed to use more than two towels for our group. We ended up draping towels over the bath tub. There were complimentary toiletries that were fantastic quality, including a shoe shine kit at each sink - perfect for busines customers.

The location of the motel is quite odd, located within an industrial estate, across the road from the intimidating The Base shopping complex, and around the corner from the largest Countdown I think I have ever seen. It was no problem for us, as we had access to a hire vehicle and the location didn't bother us at all.

Overall, we had a great experience, and budget permitting we'd be back again!

title: First-rate!!
text: I've been here several times, every stay is awesome! Great friendly service, immaculate, clean facilities, modern and well-equipped. These guys shouldn't be a MOTEL, they are more on the level of a HOTEL. Yes, the price is a little higher than most motels, but what you get for it is certainly justified by that. What's more, they respect your privacy very well, giving you what you need and then leave you alone unless you need them in which case they are more than happy to help. Some rooms are equipped with a spa, which is super! Although I stay as an individual on private business, I think these guys are geared toward your business and executive types, but that doesn't mean they are in any way unfriendly or incapable of the necessary friendly touch required. I highly rate this motel and continue to use them without reservation.

title: Excellent!
text: We stayed two nights on two separate occasions last month and both stays were great.  The rooms are very big with a comfortable king size bed.  There are kitchen facilities which were great for making breakfast.  The bathroom is large with a really nice walk in shower with excellent water pressure.  The staff were very friendly and made us feel very welcome.

title: Spacious room, friendly staff
text: We stayed in a 2 bedroom unit which consisted of lounge area (comfy sofas), kitchen and bathroom downstairs, and 2 huge bedrooms and equally massive dual-access bathroom upstairs.  The room was very clean and the kitchen very well equipped.  We received a very warm and friendly welcome when checking in, and they were only too happy to help us with directions when we asked (and the directions were spot on too!).  We stayed on a Friday night and didn't find the road noise too bad at all.  Would definitely stay here again.

title: Friendly staff, warm and clean rooms
text: Stayed here 3 or 4 times now, last being during the Americas Cup. Rooms are quiet, clean and warm. Nice tv. Shower and bathroom are very good. Good place to stay in the northern part of the Tron, would stay again

title: Nice, although remote from centre
text:
We had the two bedroom unit for a family of four.  The unit is on two levels; kitchen and small lounge area downstairs, and bedrooms and large bathroom upstairs.

The unit was clean and comfortable.  I would recommend this for a family in you are interested in being located to the north of Hamilton.  The accommodation is close to the Base on Te Rapa.  If you need to be close to town then this may not be for you.

title: Very Restful
text: The twin queen studio was very spacious and the beds super comfy.  The kitchenette contained a microwave, two electric hotplates, a fridge and tea & coffee making facilities.  The bathroom/toilet was also roomy with a large shower and ample complimentary toiletries.  The blackout blind on the main window facing the car park was excellent to block out the morning light as were the rest of the blinds in the unit.  The free wifi was as advertised and available in the motel room.  Other places we stayed in New Zealand only had the wifi available in the reception area so this was a bonus.  A very comfortable stay - thank you.

title: Clean but slightly noisy
text: The 2 bedroom unit has 2 spacious bedroom on level 2 . Spacious bathroom accessible by both bedrooms. There is another bathroom at level 1. I found the noise at night to be slightly disturbing even with all windows closed. The hall is rather small with 2 2-seaters sofa. There are 3 TVs in the unit , but only the one in the hall has sky channels. Parking right at the doorstep which is great . Shopping mall The Base is just across the road. Unit was clean . There is a big spa in the yard with no view.

title: Lovely and Spacious
text: A great find.  Used this site to look for a motel with specific requirements ie a spa mainly. Not hard to find fortunately in a slightly unusual location really.  On the corner of a busy road so there was a bit of road noise from Te Rapa Rd and then from the road running past the other side of the motel but it could have been the location of the room.  The pool was outside our windows also and while no one used the pool, if there had been people in it that might have been noisy / intrusive also. The motel was very nice, spacious, well appointed with a lovely large bed room, separate lounge and big bathroom.  Laundry on site was a great asset.  The manager was pleasantly helpful. Billed as a 5 star motel, it certainly is extremely well appointed.

title: Brilliant place to stay
text: Family of 2 adults and 2 older children. Rooms and facilities are perfectly set up. Cleanliness of everything is a credit to the owners and the cleaners themselves. Would definitely go out of our way to stay here again!

title: Stayed here for 5 nights for work
text:
FANTASTIC motel - the best.  I would not stay anywhere else in Hamilton.  The rooms are great.  I had one with the spa bath - pure bliss at the end of a work day. The bed was comfortable and I slept so well.  I liked the decor and set out of the room was perfect for someone staying for so many nights.  The kitchen was really good - I cooked all my own meals so was perfect.  

I can not recommend this highly enough for anyone travelling for work but also if coming to Hamilton for other reasons…why stay anywhere else.  It truly was 5 star.

title: 5 star but......
text: Stayed overnight and was really looking forward to it given the reviews. Was met by i presume, the lady owner. Drove from reception to the room( all of 10 meters), by which time she had opened the room, put the milk in the fridge and had left the room without showing us what was what. I felt like i had intruded on her afternoon. Unit was lovely and well appointed and you couldnt fault the facilities which were top rate. Only criticism i had was the bed was too soft (personal preference) and the showerhead was not adjustable  so blasted out at face height. Also some of the lights in bathroom were popping out of the ceiling. Lots of dust on top of wardrobe and bedroom door wouldnt slide shut fully as it was warped. Would i stay again? Yes. Is it a 5 star? Yes but owners need to keep on top of the little things that start to go wrong given its been open 10 years now. Still a happy stay.

title: Great Motel
text:
We stayed in Hamilton for a week coming from the Uk and attending a wedding in Hamilton.

The motel was perfect, very clean, nice little swimming pool and gym.

The owners were great and very helpfull.

Would happily stay again.

Thanks

title: Value for money
text: Stayed one night and thoroughly enjoyed the experience. My husband and I had the studio room. We were greeted by a very friendly host who took the time to show us to our room. It was huge .. clean, airy, lovely decor, beautiful shower, comfy bed, modern flat screen tv, free wi-fi. Close to Countdown and The Base. Definately recommend to those who want comforts of home. Thank you Quantum

title: Best motel in Hamilton
text:
I stayed here for work, and this is by far one of the best places I have stayed in in NZ.

The units are spacious, with two tv's, large bed in a separate bedroom, modern bathroom, clean kitchen, spa bath and free internet.  Couldn't ask for anything else.

Even though it was so close to the main road, I found it to be very quiet.

title: Best NZ motel I've ever stayed in
text: I stayed at Quantum lodge twice in the last 6 months. Quite simply this is the best NZ motel I've ever stayed in. The hosts are fantastic and easy to deal with. I stayed in a one bedroom unit and it is very spacious. It has a king size bed, which was very comfortable just firm enough with great pillows. Free wifi which is very convenient. A spa bath in the bathroom along with a separate shower which has outstanding power. 2 TVs in the unit - the main TV has its own sky box so plenty of channels to choose from. The kitchen is well stocked with utensils. The unit also has ambient or direct lighting in all rooms. The unit was very clean and very comfortable to stay in. The location is north of the main strip in Hamilton but that's not all bad in my opinion. Countdown is close by and also The Base is in walkable distance. The cost per stay is probably slightly more than other motels in Hamilton but it is a 5 star experience. I would definitely stay here again.

title: Best of its kind in NZ
text:
I do a fair amount of travel with work, and this is my favorite place to stay. 
The units are a great size, spotlessly clean, quiet and private.  They have large, comfortable bathrooms with exceptionally good showers. The beds are comfy, couches and chairs well kept. 

The Lodge staff are friendly, but you hardly see them - this place is so well managed!

We come a dozen times a year, and we keep coming back.

title: Great Place
text: We had a studio,it was huge,good king size bed in an area that even included a lounge and large tv, the cooking facilities included everything you needed.It had the biggest bathroom we have ever come across in a studio, the shower was fantastic, would recommend this accomodation to everyone.

title: Great motel
text: By far the best motel style accomodation we have had on the visit.  Big rooms, lovely bathroom.  Pool and gym if you are so inclined.  2 tv's  in our suite.  A little traffic noise as the motel is on a busy intersection.

title: Luxury!
text:
We had one of the best units in the motel -a 2 bedroom,  2 bathroom unit with its own hot pool in an enclosed yard at the back -sheer luxury! ! Clearly well managed, everything was spotlessly clean and the kitchen was very well equipped. The bathrooms were spacious and well equipped with lovely fluffy towels changed daily. The manager was friendly and helpful. 
   The location was ideal for the nearby large shopping centre -the Base- and for main roads. This did mean there was some traffic noise but this could not be heard with the windows closed.Apart from a bench by the hot tub there was no outside sitting space -this would have been icing on the cake - but generally I cannot recommend this highly enough -especially if you can run to a hot tub room!

title: Very high standard
text: All rooms of a very high standard, have stayed here a number of times on business trips. Small compact gym with a very small pool, also a hot tub. Laundry facilites for a very low price. The bathrooms are exceptional with wonderful showers. Now that the Base (shopping centre) has been built there are plenty of places to eat, within walking distance and also a supermarket, if you want to self-cater. Very comfortable rooms, very generous size too. On outskirts of Hamilton so would need a car/taxi if or have to jump on a bus to get into the centre of the city.

title: The best shower EVER!!!!
text:
Stayed just one night but it was like staying with friends. 
Super clean and comfortable. Walk across road for a great selection of eateries. 
Wireless Internet worked well and the Manager was super friendly. 
Would stay again and would recommend.

title: Would stay here again when in Hamilton
text: We were in Hamilton on business. The Quantum was referred to us by a colleague. When and if we are in Hamilton again, it will be a no brainer to stay at the Quantum Lodge. Our unit was on the main road side but it was very quiet and peaceful. The rooms are modern and very clean and it matches any great motel/hotels we've stayed in anywhere - world class. Thanks for your hospitality.

title: Feels like home
text: I am away overnight with my work at least 1 night per week, not often in Hamilton these days, but every time I stay at the Quantum, it's like home away from home.  Clean, large rooms, tasteful decoration and just the right amount of humour from Max to feel like family.  Well done to the team at Quantum.

title: If Staying in Hamilton You Must Stay Here
text: This is the second time we have stayed here on our visit from Australia.  We came for a surprise family birthday so quite a few family members stayed there as well.  We booked a family unit for three nights (bedrooms upstairs, living downstairs) as we loved the facilities and the idea of having our own private spa pool.  This place is immaculate, the bedrooms are very large and the service is incredible.  There is also a guest laundry, pool and gym which we didn't use.  I couldn't believe it when I got out of my car at the end of the first day, when going to the office to collect the key with my sister, when the owner came out and greeted us both and gave us our keys (I couldn't even remember what apartment I was in but he got it right for both of us)!  A newspaper was delivered every day and the delightful young ladies came to service the rooms daily.  It was also nice to be provided with 'real' milk to go with the lovely tea/coffee facilities.  We didn't order breakfast despite the option being available.  The Base Shopping Centre is nearby with many great shopping outlets, restaurants and cafes.  We had a hire car so I'm not sure what local transport would be like for getting around in in this area but you can always email the hotel in advance to check this out if need be.  I would most definitely recommend this place to others.

title: Best hotel in Hammy :)
text:
I've came with my university to present at a conference in Claudelands conference center @ Hamilton CBD, everything was stunningly awesome for the room at Quantum Inn.

We rented a Family unit which consists of 1 king size bed, and 1 double single bed room. The room was pretty big itself. And amazingly it has TV in per room plus one on the living room = 3 TVs in one unit.

The room is also fully air-con'ed which could be used as a heat pump as well.

Everything is just stunningly awesome, with a plus a private spa on the bank.

title: Warm Welcome, Wonderful Breakfast
text: A very smart modern motel, clean and comfortable, with all the amenities you'll need.  Located just to the north of Hamilton, it is close to the Cock and Bull pub, ideal for a meal and pint.  A very friendly and helpful welcome will await, and make sure you sample their lovely cooked breakfast delivered to your room.  A real treat!

title: Best place in Hamilton
text: We have stayed at lots of places in hamilton and havnt been very happy with all of them, decided to stay at the Quantum lodge over the weekend and we will be staying here from now on. Same price as the rest of the town and great location i walked to the base and the room was very big for a studio with a lovely bathroom and very good kitchen. The spa and bbq area is very nice and breakfast was great as well. Friendly staff and a all round great stay. Will 100% be back in the future.

title: Great spot to stay
text:
My wife and I stayed in a studio unit which we found to be ample in size, it had a warm welcoming feeling about it and all the amenities were of very good quality. The kitchen had all that you would require with plenty of variety of teas and coffee. Bathroom was spacious and the shower was amazing, plenty of hot water and delivered at a fearsome rate from a mulittude of shower heads.
Enjoyable stay with welcoming helpful hosts.

title: Fantastic!
text:
Great location, near main roads so easy to get around Hamilton. The Base shopping centre is across the road so Shops, cinemas, restaurants and other amenities are very close. 
Swimming pool and spa pool are lovely.
We stayed in a family unit, 2 bedrooms and bathroom upstairs, lounge, kitchen and 2nd bathroom downstairs. Small private courtyard with our own private spa.
Loads of space, kids loved the spa and was great we could sit in the kitchen and read the paper with coffee in hand while they played in the water.
Will definitely be back to stay.

title: Very comfortable stay - highly recommend this Motel when in Hamilton
text:
Our second stay here - first time in a one bedroomed - just hubby and I  - and last weekend with the 2 children.  We had a 2 bedroomed family unit - its as big as a house nearly!  Downstairs a lounge, shower/toilet, kitchen and dining area - with doors out to a small courtyard with a lovely spa pool in.  Upstairs two very generous bedrooms and a large bathroom with 2 basins, shower, bath and toilet.  The amenities in the bathroom were very generous and of good quality - lots of bath towels provided too which I love!  The tea/coffee supplies were also generous and of good quality.  A large fridge in the kitchen with fresh milk provided!  

Our unit was faultlessly clean and tidy when we arrived.  The property is in walking distance to a supermarket and an extremely large shopping centre call 'The Base', and probably a five minute drive to the centre of Hamilton.  There is also a swimming pool and guest laundry on the property.  Reception was friendly and efficent.  Would definatley stay again!

title: Classy Motel
text: We only stayed one night. This is a very good quality motel which looked after us well. The best word I can find is ‘pleasant’ ie it was a pleasure to crash there after a long drive from Auckland. I liked the décor and colour scheme – very relaxing. The place is convenient to the main highway but not too convenient. There are shops and cafes nearby and the city is only a short drive away.

title: "Great place"
text:
Stayed here on our last night in NZ.  What a great place and our room was so big and so very comfortable.  Everything was very clean and the bed was so comfy!
We ordered breakfast for next morning as it was reasonably priced unlike some other motels and it was very good.  Motel situated on north side of town (about 7-8 minutes) so very handy for travelling on to Auckland airport.   Would definitely recommend this motel to anyone else.

title: Great place to stay
text: We stayed here in late feb on the way to Whakatane for a wedding. We stayed in a 2 bedroom unit with our own spa in the courtyard which was just what we needed after an early flight from Melbourne. The shower was amazing and the unit had everything we needed. Will definitely recommend to anyone staying in Hamilton.

title: Just ok
text: Stayed here in Feb 2012 for a few nights. Great location if you have a car as there is a delicious group of gourmet shops across the way. However, despite the airy large bathroom, I must admit I found the room overall claustrophobic. The room faced south and had dark wood throughout with the only light for the front of the room which as it was on a walkway I kept the dark blinds closed for privacy. The bedroom was an internal one, ie no window. Also, for a 5-star eco-hotel I wondered why they didn't have a recycle bin in the room, nor asked guests to re-use their towels. Dont' think of this as one hotel where you could slip on your sneakers and go for a run as it's parallel to the main road into Hamilton and semi-industrialised around the hotel so not conducive to exercise. I was in Hamilton for business, and think in future I'd stay somewhere brighter.

title: Great Place to Stay
text:
We stayed here very recently and chose just a standard studio unit. What a lovely surprise as the unit was absolutely huge! I have stayed in other studio units over the years and some of them are extremely small but this was an exception being very spacious. Plenty of room for two people but even 4 could stay comfortably.
The unit was very well appointed with good decor, very clean and everything was in excellent repair. The bathroom was huge with a great roomy shower and a lovely vanity. Lots of bathroom vanity items were provided - shampoo, tissues etc and the towels were lovely and thick. Plenty of room for cooking with 2 ceramic hotplates and a microwave. There was also plenty of cutlery and crockery - not the usual 2 cups, mugs and plates and two of each item of cutlery which is most annoying when staying a few days.
The motel is very handy to everything with a supermarket close by and takeaway restaurants very close. The Base shopping centre is literally a 5 min drive away and easy to walk to if you don't have transport tho the road across to it is very busy.
About my only complaints could be the motorway noise as the highway close by is heavily used and busy tho we weren't too bothered by it. The pillows also were a little flat so replacing those could be a good thing! More towel hanging space in the bathroom wouldn't go amiss either as there was plenty of wall space for another towel rail or better still a heated towel rail! These are minor things tho, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend staying here.

title: Brilliant stay
text: Our family stayed here for 4 days over the 2011 new year in a family unit, the room was beautiful, cleaned every day, very roomy. Loved the dishwasher in the kitchen. The kids(1&3) loved the outdoor spa and the stairs. Excellent location, very close to shopping centres and Hamilton. Loved it. We will definitely stay here when we return to NZ.

title: My review Quantum Lodge Hamilton
text: What a lovely place to stay.  We stayed on our wedding night.  The spa bath is awesome!  Spacious area inside the unit.  Lovely kitchen/lounge areas.  The bedroom is amazing.  The bed is huge!  And so comfy!  The managers were very nice and accommodating.  The cooked breakfast was exceptional!

title: Quiet nights sleep
text:
We chose  this motel as  it was on the Auckland side of  Hamilton,  and we wanted an early start the next day.  The motel  room was large and very clean,  good bathroom, great bed, small kitchenette. Free internet.   We slept with the windows open  and didnt hear any road noise.  It is very close  to a big shopping centre.  We would definitely stay here again if in  Hamilton.
Enjoyed a great dinner at  Palate - Victoria Street Hamilton that night.  And we went to the Hamilton Botanical Gardens   on arrival in  Hamilton  - truely a spectacular place to visit.

title: Home away from Home
text: This is an excellent Motor Inn and my family have stayed a few times.  It is our family place of choice when we visit Hamilton.  great owners, great service and family friendly.

title: Best Ever
text: My family and I stayed at this facility in a family three times after making an online reservation. We were made to feel extremely welcome at check in which went smoothly. The units were clean, spacious and had plenty of towels and accessories. The wide screen TV's in each room gave good reception. The beds were comfortable and I would have no hesitation in returning to this facility when in the Hamilton area again. The kids enjoyed the swimming pool and the indoor hot tub was well used too. I highly recommend this facility.

title: the cleanest motel!
text: friendly staff, and good location. Rooms are always clean, has a spa too, free newspaper and broadband wireless. Has a bit if road noise as off the main road into Hamilton

title: Great place to stay while on business
text: I have stayed at Quantum Lodge twice now, and can confidently say there is no where else I'd rather stay while in Hamilton.  It is a comfortable setup, rooms small but all you need.  Comfortable and warm - also a lovely bathroom.  Very handy to most things you need.

title: 5 star in Hamilton
text: One of the only five star accommodation in Hamilton, two minutes drive from the base shopping complex. Stayed here a few times on the way to Auckland just to break the journey. Nice clean and tidy rooms with modern amenities. Just make sure you stay in a room on the opposite side to the main road that runs alongside, noise is unbearable. Owners are not over friendly but rates are reasonable. Free internet too.

title: Clean, Comfortable, Handy
text:
Good clean and tidy motel on the outskirts of Hamilton  
Comfortable king bed .
Our room was next to the pool which might be an issue in the summer months, but not in autumn.

title: Excellent rooms!
text: Heat pumps & TVs in every room, spacious, very helpful staff (I left my charger behind and they called my cell to organise sending it). Didn't use the spa outside but it was there :-) Real fast free internet. Will definitely go there again.

title: Fantastic accomodation. Highly recommended
text:
This motel is advertised as a 5 star and it certainly meets this standard in my opinion. The rooms are excellent and of a high standard and are spotlessly cleaned every morning. The large two bedrooms apartments have their own hot tubs and the single room apartments have triple jet power showers.
Not only are the rooms clean they are well maintained and there is always hot water and excellent water pressure and all rooms have a kitchen and are well supplied with crockery etc. 
The only bad points are the motel is a bit far out of town and you need a car to get around. However it is probably a plus that the motel is not in down town Hamiliton as its a bit of a dump. The Motel though is closely located to the highways and is in a good location for touring the area and North Island as a whole.

title: Modern, very clean accommodation
text:
We stayed here for two nights while attending a wedding in Hamilton.  The location was great for us as the wedding was on that side of town but the motel is well out of the main part of town so you need a car if you want to eat anywhere decent at night.
The two bedroom, two bathroom apartment we had was very clean and comfortable, with a well set up kitchen and a spa out the back.   Not a pretty location - it's just off  the main highway into town and across the road from a big shopping centre but unlike other reviewers I didn't hear the traffic at all at night. 
Only minor complaints - bedside table on just one side and  no reading lights.   There was no dresser and just a tiny narrow shelf in the front bedroom so nowhere to put anything.  With 4 people sharing the upstairs bathroom, some towel rails or more hooks  would have been handy.

title: Excellent accomodation
text: I have been meaning to write a review all year...kept forgetting. I booked the Quantum Lodge as I have been to Hamilton many times to see my husband's family and was never keen on any of the motels I saw in town. Previously we stayed with family but this time we wanted a holiday.  The other motels in Hamilton either looked old or were on the Terapa Straight which, if you have never been to Hamilton before, is a local race course for boys with V8 cars (and no insurance but that is another story!).  The Quantum Lodge is near to the road and you do hear the cars roaring past (but it is hard to avoid this anywhere in Hamilton) but it isn't bad and it certainly did not keep us awake or spoil our lovely holiday. We booked the larger of the apartments for the first 2 weeks of our stay and it was out of this world. Huge bedrooms, gorgeous bathrooms, and decent living conditions. It was serviced every day. We had our own spa out the back which was heavenly. We travelled about a bit then came back to Hamilton for another week and booked the one bed apartment. This was again beautiful but the kitchen area was a bit cramped but did give me an excuse not to cook...so cannot complain. We will be booking the Quantum Lodge for our next visit whenever that may be.

title: MODERN WITH GOOD LOCATION
text: Stayed for 2 nights at in a one bedroom deluxe room.  Very modern with tv in lounge and bedroom, corner spa bath, kitchen with microwave and hob.  Cleaned daily to a very high standard, towels changed daily, etc.  Good location for The Base shopping complex and short drive to Chartwell Shopping Mall.  Only downside was that there was pretty much continuous traffic noise most of the night.  If you were a light sleeper it wouldn't have been great.  But personally would stay there again because of the standard of cleanliness and room facilities if only for a couple of nights.  Complex also had small gym and pool.  But too wet and cold for those!!

title: Best motel we've ever stayed in..
text:
This motel was absolutely divine.
We stayed in a 2 bedroom family unit.  Clean & spacious, luxurious fittings, comfy beds.  Private spa unit.  Kids loved having the stairs to play on. TV and Air cons in both bedrooms. Two bathrooms.
Great location, across from The Base shopping centre, 10 mins drive from the Westfield shopping centre. 15 mins to zoo. 1 hour to rotorua - great for day trip. 1 1/2 hour to Auckland.  We are planning another trip later this year.

title: Great facilities, highly recommend
text:
We stayed two nights here for a wedding. Bridesmaids shared suite on first night, then two bridesmaids and husbands stayed on the 2nd night. 

We had a two bedroom suite, with massive beds and bedrooms and a huge joint bathroom upstairs, a large lounge with two fold out couches, 2nd bathroom (with shower), full kitchen (dishwasher, microwave, etc) and spa pool downstairs. The water pressure in both showers was amazing. Very new, fresh interior design.

Staff very friendly and accommodating. Loads of parking. Motel was quite far out of the central city (right opposite the base shopping centre at Te Rapa), but it was perfect for where we needed to be, plus the bride's family basically took over half the hotel, so was great for that.

We also saw the studio rooms, and were impressed with the size of these rooms too.

title: Wow, what an undiscovered beauty"
text:
We have stayed in foru lots of motels and hotels this summer and this place, which is 5 stars, has to be the best for value.  We stayed at a 4 star hotel that was not as luxurious as this place.  It is totally value for money.  $140 room got us so much more than an over priced campsite in Paihia.  i totally recommend this place for anyone to stay for a couple of nights.  it is just down the road from the base which is like a mega shopping centre, Te Rapa pools and it is easy to find.
Oh, and i recommend using the shower!  three jets.  awesome.  I wish we had found this place first.  i would have stayed so much longer.

title: Great hotel, but unfriendly owners
text:
We went to Hamilton to stay with our good friends.  We chose this hotel because it was so spacious and had great reviews on Trip Advisor.  We were taken aback when we arrived as the woman who checked us in didn't even speak a word and expected me to know what she wanted me to do (which was follow her to the office).  I am big on customer service and first impressions and I was not impressed by this.  

Luckily the room made up for the customer service as it was spacious, clean and perfect for a family with kids.  There was a full kitchen, so it was great to be able to cook our meals and eat in once in a while.

title: Excellent quality accomodation.
text:
I stayed here for 6 nights in May of this year and received a warm welcome with excellent and friendly service throughout my stay. Room was large and well furnished with very comfortable bed and even electric blankets. Bathroom was superb and the small kitchenette had everything I needed.
Will be staying again with my daughter in August.

title: Would Have Loved to Stay Here - if only they would let me
text: I booked a room at Quantum Lodge based on the excellent reviews on Trip Advisor and really looked forward to it. I received confirmation of my booking a full three weeks ahead of my trip to Hamilton. A day or two before we were due to stay there, they rang my PA to tell me that there were no longer any rooms available. No reason, just no room at the inn! As a frequent traveller with a large sales and marketing team, they have just missed out on at least 40 bookings this year. I've never been so taken aback. I stayed elsewhere and it was very pleasant. Unbelievably bad service and they don't deserve my business.

title: Excellent!
text:
We stayed here during our 2008 tour of New Zealand. It was coming to the end of the tour and as we had been on a very tight budget staying in hostels and backpackers we gave ourselves a treat and were not disappointed.

The motel is a little way out of the city but we found it without to much trouble. It is 5 star accomodation and we had no complaints. As expected it was immaculatly clean with everything of the highest standard. We even saw a sporting celebrity staying here.

Our studio had a large TV, SKY, DVD player, sofas, a huge bed, mini kitchen with fridge, microwave, etc and a very impresive bathroom.

Only one moan. They dont have WIFI. In a place like this I thought it would be included.

The motel offers breakfast in your room. We went for the full English breakfast which was huge and at only NZ$16 was very reasonable.

Overall. Excellent!

title: Best motel in New Zealand?
text:
This is without doubt the best motel I have stayed at. Immaculate presentation, very clean and all the facilities needed. I was in a 'disabled' room (813) which was very large (my colleagues room (802) was slightly smaller, but still spacious). It is far enough off the main highway for road noise not to be an issue. Tasty breakfasts available - and better than what most motels offer.

There is only one downside, it is 3km from the city centre - so a car is needed to get to restaurants etc. Nothing really of interest in the vicinity. However, it is nicely placed for the nothern expansion of the city which is happening.

title: Lovely Stay
text: Stayed three nights recently with my wife after reading previous tripadvisor reviews and ratings. We were not disappointed. It is situated on the way out of town, North towards Auckland, and is in a semi-industrial area on the main road. Despite this it was very quiet (I am a light sleeper). The motel is new, clean and well maintained. We stayed in a one bedroom unit which turns out to be the same size as a studio but with a slightly cramped bedroom. However, the bed was great and the aircon nearly silent. The bathroom was exceptional and the small galley kitchen quite sufficient. The owners were lovely and made our stay memorable. They looked after us and were concerned for my wife when she briefly fell ill. Didn't try out the pool. I understand that there is a gym, but didn't feel the need. I would stay here again and will definitely be recommending it to friends.

title: Loved it!
text:
My partner and I stayed here in November 2006 for only one night. We stayed in a one bedroom deluxe room. 
Tarriff at the time was $160 NZ per night for the one bdrm deluxe. Value for money.
We loved it!
Quite compact, but absolutely lovely!
Spa bath
Separate shower
2 televisions (One in living area and bedroom)
Huge super king bed - very comfortable!
Air conditioning
DVD player
Good kitchen facilities complete with microwave & cooktop

Would definately stay again!

title: Absolutely Wonderful
text: If you're touring NZ and need a place to catch your breath then we whole heartedly recommend a couple of nights at Korbaylen Estates. Brett and Sally are the perfect hosts and great fun. The en suite room was immaculate and fully equipped. The location is quiet and ideally located for the incredible Hamilton Botanical Gardens and Waitomo Glowworm Caves.

title: Comforts of home!
text:
Wonderful stay at this Bed and breakfast. The tree lined driveway lead us to the house. 
Greeted by polite host who was able to accommodate 2 couples. 
It had all the comforts of home. 
So clean, smelt wonderful. 
Fabulous beds, kitchen with coffee, tea, food for breakfast supplying for all tastes. Even Vegemite!!
Huge lounge, house surrounded by gardens, really just the comforts of home. 
Great communication by host also. 
Highly recommended, thank you Brett and Sally.

title: Fabulous stay!
text: We enjoyed two nights at this lovely home set in extensive park like grounds. The bedroom was comfortable with a small ensuite bathroom but we also had access to a larger bathroom, a study and a large lounge/dining room for our exclusive use. There was also a kitchenette with a huge array of breakfast items, cheese and biscuits and lovely home made fruitcake. Brett and Sally were delightful as was their little dog Mollie, who loved to visit occasionally. Hamilton is a wonderful location and their home convenient and easy to find. We loved our stay here and highly recommend it.

title: Very nice B&B
text: The time we spent at Brett and Sally's was really nice. They were very knowledgable and provided us with local information. The bed was very comfortable.   As you drive in the house and grounds remind yo of entering a ranch, with the cows and naturally a dog. It was a beautiful setting and well worth the money. I would recommend it to anyone.

title: Bride’s Party getting ready venue 😊
text:
A wonderful place for our daughter and her two bridesmaids to get ready at! The house is beautiful with lovely decor, the grounds are well kept, offering fantastic photos both indoor and outdoor.

Sally and Brett were great to deal with, going out of their way to accommodate the girls on this special occasion.

Korbaylen Estate offered everything.  It was very private, relaxing and had the best country atmosphere. We all loved our stay!

Totally recommend this place for a holiday, a break away and/or especially for special occasion photos😊

Thank you very much Sally and Brett😊

Photographer: ClaregPhotography, Hamilton

title: Lovely country setting
text:
We had a very comfortable two nights at the Korbaylen Estate. The room was comfortable, the bed was lovely, we had a bathroom which was very small but clean and had everything, The host were very welcoming as was their little dog. 
The gardens were beautiful.

title: Korbaylen Estate, Hamilton, New Zealand
text: A very nice & quiet Estate, not far from the city centre. Warm welcoming from Brett. Love the room, it is very nice & clean, very good shower, free 'help your self' breakfast, love the garden ... very lovely place. Worth the money

title: Very quiet
text: Not quite what we expected from the description and name "estate" but our room was very nice with beautiful bathroom. The do-it-yourself breakfast was more than adequate. The owners were friendly and helpful with recomendations of things to do and places to eat.

title: Beautiful place to stay!
text: We spent 2 nights at this special place close to Hamilton. They offer beautiful rooms in luxury with a huge private lounge to use. A big flatscreen TV with On-demand channels to watch (we were lucky to see the live rugby game between NZ-Aussi in Wellington :-) The shower in the ensuite is fabulous! The couches in the living are very comfi and for piano players: go ahead! Every room in the house is tastefully decorated and the kitchen with breakfast bar is convenient & complete. DIY breakfast is tasty with a lot of goodies to choose from. The driveway to their property makes you feel like a special guest and the friendly owners Sally & her husband will greet you with a warm welcome. Very recommended! Thanks guys, we will be back!

title: Disillusioned
text: Not exactly as advertised! We thought we were going to some lovely gardens. Pretty average.It was further out of town than we realised. No plug for the bath. Very hot room with their desk and answer machine in it.And they would only accept cash!
hotel_response:
Considering we have just won an award for best reviews I think this woman has a very negative attitude.
Both guests that stayed the same night awarded us a 10.
I went out of my way for this woman but she was still unhappy. You just can't please some people.

title: Poor customer service
text:
I stayed here for 6 days. People at reception were not helpful at all. To top it off, I left my glasses in my room and the bench and I called asking for them to get my glasses so I could come back and they didn’t want to help me or even check for my glasses!

I won’t be staying here again.

title: Dont waste your money!
text: Opened the door to smoke smell in room, curtins ripped, mold stains on the floor, kitchen cupboards not closing, fat dip from the range hood, bathroom door not closing due to swelling rotten door. Cracks in the shower wall taped up. Oven door handle broken, Stains on pillow cases lack of heating. This place is full of winz people with kids everywhere. You can hear up stairs walking and flushing the toilet. I travel alot and this is the worst rundown outdated motel ive been to. Dont waste your cash on this place! Long story short Checked out and found something worth paying for.

title: Homeless shelter
text:
I suggest that you give this motel a miss. I had the misfortune of spending a couple of nights here. This motel appears to have been taken over by Government  sponsored homeless people. Expect cars coming and going all night, loud and rude residents that keep you awake all night and poor house keeping. The room was quite well equiped but on using the kitchen we found dirty kitchen utensils and plates that were put away wet, needless to say, we had to wash all utensils and plates before use. I even had another guest wander into my room obviously under the infuence of an unknown substance.

I will not be returning to this establishment.

title: Business Combined With Pleasure
text: Our studio unit was clean, comfortable and spacious, but what I would term a "no frills motel." As we were out for a fair part of the time we were in Hamilton, this didn't matter. However, the office was closed most of the time, and if we needed anything we were advised to ring a mobile number ! We got around this extra expense by leaving notes for the staff who serviced the unit. Anything we needed was provided. We won't be staying here again, though, as we were advised upon checking out that the motel was no longer part of the Host Accommodation Chain which we prefer to patronise. I wasn't told this at the time of booking, but the owner did give us a discount of $5 per night, in good faith.

title: basic motel
text:
This motel is basic but was clean and tidy EXCEPT for the towels . They were old and worn . Motelier  was helpful and very obliging when we asked for directions and ice . 
It was booked for us on line by family . Not sure I would've booked it though.

title: Okay for a nights stay
text: We booked through internet and it seemed to be the last room available around town - at least 4 people were told they were full while we were outside. The room was fine except for a ceiling fan that wobbled around if not at full speed. There was a few caps from the shampoo etc left in the shower so cleaning people may be a bit careless. Otherwise it seemed to be clean enough. There was only one cereal plate although room was set up for at least three people. Motelier was very obliging and helpful - was apologetic about the plate and suggested it may have been due to a group staying that had several rooms and they tended to meet in different rooms where maybe plates were carried around. Still should have been sorted by cleaning staff and he was going to talk to them. Overall pretty average but okay for a night or two

title: Motelier was kind to allow such a late check-in but the room was bad
text:
We arrived at this motel not long before 11pm and the motelier was welcoming.  He explained the fan heater on the wall in our room was not working and he had put a radiant bar heater in our room for us.

Arriving at our room we were very disappointed, it was very tired, with threadbare carpet that rustled when we walked, like it had a layer of plastic underneath.  The heater was a tall bar heater, and it heated the room while we were in the living room, but we had to turn it off to go to bed.

Our daughter refused to sleep in the second bedroom, as it had no windows, just a skylight that had leakage problems judging by the strange brown streaks coming down the inside of it.

We spent an uncomfortable cold night in the firm beds and got up early to go down to the office and request a refund for our second night we had booked.

The motelier did not argue with us, he refunded our money for the second night with no problems.  I wouldn't recommend this motel, it is very unloved and in need of an overhaul, and it cost more than the motel we found for our second night - and that motel was beautiful!

title: Awful - tay awaay.  Read below for reasons.
text: The main motel has low cast persons staying, alcolhol, kids running arround.etc.  I think they are taking in homeless persons,  Then sent to Alpha.  No parking, expensive, no movie channels.  Awful  The curtains that thin that the outside lights shine into the room so you cannot sleep.  No sharp knifes, large spoons, masher etc in the kitchen.  No hot plates.

title: Ms

The inn is presently getting a face lift and looks like it will be quite nice proximity to the CBD is within walking distance as is the Rugby stadium. It is just a shame about the clientele

title: beds were comfortable staff were lovely :)
text: the cleaning staff were a beautiful bunch of amazing girls we stayed here for 4 nights and didn't feel anything less then apart of the community we traveled over from Brisbane Australia visiting Hamilton as our home town the whole family stayed with us during our stay we had four bedrooms upstairs and were using it as a family stay together with kids running but the staff were lovely about it :)

title: Noisiest Motel in Hamilton
text: Do not stay in this motel if you want to sleep. I had no sleep due to the noise of what appeared to be permanent residents at this property. Firecrackers going off outside my unit at 11pm,  tv's blaring all night, cars coming and going all night. People outside the units talking until 5am!  This was a Tuesday night. Also had a random drunk bang on my door for no reason. As a woman travelling on her own, it was very intimidating. I complained to the motelier, he did not seem to care. I moved to another motel and forfeit the second nights accommodation as he would not provide even a partial refund which I thought would have been fair. Rooms are outdated for the price charged.

title: Break away
text: Friendly owner good start to weekend . Room tidy and neat.good spa bath and kitchen facilities for family group. Handy to city and to Waikato stadium walking distance.will stay again when next here .good stopping place for travelers through hamilton

title: Nothing to Write Home About - Fair to Middling.
text: The place looked fine from the roadway but the room was just okay,basic, not a standout.To lift this place's rating the owners could spruise it up a bit,it just needed some tender loving care.Not dreadful but not outstanding.The road noise was a bit much to begin with, but did die down later in the evening.I wouldnt rush back here and there is a lot of competition in this part of town,so rooms are plentiful.The owner was polite and courteous.

title: Disrespectful rude racist thief
text: The room was cleaned but the ants walking through the kitchen up the walls tell me that the cleaning schedule is not worth the $180 we payed for the two bed room unit.the cobweb nest in the curtain and around the room look disgusting.The cracked light switches in the bathroom are very dangerous,never ever have I seen such poor maintenance in all my time traveling and staying in motels in my own country.This motel is a joke and not good for the Hamilton motel association or Waikato as a whole.
