This man has no right to be a manager or a custodian of Hamilton. We d

title: Mixed Thoughts on This Motel
text:
Stayed upstairs for one night and only paid $99, so quite good value/price for a motel on the strip in Hamilton.  Our unit was a bit dated and tired, but reasonably clean and tidy, certainly not spotless, as there was some mould stains in the bathrrom and on the wall panels.  Needs a bit of TLC and a tidy up to get things on track in regards to maintainance and cleaning, to be 100%.

Owner/Manager seemed OK, no problem there.  Units are mainly set back from the main road so road noise was not a real issue for the night.  Bed a bit hard for us. To get this motel to "very good" at this price, it just needs some TLC and a good deep clean, repair minor wall/chattels damages and replace broken items and tidy up generally.

title: Great service
text: Rooms are a bit dated, but owner was very helpful and it was very clean which is great.  one thing I really rated was the amount of shampoo, soaps etc in the bathrooms they really make sure you don't run out of products. 10 points for that. overall an enjoyable stay many thanks :)

title: Omg no he diddnt
text: Highly disappointed by this man. He is rasist an very disrespectful. If you have coloured skin dont stay here he will make you feel unwelcome. The room was very cold. Its summer and I needed an electric blanket. Nice rooms overall they were very big. Just disappointed with the service we recieved.

title: Great service but the room was tired.
text:
The host with the most. Very helpful and cheerful. The rooms were tired and in need of renovations. Quite a few light bulbs were out. For a family unit the kitchen needed a larger pot. 
Cold on arrival but once the heater was sorted we were ok.

title: Great room
text: Very nice guy, great room. Have stayed twice and will definitely again if in Hamilton. I am now filling in words - why do you have write at least 200 characters? Discourages me from writing good short review, I am not someone with nothing better to do (unlike some that simply look for fault so they can write about it)..

title: Helpful people but dirty unit
text:
My family recently stayed in the 3 bedroom unit.  It felt damp and cold when we checked in thankfully the heaters soon fixed that.  My biggest problem was that the unit wasn't clean enough.  Windows and sils were dirty and mouldy, the net curtains were mouldy.  The kitchen floor was sticky ie hadn't been washed for a while.  Inside cupboards were dirty, beadspreads felt unwashed.  One of my sons needed to sleep in the lounge, the fold out bed was horrible and dirty.  All the pillows were horrible.  Spare towels were thrown into the bathroom cupboard which was also dirty.  The shower door needed a good scrub.  I felt like buying a bottle of bleach and giving everything a good scrub!! 
 Needless to say we will not be staying at Sails again.

title: Very comfortable and friendly atmosphere
text: I was greeted by Ian who went the extra mile to accommodate myself and my children I was impressed by the lovely solar heated pool which is treated with salt treatment is not chlorine, i get headaches from chlorine.  Ian is a good family man who understands the needs of guests there was also another lovely lady who assisted us in site seeing ideas and brochures thanx chris.  the cleaners are even lovely and smily great place i reccommend this place and we will book next we are in hamiloton for certain.:)

title: Comfort Cleaniness and Cheer
text: The  host, Ian is cheerful and immediately comes across as friendly and happy to assist with any queries or requests. The motel is serviced immaculately the bedding and beds clean and comfortable and the environment is quite pleasant and peaceful.  I would recommend this motel to business people, families and travelers.  It is convenient to the supermarket and city the trees along side in the street make it quite a country comfort feel. 10 out of ten Ian your the host with the most.

title: Great place for team to stay
text: Finding a place for a sports team to stay can be difficult. Ian made the team welcome and was obliging and helpful. The rooms were clean and tidy and represented value for money. Ian was friendly and made the team and management welcome. The rooms are a generous size for meetings and dining as a group. Would definitely take the team back.

title: Relaxing while on business. Nice.
text:
A colleague and I went on a business trip to Hamilton and stayed two nights at Sails Motor Inn. We found the host very pleasant and really helped with all our venues we had to go to all over Hamilton.  Rooms were roomy and clean. Nice spa bath after along day. Had great cooked breakfast.
Most enjoyable stay.

title: Great place to unwind and a good finish to our holiday.
text: My son, partner and myself spent a night at the motel.  There was a swimming pool for us  to swim in, which on that particular day it had been 30 degrees. Our room was very clean and tidy, with all the extras including a full sized oven for cooking purposes. The motel was a reasonable rate, with management being very polite and helpful.  We found our unit very quiet considering it was next door to the main highway.  Even though it was hot, the ceiling fan made sleep bearable that night.  Also we were very impressed not to be charged a 3% credit card fee, unlike our other  motel we had stayed,  Cleveland Motel in Rotorua.

title: Motel needs updating and advertised facilities should be available
text:
We have just returned from a one night stay at Sails Motor Inn, Hamilton. We went to Hamilton to watch Super 14 rugby, Chiefs vs Hurricanes. It is the second time we have stayed in Hamilton, and the first time at this motel. We booked this motel as it was near to the stadium and it had a 3 bedroom unit. There were 3 adults and four children in our group so it was great we could all stay together. We payed $270 which is reasonable for our group. The motel advertised a heated outdoor pool and private spa pool. Sounded great for us all however when we arrived the pool was closed and the private spa was not working. This was a real shame as the kids were looking forward to going in the spa or pool. When we asked at reception about the spa the young receptionist did not seem to know why the spa was working or when it would be fixed. We went to our unit and it was quite spacious for 3 bedrooms. The carpets need replacing, they were frayed in the lounge and had two large black stains on it. The kitchen glassware were dirty and still had lipstick marks on some of the glasses. The crockery was old and chipped. There was an oven, which we did not use. The bathroom had a bath and shower cubicle and appeared dated. The towels were found under the sink ?
There was a large king sized bed in one room, which also had a T.V. The two other rooms had single beds. One of the bedrooms did not have electric blankets, which was disappointing as it was a cold night. One of the teenage girls slept on the sofa bed, which when we pulled it out still had sheets on from a previous occupant. The sheets were dirty and there were pubic hairs on the sheets. Obviously we did not use them and tried to contact reception unsuccessfully. We spoke to the owner the following morning who did not seem too bothered. Overall we would not use this motel again as there were plenty of others to choose from. Cleaning standards need to improve ad fascilities offered need to be available. Nevertheless we had a good time as tha Chiefs beat the Hurricanes.

title: Horrified by this experience - Racist And Rude!
text:
When my partner and I checked into the Motel around 5.00pm, we were greeted by a rather unhappy man, in barefeet, scruffy shorts and a dirty tee shirt. He was not particularly welcoming, but we ignored this, as my partner and I were not going this man spoil our holiday. When we made our way down to our room, we noticed that the door had been left open to let the room air. We quickly unloaded our belongings into the room, and then went out for the evening.

Upon returning to the Motel around 9.00pm, we went into our room, and noticed a very unpleasant smell in the room. We realised that as it was a very cold Hamilton evening, that once we turned the heater on, there would be little escape from this smell.

My partner tried to contact the office by telephone, but after 4 attempts, decided to walk down to reception, to see if there was another room available.

Speaking with the owner / manager person who had checked us in, this person rapidly got agitated and agressive saying that he had Indians in the room room the night before, and making very unkind, derogatory remarks about an entire race.

We explained that we would be unable to sleep in this room, and that we wanted another room. We were told rather agressively, that he did not like my race either, and if he had know what race I was over the telephone, he would not have take my reservation. He then came out from behind his counter, and tried to physically intimidate my partner. I actually thought this man was going to hit my partner.

At this point we told him that we were leaving, and I was relieved that he had not asked for my credit card details upon check in. As we walked away, he continued to shout racist and derogatory comments at us in front of other guests. This was a totally humiliating experience, which I hope no other person ever has to endure. 

I like to believe that as human beings, that we have evolved as a race, and that this primative dirty little man is not representative of Hamilton Moteliers in general. 

My only advice is that if you are not happy in what you are doing, that take a step towards making a change. We only have one life to live.

title: Nice Place to pause and recover.
text:
Very clean, looks like new, actually 10 years old. We had a room on second floor, kitchenette, equipped with everything, including cooking and eating utensils. However, for a modest fee, the innkeepers will cook and deliver an abundant cooked or European breakfast directly to your room. There are not views to speak of, no spa or pool, but as a stopover, it was just perfect. 

There is not a lot to do in Hamilton, but there is a lovely long walk by the river, idyllic and quiet. We used Hamilton as an easy stop between the Auckland airport and Rotorua, to shake out the cobwebs in our brain from a long 19 hours of travel time . If wine or food is your game, ask the manager for recommendations; he knows the area, the wines and vineyards, used to work as a chef, and can give extensive advice.

title: Don't go there
text: Got room with spa bath and couldn't use spa bath it keep spotting out brown yucky stuff 10pm thought it was to late to ring so when told them at reception thy said we should hve rang 10pm last night not willing to negotiate.

title: A nice motel
text: The Camelot is away from the downtown area so it was relatively quiet. The room was clean and had all the amenities. One thing I found was the king bed mattress was very soft!

title: Always a wonderful stay
text:
I’ve stayed at this hotel before, and every time, I leave happy and impressed. The staff here are absolutely lovely—so warm, welcoming, and genuinely thoughtful toward guests. They made our stay feel special from the start, answering all our questions with kindness and care.

We stayed here on New Year’s Eve and really enjoyed it. The room was very spacious, with an excellent little kitchenette that made it easy to prepare whatever we needed. The bathroom was also roomy, with a few nice amenities provided. The free parking right outside your room is a huge plus.

There was a noticeable cleaning smell upon arrival, but it wasn’t a dealbreaker.

The location is perfect, making everything so convenient. I’ll definitely be returning and strongly recommend too.

title: Caution - Has new owners.
text: Stayed here once before and it was wonderful. This time I wish I had booked somewhere else. Only reason given for the poor service was "we have only just taken over". Wont be going back. When you book with these guys double check that they are have all services that they are offering as we didn't and wasn't offered any type of a refund for the lack of services, Instead told that was the price and they were not changing it.

title: Lovely host! Beautiful place! Clean and stunning rooms
text: Lovely host who took us on last minute as a dissapointing previous motel we had to cancel. The rooms are beautifully clean, large wall mounted TV, sky, full stove pool and gym, we couldn't be happier we booked here and would honestly come back down regularly to support such a lovely place. A+++

title: Can't really complain
text:
From check in to check out everything was great. Friendly and jovial hosts make you feel really welcomed. Had a newbie check me in and he was a laugh! Had a ground level room and was totally adequate, really clean and tidy. Air con was awesome. Great TV. Shower pressure amazing. Beds were OK.....I am fussy thou. 
One little hint.... upgrade the instant coffee sachets to Brazilian....the Supreme blend is not as good quality and for an extra $10 a ctn it's totally worth it. Overall 9.5/10

title: Noisy - some rooms are tired.
text:
If you book here ask for the studios or rooms on the ground floor that are single story. The double story units are old tired and very noisy. 
The main entrance door after hours is slammed by other guests to close and wakes people up. 
The sky window- did not have a good curtain so right in your eyes first thing in the morning was a bright light. 
Pipes in the walls rattled and banged and made noises when other units were using taps. 
Tea coffee shampoo etc was not replaced and only enough for one person was supplied for three people. 
It was ok but did not live up to photos and was overpriced for what was once possibly a nice place. The units in the single story looked much nicer.

title: A really cold night!
text: Great vicinity, fantastic cleaning staff really helpful when we arrived. When we checked in no advise from management on how to work heat pump so had a freezing cold night in winter! Phoned from home to suggest they inform guests of how to use heat pump but lady manager really rude - would not stay again and we travel regularly to this region!

title: Modern, smart and spacious
text:
Three bedroom suite.  Beds and pillows are comfortable and rooms are nicely decorated.  Kitchen and lounge are spacious with comfortable, smart furniture.
Shower is powerful.  Good location - close to dairy.
Less good: Noisy at night from surrounding buildings.

title: This is an OK stay
text: Looking fir a place close for the rugby or a walk to northern Victoria St restaurants; then this place ticks the box. Everything is there. The rooms are not flash but they’re certainly adequate and ok for the money. We were in our own unit but other family members bunked in together in a larger unit and it was all acceptable. If you want flash; this isn’t it. But it’s an honest place to stay.

title: All about the money
text: I booked my accommodation and ok there was a problem with my credit card which was a bank issue so instead of contacting me they cancelled my booking and are holding out on bookings because they can get charge more $$$$$ because of a concert just got announcemented so much for customer service considering it was pay at the hotel on arrival l had prebooked a special weekend away and now it's ruined

title: A very tired motel
text: We started at the is motel the unit we had was very tired run down, mold and a hole in the bathroom skirting, Mark's etc on the walls of the unit  bed very old lumpy mattress, a hole and lots of marks on the kitchen bench, basically a very poor unit they have a 5 star rating not sure they get because it would only be a 3 star at best we had to wash the kitchen table and benches before we used them cleaning was very poor the owner offered us another room but it wasn't much better. We wont be using this motel again shocking

title: Lovely place to stay
text:
Girls weekend away and it was a lovely place to stay. Very clean and warm. Great amenities. Very quiet even though is was fully booked. Beds were extremely comfortable.
Lovely staff, very friendly :) Highly recommend

title: Family Trips to hamilton
text:
We stay at the camelot ALOT , we habe 2 young boys and a baby and they are ALWAYS so accommodating. We usually have late check in and they make it so easy. We would never stay anywhere else in hamilton.
Always so clean , like so so clean and units are such a generous size.

Your faithfully 
Jasmine & Mike
Taupo

title: Modern classical motel
text: A two night stay in this modern roomy motel. Very friendly welcome to this classical motel i.e. single story and parking outside the room.  Large apartment with lounge, dining area, desk area, seperate bedroom and bathroom with corner jacuzzi bath. TV with 3 Sky Sports channels plus Discovery.  Internet speed @ 25Mbps / 9.5 which was OK for emails, but struugled to support streaming. Large full kitchen area with cooker, microwave, toaster and kettle along with a fair selection of crockery and cutlery.  Small swimming pool (8 strokes end to end). Our only irritation was that with the motel being so empty, they insited on putting large numbers of workmen next to us, and as we were in the corner, these guys kept walking past and sitting outside our windows talking.  The same happned the second day when, what looked like a cricket team arrived.

title: Spacious motel units in a well presented complex
text: I stayed here a week ago in unit 16 & I received the warmest of welcomes from April, the lady on reception. My studio unit was spacious, clean, well equipped & I liked the good quality bed linen & towels.  It's handy to a supermarket, local dairy, petrol station, river walks & a short drive to the CBD. There's also a clean swimming pool with towels available.

title: Outstanding Customer Service
text: A little late submitting this, but have to give a shout out to this awesome little family run motel.  Have stayed here twice, and on both occasions found the staff friendly and helpful, the room spotlessly clean, comfortable and supplied with everything you need, tastefully decorated and worth paying extra to have a spa tub.  But on our second visit, for a work trip, they went out of their way to help us out when our car broke down, even allowing us to leave it in a spare space for a few days until we were able to organise a tow.  I definitely recommend this place and will definitely stay there every time I'm working in Hamilton.

title: Single night stay
text: Myself and my son stayed here. It was a really nice room. My son loved the pool. Very friendly staff. Very nice place to stay. Close to town and supermarkets. We would definitely stay here again when we in Hamilton.

title: Not clean, dated and falling apart
text: A real disappointment.  The photos online look clean and modern. The reality (at least for the 3 bed apartment, unit 14) is not good. I'm admittedly fussy about cleanliness but...a smeary table and sliding door, long hairs in the carpet, a fridge that clearly hadn't been cleaned since the last guests, scuff marks on the walls, cobwebs and dust in the skylight...and that was just what I could see. Called reception and they came to look but aside from giving us a replacement battery cover for the TV remote (which didn't work...) he didn't offer much except an apology. This place costs 220 NZD a night. I am 100 percent sure you can find better value elsewhere. Even Airbnb is likely to be better. Not good. Would actually appreciate a refund, it's that bad.

title: A comfortable place to stay
text:
The unit had a large bedroom with a table and chairs and three beds. The bathroom had a shower sink and toilet. There were free toiletries as well. The kitchenette was small but well appointed with a full size cooker, microwave and usual items found in a kitchen.
The unit is within walking distance of a Pack and Save and places to eat.

title: Friendly people good apartment
text: Very friendly and helpful staff. Spacious studio well furnished with a small but adequate kitchen. Very clean with a good bathroom. Close to Pak and Save and Countdown, also a couple of good bars, The Helm and Speights Ale House.Would recommend Camelot for a good value stay.

title: Refurbished to a point
text:
The location of the property was a little further from the centre than we'd hoped.  It took a good half hour to walk to and from a restaurant we'd booked there.
The welcome and staff here were excellent.  We stayed in a 3 bedroom apartment with parking right outside.  There was just one bathroom which could be restricting if there were 8 people staying.  (They say it accommodates 8). It was refurbished to a certain level but the stove was vintage and the blind in our room malfunctioned.  There was a cover over the shower which was covered in dust.  The wifi was extremely poor.  
I was thankful that our apartment was at the back because the traffic level was fairly high.
Would I stay again?  Probably not.

title: Comfortable
text:
Well equipped kitchen 
Spacious living room 
Good sized bathroom with nice toiletries 
Comfortable beds
Friendly, helpful receptionist 
Well placed for Seddon Park which we were visiting 
Plenty of parking
Recommended

title: Clean and comfortable
text:
Easy to find and restaurants close by
Friendly and quick check in
Room clean and spacious
Bed comfy
Shower hot enough but no pressure
No ice blocks in freezer for a drink but a lady brought some ice to us promptly, much appreciated
Wifi was terrible kept dropping in and out whole time

title: value for money
text:
A late arrival (>8.30 pm ish) and we were welcomed. The room was huge we had a double and and single and so much room. The bathroom and the room had all been renovated. 
We enjoyed the added extras such a hair net for the shower and, shampoo conditional body wash etc as we had forgotten ours. 
It was clean and tidy and we had tea, coffee making facilities and a good fridge.
Our beds were comfortable and it had good heating with a heat pump
Great location can walk to town. and not noisy considering on a main road.
Real value for money

title: Disappointed
text:
After reading all the positive reviews & Trip Adviser awards I was disappointed with our room. I think it was due for some maintenance & a good spring clean. A leg on one of the dining room chairs was broken, the shower head rail spun around sending water everywhere. The skirting boards & corners of vinyl floors were dirty. The window ledges & frames had mould & cobwebs around them, & the top of the range hood was fatty & had insects stuck to it. 
Overall the rest of the place was tidy. Unfortunately the TV stopped working on our last night. The hotel owner did his best to sort it out though. 
Owners were friendly & helpful. 
Just a little bit of maintenance & extra cleaning & this would be a lovely place.

title: A nice place friendly staff
text: This is a lovely place. I was greeted in such a kind friendly way, check in was completed quickly.   The room was spacious and light and the best thing about this motel was the mattress, it was really soft and one of the best I ever slept on.  Only two slight issues I had was in the bathroom (what was clean) there were a few marks on the walls. Secondly there were a few hairs in the bath tub. However these are very minor, and I loved my stay here and would stay here again!

title: Good place
text: We stayed late August and were pleased. Our room was on the second floor with steps leading there. The room was practical with kitchenette, microwave, comfy bed and good layout.   Everything worked, the room was spotless, parking fine, and overall good value.  We’d be pleased to stay again.

title: Great size room and dining area
text: Room was a great size and with everything that you need on hand . The location is easy to find again when you go out looking for restaurants and when back the room is set back away from road so nice and quiet. Lovely lady on reception was very helpful, friendly and informative - would defiantly stay there again

title: Comfy
text:
Clean, comfortable bed and pillows, heat pump, quiet as despite busy road, bedroom was set away from front, everything needed  for an overnight stay - good location and friendly polite friendly  staff on reception. 
Will definitely ask my company to book me here again when travelling for work.

title: Very clean and modern
text: Handy location on a main road but it certainly wasn't noisy. The room was tasteful and clean, although I found the bed a little hard. It would have benefited from an under-blanket. The reception was very welcoming and accommodating.

title: Nice but not as good as expected
text:
The room was nice but there was a slight musty smell that we tracked down to the mouldy curtains.
I have stayed here previously and found it comfortable, but the black lining on the curtains was offputting.

title: Very impressed
text: very impressed with this place. Clean well-appointed room and quiet, even though motel is on a busy street. Unit was warm and beds comfortable. Friendly reception. Pak n Save couple of blocks away. Would stay again!

title: Comfy bed
text: Nicely appointed motel room with the most comfortable bed I have ever slept on. It was like sleeping on a cloud! Full Kitchen and they give you a bottle of milk upon check in for your tea/coffee. Clean, modern and ample parking right in front of our room.  Laundry for guests right on site.

title: Short Stay
text: Very nice motel, all anyone needs for 1 night, we would stay again. Walking distance to PAC n Save supermarket. On route to Auckland. Very pleasant and helpful reception. Bed was very comfortable and all was presented very well.

title: Disappointing
text: We booked a 3 bedroom unit after reading all the positive reviews online, but our unit was dirty, with stains on the walls & carpets, stained crockery, a filthy looking dishcloth, & splashes of who knows what on the walls & skirting in the toilet. Grubby finger marks on the light switches plus a shower that smelt so strongly of mildew that we couldn’t even use it were the last straw for us. If we hadn’t have had to pay in advance when we arrived we would have found somewhere else to move to. When we mentioned the splatters of what looked like blood on the walls, the manager did ask his cleaning staff to clean this, but maybe they need to inspect their units between guests so that no one else has to put up with this. When we went to check out no one bothered to come to the desk, or to ask how our stay had been. I

title: Great value, clean, modern and spacious
text:
We stayed at the Camelot on Ulster for one night when we were in Hamilton to see the rugby.
Location was great for walking to the stadium and the room we had was perfect for our needs. It was spotlessly clean and lovely and modern and spacious - everything we needed!
Check in was a breeze and the owner friendly and helpful.
Would definitely stay here again and recommend to anyone.

title: Stay with Friends
text:
We stayed in a unit with 2 bedrooms,
My wife and I had a queen bedroom with an extremely comfortable bed,
Our friend had the second room which had a double and single bed, reported as very comfortable as well ,
Cooking facilities were available with a large fridge 
A whole family could stay here in comfort 
And Wifi was included 
We provided feedback on the room re batteries in the remotes which was accepted with smiles and Resolved directly

title: A great place to stay
text:
Well within walking distance to the local restaurants and supermarkets.
A very clean and well maintained motel.
There was no noise from the road or other guests.
The room (24) was very spacious and had an excellent kitchen area.
The bed was comfortable.
Well recommended

title: A very pleaant place to stay.
text:
My wife and I just spent a one night stay in this very good motel.
The lady at reception was really helpful and friendly ( a very valuable asset to the company ).the room was very clean and comfortable with all the things we could ask for.
 We will defiantly stay there the next time we are in Hamilton and highly recommend it to anyone requiring accommodation..

title: One night stay
text: We enjoyed our 1 night stay in an upstairs studio apartment with a small kitchen. Easy parking, 1 space for each room. Nice bedding and comfortable bed. Good value. Just one problem the towel rail was missing. Would stay again if in Hamilton.

title: Variety of rooms
text: Our upstairs room was fairly small, but that was ok because we were only staying one night. Based on other reviews, they must have a variety of room sizes. Our room had a small kitchenette and small bathroom. The room was clean, but the stairwell was tight when carrying suitcases.

title: Outstanding hotel
text: We had the pleasure staying for 2 nights. The location was great, as was the service the ammenities and comfort of the room. We would certainly book again. The saff were very helpful and allways on hand to help. Serviced daily and ver comfortable beds

title: Great family motel
text: We stayed here for one night with a family of 5 and the room we had was very spacious, clean and tidy. There was a big leather couch and comfy chair and plenty of space for the children to spread out. The large kitchen area was fabulous and the bathroom was nice and big. Beds were comfy, everything was very clean and tidy (small amounts of paint was coming off/chipped in a couple of places but didn't affect anything, usual wear and tear) and the staff at reception were so very friendly and helpful. Asked if the children would be swimming and went and got us nice big pool towels to use. We will definitely be staying here again, fabulous motel

title: Tastefully renovated
text: This tastefully renovated motel has spacious rooms and terrific blockout curtains. There is good bench space in the bathroom which is clean and bright. The bed was really comfortable and the air conditioning worked well. We had a room at the back and heard no traffic noise at all.

title: Very friendly staff
text:
Friendly staff who were very accommodating with any requests I needed. Comfortable and so central. Restaurants close by and supermarkets. 
Parking outside my room which was very convenient.
Quiet and peaceful with modern decor.
Very clean and we had a most enjoyable stay. Thank you and we will stay again

title: Very nice motel and reasonable price
text: I forgot to take pictures but this motel is very nice. The rooms and bathroom are large and there is a full kitchen with a 4 burner stove and oven; fridge; microwave; dishes and utensils. They also had a hair dryer available. Electric outlets were plenty and convenient. The bed was soft and comfortable-best nights sleep so far on our 3.5 week trip. Linens are nice too. The room is very clean and in a safe area. There is a car parking spot in front of each room. The rooms have some distance between them. Neighbors door not right next to your door. The interesting thing is the front door. For the front door there is a double glass slider with extra glass panels on each side. It takes up almost the entire width of the room. The glass is dark tinted and there is a curtain that can be pulled to cover the entire door and side panels. Staff was friendly and the room very clean. They also have a soda vending machine on site. I have yet to find a hotel in NZ that has an ice machine and this was the only one we’ve stayed at with a soda vending machine. There is a market near by. I really liked this place. When I shopped for this room I kept budget, comfort and safety in mind. This was a good choice in lodging

title: Comfortable and clean
text: My family and I stayed for two nights in a one bedroom motel room. The queen bed in the bedroom was comfortable and the two single beds were well placed in the large lounge/dining room. There was a tv in in the lounge and bedroom which was helpful with two children. The kitchen had everything needed and was spacious. As was the bathroom. The boys loved the pool. The location is great just a block away from a supermarket which was handy. I would be more than happy to stay there again.

title: Lovely motel
text:
This was a really nice motel and we had a lovely studio unit. Well appointed and very clean and a good laundry on site.
The wi-fi was a bit hit and miss, but there was a lot of young lads staying for a cricket competition, so may have had an affect?
Parking outside you room.
 We stayed for two nights after visiting Hobbiton on the way over from Rotorua.
Not a great choice of restuarants locally. The first night we went to a Speights bar which was quite close. On our full day in Hamilton we drove to the gardens - really nice and then walked into town from the motel in the afternoon. Approx 30 minutes walk, perhaps a downside of staying here depending on your fitness to walk. (Not an issue for us)

title: 3rd stop on our New Zealand holiday - 3 night stay
text: The outside was deceiving but the 1 bedroom apartment was lovely.  The down side was it was on the first floor.  Free WIFI and good, clean laundry facility.  The bedroom was hot with a fan and aircon located in the lounge.  Even a portable fan would be a good idea.  Staff were helpful and friendly.  Short drive to shopping centre, and a short walk to a supermarket and hotel.

title: Camelot  on ulster
text: Great staff. Free upgrade.  Recommended we go to Hamilton  gardens.  Wow. They were  amazing. The motel is big but the amenities  are great.  Probably  one of the best we have stayed at so it makes the whole time  here in Hamilton  more enjoyable.

title: Definitely worth it
text: The room was clean, staff were polite, near 2 supermarkets, but nothing much to do nearby, nearest fastfood is kfc and subway. I chose this place simply to visit waitomo caves and hobbiton and I would have to say it was quite comvenient. Even has a simple kitchenette to boil your own food. Shower was very strong and hot and that was amazing.

title: Clean, spacious place to stay in Hamilton
text: Planned to spend one night in Hamilton while travelling from Taupo to Auckland and after reading through some of the reviews here, decided on Camelot on Ulster.  Its located near the city centre and is definitely not difficult to spot.  Whilst we originally booked a 2 bedroom unit, we were lucky to have been upgraded to a 3-bedroom unit when we checked in.  And since we were a little early, our unit was still not ready.  However, the friendly staff on duty offered to keep some of the fruits and produce we had purchased in the office refrigerator while we went out to explore the city.  Spacious and clean, I would recommend this place for travelers keen to explore Hamilton!

title: Great service and location
text: Camelot is a well refurbished motel, very near, but not right in, the central Hamilton business area.  It is very close to a supermarket and is easily accessible by car.  The staff are friendly, helpful and always greet you with a smile.  We had a three day stay here and will definitely be back!
hotel_response:
Hi Dalyb39,

We are happy that you enjoyed your three day stay with us! Thank you for the kind comments regarding our helpfulness and friendliness - we really appreciate it. 

We look forward to hosting you next time you're in Hamilton!

Happy travels,

Michelle & Alexei
Camelot on Ulster

title: Great location
text: The staff were very welcoming and the room was spacious, well equipped and spotlessly clean. The hotel was really easy to find and parking was free outside the room. Would not hesitate to come back again.
hotel_response:
Hi robertmT4262LC,

Thank you very much for staying at Camelot on Ulster, and for reviewing your stay - we appreciate your comments on the cleanliness!

We are happy to hear that you enjoyed your stay with us, and look forward to seeing you next time you're in Hamilton. 

Thanks again,

Michelle & Alexei
Camelot on Ulster

title: Great Place to Stay
text: Have stayed here a few times.  Rooms are spacious, clean and tidy. Beds were really comfortable.  Kitchen had everything you needed.  Easy parking.  Great value and location.  Reception were helpful and check in was easy.  Recommend to others looking for somewhere to stay in Hamilton.
hotel_response:
Dear Maude T,

As always, great to have you stay - thanks for choosing Camelot on Ulster again, and thank you for submitting such a great review. We really appreciate it!

We're lucky to have a lot of space for parking. Every room has it's own carpark right outside, plus we have a few spares as well. Definitely makes things easier!

Thanks again, and we look forward to seeing you next time you're in Hamilton.

Michelle & Alexei
Camelot on Ulster

title: Great value
text: Great value and location. Good sized rooms for family with friendly staff. Easy parking access. Clean rooms and maintained daily. Only negative the kettle hadn't been cleaned for a while! Was great for our family of 4.
hotel_response:
Hi Boris m,

Thank you for such a generous review. We really appreciate your kind comments regarding the staff!

Sorry to hear about the kettle - over time they do get a little worn out, but we always have a few at the ready to replace the old ones. Thanks for letting us know!

We're glad that you enjoyed your stay with us, and we hope to see you some other time.

Kind regards,

Michelle & Alexei
Camelot on Ulster

title: Hamilton stay
text:
This is a really nice motel. We had an upstairs studio it had plenty of room for the 2 of us. The bed was super comfortable. Everything was close by to get groceries or dinner.
The people in reception were very helpful.
hotel_response:
Hi PerthMumof2,

Thank you for a perfect review score, and for your kind comments - we're glad that you enjoyed a comfortable stay with us. The beds (which are made locally) always get a lot of positive feedback!

Thank you complimenting the reception staff, we truly appreciate it!

Happy travels,

Michelle & Alexei
Camelot on Ulster

title: Spacious and Clean
text: We spent one night here-the room was spacious and nicely furnished, the kitchen well equipped. The big bed was super comfy and I loved the choice of pillows. Heating was excellent. The motel is close to the town centre but rooms are off the road so very quiet. I highly recommend a stay here if you are in Hamilton.
hotel_response:
Hi justjans,

Thank you for such a great review - we really appreciate your positive feedback!

We are located very close to the city centre, on a fairly busy road between town and The Base at Te Rapa, but as you pointed out the rooms are set back from the road, so noise isn't an issue. The double-glazed windows on the rooms help as well. We're glad that you had a comfortable stay with us!

Heating/Air Conditioning is always an important factor for me when booking motels, so it's good to hear you were happy with ours!

Thanks for highly recommending us, and we hope to see you some other time.

Michelle & Alexei
Camelot on Ulster

title: Comfortable nights stay
text: Lovely motel, beautiful and clean, nice comfortable beds, rooms were nice and warm, friendly hosts, good parking, great showers, plenty of water pressure, situated between city centre and the Base shopping
hotel_response:
Hi dimarshall63,

Thank you very much for such a generous review - it is highly appreciated, thank you for making us feel good about the work we are doing here at Camelot on Ulster. We're glad that you enjoyed your stay, and found the rooms to be clean and comfortable. Also - a decent shower and good water pressure is always a must! Haha

Thanks again and happy travels,

Michelle & Alexei
Camelot on Ulster

title: Fantastic family accommodation!
text: Excellent accommodation for families. We had a 3 bedroom unit, comfortable beds, lots of living space, clean and air conditioning!!!  Kids loved the pool as well. Staff are friendly and helpful.  Very central to city centre and a supermarket was only a block away.  Would highly recommend!
hotel_response:
Dear mumofx3sons,

Thank you for your fantastic review!

We're glad that you enjoyed your stay - and the air conditioning! Definitely a must for us when we go travelling as well. The pool is great, but not heated, so you'd have to be mad (or kids) to want to get in it at this time of year!

We are very close to the city centre and a couple of supermarkets, so we're happy to hear you took full advantage of this. We also really appreciate your feedback on the helpfulness and friendliness of the staff. Thank you!

We look forward to seeing you again,

Michelle & Alexei
Camelot on Ulster

title: Loved it
text: very nice and clean, very friendly staff, and a pleasure to stay at, your home away from home.    Units are set back from the main road which adds more "comfort and peace to one's stay.  It's situated conveniently around local amenities and not far from the city.
hotel_response:
Dear phlatohi,

Thank you for taking the time to write a review - we really appreciate it! It is really nice to read that it was a "pleasure" to stay with us at Camelot on Ulster!

Because we are between the city centre and the Base shopping centre, Ulster Street can get busy at certain times of the day. As you say, it's nice that our units are set back from the main road so that we don't have traffic noise to contend with. Double glazing on our windows also helps!

Thank you for your kind comments regarding the cleanliness and the friendliness of the staff!

Happy travels,

Michelle & Alexei

title: Not for me
text: The ground floor room had glass sliding doors which gave me a feeling of insecurity to say the least. I opened a cupboard in the kitchenette and a smell came out. The kettle had funny dots on the glass lid. And the oven mitt was very frayed and very old, like it should have been replaced decades ago. Overall the kitchenette did not feel clean, and the bathroom, although it was clean, seemed dated. I did not feel safe or comfortable in this establishment and I actually booked another hotel and left after 2 hours. No refund was offered.
hotel_response:
Hi Helena,

Thank you for submitting your second review on the 2-hour stay you had almost a month ago. It is deflating to constantly work so hard at something, only to read a review like yours, based on your personal concerns and worries about something that "might" happen during your stay. I guess it should be expected of someone who's email address is "customerservicereviews", and who is a self-proclaimed "fussy traveller" (as I read in one of your other reviews), someone who carefully inspects every aspect of the room looking for things to pick at, including the oven mitt which they had no intention of using. 

I don't know why the glass sliding door gave you a feeling of insecurity - every single one has a lock on the handle as well as a deadbolt at the top of the door. Your room was set well off from the road, managers live onsite available 24 hours if needed, and we have 8 security cameras set up around the complex. We have never had any issue with one of the sliding doors. 

To correct you, the information in the compendium states:
"If a neighbouring property is making an unreasonable amount of noise, please let us know immediately so that we can contact them and resolve the issue. You can also contact noise control, which is recommended as they tend to act more quickly with multiple complaints". It then goes on to say that we are not a party motel, and if there is disruption within the establishment to call us from the phone in your room so that we can stop it. Aside from that, the windows and the sliding door that you didn't like are all fitted with double-glazed "hush glass", preventing most day-to-day noises from creeping in. 

Thank you for acknowledging that the bathroom was clean, although dated in your opinion. We are continually updating and renovating our rooms, but I think it is important to keep in mind that we are not a large, chain-style hotel with hundreds of employees, but a family-owned motel, so completely remodelling 40 rooms at once is unfortunately not a viable option. We are proud of the amount of work we do put into maintaining our units, as the comfort of our guests is paramount to us. 

I'm not too sure what the smell in the cupboard was that you released when you opened it, but that definitely sounds like the premise of an episode of Scooby Doo Mysteries.

No refund was offered to you as it took you over 4 hours (you said you were here for 2, but you arrived at 1:49pm and left at 5pm) to decide that you didn't like sliding doors, by which time our house-keeping team had left for the day, meaning that we couldn't resell the room. You also didn't ask for a refund, or mention any of your other grievances to us when you left, so we were baffled more than anything.

While it is disappointing to get a 1-star review, I find solace in knowing that you have handed out more 1-star reviews than we've ever received. 

Kind regards,

Michelle & Alexei

title: Motel experience review
text:
Very poor communication 
I booked through expedia-i selected the pay later option (as in pay on arrival) I was then messaged from the hotel directly to say they cancelled my room as there was not enough funds in my card-that's because I did not authorise my card to be used,so I contacted the hotel to say I would pay directly on arrival.
I arrived after a days work to have no room booked, after going through the whole process of trying to fit me in,I was rudely asked will this card work as it didn't two days ago! I am a direct paying customer and willing to pay to be asked this.
Rooms ok well spaced a little older and smell a little foosty-a little airing whilst being cleaned could not go a miss, I will stick to my regular motel/hotel for my work trips where I am made to feel like a welcome guest,
And certainly not somewhere who try s to put a charge or hold on my card with no authorisation.
hotel_response:
Hi Kirsty,

A 2-star review is disappointing (and well below our average of 4.5), but nevertheless we thank you for taking the time to submit your feedback. I would also like to take the opportunity to explain why we (motels/hotels in general) request valid credit cards with available funds during the booking process.

When you book through Expedia, it states that your credit card details will be taken to guarantee the room. Once we have those details, we validate the card to make sure that the number is legitimate, and that there are funds available on the card, to the value of your booking. This is for two reasons:

1): If you do not turn up for your reservation, we can charge you for holding your room. We have a 48-hour cancelation policy. Waiting up all night for someone to show up and turning down other potential guests searching for somewhere to stay aside, if we do not have a valid card to charge, it also means lost revenue for the motel, resulting in reviews that say "Rooms ok, a little older" because we have less money to put back into upgrades and renovations.

2): The credit card number serves as security for the room, in the same way a bond does. If any damage or theft was to occur, we can charge the card. 

Expedia always sends an email to inform you that your reservation has been cancelled, and it cites that the most common reason is "due to your method of payment". It asks that you "please try booking the hotel again with a different form of payment".

I understand that your booking was genuine, but the credit card policies set up by booking websites are to protect motels/hotels from bogus reservations. If you are a "direct paying customer" then we encourage you to book with us directly as well. 

Thanks Kirsty, I hope that made the card authorisation procedure clearer!

Kind regards,

Michelle & Alexei
Camelot on Ulster

title: Excellent - exceeded expectations
text:
Ok anyone who knows me, knows I'm not a 'motel' girl ... memories of childhood 'treat'  weekends away in small cold concrete motel room, sharing 'family' room bunk beds, musty bedcovers, tiny bathrooms ... but then they had swimming pools - and that was a novelty in the 60's for any kid. 

So a weekend in Hamilton (actually two) returning next weekend to complete a 'Boatmasters' course - I was blown away how busy Hamilton gets at weekends. The one and only branded hotel, well Novotel - not normally a brand I'd choose was booked out ... so I poured Booking.com listings for rooms that were available. 

And I have to say, I lucked in. Camelot on Ulster boasted a 9.5 (or 9.2 can't quite remember but it was impressive)  score on Booking.com - (can't be bad I thought?) and from the moment I called to book my two weekends away in  'The Tron' it was a very pleasant experience. Very friendly helpful reservations made, efficient check in on arrival(and it was busy check in time) handled professionally and with humour. (Also note, a problem getting my card through wasn't a drama, just a pleasant email the following morning to say they'd processed it manually). The motel room itself was very much newly refurbished, and not just soft furnishings were new - everything new - new kitchen, bathroom, new bed (really comfortable) - NO musty smell - good heating and so absolutely quiet. Complimentary decent size milk, quality teas and paper in the morning - Novotel take note! 

A great night out for dinner with friends at Hamiltons 'Palate' restaurant (yip they were darn friendly too and a lovely meal of Raglan beef)...and best of all 50% down on our course and just another 50% to go! 

Thanks Camelot on Ulster, see you next weekend :-)
hotel_response:
Dearest Karine,

Thank you so much for your positive review! We're glad that you had a comfortable stay with us - thanks in part to our beds, which are made right here in the Waikato! 

There are still some small cold concrete motels out there, but as you pointed out, we've refurbished the kitchens and replaced the bathrooms here at Camelot. The owners are constantly updating and improving the rooms to ensure that our guests enjoy a pleasant stay with us.

It was a pleasure having you here Karine, and if we could review our guests we'd give you 5 stars as well! Hope all went well with the Boatmaster's course, and we'll see you again soon!

Thanks again,

Alexei & Michelle

Using roaming data when travelling overseas is not an option and we rely on this with accommodation which is often provided now by many cafes and publicly in smaller towns.

title: Great value! Spacious and clean!
text:
I was very happy with this motel! The rooms were a good size, the place was very clean and the kitchen was well stocked with kitchen utensils, cooking implements and crockery. I only stayed for one night, but it was a great stop.

Beds were comfy and there were plenty of them (2 Queens and 3 singles)! I had booked a one bedroom apartment, but on arrival they gave us a free upgrade to a two bedroom apartment which was great! Especially as I was traveling with my parents and had only booked a one bedroom to save money thinking 'Oh well I'll just sleep in the lounge room. I can deal with that'.

The whole place was spacious and there were only a few minor complaints: My parents in the other room were woken by all the cars being started outside their bedroom, but in my bedroom I slept like a log
The toilet, although it looked separate from the bathroom, was actually still inside the bathroom, it was just more private
And one of the glasses I took out of the cupboard wasn't clean.

The internet was of a great quality and there were no issues connecting. Parking was right outside the door and the guy on reception was very helpful.
Very happy overall! I would definitely stay here again.
hotel_response:
Dear Samantha,

Thank you for taking the time to tell others about your recent stay with us by positing such a thorough review and rating us 5 stars!. We are pleased to hear that you and your parents enjoyed staying with us and were grateful for the free upgrade. Great news that you didn't have any problems with our WiFi service and found Mark to be very helpful in reception.

We hope you enjoyed the rest of your travels in New Zealand.

Warm Regards,
Mark & Alix
Camelot on Ulster Hosts

title: The greatest people you will ever meet.
text:

The customer service was wonderful, they sent us a DVD player and even helped us set it up when we mentioned that we had brought some DVDs along. The rooms were spotless, clean, and spacious. But that's not what blew me away.

After leaving Hamilton and heading back to Singapore, it became evident that I had left my DSLR's prime lens back in the motel room. I was understandably panicked - these things are expensive, ridiculously so. I called the staff there and spoke to someone called Cindy, and she couldn't have been nicer about it. She completely reassured me, and even offered to send it back to Singapore for me, which was unnecessary actually since I had a relative staying in Auckland. The lens was couriered to my Auckland address the next working day, and she refused to hear anything about payment for the courier or for her trouble. It was truly the best way to usher in the new year, knowing both that my lens wasn't lost to me forever and that there still are honest people in this world. :')

Thank you Cindy and the Camelot on Ulster management! You guys are the greatest.

However, the design of the bathroom, taps at the sink and the shower head were a little dated. We were also not very impressed with the separate toilet with no sink.
hotel_response:
Dear GeokEng,

Thank you so much for posting a review about our property. We appreciate all of the feedback our guests offer us. 

We are glad to hear that you found the new beds comfy and appreciated the FREE WiFi that we make available to all guests. Thank you for commenting on the greeting you received when you arrived to check in. No matter what time of day we always strive to greet our guests in a warm and friendly manner.

We appreciate the feedback you have given us on the bathroom. You will be happy to know that we are in the process of renovating the kitchens and bathrooms in all of our rooms. The suggestion about the sink in the separate toilet is very much appreciated and is something we will consider when we get to renovating that bathroom.

Once again thank you for your feedback. We hope to see you again in the future.

Kind Regards,
Mark & Alix

title: Regularly returning
text:
I stay at Camelot on Ulster 2 or 3 nights a week when working in Hamilton. 
The rooms are quiet, comfortable and clean, I always have a great nights sleep due to comfy beds and the linen is lovely. 
There is always a friendly and familiar face at reception. 
It's only a couple of minutes drive to work in the CBD and a short walk to supermarkets and places to eat.
hotel_response:
Hi Kirsty,

Thank you so very much for posting such a raving review about our property. We appreciate all of the lovely comments you have given us.

We enjoy having you stay with us each week and are thrilled that you keep returning.

We hope you are enjoying your holiday in Germany and look forward to seeing you again when you return.

Kind Regards,
Mark & Alix

title: Great location, great facilities
text: This was the perfect place to stay with comfy beds, good facilities, free wifi and great location.  It was very quiet despite being near a busy main road.  I would definitely recommend travellers to stay here.
hotel_response:
Hi Kristene,

Thanks for posting a review following your stay with us. We appreciate all the feedback our guests offer us as we strive to make every guests experience with us a positive and memorable one.

It is very pleasing to hear that you found our new beds comfy (obviously a good investment!) and you enjoyed the facilities, including the FREE WiFi that we offer. We advertise our rooms as being quiet despite being on a busy road so we are glad to hear that your stay was exactly that - quiet.

Once again thank you very much for this review you have written about us. 

We hope to see you again in the future.

Kind Regards,
Mark & Alix

title: Great location with modern decor
text: The proprietor's were very friendly, we arrived a little late in the evening, but it was not an issue for them.  We also required extra parking as we had a fairly large trailer with us, this again was no problem at all.  The rooms were lovely and clean, the decor quite modern with lovely fresh colour accents complimenting natural tones.  Bed was comfortable and there was no street noise, as it is situated on a very busy road.  We had a lovely cooked breakfast which was well priced.
hotel_response:
Hi Nat,

Thank you so much for telling others about your experience with us by writing a positive review.

We are glad to hear that you enjoyed your stay with us were pleased with our decor. We know we are not the newest motel in town but are continually renovating to improve our rooms and surrounding facilities. We are currently in the process of installing new kitchens in all the rooms, upgrading the bathrooms and repainting all the interiors. Hopefully if you return to stay with us next time you are in Hamilton you will notice some of these changes.

Great to know that you were impressed with our friendly service, ample off-street parking, central location and room-service breakfast.

We hope to see you again in the future. Once again thank you for your review. We really appreciate it when our guests take a few minutes of their time to let others about their experience with us.

Kind Regards,
Mark & Alix

title: Comfortable
text: Loved staying at Camelot, but the bed was too soft. Apart from that was lovely :) Our cooked breakfast was delicious and was a great start to the day. Great customer service they were very helpful :) overall experience was to satisfaction and would book and stay again if needed. The online booking was fast and so easy also :)
hotel_response:
Hi there,

Thank you for the great review you have written about our property.

We are glad to hear that you enjoyed your overall experience with us and it was a positive one. We apologise about your finding the bed too soft. It is very hard to have beds that suit everyone. We do get a lot of very great comments about how much our guests love our beds. If you do stay with us again though let us know that you prefer a firmer bed and we can accommodate this. Our new pocket spring beds have one side which is firmer than the other so we can flip the mattress for you.

Great to hear that you also enjoyed our cooked breakfast and that the booking process through our website was simple and fast.

We hope to see you again in the future.

Kind Regards,
Mark & Alix

title: overnight
text:
A great motel loved our stay the bed was so cosy. Enjoyed the spa bath and the kitchen well equipped.
Good location, we found it very quiet.Short walk to town and the supermarket.Heat pump a good idea.
hotel_response:
Hi there,

Thanks so much for writing us such a positive review.

We are thrilled to hear that you loved your bed and had a great sleep! We get such great feedback about the new pocket spring beds we have put in the rooms that we feel they were well worth the little extra expense. 

Great to hear to that you enjoyed your in-room spa bath, our central location to the city and the quietness of our rooms which are away from the busy Ulster Street. We too feel that installing the heat-pump / air-con units last year are a great asset for our rooms.

We hope to see you again in the future.

Kind Regards,
Mark & Alix

title: Awesome!
text:
Great place to stay, 
we have stayed here a few times and we never leave dissapointed.
the staff are friendly and the room is clean and perfect, and FREE FAST internet!!!!!!
close to town and not too far from the base which is a great shopping complex with an awesome cinema!!
hotel_response:
Hi there,

Thanks you for writing us a fantastic review! We are glad that you enjoy staying at our motel and return time and time again when you visit Hamilton.

Great to know that you find our complimentary WiFi service fast. We know how annoying it can be when internet connections are slow!

As you may have noticed in the recent times you have stayed with us we a slowly working through numerous renovations. Hopefully the next time you come you will notice something more we have done to improve your room.

Look forward to seeing you again.

Kind Regards,
Mark & Alix

title: Fancy front shabby back
text: All ok. We had a discounted room. Clean and warm but old and tired. Eg Remote control broken bits, peeling paint on windowsills, very old school shower. The front of motel looked modern and nice but our unit didn't match this. Still it wasn't expensive or noisy
hotel_response:
Hi there,

Thank you for your review.

We are disappointed to hear that you did not enjoy your stay with us as we strive to make every guest's experience with us a positive one.

We realise that we are an older motel however are currently in the process of carrying out numerous renovations to improve the standard of our rooms and facilities. At present we are replacing all of the kitchens and modernising the bathrooms. We have also nearly replaced all of the beds in the rooms. And the painter is slowly making his way around painting all of the interiors.

Unfortunately these renovations take time when you have 40 rooms to do. We apologise that you did not get to be in one of the rooms which have already been renovated.

If you choose to return to us in the future hopefully you will notice all of the renovations which will have taken place and enjoy your stay.

We do appreciate the feedback and will take on board your comments as we strive to be the best we can be.

Kind Regards,
Alix & Mark

title: Great value for money.
text: Awesome friendly service, motel was easy to find and drive into. Very spacious rooms, (3 bdrm apartment) especially with 7 adults. Nice and clean rooms which were well stocked.   Will definitely stay here again when in Hamilton. Thank you very much.
hotel_response:
Hi there,

Thanks so much for your great review.

We are glad that you enjoyed your stay with us and look forward to seeing you again in the future!

No doubt when you do return you will notice changes to the rooms as we currently in the process of replacing all the kitchens, modernising the bathrooms and repainting all the interiors. We wish everything could be done yesterday but unfortunately when you have 40 rooms these things take time.

If you have any suggestions which you believe would enhance our motel we would be more than happy to hear from you.

Kind Regards,
Alix & Mark

title: A Night at the Rugby
text: The hotel room was clean and comfortable. The staff were very friendly and extremely helpful. Perfect  location for the Waikato stadium, with plenty of choices of places to eat nearby. Definitely worth booking for future trips into Hamilton.
hotel_response:
Hi there,

We are glad you enjoyed your stay with us and would love to see you again in the future! Hopefully if we do see you again you will enjoy your stay even more as we are currently in the process of replacing all out kitchens, modernising all the bathrooms and repainting the interiors. We wish all these renovations could be done yesterday but unfortunately good things take time.

If you have any suggestions which you believe would improve our motel we would love to hear from you.

Enjoy the rest of the rugby season.

Kind Regards,
Alix & Mark

title: Nice and comfortable
text: Nice cosy rooms, very friendly and helpful staff. Great location right down the road from PaknSave and also a golf course with minigolf/driving range. Very impressed with the quality of the gym there, despite costing $10 per visit to use it.
hotel_response:
Hi there,

We are glad that you enjoyed your stay with us and hope to see you again in the future.

Both Mark and I are qualified in Sport & Exercise Science so the gym is our little hobbie which we run alongside the motel. If you have any suggestions which you believe would improve our motel for you in the future or other future guests we would be more than happy to hear from you.

Hope to see you again soon!

Kind Regards,
Alix & Mark

title: Happy stay
text: my boyfriend and I really enjoyed our stay here and we would stay again, our heater wasn't strong enough to heat  the room though and couldn't connect the ps3 to the free Wi-Fi? But overall we enjoyed our stay
hotel_response:
Hi there,

title: Great experience
text:
Stayed here en-route to Auckland and also to watch All Blacks take on England. We opted for the deluxe room with spa. The bed was unbelievably comfy and the facilities are just as advertised. The staff in reception (Husband & wife Managers I think) were friendly, really helpful and gave clear indications regarding places to eat and shop. 
We would thoroughly recommend this hotel and will certainly stay when we are next in New Zealand in 2017.

Kind Regards,
Alix & Mark

title: Only average
text:
Stayed one night so we could go to,field days at mystery creek, accom usually hard to get at HAmilton.  Paid $140 which is expensive for what we got. 
Room dated, bed a shocker, you roll into the middle. Shower the drain plug moves around and mould on the roof area in bathroom.  Bathroom very small. On the plus side reception staff very helpful.  Our allocated car park was taken by some moron who took two car parks so we had to pinch somebody's else's as parking was at a premium.  It always surprises us how much these old motels charge when their units needs updating.  We think the price should have been around the $100'mark per night.
hotel_response:
Hi Pauline,

Thank you for the review that you have posted. We appreciate the feedback we receive from all our guests and take it on board as we strive the be the best we can be.
