We have already replaced 60% of the beds in the motel with brand new ones and the upstairs ones have been ordered so hopefully they are not too far away. Mark has also replaced the shower drains in the upstairs showers to ensure future guests do not have the same problem. We are currently installing all new high gloss white kitchens with stone bench tops as well as modernising the bathrooms. We have a painter who is slowly making his way around repainting all of the interiors and just this morning we have signed up to get a moisture master  ventilation system installed throughout the entire motel. We also have air cons in all our ground floor units and the contractor has been booked in to install the last five in our upstairs units.

As you can see lots of renovations are taking place at the motel so we hope if you do choose to stay with us in the future you will notice these changes and appreciate the huge effort we are making to improve our facilities for our guests.

If you have any suggestions which you think could further improve our motel your either yourself or other guests in the future we would be more than happy to hear from you.

Kind Regards,
Alix & Mark

title: An unfortunate stay but still recommended
text:
I was looking for a room with a spa bath as I had been driving for long distances up and down the North Island twice in a week and needed a spa to sooth aching bones. I negotiated a good deal at Camelot and moved into the room. Unpacked and started to run the bath and the water was a dirty brown rusty colour and not a light colouring but more heavy metal. I called the manager and he came and took a look and upgraded me to a large unit with a full sized spa bath across the courtyard.Again I unpacked and got settled and this time filled the bath and was pleased it was crystal clear water. When it was ready I prepared to step in and turned the switch on for the spa and all I got was a "clunk" as if it was jamming. Not wanting to move again I decided I was not meant to have a spa that night so settled for a soak in the tub minus the bubbles. The next morning I informed the manager who was most apologetic. The lady in reception offered me a freshly baked scone which I turned down due to having just had breakfast.

This is a well presented property with polite staff and clean units and I really think I was just unfortunate to have struck two units with problems. I dont think that reflects the overall standard which is pretty good.

The kitchen was very well appointed in both units. The bed was very comfortable and the place is not at all noisy even though it is located on a busy road.

Well recommended but check the spa bath works first.
hotel_response:
Hi Mike,

Thank you for your review you have posted for us. We appreciate all the feedback we receive from our guests as we are always striving to be the best we can be.

We want to sincerely apologise out the two issues you had in two different rooms while staying with us. The discolouration of the water disappeared the following day and when we talked to the plumber about it he couldn't give us a clear answer on what may have caused the problem.

The room you were moved to had only recently been resurfaced and the sticker which informs guests how to operate the spa bath was removed. We have since had more of these stickers made so future guests are not faced with the same problem you had. Mark informed me the morning of the day you checked out that the spa bath in the room you had been in was broken. I was quite surprised at this so went and filled it up myself to check. Once the water was over the jets, I flicked the switch my the door and pushed the white button on the bath to turn the jets on and everything worked perfectly. Following this Mark got a good old lesson on how to operate to the spa baths so if future guests aren't sure on what to do he can advise them. 

We are pleased to hear that you enjoyed your sleep. We have recently replaced the beds and get great feedback about how comfy they are along with the great quality of the bed linen and pillows.

If you have any suggestions which you believe would improve our rooms and facilities we would be more than happy to hear from you.

We hope to see you again is the future.

Kind Regards,
Alix & Mark

title: Best stay in Hamilton
text:
I would highly recommend Camelot on Ulster to everyone who travels to Hamilton. 

Service, facilities and your staff were really friendly and the rooms were to a high standard.

This place is defiantely family friendly and is so peaceful and quiet, it's a true gem!

title: Outstanding motel
text:
I stayed at the Camelot Motel in Hamilton for 6 weeks in Feb and March 2014. Having stayed near Hamilton Lake on previous visits, I was keen to see what it was like staying at the other end of town. I certainly wasn't disappointed!

Alix and Mark did me an amazing deal due to the length of my stay and it made my 6 weeks very affordable. I was out and about pretty much all day every day so it was nice to come back to a spotlessly clean room with a very comfortable bed, great kitchen facilities and the kind of spacious spa bath that I found hard to leave. The TV had all the main NZ channels as well as several Sky Sport channels which was great and the wifi internet was quick, reliable and free! My room was probably the closest of all the rooms to the main road but with the double glazing I was barely aware of any traffic noise and slept really well as a result.

Camelot has an excellent location on Ulster Street. There's a Pak'nSave nearby plus a Countdown just a bit further away. It's spot on for anyone wanting to watch the Chiefs play Super Rugby at Waikato Stadium (like me!) which is literally three minutes walk away. Camelot is also near a bus stop for the free shuttle bus that comes by every 10 mins so anyone who doesn't want to walk into Hamilton centre doesn't have to. The shuttle stops at the Transport Centre so anyone staying in Hamilton can easily use Camelot as a base to explore the wider region.

Alix and Mark are superb friendly hosts. They leave you alone to get on with your holiday but I always felt like they were available anytime should I have had any problems. There are many motels to choose from on Ulster Street but as far as I'm concerned the others would have to be extraordinary to match up to Camelot's comfort, atmosphere and value. I really didn't want to give my key back on my last morning and it felt like I was moving out of my home! Next time I'm in Hamilton there's only one place I'll be staying and that's Camelot.

Cheers Alix and Mark!

Adam P, UK

title: A good find
text:
The motels and serviced apartments that we had chosen to stay in were fully booked. We drove around Hamilton and came upon Camelot on Ulster. We were made welcome by Alex, who along with her husband Mark are the owners of this business. We opened our room and were pleasantly surprised. Our room was large,very clean and well appointed. The kitchen area was adequately stocked. Our bed was very comfortable,we also had good pillows. The overhead fan was a bonus, even though we had an air conditioner , we preferred to use the fan as we slept. Alex and Mark are a young couple who are not afraid of hard work . 
Camelot motel is quiet with the units well back from he road. I would certainly stay again when in Hamilton.

title: Excellent place
text: From the moment we arrived to book in the service was outstanding.  Spic and span rooms.  Having the fan in the room was fantastic as it was a very hot day in Hamilton.  Bed very comfy and no street noise even though the complex is very close to the main road in Hamilton.

title: Would stay again
text:
There were 5 of us booked into the three bedroom accommodation. I've rated it 'Very Good' because I would stay there again, but it's funny place with lots of contradictions. 
The rooms were reasonably clean but I found a beer bottle top in a kitchen cupboard and something sticky had been split down the wall in our bedroom so I felt that there wasn't much attention to detail. The extremely comfortable beds had beautiful crisp white sheets but a stained and grubby bedspread. The motel advertise air con but our room didn't have it which was annoying as it was so warm while we were there. On the plus side it's lovely and quiet so we slept with the windows open. We had to ask for a bedside light as none of the rooms had suitable lighting for reading, the management were quick to respond to our request.  The welcome wasn't all that warm, I wasn't asked if I'd been to Hamilton before, needed any tourist info etc etc but the ladies that serviced the rooms were lovely and helpful. I would have liked to give some feedback while we were there but there wasn't the opportunity - no comment forms and we weren't asked about our stay when we checked out. Other pluses include that the pool was very pleasant and I liked the way our room was decorated and furnished. The kitchen was well equipped and had everything you would need to cook a meal.

title: Spacious for 5 Adults and 1 Child
text: The room is spacious for 5 adults and 1 child.  They have air-conditioning which is excellent. Room is clean and tidy.  They have an outdoor pool which is good for kids. This motel is family friendly, should have been excellent if they have 50+ Sky Channel(cartoon channels for kids) option instead of just 4 Sky Channels.  And the room has a bar fridge which only has a small freezer for ice cubes, no room for 1 liter of Ice cream  if guests would buy from the walking distance Pak N Save.

title: Lovely motel
text:
Our family of five stayed a night at this motel and would have been happier to have stayed longer.

The facilities were really good, the rooms were impressively decorated, and the location was ideal. The kids loved the flat screen TV and the (small) pool.

title: Well located and pleasant stay
text: Rooms good size and clean. Location close to town if you do need to walk in. River is within walking distance as well. Nothing remarkable about the place but for a place to rest up and freshen up it is to be recommended. (That said I did notice they had an onsite gym which I did not utilise but if you are into that very convenient!)

title: Nice And Clean
text:
I must say this is just just what we need in a motel room. It was clean and tidy, It was a welcome bonus of having several coat hangers instead of one or two that we have experienced in some hotels we have stayed in. Being given the small carton of milk on arrival was appreciated too.

Staff were nice and friendly.

Would gladly stay here again next time we are in Hamilton.

title: Disappointed
text:
I made my booking by phone at 8pm the night before my intended stay.  At 7am the following morning I received an offer to stay with a friend so I called immediately to cancel my booking.  Mark explained that they had a cancellation policy which would be charged if they could not re let the room.  He didn't explain that it was a full booking fee or I would have requested that he let me know if he couldn't re let it and i would have stayed at the motel anyway. I was  shocked to see my credit card charged for one nights stay and have since made some enquiries about this with legal avenues and a variety of other accommodations.  I understand that this is quite normal however I don't think it's fair considering that the booking wasn't even made 24 hours before my intended stay.  I believe there should be more moral and flexible rules around cancelation policies.  I expect a 50% - 75% charge would be acceptable considering that by not staying my room did not need to be serviced,  no power was used,  the bath was not run, no tea, coffee, milk was used.  
Really disappointed.

title: The most excellent stay on our 23D22N NZ tour.
text:
We were three couples from the 'Lion City' touring the North Island of New Zealand.  12Sep2013 was the last leg of our tour and we intended to spend it in Hamilton before heading to the Auckland airport (2hrs away).  From research, we knew that there were many accommodations on Ulster Street. 

On reaching Ulster Street, I said to the girls in our group to take their pick as to which motel they want to stay in.  They were the ones to choose as the guys were more easy going and not fussy. 
One of the girls called out that she like the looks of Camelot Motor Inn.  I immediately turned into the driveway.  There we were greeted by Alix who was very pleasant, accommodating and pretty if I might say.  We had pleasant conversations all round.

Alix offered us the different types of rooms we can choose from.  We indicated that we would take three rooms and she generously upgraded us to rooms with spas for two, when we asked.  That really made our day.  All the rooms were beautifully appointed and very comfortable.  We slept very well and all were very happy.  Wi-fi was free and unlimited.......hooray !!!

One of the rooms had an uncaring guess before and left the room full of cigarette smell.  We highlighted to Alix and she arranged for another room next to it and it's a one bedroom suite unit instead of the studio suite. And that's another upgrade.  Wow.......what else can we asked for ?

Being the last night of our trip, we wanted a beautiful unit, a place to relax and this motel has the answers.  Parking was great.  Lots of space.  Heard they have forty rooms in total. And what's more we asked for a late check out as our flight was in the night.  That was granted in 10 seconds flat.  We will remember that.  

Also, we were told of the new mall (Te Awa) down the road that we could spend some time before catching our flight.  That work out very well too.

Thanks again Mark Boe and Alix.  Cheers to you guys !

title: Great place for our school team to stay
text:
Travelling with sports teams can be interesting- but we have had two groups stay at this property and have been fantastic.  Nothing was too much to ask here- they even helped out with the mountain of uniform/ towel drying for the team each day.  The rooms had been refurbished really nicely, were spotlessly clean and the property was lovely and quiet.

Thanks for making our winning trip to Hamilton even better.  So nice to know we had somewhere nice to stay.

Nina B
hotel_response:
Hi Nina,

Thanks for your wonderful review and great ratings. We do really appreciated all the review we do get. We are glad you enjoyed your stay with us and was great to hear that the girls team won! All the best for the rest of the season. We hope to see you again in the future. 

Warm regards,
Mark & Alix

title: Fantastic service and Great Value
text:
We recently stayed at Camelot Motel, Hamilton with a Hockey Team attending a tournament in Hamilton.  There were 24 people staying with the team plus several parents who had booked the same Motel. There was also another team staying there attending the same tournament. As with any sports team washing is always a challenge as you need it washed and dried for the following day. Even though there were two teams staying there, there was no problem with the washing - Alix took the washing each day and put it through the commercial washing machine and dryer.  She did this without asking for additional payment. We also had the boys doing "hot & colds" after each game - where they had to use the outdoor swimming pool followed by soaking in a warm bath. Alix provided extra towels for them to use. 
The rooms are tastefully decorated and each unit had its own full oven. The boys' rooms were large units with generous lounge areas and each unit had 3 bedrooms with two  "proper" beds in each rooms which meant no one had to sleep in lounge or on rollaway beds.   I can highly  recommend this Motel. The staff and management were really friendly and nothing was too much trouble for them.   
Fiona W - Wellington

title: Loved it here! Fantastic service and comfy rooms!
text:
My friend and I recently checked out after staying here for 5 weeks. 
They have us the room cheap, and went out of their way to help us!
They even said make a list of all the cooking equipment etc you'll need as you're here for a whole and within 24 hours they had provided everything.
As things do sometimes something broke, eg the lightbulb went or the hot water went, but they were all fixed IMMEDIATELY, and we were given the use of the next rooms shower until the hot water was fixed (which it was within a few hours). Fantastic friendly service from the cleaners too. 
It's about a 2 minute walk to the nearest pak n save, and within 10 minutes you're in the centre. 
The washing is free too. 
Really friendly approachable owners, only downside is that the room wasn't vacuumed for a long while when it needed to be, and sometimes the wifi kicks you off if you're on an iPhone, but these are little niggles and overall I will gladly recommend Camelot!

title: AMAZING 10/10
text:
Hi team Camelot,

Just like to say thank you for the service and hospitality yous showed us whilst we stayed there. Such nice,clean accommodation very hospitable,polite people (Liz) thanks for your kindness. The rooms were amazing and warm, everything was much more than we expected. I have told family and friends about the famous Camelot :) will stay there in the future no doubt. Keep up the good work 10/10 :) 

Jodz and Andy
hotel_response:
Hi Jodz and Andy

Thank you so much for your wonderful review. We really do appreciate it. We are glad you enjoyed your stay with us and loved our rooms. Glad to hear you will be back again in the future. Thanks for recommending us too to your friends and family. See you again.

Mark and Alix (not Liz =))

title: Excellent Motel
text:
We stayed here as a sports group with over 20 people, mainly 14 year olds. The motel rooms were spotless and very tastefully decorated, the beds very comfortable. The owners and their staff were friendly and went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed, even washing and drying  our huge amount of towels ( we are a waterpolo team.) I would totally recommend this motel. We will definitely be back.
Paula  B
hotel_response:
Hi Paula.
Thanks so much for your wonderful review! We really appreciate it. We enjoyed having your teams stay and it was great that your teams achieved successful results in Hamilton. You were great guests to have and we look forward to accommodating you again in the future. Thanks for the review once again. Mark and I are so thankful and as the new managers are trying to put our best foot forward in starting a new generation of the Camelot Motel.
Thanks again,
Mark & Alix

title: Megan
text: We stayed at the Camelot Motor Inn for 2 nights with our Waterpolo Team hiring out 6 rooms for the children.  We were thoroughly impressed with the service we received during this time, the management and cleaners were friendly and went out of their way to make our stay pleasant.  Our rooms were to a high standard with great cooking facilities.  We will definetly be returning and have recommended this to friends and other sports teams.  Thanks Mark and Alix for going that extra mile for our teams.
hotel_response:
Hi Megan
Thank you so much for your awesome review. As the new management of the Camelot Motor Inn, Mark and I really appreciate every word of it. We are glad we made your experience here is Hamilton a good one. And the fact that your girls team won the competition made it an even better experience! We look forward to having you stay will us again in the future. Good luck for the rest of the season.
Kind Regards,
Mark & Alix

title: Good reasonable priced Motel
text:
This was our 1st experience at staying in a Motor Inn. in N,Z.Must say it was a pleasant experience.We were able to stay in, to eat more, which saved quite a lot of money. We were staying 8 nights and were given a up-grade,which made it better. A large Studio room with kitchen and separate bathroom. There was not a lot of kitchen utensils,but we managed to eat in a few nights plus breakfast. We were down the side of a long oblong shaped court yard with cars parking in front of each unit.
Although its quite a busy road outside ,we never heard any noise.The staff at the front desk were very nice and helpful.Room cleaning was done everyday.
There are 2 big Supermarkets nearby ''Countdown and PAKnSAVE'' so shopping was no problem, Good bargains on Wine,for our journey around the North Island. It is possible to walk into town,though after being sightseeing all day.I drove into town,no parking fees after 6-00pm.
I would definitely stay here again.
We ate out a couple of time,Cafe Centrale,Italian food. (see separate review )
Hamilton is a good centre to visit many places and surrounding district.Including a nice river walk.

title: Awsome
text: Love this motel especially the spa. Room was great. Manager was so good ge helped us he gave us big room in cheap pice .Tried to book again but there was no vacancy, will stay again soon. Its close to pac n save.

title: Overnight stay
text: This motel was fine for an overnight stay and the room was clean comfortable and decently equipped. Its not in a great location for finding dinner but fine if you are going to events at the nearby sports stadiums.

title: Great stay
text:
We stayed here for 1 week and it was a great choice! The room was big and clean! The Internet was free and FAST!! The cleaners were great! The tv was big and and had all the connections I needed for The play station an laptop to plug in!  Bed was very comfy, location is great close to CBD. There is a busy road right out front and you can't hear any traffic. 

I would deffenantly recommend!!

title: Good place to stay.
text:
We only stayed here one night but found the room clean and well appointed. It cost $125 per night which was reasonable. 
I have seen some bad reviews of this place but on the sign outside it states that the rooms were newly refurbished so it looks like improvements have been made. 
One gripe was ytd temperature in the room as there was no air con just a ceiling fan. 
If you need a fairly cheap place to stay this could be gut you.

title: Very spacious and comfortable
text: This was a great place to stay at the last minute, we got an excellent deal. As we were travelling on motorcycles it was great too as the bikes were out of sight. We will most definitely go back there

title: A bad experience
text:
The first unit we were in was unit 34.After unpacking we were making a hot drink and it took six cups to find one clean enough to use.The plates were the same,they felt like sandpaper to touch.
I suggest they were just rinsed under cold water.
After complaining we were moved to unit 28.That evening when preparing our meal we found that the pot we needed had no lid, there was no sieve to strain our pasta and the grill in the oven did not work. After again complaining we were allowed to use the stove in an adjacent unit.
The next day after returning from our sightseeing we found that the rubbish had not been removed by cleaning staff (this is supposed to be a fully serviced facility).
There was no soap rack/caddy in the shower. When I tried to balance a shampoo bottle on the track over the shower door I discovered at least twelve used cakes of soap on it.
Light bulbs were not checked daily, and once again we had to complain.
Management/reception never took responsibility for our complaints, they blamed the cleaning staff,Indians were in the unit before us(very Racist)and they purchased a bulk supply of light bulbs which turned out to be poor quality.
Twice I asked reception for directions to a tourist attraction, but they couldn't help because they were new to the country.
We were given a $15 daily rate reduction but I feel but my overall opinion is that this is a sub-standard establishment.

title: Adequate
text:
Management did give me a good rate, but I couldn't say I would have been happy paying any more for this room. The shower was pretty unpredictable, and a lot of the things in the kitchen had not been cleaned adequately.
On the plus side, it was quite, and you do get free and fairly reliable broadband.
I was in a studio room, and it was OK for a night, but I probably wouldn't want to spend much longer there.

title: Best in Hamilton!
text: A nice a clean, refurbished room! Has new carpets, free wifi, nice big TV, a fridge, cooker, free tea and coffee! Was quite although we were there mid week and only 3/4 other rooms were occupied. It was winter so we did not venture into the pool. There wais a public bus outside to get us into town or ou to the base.

title: For a family on a budget
text:
My wife and I with our 1 year old son stayed here for one night. The host was friendly and willing to help.

The one bedroom unit we had suited our needs with a lounge area for our son to crawl around, kitchen to prepare our meals and shower over the bath which suited all of us. 

The bed was really comfortable and the unit was clean and tidy.

Unfortunately other guests were boozing it up, talking and laughing loudly until about midnight. Then from 2.30am to 4am they returned from the night clubs yelling and banging vehicles waking our son up each time.

We wouldn't have stayed here if we knew we wouldn't get a good nights sleep.

title: Top of the range
text: Stayed here for 2 nights while playing competitive sport in Hamilton. Very spacious, clean and modern. The only minus with this motel was the spa was out of use because of previous users damaging it and we did book it because it had a spa. Owners very nice and helpful.

title: Great stay!!!!
text:
Stayed here for one night. Rooms were immaculate the staff were very friendly the room is modern with a nice  30+ inch flat screen tv the only negative I had was the thin doors I could hear everything outside, people getting into cars at 6am and smokers coughing at 2am. 
Would defenantly stay again!!

title: Quiet and clean, Great facilities, Friendly owner
text:
Found this place by walking the main street.  The room had a double spa with free wifi and some sky channels.  Flat screen TV and kitchenette which is better than going to the bathroom to fill the jug for a cuppa!.  The bed was comfortable and two pillows each.  The spa bath/bathroom clean and roomy.  Definitely would stay here again if the rate was good.  It was ok to have a slightly later checkout which was appreciated.  Was about a 15min walk into town.  Parking right outside your room.  Nice heating inside with a oil heater and heat pump.  Needed it for the cool Hamilton morning!
Had 1 night at the Kingsgate and had booked for two but were so disappointed in those rooms decided to look for another place for our second night.  Very happy to find this one otherwise our weekend may not have been so good. 
Thank you Camelot!

title: Beautiful Hotel
text: My husband and I recently stayed at the Camelot Motor Inn and absolutely loved it! We were vacationing on our honeymoon in New Zealand and out of the 8 hotels we stayed, Camelot was by far the best. Everything in the room is brand new, which is a luxury we did not find in any other place we stayed. We had heard that the Inn was under new management and had only been updated 6 weeks proir to our visit. The pictures of Camelot on tripadvisor do not do this Inn justice. We had a studio room, which had a kitchenette, queen and twin bed, a shower and flat screen tv, plus free broadband. Even the fixtures were new and you can tell that the new owners care about their guests comfort. We would strongly recommend staying here. Especially if you are in town to go to a rugby game because the hotel is in walking distance from the stadium.

title: Best place we stayed on the N. Island.
text: We spent a week driving around the N. Island and this was by far the nicest, cleanest roomiest, most attractive place we stayed. The staf was very friendly and helpful, the beds were very comfortable and the rooms were spotless. We especially appreciated having menus for nearby restaurants in our room so we could see what was available befor we decided where to dine. We could come back to the Camelot without hesitation any time we are in Hamilton.

title: World Cup Stay
text:
We visited Hamilton in January 2011 looking to book a hotel for the Japan-New Zealand game of the Rugby World Cup in September.  We were staying at a hotel that did not come up to our expectations and chanced across the Camelot which was almost across the street.  The hotel location was excellent as it is in close proximity to the stadium, shops, food and restaurants  
The tariff was good and they were not increasing it to gouge the overseas tourists.  We made a one night deposit to hold the room and returned to Canada.
We arrived on schedule and were booked into a room.  It was fully equipped although the TV was not very modern.
Management and staff were very friendly and the room was spotless.  Parking was very convenient

title: Simply excellent!
text: The motel was very clean, quiet, spacious and comfortable. Facilities include a small swimming pool, gym, laundry, sky TV & spa. The hosts were very friendly. Supermarkets are nearby. The kitchen was good except that the pots/pans were too small for our needs but we managed to cook ourselves a simple dinner. The service was excellent especially the cleaning part. Thank you so much!

title: Clean and spacious!
text:
We stayed in a 3 bedroom unit which was very clean and spacious.  In the main bedroom there was a double or queen bed with a TV and in the other 2 rooms there were 2 single beds in each, with a wardrobe in each bedroom.  There was also a sofa bed in the lounge for extra guests.  There was a trampoline right outside our unit where the kids could be seen from the lounge if they were outside.

There is a Pak n Save supermarket on the same road as this Motor Inn, about a 10-15 minute walk or a very short drive, which was very handy for making use of the well equipped kitchen in the unit.

My only negative was the headboard on the bed would make a noise with every toss and turn.  Other than that, we'd definitely stay there again.

title: Very good Motor Inn
text:
The  Camelot is about 10/15 mins walk from the main area of Hamilton. The owner - Warren - is a very friendly helpful man.
The rooms are modern, clean and contain everything in terms of utilities. They are all non-smoking which was a plus for me.
This is no 4 star hotel, but if you are looking for a clean, functional place to stay close to everything in Hamilton then this is a good choice

title: Thoroughly Recommended
text: Why doesn't this motel have any AA stars?  It is excellent.  The units are large, modern and very comfortable.  We actually had a hybrid king studio/1 bedroom unit which meant bedroom and bathroom could be separated from living/dining and kitchen area by sliding doors.  The king bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was very big with a spa bath.  I had a look round at the other studio, 1 bed, 2 bed and 3 bedroom units and they are all much bigger than the usual motel units.  If you are a keen walker you can walk into town in 10/15 minutes.  If, like us, you prefer to drive it is a very short drive but parking in town is a bit of a nightmare.  The owners were very helpful with local information and we would thoroughly recommend this motel to anyone visiting Hamilton who didn't need to be in the actual city centre.

title: Sadly this accomodation business is no more
text: Souter house was sold some 18 months ago and now houses an accountacy firm

title: nice location and food
text: Stayed in Souter for 1 night in Feb 2007...rooms were fine, although a slight problem with an electrical short in main light.  Our room at the back, suspect ones at front could be noisy from traffic.  Cambridge a very pleasant town, and Souter restaurant excellent.  Like everywhere in NZ, wish they'd discover flyscreens!

title: Great Meal
text:
We’ve just returned from a 4 week holiday in NZ and found this to be one of our favourite stays.
The room is exactly as depicted on the website - very large with comfortable bed, sitting area, mini-bar, and spa bathtub. We were especially impressed with the warmth and friendliness of the owners and staff.  Be sure to have dinner at the restaurant - the food and service is absolutely fabulous. 

Kim, Stephen, Bee & de Jean: Thanks again for a fantastic stay.

title: Barclay Motel - great spot, good rooms
text:
Great sized room (#17) at the front of one of the blocks. Room was bright and airy and spotlessly clean with daily service.
Motel has a guest laundry with a washer and a dryer and a pool (didn't use but looked nice).  Staff were friendly and accommodating. 
While the room has a kitchenette, the equipment is sparse - 1 frying pan and 1 small saucepan; no tin opener, only very small teacups, no chopping board and the smallest teatowels Ive ever seen.  It was handy to be able to prepare.food though and Pak n Save is <5mins away with a dairy/milk bar <2mins away.
Good spot if you're going to Waikato Stadium and a 10 min drive to town.
Reception is not open for periods so you have to phone them if you need anything  - no phone in the room but most people have mobiles

title: Terrible accommodation
text: This is at best 1 star accomodation. Sticky floors, dirty furniture,  noisy and over priced. Rooms are let to semi permanent local families needing accommodation. Police were quick to respond to an incident and the reception staff had to reassure us that he would keep us safe. Not a comfortable night.

title: One night stop
text: We booked on a Saturday night, probably wasn't the best idea. We could hear every word spoken in the room next door and to make it worse they had an upstairs unit above ours and everytime they walked closed doors or went up the stairs it was so so loud! They had a few people over and the noise was really annoying we tried to keep out tv as loud as we could to try and drown it out. Other than that the room was good, good space and pretty tidy. The bed could do with an upgrade as we had a bit of roll together and also the pillows which didn't have protectors and were stained. Maybe if you chose another unit it would be better, otherwise don't use unit 17!

title: Faultlessly clean, budget accommodation
text:
For the price, we could not fault our stay. The room was small and perhaps a little tired but as suggested in the title, was absolutely SPOTLESS so could not nit-pick here. We staying in a studio and for 2 taller than average adults, the bed was not big enough so would suggest moving up a room category.

Good spot to stay if needing locality to the stadium as is less than a 5 minute walk

title: Wouldn't stay again
text:
Motel was in a very good location which is why we picked it, however the room was the tiniest motel room i have ever stayed in even for a studio. It was like it was a sleepout attached to the side of some of the other units. Only stayed one night but the TV kept losing the channels and going fuzzy which was annoying, the bed mattress was very old (orange 80's kind) and not very comfortable and we ran out of hot water in the shower. When we advised the motel receptionist she was rather indifferent about it and just said that's strange and left it at that. 
Wish we had stayed elsewhere as we didn't find it very good value for money at all.

title: Just ok for the price
text:
Staff pleasant
Budget room, compact space.
Good free wifi and bed was comfortable.
Adequate cooking facilities for the space, venetian blind badly needs replacing.
Bonus...free wifi and air conditioning

title: Room was great, very clean
text: I booked this motel because it had a pool, however when we arrived and checked out the pool we could not use it. It was green and the surrounding area of the pool was not t all tidy. Very disappointed because we were not able to have a swim. When I asked the owner about it we were told that there had a been a party in the pool the previous weekend and that was why it wasn't clean. I have a had pools of my own and having a party in the pool does not leave it green, the reason is poor maintenance. I paid $570.00 and was not offered any compensation.Not good service.

title: Good location to waikato stadium
text: Stayed in a studio, old and dated but clean and warm, it was nice and quiet. It has everything you need, towels need urgent replacement, they looked old and felt like they had been used already. The best thing about this hotel is how close it is to Waikato stadium, 10min walk. I would return to this hotel because of the proximity to the stadium. On a busy sports weekend it was the only option available at a reasonable price.

title: Bad Motel
text: A group of us stayed here for 4 days.  I would not recommend to anyone!  Facilities are old & grotty.  Towels were awful.  One of the rooms we booked had an upstairs unit attached to it which was occupied independently to us.  The first night despite the rules saying no pets had a dog running around and you could here every movement and word.  When we enquired they assured us that it would not happen again - wrong! 2 nights later it was rented to a young crowd who partied up there and when we rang to complain the phone in the room did not even work.  After 3 attempts to get reception top do anything I had to go out at 11.30pm and ask to be quiet, but the noise started up again at 4am on there return!  We asked for compensation from reception and got nothing!  We had booked 6 rooms here and would not recommend either of them.  This place is run by people with bad english, bad hygiene and bad motel management - dont waste your money!

title: British Lions Tour
text:
Stayed at the Asure Barclay for one night on a very wet and windy night so could not really see much.
Seven adults stayed in three rooms one of which was a full house we could have all fitted in there!
Very clean and spacious.Bit of a taxi ride into town but easily accessible.

title: Exceptional comfort
text: We stayed at this motel for two nights and in comparison to many other motels we stayed in during a tour of the country I would not hesitate to recommend this motel. Whilst the outside looks fairly unprepossessing the units are spotless. There are all the facilities you need. The owners are very helpful and pleasant and the biggest plus for me was the incredibly comfortable bed. The mattress was new and plush and I slept extremely well. All in all a great stay

title: Things not working
text: Stayed for two nights in a family unit. As it was May we were looking forward to using the spa and heated pool. Neither were working as apparently the solar heating was faulty. They thought this was funny, we did not. Also reluctantly gave us extra milk when we asked as we were four adults.

title: Average
text:
We have stayed here quite a few times in the past, owners have been amazing, no faults what so ever. On our last stay new owners have moved in. They are friendly enough though we have seen things decline slightly already.
Our room had 2 Windows, one curtailed, other only a net curtain and due to window looking onto all other rooms and car park, it felt very "public" plus all the lights were shining into our room. Bed faced the window so very little sleep was had. Definitely need to improve on window dressing!
Usual free, heated pool had sign on it requesting pre booking for minimum of 6 people at cost of $20 yet no rooms can house 6 people!!! Not cool! Rooms were ok, clean though ceiling vents/fans could do with a clean. Rooms starting to look worn and dated. Will pick somewhere different next time, sad as this was our "Go to" hotel

title: Good functional room for a one night stay
text:
This was night two of our New Zealand odyssey and we were in Hamilton to watch the Chiefs Super Rugby game against the Hurricanes. The Studio Double I booked was adequate enough for a single night's stay but would be a little snug for anything more than that. A double bed, kitchen area including sink, fridge and a breakfast bar is crammed into a small pre-fab unit and there is barely enough room to walk around the bed but everything worked fine, the bed was comfortable, wifi was good and the TV was connectable for USB and HDMI devices.
The only window in the room looked over a courtyard area which people were regularly walking past so it felt a bit like being in a goldfish bowl meaning that we had to close the blinds (no room for curtains!) and were declined natural light.
It absolutely poured with rain when we were going to the stadium and the owner/manager very kindly lent us an umbrella to make the 15-20 minute walk.
A nice little coincidental bonus was that I was able to back the car up close to the room, under the canopy to allow me to load the car up the following morning without getting wet!

title: Really good!
text: We were a group of 5 and we stayed overnight at this motel. The staff are very courteous and will go the extra mile to make your stay comfortable. The room we had was clean and the bed was really comfy! The manager was sweet enough to given is a few extra pillows too. The bathroom was clean and had heaps of towels which is always a plus! The room has parking space in front of it, which is really convenient. The location of the motel is pretty central to everything you might need. All in all, a good space for a good night's rest.

title: Booked online and turned up in minutes
text:
Booked online and turned up in minutes 
Staff obliging and friendly 
The room are very tidy 
Has parking in front of room which suited me perfectly 
Quiet and didn't hear any road noise 
The only downer was the locks on the door ,hard to lock and bit old sliding 
Would stay again for sure

title: Wonderful stay!
text: Very welcoming on arrival and our room was very clean, tidy and modern.  The bed was so comfortable.  Location was excellent.  Really enjoyable stay and will be happy to return and recommend to friends and family.

title: Great Value for Money
text: Great staff service all round. Our room was nice and clean and the linen in the bedroom and bathroom was clean and fresh. Access from parking to bedroom is superb. We had a two night stay here. Our only complaint was that the shower needed a mold treatment for a tiny spot of mold. So handy to all areas and the road traffic had no effect on our visit at all.

title: Loved the courtyard with Spa
text: Stayed 2 nights at Barclay Motel while on our family vacation. We booked a one bedroom unit with courtyard and our own private spa pool which was awesome.  Only big downfall was that the unit above us on the first night was occupied by party animals who blasted their music partied all night stomped around on the floor above which sounded like a full on rugby game was happening above us.  At eleven o clock I phoned reception and said that there had been a party going all night and we would like to go to sleep now please.  The guy at reception came straight over and asked them to turn the music off, the party then shut down and evreyone went to town.  Problem was they all came back at around 2am and started up again, I then phoned reception again and straight away the manager came over again and told them to be quiet.  The whole family did not get much sleep at all but was pleased that management came both times I phoned.  Second night was bliss with no one in the room above us.  Rooms were good, kitchen was well set up.  Highlight was our own Spa Pool.  Good value for money.
hotel_response:
Hi there 
thank you for staying with us.  I feel sorry about your bad experience in your first night here. we even planned to get the noisy people out of our motel.  whenever you have a problem, we will try our best to solve it and make your stay as better as possible.

title: Weekend stay
text: Have stayed at this motel a few times. Always found it very clean and tidy. The managers are very helpful. Handy to town and restaurants and Supermarket. Will stay there again. Being on the main road it is very easy to find.. Has plenty of parking.
hotel_response:
Hi Wally
thank you for being a loyal customer to our motel.
I am looking forward to seeing you again.

title: Ideal distance from Auckland after a long flight.
text: Room excellent, clean, tidy and comfortable. All we needed for a two night stay to recover from a long flight from the UK. Wi-Fi good but thought the allowance was a bit mean.  Quite a way to shops/ supermarket, but can be walked. Good location for visiting Waitomo Caves about an hours drive away, and that was well worth the journey. Nice swimming pool and children's play area. A credit to the Asure network.
hotel_response:
Hi Brain 
thank you for staying with us. I am looking forward to seeing you again.
well actually, our WIFI is unlimited, you could asked as much as you need, and you should have been told when the reception gave you the WIFI ticket.

title: Room was ok, but....
text: The room was very clean, comfortable and modern but there was a serious lack of power points and none that I could find in the bedroom.  We had booked here as it had a pool and we wanted to be able to swim.  There was a pool but it was green and slimy and I couldn't bear to get in.  They also had a spa but you had to give them quite a bit of notice to heat this up.
hotel_response:
Hi Bellajami
i am sorry for responding you so late. There are power points behind each bed in every room, and also in the lounge. we also can provide extension line if our guests need. It would be a better result if you told our reception that you need more power points. I do apologize for the swimming pool, we should have provided you a clean pool but the pool was polluted and we have had called a professional pool "doctor" to clean it, but it really needed time to recover.  
anyway thank you  for staying with us.

title: Clean, but needs new beds
text: My husband and I stayed here for one night.  The unit was clean, but the bed had seen better days.  The unit was in the middle of the complex and street noise was noticeable, so much that we had to close the windows while making phone calls.  The only restaurants nearby are in other hotels.
hotel_response:
Hi  Mrs Richardson
Thank you for choosing Barclay motel. We are planning  to update new beds for some rooms needed. And I am sorry for any inconvenience it made to you.  
We are at the edge of Hamilton City center, so if you keep going on about 5 minutes, you will find kinds of restaurants.  
And thanks for your feedback, it really helps us and let us know where we do need improvements
 kind regards

title: Q card accepted, Comfy Bed, Fast Internet with Spa
text: We were really happy with our stay at Asure Barclay in Hamilton . It was convenient to everything we wanted to see, and only a short walk to places such as Pak N Save when required. The Bed was really comfortable, The Internet was fast and Free , The Spa pool was heated especially for us at no extra charge plus a cold pool if we wanted it.. The service from management was excellent. We would have no hesitation in recommending this motel , and will probably stay again next time we visit Hamilton Gardens.
hotel_response:
Hi Yahn
Thank you for your great feedback we are delighted you enjoyed your stay with us. 
hope to see you next time.

title: On the way down
text: We have been staying at this motel for at least fifteen years, while visiting Fieldays. It changed hands early last year and we have found that service is slipping, while prices certainly aren't. Basics like soap etc. are not renewed daily and sheets weren't changed often enough. My group has rented 5 units for many years running, the bill tops $9,000 for 6 nights. While prices have inched up slowly over the years, (and I had until now no problem with this) one unit went from $155 2 years ago to $245 this year, the unit in question being a tiny studio that is too small even for a table.  For comparison a spacious 1 bedroom unit that sleeps 4 is $280. When I complained that  they had made an error, they said no, and wouldn't reconsider. When I said we wouldn't be back next year, the new owner basically said he didn't care, he'd find other clients. We'd had a great relationship with the former owners and every time we were in Hamilton we stayed there but I'll certainly no longer recommend this motel to anyone.
hotel_response: Hi Andrew, thanks for your time to review. Understanding you were upset about the price but the unit's rate has been increased last year and someoneelse in your team paid without any questions. Because we have huge demand during Fieldays period and always keep best rate for you guys, 20% less than normal market price. Also, would appreciate if you can let us know anything need to attention before you cheked out. Really sorry for your leaving, hope can help you next time.

title: Very happy chappy
text:
Me and my family of 5,turned up at Barclay motel on the 25/2/15,and out of all the motels along Ulster st,we picked this motel,without not booking,we tried our luck by walking into reception and asking if we could have a room,that would be suitable for me and my family,with a welcoming smile the reception said sure,she then showed us too our unit,it was perfect,king size bed,and 2 singles,a private court yard with hot tub,outside table n chairs.
Very clean,tidy,and affordable,i would recommend this too family and friends travelling too Hamilton,and wanting accom.
So thankyou Barclay Motel for the wonderful stay,and thankyou so so much too the young lady that greeted and looked after us,i didnt catch your name..sorry,bt you were wonderful.
We will be back!! :)
hotel_response:
Dear missocarroll,

It is great to hear that you had a happy stay with us. Thank you for taking the time to review our motel. We hope you will come back and visit us soon! Best regards.

title: Ken sucks
text: First 250 mb is free only, then after you have to pay. Manager said its this way everywhere, but we walked across the street to Best Western and their wifi is totally free. Pool and hot tub are disgusting. Hot tub was cold so really it was just a small dirty pool. Staff is undertrained, poor girl. Probably due to poor management. Ken the manager wanted us to pay half if we wanted to cancel and repeatedly said "if you want to talk we can talk." Really unprofessional. A con artist and a scam if you ask me.
hotel_response: Dear Jacob H, Thank you for taking the time to express your opinion. I'm sorry we can't give you free cancellation when you arrived at that day which is peak season. For the data ilimit which is stated "free wifi with condition' on the website, however, my minder who was the first day on duty gave you more than 250mb to suit your need. We are always pround of our cleaness and try our best to keep high standard, would you please raise any concerns before you left? Thanks again for your stay with us.

title: Only bad thing was wen I striped the sheets off the bed only to find a white tail spider had slept with us over Night.
text: I thought it was a nice motel. Very clean an tidy. Comfy beds. Gave my 250 dollars bond back str8 away. Room was 145 4 1 room dubbl bed an single bed. The service wen we got there was terrible the lady seemed racist. But the man was very nice morning greetings very happy.
hotel_response: Hi Misreal, thanks for your time to review us. It was the first day for our new minder, she was a little bit nervous:). We'd like to see you again. Kind regards.

title: Stayed here for new years.
text: Me and my friends all stayed here for new years, the staff were very nice and so were the rooms. We stayed in room 17 I think it was. With a private courtyard, spa, a bbq and huge outdoor table. By the look of it there was a room upstairs above it and if someone were in the room the windows over look the spa, but we were lucky enough nobody was in there. It was very clean though, and a great size for 4 people. Would deffiently stay again.
hotel_response: Dear peacelovehappinessx , Thank you for your great feedback we are delighted you enjoyed your stay with us. We certainly strive to achieve excellence in every aspect of our business. We look forward to welcoming you back to ASURE Barclau Motel in the near future. Kind regards,

title: Changes at the Motel but all still good
text: I have often stayed at the Barclay when travelling to Hamilton.  It has always been a great value proposition with spotlessly clean rooms and a friendly welcome from the owners/managers.  In November I was travelling to Hamilton for one night for work again and asked my PA to make the booking.  She came back to me - there are different people there.  This is always a risk, because standards can change with changes in management.  As it was only one night I confirmed the stay and took the risk.  I can happily advise that the same high standards of cleanliness have been maintained, and that the welcome was very warm and friendly.  I was very happy with my stay.
hotel_response: Hi Ross, appreciate your time to review us, also give a chance to have you stayed with us. We will  always offer our best and looking forward to meet you next time. Merry Christmas & Happy New Year :)

title: Good last minute stay
text: We had to make a last minute change to our accommodation for our second night and although we didn't get to use the pool (which is something we enjoy) the weather kept changing on us, our stay in Hamilton was good for what time was spent there, and the room was good for the 1nt.  We had the very last room in the Studio King Spa and the spa was a big highlight for us.  Thanks Barclay
hotel_response: Hi Jojo834, thanks for your time to review us and glad to know you had a good time with us. Looking forward to see you soon:)

title: Not Great
text:
We picked this motel for our weekend stay in Hamilton.  The new owners were very friendly, and the room was very clean. As with many older motels, it wasn't hard to hear voices from the adjoining room, and despite being in one of the furthest units away from the road, traffic noise was very noticeable.
There were a couple of light bulbs blown which could have been fixed before we arrived if they had taken time to check the room.  The toilet flush button had to be pushed in a certain way otherwise it wouldn't work.  The shower door had some good sized cracks in the glass, and the carpet showed signs of wear in places.  
Despite staying for two nights, only one small bar of soap was left on the day of arrival, with none being left on the second day by the cleaners.  There were only two bath towels which is not enough especially in light of the fact that it was a two bedroom unit.
The private spa pool is not private at. Their is a sail over part of the pool, but it is still open to the occupants of the multistory apartments directly behind you.
If you take in to account the high cost for the rooms, it is very poor value.  
The thin walls, traffic noise, non-private spa pool, worn state of the room, minimal bathroom supplies, and poor value for money means we unfortunately won't be return customers.
hotel_response: HI John, Thank you for the review. We are sorry to hear your experience was not to your liking. As we don't have a SPA pool for 2 bedroom unit, I assume that you stayed at our most popular 1 bedroom SPA tub unit which has SPA tub in private backyard. We valued your feedback and improve our service level, it's much appreciate if you can let us know when you stay with us.

title: nice stay
text: hey peeps nice place very friendly staff actually got a discount as was on own was stoked saved 25 dollars on rate so very happy also helped me place motorbike out of site very accommodating highly recommend
hotel_response: Hi Grant, thanks for your comments, we appreciate your feedback. Would like to meet youagain.

title: Disgusted with this motel
text:
We were absolutely disgusted with this motel, we had never stayed in this place before but it was the only accommodation available and we had tickets to the All Blacks. They would only let us book for 2 nights so with no other option we did this. 

The email confirmation stated that the room we were booking was a 2 bedroom unit with Spa Bath, queen bed in one room and two singles in the other. There was no spa bath to be seen, the queen bed was 2 singles pushed together and was so uncomfortable we hardly slept. The pillows were lumpy and blankets were musty. The fridge smelt so badly we couldn't keep food or drinks in it. At $300 per night this is totally unacceptable. After discussing if we should speak with the Motel owners about this we decided it was best to speak up as we don't want to see other people in this position. The Asian man who took our call was very unhelpful and didn't care at all about our concerns. He ignored me when I asked why we were told there was a spa bath and a queen bed when this was actually not the truth. Please people choose carefully, this hotel is charging far too much for hotel rooms that are not up to standard. You will be sadly disappointed.
hotel_response:
Thank you for this interesting post. We were definitely not aware you were unhappy with the room rate as you seemed happy and accepted the rate when you paid for the room. I would have thought that if you were not happy with the room rate and the room layout you would have said so at the time and chosen not to book into the room. It is unfortunate you did not come to the office with your concerns whilst you were still in the Motel and consequently realised there were “issues” several days after leaving our premises. 

As you were aware, this was a peak weekend, the All Blacks were playing in Hamilton and we understood you were very appreciative we had a room for you over this very busy weekend.

I'd like to explain again. We do have a spa bath in the unit as still can seen picture in our website.
Queen bed has got 2 split base which not effect to matress at all.We strive to ensure our guests are happy guests however cannot do this if we are not aware of guests concerns at the time. Previous guest comments on this site alone clearly show guests have been very happy with their stay at Asure Barclay Motel and as always, our high standard of cleanliness is one of the clear accolades of our property. 

Thanks again for your time.

title: Awesome spa suites
text:
No corner spa in the bathroom.. a full sized outdoor jacuzzi in you own private courtyard.
As usual with the Asure chain comfortable beds nice rooms and excellent service. There was a mixup with our room and it was handled very quickly and well
Only a short taxi ride from the busy downtown area and quiet rooms.
See you again.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your very generous review of your stay. We are glad you love the SPA tub in your courtyard and look forward to seeing you again soon. Again, thanks for the feedback. Ken & Fiona

title: Good motel - spotlessly clean
text: We struggled to find a nice place to stay in Hamilton, but the Barklay was just right. Not a great location, but all the fairly mediocre  motels seem to be on Ulster Street. The corner suite with kitchenette was spotlessly clean and had all the sensible facilites that our previous 5 star suite in Auckland did not have, like tissues, good light in bathroom, a sharp knife and chopping board etc. The kind receptionist even helped with a Puma shoe sale as I needed shoes! thank you for a pleasant stay.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for taking the time to review us. We are so pleased the room cleanness and facility lived up to your expectations. Thanks again for your review. Ken & Fiona

title: Choose carefully
text:
Regular visitor to Hamilton, usually stay at another motel, which were full and less than helpful so was looking for a new place to stay.

The room was fine no issues, but I did explain to the host about being a new corporate customer...so he puts me in the room closest to the road and it was bloody noisy!

Guessing doesn't care that much for repeat business, as due to the lack of interest and care doubt I'll be heading back again.
hotel_response: Thanks for your review Steve. As we were all aware, this was a very busy week with little else available at the time you booked.  It is unfortunate you did not mention this to us on check out. As you can see from our other reviews we do try hard to go the “extra mile” for our guests. Again, thanks for your review.

title: Nice place to stay ... remembered my name
text: We stayed here for one night, while visiting family. We had a king suite with spa bath, the unit was clean, large and had great views (was upstairs). Although in need of a couple of minor things, like the corner bench coming away and the wall-paper lifting, there was nothing wrong to write home about. I would stay here again. I was impressed that the Manager remembered and addressed me by name in the morning...Nice!
hotel_response: Thanks for your great comments. Notes also taken from your comments. Thanks again for your review. Neil & Margaret.

title: Happy in hamilton
text: We chose the barclay from a whole row of motels because it looked inviting. It was a good choice. The hosts were helpful and pleasant. We had a large studio - very clean and neat with a good bed and shower-what more could you wish for. There was a lovely garden and a pool. We will stay here again
hotel_response: Thanks for these coments. We do try hard to please so it is always nice to get these reviews and  also pleasing to pass these comments on to the housekeeping staff as well. Thanks again for your review.

title: Great Place to stay
text: We ended up looking for a place to stay late at night 1030pm and this was one of the few places still open.  It was a real gem with a great layout, clean. comfortable, and a bathroom that I would die for in my own house.  It was the best place that we stayed in during our travels in New Zealand.  The owner was great with suggestions reference areas to see in the North Island and helping us find a place to stay for our next stop.
hotel_response: Thanks for your comments Donna and thanks for your comments about the bathrooms. We put considerable thought into how we would upgrade the rooms especially the bathrooms so we do appreciate your comments. Thanks again, Neil and Margaret.

title: I always stay at the Barclay in Hamilton
text:
I often travel to the Waikato for business, and always stay at the Barclay when in Hamilton.
The welcome is always warm and sincere.  The rooms are always spotlessly clean, comfortable, and the towels fluffy. There is air-conditioning, wifi if you need it, and comfortable chairs.
Everything works well and I have never had any maintenance related issues.
The price is very reasonable for what you get.  
I always stay at the Barclay because it ticks all my boxes every time - I am made to feel welcome, it is clean, it is quiet, the bed is comfortable, the parking is good, and everything works.  No hassle.
Do yourself a favour and stay at the Barclay.
hotel_response:
Thanks for taking the time to make these comments Ross.
Regards Neil &Margaret.

title: Couldn't be better
text:
We stayed at Barclay two times, our very first days in New Zealand. First my husband, Alex, was there in August for a week. He came from Thailand and after several months in a warm country had to go to all the struggle of the transition into cold, including getting used to his new closed shoes after all-time slippers))) Neil, the owner, sorted him wonderfully out, letting his own soft shoes as an amergency and giving plenty of useful information. At that time, Alex picked up the best unit, 22, for our future stay in November.

In November 2013 we came as a family with 2 young children and stayed at Barclay for more than one months while looking for our own house to rent. The unit 22 was just as comfortable and Neil and Margaret and all the staff as nice and welcoming, as we would be hosted by our best friends. The kitchen is handy and nicely equipped, plenty of space, big outside area, playground. The staff took really good care of us, brought some toys and books for kids, helped with advises about house searching etc. Neil took our 4 y.o. boy to help him with putting down the flags. And I just adored Margaret's roses !!

The location is very comfortable, we miss it sometimes ) We didn't have any noise from the Ulster street at our unit. The riverside walk is just 10 minutes walking away, a supermarket and the free shuttle bus to the city center a bit further, but everything was very manageable with 2 young kids. Really, we couldn't find a better place for our first weeks in Hamilton.
hotel_response:
Thanks for your coments.
We say this is your home away from home & as yours was so far away it is nice to be able to help when the occasion arose. Thanks again for your lovely comments. Neil & Margaret.

title: Excellent place to stay
text: We have stayed at the Barclay Motel several times and have always been impressed by the comfort, cleanliness and friendly service. The whole place is well maintained and the units are very well appointed with good quality fittings and air conditioning. The owners give the place a really homely feel with beautiful plants and rosebeds. Good value for money and convenient for the city centre, this is one of the best motels we have stayed at in New Zealand.
hotel_response: Thanks for your comments. We put a lot of effort into making our guests stay with us memorable so your comments are appreciated.

title: Cleaness  place we have ever stayed at
text: We travel a lot and stay in many motels and this would have to be the cleaness place we have ever stayed in. Staff accommodating with out been over the top will recommend. You can tell the place is well cared for by the garden beds and grounds. Especially the rose beds.
hotel_response: Thanks for these comments. We try hard to maintan an excellent stardard & it is warming when this is acknowleged. Thank you again.

title: Excellent Accommodation
text:
We booked the Studio King Spa Suite and couldn't have asked for more. Everything was clean and tidy and the room to move was over and above our expectations. Thank you to Neil and Margaret for making us feel welcome. We will not hesitate to recommend the Barclay Motel to our family and friends travelling to Hamilton. 
Thanking you - Ian & Pam Thompson, Newman, Western Australia
hotel_response:
Thanks for these comments folks.
We do appreciate comments that acknowledge the effort we go to behind the scenes to make your stay pleasurable. Neil & Margaret.

title: Went the extra mile
text:
Thank you so much for sending my daughter's blanket to us in Australia after she left in there on our last night in NZ!
Loved the spacious apartment and lawned area for kids to run.  We had the two bedroom apartment and it felt like a house with large living and dining area and a separate kitchen!
hotel_response:
Thank you so much for your comments.
All part of the service. We know some of these items can mean so much to some. Neil & Margaret.

title: Double charged us!
text: We stayed at this motel so we could go and watch the mighty All Blacks play. The fact the nights accomodation were extremely overpriced due to high demand, to be charged on our credit card twice we could understand. However after a phone call to inform the Management of the fact and still over a month later, and no credit to our card, we are not happy with at all.
