We are dealing directly with the customer to rectifiy the situation and make up for this slip in our usual standards. Thanks, Neil & Margaret.

title: Amazing Hospitality
text: 10 Southlanders arrived very late into Hamilton. Margaret & Neil accomodated us at very short notice & without any hassle. There hospitality exceeded exspectations if ur ever in Gore look us up guys. We are the SBW crew. lol.  PS, Our booked accomodation fell through.!!!
hotel_response: Thanks for these comments folks. We to were pleased we could help all of you at that late hour. Your were a great group of people & a pleasure to have with us. Look forward to seeing you all again some time. Neil & Margaret.

title: GREAT PEOPLE,GREAT TREATMENT!!!
text: lovely unit,was sparkling clean people at reception were so LOVELY,would recommend anyone to stay here was cheap in my eyes  4 star plus such a great deal comfortable bed great surroundings with a pool and swing set and trampoline outside i wouldn't go anywhere else!!!!
hotel_response: Thank you for these comments. Setting a high standard is one thing, maintiaining that standard for almost 22 years is another so comments like this are appreciated. Thank you.

title: Found new home in Hamilton - and the reception was open at midnight
text: Beautiful 2 bdrm apt with full kitchen and garden patio makes me wish we would be around long enough to enjoy them. But it was gracious welcome at midnight when all else was closed or full that really made us so grateful.
hotel_response: Thanks for these comments. We have a policy that if we are awake then the office stays open. Pleased we could help you.

title: A quality establishment
text:
We had no intention of staying in Hamilton but an unexpected event found us in need of  accomodation. Someone recommended the Barclay and at 9pm we knocked on the door at reception... we're glad we did.

This is a good quality property with large, modern, tidy rooms. The furnishings are contemporary and the place is very clean. A large glassed area which contains a sliding glass door is curtained off at night for privacy and open during the day allowing light to stream in.

The bathroom and other facilities are adequate and tariff is reasonable... we paid $130 for the night.

The Barclay is one of many motels along Hamilton's Motel Alley but from our experience it's well run and good value.
hotel_response: Than you for these comments & thanks for choosing to stay with us.

title: Great Place
text: Our Family of 4 spent 3x nights at Barclay, I was very impressed, Clean & tidy, Lovely Host.It exceeded out expectations and had everything we wanted plus more, kids loved the play area with spa & pool which kept them entertained for hours. Due to having family in Hamilton we normally stay at a campsite cabin, but for $15 more a night we got all this. We will definitely be returning.
hotel_response: Thank you for these comments. Our aim is to please so it is pleasing to see our staff get these comments while we are away. Will pass on your comments. Thank you.

title: Close to Rugby Stadium
text:
Three of us stayed here for three nights during the Rugby World Cup.  Motel room was clean and the staff were very welcoming.  It's very convenient for the stadium, which less than a five minute walk across the road.  There are also a number of bars and shops within easy, flat walking distance.  

Unfortunately, the weather was not very kind to us during our stay and apart from a reasonably good shopping mall there is not an awful lot to do in Hamilton on a rainy day!!  However, it is a good base for visiting places such as Hobbiton, Roturua and Cambridge.
hotel_response: Thanks for these comments. It was a wonderful experience having all different nationalities here for the 6 week period of the RWC. Thanks for choosing to stay with us.

title: Lovely hosts, good location
text: The motel room I booked was adequate and very clean, nothing flashy but everything needed was there.  The hosts are really lovely people who know how to make you feel welcome and the service was fantastic. This is really what makes them stand out and my reason for a very good rating. Located close to the city centre, 5 minute walk to take-aways and another 5 minutes walk to some good restaurants. Old fashioned heating system, which did heat the room, but could definitely do with an upgrade to something quieter. Would definitely stay here again
hotel_response: Thanks for these comments. Heat pumps/Air conditioning units installed in all rooms Dec 2011.

title: Just ok...
text:
This is a hotel that we chose on a whim.  It was getting late and we had not really researched hotels in Hamilton so we just picked one on our way through town.

I can't say that I was very impressed.  This hotel is old and tired and in need of some upgrades.  The rooms have a musty smell and the beds are not very comfortable.

This place is ok if you are just looking to stay somewhere average, but we found it expensive for what you get.
hotel_response: Thanks for these comments. Note taken & final part of the upgrade completed end of 2011.

title: Personal care beyond all expectations
text: Recently I spent 15 nights with Neil and Margaret while my husband was in Waikato Hospital awaiting and during heart surgery. Each night the lights and heater were switched on so it was nice and warm when I arrived back alone to the motel. I couldn't speak highly enough of the staff and owner. Thank you so much. Will be back later when next surgery happens
hotel_response: Thanks for these comments. It was a pleasure having you. Hope all is well with you both.

title: owners/staff made us very welcome from day one through to 37th Night
text: I stayed for 37 nights at the motel and was made welcome from the very start. The manager very kindly gave us a swimming card to allow us access to the local swimming pool and gym and no charge to ourselves.  The cleaning staff were faultless. they knew their jobs well and we always had clean towels each day and clean sheets every three days. Each of the women cleaners had a real good personality and sense of humour, which is pleasing to see these days The manager Neil gave my partner a loan of his mountain bike, helmet and reflective jacket to get around the town and tracks, that was really appreciated. I would recommend this establishment to anyone.
hotel_response: Thanks for your comments folks. Looking after our guests is more pleasure than work for us. We simply put ourselves in your situation and go from there. The bike had a good workout, cant say it has had the same since.

title: SECOND HOME
text: I need to use at least 50 words, but 7 would be enough. Friendly, exelent service, like a second home. I spent about 250 nights in hotels and motels every year, i have seen more luxurious places than this, but that was also at least twice the rate. The motel is very clean, outside and inside The staff as well as the owners are very helpfull. We stayed here for one and a half month, nothing to complain about at all. Downtown Hamilton with resturants, shops, casino and nigthlife is only a 15 min. walk. When i get to Hamilton next time, Barclay is my choise.
hotel_response: Thanks for your comments. It is nice to see our focus on our customers reflected in comments like this. Thanks for staying with us.

title: I would choose this Motel again any time!
text: We stayed in this Motel with the Japanese Rowing Team for the 2010 World Rowing Championships. We had a fantastic time! We enjoyed the nice and spacey units to relax and prepare for our competition. The staffs were very friendly and helpful with whatever we needed. I can truly recommend The Barclay Motel for people travelling to Hamilton.
hotel_response: Thank you for these comments Max. It is always great to interact well with teams staying with us and be around when they share their success. "Good vibes" are contagious. All the best for you & your team for the future. Neil & Margaret.

title: Good Motel
text: We arrived early evening at Hamilton after a long drive from the Bay of Islands and found the Barclay Motel quite quickly.  The gentleman who greeted us on reception was nice and friendly.  The room accommodated 4 people, 1 separate bedroom and 2 singles in the lounge area which was adequate for our needs, very comfortable and clean.  This accommodation was definitely value for money.
hotel_response: Thanks for your comments. Happy customers are our #1 goal.

title: Nothing special...
text: Barclays is a small motel, one of a line of motels of varying size along Ulster Road, the road north to Auckland. It is not in the centre, but there are several unexciting restaurants and a Pac n Save supermarket a very short drive away, while the centre is about 5 mins drive.  There is wi-fi broadband in the rooms (not cheap at $2 for 15 mins) and a guest laundry.  Rooms are pretty basic but everything works. Our unit at $115 had king-size bed, armchair and chair, full kitchen with microwave, kettle, toaster, coffee plunger/cafetiere, and small table and chairs.  During our stay, the motel was completely overrun by children who used the courtyard outside our window as a tennis court or football pitch until late evening, so it was not very quiet.
hotel_response: Thanks for this Review. Yes another sports team in that evening however in the the ensuing period we have changed the way we book sports teams in here for this very reason. 50Mb of Wi Fi is now free to every customer. Thanks for bringing these points to our attention.

title: Excellent place to stay
text: This was a great find in the pretty town of Cambridge, situated about 5km outside. The room was very comfortable and tastefully decorated. The lounge was large with comfy leather sofas and an enormous tv; there was also seating outside on the large patio. The cooked breakfast was a real feast which we thoroughly enjoyed, thanks to Mary for a great stay.

title: The ultimate lodge experience
text:
Hadleigh Lodge is the ultimate lodge experience, nothing is too much trouble for John and Shirley.   The suite,  with large open doors into the 5 acre garden and swimming pooling, has everything you could possibly want.  Walk in wardrobe with a fridge full of complimentary goodies and drinks, an enormous pile of the fluffiest, whitest towels and a  power shower and double washbasins.
Shirley cooked a superb 3 course breakfast and we were set for the day to visit Hamilton Gardens, another gem.
Unfortunately we leave tomorrow and will miss the pampering and of course Holly the Labrador.

title: Hadleigh the hidden Gem of Hamilton
text: On entering the property through the Security gate you are struck by the magnificent garden  driveway leading to grand house. Met by owners Jon & Shirley who gave us a guided tour of our accommadation, the rooms had beautiful vistas of the gardens. Your own sitting room with complimentary wine, beer, mixer drinks and fresh baked biscuites and cake. Bedroom contained very comfortable bed, nice shower, roomy, well furnished , could not ask for more & a freshly prepared cooked breakfast to start your day.

title: Every comfort provided in a beautiful house and garden.
text: Jon and Shirley were warm and generous hosts.  We felt privileged to share their beautiful house and garden and appreciated all the many flourishes they added to make our stay an unforgettable one.  Ample size accommodation with separate sitting room, comfortable bed, home made refreshments and fresh flowers. Wonderful.

title: Absolutely Outstanding
text:
My wife and I and another couple spent two nights at Hadleigh early in September.
We were first time guests but Shirley and Jon treated us as if we were family friends.
The accomodation was purpose built and the lovely garden and grounds have been
meticulously planned and developed and were a joy to walk around.
Our rooms were a good size and were thoughtfully equipped and each had a full
view of the gardens. Breakfast was a treat and our individual preferences happily
catered for. Complimentary drinks and canapés were provided each evening.
The Lodge is set in the lush Cambridge area and conveniently close to Hamilton.
Hadleigh Lodge is outstanding and outstanding value and we give it our highest
recommendation .

title: Exceptional
text: The hosts, Shirley, Jon (and Holly), offer genuine, warm hospitality. The house is beautiful and the grounds are stunning. The Kotare suite; bedroom, ensuite and lounge, has quality furnishings, is spacious and private. The complimentary evening drinks and canapés were a delightful treat and the breakfast was five star. There were many other thoughtful touches and attention to detail that made this an exceptional stay.

title: Great hosts and lovely home
text:
This was our first experience in a bed and breakfast type stay. 
I can honestly say it far exceeded our expectations - Jon and Shirley are amazing hosts,  their hospitality was fantastic and we felt more like long lost friends rather than strangers. The home extremely comfortable and the gardens are wonderful to stroll around.
We had a truly memorable stay and would happily recommend Hadleigh to anyone.

title: Once in a lifetime!
text:
We stayed at Hadleigh for one night and it was an amazing experience from start to finish.

The accomodation and grounds were 5*++, but what really made the difference were the hosts Jon and Shirley. Nothing was too much trouble, including driving us into Hamilton City. A complimentary mini bar was provided, along with baked treats, and a breakfast fit for a king!

If you've been thinking of exploring more of New Zealand and feel like being spoiled, give Hadleigh a visit - you won't want to leave!

title: A beautiful lodge set amongst amazing gardens. Fantastic hosts.
text:
There is nothing we could fault about our three night stay. Jon helped with restaurant bookings, was our private chauffeur in his dashing white Porche and he and Shirley made every aspect of our stay a delight. Shirley excelled with scrumptious breakfasts. They are both friendly but not intrusive hosts.
I would recommend this wonderful lodge without hesitation.
A very special highlight was Holly the Golden Retriever. She has customer service off pat ( excuse the pun)

title: Totally unsurpassed - so welcoming, beautiful...and Delicious!
text: We loved this beautiful place!  The home & gardens are absolutely lovely!  Jon & Shirley are very special people...a most interesting couple...we did so enjoy our time with them...and Holly is the perfect four legged hostess.  She provided us with many special moments!   We had the best sleep and loved waking up to the sound of birds singing!  Breakfast was superb...Shirley is a spectacular Chef!  Everything...from our menu choices, the fruit with home made yoghurt to the fluffy blueberry muffins was absolutely perfect!  Jon makes a delicious cup of cappuccino too!  We will savour memories of this special place!

title: Feeling royal and at home!
text: The mansion is just a beautiful spot to spend a night or two. Jon and Shirley are a lovely and fun couple who run the huge place and do everything to make you feel at home. Be sure to give Holly a belly rub to ensure the extra cozy feeling and enjoy the luxurious breakfast with sight on the huge garden with pool, sculptures and trees.

title: Beautiful location with amazing hospitality
text:
Our family of 4 stayed at Hadleigh for 2 nights, using both the upstairs and downstairs suites. Both the house and extensive gardens are immaculately maintained and lovely to stay in. The garden could be in a magazine and guests are welcome to enjoy roaming through it. The bedrooms and bathrooms are spacious and hosts Jon and Shirley open up many other rooms including the library for use by guests. The breakfasts each morning made by Shirley who went the extra mile to meet our dietary requirements were generous. Welcome drinks and canapés with on our first night was a lovely introduction and the heated swimming pool was a hit with our sons. 

We couldn’t fault the lodge and highly recommend it.

title: Superb
text:
Wow! We have just left our stay with Shirley and John and we wish we could go back. They really go above and beyond to ensure your stay is perfect. From arrival they give you a good introduction to your suite and the welcome guide has lots of restaurant recommendations, which is very useful when you’re not from the area. There are so many little touches that make the stay incredible such as freshly baked biscuits, complimentary mini bar and homemade breakfast (we are still talking about the granola they make - so good!). Each day the breakfast offering changed which was great to have some variety and to be able to taste more of their wonderful cooking! John was also kind enough to drive us into town for the cricket to save us getting a taxi there and back, which is another example of the great, personalised service you receive when you stay with them.

Hadleigh really feels like a home away from home - especially with Hollie their lovely dog who kept us company on an evening! They show genuine interest in you and have some great stories to tell as well. Thank you for a lovely stay.

title: Exceptional!
text:
A little piece of paradise , Fabulous hosting from John and Shirley , warm and inviting

title: Country bliss
text: Jon and Shirley were lovely hosts and their property simply breathtaking. We were visiting during the TA cycling tour and really enjoyed their genuine hospitality, including a lovely cheeseboard on arrival and full breakfast in the morning. I particularly enjoyed the chance to talk cars with Jon who has some unique racing stories. Highly recommended.

title: Peaceful and serene - a world away!
text: This lodge was so much nicer than anything else we looked at in the area. After doing tourist stuff, we drove down a long drive through the gates to a peaceful, lovely home.  All of the rooms have french doors that open to a large yard (I would actually say a park - it is so large) and sitting outside listening to birds was so relaxing with wine and cheese.  Everything about the room was lovely - my tall husband loved the shower and breakfast was tasty Highly recommend - and only a few minutes to town

title: Lovely
text: Jon and Shirley were perfect hosts, we felt comfortable and especially enjoyed Holly!!, Our room was lovely and home baking extra special.  We enjoyed a wonderful banter of sharing interests, jobs and life experiences. Christchurch loss is definitely the North Islands gain,

title: Best BnB we have ever been too!
text:
Jon and Shirley are excellent attentive hosts.  We were greeted with home made slices, our own lounge room and amazing bedroom with beautiful views of the garden.  But it was the extra touches that made the difference.  Our washing and ironing was done for us and they provided 'happy hour' before dinner each night with lovely home made hors-d'oeuvres and cheeses.  When they didn't have the wine I liked to drink, they went out and bought a bottle for me, which I was given to take away what remained after our 3 night stay. 
Shirley is amazing cook and we even made a menu drawn up for us each day, where we could choose 3 hot dishes for breakfast each morning.  Every day was a different menu.
We shared their interest in gardening and went to see the Hamilton gardens for inspiration for our own garden.

title: A driven experience
text: We spent two very enjoyable nights here. Warmly greeted by Jon and Shirley on our arrival, The facilities were second to none, very warm and comfortable, breakfast on both mornings were absolutely delicious, with a very tasty selection of dishes on our personalised menus. Each evening was commenced with canapes and drinks in one of the lounges, with our hosts . Jon had kindly booked our two nights of dining in Hamilton restaurants, and the perfect touch was his chauffeuring us, there and back, in his Porsche. We wholeheartedly recommend Hadleigh House for anyone considering staying in the waikato area.

title: What great hosts!
text: Hadleigh is a lovely house and the garden is amazing. The accommodation is spacious and beautifully appointed.  The breakfast was delicious and full of homemade goodies.  The hosts were very friendly and couldn't have been more obliging.  There were also lots of lovely little extras.  Highly recommended!

title: Amazing is an understatement
text: Stayed last night with Jon and Shirley, and just amazing place. They were both so welcoming to share their fantastic house and grounds (and Porsche...). We had complimentary drinks and snacks and alcohol, an amazing bed and the view from upstairs was stunning. We had some canapes and a wine with our hosts (enjoyed the conversation immensely), and even offered a ride into town if we wished. Lovely dog as well. The breakfast was BETTER than a top-class Hotel when we had a great spread for starters, on top of having a list of meals that Shirley cooked upon request! I really wanted to put a 6 or 7 rating for here. We didn't try the pool, but option was there

Fantastic overnight stay for our wedding night. John and Shirley are excellent hosts and made us very welcome, even picking us up from our wedding reception. Breakfast was superb and the grounds of the lodge are beautiful. Definitely recommend!

title: Gracious living near Hamilton
text: Hadleigh Boutique Lodge is a beautiful family home located on five acres just minutes out Hamilton.jon and Shirley Warring are generous hosts. We loved Shirley's great breakfasts.This lodge is located near the stupendous Hamilton Gardens.

title: Hamilton Retreat!
text: Hadleigh Boutique Lodge is absolutely wonderful. The  accommodation and grounds are divine. The pool was wonderful on a hot day. Hosts, Jon and Shirley are lovely. The made us feel very welcome and we enjoyed their company. Jon dropped us at our restaurant which was great and Shirley made an absolutely scrumptious breakfast. I would without hesitation recommend Hadleigh Boutique Lodge.

title: Fantastic place - highly recommend
text: The hosts have thought of everything.   So spacious and comfortable; so hospitable with drinks and canapés in the evening; so much was complimentary: drinks, fruit, cake etc;  lift to restaurant in the evening;  personalised menu at breakfast.   Very attractive gardens and pool looked very inviting but just too cold when I visited.  Close to Hamilton and the Airport.  The nicest and most interesting people.

title: A most enjoyable stay
text: Thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Hadleigh Lodge. Our stay was only one night and and found Hadleigh Lodge to be very comfortable and quiet with the added bonus of a beautiful garden. We only booked for one night and should have planned for a longer stay.

title: On The Way To Huka Lodge
text:
We had a very enjoyable stay with Jon & Shirley who made us feel very welcome in their beautiful home 
Their gardens were amazing and we lacked for nothing
Breakfast was memorable, bathroom spacious and bed very comfortable

title: Wonderful Stay in NewZealand North Island Countryside
text: We (2 couples) really enjoyed our stay at Hadleigh.....great hosts, comfortable rooms, wonderfully-prepared elegant breakfasts and afternoon nibbles, good conversation...a very pleasant place to stay. After 2 days in Auckland we wanted to get out and see some of the countryside. We knew that we didn't have time enough to go too far south, so we decided on the area near Hamilton and Cambridge to use as a base. On day trips, we explored Rotorua and the Glow Worm caves. We felt that this was a very authentic part of NewZealand and had a great time. What made it even more special was that Jon is a longtime Porsche enthusiast as are the 2 men in the group....so what could be better!?! Jon and Shirley are great conversationalists and we learned a great deal about the area in our short visit. Highly recommend!

title: Great hosts!
text: Having moved from their old location in Christchurch, Jon and Shirley have established a lovely B&B conveniently located just outside Hamilton and Cambridge. Room and ensuite were spacious and immaculately clean, with a guest lounge just next door. Grounds are extensive and loving maintained including a pool, thanks for the guided tour Jon. Plenty of choice for breakfast and well cooked, thanks Shirley. Genial hosts, great conversation and all in all the perfect place to stay if you are in this part of the world.

title: A Trip Highlight
text:
My wife & I had a two nights very enjoyable stay at Hadleigh. Right from the time we arrived we were made feel like old friends. The presentation of the property, the ambience, the little touches eg. Fresh biscuits, cake, the complimentary room fridge contents etc. were way above any expectation.
Listening to Jon & Shirley's lifetime stories were somewhat inspirational. The whole experience was a highlight of our NZ trip.
We wish you both, including Holly, the faithful Lab, all the very best.

title: Beautiful and relaxing stay
text:
Where to start? Jon and Shirley were fantastic hosts - as others have said, they have thought of all the extra touches and made every effort to make the stay a fantastic one.
Hadleigh is a beautiful property with gorgeous gardens, a delightful pool and lovely spaces to relax. Our room was spacious and clean, with home-baked treats and complementary beverages awaiting our arrival. We joined Jon and Shirley for canapés and drinks before Jon gave us a lift into town for dinner (we followed J + S's recommendations and were very impressed!). Breakfast was delicious and we were sad we couldn't stay longer! I must also mention Holly the dog - another star of the show - friendly and well behaved! Thank-you Jon and Shirley from Louise, Sarah and Christine!

title: Luxury stay
text: Jon and Shirley were great hosts - great breakfast best omlette ever. Top class accomodation they have thought of all the needs of their guests and more . Very thoughtful to put out biscuits cakes and lots of drinks too. Our flight was late so we missed their happy hour drinks but I'm sure they would be good company. The room and bed were luxurious.  Love their porche BTW.

title: Wow !!
text: Beautiful house in a stunning setting. This is one of those places where the hosts think of all the extra little touches and then some. Shirley & Jon are gracious hosts with an evening drinks get together before going out for tea. In the morning you are greeted with the most divine breakfast. My only regret it is in New Zealand and we are in Australia. Go ahead indulge yourself

title: BEAUTIFUL RURAL ESCAPE
text: Shirley and Jon's BnB in Hamilton is an elegant weekend away.  The house is magnificent set in expansive parklike surroundings, including a lap pool for keen swimmers.  Holly the Lab is very welcoming and well behaved.  We enjoyed Shirley and Jon's company in the evenings around the fire with delectable nibbles and drinks before we tried out Hamilton's restaurant scene.  Breakfasts were a treat with stewed fruits, salmon, eggs, croissants - anything you desire actually and Jon was always there ready with fascinating stories about his Porches and the Christchurch earthquakes; having lived through them both.  I sincerely recommend staying with Shirley and Jon at Hadleigh for a top class weekend away.

title: Exquisite Boutique Lodge
text: We stayed for just 2 nights at Hadleigh Boutique Lodge. Wish we could have stayed longer. The setting is beautiful, the grounds stunning and our suite very comfortable. But what surprised and delighted us the most was the hospitality of Jon and Shirley. Nothing was too much trouble, the breakfast was excellent, aperertives in the lounge each evening so enjoyable. Jon drove us to dinner and picked us up, the list goes on. Everything they say on their internet site is so true and more.  We have no hesitation in recommending their wonderful lodge.

title: A Wonderful Haven
text: This Deluxe B&B is a beautiful haven, and Shirley & Jon are so welcoming and accommodating. The house and huge grounds are gorgeous and serene. My husband and I could only stay one night on our New Zealand travels and wished we could have stayed longer. Drive out of Auckland an hour & a half, and stay here instead!

title: Had a Good Time at Hadleigh
text: We had a lovely one night stay in Shirley and Jon's Boutique 5 Star B&B just outside Hamilton. They are very welcoming hosts and the guest accommodation is superb.  We stayed in the Kotare Suite upstairs and had a lovely view of sheep in the next field, right next to the Guest Lounge which overlooked their superb gardens.  After a welcome drink and chat and nibbles, as it was a cold evening and didn't want to go out, we spent the rest of the evening relaxing in the Guest Lounge, where we could make a coffee, use their crockery for our own snacks, use the complimentary wifi and watch a DVD.  The suite had every facility, nice toiletries, hair dryer, electric blanket etc.  Breakfast was scrumptious, especially the homegrown fruits, homemade muesli, a cooked breakfast to order and a bottomless pot of coffee.  We were well set up for the next part of our journey to Taupo and quite sad to leave their fabulous home.

title: Stay at Hadleigh
text: We recently enjoyed an all to brief stay with Jon and Shirley at their magnificent property Hadleigh in its rural Hamilton setting. Our first class accommodation was just the start as we later enjoyed a glass of wine with our knowledgeable hosts and a walk around their expansive gardens. Shirley's breakfast was beyond our expectations and a great way to end our short break with them and return to our home. We will make time for a two day stay when we plan our next visit.

title: Nightmare at Aspen Manor
text: I have never left a review like this so I’ll begin…. Absolutely terrible place. I would like to be able to say we even had a “stay” but seeing as we left within an hour I’ll start there. No one greated us at reception, we got the key from a lock box after calling the number on the locked reception door. She was very rude.  Walking into the room there is a strong smell of mould. title: Falsely Advertised
text:
I can not understand why this is classified as a 4 star motel. This is our 4th motel in the last week, the filthiest and most under provided out of the 4 but the most expensive. 
No one to greet you at reception.  You have to ring a number and they will come when THEY are ready. Not very friendly. 
No milk, no bath mat, no face cloths, no dish cloth. Two towels,  two flat pillows and filthy dirty. Two quarter rolls of toilet paper. When I asked for more, the response was, we are running low on supplies. We did get more toilet paper and a couple more towels to use as bath mats. The room was dark and gloomy.  The only light switch was by the front door so after you turned it off, you had to try and find the bed. Thankfully I travel with a torch.
At $140 per night, they should be able to purchase more if they are running low.
The cleaning cart sat in the same position for the 2 days we were there. Rooms definitely not serviced daily. 
The grounds are full of rubbish,  weeds and long grass.
I asked about returning the key on checkout as no one is normally at reception and was told to throw it through the window. 
I would never stay here again and would not recommend it to anyone.

title: Do Not Stay Here
text:

There were missing light bulbs in the bedrooms, a noisy fan in the bathroom, no milk in the fridge, and a general feeling of insecurity. We decided to leave after 1 night, informing the reception by phone of our decision as there was no-one on site at 8.30 in the morning. I emailed to confirm my verbal request of a refund of $170 as I had booked through the website.
I have since emailed (6 days later) and again requested a refund for the night not used with no response.

title: Never Again
text:
My husband and I arrived at Aspen Manor on Friday, 15 January at 4:00 pm.  Reception was locked and dark with no sign of life (peering inside it looked as if it were being used as a storage space). There was a note on the door to 'dial 7' on an incredibly dirty/greasy phone - there was no answer.  I phoned the motel and the woman that answered had very poor English skills, I had to repeat my name five times.  Once that was sorted we were directed to Unit 3 and told the key was in the unit.  Guests staying at Unit 2 had just arrived and could not find the key - they had phoned the motel and established the key was in the cupboard and suggested that is where we would likely find ours (and we did).

On entering the unit the first thing I noticed was there were no towels.  I phone the motel number again and was advised that the towels weren't ready yet - still being washed (it was 4.20 pm!!) -  she would bring some over when ready.  No apology was offered for the inconvenience.  We left to go out to dinner at 5.20 pm and the towels had still not arrived.

Whilst waiting for for the towels I did a recky of the unit - there were multiple hairs in the bathroom sink and another hair in the shower (refer photos).  In addition, and probably the most disturbing is that the smoke alarm had been removed (refer photo) - I thought maybe it had been replaced by a more modern alarm but I failed to find any sign of an alarm.

On walking outside, I spotted some very unsafe wiring in the ceiling of the overhang which appeared to have been like that for some time as there was dust and grim all over the wires (refer photo).  Further along there was a broken outdoor light fitting with jagged edges that is an accident waiting to happen - especially for kids playing and running around (refer photo).

I was dreading going to sleep that night however the sheets were clean.  The towels, however, were old and stained.

In relation to COVID there was no QR Code and no mention of COVID whatsoever.  I am not sure if that is even legal.

Up until four years ago my husband and I lived in Hamilton East and used to recommend this motel to friends.  The motel has most certainly gone way way way downhill since then.  The charge for the room was $140.00 ... never again!

...I have just been perusing Aspen's website that says "53 people rate as excellent" so reviewed the reviews and the last time someone rated it as 'excellent' was July 2019 - since then there have been many unhappy customers.

title: Cheap and tidy
text: It was a good place for our purposes of just a bed for the night. We were in a family unit which is in the block where there seemed to be long stay residents which did not feel great. The place is a bit run down and is overdue a make over.

title: Alright for sleeping but needs some work
text: Alright for sleeping but needed some maintenance in the unit. Hot plate in kitchen didn’t work and bathroom needed more lights. Had to ask for towels as not enough in unit. Receptionist very business like and didn’t offer any more than the key. A positive was the large size of the unit.

title: Do not stay here!
text:
Really disappointed and not what we thought it would be.
False advertising at its finest, on arrival and after seeing the room we complained and we were told if we wanted a cleaner room that didn’t smell like cigarette smoke and have holes in the carpet etc etc we needed to pay more for a “better room”. It is being used for emergency housing. Didn’t feel safe staying here with the people who were hanging around the rooms so had to go elsewhere. No refunds, management was rude and couldn’t care less about the derelict state of the rooms and insist that they are as advertised when they are clearly not. Couldn’t pay me to stay here, don’t waste your money!

title: Stayed in October
text: While the room was amazing!!!! I had made a booking a month before for a family room. An alternative was given however split rooms at opposite ends of the complex splitting me and my children with no good explanation on why this happened.

title: Terrible value for money
text: Booked to stay here for work.  My company paid premium rates.  But the room smells of smoke ,and there is a filthy spa bath in the main bedroom with actual sediment and dirt all over the inside of it.  The room is shabby and dated, and did I mention the smell?

title: Don't stay Here
text:
We booked a "Spa Room" but were unable to use the Spa for a number of reasons:-
•	The plug was broken! 
•	There are no steps to get in and out of the Spa Bath and there is also no handrail. I am 70 years old and the lack of health and safety considerations is a real problem.
•	There was water in the bath from a previous usage.
•	The drain outside our bedroom window had used cotton buds and condoms on top of it
Disgusting place, not clean, run down and not worth the money

title: Review of stay
text: Found the premises quite run down, only one cup/mug in unit, till we found 2nd outside next day (residual coffee suggested it had been there for several days), no dish cloth or washing up brush, two heaters in unit but only one worked, no remote for lounge Tv, bathroom extract fan blocked due to extreme build up of dust

title: Motel looked derelict
text:
My husband and I checked in to this motel on Friday night for a two night stay. The grounds looked derelict, and there was rubbish in the long weeds in what used to be gardens. The unit stunk, I’m not sure why. The walls were smeared with something indecipherable, there was a hole in the door mat, there was a hole kicked in to the bedroom door. In the bedroom something brown was smeared on the wall. The whole unit was very old and run down. It badly needed maintenance. We couldn’t stay there, so went straight back to reception and asked for our money back. On the way we passed a smashed window in another unit, and ripped curtains in others.We were given the owners business card and told to contact her via email for our money back, which we did. She has not replied. 
We have since been told this motel is used for homeless people, something which was not mentioned on the website.
We would never stay here, it was scary and we felt unsafe.

title: Not happy
text: We asked for a unit with a spa bath. The spa was not cleaned. The room smelt like cigarette smoke. The electric blanket only worked on ine half of the bed and you could clearly see that maintenance had not been completed.

title: Unsafe place, don’t stay.
text: Two nights at Aspen Manor in a room with stained bed, but the worst of it was neighbours who screamed, yelled, banged walls smashed things all night as well as playing music. Motel staff said this never happens, but second night was worse. Back with the fighting, smashing of glass and then at 2am people knocking and trying to enter your room. They have hired security on site as this IS a regular occurrence as it is being used for emergency housing. If you want no sleep, to listen to the most horrendous abuse being doled out, walls being smashed, cars driving around all night, a personal hits concert being played at All hours of the night and surprise visitors trying to access your room ~ then this is the place for you.

title: Neglected and overpriced
text: We were quoted $200 for a studio unit over school holidays. Usually $130. I asked why and they said it just is. It was meant to have a double plus single bed, but the single bed was missing! No discount was offered for the missing bed... Nor were we warned about the door and the bathroom wall with fist holes punched through it. The taps were loose, the TV remote was broken, pillow cases were stained and generally everything was quite dirty and neglected. On the positive side, the bed was quite comfortable and it was a good sized room.

title: They are taking on WINS homeless persons
text: I have been staying at this motel now for a few years - about 8 stays / year.  This last visit after lockdown I was still given my room, However, what they did not tell me was that they are now housing WINS homeless persons in this motel.  I was first suspicious when my room had no shower curtain, the TV remote was missing, the heater had broken legs, no milk etc.  The person in the next room then asked me if I was his new neighbour.  The person in room 2 down looked as if he was normally living on the street.   On complaining they eventually admitted and gave me a room in their other motel which is very nice (Brooklyn Motor Lodge) (So stay there).  They should have done that when I booked in and all would have been forgiven but the apologie only came after I complained.

title: Not recommended. Shame because could be very good
text:
Great spot, within a short drive to Hamilton Gardens and the CBD. But unfortunately, a couple of filthy things really let the motel down during my stay: 1) Blood on the bed cover 2) Rubbish including loo paper and pizza box outside the rooms 3) Old bed, sinking towards the pillows and uncomfortable, and 4) Blocked sink and nobody available at reception to offer help.

I saw the manager (owner?) walk past the rubbish, so that was really disappointing. And called from the office to a phone number provided and nobody came.

With a little more cleaning and customer care, this place could be really good for the price.

title: A nice surprise
text:
Located a short distance from the city, this is a large complex of single-storey rooms with parking in front of each of the rooms. I shared a room with my sister so we went for a double queen room which was very large: two separate rooms for the beds a little lounge area with two TVs and a kitchenette, all well appointed. Nicely decorated, modern, comfy beds.

The only slight downside was that it could’ve been a little cleaner: my sister’s pillows pillowcase was stained and the window in one of the bedrooms was very dirty. There was a dead bird outside my bedroom but otherwise this was not off-putting. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Substandard
text:
Budget is one thing, grotty is another. Let me count the ways...
> Toilet seat had a chunk of plastic missing leaving sharp edges
> Kitchenware not clean and a bit gross - washed everything before I used it after seeing the state of it
> Kitchen edges and ledges grimy leading to a sense that I didn't want to prepare food there
> Kitchen light is a sole wall-mounted low power tube which was just rubbish for being able to see clearly what I was doing
> the iron shed pieces of black stuff on the clothes I was ironing
> the ironing board had melted plastic stuff along one edge which I needed to pick off to ensure it didn't melt again onto my clothes
> Some windows and frames not cleaned contributing to a general sense of decay.
> One floor standing fan which had one speed (slow) and no power switch. This during a hot Waikato summer which is common. Room uncomfortably hot at night.

Will certainly not go back!

title: Well Suited and quiet
text:
Prior to arrival had a phone call to clarify booking - all ok - tick!
BUSY HAMILTON due to Super 7's and CRICKET
Booking - UNIT 24; Would stay in this room ABSOLUTELY again.
Myself and my sister (so went for 2 Queen Beds)
Quiet and comfortable motel. 
Parking outside, (NOTE:  Parking was VERY tight getting around rear of building, so would not advise towing or parking for a trailer, however, the Motel may accommodate for this - so just check) 
Free wifi. 
Friendly welcome, not too far from cafes etc. 
Reasonable price - slightly inflated due to above activities.
Heater in room; Fan in room; plus tea, coffee etc.
Would stay here again for sure!

title: It's a motel. Think Econolodge, not Hyatt
text: Clean, sparsely furnished, everything was functional, albeit dated. Inexpensive and uninspired. Stored luggage after checkout - nice. No problems. Fine for a short stay you ain't planning on spending a lot of time inside. WiFi worked.

title: Poor reception, Overpriced Breakfast and dull rooms
text: At best this is a 1 star motel. The receptionist spoke broken English and was not very welcoming. Considering we had booked around 10 rooms for various family members I would think you would make a special effort, but no. The breakfast was adequate at most but $18 for average food is crazy. The shower was like a water blaster when turned on. The decor is warm and dated and the lighting poor. So many things that not worth listing them.

title: Poor - never again.
text:
Told Spa room not available after it had been booked. Due to an 'accident'. Was given what appeared to be a converted store room or back packer room. TV but no remote = no TV. Threadbare carpet. Very basic facilities. Went to reception to get a remote at 7.00pm closed. Checked out 9.30am to return key. Reception closed.
Original price $189 but offered a $59 discount. This took several phone calls to expedite.

title: Not what was expected
text: Stayed here 5yrs ago, the motel has deteriorated since then. Mould on bathroom walls,  wall lights dont work. Toilet button missing, just generally dirty, not clean to a motel standard, knob fell off dishwasher when opened. Towels and pillow slips are stained. Pretty grotty. Bugs in light shades. Nets falling off and shabby.Motel changed hands since last there. Wouldn't stay there again.

title: The worst Motel my family and I have been in
text: The Aspen Manor was the worst Motel i ever been too the first night we had no hot water we tried to contact them they wouldn't answer, we had to boil water for our kids (camping styles), when we woke in morning there were ants all over bench coming from under microwave when I told them about everything they came and check and said the will send someone to fix, I asked them to have something sorted by the time we got back around 2.30 pm, we left at 10.am we got back we all starting having showers about 8 pm and still no hot water, I rang them they said sorry the couldn't get a electrician out till next day. I asked why wouldn't you let us know when we returned before we started washing, she its ok you can go unit 11 to use showers I said she should have moved us there when we returned, she reckons its ok our back door will take us out to back door of unit 11 we get there and there cockroaches over bathroom basin. There also was empty alcohol bottles under bed bedrooms smelt of alcohol. There was rubbish in what looked like a garden.

title: Not great
text: You would have to be desperate to stay here. Really shabby. Someone’s dried up vomit still on the bathroom tiles. Asked for it to be cleaned 3 times and still there. Point plug was flashing so they put tape over it so we didn’t use it. No smoke alarms. Heater missing dials to turn it down. Very dangerous place to stay. Needs desperate upgrade and cleaning standards need to improve.

title: comfy & quiet
text:
After a terrible time at Uni motel, this motel was like paradise. The rooms were quiet and warm with a decent kitchette, strong WIFI & parking right outside.
A big bonus was being in a great location, walking distance to a range of fantastic restaurants... And a slightly longer walk will get you into the central city. Very happy, will choose to stay here again anytime.

title: A very convenient stay, close to town
text:
There was ample off street parking and I was able to park in front of the unit. The motel in very central, but still quiet.

The motel does not supply small shampoo bottles, but there were large dispensers in the bathroom, much better for the environment.

The single bed was very soft, some people might like it, but it was uncomfortable.

To get into the shower there is a 35cm step, not ideal for older people who aren't that mobile. A handle on the shower would've helped.

The water in the shower was extremely hot.

user_location: Bay of Plenty Region, New Zealand
title: Aspen
text:
Arrived to motel friendly and helpful front desk Cayson thank you for your friendly face after a long day overbooked by booking.com
Room clean and sheets were crispy clean nice! parking for two cars no problem.

title: Average
text: Had a new lick of paint, however basics like no iron board cover and crappy shower let it down. Feels overpriced for what it is however Hamilton has a shortage of accommodation so that will drive the price higher.

title: Dont book by photos alone
text:
I booked this place purely because of the spa pool (not spa bath) in the room. I did not read the other reviews, but perhaps I should have, and only looked at the photos on the booking page.

The Motel is very much from the 70's and in its day might have been first class, however, today I do not believe that their four stars is the correct rating for this property.

The grounds are barely maintained, parking line markings are very faded. Entering the unit I was a little disappointed as in this day and age I expect a little more and when you pay close to $200 for the night you assume quality.

Only seating was a very small two person kids sized couch (excluding the two dining chairs). Smoke alarm was missing from the ceiling mount. Bedroom  was very small and dark, the lighting was not the same as images on the booking page and there was a musty wet smell. Curtains off their rails. Advertised SkyTV, however, the only channels available were free-view - no Movies or sports that you would expect from most motels these days.

Would I stay again? - No sorry

title: "Last minute choice"
text: For our last minute choice we really liked our room with 2 bedrooms. Kitchen had a microwave, fridge and 2 element cooker. We spent most of our time at the hospital which was close and easy to get to when you are coming back late. Would stay here again.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to give us feedback.

title: In need of an update
text: Stayed with a sports team over a weekend. The staff were accommodating and tried hard to meet our requirements.   Rooms had room to spread out however facilities needed some attention and decor needs an upgrade. Brown and beige not very uplifting and coupled with very dim lighting set a bit of a gloomy atmosphere. TV remotes were missing, TV's and dishwashers did not work and legs fell off the heaters. Internet worked OK. Self service laundry service as advertised on this website did not exist. Very handy to shops and cafes.

title: Very Basic
text:
Uncomfortable beds, broken plug on electric blanket. Noisy stairs that meant any time someone came downstairs to the toilet in the night every body woke up.
Would not stay here again. Only thing that could be said for it was big enough for family.

title: Has become very average.
text: I have stayed here many times over the years but not sure I will choose this again.  The place feels tired and I cant quite put my finger on it but something is missing.  I assume they have free wi fi but I don't know because its not mentioned when you check in.  Breakfasts are best avoided.  Things tend to be undercooked or you have things missing that you ordered. However the place is quiet and parking easy.

title: Tired and Basic
text:
Have stayed here a few times, it's great if you want a Spa Bath in your room, but overall rooms are fairly basic and getting tired. Very basic amenities but good budget property.
Value for money? .. not sure

title: Come one come all!
text:
Great accommodation with a range of options to cater for the requirements of the family.  Helpful staff prior to the visit spent time arranging the different units for us.
Close to shops and Hamilton gardens.  
Units clean and tidy.
hotel_response: Thank you for sharing your great experience with other travelers, we look forward to welcoming you again in the near future.

title: NOT RECOMMENDED - Double-Booked on my my nans 80th birthday
text:
Booked online, turned up and was told the room had been double booked.
The other booking had already arrived and occupied the room.

I ordered a room with double spa baths for my nan's 80th birthday, traveled from Auckland and wanted to put nan in a spa before attending a private birthday party, but the room wasn't available.

title: This motel is in a good location , staff were friendly n helpful. Rooms were clean n tidy.
text: Downside to rooms was the internet kept dropping out also no fan or air conditioner in room so was a bit warm at night time . Would stay again despite no fan as it’s in a good location plus in the past they allow cats as we come for the HamiltonCat Show each year
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comment, it was our pleasure to accommodate you and your family during the visit in Hamilton. Most of our guest room are equipped with fan, we will have a look if any fans are missing in our guest room and will replace it shortly. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and hope to see you again in the near future!

From Aspen Manor Team

title: a great motel
text: My wife and I stayed here last night and we found the room to be excellent and the staff very nice to deal with. The staff are very low key and just go abouit their jobs with no fuss. As the motel is not in the centre of the city the noise is low and access is great
hotel_response: Thank you for your review. We are delighted to know that you had a pleasant experience during your stay with us, we are looking forward to welcoming you again!

title: Good location
text: Well situated and comfortable in East Hamilton near Hamilton Gardens. Room was well appointed, very clean and service was excellent.  No outdoor facilities for visitors. Small kitchen had all essential tools.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking time to post your review of our motel. We do appreciate all the great comments about our location, cleanliness and service. We are looking forward to welcoming you again!

title: Comfortable and clean
text: Very good accommodation for the price paid. Clean and reasonably spacious. All kitchen utilities very handy. Car parking at the front door. Unlimited WiFi in our unit. Would preferred smokers area as outside the unit has the smoke lingering into neighbouring units
hotel_response: Thank you very much for your positive review and also for your useful recommendation. Your feedback is much appreciated and we hope to see you again in the near future!

title: Horrible
text: Horrid. They sent breakfast worth 70 to my room and allowed someone else to order whilst i wasnt there. They accused me of taking a tv remote and a $20 dollar electric heater. They would not give me milk everyday like most motels because she gave me a discount for staying for two weeks. And had the cleaner not told me i would never have known that because she discounted me for staying for two weeks i would have not been allowed a set of clean sheets, pillow cases and blankets.they took my bond amd never refunded $10 i gave them to do my laundry which never got done. Am disgusted.

title: An unfortunate event
text: Unfortunately, we did not stay at Aspen Manor Motel as the booking, inexplicably, had a glitch between Booking.com and Aspen Manor.  Consequently 26 people turned up on a busy Labour Weekend expecting 13 rooms and only found 1 booked.  Nobody stayed as all were travelling together on a bus and needed to stay at the same place.

title: Overnight Stay
text: Very quiet area of Hamilton east, close to city and other places of interest.  Friendly staff at both checkin and checkout.  Area was clean and tidy and room was very comfortable, with all amenities that we needed
hotel_response: Thank you for your positive feedback, we're happy to hear that our room was equipped with everything you needed. We hope to see you again in the near future :)

title: Cheap and clean!
text: The place was clean and spacious. The price of a 2 bedroom family unit is very affordable. This place is very close to shops, city centre, parks and museum. I definitely recommend this place if you are looking for a very affordable place to stay :)
hotel_response: Thank you for your encouraging feedback :)

title: Good motel to stay in Hamilton East
text: Good sized rooms, quiet but handy location.  We were very happy that the motel found a necklace that we had unknowingly left behind.  Decor a bit dated, could do with an upgrade.  We have stayed here before and would likely stay again.
hotel_response: Thank you for your wonderful feedback :)

title: Regular Stayer
text:
Good price and good size rooms, beds are comfortable and parking directly is outside of room. Rooms have cooking facilities and shops are 5 - 10mins away.
Nice staff and a good breakfast.
Downside some items are like rubbish bins are due for replacement but other wise fine.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, both the positive and the constructive! It is helpful to know what we are doing right and what we need to improve on, so thank you and we hope you remain a regular guest :)

title: Amazing environment
text:
When I came to New Zealand I didn't have any place to go and I came here to stay for a while until I find a house.
I felt like I'm in my home country, very clean  , everything was great, they were super kind and they don't just think about money, even they looked after me for everything.
Aspen hotel is feels like home
hotel_response: Your kind words really do encourage us to keep up with our goal here at Aspen - "providing a home away from home" for our guests and we would be delighted to accommodate you again in the future :)

title: Convenient and very comfortable
text:
Aspen Manor was great for a work trip.
The room is very comfortable and has all the amenities I needed.
I will look to go back there for future trips and am very happy to recommend to others looking for work accommodation.
hotel_response: Thank you for your encouraging feedback! We look forward to accommodating your next stay, here in Hamilton :)

title: Distinctly mediocre
text:
First up, I'm not saying "don't stay here". It's in a reasonable location and offers fair value. It simply didn't go the extra mile in my view.

Check in was simple and quick. The room was fine, but we had a two ring hob not a four and the galley kitchen was a little cramped.  Everything was clean but I just got the impression from a few little things that the guests weren't the priority. For example, a knife from the cutlery drawer actually bent while I was spreading butter and the washing up liquid (which was provided free I have to say) was so thin that it must have been diluted. Also, if you wanted a coffee plunger, you had to go to reception. They weren't stored in the room due to thefts!! Finally, the tv remote only worked to turn it on. Off was hand only.

I appreciate these are small things but when you've paid NZD $580 for three nights you expect a little better.

Beds etc were fine and there're a couple of bars and restaurants in easy walking distance. CBD is around 15mins walk so the location is good. There's free onsite parking and free wifi an sky TV. Its not all bad!!
hotel_response:
Hi there,
Thank you for your honest feedback and while we do value your fair critique, I would like to push that, our guests ARE our first priority. 
Unfortunately, we have had one too many coffee plungers nicked from the rooms to leave them in there but when requested, they are easily picked up from reception.
We have looked at both the cutlery and remote in each of our rooms and are making the necessary changes to ensure these irritants are not repeated for other guests. 
Again, we do appreciate your feedback as this helps us provide a more satisfying experience for future guests and we do hope you will be one of them!

title: Quiet and comfortable
text:
Quiet and comfortable motel. Parking outside and free wifi.
Friendly welcome, not too far from cafes etc. Reasonable price - slightly inflated due to Lions match and about 30 minutes walk to stadium.
Heater in room plus tea, coffee etc.
Would stay here again.
hotel_response: Thank you for your positive feedback :) We would be thrilled to accommodate your next visit here in Hamilton!

title: Don't Stay here
text: We were a party of 4 people and had made a booking with booking.com for which we gave credit card details and had a confirmation number, we were running a bit Late so rang to explain this only to be told that they had no Record of our Booking and they were full despite our having a booking confirmation they then became very Arrogant telling us to go away as they were full, they quite clearly have severe Administration Problems and their customer Service is non-existant for theses reasons alone, I would suggest that people avoid this establishment if at all possible
hotel_response:
Hi there,
In regards to the booking failure, we are putting it down to a glitch in the computer software we use for the management of our bookings. The software we use is operated by a third party and not one we entirely control ourselves. 
The booking system we use takes in bookings from numerous channels, and it updates every fifteen minutes. During this fifteen minute period however, reception can directly book rooms for people who contact us in person or over the phone, subsequently putting those who have booked online into temp rooms and that is why you would still have been sent a confirmation email.
We have since contacted the providers of the software and requested a solution to the problem and it now updates every two minutes instead of fifteen. 
As for the treatment you received from staff, we can only but deeply apologise for this and in no way did we mean to come off as "arrogant". We have since been trying to implement a better behaviour protocol for when times such as this arise.  
It is still regrettable that we could not take you in and we do apologise for the embarrassment of not being able to accommodate you and your group.

title: Nice spa.
text: Thought the rooms were tidy and looked after. Our room had a two person spa in it was great. Have no reason to complain would stay again (: kitchen is gallery and not too tiny. We had two rooms separated by kitchen. Was good little set up.
hotel_response: Thank you for your positive review; we hope you may choose Aspen Manor again with your next visit to Hamilton :)

Several contradictory explanations later , from an extremely rude person on the phone, we gave up.  I am still awaiting a response from both the hotel and from Booking.com, nearly four weeks later.  Not in any way indicative of the general welcome and efficiency we found in New Zealand.

text:
We had booked a room for 28 March for 4 people and advised we would be arriving late. Received confirmation from booking.com.
As we were driving to Hamilton on a very wet evening we phoned the hotel at around 8.10 pm to advise we would arrive around 9 pm.  They advised they had received the booking but they did not have a room for us.  We had provided a mobile number and an email address but no attempt was made to advise us.  No apology was offered.  
We were left high and wet!
I would advise to avoid this hotel.

title: Tired
text: Generally the motel is tired and needs a serious makeover.  The bathroom was particularly poor with mould in several areas.  Reception was distinctly unfriendly and the breakfast was unreasonably expensive. This will be my last visit to this motel.

title: Average...
text: The two places we normally stay at were both booked out so we chose Aspen Manor for our overnight stay. Separate bedroom with spa and a single bed in the lounge. Bed was comfortable enough.  Unit was clean and tidy although bathroom/kitchen are dated.  One spa headrest was missing, the other unattached. No towels in the unit, so had to ring and ask for some (I had read a review that said the same thing).  Sofa in the lounge seats two uncomfortably.  It was quite busy the night we stayed but it was quiet.  Welcome at reception was average and I got asked to pay even though I had prepaid but that was easily sorted.  It was okay for a night's stay.  There is a dairy directly across the road which was handy and it's also a 5min drive to the CBD.

title: Overpriced and tired
text: A colleague and myself booked into a twin room unit.  The front room (presumably what used to be the lounge) had a queen bed stuck in it and the back room also had a queen bed with a small seating area off to the side. There was no lounge as such to watch TV together unless we sat on the bed.  The bathroom sliding door was off its runners and propped up against the wall.  This must have been known to the owners as the pelmet was also off and leaning against the wall in the bedroom.  We couldn't get this working and as such had no privacy when using the bathroom.  The extractor fan in the bathroom was incredibly noisy.  The décor was cheap - some copper flowers that were stuck to the wall with blue tac.  One fell off onto the floor just after we arrived - we hadn't even touched it.  The two flannels folded up in the bathroom looked like that had brown foundation makeup on them.  Overall, the unit (26) was tired and shabby; very overpriced for what it was. The good however ... beds were comfortable and clean; shower was clean; the owner was friendly and let us store our bags in the office during the day while we attended a business function.  Regrettably, we wouldn't stay here again.

title: Pokey rooms but good enough
text: Ok for what we needed but would look elsewhere if we went back to the area. Have stayed in much nicer places for much less money. Rooms a bit small for what you pay for and layout of wasn't easiest to adapt to. Bathroom door was partially off the rail so difficult to slide open/closed and there was something gooey wrapped in a glove in the freezer. Lovely front of house staff and good location though

title: Seems like Hit n Miss with reviews!
text:
It just wasn't a good first impression. Unfortunately an unpleasant smell hit me when I opened the room. I suggest you look into cleaning your soft furnishings, (carpet, couch), including the dirty finger prints left on the curtains. The remote controls for the tv were covered in some greasy substance! I needed to wipe everything before I touched it. Booked for 3 adults, could've done with 3 chairs for the dinner table No tea towel left to dry dishes. 

Location great
Staff relatively polite
Comfortable bed
Found the location relatively quiet for where it is
Parking rather tight if you have a large vehicle

title: One night stay
text: Have stayed here several times now and will continue to do so. The rooms are of good size and well presented having recently been upgraded to a high standard with modern fixtures and decor, and everything was very clean and tidy. The beds are comfortable and all linen clean and fresh. About 10 minutes drive from The University of Waikato is another plus for us.

title: Some work on's for new owners
text:
We stayed in one of the spa pool units.
Nice option to have. However the re-purposed door handles for taps needs improving.
Our main issue was cleanliness.  Extra effort is needed to get the place back to a "clean" standard. Mould on curtains and marks on walls. Dust and dirt in every gap throughout, extractor fan, Window sills, the sanitizer unit on the spa pool. The place did not "feel clean" .
I understand the owners are new, but they will need to take extra steps to ensure things do not get worse. 
They also need to walk around the grounds and pickeep up rubbish etc daily, there was broken glass in the car park outside our unit.
Customers like us will put extra effort to clean our mess if the owners appear to work hard at keeping the property and rooms clean.

title: Average
text: Room wasn't flash, dirty face cloth hanging over shower rail. Curtains had mould along with mould on the walls. Not hard to give them a wipe. Rubbish under the bed. Reception was average. No told about WI Fi or anything actually. Was an average stay

title: Value for money motel
text: Location was our priority and as we have stayed at Aspen Manor previously and not had any issues we chose to stay again and have three further bookings going forward. However we have chosen the twin Queen unit for the future bookings which was not available on this occasion however the one bedroom unit had everything that we required, in particular a comfortable couch to relax on.
hotel_response: Thank you for your positive feedback, we look forward to hosting you again in the future :)

title: a let down
text: Booked this motel as it had good ratings. Asked if we could be picked up from train station. After an hour driver came as he didn't know where it was. He parked 2 streets away,walked to the station and asked if we could carry our bags to where he parked.We said no,he could drive to where we were, which was only a 2 door older car. After arriving at motel, went to our room which looked very dated, decided to have a spa and checked the towels beforehand.There were 6 and all of them were damp, as if they had been used and just rolled up again.I could go on, but i am over foreigners who can't speak good English taking over everything in NZ. Thank you NZ Govt. Would not recommend this motel.
hotel_response:
Dear Berkyboy1, 

Thank you very much for posting up your review. Firstly, I would like to sincerely apologise again for the damp towels in the room. That has not happened before and will most definitely not happen again. We pride ourselves in taking care of our guests here and, therefore, we made sure that we were quick to replace those towels for you as well as returning 10% of your room rate. 

In regards to your comments about the transport from the train station to the motel, we do not have a chauffeur service here at Aspen. However, when you were asking us about transport options, we offered this as an extra, complimentary service to try to make it easier for you to get here. We sent one of our reception staff out to pick you up but it was very hard to get in touch with you via the cell phone number that you provided us with – which is why it took a while to locate you. 

The reception staff member that you are referring to has had some amazing reviews prior to your one and is a very polite and well-spoken person. He used his own car to pick you up in and would most likely have asked you to walk to his car as it is quite hard to find car parking in Hamilton. You may have found your transport experience not satisfactory, but you do have to understand that this is a service that we do not usually offer. However, we did our best to provide it to you regardless. 

Thank you again for taking the time to write us a review. All feedback is good feedback as it gives us the opportunity to look at what we need to improve upon. 

Kind Regards,

Grace

title: Peter & Shirley
text:
Due to booking problems elsewhere this was a last minute booking. Assistance given by the front desk at ASPEN was first class and immediately made us feel at home, Room was very good,plenty of space and well laid out (Business Studio)
We only stayed the 1 night but have already lodge a request for a further 10 nights accommodation
hotel_response:
Hi Peter & Shirley,

Thank you very much for your warm words that are really encouraged us. I really appreciate it.

title: Great service
text: We arrived early due to attending a wedding and the man on the front desk was very accommodating and allowed us to check in early to iron a shirt! He was friendly, polite and excessively helpful with directions and a few tips as we hadn't been in the area before. The room was spacious and clean although not much TP was supplied and we resorted to tissues at the end of the night. We had room service breakfast and despite them being VERY busy breakfast was lovely and delivered with a smile. I'm kicking myself I didn't get his name but whoever was working on the afternoon of 28 Jan and morning of 29 Jan, give him a raise!

title: Very helpful
text: In Hamilton for a softball tournament over Auckland Anniversary weekend and had to fit in 15 pax. Aspen Manor was a great base for the team. We had a couple of people drop out and when I phoned, they adjusted the booking with no problems at all.  The only down thing was the laundry was out of service so uniforms had to be washed in the bathroom sinks.  A lot of amenities were very handy.  Handy to the city centre
hotel_response:
Hi Jones,

Thank you very for taking your time to post the review. It was so nice to read that you enjoyed your stay with us. I am sorry about the broken down laundry while your stay. however, we still provide the laundry service in the facility laundry which is writhen in the compendium. I sincerely apologise for the less communication. We will put a clear note in the guest laundry. 

Kind regards

Grace

title: Aspen Manor is great!
text:
My family and I stayed in two units for three days over Christmas to be near family- and it was the perfect place for us!
We were greeted by friendly helpful staff (family run) and the units were spotless and well equipped.
hotel_response:
Hi Jan,

Thank you very much for taking your time to share the review. It is so lovely to read that you enjoy your stay. We'd like to satisfied our guests.

Kind regards

Grace

title: Good location - disappointing service
text: This was a well priced motel - the rooms were about what you'd expect for the money - a huge plus was that it was VERY quiet. Unfortunately, the rooms weren't serviced during our two night stay - we asked for clean towels on day 2, and were left 2 more (for the three of us) on day 3. They didn't even check the toilet paper, which we discovered when we returned at 9pm - luckily my husband had a roll in the car!
hotel_response:
Hi Jo, firstly thank you for taking the time to post your review. As you can imagine this is not the type of experience that we wanted you to have at Aspen Manor Motel and we absolutely apologise for not meeting your expectations during your stay with us. 
Secondly, I know there is nothing I can do to change this experience of stay. All I can say is to thank you again for pointing out this problem, especialy for me- a new owener. As if we don't know that something is not right, we cannot look to change it or fix it. This let me know what our service should be improved. My team and myself will do better service in the future. I really appreciate it, Jo.

title: Aspen Manor, Hamilton - you are the best
text: Aspen Manor is easy to get to, very close to shops and eateries. Aspen Manor staff are very welcoming and friendly. Our room was very clean, tidy, comfortable and had everything we needed. We would highly recommend this motel, it is a great place to stay and we will definitely stay there again. 10 out of 10 for us Aspen Manor Motel, Hamilton.
hotel_response: Thank you we really appreciated your feedback and you sharing with others that you found the Aspen Manor Motel a great place to stay, clean, comfortable and with everything you needed. Aspen Manor is indeed easy to get to and very close to shops and eateries. The team at Aspen Manor are so glad you will visit again and we look forward to welcoming you the next time you are in Hamilton.

title: Great
text:
Close to hamilton gardens for a cheap taxi fare after wedding there.  Quiet, nicely decorated and comfortable bed.
Only down side which was small was the toilet was overly noisy upon flushing.  
They let us check out at 11 which was hugely appreciated after a late night at a wedding
hotel_response: Thank you Sandy for the lovely review, we are so pleased you enjoyed your stay and found our motel quiet and nicely decorated with a comfortable bed. We hope to see you again the next time you visit Hamilton.

title: Convenient motel option close to city and Hamilton East shops
text: Friendly staff and clean facilities delivered all I needed for a one night stay for business purposes. The room had plenty of space, with table and two chairs, comfy bed, a wee kitchen with cooking and serving equipment, handy to Hamilton East for good dining options and quality takeout food, was an easy drive to the office at the southern end of the city next day. Good reading light above the bed. Could be improved with black out curtaining, as the external lights are bright, and by including an armchair or small couch. Overall, easy access and parking and fairly competitive rates.
hotel_response: Thank you Sandy for sharing with others that you found Aspen Manor to be a convenient motel option close to the city and Hamilton East shops. We are delighted you found our staff friendly and our facilities clean with plenty of space and a good reading light above the bed. Thank you for letting us know about the external lights being bright and the need for a armchair / small couch in the room, as new management at Aspen Manor we are grateful for ideas on how we can improve.  We are glad you enjoyed your stay and hope to see you again the next time you are in Hamilton.

title: Average all rounder
text: A bit disappointed by first impressions which were very dirty mirror in lounge with a single bed in it which greeted us. Wet patch on bedroom carpet and broken microwave. Could do with upgrading and renovation all round. Bearable for one night.

title: Good motel option close to Hamilton East amenities
text: The owners were very accommodating and the room was good - basically a modernised standard motel room but very clean and tidy.  Plenty of room even with an extra rollaway bed.  The queen bed was a bit softer than my preference but everything was perfectly comfortable.  Nice to be offered some trim milk on arrival with complimentary teas/coffees/hot choc sachets. Room also had fan and heater and the all-important FREE WIFI!!

title: Outstanding
text: This motel ticked every box; well furnished and modernized standard room with great kitchen basics, extremely clean and attractive. Quiet neighbourhood but close to the city center. Great price for the room. Friendly reception. I wouldn't look to stay anywhere else in Hamilton for my next visit!

title: Nice place :)
text: The room was very big and comfortable, has it's own kitchen and bathroom. The bed was comfy, has heater and Tv. It is a little bit far from the cuty centre if you don't have your own transport, but pretty close to the beautiful gardens.

title: Relaxing
text: Had a lovely peaceful stay. The spa pool was a treat. The cooked breakfast was superbly cooked to specifications. Separate bedroom from the lounge. There is a dairy right opposite and it's just a short distance from the hamilton gardens.

title: Great as usual
text:
Room just what we needed.Clean and quiet with Laundry on site.Walking distance to Hamilton East shops - note market day on Saturday mornings and great selection of restaurants  including Turkish and Asian foods. Staff friendly and helpful. 
 Close to Hamilton Gardens and easy access to Motorway.

title: Short stay. Good room. Very friendly service
text:
A good example of a well-run motel. Friendly and helpful management

The room was large with a spacious bathroom and kitchen. Great value for a 3 night stay.

Plenty of food nearby. Kiwis really do need to tone down the whole coffee culture thing though. It's a drink, not a religion.

title: staying 1 night
text: overall all was lovely, but in room 28 it was catered for 4 persons, like 4 plates, cups, glasses etc but there were no 4 proper table chairs around the table to eat.  it would be easier if there were .4 table chairs available.

title: Comfortable, great value accommodation
text: Nicely appointed unit. Stayed in the two bedroom which was great value. Spacious enough and close to restaurants and the CBD. Hosts are warm, welcoming and organised. The unit was clean and comfortable, including the beds!

title: Quiet, convenient, comfortable.
