text: I was on business and had very long, busy days and Simon and Lornae were super helpful and extremely efficient in assisting me for whatever I needed. Beds are fabulously comfortable, great kitchen facilities and just about everything you need.

title: Nice Tidy Room
text: The Reason we choose this motel was for the private in-room spa. Unfortunately the jets didn't work so it ended up being just a big bath. Overall a nice tidy motel and good quiet place to stay.  Apart from that one thing I would recommend it!

title: clean comfortable all amenities
text: Aspen Manor was close to Southern Cross Hospital so was convenient for our 1 week stay. It was everything we needed with adult family support also staying, needing 2 separate bedrooms and amenities for a long stay. It was quiet and peaceful  We also discovered the area had many great restaurants and shops. We would return to this clean comfortable motel.

title: 1 Nite only
text: Only stayed there as I had an early flight the next morning.  They are in the middle of renovations, my room was done - probably a 3*.  Next time I would probably try somewhere else. Parking was tight as I arrived late.

title: Lovely bed!
text: We had a family unit that slept my friend and myself and our two older teen sons.  1 bedroom sleeping to single and the other had a queen bed and a single.  Downstairs had a single bed in the living room.  The unit itself is basic and clean.  It does have a narrow kitchenette, the lighting is a little dark in this area but good cooking surface and a dishwasher!  There was a tv downstairs and one in the master bedroom.  If they offered sky then I couldn't figure out how to get it to work.  There was a sky brochure in the room but if the teenagers couldn't get it to work, then no one could.  I slept in the Queen bed and have to say it was extremely comfortable and I loved the pillows. The unit is quiet, the only downside was it did rain quite a lot in the night and maybe one of the gutters outside is blocked because there were some very loud dripping after the rain eased off.  Would happily stay here again.

title: Long weekend stay
text: The motel was easy to find on a main street and the reception on arrival was very friendly and helpful. The one bedroom unit, recently upgraded, was very clean, warm and well appointed with both rooms having a TV which was a bonus. We travel to Hamilton on a regular basis and this has been the best motel so far for all round convenience, accommodation and cost.

title: Our number one go to!
text: When we have an overnight stay in Hamilton, there isn't any other place we think of. The family units offer so much space that everyone can chill out together or in there own space. Plenty of bedding and electric blankets for those chilly nights!

title: Quiet and cosy
text:
Good for a quiet stay. It's far enough from the city to be quiet but close enough to walk to it as well. Not far from a small shopping area. We liked that the kitchen area is compacted and out of view in the cupboard.  Offers multiple sky channels but only 2 movie ones
 Would stay again.

title: Another good stay
text:
A repeat business trip for 2 nights, with the motel booked by the club employing me.  This time I was sharing a 2 bedroom unit with a friend, and it was lovely to have a bedroom each.  The bedrooms were upstairs so were warm with the heat rising, but the wooden staircase up was quite creaky, especially in the middle of the night.  The rooms were very quiet, little road noise as set well back from the road.

There are excellent eateries within walking distance of the motel.

The weather was not overly cold so we coped with the heater provided, but I still think the units should have heatpumps installed.  

Well set-up kitchen if one was cooking, and the Continental breakfasts (on a tray delivered to the unit each evening) were excellent with good choices.

The only gripe was the bathroom, which has an inadequate fan so it takes ages for the mirror to demist after using the shower.  With no mirrors in the bedrooms, this was a big disadvantage for two women.

title: Good value
text: This older style motel is located in Hamilton East within an easy walk of shops and cafes. The room was clean and comfortable and easy to heat. Off-street parking is very good. Wifi service was excellent. it was very good value for money for an overnight business stop.

title: Quiet Motel unit
text:
Needed overnight accommodation in Hamilton due to eye surgery and follow up clinic next morning.
Aspen Manor Motel were offering a unit with 2 Queen beds at an excellent rate. 
As it turned out the beds were in separate rooms which was a bonus. 
We ordered continental breakfasts which arrived on time and met our expectations.
Will be booking this unit again next time we need accommodation in Hamilton

title: Aspen manor
text: Pretty average. Good handy location. Expensive for an average motel. Comfortable bed. Clean. Shower room/ bathroom tiny . The hosts were friendly and accommodating allowed us to leave car parked at motel after we had checked out. Handy to excellent restaurants. Handy to hospital which is why we chose it

title: A great stay- but don't rely on keeping your parking bay
text: Wonderful place to stay. We booked one of the Spa Units which are situated at the back of the Motel. Room was dated but extremely clean and the Spa in the bedroom was absolute luxury. However you will be disappointed if you are expecting to keep your allocated car parking bay for the whole of your stay- another car parked in our bay and the motel could do nothing to move them, leaving us to park elsewhere and walk to our room.

title: Very relaxing getaway.
text:
Stayed two nights in a spa unit. The spa was incredible. The unit was immaculately clean, well stocked and serviced. Great for a romantic get away or equally as good for a family. Walking distance to a good variety of dining options.

The only dissapointment during our stay was to come back to our room after a night out to find our allocated carpark occupied and we were forced to park a good walk away from our unit. But this was a minor inconvenience.

I would highly recommend staying here and would happily visit again.

title: Spa Unit was great!
text: Myself and two young children stayed three nights in a Spa Unit which was wonderful and relaxing for all after our long busy days.  Units were very well maintained and daily servicing was excellent.  A well laid out unit with ample space to spread out.

title: Excellent
text: Great location.. Easy accsess.made to feel very welcome. Handy to many activities In Hamilton and around the area. Great place to stay and affordable. Quieter location from traffic noise. Children are very welcome

title: best motel
text: We use motels all the time for our work. We like to have a t least two rooms and kitchen facilities. This motel unit had 4 rooms, the bed was so comfortable..the bed felt expensive..we loved everything about it and have asked the organiser of our tours to book us there again. We LOVED it. Didn't want to leave

title: Quiet ,relaxed and conveniently located
text: Rooms were  really quiet. Proprietors were relaxed and friendly Aspen Manor motel is conveniently  located  close to university ,on site parking and ease of access off main course. Would book again thank you

title: very great place to stay
text:
From the time we arrived for our 3 nights, the staff were great and helpfull.
The room was a good size and very clean and they serviced each morning.
The location was great only a few minutes to town & the gardens.
Great place to stay
They are part of the Host group

title: Nice Motel!
text: 2 double beds and nice size kitchen. Suitable for a small family or a small group. Plenty of parking. Quiet and well equipped kitchen.large rooms and comfortable bed. Sadly one of the room was not cleaned thoroughly and we found some nasty human hair stucked in a hardened nosepick on the wall by the bed.

title: Lack luster service, lovely rooms
text:
Booked a spa unit, spa hot tap was broken so couldn't use it.  Not the motels fault but their response to being informed of it was confrontational rather than apologetic. Was told they would follow up but never heard from them again. 
Otherwise the motel is in a great location, and the rooms are wonderfully clean and the beds comfortable. Plenty of parking off street.

title: Excellent Quality Room & Decor
text:
Stayed one night in a business suite during the Balloons Over Waikato Festival. Very nice room & bathroom with good quality, well maintained décor & facilities.
Very comfy bed.
Diappointing not to have aircon, but I didn't check that when booking the room. However there was a good pedestal fan to use.
Would definitely stay again.

title: We stayed there for one night with the family
text: We booked for 5 rooms with the whole family and friends and we had a pleasant time. The Motel is situated by the main road but it is surprisingly quite. The rooms are very comfortable and clean. We will definitely coming back.

title: Very peaceful place, staff are very friendly and the price is very reasonable
text: A very peaceful place to stay close to Hamilton town center, Hamilton Gardens, Waikato River and shops. The staff are very friendly and very helpful. Had a great time with my family and friends after my wedding.

title: Great Place to Stay
text: I regularly stay at the Aspen Manor Motel on business.  The accommodation is well appointed, clean, quiet, well maintained, with onsite parking all at a competitive room rate.  Aspen is well positioned within the city for traveling to the CBD, University, local restaurants/takeaway outlets, shops and so on.  The owners are very polite and efficient when checking in.  I take advantage of the breakfast and recommend the homemade muesli breakfast (other types of breakfast are also available).  I've stayed in many motels across New Zealand and the Aspen Manor Motel is one of the better ones and as such I'm very happy to recommend the motel and write this review.

title: Nice,clean, and well maintained. Quiet area
text: We have stayed here before and will continue to stay there in future trips we have to Hamilton. It is close to the main part of Hamilton, yet far enough away to avoid the noise.  We would recommend people to stay there. We have stayed at several motels in Hamilton before we discovered Aspen, and now we wouldn't stay anywhere else when visiting Hamilton

title: Quiet, comfortable and convenient.
text: Clean well appointed rooms. The complex is well located and is easy to access from all directions. Basic services are very close in the adjacent shopping centre, and the river walk is a real feature of this part of the city.

title: Convenient to Restaurants
text: This property was close enough to the CBD that we could walk to a restaurant for dinner.  It was very clean which is really important to me.  We were four adults and there was plenty of room as we had a two bedroom unit.  It would have slept six easily.  My only complaint is that the pillows were very thin.  Thank goodness there was extra bedding as everyone needed at least two pillows.

title: Worst motel stay
text: This was the worst motel stay I have ever had in NZ. Starting with an inefficient check in which took ages as they couldn't find the booking to start with. The room was tired, with peeling wall paper, ripped shower curtain and not very clean feeling - like you don't want to touch anything. The mattress is well past it's use-by date, it was extremely warm with no air conditioning. Though what really topped it off is having a huge group of young people in the room adjacent/above us. They would have been way over room capacity and kept us up until 4am! And in a unit behind us there was a group of people having a party with loud music.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review.  We welcome all feedback from our guests.  Your booking was under your companions name who had booked a few rooms with us that is why we could not locate your room at first.  It is our understanding that you would not have had to wait longer than five minutes to be checked in.  We also operate a system where all guests can contact us 24/7 from the handsets in the units by just dialling 7, this info is next to each telephone in the unit.  If there is a loud guest next to you, all we expect is a call to let us know.  We don’t mind if someone contacts us at 2am to tell us about a problem, we would have sorted it out.  We try to do all that we can to ensure that a guest has a happy night with us.  As far as the bed is concerned, some people like a hard mattress, some people like a soft mattress and some people like it in between.  As you can imagine not everyone likes the same firmness.  We get loads of compliments about our beds and about how comfortable they are.  We are sorry that the beds were not to your liking.  We are in the process of doing a refurb to the motel.  We are aware that the units need to be repainted but as you can appreciate we have 31 units to look after and refurb, so the equivalent of 31 homes.  We are working our way through it and we have a refurb plan in place though we will relook at the order we refurb our rooms after your feedback.  If you would like to discuss these points further please feel free to contact us directly. Simon and Lornae

title: A Friendly, Value for Money Motel
text: Really enjoyed staying in this motel. A quiet location in a busy city. The owners are super friendly and go out of their way to be helpful. The room was spotless and beautifully decorated. With two double beds in different rooms and a kitchen between, it was wonderful. Would be great for families or for business colleagues as there is private space for all. Although there was no air conditioning two fans were provided and were more than adequate (it was VERY hot when we stayed. Another bonus was two flat screen televisions in the rooms. My sister and I stayed here while dad was in Hamilton hospital. It was perfect, close to the hospital but not too far from the city. There are also plenty of food outlets in the surrounding area. Real Value for money, I will certainly return and highly recommend to others visiting Hamilton for whatever reason.
hotel_response: Hi Jill, thank you so much for your review.  It was a pleasure having you stay and we look forward to welcoming you back at some point.  Simon and Lornae

title: Comfortable and friendly
text: I stay here on business reasonably often. Although it doesn't look much from the road it is very clean, comfortable, quiet and you feel safe - important for women travelling for work or holiday . You will be well taken care of. Cooked breakfasts are awesome.
hotel_response: Hi, thank you so much for your review and we are very glad that you enjoy staying with us when you are in Hamilton.  Yes we can't do much about our view from the street but we can be helpful, accommodating, clean, comfortable and let's not forget the cooked breakfasts!  See you next time. Simon and Lornae

title: Outdated/overpriced
text:
3 of us stayed here early February in a one bedroom unit. The rooms were extremely hot with no air con and only one portable fan which didn't oscillate. It was a room for 3 ppl but only had 2 easy chairs to sit in and only 2 chairs at dining table. Bathroom very small and old with a shower curtain that hung out over  the edge of the shower so that water went on the floor. 
The floor in bathroom and kitchen was very tacky and sticky it needed a good clean.
The beds were comfy which was a good point . It was also very quiet with no road noise.
Overall we wouldn't stay again as the price of $170/night for a very dated room we thought was way too much.
hotel_response: Hi. Firstly thanks for choosing to stay with us.  We are sorry that you didn't enjoy your stay.  We aim to see to our guests needs and if you were not happy with your room, or lack of fans we could have accommodated you if you had told us.  We would not have minded if you had called us at 2am with a problem, we would have been happy to help.  At the next place that you stay, let the managers know if there is anything that you are not happy with before you leave, that will help them to help you enjoy your stay.  Simon and Lornae

title: Lovely motel
text:
Thank you to dean berry, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. You were very helpful and pleasant. We would definitely stay anywhere he was managing. 

The motel was very tidy and clean. The bed were so comfortable.
hotel_response: Hi Annmarie, glad that you enjoyed your stay at the motel.  Dean is an excellent minder for us and thanks for your kind words, I will pass them onto him.  Simon and Lornae

title: I'm living in a parallel universe...
text:
I stayed at the Aspen Manor Motel recently when I couldn't stay at the motel I normally stay in when I'm in Hamilton on business. Having looked through the other reviews (skewed to the upside) I feel like I'm living in a parallel universe. However, I'll share my experience in any case.

My room was "minimalist" but tidy and the electric blanket worked on one side of the bed only (not a major drama because I was by myself but not good attention to detail). If that were all I would rate it average not poor. The thing that tipped the balance to poor was the fact that I (and other guests) were treated to all-night noise from another unit. When I attempted to contact the owners about this problem at 10.30pm there was no response from reception. I complained (together with another guest) when checking out and we received sympathy but no apology nor any offer of compensation for our duress.

I won't stay at this motel again accordingly.

title: West
text: Very helpful  owners as was a last minute  trip to attend a funeral. Excellent  service and facilities would highly recommend.  The room was very good and suitable with a separate  bedroom for family members. Good comfortable  beds.

title: Average to good place to stay
text: Large bedroom with good comfortable beds. Could maybe have done with a sofa rather than the single bed for a comfy seat. Free wifi - always good to have. Kitchen area and shower/toilet area could maybe be updated at some stage but functional and all you need so just being fussy really! Layout of hotel meant that there was no road noise in the rooms. Good value compared to some other motels in Hamilton. Handy to Grey Street shops and cafes plus Jett's gym just down the road too which always sways my decision making! Walking distance to Hamilton Gardens

title: Well located
text:
This place does what is says it does.
The room was clean and recently painted, albeit a shade darker than I would have picked. A new toilet seat would make quite a difference, but overall the stay was pleasant and there a bunch of bight and breezy eatery options within a few minutes walk.

title: One Bedroom Unit with Spa
text:
Our first impressions were that we had everything we needed. 

Good parking. 
Spacious rooms. 
Free wifi. 
Quiet area. 
No noise from rooms next door.
Comfortable beds.

There's is nothing fancy about the rooms and they could do with a bit of a "joosh" but we were more than happy with it for the price we paid. We had chosen to stay here specifically for the spa which was located inside the room, right next to our bed - luxury! Unfortunately, 3/5 times we tried to fill the spa, the water ran cold. The first time, we were promised it would be remedied and indeed, we had two warm spas following that. However, when we tried to prepare one the following morning, it had gone back to being cold. I think it's important to give people a chance to remedy a situation and indeed, we spoke with the owners in the morning. After some reluctance, they took half of the cost from our upgrade price which is why my rating is a 3 and not a 2. I do think, however, that if you offer a particular service and do not provide it (consistently), you should not charge for it. 

I think it's also worth noting for older or not as physically-abled readers, that there is no rail to assist with entering and exiting the spa bath. 

We couldn't access the Wifi from the bedroom although we were able to get it in the lounge area.

All in all - OK. Affordable and has everything you need - as long as you don't need a spa!

title: Great Affordable Accommodation
text: Great motel, very spacious rooms, clean and tidy.  The bathroom is huge and the amenities are good.  Close to city centre.  Very friendly staff.  Would definitely recommend if you are looking for great affordable accommodation

title: Pleasantly pleased
text: Always a gamble when booking in for the first time. Good parking, easy room access, roomy room with free wifi and modern amenities. Room service excellent. We had a restful stay, and have no hesitation in recommending to others.

title: Very comfortable, enjoyed use of conference room
text: Two day business staying on site and use of the conference room. Free WiFi use during our business stay. Lovely spacious rooms. Huge comfy bed. Loved the soak in the bath. Ordered cooked breakie with the works, top chef. Easy walking distance to cafe for lunches and dinner. Enjoyable stay. This is now our preferred place for business and second time in 6 mths. 6 of us come from different parts of nz.

title: Large complex, close to food options
text: This is a reasonably large complex. We stayed in a 2 storey apartment - bedrooms upstairs and lounge/kitchen/bathroom below. Overall it was nice enough. There's no heat-pump, just assorted free-standing heaters. There is no sound insulation between the levels either and every little sound from downstairs travels upstairs. Just up the road are the usual fast food places, and a few restaurants.

title: Always excellent
text: I always stay at the Aspen Manor when visiting Hamilton. The rooms have everything I need, they're quiet and private, warm in the winter and cool in the summer. The service and facilities are great, and the hosts friendly. Highly recommended.

title: Best in Hamilton
text:
We travel a lot to Hamilton because we live overseas but all my family are in Hamilton.  We have stayed in a load of places, and this is the only one I came to a second time.  
The others all had little issues that were just basically a pain and made it difficult to stay for a length of time - we tend to stay for 3 weeks in Hamilton.
This place is always clean, the family running it are local and lovely, very helpful people.  The furnishings are nice, and the kitchens in the family units include all the utensils you'd need, 4 burners on the stove and (get this) a dishwasher - bliss!!!  The fridge is also a really good size - when you've got kids you really need that.

title: A definite return
text:
Great location very quiet very comfy beds loved the makeup remover flannel👍Hot shower fantastic. Never thought about a bath at the time of booking as I had a 4yr grandchild with me! Just a tip for those with a small child.
My only criticism with the room and this applies to many Motels is leaving a heater on all night and as it was a VERY COLD NIGHT probably -2 overnight AND with a small child there was no way I was sleeping in a cold room
Wish Moteliers  would invest in small heat pumps Its safer and perhaps on very cold days having the room warm on arrival. If one does give a time guest will arrive
Will certainly be back to use this motel.

title: Good business motel
text: bed was comfortable, room spacious and well decorated, bath was a bonus (with VERY hot water) and the internet was good so no complaints for a nights' stay during business in Hamilton.  My only comment would be that if you were staying in summer you would need to close the curtains for privacy - one large ranchslider leading to parking and through-fair.  Having said that, good service and despite being on a busy road the room was quiet.

title: Comfy stay
text:
We stayed here for one night in a twin double room.  The beds were some of the comfiest I have ever stayed in at a motel,  Very nice.  I had a room that was appeared in the process of being done up as there was a small empty room attached to the back of my room that looked as though it had just been built or renovated.  This wasn't a problem but there was a constant drip drip drip, all through the night coming from right outside my window. The shower/toilet a little outdated but pleasant enough.

I wouldn't choose to stay here for a longer period of time, but do recommend it as a pleasant motel and it was very handy to the location I needed.  The rooms are off the roads so it was lovely and quiet.

title: Consistently Excellent
text: I stay here often when on business in the Waikato. The rooms are so nice and clean and well appointed. The best part about this motel is the beds; so comfortable! Hosts are always friendly and obliging. Would recommend this motel any day. You wont go wrong.

title: Enjoyable Stay
text: We have stayed here 3 times now and look forward to continuing to come back. Simon and Lornae are a good hosts, nothing is a problem. The service and rooms are both excellent. The units are away from the road, so it is very quiet. Would defiantly recommend this as a place to stay to anyone.

title: Excellent service
text: Although we found on our tour of new zealand that most of the new zealanders are very helpfull and friendly, I have to say that Lornae went above and beyond to help us on what turned out to be a very pleasent stay.

title: wedding booking
text:
We booked 20 rooms for a wedding. Simon and Lornae were great. They managed to be flexible with our frequent room or booking changes, helpful with our numerous questions and went out of their way to help make this a fantastic family wedding. The rooms were comfortable and clean. 
Thank you, 
We would highly recommend this motel.
Glen and Naomi

title: awesome stay
text: large room  comfortable bed clean and comfortable great service  highly recommend to anyone who wishes to stay in Hamilton away from the busy noisy main streets  loved it  will stay again in the near future

title: Great room, friendly service
text:
This motel was chosen for us by the organisation my husband was doing business with.  However, we were pleased with the lovely big room and the friendly staff.  The room was very clean and well furnished with a desk, table and chairs as well as a comfortable bed.  There was a small but well equipped cooking area, more than adequate for breakfast and light meals.  We went away for a long weekend in the middle of our stay and were given the same room on our return without having to ask.  There was no air conditioning, but a fan was supplied, which we only needed to use once in our stay, during a heat wave.  Free wifi via a system of vouchers with user numbers and passwords.

It is located just across the road from a convenience store and there is a good family run supermarket within walking distance.  There are also good restaurants within walking distance, including Turkish and Indian that we tried.  There are also some fast food establishments.

It is also located close to Hamilton Gardens, a world class botanic garden, and there are pleasant walks along the river to the Gardens and to the city centre.  The Zoo is a little further off, probably about a half hour drive,  and there are good public transport links around the city.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your great response and positive reviews of our motel and surrounding areas.  We are glad that you enjoyed your stay.

We try our best to give our guests the best stay so it is good to hear the feedback.

See you again soon
Simon and Lornae

title: Average motel
text:
This motel is OK but nothing special. The room was a bit airless as there are windows only on one side and it was noisy when they were open. You also get some noise through the walls from the rooms either side and behind. The bed was comfortable though and everything was very clean.

 It's quite a walk to the nicer part of Hamilton where all the restaurants are - near to the motel it is fast food city. 

This motel is fine if you just need a brief stop over, but I wouldn't spend any more than one night here.

title: great experience.
text: wonderful staff, friendly, hospitable and made our stay an great experience of Hamilton, close to the gardens, the Thai restaurant, the river, the coffee shops and authentic local shopping, simply great. amazing sunsets, close to cabs, uni, etc.

title: Great Sized Rooms
text: I really like it here, the rooms are a great size. There's a good sized desk and couple of chairs to relax in. I have been staying here for several years and it was renovated a couple of years ago. The kitchen is out of the way, hidden behind doors.

title: Great value, enjoyable stay
text: We stayed here with four adults for one night in a twin queen apartment, which was simple but clean and tidy and overall a great price for what we got. The kitchen was well equipped if you want to do your own cooking. The apartment was divided up so there were separate spaces for each bed and a door closing off one of the rooms, but it would have been nice to have another door separating the other room from the kitchen and bathroom area. Overall we enjoyed our stay and the staff were friendly and helpful.

title: Awesome
text: No hassles, comfortable room, enjoyed breakfast, nice and quiet, close to amenities, enjoyed our stay. Really affordable for a family, really enjoyed the fact we had our rooms cleaned everyday and management were very nice and helpful.

title: Rooms with Comfort
text: Stayed at the Aspen as it was close to the business where i had a meeting.  Room was comfortable and tidy, friendly service.  Close to restaurants and shops.  Thanks for the stay, really enjoyed the room

title: Great venue, very affordable!
text: We used Aspen Manor to host our judges and some of our committee member s for the Hamilton Cat Club Cat show, and the feedback from all of us was great! The judges had a great time, and as committee member I was very impressed with the flexibility of the motel's team, early check ins, accommodating personal requests etc...  Recommend this Motel to everyone, and we'll use them surely again next year for our show!
hotel_response:
Hi, thank you for taking the time to review our property.  Great that you found our venue affordable and great.  We look forward to welcoming you back here when you are next in Hamilton.
Simon and Lornae - Aspen Manor Motel

title: pleasant place to stay
text: Had a really wonderful time here with my husband, everything was at our fingertips Close to many different restaurants and shops, would recommend to everyone. We stayed in the studio suite with the spa pool just what the doctor ordered, so relaxing and not a bad price.
hotel_response:
Hi, thank you for taking the time to review our property.  Glad that you found it a pleasant place to stay.  We look forward to welcoming you back shortly.
Simon and Lornae Lowe

title: wonderful hosts, very helpful & accommodating
text: my family and i stayed over-night, we didn't arrive till later that night as we were attending a wedding in hamilton. Thank you both for an enjoyable stay. I would definately recommend for anyone to stay. Close to city and shops and food places. Hamilton is a beautiful place.
hotel_response:
Hi, thank you for taking the time to review our property.  We aim to please our guests and I am glad that you found us helpful.  Thank you for spreading the word on your enjoyable stay.
Simon and Lornae Lowe
Aspen Manor

title: Comfortable, Clean and Quiet.
text: I stayed here for a week while my father was in Hospital. The room was spotless and well appointed.  The units are set well back from the busy road so it was very quiet. The parking is easy and directly in front of your unit.  It was a great home away from home for me that was very close to the Southern Cross Hospital.
hotel_response:
Hi, thank you for taking the time to review our property.  We are glad that you found our property clean and presentable.  Our staff do a brilliant job on keeping the rooms clean and presentable and we are very happy with our team.  We look forward to welcoming you back here at Aspen Manor Motel.
Simon and Lornae Lowe

title: A very pleasant stay
text:
2 nights accommodation had been booked here for me by the club employing me, so I knew little about the place before arriving quite late in the evening.  I had rung to check that the office would still be open and they had stayed open for me, and brought along my Continental breakfast tray for me shortly after I arrived.  A large and excellent breakfast both days, with a good kitchen for tea/coffee/toast.  The unit was well back from the road, and very quiet with no road noise which is always important to me.  It was spotless and very comfortable and modern looking, though the bare wood dining chairs were rather cold to sit on!!  Good to have free wifi, easy to connect.  

The only thing that could have been improved was the heating - an electric heater stored in the hanging cupboard space.  A heatpump would have been much better.
hotel_response:
Hi, thank you for taking the time to review our property.  Thank you for the helpful comments, we are always looking at ways of making our guests stay more comfortable and enjoyable.  There is a heater in the cupboard which can easily be moved around and more are available on request if needed.  Also, if we are asked for more blankets we are more than happy to oblige.  Obviously heat pumps would be the ideal answer to the cold and we are looking into all options.  We look forward to welcoming you back shortly.
Simon and Lornae Lowe
Aspen Manor Motel

title: We loved this place and counted on it for almost 15 years.....
text: ....Until, for the first time, the new owners DID NOT rebook our usual Room 12  They forgot. They didnt seem to care.  We are gutted as there is no other accommodation in town due to the Mystery Creek Field Days.  I'm so disappointed as we have stayed there for years, had the same room, same routine.  Now it's all off and the new owners have booked with someone else instead of us.  I would like them to correct the error they made and get us a room!  So disappointing.

title: Large complex yet private, spacious, comfortable, easy walk to amenities
text: Company put me up here. Great reviews from others. Single person in unit. Large queen bed to myself, large open shower facilities. Absolutely spotless. Easy wifi free, limited to 24hrs and or 300mb. Quiet from any road noises. Lovely cooked breakfast, continental or full cooked. Easy parking even with visitor park as well. With so many motels to chose from, I am glad admin did the choosing. I was well rested, well fed. Easy 5 minute walk to shops or restaurants.

title: Awesome!
text: Amazing motel! We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! The staff were friendly and polite and the room was clean and very tidy. Loved the modern feel of the place. The only thing that was a bit "eh" was the lights outside the sliding door being so bright. Otherwise an awesome weekend!

title: Quiet tdy and clean
text:
My wife & I were looking at staying in a reasonably upmarket motel near Hamilton Gardens and that is exactly what we got.
Well laid out motel, not on top of each other,very clean tidy and well appointed rooms,bathroom kitchen area a tad smaller than I had hoped but did the job.Clean well maintianed laundry and within walking distance to several eating establishments,parking directly in front of our unit so ver yhappy with our choice

title: Aspen Manor Motel
text: We have stayed her three times now and each time the rooms have been spotlessly clean.  The bed is very comfortable and pillows likewise. Would definitely stay here again.  Having free Wifi while staying is a bonus.

title: Adequate
text: Disappointed with this motel.  It really was just a place to stay, rather sparse and cramped for 3 people and only just passable.  It is in a good location, close to the Gardens and reasonably quiet but I wouldn't stay again.

title: Great Overall
text: We stayed three nights.  Loved the quality clean fresh linen, comfy bed, spotless bathroom etc. Friendly helpful reception. Quiet, good parking.  Very close to Hamilton East CBD and restuarants, take aways etc.  Convenience store across the road. Short walk to Hamilton Gardens which is a MUST.  Would recommend this motel.

title: Really enjoyable stay
text: Motel easy to find, clean and comfortable The reception was most helpful .. More than we hoped for with free wifi, and handy to Hamilton East shops. near the river and when we asked for directions, the response was clear and concise. I recommend this motel and will stay again when next in Hamilton.

title: PLEASANTLY SURPRISED
text: The room was perfect for us. nicely appointed and clean. a spa in the main bedroom - nice touch and very relaxing. no condensation made it very pleasant. My 4 year old had a blast. very helpful and polite service at the reception and extremely helpful and friendly staff. When back in Hamilton we will return - Thanks

title: Value for money, clean and comfortable
text:
I had doubts looking online but on arrival I was pleasantly surprised with the new interiors and extra friendly service.
These well-priced rooms are well suited to friends travelling, with two separate QS beds in their own room. 
The first room has a small table for two and a bed, then a kitchenette and bathroom, and a separate bedroom. Our rooms were in the midst of extension to add a sitting room which will make the areas a bit more functional and roomy.
The bed was super comfortable and I slept like a baby! 
Only very small down side was the lower water pressure and shower head not the best.  Loved the parking outside the door and the friendly staff who allowed us to check in early

title: Located near the river walkway and gardens
text:
We really liked the location, it is an easy walk to the river walkway and along to the gardens or even into the city.  We stayed 4 days in a unit at the end of many while visiting our daughter at university. 
Wifi is limited in terms of capacity, we ran out of the 100MB allowance twice, but we run an IT business and use 100s of MB per day.  The operator was very good about providing more :-)
Oh and very quiet

title: Friendly and warm
text: Stayed on a very cold winter night so really appreciated the electric blanket and room heater. Big bathroom and a kitchenette in a cupboard with tea and coffee. The welcome was warm and everything was clean and efficient. Great location in East Hamilton.

title: Clean,quiet and roomy
text: We only stayed one night at the end of our holiday to NZ but this place was probably the best we'd seen. Great kitchen facilities and an inexpensive coin operated laundry with powder supplied. Thanks to Simon and Lornae

title: Mostly excellent.
text:
We went to Hamilton for the "Balloons over Waikato" and stayed one night. We were kept waiting when we arrived as the person on duty was attending to another guest. She must have been on her own because no-one else responded to several "buzzes" from their foyer. After that the service was pleasant and welcoming.

The room was excellent and immaculate. I was especially impressed by the roomy bathroom/ shower area. The kitchen facilities were also very good.

My wife thought I was a bit nit picky about the TV, which offered the Freeview channels plus Sky Movies, Sport, TCM and News., but the fact is that not all the channels had been adjusted correctly for the wide screen format. The sky news channel was stretched and chopped which is a waste of a nice TV!

We were hoping to be able to walk to the Balloons events at the University and the Lake to avoid parking and traffic. The University venue (Night Glow) is about 30 min walk if you know the shortest route (through the park) but you can park a car about half way there if you go 1hr early. The Lake venue is much further (1hr walk?)and we took our car but we had no trouble parking 5 min walk from the balloons when we got there about 6.30am.

title: Good clean functional motel rooms
text: Our family stayed in a two bedroom unit for one night. Layout was lounge/dining, kitchen and bathroom downstairs, and two bedrooms upstairs. The room was clean and well maintained, it looked like it had been partially upgraded from an older style room with new tapware, appliances and kitchen fittings. Kitchen was a good size and everything worked well. Beds were good and we weren't cold, there were heaters on both levels of the unit. Our unit was near the middle of the complex, no road noise or other disturbances. Our car park was just outside the unit. We didn't have the breakfast, and no morning newspaper was offered when we checked in. Overall it was pleasant enough, reasonable value but felt a little dated despite obvious efforts to brighten and modernize a bit.

title: Good value, clean,tidy, pleasant hosts
text:
My Familyand I recently spent 5 days at the motel while Holidaying in Hamilton.
It was very clean & tidy with adequate Kitchen facilities. The coin operated washing machine & dryer were low cost & worked well.
It was great to be able to order a lovely cooked breakfast early the day we left.
The hosts were very pleasant and helpful.
The Motel is handy to lots of eateries & a couple of Pubs.
We would not hesitate to stay there again.

title: Pretty good but overall inconsistent rooms
text:
This was my first stay at Aspen Manor Motel and it was mostly good. My family stayed in another room, and it was obvious that we got the better deal than them. The room we stayed in was well equipped, clean and tidy - although a little old. However a long length mirror was lacking (we were going to a wedding so it would have been good to check the appearance fully!!) It was spacious for a studio room, and we were pleased that the bed had heated blankets considering how surprisingly cold it can get on a Hamilton night in June! There was also a heater in the room, and the curtains were insulated ones. So when we arrived home it was nice and cosy. The bathroom was clean, although a couple of extra towels would have been nice (as well as better toiletries - no shower cap or body lotion, only soup and shampoo). The kitchen was inside a cupboard, but it had everything we needed for one night, I think my family's room didn't have a coffee perculator - but we did. 

Overall Aspen Manor Motel was pretty good - it was a shame that my family's room wasn't as nice and spacious, and didn't have all the amenities required, even though ours did.

title: Clean and tidy, helpful hosts
text: Just spent a night at the Aspen Manor and it was good for us as we were attending a wedding and needed something on that side of Hamilton.  Our family party had a one bedroom unit and a studio unit.  The studio seemed more appealing somehow - just seemed cosy and warm and modern.  The one bedroom wasn't as modern and was a bit tired.  A couple of minor gripes are there is no coffee plunger, just cheap nasty instant coffee and no full length mirror.  For the price paid - these should be available. Sadly the mirror in the living room was above the single bed and was too high to be of much use.  All it would take would be for it to be moved to a more suitable wall space and it would solve one of the problems.  Housekeeping also walked in at 8.15am the morning after the wedding - waking everyone! Not sure why?    The hosts kindly allowed us to park after we'd checked out so that we could walk to nearby Grey Street Kitchen for brunch - which was excellent.  We also ate at Babacanoush which is also within walking distance, and was great.  All in all a good stay.

title: Consistently good and popular motel
text: Have stayed here several times and never had a bad experience. Rooms are nice, and the slightly offbeat but lovely owners always seem to be improving and updating the rooms. My last stay was very comfortable. Had a room far away from Grey St so it was very quiet. 2 minute stroll to many take aways and restaurants so you can take your pick. Situated in the south east, which is not the most popular side of town, but convenient for most travellers.

title: Clean but basic for tariff charged.
text:
Arrived to a welcome of - Do you have a booking? Was aksed what milk I would like and given the key to the room.

We had paid $170 for a 1 bedroomed spa room - On using the spa, which is in the dark corner of your bedroom we found the jets to be pretty weak and useless - not enough pressure? No bubbles. So paying the extra $50 for a room with a spa was not worth it.

Double bed in main bedroom with spa then a single bed in the living area. Had basic sky channels. Tv in living area and bedroom.

Unit was very clean, but found the furniture to look very basic. The actually colouring of the unit could be cheered up with some bright colours as it's feels and looks very drab. 

Toilet and shower area looked plastic and had a cheap feel about it.

Cooking facilities of a hob and a microwave, fridge and some crockery included.

Internet was given - 100MB free but after looking briefly at 5 sites - BBC news, tripadvisor, Sky sports, Aussie open and digital spy - hardly high data eaters. I got a message up that the 100MB had ran out and would now start charging! 

Seems the cap was much lower than 100MB as got this limit at other places and it lasted a few days including browsing and webmail.

Quiet enough motel - rooms are well off the road and you can't hear any traffic.

We drove around to Clyde shopping centre to Hell pizza - yum! 

Free car parking for 1 car outside of your unit. There is a security firm that patrols the motel at night. 

Unit info folder has loads of local menu's for you. 

Overall a decent stopover - but don't waste the extra $ on a spa unit - it's really not worth it!

title: Clean and well appointed
text: We picked the family room which was on two floors.  Two bedrooms upstairs and a bed downstairs in the lounge.  We were three ladies so all required our own room which was perfect.  Very clean and modern with a dishwasher fridge and microwave.  On the whole a pleasant stay with welcoming staff.

title: Nice Hosts
text: Located in a reasonably quiet area of town the Aspen Manor provides a good night's sleep and a homely asmosphere. The hosts go out of their way to make you feel welcome and at ease. Nice place to keep in mind! Jan van Houten

user_location: Brecon Beacons National Park, United Kingdom
title: A bit tired looking but pleasant hosts.
text: We had booked for a few separate days but moved elsewhere after one stay as the room was a bit tired and the shower room a bit cold and unwelcoming. There are better places nearby at the same price. We didn't have breakfast here so can't comment.

title: Great place and service.
text:
We've just returned from our RWC visit and Aspen Manor Motel is a nicely detailed and well- looked after place to stay. We had a spa room and breakfast was extra and we enjoyed the service.
June and Joe are great hosts and they do keep it real. The spa was wonderful and the room is smartly designed and functional as is the bathroom. It's located 10 minutes walk to the CBD and there is a bus in if you need transport. There are great cafes a block away.
If you want to be part of the RWC but want a quiet place to stay, this is the place to go for.

title: Terrible customer service
text: We recently booked this motel and had a booking confirmation with a price for 6 people (3 adults, 3 children) in the family unit. When we went to pay the manager tried to charge us almost double the quoted price, saying that price was only for 2 people - even though 6 people were clearly stated on the confimation booking. He became very aggressive and quite rude when we refused to pay the extra amount. Also while staying there, we had no hot water at all in the room and when we asked about this we were told that the hotel was busy and the hot water had been used. We had to wait until the following morning to get some hot water. This is not good enough. Very disappointed with the service and treatment we received. The motel management were not very helpful; nor were they people friendly. Would not recommend Aspen Manor at all - way nicer, larger, cheaper and friendlier motels in Hamilton!!!

title: Wonderful stay for our Anniversary
text: My husband and I stayed in the spa unit, and loved it. It is pricey for just one night ($170) but it was immaculate, with flat screen tvs in both the bedroom and lounge, very tastefully decorated (none of those tacky blue and yellow motel bedspreads or curtains that so often feature) and with a comfortable bed. The spa pool in the room was great! Couldn't say anything bad about it really, except that it's priced a bit high for us. We'll definitely be back next time we want to treat ourselves!

title: An extremely comfortable, homely and cosy b&b in a peaceful location
text: The hosts, Diana and Fred are absolutely delightful, warm and welcoming.  Their home is clean and comfortable and they cater for every need.  We stayed in a twin bedded room which was of a good size.  The only down side is a shared bathroom, but as there are only two rooms for guests, this did not prove a problem.  Also the cost of the bed and breakfast was very reasonable to reflect the shared facilities.

title: Home Away from Home - with a Touch of Class!
text:
I spent two weeks with Diana and Fred at 'Hamilton Home Hospitality' while my partner was in Waikato Hospital, for a major, 5 graft heart bypass operation.
Their kind and caring friendship gave me valued and much needed support during this stressful time.
Their spacious home is open to guests on the ground floor where every need is catered for - and upstairs is a private dining room where a scrumptious breakfast - to order, is served.
The home is set near the end of a cul-de-sac overlooking the Waikato River in the centre of Hamilton City. No traffic noise - in fact, no noise of any kind. Good parking on site.
The scenic walking path along the riverside is beautiful.
Coffee, biscuits and a range of different teas are available. Fridge, TV - information pamphlets - hair dryer, toiletries are offered.  There was no air conditioning but if I had asked I guess a fan would have been available to use. Very comfortable beds and all rooms spotlessly clean.
Diana and Fred will be my friends for life and we will be back to stay whenever in Hamilton in the future.
Highly recommended.  The best value for money in Hamilton!

title: Very comfortable stay
text: My arrival in Hamilton was very comfortable, thanks to Hamilton Home Hospitality. This big house is located on a hill next to the river, very close to the city centre. The rooms are spacious and very comfortable. One room features 2 single beds, the other has one kingsize bed. A separate living room is available for guests, with coffee and tea maker, fridge and tv. The bathroom is right outside the rooms. Breakfast is served upstairs and is really great. The owners are friendly and very helpful. All in all, highly recommended!

title: Hamilton Home Hospitality
text:
wonderful time chatting and learning!!!
These two lovely people are well suited to this!
everything was well explained
I was able to find my destinations through the directions given
they were not intrusive at all and when we did talk it was very interesting

title: Happy Hamilton Home Hospitality
text: The home is positioned very close to the city centre and within easy walking distance along the attractive river path.  Set back from the road and in a high position above the Waikato river it was peaceful and I was not aware of how very central it was until I was told. The room was excellent with comfortable beds, good storage and the separate sitting room available for guests was very attractive and offered tea and coffee making facilities. My hosts were very friendly and informative and obviously have much pride in their city.  Breakfast servings were generous and breakfast is served in a separate dining room which opens onto an attractive deck. All in all, I would stay again and highly recommend 7A Hamilton Parade.

title: Comfortable Hostel
text:
Clean and comfortable with everything you need for a budget stay with onsite parking.  

I had a single room which was small but adequate with shower and toilet next door and close to the kitchen and laundry amenities.   

Also just a few minutes walk to a large Pack'nSave budget Supermarket.

title: Wouldn’t stay here again.
text: I can understand why it is called Microtel… The room was tiny, literally just a bed, not much room for Two people… baggage was put under bed for more space but honestly wouldn’t stay here again. Kitchen was okay I only used the microwave after reading previous reviews of the wear and tear of the cooking facilities… Check in is stated for 10-11am but they were already cleaning around 945-10am. Knocking on my door saying room service… vacuuming when I’m trying to get rest in the dorm next to mine. Was very disappointed with that. I will not be staying here again. Perfect for travellers or people that aren’t afraid of small areas. Staff were okay, not the best service I’ve had wish they hadve offered a better room not a shared facility.

title: Closed while fixing major fire damage
hotel_response: Now Fully operational

title: Interview Preparation
text: When i turned down the bed the top sheet had several long black hairs literally sitting on top of the sheet. Someone had been sleeping in my bed. It must have been goldilock's friend. They weren't weaved through the fabric as asserted. I have short brown hair. When questioned the woman said " oh that will be the washing machine. They obviously haven't just come off" I took photos of them. Then all the forks in the shared kitchen had hard food stuck to them. DIsgusting. Then to finish off the stay, the shower in the morning had luke warm water. Not the start you want when you have an interview assessment day ahead of you

title: Teeny tiny room but good location
text: I stayed at Microtel for one night en route to Rotorua and while the location was pretty good (walkable to CBD) the room was absolutely tiny - virtually just a bed. There was a shared shower and toilet between two rooms which was ok and I'd give the kitchen a big tick for cleanliness. It was ok for one night but I couldn't have stayed longer - the room was just too small. Nice people though.

title: IMMACULATE CLEAN LITTLE HOTEL
text: I spent a week in this hotel and it was very, very clean. The hotel is a walking distance from the Waikato Stadium. The rooms are not big, but you don't really need anything more. The manager was very friendly and helpful. I'll go back there any time!

title: Cheap but not cheerful
text: On the positive side the WiFi was good and so was the shower. The staff were welcoming and friendly. However, the kitchen and cooking facilities were horrible. The only 2 saucepans had revolving handles - a serious scald waiting to happen. The stove was greasy, the drying cloth was filthy and the kitchen itself was falling apart. The room was dark and too small to put bags down so we kept them in the car. We have stayed in accommodation that was similarly priced but so much better

title: Great budget place
text:
If you are booking somewhere called 'micro' a small room is expected.
However, it was a great surprise that the 'shared bathroom' was only with one other room, and there was a tv and great storage in the room.
Free towels, free wifi and free parking is always a bonus as a backpacker, so to get all 3 is a winner in my eyes.
Kitchen and bathrooms were clean and tidy.
Only a ten minute walk into the CBD and sky city.

Would recommend and stay again.

title: Very nice low budget place
text: A very nice place to stay in Hamilton. It has parking, nice and comfortable bed, very pleasant and helpful stuff. The only disadvantage is that it is a bit far from the city center if one wishs to walk.

title: Nice stay
text: Booked into the dorm room that's available it was very clean and had a cleaner come in every day to clean, dorm room had its own toilet,shower and sink. A nice communal kitchen and lounge upstairs again clean. All staff was very friendly and helpful. Would recommend staying here if your in Hamilton

title: Micro-Hostel
text:
Booked last minute, and this place is exactly as it says: a micro backpackers. What I didn't expect was the surprisingly powerful heater and nifty TV room set up like a cinema. 

It's not a motel, which is why the price is cheap and I think that's why some people are miffed it's not five star quality, but it has the basics and super friendly staff. Right next door to a pak'n save and 30min walk (5min car ride) to the bus central. Recommend.

title: Two nights ok
text:
Here for two nights. 
PRO: quite near the city centre and the stadium
Very fast wi fi connection
CONTRO: bathroom and showers not so clean 
Too small rooms (feeling in a box!)
Kitchen not well equipped
No carpark 

By the way for two nights it's good.

title: Clean, Affordable, Central
text: I originally booked for two weeks here whilst I looked for a room to rent in the city. I booked a single room, the room was small but clean with its own TV, the bathroom was shared with just one other person, also clean and well kept. What I liked about this place was the kindness of the staff and the flexibility with my booking, I had paid for a week upfront but found a room after just two nights! They refunded me what I paid and only charged me for 2nights which was very nice of them considering they were losing my business for the 2 week stay! I'm very grateful and would recommend to anyone looking for an affordable place near the city. There's good kitchen and laundry services and a free car park.

title: Cheap but not cheerful
text: The place has a rundown feeling to it with mismstching crockery in the kitchen area, and very little of it. My room is the proverbial 8 x 6 with a bed and a television. Nowhere to put the case or hang clothes. I have been in much better YHA's on this trip.

title: Alright
text: This was the first hostel I stayed in New Zealand and it was an okay experience. The room next to mine was being painted during my stay so the paint fumes were kind of annoying. Location is good and price reasonable.

title: Great place in Hamilton
text:
We spent two nights in Hamilton, the second at the Microtel, and really enjoyed our stay here compared to the first place.  It was perfectly located in the CBD near a Pak n Save and other amenities. 

The room we had was newly renovated and very nice. Comfortable beds, clean sheets, and a decent selection of workable items in the kitchen. 

Staff was very friendly, we enjoyed the resident cats too. Had a few issues using the Internet and Martin was patient to help problem solve the issue with us.

title: Worth it
text:
Great prices, friendly people to chat to.. Excellent kitchen area and bedroom was quite nice.

Lady at check in was a breeze to deal with :). Will definitely be back here another time next year. Close to CBD and grocery shopping.. Free parking is also available

title: Thiefs
text: I spent there 2 nights and forgot my drybag with a fleece in it there. The owner couldn't find the it and didn't seem to care at all that I had just lost items worth 140NZD and that there are thiefs there. No apologies or refunds or nothing. Cant recommend at all.

title: Nice facilities, but...
text:
We stayed in a single ensuite room on the ground floor. The room seemed nice when we first walked in, but over the course of the first day, we noticed that the room wasn't well ventilated and just seemed slightly damp overall. We also noticed black mildew in the corner of the room.

That being said, it was also a damp winter and it was the low season for the area. Doubtless, they'll have figured out and cleaned up by now. Handy to have a kitchen and laundry in house as well. Also convenient to have a Pak-n-save just across the corner from it.

title: Nice place
text: Very inexpensive place. We booked a double room with ensuite  and it was very good value for money. I have stayed in many YHA the last months and this is probably one of my favorites. The room and toilet was really clean. The bed was maybe a bit small but it was comfortable anyway. Unlimited Hot shower with good pressure. They provided us with towels and some toiletries . Our bus arrived to Hamilton at 11pm so we arrived quite late to the hostel. The owner waited for us and it was very helpful! Would stay again!

title: Paper thin wall.
text: Plus side guy on check.in friendly etc. All ok. CBD 5mins walk. BUT we have the private room number 1, which has the stairs to the left of it, so constantly sounds like a heard of elephants charging up and down, now maybe some dnt care. BUT if you wish to sell these private motel type.rooms then walls this thin are NO good or maybe get rid of room  1 then the noise an vibration may not be a problem. No sleep at all for me. Not happy and wish we paid an extra $20-30 buck to stay in a motel which wouldnt havethe stairs problem. This is part YHA but sadly not the best. Like say the guy on check in pleasant but paid $80 for NO sleep. May aswell slept in car

title: Very Interesting...Probably I'm too old for hostels
text: Very inexpensive, fairly clean, great location.  And the staff was really friendly.  I paid a little more for a private room that shared a shower and toilet with another room.  The room was spartan.  Had a small TV but very spartan.  Hooks were screws in the wall. The no longer used soap dispenser in the shower was disgusting.  Still, the room itself was clean.  Expect some noise from the street outside.  It is what it is.  It's a third or half the price of everywhere else.  And that's what you get.  Nearly every hotel in Hamilton was full was what brought me here.  On the plus, again, the gentleman had a great attitude and friendly.  Got me checked in and on my way.  Room and bed itself was clean.  Had a nice, large kitchen for all to use.  Had a TV room for all to use.  If you're on a budget and single (or couple), I can see this being a viable option.  Also, only a few minutes walk from Hamilton CBD, so there's that.  Probably younger than me would work too.

title: Great budget accomodation
text:
I've stayed at this YHA several separate occasions in the past few months.  I have sampled both the dorm and private accommodation, and have found both to be clean, comfortable, and restful.  I have experienced many backpacker facilities in my time, and this one is one of my favourites.

The kitchen facilities are small, but clean and well-equipped.  The pantry and refrigerators are obviously cleaned out regularly.

Proprietor is very friendly and helpful.  Obviously takes pride in providing good service, and making people welcome.  Even has set up a Christmas tree, which makes me feel at home.

Near a busy street, so there is a bit of street noise; however, I have found the noise inside and outside to be at an acceptable level.  And I'm fairly sensitive about noise and like a good sleep.

Showers in private accommodation excellent in every way, great pressure and lots of hot water.  (I can't remember the conditions of the dorm showers.)

In all, I've been in three separate rooms.  Each is a bit unique, and that's part of what I like about the accommodation.

All in all, would definitely recommend to others and will be staying here in the future.

title: Spent as little time there as possible
text: Booked double room for a one night stay. The awful smell of the room hit us first and it felt and looked unclean. Not enough room on floor for bags, bathroom flooded when showering because curtain didnt go whole way around. Dirty plates and cutlery were left around the outside of establishment. Location not too bad, easy walk to shops and restaurants. Spent most of the night out and came back purely to sleep and leave ASAP in morning. Not recommended.

title: I love YHA!
text: Yvonne is the bubbliest YHA receptionist ever! She will surely make your stay here an enjoyable one. You will have a memorable experience in this cute and affordable place to stay in Hamilton. I will surely keep coming back here. Be sure to be a YHA member to receive discount.

title: Vary friendly staff
text:
Staff were extremely friendly and helpful

Facilities wise it had all the basics but unfortunately not much else. Room i was in didn't have a wall jack so I had to unplug the tv and use that one, room was extremely small.

title: Caught Bed Bugs Here
text:
I spent three nights here altogether. Two consecutive nights, went to Taupo and stopped over back here for one more night.
The manager, Yvonne, is extremely friendly, welcoming and accommodating. Her customer service is fantastic.

Booked a three person bedroom but was put into a seven person bedroom.
The rooms were nice, had a little bit of space and an ensuite. Kitchen isn't well equipped - they don't have many pots/pans/cutlery etc.
First two nights were fine and no problems.

The last night I stayed there, I slept on my right side and I woke up the next day with rashes on the left side of my arms, neck and feet that grew into lumps and are still very itchy today. I suspect that the blanket was not cleaned and may have had bed bugs.

Very disappointed as I had to continue my holidays with a very itchy rash.
Two stars as Yvonne really is a great and friendly manager and the room itself wasn't too bad.

title: Great for stopovers
text:
I only spent one night here but it was a truly enjoyable experience. I spent the night here as it was easy to get to the Waitomo Caves and Hobbiton. The place itself was really small but the rooms were clean, the beds were comfortable and each room has an ensuite bathroom. There's not much space in the rooms itself but it wasn't really an issue for me as it was just a stopover. The hostel itself is a bit further from the town itself so you may need a car to find places to eat and such but there's a kitchen available if you want to cook.

The kitchen was clean and had everything I needed. There's only one dining table so if there's too many people about you may have to squeeze in at the table. There's also a TV room which has been renovated with old bus seats that gives a cinema vibe to it. 

There's parking at the back of the building although if there's too many cars around you may excellent driving skills to move in and out of the small lot.

title: G'wan Yvonne
text: We stayed in the YHA Hamilton while passing through Hamilton on the Te Araroa Trail and again when we had finished.  We couldn't resist going back for more because we had struck up such a lovely comradeship with the manager on our first visit.  The hostel rooms are great as they are all en-suite, impeccably clean and our room even had a tv (quite a luxury when you've just walked out of the wilderness.)  The kitchen is clean and large and the hostel is spitting distance from a Pak N'Save Supermarket so convenient for dinner supplies.  We had to stay here longer than expected due to an injury but Yvonne was so helpful in accommodating us that we enjoyed the extra few days.  Thanks!

title: Friendly staff
text:
The staff is very friendly. 

The location is not the best but if you've a car, you don't mind. 

The dormitory rooms are okay. But not too big. The ceiling is very low... If you sleep on the top bed. Take care of your head when you wake up. 

The shower is very very small.  

The kitchen is okay, but miss some knife.. We found no one... 

Regards

title: You'll love the owner
text: The hostel is very clean and the communal areas are excellent, the rooms are tiny but tidy, even though the bathroom was a bit too small. The location isn't great, but Yvonne, the owner, will do anything she can to help you and that's always a massive plus.

title: Loved it.
text:
We spent two nights at the YHA Hamilton and enjoyed it. The dorm was large and clean, just like The kitchen. The beds have been a Real blessing, they were one of the best ones so far. 
The host Yvonne is just a sweatheart! She just started working here and she is totally in her Job. The People are also very Communicative and easy going. The Location is also close to the River Walk, which is really nice! :-)

title: Small.
text: I stayed here over the new year for three nights. The rooms were tiny but clean. Noise could be heard through the walls from other guests. Wifi was free which was great. The place is located to far from town especially if you have a heavy bag. Bus route 18 and 21 will get you to the transport centre and back again. On the first day I got back I found the door to my room open luckily for me I had locked the interior room up. This was a great concern to me. Host was pleasant  and gave me a 15 dollar discount. A good basic place to stay.

title: It's not that bad...
text: YHA Hamilton is a little bland, but I met some lovely people in the kitchen to make up for that. The communal facilities are quite good for a YHA, but my room looked like my first attempt at decorating and the beds are precisely too small to be really annoying for someone 6'3". It's also next to a busy intersection which can be noisy, but also next to a massive supermarket which is handy. Using the car park can be fun if you like playing the difficult levels on Tetris.

title: Comfortable, clean and cozy
text: I had a similar thought about the microscopic driveway when I first saw the YHA. Luckily during my stay there were at most 2 other cars in the car park plus my own car so that made getting in and out a whole lot easier. I was met by a kind lady, and even though I had paid for a basic 4 person shared bunk room, told me the top floor rooms had a heater and she would put me up there because it was quite cold at night. She showed me my room and it was great! Two private lockable bedrooms with double beds crammed into the tiny room plus a shared shower and toilet. There was someone staying in the room next to me but I never actually saw them so it was like having it all to myself! The kitchen facilities were excellent and clean and there were lots of up to date brochures for perusal. Would stay here again.

title: Ups and Downs
text: On first sighting all I could think of was how on earth are people supposed to park in that tiny carpark or even get their cars through the narrow driveway!  And then there is the 20 point turn to get your car out again and onto the busy highway right on a busy traffic lights intersection.  The bunk rooms are very very basic but thankfully the heater and hot shower worked well and the beds were comfortable enough.  You will need your own electric blanket as Hamilton is cold!  Also take your own double adaptors. The shared kitchen facility was OK for backpackers but the TV room set up is strange with old bus seats making up the majority of the seating! On the whole I think that if you used What If or a motel voucher you could probably get better value for money from a motel than this place.  There is actually a sign on one of the doors saying Private, Go Away - not very friendly for a backpackers!

title: Rooms quite adequate but other aspects need improvement
text:
My husband and I had flown from Melbourne into Auckland, hired a car and driven to Hamilton to stay overnight before heading onto Rotorua the following day. Unfortunately our flight was delayed (and we'd overlooked the 'call ahead for outside reception hours access' on our booking notes) so when we FINALLY managed to locate this YHA (not at all obvious nor well signed), we were more than a bit frustrated that the reception was well and truly shut and there was no note or anything left for us to work out what to do.

We ended up calling YHA NZ customer service and the helpful lady we spoke with tried calling the 'after hours' number for this YHA ...but there was no response. Her only advice was to hang up and call her back in another five minutes. Talk about taking the wind out of your sails! Here we were having booked and paid for our night, only to be locked out on the street (and not an overly pleasant area of town either it seemed) - and it was only 10pm. 

Luckily (and I cannot stress the luck part enough) for us, the owner lady had heard us on the phone and came down in her dressing gown and slippers to let us in just before we got off the phone to customer service. I have no idea what we would have done if she hadn't and, which I think is pretty damn crap, she told us that she 'turns off the after hours phone' ...?! Why be in the business if you can't make alternative arrangements for people who are meant to be showing (she said she saw us in the system) or at the very least, have the phone ON?

Anyway, our room was fine - small but had a half size fridge, toaster (no kettle) and good sized ensuite with (a decent) shower over bath, toilet and basin. We even had a decent-sized flat screen tv ...but no wifi even as a YHA member (apparently this has just changed and, for the most part, is unusual for a YHA). We were also supplied with real towels and face washers (a lovely change from having to use microfibre travel towels) and soaps.

We didn't use the shared facilities other than look at them but whilst they seemed to have everything you'd need, they were very cramped. 

Would I stay here again? Perhaps - depends on our circumstances. It's great if you're just stopping over (and can get in) but other YHAs leave this one for dead.

title: Staff were shocking at there job
text: Arrived here feb 2013 for 1night. The reception staff didnt have a clue one was german and didnt understand a lot of english and the other looked stoned and was unhelpful. No free wifi.  The rooms wernt cleaned properly we had someones bedding from the night before, and there is nothing to do in hamilton seriously NOTHING! But there was a supermarket over the road which is handy

title: definitely the worse YHA we stayed at
text: The guy working at the desk was pretty bad. It seemed like he really didn't like the fact that we were there and needed to check in and had questions. I guess maybe we were bothering him while he was busy on his cell phone? This was our 3rd YHA and definitely the least friendly staff we encountered. The rooms were tiny-as it was a microtel and not particularly clean and very shabby. I definitely would not recommend staying here!!!

title: Worst Experience
text: I am so angry, upset and disappointed we stayed at this nightmare backpackers as it has completely ruined our holiday to NZ.  We have stayed at a number of backpackers on our holiday so we are not a stranger to them and they have proven to be little gems until THIS one.  We paid approx $130 for 2 nights for a double room with ensuite.  We have had not ONE but TWO sleepless nights and early mornings.  The noise has no switch off as the night progresses 1am 2am half hour sleep 3am etc and then 7am it starts up again.  it is just constant talking, laughing, arguing, yelling as if you are in the same room as them.  It has been devastating to our break away.  We completely understand the nature of youth backpackers as we experience them all the time but to pay for not being able to sleep which is everyone's given right.  Most other places we have stayed has had a noise curfew and so everyone should have that same respect and accountability.  When you didn't think things could get any worse it did !!! 7.30am lying in bed in the comfort of OUR paid room we have another backpacker unlock our door and walk on in on us in full view half clothed in bed.  The poor bugger must of got a big fright and quickly closed the door.  So someone else has a key to our room with our possessions ???? All our valuables locked up safe (we thought) and some random has a key to our room.  It left my partner and I humiliated to say the least for the experience.  On arrival the sheets were still wet on the bed, plates had dried food on them and needed re cleaning before use the fridge still had the person befores food in it.  Just outside the door stinks of cigerette smoke as we were placed obviously right next to the smokers domain.  You can't get any air circulation in the rooms at all and if you leave the door open we then lose all privacy.  I then tried calling the office after our stranger encounter this morning but to no avail.  I hope to god no one suffers this type of stay ever !!! Really really upset that this could even happen.

title: Reasonably priced but cramped
text:
My husband and I stayed two nights here and it was okay. We had a double ensuite room on the top floor of the hostel. It was quiet at night and the linen and towels were very clean and of a good standard, but it was quite cramped. We probably found it worse than others as we are both six feet tall.

The toilet was one side of the room and the shower the other - with the sink in the bedroom. This is quite an odd arrangement, but it was fine, although there was barely any room in the toilet. The bed was on the uncomfortable side as it was too spongy.

The communal areas were very clean and the kitchen well equipped, but it wouldn't be big enough if there were lots of people staying at the hostel - it didn't seem very busy when we were there.

title: Unexpectedly impressed
text: Being the first hostel 'Ive stayed in i was expecting the worst - but I was surprised. The room I stayed in was a twin with ensuite - although I only booked a twin. First I was greeted by a super friendly guy at the reception who was more than happy to show us around the hostel, once inside the room i was surprised at the creature comforts that i assumed a hostel would not have. The room was complete with T.V., a bar fridge and a comfortable bed. The bathroom was a little outdated but to be honest I couldn't care less. The shower was roomy, hot and had lots of pressure. The bed was one of the most comfortable I've ever slept in and had trouble getting out the next morning. When leaving the staff pointed us in the right direction and wished us a safe and enjoyable holiday, what more could you ask for. I would stay here again and again and definitely recommend it to anyone wanting a comfortable place to lay their head

title: microtel ..2475 sanders st..conway ar
text:
we travel quite a bit and usually stay at hampton inns. being very tired and late at night, we came upon this hotel and decided to give it a try. it was outstanding to say the least. the room was like a new room. very nice. a full breakfast was awaiting us . the staff very friendly. we will be considering this chain again.
w & j sutherland

title: A comfortable week
text: We knew the rooms would be tiny having seen it online.  The walls were freshly painted and the bedding was all fresh and finer than some other hostels.  I shared a modern shower cubicle with strong, hot water flow with one other, similarly the toilet.  The TV reception was clear.  Extras such as shampoo, soap and fresh soft white towels and face washer were notable.  The kitchen was pleasant with clean new utensils and crockery while the livingroom was modern and conducive to some small talk with fellow travellers.  A great Nosh supermarket was opposite as well as Pak 'n Save and the walk to the city centre was ten minutes max.  And the main street is packed with bars and cafes of good standard.  If you really are claustrophobic a double room would be the go.  High summer would need the outer door to be ajar and a heater for winter.  The cleaning was of a high standard and I was comfortable there.

title: Average
text:
