We stayed here for one night and did not use any of the facilities other than the bed and bathroom.
We had booked using hostelworld which listed the room as Double Bed Private - Ensuite. The lady at reception could not find our booking as they had not had any communications from Hostelworld in the last few days so we were instead put in to a double bedroom with shared bathroom. No discount offered
The room itself seemed clean enough but was very small - about the length of the bed and the width of the bed + 1 metre. Only plug socket was the one the tv was plugged into.
Not enough parking spaces so we had to park round the corner.

title: Decent place to stay
text: We stayed at the Micro Tel for two nights at the end of a trip through New Zealand.  I'm writing because some of the reviews on this site seem extreme and completely opposite of what we experienced.  It is located on a pretty busy street (you only hear the traffic if you stay in a room at the very front) with a small parking lot in back and some rather small rooms.  However, it was clean, the staff was friendly, the facilities in general were in good shape, and we were lucky to get a free upgrade to a studio room with our own bathroom and small kitchen area (fridge, jug, toaster, microwave, free tea & coffee, air conditioner).  I did see how small the other rooms were so I can see that travelers might be turned off by having barely any space beyond the bed.  I can also see how some might find the kitchen area a bit cramped or untidy.  The owner showed us where they are in the process of remodeling to make the kitchen a much larger area, but truly the current one is likely good enough for what you need.  We were there when a large group of softball players were in-house for a local tournament, and the owner advised us that it might be a bit noisy and perhaps crowded in the kitchen.  They were kids with some of their parents from Wellington, and they were great fun.  The next night when adults and couples were staying was when it got a bit noisy but not unreasonably so.  In reference to the comments about dirty conditions and unkind staff, I found the complete opposite to be true.  I would recommend staying here if you are okay with a small space and being located in a busy location.  It is adjacent to a Pak 'N Save grocery store, minutes from the main shopping/restaurant area and a short drive away from the spectacular gardens.  For the price, off-street parking and a decent place to stay, I would definitely recommend Micro Tel Hamilton.

title: Wish I didn't stay here
text:
I was only in Hamilton for one night as a stop-over between desitinations and thought "How bad can it be?" Haha, oh it can be very bad! 

The guy at reception was nice and even carried my bag when showing me to my room, but after that it was just dismal. My room (a single with a bathroom shared with one other which was not occupied) was about the size of the cells at the Old Melbourne Gaol and was very dirty. The bottom sheet had hairs on it and the floor didn't look to have been vaccuumed in a month. I resorted to caccooning myself in the clean top sheet to sleep, luckily it wasn't a cold night. 

The kitchen was disguting. I used only the microwave and even that was a stretch for me; I stuck to eating with my own camping utensils. 

Do not stay here unless you're a unhygienic slob yourself.

title: Clean Room, Very Noisy
text:
We had a group staying for one night in Hamilton. 
Rooms were basic and clean, thats all we needed. so perfect for us.
Microlet was in a great location, but we got no sleep due to the noise. People came and went throughout the night, every movement and converstaion was heard!
Rooms advertised as air conditioned - Completely untrue. We had to open the main door to get any air in.

Would recommend if you staying one night for a stopover, but not long term, or if you want to get any sleep!

title: pretty good value indeed!
text:
we arrived microtel around 10pm, the stuff was friendly. there were people partying at the back yard. luckily they went away pretty soon. we stayed in a double room, it was pretty clean (not for hotel quality, but good enough for the money i've paid). shampoo and soap were provided. the water quality was really nice. the TV in our room was not working probably but we had a good night sleep. 
it;s recommended by us i think, at least you can have a good sleep.

title: clean, tidy and value for money
text:
After reading the last review thought better add a review as I felt it was a great place to stay was there for 4 nights and my linen was clean fresh, rooms were serviced daily the staff were helpful, friendly and funny. 

The rooms are small but have everything I need and that didn't put me off as it is a modern hostel with good lounge.  Hostel has just had a major refurbishment and is looking good, nice and vibrant.

I'd recomend it thanks microtel for the good stay.

title: Never again; Stinky, Dusty, Dirty, Small (solitary confinement), indifferent staff
text:
It was a major disappointment. The room was as small as 3 square meter. all the beddings were dusty, stinky, dirty, and totally disgusting. the corridor was narrow and dirty with construction material left on the ground. There was no heater in the room and when I asked for one, the staff said not all the rooms have heater. We stayed for 3 nights there was no single change of any thing (sheets, rubbish, ...) . The staff couldn't even confirm my reservaion so he asked me to login to my personal email address and show him the confirmation email I received from YHA (Youth Hostel Association).
The room was so dusty that I gut sick and couldn't breath.

title: small, comfortable place to stay
text:
having read other reviews, i had to write about my experience of this hostel. It looks to me that when i was there the place was three quarters of a way through a major renovation.
The communal areas looked nice, clean and relaxing. Must admit sisnt use them as i went in to town which is only a 10 min stroll.
I stopped for one night in a single room with shared bathroom. the room was small but comfortable with a small tv.  had no problems with noise and the bathroom was spotless.
check in was easy and the lady who served me very frinedly and very helpful with all the questions i asked.  this was the second time i have travelled to nz and this place is very resonable a nd clean for its price compared to a lot of other hostels i stopped in while i was there. Plenty of parking on site however if you making an early start it may be better if you park at the front so you dont have a lot of reversing to do when trying to get out when your still very sleey.

title: A great place to stay in Hamilton
text: I stayed at the Mircotel as a single female for  2 weeks (Aug 17-28th) to attend a course, in a single room w/shared bathroom.  The bed was comfy, the water was always very hot and high pressure, clean towels & bathroom/toilet, and my room was  serviced every day.  Microtel is close to town, good off-street parking, clean, modern, great atmosphere, and safe. I have stayed at many places overseas in the past few months, and I can tell you the Microtel is good value for money and Karen and Rob are great hosts.  I plan to stay here again at the end of the year.  I have also seen the studio rooms and they too are clean, modern, and nicely appointed.   Ignore KWICKSGIRL's review, her guest etiquette is no doubt worse than her grammar - that  says it all.

title: Small, dirty and rude
text: what air conditioning ? its stuffy in there and its still winter imagen what it would be like in the summer , it smells like old persons fart, and there is only one tiny window that dont even have a brezze coming through, the shower and toilet was untidy,  the hostel lady is a grump and rude maybe shes just like that to a selected few but my group of friends where treated rudely and our personal spaces where invaded left a light on in our room and when we came back the light was turned of, this could not had been done unless someone had entered the room with a key, we found her to be unprofessional no ID was asked for No recepit given and we had to find our own way to our rooms.  other guest that where staying there where drinking and highly intoxicated is this appropriate behaviour for a hostel that is so close to the CBD and some of the guests where asked to leave (like find another accomodation)  at 11.30 pm by the hostel lady and she knew  they where highly intoxicated - guess? how they got their BY CAR!! guess? how they left BY CAR!!, this was not right she should had not let them drink here in the first place knowing to right they would get intoxicated and loud and out of control she did not show good host responsibilty nor did she own the problem when it was a dressed, they could had caused an accident on the road not only did she put them in danger she put others at risk as well,she should had not kicked them out if she let them get that way in first places, there was nothing in place for a back up for this kind of behivour no other transportation was provided or other alternatives. I would not reccomend this place to stay unless you want to stay in a grampy tiny room with a smell and a unprofessional, grumpy,hostel lady

title: Disgusting
text:
this is hands down the most disgusting and awful place I've ever stayed - and I recently backpacked around india!!!
we booked online as we were arriving late and figured it looked ok on the website and it was only one night. if it hadn't been so late I would have left and checked into another hotel/motel.
The room was tiny, like the other review, it stank like it hadn't been aired in the last ten years, the blinds were broken so anyone walking past (it was ground floor) could look straight in, the were hairs all over the pillows and sheets had marks that led us to believe the bedding had not been changed from the last guests! the door didn't lock so we had to hang a blanket over the broken blinds and prop a chair in front of the door.
we were promptly woken by a smoker with a hacking, flemy cough sitting outside near our room spitting on the ground.
would never ever stay there again. a complete rip off even considering it was only $100 a night.

title: Not the Greatest
text: We stayed in the studio with shower ensuite.  The room was very compact, however this was fine as it is what we had expected and we were only staying one night.  However we were disgusted by the cleanliness of the unit.  It smelt very musty when we first arrived, like the window/door had not been opened, this was fixed by opening the window and airing the room out.  The kitchenette was good, except for having to try to fill the jug in the bathroom handbasin (which because of the style of the tap proved a little difficult).  We were disgusted that the coffee mugs that were provided were filthy, with coffee stains in the bottom, and mouth marks round the rim.  Not surprising though, the tiny dishwashing liquid container was empty, and they would have had to been washed in the bathroom handbasin anyway.  There was no soap in the either of the two dispensers in bathroom.  The batteries in the TV remote were flat.  When we arrived back after dinner there were no parking spaces available.  We were told we could park in the car park of a place next door (we said we would be checking out at 10am, and parking there till then was apparently ok).  We also thought this was kind of rude as we were staying in one of the more expensive rooms.  The next morning at approx 8.15am, we were woken by a phone call telling us we had to move our car.  Pretty rude, we would have parked on the street if we had known we would be woken early.  On top of all this the spa was out of order (dont think i would have used it anyway looking at the cleanliness everywhere else).  The unit could have done with some soundproofing also as it was on ground floor with stairs above it and driveway beside it.  This motel is cheap and you barely what you pay for, and for less you can get better staying in a cabin at a motor camp.

title: Bare bones, but clean & cheap
text: The MicroTel is located a short driving distance from downtown Hamilton. There is nothing exciting about the hotel, and "micro" definitely describes it well. Everything - from the parking lot to the rooms to the TVs - is small. That said, our room had all amenities one might want, including a minifridge, microwave, tea, coffee, sugar, and a full bathroom with tub. The entire hotel was very clean, and the night stay was cheap. The MicroTel advertizes "compact luxury". The "luxury" part of it probably refers to the mints left on our bed.

title: Review of Linden B&B  Natchez MS
text: What an incredible and memorable place fo stay with friends. The rooms, the food, the amenities, the staff, the tour of the house, all were exceptional. There were 8 of us and we especially enjoyed gathering on the "gallery" (the back porch) to visit and drink Linden's hot coffee in the mornings and open a bottle of wine or two in the evenings. We hope to return.

title: Falls visit
text:
Great hotel in the heart of the tourist zone . No need for further parking fees. 15 minute walk to the heart of the Falls. Lovely staff , especially room keeping & great breakfast buffet. 
Ideal if you want to cross the border into the US, walking or driving .

title: Excellent
text: Once again, we have chosen to stay here and are not disappointed.  Really roomy rooms and right in the heart of the CBD.  Owners were very friendly and helpful and gave us an upgrade to accomodate an extra person. .  Will definately be staying again.

title: Great room.clean.spacious.noisy.
text:
Stayed their for one night.picked a one bedroom apartment that had a balcony over main street so we knew itd be noisy.and it was.very entertaining tho watching the drunks wandering.quietened down at about 2a.m.
Unfortunately we did not know their was a big event (bridge to bridge run) the next morning and awoke at 6.45 to loud speakers and an hour later hundreds if not thousands outside :(

Room itself was great.very roomy and clean.no sky tv like advertised which wasnt good.
Great location.2 minute walk to casino . Friendly managers. Carparks are free but hv first in first get basis so suggest getting their soon after check in time if wanting park.

title: Basic
text:
We stayed here for one night and it served really well for a flying visit.

First impressions were formed upon meeting the staff who were really cheerful and helpful.

The room itself was a good size, comfortable bed and clean bathroom.

Overall the place had a bit of a tired feel.  There was some noise and we were at the rear, so maybe the windows could do with some double glazing!

Can't complain too much because it was so cheap.  I'd stay again for a night, but no more.

title: Center of Town
text:
Good location, close to restaurants, shops. Sky City Hamilton across the street. Rooms are spacious including bathroom. Free wifi but very slow. Free parking is a plus. Reception is good.
A shopping center is close by including KMart store.

title: Haven
text: Our flight had been delayed and we were late in arriving. The weather was not the best. We finally found the suites and the manager came out to direct us to the car park (free, but difficult to find). Whilst in the park the manager arrived with the trolley to help us get in. We had booked on line for two nights. The suite was very large, overlooking the main street.the amenities were more than adequate. Bed was comfortable, managers could not have been more helpful. We decided to stay an extra night. No problem. I would highly recommend this place to stay. My only query, why not advertised in the AA book?

title: Great values for money
text:
We have stayed here 6 times this year. What does that tell you? The place is clean, the owners and staff are very helpful and polite. Ample parking underneath, cool ice machine. Rooms are clean, very roomy with an awesome bathroom. Can be a bit noisy in some rooms from the nightlife. However they do warn you at time of booking in. But if you are part of the nightlife, who cares. Right in the heart of the city.
Will always stay there next year too! Come on the the Chiefs 2014!

title: Cockroach central
text: Our suite was supposed to be "luxury" but was nothing of the sort. I squashed a cockroach in the hall, there were ants in the glasses, and cigarette butts in the lift. The bedrooms had no windows, the lounge windows didn't open, the bathroom smelt mouldy, and the toilet was filthy. The view was of rusty old iron. In one of the bedrooms the light seemed to be a dim 20 watts. The curtain was only partly attached to the rail. The appliances were faulty and there were no Sky channels as advertised in the brochures. I saw staff cleaning the floors with bath towels. The couch had holes in it. Street kids were taking drugs outside the front door. Need I go on? Avoid it like the plague.

title: Great value and spacious room
text: I stayed here for a night with a friend and thought it was great value.  It might look basic from the outside (white throughout, no decoration), but the room was very spacious and bathroom was nice and clean.  It seemed like it used to be a studio apartment and turned hotel.  Parking was included and location was excellent - tons of restaurants and cafes on Victoria.

title: Centrally located hotel but that may not be a good thing!
text: We stayed one night, choosing it because it was in the centre of Hamilton. We stayed in a one-bedroom apartment. The main sitting room with kitchenette was cavernous and badly lit which gave the whole apartment a dingy feel, even though it was perfectly clean and equipped. The bedroom had much better lighting and was more welcoming. The shower room was slightly dated but perfectly fine. The parking is behind the hotel and easy to find once we stopped at the front to check where to go. The entrance from the front and the car park feels like the entrance to a city centre apartment block rather than a hotel (not a problem, just different). The staff were helpful: the hairdryer in the unit sparked while I was using it and they quickly brought me another one. We had a room at the front on a weekend night and it was too noisy - there are a lot of bars in Hamilton and it was a bit too noisy in the early hours. In retrospect one of the key places we were in the area to visit was Hamilton Gardens and therefore it would make sense to stay on the outskirts near them, or around Cambridge.

title: Disgusting dodgy people!
text:
My partner and I had a look at the hotel info online before we arrived in. A woman came down first and told us the price for a night, when I mentioned about the online pricing was a bit different which is cheaper, she said in that case we need to pay $5 booking fee (It clearly says no booking fee on line!) she then went inside of the office quickly typed something on the PC and immediately I can see on my phone that online vacancy is no longer available. HOW DODGY! As soon as I  questioned her about the disappearance of 5 available vacancies online, her attitude changed to very aggressive, basically telling us either stay with the price she named or get out. At the same time I have noticed a man in the office started waving his hand to us wanted us to leave. What a 'team work' aye?

We are glad we didn't stay in that place after reading many feedbacks about how dirty the rooms are, guess that's reflection of the owners/staff?

There are many nice motels on Ulster Street if you want a good stay.

title: best value hotel
text: Booked online. Great price, fantastic service,  well appointed. If you want a great room at reasonable rates close to the centre of town you will not do better than this. Friendly hosts and nothing was a problem (not that there were any). Thankyou

title: Central City yet no night noise
text:
I booked this hotel due to wanting to walk around the bars and not have to catch cabs, and found it close enough to all the bars, yet far away enough for there to be no noise heard from the clubs.  I arrived about 8.30pm on a Saturday evening yet found a free secure parking space under the building. The room was spacious with modern, comfy decor.
The managers were very friendly, helpful and went out of their way to help.  Even though my room didn't have a view, it didn't worry me as I got it at a reasonable rate and left early in the morning. I did find the doves a bit noisy though so if you intend to sleep in - pack some earplugs. I really liked the uniqueness of the artwork too. The building was secure and there is a strict rule to have no parties on site and the managers live on site to be oncall if needed.

title: Special request on reservation - too hard!!
text: To be fair to this establishment I never got to stay here. My complaint is about a request upon reservation. Made my booking through Late Rooms.com. I requested an early check in as we had a wedding to attend early afternoon. A fairly reasonable request I would have thought and one which most hotels would be happy to provide. However it was refused as they said they were quite busy that weekend and suggested that I either CANCEL or stay the night before as well. What business today suggests someone CANCEL? Unbelievable ,as to me it was a simple request as the room that was allocated to us could have been first on the housekeeping list the day of our arrival and be ready for us by 12 as requested. Not rocket science, as I told them ,and if they wanted the business it was something they could do easily. (I would have paid a little more for this but it wasnt offered)  Whilst I realise I received a good room rate why offer 'special requests', that really arent that 'special' when you are going to refuse for really not a good valid reason!! I understand that they will undoubtedly rent the room out to another, and thereby losing my business is probably no big deal to a large hotel chain, however customer service should be paramount in this business and a negative feedback can have longreaching effects. It is probably a very pleasant place to stay, given the feedback I have read, but I won't ever know this as I have cancelled AS ADVISED BY THE HOTEL! (I wonder if their CEO knows they suggest this to people) If you book here, dont expect any special requests to be honoured. My advise is book somewhere else more accommodating.

title: Excellent value for money
text: The staff were very helpful, my bags were not only stored for the day but taken up to my room waiting for me when I checked in. I can't remember when this happened last even at high end hotels. The rooms are fairly plain but have everything you need. The queen studio has a microwave but limited cooking utentsils enough to do breakfast though. There is free wi-fi although it is not hugely fast. Overall great location, handy to everything, plain but pleasant and excellent service.

title: Superb
text: The warmest welcome I have ever received when staying in Hamilton. The room ( Queen Studio ) was enormous and extremely clean. The bed was lovely and it was a nice touch to have the aircon on so room was lovely and warm when I arrived. I realised on the drive home I had left some personal items and with one phone call they promised to send to me asap. Many thanks.

title: Great location, clean and central
text: The facts all add up.  It is right in the middle of town with free parking and cheap rate for a proper hotel with your own bathroom.  It was clean and the staff friendly.  Large rooms and good shower.  I did feel a bit insecure there and probably wouldn't stay again but there is nothing I can put my finger on that made me uncomfortable.  The staff were friendly and facilities good.

title: Basic, clean, centrally located, soulless, maintenance problem
text:
Large rooms with not much in them! Very clean and tidy, helpful staff. My shower was broken and sprayed me hard in face and on floor. Quite hard to wash! Think it had been like that for a while. No soap in shower dispenser. TV reception poor. 
So maintenance not great. OK for a night if you get a good rate.

title: Clean apartment - excellent value for money
text: We, a group of six booked a two bedroom apartment and a studio apartment.  We found the apartment had very well equipped kitchen and very clean.  Both bedrooms had queen beds and the linen was very clean and sheets crisp. The hotel is very central to the restuarant area and has undercover parking.  Highly recommended.

title: traveller
text:
Very good value for money and good location. Great to have two rooms, very quiet and clean.
Lovely hosts.

title: Central location,  excellent rate
text: This hotel is very central and the undercover parking is very good.  I felt the decor in the room was rather drab, but it was clean and very quiet.  It was very spacious and the shower must be the best one in town.  Very powerful.  I would stay here again because the rate was excellent value for money.

title: Highly recommended
text: Great location in the centre of town with free, covered parking. We stayed for a week and were given an upgrade, which was a nice touch. Our one bedroomed suite was quiet and spacious. The free wifi was a bit slow, but otherwise fine. Staff were helpful and friendly. We asked if we could borrow a coffee plunger and a selection was provided immediately, which impressed us. Similarly, a later check-out time was no problem. The kitchen area in the suite was well equipped and hot drinks supplies were replenished daily. Overall, a very good experience and we will return.

title: Clean, Good Location and Friendly Staff
text:
I stayed here in early October, and booked a queen studio room for myself and my husband.  We were attending a function across the road so it was in a good central location for when we went out later in the evening.  

My first impressions were good, it was easy to find and we could park our car in the under cover parking building for free.  When I checked in the hotel owner was helpful and I paid on arrival, it was only $136 which I thought was cheap.  Our room was around the side of the hotel and off the road, so it was really quiet.  The room was nice and clean and everything was tidy.  It was basic but everything was there if you wanted a hot drink, or to heat something up in the microwave, so don't expect to be able to cook something in this particular room.  There were plenty of places to eat at around the hotel anyway.  The bathroom was nice, a shower and no bath, but just what we needed.  Their was an air con system, but the room was just the right temperature so we didn't need to use it.

Overall this hotel is great if you are having a night out and want somewhere central to stay.  It's comfortable enough and the parking was handy as it was secure.  The earlier reviews were about harsh, but maybe they have done renovations or updated it since those were written, but it is definitely priced well and you get what you pay for.

title: Over-priced hostel
text: When I arrived here I went straight to my room which had not been cleaned. Even after it was done, there were still pubic hairs in the shower and on the floor. There is no view from the window and a walled in patio area with cig butts scattered around.  It is a noisy place with people shouting and slamming doors, so if you're looking  for a good night sleep, this is not  the place. I wish I'd payed an extra 20 bucks and stayed in a better place.

title: Perfect location, good wi fi, friendly helpful staff
text:
I thought I was taking a gambol staying here as hadnt read tripadvisor reports as it is strangely classsified as a B and B rather than a hotel on trip advisor.
When we checked in and I couldnt get the Wi Fi to work the manager was concerned and sorted it out within minutes. After that it worked perfectly.
The room was huge and clean, with a large comfortable bed, air con worked fine. We had a kettle, toaster and microwave.
Good shower in bathroom but no bath.
Computers in lobby free to use and free newspaper.
Room could do with a bedside lamp on each side of the bed and some nice pictures.
Ideal location in victoria street where there are lots of good restaurants, we ate at Bank, iguana and gengys.
When we had to rush back to England due to serious family illness they were kind sympathetic and allowed us to print out our changed tickets.
I highly recommend the staff and would stay here again if we come back to New Zealand

title: Comfortable beds, clean, modern, spacious and in a great location.
text: We had booked a 1 bedroom suite but were upgraded to a 2 bedroom on arrival as they were laying new carpet.  This was on the first floor where all the suites are and was like a modern 2 bedroom city apartment with a balcony.  We were very happy.  The suite was super clean, modern and so much bigger and spacious than your normal hotel room plus it had a modern kitchen and dining table.  There was a double bed in each of the bedrooms and the large bathroom had a shower, toilet and vanity.   The location was  great in an area with lots of restaurants, cafes and a convenience store nearby.  All this and friendly staff mean we have no hesitation recommending it as a good place to stay.

title: fsntastic value, brilliant location
text: Great hotel at the price, the rooms are big and fully equiped and the location is perfect, right in the center of hamiltons main street.  Would really recomend this hotel

title: An excellent hotel right in the centre of lovely hamilton.
text: The hotel was great.  Right in the centre of Hamilton and near all the shops, bars and restaurants.  The rooms were huge with excellent self-catering facilities and a lounge area.  Everything was very clean and the en-suite was also very good. The reception area was also good with a coffee machine, internet and lounge area.

title: comfortable large rooms which were very clean
text: I wanted to write this review as I had read other reviews before staying there for a full week during the rowing world championships. The place was very clean and the service attentive and friendly. My room didn't have a window but when I stayed at the Ibis in Hamilton they gave me a room with a view over a car park and Victoria Street is not the place to stay if you are after a view.  It is in the midst of shops, restaurants and bars which was good and not at all noisy.  I had a good stay at this place which is not fancy but very comfortable.  The nearby Chef's Kitchen Indian restaurant was really lovely, again not fancy but very welcoming and terrific food.

title: Perfectly adequate for the price, good central location
text:
The renovations are complete and the Hotel presented as clean, modern and comfortable.  It is not fully serviced and reception closes at 9.00pm but there are many restaurants, bars and shops within 5 minutes walk.  Finding the parking lot was a bit of a problem but direct access, even in a wheelchair, from it into the hotel worked well.  The suites are modern, well presented and ours were quiet.  The staff where friendly if somewhat inexperienced.
A very handy place in the heart of Hamilton's CBD.
Free, in room, wifi was a bonus.

title: This hotel is a disgrace, stay away
text:
This place can not even call themselves a hotel.  It is truely awful.   It is shabby, uncomfortable and has unfriendly staff, We had to go and buy soap as the bathrooms had liquid soap dispensers attached to the wall (and in the shower) which reak of "high school pranks".  One of my colleagues had to sleep on top of the bedding as he felt it was just too disgusting and unclean, (there was a stain (large and yellow) on the top of the bed sheets and on the pillow. )  
You are not allowed vistors after 9pm so It feels like an overpriced Hostel. 
Stay away

title: Excellent
text:
Although we only stayed one night, we were very happy with our choice of accomodation. We arrived after hours, around 3 am, with no problems retrieving the key with security and getting into the carpark. The unit was satisfactory - spacious and clean. 
The service deserved special mention - It was absolutely excellent; really goes above and beyond. My friend had accidentaly left a valuable jewellery at the hotel - we contacted Guru and he managed to retrieve it in the bedroom and have it returned to our address in Sydney. Really thank you for the excellent service! :)

title: Superb hotel with friendly staff
text: We stayed two nights, the guy at reception was always at hand and was very helpful when we asked for restaurants to go to close by. There  are some renovations going on but with that aside I can see that this hotel is going to look even better than it does now.  The reception very new and in front of the entrance. Other than that what more could you want, free parking, a nice room to stay in and in the heart of the city for just the price of a room ..Will definitely be back there

title: Best medium priced accommodation that we've ever encountered!
text: Suite was spacious, clean, central city with secure carparking. Whilst their were renovation works in progress in the downstairs lobby we could see the potential of this that would enchance the hotel appeal.

title: Stay Away - A Disgusting Pit of a Hotel
text:
I had the misfortune of staying at this filthy hole with my family (wife and two young children) whilst visiting Hamilton for a rugby match. We were ripped off to the tune of $280 for a "suite" because the game was in town. The rate the following night was half of this. The room was dingy, dirty and smelly with sheets that had been used before. The walls are paper thin. We had requested a rollaway bed in advance but didn't get one. We had arrived late and the desk staff (one guy) disappeared before we had a chance to complain. No number was given to ring after hours. Around 10pm, the drunken parties kicked off in other rooms and we ended up having to sort the noise out ourselves due to the lack of staff. On the verge of calling the police, a night porter eventually appeared but was useless. When the noise eventually abated at 3am, he kept us awake for the rest of the night with noisy footsteps up and down the corridor.

After five visits to NZ, this dump is by far the worst place I've stayed in (and probably the worst hotel I've ever stayed in). I wouldn't put my dog in it. An absolute disgrace.

title: Worst hotel in New Zealand
text: Very bizarre experience!  We arrived late 11:30 pm and the manager was nice to meet us and help us into our room. It does have a private parking garage, but no parking to check into the hotel. Our room was dirty and disgusting with soiled carpets, old beds, and hair on our bedding! It was very noisy!  Our door to our bedroom wouldn't close. The room itself was large, but that is all I could say about that. The door to the room didn't have a lock, so I didn't feel very safe. We couldn't wait to leave the next day, and left at 7:30A.M. It was the worst hotel in our entire 2 week stay of New Zealand. It was very expensive and not worth the money. They are still undergoing a remodeling of the lobby and hallways. I don't know when they will remodel the rooms. The pictures online are not very accurate.

title: Surprisingly great hotel
text:
On first appearance, we thought this was going to be a horrible hotel. It didn't help that we arrived very early morning hours (around 3am) and there was a lot of construction/remodeling going on. So first appearance was not good.

HOWEVER,  after checking things out the next day... we found it to be a very lovely place. Manager was excellent, very friendly, knowledgeable of the area. Staff was great. The maid did a wonderful job cleaning our room. Size was excellent for three adults.

We like to come back again after the remodeling is complete to see what a great hotel this really is.

And it was very affordable. We stayed for one week. And would definitely return.

title: Spacious, simple, secure, central
text:
I stayed for about 3 months while on business.  The management was accomodating to my wife and I.

Pros

1. Located in the middle of the main street in Hamilton CBD
2. Secure, off street parking
3. Large rooms, enough to fit pool table.
4. Friendly, down to earth staff
5. Free internet access at request
6. Reasonably new facilities
7. Prices below competition in area
8. Free local newspapers everyday

Cons
1. It doesn't have that touch of luxury e.g. carpets, tiles need professional cleaning, door locks need to be replaced with card system, internal phone in lobby instead of full time receptionist, elevator slow, 
2. Car park smells most likely due to neighboring restaurant

So all in all I would recommend it to those looking for a simple place to stay and not expecting luxury.

title: Very accommodating
text: Great staff - very helpful. Great large rooms, very spacious; excellent for a group booking. Excellent location right in the city centre near the night clubs and cafes. One level of rooms makes it easy to visit friends in other rooms. The hotel took on over 50 of us and it was a great easy stay, few stressful moments

title: An unusual but satisfactory experience
text: Admittedly an unusual but adequate hotel. We wondered what we had struck when we navigated thru the maze of corridors to our very large suite which was great for our extended family's stay. It certainly worked out cheaply per head and the suite coped with 7 people for 2 nights without feeling cramped. I found the staff very helpful if a tad amateurish.

title: Avoid this hotel!
text: I stayed here for 4 nights and it was truely horrible! Every other hotel room in the city was booked out because of a large sporting event, so we were trapped.  We requested (and paid for!) a triple room but got a single room which they squeezed a double bed and two single fold-out beds into.  A freind in the next room has bites all over his legs from bugs in his room. NEVER, EVER stay here!

title: worst hotel in new zealand
text:
pre booked, stepped into room swung around to husband and said we cannot stay here. The smell was so over whelming, with warmth in the air and it took your breath away. Exiting the room a glance into the bathroom, a large cockroach was in the shower.
Went down stairs asked for a refund, was refused. was told that it would take one month for hotel to recieve money from booking company. Requested to speak to his boss, was then told it would be 2 days for hotel to recieve money.  Manager caught out with a lie. After a couple of phone calls ro booking company and return to hotel, Manager agreed to allow cancellation. Whilst there he had relet this same room. Earlier the manager agreed there was a smell, but it was from a leak in the roof. Where there is one cockroach seen there must be others. The appearance of Hotel, down to poor Management is a disgrace to the hospitality industry.
Michelle From Australia

title: I MIGHT AS WELL STAYED IN A PIG PEN OR SOMETHING MORE WORSE
text: I would never stay here again in my life- the entrance from the carpark to reception is disgustingly smelly worse than a pig pen and mixed with other smells. the hotel totally needs an upgrade, there are other hotels at the same cost that is a 3star hotel - would rate this as a 1 star. the rooms smelt old, meldew and not breathable. the Aircon did not work, the patio walls are growing moss and has lots of bird poops on it. the linen sheet had brown stains on it and look as if it wasnt cleaned. i would never recommend anyone to stay at this disgusting hotel and this is rated at a 3 star - should be 1 star or half a star. This is more like a back packers hotel or worse. the staff is not friendly at all.

title: Victoria Hotel, Hamilton
text: The hotel was very easy to find for our first time in Hamilton and it was dark by the time we got there. Plenty of space in the room.  Very child friendly, Nice that the factilities were modern and not dated. Very clean and helpful to have extra pillows. An overall must if you are staying in Hamilton it was excellent and will be staying there again, definately.

title: Fine if you can get it cheaply
text:
Very basic and slightly dated. Secure parking is only locked late at night and opened up early in the morning, so not very secure, but at least it's free.
We had a studio room and the kitched consisted of fridge and microwave. There wre cups and plates but nowhere to wash them except for the bathroom.

title: Rather soulless hotel
text: Handy for restaurants. Good parking. We wouldn't stay here again.

title: Trying to be something it's not
text: This hotel bills itself as suites and has a gorgeous website.  The reality is that it really is little better than cheap motel furniture in a larger room.  It is more like dorm furniture than hotel furniture.  It claims high speed internet access - only in some rooms, not available in all (most rooms have NO access).  The front desk has very limited hours.  You are not allowed to use calling cards to make phone calls.  There are much nicer places to stay in the Hamilton CBD.

title: Not much to say
text:
Hamilton 4th largest city in New Zealand.  Neat clean rooms, plenty of space.  Booked a twin queen studio, don't know what the "studio" bit meant.  Had a room with two queen beds, suited two adults and two children.

Rooms clean and nothing fancy.  If you are simply looking for a place to stay and don't mind a simple room, then this would be fine.

They don't offer breakfast as part of the deal.  Need to go out into Hamilton for that.

title: Great stay thanks Tudor
text: I stayed one night as a solo female up for a heart procedure. I was worried after reading all the negative reviews. Is it dated and basic Yes, but it had everything I needed. The lovely lady at reception upgraded me to a two bedroom unit upstairs and booked a reliable taxi for me early the next morning. It was clean and tidy, there were three working air cons in the room so I wasn't cold. It was very quiet and I got a good night's sleep before surgery. I meet some lovely Asian folks staying there and at no time did I feel unsafe. Water pressure was great and hot, I got milk. I must be one of the lucky ones that had a great experience.

title: Run Down.  Grubby exterior and would never go here again.
text:
We were booking into this motel as the preferred option for an appointment at the Waikato hospital as we live a fair way away from Hamilton. I was very dubious given the reviews on Booking.com but decided I would check it out for myself. My husband and I stayed on the 29/6. First appearance was driving down the driveway to the motel which the driveway took you to the back of the units where the office was. There was a child size mattress on the driveway and too the right longish grass and a pool covered with a tarp and fenced off. The water looked green. I had difficulty finding the office and beside it was a broken washing machine and a lot of other used and broken stuff. When the receptionist finally came ( she was out helping someone else and I called her 4 times by ringing the bell. She said I could choose from 2 rooms.  One downstairs and the other upstairs. When I asked what the difference was she said upstairs would be quieter. We opened the door and the unit looked a bit grubby to me but not really bad. The bed was a double and we rolled towards to middle so not the easiest to sleep in   The shower glass was covered in soap scum. We opened the kitchen window and outside of it were lots of dust and cobwebs. I’m guessing not much gets done on the exterior as it was all very grubby looking and could do with a good steam cleaning. 
 Our unit had no milk and the fridge froze the stuff I put in there even though it was only turned to 2. 
I have to go back over there next week and I have chosen to pay for my own motel at $126 a night for something much newer and nicer. It’s a shame these people are guaranteed an income from the hospital booking patients and relatives there so they don’t need to do maintenance or upgrades.

title: Never ever again
text: Was supposed to stay here as i was support person to my brother in hospital HOWEVER I was suspicious on first view, reception was average looking but person pleasant. Went to my room upstairs it was dark and within minutes I heard loud swearing from the back...enough to make me feel unsafe.  Very old and outdated, I felt unsafe and place felt very uncomfortable. Messaged my cousin and went to stay with her, Thank goodness. My brother has to go back n for a week and no way is he staying there we've found a much nicer one and closer and I'll personally pay the extra cost so that I know he is safe and comfortable.

title: Pleasant Homely vibes
text:
Definitely a no frills experience dated facility worth the cheap cost . With the most freindly staff ready to accomadate you where they can. Close to town and shuttles to hospital. Very clean, rooms serviced daily.

it gives off an old motel feel, which for some is a pleasant experience with its homely vibes.
Pool not operational, kitchenette with basic utensil Works fine.

highly reccomended not flash but good value.
Thankyou Tudor

title: Over Priced, Poorly Maintained and Not Recommended.
text: The photos seen in the booking process bore no resemblance to what we received.  The motel is run down and in need of major upgrade. Whilst our room was relatively comfortable the kitchen facilities were completely run down and were on the dirty side.  The bathroom window was opaque but if you showered at night your silhouette  could be seen from the car park and street above.  The morning I was greeted with a cold shower!  On check in we were greeted by a women (Chinese) with poor english standing well behind a perspex barrier.  It was difficult to relay our comments to her on how we found the condition of the motel.

title: please dont stay here it is a health risk
text: the place is very dirty, sheets on bed are grey/brown had to go an buy my own sheets ,the bedding on the mattress protector and electric blanket had urine stains and other bodily fluid stains on them very off putting. mold at the back of the toilet the size of a dinner plate ,outlet drain in shower broken curtains have coffee stain all over them and the aircon filter is full of black mold opened to take a look as started coughing while staying here overall this is a health risk for people to stay here.

title: budget quality
text: Luckily I read reviews before staying there so I was prepared for the worst. I didn't book it myself. I notice they say the rooms are refurbished, but ours wasn't. Having a low expectation helped. You could take your own towels, tea towels, fly spray and disinfectant wipes, as I did. I was glad I did. I can only go by my own experience but it is a basic, budget motel and it was adequate. Other motels in the area charge a lot more. I did find the staff very pleasant and helpful, but maybe they don't read the reviews, which is a pity. A bit more effort would go a long way. I would rather not stay there again but if I had to, I would take my own gear again. Just don't expect much and you can't be disappointed.

title: Good place to sleep
text: I am a motel cleaner myself and was satisfied with the room, lovely couple who cleans the rooms themselves so really have to give it to them for their service as well as the state of the rooms, they do great for what they have, my son and I stayed in room 28 which is upstairs, 1 bedroom with a queen bed, room has all the basics you need, stove top but no oven, the next night we were lucky to be rebooked In as we didn’t have to stay in the hospital and we got room 32 which is downstairs and had a separate bedroom with a queen bed and 2 singles in the main area. Shower pressure was great in both rooms, towels and rubbish gets left out the door and is replaced. Wifi was good.

title: Needs a overhaul
text:
We have stayed twice in the last 2 months due to hospital appointments both times have been a terrible stay the rooms are not well cleaned we found mold in the bathroom around the windows and shower floor.  Dust over wire covers. grease and grime in the kitchen. rust in the microwave. We found blood on the wall near the TV power point The pool looked like it had not been cleaned in months.

These rooms are meant to be disinfected after each time the room is vacated Due to Covid.

title: Desperately needs maintenance.
text: Two nternal doors would not shut without jamming, and the third, the toilet / shower was not able to be closed within the frame.  The electric jug leaked water out of its base.  The dining table was very wobbly.

title: Old but good
text:
Old but good. Refurbished where needed. Spacious rooms. Good value, budget friendly. Excellent staff service. Stayed here to see a Show at nearby Theatre. Great location, easy walk to both theatre and restaurants.
Winter stay, so heat pump (quiet) much appreciated.

title: Bare minumum of kitchenware:  missing hand soap
text:
We chose this motel for its location.

This motel room and ensuite size were fine.  The owner, who was quite friendly, did arrange a room on the bottom, so we did not have to undergo the stairs.  The room was clean enough.  

There was no hand soap in the dispenser, so we had to get it each time from the dispenser in the shower.

When we came to cook breakfast however there was very minimum equipment.  The two plates were very big, with no other option.  Two knives, two forks, one teaspoon.

There are better and cheaper Hamilton motels available - we will not be going back.  This place is over-priced!

title: Recently renovated
text: I’m guessing the rooms were recently made over. I booked this place before reading the “tired motel” reviews and was a little apprehensive but I needn’t have worried. Our room 24 greeted us with the smell of fresh new carpet. Fresh paint job too I would think. Large kitchen, great shower with contemporary fittings. Great location, only a short walk into town. Great value too so give it a go!

title: Cheap and cheerful
text:
.Budget friendly motel.
Yes a little bit tired but clean and dry warm .
Good clean bedding, linen etc.
Is good location, 
Has heat pumps in each room and tvs.
Only odd thing is lack of toiletrys. There is a combined body wash shampoo pump in shower but none on hand basin.
Odd.
Recommend for short stay , especially overnights.

title: New Zealand 2019
text: This motel is an older style motel but in a good location just on the outskirts of Hamilton.  It is about 2 blocks from Pac N Save supermarket and about 4 blocks from the CBD.  The motel room was a good size and had a well equipped kitchen.  The receptionist was really nice and showed us to our room when we arrived.  We were on the ground floor of the 2 storey building.  We used Hamilton as a base for a few days visit Taupo, Tauranga and Matamata (to visit Hobbiton).  There a lot of good shops to visit in the CBD and we took time out to visit the botanical gardens.  We will stay here again when we return to Hamilton in the future.

title: Tired hotel
text:
I arrived in Hamilton after a long day in Waitomo Cave watching glow worms. It was raining by the time I arrived at the destination, the reception was kind enough to expedite my check-in but once she saw my 3 kids running in, she told me that I only put 3 pax for my room although the room could easily accommodate 5 pax (the exact pax). She told me that her manager demanded extra $20 for that.. I didn’t understand why but I didn’t want to argue much due to the long and fatigue day so I just paid the extra. I didn’t realise that I’d made mistake by keying in the wrong number of pax but the extra was totally unwarranted for. Just so you know.. it was managed by a Chinese (please don’t call me racist as I’m a Chinese myself) but I felt profiteering is being practiced here. 

My wife complained that the carpet was in need to be cleaned thoroughly as she’s very particular in cleanliness. Lucky for us we only stayed for a night.

title: A Tired Motel
text: I am an American traveling through NZ.  Overall I have found the NZ accommodations to be good.  Because of the ANZAC Holiday pickings were pretty slim in Hamilton and I stayed at the Tudor.  The Tudor is an old facility which needs a major refurbishing.  There is nothing all that bad, it is just that it needs a better bed and a major sprucing up.  We stayed 2 nights and though they gave us new towels, they failed to make the bed on the second night.  Probably I should give the place a 2.5, but that is not possible.

title: comfortable and easy to get on with
text: Receptionist, Celine, was excellent rooms were as described and clean. Facilities were as described. They were willing to make our stay, 35 female footballers, as enjoyable as possible. Happy to let us move BBq to a more accessible area. Within walking distance of CBD

title: Good location, but needs a thorough clean
text: As we decided on a last minute trip to Hamilton on the same evening as the Sevens, there were hardly any options available. We found Tudor online for $175 per night (this is obviously higher than their normal rate due to being an event weekend). Location was great, within walking distance to the city centre. The room was in need of a really good clean. There were stains on the carpet and food marks (hopefully it was just food) on the walls and doors. Our friends who stayed in the room next door to ours found a used bar of soap with a hair on it in their shower. I understand this is a cheap hotel, however I would still expect it to be clean. In saying that, he room had everything you needed, and it was very quiet so we had a restful sleep.

title: clean and convenient
text:
pleasant staff, 
clean and convenient,bed was comfortable
They didn't make my bed after the first night which is something I have come to expect.
I loved the shower.
I thought $9.00 dollars for a skimpy continental breakfast on top of the room rate was a bit rich

title: Convenient and good value
text: We were pleasantly surprised at this motel.  Very good value, it was clean and warm and spacious.  We had everything we needed in the kitchen.   The staff were friendly.  It was close to everything.  Free off street parking

title: Pleasant
text:
A fairly basic motel that met our needs for rest and sleep.  Its dated and in need of a tidy-up.  Rooms were clean which is what I look for when choosing a place to stay.  
Walking distance to Hamilton Central and short drive to other points of interest.

title: I'm sure there are better options around
text: I stayed here 2 nights for a conference. It is in desperate need of a makeover/attention to detail- dated, some mould in the bathroom, curtains too short for the windows, door locks a bit flimsy. No information on checkin about check out, services etc. Not even a number to call for reception- I had to call from my cell phone to ask about checkout! Odd service too- came back after a day out to find my used towel gone but not replaced, and the bathroom window open. I appreciate it was safe, as it's up a story, but it was FREEZING!  And nothing else had been touched. The wifi is also unreliable. There was a heat pump and it was 15 mins walk from the main restaurant district which was convenient, but my advice would be to look elsewhere for somewhere nicer as I walked past 2 others on the same street. It strikes me as the kind of place that maybe was nice at some point, but  people have just bought it for some income and aren't really interested in the business.

title: Absolutely shocked!
text:
I booked a studio room for 2 nights.
I was on my own.
When I arrived I was” upgraded” to a room with 5 beds. It had 2 bedrooms and 2 beds in the lounge.
It was very crude and scruffy. In need of a makeover.
The double bed was very uncomfortable and I slept poorly.
Next morning was a beautiful day so I opened the windows.
Imagine my shock on finding the latch on my bedroom window was broken and anybody could have easily climbed in as the window was at my chest height from the  walkway outside.
I left immediately and requested a refund for the second night which I was given.
I have been left traumatised by this experience.

title: NICE MOTEL IN HAMILTON, NEW ZEALAND
text: The Tudor Motor Lodge is an older place on a side street. Our room was nice enough and had a kitchen. We were a little tired so I went to a grocery store and got food to cook for dinner in the room. There was free parking right next to the building.

title: Unsafe and dirty
text: Used to be a manager Margy but no more. Place has deteriorated since she has gone. Went to use jug but plug hanging out of wall and owner pretended not to understand. Used to stay when I visited Hamilton but I won't go back since Margy has left due to lower standards

title: Clean and Quiet
text:
We loved this motel! We were in town to have some medical investigations and were booked in here by a hospital. It turned out to be excellent! The whole unit was scrupulously clean, well stocked and very comfortable. The motel is not in its first youth, but really - does that matter? Modern is not always good in our experience, usually it means jerry-built! The whole place was very clean, the situation was extremely quiet (and we are country mice normally so city noise  could have been an issue) and the staff were friendly, helpful and hardworking. Beds were comfortable,everything worked perfectly (TV, appliances, A/C, FREE WIFI!!) and we were impressed!

The location is excellent - 6 minutes from pretty much anything you could want - fish and chips, restaurants, hospital,  shopping; it is all available. it is also easy to get to for  "out-of-towners" and parking was  marvellous; well off road and a capacious car park. 

We discovered that pets are also  allowed in some units, which if you are travelling with your canine or feline companion, is an absolute godsend.

We recommend giving this motel a try if you want somewhere comfortable in Hamilton.

title: Not impressed
text: My husband and Dad booked in on a Tuesday and I arrived the following Monday. I walked in and found that they had not cleaned their room for days it was dirty and uncomfortable to be there. Dad was sick during the week and they did not clean the toilet for 5 days, also Dad asked if they could change his sheets and they did not change them. My husband also told me that they hadn't changed his sheets either. I asked to see the manager and they avoided me. Maggie in the office was the only nice thing about that place.

title: Nice city motel
text: Booked 3 rooms including a family unit, managed to have all rooms next door to each other. Nice, clean beds. Clean showers. Family unit is spacious. Kids enjoyed having their own bed. Close to city centre, 5 mins walk. Definitely book here again.

title: Nice city motel with parking
text: What a nice little place, especially in the city and for a good price.  The Tudor Motor Lodge is a couple of blocks from the CBD and has free parking! This is a good thing with any city hotel.  The room was big and nice with a comfy bed, individual AC/heat control, electric blanket, windows that open and darkening curtains.  There is a kitchenette with a couple of burners, microwave, electric kettle and necessary dishes and utensils.  I didn't turn on the oversized tv.  The shower rocks and everything was clean.  There are convenient lights and some built in outlet adapters for those of us from far away lands.  The wifi works well.  Check in was easy and the staff very welcoming.  A nice outdoor patio with tables and benches is situated on the second floor.  There is no lift so if mobility is an issue, let them know to put you on the ground floor.

title: Not up to scratch
text:
I stayed here in the family unit with my three children. The only positive thing I could say is the bads were clean and comfortable. 
The full kitchen was tiny no oven and I don't know how anyone could cook for 7 people in it (thats what the unit could sleep) It was also filthy as was the bathroom which had hair everywhere from the last guests. There were two windows that didn't close and we looked out onto the rubbish from a room refit.

title: close to every thing.
text: loved being able to pop down the stairs to the commerce club for really great value meals.  We walked to town so no hassle with parking  our room had everything we needed for a weekend and for the money was well worth it.  would stay again.

title: Close the hospital and lake.
text:
I stayed overnight with our 3 dogs after hubbie was airlifted and admitted to Waikato hospital from South Taranaki.
The staff were very helpful and accommodating.
The room was perfect with good heat pump which worked well.  Clean, with everything you need.
Walking distance to the hospital, lake and city centre.
The dogs loved the place and I had no issues with them being here.  Worth the extra $20 per dog for the defleaing service post our stay.
Definitely with be staying here again when we have his follow up appointments.

title: Lovely
text: Not the flashiest motor lodge in the world, but lovely service and love the fact we could bring our two dogs. We did pay only $30 extra for them as they de-flea the sheets etc. The lady at reception was super lovely and super friendly! Had no issues with the place, sadly the people in the room to us kept banging something around, but not the owners fault for this. Heat pump worked well, walking distance to the lake and into town. Will be staying here again next time we drive though :) thank you!

title: A Good Place to Stay
text: We have stayed here several times when coming to visit or grandson at Waikato University. It's near the university and the CBD and restaurants. We have come accompanied by younger grandchildren and always made most welcome. On our last visit were warned they had 28 motorcyclists staying the night so it might be noisy but it wasn't. We had breakfast this time and it was very good and we were shown what the choice was and it was placed in our room the night before. Beds comfy. air conditioning and heating worked well and we had a full kitchen if we wanted to cook our evening meal. Suggestions as to where to eat locally were made.

title: Great place
text:
Awesome place very nice and just helpful with our needs.

Our room was nice and clean bedding were clean, hygiene was great. 

Enjoyed out two days we were there would deff recommend to other people. 

Had movies and DVD player for my boy to keep happy.

WiFi was awesome had no trouble with that.

Owner was very polite and helped us when we asked and needed it.

title: Cheap not cheerful
text: We had the unfortunate experience of having a room that was badly in need of refurbishment.  There had been a weather seal on the outside of the door at one stage which was missing and so there was a big draught coming through the bottom of the door.  This may also have been where the big black cockroach came in during the night and perched itself on the beside table.  The plumbing needed serious attention, pull the plug out in the sink and dirty water came up in the basin in the bathroom.  The cistern of the toilet took over an hour to fill.  Beds were comfortable and sheets and towels clean but we felt too uncomfortable to eat breakfast there and had a fairly sleepless night after discovery of our 'guest' which we put under a glass for the night.  There may be rooms more recently upgraded than this one, so if you book here, don't pick the cheapest price.

title: A grumpy manager and a place for hospital patients
text: Me and a friend stayed here on Saturday night for a dance party event down the road. There were 4 other rooms that also had young people staying that were going to the same event . The manager was friendly and fun when we arrived she said to have a fun night and we said we would turn our music off by 10. Turned out the boys next to us got too rowdy and one went to jump in the pool and missed! The manager then went absolutely mental and screamed at the four other rooms several times for even being on the balcony ! In my opinion they weren't even that loud . She ended up calling the police and got them kicked out . She came and told us we have to keep our music down and keep the door closed, and that we weren't even allowed to talk on the balcony.  then next thing the police turn up, they laughed at the manager because We weren't loud at all - the manager then said that patients come to stay here after hospital so we can't play any music - it was 8:45pm at this point . It should be advertised as a rest home not a hotel . Also when leaving in the morning she was screaming and swearing at her maids - just appalling

title: Wedding weekend
text: I was a little disappointed with this place. I should have looked at it first hand pool area very run down. Photo of it very deceiving good ole photos shop glamoured it up.  Shower rooms very poor little or No pressure horrible pull shut doors and very small shower rooms. Mouldy run down ceiling in the bathroom. We had  about 7 rooms booked out for the weekend of the 25 February and they were all charged out wrong to my quote very disappointing wont be back. The wedding was fantastic so Im not letting this accommodation spoil my memory of my sons wedding  cant be bothered complaining to the office as I don't think they know what they are doing too.

title: This place need Real maintenance! OK for a night, not more.
text: This place is very messy, specially in the ground floor. Many construction items, curtain falling apart, rusty barbecue parts waiting to be discarded (for a long time). It looks like to be maintained by unprofessional people. It looks like the laundry machines are shared by hotel staff and guests. Cleaning Staff is not very frindly. Eventually, the place is worn out and not so clean.

title: More than you'd expect for the price
text:
I stayed at this property three days over the course of three weeks. Frankly, there’s little to say about my stays there, as the place provides everything you expect. The three rooms I had all were clean, and with all facilities you would expect.

The WiFi is of excellent speed – clearly not the usual case of a business trying to pretend it has free WiFi for everyone when really what they have is a residential connection and a modem that shouldn’t have more than five people at a time. The connection did drop from time-to-time, which can be an annoyance, but all-in-all, it was great.

From what I could see, there was laundry facilities available – as I was staying for one day at a time, I didn’t try these, so can’t comment on those. Same with the pool, which I noticed but did not use.

Some rooms seem to have the air conditioning set to automatically reset after a certain length of time to 23 degrees. Not all rooms have this issue, but it was a slight inconvenience, though nothing worth getting upset about.

Any issues that I did have were quickly and pleasantly fixed. The location is run by a lovely lady who is more than helpful.

Overall, my stays were more than pleasant. For a very reasonably priced place, I was more than happy, and I would certainly come back again.

title: Friendly, affordable motel that is pet friendly
text: This motel is great value for money. In a good location - walking distance to central Hamilton.My room was clean and comfortable. I was travelling with a pet and the staff were accomodating regarding this. The lady on reception was genuinely helpful.

title: Good location - old and dirty
text: The place is very handy to town which is useful as parking in the city is often hard to find. We had a one bedroom suite.  The room was dirty.  The kitchen area was okay and had your standard tea and coffee.  But you dont even get a bar of soap in the bathroom just the liquid dispenser.  I wouldnt stay there again.

title: Antiquated but inexpensive
text: For the price, the Tudor Motor Lodge was not that bad. The only thing keeping me from giving this place a 4 star review is the dated feel to the entire place. The rooms are in need of a serious upgrade. Location wasn't too bad, since the walk to the main couple of streets was under 10 minutes, but it still doesn't compare to a place located right in the city center or over looking the lake.

title: Tudor lodge
text: We spent 3 nights in this lodge.  It was not modern but the rooms were tidy and neat.  There is a full kitchen.  It is close to the Waikato Hospital,and an easy walk to the shopping centre.  The staff were friendly and helpful.

title: Felt Like Home
text:
Our flight to New Zealand got us in around 11:00pm. We decided to take advantage of the night and drive down to Hamilton so we could get an early start at our first destination - Hobbiton. As with most motor lodges, the desk closes around 9pm. We phoned ahead and spoke with the proprietor who was so very understanding. She assured us that she would leave the key in a disclosed location and keep the lights on for us. Sure enough when we finally arrived to the motel at 1am, everything was exactly as she said. She even gave us a larger room because there were four of us. 
Upon checkout we spoke with the owner, sorry I wished I remembered her name, and what a delight she was. She informed us of a hot air balloon festival which was happening in town that weekend. We wished we could stay. Oh, the room was charming, beds were comfortable, the bathroom a bit old fashioned - but everything worked. She laid out chocolates for us. Perfect for after a long drive and a sweet before bedtime. We will visit again!

title: DOGS!!!
text:
The motel is old but the owners are trying.  New bedding, new heat pump, new tv.  Unfortunately a bit of paint wouldn't go amiss and the plates were greasy & wet.  My biggest issue was the dogs of other guests not only yapping but allowed to wander the grounds without a leash.  I don't want to stay in a room where dogs have and in fairness I couldn't find any trace in the room.  Location good, easy walk to town, the place we usually stay is in the same street but wasn't available.
Our room had a roller shower door, first time I'd seen one and was quite impressed until I used the shower and there is no handle inside to open the door.  Had to jiggle it a lot to escape :-)

title: Ugly but cheap
text:
You'll get what you're paying for. It was the only place I could get, I booked it just 30 minutes before getting there and they had the room ready with a carton of milk in the fridge. 
If you're used to go fancy places you won't like this one... to have a better time just try to remember the price of the room and it won't look that bad.

title: Terrible experience
text:
Visit tudor yesterday.its totally wastage of money.that old women on reception is so rude .room was so smelly.bed sheet was very dirty,microwave wasn't working.toilet seat was so dirty.its a terrible experience.Facility is 1*,old building.
 Heater was not very efficient, took ages to heat the room.

title: Great staff
text:
The motel was just as expected, plenty of parking and spacious, clean rooms. 

What made this stay great were the staff; we had a really delightful lady check us in... Made us feel very welcome and gave us fresh milk for cups of tea! So thank you.

I'd recommend.

title: Great value + really friendly and helpful
text: My title says it all .... Friendly couple running it who helped us with tips to get good fish and chips and information. Not a fancy place but at the price it was definitely good ... all the facilities you need ... Not fancy my any means .... But comfortable and clean.

title: Outstanding friendly and helpful hosts
text: Location is very convient although an older building unit was clean and well appointed. The first unit we were shown was cramped but on request was cheerfully changed to a larger more comfortable one.

title: Awful.
text: Walked into the room and was instantly hit with an awful smell. The room had clearly not been cleaned properly as there were crumbs on the couch and bits of food on the floor. There were also A LOT of flies hanging around. It was honestly so dirty that we had to leave after five minutes. Would NOT recommend!

title: Very Dated Decor
text: Husband had a hospital appointment on two consecutive days so needed to stay overnight in Hamilton. Good comfortable bed and very quiet motel as no road noise. But the unit was very dated and although I was assured we had been upgraded (goodness knows why) I would not have liked to have stayed in a unit that in theory we had booked. No dinner plates in cupboards so just as well we decided to eat out. Ok for breakfast as there were bowls we could use. Bathroom in need of renovation. I doubt I would stay here again but it served its purpose for one night.

title: Second visit
text:
Thought we would try this motel again and although different room on ground floor room was hot and stuffy with very little ventilation as windows very small. Yes you could leave door open but seeing all guests walked passed it as we were right on the corner to get to car park that was not nice having them staring into yr room.
Utensils very scarce, no small sharp knife and hardly any dish wash in bottle.
Sky channels were just about nil. Lawn strip along entrance to ground floor units unmowed and very untidy. Lady who checked us in very helpful and polite. By the look of photos units upstairs are more spacious and better set out.
Two tiny white prescription tablets found on carpet which would of been a major concern if kids had been staying in unit.

title: Friendly staff made it
text: Don't let the pictures of the pool fool you . Haven't said that reasonable prices for a two night stay . Rooms were clean and easily presented . Lodge is situated just a short jaunt from the cbd action . Staff are what made this trip for me . All very friendly and accommodating . Highly recommend .

title: Economical and close to city and hospital
text: The hospitable hosts accommodated for my needs and were very friendly and humble people.  The spacious room had modern decor and comfy beds. Fortunately I was able to do a late booking and extend my stay due to hospital visits, as the motel had no vacancies by the end of the night. The complex does however need some maintenance repairs e.g. windows and toilet doors.  I will be back with my grandchildren in summer time to use the pool if the rate is still reasonably priced.

title: Cheap, comfortable, cheerful and clean
text: We booked a one bedroomed apartment for 3 of us for a one night stay.  Our trip was a last minute one for a funeral so after paying for flights we wanted to keep other costs down.  We received a warm welcome here and shown to our unit and the features and how the heating worked.  Although these motels are quite dated they were clean and comfortable and the beds gave us a good nights sleep.  Tea and coffee facilities provided and basics in the bathroom.  A quiet location.

title: Amazing sleep
text: Was a great place to stay, very friendly staff, room was nice and comfy, bed was amazing, so much that we wanted to keep it lol..bed were very warm and made to a great standard. Cant fault this place at all except for the false advertising of sky tv. Thanks for the great stay. Rm 20 :)

title: Good Value
text: Good location, staff friendly and motel clean. Motel unit was big enough for two but not three! Shower definately wants attention, hardly any pressure at. Motel was also very musty smelling, wants a good airing

title: A little surprise
text: This motel has since been taken over by a young couple who are slowly doing up the rooms.   Although a little dated the room I had was clean and comfortable, lots of TV channels and very handy to the lake and town.  They also allowed me to take my dog with me who was very good.   A very quiet motel and worth a try and not expensive to stay.  Am sure will see some changes in the year ahead.

title: Service with a smile
text:
The occasion of a family wedding brought us to Hamilton in the Waikato, just 90 minutes down the road from Auckland  for a one night stopover..

Our twin share unit had tons of room, was emaculately clean and tidy. Service was outstanding and staff could not do enough for us. The little matters that easily add up, were expertly dealt with. Wow, what a bonus on top of the wedding!!!!

Location, close to turn off from Auckland and onward to the Coromandel Peninsula, Rotorua and Taupo, was ideal too.

title: All we could desire
text: We were travelling from the far north of the Coromandel Peninsular to Hamilton after work and to be in time for business meetings the next day.  The motel owner was very accommodating of our late check-in time which was after the office closed for the day, and made arrangements for us to find our room.  A good night's sleep resulted and a successful day followed...

title: Highly recommended
text: Highly recommended, we stopped off in Hamilton for a couple of days on the way from Auckland to the ferry to the South Island.  The motel was a random choice but definitely a very good one..  The accommodation was very good with a separate room from the bedroom as a kitchen/dining room.  The motel owner was very friendly and, when the summer sun proved to be too much for us obligingly supplied a fan.  The location of the motel was great, within waling distance of bars and restaurants and about 10 minutes from Hamilton Gardens and the Waikato River Cruises.

title: A comfortable 5-day stay
text:
After reading the mixed reviews from previous visitors, I checked it out before deciding to stay here for 5 nights. I stayed in studio unit #16, and found it clean and comfortable. 
The queen-size inner-spring bed was very comfortable. It had an electric blanket, and duvet. There were also extra polar-fleece blankets if needed.  
The unit was quite warm, and there was an upright digital thermostat-controlled heater that keep the unit cosy on some colder nights. 
The lighting was well-placed and at a much better level than the dim light in a lot of hotels. The lounge had 2 comfortable chairs with adjustable back-rests, and HD TV.
The kitchen had 2-ring cook-top, microwave, electric jug, and toaster, 2 saucepans, and a frypan, fridge. I only used the last 2, which worked fine, as I was only having breakfast there. All were clean, as was the crockery. the kitchen table was large enough for 3 people, and the chairs were comfortable. 
Shower had a Topliss mixer, and a retracting plastic shower. This is a great improvement on the flappy plastic curtains that seem to be a mandatory fixture for many hotels and motels. Shower had a water-saving head, but still had reasonable pressure.
The door between the bathroom and the shower was showing its age, with some of the facing along the bottom showing bare wood. This was only decorative, as it still functioned well. 
Towel, facecloth, and shower mat were cleared then I requested them to be changed. 
The rubbish was only cleared every 2-3 days. I didn't create much, but it would be something to check if 3 people were having all their meals there.
Overall: The unit was clean and tidy, comfortable and functional. Car parking was good, and well-spaced. I would happlily stay there again, and would recommend it to friends and family as a comfortable place to stay at a competitive price.

title: 5 Star service & Pet friendly!
text:
Had the loveliest 2 night stay here. The owners are the most friendly accommodating people. From someone who travels regulary ,it was so nice to be treated as a guest and not a number! My dog was able to stay and had a big grass run to play on. Bed was super comfy and rooms were extremely clean.
