I only stayed because it was pet friendly but from now on i will stay all the time for work and be telling others.
Absolute pleasure, thank you so much for a lovely stay.

title: Cat friendly
text: We stayed here only because we needed a place to stay while moving north for the night that allowed cats. Not too many places left that do this these days. The room was average, with some work done on it, but we did not mind as we had the cats. The owner/manager was lovely and we meet her sphynx (hairless) cat

title: Lovely friendly and welcoming!
text: I have had a look at these reviews and I completely disagree with most of these. The place was overly clean, nice tidy environment clean units, I certainly couldn't smell any smoke?? Lovely and friendly owners always keen to help ya and crack some jokes. The room was very modern as apposed to what every one is saying, nice beds, nice linen, new TV all the good stuff you would expect from a nice motel. Would recommend to anybody! If you have any doubts I'm sure once you meet the owners you would love to stay here. - emily

title: Motel in good location
text:
I would agree some of the rooms are dated but the furnishings were new and stylish (bedding etc) 

Had no issues with cleaning either, clean rooms and no bad smells.

Well stocked kitchenette although we didn't use but full size cooker, fridge, etc.

Friendly welcome and good central location. Easy to walk to bars and restaurants. 

There is a launderette on site, didn't use but imagine very useful if been travelling for a while.

title: needing a makeover
text: booked casual for family,room dinge dark,dead roaches,rubbish bin not empty,no sky tv,shower felt like it was going to collapse,strong smoke smells outside,very abrupt response when cancelled other two nights,did not refund two thirds  of cost,claimed we could have delayed others,suspect we were only guests other than permanents so consider we not inconvenience them,stayed two doors away,less cost two rooms all amenities and lovely hosts

title: Not the best
text: We definitely would not stay here again felt it was overpriced for a very basic and dated room. Advise if travelling with a dog make sure you check the price before handing over your credit card details they charge an extra $30.00 for cleaning.

title: Old but clean motel with friendly service!
text: My wife and I stopped at Hamilton for the night on our drive from Waitomo to Auckland. We wanted a reasonably priced motel room close to the city centre and this was it. Enjoyed friendly service from our hosts...

title: Wipe your feet on the way out!!!!
text:
I stayed here for 3 weeks for work I travel a lot and this is the worst place I've stayed ,dirty motel room ,rude and arrogant service is constant leave your wet towel on the floor to get a clean one and get back from work to find it is still on the floor and still wet but they had time to come in and open all windows(daily) but no time to close them at night(in WINTER) so u walk in to a freezing cold room! (every night after work) washing machine and dryer don't wash or dry properly. It took 10 days and a phone call to get the sheets changed and floor was not cleaned once in three weeks.
The only good thing about this place is that the Commerce Club is very close!!!!(the staff at the club are first class as is the food)
I wouldn't wish a stay here on my worst enemy or a dog that bit me. 
Yours truly, Big D.

title: always a pleasant stay
text: My husband and I were in Hamilton for 2 nights and as we had stayed here a few years ago and had liked it then, we decided to return. The place is older but very well maintained with modern facilities were needed ie the tv. The owners were lovely and very helpful when asked about places to visit. Quite happy to chat with us and share the odd joke. This place is close to everything with restaurants etc all walking distance. Yet it is very quiet with no road noise at all. A very large car park at the front with accommodation behind. We stayed in a small studio unit both times but these are large enough to be able to move around with loads of space for our own stuff. The bed was a bit hard but I like a soft bed. Everything was very clean with hand soap and shower/body soap dispensers provided. Highly recommend. We were on a ground floor and although we knew there were others above us we only heard a slight noise a couple times and this during the day time.

title: Family / animal stay
text: This was absolutely a great place to stay we were a family of 4 adults 2 children 2 powderpuff dogs and 2 rotties.We were made to feel most welcome and it was a most relaxing worry free stay. The kids enjoyed the pool and the dogs were made welcome too. Would definetly recommend this to any family who travel with pets and even those who don't as it was as nothing seemed to be a bother. Will certainly go there again and will recommend it to other family and friends. Who cares about flash if you are made to feel welcome.

title: Unplanned  in New Zealand
text:
During our trip in New Zealand in Ocotober 2012, my sister in law fell ill and was transferred to Hamilton Hospital. Needing a place to stay nearby, we booked into the Tudor Lodge, a fifteen minute walk away from the hospital.
The Tudor lodge is very reasonably priced and whilst it may nor be five star, it is very comfortable and the owner - Karen Lyman -  is a lovely and very helpful person.
Happily my sister in law had recovered  enough for our scheduled flight back to Australia where she lives, but the Tudor Lodge was happy to hold our room in case the hospital did not consider her well enough to travel.

title: value for money
text: After arriving in hamilton on a rainy night in peak hour traffic my husband and I who usually stay at 5 star establishments came into town to find a large conference on and the big hotels  booked out. After viewing a few hotels at the other end of town which we didnt like the look of we ended up here. The reception from the owners was warm and friendly so we decided to stay the night here. Yes what a great location only 750 mtr into the main resaurant and bar area of Hamilton. The owners even had umbrellas available for us to use. As other reviewer say the  decor is a bit dated although the room had a flat screen TV and a fantastic heater that had a thermostat so we didnt over heat in the night. Not a flash hotel but great value for money.

title: Excellent location, service,cleanliness,cost. Trish & Michael B.
text: We stayed for 2 nights 15 & 16 January,2012.  Rebooked for 14 March. We found no issues to complain about. Value for money "ABSOLUTELY". So what if the place is looking a bit dated. An establishment does not have to be new to be comfortable. After all, at these prices one would not expect to stay in a Palace. If you want one of them go and pay their out rageous charges.

title: Good location and value for money
text: Stayed here resently and thought it was good value for the price. The motel is in a good location (walking distance to town) and is priced to suit. The owners are very helpful and cook us a good breakfast. I looked at other reviews (after booking) before staying here and was a little worried but found it to be above what i had expected after reading the reviews. I would stay here again because of the close proximity to town and because you are charged for what you get. If you want 5 star stay somewhere else and pay the big money

title: Thumbs Up for Location, Thumbs Down for Room
text:
Great location close to the heart of Hamilton City. Within walking distance of the main area for bars, restaurants, the casino and the stadium.

Unfortunately the complex is very dated, but the price reflects that. Choose this place for the location but not if you are after comfort.

title: Dirty, dirty, dirty
text:
The motel was in a good location as it was in walking distance of the central city.  The reception staff were friendly, however having their pets in the front office was a bit off, especially when the cat farted and smelt the place out.
Our room was very dated, but we knew that when we booked in so it wasn't a surprise.  It was a surprise though to find we had to slept in single beds, it had two rooms and there were four single beds which was a big weird.
The room was dirty, we found rubbish from what looked like a party underneath one of the beds, cans and wrappers and dead bugs everywhere.  Yuck!
hotel_response: I am truely sorry that you found your unit dirty-no excuse but it was an extremely busy week-end(world cup rugby) and your unit obviously missed vaccuming. The room is set up for groups of 4 individuals. We have only owned the motel for 6 months and are trying hard to upgrade and refurbish the units. And hey kittens are like babies you dont always know what they're going to do

title: Absolutely sublime. Don't miss it.
text: This wonderful place would rank in the top 5 places my wife and I have stayed at in 25 years of travelling the world. It really is magical and just as the photos show it. Jessie and Craig were the perfect hosts, there when we checked to assist and then we were left alone to enjoy the property safe in the knowledge that they were not too far away if any help was required. We enjoyed a peaceful afternoon by the small lake in the company of the ducks, a candlelit evening meal followed by snuggling up together on the comfy, warm bespoke shaped bed. The outdoor shower is wonderful with plenty of hot water, breakfast by the lake and then all too soon it was time to leave, wishing we had time to stay more than one night. The whole place shown in the photos is yours for the stay, nobody else there save for the ducks. It's just lovely.

title: Magical Underhill must stay
text:
What a fabulous way to start our adventure thru the north island of New Zealand.  Being a Tolkien fan from a young age, this was a must when the travel agent offered this option.  On arrival, it was an awed and speechless moment, like a dream coming true.  Peaceful and rustic wooden and stone  interiors let the natural beauty shine, with the pond outside covered in lily pads with stunning yellow lilies and 2 little, friendly ducks.  The outdoor double bath by candlelight was a delightful experience.  
This is a piece of paradise and is a must place to stay while near Hamilton. There is a book available to read, that the owners father wrote about his life, and the history of Underhill. Jess your dad was an amazing, imaginative man and Thank you for opening this piece of magic to the public.  Thankyou

title: You have to stay here
text: This is the ideal place to stay, especially after doing the Hobbiton tour. It's relaxing and a unique experience.  From the outside bath and shower cave to the candle light and friendly ducks, it's fabulous.  Waking up and looking out of the window at nature is great.  Ideal for a couple wanting a romantic getaway

title: Unique hideaway
text:
It was the uniquest way to end a month of celebrations for my 80th birthday.  Having time to spend with my very special best friend in the quiet, playing potonk, lighting the coal range and listening to the whistle of the kettle made this experience so awesome and one that I will never forget.
I found that the toilet was a little too high for me and a stool would of helped.   Loved everything especially the wood and stone work.   Thank you Jessie and Craig.

title: Amazing
text: So freaking cool can’t say enough , great hostess , such kind people and lovely place to stay, I will soooo be back soon, and close to town and even on good places to visit only less than n hour away

title: Amazing Hosts
text: A perfect little spot for all kinds of special days.  The scenery is beautiful and you get a true hobbit experience. The hosts were so responsive, kind and adaptable. Couldn't recommend this place enough,

title: Phenomenal Stay
text: We spent 2 nights here as our mini honeymoon, and we have NO regrets! It was a fantastic getaway, and so peaceful. The hosts were gracious and would pick us up when needed. The outdoor bath was PERFECT, surrounded by candles and the stars. We couldn't have asked for better.

title: Great little getaway!
text:
Well hidden spot perfect for switching off and getting away for a bit. We didn’t expect the bathroom facilities to be so well set up so that was a bonus! Incredible view of the stars as well. 
One small feedback (though it didn’t affect us) would be that the outdoor bbq was full of creepy crawlies - it might need to be kept in a different spot? 
Thank you for having us!

title: Greatest place on earth
text:
Let me just say we were blown away. My wife and I spent our honeymoon at this amazing destination. We are from the United States and we wanted an amazing destination to celebrate our marriage. We arrived in New Zealand to find out we were unable to rent a car. The hosts came and picked us up from the airport and really helped us out. Not only did they accommodate us with the lodging they set us up with a package to transport us to different locations. They went above and beyond as hosts. 

Underhill is absolutely breathtaking. It’s quiet, beautiful, and honestly jaw dropping. Every part of the house under the hill was unique and different from anything we could have imagined. The outdoor shower and tub were something out of a fairy tale. The amazing view made for perfect relaxation. We left the doors open at night because it made for peaceful sleep. The pond had eels, now I know you think that is not a safe thing, but these eels were something else. We fed them by hand and it was awesome. The baskets for meals were fantastic and because of them we now have sundays with a grazing platter. That made a huge impact on us and turned into a tradition we have so thank you for that. We loved our experience here and to translate it into words is impossible. Thank you for everything! We will be staying here in the future without a doubt, we are planning our next trip and it WILL include spending more time at Underhill. 

-Josh and Hannah Mann

title: A hobbit hole of distinction
text: We spent a night at Underhill and loved every second of it from the gorgeous house to the outside bath and the surroundings. Hosts were absolutely lovely and we had everything a hobbit could desire. And there were even marshmallows. It was an absolutely magical experience and nice to get away from the modern day appliances for a night.

title: Fantastic getaway
text:
I surprised my husband with a 1 night getaway to Underhill. Easy to say we both loved this place. Nice and quiet. The bed was really comfy. We enjoyed the bath under the stars. We ordered a platter through Jess and it was plentiful and really yummy. They provided a chilly bin with ice. Tea & coffee making facilities all good. You have to rely on candles alone and a small torch for lighting. A battery operated portable lantern would be good to have. We had to head off at 6am so lighting wasn't the greatest at that hour, but our hosts went out of their way to do a early morning pick up to ensure we got to the airport on time. We visited early June when it was getting cold. There is a coal range for heating. It would be a nice touch during winter if this was going already for arriving guests as it does smoke a bit and then it would be cosy and warm.
we have stayed at a lot of glamping places and this is purely magical. For me to make this place outstanding would be perhaps maybe a portaloo be provided especially during winter as the outside toilet is a little way from main accommodation but on the plus you are provided with warm dressing gowns which is a nice touch and maybe a small charging device (tho I understand the whole chilled atmosphere no power, good excuse not to use your cellphones thing). 
There were flowers placed all around the place which I personally loved. 
the wow factor is the entrance (doors) to underhill and the fact you can sit on your own little deck by the pond and just chill :)

title: Weekend escape to Middle Earth!
text:
A fantastic experience from start to finish. 
We were fortunate to book this on a cold, but sunny Winters day. 
We were greeted by Craig, his dog, a ram, some calfs and some angsty pregnant ewes, and driven down the hill to our hidden home for the night. 
The photos they publish are spot on and not a product of clever digital photography. 
We made full use of the candles and the range once the sun began to set. We took our own food and fondue kit and were surprised at how well equipped the kitchen was with utensils, such as a grater and numerous pots, pans and even a cheese dome! 
The bath took a while to run so start it early, but it's so worth the wait to see the star clusters away from light pollution. It meant we didn't have a lot of hot water in the morning so you may need to shower together or quickly, if you like your water hot ( like I do). 
We had a fantastic nights sleep and I didn't mind waking up in the night to see the full moon glaring through the skylight. The ducks woke us at around 8:30am and we started to make a leisurely breakfast to enjoy by the pond.
For us city folk this break was a dream and it was so refreshing to lose the distractions that gadgets and devices serve. 
We topped off the weekend with a trip to Hamilton Gardens, Good George Brewery and of course, a trip to Hobbiton. 
Will certainly be back 1 day. Thank you.

title: Incredible getaway!
text: My wife and I spent three nights in heaven! Having a bath under the stars on a freezing Waikato evening was sensational! The next night we had a bath in the rain! The lack of electricity only adds to the wonder of being in nature - being woken by the birds, looking at the stars through the glass roof and generally being able to unwind and relax. Jess, Craig, Paige, Piper and Oakley - you are indeed wonderful people. Thank you for allowing us to experience your family hide away!

title: Wonderful getaway!
text: Craig and Jessie received us at their gate and were very warm and welcoming to us. Craig is very friendly and took time to show us the facilities at Underhill and even taught us how to set the fire. The cottage is great, nicely decorated and very relaxing and peaceful for the mind. Everything was well-thought of and you have everything you need for cooking - pots, oils, salt, pepper, utensils, crockery. The BBQ cart came very handy as it took a long time for the water to boil using firewood - made us appreciate our gas a lot! I love the bathroom, it has a unique modern feel among nature. However, the bed was a bit small for 2 persons to sleep in. And at night, the sound of the traffic was rather audible. If it had been quiet it would be perfect! Overall, it was an awesome experience. Thanks to Anthony for bringing us to our car - he is very friendly and nice guy too! Thanks again!

title: Absolute highlight of our visit to New Zealand.
text: No electricity, no free wifi, no telephone - none of the usual hotel amenties - and this is what makes Underhill the best.  It really fits the new wave "Glamping" phenomenon, not how I would chose to live on a weekly basis but a real treat for the soul to go back to a more calmer and restful space.  We ate near the lake feasting on local produce cooked on the woodburner and sat around talking, really talking - around the candlelight.  The shower and toilet are outside the hut and although I like my ensuite - it really wasn't too much of a hassle for the time we spent there.  The only thing that I would prefer is a wider bed (the end tapered off and took playing footsies at night to a new level) and the glass window above the bed would be better if you had the option of blocking the morning sun out........and that my friend would make this place PERFECTION!

title: LOVED our stay at Underhill!
text: My husband and I stayed at Underhill for one night during our time on the North Island of New Zealand, and had the best time!  We were met straight away at the gate, and taken down to the house, given a tour and overview of the property, and left to ourselves for the rest of our stay.  We felt welcomed, and that the information given at check-in was thorough.  We enjoyed taking "hobbit' pictures all around the property, listening to the birds, and the cows, looking at the stars, and feeling the breeze on a cool night.  There were games available, plenty of candles, blankets, nice towels, etc.  Everything was clean and cozy, and the bed was very comfy.  It was a very artistic space that allows your imagination to run wild, and to bring you back to the basics.  A nice way to reconnect an enjoy the simple things. We were so glad to have had the opportunity to stay here, and could not recommend it enough!  Thank you Jessie for your hospitality!

title: PERFECT & PRIVATE
text: OMG.  We came from Australia for our honeymoon and this made our holiday.  We even came back on our last night just to do it again. So private, you feel like you are the only people on earth.  Lovely hosts. The outside bath was lovely, to be in under the stars at night and have a hot bath was terrific. It also has a great shower if the bath isn't your thing.  Very different from anything else. 10 out of 10.

title: Perfect getaway in a unique property
text:
We booked this at the end of our trip around the North Island of New Zealand. A great way to end a fabulous trip. 

Underhill is very different from any other hotel experience, and well worth stopping for a night or two to enjoy.

Booking and payment were all really simple, and our hosts Jessie and Craig made us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. They leant us their quad bike to get down through the fields to the "room" which was a great help. Their intro told us everything we needed to know, and they gave us their mobile number, just in case we had any questions or needed any recommendations.

Underhill itself is beautiful, and maintained really well, with everything you could possibly need for a short stay. The place is clean and tidy, and all the little details have been remembered (candles, matches, cards, even an honesty bar / shelf with a few bits too). The bed was really comfortable, and we loved the outside bath too!

We drove up from the Waitomo Caves (about an hour) and also went over to Hobbiton (again, about an hour away), so really easy access to everywhere. Great for self catering, but Hamilton also has some good restaurants near by too. Gas BBQ as well as a charcoal one available, so lots of glamping options available.

Be honest with yourself - if you're not into camping, getting away from it all, and turning off you phone, then Underhill probably isn't the place for you. If you're happy to escape into the wilds, not charge your phone for a few days, and watch the sun go down before escaping into your candlelit bunk, then you'll have a fantastic time. 

Hope you enjoyed it as much as we did.

title: Mixed feelings
text:
Booking easy.

Instructions for the road trip not accurate - owner admitted she knew this and said "we must look at this as roads have changed"

Met at the gate by the owner as arranged and taken to the "hobbit house" This building and nearby bathroom  we were told by the owner were constructed by her father over several decades - clearly a labour of love and an artist.

Beautiful close views from the house of hills and pond.

We self catered - if doing this bring everything as in a relatively remote location. Lots of candles provided but take a torch. 

We were given a run through on arrival how to operate everything - told there was a gas cooker for quick hot water to make a drink - in the morning when we looked for it not there.

Despite being told in writing that the check out time was 12PM , and the instruction book in the accommodation said this, we were asked on arrival when did we want to leave - 11 AM being the latest as the owner had child care commitments!! We felt the owner couldn't wait for us to leave - we had looked forward to this break - we felt tolerated but not welcome.

While all furnishings were adequate in an artistic way many were grubby - windows looking out to the pond filthy in the early morning sun -  Hobbits were not dirty!

Instructions said to leave the BBQ clean - there were two - gas/electric - all plates were dirty when we arrived - rather than clean them we settled for a salad. While we were "Glamping " and are experienced campers we did expect facilities to be clean on arrival - plates dirty, sink dirty etc. From a distance the pond looks pretty - it was not enjoyable to sit near - needed a good dredge to remove mud and dying vegetation.

In summary wonderful accommodation  let down by various management issues.
hotel_response:
Thanks for your comments! We value all feedback about the Underhill experience and appreciate it takes time to complete a review.

Your comments regarding the directions and check out time reminded us that we do have a few small details to update, so we're really sorry about any confusion this caused. These details will be rectified immediately. 

We'll also make sure our verbal briefing is made a bit clearer, as the gas cooker referred to is actually part of the BBQ rather than in the earth house itself. Again, apologies that this wasn't clear.

While we clean Underhill as thoroughly as possible, it is an 'earth hut', made from natural materials and 'carved' into the hillside.  Unlike a typical motel or hotel room, it's almost impossible to keep it completely immaculate. Some of the things that make it so charming, such as the handcrafted wooden doors, and the old coal range, also make it challenging to keep everything sparkling clean. Having said that, we appreciate your comments around cleanliness and will make extra effort to check and recheck - particularly the items and areas you specify.

It's been extra dry in the Waikato, so our pond isn't it's usual lush self. We expect that with a bit more rain on the horizon, that will change soon!

We're really sorry you didn't feel welcome at Underhill. It's certainly not our intention to make you feel anything less than completely welcome and at home here. Please come back and stay with us again so we can change your impression from average to amazing!

title: Our little piece of paradise for a night ....
text:
I booked this as a night away for my husbands birthday, and we were wowed by the photos we looked at when we booked .. we were not dissapointed.
The little piece of paradise that you feel privaleged to be able to stay in is AMAZING.
From being welcomed by the owner and driven to the house and rounding the corner to see the house and its surrounding you are blow away. It is so pretty and scenic and very well loved.
Everything you need is on site & the quite peacefulness surrounds you with visiting swallows and dragonflies.
We had the food pack supplied from Jess the owner, dinner and breakfast which included aa easy to read and follow menu to cook some delicious food for the night. We opted to cook on the open fire grill outside and the fire inside, and loved every bit of it. Tea,coffee & hot chocolate were supplied and a good amount of milk .. 
Come night time we filled the outdoor bath and enjoyed a dip under the stars.
The shower cave has lovely hot flowing water for the morning with an anbundance of towels supplied.
We loved it all from start to finish & will hopefully be back!

title: Wonderful place to get away from it all
text:
This is a bit of a late review as we stayed in August...
We really enjoyed our stay. 
Highlights were the outdoor bath, cooking on an old fashioned stove, using candles for light and just daydreaming watching the birds dart across the pond. 
We left feeling refreshed and as if we had been away for ages!

title: Fantastic and relaxing experience
text: I surprised my husband with two nights at Underhill for his birthday. He was so impressed and we both loved our stay so much. The hosts are wonderful, catering is excellent, and everything is so well set up. Gorgeous fixtures and furnishings, and such a pretty setting. We would love to return in the near future.

title: Accommodation with a delightful difference
text:
My wife and I stayed one night in this naturally pretty and private setting. We were taken to the site by quad bike, a short trip through farm land, by our friendly host, Jessie, and following a quick rundown of the facilities were left to our own devices. There was no further human contact until we were picked up at midday the following day. While there is no electricity at the site its absence is hardly noticed but all the facilities are in place for a comfortable and convenient stay. Heated water is available in the unique and roomy (indoor) shower.
Anyone looking for a relaxing holiday or overnight stay with a difference will thoroughly enjoy this place. It's dry, cosy, private, tranquil and scenic, and if you're lucky the resident frog will provide a brief serenade. A Christmas present this year will be an accommodation voucher for other members of our family to enjoy the experience.

title: Good experience
text:
My wife and I recently stayed one night in this amazing location situated under the side of a hill and looking out onto a lily pond complete with timber arch bridge.
This place has an old world charm about it. My only criticism is that the custom made bed is a little narrow unless you are used to sharing an old fashioned sized double bed.
Lovely to sit with the doors open and watch the swallows darting over the pond.

title: Romantic glamping in a beautiful setting
text:
Underhill is a wonderful romantic glamping retreat. We stayed one night and had a really lovely, relaxing evening - watching the wildlife by the pond, cooking the amazing dinner (prepared by host Jessie so all we had to do was light the BBQ and cook it!), and drinking wine under the stars. The setting is gorgeous and very peaceful. The cave is very cosy and candlelight makes it look even more special, and the bath cave is excellent - plenty of hot water!  Everything's provided to make it super simple so we almost forgot we were 'camping' (and therefore had to do the washing up!).
Definitely recommend Underhill for couples looking for a relaxing short break away from it all.

title: Good situation close to Hamilton Gardens and Hamilton East shopping area
text:
Great basic accomodation for a weekend away.
Very handy for Easy walking close to Hamilton Gardens and Hamilton East shopping area. 
Easy access to the river and CBD.
All basic motel facilities provided.

title: Quiet and tidy
text: Pretty friendly and helpful staff with tidy rooms. There are stone walls and it’s very quiet at night. Hot water is good enough to take a shower. Although it’s a little bit old you can have everything you need in a motel. Definitely recommended!

title: Quiet and great location
text: Older motel in the process of a gentle refurbishment. Really clean and friendly owners/managers. Good location in the heart of Hamilton East with a shop 50 meters away and loads of eateries 500 meters up the road. Definitely value for money. Thanks.

title: Clean, but well past it's prime
text: Clean and roomy. Furniture very tired, adequate for our one night stopover.  Staff very friendly and helpful. If you like retro, then this is the place to stay. Not far from Hamilton gardens. Parking on premises. Switched fridge off overnight as it made alarming noises!

title: Clean, inexpensive. quiet motel in a good location. With amenities.
text: This motel is so clean, great price with very good service. My room had a full kitchen at the end of the lounge.There is a diary next door for my ice cream fix that also has ingredients for making yourself a meal. And a great licensed Turkish and other restaurants a couple of blocks away.  The furnishings are very retro, but as I said it is very clean. Free WiFi, electric blanket on the main bed in the bedroom. I was pleasantly surprised how well done this inexpensive (cheap) motel was for me.Small fridge, milk, soap, shampoo, good towels, curtains on all of the many windows. They also brought me a hair dryer within minutes of my request.

title: Clean interior  but tired
text:
Good points: Clean interior , convenient location- walking distance to eateries, chemist, bakery, bank etc, short drive to university campus, and city centre, full kitchen albeit cramped, good wifi connection and free. We appreciated the electric fan.
Not so good aspects: Drab (but clean) interior, outside surroundings quite unkempt and untidy, parking is tricky at times as the spaces are not numbered to match units - no guarantee that you’ll be able to park in front of your unit, to get out you had to reverse and manoeuvre your vehicle out of the limited space between the row of cars of cars belonging to other guests,  and the front of row of units. Water pressure in the shower very low. Cigarette smoke from guests sitting outside their units smoking, wafts into adjacent rooms.

title: No control
text: Spent one Saturday night hoping for a good nights rest only to find it over run with party goers who to be honest most stopped around eleven when they went across the road to a hotel only to return at three. Apart from that, the motel is very out dated which is a shame. The rooms are adequate, separate kitchen close and shower toilet. The rooms are clean, with a flat screen TV which can be used to drown out the party people

title: Very drab
text: While everything was clean, it was so outdated that it was an inconvenience. I doubt the bathroom/kitchenette/laundry has been renovated since the 1970's (at least). Was close to quick and easy fast food.

title: Great Inexpensive
text:
Super clean, 70's/80's retro but really comfortable. Easy to get to walking to some fanatstice  restaurants. Quiet. The friendliest host you could ask for. Travelled with our two dogs and they were well looked after as well.....We have travelled all around NZ and stayed in both 5 star and budget, this place is the top of the list value for $....
Highly recommend this motel.

title: Old but clean
text:
This sad but very clean motel is comfortable, but very basic. The lady on reception was very helpful and friendly. 
The location is good small supermarket and restaurants close by, as well as your fast food outlet. The room has a kitchenette for convenience of breakfast.
If you are looking just to stay and rest a night this motel is fine, beds are good.

title: Clean and quiet
text: Very clean and quiet place, has everything you need-bedding, towels, cutlery, crockery, tea and coffee, free wifi, host is very kind and prices are best comparing all other motels on that street. Big choice of good restaurants just 3 min.walk, close to the Hamilton gardens too. I recommend for sleepover in Hamilton when traveling to/from Auckland airport.

title: A great nights sleep
text:
This is a budget motel okay the rooms are dated however if your on holiday you shouldnt really be in the room for to long and should be using the room for sleep. The proprietors are friendly and nothing is too much trouble. 
You know that this is a budget motel and you get what you pay for.
As for me it catered for everything that i wanted and i will definatley stay here again

title: Expensive for an average motel
text:
There are better options elsewhere for the same price.

Pros: Unbelievably clean, great location close to the city centre and food options
Cons: Terrible shower head and taps in both the kitchen and bathroom. No extractor fan in bathroom.

We travelled as a couple, in Hamilton for a sporting competition. As such, a hot shower at the end of the day was essential. While the need for renovations might be presented by other reviewers as "optional", I personally do not view the availability of a reliable hot shower as optional. The water pressure was weak and temperature alternated between scalding hot and lukewarm (in winter, this translates as freezing). The shower mixer was clearly new but the underlying mechanism hadn't been changed.

Overall, the unit we stayed in (#1) appeared unchanged since the 1970s, except for a changed linoleum floor and carpet. Even the Shacklock standalone cooktop was original and in immaculate condition. The downside is that if you are used to mixer taps in the bathroom in particular, this is very inconvenient. There is no such thing as having warm water out of the taps - it is either freezing cold or scalding hot! We were charged $99 per night as a couple, which was a surprise to us as it had been cheaper when my husband booked using Booking.com (apparently they charge more when the unit is occupied by more than one person, even though it sleeps 3). If I had realised it would be that price per night, I would have stayed elsewhere.

title: Good nights sleep
text: I agree with others that this motel can do with some renovations however I couldn't care less about fancy light fittings or decorative wallpaper and furnishings when we arrived there last weekend. After a seven hour trip driving across the country and a midnight arrival I was looking forward to a hot shower, a quick cuppa and a good nights sleep. All was rewarded at the Manhattan. Our room had comfy beds and a full kitchen and bathroom. Location was also convenient to everything we needed including the Hamilton Gardens and city centre. I believe had we been able to stay longer we would have had a relaxing time away from home.

title: Clean & tidy
text: The motel unit was rather tired although presented in a clean and tidy condition. Kitchen facilities had basic requirements. Wifi was rather spasmodic also. All around very average with nothing to rave about. OK for an overnight stay stopover. Being in Hamilton East it is quite a walk into the city although not too far from the Hamilton Gardens.

title: A port in a storm
text:
It was late, and we had just had a horrific drive from Auckland airport through very heavy rush hour traffic. It had taken an hour longer than expected. 
This was the first motel we found on our route south that had vacancies.

The check in was polite and we weren't arguing over the room - we needed it.

But an honest appraisal would call it old and tired. 
The room smelt very musty like it needed a good airing. 
In retrospect after a month touring north and south Island this was the worst place we stayed at and most were cheaper.
So would i stay here again...........

If our situation was repeated.
Or
It was 30% cheaper, you call it value for money.
Or
If it was completely refurbished it would be OK.

title: This motel is OK
text:
Other comments are most unfair or the motel has improved. Yes it's old and tired but it was perfectly good for an overnight stay and at 109 dollars very good value. It was clean, and my wife is super fussy, a very large and comfortable bed. Full kitchen. Not many of those these days. Plenty of hot water. Nice and quiet as set well back from the road. Even things that are often missing such as a coffee table and a sofa. Also free WIFI.
We have stayed in dozens of motels in NZ and you could do far worse.
hotel_response: Hi, thank you for your review. We will do our best to manage ourselves further more. Thanks again.

title: The worst motel!
text: This is by far the worst motel I have ever been to, let alone stayed in.  The motel room was overpriced at $108.00 per night; the decor and furnishings were old fashioned, poor quality and out-dated; no air-conditioning unit except for an old window mounted fan; the room smelt like previous tenants chain smoke in it, THE LIST GOES ON......  I would never recommend this motel to anyone!  Highly disappointing and a waste of money.
hotel_response: Hi, thank you for your review which made us reflect on ourselves and consider sincerely what we have to do from now on. As I am a new owner of this property I will do my best to improve our poor operation and renovate outdated property one by one. I hope that Manhattan Lodge Motel impress most of guests with comfortable service, clean facilities and convenient location near future. Thanks again.

title: Absolutely awful.
text:
As a family we are prepared to stay in budget motels and have many times, also places that are tired and need a re-vamp but this place was just horrendous.  As soon as we walked in the door my wife, and daughter who had booked another unit here, both wanted to get back in the cars and find another motel.
The cleaners do a poor job. The lino floors were sticky. The fridge was turned off and there was a carton of milk still in there from the last occupants.  Also there was a wet towel from previous occupants still hanging on the rail in the wardrobe of the room to be used by my sons. The window sill in their room was also covered by dust and mould.   As soon as we put food on the bench in the kitchen ants appeared.  We wanted to use a pot to cook tea for my grandchildren and had to wash it first as it had mouse poo in it.    Also, we had booked in 4 people but only 2 towels were supplied.  Hopeless.
You need to be quite good at backing your car in order to leave the carpark.  There is no way to turn your car around outside your unit and I was grateful that I can back up and that our hire car had a rearview camera as I had to reverse back past 8 other units to get out.  
I would never recommend this motel to anyone.  We chose it because it was one of the cheapest we had see with a 2 bedroom unit  but in hindsight I wish that we had just gone with the dearer options available.  
Do yourself a favour, find somewhere else to stay.  This place may be cheaper than others but it is certainly not cheerful.

title: Don't bother
text: When arriving at check-in it was noted the bad smell of reception. Then the room we booked for 2 adults and 2 small children only had 1 room. The bedroom was small and had a hot water service in a cupboard. The walls on the bathroom and bedroom were covered in mould. The heater didn't work in our room and could only offer a little portable oil heater. The floors were sticky and the room just smelt dirty. Also the parking was impractical and hard to get out, as you nearly need to reverse out the whole way.

title: All good.
text:
Awesome location.
Room had everything I needed 
Shower was big and good water pressure 
Great value for money
Room was clean 
I stayed a week and no complaints.

title: Very Nice Experience
text: Very Nice Motel, very affordable, and strongly recommended to everyone. Very convenient to go the hot cities, like Taupo and Rotorua. Besides, the hostess is very friendly. Thanks Grace.

title: Dreadful
text: This place is to be avoided! We only ended up here because Hamilton was "full". After we checked in it was quickly obvious it was a horror show. Everything seems to broken or neglected. It's as if they have never heard of "maintenance".  What took the prize for us was the hole in the bathroom wall which had tissues stuffed in it! They didn't stuff tissues into the hole in the bedroom wall though. Obviously hopeless management. it's grubby and neglected. Avoid it if you can.

title: Trip from hell
text: We booked into the Brooklyn Motor Lodge for a Two night weekend stay confirming on the day and said yes we have it all booked . On arrival after our long drive she couldn’t find our booking and said she was booked out, so has booked us into there other Motel , we weren’t happy as it was her mistake and we wanted to stay at this Motel. So we then drive all the way to there other Motel “Aspen Manor” we found out through the guy managing it that the other women had over booked our room and told him we were happy to be in the Manor motel this was before we even arrived she lied . We had a look at one of the rooms at the Aspen Manor it was disgusting the worst place I have ever seen , go look at all the reviews of this place so we left tried for a couple of hours to find somewhere else to stay in Hamilton but was all booked out so finally found one in Cambridge.

title: Dark & Dingy  and quite expensive for the state of the property!
text:
Dark & Dingy  and quite expensive

To be honest I haven't been to a motor lodge quite so run down and dirty in a very long time.  The unit needed a damn good clean, maintenance needs to tended to immediately.

We had 1 x face cloth and 1 x hand towel for 3 of us and they were a washed out blue colour and the hand towel was frayed - needs to be thrown away actually.

They provided no glassware at all and we had to drink water out of a tea cup.

The pillowcases were stained and didn't match the sheets.

There were insects - possibly cockroaches.

Hand towel rail was detached and sitting under the vanity.

No sky remote - although they advertised that they have Sky

The couch was marked and stained and needed to be removed and burned.

Net curtains were ripped & mouldy

They obviously rent rooms by the week or have emergency housing rented space - they need to inform people that this is happening before they spend $270 a night.  The current environment is not a safe environment.

If I had read Trip advisor and read the numerous reviews about their lodge we would never have stayed.

I think if the health department were to visit they would be appalled at the cleanliness of the lodge - it is disgusting.

title: If you are seeing this review your lucky, AVOID AT ALL COSTS
text:
I stayed here a few weeks ago, i do quite a bit of travel for work and have stayed in some sub par places in nz and overseas but this is hands down THE WORST place i have ever stayed anywhere in the world!

The place is falling to bits broken door handles the rooms stink of feet after the beds made there are dodgy residents living in some of the rooms and its $200 per night. 

If i had to put a price on what i think would be reasonable i would say $45 max per night. Dont fall victim to this place

title: A disgusting motel
text:
We have recently stayed in this motel and would rate this stay as very disappointing indeed.  It was listed on their website as a brand new motel! That was in 2013! As I have since found out.
The price we paid is completely over the top for the disgusting state these two units were in.
I list below the items in question from our Unit 15.
1	Lamp in bedroom is not working, the overall lighting is very poor.
2	No soap in the bathroom so we could wash out hands.   We had to ask the cleaner for a small soap!  The dispenser that had been on the wall had been torn off.
3	No handrail for our towels to hang on (it was lying broken on the floor.
4	No pillow cases for the spare pillows (if you could call them that!) I had to ask the cleaner for some.  The pillows are very flat and need replacing.
5	Dirty drawers in the kitchen.
6	Heater in the bathroom – not working!
7	Met curtains are disgusting.
8	The sofa very uncomfortable.

My sister and her partner were staying in the unit across from us- #6 I think.  We had asked for a sofa bed in the kitchen area, she had to go and ask for some sheets etc so she could make it up!

My husband had an eye operation and I brought him back to the motel in the afternoon, but he was not able to sleep with people thumping up and down the stairs all afternoon.
We suspect the motel is being used for the homeless, what a great way to get extra income and run the place down!!

Steer well clear of this motel, I wrote to them but have had no reply!

title: A grim and unpleasant wee box to spend a night in
text: This motel is overpriced, underserviced, noisy, and unwelcoming. One could've forgiven for thinking that the owners care less about their guests than the revenue gleaned from unsuspecting travellers condemned to spend a night in one of their unloved, inadequate "dog kennels". Never again. Avoid!

title: Absolutely not recommended
text:
Dirty, cockroaches, stale cigarette smell, a drawer full of someone's tshirts and a baby bib, a lot of items missing from the cupboards, sticky kitchen floor, yuk yuk yuk would never recommend it.  Weeds all around outside. Spilt soap powder on stairs, no code for wifi and when we did get it it was an intermittent  service.
Not recommended at all

title: Run down!
text: 2 bedroom unit for husband and me plus 2 adult kids. The unit was run down: broken Venetian blind in the kitchen, laminated note with the wifi password was tatty, no bedside lights, bedspread was threadbare, luggage rack was broken and didn’t balance on 3 feet with a bag on it, cobwebs outside windows, litter in carpark, broken (and grubby) outdoor chairs, dirty light fittings, only 3 dining chairs for 4 people, rusty (?dirty) fridge door, no plug for the kitchen sink (asked for one but it never came), filthy torn net curtains, no pillow slips on spare pillows, no rail in the wardrobe, bathroom heater broken, but the location was great. I’d chosen to ignore bad reviews and give them a chance, to our detriment. Was quite expensive, poor value.  Bed looked saggy but was actually quite comfortable and we slept well.

title: Absolutely fuming at this terrible experience!!
text: Booked a room in May this year, was confirmed. Now received email cancelling my booking! I've booked flights and concert tickets....guess what? They don't care at all. Please don't waste your time here

title: Never stay here again
text: Absolutely disgusting service, paid for a room 6mths ago for an event. Now the motel has cancelled my room a few weeks before the event, for someone willing to pay a higher rate. What's the point in booking early if the motel can cancel last minute.

title: Worst hotel!
text: This hotel was the worst I have ever stayed in. I had originally booked & paid for 2 nights but left after staying awake all night on the first night. The room was filthy, stained bed cover, dead flat pillow, no spare blanket so was cold, blood on drapes, holes in net curtains, broken towel rails, stains on cups, stains all over carpet,  food under stained couch, stunk so bad! But it wasn't just the filthy grotty room, it is a emergency housing so unsavory types roaming outside all night yelling, slaming doors, music. In the morning I rang the Chinese lady to come & talk to me about it, she refused,  she was so rude, has not paid us a cent back. I booked another motel & could not leave there fast enough. She is scamming people! She advertises 4 star, near New motel! It is disgusting.  DO NOT stay here!

title: Avoid at all costs
text:
Motel is used for emergency accomodation. Some of the residents are very unsavoury. Within half an hour of our arrival, there was a domestic for which the police were called upon to attend.
No milk in fridge for coffee. I asked reception if I could have one. She said she would bring it down. Nothing came. 
Off to have a shower before going out...towels are dirty, and towel rail was broken, and found lying on floor under basin. Also no hand soap to wash hands after toilet.
Only one drinking glass for two people.
No sky remote, despite it being advertised that there is sky.
Pillows supplied are so flat, and offer no support, and sheets are too small for bed.
This is the worst motel I have stayed at. I thoroughly recommend choosing elswhere to stay.

title: Terrible service
text:
We checked into this place on 19 April having chosen it partly because it had a four star rating and we knew that it was reasonably new. When we booked we asked for two beds, each in a separate room. Entering the unit we noted that there was only one bed . They claimed that we had not asked for two beds. A person came to the unit and pulled out a sofa bed which looked to be very uncomfortable being only a wire wove with a very thin mattress. We had to ask about linen so sheets were brought to us together with a very scruffy looking duvet. We had to ask about pillows so one was brought from the four on the main bed. It had no pillow slip and neither did the other three. There was no offer to make up the bed. There was no teatowel and the kettle and the toaster were grimy and had food caked on them. The floor had dirty footprints on it. There was only one wine glass and the bare essentials of cutlery. A guest in another unit had similar problems and among her issues was only one tea spoon.
All in all the service and preparation of what could be a nice unit was quite disgusting. A relief cleaner was blamed by management who said that there had been no check on the cleaner. This highlighted our opinion that the management is totally unsatisfactory.
There were probably other issues but we were offered our money back so that we could leave. This was at great inconvenience to us as Hamilton was almost fully booked by 6pm and when we found alternative accomodation it was at extra cost. We definitely would not stay at this place again unless there is a change of management and preferably a management that understands New Zealand hospitality.

title: TERRIBLE Stay
text:
Arrived at the motel where there is no one at reception, used intercom and was finally greeted by a woman who was very difficult to understand. She called the cleaner to open the reception and deal with our reservation and hand us our room key. The room was not very clean and suffers from a lack of repairs and maintenance. We can understand why as rooms are being used as emergency accommodation by the NZ Government/local council. The people in those rooms were not respecting anything - doors slamming, shouting, loud music playing. 
DO not stay here - why pay good money for below standard rooms and to deal with those given emergency accommodation at yours and our expense!

title: Terrible
text: We had booked weeks before arrival - arrived and no one in office to greet; phoned and they were off site.  Once inside -  dirty kitchen cabinets and floor,  broken blind in kitchen (the only window), cobwebs with dead spiders everywhere, ants crawling all over wall in main bedroom, cockroaches in bathroom and kitchen, broken fridge leg, no dish cloth or tea towel.  This was like staying in fawlty towers, or a dungeon.  We stayed because we had paid (mistake), the location was handy and not too noisy at night but we will never stay here again!

title: TERRIBLE!
text: 2 bedroom unit for 1 night with grandkids. Good location, plenty of kitchen utensils and appliances (apart from only 3 forks for 4 people). Salt & pepper but no coffee, sugar or milk supplied. Had to wash glasses etc before use as they were dirty. Cockroach seen on wall too. Only 1 remote for 3 TV’s, also a remote with no batteries, aircon remote not working so only one setting…cold! No bath mat, facecloths or hand towels so had to use a bath towel. Wiped water off floor in kitchen and it was filthy. This could be easy fixed if they used a check list per room when cleaning. Not enough power points in rooms for charging, had lamps & electric blankets but couldn’t plug in if you were watching TV as only one outlet. Beds comfy but pillows flat as pancakes so had sore necks in morning. Really noisy road in morning…early. Strange goings on too, police turned up last night. Also quoted $245 and got charged $255. Could be a really nice place if they cared and took some time to actually look over the units and what was missing… a little disappointed….and probably wouldn’t stay again unfortunately.

title: Disappointing
text:
On arrival there was no one in reception to meet us, they were off site. It took 15 minutes for them to arrive.
The studio room we had boomed was not available, so we were “upgraded” to a one bedroom apartment (none of which were available when we booked months earlier.
The unit had no ironing board, no iron (despite this being in their compendium). There was also no face cloth, bat( mat or tea towel. They were provided on request, but were not replaced when serviced. We found a vodka bottle cap and some wool in the lounge and bedroom, implying that the vacuuming was not thorough.
Won’t be back.

title: Don't stay here
text:
This needs to be negative stars poor dosent even begin to describe this place the blinds weren't work the bed was covered in little bugs that left bit marks all over my wife when reception was told all they would offer was some spray, the family that was staying there had four kids and they were running around the carpark kicking the ball around which was hitting all the cars leaving dents in them never stay at this absolute dump of place.
I wouldn't even recommend it to my worst enemy.

title: Do not book or stay here!
text: Terrible customer servicing when trying to change/cancel a booking which was originally booked direct via their BML website. Woman who answered phone was hard to understand and she was yelling nonsense at me! I ended up hanging up and emailing them instead. When I didn’t get a reply after a few days, I emailed again and said that if they didn’t rectify the matter I would go to the Commerce Commission etc. Next day we got a full refund!!??  Bizarre. These people should not be in business. You have been warned.

title: Dirty and Impersonal
text:
The service was appalling. The manager was off-site and communicated via intercom. It was very hard to understand what she was saying. We didn’t see her when we were checking in or checking out, which was very impersonal customer service. 
The kitchenette came with a cockroach in the cupboard and filthy glasses. The bedspread was badly stained and there was only one bedside lamp. 
We’d booked a room with a spa bath but the bath had a visible layer of scum around it, along with pubic hairs in the spa jets and there were also hairs on the towels and in the shower. 
Altogether, it was a pretty gross experience, which was a pity because the location is good and the motel units themselves are in reasonably good order.
A marked improvement in customer service and hygiene standards is needed. We wouldn’t stay here again.

title: Wow what a disappointment this place was, had to relocate after one day!
text: Wow what a disappointment this place was.  Was supposed to stay here got a week.  On arrival I had to check-in using an intercom as the office was unattended at 4.50pm!  When I couldn’t understand the Chinese women on the other end of the intercom, she got cross and told me to wait and she would drive to the office.  I was checked into a room that wasn’t what my boss ordered or paid for, then transferred to another room.   The state of that room was terrible! Dirty bed cover with several large visible stains on it (see picture!), broken light fitting in bathroom, missing towels, completely missing towel rail in bathroom, duct tape over the heater switch in bathroom, broken window handle, and a fridge with no ice box door!  The Owners were argumentative, not good a good experience.  Moved to another motel the next day and got booking.com to refund.   Would NEVER stay here again and would not recommend.  If I could give it 0 I would!

title: Raises the room rate after guaranteeing your booking at a lower price
text:
A group of friends and I all arranged to stay here for an event we are going to in Hamilton in a few weeks. I saw a price advertised online and called to see if there were enough rooms for everyone before booking (which there were). I was given the same price as they had advertised online and gave my CC details to book.

24 hours later I'd still not recieved my email confirmation. When I emailed to chase this, they sent it through with a substantial increase to the room rate. When I queried this I was told the rate had gone up the day I had booked  and I had been given that very price when I booked.

I contested this as I'd been given a much lower price and if I booked online that's what would have been emailed to me. The reply I got was basically to take it, or cancel. 

At this time I went on the BML direct website, entered the same booking details for the same room and the price shown was  more than what it had been the day prior  but still significantly less than what was on my confirmation. I took a screenshot and asked how they could charge me a higher rate than what was advertised right now on their website. I sent 3 emails over the weekend about this which I did not get any replies to.

My friends also tried to call several times as they had been overcharged too. They could not get through or leave a message and instead got a text saying "call you back" but after 2 days they are still waiting to hear back.

Today I called to speak to the manager and explained the situation in detail. She called me a liar in reference to the initial quote I got - even though she was the one I had booked with! I explained that according to the commerce commission and consumer guarantees act, what she was doing is considered bait pricing and was illegal. I said I'd  have no problem contacting someone there about the situation as what she is doing is terrible business practice.

The manager started yelling at me and told me if I am going to threaten her she will cancel my booking. Then she said she would email me cancellation confirmation right now and hung up on me.I still haven't got the email lol but no surprise there. I'm concerned she will charge my card despite being well outside of the cancellation conditions.

To summarise, I would double and triple check the rate online and the rate in your confirmation to ensure you aren't being overcharged. This clearly isnt the first time this has happened. BEWARE!

title: Maintenance and upkeep severely lacking, very noisy one morning 5.15am
text: We have stayed here annually for the last 5 years as it is very close to an annual event we attend however we have noticed that maintenance has not been done and it is starting to look and feel a bit tired. The fridge was leaking, windows didn’t shut securely, blinds broken, ... to name a few. Several of our friends also stay in other units. The worst thing was the noise of a truck engine and the emptying of bins at 5.15am on a Friday morning in the MacDs next door. The beds are comfortable and it is clean, nice linen.

title: In Hamilton to take someone to Southern Cross Hospital
text: After initially being given wrong room we were given some sheets to make up bed in lounge area. Had a lot of trouble getting heat pump to work. (only heating in unit) Found tiles in bathroom very slippery when wet. Only single pillows on very comfortable bed. Very good water pressure.(shower)

title: Noisy
text: Very noisy  as end unit right on road &  over the fence was the drive-through of a McDonalds, so cars and  period yelling/ music  seemed  to go on for a while . Room had overpowering smell of cigarette smoke-  even though had specified a non smoking room when booking.  I did ask for another room but told none available. Reception person brought air freshener and said unwell to smell anything due to sinus problem. No " no smoking" signs or stickers.  Would not stay here again.

title: Handy to Claudelands Arena
text: Stayed for night at the motel as it was close to Claudelands Arena, which was about a 10 min walk away. Check in was easy, first room we were given had a fishy smell so asked to change rooms. The lady on reception was accommodating and offered us the room next door. Room was clean, modern  and had everything we needed. Good parking out the front of the room

title: Poor experience
text: I've been visiting this motel frequently over the years but since the new owner the service, standards are going backwards rapidly. My rooms had regular maintenance issues or cleaning issues. But most frustrating was the owner not sticking to agreements, not responding to emails, calls and changing arrangements frequently. Integrity in business is important and this is surely lacking with this new owner. Avoid the place!

title: Not too bad
text: Stayed here as we had a friends birthday close by. Room was clean and everything you expect was provided. Easy check in as we booked and paid online. Bed was comfortable. Okay place to stay but nothing flash.

title: Two day one night stay
text: I thoroughly enjoyed staying here in Motor Inn with my Husband. He drove work even down and I drove our car down to Hamilton on Saturday morning it was very pleasant to stay in this Motor Inn. The Room we had was essential for what we needed.  Staff very Pleasant and you do get Maps to show you the Roads you wish to travel.  People in Hamilton are very Friendly and couldn't do enough to make sure you are Comfortable. W

title: A nice motel
text: Our second visit - good but a little disappointed after our last visit. We booked a one bedroom unit but although the bedroom was separate there was no door as such. Bathroom heater was disabled. No reception on arrival (room cleaner booked us in) or on departure - a contrast with last visit when reception was very helpful and friendly. But will stay again as overall good and location suits us.

title: Nice motel with nice host
text: This motel is centrally located with only minutes away from the centre of Hamilton. The host was minding while the owners were taking vacation. She was very helpful and even allowed us to use the vacuum cleaner to clean our rental car, the staff were very nice too. The facilities of the motel were excellent, parking was easy. Good shower. We had a very nice stay and would recommend to anyone.

title: A quality motel
text: We stayed for two nights and were very pleased with our room which had good seating and good lighting. Very clean and well maintained. The king size bed was very comfortable and the wi-fi reception excellent. Conveniently located for travellers and close to a lovely park. Very helpful at reception. We will stay there again when visiting friends in Hamilton..

title: A short stay for work.
text:
Stayed for 2 nights mid-week. Booked online with no trouble. The greeting at reception on check-in was very nice. Rainbow is very friendly & helpful. Room 15 was more than big enough for just me, & aside from one curtain, the room was very clean. Pleasantly, everything worked, there were good instructions for the TV & A/C, nice towels & somewhere to hang them, & a comfortable bed. I had the cooked breakfast on the second morning, which was just what I had ordered, & the toast was even still hot when it got to my room.
The only negative, was that on both nights, I could hear someone snoring in the next room.

title: Family Wedding Weekend
text: Very happy with our room, great position. Friendly staff & owners made our stay very enjoyable.Close to a laundry mat and a huge offering of eateries also a Countdown in short driving distance. Will recommend the Brooklyn to friends whenever they need somewhere to stay. Thankyou

title: Good quality motel...comfortable and handy to town or  university.
text:
We stayed a night at the Brooklyn Motor Lodge, Hamilton. We got one of the last rooms that day which was for disabled persons. It is handy to both the city and the university which was great for us.
PROS: Clean, tidy ,spacious with all mods cons.
CONS: TV fixed to the wall so you can't adjust the angle. A just a bit of fly pooh on the smoke alarm detectors if you one is fussy about cleanliness.

title: Wedding weekend
text: We had a 4 night stay here for a family wedding. Very friendly helpful host, lovely clean motel handy to our venue. We had a 2 bedroom unit and would like to suggest more electrical points as 3 people with 3 phones need accessible points.

title: Great place to stay
text:
Stayed here in mid-Dec on business. The rooms are very modern and comfortable, with a good sized living area, kitchenette and bathroom with shower. TV with 5 Sky channels in both living area and bedroom. Everything is spotless and cleaned each day. The staff are extremely helpful - I arrived in the evening and needed to use a PC to edit a presentation for the next day; the lady at the front desk happily let me use her PC which was very kind.  Nothing was too much trouble. McDonalds next door and great coffee shop across the road. Location is fine if you have a car, otherwise it's a 30 min walk into Hamilton.
Highly recommended.

title: Clean, comfortable and cheerful
text:
A first visit, as the normal accommodation used by the company was full. 
I was impressed with the service and the accommodation. Very friendly and the rooms still feel new and fresh. 
Great cooked breakfast although the yoghurt option seemed to be vanilla or vanilla. Also, limited to 7.30 am onwards, so if you need to get away early continental is the only option. 
The minor issue is the difficulty of finding places to park if you are going to town. However, if you are planning to be in the Claudlands area then this would be the place to stay. 
I'll be recommending this as an option to others at work.

title: Lovely Friendly Receptionist
text:
Lovely first impressions at reception by friendly cheerful lady.  Nice clean room with lovely big bed. Nice bathroom and accessories in kitchen were lovely quality. Double glazing helps a busy spot be quiet. 
Would stay again

title: A clean, modern motel with everything you need
text: A great motel!! It is clean, modern and well maintained. The rooms have well equipped kitchens, modern bathrroms, no shower over the bath- YEAH!! The bed was comfortable and cozy and it is close to shops, supermarket,  a great park to run in and a short drive to the city

title: Great accommodation
text: A very clean quiet motel block, very comfortable and has a great shower. Stayed four nights in July the unit was nice and warm. Plenty of shops close by including a great Chinese restaurant just across the road from the complex. Not far from large supermarket and also a Westfield plaza.

title: Amazing place to stay
text: I had thought we had stayed here before but as it turns out it only looks like the place we stayed out but so glad we made that mistake, the owners were top notch on the service and found us a safe park for the car and trailer we had with us, the rooms were modern and clean and had more than enough bedding for the pull out bed, the cooked breakfast was done perfect and the boys made light work of that, we will be coming back here next time we are here. - only down fall 2 tvs and only 1 remote to share, and wifi was really bad and we were unable to use it.

title: We have twice stayed here in winter and both times, heat pump had been turned on prior to arrival.
text: The rooms are always clean and Rainbow, on reception, is bright and welcoming. Further, we were in Hamilton because of day surgery. The following day we were told we could have as late a check-out as needed and there would be no charge as we had stayed there before. We felt this was wonderful service.

title: Awesome!!
text: Tight from the start this place was awesome, the receptionist is happy and bubbly, the room is clean, the bathroom is sparkling, the spa bath amazing. Restaurants across the road, a novelty shop and a gas station. Will definitely recommend to all

title: Best motor lodge in Hamilton
text:
We were extremely happy with the Brooklyn Motor Lodge.
Why, Rainbow was very accomodating when we asked about a room for a family of 6, 2 grandparents & a family, to go out and find a suitable room was great.
Little things do make a difference that the rooms have compared to other lodges, hand towel for makeup, good quality toilet rolls & soft towels.
This place was like staying in a 5 star hotel.
A large group stayed at this lodge for a wedding and everyone commented on how nice the lodge was.

title: Great location, comfortable bed.
text:
The location was very central and easy access to a number of good takeaway and food outlets in a stone's throw of the motel. 

The bed was one of the most comfortable I have slept in at a hotel/motel for a very long time.

I got a room with a spa bath which was very relaxing and really helped me to sleep (although I was exhausted so that probably helped!).

The only negative for me was that my room backed on to the kids playground at McDonalds so it was rather noisy with screaming children until later in the evening. 

Overall, really nice.

title: Modern
text: We chose this motel because of its proximity to Claudelands Events Centre (walking distance).  It was new, modern and relatively clean - there was a bit of grime behind the taps in the bathroom. There was plenty of parking and it was quiet.  The price was good and value for money and we had an adjoining unit to our friends. The bonus was we were given real milk and not that awful long-life stuff!

title: Excellent facilities, shame about McDonalds next door
text: I have been booked into the Brooklyn on many occasions and find the staff to be lovely and helpful, the rooms are well appointed, modern and are nice and spacious. When you book though if you are light sleeper it may pay to ask for a room which is not right next door to the McDonalds. Unfortunately the McDonalds does operate 24/7 so there are trucks and cars that idle in the carpark next to the Motel rooms for ages in the night. This can make for quite a disrupted sleep, along with yelling or other noisy people using the McDonalds. Not much the Motel can do about it, and the Motel is situated well for convenience to a coffee shop, a Burger fuel, a petrol station and other nearby takeways.

title: Good family motel
text: This is a great family motel, interconnecting rooms are available for larger groups. The motel is fairly new and is well appointed, clean and tidy. Ample carparking onsite and it is across the road from Claudelands park with a playground etc. Wifi is free and reliable. Will stay again next time we are in town.

title: Great motel
text:
Stayed in room 17. Some noise heard through walls and neighbours toilet flushing could be heard. Otherwise very large comfortable bed and a great shower. Units clean. There is a Coffee Culture cafe across the road for brunch etc which was nice and you could walk to the new Countdown if you wanted. Our dishes were washed and put away and unit serviced every day which was nice. Heat pump in room if needed. Good off street parking. Could walk to town if you wanted but would take about 40 mins. Take away outlets  2 mins away.
Units would be better if they had an info folder with nearest cafes, restaurants, supermarket, etc and a town map.

title: Awesome place
text:
We booked last minute and arrived and she was just finishing cleaning our room and from the moment we arrived she was lovely and nothing was too much trouble.
The room was spacious and very clean and comfortable. Was easy to find and close to food places. Will definitely be staying there again :)

title: Great for a short stay.
text: We recently moved house and needed a one night stay near Rototuna. Brooklyn Motor Lodge proved an excellent choice.The bed was very clean and comfortable and we were able to walk across the road to the excellent cafe, Coffee Culture.

title: Outstanding
text:
I have stayed at Brooklyn Motor Lodge several times and had consistently good experiences.  This time, I arrived after hours because of a delayed flight, but I was welcomed warmly and found that the lights and heater had been turned on in my room.  Most welcome on a cold, wintery evening!
This motel is always excellent and is now my go-to place in Hamilton.  Rooms are comfortable, attractively furnished and well equipped.   The staff are always friendly, efficient and welcoming.  I couldn't help comparing this motel to my recent stay in a 4-star hotel in Sydney.  The hotel was twice the price and nothing like as good!

title: Very nice
text:
Here on business conference.  Arranged accomodation but im very happy.  The room (Rm 22) is clean and spacious.  Continental breakfast is delivered the night before.  Great shower !

Cafe nearby.  McDonalds nearby.

Highly recommended.

title: Excellent accomodation
text: Very tidy, clean place to stay.  Very friendly owners.  Plenty of room, great bathroom facilities, large shower.  Great food outlets right on the doorstep.  Would defiantly stay again. Handy to Claudlands Event centre.

title: Very comfortable stay
text: I had a 3 night stay here while working in Hamilton. Its a newer motel complex and my room was large and had everything I needed. The bed was exceptionally comfortable. I like the location of this motel as it is close to town and right next to a great cafe. The motel staff were very friendly.

title: Handy location
text: A good location as handy to a number of arterial routes and main thoroughfares. Very quiet at night even though it is a busy road during the day. Well appointed facilities. Very clean accommodation and nicely decorated. Good parking.

title: Excellent place to stay!
text: The room looked fairly small but was very clean and modern! Bathroom was awesome, great shower pressure! It is very convenient to food outlets right next door. Staff were friendly and the price was good! Heat pump was good, free wifi and the bed was really comfy. More than happy to stay again!

title: Last Minute Surprise
text:
We were a walk in late book on a Saturday night.
We booked two adjoining rooms and were delighted with the friendly staff, clean modern rooms and the quiet, despite being near a busy intersection and a McDonalds drive through over the fence.
This is the sort of motel you would pick if you had time to pour over all of the listings!
Great value for money and would stay again.
It is also within walking distance to the Claudelands Showgrounds

title: Clean, Noisy and Hard Beds
text: Our two bed unit was very tidy and super clean with lovely bathroom and good kitchen. Unlimited free internet a bit slow at times but OK.  TV's in each bedroom and in lounge which was a bonus but only a few Freeview channels so a bit pointless in the end.  Lady at reception was wonderful - couldn't do enough for us but our stay overall was not good.  Central living area was too cramped for a family of 3 let alone 4 and no one could move around once everyone was in.  Although beds had polyester toppers on (plus I asked for a further topper to be safe) all beds ended were still extremely hard - you could feel the springs in unit 2. The motel is situation beside McDonalds and between two of a five road intersection and windows were double glazed but the vehicle noise still drove us insane.  There were no lamps or power-points beside 3 of the four beds so setting our phone alarms and charging was a pain.  Only power point in second bedroom was for the TV and this one gets me every time for those who wear makeup and need to dry their hair - put a damn mirror in the bedrooms so others can use the bathroom - easy!

title: Overnight
text:
Stayed one night in a room with McDonalds over the fence. The room was very comfortable and well appointed which made the stay a very pleasant one. The room was very clean and was not one where I felt the owners were trying to cut corners to save costs. 
Although McDonalds car park was over the fence and it was a busy Saturday night there was little noticeable noise. 
I would definitely stay here again.

title: Holiday
text: Stayed  one night very  helpful staff  extremely  clean would  definitely  stay  there  again very comfortable  bed  handy to city found it really  quiet at night  had choice of upstairs  or down chose  down for convenience

title: Comfortable stay
text: The quality of the units were up to standard. Everything was well maintained and very clean. We were comfortable and the location is very central to everywhere in Hamilton. Personally found that the TV was at the wrong height but that is a personal thing so shouldn't worry anyone else. Service was great apart from not being able to raise anyone at reception on one occasion. They must have been occupied somewhere. Also was a bit annoying only accepting VIsa as I put all my business expenses on another card that was not accepted - AMEX and Diners.

title: Most comfortable
