text: We were allocated a very nice, clean and spacious unit during our overnight stay at this motel.   Kelly at the reception was most helpful and accommodated our request not to be in an upstairs unit as we are elderly.  We would definitely book in again.

title: Tidy decor
text: The motel was comfortable and extremely clean.  I appreciated the good kitchen facilities although the coffee plunger is too small for a couple to share, and I would have enjoyed a larger one.  The furniture is comfortable and well-appointed and the quality of everything is obvious.  Personally, the bed was on the 'hard' side but the quality of the bed linen was really appreciated. Having free wi-fi was a feature that increased my enjoyment of my stay, and shows the generosity of the hosts. I intend staying here next time I stay in Hamilton.

title: No problems here...
text: Wanted a modern, clean and high class motel near Claudelands for 1 nights stay. Brooklyn fitted the bill. Warm welcome from 'Rainbow' beautiful unit with quality bedding etc. Very good value and would recommend to anyone.

title: Perfect place to stay in Hamilton
text:
Stayed here for 5 nights and found it absolutely ideal. My mother required treatment at Waikato Hospital each day and whilst this motel is not close enough to walk to the hospital it was only a short drive. It was new and clean and had everything we wanted. 

We had two, one bedroom units with an interconnecting door which meant we had a huge space for my parents and myself.  Cooking facilities were more than enough, bathrooms were spotless and the beds were comfy. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend the Brooklyn Lodge to anyone. 

McDonalds is right next door and across the road is a coffee shop, takeaways, dairy, butcher, fruit shop etc.

title: Highly recommended
text:
I stayed at this motel for two nights on a business trip.  The room was spacious, comfortable and well-equipped.  Best of all, there were two really comfortable chairs for lounging in - really unusual in my experience!  The motel was being minded by temporary managers while the owners were away.  They were friendly, welcoming and very efficient.
This motel will definitely become my accommodation of choice when I travel to Hamilton.  It's one of the nicest places I've stayed and the location is great.

title: Exceeded expectations
text:
Stayed here at short notice last weekend. It's a lovely new modern motel. Well fitted out. Spacious. Huge and very comfortable King sized bed. Large roomy bathroom with spa. Heat pump that kept us warm in the minus 2 degree low. Well equipped kitchen with plenty of supplies of tea/coffee/hot chocolate. Included fresh coffee grounds.
Central location away yet from the crowded motel street.
Highly recommend this Motel. It is as good as another in Hamilton that we have stayed at that is winning all the awards. And cheaper.

title: Brooklyn Motor Lodge
text:
Arrived prior to check in time hoping to just drop of our bags but were shown straight to our room.  Reception staff very friendly and helpful.  Room was immaculately clean and we liked the design layout of the studio apartment.  
A minor problem with the fridge door staying closed was fixed almost immediately as was a later request to explain the TV remote.  It seemed nothing was too much trouble for them.  A comprehensive and well thought out information guide in the room was very helpful and contained lots of interesting brochures and I particularly liked the way the free WiFi did not time out after a period of inactivity.  
Check out was equally as smooth as check in and I would certainly recommend this motel to anyone wanting to stay in the Claudelands area of Hamilton.  The motel is adjacent to a small shopping center complete with a Liquorland and several eateries, and the town center was only a few minutes drive away.  
If I had to find anything wrong with the unit (for the sake of a balanced review) it was that the only bowl provided in the kitchen was stainless steel and not suitable for the microwave and there was a glass casserole lid but no bottom.

title: Great location
text:
It's a nice, clean and comfortable near new motel. The manager couple is very friendly. And I like it the best of all is that I can actually
walk to claudelands event centre for my business event. I'll be definitely stay in it again next time. when

title: Cosy, clean and peaceful, friendly staff
text: very handy to Claudelands event centre just a few minutes walk, a forest park just across the road, obviously newly refurbished so looks tidy and classy. The rooms are cosy, spacey and mordern styled with new heat pumps and TV. Very friendly and helpful staff.

title: Ur best choice in Hamilton!
text:
Friendly and helpful manager
Comfortable, clean and quiet place to stay over as they are new! 
Super close walking distance to McDonald! It's so convenient we just need to walk across to buy our breakfast where it's the quickest way to fulfill ourselves n kids too....
Nice location, walking distance to a park with playground! Lots of shop lots around! Pretty convenient!
A+++ strongly recommend! Great experience staying over! Will come back again if we go Hamilton!

title: Nice New Motel
text:
Brand New Motel in Hamilton.
Walking distance to claudelands event centre.
Restaurants and shops right across the road.
Double Glazzing Windows.
Very efficient Heat Pumps.
Easy parking.
Free WiFi internet.
Friendly staff.
Brand New.

title: To be avoided
text: This place is very poorly presented.  Cats sleep on guest beds and drink from a bowl on the kitchen sink.  Rooms are full of clutter, together with bits of mismatched old bits of furniture, they must have picked up cheap somewhere.  Beds were old and uncomfortable, sheets crumpled.  Whole house is very messy with junk everywhere.  Breakfast was help yourself to rice bubbles or weetbix and toast in their very messy kitchen.   Table covered with an old plastic table cloth.  I bumped into furniture cluttering the hall when I had to go to the toilet in the night.  $100 cash taken for the room with no receipt given.  I felt like I had been taken for a ride!  Only good thing was the view from the house.

title: Very budget - needs some work
text: Recognising that this is a budget motel and the prices reflect this, I am amazed that anyone could rate it 4 stars. My 3 star rating is generous in my opinion. There are no smoke detectors which made me feel uneasy, there were stains on the carpet and on the curtains. Everything is very old style and I feel that a bit of attention could improve the units. On a positive note my bed was quite comfortable. The management were quick to respond to my email about my concern relating to the smoke detectors and they did say that some updating is planned for the future and smoke detectors will be included.,I don't think they should wait to install these. They also said hair dryers and irons are available on request at reception however we had no notice of this in the unit at the time.

title: Great hosts and comfortable and clean units
text: The hosts are very friendly and helpful which makes a big difference (Many thanks Lance and Manuela). The units are spacious, clean, and tidy, and with reasonable tariffs. I stayed in a 1 bedroom unit and it was very comfortable and had everything I needed. There is plenty of parking and of course Hamilton is just up the road. Many thanks for another great stay while I was in Hamilton. I will definitely be back.

title: Very clean and comfortable
text: Stayed here with my husband as it was one of only 2 motels that had rooms when the All Blacks played at Waikato Stadium. Unfortunately we ended up attending a funeral that weekend as well as being in town to visit family. We found the rooms to be very clean, and comfortable. The bed was very comfortable and had an amazing electric blanket. The rooms are dated but this did not worry us at all. The motel owner was very kind and made sure that we were happy and knew our way around Hamilton etc. on the morning of the funeral we left quite early - leaving dirty dishes in the sink and our bed unmade. When we got back to the motel, all our dishes were done and our bed was made, this was amazing. Would definitely stay here again. Only down thing was the height and pressure of the shower, otherwise all good.

title: Great stay
text: I stayed here for one night and although the neighbours were having a bit of a barney next door, I have no complaints about the motel. The owners were excellent and very helpful. My room was clean, tidy and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. Of course Hamilton is only a hop, skip and jump away. I will definately be back when in this area.

title: Great staff
text: Sue, on reception was amazing. Her local knowledge was very helpful and nothing was a problem, even though that motel wasn't her usual one to work at. The room was great, clean,big. Not far into York City

title: Abbey Travel Lodge, Hamilton
text: This is a very comfortable Motel with everything you could possibly need. Best ever beds, very clean & tidy, walking distance to the hospital,lovely garden area with barbeque. Thank you so much Suzie!

title: Wonderfully comfortable
text:
I was given room 10, which was nice and quiet and very well presented.

The bed was very comfortable, with nice clean crisp sheets. The bathroom was a wet room which was great, no having to climb into a shower.

The hostess was friendly, the the stay was value for money. I'll definitely be staying there the next time I'm in Hamilton.

title: Wonderful Service, great rooms!
text:
I stayed here with my partner for a few weeks while finding my feet in Hamilton having moved here from abroad to work at the hospital.
Suzie was the most gracious host that anyone could ask for, the room was brilliant with all amenities and a very comfy bed.
The management and all the staff are so approachable and really go the extra mile. Special mention also to the cleaning staff who are really lovely. 10/10

title: Close to the Hospital.
text: We needed somewhere close to the hospital at short notice so the location was excellent.  An old fashioned room with a step into the shower but the beds were comfortable.  Good, friendly service.  Good fish and chip shop near by.

title: unpleasant experience
text: We had a very unpleasant experience. The dates we requested were not marked correctly. The manager was very rude and intrusive. She was also not very truthful in her interaction. We had to suddenly find another place

title: Close to the Hospital
text: We’ve stayed here before so did not hesitate to book again. It is an easy walk or drive to Waikato hospital where my husband had a morning appointment so it was very convenient. It is close to the road so there is traffic noise but we both slept well. the rooms are well furnished and have everything you need. Plus there is onsite parking. The owner is so friendly and helpful - would not hesitate to recommend it and we will definitely go back.

title: Abbey travel motel
text:
Stayed here while my husband had heart surgery. Very accomodating when surgery got brought forward. Even though the rooms were not as modern as some they were very warm, tidy and comfortable. The hosts and staff were amazing. The hosts couldnt do enough to help me through this time. So very friendly and professional. The staff serviced the rooms daily.
Thank you

title: A little gem
text:
What a great motel this is. Good size one bedroom unit, with cooking facilities, nice furnishings, comfortable beds and a good rate. 
We were only staying one night so we could catch the train from Hamilton to Wellington and our hosts dropped us off at the station and also offered to look after our vehicle!! Wonderful service where nothing is too much trouble. 
Great location for the hospital too.
We will definitely stay again.

title: Excellent motel with great facilities and helpful staff.
text: Excellent modern facilities and exceptionally clean throughout , very warm and cosy, soft and comfortable beds, great set up of apartment with kitchenette, bathroom, living room (with single bed), double bedroom, very warm with efficient heating. Very helpful and friendly staff. Room was serviced every day with fresh towels. Would definitely stay here again. Free wifi.

title: A lovely motel to stay in,and the owners Suzie and her husband were  great
text: My motel was lovely,spotless,and the bed one of the most comfortable Ive ever stayed in,in a motel,in NZ or overseas. The owners could not have been more obliging,or helpful,and Suzie definately went the extra mile.

title: Excellent
text: We stayed at Abbey Lodge for over a month as our babies were at Waikato Hospital in NICU. Abbey Lodge made our stay pleasant. Its very close to Waikato hospital. Our room was shifted a couple of times due to unsurity of discharge of our kids. We were moved for a night to another hotel but we requested the owner to have us back. The owner has been very supportive and booked us for another month and was happy with last minute cancellation if we had to.

title: Short notice stay
text:
Had to find accommodation quickly and near the Waikato Hospital.

Aside from the fantastic location being so close to the hospital, the Abbey Travel Lodge exceeded all expecting. 

They could not have been more helpful. Nor could the room have been any more comfortable and more importantly, clean.

I and very grateful to them in being able to be accomodated at short notice

title: Nothing to much trouble.
text: We cannot recommend this place more.  We recently stayed here while my mum has a major operation in hospital.   Owners went well above our expectations to mash our stay as stress free as possible at this extremely hard time for us.   Nothing was to much trouble.   Unit was clean, tidy and so handy with full kitchen.   Thank you.

title: Excellent accommodation in a time of need
text: We were touring around New Zealand when my wife developed appendicitis and needed an urgent operation and this motel is within easy walking distance of the superb waikato hospital. I cannot speed highly enough of suzie who welcomed me when most of the accommodation around was fully booked. I stayed for two nights in one of the renovated lodges where the standard of accommodation was on a par with the most expensive accommodation we stayed at during our travels...heritage etc.. I highly recommend to anyone who needs accommodation in the area...

title: Recommend staying here
text: This motel is directly across the road from the hospital. The host was very welcoming and not a problem checking in early. We also got upgraded to the lovely 2 bedroom apartments. They are older style units on the outside but have been renovated and beautifully decorated on the inside with everything you could want, especially if you were staying longer - full size fridge, combined washing machine/dryer, dishwasher, dining room table with six chairs and two 2-seated sofas. Unfortunately, we were only staying one night so did not really to get to enjoy all this. The bedroom and bathroom were spacious and the bed was very comfortable. Will definitely stay here again when in Hamilton.

title: Great stay
text: Stayed for 4 days in a studio room as it is a short walk to the hospital.  The room was clean and comfortable, especially the bed which had triple sheeting.  The owners were great and I highly reccommend this motel  to everyone.

title: Quiet and comfortable
text: We stayed 2 nights while visiting a friend.   Our unit was a little tired, but clean and comfortable, well situated to the hospital and convenience stores.    Everything we needed was in the unit, we would certainly stay again.

title: Great Great
text: So grateful to owners of this home away from home Susie was so bubbly and caring and the unit was great with everything one needs in times of stress at Waikato hospital recommend to all. Clean,beds comfortable electric blankets older building but tastefully redecorated

title: Wonderful accommodation and excellent caring owners
text: I'm so appreciative to have the pleasure to meet and stay with the beautiful humble mangers of this amazing home away from home. Thank you so much for the wonderful hospitality, caring an helpful host they you and your husband are. Definitely recommend this accommodation to all people that travel to Hamilton for what ever reason. :)  :)  💖👍👌

title: Great place to stay.
text:
Always stay at Abbey Lodge Motel when I am in Hamilton.
Managers are great, Susie is a darling. Nothing is ever too much for them. 
This is an older Motel, but most of it has been refurbished
Units always clean and tidy. Highly recommended.

title: Wonderful Accommodation
text:
Very handy to Waikato Hospital. 
My sister and I stayed in a tastefully newly redecorated two bedroom unit. It was a pleasure to stay in home-away-from-home surroundings while my husband had major surgery at Waikato Hospital.
When my sister returned home I was able to transfer to a delightful comfortable studio unit.
Suzie is so kind and caring, and nothing was too much trouble for her. 
Thank you so much Suzie.
I highly recommend this motel and would definitely stay again.

title: FRIENDLY AND ACCOMODATING
text: Thanks for a pleasant stay, making my hospital visit as bearable as possible! The hosts and cleaning staff were super cool, with smiles and friendly vibes all round. Nothing was too much trouble and the advise on eating out was bang on. You have no idea how much it meant to go that extra mile in the last hour of my stay after checkout but before pick up. FOREVER GRATEFUL.

title: Average...
text: Very average place to stay, the price doesn't reflect the quality. Receptionist was pleasant. The room was clean but worn, same with the toilet/shower facilities. Studio had no cooking facilities. Stay elsewhere if you can find something available.

title: Excellent Service
text: Stayed for one night while visiting Waikato Hospital. Close to shops and hospital. Room was clean and tidy. We were offered a home cooked meal and this was appreciated after a long day travelling. Great Service

title: 17th stop on our road trip
text:
My wife has been taken seriously ill and taken into Waikato Hospital Hamilton. This hotel is very close to the hospital and a lot of clients are visiting people in the hospital. IU stayed in this hotel firstly on my own and when my wife had recovered sufficiently, with her, for a total of 25 nights in all. The hotel is a bit older than some and is close to a noisy road, but above all is near to the hospital.
Jonathan Suzanne and Harriet and their staff helped us immensely during our stay there. When I was down at my lowest ebb when Janis was really ill, they were really supportive. I can't recommend them as hosts highly enough. Nothing was too much trouble for them. Sometimes the way you are treated is more important than the newness of the hotel. The hotel is about a twenty minute walk to the city centre and Hamilton Gardens. Lake Rotoroa is somewhat closer.

title: Good value
text: Stayed for 7 night over 2 weeks, very good value for money. Feels like holiday flat vacation with the added bonus on being cleaned daily. Close to shops and the main road to see tourist stuff. Is was very hot for our stay (we didn't bring the rain with us). And they provided us with extra fans to keep cool

title: Great pet friendly place to stay
text: We stayed for two nights with our two dogs and will come back to stay here, when we are next in Hamilton. Really convenient location and the room has everything we needed, lovely and clean and right next to the garden. Thank you too for the friendly, helpful service

title: A place to be central!
text: We stayed here for three nights because it was close to Cambridge (as son was playing in a tournament & no vacancies in Cambridge) & easy to get to the centre of Hamilton.  This motel is right across the road from the hospital so if I were visiting a relative there - this is a good place to stay.  Usual traffic noises until around 10pm but after that quiet.  I have to HIGHLY COMMEND the housekeeping service!  It's even better than some hotels we've stayed in!!  Very clean & thorough.  Black out curtains help a lot!  Shower is a bit weak but the units are being refurbished at present. If I had to, I would stay again. 😊

title: What a fantastic motel!!!
text: We git such good value for money. The motel even let our in laws have a room next to us which was perfect. They even got a brand new high chair and baby cot for our little 1 year old. Did everything they callus to make out stay perfect.

title: Great Little Motel
text: We stayed at this motel while visiting family at Waikato hospital which is so close. The owners went out of their way to make us feel so welcome. We stayed in the big unit at the back and even though this is on a main busy road it was lovely and quiet. It is an older motel but it is clean, tidy and well priced. This suited us for what we needed and if we are ever back in Hamilton we will certainly stay here again. Thanks once again.

title: Simply the best in every aspect
text: Mort and April were quite possibly the most professional, thoughtful and obliging hosts we have ever come across. Everything in the villas has been well thought out and executed, from the lavish spread in the fridge, to all the little extras in the cupboards and bathroom and kitchen facilities. Alongside this, the tranquility that exists at this property, couple with the bush walks and relaxing spa overlooking the scenery is spectacular. This is a stop and smell the roses accomodation and one that I cannot recommend enough.

title: Beautiful, comfortable villa with amazing hosts
text: We absolutely LOVED our stay!  The property is lush with trees and birds.  The views are gorgeous!  We walked the trails through the forest around the property.  The bed (and window seat) were super comfy.  The kitchen had everything we needed and April provided a delicious continental breakfast, customized to our likes.  It was my favorite accommodation on our trip through New Zealand and I wish we could have stayed longer.

title: A couple of days in paradise
text:
Wonderful 3 nights stay to celebrate our golden wedding anniversary. We arrived to an anniversary cake on the table and beautiful garden rose floral arrangements.
We can not speak highly enough of the welcome from April,  the presentation of the villa, of the property with garden walk, spa pool(saw a shooting star one night),  and delightful garden room to while away a few afternoon hours. If relax and reset is what you are looking for this is the spot. 
Property also well situated for visiting the area, a day visit to Raglan beach,  Bridal Veil Falls, Maungatautari bird sanctuary, Cambridge/Hamilton and surrounding area. You will not be disappointed.

title: Heaven on earth
text:
If you love being in nature, but with every comfort and convenience, this is the place for you. The studio is beautifully designed and spacious. The kitchen is equipped with everything you need to make simple meals and there is a gas Weber for grilling.  The cupboards even offer champagne glasses. The bed is true king-size and supremely comfortable with luxury bedding.

There are views toward the distant hills over lush greenery.  Bird life abounds. The grounds offer walks through native bush and landscaped areas. The bird feeders attract all manner of birds, especially right after they are re-supplied.

The porch is sheltered and a fabulous place to sit with morning tea, or wine later in the day. If it is rainy and windy, simply move to the window seat inside or one of the comfortable club chairs.

Roberts Road is lightly traveled and offers beautiful country walks.

Finally, you will not find more gracious hosts than April and Mort.  They genuinely care that you have the best experience possible and make every effort to ensure it.

title: Quiet and peaceful
text: Very nice off the beaten path spot still close enough to lots of the sights! The hosts were extremely accommodating! Our room included fresh fruit, eggs, milk, juice, Coffee and tea. The patio over looks the hills and a garden and has a yoga platform and a little reading shack that are a short hike from your door.

title: Truly special
text: Perfect location, very tastefully decorated and squeaky clean. I feel so lucky to have found this listing. Amazing breakfast with super high quality ingredients, super comfortable bed, linens, landscape and spa jacuzzi with views. Hosts went above and beyond. Can’t recommend this place enough.

title: Beautiful self catering hideaway.
text:
HIlltop Views is a spacious, clean, well equipped, nice decorated and perfect accomodation. It has a lovely big garden. It really feels like the perfect holiday setting. Not far from tourist attractions like Hobbiton and Watomo Caves e.o. 
We loved it so much that we decided to come back after 3 weeks to stay again. Sharon is a very friendly lady. Thanks Sharon that you let us stay twice in your lovely accomodation.

title: Beautiful location
text: About 15 minutes out of Cambridge, located atop a rural hillside.  2 units in a separate modern wood finished building.  A rear patio overlooking a gorgeous panorama.  Very spacious and clean.  Friendly and helpful owners.  A perfect location for some peaceful R&R.

title: Fanatiast, just book it, peace, comfort, privacy and a great nights sleep
text: This property is located just outside Cambridge on a hill top over looking the countryside. There are two self contained cottages away from the main house and both are beautifully decorated with simple, good quality furnishings and fittings.  The bed is fantastic and the linens and towels all lovley and fresh and good quality.  There is a small bush walk and the gardens are lovley, we lost count of the tui and birds we watched just sitting on the patio with a wine at sunset.  The kitchen has everything you need to whip up a meal. There was yummy home baked treats in the fridge and a simple vase of fresh roses on the table.  This really is a wondeful, quiet, relaxing spot to stay and the hosts leave you to do your thing but are wonderfully gracious, we left with a pot of their honey :) .  Excellent wifi speed  too.  I can't recommend this enough.

title: Nice, clean and comfy!
text: First time for me to go to New Zealand country side to look at farms and Fieldays. It was a surprise that there existed this kind of place. It was located really remote from the town and city centers. It was in the middle of the big farms. But keeping an open mind, we were at awe at what this place can offer, different from what we have where we come from. Nice views, clean skies. One should see the stars on the clear night! Plus the owners are really nice people, anyone would easily feel at home!

title: Wonderful all around
text: We had the most wonderful time staying here.  The studio is planned and equipped for every comfort.  The king bed is comfortable and you can watch the sun rise with a cuppa. (Then sit outside with a glass of wine in the evening and watch the sunset.) The landscaping is carefully designed for both the views (which somehow manage to be both stunning and restful) and privacy.  The kitchen has every thing you need to make basic meals, or just picnic.  Jan and Paul could not possibly be more welcoming or more attentive to your comfort and interests. Jan lent us her map book to the area, and also left us a stack of bird books when she discovered we are birders.  It is a bit away from Cambridge, but the drive is beautiful and it is less than 20 minutes.  Also, it is an easy drive to Sanctuary Mountain.

title: Totally agree with Josie 006
text:
We have stayed at Hilltop Views many times.. We first went when our son was rowing for his school at Karapiro and stayed for each regatta. We now stay as our place in NZ where we can truly relax and enjoy the abundance of Native Birds and Trees. 
The hosts couldn't be more helpful or friendly.
The rooms are exceptionally clean and the food is fantastic

title: Amazing rurual views from this location.
text:
If you want to completely spoil yourselves with the best all round B & B this is the place to go.
We've been there a few times and find it such a quiet haven of rest that one might want to keep this place a best kept secret but the owners are quite happy for me to review it.  The extensive views from this hilltop are special and their own surrounding garden winds down little staircases to a peaceful viewing platform.  The outdoors hot spa pool set amongst bush is an added bonus to your stay and great after a hard day of bush walking.  The quality of the furnishings throughout and comfort of the big bed are the best and the couple who own the place are most obliging and super friendly.

title: Friendly host
text: Clean comfortable unit. Good value for money.

title: Great Place to Stay
text: Friendly staff, good wifi, spacious rooms and a good location. We stayed in the 1 bedroom and it was lovely. Bed was quite soft which is a nice change from most hotels in ANZ. We stayed for 4 nights. This is my favorite type of hotel to stay in.

title: Felt like home
text: Excellent place to stay. Clean & tidy unit, heating worked well, chairs & bed were comfortable & unit was spacious enough. Bathroom was good with heater & fan and you can also open the window so no problem with ventilation or heating. Extremely well-located & very pleasant staff; price was very competitive also. Will definitely stay gain when back in the 'Tron.

title: Best ever
text: So sad to see the reviews from 5 years ago Motel has changed hands since then and is absolutely lovely. Service was impeccable room was clean and tidy and very comfortable no problems with internet will be returning next week

title: Cherry and Bing are excellent hosts at this great motel
text: I was on a visit back to New Zealand and a friend suggested that we visit Hamilton to see the gardens, which were great. We rang Settlers and spoke to Bing, who gave us an excellent rate. The motel was lovely, clean and with excellent facilities. It’s not too far from the city centre and has plenty of parking. But the best part of the motel is the customer service you receive from Cherry and Bing. Home-made biscuits, a lovely welcome note and really helpful service. Would definitely stay again and would highly recommend to fellow travellers.
