Shocking 

motel
text:
Whole place is bad. needs better wifi takes forever to log in office people are rude and rooms are bad, 
bad coustomer service wouldnt even give us a didnt room. Shocking dont recomend staying here. Kids run every where well they perants sit in there room and smoke p

title: Horrific
text: On arrival, carpark had people sitting in it, drinking, smoking & swearing. Office woman declined me a refund when I said at check-in that I would prefer to go elsewhere. She said it would be quiet by 11pm (and it was). By then I had barricaded the unit door with chairs after a loud male banged on my door @9.30 pm yelling for someone (who was in the unit 2 over). The upstairs was extremely hot with no fan, the sofa was stained, the shower curtains mouldy, the dishes dirty. By the morning my car had two dents & a scratch probably from the kiddies racing their scooters around the carpark. Just don't go here.

title: Yeah-nah
text:
This is the first time we’ve actually packed up & moved accomodation. Checked in about 3pm & checked out at 7:30pm. Lots of yelling & swearing in the complex. Even came out at one stage to find about four different units outside arguing & yelling at each other. Decided that a move to other premises would ensure a much better sleep.
The room itself was tidy & would have worked well for our family.
To their credit, the owners agreed to refund some of our money.

title: Dont stay here full of winz people
text: I use to love this motel it was one of my favourite motels in Hamilton. So i booked online as usual knowing id have a nice stay. Much to my disgust when i arrived i thought i was in a scene from once a warriors!!! Screaming kids running around solo mothers outside chain smoking and drinking in pjamas swearing cars coming and going. i was scared to even stay there but i had booked and had no choice. The smoke waffled into our unit and the next unit person even threw there slopps out of the pot infront of our unit!! What has happened to this motel is a crying shame spoilt by people that cant afford houses so  this motel decided to lower the standard of what was once a nice motel and house them. There was even a domestic next door that the police should of been aware of where the woman threatened to smash the motel window. What next i thought to myself how dear they take my good money i work  for a nice hoilday ruined by this motel. Think twice before booking.

title: Beneficiaries Live Here
text:
We have stayed at this place numerous times over the years and it has always been good but unfortunately the owners have now accepted easy money from the government and allowed the homeless to live at this motel while they wait for state housing.
If you want to stay at a place with kids running around at all hours and a general atmosphere of a boarding house this place will suit you otherwise give it a miss.
The rooms are still nice and the owners look after the place well but probably not for long with the type of people setting up home here.
Hamilton is full of these places now so shop around carefully.

title: Just OK
text:
Relatively cheap but you get what you pay for. The rooms are OK with a downstairs studio like room and a first floor double bed but without tv. Lavatories need some stain removal.
Reasonably good location.
I'll not be back.

title: Clean and spacious
text: Lovely unit with plenty of space. Good spa-bath and shower. Spotlessly clean. Friendly and help-full staff. Good wifi connection. Only problem: The car-park was over-filled, so we had to park on the side opposite our unit, but that was no biggie.

title: Great stay
text: We were warmly welcomed by the owner and promptly shown to our room. Very tidy and had everything we needed. Nice, big soft towels, enougth for all 5 of us. The owner was very helpful with the w/f and milk late at night. Comfy beds with electric blankets and soft pillows for a good nights sleep. My only complaint would be the noisey downstairs heater. Will book again.

title: Balloons Over Hamilton week end away
text:
Well years ago we stay here and it was a lovely motel in its day now sadly its a Tried
motel with new owners that have put in budget  bathroom soaps shampoo Containers
& hard to use toilet paper dispensers and very slippery hand rails up stairs to bedroom which used to have wall fitted Sky TV but was no longer there and a Spa bath that was not cleaned out from last guests Did have nice 2seater couch but very small TV on downstairs lounge wall and hard to use sky as cables were pulled out Did have Free unlimited Wi Fi that was nice...

title: Great accommodation and friendly
text: Easy checkin friendly and so helpful also helped with issues  connecting to internet. Also helped with sights to see. Very  clean and spacious. Well equipped kitchen also comfortable lounge. We enjoyed our stay so much we extended by another day. Recommend this property.

title: Clean, cozy and comfortable
text: We stayed for a one night stop over and this was perfect for our needs. The rooms were small but well appointed with little things like a make-up table in the bathroom that made a point of difference. The wi-fi was free and it worked. Standard foxtel channels on tv. We drove into town for dinner so I'm not sure what is available within walking distance. Overall a pleasant stay.

title: Rotten stay here
text:
Really horrible. Extremely noisy road. Dirty fan. Dirty blinds. No air circulation. Fan didn’t work. Run by non New Zealanders. Don’t stay here. Really really disappointing. 
Nothing good today say about this place. Stupid little uncomfortable waiting room sofa thing masquerading as a couch. Rather stay in a tent !

title: Clean and Friendly
text: Enjoyed our stay at BK Settlers. Surprised at the nice spacious twin room for the price.  Lounge had Easyboy style seats, which were appreciated. Great shower pressure and usual array of appliances. Off street parking affords security for cars. Staff very friendly.

title: Convenient location, good value
text: We had an upstairs room at the back so it was a little quieter than I thought it would be - apart from the guests in the upstairs unit across the hall from us, who let the door slam every time they left the unit and thundered up and down the stairs during the night! A draught stop would have been good on the unit door as a cold draught from the open stairwell came under the large gap under the door. Car parking is a bit of a hassle as the parks are narrow and not numbered. We had to try and back in to the park closest to our room but one night a huge 4WD had taken that park so we had to park near the office. Plenty of huge bath towels, good shower pressure, and large bathroom. Lights over mirror could do with being cooler - even without the heat lamp turned on, the bathroom was hot due to the mirror lights. Heater is a wall-mounted digital one and there were no instructions. TV could do with being on a longer arm as you can't turn it around enough to watch from anywhere other than the bed. Mind you, the couch wasn't overly comfortable anyway! Room serviced daily, they even made the bed! Staff friendly, and room good value. Unit nice and clean and fresh smelling. Bedside lamps a bit wobbly. Fridge didn't seem to keep things very cold.

title: Good and central
text: A nice place to stay. The beds were comfortable and spacious rooms. The woman at reception was incredibly friendly. Where I did not get the chance to give the spa a go it looked very inviting, however the water pressure was good. The point I would note that the there is no heat pump, rather just a plug in heater which was enough for the room we were in. Would recommend staying here when visiting hamilton.

title: Weekend in Hamilton
text: Spent 2 nights in an upper studio room when in Hamilton for Queen concert.  Very friendly helpfull host. Room very clean. Super comfortable bed.  Very quiet room. Easy access to city or the base for shopping.

title: Absolutely Fantastic
text: This place is one of the best motels I have stayed in NZ for this price. Super clean, roomy, nice bathroom & lay-out. The guy running it (was on a Sunday) is lovely - very friendly & warm. Will 100% be coming back to this place when in Hamilton.

title: Good 1 x night stopover for Chiefs v Lions
text:
Short  overnight stay for the Waikato Chiefs v British and Irish Lions game . We had a 2 x bedroom Unit upstairs and downstairs ,double  bedroom upstairs with  ensuite spa bath  and single room downstairs with kitchenette .
The room was spacious with very friendly and helpful receptionist at check in .
The Motel was ideally situated for the FMG Stadium  and at the top end of Ulster Street which is one of the main streets in Hamilton .
Simply follow this street towards the CBD and you come across  plenty of bars and restaurants etc  so the location was ideal for our requirements .( 20 mins walk to the bus station . ) 
Overall a clean , convenient and friendly accommodation option if your looking for for a short Hamilton stay.

title: Clean room with a soft mattress!
text:
The room was clean and good size for a single overnight stay. The staff were very helpful and assisted where possible. I found the room to be cold. The wall mounted electrical heater was not working but in its place was a small electric hot air blower. 
I was fortunate to find two extra bed coverings in my room to ensure I could sleep properly. Granted this was a last minute booking and i was happy to get accommodation late in the evening. However if i was asked would i stay again, I would look elsewhere.

title: EXCEPTIONALLY FRIENDLY
text: We were in need of a unit to stay in on Friday evening - which coincided with the field days.This motel was the only one that we called into that did NOT increase their  prices. (We were blown away with  the increase in some of the motels over this period, some up to almost three hundred percent of normal rates ).The receptionist was very friendly and helpful, the unit was very tidy and comfortable and we had a pleasant  nights sleep.

title: Great Motel!
text: Receptionist was extremely friendly and helpful. Room was spotless and well presented each day. Nice & quiet and super close to restaurants. Spa bath in th house was great. Would definitely stay again! 10/10.

title: Comfortable for one night
text: I stayed here en route to Auckland and we were lucky to get a room away from the main road which allowed us to have a good nights sleep. The motel is nothing outstanding but it provides a spacious and clean accommodation for an overnight stay with friendly and helpful hosts at reception. Location is good quite close to town but you do need a car if you want to go to the main town.

title: It was okay for a night's stay
text:
On first impressions, the hotel appeared very nice, but on entering the unit the pink dirty armchairs did not sustained that first impression.  I think it's better not to have stained furniture as it makes you wonder about the rest of the unit.  I think the pink needs to be replaced as steam cleaning every couple of years doesn't seem to keep them in good condition and the stains are still showing up.

We had a two bedroom unit .  The beds were good, the bath was very good and a very good refrigerator, but for the number of people the table is too small and not enough chairs.  For us the overnight stay it was okay but for an extended stay, with no dishwasher and the only weak detergent I am not sure the dishes would be cleaned adequately.

title: Very friendly and helpful
text:
The staff at the hotel were very friendly and at tentative, the room was a good size with cooking facilities and the bed was comfortable ( although I think the mattress was inner spring) and I didn't expect it to be. 
We booked for the wrong night through a third party and thought we had lost our money, I emailed the hotel and they got straight back to me and were happy to change the booking to the correct night at no extra charge. 

The hotel is located about four doors down from the supermarket and the shopping centre is close by. A good stop over place.

title: Lovely owners
text:
Stayed here for two nights, lovely owners, very proactive sorting a group of people out that were been a nuisance to others staying. Although I felt our room for $170 was over priced.
They do need to sort there cleaners as our duvet cover had a few surprises on it from previous stayers. yuk!

title: Great motel, wonderful staff, reasonable price
text: We stayed here for a weekend away watching the kids compete in their sports and a bit of shopping. Staff couldn't have been nicer, were super helpful and friendly. Room was excellent, and spotless. 😍

title: Excellent!
text: Staff are very friendly. Rooms are spacious and comfortable. Cleanliness is very well maintained on a daily basis. I'd recommend it for anyone who is visiting Hamilton. I couldn't find a single flaw with the place. Grade A+ accomodation.

title: Outstanding BK'S SETTLERS LODGE
text:
Thank you very much, Karlin and myself traveled up from Taranaki to Hamilton for the weekend and stayed here at this Motel. Outstanding hospitality, Fantastic rooms definitely made our weekend.
THANKU

title: Amazing ❤
text:
Me and my partner stayed two nights in the spa suite and it was absolutely Devine! My partner had a special request for chocolates and flowers which they done a beautiful job with and also added rose petals on the bed which was a cute touch. 
The amount of quality you get when you stay here is amazing. I could not fault the room we had in any way. I felt comfortable from the moment we checked in. Very clean and warm. Thank you for an amazing weekend we will be back !! 👍👏❤

title: Little maintenance needed but good
text: Very helpful staff knowledgable, rooms a little run down and a little dirty in bathrooms great for children, wouldn't recommend long stay but 1 or 2 nights good. Parking was good close to the base . Can be noisy. No air con or very good heating just wall panel heaters

title: We will stay again
text: Excellent apartment that was clean, tidy and relaxing. Great hosts who were very welcoming. It is only a small thing but we love how you offer a small jug of milk for drinks. Beds clean and comfy. Relaxing spa bath. My son and his friend (age 10) also loved the beds and how comfortable the place felt. Wonderful stay.

title: Brilliant Motel to stay in
text: I stayed two nights at this Motel and was very impressed. Very friendly owners on arrival, easy check in and the unit was amazing. Very comfortable rooms, very clean and tidy and warm. I would recommend this motel and definitely stay again.

title: Lovely central stay
text: Nice and neat little units. Lovely service and very helpful. Nice and central to Hamilton. We walked out for dinners every night. Pak n Save very handy just at the end of the street. Close to main street. Slight pain to get to in peak hour unless approaching from the right direction

title: Absolutely fantastic service and welcoming people
text: When we arrived we were welcomed with a smile and a chat, we stayed their for 3 nights, thought rooms had a oven when I them but none as we had brought a roast lamb and veges discussed it with owner they said we could use staff kitchen which was awsum, we were welcome to use it while we stayed, great people and awsum service nothing was to much trouble. Rooms were very clean and well serviced daily, would reccomend this motel close to city centre, and are Waikato Chiefs supporters.

title: Wonderful motel
text: This motel was absolutely lovely...very friendly and showed us to our room...the room was spotless and fresh and clean..the rooms were very spacious and my kids enjoyed the spa bath.they even accomadated us when my son locked me and him out of our room ...nothing was an issue for them to help us .....I have nothing but praises for staying at this motel and will be coming back

title: Modern and spacious
text:
We had a 2 roomed unit, with the rooms upstairs. All very modern facilities, spacious downstairs lounge/kitchenette, and a bathroom with a spa bath.

Would have liked to have seen a handle  on the wall adjacent to the bath to make getting in and out of the bath easier. but apart from that, quite happy with the place.

Friendly customer service.

title: Very good customer service
text: We stayed over night in the two story 2brm apartment, family of 5 (with 3 kids), it was lovely presented, well setup, modern and very clean. On arrival the owner was very helpful, kind and considerate. Great location, a short walk to the local grocery store. Highly recommended.

title: Amazing customer service
text:
Due to being late from Auckland we arrived and were not able to get into our accommodation booked (at another location), Wayne opened his doors even tho they were well and truly closed. He gave us a room for the night, he even accommodated us after we were able to cancel the other accommodation by moving someone so we could keep the same room. Both Debbie and Wayne were gorgeous, friendly and helpful people.
The room was amazing, for the price we were amazed at how roomy and modern it was. It was multi level giving us space and privacy. The spa bath was a generous size.
Overall i would recommend this motel to anyone, i have never had such helpful and kind hearted service before.
Once again thank you for saving us at 11pm. 
From the Aussies :)

title: COMFORTABLE AVERAGE ACCOMMODATION
text: The 1 bedroom unit for 3 people was very cramped downstairs, access to kitchen crockery, glasses etc was difficult. Large bedroom upstairs with ensuite and separate downstairs toilet. Units looking dated and tired. Location was good.

title: Can't fault it
text: We spent our first night in NZ here. Owners were very friendly. Room was clean and exactly as per the website. WiFi available. We ate at one of the recommendations in the bumpf which was very nice too. Easy to get to.

title: Warm and delightful place!
text: We had a great experience in BK's Settlers Motor Lodge. It's a nice place, 5 minutes walk to supermarket and also walking distant to go to the town center. The rooms are clean, the spa bath is very relaxing! The host is super nice and she gave us a lot of good advice in terms of restaurant choice and helped to book the Hobbiton visit as well!

title: Good as gold
text:
Two nights in late January, and it's stinking hot. Most NZ motels seem to have forgotten about summer, and don't have much in the way of cooling systems. Although a bit of air-con is good, I prefer a fan, and these rooms have them on the ceiling, above the bed. Perfect! 
Room was spacious, clean and the kitchen was ideal for what I needed. 
Definitely stay again.

title: Exceptional haven
text: This is my second visit and I can't help but rave over the exceptional cleanliness and comfort of this place and the delightful friendliness of Wayne and Debbie. This is my 'go to' place whenever I'm visiting Hamilton! It ticks all the boxes for me - over and above!

title: A Top Pick
text: What a delightful place to stay.  My room was beautifully presented, clean and had all that I needed to enjoy my visit.  The service was 10/10. Walking distance to the supermarket and even the CBD if you so wished.  Well done guys you have a great place to stay.

title: Home away from home!
text: We stayed for a couple of nights and Debbie and Wayne were gracious and helpful no matter what we asked.  We needed two rooms and both were spotless, nicely done up and the spa tub was heavenly!  Comfy beds and a little kitchenette to make a cup of coffee/tea/hot chocolate!  Close to all sorts of things like the Classic car museum and easy find. We would stay there again and certainly recommend the BK's Settlers Motor Lodge! Thanks from the Harts

title: Nice place to stay for a couple of nights. Good spacious rooms.
text: The place is close to the local center. We stayed there for two nights. Rooms are spacious and clean. There were a problem with Wi-Fi during the first night. It seems like slow Internet is a problem all around New Zealand.

title: Hospitality and comforts of Home
text: My wife and I arrived at BK Settlers Motor Lodge late in the afternoon following a long day at the Waitomo Caves. Debbie was there to welcome us and quickly checked us in. We inquired about dinner options and she gladly shared. We choose to order the recommended Indian food for delivery. Debbie helped us place the order. Minutes later the food arrived and we enjoyed our dinner in our room. We then relaxed the rest of the evening. We had a much needed quiet and relaxing evening. Thank you Debbie for your hospitality. We got some of our best sleep on our trip!

title: Great accommodation...loved it!
text: Spotlessly clean, very tastefully decorated. Well priced, close to CBD, nice owners very friendly, helpful and accommodating. Lovely room very comfortable bed. Secure parking at the front door. Would recommend this lodge to others as a great option in Hamilton.

title: Fantastic!
text:
A lovely modern, clean and comfortable motor lodge with a lovely host. My friends and I really enjoyed our stay. Thanks Debbie!

Will stay again next time we visit Hamilton. Short taxi ride from bars and restaurants in the cbd.
-------------

title: Staying here first time visit-4 star
text:
Amazing rooms, very clean, fresh and very beautiful, just loved the 4 star.
Booked on booking.com would be nice to have more cheaper specials
would come back and stay again. 
Loved the spa bath, and deck up stairs. fresh sheets, bed was so soft and great nights sleep

title: not 4 star
text: Furniture awful pink and lime green. No instructions for use of heating. If more milk required told to go to supermarket. No proper shampoo or conditioner supplied. No phone in room. Bedside light only on one side of the bed. Breakfast continental only. Comfortable bed. Clean

title: Clean, tidy, good service.
text: We only stayed for one night and was very happy with the unit we stayed in. The host was very nice and welcoming. Room was nice and good quality of sleep. Will stay again if we travel pass Hamilton. Thank you.

title: Second-time honeymooners in New Zealand.
text:
Decided on Hamilton for our second honeymoon trip in New Zealand. The place was awesome! It was clean with every single day of room service. We did not regret with the choice made. The hosts were VERY friendly, especially Mavis, who made us young couple felt at home (she was like a motherly figure during our stay here). Please do pick this motel when you come to Hamilton!

P.S. Mavis, if you're reading this, don't forget us! =D

title: Awesome
text: We just spent 2 nights here 2 Adults and 2 Children. Wonderful place to stay. Very clean and quiet. The staff were very friendly and helpful. The spa bath was amazing and the water pressure in the shower was perfect. Will stay again when in Hamilton

title: Great location, Friendly Staff, Quiet and Convenient
text: We had a fantastic stay at BK's. The staff/owners were incredibly friendly and helpful. The rooms were spotless and well stocked with all you need for a comfortable stay. The location was great. Only a stones throw from the CBD and supermarkets etc. Ample parking, great atmosphere.

title: Lovely Motel and Hosts
text: We had a team of 11 stay at BK Settlers for Mystery Creek Fieldays. Bk Settlers were great hosts and you would have never known the motel was booked out as they service and rooms were amazing.  Would totally recommend BK Settlers to anyone and we will be back next year :)

title: Hospitality Exists by Art and Mev
text: Two words to describe our stay in this motel lodge – 'utterly satisfying'. Hosts were nice and accommodating. The rooms are extremely clean with sufficient heating facilities – heater and electric blanket to keep us warm - day and night. Room was regularly serviced during our stay. Location is very convenient. Close to supermarket, petrol station, stadium and best staging place to go to famous tourist spots in Hamilton, Waitomo and Coromandel. Can’t ask for more.

title: Berrys and Henderson families
text: Totally recommend BK Settlers Motor Lodge. Great service, lovely hosts, nice and clean and comfortable accommodation. Location is perfect, supermarket and eating places all within walking distance. Will be back to stay very soon :)

title: New to Hamilton (Relocation)
text:
We relocated to Hamilton with my husband's new job. Although I grew up in Wellington my family and I were returning home after a number of years and this was our first stay in Hamilton. 

We were very surprised at the very generous, spacious and clean accommodation at BK Settlers and what made our 1 month stay even more memorable was the very friendly and helpful owners. The staff were equally nice and our rooms were cleaned daily and towels replaced daily. Our sheets were replaced weekly and main areas vacummed. 

We really enjoyed our 4 week stay at BK Settler's Motor Lodge and will recommend it to all our friends and family. What made our stay that extra special for us was that when we placed items of clothing in the washing machine on completion of the wash - the load magically got placed in the dryer! Now that is FANTASTIC service!

title: Great place to stay highly recommended
text: Lovely, clean, warm and welcoming. My husband our 4 month old daughter  and I stayed 2 nights in the family unit we had everything we required and more, was so warm for my baby and quiet. We would go back with no hesitations. The hosts are very welcoming, motel is reasonably priced

title: Hamilton Overnight Stay
text: We were pleasantly surprised at the lovely 2 bedroom motel unit we stayed in recently. It was tidy and well equipped with everything we needed. Although it was 2 levels, my elderly mum was able to sleep on a very comfortable bed on the ground level, while my sister and I had a bedroom each upstairs. The hosts were wonderfully helpful when the weather turned cool and assisted us with our heating query. The heat pump was a little tricky to understand but once we did it was easy. Great location close to shops and although on main road did not hear much traffic at all.

title: Dance Squad on Weekend stay
text:
BK looked after my Dance School of 57 people, when we stayed in Hamilton to attend a Weekend Dance Workshop. They were extremely accommodating, allowing extra beds in the room to cater for us all, and even completely refiguring one room so we could use it for group Breakfast, Dinner etc. 
The Motel is very very clean, and the owners did everything they could to make our stay enjoyable. Thanks so much to Wayne and Debbie.  
The Students of STUDIO 246 (and their Teachers and Mums!!)

title: Excellent, clean and well-equiped place
text:
The hosts were friendly and helpful, and this was one of the best motels we have stayed in since we moved to NZ 2 years ago....and we have travelled about quite a lot!
The location was good, near to city centre, large supermarket and not forgetting the Speights ale pub, a couple of minutes walk away. We would definitely stay here again if in the area and would recommend to friends etc.

title: Neat & Tidy Place
text: BK Settlers is the place to stay in Hamilton. Wayne & Debbie are great hosts and make everyone feel welcome. The rooms are clean and we enjoyed the spa. The place is close too all major attractions and shopping. Wish we could stay longer.

title: Beautiful Hosts & Motel
text: After a long drive from Masterton with the family, you can imagine their delight at saying we would stay the night in Hamilton. We hadn't planned anything so thought we would just take a stab and pick one based on Trip Advisor's feedback from other guests. I can absolutely agree with others that Debbie & Wayne were both very accommodating and welcoming on our arrival even throwing in an extra roll away bed for our rather large teenager daughters. The rooms are very clean, new and well maintained. Looking forward to our next to our next stay this time with all the kids (all 4 of them)

title: Awesome stay!
text: Enjoyed a one night stay after traveling from Tauranga to Hamilton to watch the Chiefs take on the Blues.  The motel was extremely clean and quiet. Received warm hospitality from the owners. Would definitely stay here again!

title: great stay
text: The motel owner were very friendly, the room were extremely clean, very quiet motel, 200% will recommend to all my family and friends, i personally will definitely visit again!

title: So Welcoming!
text:
From the moment we arrived we felt at home. The lady on reception was so welcoming, and made sure we were well looked after.  The unit was gorgeous, lovely decor, the most relaxing spa, and toiletries provided.  I cannot fault this establishment, I felt so rested after a lovely spa and an extremely comfortable bed.  Breakfast was very good, and I particularly enjoyed a fresh plunger coffee! We felt ready for our drive back to Wellington, which was an advantage to have had such a lovely stay. Thank you so much BK's I absolutely recommend this Motor Lodge.  
1

title: A very pleasant stay
text: We enjoyed a very pleasant stay for three nights. The two bedroom unit was very well equipped clean, & very quiet. Debbie & Wayne, the owners, were so lovely, kind & helpful. They made our stay very enjoyable. Would recommend staying here

title: Fantastic!
text:
Villa style lodge. Located near the Hamilton main strip of restaurants (about 5-7min drive & 30min easy walk). Although near a main road, we didn't hear any traffic noise. Plenty of complimentary parking for guests. 

The owner Debbie was fabulous! Greeting us with a genuine smile & helpful with the local area ... even though she was busy at the time we arrived!

As soon as I opened the door to the room I loved it. It had a warm, modern, clean and welcoming feel to it. Compact yet not too small. Two seater lounge & small glass topped table in 'living' area. Self contained modern kitchenette. Modern and good sized bathroom. And the best part was the bed! We'd been travelling for days & had slept on horrible beds & pillows....this was such a pleasant & welcomed surprise! Bed & pillows were so very comfortable!!

I loved it and would definitely recommend staying here. I would definitely stay again!

title: grab one experience
text:
Last week I bought a stay at this motel  from grab one and used it the very next day .
It was the first time the owners had listed with grab one and so they were a bit nervous about this.
They are new owners and are so friendly and helpful.Debbie showed us through and gave us a bottle of wine and breakfast menu .
Rooms are lovely and clean, and for a studio room it was fantastic with table and chairs plus 2 armchairs . Lovely spa bath . 
What also impressed me was the recycling .
and Debbie says she wants to have one room set aside and the money from this will go to  a charity. A lot of owners/ managers  do this ,but the money from the room goes as perks for themselves .
Debbie and Wayne are such friendly and welcoming hosts and I do hope they stay here for years to come
we will definitely be back .

title: Really nice! Muito bom!
text: Really nice place to stay, very organized and the owners are really nice. Near of the supermarket and you can cook in you room. I really love to stay there! I would recommend for the price, organization and facilities.

title: Best ever
text: We stayed recently for 2 nights. Awesome room and amazingly quiet considering it is close to a main road. Had a great spa bath and the shower was wonderful.The shower head is adjustable so a tall person can also fit under it! Comfy bed was so welcome. We had recently done a road trip around lower North Island and this was the best motel by far. Amazing friendly owners make you feel right at home. Well done Wayne and Debbie

title: Fantastic Place To Stay..
text: On enquiring about a room, I was so impressed with the welcoming and friendliness of the new owners, Wayne and Debbie, I knew right then this was the motel for me to spend my duration of 4 weeks.They made my stay so comfortable was like home away from home , room was so clean and comfy and daily serviced and they always went that extra mile to make me feel at home. I have    travelled and stayed in many motels home and abroad , never have I found one as clean, so friendly, and accomodating..Will highly recommend this to anyone I know that is looking for accommodation in Hamilton.. 100/100 Wayne and Debbie. THANK YOU.   And all the best for further improvements that you are intending to do. I'll BE BACK....

title: Genuine, Comfortable and Welcoming
text: This luxury establishment has been revitalized by the new and improved owners. This team knows there customers and treats everyone with a unique kindness and experience you need to see to believe. There are renovations happening to upgrade the Settlers Motor Lodge and I can't wait to travel back there again.

title: Great Place to Stay!
text: We stayed there for a couples getaway for the weekend. The room was incredible with such a great rate too! The managers (who are new) were really friendly and super nice! Although I wish there was an air-con in the room, I really enjoyed our time there!

title: Absolutely Amazed!
text: There seems to be a little bit of chaos as the managers have only just taken over and were left with what looked like a lot of confusion, however Wayne and his wife explained the situation and dealt with it is a very calm and professional manner. We received a warm greeting on arrival and were shown to our lovely spacious room which was clean and tidy. We loved our stay there and wouldn't mind returning for another holiday!

title: Good choice for Hamilton
text: Ulster road/street is full of motels so how do you choose? BK Settlers is one of the nearest to shops and restaurants, good price, really nicely furnished and has just been taken over by very enthusiastic and friendly owners.  Plus the Helm bar (behind Subway) is a pleasant place to sit and enjoy a good meal and it's just 5 mins walk from this motel.

title: HAMILTONS BEST ACCOMODATION EVER!!
text: My friend and I just stayed there this weekend and i tell you from the moment we got there we were pleased to see such a well presented building... then came the customer service of two most amazing people i've ever met in my life a couple who have just started to run the place (the new owners as of monday) and they made my stay just that 10 times better with their polite manner of speech to them going out of their way to make sure we were comfortable and had everything sorted including activities around the place, pretty much told a tourist what they need to know. Really friendly and helpful of them both. I was overwelmed with my stay here. one night and i didnt even want to leave. Thank you so much to the new owners and your immaculate place and amazing service 10/10 best motel and service ive ever had a memorable experience one i will cherish forever and i will definately come back and put the word out to all my family and friends that if their in hamilton this is the place to be!!! love and regards from ruth faui'i and i (yovonn maharaj)

title: Thought I had made a mistake
text: On arrival reception was total confusion. Couldn't find our room on the computer, there was no door card and was told not able to pay by credit card. BUT WAIT !!!!!! We then found out the new owners had to come in early and were trying to sort out what was going on with bookings, accounts etc so the eftpos was shutdown on them over the holidays. Once they explained that we got our room, which was a 2 bedroom apartment, we found everything to be clean and tidy. We wish Wayne & Debbie all the best with the motel and believe they will make it a very enjoyable place to stay.

title: Simple and casual stay, free parking
text:
The room was nice and tidy. It has everything for simple cooking including stove, microwave, fridge and all the dishwater. Free parking is available right next to the door.
Cons:
1. The blanket case had some dirt on it.
2. WiFi cost $5 for 500MB, which was a disappointment as Hotels.com advertised that it has to be free of charge in rooms. And even for the money, the signal wasn't stable. Sometimes I needed to go on the street to get the bars again.

title: Good value for money
text: A friend and i stayed here recently, we booked a 2 bedroom unit which was only $124, while the room wasnt "luxury" it was definitely spacious, with 2 toilets, mini kitchen etc. the carpark is tight and i can imagine it would be a nightmare on a busy weekend but luckily we had no issues. The attention to detail in the rooms could be better, the curtains held up by wire and half the amount of plastic clips in one bedroom, smoked cigarettes in the ash tray on the balcony in the other room, my bed had a huge dip on the mattress which i kept rolling into, but overall it was a pleasant stay and the lady in the office was very helpful. I would stay here again, especially if you want  a bit more space than a studio would provide for the price.

title: clean, quiet, convenient
text: we stayed just one night and found the unit very clean, comfortable (except for the oversized pillows, but this can easily be sorted to suit) and quiet.  despite being fully booked, we didn't hear any road noise or people in neighbouring rooms.  well supplied kitchen, friendly staff, great location to downtown, would stay here again.

title: Great stay
text: Good sized unit for 5 adults and a baby.  2 bedroomed unit was perfect.  Clean and no noisy considering its on a busy road.  Would have loved free wifi but its not important. Not enough kitchen bench space to use with having 5 adults to prepare food for.

title: Comfortable stopover
text:
I needed somewhere to stop over in Hamilton at short notice as I incurred car troubles and needed repairs at a garage before I could make my journey home to Auckland. I wanted somewhere cost effective and comfortable to stay.
For a good price I was given a ground level studio unit with spa bath. It was nice to enjoy a soak in the evening.
The room had upgraded furniture - 2 x leather-like armchairs, nice neutral bedding with modern coffee coloured feather down quilt, a flat screen TV, small heat pump which worked brilliantly to take the chill off the room in the early morning. Fan and heat lights in the bathroom. All the windows had security latches on them so it felt safe and secure.
The Owners/Managers have obviously taken on board previous feedback re the condition of the furniture and have acted on that. There was still the odd quirky decorative item such as an old lamp on the dining table. An unnecessary item if you wanted to modernize further.  
The larger units which I believe are 2 story with a balcony on the 2nd level looked nice. The balconies were a lovely suntrap.
I would rate 3.5, as there is no half mark option I rounded up to 4 for the commitment to improving guest stay.

title: Quiet and comfortable
text:
First impressions were not good as when we arrive the receptionist was on the phone and after standing at the counter for at least five minutes she told us the room number and said she would bring a key later. The key did not appear and when I went back over an hour later two people were behind the counter, one on the phone and one rifling through drawers. Both ignored me. Eventually the one on the phone spoke and said there was still no key available and to come back later than night.Not a warm welcome by any means.
The second day we came back from being away for the day and found our key did not open the door and our room had not been serviced. Had to go back to reception to get key changed before we could get into our room.  The cleaner rushed in at the same time as us and quickly picked up dirty towels and gave us some coffee sachets and left.
 When we checked out the person did not know how much we had been quoted for the room so made a guess!
Room was very small, bed was very comfortable, spa bath was not that good, no comfortable way to lie in it. Advertising said recliner chairs but there was only one chair in the room. Very little road noise, off street parking and clean units.

title: room for improvement
text: Well it all started with the check in. I was part of a group booking for business. The large unit that  had been allocated to me, on arrival had been given to some one else. She found me a smaller room and then only had me booked in for two nights instead of three. I had to request breakfast and that was a waste of time. She produced a form to select from. Who knows why, as delivered to the room was nothing like what I had requested. The second morning had to set off for the day minus breakfast as none was delivered. Parking was painful with a large vehicle as reception canopy to low. The room it self appeared clean and tidy although house keeping should pay better attention to what is working and what is not in the room. Owner appears to try very hard but maybe needs more staff and a better booking system. Traffic noise very noticeable and rooms could do with double glazing. Often stay in Hamilton so hopefully somewhere better next time.

title: A good place to stay
text:
We booked through Booking.com. Good price. When we got their lady upgraded us which was nice to a room with spa bath. A bit limited on Wifi. but not a big deal. parking was a bit tight.
Will stay here again.
hotel_response: Thank you for your positive comments. Sorry that parking was not all you wished for, but the Motel was originally designed to get maximum accommodation space on an city lot. Thanks again for taking the time to give me your feed back.

title: Great Stay
text:
A most enjoyable 2 night stay. The owner was very helpful and pleasant with the units in top condition. The unit was very clean and of a good size.
Simply, we have no hesitation in recommending this motel and would certainly stay again.
hotel_response: I really appreciate you taking the time to write a review and to receive such positive comments. My team will be very pleased as well. Thanks again

title: Fab service and prime location
text: Thank you for our stay.  It was very clear to us that you have taken on previous comments and made changes accordingly.  All of our furniture was very clean and comfortable.  Thank you for taking the time to ring ahead to the zoo for us to make sure our visit there was possible.  Top marks for the cleanliness of your rooms and your personable service was appreciated.
hotel_response: Many thanks for taking the time to post a review. I will pass on to my staff your comments. I appreciate that my Teams efforts to continue to improve the Motel are well received. I hope you enjoyed your trip to Hamilton Zoo, an often hidden treasure in Hamilton - Thanks again.

title: Very friendly
text: We came late at night, were exhausted from long driving hours and bad motel experience in Wellington (because of the Seven). The BK's Settlers Motor Lodge owners were very friendly and offered us an excellent and generous deal. We had a calm and comfortable night. Settings and close-by restaurants very good.
hotel_response: Many thanks Catherine for taking the time to place feedback. I am glad you enjoyed your stay and welcome you back in the future. I have some exciting plans to further improve BK Settlers and hope to see you again.

title: Welcoming and friendly
text: Comfortable but only two comfortable chairs in the sitting area and they could have done with a clean. We were a family group of four. It would gave been nice to have sofa to sit at before going out for a meal.
hotel_response: Hi. Thank you for your feedback. I have taken on board your suggestions. Every unit has had the furniture steam cleaned and all the chairs are really nice and clean. I have bought some two seater settees for some units and would appreciate feedback as to what our customers think of them.

title: owners are wonderful
text: The lodge was very cozy and clean. The owner's here are incredibly nice. I was backpacking through and she gave me a ride to the store and the bus station the next day. If I am ever in Hamilton again, I would stay there. Thanks!
hotel_response: Thank you for taking your time to place feedback. Of course we would like to see you at our Motel should you be in Hamilton again.

title: Probably could do better elsewhere
text: We picked this motel as the exterior looked welcoming and well-kept.  The lady on reception was helpful but once inside the motel, we found it only very average and would not recommend it.  The bathroom was clean, but the place was let down by shabby and stained seating in a shade of dated pink, and which should be consigned to the rubbish heap.  There was only one armchair, which was strange, as there was a double bed so the room was clearly for two people, but in any case, it was dirty so I did not fancy putting anything on it or using it.
hotel_response: Hi. Thanks for the feedback. The furniture has all been professionally steam cleaned and is back to the standard I wish to maintain. I have bought some two seater settees for the larger units and have had positive comments about them. I would love to have the chance to show you the changes should you be in Hamilton again.

title: Unpleasant smells
text:
the smell in the room from prevous cooking and generally smelt of old socks. lounge furniture old dirty and tired. toilet set needs to be replaced as well as shower head. tv in bedroom too small.
Very disappointed in the standard of this motel, would not stay here again
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to place feedback. The furniture is now up to the standard I wish to maintain, having been professionally steam cleaned. I am sorry about the smells you encountered, I have made an extra effort to keep an eye on how my units are freshened up by my staff. I would be happy to show you through my Motel, I am sure you will see a big difference.

title: STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!!
text:
We booked a one bedroom unit for a long stay (2-3 weeks) for business. All went well with booking, checking in, etc. until the 4th night when the lady owner barged into our unit while we were preparing dinner, and told us that we had to move into another unit the next morning as her husband had apparently double booked our unit! (We had agreed previously to move for one night due to a rugby match later on in the week),

When we questioned why we were not made aware of this much earlier, she claimed that she had been sick and her husband was incompetent at managing the bookings. We then asked how is this our problem, she shrugged it off again and repeated that her husband didn't know what was going on. (We had no idea who she was until this point, she could have easily been someone off the street. That was how poor her overall demeanour was!) - there was a lot of finger pointing and threating/intimidating behaviour from her during the whole discussion. Finally, to add insult to injury, before she left, she said she would be fine if we wanted to leave, as there is a lot of business for the weekend due to the rugby.

We decided to check out that evening and at check out, the husband told us that the room bookings were all sorted, and we actually didn't have to move after all! Again no apologies made and no explanation, just another example of the shoddy management and very poor customer service!

We have stayed in other BKs in NZ, and have always had good customer service. Unfortunately this one fell way short of the mark. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!!
hotel_response: Hi, I am sorry to hear of your poor experiences. The Motel is under new management now. I have invested in new booking systems and hope, that should you wish to visit my Motel, you would see big changes to the level of professionalism and overall service focus.

title: didnt compare with other 4 star motels we stayed in
text: We were disappointed at this motel as it didn't match up to other 4 star motels we stayed in whilst visiting nz. It was clean and tidy, but downstairs really small and the lazy boy chairs were grubby and one was burst. The beds were really comfy and staff friendly.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking time to place feedback. I agree about the state of the furniture and one of the first things I undertook was to get the furniture professionally steam cleaned. The Motel is now under new ownership and is back up to a good 4* standard with further exciting changes in the pipeline.

title: Two Storey Living
text:
We stayed four nights here having decided to stay in Hamilton longer.
Staff were friendly and helpful.
Our accommodation was two storey, which included a downstairs kitchen, lounge and bathroom with toilet. Upstairs included two bedrooms and a second toilet, which is handy when traveling with teenage kids.
Downstairs kitchen and lounge area is small although adequate, beds were comfortable.
Some sounds relating to two storey living could be heard around us, although these weren't excessive and didn't stop us from sleeping well.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to place feedback. I am pleased that you had a good experience at BK Settlers Motor Lodge. I am sure that since I have taken over, the positives you talk about have been built on. The place is in the process of being upgraded and we would love to see you back and to share in the changes being made.

title: What a gem!
text:
Beautiful, well-appointed, studio which was perfect for my husband and I while visiting Lake Karapiro. 
Gavin and Judy are lovely hosts.
The room is spotless and equipped with everything you could possibly need. 
We highly recommend Hydro Road. We've stayed all over New Zealand and this was one of our favourites.

title: Nice Accommodation
text:
Ramada Hamilton 
Very nice for the price.
Great location in the heart of the Hamilton CBD

title: Gulag
text: A truely depressing experience - would not stay again unless sentenced there

title: Nice n cosy
text: Will cum again  with all the famz

title: Good stay
text: Good stay and very convenient to town life. Worth value for money if you include breakfast buffet. Great staff as well..

title: Dirty hotel
text:
Absolutely terrible hotel
Dirty room. Nobody on reception when I went to enquire about the tv not working. 
Do not stay here…thankfully we were only here for one night passing through., couldn’t wait to check out. This hotel doesn’t even deserve 1 star

title: Good value
text: Good value. Basic but clean room.

title: Good, clean room with comfortable double beds
text: My cousin and I stayed at Ramada by Wyndham Hamilton City Center, as our previously organised accommodation was not cleaned after their last guest. However, we were both happy that it did fall through, as from the service to the cleanliness of the room,  it was definitely value for money. The room was not only clean, but so spacious and both beds were very comfortable. The bathroom was also clean and a good size.  The hotel is centrally located, with shops and restaurants a walk away. Overall, we had a pretty good experience, but I would like to mention, that there needs to be signs with directions from carpark to the elevator as we initially had no idea how to access the lifts and we ended up just following other guests from the hotel. Thank you.

title: Pretty rubbish.
text: Pretty rubbish. Birds flying around inside. Food(?) spilled on carpets between reception and room. Walls scuffed and scratched. Overwhelming smell of old cigarettes. We checked out within 10 minutes of seeing the room and went and stayed at a BNB in the country side which was way better for half the price. It was twice as much as our regular stay in Townsville and twice as worse. Upon handing in our card we were told we would get a refund for the room but haven't gotten anything yet and we are unable to contact them about it.

title: Staycation
text: Excellent location, very handy to everything being right in the middle of the city. Cute room, value for money, very clean and the beds were sooo comfortable. Will definitely stay again

title: Lipstick on a pig...
text:
Overpriced, clumsy, and cramped studio(room).
Room too light at night. Wifi slow. Parking too pricey. Air con leaked water onto floor.
Good location and friendly staff, but a classic lipstick on a pig building.

title: Great Value for money
text: Close to restaurants and bars, friendly staff. Great value for money. Room and bathroom were spacious with small outdoor courtyard

title: Tired, and run down.
text: Friendly reception staff, but despite my room being paid by a conference organiser, I was asked to pay on arrival also (I refused). I was given a cold room with the air conditioning on, but no remote to turn it off. Instead was given a small plug in heater. It was an uncomfortable noisy night. The kitchen did not communicate with the reception, again I was asked to pay (another 2x). They gave me a remote for the AC the next day......... after I complained again. The room was dusty, run down and old. The liquid soap (for everything!) was harsh on my skin. the breakfast buffet sux if you are vegetarian. I would not go back, even for free!

title: Wouldn’t recommend
text: Hi there, thank you for letting me stay overnight, the check in process was smooth and beds were comfortable. Unfortunately, the smell from the shower drain was malodorous which filled up the room. This was an unpleasant smell to walk into every time. The heater blew only cool air despite the high temperature settings. The ironing board was almost falling apart. When I needed to carry my heavy bags down from the room, the lift stopped working so this was a slight inconvenience. Overall, the interior is quite old and the experience was unfortunately not worth the price.

title: A hotel to regret and forget.
text:
I'm not one to write negative reviews, but my stay at the Ramada Wyndham in Hamilton was so disappointing that I felt compelled to share my experience. Firstly, the positives were the hot shower with good pressure and the breakfast, which was a decent price. 

Beyond that, I only have negative opinions of this place. The hotel was atrocious. Upon arrival, we were left waiting as the receptionist who noticed us arrive disappeared out into some office, leaving a "back in 5 minutes" sign. He arrived 10 minutes later. It's not a good start. 

The cleanliness of the room and hotel in general was revolting, the paintwork was shoddy, and the entire establishment felt incredibly outdated. The room had a strong musty smell. There were many stains or areas that hadn't been cleaned in months/years , so I was worried to go to sleep  for fear of what insects may appear.

The view from the room was of a roof with air-conditioning units (there was no mention of this in the booking listing). The room itself had only one bedside lamp, which itself was broken. There was a TV in the less than inviting lounge area but no TV in the bedroom, so you couldn't lie in bed and watch a movie. The furniture was a mismatched collection, and the lack of shampoo and conditioner was a minor but telling detail. 

I ended up cancelling my second night's stay and going somewhere else. I've stayed in cleaner backpackers' accommodation that were cheaper. The fact that previous reviews have mentioned the same issues that I have shows the management obviously doesn't care to change the situation. DO NOT BOOK HERE.

title: False Advertising
text:
Bed is low and tiny. Not like in photos
Bathroom was dirty and stained. I refused to Use shower. Carpets are dirty and stained. Rabbit warren to get from
Parking to your room. Bad layout. Smelled like toilet in hallways. Not much or any parking onsite. Will never stay here again. A back packers would have been a better choice. So disappointing. Thinest pillows iv ever slept on.  Bedding had pubes and hair on it as well as stains. Not worth $240 a night! Soap dispensers dirty and brown. Table in room kiddy sized. Not sure if i booked into a little people hotel but this is literally how it feels.  Tint horrible room.

I don’t like leaving bad feedback but it seems that this is a recurrent problem that hasn’t been addressed despite the feedback. It is not hard to clean an old hotel well. Give it a good scrub with jif and that would help. I will not be staying here again.

title: Dated & Missing Finer Details
text:
Wasn’t impressed from the moment I got to this hotel. Have previously stayed in the Sudima in Auckland so was expecting on par with that, but was sadly disappointed. 

The hotel is missing finer details that one would expect from a 4-star hotel.

- Cigarette Smell
The first room I checked into smelt like cigarette smoke in the bathroom, because I checked in late though & was ready for bed, I quickly setup and got into bed with the bathroom door closed. In the morning when I opened the door, the cigarette smell filled the room - I asked to change rooms. They were accommodating to my request after they came into my current room and smelt it. 

The second room had no smell, so was much better.

- Odd Bits and Pieces 
The rooms didn’t have matching glasses. Which sounds like nit picky feedback, but they also had odd forks/knives/spoon sets and cups and saucers. It made the room feel like a poorly serviced motel. 

- Bathroom Mould 
There is significant mould around the shower boxes. This was not the standard I was expecting, however the bathroom looked tired and rumpty, so it could be mould that has come with age. 

Overall I was not impressed and won’t be staying here again. I had originally intended on staying at the Ibis across the road, but needed a 2 bedroom apartment, plans changed again and I no longer needed the 2 bedroom apartment but thought I’d take a twin studio for convenience of the booking. I did not expect this and spent my entire trip regretting that decision.

We are a fully non smoking Hotel but unfortunately this is not always adhered to. I am glad we could change your room and subsequently eradicate the odours. The various Housekeeping issues have been addressed with our Team for the future convenience of our Guests.

Regards,
Mike Eccles
Hotel Manager

The bathroom was clean and modern. The heat pump worked well, though some appliance (possibly the fridge) made a humming, breathing noise all night. The hotel is located in the centre of town near heaps of restaurants and bars, which is convenient, but it also means listening to drunken students and townies at all hours of the night. We were tired and slept, anyway, after an excellent meal at the steakhouse across the street. Parking was reasonable ($10) and breakfast was included in our deal. A short stroll across the street brought us to Metropolis, where we ate hearty cooked breakfasts in a funky little cafe. It's too bad others have had less-than-stellar stays, but I can't fault the staff or our room (303) at Sudima Hamilton. Our experience was very pleasant.

Well I bought my 2 young girls down for the hot air balloons, we have really been looking forward to this trip. We don't get to go away that often so it was meant to be a real treat staying in a hotel.
Upon arrival I was pleased to see plenty of car parks, not so pleased when I discovered I'd have to pay to use them. Even in Auckland where car parks are like gold, you get one included with your accommodation. Anyway, I looked past this and after a long week & drive in peak traffic all I wanted was to get to the room and freshen up. So the room was very spacious, I was quite surprised however that's where anything vaguely positive came to a grinding halt!! 
everything was tired looking or dirty. 
I kept my thoughts to myself as I did not want to ruin anything for my kids however, I noticed my 9 year old wearing her jandals in the shower!! She had noticed how dirty it was and taken it upon herself. There was hair stuck to the little screws in the shower, the door wouldn't shut properly & half the fitting was missing... that's just the shower! The toilet has an annoying CONSTANT drip, the overhead vent in the bedroom is so loud (& automatic so no way to turning it off) that even my kids couldn't sleep so despite paying for a 2 bedroom apartment, we ended up all having to bunk down in the one room & share beds! These kids will usually sleep through anything so you can imagine the volume of this thing. We also had a room which was right next to the vent from the Chinese restaurant downstairs so had that noise to contend with until 11pm.
The apartment was generally grubby. The kitchen bench very dirty, no sparkle to the stainless steel and needed a good scrub round the taps and hobs as did the lino floor.
I was disappointed we had to pay upfront for 2 nights as I would have cut our loses and gone home a day early. 
The only positive thing this place has going for it is it's location- if you just want a bed & access to Victoria St and don't have a car and aren't spending too much time in the room then this place would be suitable BUT pack your jandals for the shower!
Will not be returning and if Hamilton Sudima is like this then I assume the other ones are too. Avoid!
Over priced and under delivered!

When she came back down she replied surprised with "it's almost near clean up there". We smiled, and she gave our "bond" back. Luckily this didn't ruin our day.

title: Location is great, but the room was lacking in a lot of ways
text:
I'll start with the good points: the location is great and central, and the reception staff are excellent. The rest was either average or not too great, unfortunately. I know this can't be helped but if you arrive with a car, the journey to reception is incredibly convoluted and confusing. You have to wind through corridors (some a bit creepy), go up a lift, and then down another. Also our room, 102, was in I believe the very old part of the hotel, and in my opinion it's in need of an update. There were two different colours of paint on the wall, the paint was peeling off the ceiling in the bathroom, there wasn't even a toilet roll holder (the toilet paper sat on the back of the toilet), there was no desk, no microwave, and the heat pump was old, ineffective, and incredibly loud. The bed also wasn't the most comfortable, and because the sheets aren't fitted well to the bed, you end up having to fix them constantly or sleep on the mattress. The internet, while free, was absolutely horrendous, and I would honestly rather have paid for useful internet. It's possible this problem was because of the room we were in though, as we noticed the room was located directly in between two routers, and the connection had the exact same name for both. Finally, while a view isn't needed, it was a bit odd to be looking at a bunch of outdoor units for heat pumps, and there were loud noises from the area throughout the night, not to mention from other rooms as the walls are incredibly thin.

In summary, staying here did the trick, and we really enjoyed the location, but I probably wouldn't stay here again unless I could be guaranteed a room in the newer part (I can't speak to how nice or not nice those rooms are).

title: Disappointing
text:
I booked this hotel because of its location.  I knew that it was a 3-star hotel and did not expect all the bells and whistles of a higher-level hotel, but I still found it seriously lacking.  After parking in the underground carpark, I pulled three wheeled bags down endless tatty corridors and up and down two lifts to get to the reception.  When I pointed out that it would have been handy to have a trolley available (there was one at reception), I got the reply that it used to be two hotels.  Not sure of the logic there!
The gentleman on reception was friendly and went out of his way to be helpful.  So much so that I didn't really feel like pointing out that most women (particularly businesswomen) find it incredibly patronising to be addressed as 'dear'.
The first room I was shown to was dark (one light not working) and there was a very loud, repetitive noise similar to a wall being drilled.  When I phoned the reception, the gentleman helpfully moved me to another room.  I pointed out that it didn't have any table at all and I would have difficulty working, he brought me a small table and chair.  Not desk-height, but still relatively useful.  The room was spacious and clean and so was the bathroom.  However, the bedding was cheap and didn't fit properly, the couch faced away from the TV and the hairdryer didn't work.  
Basically, all the staff I encountered were friendly and helpful and the location is great.  However, I would not consider staying here again.

title: I do expect more from the Sudima brand
text:
I have stayed at various Sudima branches and usually find it is a good brand.   This one is located in an old building that I think is actually the Historic ‘Commercial Hotel' where Cobb and Co once was in downstairs.     

There was a football match in town, the Novotel, Ibis, and even Oaks across the road were all full.. we hadn’t booked, so we were thankful to get what I think was Hamilton city's last half-decent room in the main street.    The reception was okay and the solo staff was friendly and helpful.   We took the lift and that really showed off the buildings age.  We went along corridors that raised and dropped in height, I think we were actually walking between old joining buildings.

The room was an ‘Apartment’ and very bland.    The room was on the main street and very noisy all night.  Football hooligans running rampage until early hours…  in the morning you could smell the urine all over the street.   The homeless people hanging around the front of the hotel were hardly decorative, at least they did not engage us, so un-harmful.   Hamilton to me, a town I grew up in and left… has gone to the dumps in my opinion, other than the Casino and Novotel made it feel like it has slightly progressed.

I do expect more from the Sudima brand and wonder why they didn’t occupy a new building or build one like Novotel did.   I think this branch did some damage to our perception of their brand, as our next stop Rotorua, we drove right past the Sudima branch there that looked much nicer, but we were just not interested.

Of course being a Level 6 Contributor with a leading number of 'Helpful' votes (Now called Thumb’s up) …you might imagine I put a lot of time into helping fellow travelers by writing detailed and honest reviews.    I get paid nothing.. No rewards, No discounted accommodation, No points…  nothing, just a mouse click from you.    So if anything in the review is useful please let me know by clicking me a ‘Thumbs Up to keep me going’…. thanks!

View onto brick wall and plumbing pipes.  Bathrooms clean but linen needs updating - doonas very thin, mattresses too soft.  Airconditioning very noisy so had to be shut off at night and use extra blankets. title: stay anywhere BUT here
text: From the moment I arrived, I thought I must have arrived in Faulty Towers. the carpark is out the back and NOT well lit, there is a doorway in the carpark (if you can find it), that is suppose to lead you to a elevator and I was not told of it and ended up walking on the main street up to reception with my luggage.
