Hotel Manager

title: Ok for short stay
text:
Over all an ok stay. Room seemed smaller than I imagined/ shown in pictures online but was modern. Bed was nice to sleep in. Flat screen TV with all free to air channels plus some sky channels. Tea/coffee facilities. In room safe, iron. We booked the couples package which included a bottle of bubbles and chocolates which was all ready in the room when we got there. Also included a free Carpark - was a bit of a walk though and is first come first served.

Bathroom was nice. Modern facilities. No bath. 

The hotel itself is pretty dated and lay out is all over the place. Seems it may have been different buildings they have all put into one - rooms make up for I guess. 

We stayed on a Saturday night but were woken at about midnight by other patrons that had obviously had a good night out and made noise for almost 2 hours (loud music, laughing, talking). Rooms are not sound proof so sounded like they were right outside the door. Tried calling reception several times but they didn't answer. Lucky I brought ear plugs. 

Other than the noise issues it was a pleasant stay. 

Would not recommend staying on a Friday or Saturday night in a superior room as they are so close together - maybe a apartment room? Recommend short stay only.

title: Central Convenience
text: We just wanted somewhere in central Hamilton - and the Sudima hit the spot. Reception is just a shop-front, which we missed at first, with the accommodation upstairs. The loading zone outside allowed us to unpack the car before taking it to the hotel car park (extra cost). In Hamilton's main street, there are plenty of restaurants and cafes nearby. Our room was quiet and comfortable. We would come back here again if we are in Hamilton.

title: Stay elsewhere.
text: Shabby, smelly, noisy and very small rooms. Expensive - $199 is a joke. .There is much better accom for what they charge.  Limited parking too. Didn't use my car because I didn't expect to be able to get back in. 200 character s........  ggdd..hfd. I think I've summed it up.
hotel_response: Dear Guest Thank you for your review. I am sorry that the room was not up to your expectations on this occasion. Thank you for your feedback.

title: Lk
text: Very disappointing. The room was unkempt and not very clean; numerous stains on the furniture and carpet. Additionally, had my robe stolen from the room. Wouldn't stay there again. Getting assistance was also difficult because no one monitors the front desk on a regular basis.

title: Not worthy of being a "hotel"
text:
Had to visit Hamilton for work, so figured the wife and I would go and stay the night and catch up with friends.
We picked Sudima because of their good reputation and the deal they were offering.

We should have gone elsewhere....

Cost : Deal was "From" $129 a night - we paid $149.

Parking :  Parking area was awful - funny thing is they usually charge for it (was part of our package), yet they have no way of telling who owns what car etc as they didnt ask for our rego. Couldnt find the "entrance" to the hotel from the car park until we were leaving...
 So if you want free parking in Hamilton for a night out, try the Sudima car park.....

Staff : What staff ? My wife had to call via a phone at reception to get someone to check us in, and then the same when checking out - appears they only hire one staff member and he was upstairs each time so we had to wait until he ran down to assist. Seriously saw no other staff at any stage.

Room : Clean and modern looking. Comfortable bed, but way over sized cabinet in the room dominating it. Blinds on windows were useless as during daylight you couldnt see the TV due to reflections, and at night they allowed way too much light in from the building next door. Opening the blinds offered us a view of a bird poo covered wall and windows of the building next door. I know you dont goto a hotel for the view.... but yeah.
Not much can be done I guess for the view , but maybe replace the blinds with blackout curtains or something instead. The "kitchen" (yes, in a hotel) consisted of the usual coffee options and..... that was it. The fridge was a tiny little thing sitting on the floor (not your usual style bar fridge) and all that was in it was the wine that was part of our package, and little packets of milk. No mini bar, snacks, nothing.

Then my wife noticed that there was an extractor fan unit above the bench - but no cooktop. So why have the extractor fan system... upon inspection I found the extractor didnt even have an outlet so all you'd be doing is pumping the air back into the room.  Did find a portable electric cooktop in a cupboard... but being a hotel, this isnt normal, is it ? 
There was a hole in the wall behind the door, obviously made by someone swinging the door open too hard - dosent look like its the first time its happened too going by the plaster and paint job....

Bathroom was nice looking and modern, shower leaked a little onto the floor.

One thing that did concern us, was the lack of attention by house cleaning, to the glasses on the bench. One had lipstick on it from previous guests.

Sudima Hamilton to us felt more like a backpackers trying to be a hotel, just too many things that didnt match up or reflect a hotel service. For the price we were expecting a bit more....  wasnt even any sort of room service offered and the "bar" appeared to be unmanned. Probably due to the single staff member having to run around doing everything...

Upon checkout, the staff member didnt even ask how our stay was.... think he knew better than to ask.
hotel_response:
Dear Guest
Thank you for your review and the feedback that it contains. I am sorry that we did not meet your expectations on this occasion, in particular as far as the issues you encountered with your room. We have shared these with our maintenance and housekeeping teams here as these are most certainly not up to our usual standard. Thank you again for making us aware of these issues.

title: Not that great...
text:
Hard to find (signage was horrible), parking was sketchy and confusing (you mean I have to drive through an alley with an open door and a (possibly) homeless (looking) guy sitting outside the doors?...) plus it was a maze trying to get to the parkade (through the elevator one way, walk a bit to another elevator, though a hall way by a chinese restaurant with a huge box of cabbage...)

When we got into our room, it was horribly hot, and we didn't know the thingy above the bed was an AC unit... thought it was a heater. Once we found out it was an AC, it helped a bit, but the AC was quite loud...

We tried going for a walk at night; this seemed pretty sketch to us. Lots of drunks out, some homeless looking people. Dark streets. Not much open. We grabbed an ice cream treat and headed back to figure out the AC in the room and watch TV. At least the bathroom was nice...
hotel_response:
Dear Guest
Thank you for your review. I am sorry that you felt that your stay did not provide you with value for money on this occasion.

title: Great stay
text: Was a great comfortable stay, sfaff was kind, good service and nice decor, definately will come back, it was really a memorable stay here at sudima hotel, everything was managed very well, good work sudima keep it up, will definately recommend others.
hotel_response: Dear Guest Thank you for your review. I am pleased that you enjoyed your stay and in particular the service provided by our team here.

title: Indian faulty towers
text: Stayed there in January, large generous rooms, unfortunately our stay was peppered with some misadventure, a night duty manager (Indian) that didn't really know how anything worked, a day manager that was very helpful (Indian) and a cleaning lady (Indian) that seemed unable to speak English. I did not see any non - Indian staff.  And then they charged us for parking.
hotel_response: Dear Guest ,I am sorry if you felt that our wonderful team was not to your liking,Thank you for your comments about our spacious rooms, yes there is a minimal fee applicable for parking mentioned on the hotel website .thank you for taking the time to share your experience.

title: Good location, clean spacious rooms with AC
text: The staff kindly let me check-in early, the room had good facilities, bed was comfortable. Had AC and good size TV. Shops/cafes/restaurants close by, free on-site parking. 15mins free WIFI p/day. Room deco is dated, but ok.
hotel_response: Dear Guest Thank you for your review, we are pleased that you enjoyed your stay with us.

title: Centrally located and recently refurbished
text:
The lobby is the star of the show here, with a sparkling back wall taking centre stage.

Situated right in the centre of town, this hotel is larger than it looks from the front door. 

The service from Iho at front desk was exceptional. My car was whisked away to the carpark and my luggage delivered to my room. There is short term parking in front for check-in.

I stayed up on the 3rd floor and the room was basic and compact but comfortable. The bed, towels and toiletries were very good. The pillows and shower okay.

The room had a (loud) fridge, kettle and coffee & tea facilities, a work desk and free WIFI.

The continental breakfast was basic, but very kindly started earlier to accommodate my check out.

The service is all here.

title: Sleepless stay at Sudima
text: When we arrived in our apartment it looked spacious and modern.  The room was freezing cold with the air conditioning turned down to 17C but you can excuse that.  The light in the 2nd bedroom (with no windows) would flicker but not come on steadily - thankfully the bed-side lamps worked.  How do they clean that room?  The water taps in the bathroom weren't pressure limited.  This means that it was easy to get a shower when turning on the tap in the basin and almost impossible to regulate the water temperature in the shower.  The clock in the bedroom was unplugged.  While plugging it in I found that the power cable on the one of the bed-side lamps was faulty and the lamp flickered each time I touched the cable.  I unplugged it to minimise the potential fire risk.  After the first night someone plugged this lamp back in but left it switched off.  It seemed that they might have noticed the problem, so why not replace the lamp?  The mattress "clunked" on my side of the bed and I could feel the springs in that area.  However, it wasn't the mattress that kept me awake.  It was the fact that we were 1 level above Hamilton's central nightlife area (who knew?  not us!) and the windows don't block any of the noise that goes on until about 04:00.  As "luck" would have it, we were booked in for Friday and Saturday nights, so we got very little sleep.  On the 2nd night the noise was bad enough that our 5 year old, sleeping in the windowless 2nd room, was woken up at about 04:00.  For reference, there's some sort of street or pavement sweeper that goes through at about 04:00 and again before 07:00.  Someone might want to consider spending a few dollars double-glazing all of the windows facing Victoria Street to allow guests to sleep when the area is in party mode.  The fridge was set so cold that it froze our water, milk and carrots - though we gradually seemed to sort that out over the final 24 hours.  There were knives but no chopping board, a dishwasher but no dishwasher detergent.  We wanted to make toast but there was no toaster and the oven/griller didn't work (though on checkout I was told that the timer needs to be set for the oven to work).  I think that's all the major annoyances.  The good news is that when I explained most of these issues at checkout time they apologised and waived our parking charges.

title: Second visit not so good
text: Stayed here once and really liked it. Was given an upgrade and the room was lovely. Great location in the CBD of Hamilton. Second visit i was given a standard room despite booking an Executive King room and the towels provided were dirty. hmmmm. The staff are friendly just a shame about the cleanliness.
hotel_response: Dear Guest Thank you for your review, I regret that we fell short of your expectations on this occasion and do hope that we may have the opportunity to correct this on your next stay.

title: Well located for Hamilton's cafes and nightlife
text:
The Sudima Hamilton is residence in a historic hotel building which had a freshen up when the Sudima chain took over a few years ago now. Hence the maze of hallways other reviews refer to, small elevator, some brick walls in the corridors, nostalgia & decorative room elements such as shutters. 
All this considered, I was pleasantly pleased with my room, which was a cosy queen studio with ensuite bathroom. It was clean, comfortable with a small but modernised bathroom. It's not plush, flash, luxurious or romantic- but it is simple, budget conscious, & adequate.
I selected to stay here as I was attending a function in Victoria street. 
The Sudmia is perfectly situated for Hamilton's hospitality & nightlife district. The casino is just up the street less than 50 metres; cafes, restaurants, bars & nightclubs. So yes it does get a bit noisey on the weekend & you'll see some characters out on the street late on a Fri or Sat night- as you would in any city.
The front door is locked after a certain time at night. You gain entry showing your key. Reception is 24 hours, so it is secure for guests.
All in all, I would choose somewhere else (like the Novatel) if I was planning a romantic getaway, but I would definitely stay again for events or functions at that end of town. Would also be great for travellers as everything is within easy walking distance. It's convenient.
hotel_response:
Dear Guest
Thank you for your review, I am pleased that you enjoyed your stay with us.

title: Tiny rooms but right in the town center
text:
We had the most Ridiculously small bathroom that had a step into it and the it was near impossible to brush your teeth without knocking your elbows.  Forget rubbing yourself dry after your shower.  Staff were ok but I don't think they were kiwis.  They certainly didn't show the usual kiwi friendliness attitude that we are used too.  There also only appeared to be one person there and they came from a back room when I went to reception.  
I felt this was over priced for the quality of rooms. No one should have to pay for wifi in a hotel.  Specially when most bookings are done via the Internet.

title: Zoo package
text:

The apartment was huge and clean with a full kitchen, two spacious bedrooms and a big lounge. 
This deal was excellent value for money and I have no hesitation recommending it to families.
Super friendly staff and great central location.
We will definitely be back.
hotel_response:

title: Central, comfortable with some interesting characters hanging outside
text:
We stayed on a Saturday night and after parking our car (which is an extra $10) we made our way into the labyrinth of hallways, stairs and lifts in search of our king-size room, 

The room itself was pleasant enough with a big great bed, modern bathroom, flatscreen tv and a working kettle. It was smaller in size than what we expected but it's not like we were in there to do cartwheels or anything.  

It's right in the center of town and with that you may encounter some colourful personalities hanging around outside - some begging for money, others just shouting and one lady singing away for no good reason. Being a Saturday night it was a bit noisy outside and we weren't high enough to not hear the night-time noise. Also, some of the drunken crowd made their way into the hotel and there was shouting to be had outside on out hallway and don't think any effort was made to stop the other noisy guests. 

it was one night, we got some sleep and the shower was pretty good. Ok. May come back.

title: Not overly impressed
text:
Situated on the main street in Hamilton - good location, apart from the undesirables hanging around nearby, heaps of restaurants in the area.
Rarely find anybody at reception, need to call them for them to turn up. Once called, they do turn up promptly.
Unfortuntely the place is like a rabbit warren trying to find your way through the hallways and two separate lifts with little signage to the pokey little room. They have off street parking - at an extra cost.
There is internet available - at an extra cost. 
Room cold - even though aircond set on 28. (Was actually on 32 when I arrived so obviously previous occupants had similar problems.) Tends to start up flat out and really heat the place up then stop for ages when the room gets very cold again.
Breakfast was available - but not in the hotel - had to take a walk down the street to a restaurant. Not open until 7am, too late for me as I need to be at my workplace by 7am.
Went to leave at 7am this morning - front door locked. Nobody on recrption, no way to open the door, there are better places to stay around this central location.

title: Very enjoyable
text: Could not fault this hotel. The duty manager,s were most efficient  and went the extra mile to make our stay just right. Will defiantly stay again when visiting Hamilton again. There was an abundance of good eating establishments very close to this hotel and also very close to the Waikato river for a good early morning walk. Thank you sudima hotel.    Ross &leanne Australia

title: average
text: This hotel serves it's purpose to all those late night party animals at victoria street. A small business hotel,, has it's own parking for extra $ 10. we paid $ 109 for the room , which i reckon is pretty olryt for the quality of room. Moreover, the asian duty manager was of great help. who booked me in at 2 am in morning.

title: New Zealand Holiday
text:
Hotel staff were very friendly and helpful.
We booked a twin room which was very small, the bathroom was very nice.
The car was parked for us and when we left the reception clerk went and got the car for us.
We went to the chinese restaurant next door and got some take away……not very nice so I suggest don't go there.  But that was oohing to do with the hotel.

title: Romance on a Mars Bar
text:
We booked this as a romantic night for two, with the addition of a bottle of bubbles and chocolates.
Parking and reception  where ok and the staff very friendly
Then it all went downhill.
When we booked we had requested a highest floor possible away from the lifts, we where given a lowest floor right next to lift, they did change this when we pointed it out.
The room was ok, but the fridge was growing its own penicillin and was more like a science project. Maybe this was needed as the drains in the bathroom were emitting a very nasty odor. The fridge was cleaned promptly on request.
then the bubbles and chocolates, to complete the romantic package arrived, the bubble fine usual Lindaure didn't expect more so all good, but the chocolates, was two Mars bars, lol, hardly romantic chocolates in either of our books.
Then when we came to go to bed, I can forgive the sheets being a little crinkled but these looked as if they had been slept in and just pulled straight.
Basic hotel not really worth the $140 a night, if it had been under $100 it may have got a better review.
Thankfully the restaurant we went to , see earlier review made up for all of these issues.

title: Last minute work stay
text: Excellent friendly service from the moment we walked in late in the evening to make a last minute booking. The duty manager took care of all our needs. After visiting family we came back to ask if they knew of anywhere to purchase food( very late and a public holiday) the duty manager on was extremely helpful and googled all places near by. Our room was clean and modern, small but fine for what we needed, spacious bathroom with lovely amenities. Air conditioner was stuck on cold and we had to climb up and turn it off not sure why remote wouldn't work. Overall 10/10 for customer service and room and excellent location.

title: Absolutely awful!
text:
This was by far the worst hotel I have EVER stayed at. 

THE SMELL: We parked in their car park behind the hotel, which reeked of old beer. After checking in, we stepped into the stairwell, and it smelled stale, like a room that has been completely closed up for the past year. When we then stepped into our corridor, it stunk of smoke really bad. We then found our room, stepped in, and we were back to the stale stench.
 
THE ROOM: I realise hotel rooms have to be compact, but the size of the bathroom was ridiculously small, and felt unclean. I didn't feel comfortable using the toilet or drinking the bathroom tap water. The walls between our room and all surrounding rooms were paper-thin. The people next door talked incessantly all night, and we heard them very clearly. All night. Though, they were Asian, so we had no idea what they were saying. The bed was extremely uncomfortable. We both woke up with very sore backs and necks. The window also did very little to keep sound out, so could constantly hear traffic noises outside, as well as people in town. When we woke up, I just wanted to get out of there, so had a very early check-out of about 7am.

CUSTOMER SERVICE: When on our way to check-out, I decided that when the concierge asked if we had enjoyed our stay, I would reply, "It was not what I expected, and I would not recommend it." However, he did not ask if we had enjoyed our stay. That was a first for me. Very poor customer service.

In a nut shell - I would never stay at The Sudima Hamilton again, and recommend that people stay away from it.

title: Great place to stay, terrible service
text:
I stayed with a tour group from my university about one week ago. The rooms were faultless - large tidy and well maintained. 

However, the group were met with the ultimate distrust by staff. There were approximately 150 of us staying at the hotel and we had booked out pretty much the entire floor. As you would expect being in a large group people would want to talk to each other. As soon as more than 2 people were in any one of the standard rooms at any one time we were told to leave. And again, the moment any of us had more than one other person in the room the management would come knocking at the door and/or calling multiple times insisting that we leave. When we ventured into the hallway the management were demanding to know our room numbers.

Despite the lovely rooms I have never felt so unwelcome or uncomfortable as I did on that occasion. While I appreciate with hosting that many students the management may be uncomfortable about alcohol and/or parties however no noise was being made, as far as i'm aware no damage was done so there was no reason for such hostility. The management i'm sure knew what they were getting themselves into when agreeing to have that many students there.

Not too mention - later in the evening I was one of a few people quietly talking in the hallway and was imperatively told to go to bed! 

While Sudima could be a nice play to stay unfortunately therefore I cannot rate it as highly as it would have scored.

title: Nice place
text:
Well its a good hotel if ur looking for a decent place with good service in affordable price..

The bathroom and bed was pretty good as compared to other hotels with same price.

Would recommend this to every one
hotel_response: Dear Guest,thank you for your comments,great to hear that you enjoyed your stay and made most of the CBD location.see you again soon.

title: Big Rooms

title: Good hotel with parking at a good price.

The room and bathroom was great, we really liked it!
The hotel is situated by the main street with a lot of restaurants, which we really liked.
hotel_response: Dear Guest, I am pleased that you enjoyed your stay with us. Thank you for taking the time to write a review.

title: Nice room but no good if you are short
text:
This looked a bit of a dive from the street but it was better than our first impressions. The reception area was very small. We did not have breakfast although it was available. 

The room was of a reasonable size and the bed was comfortable. There was a chair, table, fridge and kettle. The view outside was bad, just a flat roof and walls but it didn't matter as we were only passing through for one night. 

The main criticism was the bathroom. The shower was fine but changed temperature a few times. However there was a very steep step to get into the shower room and another very steep step together into the shower cubicle. Be careful if you are short. Plus the mirror in the bathroom (incidentally the only one in the whole room) is very high and as I am vertically challenged at 5' nothing I could not see into it at all.

Anshul on Reception was VERY helpful and friendly. He did various things for us and was really kind.
hotel_response: Dear Guest, Thank you for your comments about your stay, pleased to see that you had a comfortable stay overall, and thank you for your kind words about our team going the extra mile.We hope to welcome you back to the hotel best regards

title: Good position
text: We had originally booked our rooms as the Victoria Hotel but, when we arrived in Hamilton, found it had been taken over by the Sudima group.  No contact was made with us prior to our arrival to advise us of the change of owners.   We had hoped to access our rooms earlier than the 2 00 pm checkin, however, due to a flowover of guests from Auckland due to events being held there, we had to wait until nearly 2 30 pm before the rooms were ready.   The studio room was huge, although there was a 'pokey'  little unit by the entry door where there was a kettle for making tea/coffee, but no toaster, which is usually available in motels/hotels.  Fortunately, the two bedroom unit across the hall, was better equipped, as it had a good size kitchen with full size oven and fridge, dishwasher, and a toaster, as well as the kettle, etc.    The two bedrooms had no windows, and our family who occupied this unit, found them very claustrophobic and stuffy, especially if the doors were closed.   We appreciate having only recently taken over this property, there is still some 'upgrading' to be done, as well as such basic items in the kitchen (eg;  bottle opener, vegetable peeler).    We had been spoilt with our previous motels in that we had views from most of them, but the windows from these rooms looked out onto very rusty roofs and airconditioning units.   Glad we only stayed two nights.   However, we must compliment the staff, who were very helpful when we requested the kitchen items, and suggested other improvements to the facilities in each room.   Really difficult to rate it as excellent, but it was clean and the beds comfortable.
hotel_response: Dear Guest, We are pleased that your overall experience was enjoyable.Thank you for taking the time to write a review.

title: Modern & central
text: Nicely appointed rooms right in the heart of Hamilton. Only downside is Saturday night revellers and the shower had terrible pressure but reception staff were pleasant and more than obliging when we asked for a knife and wine glasses.
hotel_response:
Dear Guest, I am  pleased you enjoyed the stay and the location.
The shower pressure has since been fixed and I do apologize the disturbance caused by the revellers.Thank you for the positive comments about our team and look forward to welcoming you back on the next occasion.

title: Sudima Hamilton,
text:
My wife and I arrived @ 6pm without a prior booking and walked into the lobby. We where then greeted by Parm Sahu at the reception desk. He was the most friendly and polite man we had the pleasure of meeting while in Hamilton, he showed us the rooms that where available , and assisted us with parking and luggage. He is a credit to your hotel and you are fortunate to have him in your employ. The hotel has had a recent refurbishment and is very pleasant to stay at, the bed was brand new and also very comfortable. The room was very clean and had everything we required. The hotel is located right in the heart of Hamilton which is very handy to the restaurants and  directly opposite the casino.
Overall it was a great night in Hamilton we wish we could have stayed longer.
Great work
Cheers

title: Amazing staff
text:
First time here as the Novotel in Hamilton were unable to accommodate us, certainly will be back. Staff were professional and very willing to help. There was an odour coming from the bathroom upon entry to the room, after looking at other rooms we preferred the original one we were in so staff arranged for the bathroom to be cleaned thoroughly... Smell gone! 

Staff offered ice when they saw us return with beers, whole hotel is warm and clean. Air con is a bonus and bed extremely comfortable. 

The only downside is the towel rail... There is none! Towels are stored on a shelf above the sink so you have nowhere to hang towels after use (we had to ask for more)  and no where to place your toiletries 

This will not put us off returning. See you again soon sudima!!!

We do appreciate your wonderful comments about our team.The issues raised have since been addressed.I trust that on your return visit you will experience first hand the improvements your comments have directly led to.

title: A pleasant place to stay
text: Pleasant staff particularly the reception staff who were very helpful. Room small but clean and adequate for a one or two night stay. In a central location in the city with good secure car parking at the rear of the hotel.
hotel_response:
Dear Guest
Thank you for your review and the comments it contained, in particular about our team here. We are pleased that your stay was an enjoyable one.

title: Excited to let down
text:
I arrived to the Sudima Hamilton really excited about my stay and night away, the initial greeting was friendly and they have done the front reception area well, I was looking forward to getting up to my room. I had arrived a little earlier than 2pm and upon checking my room was ready. So up I went, so disappointed the room stunk so badly of a sewer like smell, the guy on the front desk has just been up to check it and there is no way he could have missed the smell. So I quickly dropped my things and left.
I returned got ready and went out for the evening, returning later the room was so strong of this sewer smell I couldn't stand it. Burying my face into the pillow.
I woke in the morning to get in the shower turned the water on and was completely hit by that hideous smell again so strong of sewer I quickly turned the shower off and shut the bathroom door and never went back in there.
There was no hand towels or flannels, sheets were clean though.
Returning later that evening there was no parks so ended up parking on the road.
Overall SO disappointed, it was such a let down. I stay in Hamilton frequently and won't be returning to the Sudima anytime soon.
hotel_response: Dear Guest, We are always looking at all possible ways to improve our guests' stays and this includes to address and fix the issues you have raised, I am sorry that your stay on this occasion could not draw a higher rating but I do appreciate and wish to thank you for the time that you have taken to share your experience with us.

title: Good Value, good facilities, small rooms.
text:
For this hotel only a simple review is required, as there are really no complaints. The hotel is clean, and feels recently refurbished. The rooms are great, large TV, well looked after, and clean. The hotel location is great. The staff could be a little more friendly, and the rooms are a little small (although it is an old building)

Overall, definitely worth the visit.
hotel_response:

title: Good value? Quiet
text: I was very pleasantly impressed with my stay, very clean and very quiet- and staff were very pleasant and helpful. Rooms small however for business or the odd night its perfect.  I really thought the breakfast area and lounge was very nice.
hotel_response:

We look forward to welcome you here again in future.Best Regards,

title: Good value, pleasant hotel, good location
text: Hotel's greatest assets are friendly, very helpful desk staff, and central location. Clean, pleasant, no-frills rooms with heat pump when needed. Good value at $129/night (week days, winter). Continental breakfast and no room service.
hotel_response: Dear Guest, We are pleased that you enjoyed your stay and thank you for taking the time to post a review. We look forward to your next visit. Kind regards,

title: We paid for this!?!?!?!?
text:
We drove to Hamilton from Auckland - 126 kilometres of a straight road with lush green meadows on both sides dotted with occasional herds of cows or sheep made the drive pretty enjoyable. Hamilton as such is a small town, not more than 4 streets with hardly anything to do! It’s a quaint quiet town where you can simply loiter around the streets and enjoy the weather, but unfortunately it was raining the day we ventured in. We were booked in at the Sudima Hamilton on Victoria Street, a hotel with Indian staff, at least for both the shifts that we saw. Room 212, began and ended just as we opened the door! It was a no nonsense room with no space wasted and no view! It had nothing that made it part of a honeymoon trip and there was hardly any place to walk around after the bed and the closet. The TV took 15 minutes to work and had 4-5 channels with very bad transmission. 

The only selling point is probably the location which has a few restaurants and bars around it. 

Not exactly an option to consider if you need a relaxing stay at Hamilton. More suited for business travellers.
hotel_response:
Dear Guest, I am pleased that you enjoyed the drive to Hamilton and the CBD location.We regret that your stay wasn't pleasant as expected,Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us.
Kind Regards,

title: Ok for one night
text:
Our room was a bit small but the hotel has been recently refurbished so furniture is quite new and modern although with some design flaws....kettle and coffee are on tight shelf with no power plug...you actually have to remove the kettle and put on the large desk to plug in (would be better to put the whole coffee making things onto it...). There is no water jug to fill the kettle with....and the basin in the bathroom is so small that you won't be able to fill the kettle from the tap....so filling was a lenghty process with a small glass....surely housekeeping can come up with something better???
According to the description of the room there would be a microwave but we didn't see it! 
The TV is new and mounted on a wall but reception was so poor that it was merely an ornament!
The bathroom is also small and we found that not a lot of attention was put in the details...the shampoo kit had already been opened by previous guests but not replaced...and quite a few water marks were on the very well lit mirror! air con is not really adjustable so we were a bit cold during the night.
The 3 stars rating is due to location 'cause it's right on Victoria St and close to restaurants and night clubs and shops. It's also got free parking and reasonable rates.
hotel_response:
Dear Guest, Thank you for your comments. I apologise that your stay was not up to your expectations. As a new hotel we are still bedding in some services and are grateful that you took the time to note where we could improve. We have acted on those observations and are confident that upon your next stay you will see first hand how we have learnt.

Kind regards

title: Great Hotel
text: Great little hotel, with friendly efficient service from the hotel staff. Clean and fresh, nicely decorated and everything worked.   Rooms were not large, but there is enough room.   Beds were big and comfy.   Very adequate continental breakfast provided in the bar area.
hotel_response:
Dear Guest, We are pleased that you enjoyed your stay and thank you for taking the time to post a review. We look forward to your next visit. Kind regards,

Best Regards,

title: Clean comfortable rooms
text: We stayed at sudima for one night and upon arrival reception was unattended but after a quick phone call someone appeared we were given an upgrade to a superior room which was nice and a nice gesture. The room was very clean thanks to housekeeping and the heating was sufficient to warm the room however we had thought that perhaps a hotel such as sudima would have sky tv but this was not so. Car parking was available but limited so lucky for us not too many people had cars while we stayed. We paid a good price for our room as it was a special on the trade me website as a mystery hotel. The hotel is conveniently located in town and within easy walking distance to many restaurants and shops including the casino. Over all I would tell my friends to stay here but just one thing as far as the parking is concerned there is no internal access from the car parking building so if it is raining just make sure to take an umbrella. Our room was right beside the main road so a lot of noise so just ask for a room elsewhere. Also they have a bar and breakfast is not cooked just continental.

title: Great value very modern
text:
you cant go wrong here. great value and the staff were fantastic. 
the location is is the heart of the city too.
the rooms arevall modern and parking is avail too. 
you can get a joining rooms for family accom.

title: Budget hotel.
text:
In my opinion, much money has been spent on literature and the reception area to give this hotel a sense of modern, luxury and contemporary feel. (My booking was based upon this). But this experience stops there. My double room was basic, bathroom was through a sliding door because there wasn't enough room for a traditional door. The overall quality was poor and I find it amusing that the company have self rated themselves as "a 4 star hotel".  

It is not, in my opinion, a 4 star hotel, and visitors should not go expecting a 4 star hotel or you will be as disappointed as I was. I chose to forfeit the full booking price, checked out and moved on. 

I found the reception staff helpful and they offered me a free upgrade which I chose not to take after viewing.

If you need to be in Hamilton and looking for a no frills, budget hotel, then this may be suitable for you.

title: Sudima Hotel stay
text: A most enjoyable stay at Sudima Hotel on Friday night.   The staff were excellent, very polite, and helpful.   The room was quiet, air conditioned and clean and tidy.   Great stay, and would recommend to others.
hotel_response:
Dear Guest
Thank you for taking the time to write a review, we are pleased that you enjoyed your visit.

Kind Regards,

title: Good location but basic hotel
text:
The location is great, right in the Hamilton CBD on the main road. When we looked at the hotel online the rate said $150, we called and tried to book and were told it would be $450 as it was one of the last rooms, needless to say we booked online at the cheaper rate. Prices should be consistantly advertised.
We were advised that parking is available. We arrived to find the carpark full, which is understandable but it is one way in/out and it was jam packed. It was with great difficulty that we managed to maneuver our way out. Just having a sign say FULL would help a lot. We got to reception and told him that we couldn't find a park - no suggestion of alternate parking options was offered, even though a carpark is just across the road. Receptionist in evening was not very helpful at all. Did not explain any of the hotel services, check out time etc. 
The room is decorated well with a new bathroom which was nice. Nice large single beds in twin room.
No compendium of hotel info in the room, no minibar.
It was not a bad stay, just average and served it's purpose.
hotel_response:
Dear Guest,
Thank you for your constructive feedback.  We can and will do a better job.  An in room compendium is currently being designed, however information should have been explained to you upon check in and suggestions for alternative parking offered.  The rooms have recently been refurbished, so its great to hear you liked the décor and bathrooms.Best Regards

title: nice location
text: This hotel has a perfect central location, big bonus that their car park is free and we just left our car at the hotel and walked everywhere. Not sure how much data but we received an internet code with our room key- thank you, its usually so expensive! Room was a little bit small but nice and clean! I believe this place is perfect for those who are planning to stay just overnight as there is no room service, not sure if they have any restaurant either! Nice and friendly staff at front desk as well!

title: Fine, just feels like it's put together from a kit
text:
Stayed one night for a business trip.

Pros:
* location is perfect in the Hamilton CBD, near my client and near restaurants and the river walk
* staff were lovely - friendly, professional, remembered me the next morning from when I checked in
* room very clean and sufficiently large, and bed quite comfortable
* parking was free and easy to find
* wifi was included in room rate, which is not common in NZ
* nice to have the option of stairs as well as lift
* lovely old building

Cons:
A few little things about the room made me feel like it was set up by someone who's never stayed in a hotel, and certainly never tried staying in this one. For example: 
* kettle didn't fit under bathroom tap, so had to ferry water to kettle in a cup.  
* Wardrobe door opened onto the room door hinge so would only open to 45 degrees. Couldn't have put much in the wardrobe.  
* Curtains were very thin and didn't block the light from the main street outside the window. Hard to sleep when there's a streetlight in your face.
* Folder on the room's desk, as is usual for hotels, but with NOTHING in it.
* Can't remember for certain, but I don't think there was a "how to escape" map on the back of the room door.
* Alarm clock time was set 20 minutes late.  Just close enough to the real time that I didn't notice until the next morning. Lucky I didn't use it as an alarm.

Some of these issues are easy to fix, some less so (I can't imagine them installing new sinks). But they all imply a lack of real thought in the setup.

title: Awesome place to stay at Sudima (comercial hotel)
text:
Sudmia (Commercial) Hotel is one of the best hotel to stay in Hamilton,Waikato, New Zealand.The Service was good.As the hotel is situated in CBD. All restaurant and supermarkets are near to it.
Great customer service with full satisfaction.Will Suggest everybody to stay in such wonderful hotel

title: The only thing going for this hotel is its staff
text:
I chose to stay at this hotel based on previous Sudima location stays.  I was hopeful as this location has just undergone a change in ownership (formally the Commercial Hotel).
Well... where to start?
Pros - staff & location.  
The front desk staff were very helpful, warm & welcoming.  I could not have asked for better under the circumstances.
The location is very close to the river, main shopping precinct and Sky City Casino.
Cons - In no particular order: Windows that didn't close & were cracked, hairdryer that didn't work, no working lights in the bathroom, a room door that didn't close properly, kettle/jug that didn't fit under the tap to fill it (I ended up using the showerhead!), TV channels that weren't clear (read was unable to watch), extension cord running down the hall across the main entrance door unsecured and road noise.
Did I mention that the milk supplied in the fridge had expired a month prior?! 

I understand that this hotel is going through some management/branding changes, but that is no excuse for unsafe work practises(extension lead, broken windows, doors that don't lock) and unsatisfactory room maintenance (expired milk, lights that don't work). 

Would I stay here again? NO
Would I recommend it to others? NO
hotel_response:
Thank you for your review and feedback.  It’s great to hear our new Front Office team were welcoming and friendly!  We have just completed a month of trading under the Sudima brand and are continuously making improvements to the existing product along with other services. 
We do hope you will give us another opportunity to get things right and would welcome further correspondence from you in order to facilitate this, please email reservations@sudimahamilton.co.nz.

title: Wonderful hosts, peaceful surrounds
text: I have stayed at Darcy House a couple of times and it has always been a great stay. Martyn and Lizzie go right out of their way to please. The house exudes olde world charm,the rooms are comfortable and quiet and the breakfasts are a perfect way to start the day. Situated equidistant from Hamilton and Cambridge and 5 minutes from Hamilton Airport makes this an ideal spot for touring the Waikato.

title: Great Getaway
text:
Darcy House: Come for the chill vibe, stay for the espresso. And the rocket salad. Lizzie and Martin are fabulous hosts. I wish I could have stayed a month. Warm fires and friendly dogs. 

A very good creative spirit abounds, great for painting or writing or composing music. Cannot wait to get back!

title: A Great Find in Ulster Street.
text:
Spacious well appointed suite with car parking. Great King size bed, two very comfortable easy chairs, dinning table & chairs plus fully appointed kitchen.
Separate bathroom with washer drier. We couldn't fault.
Oh  I suggested a bedside lamp would be good to our wonderful host Judith. Done!💥🥳
Full room service by charming staff every day. Excellent.

title: Absolutely DISGUSTING
text: This place is disgusting and not family friendly in anyway. There are scum living in the motel, dealing and doing drugs while they live here permanently. There were cockroaches in our room, no tv and graffiti on the walls. The fridge was stinky and not turned on. We were awake the entire night and witnessed a domestic fight between a woman and a man at 2am. Unsafe and scary to be anywhere near here. Change your name to a trailer park.

title: The 70's called, it wants it's hotel back
text: Whilst the 70's vibe of this place was quite sweet, I found the beds to be incredibly uncomfortable and the shower was abysmal.  I mentioned the dribble to the owners and I got the sense that they are fully aware but instead they pretend that they look into it and never do.  My suggestion to the owners is that it's either time to sell and move on or find some zest, borrow some money and reinvest in the place to bring it back up to standard.

title: Clean and safe
text: Sure, it’s dated but you get what you pay for. If you are looking for an inexpensive, safe, clean place to stay, this is it. Combine that with friendly staff who give you milk on arrival, and you’ve got a winner

title: Dated, old and unwelcoming granny flat
text:
The beds were hard and lumpy
The wifi was terrible - kept cutting out or not working at all
The housekeeping was bad - no fresh towels, no clean sheets
The room had an insect problem - baby cockroaches through the flat
The proprietor was arrogant, blunt and came across condescending. Did not make us feel welcome.
Not enough cutlery and cooking utensils
Very dated decor
The only plus side was that the pool was nice and the temperature was good

Will never be coming back to this place again.

title: Friendly owners, no frills stay
text:
Good value motel with very friendly owners and well located in Hamilton.

My family and I stayed for the weekend, We stayed in a single room unit (Bed in the lounge and 2 singles in a separate room)

Room was pretty dated and a little on the unclean side (hair in the bathroom and used dish cloth in the sink) master bed was pretty small for a couple to sleep in and the second night i slept in one of the single beds to have a restful sleep.

Shower pressure was terrible almost gravity defying and trying to shower small children was difficult.

The kids playground was fun for the children and the swimming pool was great as the weather was warm and the room had only a single fan for cooling.

All in all a good stay and for the money i would recommend the Ascot Lodge Motel to others that are either on a budget or in a pinch.

title: Very Good Value, and friendly staff.
text: I stopped here on a long car journey. My criteria were clean and affordable, and this motel met all of these. In addition I also got friendly and helpful staff.  The facilities are slightly dated, but were spotless. Excellent Wifi speeds as well.

title: Nice place.
text: Very nice place with lots of parking. Friendly staff at the country.  Clean and tidy room with good quality linen. Clean bathroom. We enjoyed staying there for three night. Definitely visit again in future.

title: Old but O.K
text:
Good value family accomodation. Motel is very dated and tired but it was reasonably clean and in a good location and was spacious enough for a family of 5.  Our room was at the front and the traffic was very noisy, we were also treated to a roadside domestic incident.....

With a spruce up and the removal of the mouldy curtains, this motel would be great. We would stay again but in a quieter unit.

title: A great nearby hospitals location
text: The Ascot Lodge Motels are ideally situated within walking distance of both the Waikato and Braemar hospitals. The rooms are clean, tidy and comfortable. Good and easy transportation into central Hamilton is available nearby.

title: OLD MOTEL BUT CLEAN
text: Just needed a place where we could bed down and were able to do our own cooking.  This is definitely an 'old' motel with the basic necessities but it suited our purposes.  This certainly is a popular place for travellers as it was full every night we were here.  The price is a draw card as well.  I have to say our room was larger than most motels.

title: Everything we needed
text: I travelled with my mother from Whangarei and we have booked this place every time we visit her 'aging' sisters. We didn't want 'cheap, cheap' but we didn't want pricey either. We get the room with a bath and a kitchenette. They are spacious with good lighting. They are clean and tidy with very little noise. The breakfast is lovely with a nice relaxing view out the large glass window/ranch slider. We keep going back.

title: Good budget accommodation
text: Stayed in a two bedroom unit which was tidy and clean.  The bed was comfortable and the room large, however the shower pressure wasn't the greatest.  The Motel is close to both the Racecourse and the Hamilton Golf course.  The room was somewhat noisy from the road noise.

title: Just what we needed.
text: This place was great. The rooms were clean and tidy (nothing flash). They had a lovely pool that my children fell in love with.  The staff were really friendly and helpful. Only minutes from TE Awa The Base shopping mall and also from the city centre. The price was great and it was a relief to know that we had an affordable location for accomodation.

title: Good budget Motel
text: Some people have complained about this property. It's true that it is older in style but its very clean, spacious and well equiped. The staff were very efficient and friendly. My main reason for choosing this location was price and convenience. There is parking right outside the unit doors so unless you want to pay a lot more for more modern furnature and fittings then this is a very good place to stay.

title: Mrs and Mr
text: Although this is an older motel it is very well appointed,  comfortable and lots of room.  Friendly managers and all you want.  We had the apartment which would be ideal for a family and the tariff is very reasonable.  We recommend it.

title: Good accommodation
text: Clean tidy fully equiped room with on site parking. Swimming pool and childrens play ground onsite as well as barbecue  facilites. Room has back porch with table and chairs where you can sit and keep an eye on the children. Motel includes on site laundry which is an added bonus. Whilst the decor could do with an update, the facilities  were clean and tidy.Good value for money.Located on main road between Te Rapa Shopping  Centre and the CBD.

title: There is much better
text: Tired, drab and out of date. The motel needs a complete refit. It is like going back in time. The internet keeps dropping making forward planning impossible, the bed was very well worn. At the price there is much better available - look elsewhere

title: Great family motel
text: This motel was amazing, it was so spacious and accommodated 2 adults and 2 children. Enough room inside for the kids to move around from room to room and not crammed up in a small room. Great value for money. A little outdated but all the bits and bobs there. Tea coffee pans pots cheese grater etc. Also added bonus open the back door sit on the steps with a coffee and watched our kids play right outside on the playground. Awesome place. Will be back!!!!

title: Much better than expected
text: Actually liked this place.  Price was great.  Location, not so much.  Halfway - or so - between Te Rapa Shopping Center and Hamilton CBD (closer to Te Rapa), nothing really around there.  Got in late but the person there was friendly and cheerful.  I didn't the room was actually a fully equipped apartment.  Full kitchen and all.  With beds and pull out sofa, could probably sleep up to 6, no problem.  The apartment was old but comfortable and clean.  This would be a good place for a family on a budget.  No frills, yet probably much has what you need.

title: Cheap and cheerful
text:
Great value for short or longer stay - the older style units have everything you need for families or a quiet time. Nice pool and swings and great location. The water pressure is terrible but a small price to pay for an otherwise economical and friendly place.

Not sure why the free wifi kept cutting out...

title: Great family units!
text: I stayed with my two young children in a unit for two nights. HUGE thanks to the owner for giving me a portacot at 9pm on a Saturday night when I realised co sleeping was NOT going to happen! Very quiet motel, central to everything (driving distance). The only thing I would change would be the pillows. They were like rocks! Thanks again, we will be back :)

title: Ok stay
text:
Room was very dated. the kitchen was something from the 70's as was the décor. The site itself was ok, not too bad for location. It did its job for us at a reasonable price. Owners were friendly. There is a pool in site which looked ok but we didn't use it.
There is WIFI if you can get a signal which we couldn't which was a shame, most of the time we went to burger king to get a signal

title: Overnight stay
text: Clean, tidy and cheap. This was a perfect overnight stay for me. They even offered to park my motorbike in a gated area. I stayed in the front unit, by the road, it didn't worry me, as I only used the room to sleep, but I could see people being upset by it. Very friendly staff. If you're happy with the basics I highly recommend Ascot Lodge.

title: Value for money and friendly
text: I am so happy to share about the Ascot Motor Lodge.  We had a really well priced 4 night stay.  The rooms are really spacious and ideal for families.  We had a back unit and found the noise minimal.  Everything was so close to where we wanted to go its location made it a no brainer to stay at.  Bruce and Lynn were really nice people and I was so happy to meet them.  Everything we needed for our stay was in this unit and anything I needed was no trouble, you cannot get better

title: holiday
text: After travelling all the way from Porirua it was nice to arrive an find a nice an clean unit. The host where very friendly an helpful. The beds where comfy an serviced daily, The pool was nice an clean. The housemaid was very helpful an did a excellent job on the units well done. Would stay again

title: Beware
text: owner/manager needs to keep off the booze ...  Wouldn't stay again with my son as when my older boys came for a visit he went mental and was ready to hit me. What a dick! Needs to attend anger management and customer service course.

title: Treasure!
text: The Owners were lovely and VERY accommodating. I requested a particular unit and they made a few changes and I was able to have that unit. Lyn & Bruce were helpful & friendly and really do make the effort to get to know customers. Pool was clean everyday. The unit we stayed in was just what we needed. Location wise- Easy to find. The unit had everything we needed Would definitely stay again :)

title: Affordable rooms with Outstanding warm service
text: This isn't the Hilton as indicated by the super low value and affordability. The beds were decent sized, nice and clean as well as comfortable. The service is outstanding we asked for extra towels and received without hesitation, they even heated our room knowing we were going to be a late check-in on a cold wintery night. The 1960/70's decor is a unique touch that takes me back to what old school NZ use to look and feel like, even though its old and outdated it does the job i'm warm, comfortable, safe and satisfied.

title: affordable, care-free and comfortable
text: god sent motel,would recommend ascott rd motel to everyone, the pool is so refreshing, big enough for the whole family, staff are very helpful, rooms r tidy and clean, uplifted my stay in hamilton, wishn i was bak thea, thank u ascott rd.

title: AWESOME
text: It is a really nice Motel , very clean and tidy and comfortable. Some of the other reviews surprise me - far from our experience. Good old fashioned honest accommodation at a reasonable price , you cannot ask anymore than that> We will stay there again.

title: OMG
text: We stayed for 3 nights in January 2014 in a 3 bedroom unit, upon initial arrival it seemed we were time warped back into the 1960's, without the psychedelic colours. The rooms were small, beds were very old and the so called double beds were just bigger than a single. Furnishings were dated and the whole unit was dirty. We found our so called clean towels had dried vomit on them, to which they were promptly replaced, the free wifi was on occasions available but had to hold the iPad up in the air at a 45 degree angle to gain reception, then I'm sure that a Commodore 64 would have been faster than the wifi. Overall a disappointing experience on my first trip to New Zealand and to put icing on the cake, we booked the 3 bedrooms for 7 people, only to find out that the price had somehow changed and after costing us another $200 dollars extra, we left never to return to this establishment again.

title: A budget motel, and nothing else.
text: After a check-in mishap the hosts did rectify the situation. But the room was out-dated (Apart from the flat screen TV). It could do with some modernization. I mean it was comfortable, and clean but just lacked that sparkle. The pool outside is like jumping in the arctic (not heated). On the plus side the hotel is over the road from a chinese takeaway and liquor store which is a bonus. Overall, I probably would not stay here again.

title: Disappointing
text:
We stayed for 3 nights in December 2013 in a two bedroom unit which would have been good had it not been in urgent need of renovation.  Paint was chipped, walls were grubby, the bedspreads were probably clean but the pattern made them look dirty.  Carpet was stained.

Mismatched cutlery, crockery and glassware.  Kitchen cupboards and fry pan smelt mouldy.  We had to wash all the crockery before we started as plates were stuck together.  No air conditioning so windows had to be opened to reduce dusty smell.  No fly screens.

The room was spacious and could have been really good if it hadn't been so tired.

Disappointing.

title: Spacious and Comfortable
text: Nice traditional  NZ motel. The older design means lovely large units. Unit had been refurbished and was spotlessly clean. The Hosts were very helpful and welcoming. Good value cooked breakfast of bacon and eggs with toast. While on Te Rapa Road using the aircon and closing the windows meant we had quiet undisturbed sleep. Good comfortable bed and pillows. Would happily stay again.

title: High tea birthday treat
text:
The Henley Hotel is a stately building in a spectacular setting. We were warmly greeted upon arrival by a lovely man who showed us to the table for our high tea. The art, the furniture and the wider decor with its nod to England is captivating. 
The food and wine was excellent along with the waitress who attended to us. 
We wandered the beautiful grounds afterwards. 
A truly memorable birthday treat.

title: Out of the Box. Ambience, quality and service.
text: My wife and I stayed 2 nights. The Hotel is set in its own grounds with beautiful gardens and trees and a small lake. The surrounding countryside is rural with an English tinge. The Hotel is themed on the Henley on Thames experience. Internally the hotel is very elegant with a sweeping 'Gone with the Wind' staircase, a swimming pool and spa. Everything is immaculate. The staff are exceptional and the food was outstanding. Stayed in many places but this is up with the best in the Private Hotel style.

title: Outstanding Food, outstanding staff!!!
text:
Three couples celebrating birthdays 31/7/21. 

Was so excited to bring friends to Henley this weekend just gone. Had the most exquisite 6 course meal beautifully prepared from the amazing head chef Corey and his awesome team. In addition, the most beautifully matched wines from the very professional and knowledgeable not to mention hilarious Nico, as we have fondly nicknamed him. 
Not my first stay here as I love the food and friendly staff who always make you feel so welcome. Nothing is ever too much trouble. 
Thank you once again to all the wonderful staff for your amazing food and professionalism whom of course I highly, highly recommend!!!!!

title: Weekend away
text:
Great night at the Henley with good friends. Food was superb! 10/10! Chef Corey put together a fantastic menu and executed it to perfection. Would stay again just for the food. 
Nico the sommelier was fun and so great at his job! Nick was welcoming on arrival and very professional. 
Rooms well presented and comfortable and grounds beautiful. Definitely worth a stay if you are looking for a nice relaxing weekend away.

title: Surprise 70th Birthday Weekend at THE HENLEY
text:
This was a surprise birthday weekend away, commencing with a car rally to The Henley.
The main event was a Murder/Mystery dinner held on the Saturday night.  There were 20 guests including 2 young children.  The preparation with Hotel management leading up to the event, and the accommodating behavior of the staff over the weekend, was outstanding.
Not to mention the beautiful Hotel & its garden surroundings.

title: Wonderful 5 star stay
text: This was a really fabulous experience, we can not find one fault even if we tried, the facilities are fantastic the gardens superb with a gorgeous swimming pool and fabulous decor and the food in the restaurant is excellent. Nick the front of house manager is a fantastic host and Nicolas the food and beverage manager is extremely passionate about the industry and so professional and has extensive knowledge about different wines he really made our stay special we are sad to leave and we highly recommend a stay at Henley.

title: High Tea - Low experience
text: After reading previous reviews. I was excited to book a birthday High Tea at Henley. However such a disappointment and must attributed solely down to the staff and chef. Beautiful sunny day, we were placed inside as its 'difficult to seat 7 outside'! No tea menu and savories were frozen packet style, sandwiches had gone crusty. Had to ask for bubbles, ask for a non alcoholic option, ask for a cup of tea!!. Beautiful Hotel and styled, lovely grounds. Suggest the staff take some high teas themselves at zeelong as an example, to see how it's done. Very expensive for what was experienced.

title: Beautiful Hotel
text:
The Henley hotel just out of Cambridge is beautiful
Stunning rooms 
Lovely friendly staff
Excellent facilities 
beautiful grounds
Close to Cambridge and Hamilton city
Staff are just friendly helpful and all round lovely people

title: CHRISTMAS LUNCH FIRST SITTING
text: You would expect a boutique hotel and spa of this calibre ( The Henley Hotel in Cambridge) to have chefs who cater for vegans and vegetarians. But NO, absolutely not. I would not recommend dining here. A set menu of $89 per head was served for Christmas day lunch. Prepayment was required a week before. I liased via email before,asking if they would cater for vegans, saying there was nothing on the menu suitable for me. It was indicated they could. This is what I got for $89. Entree-cold beetroot soup ( everyone had this as an option also - it was okay) My main course was a small plate of rice risotto! Norhing else. No roast vegies cooked in oil, although the set menu said all main course options included as such, no salads, nothing! My dessert consisted of a couple slices of pineapple, kiwifruit and a few grapes! No strawberries, no melon, no dairy free yoghurt. TOTALLY USELESS. DISGUSTING IN FACT! The water in the urns for tea and coffee was luke warm.Some years back when the same premises were called Sarnia Park, I attended Christmas lunch there with family. They had a set menu far superior plus the chefs prepared  wonderful vegan courses for me. The interior decor may have changed to look more palatial,but as for the food and the chefs, that's another story!A HUGE DISAPPOINTMENT.

title: Best Hotel, Beautiful Hotel, Best Customer Service
text: We and our two little boys were very happy to stay in Henley Hotel. Great food, great customer service, beautiful gardens, lakes, food, bar, spa. I loved the Mona Lisa pics. It's beautiful stunning. Great place for pictures. Staff helped me get beautiful pictures. I enjoyed my Jim Beam n the authentic dinner. Breakfast was tasty and healthy. Very clean place. Will definitely recommend the Henley Hotel and will visit them again n again... Lovely Memories 😊

title: Christmas dinner spectacular
text: Five of us very muched enjoyed the second sittinģ dinner on Christmas day. Well balanced three courses multi choice meal. Very well presented, well served by ftiendly professional staff. Some of whom (Hungarian and French) are trapped in NZ due the pandemic.  Small negative point - would have preffered a wider selection of red wines but this did not spoil the experience. The new owners are to be complimented on wgat they have achieved.

title: Can’t wait to go back!
text:
A beautiful hotel with wonderful staff.  
We were greeted very warmly upon arrival and shown right around the home.  The room was beautiful and very comfortable.  On our second night we requested an extra bed as our daughter was joining us unexpectedly.  This request was accommodated with no issues at all.
We had drinks in the bar both nights.  The bar staff were very friendly and helpful.  Dinner was delicious and again the service was exceptional.
We’re looking forward to being able to go back.

title: Touch of luxury to end trip
text:
A fantastic room with beautiful dressing gown and toiletries.spacious and comfortable.
I enjoyed the peace and serenity of the grounds. It enabled one to get away with a quiet coffee and relax and listen to the bird song.
We had an excellent meal and chose some interesting wines from their good wine list.
The service was brilliant , our hosts friendly and helpful with local advice about shopping in Cambridge. Try and combine a trip with the local Saturday morning farmers market.
Altogether one of the nicest 24 hour breaks that I have ever experienced.

title: Special Setting & Superb Staff
text: Hubby & I have just returned from a one night stay in the "Best Room".  We had previously been to the Hotel for an afternoon tea with our car club when it was called Sarnia Park so decided to return when we needed a place to stay overnight.  Courtenay welcomed us on our arrival as Nick was busy looking after other guests and showed us around the facilities.  Nick then assisted with taking our luggage upstairs to our gorgeous room and explained its features.  We enjoyed a pre-dinner drink in the blue bar and the dinner was good but the lemon cheesecake was divine.  Nicholas the Bar Manager was very quirky and unique and Clementine was lovely and took good care of us during drinks/dinner.  The hotel was very quiet overnight and a very tasty breakfast was enjoyed before we had a walk around the grounds and then departed.  As it is a very small hotel there are only a few staff but they  were versatile and helped each other out as a team.  The thing that really stuck out to me was that ALL the staff made us feel genuinely welcome and went out of their way to make us feel special.  As the hotel was probably only half full they had time for a quick chat each time we saw them which was lovely.  I am keen to return for a girls weekend and take advantage of the pool/spa & high tea.  Highly recommended.

title: Excellent service and food
text: We celebrated a birthday here with a high tea.....amazing service, we found the owners and staff to be friendly and totally professional. I would recommend this place to everyone who appreciates the finer thing in life. The food is gorgeous and the staff were so obliging to my requests....please put this place on your 'must visit' list.

title: A hidden gem in Cambridge
text:
The communication with the hotel was easy and effective one. We were well informed of the facilities and what to expected.

We book a best room with two queen beds in it. It was very spacious and cozy with heat pump. A leather two seater couch in front of the electrical fireplace was a nice set up. This room came with bath tub,  separate shower and double basins. However there was no space to place our skin care bottles. 

The hotel had a huge ground with beautiful cherry blossom trees, a pond and a cathedral for wedding events. 
The lobby was grand and pleasant. Nick was a friendly host who made our stay so welcome. Other than a indoor heated pool and jacuzzi pool beside the main pool, there was also a spa, restaurant, bar and mini cinema.

Rebecca the in house facial therapist was very experienced and made our facial treatments very relaxed ones.

Nicholas the F&B manager was very friendly and funny. We had beef, lamb, salmon and kid Mac and cheese. The beef and lamb were very good. 

Our package including the cooked breakfast. A wide range of breakfast menu to choose from. 

It was a very good experience we had with Henley Hotel.

Thank you Nick, Nicholas and Rebecca.

title: A Wonderful Stay
text: We sadly only stayed one night here. I wish we could have stayed longer.  Nick, the manager, was a sweet man, very friendly and accommodating. The room was spacious and tastefully decorated. The bed was so comfortable and the shower was the grandest that I have ever seen. The breakfast was very tasty, with many options to choose from. We didn’t get a chance to walk the grounds, but they looked lovely. I highly recommend this property.

title: Anniversary trip
text: The staff, the grounds, the food - everything here was SO good - we absolutely loved it and were thinking we should have stayed there another day instead of just one.  We had the trip planned ahead of time, but if we had wiggle room, we would have stayed another day.  It was quiet and beautiful and everyone was so nice we felt like we could become good friends immediately.  And, they had absolutely the BEST robes!  What a nice thing, sitting by the fire in a beautiful soft robe (instead of little spa robes like many places have.....which is nice, but, this was GREAT).  Would go back again for sure if in the area!!

title: Loved this place
text: Staff, service, food, rooms all well above average expensive but well worth it. We would certainly go back and stay there for a special occasion. The gardens and the lake with a private seating area was just lovely.

title: Just Spoil Yourself
text:
As you leave the country road and enter the very long tree lined driveway your expectations of something special ahead are raised.
As you pull-up you are greeted as the wheels stop
From that point on nothing is too much trouble wonderful staff very good food and wine.
The grounds are substantial and make for pleasant walks.
A very nice experience

title: An English manor
text: An interesting place to stay, with an English host, Nick, in the midst of equine territory. Beautifully and expensively decorated and furnished but was almost empty while we were there. Probably depends more on weddings and events but good for visiting Hobbiton

title: Birthday high tea
text: This place is perfect for a birthday high tea, what a wonderful experience. The china teapots and tiered plates were a little bit of the Ritz here in Cambridge. This place has had a do up and is beautiful...the grounds are being done up...a wedding at this place would be perfect. We saw the dinner menu it looked delicious and was a reasonable price..I will be back. Wonderful and welcoming...great staff.

title: Best Hotel in New Zealand
text: Out of the 5 resorts I stayed at in New Zealand, this was the best. The rooms are spacious, well decorated (trash bins are bedazzled), and there’s a jug of water on hand. Server: Donna and Manager: Nick were delightful.

title: Beautiful hotel with old world charm.
text:
We stayed here for 2 nights in August on a Winter special deal. We stayed in a " Better Room" (3 types of room - Good; Better; Best) and it was wonderful. The room was clean, comfortable and lovely. The bed was comfortable. There were lovely fluffy bath robes in the cupboard and Henley scuffs to use. There was a beautiful teddy bear decoration on the bed. The bathrobes and teddy bear are available to buy from reception. The little bedtime extras were delightful. The first night we were left an eye mask each and on the 2nd night we were left a plate of goodies - 2 heart shape melting moment biscuits and 2 small flake chocolates. Yum! The staff were very welcoming, friendly and helpful. Mia was fantastic. The hotel has that old world charm about it, even though it has been recently renovated. 
The hotel has a lovely indoor heated pool and spa. There is also a Cinema room that you can use. Watch either the dvds that are provided or bring your own. The entry foyer is amazing! Lovely grand stair case up to the rooms and mezzanine level.
The food at dinner and breakfast was delicious. The hotel is set at the end of a lovely long driveway, with beautiful gardens, a pond, a chapel, a separate reception venue and extensive grounds. It was lovely to walk around even in Winter.
We thouroughly enjoyed our stay at the Henley and would love to stay there again on a future trip to New Zealand.

title: Superb.
text: Everything about this place is brilliant, from the friendly staff who cannot do enough for you, to the beautiful grounds and the top notch food. Love this place and definitely coming back for more. Nice personal touches such as when arriving with a stinking cold a hot honey and lemon was offerred spontanaously, that's a great customer service culture in evidence !

title: Awesome Hotel
text: We stayed for one night with another 2 couples, we all loved the place , has stunning views and spacious gardens around it ( you can use the hotel bicycles for free)  very ideal for a relaxing trip, staff were very welcoming and friendly, the manager came to introduce himself to us and taking us for a tour around the hotel, rooms are very spacious and super clean, with elegant furnishings and decorations , each room has a different decor. Dining area is very cosy, dinner and breakfast were very good. Lounge and dining area has 24 hours Nespresso coffee and snacks for free . Would love to stay there if n the future.

title: Magnificent Property
text:
A delightful modern property with old world charm.  Staff and services were exceptional.  Our room was a perfect place to relax and unwind at the end of our day.
The gardens and surrounds were magnificent, a  wonderful place to relax and wander.  The breakfasts and evening meals were fit for kings and queens!

title: Great hospitality
text: Very pleasant environment, staff were exceptional. Polite very courteous all with a smile. Breakfast dinning was excellent with the best bacon ever! Grounds were well kept and looked impressive with the Cherry trees in full bloom. Room was immaculately presented. Would highly recommend

title: a little disappointing
text: Went here for Cheery blossom High Tea, and was expecting first rate service and food from this place. The setting is beautiful, on a nice day the tables are set outside, next to the cheery blossoms. Unfortunately from the booking to the welcome/seating to the actual table service it was a struggle, difficult, unfriendly, almost no service. The food was ok, sandwiches looking a bit tired, and some of it seemed to come from a package.

title: Fabulous
text: I took my daughter for a birthday Cherry Blossom High Tea....the attention to detail could not be faulted it was just out of this world. Hospitality would have to be 6 star rating. The grounds are lovely and well kept the food was just top notch again a 6 star rating. I would strongly recomend this place. One word FABULOUS

title: Great retreat
text:
We came here to celebrate our wedding anniversary 
The place was everything I hoped for
Amazing staff as well 
Will highly recommend this place for anyone who is looking for a quality holiday
The food was very good as well

title: Jason and Maris wedding
text: You made our wedding a dream wedding with your excellent customer service. Your staff went above and beyond 😊 thank you so much! Will definitely be back. A special thanks to Leanne and Gillian for everything they did for our wedding!

title: The Most Perfect Place We Have Ever Stayed!
text: We had a lovely one night stay here. The long driveway gave a the first clue that this hotel was out of the ordinary. The parklike grounds, together with fountains, lakes and rose gardens all completed the image of a real English garden. Inside the beautiful sweeping staircase gave the reception area a fine hint of elegance. Staff ensured we had a personal tour of the hotel, lit with many chandeliers and fire places going to give a very cosy feel. Our room was extrermely spacious with amazing bathroom facitlies. Drinks before dinner in the little 'snug' bar was followed by a great dinner with a good variety of choices. Enjoyed the coffee/tea area, together with home baking  - a nice touch. Used the bikes and explored the coutnryside but ran out of time for a swim in the indoor pool. Next time perhaps! Having travelled extensively, we found we could not find any fault with this establishment - every detail was tastefully covered. Fully recommend!

title: Extremely Elegant and Rstful
text: A very pleasant place to stay that takes you back to yesteryear of Hotel stay.  Elegant gardens and tasteful furnishings and huge rooms.  Good service with an excellent breakfast in the large dining room.  The eggs benedict were divine!

title: Bright and Brilliant
text: wonderful staff and a beautiful park like setting make the Henley worth a visit. Good restaurant, great rooms and comfortable beds, nice touches of luxury in an otherwise poor local accommodation offering. I would seriously recommend anyone stay here if they are looking for quality and comfort.

title: Fabulous
text: A beautiful setting near the village of Cambridge. It has a lovely long drive way through to the hotel car park.
