Daffodils were coming up and the grounds are large if you want to take some time to walk through them. We received a very warm welcome at the front door and enjoyed the ambience of the hotel as we walked through to a beautifully set table for our high tea. Excellent staff and delicious food it is truly worth a visit.
hotel_response:
Dear jej747, 

Thank you for your kind words. It was a pleasure to host your special occasion. Your feedback will be shared with the team, and I am sure it will encourage them to continue exceeding our guests' expectations.

We hope to see you again soon.

Regards
Sebastian & team

title: Really Enjoyable
text: All the staff were super friendly and helpful. Sebastian was great. The room was beautifully furnished and well positioned. A stroll around the grounds was very pleasant, even mid winter. Would stay again, if we were in the area.
hotel_response:
Dear Tom, 

Thank you very much for your kind words. The entire team will be thrilled to learn you enjoyed your stay with us. We love making our guests feel at home, and love it even more when they get to enjoy not only our facilities but also the beautiful gardens we are surrounded by. 

Looking forward to see again in the near future.

Sebastian & Team

title: A bit of a treat
text: If you are looking for a quick relaxing get away with a special friend here is the place.  Whether it be a girls weekend or with your extra special person. Friendly people, very clean - food is great, grounds are lovely.
hotel_response:
Dear Karen, 

Thank you for taking the time to provide feedback. We are happy to learn you enjoyed your stay with us. I am sure the team will be thrilled to know how you felt about us and the property.

We hope to see you again in the near future.

Regards
Sebastian & team

title: A GREAT PLACE TO UNWIND
text: a great property nested amongst tress, with friendly staff who make your stay as comfortable as it should be , the rooms are very spacious , with attention given to the smallest detail . This place is not far from Auckland yet feels like a great holiday away from home
hotel_response:
Dear aadilk50, 

Thank you for your feedback. We are happy you could unwind and that our team made your stay comfortable. We take pride on making our guests feel at home, and helping them to make the most of their stay.

Next time you are in the area do not hesitate to contact us, we would be more than happy to welcome you again.

Looking forward to see you in the future.

Regards
Sebastian & team

title: Henley Luxury
text: This is truly one of the most impressive Hotels in New Zealand with 5 star luxury. Set in beautiful surroundings and with outstanding decor and fine food, I would highly recommend for a romantic weekend or peaceful retreat.

title: Absolutely Perfect
text: My stay was absolutely perfect service excellent experience  The quality of the rooms were the best of ever been too, Beautiful secluded and quiet everywhere was beautiful and seem just like being at home I’ve been away I would recommend this to anybody I come across

title: English Manor in Cambridge, NZ
text:
Excellent room very plush and cozy.
Lovely staff very professional and attentive to all our needs.
Great food, drink and ambiance.
Like an English Country Manor. Home from home for us moms.
Peaceful and tranquil. 
Lovely gardens to stroll in.

title: Magnificent Country Property and Holiday Experience
text: We were delighted with our stay at Henley Hotel.  The wider Cambridge area is beautiful in Autumn, and this little luxury hotel is set on a magnificent property.  The dining experience & service was great.

title: One night of luxury
text:
Stayed here one night on 10th May.  Was an absolute pleasure, the room was very elegant, the whole property was spotless and well maintained, the staff were very friendly and welcoming and attentive.  We dined in, there was a group dining together that were quite loud so they put us in the drawing room on our own, moved our table in front of the fire, candles etc, very private and romantic!!
The dinner was amazing, devine fine dining.  The breakfast was included, but my partner doesn't eat eggs so not much choice for him, he was disappointed with the meat and cheese selection for breakfast.

title: KenOz
text: You need a car if you wish to explore Cambridge, but the hotel is well appointed and has beautiful grounds.  We only had breakfast, so cannot comment in detail about the dining options.  If we are in the area again we will return.  Full marks to Mia at reception.

title: Short Autumn Break
text: Great location, beautiful setting, nice room. Great service & nice spa pool on a sunny autumn day. Lovely grounds - would have explored by bike, but the hotel bikes seemed to be fixed on seat height for 6'3 & over! (Small matter)

title: Henley Hotel
text: Thank you for a wonderful stay at the Henley Hotel - we had such a great time and everyone made us feel so welcome! The food, hotel and hospitality was just amazing. The bed was the best we have ever slept in! Just beautiful!

title: Fantastic experience
text: We loved staying at the Henley we had such a relaxing time. The rooms were gorgeous and the decor  was cool. I would recommend this hotel and the food to other people as well. we didn't want to go home.

title: Lovely
text: A beautiful located lovely last stay in New Zealand. From the staff to the room (ground floor near fountain)to the special touches to the breakfast to the available bicycles to the surroundings. So lovely! You definitely can be and feel pampered here! Thank you to the wonderful staff! We really appreciate & enjoyed meeting you!

title: Highly recommend
text: We stayed here with our young family and were very impressed with the rooms, pool and beautiful grounds. The food was of a very high standard and the service was faultless. Within driving distance to key attractions and located minutes from beautiful dining spots in Caimbridge we couldn’t ask for a better place to stay. We will absolutely be returning and highly recommend this location to others who are looking for a luxurious and memorable stay on the North island.

title: Heaven away from home
text: Make sure you arrive early enjoy to enjoy the glorious park like setting.  We were offered a gin on arrival in the Gin Room which set the scene for a lovely stay.  Our room had everything you would want.  It was also quiet and private.  The breakfast was first class and all inclusive and the service second to none.   Hard to beat.

title: It should be Amazing - but it isn’t
text:
The Henley is a beautiful hotel, in beautiful grounds, recently opened and looking its very best.  

Unfortunately, the same cannot be said about the staff.  On arrival at the hotel, there was no one at reception, so we had to wander around to find someone to check us in.  There were three front of house staff on duty when we arrived, but it all seemed a bit disorganised with no one taking control or responsibility. 

The bedroom and en-suite was beautiful styled, maybe over styled with too many artefacts as the room was small for two people sharing. 

We ate at the hotel, a late lunch on arrival, dinner in the evening and breakfast before we departed - all of which were delicious, well presented with generous portions. The food was excellent. 

Some minor points, dinner was served from 5.30 to 8.30, but the Bar wasn’t open until 6.30, but if you wanted to order a drink, and you  could find a member of staff, then they would serve you.  So when is the bar available? 

The bar is called the Gin Bar, so my husband ordered a G&T, he asked for recommendations of the different tonics that were being offered, but the staff were unable to advise. Also the G&T lacked any garnish - not what you expect from a Gin Bar. 

I think the hotel has some teething problems and that’s such a shame because it could and should be wonderful - staff selection and training desperately needs to be improved.

title: A truly superb, dining experience
text:
Tonight, as I had returned, briefly from Amsterdam,my Mother and Father and I decided to celebrate my return with a culinary experience at the Henley Hotel.
Right from the outset the attentive young lady, catered exceptionally well, and went right out of her way to make the evening most enjoyable.
The attention to detail, with our meal choices had us thinking just how lucky we were.
A superb effort from all involved, in lovely surroundings, a superb evening was enjoyed.
Thank you all.

Sarah Fitzgerald

title: Very happy stay
text: The most friendly and comfortable hotel you will ever stay at. The grounds are so beautiful and clean. The room are very clean and the staff are very friendly and helpful. Our breakfast was very yummy

title: Nice place
text:
Converted estate to make hotel. It is gated as well. Must have reservations or appt. Food was delicious. Beautiful area with a lake nearby.

They need more staff working there though. There was one person doing 5 jobs.

title: A very stylish boutique hotel
text: A truly exceptional hotel, immaculate, with fabulous bathrooms, very stylish interior design,with great attention to detail, and excellent service. The perfect choice for any discerning traveller. An absolute gem.

title: Outstanding Place to Stay
text:
Just spent a long weekend at the Hotel.The room was very spacious and clean and the attention to detail is very good. Staff at the hotel are very welcoming and attentive. All in all this is clearly the only place to stay when visiting the Hamilton/Cambridge area.
We will definitely be back and would certainly recommend it. Thank you all for a lovely stay.

title: My son's wedding WOW.  GREAT PLACE
text:
My son chose this place for his wedding and wow.  What a great choice.   LOVED the venue.  Perfect time of year for the blossoms.  The only time we ate there was for the wedding dinner but that was great.
Wine choice a bit limited but that might have saved me money.
We were the first big group since the massive refurb so a few things still not there, like signage.
Our room was amazing.

title: Beautiful grounds, service lacking
text:
We stayed here for one night after a visit to Hobbiton and, while the grounds are superb, the service is lacking.

We were the only guests but were placed in a standard room overlooking the car park, it would have been nice to stay at the front of the hotel overlooking the beautiful scenery. The pool was freezing cold, the sauna switched off and the hot tub was covered so we had to remove that ourselves.

The dining room was kind of quirky and the music was mixed between every type of style imaginable, even including Christmas music, and the menu did not include a vegetarian option and was quite limited.

The rooms are well presented but there is no drinking water available, unless you purchase it, which is a shame.

title: SERVCE AT THE HIGHEST LEVEL
text:
This lovely lodge was our home for a week whilst we competed at the World Masters Games in Rowing. 

It would be hard to find better service from Bev and Ron and their team. 

The rooms are wonderful and huge. Fire Places and balconies make this lodge unique.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review and lovely comments.  It was a pleasure to welcome your well organised group to Sarnia Park as we enjoyed your company and some of the 'buzz' which the Games brought to the area.  Thank you for coming and we hope that some of you will return to this area and particularly Sarnia Park in the future.

title: Beautiful grounds and very  comfortable stay
text: We had 3 nights at Sarnia Park for my wifes 80th birthday and loved it Beverley and her excellent staff made us so welcome and the chef prepared a special meal for my wife on he birthday which was sublime.The room was huge and bathroom full of aall the toiletries you could wish for. An ideal centre for touring the area

title: Magnificent place in magnificent parl like grounds
text: we went there to celebrate a friends birthday. It was a set lunch with a choice of beef or chicken and a choice of deserts, there was also a choice of wines or beer. Although not always a fan of set menus this time it was extremely good, well presented and the service was excellent. we didn't stay overnight but did get a look at the accommodation which was grandiose, huge rooms bathroom as big as a normal double room and grand sweeping views of the park. People dressed up which was fitting for the surroundings and all in all a marvelous time was had by everyone.

title: Luxury bed & breakfast
text: Beautiful Holiday accommodations! This was our second visit to Sarnia Park; we LOVED it here so much the first time we stayed! Breaky was AMAZING! The English gardens were breathtakingly beautiful. I wanted to get married all over again, the chapel is a perfect place to exchange your vows! A MUST stay for anyone traveling through Cambridge on your way to Hobbiton, or any stop near Hamilton.

title: Overnight stop from waitimo to auckland
text: We really enjoyed our overnight stop here. Beverley made us very welcome and despite having a wedding function on, we still seemed to have plenty of room to explore and enjoy. Breakfast was great, as was a walk around the grounds. Next time we will have 2 nights.

title: Beautiful gardens and a great function venue
text:
We attended our cousin's wedding here and what you notice straight away about this property are the beautiful gardens.  The cherry blossoms and different types of flowers were in full bloom, the hedges were well trimmed.  The host and owner of the property Beverly and her husband were very nice and accommodating and their attention to detail was amazing (just look at the gardens).

The lodge itself is a mansion be-built for gatherings and private dinners and it sets the tone for an intimate get together.

The rooms (sorry i don't know how many) are located upstairs and they are huge ( one of the bathroom is the size of an average bedroom).   The beds are very comfortable.
 
Breakfast can be taken at one of the can be taken in one of the dining areas with a cosy fireplace.

Thank you vey much again Beverly and husband for the great hospitality.

Oscar

title: Mark & Tracy's NZ wedding
text:
From the moment we contacted Bev at Sarnia about travelling over from the UK to hold our wedding ceremony we knew straight away we had chosen the right place.
There were only 4 of us and wanted a very relaxed unplanned day and Bev and her staff made that possible. We arrived the day before and were upgraded into the bridal suite straight away. The rooms and the inside of the house were stunning and we felt like we were staying in someone's home and not a hotel.
We had use of the full beautiful grounds, very spoilt for wedding photographs.
The food we were presented with was outstanding, the best food any of us had ever eaten.
We would highly recommend eating/staying/event at this amazing venue.
We will be returning. Thank you Bev.

title: A lovely function venue
text: We attended anniversary celebrations at Sarnia Park recently.  The venue is very classy and the staff very friendly.  We enjoyed a lovely meal and the desert selection was delicious.  The gardens are lovely and it would be perfect for a wedding.

title: Amazing hospitality, attention to detail and incredible food!
text:
We were warmly invited into Sarnia lodge by management, owners and attendants. We felt welcomed as soon as we entered the premises. Such a serene and peaceful place to stay. The rooms are immaculate and the attention to detail, like the fresh poppies picked from the garden that morning, in the room, don't go Unoticed. 
They seriously look after you! The owners are 24/7 and are incredible hosts. The chef is also very talented and the food is divine. I've stayed in hotels in many places, here and overseas and this place is fantastic. Seriously recommended, for functions, weddings, Devonshire teas, accomodation, food etc. AAA++++ amazing place to stay!

title: Wonderful 2 night stay
text: We really enjoyed our short winter break. The room is beautifully furnished & dressed, the food superb, and all staff so welcoming. Bev made us feel like friends not just hotel guests. The park like grounds are lovely to wonder around. Fresh flowers on all the tables. We really enjoyed reading in the comfy wing chairs by the fire and dining by the fire. It is a   perfect setting for  a very fine dinner. We will return.

title: Didn't stay but let me tell you about the food ...
text: I think Sania Park is without question the very best place to eat in Cambridge. The European inspired menu offers a good choice for all tastes and caters for vegetarians as well. We went for Sunday lunch with a group of 12 and everyone went away very, very happy indeed. Its a beautiful location and a chance to dress up a little and lose yourself in the lovely gardens after lunch and reflect on how life should be. I cant recommend this place highly enough especially for special occasion dining with a group or an intimate romantic lunch with someone special.

title: Georgian architecture, beautiful gardens, flavourful food and warm hospitality.
text: Sarnia Park Boutique Lodge offers the complete package for a wonderful stay. The treelined driveway brings you to an imposing and elegant Georgian residence. The extensive gardens are beautifully landscaped and immaculately maintained. A lake, pergolas, gazebos, seats and an historic chapel dot the gardens. The interior decor complements the exterior architecture; bedrooms are spacious, tastefully decorated and enhanced by Bev’s attention to detail including fresh flowers and homemade biscuits. Breakfast and the three course dinner were interesting flavourful and plentiful. The spa pool is set next to the pool in a lovely glassed atrium, and much appreciated in winter. Bev’s gracious manner and Roy’s helpfulness combine to offer genuine and warm hospitality. A very special place.

title: Posh dining in elegance
text:
The estate at Sarnia presents like an elegant English or European manor house and I felt I should be dressed in Regency clothing to dine appropriately for lunch.

My friend and I had duck leg and pork belly respectively and both mains came moist/cooked to perfection with aromatic sauces and filling accompaniments. Discreet and professional wait staff, dining conversations that are private yet with a sense of echo and history in the dining room and plenty to see inside and through the windows, where apparently cherry blossoms will soon be in bloom.

Will definitely have to find a reason to stay given my first dining experience was excellent. Menu has plenty to satisfy most palates.

title: Thank you Bev!!
text: I had a wonderful stay at this lovely place for one night on August 19th.  The lovely lady Bev received me and took me upstairs to show me the room.  I had a wonderful breakfast next morning which was prepared very well.  On my way out to check out, I found my wallet was missing and you can only imagine how much I was in at that momement.  I was looking all over the place, the bedroom, the dinning room and my car with no avail.  As I was contemplating to cancel the rest of my trips and calling credit card companies to cancel my cards, Bev came out of the door with my wallet in her hand, she found it bewteen the table and bed in the bedroom.  I was so happy so I gave her a big hug and thanked her.  She was my life saver that day and truly demonstrated the highest standard of the Kiwi hosptitality.  I will be back soon to visit!  My short stay in Sarnia has been my best most memorable moment during my travel in NZ.  I will even consider it for my wedding or honeymoon!!  -William W Chrsitian from Tokyo, Japan.

title: lunch (and private tour)
text:
My sister loves going here for lunch. Her daughter is getting married here next year and she keeps going back whenever they have questions relating to the wedding (more fun than a phone call).  This time I happened to visit with them.

We went on a sunny sunday for lunch. There was a steady flow of customers. 
We received very good service with the perfect break between courses.
I asked for the salmon but with a different choice of vegetables than what was on the menu... they were happy to oblige.
My sister said (all the combined visits) her group has now tried all the menu choices and loved them all.

Because of the wedding booking I was lucky enough to get a tour of the upstairs bedrooms (7 rooms). It is all very beautiful.  These will be booked out for the wedding party (and parents). 
The grounds are spread out (lots of photo opportunities) with gardens, open lawns, lake, church and lots of trees.
hotel_response: Thank you for your thoughtful review, the description of the park, and, the service you received at Sarnia Park on a cold but  sunny winters day.  It was a pleasure to see you and your family enjoying the surroundings on Sunday and to witness the excitement of planning a wedding at Sarnia Park.

title: Absolutely Superb
text: We can't speak highly enough of the service at Sarnia. The staff were so helpful and you are not charged for every little thing. There are some lovely touches. We were given a complimentary Devonshire Tea on arrival and thoroughly enjoyed this sitting in front of the fire. The evening meal was stunning, in fact it was so good we immediately booked in for our second night as well. The three courses were presented beautifully. A complimentary taster got the tastebuds excited. Breakfast was just as tasty with homemade marmalade and muesli a real treat. Fresh flowers and homemade biscuits in our room were other nice touches. We spent time wandering through their stunning gardens and on return was offered a coffee or tea. Again this never appeared on our bill. We felt thoroughly spoilt every moment we were there. Nothing was ever too much trouble.
hotel_response: Thank you for your lovely comments.  We really enjoyed seeing you making the most of the fire on such a wet cold weekend. We look forward to welcoming you back to Sarnia Park at some time in the future.

title: Sarnia stay
text:
We have just come back from a lovely two night stay at Sarnia Lodge. We booked the Tui room which although small, had all the facilities one required, including luxury touches such as bathrobes which were worn when visiting the spa pool downstairs.

We were extremely impressed with everything & the warm hospitality, service & genuine interest shown by the owners were exceptional. 
The breakfasts & dinner were of the highest standard, with Bev personally setting our table & presenting each course with impeccable attention to detail. 

The gardens & weather were not at their best due to the time of year & we have promised ourselves to revisit during spring &/or autumn when they must look stunning.

Bev & Roy, you have managed to recapture the elegance & excellence of a bygone era & made us feel very special by sharing your home.

Thank you for a truely memorable experience.

Trevor & Maggie McKeown.
hotel_response: Thank you both for your lovely comments and your company over the two days you stayed at Sarnia Park.  While the weather wasn't the best, and, the garden is in winter mode, I hope you will come in to see it in the spring.

title: Peaceful Lunch
text:
I went to Sarnia Park with five friends today, for lunch.
We arrived at 12.30 pm at 3.40 pm we thought we better go home.
The time had gone by fast as it was so peaceful we could sit and talk to each other.
The meal was very tasty and the young lady serving us was very pleasant.
Thank you 
Looking forward to going back.

title: To the Manor born
text:
Wow - Sarnia Park is a special place. We stayed for 2 nights mid-week during April and had the entire place to ourselves !
The location was much closer to Cambridge than I expected. 
Perfectly quiet location, lovely gardens and grounds - plenty to explore. 
The 'manor' itself is exquisite - very grand due to the Georgian design. The staircase is amazing.
The room (No.5) had a divine bed, great ensuite and even wardrobe/storage room for bags etc.
This place was lovely for our brief treat - and would be perfect for weddings. The chapel is so picturesque. And heaps of spots for photos in the grounds.

title: Magical Gardens Boutique Lodge
text: We had our daughter's wedding here, ideal venue for photographer. Accommodation upstairs several spacious rooms. Stunning park-like groudgs fot for royalty Ideal function venue and church. Inside complex a pool. I also come here for morning tea coffee and real scones with cream and jam so I can write me next book. Beautiful surroundings and only minutes away from Cambridge town. They also do Mother's day special teas and a christmas lunch from noon to 3pm 5 course for $115.00 per person...

title: Truly Beautiful and Peaceful Boutique Lodge
text:
We turned off the highway into a paved road lined with beautiful trees, shrubs, and flowers which ended at the HUGE two-story MANOR.  (which looked exactly as shown on the internet).

The interior was as fantastic as the exterior.  As you entered, your eyes looked immediately to the right to the winding staircase with lush baby blue carpet.

We were greeted by the lovely and friendly MRS. BEV .  She was a super gracious hostess to us during our stay.  She even recommended nearby sites for us to visit plus things for us to do at our next destination in Napier (all of which we thoroughly enjoyed).

Please be sure and book BREAKFAST  which was served in the elegantly decorated dining room and den (fresh roses from her gardens adorned the dining table).  The food was DELICIOUS--fresh squeezed orange juice, fresh fruit, eggs of your choice, bacon, yogurt, homemade bread, coffee or hot chocolate.

The interior was SUPER CLEAN, and the exterior was WELL MANICURED.

Be sure and allow time to TOUR the gardens--lots of roses and azaleas (several colors), purple wisteria plus white impatients for spring or red poppies for winter to add even more color.

We booked the Bridal Suite which was HUGE with a HUGE BATH with lovely tile on walls, floor, and shower plus lovely shaped claw-footed tub.

We only stayed one night but wished we had stayed at least two or more.  There are enough sites within driving distance in the area to warrant staying at least two or three nights.

Stay here and drive to Hamilton Botanical Gardens just 15 minutes away.  Close by visit Bridal Veil Falls near Raglan and  Waitomo Glowworm Cave at Waitomo. 

 Drive around Cambridge and see the spectacular horse-breeding farms with white wood fences, red barns, and lush green pastures.  Cambridge is home to New Zealand's thoroughbred industry.  

Drive about 30 minutes and spend the day visiting HOBBIT TOWN--about a 2 1/2 hour tour, and then shop all the quaint stores in regular part of town. 

In conclusion, our time at this lodge (really an AMAZING ESTATE) and our time in this area was FANTASTIC!!!

title: Manor Expereince
text:
My wife and I have now stayed here twice and loved the experience both times. It is a bit different to our normal tastes, being a manor set in an amazing garden (normally we go for something a bit more modern), but we love it never the less. 

Both times we have stayed in the Weka Room, which is a large room, with two queen size beds, an open gas fire with two extremely comfortable chairs either side - very cosy. The room has a great outlook over the park like grounds, and a great bathroom. Being used to a Californian King, the queen seemed a bit small but nothing to complain about there. The bathroom is well appointed also. Importantly, the rooms are a great temperature without the need for noisy heat pumps or air conditioning. 

The breakfasts are fantastic, and nothing is too much trouble for Bev. The fresh biscuits are a nice touch too. A drink in the library and exploring the rooms, swimming in the heated pool, and soaking in the spa are all great differences. 

Being in close proximity to the Lake Karapiro Rowing Course is also very handy for us. 

i would definitely recommend Sarnia Park  for a romantic weekend away.

title: Lovely surprise - worked out well for a group lunch!
text:
We had a group lunch here and had the place to ourselves...joy!

The property is striking on arrival - beautiful park-like environment with grounds kept really nicely. Just felt well established and peaceful. Entrance to the house is quite grand as is the foyer with it's elegant sweeping staircase up to bedrooms. It's not lavishly decorated or full of antique furniture but nevertheless manages to carry the grandier of an significant residence.   

Staff were obliging and efficient, and very discreet - didn't really see anyone until meals were delivered and plates cleared. The bar is in a small library - well stocked both with books, drinks and trivial games etc. 

Meals were delicious albeit a bit small, but possibly reflected the amount we had available to spend! Everyone enjoyed their meal and the opportunity to walk around the grounds. It was much more enjoyable than having a group meal in a restaurant...much more personal and relaxing. 

A little surprised there was no hint of Christmas at Sarnia - maybe we were a little early. If decoration for an event or at Christmas is important to you, I'd suggest checking what the decor will be on the day. 

The staff worked well together and everything went smoothly. The service was discreet to the point of being invisible until needed. There didn't appear to be a manager or anyone in charge so if you're hosting a big or important event there, I'd suggest checking who will be coordinating things on the day so you have a point of contact if needed.

Thoroughly enjoyed the venue and would definitely return.

title: Perfect place for total R&R
text: We needed a few nights/days of rest, relaxation and peace and quiet. Sarnia Park exactly fit the bill. The food at dinner was wonderful. Being offered breakfast in our room was a great treat and ensured an unhurried start to the day. Staff were friendly and helpful. Scones for afternoon tea was another treat. Perfect.

title: Amazing Discovery
text: We have found this lovely place by chance, passing the sign on our way to Auckland Airport. The charming lady owner, who served us excellent breakfast next morning, showed us the room and we decided to stay and didn't regret. We asked where we can have picnic and she recommended the little altan in the lake - what a treat in the evening, listening to the birds settling for the night and watching an owl to glide by with stars and moon at the background. I'd love to return and see the gardens in the different season.

title: Lifestyle Retreat
text: Personal service and amazing staff, scenic grounds including man-made lake & onsite chapel, lovely accommodation, totally relaxing.  Visited farmers market in town Saturday & nearby to Lake Karapiro Dam.

title: Lord and Lady of the Manor
text: I had visited Sarnia Park gardens before and put it on my list of "places to stay".   It is a modern mansion, perfect for weddings being large and spacious.  There is a grand staircase and I could just imagine a bride sweeping down in a gorgeous gown.  There is also a chapel on site and a function room.  But we were just having a couple of nights away for a special occasion.   We upgraded to the bridal suite and it was fabulous.  Dual aspect so we caught what sun there was on the first day.  Bev was our hostess and I was wondering at one stage if there were any other staff, because she seemed to do everything effortlessly.   However our chef, Mark, prepared the most wonderful four course meal on our second night.    We could only manage the continental breakfast the next morning, a shame because we had sampled the "big breakfast" the day before.  The gardens are beautiful with a man made lake.  I took advantage of the large indoor swimming pool and had a soak in the hot tub, both located in the very large conservatory and it was nice to look out at the pouring rain on our second day.  We did visit a bird sanctuary close by and took advantage of Cambridge for shopping but Sarnia Park is a place you can just chill out and enjoy.   There is also a very well stocked library.  We were the only people staying and we certainly felt as though we were lord and lady of the manor having the complete run of the place.  The fabrics and furnishings are superb quality; the bed linen crisp and lush and the bathroom was absolutely huge.   I could not fault it, simply beautiful. Thank you Bev.

title: A wonderful experience in a great location
text: A mid week get away turned into something special at Sarnia Park. Fabulous accommodation - the most comfortable room ever! Lovely food served in the elegant dining room set in beautiful surroundings. A special place to relax and a central base to explore the surrounding area. We didn't have time to take advantage of the bicycles or the pool and spa, so we would love to return in the summer and enjoy and also see the garden in a different season. Will recommend to our friends for sure.

title: Well worth the drive to Cambridge from Waitomo
text:
We were recommended Sarnia Park by our guide Neill (Time Unlimited tours). It was a little bit of a detour from Waitomo Caves where we visited to see the spellbinding glow worms and it was after dark when we arrived. 

Beth of Sarnia Park made us feel warm and welcomed the minute we checked it!  She was a sweet old lady, an octogenarian according to Neill but her agility and presence of mind belied her age. In fact she was the only person we saw during our overnight stay - she showed us to our rooms, took our preferred time for dinner, was there to host and serve us for dinner, and even stayed to chat a bit with us after dinner in the drawing room. 

The English garden like surrounds of Sarnia Park was its drawing point but we will stay at Sarnia Park again simply because of Beth!  She was so attentive to every detail that we thought she would have spent many years in the hospitality industry, but no!  Beth had been an IT educator (even teaching post-retirement) until recently when she and her husband acquired Sarnia Park.

title: A Wonderful boutique Hotel
text: My wife and I had a two night stay which we thoroughly enjoyed. Great presentation and attention from the hosts Beverly and Roy. The rooms are large and well appointed. The arranged evening meal was excellent - nice presentation of very good food. Very good wine selection and a very wholesome, family style breakfast . The grounds including the long driveway are a delight and the lake was full of ducks. Wonderful little chapel also on site. We look forward to our next visit.

title: Superb in every respect !
text:
Beautiful grounds and gardens,Stunning and HUGE room (room 1)which was immaculately presented, very warm welcome,superlative food !
What a hidden gem.
Right up there with the best in New Zealand, which is up there with the best in the world !

title: Amazing Stay!
text: Stunning house with stunning grounds. Bev was really nice. Breakfast was nice. Location was little bit out of the " town centre " but it was a nice drive. This place was one of our best stays in New Zealand! The Free Wifi was very fast. Hope to get the chance to come back.

title: Amazing place to stay!
text: Stayed two nights at this wonderful hidden gem in Cambridge, New Zealand. One of the most enjoyable places I have stayed in quite a while. Everything first class.....the owners are just marvelous.  Bev and her husband handled all our needs. Full breakfast was included with our stay and everything made to order, including the homemade pastries and specialty coffee. All meals could be had at a cost. This place has it all, including a wedding chapel and banquet facilities if one wanted to get married. The facility  and grounds are very large and one could even take a stroll through the garden or walk around the grounds as there are many places to check out. And very quiet too. Would highly recommend checking this place out. They went above and beyond our needs. Would definitely stay here again whenever in the area. Thank you so much!

title: Sarnia- most unique luxury hotel in north island
text:
Stunning property
Beautifully maintained
Very attentive staff
Beverly- head in charge is warm and lovely person 
Food was personalised to our taste by the chef Sebastian 
Gardens are huge and well maintained
Cycling is great outdoor thing to do

title: Conference at Sarnia Park
text: We have just attended a conference at Sarnia Park and experienced the facilities, food and service over a three day period. The venue was excellent for our needs and staff and service were superb. The food was wonderful as we had morning and afternoon tea, lunch and full evening dining. Each day was different and wonderfully cooked and presented by the staff. We had a great time and cannot fault the service or the wonderful accomodation and amazing grounds. The gardens were beautifully maintained and at this time of year so striking with the trees in blossom. If you are thinking of this place for a wedding, conference or a weekend away its just a lovely setting.

title: We loved it!
text:
We recently spent a weekend at Sarnia Park Lodge, staying through Sunday night, to celebrate my husband's birthday. What a beautiful place! The grounds and gardens are just breathtaking, and so well maintained! With the cherry trees and tulips in bloom, it was the perfect setting for a spring getaway. And the hotel itself is so luxurious. A purpose built lodge in the Georgian style, all of the amenities are catered for. My only criticism is that they really need to add to the decor and furnishings. There is a huge, but mostly empty main hall and many of the larger rooms (that we peeked into!) could use more furniture to make them more inviting. But we were in the Tui Room, one of the smaller ones, and it was just charming and perfect for us. The bed was really comfortable and I loved the big walk in closet with shelving for all of our things. I am usually disappointed by the lack of space in hotel rooms, both for clothes and especially for bathroom storage, but we had plenty of both at Sarnia Park.

But the real standouts in our visit were the service and the food. We were there on a grabone deal that included two nights, breakfast two days and a three course dinner one night. Sometimes on taking advantage of these deals, we feel treated like second class citizens. But not at Sarnia Park! We got every bit of service and accommodation as if we had paid full price, and we will very likely return, even at those prices, as it was well worth it! We loved our delicious breakfasts, and the 3-course dinner was superb. We had our dinner on Sunday night as the only guests staying at the hotel, and felt a little bad about it, that the chef and maitre d' had to work that night just for the the two of us. But we were served with wonderful, professional and friendly service and never once felt that we were putting anyone out. We were served at a small, private table in the lovely and very welcoming common room, with fire going and a view to the garden. Really lovely.

No complaints, we loved Sarnia Park, really enjoyed our stay and will return. It's a really special place and a special thanks to Sebastian for the great service!

title: One of a kind
text: 1st Class accommodation, fabulous surroundings, heated indoor pool & spa, 100yr old chapel, ducks on the lake, peaceful, relaxing, superb food & wine, extremely helpful & thoughtful Hosts. Highly recommend staying here in luxury @ Sarnia Park!

title: Brilliant breath-taking experience
text:
This place was absolutely amazing! Beverly was so lovely, and Sebastian was brilliant. Everyone there seemed to really CARE about us and our experience. I went with my partner and it was so wonderful, not once did we feel like "customers" or "just money." They were polite and always chatted to us and actually took an interest in what we were doing and how we were. They told us good bike tracks to go on, and were so friendly it felt like we were part of the family! 
The location is absolutely BEAUTIFUL, the Lodge itself is divine! It's like we were Royalty for the time we were there. The meals were delightful and the effort put into providing such perfect delicious breakfast and dinner was breath-taking. I would HIGHLY recommend this Lodge to ANYONE who is looking for a beautiful place in gorgeous scenery with huge rooms and beauty in every room. It's a relaxing get-away and is always very well looked after and clean. 
Thanks so much Bev and the team, we are definitely coming back!!

title: Exquisite delightful experience
text: Thank you so much for having us before the bike race in August. The property is gorgeous and we particularly love the chapel. The fireplace in the room was lovely, and the service simply excellent. Can't want to come back during spring and summer time for the garden.

title: Just perfection.
text: I stayed here with my partner for a couple of days and it was just fantastic. Bev was so accommodating and made the whole place feel very homely. The food was fantastic and the garden was breathtakingly beautiful. I will definitely stay here again! :-)

title: Accomodation
text:
Many Thanks to Beverly and the Staff at Sarnia Park.
We attended a Wedding which was the perfect location and fortunate to have stayed onsite.
Great Breakfast and very polite staff.
The pool was clean and the grounds were well groomed.
Food was good at the function.

title: Wonderful wedding venue...
text: Thank you Sarnia Park staff and owners for an amazing experience for my daughters wedding yesterday ...it will long be remembered for the smooth and precise running of a wedding and reception.  Planning of the wedding and catering for the changes in weather were well rehearsed.  We had a wonderful day and thoroughly recommend this venue to anyone wanting stress free planning and owners well practiced in the art of entertaining a large number of people. Thank you again....
hotel_response: Thank you for your positive and thoughtful comments.  It was a beautiful wedding and it was our pleasure to be involved in the planning with the bride and groom as it is then so easy to co-ordinate things on the day.

title: Such a wonderful experience
text:
We were lucky enough to choose Sarnia Park for our small, intimate wedding.   It was a wonderful day, and everything was as we wished it to be.   Bev our host could not have been more pleasant or helpful in planning our wedding.  We and our guests were greeted and well looked after.   We were made to feel at home, rather than as hotel guests.   The lodge was warm and welcoming, and the meal was superb - enjoyed by everyone without exception.   The grounds are beautifully laid out and cared for, and the chapel could not have been better suited to our needs.   Thanks to Bev and her team.   We have magic memories of our special day.

David and Patricia R.

title: Great place to visit amazing location
text: I really enjoyed my visit to Sarnia Park. It is an amazing location. Great hosts. This place has a lot to offer all age groups. Highly recommend you visit the rose gardens and the church. Place not to be missed.

title: Simply Amazing
text: We were lucky enough to be invited to a wedding at Sarnia Park last year and because of the amazing food, scenery and building we decided to treat ourselves to a night at Sarnia while visiting family close by.  The way we were greeted made us feel like celebrities.  Bev is the best host we have ever had the pleasure of meeting.  We took a walk around the gardens, which are beautiful at the time of the year and visited the chapel and it's beautiful stained glass windows.  Our four year old son enjoyed a swim in the heated indoor pool, then finally to dinner in surroundings that left me totally gobsmacked.  The interior design and decorating is as amazing as the exterior of this venue. The staff were amazing and the food nothing less than incredible. The set menu was divine, and they catered for our son creating the best chicken and chips he will ever have. The room we stayed in was absolute luxury, a five star for this place is just not enough.  I have never stayed anywhere that comes close to this standard.

title: Truly  Magnificent
text:
We recently attended a wedding at Sarnia Park. We had heard glowing reports of this venue. Were we impressed - you bet we were. It is a truly magnificent complex.  The grounds can only be described as stunning - a photographers dream. The wedding ceremony was held outdoors  in just one of the beautifully manicured private hedged settings - then onto an adjoining area for photos, refreshments and games - and then to a most memorable reception - - still outdoors - in yet another area under a canopy of overhanging branches.
The food put forward for the wedding breakfast was simply superb.
Finally, we moved indoors to the ballroom to conclude the days celebrations.
Well done Sarnia Park - it is hard to imagine a better venue anywhere in New Zealand - and your staff were excellent.
Your Qualmark rating of 5 star barely does justice to what we experienced. Just wish we had stayed on in the accommodation on offer..

title: A touch of Elegance
text: This visit was purchased at a Child Cancer Charity Golf Tournament - dinner, accommodation and breakfast for one day.  First contact to confirm booking was very pleasant and helpful/accommodating.  Travelling instructions obtained from their website proved excellent.  Entering the driveway we did not know what to expect and were so pleasantly surprised.  Reception entrance was huge, high ceiling and glorious stairwell to upstairs accommodation.  Large comfortable room, very comfortable bed, hot roomy shower and canapes at 6.45pm for dinner at 7pm.  Walking down the wide stairwell I remarked "hello Clark Gable I feel like Vivian Leigh in the 1920's" as we descended to the music of Frank Sinatra.  We were fortunate to be the only guests this Monday/Tuesday after a large wedding that weekend with another the following weekend.  The dinner was delicious, presentation as good as any top restaurant in Auckland and cocktails very yummy.  Breakfast by the pool in the morning and off to play golf on the way home.  You will love this experience as we did.  Hosts were enchanting and very hospitable.  Thank you Bev and Rob.

title: Perfect Hospital Location
text: Perfectly located to Waikato Hospital. We had a 2 bedroom apartment which was well appointed with adequate space. Comfy beds & excellent bed linen. Washing Machine handy as was the single drawer dishwasher. Highly recommend

title: Bright, clean spacious apartment in Hamilton.
text: This is a great place. We stayed only one night but it would be ideal if you were staying longer as it is very well well equipped. Everything is new and comfortable. There is a living room / kitchen, a shower room, and a bedroom with queen bed. It even has a small outside area where you could sit as well as a line to dry clothes.

title: Somewhat tired hotel rescued by excellent staff
text:
We would agree with two regular themes mentioned in reviews - the hotel is a little tired and the location out of town is such that there is nothing really in the way of facilities like restaurants and bars within a reasonable walking distance.  Whilst we there the hotel also had a rather ghostly feel, being very quiet.

However, despite all these comments it was actually quite a good stay here.  The room was a good size, car parking wasn't a problem but most of all the staff were excellent and the restaurant food was surprisingly good.

The ghostly feel seems to be a result of its primary function as a conference centre and we must have been between conferences - we were told it was fully-booked the following week.

The limitations didn't prove to much of a problem for us in the end, so we were quite happy with our stay here, but you need to be aware of them when considering a stay.

title: Distincton Hamilton
text: A nice budget hotel. Standard rooms have King and Queen size beds. Clean and reasonably quiet at night. Set in grounds near to park and racecourse. Not much choice for eateries locally in walking disrance so dined in restaurant which was good value for money as enormous portions. Second night we had food to share. Good value for money and reasonable location.

title: Very nice place to stay
text:
My husband and I stayed here one night before taking the Northern Explorer scenic train. The room was very spacious with two comfy chairs as well as places to put our suitcases. The water pressure in the shower was very strong, which I LOVED but my husband didn’t really like. The only downside was the shower had one of those glass doors without a rubber gasket at the bottom so the water leaked out a bit even if you pointed the shower head the other way. 

The room was a bit musty smelling and damp, but cleared up pretty well when we turned the aircon on. 

The front desk was really helpful. We got Indian takeout for dinner and when I asked the front desk for some silverware they gave me a full set of dishes to use. 

We purchased the breakfast the next morning and it was really good and worth the cost. They will make you eggs to order for no extra charge, and have all the other full breakfast fixings on their buffet. They have instant coffee for free or you can order espresso for an added charge.

title: Rather dated but Functional
text:
Our double room in the 400 wing was spacious but unfortunately very dark as it received no sun at any time of the day. Im sure updating hotels is a very expensive business, but frankly the room seemed a bit tired and would benefit from a refresh.

Very accommodating staff and  good food which was appreciated.

title: 100 Garnett Avenue, Hamilton.    A rare GEM in a great Country.
text: A really great place to unwind after a long flight from Perth W.A.  We stayed four days here and the staff in total were EXCELLENT.  Nothing was too much trouble for them, even when I had a problem trying to telephone back home to Australia, they assisted me at no charge at all.    Great place to dine, relax & prepare for your flight back home.   WELL DONE TO ALL STAFF, ESPECIALLY COLIN AT RECEPTION.

title: Little tired and soulless
text: Good sized room- away from town centre. Has a captive clientele for restaurant. Nowhere to go without transport.  Restaurant  area no atmosphere. Room was large with comfy armchairs. Good bed and very cleanexcept for. Extractor fan in bathroom needs a look at- don't think been cleaned in months.

title: Nice hotel; location not central
text:
I stayed here for two nights in March 2025.

The hotel is fine.  The room was tidy and well equipped, and there was no noise.  The wifi worked well.  I was here for a conference, and the hotel is very suitable for a conference as the conference rooms were large, and the lunches were wonderful!

The only drawback is that the hotel is located in the suburbs of Hamilton.  There is a small shopping centre about 200 metres away with places to buy food but, apart from that, the hotel is in the middle of a suburban area, so there is not much around.  It's ok if you have a car.  There's plenty of carparking.

I would stay here again if attending a conference or if I'm using a car.
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind words

title: Perfectly adequate for a one night stay
text: This is really a one night hotel unless you’re on a conference. The room was nice but with a strong smell of bleach, the food was adequate and there was plenty of parking, it was a little far from the town centre. It had plenty of parking and a laundry room which is always useful when travelling
hotel_response: Hi Simon,  Thank you for your review.

title: Distinction hotel Hamilton New Zealand
text: Restaurant had the most amazing meals, friendly and knowledgeable staff, had a book exchange ( for the book lovers), gym   Although a little old was still functional stair master a killer!!  updated rooms - comfortable bed - will be staying again
hotel_response: Thank you very much for your kind comments.

title: Bit out of the town but staff excellent.
text: The hotel was v busy as it is a conference centre. It is not the place to go if you are on holiday as it is well away, not walking distance, from the town.  Main attraction was a very pleasant open lounge area where you could also dine- as well as the restaurant where breakfast was served. Food was really good and average priced. Staff were young in the bar and restaurant but gave excellent, pleasant service with a smile even though they were clearly busy. We had been allocated a 3rd floor room with no lift (and poorly husband), so asked for a swap. The Duty Manager ( Mike Smythe) went out of his way to sort it for us and got us a ground floor room very quickly, even helping with the cases. He was really helpful throughout our stay. Breakfast good and room large and comfy. Would stay again. The convenience of the meals and bar, reasonably priced was a bonus.
hotel_response: Thank you very much for your kind words and we trust that you have a wonderful Festive season.

title: Highly recommend this for accommodation.
text:
Clean and a well kept old style hotel with affable staff and good facilities. Lots of car parking and right across the road from Water World. 
The only reason I didn’t give it 5 was because they were unprepared for a busy Saturday night during a long weekend when they had a hotel filled with children there for a tournament. We waited a very long time for meals but the service staff kept their calm and remained professional through the ruckus. I was really impressed with their patience because it was pretty noisy.
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind words.  I agree that we were unprepared for the amount of meals on Saturday night but under normal circumstances, families do not always use the restaurant.

title: Noisy rooms
text: The battery was flat in the remote for the heating. We had to get themreplaced at reception. The heating was noisy and we couldn’t sleep with the heat pump on low due to loud  noises. Then, someone in another room took a shower at 10.40pm and that  was exceptionally noisy. I wouldn’t stay here again. Way too noisy for me.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to post a review.  I am happy that the staff changed the battery for the remote.  I am sorry that you found the rooms noisy.  We can unfortunately not do much about it.

title: Happy to stay again.
text: We would stay here again. Staff were fantastic. We were in Hamilton for a pressure at the Hospital. They made our stay relaxing and we felt welcome at a time of stress. While the place would benefit with an upgrade, it was clean and comfortable. The meal we had was great. Well done.
hotel_response: Thank you very much for your kind words.  We strive hard to make our guests fell welcome.

title: Old world charm - fresh modern rooms!
text: LOVE this hotel - the beautiful wooden-walls of the lobby were an impressive first impression! Very friendly staff & well appointed room. We enjoyed our stay & would highly recommend Distinction Hotel to anyone visiting New Zealand. The Distinction Hotels we stayed at had old world charm with modern rooms, great amenities & excellent service!
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your positive comments and we are pleased that you enjoyed staying with us.

title: Terrible service
text: We attended an awards evening for a national championship event at the distinction hotel conference rooms. The service was appalling. There was no one overseeing the event. We ran out of water at our table after everyone filled their glasses and returned the jug ourselves for a refill but it never came. The buffet table ran out of food, particularly the meats and there was a long wait for it to be replenished. There was no one clearing away plates or empty bottles from the tables. The organisers of the function had to do it themselves until the hotel manager could finally be found. Then the dessert table ran out of food half way through as well. I would certainly never book a function here after this experience! Terrible service and very embarrassing for the hosts.
hotel_response: Thank you for your comments.  The matter was dealt with yesterday, with the Organiser and the relevant departments have been dealt with.

title: Great Family room
text:
Family room perfect for our family of 5 - so great to find a room that actually fits 3 kids in their own beds (and in their own room!) Comfy beds, very spacious room. 2 sinks in bathroom saves a lot of fighting and shower pressure was good. Bathroom could do with an update as tiles/grout getting a bit grubby and spa bath was broken. 
Staff were all super friendly and helpful - special mention to the restaurant staff who were fantastic and went out of their way to help us - best breakfast buffet ever! 
Parking was easy and very close to room. 
Highly recommend for families.
hotel_response: Thank you very much for your kind words.

title: Dated but not terrible
text:
You get a grand start to this hotel due to the size of the reception area, its huge! We got a superior triple room, which had two double beds & a single bed in one single room. Perfect for our family, for a single night stay we thought, except the beds were very close to each other and that didn't lend itself to a good night sleep with kids that move around a lot. We would get a family suite next time with a separate sleeping space for the adults.

The room itself was nice and clean, well stocked bathroom, good tv, so I would stay there again, just maybe on a couple's holiday. I must say that the entry foyer for the rooms was very low & dark, in direct contrast to the reception foyer, but that was a minor observation. Plenty of car parking located outside the rooms,
hotel_response: Thank you for your comments

title: Highly recommended!
text: Very good hotel. Lots of parking space. Very friendly and polite, enthusiastic staff both at reception as well as in the restaurant. Clean, spacious and tidy room, great selection at breakfast and dinner, well worth including it in your booking, real good food quality. Their hotel deal 'Bed & Breakfast For 2 - Hamilton' is highly recommended!
hotel_response: Thank you very much for your kind words

title: Great place to stay
text: The hotel is on the outskirts of hamilton centre and is accessed by bus, taxi or if you have a hire car. The hotel is sited over a large area with different blocks housing the rooms. The rooms themselves cater for your needs, safe, coffee making facilities aircon and fridge. The rooms need modernising but were still cleaned to a high standard. There is a small gym, restaurant and a bar within the main complex. Staff were  brilliant, friendly and helpful. Overall not a bad stay just the location msy cause issues for others
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind words.

title: Ok but probably won't be back
text: A little dated. The room was a good size but had a musty/smoky smell. I was there for business, and the stay was arranged through work. If I was looking myself, knowing what I now know, I would prefer to book somewhere else.
hotel_response: Hi, I am sorry that you round the room smoky.  Please just ask to be moved to a new room in future and we will happily change the room.

title: She's big and old but her she's got a good heart
text:
While the buildings are a bit tired the rooms are super-comfortable with new carpeting, cosy beds, great water pressure and very lovely rooms. Service was excellent and friendly. Be sure to get the buffet breakfast for a great start to your day. 
Rooms were quiet too. 
The Bar area is comfortable and clean although the decor is a bit 90s - did not affect our ability to have a lovely drink and dinner one iota.
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind words.  The whole foyer and bar area is due for an upgrade next year and we are looking forward to the work being done.

title: Great Stay
text: A hotel on the pricier side but we enjoyed our two night stay. The room was comfortable, quiet and warm. Shower pressure and temperature good. Free onsite parking. We had a breakfast package and it’s probably the best buffet selection of cooked and continental options I have ever seen. Would stay again.
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind words and we are happy that you enjoyed your stay.

title: Convenient and comfortable
text:
We stayed 1 night while passing through Hamilton.  We stayed in the 100 wing which I presume must be one of the older wings, yes it is dated but clean, comfortable and roomy, nice and quiet at night.

The highlight for our family was the buffet breakfast, (which started at 6.30 on the Saturday we were there) the dining area is dated as well but huge. The buffet had so much food to choose from, something for everyone. Kids loved the pancake machine and array of toppings. 

Probably wouldn’t stay more than 1 night but just what we needed while travelling through
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind words.

title: Pick a little fruit and you are out!
text: There must be 20-30 different various varieties of citrus trees surrounding the enormous car park – I suspect originally planted by an amazing gardener from years gone by for hotel use and guests to enjoy as I have seen other hotels/airbnbs do. As paying guests, we made the innocent mistake of genuinely admiring the trees, and picking half a dozen fruit (the fruit was literally rotting all over the ground – I wish I had taken photos to post here but we were frog-marched off the property so quickly I didn’t have time) – we literally only picked a small amount and just assumed as paying guests it would be okay given the copious amount of fruit (most NZers are only too happy for people to take excess fruit and save a big rotting mess on the ground). Big, BIG mistake. A VERY hostile Manager came marching over and without question ordered us to “Do ourselves a favour and get in your car and leave now”. Wow. He was extremely aggressive and would not even listen to our apology and let us return the small amount of fruit – we were just told to get out (even though we were paying guests – so we had to check out early for our ‘crime’). According to the hostile manager, the fruit ‘is only for staff and for hotel cooking’ (again I stress there is SO much fruit - they must make a lot of marmalade?). I suspect the issue was more of a territorial issue than about who took 'his' fruit. We were mortified, so after trying again to offer our apology and explain we were guests so thought it okay given there was so much fruit and no signs, aggressive manager refused to engage with us – would not reason with us except to stand behind a fence and tell us ‘some lemons would be okay but not the other citrus’.  So – my advice is to avoid encountering that level of aggressive hostility and embarrassment, don’t make the mistake of admiring or taking any of the copious amounts of citrus fruit. There are no signs to say you cannot pick any of the huge amounts of fruit or rotting fruit off the ground – perhaps the hotel should put some up as I am sure we were not the first to make this mistake?  My personal view is that someone that hostile should not be in management - or he could learn how to constructively engage with guests - was our 'crime' really that bad?  We would have been only too happy to leave the little fruit we had as were deeply upset to have caused such a level of trauma to this angry manager.  Other comments are that the complex is very dated and carpets filthy. A strange and highly unwelcoming place to stay - we were only too happy to leave after that encounter!
hotel_response: Thank you for your letter, but along with most things in life,  please could I have some fruit would have been the right way to go about things. We have many fish and chip shops that seem to think that it is their right to just  drive in and help themselves and there was no way of anyone knowing who you were at the time.

title: Family Weekend Away
text:
We recently stayed at the Distinction Hotel in Hamilton, as a family. First impressions when arriving at the hotel is that it is very run down, with the exterior in need of a lot of work and many of the common areas inside looking very tired. 

Check in was quick and the front desk staff were very welcoming. 

We stayed on the second floor which was only accessible by stairs. The exterior door also has to be unlocked with the room key. This did make the arrival and departure process a little bit tricky, trying to navigate the locked door and a staircase with our luggage and two small children. With that said, I am sure that a ground floor room could be requested. 

The breakfast buffet was fantastic, you simply could not dream of more menu options to choose from! The food was tasty and well presented. The restaurant staff were lovely and very hospitable. 

We stayed in one of the refurbished rooms and it was really nice, with comfortable beds and pillows. 

The thing that really lets the hotel down is the cleanliness. You can see past a tired interior if it is clean, but this hotel unfortunately is not. The hallways and stairways were noticeably bad, with everything from food that had been dropped and then stepped on and crushed into the carpet through to leaves and mud. They definitely were not vacuumed once the entire time that we were there. Our bathroom had not been cleaned, there was hair on the shower walls and floors, marks all over the mirror and the floor was visibly dirty. There were also half-eaten lollies and wrappers on the ground in the main part of the room. We did phone Reception to give them the opportunity to hopefully rectify the situation for us, but all they could do was advise that the house keeping team was short staffed. 

You can definitely look past the run down areas of the hotel as the refurbished rooms, great breakfast buffet and friendly staff overshadow those things. They really just need to sort the housekeeping side of the business out, that would be the thing that would prevent us from staying again but I genuinely hope that it was just a one-off.
hotel_response:
Dear Heidi,
Thank you for your constructive comments,  I will most definitely take the matter up with Housekeeping.  The 500 wing which you were in in particularly bad as there are leaves that get trodden into the carpet and I have made Housekeeping aware of this on a number of occasions.  I knew that you had spoken with the Duty Manager on Friday as it was in our daily reports.
It is true that we were tight on Housekeeping staff on Friday, but that is not an excuse not to clean the room properly.
Kind Regards
Colin

title: Matariki weekend stay.
text:
Stayed 3 nights over a long weekend.
Quiet clean room in 400 block which was great.
Plenty of parking space.
Buffet breakfast was awesome even when under staffed, which is understandable in NZ at the moment. Staff were  friendly and attentive.

Would stay again
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind words

title: Good for the price
text: The room was well appointed, comfortable bed, nice pillows and linen and clean. There were some cracked tiles in the bathroom, but other than that is was perfectly suitable for the price. The staff are very friendly. Breakfast at $38 I thought was a bit expensive. The grounds could definitely do with some work, paint the buildings and tidy the grounds along with planting some gardens would be of benefit as from the outside the hotel looks terrible.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review.  Breakfast is $36.00 per person and the gardens are a work in progress.

title: Overall a plesant experience
text: Our week long stay at the Distinction Hamilton hotel for a Dragon boat festival was comfortable and the food was very good. The staff were very helpful and responded to our few requests promptly. The manager "Niel" was busting his butt due to a shortage of service staff personnel within the restaurant. The beds were very comfortable and the room was neat and tidy. The hallway carpeting does need cleaning/replacement.
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind comments Brian.  Neil is a good man and the staff shortages in the country at the moment have put pressure on everybody.  The carpet is due to be replaced as no amount of cleaning helps.

title: No recommended
text: We were on a tour of the island and this hotel was used for two nights of the tour.  The first night dinner was provided but the second night had to get a taxi to town to find a decent restaurant.  The room and bathroom were not clean.  The carpet felt tacky.  Breakfast was very basic.   Very disappointed and would not recommend.
hotel_response: I am sorry that you felt this way and wish that you had brought the bathroom to our attention whilst you were here as we would have been able to move you.  It is interesting that you say that our breakfast is very basic as we have many comments about how extensive it is and that it has one of the largest choices that they have seen in the country.

title: Good stay
text: We had to change our plans at the last minute due to the stormy weather and moved here for 2 nights. The hotel is far better than 1st impressions! Whoever designed this hotel needs to think again!! Colour schem and decor are terrible! Staff were very friendly and helpful - thank you.
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind response and we are glad that we were able to assist

title: one night stay
text:
1,  Booking confirmation email unable to be opened
2. Outside appearance of the property is discusting
3. Room was average, cleaning average, beds comfortable.
4. Arrived and wanted to watch Bathurst - sky wouldnt work, contacted reception who sent duty manager.  He thought he got Sky, but said he didnt have it at home and when he left there was still no Sky sport - very disappointing.
5.  The whole place in need of a big update.
6. At $200 for 2 people we expected a lot more.  Wouldnt stay again.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review.  We only have a bouquet of 4 channels for Sky.  I am sorry that Bathhurst was not available to you

title: Dirty and disgusting
text: Used coffee cups in the room from previous guests. Curtains hanging off the rail. Hairs in the sink and beard hairs around the sink. Sticky substance and crumbs in the fridge. The room definitely wasn’t cleaned, maybe just the bed was made up, it made us feel so uncomfortable to stay. When we mentioned it to the front desk we were only told that they will talk to house keeping. I would never stay there again and would encourage people to avoid as there was no resolution made for our issue. To finish this all off we payed $258 for one night of this dirty room. We are so disappointed and want our money back
hotel_response: I apologise for our shortcomings and this has been taken up with the Housekeeping department.

title: Don’t bother
text:
Positives - large refurbished room comfy bed and pillows. Great front counter team. 
Things to work on - housekeeping poor there were hairs through the bathroom and blood on the toilet roll holder. Carpet in corridor to room was filthy. Treadmill in gym broken and not working and water dispenser filthy. Spa and pool not in use. I had a cooked breakfast and at $35 was certainly not worth it.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review.  The carpet in the corridors is soon to be replaced and unfortunately the pool and spa complex has been permanently closed.

title: Just what we needed after a long stay in Hospital
text:
I have rated this hotel higher because your rooms are just lovely.. they have been refurbished to a very high quality...furnishings and decor etc... one of the nicest rooms I have been in.
The bed was large and super comfy. A very large room.   Shower was great and bathroom was perfectly fine.
There was plenty of choice for the tea and coffee.
My only fault was that you advertised you had SKY TV...,you did not....I rang reception and they said there was connection issues, so we just had normal TV channels which was OK.
A real shame in an otherwise great room and stay.
hotel_response: Thank you for your positive response

title: Tired, dirty and overpriced
text:
Incredibly disappointed with this accommodation.
Room is tired and carpet has what appears to be blood drops on it. No bath mat or clothes hangars in the room. Staff were apologetic about hangars but at $300 a night, the least they could do is present a clean well stocked room, serviced daily. 
I avoided the restaurant as pricing was unreasonable.
Do not stay here as the poor staff are putting people into rooms that should be out of commission.

title: Very disappointed
text:
Spent 5 nights. Room wasn't serviced in whole stay - you have to request a room service. Requested room coffee supplies to be replenished which partially happened after a second request and long wait . 
Room appears to have been recently reviewed but the rest of the hotel is showing signs of lack of maintenance for a long time.
Definitely not worth the rates they are charging given the service (or lack thereof) and facilities.

title: Quiet and comfortable
text: We stayed for one night. The staff was very friendly. The room was recently refurbished and was very quiet as the hotel is located off the main road. So we had a good quality of sleep. The hotel is 5km away from the CBD and no eateries are nearby. It was not a matter for us as we had a car. We tried their buffet breakfast, Decent choices and food was fresh. I noticed many families with kids staying at this hotel. It is a good choice for family holiday.
hotel_response: Thanks very much

title: Okish
text: Stayed for 2 nights. Room is big and spacious. Bathroom is big too with superb water pressure. Mattresses were not comfortable, too soft. Pillows were either too soft or too hard. Cleanliness in the room and in the common area - ok ok. Car park is massive. Restaurant- good breakfast.
hotel_response: Thanks for posting a review- we appreciate it

title: Bearable MIQ
text:
I found this to be the best place to be in MIQ. It helps that the hotel has a huge car park that guests could walk around at the designated times. I enjoyed my stay in MIQ at this facility. I didn't physically interact with staff, so I don't know what to say about them.
The hotel could do with a few more TV channels.

title: This Hotel needs to be taken off MIQ
text:
Terrible on all fronts. Food is disgusting. Staff incredibly rude and unhelpful. Some parts of the roof inside of the building is falling in after a little bit of rain.
If you get this place for MIQ you are one of the very unlucky ones! Be prepared to order food in. Also be prepared to be told completely contradictory information on a daily basis. A huge thumbs down!!

title: Terrible food
text:
I have had to stay at this hotel twice for quarantine coming into New Zealand. The hotel itself is ok for what is 3 star, I mean its basic, but there are worse places to stay. The Food however - wow, it is terrible, and I dont mean a little terrible - its really bad.
I know the hotel has to work within a budget, but I have friends that have stayed in different locations and from the pictures, their food is leaps and bounds over the stuff the Distinction serves up.

9 times out of 10 it turns up cold, it looks to me like they have 2 people (maybe 3) delivering the food to the hotel guests - I have seen the delivery start, yet it can be 45 mins before it would come anywhere close to me so I get the cold - and thats just bad logistics from the hotel.

Most of the time its well overcooked, they put a salad in with breakfast nearly everyday (salad - breakfast - by salad I mean leafs). Vegetables are soggy, meats over cooked - and some stuff I don't even know what it is - look, I  cant describe it, its just very very poor, and it was the same both times Ive stayed - and remember, we are paying $3100 to stay in a 3 star hotel and crap food - they should do better.

When I stayed there in December 2020, the first time, in the middle of the two week stay they provided fresh towels and sheets -  this time, they offered nothing - again, quite poor considering the cost that is passed on.

title: Rat food for you to try
text: If you haven't tried rat food yet, the Distinction Hotel Hamilton is here for you to get this incredible experience. Being a human, I have thrown away 2/3 of the Hotel's served food as it was next to impossible to swallow. 1/3 was eaten only because I was too hungry during my Covid stay in this dismal place. Some receptionists were quite nasty, too. The only positive side of things was quite clean bed sheets (towels were grayish and some even stained, though). So, I'd suggest you avoid this place in Hamilton.

title: managed isolation
text: Did my two weeks quarantine at distinction and it was great. Food was amazing and staff/army/nurses were beyond lovely and helpful. Room was also nice and had everything we needed. Can imagine this would be a very hard two weeks for some but being at distinction definitely makes it a lot better. Big ups to everyone there to help, created a really nice environment!!

title: Two week MI stay
text:
Stayed here as part of the NZ Govt Managed Isolation requirements. Clean and tidy throughout, and all guests for this purpose was well catered for.

Bathrooms are a bit dated with the floor in my room cracking and the shower head needs replacement. 

Comfy beds and chairs. I was in a renovated superior room. Not sure on restaurant as we were brought meals to the room as part of the quarantine process.

Staff were all very friendly and accommodating and did what ever they could to assist. Thank you for making the two week easier!

title: Look elsewhere
text: Average accommodation with not an original thought in either the room decor, service or food. Horrendous breakfast, below average service and when raised with the manager felt as though I shouldn't have bothered! Much better options available and I have advised my workplace of this

title: Comfy beds, clean rooms
text:
Stayed here as it was close to friends we were visiting.  It's not a tourist area, it's more of a business / industrial area.  Not many close restaurants just fast food and takeaway places.

Room was nicely refurbished - nice comfy bed and clean bathroom with good amenities.

Friendly reception staff and plenty of parking.
hotel_response: Thanks for taking the time to leave such a nice review. We appreciate it.

title: Not for tourists
text: It’s a 70s style hotel set in the middle of an industrial / retail estate. There’s not much to the aesthetics of the place. If you can get over this (and you have a car and are passing through for one night only) then it’s clean and functional. Some of the staff were super friendly. I had to wait 40 mins to get a table for dinner on a Wednesday and tbh the hotel was not that busy. But it’s popular with those that are staying because you would have to drive to get anywhere else.  There seemed to be a lot of business guests staying. If infinity travel had not recommended I would not be staying here. It’s not for tourists - too far away from anything and slightly depressing after a great day touring the countryside around Hamilton. Do yourself a favor and keep heading south.

title: Close to racetrack
text: Decent place. Slightly outdated but rooms were nice Easy walk to racetrack. Friendly staff. Breakfast was average, expensive for what you get. Felt safe there, new carpets, showers were kind of gross but manageable. Would revommend
hotel_response: THanks for your review- we do wonder what you mean about the gross shower. These are older but are very clean.

title: Handled an ssue perfectly!!
text:
