Had an issue with the cleaning in our room when we arrived today (3/2/2020) and advised reception who immediately advised Duty Manager Samantha.

We were immediately given another room with an extremely sincere apology and because of the way the issue was handled, am happy to give an excellent rating! Have worked in retail & hospo for over 30 years, and CAN NOT fault the manner in which Sam and her staff dealt with our issue.

FANTASTIC service and WILL definitely consider this property for future stays because despite the relatively minor problem with our first room, have SO far thoroughly enjoyed every interaction with these lovely ladies!

PS really good value for money!!

title: Large room.
text: Great bed, great room. Pool was laughable but had better showers than the room in the changing room at the gym area. Ok but not the best. Didn't stay for breakfast but needed a car to get anywhere. Could do better.
hotel_response: Thanks for taking the time to write a review

title: Not on a par with other Distinction Hotels
text: I regularly stay at other Distinction properties in Dunedin, Christchurch and Wellington for work hence decided to stay here for pleasure as we were visiting friends near Hamilton for New Years. It appears as if this property has been acquired by the group and whilst you can see some changes are underway it is very tired and dated. Hotel was very quiet as it was NYE and hotel is not really CBD located. Room was absolutely adequate for a decent nights sleep and a hot shower. Nowhere near the standard of other hotels on the group. If you regularly stay particularly in Dunedin or Christchurch and expect a similar experience you’ll be sorely disappointed. For a $150-175 per night property though it’s a decent enough option with free parking and good access to the motorway.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to post your review. You are correct- we are not the same as the Dunedin and Christchurch hotels.  As you observed work is ongoing at the hotel and Hamilton is a very very quiet place over Christmas and New Year.

title: Shabby, dirty and unfriendly
text: Happily I was only in this place for the night. Dirty, shabby surroundings. House spiders lurking in every corner (a sure sign it isn’t being cleaned properly) a shower that I could pee faster than. Limited range of Sky channels. My bed had huge dips on both sides and a jump in the middle.  Unwelcoming staff. Paper thin walls. Foul filthy carpet in the dining room. Food was the saving grace. A lovely dinner and comprehensive offering at breakfast.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to post your comments. It is a shame that you checked out without passing any of your comments to the hotel staff about your stay. We then could have explained that your travel agent had booked you into an unfurbished standard room. These rooms are not dirty but old. Spiders being present will be because the window has been left open and are is reflection of the cleaning of the room. Unfortunately the beds are also old and due for replacement soon. Our carpets have been cleaned in the last month and perhaps the soiling you saw was because a guest had dropped something that morning.

title: Not accessible
text:
The Distinction Hotel Hamilton does not have rooms that are accessible for a person with a disability. There is no fixed shower seat in the shower and no handle at all on the bathroom door. The toilet is too low for a slide transfer.
The rooms do not comply with the NZealand standard NZS 4121:2001. At all.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking time to write a review. Our 4 newly refurbished accessible rooms do comply with all required NZ standards. If you had let the hotel know of your concerns during your stay we would have been able to discus this with you.

title: Nice room
text: The room was nice but the shower was an absolute disgrace.  I didn`t want to shower there but had to.  Grout was mold stained, shower rose was dreadful, no water pressure and water started to go cold.  Light switch for bed lamp was very dirty, don`t think it had ever been wiped down.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to place feedback. 
Unfortunately the showers are aged and the grouting is a dark colour- it is not mould. If you had let someone know at the hotel that you were worried about this we could have assisted you immediately. Unfortunately now we do not even know which room you are referring to. We always appreciate being given the opportunity to correct any problems whilst our guests are at the hotel.

title: One of the worst hotels I have stayed at.
text: Had a room in Wing 5. Check in was easy and all seemed to go well. Room looked clean enough except for the shower which looked very average. After 2 days I rang reception as we had no hot water. Apparently they are on cylinder and once the water goes it needs to reheat. Need to wait half an hour or go to the gym for a shower!!  The bed leg kept falling off the bed (maintenance came 3 times), The sheets were not changed for 6 nights and that was only because I went to reception and asked for them to be changed. There are signs everywhere asking you not to leave your windows open when not in the room yet each day we came back to the room and the windows were open (housekeeping), except for the day we were not serviced at all. Once we came back to no towels in the room. The ultimate was the Rugby. When we checked in we got a note with the wifi password (which never worked) and told we would have Spark sport. Sitting there 11.30pm waiting for the rugby and NOTHING. Rang reception and was told it must be running late and the tele in the bar was the same? Really !!! Rang home and it was 28 minutes into the game. The reason I have given this a poor rather than terrible was the breakfast was nice.

title: Fabulous dinners
text: Lovely Hotel to stay in.  Rooms are spacious and comfortable bed.  The staff are always helpful.  The dinner chef is fabulous.  Ate in the Garnett Restaurant two of the three nights and the meals were amazing.  The French maitre de is fabulous and knows his wines.
hotel_response: Thank you very much for your feedback. I will pass it on to the team and I hope you are able to stay with us again soon.

title: Pleasant stay
text:
Rooms nice and clean also quiet although place is a little dated
Had good quality meals both breakfast buffet good selection  and dinner choices ok and nicely presented
Staff very friendly and plenty of parking available 
Value for money in my opinion
hotel_response: Thank you very much for your review. We hope you can stay with us again soon.

title: Perfect place to stay
text: Our room here was really nice, large with stylish armchairs and the best bed I have ever slept in. Shower was awesome, high pressure and room was so quiet. I have stayed here twice and will be back.love it.
hotel_response: Thank you very much- we really appreciate your feedback. It will be lovely to have you stay again soon.

title: Excellent beds and Breakfast buffet
text:
With one of the best breakfast buffets I’ve experienced, this hotel has much to offer. There is an amazing array of food and a chef on hand to cook your eggs however you like them.
We had the restaurant dinner in the evening and there was plenty of choice. Our group enjoyed all their meals.
There are several conference areas although our group only required a smaller room.
The accommodation is in several wings on two levels. Unfortunately there is no elevator and you need to request a ground floor room if you can’t manage stairs.
The room was comfortable and the bed very comfortable. More SKY Sports Channels need to be added as I was unable to watch netball games.
All in all a comfortable place to stay.
hotel_response: Thank you very much for the feedback. We are all delighted that you enjoyed your stay.

title: The Good, Bad and Indifferent
text:
The Good, Bad and Indifferent 

This was my first stay and first conference experience at the Distinction Hotel in Hamilton.
First impressions driving in were disappointing as the buildings looked tired and in need of at least a paint renovation.
The reception area was amazingly huge I can only suspect that it is this big to accommodate presentations or product displays related to their conference events.
Certainly a friendly welcome and the rooms on level two were immaculate but listening to other conference guests not all their rooms were that great.
In the evening a buffet was provided all good with friendly helpful staff but why did you close the bar so early and force guests to leave to find somewhere to enjoy a drink.
Bad and indifferent was the staffing at breakfast when it was easier to find your preferred meal than a smile from any of the staff except Vicky.
The food 10/10 but hard to find a staff member at the coffee machine or the cook to fry an egg although staff did seem to drift in closer to 7am although still without a service based attitude.
I hope that the renovations I saw is an indication of better things to come however it’s a journey that seems to have a long road to completion.
hotel_response: Thanks for taking the tie to place feedback. Unfortunately you never passed your comments on to the hotel directly so we are unable to give any explanations about our ongoing refurbishments etc.  Renovating such a massive complex does not happen overnight. If you do stay again please let the team know if you have any concerns or comments as we would love to actually be of assistance.

title: Below average
text: Rooms given an upgrade from the previous establishment, but boy what a let down with staff. Very rude from booking, check in, breakfast and departure. Felt like I was dealing with a ferrel ex- ex partner the whole time. I travel for work 5 days a week and will never stay with Distinction again
hotel_response: Dear Guest- As I am sure you are aware it is impossible to tell from Tripadvisor who you are and when you stayed. This means I cannot give you any feedback about your comments or deal with any difficulties you may have had when you were here. The unfortunate thing about waiting to post on Tripadvisor is that we can do nothing to improve the situation, if you had said something during your stay I would have met with you so something constructive could have been done.

title: Overnight stay
text: Stayed overnight to break our trip between Rotorua & Paihia. This place is huge. Only 2 levels but no lift. Room was great just had new carpet put down & very spacious & clean. Great for an overnight stay. But not in the heart of Hamilton. Restaurant food was delicious.

title: Weekend conference
text:
We booked Thursday to Monday for a conference friday-sunday.  Accommodation was very comfortable however housekeeping was random with bath mat and hand towels missing on various days.  Fridays buffet  was overpriced at $45 with only one meat and 3 salads available. Saturday buffet was better.  Sunday night menu was better.
Conference facilities were excellent.

title: Fantastic place!
text: Stayed here for 4 nights and found it to be very comfortable, quiet, and easy to get some well earned rest. The conference facilities are amazing, and they run it like clockwork. Restaurant and bar facilities have great food and service, and the front of house staff were friendly and helpful. Checking out was easy and the well spoken Gentleman behind the desk was very representative of the pride and quality of this hotel and conference facility. Top marks from me all around.
hotel_response: Thank you so very much for your feedback- I will be certain to pass it on to the team. I am delighyhted you enjoyed your stay and we hope to welcome you back soon.

title: 3 embarrassing experiences! Not good enough
text: Having checked in, we were allocated a room, only to find it already occupied. We were allocated another room, but on opening the door found a woman wrapped in a towel coming out of the shower - again an occupied room!! The manager came over with yet another key - blaming the receptionist for the error. A curt apology given, but a glass of wine on the house would have helped. We went to the bar and ordered our own drinks to be told by the woman at the bar she couldn't serve us because she was underage. Good grief! At dinner there were 2 trainee wait staff who clearly did not understand their role and stood around talking to each other - then next day we had to ask for towels (at 4.30 in the afternoon) because none were left in our room when it was serviced. The receptionist said towels were probably still being laundered. Nightmare stay!!!
hotel_response: My apologies for your stay. I was not made aware of any of these issues but I will be following up with the staff concerned.

title: OK for the 2 nights stay
text:
A bit far from the city center, but was ok as it was just our base for our holiday.
Rooms were clean, there were 2 queen beds good for 4 adults. Amenities were complete.  Bathroom was huge with enough toiletries.
hotel_response: Thank you for the feedback- we appreciate you taking your time to make a post..

title: Fine for a couple of nights
text:
This hotel was fine for a couple of nights during our road trip along the length of New Zealand.  A good size bed, good shower free parking and WiFi - what's n OT two like!

It's a bit out of town so it's either a bus or a drive into Hamilton.
hotel_response: Thanks for the feedback- luckily if you have a car we have 300 free carparks for you and the buses run past us all day long.

title: Work
text: The bedding smelt unclean and damp.  As my room was on the ground floor I could hear every noise the person in the room above me made on the toilet. Absolutely disgusting experience.  The hotel is In desperate need of an upgrade and sound proofing.
hotel_response: Thank you for writing a review. Unfortunately you didnt bring up any of your concerns during your time at the hotel, which meant we did not have the opportunity to correct any issues you faced. Your comments have been passed on to the team.

title: Superior King Room Fantastic
text:
Fantastic accommodation, extremely friendly staff, superior king rooms recently refurbished! Extremely comfortable beds and very clean. 
Great restaurant/facilities. Clean spa/sauna.
Great room service!
High recommend this accommodation!
hotel_response: Thank you for the excellent review- we are thrilled you enjoyed the hotel so much.  I will pass your comments on to the rest of the team.

title: No frills motel style hotel
text: We stayed one night at the hotel on our way to Auckland from the Waitomo region. It is a spare slightly funky hotel that was fine for a one night stay. Check in was quick and easy. Our room was on the second floor and there was no elevator so we had to haul our bags up the stairs. The room was a superior room with 3 beds - two double beds and one twin and a small bathroom with toilet and shower. The room had everything one would need but nothing fancy. The beds and pillow were comfortable and the A/C worked well (it was a bit noisy). The indoor pool area smelled musty and was very crowded (with happy children/young families) and the gym smelled bad and my husband reported the machines were not in good condition. The staff were all polite and efficient and check out was simple. Parking was also ample and free.

title: Great place
text:
We were a family of 4 and we had a 2 room unit. It was a great place to stay very comfortable. From the looks of it they are in the process of doing it up and it is a big place to do. We were in one of the new units.
They do need to sort out the carpet in the corridors it needs a good clean but you don't sleep in it. Good staff made it easy to stay.

title: Awesome stay!
text:
One of my usual one night, in and out business trips provided me the opportunity to stay in Hamilton so I chose the Distinction which I was very impressed with.

Probably one of the most comfortable beds that I have slept in for some time at a hotel (new bed topper really helped), friendly staff, quick & tasty room service with great WIFI - loved my stay.

With plenty of parking at a good price, I think I will be back.  Only downside if that it is a bit of a distance from the city but for me, not really an issue due to reason for my trip.  Thanks Distinction!
hotel_response: Thanks for your great review- I hop we we can welcome you back soon.

title: Amazing stay
text: Stayed here for 1 night with my partner and 2 kids I honestly dont think I could of stayed anywhere else so amazing here!!! They allowed us to check in really early no extra charge because we were travelling long distance.. food was amazing staff interaction was fabulous even got to have a dip in the pool which was nice. Asked for extra towels was handed more over no issue, asked for more glasses due to having my son and they were delivered to my room so amazing I will stay here again without no hesitation..... I think the only frustrating thing was road worker trucks were using the carpark as like a lunch break at 3am in the morning which was frustrating but not hotels fault in my eyes
hotel_response: Thanks very much. We are deighted you enjoyed your stay so much. I will pass your comments on to the rest of the team.

title: you'll be suprised with the food
text: the rooms are a bit dated but really comfy.  But the thing that sets this place above some others is the restaurant.  the food is amazing, and the bonus of having happy hour is cool.  The huge array of things to have for breakfast will blow your mind.
hotel_response:
Thanks for your review, we really appreciate it. We have in the past 12 months completed renovation of 125 rooms and upgraded them to Superior rooms. It seems that you were in a standard room- these have not been renovated. 
We think the food here is great too- breakfast is very unique. I hope we can welocme you back again soon.

title: Good value for $'s
text: When you arrive, you can tell this was a top-of-the-line hotel when it was built.  Grand reception area, large dining area, several wings of rooms, etc.  Some parts are looking a bit tired on the outside, but the room I stayed at had been recently refurbished, making it very good value for money.  The hotel even has room service, something you don't really expect in this part of Hamilton.
hotel_response: Thank you very much for your review. It is very satisfying to have all our hard work noticed. I hope you can come back again to stay soon.

title: Good Hotel
text:
I stayed here for one night as planned. First impressions as I entered the Reception area was "wow!" Very large open space, clean, well dressed and friendly hotel staff. The huge lounge area was equally as impressive, as was the dining room. Very good dinner, could not fault it at all and an excellent choice of wines to accompany the meal. It was evident that the waiting staff were well trained and must have an excellent, well experienced leader! Breakfast was a slight disappointment, but understandably so, given the huge numbers of guests staying that night. But food kept warm on hot plates for mass dining, soon loses its appeal.

My room was very well presented and comfortable. One of the best hotel beds I have slept in. My only disappointment was the bathroom - especially in the shower cubicle. White tiles with light coloured grouting are a nightmare to keep clean. but looks terrible if allowed to get dirty. The grouting on the tiles was very dirty, the glass of the shower cubicle had not had a deep clean for a long time, as it was covered in "limescale" type marks, making the glass semi opaque. On the floor of the bathroom, were strands of long hair - certainly not mine, as mine is short. I would tend to question the cleaning routine and thorough daily checking.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback. I apologise for the long strands of hair in the bathroom, that is unacceptable and it will be followed up. Unfortunately the grouting and glass in the shower are not unclean just at a stage in their lifetime that they are looking their age.

title: Comfy Bed
text: We arrived quite late and the young gentleman at reception was very friendly, the room was clean and the bed was one of the best I have slept in away from home. The room has recently had new carpet installed and it made the room feel very fresh. The only fault was the noise from other occupants leaving in the morning could be heard very clearly through the door.
hotel_response: Thanks very much for psting a review. You are absolutely our new beds are incredible. We hope you can return again.

title: 3 night stay.
text:
This hotel has recently had renovations and what a difference! New carpet makes the rooms feel luxurious. The bed was very comfortable.
Big bonus for me was being able to open windows. The rooms are always so hot at night, so this let the air in.
The bar area is huge, great for meeting colleagues ect.
Restraunt is good, the food is delicious, thank you chief, but the staff that were on on the week nights needed more training. The hostess was very good, she told me that they were only new. 
Never used the pool/ gym but it looked excellent.
hotel_response: Thanks for your feedback. The other option to opening your windows would be to use the air conditioning in your room but I know not everyone likes to have the air con on all the time. Yes we do have new staff in the Restaurant who are receiving training. I have passed your feedback on to the team- its really appreciated.

title: Helpful
text: We only stayed one night and arrived in the late afternoon.  We had to deliver our rental car. The man behind the counter was called Colin. He was most helpful and friendly.  He arranged a taxi to be waiting at the rental pkace as it was a Sunday afternoon.  He was also able to change our room so we didn't have to lug our suitcases up the stairs. We are dinner at the restaurant there. It was very tasty. The next morning we enjoyed a delicious buffet breakfast. Colin organised a taxi to take us to the station. We appreciated the chocolates waiting for us for our honeymoon!  The only downside is its a bit out of town and the taxicost a bit over $20.

title: Great conference venue
text:
A group of 10 of us stayed here. Excellent meeting facilities and friendly staff. We went to café up the road for meals. Meals and alcohol on the more expensive side but good to have available on site. 
One room had 3 fuzzy Sky channels and mine had none.
hotel_response: Thanks for the feedback, its great to hear. Just one question- did you tell anyone about the TV issues so they could assist?

title: Strange hotel
text:
Was disappointed on checkin that the cost of upgrading to a family room was more than double what we were already paying; but moved on. Buildings are very dated, and not welcoming, like an old army barracks. Struggled up the musty stairs to our room; had to get my man to open the hotel door, as the lovely new carpet is so thick the door is a struggle to open. Won’t look good in a year or two when the door has worn a track in it.
Three of us but only two cups and glasses; asked at reception for more and told to just get some from the bar! What the......
Towels were disgusting colour and thin. Need to be replaced or at least a good soak in bleach; only the one replaced next day, or was it just folded from where I had left in on back chair.... nowhere to hang a third towel....
Otherwise room/beds comfy and very warm. Fridge was noisy.
Won’t be back.
hotel_response: I am sorry you did not enjoy your stay. Your feedback has been passed on to the staff involved.

title: Great value for money hotel
text: This is the 4th time we've stayed here - it is our go to hotel, with the price being better than most of the motels in the area.  We get a twin room, plus a cot, and it happily sleeps 2 adults + 2 children.  There is a pool and spa pools, a bar and restaurant, and ample parking.  They are in the process of refurbishing the rooms and the new decor is really nice and comfortable.  The first night the tv wasn't working so they swapped us to another room next door with no fuss.  The only downsides we missed our room being serviced as we didn't leave till 11 one morning (although they delivered fresh towels and more teabags when I rung for them); it would be nice if they changed the cups/glasses when they do service the room, most of the towels could do with being replaced; the new reading lights are very very bright, if its pointed at you its quite blinding.  Its a bit out of the CBD, so walking to Victoria St is a bit of a walk.
hotel_response: Thanks for your feedback. I am delighted that you have enjoyed your stays with us.

title: Great rooms
text: We are traveling with a large group. I was very wary of what the rooms would be like, based on other reviews. They couldn't be more wrong. Our room is recently renovated, with super comfortable beds, and a clean, renovated bathroom. Family of four has two bedrooms, which the kids love. This is our 3rd hotel as we travel through NZ, and is by far the nicest.
hotel_response: Thanks so much- we love our renovated rooms, and are delighted that you did too.

title: Its gross
text: We were booked in this hotel for 3 nights, but did not stay at all. Towels are stained, its not white anymore, its ecru. Bedcovers have seen better days, not clean at all. Found human hair under the bed covers... and the room rate is NZD200 per night. They only refund 2 nights of my payment and they told me they cannot refund the other one since i already checked-in and stayed 30 minutes in the room.....
hotel_response: It is disappointing you did not stay with us. When you told us you had a change of plans none of the issues were reported to anyone. You had booked a standard room which has not been refurbished.

title: A great meal with friends
text: We didn’t stay at this venue but joined friends for a casual meal, we were able to eat our meal in the lounge watching the rugby, no other guests were there so we appreciated this gesture.the food was very nice and our group selected quite a range from the menu. The only downside was a man decided to use a drill and do some running repairs in the bar area!🤨
hotel_response: Thanks for the feedback, I will pass your comments on to the team. I will also speak to the person with the drill- very odd.

title: Mediocre Hotel - not as advertised and mediocre food.
text: This hotel advertising pictures on it's website didn't match with out experience. We booked a Superior King Room - if that was superior I would hate to see what is below that. The room itself was clean enough but for the rate charged it wasn't in superior room bracket. The meals are also pricey and not very nice. The bathroom tiles are stained particularly in the shower - bit grotty really. That's not to mention the bathroom fan that sounds like it's going to fall apart! But then the next room fan that woke me at 3am in the morning with it's racket filling the room. The staff were pleasant enough but i couldn't recommend this as a place to stay for the discerning traveler.
hotel_response: I am sorry you did not enjoy your stay. I have passed your comments on to the rest of the team.

title: Bathroom was filthy
text:
Last thing you want to see is a toilet covered in vomit and other excrement 
Towels on floor 
Used soap everywhere 

Obviously uncleaned 

Refused a room change

Horrible service and experience 

When I travel for work regularly this is the last thing any traveller wants to experience 

Gym and pool area also closed until next month
hotel_response: Please accept our apologies for this- the bathroom had obviously not been cleaned. As far as the pool area being closed (not the gym) this is for maintenance, all facilities need to be closed for maintenance at some stage. It is considered that Winter is the best time to do this considering that our pool is not a hot pool.

title: Questionable Housekeeping
text:
Stayed at the hotel for a business trip to Hamilton.

Building is quite dated with need of a refresh.
Staff are okay and polite.

The entrance of the wing is dirty with dirt and mud strewn across the floor. Furthermore the toilet hasn’t been cleaned from the previous guest, with significant “residue” remaining on the seat and on the bowl.

I was given a new room in which the shower booth is mouldy and the floor still has remains of hair and used soap from a previous guest.
hotel_response: I am sorry you did not have a positive experience with us. The housekeeping manager has spoken with the staff members involved to ensure they do their cleaning correctly.

title: It’s so so
text: The hotel is a few minutes drive from Hamilton town proper. We were given a ground floor room in the 6th wing. The room and the hallway seems dated. My kids were so disappointed that the pool was closed without prior notice. We booked the room for 4 people but every night I have to ask the front desk for an extra towel as you only provided 3 in the room. There were numerous parking spaces but each space is “very” narrow. Also, if you arrive late, most likely you will not be able to find a space near your room and have to park all the way at the back of the hotel. There is also no microwave in the room. There was a gym with a treadmill, cross trainer, rowing machine and 3 benches with dumbell free weights.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to post a review. Unfortunately we have had to take longer than expected to complete maintenance and painting of our pool area, this however was shared on all websites and on confirmation letters and in our email signatures. We have 300 parking spaces for our guests to use at no charge and this is the first time I have heard them described as 'narrow'. I am sorry if you found parking difficult however the hotel was obviously very busy during your stay. Thank you for letting me know about the towels- I have passed this on to Housekeeping. We do not provide any cooking facilities in our rooms as we are a hotel and have a Restaurant that you can take advantage of.

title: Middle of the road
text:
I stayed here for a couple of nights recently. Service was very good, and very efficient both at reception and in the restaurant. The room was ok, clean and tidy. The bathroom was starting to show some wear and tear. Only issue was the bed. Not a biggy but I didn't think it was made up very well the first night, and a rather cursory pull up on the second. Both nights I had to remake it.

This hotel is out of the main city area and it is not that close to shops, restaurants so recommend having a car, plenty of car parking so no problem there.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback. I will pass it on to the rest of the team

title: Very comfortable, nice amenities
text: We were located on the bottom floor. That night was very cold and found the heat pump and it warmed the room in no time. Nice thick blanket on the bed and another double fleece in the drawer. Very,very quiet and woke up to find it was a very cold stormy night. None of which we heard.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review- we are delighted you enjoyed your stay.

title: Feildays accomadation
text:
Great place to stay over feildays event. Good clean rooms with nice size. Great parking which is very important when arriving back late and tired. Very nice helpful staff.Restraunt was big with good range on menu, as was the buffett breakfast.
For travellers, business trips and the likes a great place to stay.
hotel_response:
Thanks very much for the feedback. We really appreciate it. I will pass your comments on to the rest of the team. 
P.S- if you are looking for somewhere to stay for the 2019 Fieldays I suggest you get in touch with our reservation team ASAP.

title: Quite good in some aspects.. others not too good
text:
After reading many of the other reviews, I was a bit sceptical.  Assigned one of the newly refurbished rooms, the carpet was nice, and the bed was extremely comfortable. Heat pump was quite cold, and after discovering it was still in the "cold" setting and changing it, situation improved. It was useful to have a fridge in the room, unfortunately it was very noisy and the freezer compartment had been broken so couldn't hold items. In the shower, hot water came out very quick, at constant temperature,  and hopefully when bathrooms are re-done, looks will improve (grout was not white and gives the appeareance of uncleanliness or maybe even mold). 
Had breakfast, lunch and dinner buffets, and all provided good variety, warm (not hot) meals. 
We asked for a less plum pillow at the front desk, and it arrived to our room 3 hours later. Other than this incident, staff service was excellent.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your review.
Unfortunately because you did not pass on to anyone at the hotel about your fridge we now we will try and work our which one it is so it can be replaced. Feel free to make contact and let us know so we can take care of it. :)

title: Needs a lot of work
text: I found this hotel to be a series of contradictions.  The foyer is huge but when I was directed to my room I had to drag my bags up the stairs to the second floor.  The hotel then looks like my university dorm room with stained old carpets in the corridors.  The carpet in the room was new and nice.  The bed was comfortable but the stains all over the covers looked disgusting.  The bathroom was new but there was mould all through the shower recess.  I would not come back here by choice
hotel_response: Thanks for taking the time to post your feedback. The rooms have been renovated but not the bathrooms. The rest of the hotel is scheduled to be renovated in the not to distant future.

title: Very good
text: Large hotel with huge conference room.  Restaurant and reception a bit on the dark side. The room was very clean and the two queen size beds super comfortable. The restaurant was a bit pricey but there was an Indian restaurant 4 mon. Walk away.
hotel_response: Thanks for taking the time to write a review. We are really pleased that you enjoyed your stay.

title: Real disappointment
text: Went to the Distinction for a conference and although I have stayed there some time ago, it was a significant  step backwards. Although the decor is a bit dated, the 2 point rating applies to the conference services. The food was absolutely below what would be expected to the point that it looked as if it all came out of cans. Suffice to say, there wasn't a big rush to grab something to eat. Someone must have known that the supplied food was not very good as we noticed another group who had brought in their own catering. So no, not very impressed at all.
hotel_response: It is disappointing that you feel this way- we normally get rave reviews about our conference food. The other group you saw did not bring in their own catering- everything is made on site, packed lunches and all.

title: Went for conference
text: Went for a conference in facilities and lunch. Food was laid out well buffet style in dining area which was really great hence the stars however quality of food was not that great.  Butter chicken and rice, rice was served with raisins in? Butter chicken sauce looked and tasted like it had split/curdled with the cream or youghurt. Cold meats tasted a bit tangy as if were starting to go off or left out. But overall average since facilities are quite dated. Heaps of parking though so a plus.
hotel_response: Thanks for taking the time to post a review. We normally get amazing feedback about our conference lunch buffet. I have however passed your comments to the executive chef.

title: Awesome nights sleep
text: Wow what a wonderful nights sleep after a hard day's shopping, Our room was set way back in the far corner, so quiet, plenty of parking, the beds were so comfortable, large tv screen at the end of our bed perfect to watch the rugby, rooms had everything we needed for a unplanned stay, will definitely come back and stay! Thankyou
hotel_response: Thanks very much. We take great pride in our fantastic beds and large TV screens. I hope you can come and stay again.

title: Less than average
text:
I’ll start off by saying the room I stayed in was nice but it stops there. The towels in the bathroom look like they’re 10 years old and cleaned in drain water. Might pay to replace them. Also a clump of hair fell out of one of them. I stayed four nights. On the first night I ate at the restaurant. I ordered the chicken parmigiana. I can tell you it was heated up in a microwave, what I couldn’t tell you is when it was actually made. At a price of $32 I would have expected it to be made on the night. 

This hotel has so much potential to be great, you just need to make some cost effective changes. Put freshly made food on your menu, replace the towels with new ones, retrain your staff including housekeeping (all they did was pull up the bed and fold the ends of the toilet paper) and rename your wings from numbers to actual names so they don’t sound like prison blocks. 

I really hope that I can come back in a few years and see that thing have changed.
hotel_response: We are naturally disappointed that you did not enjoy your stay. Your comments have been passed on to the Department Managers

title: Average Stay
text: Went to check in and was greeted and started the process then the receptionist answered the phone and I was left standing there for ages waiting for them, finally someone else noticed and came over and took over the check in!  Room was refurbished which was nice, unfortunately cant say the same for the bathroom which was a let down as the shower was old with cracked and moldy tiles. Also attention to smaller details when cleaning would be of benefit, the heat pump was dirty and the bathroom vent was very dusty.   The swimming pool isn't heated!!!  Perhaps I should have checked but I assumed as it was inside it would be, bit of a let down as was one of the main reasons I booked here!! I have read some more reviews here and since found other people have commented on the cold pool also so will ensure I read more reviews next time I book somewhere! Make sure you check the alarm clock isn't set for some crazy hour as mine was! Woke me up very early.  On the positives, comfortable refurbished room, nice comfy beds, fridge in the room which was quiet.  It was overall an average stay.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review- your comments have been passed on to the department managers

title: Lots to be recommended.
text: Love the upgrade in Block 5 but .....it took 2 fit ladies,av. age 80,to open/shut the door which is rubbing on the new carpet. Several others in our tour group found the same. We also found the towels were not up to the same standard as the bedding. One had a huge hole in it, the others were threadbare. Dining room staff were particularly helpful.Would suggest that desserts are always separated from mains as we watched an international visitor put pavlova on top of his vegies as desserts were beside salads on our first night.
hotel_response: Thank you for posting a review. The carpet will settle down after time- it is brand new.  I will pass your comments to the Housekeeper about the towels to follow up.

title: Really friendly and helpful staff
text: Stayed here whilst touring New Zealand with friends. Really welcoming staff and very spacious accommodation. Very good leisure facilities, good size gym and swimming pool. Breakfast was good with plenty of choice. Not much in the way of local bars and restaurants but within a short drove to Hamilton.  When leaving check out time was 10.00 but we asked if we could leave a little later as we were all jet lagged from our long journey from UK. No problem to staff and we left at 11.00. Just the kind of people you meet in NZ
hotel_response: Thanks very much- I am delighted to read this. I hope you have enjoyed the rest of New Zealand.

title: Nice refurbished rooms
text: We were upgraded to newly refurbished rooms which were nice. The location of hotel was also good. The rooms were scattered in the huge property which gave privacy to guests. However the booking department had made a blunder in inclusion of breakfast in our booking which they sorted out later.
hotel_response: I am thrilled you enjoyed the hotel- thanks for letting us know about the error with your breakfast. If we know of a problem it can usually be sorted out quickly.

title: Lovely hotel
text: This hotel has recently refurbished rooms which are great. Three beds in each room, 2 King size and 1 single. Food is very good and staff very friendly. Shops nearby for the essentisls. The area is quiet so good night's sleep.
hotel_response: Thank you for your great review. We are very proud of the progress with the refurbishments. I will pass your comments on to the rest of the team.

title: Don't judge a book by its cover..
text: We stayed at Distinction Hotel on the weekend while attending a wedding in Hamilton. From the photos online the room looked great. When we arrived at the hotel I was a little worried as from the outside it is actually quite ugly and dated. The reception area is also very dated. By this point I'm thinking that our room is probably going to be the same. I was very pleasantly surprised when I opened the door to find a very nice, modern room. The carpet felt new, everything was clean and the beds were comfortable. The lady at reception was friendly and check-in was quick and easy. Location was great. I think this was great value for money and would happily stay again if we end up in Hamilton again!
hotel_response: Thanks for the great review. As you probably figured out we are in the process of the renovating the htoel and have started with the rooms. The other areas will be done in the near future.

title: Reasonable accommodation with a reasonable price
text:
Don't expect great service at reception. We went to check and waited our turn. As we were being served another guest arrives and asks for assistance with their luggage, so we were left hanging without an excuse me or apology. Once the luggage was sorted we were then attended to but this added another 10 minutes onto our check in experience. 
The room was very comfortable and clean, but the shower tiles could have done with some mold remover  which is a shame as this was the only detractor.The rest of the bathroom was fine
The hotel is well enough away from the road and we did not find it at all noisy
hotel_response:
Our apologies that you were left waiting. 
We have ungraded the rooms but we are still waiting on a bathroom upgrade to replace the tiles. The black on the tiles is in fact not mould but old age.

title: On the way up
text: The Distinction is mid way through an upgrade, the old rooms tired, the new refreshed and well up to scratch and the quiet air con most welcome. In the summer this is a regular stop for family, spacious rooms, swimming pool, and the surprise: wifi with real grunt, all of the family on a device and happily streaming in the quiet moments. if you get a breakfast deal, plenty of the full English and other options. At night the bar has local Good George ale on the taps.
hotel_response: Thanks for the great review- its wonderful to hear you enjoyed the hotel.

title: Great Stay
text: Excellent hotel which offers free and has ample parking. The service is wonderful and the receptionist was very helpful and pleasant. Spacious hotel offering spacious rooms. We had booked two rooms and both included two double beds and had breakfast included which was wonderful. The breakfast variety was great also. Overall wonderful hotel to stay at when in Hamilton. Close to the stadium if you are travelling to see a game and close to Hamilton CBD. Catching a cab is no issue at all.
hotel_response: Thanks for the review, we are delighted. I hope you can come and stay again.

title: Average Stay
text:
We stayed here during the Hamilton Sevens. Overall not very impressed. Although the rooms have been renovated it seems very cheaply so. The Fridge in our room was still very old and didn't cool. 
Overall feel of the hotel is very tired and dated. The pools was cold and none of the 3 spa tubs seemed to work and were cold too. There was a sauna in the shower room but was not working. 
In my opinion if a hotel puts signs out that its under renovation and then one would expect facilities to be down...the price should match.
Hope the renovated hotel will be a better stay for some.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to post a review.
The hotel is under the process of being renovated- this does take quite a lot of time.  
The renovations of the hotel have not been done cheaply - unfortunately because you did not pass on any of your comments during your stay we are unable to tell if you were in a renovated room or in one that was still to be done.  
Please note- our pool is not a hot pool.

title: Not impressed
text: Due to the rugby 7’s we were unable to get accomodation in the area. We were fortunate to find a room here however at $200 per night we were expecting a lot more than we got. The premises were old, dated and appeared dirty, however there were signs saying they were in the process of rennovating. On a good note, The rooms had been updated but nothing special. Dinner at the restaurant was a mess. The menu didn’t match what they brought out. There was only one other family there and it took forever to get our food. The next morning at the buffet they ran out of lots of things. It certainly didn’t accomodate for the amount of people there. Not worth $28 for sure. The pool was cold and the hot tub didn’t work. Overall, not a good experience!
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to post your comments. As is normal practice in this industry hotel rates do increase when there is a major event on. You were in a standard room that has not been renovated as yet. I have asked the restaurant staff for a report of the hold up with your meals. Please note that our pool is not a hot pool however thank you for bringing to our attention an issue with the spa pools.

title: An excellent refurbishment and lovely staff
text:
Staff were welcoming and nothing seemed too much trouble. The room was well appointed and clean. The carpet on our room was so new the door hardly closed! Good comfy bed and easy free parking. The hotel is out of town so it’s very quiet Breakfast was very good with lots of fresh fruit options 
Suggest a second floor room to get the same experience as we did.
hotel_response: Thanks for the review- the team will be thrilled to know you enjoyed your stay.

title: great family friendly  place
text:
this is the second time here in the last 2 months, great value for money, yes the place is dated in some areas, but I wasnt here to look at the walls, the front staff were friendly and the rooms were clean, we got the deal with breakfast and it was lovely, plenty of food to select from and great layout.
the bathroom I think was due for an update but the signs on the doors explain this, we will be coming back.
hotel_response: Thanks very much for the review- we look forward to welcoming you back.

title: NOT a 4 Star hotel
text:
Sadly disappointing.  I booked ( prepaid) for two nights with the buffet breakfast deal, 3 guests.

The facilities are VERY tired and dated. 
The positive- the room had been recently redecorated.

The many negatives
- The facilities are extremely tired and dated.
- We had to carry our bags up the stairs to the second level , no lift. 
- No milk provided in our room. I had to phone reception to ask for some 
- Only 4 ' squares' of toilet paper in the room on arrival. I went to reception to ask for some toilet rolls.
-  on the second day the staff forgot to service our room . I had to phone reception to request clean towels.
-  IF the staff had asked how my stay was when I checked I I would have given them the feedback in person.... they didn't ask.
- Such a disappointment to an otherwise lovely visit to Hamilton.
hotel_response: We are naturally disappointed to receive your comments. Please be assured they have all been taken on board and discussed with the staff members concerned.

title: Good hotel for our short stay in Hamilton
text: We were visiting Hamilton for our sons cricket tournament so didn't want to spend a lot as we would only be sleeping here.  We got an upgrade to a lush and stylish room that had just been refurbished.  The beds were quiet firm but that's a plus for me.  The check in was friendly and quick.  Strangely all the cricket parents had booked this hotel so it was nice that they have a large bar were we could meet and discuss the day over a drink.
hotel_response:
Thanks for your review- I hope the tournament was a success for your son's team.
We look forward to being able to hosting you again.

title: Conference Hotel
text: Stayed for a conference for three nights.  Good rooms.  New Carpet impeded door opening and closing. Friendly staff.  Limited activities and facilities nearby but restaurant at the hotel and cafe/bakery nearby.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review. I will pass it on to all the team. The lovely new carpet will slow settle down to make the door opening and closing easier.

title: Getting there!! Slowly doing up the rooms.
text: The room we had was a superior king size. The room itself was spacious and nicely decorated, it had obviously been painted and had nice new carpet. The bathroom and shower needed re-tiling and then it would be really nice. The complex was quiet and close to where we wanted to be. Outside of buildings looking fairly shabby.We did not have breakfast at the hotel as it was very expensive. Several marks on the underside of the bedspread, so we removed this
hotel_response:
Thank you for your feedback. 
We are going through and refurbishing as you have noticed, starting with rooms and then we will move to other areas. Did you let us know about the bedspread?

title: PSA regional conference
text:
Professionalism with all staff I met during my 2 day stay - friendly and helpful.
Stayed in building 400 my room was well appointed clean warm cert modern.  Recommend everyone to stay there, you won't be disappointed.  Thank you to all the staff.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback- we value it. We have received many positive comments about the conference- I am glad that everyone enjoyed it. I will pass your comments on to the team- they will be thrilled.

title: Friendly staff
text: Stayed in a newly renovated room.  Nice quiet surroundings, with clean, comfortable room.  The staff were friendly and accommodating.  The receptionist went out of her way to check us into a room when we arrived before our room was ready.  The pool is a good size, and there are three spa pools at varying temperatures.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your feedback- it is valuable to us. I am delighted that you enjoyed your stay. I will pass your comments on to the rest of the team.
I hope you can make a return visit soon.

title: Rooms ok but hotel looks and feels cheap and nasty
text:
This is a conference hotel and whilst the rooms are ok, clean, comfortable the rest of the hotel is shoddy and the bar is just a giant hall. I did try to use the gym but the treadmill literally fell apart as I used it. 
I was there after a Lions match and the bar closed at mid-night despite 200 guests wanting a beer!
Probably fine if you are having a sales conference and want to house 100 of your reps but I would not recommend it.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback- I appreciate your thoughts. The hotel rooms are almost complete in their refurbishment and we hope to move to the public areas next.  We are also in the process of replacing the Treadmill in the gym.

title: Very cold venue
text:
Four of us went there for 9 days to attend a Bridge tournament in the conference centre.
I have never been so cold daily in all my life. I have come back home with a massive cold, a friend had her asthma flair up because of the cold, the Australians in the room all had their jackets and hoodies pulled up.
I had to wear boots and jackets every day which is most unusual when inside a venue.
There was one woman who was complaining it was hot, but she had bought her own fan with her so obviously always has issues.
Cold air kept blasting through the airconditioning unit
Service at bar after each finishing play at 5pm was very slow.
One toilet in woman's bathroom was constantly getting blocked.
They did make good coffee though and I enjoyed the final meal we ate there.
hotel_response: Thank you for providing your feedback. I will; pass your comments on to the departments involved.

title: Good comfortable accommodation that doesn't break the budget.
text:
On first impressions this looks to be a quiet dated hotel. However it appears that work is being done to improve it and bring it up to a higher standard. All in all the rooms are comfortable and of a decent size and good value for money.

One quip is the very average standard of the gym and its equipment. The equipment looks like it has been rescued from a gym that has closed down and some of it does not work properly. Attention to some maintenance of the equipment would be a good idea.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your review. You are quite right we are going through the hotel and refurbishing. Just this week I have started sourcing quotes for new gym equipment so that will be rectified soon.
I hope you can come back and stay again soon.

title: Great stay.
text: The Distinction was a great stay for our family. Quiet and off the road away from any noise. It is a large, older style hotel. They have several rooms newly remodeled that came with brand new beds and comfortable rooms. I recommend a stay here when traveling in the area. The staff was courteous and accommodating.
hotel_response: Thank you for the great review. I hope you can come and stay again soon.

title: Shows promise
text:
I was traveling alone for work and stayed at Distinction for two nights recently. I had heard that there was work being done and had crossed my fingers to get one of the revamped rooms but unfortunately missed out.

The staff were great and the food was tasty. The room was clean but bathroom was pretty rough and a wonky rusted shower required a bit of tenacity to get going. Quite musty but hopefully back one day to see the improvements.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, I am delighted that you enjoyed your stay. We hope you can return soon and enjoy one of our 'Superior' rooms.

title: A large hotel on the outskirts of town with variable facilities
text: We stayed in Hamilton for 3 nights and we had a good newly refurbished room but we were aware that others had more dated rooms and were not happy. This was also reflected in some old tired gym equipment but the restaurant and bar areas were large and good. The hotel was however a 30 minute walk from the town centre
hotel_response:
Thank you for your feedback.
We are in the midst of a Hotel Room refurbishment and will be complete by the end of the year.

title: Exceeded Expectations
text: 3.5/5 Family 1 bedroom room In the 400 wing 1st floor.  Both areas were clean spacious and modern and both rooms had their own tv.  The staff were helpful and friendly.  It would be 4/5 but there are signs of wear and tear visible to showers and facilities gym equipment is dated with wonkey spin bikes and flat swiss balls.  The pool was freezing and the spa barely warm.  It would be awesome if the facility was smoke free away from entrances so we didn't have to walk the gauntlet of passive smoking to get to our room.  We'd be back.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review. I am glad you enjoyed the hotel and I have passed on your comments about the Gym equipment to the Maintenance Team. While the pool is heated it is not a 'hot' pool and one of the 3 spas is a plunge pool not a heated spa. We look forward to welcoming you back.

title: Don't judge on first sight
text:
At first glance this Hotel complex looks a bit old and outdated but when I open the door to my room I was totally wowed ... seems like the rooms have been recently refurbished. My room was spacious and the bed was most comfortable. The bathroom was spacious too,  for me I would have loved a hand held shower and the hand basin was a tad too narrow.
The highlight though was the TV.  It is such a pleasure to stay overnight in a room with a decent sized modern TV well done Distinction Hotel. Check in was fairly easy and although this hotel is a little out of the city centre I will certainly stay here again because it's just spacious and really nice.
hotel_response: That's fantastic- thanks very much. We agree the newly refurbished rooms are great. We look forward to welcoming you back to Distinction Hamilton soon.

title: Different hotel in Hamilton this time.
text: I normally stay in the CBD, but with Field Days on had to stay in the suburbs. Having stayed here before, we knew what to expect, but were surprised at the work that has been done to refurbish the rooms. From the new carpet to the fresh clean look - it was great. The following morning we enjoyed a sumptuous buffet breakfast in the restaurant. Nothing too fancy in the stay but functional and very appropriate.
hotel_response: Thanks for your review, I am delighted that you enjoyed your stay, the good news is we have more refurbishment throughout the hotel still to do. Thanks for the feedback, we really appreciate it.

title: Good generally - not near city centre
text:
We stayed for 2 nights as part of a tour. Our room was spacious with 2 double beds, easy chairs & table, desk, flat screen TV, fridge, kettle & tea/coffee with milk provided. It was clean and decor was OK. The air con/heater was quite noisy.
 It is 2-3 miles from the city centre but is on a bus route if you don't have a car. There was a good choice at the breakfast buffet . There are two floors but no lift and no porters. Staff we met were friendly and helpful. Free wifi & parking
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to provide us with feedback. I hope you enjoy the rest of your travels through New Zealand.

title: Good stay
text:
Stayed here 1 night 18/06/17 reception  was friendly and efficient My room was big and clean with 2 x doulble beds, heat pump, flat screen, bed was fine I took the buffet breakfast - great selections hot or cold.
Free wifi and parking, and about midway between the Base shopping complex and city. Very reasonably priced but I have noticed that they are inflating their prices steeply  for the 7s next year. You have been warned.
Definitely stay here again
As everyone has said they are doing renovations.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review. I am delighted that you enjoyed your stay. I hope we can welcome you back again soon. P.S- yes prices will increase for events like the 7's, just like an airline hotel prices increase with demand.

title: Good overall - recently refurbished
text: Visiting Hamilton for a family event, we were a party of three adult relatives so we booked a suite which had two bedrooms. The rooms were clean and fairly well appointed. The hotel has been through a recent refurbishment. A couple of minor additions to the rooms might help with boosting comfort levels, e.g.: bedside lamps in the 'second' bedroom (this room had three single beds), plus a mirror in that room. Also, a simple but appreciated gesture would be to have a complimentary bottle of water provided for each guest.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback We truly appreciate it. We are pleased you enjoyed your stay in our recently refurbished rooms.

title: weekend stay
text: were there as part of a bus tour we were on to nearby Hobbiton.  Large room, very clean, good size bathroom.  Bed was a little hard but that is subjective. Decor was very 80's but I could see they were in the middle of refurbishments so perhaps not for too much longer!  Breakfast the following day was good, hot and plenty to choose from, nothing to complain there.  Didn't have much interaction with staff, but what we did was friendly.  Only real criticism was there was a sports team staying in our wing and they were very loud, I think thin walls didn't help!
hotel_response: Thank you for your review. You are quite right- we are currently refurbishing the majority of our rooms. The 'thin' wall issue will not be arounf much longer.

title: Conference
text: I was here for work. Conference facilities were okay but basic and The food arrived late so was not great. While we did not use the restaurant facilities, you can do. Food is a reasonable price and caters for large numbers numbers.
hotel_response:
Thankyou for taking the time to post a review. To our knowledge we have not had any incidents of food arriving late at recent conferences. We did have a conference that broke for their morning tea early and the food had to be rushed out, this was however the decision of the conference organiser and not the hotel. If you were the organiser of a conference and the food was delivered late we would really like to here from you directly.
Thank you

title: Basic
text: We stayed here passing through to Auckland. The gentleman checking us in must have been training as he could not answer any question on his own. There are no elevators and we stayed on 2nd floor. Everything must be toted up the stairs to guest rooms. Rooms are outdated but adequate. Very thin walls and hallway noise can be heard easily.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review. Our new refurbished rooms have been relined to absorb more noise from other guests. We hope you are back to enjoy the new rooms soon.

title: Very good .... but
text: Hotel is being renovated so we had a newly re furbished room. Nicely fitted out and reasonably spacious.Staff are friendly . Whilst not necessarily receptions fault I had to return twice before getting a room that was ready for us. Lack of communication between housekeeping and reception as to which rooms were available/ready and again when we had arranged a late checkout . Quiet location and not too far from anything.  Free and fast Wifi .
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to post a review. I am glad you enjoyed your room. Thank you for letting me know about the delay in having your room ready.  I hope you come back and stay with us again soon.

title: Just don't
text:
Paid in advance $260 for a room we could have got for $136 on the day.  Room was outdated, mouldy shower and horribly uncomfortable bed.  Our room was opposite rooms being renovated, so we're woken by tradies.  
Never again.
hotel_response: We are disappointed that you did not enjoy your stay. Our apologies that you were disturbed by tradesmen. We are undergoing major refurbishments at the moment to upgrade our rooms. Unfortunately I can't look into the rate you paid, if it was booked directly with the hotel you should always be receiving the best available rate. Once again our apologies for the disturbance caused.

title: Good for passing through
text: Stayed here 2 nights. Location is OK for travellers but no decent restaurants within easy walking distance - had to drive to a shopping mall, not exactly fine dining. Can't comment on the meals at the hotel, its a large place and there weren't many guests so the atmosphere wasn't very appealing. Very large rooms and plenty of space in the corridors and public areas. Undergoing some refurbishment so likely to improve
hotel_response: Thank you for your review. We hope you stay again and take advantage of our dining facilities.

title: Weekend Away
text: Wouldn't recommend this accommodation,  very misleading with its advertising. Went to check in after 2.30pm to be told our room was not ready. After checkin, we had to walk through white plaster dust to get to our room,, as it was all over the carpet,  a guy was sanding,  with the door wide open, across the hallway, very dusty . Our  room was very shabby, nothing like the photos advertised. Dirty glass, broken ironing board, very disappointed  . Run down place, management not helpful or caring. After complaining to duty manager, was told she would speak with the Manager next day. Never heard back, credit card was still charged full amount for a miserable stay.
hotel_response: I am sorry to hear about your experience.  We are currently undertaking a major refurbishment of our accommodation rooms, most of these have now become available this week. These new rooms are Superior Kings and were not available during your stay, they were also not advertised as available. The room you booked was a standard room and the photographs do reflect this. I do apologise for any inconvenience the refurbishment caused you during your stay.

title: Basic faculties
text:
Stayed one night in their standard room. The room was out dated, but clean with basic facilities. The bed was awfully uncomfortable as were the pillows. The duvet between the sheets was yellow. The walls were thin as we heard chatter from the rooms around us. The bathroom carries basic facilities. The pool/spa that were available to use were somewhat clean until we found a clump of hair in the spa. They advertised steam rooms but these were gender specific as they were in the change rooms for each gender. 
The next morning we sat down to a complimentary buffet breakfast. It had a wide range of options and was very satisfying. Overall an average room an average stay.
hotel_response: Thanks for taking the time to write a review. We are currently undertaking room refurbishment in 55 of our rooms. This includes relining all the walls and ceiling to make the level of noise proofing very high. The rooms will be completely brand new and once the first 55 are complete we will continue to upgrade the other rooms. I hope you can return soon to experience the new rooms. We are very proud of our breakfast- so glad you enjpyed it.

title: Great hotel for the value
text:
Love the pool     
Love the price
Hotel rooms are ok, look bit old but are comfy.
We went there for couple nights for a family get away from auckland
Great hotel for the value.
They got lots of rooms to acommodate big events as well.
Definitely will be back :)
hotel_response:
Thank you for your review. We are very proud of our facilities and are very glad you enjoyed the pool. 
Our rooms are currently undergoing major refurbishment and the first of the refurbished rooms will be available in the next few weeks. Its very exciting. We look forward to having you stay with us again soon.

title: They would need to convince me to stay again
text:
This hotel is a large hotel on the outskirts of Hamilton.  I was here in November and only for one night.
When I arrived I was greeted by a friendly receptionist who could not do more to assist me in finding my room.  I made my way to the room and was pleased to see that I had a large TV, a large room and a minibar.
The bathroom was a little tired as well as the decor in the room.  This was true for the restaurant/bar area also.  The whole place was probably cleaned regularly but I still felt a sense of 'un-cleanliness' about the room.  I woke up in the morning to a dead cockroach on the bathroom floor too.
Walking around I felt like I was the only person there in the hotel. Which in honesty is not the hotels fault, but I did feel as though I was rattling around in a vast area.
You would be forgiven for thinking that this place had been passed from owner to owner.  It has the feeling of 'refurbishment' about it.  Work in progress if you will.
The food was not the best.  I ordered steak and most of it was gristle.
This is my experience of the hotel and I don't like to 'slate' places.  I like to try and give an honest account of where I stayed.  I will say that I made no complaints to management on my experience; apart from one.  That was the fact that someone had opened my minibar red wine and had a couple of slogs, before re-sealing the cap again!!
I couldn't fault the staff.  They were brilliant and they handled the complaing exactly how you would expect.
If the hotel is going through transition then I wish it well and perhaps when it is finished I will revisit.  If, however, this is the end product, then I think I will have to be strongly convinced to stay there again.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback. The Hotel was purchased by Distinction Hotel Group in February this year after being under the same ownership for 18 years. We are currently undertaking major refurbishment in our accommodation rooms. These will be available early next year. Thank you for your kind remarks about the staff- they are certainly a great team. This is certainly a transitional time for the hotel and we hope that you will return again when the refurbishment process is complete.

title: went there  to pick up family pack for special olympic
text: this place looked very nice  i wish i had stayed here  with the team looked  much nicer than the place  i stayed at, as family members of the team  we where made very welcome   Thankyou,  My son  Matty who stayed here said  the room he had was very nice  and  a very good bed and the food  was very very good and he would like to thank the staff working there and making his stay enjoyable
hotel_response: Thank you for your review. All the staff at the hotel really enjoyed having the special Olympics teams stay with us. We would love to see you all again.

title: Went to this hotel for Special Olympics registration
text: I went to this hotel to register myself for Special Olympics on 24 November 2016 and collected handbooks from this hotel! I also got to see my Special Olympics group there and there was sweet popcorns which I snacked on and did not like these sweet popcorns!
hotel_response: Thanks for the review. We hope you had a great time at the Special Olympics event.

title: In need of some love
text:
We recently had our trade conference at this function Centre. 

The food was below standard, often cold, unappealing. They served burgers to us at an Awards dinner.

I found the cleanliness of the room very poor also. There were stains in the bath that I wiped away. My colleagues found their sheets had not been changed. 

The decor is tired and rundown. It needs some serious maintenance. I would not recommend hosting a conference here.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to write a review. Your comments differ greatly from the bulk of the feedback we received. The organisers made a point of telling us how well the conference had gone and how good the food and service was. Please remember that it is the company having the conference that selects the food served- not the hotel. We are naturally disappointed that you found your room to not be to a high cleanliness standard and do wish that you had let us know this during your stay and not afterwards. The situation could have been rectified. 
Usually for a two night stay the sheets on a bed would not be changed- if you had stayed three nights they would have been changed on the third day. 
You probably noticed that  we are currently in the process of a major accommodation room refurbishment, in fact your companies services were offered to assist us with this.

title: Dirty, run down, cold and disconnected.
text:
We were pleased with the outside, the foyer and the staff but that's where it ended.
The 'block' our unit was in was on the road so it was noisy.
The corridors are long and hae carpet patches where other carpet tiles have become worn or damaged....the original carpet is beige...the patches are blue.
The room was dirty, the bathroom was worse, the fan was disgusting, the shower was just gross with mould, the vanity was falling apart, the tap was covered in soap scum and the floor was not clean either and it smelt bad.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to write a review. 
You will be pleased to know that we are currently in the process of refurbishing 55 of our accommodation rooms. The carpet tiles you refer too are actually the pattern- beige and brown. They are not patches that we have tried to fix.  However there is no excuse for your room cleanliness not be to a high standard and your comments have been directed to the Housekeeping manager and their team.

title: Used to be great , now NOT
text: Originally Kinsgate, booked for 5 people for 3 nights and got a written quote.  When we arrived, found Hotel had changed ownership.  They verbally said they would honour original agreement, but then overcharged us and refused to negotiate.  Would NEVER stay here again or recommend it to anyone wanting a honest friendly Hotel.  Complained in writing, got a phone call but no refund, no apology, no assistance in meeting original agreement.  Was completely unsatisfied with the service we got from this Hotel and from their management.
hotel_response:
We are disappointed that you feel like this. At check in your party asked for the booking to be changed to include breakfast. Your original paperwork showed that you had booked a room only rate. We changed the rate type to be one that includes breakfast but obviously the charge increases. 
When the phone call was made we were thanked for making the call and our apologies were given if there was a misunderstanding. We were even told that most people don't even bother to respond to complaint letters.  No refund was offered as no error had occurred. A friendly polite conversation was had.

title: Formerly Kingsgate spacious accommodation
text: Having stayed on a number of occasions when previously Kingsgate we booked although we had read some rather negative reviews.  This hotel is obviously an older hotel and would benefit from some upgrades but all we wanted was spacious clean and comfortable accommodation.  We always book ground floor because yes there is no lift and we are not as young as we were. Rooms have air conditioning,queen and single bed clean bedding bed covers perhaps not latest trend but clean. Lovely large mirror in the room with power point handy for hair dryers etc. large screen TV comfy easy chairs. Tea and coffee making facilities.  Bar fridge, staff accommodating we don't like uht milk so always as for a jug of fresh milk no hassle at all.  Bathroom fittings clean as were towels.  If I was to find any real fault I would say the rubber bath mat could do with a bit of a scrub.  Good free parking.  We did not dine on this occasion so cannot comment here. But reception and bar staff very friendly happy hour in the house bar very reasonably priced.  This is not a five star complex but good affordable family accommodation.  We would stay here over the Ibis every time. Our one experience at the Ibis was a claustrophobic room and greasy inedible breakfast.  We will stay again without a doubt at the Distinction.  A big complex like this is bound to have the odd issue so I hope this review helps viewers decide to give it a go I am sure you will not be disappointed and if you do have an issue talk to management at the time to get it rectified rather than just post bad feedback.  Good luck to the new owners.Sue and John.  Also has free wi fi now.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your review. We really appreciate it.
We are undertaking our refurbishment currently so hopefully next time you return you will experience the fabulous new modern rooms. 
I will make sure I pass your comments on to all the team.

title: In need of care and a revamp....but great if you love hide and seek.
text:
Stayed one night for work. Pleased it was one night.
The reception and restaurant area look good but the accommodation areas are looking very tired and in need of care.
The air con in my room didn't work, the TV didn't have a remote (one part of the hide and seek) & although it could be switched on at the wall, the channel & volume could not be adjusted. The second part of my hide & seek was trying to figure out what the dripping sound was - the seal on the fridge was so worn that it didn't seal well.
The complimentary wifi was strong and allowed for on demand viewing on my phone.
The main bright side was that the meals I ate there (dinner and breakfast) were nice. Gluten free continental breakfast was reasonably catered for (cooked would have mainly consisted of eggs and beans).
Feedback appears to suggest a refit is on the plans - in its current guise I would not stay again.
hotel_response:
Thank you for posting a review.
I am sorry you didn't enjoy all aspects of your stay. If you ever have any problems in a hotel while staying they can normally be immediately corrected if you just make a quick call to reception. 
Our refurbishment is currently being worked on and the new rooms will be much more modern.

title: I'd stay elsewhere
text:
Run down and quite shabby.  Once upon a time this place must have been busy and maintained, sadly nowadays it's just not.  My room had peeling wallpaper, a fridge that didn't work, and the worst rock hard bed I've ever tried to sleep in anywhere in the world.  You know it;s bad when you get all the pillows and lay them in a row to try to sustain some level of comfort, but in the long term it just doesn't work.  
Breakfast buffet - just don't go there unless you want toast.
Dinner - surprisingly - very good indeed.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to post a review. 
You will be pleased to know that we are currently undertaking a major refurbishment project. However your comments have been noted and passed on to the team.

title: most disgusting experience whilst in New Zealand
text: Absolutely repulsive state of linen, towels & general cleaniness of room 403. Bathroom had not been cleaned as tap & sink had what appeared to be spit marks. Hand towels were  terribly worn & discoloured. All bed linen was thin, worn out & discoloured. Pillow protector yellow stained as was bed duvet. Bed also contained human hair & stains. Bad experience which turned my stomach & never to be forgotten.
hotel_response: We are obviously disappointed to read your comments. I have passed your review on to my team mebers for review. It is a shame we did not hear anything about this from you prior to your departure. Please be assured we take your comments very seriously.

title: Centrally located family trip
text:
Check in to the hotel you enter a grand reception, staff were super friendly and we were very impressed to be able to check in earlier than normal. (With kiddies this means the world to us). I called to request a room with a bath and this was arranged without any hassle. Decor seems dated and perhaps a soft refurb would be on the cards but on the whole the room was comfy and big enough for my family. 
We made use of their swimming area, it was fantastic!! clean and tidy. 
Staying in wing 600 is a huge benefit as you will be very close to reception, swimming pool, gym and the restaurant. 
Breakfast was amazing!! excellent choice and fresh. Jenelle one of the staff members was exceptional, she went out of her way to ensure my kids were comfy and gave them coloring goodies to keep them occupied.
From one mom to another that small gesture makes the world of difference.
hotel_response: Thanks for the great review. I will be sure to pass your comments on to the team. We are about to start a refurbishment in our guests rooms so I hope you can come back some time and enjoy the hotel again.

title: Everything you need but a little far from the city centre
text: This is the second time I have stayed here for a work conference. This Hotel is basic but very comfortable. It is clean, staff are friendly and breakfast is great. Maybe a bit to far out of the city centre for my liking but it is only around a 5 minute drive away. The Hotel is located next to a small shopping centre
