hotel_response: Thanks for taking the time to post a review. We are glad you enjoyed the hotel. We will soon undertake a refurbishment of the property so we hope you are back to see the new product soon.

title: odd place but did the trick
text: went here as a last minute choice for rugby match at WAikato stadium.  Sort of an interesting mix of dated decor and quality.  Room was fine.  Creaky floors in halls.  wooden doors, almost dorm like.  But room was fine.  fixtures all worked, not super modern or trendy but perfectly fine.  Very clean, no peeling wall paper, cracked tile, etc.  Plenty of hot water, heating worked, clean linens and beds.  A bit overpriced but again, i didn't have a lot of choice.  Super friendly and helpful desk staff.  Did everything it was supposed to do.
hotel_response: Thanks for the review. We really appreciate it. We are about to undertake a refurbishment of our accommodation rooms to make them far more modern. We hope you come back and visit again once this is complete.

title: family stay to attend  Te Rapa Races
text: Chose this hotel due to its location adjacent  to Te Rapa race Course. We were disappointed with the cleaniless and presentation. We had 3 rooms and 2 of these were not cleaned properly..A.large pile of biscuit crumbs beside the bed and unvacummed look throughout  in one room, very rumbled sheets on bed in another and bathroom not cleaned properly  The hotel was very busy that day and a family member did inform a staff member.  Beds comfortable enough but i would check room if we did decide to stay again .
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to post a review of your stay. I am disappointed that your room was not up to standard and I have passed your comments on to our new Housekeeping Manager. I do hope you return another time.

title: Business Seminar
text:
Stayed night before seminar to catch up with other attendees 
Had business dinner and breakfast package. Good food and service. Great venue for seminar we were well looked after and food choice was most excellent
Would highly recommend for conference venue
Hotel rooms good size a bit basis but very clean and price was very reasonable
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to post a review. We are delighted that you enjoyed your stay and that your seminar was such a success. We hope to welcome you back again soon.

title: Distinctive! Will def stay here again.
text: Front Desk Workers all day shifts were welcoming, accommodating, enthusiastic & helpful. We were very impressed with all staff and we felt at home during brekkie service & when we were in lax mode. Enjoyed the spas and pool. Comfy bed and room.
hotel_response: Thank you for the fantastic review. We really appreciate it. We hope to see you back again soon.

title: Distinctly mediocre
text: The room was perfectly ordinary, although a wine glass carried the lipstick of a previous guest. But on no account eat here! We ordered soup of the day and a Caesar salad. Might take a well organized kitchen a couple of minutes to prepare, but it took half an hour and when it arrived the soup had a distinctly unfresh feel while the accompanying roll was very stale.
hotel_response:
Thank you for letting us know about your stay. We appreciate any and all feedback.
I have passed your comments on to housekeeping and the restaurant to ensure they have proper procedures in place.

title: unhappy
text: we have stayed here before and that was great but this time we were disappointed the bed was hard the furniture was old and warn out springs coming through the furniture  and you are paying good money for what
hotel_response: Thank you for tasking the time to write a review. We are naturally disappointed that you did not really enjoy your stay with us however I am pleased to be able to let you know that under the new ownership the refurbishment of the hotel is about to begin. Watch this space.

title: Great place to stay
text: Excellent facilities at an affordable price. Good location, plenty of parking. Nice restaurant, pleasant and helpful staff. Clean rooms. Car park able to park over a hundred cars. Close to Bunnings store for the boys!
hotel_response: Thanks very much for your review. We are thrilled that you enjoyed your stay- sounds like the Bunnings store just down the road was a hit. We hope to welcome you back again soon.

title: Great  place to stay
text:
Really enjoyed our 3 day stay here. We arrived earlier than  check in time and the lady at reception was very accommodating at getting us into our room as soon as she could (the complex was very busy!). On the second morning we had issues with our air conditioning unit and when we alerted reception we were moved to a new room - no questions asked no problems at all - fantastic service.  Our room was lovely and clean and our bed was big and  comfortable.  Would definitely stay here again. 
It's so nice to see staff that are approachable and helpful.
hotel_response: Thank you for your fantastic review. I am delighted that you enjoyed your stay so much. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon. I will be sure to pass your comments on to the staff too.

title: Just Average
text: Decor quite tired and the whole hotel could do with a massive refurbishment. Close to The Base for shopping. Eat in the hotel or you will have to travel about 4km into the centre of Hamilton as there is no where close to eat. Staff are very helpful and efficient. This hotel is often full as it host to many Chinese tour parties, and their coaches.
hotel_response:
Thank you for posting a review. 
The hotel is about to start renovations so we hope you may return to enjoy the new look and feel. I will pass on your comments about the staff to the team. Its always good to receive feedback.

title: Frequent travellers
text: We stayed one night after a social event in Hamilton. It was a last minute decision to stay overnight and phoned to make a booking and arrived about 10.30 pm. The reception area was huge with a lot of wasted space and not atmosphere. It reminded me of venues from the 70's where they would have had a lot of sales conferences and people standing around smoking. I got that same impression walking through the hallways to our room. Although our room was spacious the whole place needs refurbishing. It's a big hotel with good parking, just felt we were in a time warp.
hotel_response: Thank you very much for taking the time to write a review. Plans are in place for an updated look. We hope you can return again to enjoy this when it is done.

title: Hotel rebranded
text:
This hotel is now a Distinction Hotel. 

Large, plain, clean room. Corridor smelled of cleaning product? Door to 400 block tricky to open. Outside presentation of buildings very drab. 

Seems to cater for groups. One group was outside their block smoking/drinking at 4pm and 11pm. I was out so not sure if there all the time, but was not a welcoming look when driving in. 

Location is a few km out if city centre which is fine if you have transport.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to post a review. We hope that the other house guests outside did not disturb you too much. We do have lots of groups that come and stay with us for a weekend away. Hopefully we can welcome you back soon.

title: Overnight getaway
text: Great place to stay if you want somewhere quiet and away from town.  Friendly service on front desk. Comfortable clean  rooms. Adequate facilities for myself and teenage son.  Only downer was the weather.  Otherwise a pleasant stay.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments and its pleasing you enjoyed your stay with us. I apologise for the weather but as they always say in the Waikato "the farmers will be pleased". Once again it is appreciated that you have taken time to comment.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Excellent place to stay
text:
The place is great, organised, and clean. nice room and staff. We had a bit of a holiday rush in booking but it all went sweet.

Heaps of parking so need to worry on crowded and small spaces. Interconnected buildings allows you to stay under the roof if you wish too.. There is SPA though the pool is not too child friendly it is there for a quick dip.

Location is good and near to a few recommended "must see and do" in the area.
hotel_response:
Your comments are appreciated and I thank you for taking the time to provide the feedback. Nice to see you realised that the blocks are interconnecting and you can access all parts internally or under cover. We look forward to accommodating you again should you be visiting Hamilton.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Priced Right
text:
2 adults 2 children for $127 per night. Was good value. If you expect something fancy this is not the place. Basic, older yet spacious rooms but for all of us represented good value for money.

Management do need to address the tiled steps leading into the blocks of rooms. Very very slippery when wet. They need grips on the edges. I slipped down 4 tiled steps and it really hurt my back and badly bruising now and tender. Had it been an older person they probably would have had a broken back or similar.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments regarding your stay with us and for advising us regarding the steps to the rooms. We will water blast them down and see if there is improvement and if not look at the suggestions you have made.

thank you again for the feedback.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: conference
text: venue near shopping centres and waterworld, away from Hamilton central business district where parking is so expensive and unforgiving. walking distance to dairy and shops for those emergency things and cravings.

title: Ideal Place to Stay for Business Trips!
text: Quiet and tucked away from the main road so quiet.  I've had breakfast here and also dinner and I must say the food was awesome.  Although away from the city, it was close to the shopping centre (The Base) and also nice dining places.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. We have spent a lot of time listening to our guests regarding breakfast and believe the current buffet we are providing is good value for money and certainly being well received by our guests. 
Your comments will be passed onto the kitchen as they do try very hard to please our guests and I am sure your feedback will be most appreciated.
Hopefully we will have the opportunity to accommodate you again should you be in Hamilton.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: 1 night was enough
text: Was meant to stay here for 2 nights while visiting family in Hamilton but checked out after the 1st night. Rooms were not clean at all. Reception staff were not very friendly. We found another hotel for the same price up the road that was clean and tidy so if your shopping on price then look around.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your review from when you stayed with us 3 months ago. It is disappointing that we failed to meet the standards you required and I apologise for the shortcomings of the staff in the areas you have commented upon.

These issues will be taken up with the appropriate departments and addressed as required.

Thank you again for taking the time to make comment.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Family getaway
text: We booked 7 rooms and our stay was great, the decor was very old fashioned it did not bother us..The staff were helpful and friendly and never fussed with the dos and donts like other hotels..The spas and indoor pool was clean, the gym had the basic equipment. The rooms were clean and tidy and private. If you want good hotel staff then this is the hotel for you, but if your after a posh hotel resort then pay the extra $130 more. Great parking, security officer patrolling the hotel, close to township.  My only question would be why we were charged different prices for the same rooms?
hotel_response:
Thank you for the kind comments and great that you enjoyed your stay with us and your visit to Hamilton. I can only assume rooms were either booked on different dates and as such rates do change regularly dependent on occupancy levels. Alternatively there could have been triple rooms booked which are priced slightly hire as many people book them for two adults (or even a single adult travelling) only and this means we are less able to accommodate family's travelling with children. These rooms are especially popular due to the size and number of beds.

Once again your feedback is appreciated and that you have taken time to provide positive feedback. Hopefully we will have the opportunity of accommodating you again should you be visiting Hamilton.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Dated and in need serious renovation
text:
Don't let that this Millennium Hotel fool you. This is far from the standard for any Millennium Hotel i've have ever seen before. This hotel reminds me of something from the 1970's and its probably when it was last renovated. Very dated room facilities, though foyer is well presented to give the image of a decent hotel. Room was basic and uncomfortable. We had difficulties with air-conditioning and there was musty smell in the room. Bathroom was dated and shower had mold discolouration around lower tiles. Would not recommend to any other travelers. Couldn't find any positive point of this hotel. 

again personally.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment.

We are a Kingsgate Hotel, the 3rd tier of the Millennium Hotels Brand with Copthorne Hotels rated above us as well.

The hotel was built in 1998 so yes it has had a full and complete renovation since the 1970's and even over the last two years we have replaced: All carpet throughout the hotel, room curtains, flat screen TV's, headboards, room lounge and desk chairs and all wooden room fixtures have been stripped, re-stained and re-varnished.  We have painted all entryways, corridors (and added artwork), and wi-fi has also been installed throughout the hotel. 

I am sure if asked reception would have been more than happy to show you how to operate the air conditioning units, we do have many guests who incorrectly use the wrong mode when seeking heat or cooling.

I regret that some of the work done may not be to your liking and not to the standards you desire, however I do believe the pictures we have on various websites do show a true indication of the hotel. 

Again thank you for comments and work will be continuing. 

Kind regards, 

Murray Cook.

title: Down at heel
text: Sprawling complex used by groups for weekend benders. Bar fridge in room empty which was annoying as we arrived late and everything was closed; Rooms are a throw back to the 80s.  Very disappointing, untidy and unkempt.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment.

I am unsure what date you stayed but the only group that I think you could be referring to was a leading New Zealand company who held their annual conference and function outside of the Hotel. They booked 127 of the 147 rooms at the Hotel. 

We certainly do not encourage or like having guests on "benders" and would appreciate if they stayed elsewhere. Unfortunately with many guests booking on-line in these times one does not get to choose who can stay or not.

This is also a reason two of our blocks do not have minibars and they can be requested if required.

I regret we were unable to meet your standards and that other guests appear to have helped add to a disappointing stay with us.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Very tired and a bit grubby
text: No way in the world this place should have a 4 star rating. Decades old decor, furniture and beds. Stained carpet and bedding. Holes in the bedspread, cobwebs everwhere, peeling wallpaper, grubby fridge, squeaky floor boards in my room and the neibouring room - yes I could hear every step. Find somewhere else.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comments. The room chairs have been replaced within the last 18 months and the desk chairs within the last 2 months. The wooden tables and desk tops were all repainted within the last 10 months. The carpet was replaced throughout the hotel 2 years ago and bedspreads as well. The block you stayed in was wooden framed where as the other accommodation blocks were block built and as such there are some creaking in the boards in the particular block you stayed in.

I regret we failed to meet your standards and apologise for our shortcomings. Housekeeping will be informed regarding their shortcomings and in the area's possible the problems will be rectified.

Kind regards

title: Good place for business stay
text:
Stayed for 2 nights room good for the value, good restaurant,has swimming pool.
Needs new bed though room bit old but clean Though .big room and shower plus close to main attraction of Hamilton . Friendly staff and very helpful
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment and your evaluation of the Hotel.

Unfortunately we cannot ascertain the room you stayed in to check or replace the bed. We get many comments regarding the bedding as the softness or firmness is a very personal item for a guest. We replace bedding when guests make comments or there are obvious signs showing the need for replacement and always carry stock of new mattresses.

i appreciate the comments regarding the restaurant and staff and these will be forwarded to them.

Thank you again for your feedback.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Old and tired
text: We were given a nights' stay at this hotel as a gift.  This particular Kingsgate is more of a motor lodge than a hotel.  It is set out in several wings most suited to tour parties or school trips or church camps perhaps. In fact the whole experience, right down to the catering, did feel like a church camp.  Old beds, tired decor, tiled bathrooms in need of a makeover.  Buffet breakfast was simple but passable.  Reception staff weren't particularly welcoming and didn't explain the hotel or its features or layout when we checked in.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment.

When the Hotel was built in 1998 council by-laws limited the height to 2 story level only (the area is still zoned as such)  and as such to accommodate 147 rooms the hotel was built in wings with all rooms being accessible internally.

Over the last 2 years we have replaced: All carpet throughout the hotel, new blue curtains, flat screen TV's, lounge and restaurant furniture, headboards, bedspreads, some beds, room lounge and desk chairs, reception and F&B buffet and service tops. We have painted all entryways, corridors (and added pictures), all wooden surfaces in the rooms and one block of rooms. Wi-fi has also been installed throughout the hotel. 

Your comment regarding reception and check in has been taken up with the Front office Manager and will be addressed. Thank you for bringing this to my attention and again thank you for the feedback.

Kind regards, 

Murray Cook.

title: had a great night
text: the room was very nice and the staff at reception were very nice and welcoming, I would stay there again, It had everything that was needed, the shower was great and was a nice place to stop before going through to Auckland, we arrived there latter in the day and left early in the morning
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments and great that you were able to use us as a stopover when travelling through to Auckland. Reception staff will appreciate your comments as many people do not take the time to provide positive feedback.

We look forward to accommodating you again should you be staying in Hamilton.

Kind regards

title: Family visit to nearby attractions
text: We stayed here while we were visiting local attractions. We found the rooms to be spacious which was great for my wife & I & our 2 youngest children 11 & 5, the place had a dual door senario where you had to unlock the door to the block  & then unlock the door to the room. It was a little awkward if you went out to the car you needed to take the key as you couldn't just tap on the door to have some one let you back in. I found a local pizza shop (hells pizzas) or some thing like that, which was convenient & cheap & had a noodle shop next door which feed us for the night. All in all it was a pleasant stay with spacious room that were a little tired & stuffy. This was reflected in the price being cheaper than others though.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment as your feedback is appreciated. The dual lock system although inconvenient is appreciated by many guests as it provides a feeling of added security with entrance to accommodation wings can only be made via key. reception would be more than happy to provide multiple keys for rooms if requested.

It is great that you were able to get away with the family and hopefully the weather was good enough to spend time at Waterworld across the road from us or do some shopping at the Base complex further down Te Rapa straight. Hells pizza shop and the noodle restaurant are close by and across from them is also a good indian takeaway restaurant.

Thank you again for your comments and I am pleased we were able to provide value for money as you have indicated.

Kind regards

title: A hotel for all occasions and tastes
text:
This hotel was full of 4 football teams and all its support staff for the FIFA U20 World Cup for which Hamilton was one of the host cities. It never seemed crowded despite being full and had a relaxed atmosphere most of the time. The staff were incredibly accommodating although they were 100% full and meeting the demands of the needs of 4 national teams professional players competing in the all important event. 

The rooms are not the most modern but they are very clean, large and well appointed and totally comfortable complete with fridge and individual heat pumps.

Parking is a breeze and so easy as the grounds of the hotel are so large. There is a big lounge and bar area as well 2 restaurants.

Good buffet breakfast and nicely furnished dining room. 

However what made my stay here (13 nights) was the staff. They were just ready to make the stay as easy as possible and worked hard to ensure all the different needs of the guests were met with great timing.

Great hotel, great service and no problem to recommend at all...
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments. Yes the FIFA World under 20 Championships were a busy time for the Hotel, especially catering for 4 individual teams in 4 different conference rooms at varying times and on different menu's. With teams coming and going it was exciting to meet the teams with their different cultures, languages and personality's and the staff working through this time certainly enjoyed it.

It was a well organised tournament and the FIFA management and teams support staff were easy to work with which assisted us in providing the service we were able to over the period of the event.

Thank you again for the comments

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Dated
text: Stayed here as a stopover to napier but probably  wouldn't  stay again rooms were a bit shabby,showers the we're just warm even on highest setting and no pressure.the staff however were lovely. Place just needs an update.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments - Considerable work has been done, over the last 2 years we have replaced: All carpet throughout the hotel, new curtaining, flat screen TV's, lounge and restaurant furniture, headboards, bedspreads, room chairs, reception and F&B buffet and service tops. We have painted all entryways, corridors (and added pictures), all wooden surfaces in the rooms and the walls in one block of rooms. Wi-fi has also been installed throughout the hotel. Maintenance and upgrade is an on-going programme and will continue. I regret that some of the work done may not be to noticeable or done to some peoples liking but I  believe the pictures we have on various websites do show a true indication of the hotel and if anything are outdated in some cases. Again thank you for comments and be assured work will be continuing. 

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Great Value Hotel
text: Clean, comfortable and spacious hotel. Large rooms, quiet location with easy parking. Good size gym and pool facility. Restaurant food nice. Great value. The location is between town and the Te Rapa shopping precinct so easy for both.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your feedback which is appreciated. Certainly it is one of the larger hotels space wise in Hamilton with large public area's, rooms and conference area's which make it appealing for travelling groups and individuals alike. 

I hope you managed to pick up a bargain at the Base shopping centre which is reputed to be one of the biggest shopping complex area's in New Zealand and hopefully we will have the opportunity of accommodating you again should you be in Hamilton.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Excellent value
text: Stayed here while in Hamilton for my sisters graduation and we loved it. For the price you pay its very good! Although the bathrooms could be in need of a refurb everything else is great! We don't stay anywhere else. This is our 3rd time here thank you Kingsgate
hotel_response:
Thank you for the kind comments and congratulations to your sister for graduating.

I appreciate you taking the time to provide such positive feedback and hopefully we will have the opportunity of accommodating you again should you be visiting Hamilton.

Kind regards

title: Very underwhelming
text:
The hotel is clean and expansive, but during my recent stay I was left underwhelmed by certain aspects that left you feeling that some aspects were sloppy. My biggest gripe was the noise in the rooms. I was not alone, but air-conditioning, fridges and creaking floor boards in next door rooms meant a good night's sleep was impossible. On a 16-18 hour business day not being able to sleep when you are completely shattered is disappointing. 

Then there was the food. 40 minute wait in the restaurant for a post meal cheese board. Orders missed. Juice empty at breakfast, bread not replenished, gelatinous scrambled eggs, and the toaster that was turned off at 8am. (breakfast runs until gone 9am). 

I certainly wouldn't be giving it a 4 star rating. Perhaps at a push a 3. I've reviewed my visit as average, because that's what it was.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment on the Hotel. 

I understand you comments regarding the noise in the wing you stayed in. This would be the 600 wing which was built later than the rest of the hotel and rather than the concrete block build was built using timber. Unfortunately there are areas where we do still get creaking floor panels and it looks like we will need to tighten them down further. Each room has individual air conditioning units and there is some noise associated with providing heat pumps that may be on all night during the colder winter months.

I have followed up regarding your restaurant comments and at no stage have we had the tunnel toaster and 4 slice pop up toasters turned off at 8.00am and advise breakfast runs until 10.00 am. We have 4 x 3 litre juice containers with orange, apple, grapefruit and pineapple available along with carafes of tomato juice and iced teas. It surprises me that juice would be empty and have advised staff to ensure this is monitored more stringently.

Thank you again for making comment.

Kind regards

title: Good value for money
text:
Easy to find, real close to Te Awa and The base, room definitely was value for money, only booked for 1 night as i was attending a 21st in ngaruwahia.  Decor is outdated, the fan in the bathroom doesn't work, had a motel feel plus side, had a flat screen with access to sky so could watch the game :)

Gym equipment needs an upgrade, access to the spa and pool closed at 9.30pm bit guttered, but next time will definitely make sure to hit the spa/pool earlier next time.

overall value for money, definitely will be coming back
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. Yes the rooms are large and many do have 2 x queen beds or more in them. I understand the gym gear is not the latest available but still believe it is a welcome addition to find when staying at  a hotel. It is a pity you missed out on using the spa's and pool as these are very popular with our guests, especially those travelling with family.

Once again thank you for the comments and appreciate that you will look at staying with us again when back in Hamilton. Hope the 21st was an enjoyable night.

Kind regards

title: More like a Motel
text: Accommodation is more like a Motel. I've read the managers comments on other reviews about the layout and restrictions wen built but this asside I think the Kingsgate could do more to add a hotel feel to the rooms themselves. They have a Motel feel and look to them.. the rooms have a musty smell in entering and the attention to detail is lacking we were in room 108 light fittings were hanging needed screws replaced, bathroom was dirty with mould in shower and the roof was moldy... I did let staff know and I have emailed hotel directly..
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments and as stated in my email to you the showers were inspected and what you refer to as mould is black grouting that has faded and become somewhat unsightly over the years with constant use of exit mould and bleach cleaners. A programme is in place to address these when possible. Yes there were two small spots on the ceiling which the housemaid allocated that room could not reach. The light covers were loose but not hanging as you have stated and this has been repaired. You were than welcome to change rooms if requested as these shortcomings made for a stay less favourable than we would have wished.

The rooms have no cooking facilities as a motel room would. The hotel has a housebar, 2 restaurants, 24 hour room service and reception, conference facilities, indoor pool and spa's, steam rooms and a gymnasium which motels generally do not have. There is little difference between hotel and motel rooms apart from the cooking options but appreciate your comment.

Again thank you for your comments and bringing up our shortcomings so they can be rectified.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Very handy to the Base shopping
text: The room was adequate.  We often find these places a little tired in the decor.  The bed was comfortable.  We ate at the restaurant - compared to Whangarei Kingsgate it lacked panache.   The staff were obviously new - no warm and friendly feel about the place and our meals were very average.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. I am unsure what restaurant you dined in but if it was the main one that is predominantly used for breakfast I can understand your feelings as it is very spacious and set out to for large numbers and when quiet is underwhelming. The restaurant we use for a la carte is a 70 seater restaurant and often receives positive comments for the staff and product produced. I am sorry that on the occasion you dined neither seems to have been of acceptable standard.

Your comments will be passed onto the Food and Beverage management and all staff along with the levels of service required from them. Thank you for bringing this to my attention.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Bleh
text:
The hotel is positioned a 10 minute car drive from the city centre. Whilst clean enough the rooms and corridors are very dim and outlook dreary. We were told our room was ready but a cleaner was doing the bathroom floor. She advised that she had to go to morning tea but would come back to finish - which involved a 2 second wipe with a towel - it was not clear why she could not do this at the time. 
Nothing really wrong with this place - apart from generally depressing air. Large grounds but nothing made of them - some plantings may have livened the place up.
hotel_response:
Thank you for the comments. The hallways were painted a mosquito grey in the last 12 months and have down spotlights, pictures were added within the last 2 years. I think what may make them dreary is the size and length of them. Council regulations for the area restricted the building to 2 levels and as such it is spread over a large area in separate wings. With 147 rooms and conferencing for up to 600 people a large number of car parks were also required by local by laws and as such the large the large carparking area. 

I appreciate the feedback re the housekeeping staff and am at a loss as to why this would happen. The matter will be taken up with the housekeeper and staff member concerned. I apologise for this and agree it is starnge and unacceptable.

kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Mixed bag
text: Fairly large property with lots of parking, spacious lobby and restaurant. Rooms were fairly large and bathrooms spotlessly clean. The staff at the reception and restaurant were friendly and responsive. Though limited menu, found the food at the restaurant to be great with prompt and attentive service. Breakfast spread was limited and got rather monotonous as spent close to a week. The only downside was that it took two days to get the flush in the loo rectified,.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. I would suggest if you have a long stay at a Hotel you ask the staff if you require anything that may not be on the menu eg omelettes, ice cream sundaes, eggs benedict etc. Our kitchen and restaurant would be more than happy to help. Our breakfast buffet is extensive and we have spent a lot of time adapting it to fit guest requirements. It has 5 cereals, 4 fruits, 2 yoghurts, meat & cheese, 5 bread types, croissants & pastries, 5 juices, tea & coffee and we have just added iced tea. Hot food available consists of scrambled egg, mushrooms, baked beans, hash browns, sausages and bacon. We will cook eggs to request if scrambled eggs are not required.

Your comments regarding the staff is very much appreciated and I apologise for the time taken to repair the toilet cistern. Many times the button just sticks down but in your case it was a matter of replacing the whole cistern workings. Thank you for bringing it to our attention.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Doesn't quite live up to its name
text:
The outside looks impressive but rooms are very dated - the TV for example was slumped from horizontal onto an angle, summing up the tiredness of my room. 

I thought the service would be similarly shoddy but was surprised at how good the staff were when I asked for a quick room-service meal. I needed it within half an hour because I had night work. It arrived within half an hour and was excellent. 

The hotel seems popular with cheaper bus-tour groups, When I arrived back after work before midnight there were several noisy groups of young travellers around the entrance and foyer. However the noise didn't extend to my room. I found the bed comfortable and clean and had a great night's sleep.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. feedback regarding the staff is always appreciated and I am sure they will be pleased regarding your comments.

I will get housekeeping & maintenance to check regarding the TV's in the room but was aware of the difficulty's installing the flat screen TV's when replacing the old style TV's with not being able to fix direct to the wall.

The groups you may be referring to were people attending a dancing competition in Hamilton and they particularly book this Hotel every year for the large triple rooms and location to the event.

Thank you again for the constructive and thoughtful feedback.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Not as glamorous as it looks...
text: The reception foyer is quite impressive. Upon entering the accommodation wing I was overwhelmed by the stale hospital smell. It got worse in the room, including being stuffy.  Bed was uncomfortable and room seriously needed updating. When the air-conditioning didn't work they did give us another room without question. It was cheaper accommodation, so you do get what you pay for.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments and taking the time to evaluate the Hotel. We will take the matter regarding the clean air deodorant product we use to our supplier (Diversey) and advise them of your comment. I am sorry that you found the room stuffy but we have had humid weather recently and we do close the windows in rooms once cleaned and they all have air-conditioning units, although yours was faulty and has now been replaced. 

It is pleasing that staff were able to move you to a room with a working air-conditioning unit and thank you for bringing it to our attention.

Again, thank you for the comments and I regret we did not provide the stay we would have wished for you.

Kind regards,

Murray Cook

title: Peter
text: Great hotel. Enjoy everything about the hotel. Staff awesome and helpful. Really convenient to waitomo and raglan. Would visit again. Keep up the great service. Would recommended hotel to all who visit Hamilton.
hotel_response:
Thank you for the kind comments and evaluation. These will be passed onto the staff who I am sure will appreciate them as they do try hard to meet and exceed guest expectations.

It is always special when someone takes the time to express positive feedback on service and staff and once again I thank you for this.

Hopefully we have the opportunity of accommodating you again when visiting Hamilton.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Great Hotel for a great price!
text: We got a great deal here for the 5 of us including breakfast. The kids loved the pool and the 3 spa pools and we spent quite  a bit of time in these.  Our room was large and adequate but we had a couple of issues. We had a very bad flickering light but once I reported this it was sorted straight away. The milk was frozen in the fridge so I wanted to call for more milk and also we wanted to order some room service when I went to use the phone it wasn't working, I realised it wasn't plugged it, the reason being that the jack on the wall was completely broken so I had to pop to reception with 3 kids in tow to ask for more milk and report the fault.  We then decided to go out for dinner and when we came back popped into reception and she said the phone could not be fixed as the maintenance man had gone home!! Not very impressed. However still give the hotel a good rating and would stay there again as great price, good facilities, lovely breakfast, big room and good location. It is very close to The Base which is a huge shopping complex with lots of places to eat. Even though the phone problem was inconvenient it won't put us off.
hotel_response:
Thank you for the comments and feedback. Unfortunately replacing telephone jacks is not something our Duty staff are able to do and apologise that this caused an inconvenience. 

Great that the kids were able to enjoy the pool area and in case you were unaware Waterworld is across the road behind the Hotel.

Hopefully we will have the opportunity of accommodating you again when visiting Hamilton.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Pretty average
text: We requested to check in early on the online booking. They don't do early check in, no one bothered to contact and tell us, I phoned and was told to just show up early and see wat happens. So we arrived around 1 couldn't check in till 2 when our wedding started at 2. The receptionist got us in a bit earlier after talking to the cleaners, arrived a our not at all **** room, it was either old or poorly maintained. Ther was black hair in the bathroom, stains on the sheets and a damp smell hanging around. After attending the wedding we went to our room and I suffered from an asma attack, forgotten my inhaler and no one had an asma pump handy,so we rushed back home at 3am and never even slept in our room. This place looked older than a RSA and was badly maintained. I've stayed at the sky city grand hotel for the same price before. Not a 4star
hotel_response:
I apologise for the room not being ready for your early arrival. I have gone through the booking with the reservationist and unfortunately the receptionist who loaded the booking into the system failed to put your request in the comment field or respond.  Unfortunately the 600 wing where the wedding guests group was allocated was one the last to be done and again I regret our shortcomings and appreciate the feedback.

The Sky City Grand is a 5 star Hotel and you have done very well if you stayed there for the same price - going on todays rate you would be paying twice as much staying there rather than with us and our rate includes  two breakfasts.

I regret our standards failed to meet your expectations and again apologise for our shortcomings.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Very good hotel - good value for money
text: We only stayed at Kingsgate Hamilton for 1 night on our way back to Auckland and it was a very good choice. Well positioned hotel in a nice quiet area with a very good restaurant. Hotel staff was very professional and helpful. Room was pretty standard, clean and overall well appointed. Bathroom was particularly clean which always is a bonus. We were offered late check out at no charge which made the leaving day a lot more relaxing. Very good value for money. We never stayed in Kingsgate chain of hotels before but based on this experience definitely will in the future.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments and the feedback is very much appreciated. It is always special when people take the time to mention the staff and how helpful they were during your stay, I am sure they will join with me in thanking you for the compliments. 

Hopefully we will have the opportunity of accommodating you again in the future when staying in Hamilton.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: silent and peaceful
text: A nice hotel with good parking space. Hotel is spread in all directions with not more than two floors. all are interconnected. nothing much for shopping or activities near by as the hotel itself is in a quite area. Laundry has to be delivered at the reception before 9am as it is outsourced.. like many other hotels. Nice breakfast and recreation center in the lobby level.
hotel_response:
Thank you for the comments. Yes being off the main road doe's make for a more peaceful environment and hopefully a better nights sleep. 

Council restrictions limited the building to two storey's and as such the wing type set up. It is pleasing to see you found that all rooms can be accessed through interconnecting corridors internally.

Thank you again for taking the time to make comment and they are very much appreciated.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: KINGSIZE EXPERIENCE
text: Firsts are always special so will be the kingsgate hotel for me, my first hotel stay in new zealand. the room spread is across sections. i was in section 5 which is one corner of the hotel but absolutely no complaints..the view was serene and rooms were very spacious and cozy. To top it off one the great aspects was the pool table at reception area, at 2 dollars a frame it was quite a steal and quite a night-time experience post work. A great place to stay with a very co-operative staff a special mention for a gentleman named lance who was very very helpful during our stay.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment in such a positive way. Your comment regrading Lance are especially appreciated as a staff member who works the "graveyard" shift gets very little recognition and I am sure he will appreciate it. 

I hope the rest of your trip to New Zealand is enjoyable and once again thank you for the comments.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Sausage scandal
text: Our family of four stayed one night.  We had booked online and reservation included hot breakfast.  When we showed up for breakfast that morning, we found it was only valid for two hot breakfasts (although we booked the room for two adults and two kids).  The hostess entered the kids ages into the computer and we opted to get them the cold breakfast.  I shared a hash brown and sausage link with them and we were charged $32 for two additional hot breakfasts at checkout!!  I found it outrageous.  Beware of the hidden charges and scandals of the breakfast buffet!!  Left a rotten taste in our mouths, for sure.
hotel_response:
Thank you for the comments. All our B&B packages, apart from the one on our own website, are for for 2 breakfasts only. That is why they are priced at $30 above the room only rate. For two breakfasts this represents a $7 discount off each breakfast. Dependent on the age of the children 14+ years for a continental breakfast is $16. If the children were over 14 years of age this would be $32 for both of them

We certainly allow leniency in some area's and do not upgrade continental to full breakfast if someone was to have a sausage or a hash brown off another persons plate.

I thank you for your comment.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Don't every stay here
text:
This would have to be the worst place I have every stayed, very dirty and out dated, unhelpful staff.
Over 40 of us stayed here for a week, and every one of us would never be back.
Very dirty rooms, also very smelly . They don't change the sheets and never really clean the rooms.we saw lots of cockroachs in this place .
Also the food was just the worst I have ever seen.
They say the are 4 star, Haha, be lucky to get one.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make complaints via the internet. 

I can assure you sheets are changed every 3rd night for long stay groups and obviously every night for new guests. Cockroaches are very common in Hamilton and they are the Gisborne variety that feeds on bark and will be found everywhere there is greenery in Hamilton. We have only had comment on two seen in the accommodation wings over the entire summer and doorways are sprayed to ensure they don't enter the building.

I find it disappointing that we now get informed of these shortcomings when nothing has been reported during your stay with us and any problems being able to be rectified at the time.

It is also disturbing that you rate the food as the worst ever seen as we put a new menu in late February and feedback has been extremely positive with no negative comments at all, breakfast is also rated very highly by our guests as well.

I regret we failed to meet your standards and apologise for shortcomings of the hotel and staff and again thank you for taking the time to put your thoughts into writing.

Kind regards

title: Hotel needs to spend some money!
text:
Not impressed at all with the facility but good customer service during checking in and out.  I booked in at Kingsgate Hamilton Hotel because of a excellent experience as Kingsgate Rotorua Hotel.  Kingsgate Hamilton was crap in comparison!!!  This was so not a hotel like facility.  The rooms are outside - like a motel more like it.  The sense of security when you check into a hotel was not really there at Kingsgate Hamilton because you have to leave the main reception building to a outside facility to your room.

Thinking, okay we can manage that.  We went into our room, there was a sense of the room being used and not cleaned.  There were stains on the shower glass, soap stains.  The toilet seemed uncleaned. 

Then to top everything off, the furniture and furnishings were so outdated that i wondered when the owners of the place would have last invested in their assets... like 20 years ago?

I did ask if the hotel was a franchise ... yes it was ... go figure! owners making money and not reinvesting any of it back into the facilities.

So not the money i spent for a nights stay!

Great for kids and large family's looking for a motel facility to stay in.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment.

Over the last 2 years we have replaced: All carpet, curtains, TV's, lounge and restaurant furniture, headboards, bedspreads, room lounge chairs, reception and F&B buffet and service tops. We have painted all entryways, corridors (and added pictures), and all wooden surfaces in the rooms and one block of rooms. Wi-fi has also been installed throughout the hotel. On order are new desk chairs for all the rooms. Maintenance and upgrade is an on-going programme and will continue. I regret that some of the work done may not be to your liking and believe the pictures we have on various websites do show a true indication of the hotel. 

On construction of the Hotel in 1998 council by laws limited it to two levels and as such it is built in wings. Internal access is available to all rooms via reception through the overbridge or 300 entry. Security is added via a two key system with one key for entry to accommodation and one key entry to the rooms. The 500 wing you have stayed in is a mix of queen only, queen/double and rooms with queen/queen and single. Other wings have king only or queen and single and the 600 wing has shower over bath for people travelling with young children.

Again thank you for comments and work will be continuing. 

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Reasonably comfortable
text:
Nothing special but had a reasonably comfortable couple of nights. Not really close to anything, e.g. Restaurants, shops, sights, etc. Although water world nearby if you have kids.
Rooms a bit dated, poor SKY reception in our room. Useful exercise area, although sauna disappointing. Breakfast good, friendly staff. No regrets but would stay somewhere else next time.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make a constructive and informative comment. I am unaware of the date you stayed but recently we had trouble with SKY TV and this required a new amplifier unit which meant the signal was not as strong as possible. The sauna is a steam room and works on boiling water and as such does take a period of time to heat up (usually 5 minutes maximum). We are one of the closest hotels to the Base Shopping centre (5 minutes drive) which is one of the largest malls/shopping areas in New Zealand and I would suggest visiting there if in Hamilton again.

Again thank you for the review.

KInd regards

Murray Cook

title: Very Average Place to Stay
text: Staff at reception was in such a hurry I couldn't pick up anything he was saying.  Room was very dated, bed was hard as a rock.  Everything was clean but well over due for a do up.  I was there for a work conference, our conference room was beside another group that was so loud we couldn't here our speakers.  Food was definitely below average and they never supplied enough especially at morning and afternoon tea.  Standard of the food was also very average, never any fresh fruit on offer and the main lunch and dinner meals were very stodgy.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments - we have an extensive conference food list to choose from and any food requirements are chosen by the conference organiser. Many are priced individually e.g. sandwiches so if particular people want to eat more than the ordered amount others may miss out or if fresh fruit is not ordered you will not get it.

Thank you for making the time to point out our shortcomings and we will speak to the receptionist involved to ensure he speaks more slowly and clearly. I have received no notes from reception or in house guest comment forms so cannot identify the bed that needs looking at. It is very helpful when guests let us know as we have replacement beds available at the hotel for replacement when beds are past there best date. Strangely most comments are that the beds go soft once they are getting older with springs losing there strength. 

Thank you again for your feedback and I regret we were not up to the standards you would have wished us to provide.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Good value for families
text: This hotel is huge and well set up for conferences with a small (cool) pool and 3 hot spas, along with a sauna in the huge changing rooms. We stayed in a family room which was also huge (2 queen sized beds and a single) for only NZ$85. (Booked on Booking.com) Beds were comfortable, wide range of tv channels, bathroom fine. Half an hour of free wifi available within the lobby. Huge shopping centre with food hall 5 mins up the road. If you are looking for cheap accommodation in Hamilton this would probably suit you well.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments highlighting the benefits of the Hotel for those travelling with families. Great to see you were able to take advantage of one of the special rates frequently available and get one of our triple rooms. We do not have a large number of these rooms and they are generally sold out over the busier weekends and the holiday periods. 

I hope your time in New Zealand was enjoyable for you and the family and wish you will for any future travel plans you may have. 

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Great service but very dated - in need of a refresh
text:
First and foremost the service is exceptional. The staff are very friendly and helpful.

Spacious rooms but very dated decor with wallpaper bubbling and peeling off. Not many power points in the room.

The onsite restaurant is very good,
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Note all wings have a double key system to provide added security to the blocks and rooms. We have received a number of comments recently thanking us for this and the sense of privacy it provides. I apologise that it may be an inconvenience but unfortunately in this day and age we do not wish to provide access to all the accommodation areas for everyone. Room maintenance and upgrade continues when possible and the upstairs 300 wing has just been painted and new desk chairs ordered.

Thank you for your comments regarding the restaurant and staff as we have just put in a new menu which we believe is one of the better one's we have had. I am sure the staff will appreciate your positive feedback and thank you for it.

Thank you again for taking the time to make comment.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Short stay
text:
My partner and I recently stayed here for a night to go to an event. While the receptionist was lovely she ran over the features to quickly to understand. The menu in the room was totally different to what the restaurant was actually serving and the opening hours were incorrect. Again the receptionist gave us the menu that was available, we had to order it as room service and sit in the lobby to eat. The stay in general was sufficient for what we needed it to be. The bed was quite uncomfortableq. Room service in the morning was good however just pay more attention to the tray as your doing an order for two people but there was only one set of utensils on it. I did want to mention the receptionist that was accommodating to us but she was not wearing a name badge. 

I hope these points help in some manner:)
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. The menu available was brought in for the December & January holiday period and is currently being replaced. We do this annually to make items more acceptable to families travelling over the festive season and I regret the confusion this has caused and apologise for the inconvenience. Your comments regarding the receptionist are appreciated and I can only assume they may have had their jacket off with the hot weather being experienced as this would have had a name badge attached.

We have a stock of spare beds at the hotel and to some extent rely on guest comments for the continued use of or replacement of beds. It is certainly appreciated when guests make us aware of a particular bed so we can change as necessary.

Thank you again for a constructive well written evaluation and I hope you enjoyed the event you attended.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Good for Families
text:
While this hotel is very dated it has several advantages. It is an excellent choice for people with kids as the rooms are very spacious, there are grassed areas around the buildings, an indoor pool and best of all, it's within walking distance of Water-world.
It is also very good value for money.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your constructive review. The hotel was opened in 1998 and due to council height restrictions limited to 2 levels and as such has what may be considered an old fashioned set up. The advantages being the amount of space at the hotel, A one level 300 car parking area, larger rooms and better leisure facilities than most. Great that you were able. Its great that you were able to enjoy Waterworld with the family and it is certainly a good amenity for Hamilton.

Providing value for money is certainly our aim and as such there are days with some good rates available, to get this response is very pleasing and I thank you for taking the time to post it. Hopefully you will be able to travel to Hamilton again in the future and we will have the opportunity of accommodating you again.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Well Priced Hotel
text:
We recently used this hotel as a one night stop-over to enable us to visit friends on our return journey to Christchurch from the Far North.  It is an older establishment but is very clean and tidy.  It provides excellent value for money, especially with the bed and breakfast option that we booked.

The pool looked great, although we did not have time to use it.  Each of the two rooms we had had an air conditioner, much needed this summer.

It has a huge restaurant and appears to be a large conference venue.
hotel_response:
Thank you taking the time to make comment in a good and constructive way. It is a shame you didn't get to use the pool as it has been very popular during this spell of hot weather. Being indoors and covered is also a benefit to protect from the suns rays.

Providing excellent value for money is a comment that is most appreciated and hopefully should you be in Hamilton again we may be able to accommodate you again.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Tired and needing some TLC
text:
A large hotel and conference facility, which when it was build was probably the best in the area. Sadly the rooms are now in need of an update.
The sink and tiles in the bathroom were cracked, and the shower head could do with a good de-scale. Whilst the pool was nice, the changing rooms smelt like they had just been filming a "deodorant" commercial in them. I suppose the fact that the dining facilities were listed as "Lady Chatterley" and "The Game-Keeper" sum it all up. Greta in its day, but now needing some TLC.
Can't fault the staff, they were friendly and helpful.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. Unfortunately I have been through all maintenance and guest comments and can find none regarding a crack in the hand basin but will get housekeeping to check all rooms and get it replaced. There is hairline cracking in a number of tiles due to earth movement and settling over the 15 years the hotel has been open and these will be addressed when a bathroom refurbishment is done.

The changing rooms do require a large amount of air freshener as it also contains a steam room which causes a high amount of sweat and body odour.

Thank you again for making comment

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Always Good Value
text:
Have stayed here a number of times as always find it value for money & usually give the hotel excellent reviews, but this time there were a couple of little things that made it fall short of excellent. One of my major gripes with hotel rooms is when you book for 3 people but the room is clearly only set up for 2 - 2 towels, 2 cups etc. Kingsgate hasn't done this in the past but this time they had added a mini bar and taken away a lot of the standards such as cups and glasses etc.
A little bit of attention to the items in the room would go a long way - things like the compendium which had obviously fallen victim to a previous guest and had lots of damage making it unreadable. 
Staff were helpful and friendly as usual and you still can't go past the Kingsgate for value for money.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking time to make comment on your recent stay and the feedback is appreciated. By the sounds of it you have previously stayed in our 100 and 500 wings which are more family orientated and have triple bedded and queen/double bedded rooms. These rooms do not have mini-bars. The rest of the Hotel is made up of queen/single or King only bedding and set up for two person occupancy. However housekeeping do get an arrival list and should recognise extra people in rooms and equip the rooms as necessary. 

I will take this up with the housekeeper and ensure that the arrival lists are checked in a more thorough manner.

I appreciate you bringing this to my attention

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Eating at the restaurant
text:
I haven't stayed at the Kingsgate but met up with friends who were.   They were more than happy with their accommodation.   I was there from 2 p.m. we had a meal in the dining room at 6:30 p.m. and I left at 9:30 p.m.   Found the meal very nice although maybe just a bit too much for me.   Wish these places had 'childrens sized' meals then I'd been able to have 3 courses.
I'd eat there again -  the dining staff were very helpful.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comment regarding the restaurant. I think it is the first one on trip advisor regarding the hotels restaurant only.

Your comments have been passed onto the restaurant and kitchen staff who are extremely grateful that you have taken the time to express your positive comments.

Thank you once again and we should have a new menu in mid February.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Great value for a one-night stay for a family
text: Great value for money. Family of 5 fit into one room with 3 beds. Room is simple but it was both clean and adequate. Checkin and checkout were easy although there's a small surcharge for paying with a credit card but kudos to them for taking our booking without charging the card. Good selection of tea and coffee although having a plunger with some ground beans would be a nice addition, since I'm not too keen to wake up to instant coffee. On the whole it was a good place to stay, good location in Te Rapa and a good price: we'll contact them first when arranging our next stay in Hamilton.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments. Yes the triple rooms are large and give families plenty of space. This along with the spa, pool, gym and steam rooms make it a popular Hotel for adults travelling with their children.

Of note straight across the road is Waterworld which is a great place for the family to spend a day.

Sorry about the coffee in the room but reception could provide more and 3 of those sachets in one cup tends to give it some kick.

We look forward to accommodating you again when in Hamilton.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Tired
text: The price was good and the complex is sprawling. Reception staff were very friendly and efficient. The room was tired. And while lots of space in the room - it's the little things. The jug does not switch off. No wifi - you have to pay (although you can have 30 min free in the reception area). The fridge drones on quite loudly. There is a very good gym however. But overall - the place needs a spruce up. Door handles are in disrepair, the outside cladding is faded/weather-stained. I think we would stay again. As another reviewer pointed out - because of the price.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking time to make comment and in some specific areas. I think you mean no free wi-fi as we had wi-fi installed at significant expense throughout the hotel. Prices have come down and once we are closer to repaying the investment I see the day it will be free. I have asked  housekeeping regarding the electric jug and like me they are unaware jugs without automatic switch off were on the property. I have asked them to find it and dispose of it. Door handles will be looked at and whenever possible the repainting of the externals of the building will be done.

Thank you for taking the time to make comment..

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Barely adequate, never again
text: The room (400 block) is of reasonable size, but dated & smells of smoke. Filthy stairs leading to the 1st floor, dust & particles still there a day later, so obviously not cleaned. Rather pathetic coffee facilities - 4 sachets of coffee total, all less than 1 level teaspoon, milk so small (15ml!!) that 4 are needed for the mugs they supply. Bring your own. Internet access marginal - I see 2 wifi guest servers, both showing at only 1 bar, no hi-po router here, f'sure. Plug into the broadband connection, I read that I can access 50Mb for $3, or other even pricier options. Sure not worth the rack rate. Don't stay here - the 4 star rating is a joke. I gave 3 stars, only because Hamilton is hardly a bastion of quality rooms. In Auckland/ Wellington/ Queenstown, I would call it 2 stars.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. 

It is appreciated that you have taken the time to make your criticisms known and where possible we will address them. Certainly smelling of smoke is difficult as the Hotel is entirely non smoking.  

The milk and coffee sachets are standard sizing for all hotels & motels and extra is always available on request.

Kind regards

title: Stayed 7 nights - average
text: We stayed for  7 nights in June 2014. We are a family of 5. We were expecting a high quality room because we thought the Highgate name was associated with quite a high standard of hotel, but we found the rooms were pretty dated. Our room was right beside the driveway so we had to keep the curtains closed or put up with service vehicles, couriers and other cars passing right next to the window. The jug was old and faulty. Actually, my son burnt his hand trying to make a milo because the plastic heated up so much. Looked like it hadn't been renewed in a long time. To their credit, when we pointed this out they changed it immediately. The price was good but when we wanted to extend our stay for a few days we found that the price was going to virtually double due to an event in town. No room service at night - we had jet lag and were starving in the late evening, around 10 or 11 but when we rang reception we were told there were no room service options available at that time of night. It was a long hungry night. Would stay again only for the price.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments regarding your stay in June. I am surprised that you were unable to obtain food during the night as we run a "night owl" menu throughout the night once the kitchen is closed. This is advertised in the compendiums. I will follow up with the Duty Manager on the night of your arrival and thank you for bringing this to my attention.

I have been able to find what I think is your booking and note the increase from a 5 night stay to a 7 night stay but also note the extra nights stays were charged at the same rate as your original booking. The extra nights requested went into the Field Days event and rooms had been sold out for a lengthy period of time. It was pleasing that we were able to extend your stay as most of, if not all of, the city was booked out.

Thank you for bringing these matters to my attention and I apologise for our shortcomings.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Shame on you Kingsgate.
text: Having stayed at many Kingsgate hotels would have to say this is not one of their best. It seems they are directing their attention towards flash looking reception area's whilst neglecting pretty much everything else. Clean but far from comfortable and in desperate need of a make over, think the beds may have come over with Captain cook on his first voyage. The cooked buffet breakfast was cold, not tepid, actually cold, maybe if they were to make available the appropriate food covering lids in order to retain heat, then people might just use them for example. The parking was good and there was no problem with any road noise as the entire complex is located a good distance away from the main roads.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. I have been through all maintenance sheets, guest comments and reception diary and am unable to find any complaint regarding the uncomfortable bed you experienced. Unfortunately I cannot also find a booking from your non-de-plume so unable to identify your room this way. We have a store of new replacement beds available and when we are informed of uncomfortable beds they are checked and replaced. If we do not, for some reason, have a replacement bed available our staff would be more than happy to move guests to a bed that suits their needs.

Our 300 block will be having replacement beds shortly doing away with what were the split king beds which are annoying and manufactured with the intention of avoiding 'roll-together".

Comments regarding the buffet have been positive but we will check the heating elements and ensure the food is keep to a hot temperature. thank you for bringing this to our attention.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Not for 'out going couple'
text:
Driving out to the hotel, I was thinking, hhmm this place is a bit further from the city then I thought.
We arrived at the hotel, situated slightly behind a block of shops containing a bakery, liqiour store, post office etc.... A couple of good convenient shops to have near your hotel.
We entered the driveway of the hotel.
Wow! Huge. Sections of blocks containing rooms. Walked into the reception area, WOW, HUGE! nice & flash reception and bar/lobby area. Pool table - $2 a game - restaurant was in a different room going off the bar area.

Headed to our room, the door to the block of rooms needs a separate key to get in. Luckily for me, our room wasn't up stairs, because there isn't an elevator.
Walking down the hall way towards our room, I could hear the people talking in their rooms even though their doors were shut. ( hhmm very thin walls ).

We got to our room, I opened the door & thought, wow, stepped back into the 1950s lol. It was different to what the usual modern day hotels look like apart from the TV of course lol.
The bathroom was nice, but when I was having a shower, WOW I could clearly hear what the people were talking about in the next room.
The bed was comfortable, nice pillows! 
Looked above my head and saw brown slimmy looking stuff smudged across a part of the wall. It wasn't wet though, it was like, GEL like, but at first glance, it looked like glossy poo smudged on the wall....wasn't impressed.
And then not too long after that, near the roof, there popping out of the wall was some toilet paper shoved in a hole. I thought to myself.... What the hell is up with this room. I was considering of getting a change of room at that time.
The air con couldn't be turned down lower then 20degrees...what the? Lol. And it was quite warm that day.

The mini bar was expensive. $6 for a bottle of Waikato Draught.
Can of fizzy drink....not even worth mentioning the price.
Restaurant food - $25 & .......

Best thing about this hotel.....
The Base is a 5 minute DRIVE down the road.
Nope I wouldn't stay here again. Just my own preference. But each to their own 👍
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Unfortunately we can not identify the room you were staying in so we will search all down stairs rooms for the toilet paper and brown goo in the room. This is totally unacceptable and certainly not indicative of our rooms or standards.

It is appreciated that this has been brought to our attention.

Mini bar prices are dictated by the amount of loss we are required to cover. If everyone declared their usage when checking out prices would be much lower.   

The air conditioning can be set lower than 20 degrees but we recommend 20 degrees as many people, in hot weather, set it extremely low and leave for the day and the units freeze up.

Again thank you for the comments and they are much appreciated.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Average
text:
The room was outdated and tired looking. Bathroom was clean. We had two heavy cases and were in a first floor room. With no lift, it was actually quite a struggle/trek to get to/ from the room. We had room service as my partner was not well and didnt want to go out. his Gnocchi was really nice apparently, however the fish and chips i ordered looked and tasted like it was a week old. The wifi was fairly expensive and we were only allowed 300MB, which is quite poor for 2 people over 24hrs. 
Would not recommend this hotel, as i'm sure there must be something better in the area for the same price...
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Wi-fi at this stage is $10 for 24 hours 500mb. This has come down from previous rates as installation costs are gradually being paid off. This will be reviewed again in 3 months time to making a gb available.

Porterage of bags is available on request at reception and someone would have been more than happy to help you with your bags or alternatively move you to a ground level room.

It is disappointing that your stay with us was not what we would have liked and apologise for our shortcomings.

I wish you well for you trip to New Zealand and hope you have an enjoyable time. 

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: noisy
text: grubby shower, hairs on wall and in soap dish, dirty quilt cover with stains on it.   Noisy room with parties going on in corridor until 4am.  the Jacuzzi was nice and breakfast was ok, the parking is great
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments the bathroom issue has been taken it up with Housekeeping and put on the top priority list for programmed spring cleaning.

We had a number reservations from a group of people who booked rooms over the night in question. They booked individually and as such were allocated rooms through various parts of the Hotel and were not isolated to a particular area. We had numerous issues with these people who were obviously using Hamilton as a party venue and unfortunately part of this involved accommodation with us.

These people will not be welcome back with us and in hindsight should have been evicted, however due to them being spread over different areas of the Hotel it proved difficult to isolate particular offenders. Our night Operations personnel could have handled this better and we have looked at procedures to prevent similar events.

It is indeed very disappointing when people have little or no regards for others around them and as stated above they and guests like them are not welcome at this Hotel.

Thank you for your comments.

Kind regards

Murray Cook.

title: Not quite four-star but much better than three
text: I stayed two nights.  My room was spacious, well lit, hot shower, good (slightly noisy) heat pump and lovely towels .  The room looked over an internal grass courtyard which meant it was quiet, and you could hear a bird singing.  But there was no lift and I had two cases, one quite heavy, and no offer of assistance when I checked in.  I had two dinners, one delicious and one very ordinary.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. We would be more than happy to help with luggage or move guests to a ground floor room, if requested.

Your comments regarding the room and meals are appreciated and help indicate area's we may be able to make improvements. Constructive feedback such as yours is always appreciated.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Really needs an update/rennovations
text:
I have stayed at the kingsgate twice for business over the last 3 years and to be honest I try and avoid it. 

The rooms I've stayed in are between $180-200 per night. The staff are friendly and the hotel is equipped and feature large rooms but the main let down is you feel like you've stepped back into a motel in 1995. 

The rooms are fitted with old worn furniture, wallpaper walls that is peeling, and bathrooms that have all the white plastic now a yellow/sand tarnish colour. Surely it must be time for a complete renovation of the hotel.

Other then this I can say that staff are friendly.... That's about it though.
hotel_response:
Thank you for the comments. As you have stayed twice in the last 3 years hopefully you would have noticed quite a number of changes over this period. In the rooms all TV's have been replaced with flat screens, all wooden tops have been re-varnished, the curtains replaced and new chairs and carpet in the rooms and throughout the Hotel. The corridors have all been repainted and we will be embarking on room wall coverings in November.

Upgrade work is a continuous project and done as and whenever possible. 

i do appreciate you being specific with your comments which gives us feedback on the particular area's that need to be addressed.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Good deal
text: Stayed here for one night $99 including breakfast all u could eat, very good deal. Room very spacious and quiet, restaurant meal was very nice. Good sized light bathroom but unfortunately the shower did have a bit of hair in it, but would definitely stay again. Staff very friend and helpful.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments and great that you managed to take advantage of one of our special Bed & Breakfast packages.

I also thank you for your comment regarding housekeeping as it is an area we have been focussing very hard on over the last month and will continue to do so in upcoming months. Having comments such as yours help enforce with the housekeeping department their shortcomings and area's that need improvement.

once again we appreciate the feedback.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Great stay
text: Stayed here for one night with my hubbie as he had to work in the area for the day.  Fantastic service with friendly staff.  They also allowed me to check in early no problem.  The room was slightly dated (hence the lower rating) but large, clean and very comfortable.  We also ordered room service which was surprisingly fantastic food.  Did not have time to check out the leisure facilities but they also looked good.  Unfortunately no free wifi but not too important for a one night stay.  Overall great value for a short stay in Hamilton.  We will stay here for sure when we are next in town.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments and we look forward to accommodating you again when next in Hamilton. Hopefully this time you get to use the gym, steam rooms, spa's and pool.

We have just updated our free wifi in reception up to 30 minutes and 50 mb. A recent installation of wifi equipment has now given access throughout the hotel and as the costs are recovered newer and less expensive packages will be introduced up until the stage it will be free.

Thank you again for your comments.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: AUSIMM Conference
text:
Stayed at the Kingsgate Hotel for the duration of the conference and was extremely pleased with the friendly service. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. Catering at the event was very nice with a great variety of options. I was happy with the facilities especially the spa pools! Would definitely recomend this venue for any conferences or family stays.

Thank You Kinsgate Hamilton
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments and I hope the conference you attended was beneficial to you. 

The comments regarding the service and food will be forwarded to the staff and I am sure they will appreciate you your positive comments.

Once again thank you for the comments and taking the time to evaluate your stay with us.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Relaxing Stay in Hamilton!
