text: We really enjoyed staying at the Kingsgate once again. Hamilton is a lovely city with many charming spots to visit and our stay at the Kingsgate was very relaxing. The staff were wonderful, the rooms were comfortable and food was great! Nothing more to add :)
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments and it is appreciated that you chose to stay with us again.

It is especially pleasing that we have continued to meet your expectations and provide the service and facilities that you require.

Should you be staying in Hamilton again we look forward to the opportunity of hosting you again.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Wonderful staff however facilities did not support their exceptional service
text: Stayed at the Kingsgate Hotel for a conference for  7 nights in August. Could not fault the staff who were exceptional with every interaction I had with them.  The Hotel itself is however getting very dated.  The first problem was the bed.  The mattresses need to be replaced.  I had to ask for a foam overlay to be placed over the mattress due to the ribs of the mattress digging into me all night.  No comfort at all left in the poor thing.  Second was the food.  I ordered room service the first evening and could not eat the sirloin steak as it was incredibly tough and there was an unusual relish all over it.  I went to breakfast the next morning and chose the $29 full buffet.  Full buffet consisted of the usual continental cereals and toast and some fruit.  Hot breakfast was scrambled eggs, mushrooms, hash browns and beans.  Everything was cold and I didnt  return for a second time in the 7 days of my stay.  The conference food over the week was far below what I would have expected for a conference and so overall, I just ate elsewhere for the whole week.  The conference dinner was so noisy with no acoustics to deaden the noise that you could not speak to the person sitting beside you at the table without yelling.  I ended up going home early.  Measured t$18 for 300 mb.  Most other hotels on this trip have provided an initial quota of 1Gb per night included in the room cost so dont know why it was so expensive at the Kingsgate.  Signal strength was also not reliable with usually only 1 or 2 out of the 5 bars in strength. So if you were going to stay at this hotel I recommend that you have a car.  Overall a disappointing experience which was compensated remarkably by the genuine helpful staff. Feel a bit bad giving such a ordinary review in light of the effort that the staff are making to ensure guests have the best experience they can at a hotel which needs some cash injected into it.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments, you have raised some issues we have not encountered before. I believe the mattress was replaced on the Monday of your stay as soon as maintenance were made aware of it. I apologise this was not done on the Saturday of your arrival. The full buffet breakfast you have quoted as $29 is actually charged at $22 with a $3.50 room service charge should you wish it served to your room. 
We have had a number of large dinners in the room your conference dinner was held in and never had comments regarding the noise absorption of the room previously, perhaps this is something that has come about since we have stripped a wall of wall paper and re-painted. It will be monitored and I thank you for bringing it to our attention. 
Internet charges continue to come down as the significant installation costs are paid off and recently we introduced the 30 min 50mb free wifi option in our reception area, 
Thank you for your comments, especially regarding the staff, they are very much appreciated.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Dont waste your money
text: Stayed two nights with the kids and was serverely dissapointed..Room looked like it hadnt been touched since the 70's..smelt funny all fufnishings etc were so dated and old looking i instantly wanted to leave !! Food in resteraunt was rubbish and service was terrible..yes i have three young kids but the maitre d was rude, unhelpfull and slow.this has to be the worst stay i have had at a hotel ever
hotel_response:
Thank you for making comment on your stay in January??. I note also that you have a Hamilton address so I imagine you would have received a very special rate. I am sorry that you felt you stay with your 3 children was a waste of money. The Hotel was built in 1998 and since your stay all room furnishings have been revarnished and corridors and restaurant furniture repainted.
 .
Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Moderate but dated
text:
The decor is old and dated.  The amenities are ok.  The beds are not plush and the pillows are the $2 shop variety.  
The restaurant sold nice food at a good price and overall not bad for the price but I will try somewhere else next time.

title: Great price for spacious room
text:
This is a great hotel for eating, conferencing, staying over. It's very easy to find, not far from everywhere and comfortable.    I used Wotif and the friendly staff accommodated a matching price for me.    My room had a large bath in it and two beds.    Great size with everything available.
Would use again.....wotif price of $85 makes this room an absolute bargain!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Of the 147 rooms at the hotel the decor is pretty much the same in every room with the differences being rooms with a bath, twin bedded room of triple bedded rooms.

I believe the pictures are pretty indicative of the look of all the rooms. Great that you were able to get a good deal and appreciated the size of the rooms.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Affordable overnighter
text: We stayed here for one night because it was cheap and close to an event we were attending.  It was relatively close to town and well-priced.  We had a spa which was lovely, not private but still nice for a Winter dip.  The swimming pool would be good in the Summer.  It also had a gym area for those active types.  The beds were comfy and facilities while older were clean and tidy.  The place needs to be updated as it does look a bit tired and dated.  Staff were friendly and because it was cheap accommodation I would return if we had another event to go to nearby.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. From these I believe you had value for money and that is our aim so it appears you were well looked after. 

Its great that you  were able to use and enjoy the facilities at the Hotel and hopefully we will see you back again. (the pools heated to 25 degrees so can be used year round) 

Ongoing maintenance and upgrade work has been continuing for an extended period now and will continue when possible. 

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: over night
text: We would come back to this establishment for the future.  Handicap room in the 100 section.  A suggestion is to either sand down the wood on the handicap stool so mold does not show.  Or put a coat of waterproof paint on the wood.
hotel_response:
Thank you for the comment. An excellent idea and one that will be given to maintenance immediately. All the wooden fixtures and furniture in the rooms has been re-varnished in the last 6 months and this obviously missed.

Thank you again for bringing it to our attention.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: The very essence of adequate
text:
Stayed at this Hotel for business attending a conference and everything was exceptionally adequate.

For a start, the Hotel is away from the City Centre, so if you're there for any sort of tourism or experience, I'd suggest looking somewhere substantially closer to the city, especially as, if you're fond of using public transport, the buses don't run much later than 8pm.  It's quite a taxi fare to and from the property, and on the other side of the town from the airport.  I tried to find something close by to try for dinner to no avail - it's either eat at the Hotel or catch an expensive fare in and out of the city,

The rooms themselves were actually decorated with beige and floral prints (who knew such things still existed in Hotels in the 21st century?).  Apart from being dated, the minifridge was also exceptionally loud (I ended up unplugging it), the bed was poorly made and the sheets all untucked by the time I got into them, and the shower head sat annoyingly low on the wall.  I've never understood why hotels insist on installing shower heads either at face or chest height, I'm not that tall, it would be so much nicer for it to be another 10cm higher on the wall.

On the plus side, the rooms were spacious and kept clean, and the service was efficient and friendly.

More like a motel really than a hotel, unless you're on a budget, just travelling through or on business at the conference facilities there, I'd suggest spending a little more finding something nicer closer to town.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comments regarding your stay with us at the Hotel. We are located 4 kms from the city centre, however there is a shuttle that runs to the Casino and this should have been pointed out if you booked a taxi through reception. 

From your description of the bathroom you would have been in our 600 wing. These were built with a shower over a bath and I agree for taller people the shower head is very low. All other accommodation wings have walk in showers and this would have been a better option for you.

Thank you again for a balanced evaluation of the Hotel.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Oldie but clean and tidy
text: This is an older hotel but room was large and the bathroom spotless. Bed big and reasonably comfortable. The outside could do with a bit of a face lift as the air cons are all looking rusty. Needed a power plug by the bed but all the points were hard wired so had to run an extension cord across the room. Staff very friendly and capable.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. The staff appreciate it when people take the time to make positive comments regarding their service, such as you have.

Your comments regarding the individual air conditioning units is a good one and will be addressed by maintenance.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Family Stopover
text:
Booked this hotel based on price and location - stopover en route to South.  
Location was good - easy to find coming off SH1.  
Room - very dated and basic.  Beds - very uncomfortable and hard.   Was large with Double and Single bed.
Rooms are in different blocks - after check in (very unfriendly staff) there was nowhere to park near the block so had to unload outside front door and park elsewhere. (limited spaces).  No lift to upper floors so carrying lots of luggage and a child while propping doors open was interesting!
Couldn't wait to leave and wouldn't stay here again.  Ibis is better!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. As we have over 300 free car parks I find it surprising that you have stated limited car parking. We are more than happy to help with luggage if requested and if possible we will move rooms to satisfy a guests needs.

Your comments regarding the check in staff are disappointing and the matter will be taken up with the Front Office Manager. Thank you for bringing the issue up.

I apologise for our shortcomings and regret the stay was not one we would have hoped for.

Kind regards

Murray Cook
General Manager

title: Great value
text: Enjoyed our stay, good value for money hotel in Hamilton. Friendly staff. Room an older style but perfectly clean and fine for what we paid. Good sized room for a family of 4. Just off a main road so easy access to town centre but no loud traffic. Spa pools were great, indoor pool way too cold for us though!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments. Feedback, such as yours, is always appreciated by the staff and management.

From your comments it seems like you got one of our triple rooms which are very popular with families, having the queen, double and single bed and still plenty of room certainly makes them sought after.

Its pleasing you got to use some of the leisure facilities we have available and we do run the pool at the recommended 26 degrees celcius. I'm sorry that it was not warm enough for your liking but hope the spa's managed to warm you up.

Once again thank you for taking the time to make comment and hopefully we may be able to accommodate you and your family again in the future.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Good size motel
text:
Rooms are clean and big. We had a room with 2 queen size beds and 1 single bed. Perfect for our family of five.

The motel has good parking facilities, near to most rooms. The whole motel is of a good size, with a large reception area.

WIFI is free for only 20 mins and thereafter, need to pay.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment and I am happy that you were able to take advantage of one of our "triple rooms". These are indeed large and very suitable for family's travelling. As such they are very popular over the weekend when they generally sell out very quickly. 

We have just recently completed installation of wifi throughout the Hotel and with this are offering an hours internet (capped at 50mb) for $5. Or in the lounge $3 for an hour (capped at 20mb). There are also other options available.

Thank you again for your constructive comments.

Kind regards

Murray Cook
General Manager

title: Friendly people, terrible facilities
text:
My wife and I stayed here for three days in June.  
When we arrived the roof in the room was leaking.  It took over an hour before someone came to look, which resulted in a bucket with a couple of towels being carefully positioned under the leak.  It was fieldays week so they were completely full and couldn't move us to another room.
The next morning the leak in the roof was fixed, but the room was now very damp.  The ceiling and carpet remained wet the whole time we were there, with the accompanying damp smell.  No effort was made to dry the carpet and every time we came into the room the smell was unpleasant to say the least.
Dinner in the restaurant was tasty but the breakfast anything but (how do you make watery bacon and sausages?) and definitely not worth $25.
The people were friendly, but ineffectual - they seemed too busy and preoccupied with other things to actually do something about solving the problem with our room. There was no consideration given to the discomfort we experienced on checkout and we were charged the full rate for the stay.
The décor seems to be from 1980's and the whole place could do with sprucing up.  The pillows are mediocre and the bed far from comfortable.
Completely unimpressed and I strongly advise against staying here.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. It is shame that you did not take the option to move when offered. I apologise that there was a leak in the room from what can only be described as a storm. The flooding in our entrance way was the first ever seen there in the 15 years the Hotel has been in operation.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Everything we needed
text: Good clean facilities in a handy location.  Spa pool was an added bonus when we found it - there were no signs showing location of the pool Pillows were very flat, beds were very soft.  Shower door dragged the bath mat when you opened the door or closed the door - not very helpful!

title: Don't stay here...
text:
Unless you are here for the conference facilities (in which case I doubt you have a choice), do yourself a favour and find somewhere else. The rooms are tired, beds soft, pillows rubbish and you can hear the plumbing!
The breakfast is extortionately priced and is poor quality and the staff were busy cleaning the place as we were eating.
I am sure that there are some lovely privately owned hotels or motels nearby that would be far more pleasant. 
Millennium Hotels are generally OK, but this one is a let down...
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comments. 

The $22 charged for a full  buffet breakfast includes a variety of breads, danishes, croissants, spreads, 5 types of cereal, fresh fruits, yoghurt, 4 different juices, cheese and meat, 6 hot dishes and tea and coffee. 
If you do not wish to have the hot dishes the price is $16 and for Tea coffee, breads, danishes, crossaints and spreads $6.90. 

As it is an all you can eat buffet we do operate at the above pricing schedule only and I do understand that you may have wanted only part of the buffet and am sorry that we only have the above options. 

Staff clear, clean and reset tables during service - all other cleaning is done after service.

It is disappointing that we failed to meet your required standards and I apologise for our shortcomings.

Kind Regards

title: Weekend away
text: I have stayed here many times. The breakfast is good, Staff always pleasant. Rooms are large with all that you need. Most have mini bars.The spas are good and we loved the pool.Will be back. Great parking.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments. The staff always try to please our guests and they appreciate people who take the time to make positive comment when so many focus on the negatives.

We look forward to accommodating you again in the future.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Uncomfortable and extremely average
text:
My partner and I recently stayed here for a couple of nights, and unfortunately we don't have a lot of good feedback.
We arrived to find that although there were lots of parks, you would be lucky enough to get one anywhere near your room. We had to park down the other end (which looks like the conference centre car parks), and being pregnant it was not very nice having to walk that distance with bags etc, just to get to our room.
We found we had to use 2 keys - one for the building and one for the room - and found there were actually no lifts if your room is upstairs, which ours was. Not good if you have a disability or lots of luggage. Though not too bad for us I'd suggest getting a bottom room if stairs are no good for you.
Although dated, the room itself was fairly nice, but that's where it stops.
You could hear a lot of noise going on around the place - people walking/running through the hallways, going through exit doors, talking, etc. Unfortunately one of the nights there was a wedding party staying there too which didn't help.
The beds are extremely uncomfortable, making for some bad nights sleep.
We ordered room service for dinner one night and were told to leave the tray outside the door and it would be collected. The next day we found it hadn't been picked up and was sitting there in the hallway all night - I'd say that's asking for mice or rats...
Next day we had left out the door sign asking to please make up our room, but I'm not even sure what they did. The bed hadn't been touched, and although I know they don't change sheets daily, from my experience in lots of other hotels they still make the bed. In the book in the room it also says the mini bar is replenished daily, but this wasn't the case either as we had had a (ridiculously priced) water and that had not been replaced. We had to share the last tiny bottle between us. It was either that or drink from the bathroom taps, as no room to put our own in the fridge. There were also hairs in the bathroom, which were also there when we arrived.
It didn't make sense either that Ethernet cable was by the bed but there were power points on the other side of the room. You could not plug anything near the bed if you needed to.
Overall we felt very uncomfortable and would likely not stay here again.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make such in depth comments regarding your stay. It is disappointing that your stay with us was not as enjoyable as we would have liked and apologise for the areas we have not performed in. 

The room you stayed in has been signed off as being serviced on the Sunday and we do make all beds daily, but we do leave the bedspread folded down. Restaurant trays are meant to be cleared by the restauarnt at end of shift and by the night manager during the night so this will be taken up with staff concerned.

Porterage service is available if requested at reception, or alternatively as you have suggested a downstairs room can be requested.

Thank you again for you comments and I appreciate the feedback on our shortcomings. 

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Last Minute Booking
text:
Needed to book a room at very last minute - they accommodated at a great price and the room was very comfortable.  It helps that the hotel was so close to where I needed to be for business.
Staff are very friendly and the room was very clean and tidy.
hotel_response:
It is pleasing that we were able to offer prices and accommodation to meet your last minute requirements. Thank you for taking the time to make comment and your positive feedback.

Hopefully if you are staying again we will have the opportunity to accommodate you.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Time for a revamp
text: I stayed here for a conference for 3 days. Rooms clean and tidy but as others have reviewed its like a school dorm. We had a set menu and the meals were child size. 3 rooms that I am aware of had real squeaky floors as well as the passage ways, not sure how the people felt in the bottom floor. Rooms are large but must have original beds. Dining lounge is absolutely huge and is very neat, tidy and clean. Has a good bar with good seating area. For a 4 star hotel it needs bringing into the 21st century for decor and the floors repaired. The parts I saw of hotel were very clean. Staff were very courteous and helpful but unfortunately it doesn't take away the age of the place and the fact that it's time for a revamp.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. I find your comments regarding the meals interesting as we were requested to print of the set menu's you had over the 3 days to show people staying elsewhere how superior the meals we provided were in comparison.

The hotel was originally planned to be 5 stories but due to building restraints (you would notice that basically anything outside the immediate city centre is limited to 2 stories) we were unable to build above 2 floors. Providing 147 rooms over 2 levels was the only option available and as such 6 different wings were constructed with each wing approximately 24 rms over 2 levels.

I thank you for the positive comments on the cleanliness and staff and appreciate you taking the time to provide useful and constructive feedback.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Good and bad
text: Too far from town, has a kind of "school dorm" feel to it, ate there twice - was sick both times. Pool, spa's and gym were great, ample parking. Wifi expensive. $22 burger terrible, walked around the corner to a small takeaway and bought a burger (with everything) for less than $3. It was excellent!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Regarding feeling sick after eating I find this very strange as it would be the first time we have heard this in over 3 years. We are an accredited eating place with a stringently monitored food hygiene programme initiated in conjunction with the Hamilton City Council. There are very few properties running this programme. 

Its pleasing that you found wackos takeaway fish & chip shop around the corner. The burger you mention is the basic hamburger and the one that is the best is their jumbo burger priced at $8.90, of course chips are an extra cost to this.

Thank you for taking the time to make your concerns known to us.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: My room smells funny
text: I attended a conference at the Hamilton Kingsgate and the conference end of things were fine, sadly when I got my room, I could smell this funny smell which was somewhere between damp and sewage. I opened the windows that had the big sign on them saying for security reasons, dont leave the windows open but the staff kept closing them so every time I came back to the room, the smell was back. To end on a positive note, Loren at the bar provided good service with a smile and a joke.
hotel_response:
Thank you for making comment on a staff member who made the effort to make your stay a more enjoyable one. It is not often someone takes the time to respond positively regarding staff such as you have and it will be very much appreciated by the staff member concerned.

Maintenance have inspected the room and run draino through the pipes and the smell has gone. I apologise for the inconvenience this caused.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Clean and good value hotel
text:
Coming here is like having a peak into what hotels were like in the 80s. Peel away the superficial layers though, and it's still a clean and comfortable hotel. No mystery carpet stains, or dirty streaks on the bathroom mirror, or musty odours. It was a fairly hot day so appreciated the heatpump and fan. TV channel selections are minimal.

Located in the next suburb to CBD so expect to drive in.

Basic toiletries provided but no disposable toothbrush even when requested. Other conveniences that have long disappeared in budget hotels include irons and hair dryers in every room, plus there's no need to leave a key card in to get power (useful when long charging batteries).

title: Good but not outstanding
text:
The hotel is located on the Northern side of Hamilton, convenient only if you have your own transport, but there is a huge car park out the back of the hotel.
It is clean, and staff are friendly and helpful, but it is looking a little tired, and feels a bit impersonal.
Rooms are a decent size, mattresses are a bit soft and pillows too flat.
The shower is my main quibble with this hotel, with one of the most awful showerheads I have come across lately - it is fixed to the wall at eye height which forces you to go into all sorts of contortions to be able to wash and rinse your hair and wash your face.  Please either fix it (much) higher, or supply removable showerheads which make life a lot easier.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments regarding the Hotel. We have replaced all shower heads throughout the Hotel in the last 18 months. I can only assume you were in our 600 wing which has a shower over the bath and yes they are quite low. All other wings have a walk in shower and sound like they would be more what you are after. The 600 wing was built 3 years after the other blocks and the showers over bathtubs were put in in response to guests requests, especially those with young children.

thank you again for your comments and taking the time to make known your concerns.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Nicely priced
text: 2nd time here, room is well priced and has air con. Shower has good water pressure, and no street noise and I had no noise in corridor. Room service was nice and warm on arrival, reception staff were good
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments and it is especially appreciated since you have stayed with us twice now. It was nice of you to comment on the reception staff as I believe the new new staff we have in reception are doing well for two new people to the industry.

We look forward to accommodating you again in the future when in Hamilton.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Place for a Quiet Sleep
text: About an hour outside of Auckland.  Clean, comfortable, fair priced room. No view as the windows looked into a sort of court yard.  It was just a convenient place to stay for an affordable price with free parking and away from the hassle of the big city. Breakfast buffet was nothing exceptional so if you can wait, find a cute restaurant further along the hi-way.  After a long day of travel, I don't look at the decor of the hotel - as long as it has hot water, no irritating smells, clean bed, minimal noise and darkening curtains.  This hotel met my needs perfectly during our short stay.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. A well written review and pleased you mentioned requesting ground floor rooms if required. The comments regarding breakfast are interesting and I would point out that if you look at our Bed & Breakfast package rates I believe a full continental & cooked buffet is pretty good value for money.

Nice to have you stay and hopefully get the chance to accommodate you again in the future.

Thank you again.

Murray Cook
General Manager

title: Cold pool - brrrrr.
text: Rooms and common areas very tired and in need of decoration. Restaurant set out beautifully - however very long wait for (very small) meals. Party of six - one diner served about 30 mins ahead of others  - we were offered free drinks by way of an apology. Indoor pool NOT heated - therefore unusable (my grand daughter has asthma - only booked here for the pool). No milk provided in room - when I asked for it at Reception I was told to walk down to the kitchen and ask for it (long walk)! It was my Birthday and the friendly restaurant staff brought out a large slice of cake (enough to share between us) with a candle - thank you!
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. The pool is heated to 25 degrees as recommended by our pool contractor. It may have seemed colder with the extremely humid weather being experienced. This is checked daily. The rooms have nearly had all furniture re varnished and corridors are currently being painted. I am disappointed that you felt the common rooms seemed dated as they have been re-carpeted and re furnished in the last year in addition to the new bar and reception desktops and the addition of 2 large flat screen TV's.

I appreciate the feed back and taken up the issues regarding the lack of milk and what I believe poor service delivered upon your enquiry  Thank you.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: uncomfortable, damp place we would never return
text: We are a family with two little young children, we booked to stay longer for cheaper rate, we then got put in a room without a bath, next to the housekeeping room, along the street side, we got waken up in the morning around 6.30am by the washing machine in the housekeeping room,called reception, and got waken up again the next morning. During our stay, only our towel and rubbish bin got changed, bed made without changing the sheets. the beds are very damp feel and do not look clean either. all the facilities are very very old, no wifi, internet use will cost about $20.00 for one day use. compare to all other places I have stayed, I would promise that I will never stay in this hotel at all in my life. and I will tell my friends not to stay here either.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to comment, it is very disappointing that your stay with us was not as you would have wished. The laundry staff did start at 7.00 am in the morning and I apologise this happened 2 days in a row. Bed linen is changed on the 3rd nights stya for guests staying over. There are many internet options including $3 for 1 hour or 20 mins free in reception and $5 to $18 for various hours usage in the rooms.  Triple rooms (with a Queen, double and a single) are shower only and this should be shown on the website you booked through.

It was pleasing that you managed to get one of the triple rooms for such a reduced rate as these have been in great demand over the Christmas period, however as stated above it disappointing that we failed to meet your expectations.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Always value for money
text: This hotel has become a regular for our annual stop over in Hamilton, one big family room (2 kings and a single) is tremendous value. The children love the in door swimming and spa pools and the travel budget can be spent elsewhere. Whilst the price is good the decor is a little dated and tired but rooms and common areas are always clean and tidy, and the staff friendly. There is a golf driving range down the road, a New World up the road and a Water World swim complex behind, so nicely located, the drive into CBD 5 minutes. No doubt we will be back next year.

title: Broken bed and the staff simply could not have cared less
text: We recently stayed at this hotel and would not recommend it to anybody. The bed had 6 broken springs sticking out which caused injury to the lower leg. When informing staff about this they showed absolutely no interest and offered no adequate solution at all. I have searched for someone to contact in regards to this but find that this hotel makes it impossible for customers to give feedback. At the very least I feel that the hotel should refund the price of our stay here as they fail at the very basic level on which a hotel should function - providing a bed that won't injure you!
hotel_response:
Thank you for making us aware of the problem with the bed and it has been replaced. Staff check for these things but run a hand across the mattress seams rather than put weight on the bed which forces any springs that may have come loose to protrude through the mattress. 

It is disappointing that you have felt staff were unsympathetic because they took it very seriously and ensured the bed was changed as soon as they were made aware.

I apologise for our shortcomings and again thank you for making us aware of the situation so it could be remedied.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Spacious & Excellent Value
text:
Have stayed here a few times in the past, but this time it surpassed my expectations and my experience has ensured we will be returning. The reception staff were excellent, welcoming and polite - certainly much more welcoming than I have struck in the past. Even the housekeeping staff member who cleaned our room was lovely and friendly. 
Could not have found better value for money for our 3 day stay and the room was very spacious, 2 queen beds, had good air conditioning and good sized flat screen tv.
We used the pool and spa - both of which were clean and pleasant to use.
I am not sure if the staff are new or they have provided new training for them but I was very impressed and shall be recommending this hotel to others.

title: Spacious, clean and a bargain!
text: Perfect stopover! Especially for the price!! (Some hostels charge more than we paid for a double room!!) Although like all the other reviews say, the decor is slightly dated but everything is maintained well. It was spotlessly clean! The room was huge, with a flat screen tv; we were expecting an older one from the photos. The grounds around have been kept nicely. Although we didn't use it, the pools looked clean and well maintained. The staff were extremely polite. Comfortable bed! Would strongly recommend!

title: Needs Updating
text: Very 70s hotel.  The place needs updating.  Rooms were large, but not well maintained.  The bed was not good, needs to be repalced.  The breakfast is always the same.  We stayed three nights here.  Not a lot of places nearby to walk to save for a small market and bakery.  Also large tour groups use this hotel.  Not sure I would return.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. I am sorry that you found breakfast the same on the 3 days you stayed, we do put out a full buffet breakfast everyday with a large number of choices available but understand that you may have required something else. We are currently going through the rooms re-varnishing, coating and changing the woodwork in the rooms. Over the last 18 months, carpet, curtains, bedspreads, bed heads and flat screen TV's have been put into the rooms. It is disappointing that these were not to your taste. Hamilton is not a large tourist town and the group you encountered when you stayed in October were a one off group visiting the famed Hamilton Gardens and rose gardens around the Waikato.

Thank you again for making comment and hope you enjoyed your time in New Zealand.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Very very old
text: Personal very friendly, willing to help. The spa is old but very comfortable and quiet. Unfortunately the hotel and especially the rooms are very old and never modernized since the construction. He could be vintage and cosy but in this case it produces a lack of comfort and an impression that the hotel will be destroyed very soon. I recommend it only if you don't have any other choice
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. The Hotel was built in 1998 and the 600 wing (with spa, sauna, gym and indoor pool complex) was added in 2001.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: above average for cost, strongly recommend if you're looking for value for money.
text:
We had a $99 room and buffet breakfast for two, excellent value, highly recommended. The room was spacious and clean and the beds were comfortable. Excellent selection of good instant coffees, teas and cocoa. Very friendly, helpful staff.
Had a little trouble getting key into outside door lock.
Only real down side was the VERY NOISY bar fridge, which is why I marked sleep quality as only average, after I turned it right down I got to sleep. This did defrost the icebox as I'd imagined it would and I was awoken by a clunk of falling ice, and then I used the towels to clean up all the water leakage. Apart from that it was well above what i expected for that cost.

title: comfortable budget hotel
text: The Kingsgate Hamilton is an aged hotel which shows in the rooms and general appearance, however the rooms are very spacious and quite comfortable, there is a god restaurant on site which serves up a very nice breakfast at a  very reasonable price, dinner was a different story, there were only 4 people  in the restaurant and the meal took about 40 minutes to arrive . The staff are very friendly and helpful.  Boadband cable in the room which worked well, wifi available only in the reception foyer. Very handy to Horotiu, ood accommodation at a good price, I would stay here again.

title: Close to Horotiu but won't stay again
text:
Shabby rooms, tacky awful sticky cheap pine furniture with all the coating coming off, badly in need of renovation, Could put the laptop on the desktop for fear of it sticking down. ALL WHITE BATHROOM!!! Ouch. Lumpy mattress. Still it was OK for 2 nights and close to Horotiu where we were inspecting. Would not have stayed there one night longer than necessary. 

Staff were nice and checkin and check out efficient.

Price was right but think next tie will go for more comfort.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments, now that we have been advised, by internet, we will replace the kettle and inspect the mattress in the room. Many items such as these are replaceable upon request at the time. Bed comfort is a difficult one for staff to assess so guest feedback, such as yours, is important. Yes the furniture is pine as this was the most accessible timber for the 147 rooms at the time of the build in 1997. As ongoing maintenance all the furniture will be stripped and re-varnished during the coming festive season.

Yes the bathroom tiles are all white. Housekeeping have been informed to inspect the room and chemical cleaner they are using to ensure there is no tackiness on the tops. I suspect a wrong cleaner may have been used since we recently changed over products.

Thank you again for your comments.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Poor Experience
text: Do not stay at this Hotel.  Generally tired and in need of renovation.  Advertised WiFi in all rooms, but no signal at all in room 606. Broadband cable , if it worked , no use for iPhones / iPads .   Despite being the only 2 people in the restaurant for an early dinner , it took over 30 mins from ordering to receiving first course - however, when received, food of good quality.  Also discovered that several items in room minibar had passed their expiry date - some by almost 1 year!  Hotel management obviously very lax.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. We have replaced the one beer and chocolate bar that was past its "best before" date. The minibar person has been advised of the oversight and will be going through all stock to ensure nothing else is past its best before date. 
It is disappointing to read your comments regarding the meal service as you specifically booked a place in the restaurant at 5.30 pm which we accommodated, even though we do not open our restaurant until 6.00 pm, as advertised. It was requested that you needed your meal by 6.15 pm as you had a taxi to catch for the rugby and you had finished your entree and your main meal was served to you before 6.10 pm.
Regarding wifi, we are unaware of any advertising that states we have it throughout the Hotel, 4 blocks are covered and when requested we allocate accordingly. There is also 20 minutes free wifi available per day in the reception and public areas and yes the broadband doe's work. 

I apologise that we did not provide you with the experience you required and where possible will address your concerns.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Good value family getaway
text: I have stayed here many times . Yes it is a little dated but this is usually reflected in the price I feel. We come from Auckland and stay here with friends of ours and our children . The triple rooms are great value for money. Once checked in we usually go across the road to the Hamilton pools which have slides and the kids spend a couple of hours there. We then come back and have a rest may go in to town and do something and then after dinner the kids go down for a spa and swim in the hotel pool. After that we sit back and relax ,kids in one of the rooms adults in the other and if we are lucky some of us go off to the casino for a little play. The ones that stay back order from room service a late night snack which is very reasonable prices and nice. We have always found the breakfast nlce and feel this is a great value for money getaway for a couple of days. On our way back to Auckland we go to firepot cafe in gordontown which is awesome. Looking to come down in school holidays next month.

title: No phone reception!
text: Apart from being a very dated, non-central conference venue, bar far the biggest let down was the lack of mobile phone service on the property. Beds and decor were old. On the plus side the food was okay and the staff friendly. But given I couldn't work without my phone and data connection, I wouldn't stay again.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments, cell phone coverage from vodafone is not a strong signal and when atmospheric conditions are not right signal can be blocked by concrete block walls which the main accommodation wings are made of. We are 4 km from the city centre and as such enjoy benefits such as less noise, large free car parking and easy access.

Beds are replaced as and when required and to some degree this is dependent on guest feedback such as yours. We will endeavour to ascertain the room you stayed in and check the bed. All curtains, carpets were replaced in the last 18 months along with new boxed bedspreads and headboard material.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Looking for somewhere for large group
text: I have stayed at the Kingsgate Hamilton for 3 years in a row.  Found the Hotel to be adequate, but in need of some refurbishing.  The rooms are large and the common areas are perfect for conferences etc.  I normally stay here as part of a group attending a dance workshop for children and teenagers.  The Hotel is really accomodating for such a group.  The breakfast is a bit average, but very adequate .. plenty of food.  Good dining room.

title: Great if you don't have high expectations
text: This is an ok place to stay if you don't have great expectations. If you just need a clean room to sleep in for a night, then, this will do. We booked and paid for 2 rooms with breakfast included through the bookings. com website. When we checked in, they only had one room for us. After a long process we managed to get two rooms adjacent to each other. The rooms were spacious and lovely to lounge in. Walls are really thin. We had trouble sleeping because the couple on the other side were very 'loud'.The swimming pool is not heated but the kids had a blast in the spa pool. The pool area is not very friendly because you can't lounge around and enjoy a drink ( no food or drinks are allowed in there). I can understand this is for safety but I think it would be more enjoyable if there was bar service. Full buffet breakfast was nice but they kept running out of bacon and eggs. On the upside...the staff were very nice and friendly and Kingsgate is a good place to stay if you just need a nice clean place to crash while in Hamilton. No activities for kids. Good place to stay for conferences but not for family holidays.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments the swimming pool is heated to between 24-26 degrees, as specified by our pool servicing company to avoid bacterial growth. The temperatures and PH levels are checked on a daily basis.

I would suggest if travelling with a family you try to book a triple room as they are in the other wings from the 60 wing and block concrete walls between rooms whereas the 600 wing was built at a later date without concrete block and as such the sound proofing is not as effective.

Waterworld is directly across the road and a great place to take the kids and very popular with families staying at the hotel. 

I do not know when you stayed with us but we do try to put out fresh food on the breakfast buffet all the time and over certain periods there may be a rush e.g. 9.30 on a Sunday morning,  All items other than the scrambled eggs should not take more than 5 minutes to refresh from empty and  bacon and hash browns in particular can be hit very heavily and quickly if a number of guests arrive at once.

Thank you again for your comments, they are very much appreciated. 

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: not too bad
text:
just got back from one night in this hotel, firstly on outside appearance,not really very inviting, and the rooms are dated and could do with refurbishment and soon, would not take a lot to make them more modern, however they are adequate, very good size and the bathrooms are pretty modern,could do with a heater in there though, beds are rather uncomfortable,however we had a nice sunny room with a view to the road so was pleased about that, the spa and pool facilities are excellent, however would be nice if they had private changing rooms.
The buffet breakfast was excellent, cannot fault it at all, enjoyed it very much, everything you could wish for , the dining area very pleasant and staff most helpful and cheerful.
overall the kingsgate is not what i call a top hotel, but average and probably good value for money and a family,however i was on a discounted tariff and certainly would not liked to have paid more.
The reception area could do with some brightening up , i also was curious as to why the receptionist enquired if we were a couple, we are, but what business is that of her's,we had pre-booked our rooms in advance, so cannot understand why this question was even asked.
I still enjoyed staying at the hotel, but not sure if i would return.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. I am at a loss to your comments regarding the changing rooms as there are two very large changing rooms (with lockers and steam rooms) in the hallway just outside the spa & pool area that leads to the gym. The next part in our refurbishment is to re-varnish the tables and desktops in the room and new material for the bedspreads is currently being sourced. This will complete the new chairs, carpet, curtains and TV's which have all been done in the last 15 months.
Thank you again for taking the time to make comment.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Unwell and uncomfortable
text: My sister and i stayed at this motel, she booked us in and by the looks of the pics on the internet we were looking forward to a great weekend. we checked in not realising that our room was quite the walking distance from the main reception area.  We get to the main door leading to our room and we ended up going up a flight of stairs that we had no idea existed.  Both my sister and i were unwell walking the stairs did not help.  My sister rang the number on a card placed on the desk for a massage and the number was disconnected. I went to have a spa, it was cold, i hopped in the other spa that was luke warm, warm enough for the pregnant lady to hop in. The changing room was not clearly signed.  The heat pump must of had dust in it because as soon as it was switched on my sister started coughing and spluttering. My nephew was moved from the other room my sister booked for them to be in because the mtel double booked the room, when my nephew turned on their heatpump it only blew out cold air. Parking is an issue as there is not enough. I wouldnt recommend this motel and my sister and i stay in motels all the time but this is the first time ive written a negative review.  Sorry guys.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Of note we frequently get guests commenting that the air conditioning does not work. It helps if people put it on the heat mode rather than cool and if requested we will always go to the room to show guests how it works. I am at a loss to your comments regarding parking as we have over 300 car parks on the property (free) but acknowledge that these are not all directly in front of the 147 rooms we have.
I would be very disappointed if were not able to move you rooms closer to reception and the only case I can see that we may not have been able would be if a particular room type (e.g. Triple room or Double/Queen room) was requested.
My apologies for our shortcomings and hope you are feeling better.
Please note we are classified as a Hotel and do not provide motel facilities such as kitchenettes etc.

Kind regards

title: Reasonable hotel in Hamilton
text: Not flash but good value for money and the staff are pleasant. My bed had obviously featured some heavyweights and the mattress will need replacing. A very generous continental breakfast and watched the Lions test on Sky so not a bad experience.
hotel_response:
Thank you for the comments and glad you enjoyed the Lions beating the Australians in a close fought game. I appreciate the comments regarding the bed as many times it is feedback on these issues and other maintenance issues that do go unnoticed until brought to our attention. Thank you again

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Bring it up to date.
text: We stayed at the Kingsgate in Hamilton for 1 night 15/6. We were stuck for choice as we forgot it was field days. We had a studio room, which was some what outdated and tired looking. Why put 2 cold high vinyl chairs in the room? Why not some nice comfy fabric ones to sit in to watch t.v, with a small coffee table, instead of a long table which was almost like a classroom table, and another that looked like a school desk, it was somewhat unusual décor. Bathroom was bright lovely and clean. To get access to our room we had to unlock a front door that I likened to a dormitory block, and up 2 flights of stairs through a fire door and then unlock our studio door, all while trying to get our bags through. On a good note the front desk lady was lovely and helpful with directions etc.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments, the previous chairs in the rooms were cloth and very comfortable but guests repeatedly told us they were old fashioned and as such we changed to what people had suggested we have. The key locks are a security feature of the Hotel as we do not wish external access to the general public. Staff are available, if requested, to help with luggage or alternatively we would be happy to relocate rooms to ground level. Thank you for your constructive comments and where possible we will address the matters raised.

Kind regards

title: Slightly tired property but clean and comfy
text:
I have just returned from a two night stay at the Kingsgate for a work trip (working at the Mystery Creek Fieldays) which was booked through my company. Normally when travelling for leisure and making bookings myself, I look for either a newish property or one with some character.The Kingsgate was neither, but nevertheless it was perfectly acceptable. 

The room was large and the bedding and bathroom clean. The air-conditioning/heating unit was quite noisy so I turned it off and the room stayed warm enough. The bar fridge was also noisy - probably on the older side. The shower had good pressure and the bathroom had a good number of fluffy towels and toiletries. 

The hotel is a reasonable (ten mins or so) drive back into the city centre. Normally I tend to shy away from hotel restaurants but we were so tired after 12 hours on our feet that we opted for the onsite restaurant rather than the drive. We went for the menu options (although there was an extensive buffet) and my fish meal was delicious.

All in all, this hotel was marginally better than I'd expected from the reviews here. Would I stay again? Possibly not, but if you get a good rate, or you're booked here for work - it is perfectly adequate.
hotel_response:
Thank you for a very balanced and well written review. The Hotel was built in 1997 and over the last 12 months had major maintenance projects including re-carpeting throughout, new curtaining, lounge, rooms and restaurant chairs. The corridors and room furniture are in the process of being re-painted and upgraded. Once again thank you for a well written review.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: old fashioned hotel
text:
old-fashioned hotel, I could not find better because there was a big event going on. The field days. Everything was fuly bookedl. Breakfast was weak. Staf was friendly and helpfull.
but I will not come back.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments, it is disappointing that you felt the hotel is old fashioned after all the work that has been done in the last year.

Kind regrads

Murray Cook

title: Nice stay at a good price
text: We only stayed for a night and the accomodation was good. Not a luxury place but neat and clean. We got a great rate with a full buffet breakfast included. A very grand reception area and large lobby area to relax. Good for those just passing through. We stayed on the 2nd level and there was no lift so we had to carry our luggage up the stairs. Otherwise, a nice stay
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Assistance with luggage is always available, if requested. Or alternatively we can generally move people to a ground floor room. Thank you again for taking the time to make comment and should you be staying in Hamilton again hopefully we can accommodate you with one of the special deals we have going at various times.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Kingsgate Hamilton Not Impressed
text: I wasn't happy with the hair's I found in the shower which weren't mine made me feel a bit yuck to be honest. Well then I went to have a cuppa and all the cups and saucers were stuck together I kid you not .I have stayed in cheaper motels and they have been spotless so I would think The Kingsgate would have been a lot better.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make comment. Unfortunately from your non de plume we are unable to find your booking and as such cannot isolate the staff member who failed to clean your room to the standard you and I would expect. Your comments have been given to the housekeeping staff along with a clear message that this is not acceptable.

Thank you for bringing it to my attention.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Excellent price and great staff - very welcoming
text: My daughter and I decided to have a last minute trip to Hamilton, late on a wet Friday night. I rang hotel to check on availabilty etc. Amy, on reception was extremely helpful and friendly. Advised of special deal for breakfast ($10) for a buffet brekky! Great price. I think it was Amy who greeted us at reception when we got there just after 10pm. Once again very friendly, and prepared for us. The lobby at this hotel is huge, biggest I have ever seen! Room was nice and tidy and again huge. Bedcovers and side tables were a bit dated. But apart from that all, was great. Room was lovely and quiet 519, so had a good night sleep. Breakfast the following morning was very good also. Good variety of cereals, hot dishes, juices, danishes and even the toast 4 types available. We were impressed. Staff in restaurant were just as welcoming as reception the previous night. Also when checking out, lady on reception, once again as friendly as others. We were very impressed with staff and their manner. I wish all hotels were like this. Well done to Kingsgate Hamilton

title: Comfortable enough.
text:
Very impressed with the with the check-in.  I was part of a group booking of a 100+ people all arriving at the same time.  The hotel had organised this really well, it was streamlined and quick.  The room itself was OK, rather dated decor, bed was comfy, clean for the most part apart from a dirty great big black long hair in the bathroom.  Shower water pressure was a bit piddly.  Typical buffet breakfast for a hotel/motel of this genre, neither particularly good nor particularly bad.  Checkout again was quick and easy.
Not sure what the price for the room was.  I would certainly consider staying here again if I was paying myself if the price was right.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments and appreciate you mentioning the reception check in and check out being done in a timely manner. We look forward to accommodating you again in the future.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Pleasant, hassle-free place to stay.
text:
Booked online . Greeted by reception who located my booking easily. Room was basic but clean and tidy. Parking great! 
Ate at the restaurant buffet which was a bit of a letdown. Fries were cold, and mains were limited! Soup and dessert were yum.

I have stayed here several times over the years and never hesitate booking again!
Thanks Kingsgate.
hotel_response:
Hello Elaine, thanks for your comments. We are just trialing the weekend buffet over May and June and feedback such as yours is invaluable and much appreciated. 
We look forward to seeing you with us again in the future.

Kindest Regards

Murray Cook

title: Quick overnight stay to watch a sports game in Hamilyon
text: We stayed here for one night to watch waterpolo games at the nearby pool (400m away). We got a very good internet deal on the hotels web site that included full buffet breakfast. Room was large and spacious with a large bathroom- basic but adequate. Slight musty smell on arrival but sorted once we opened a window. Great pool and hot pool facility. Breakfast was good, usual fare but not dried out like you get in some places. Didn't have dinner here but several reasonable takeaways near by.
hotel_response:
Thank you for the comments. Our internet provider (Reivernet) are currently doing a survey to provide internet to all the accommodation wings of the Hotel. Currently the 200,300,400 wings only get wi-fi. As you mentioned 20 minutes free wi-fi is available each day in the reception lounge. Hope you enjoyed the water polo.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Went the extra mile for us
text:
By chance, rather than by organisation, a whole lot of us families ended up staying at the Kingsgate while our kids played in NZSS water polo tournament across the road.  Once we realised we were all staying together we decided to organise dinners for the players together, and staff at this hotel allowed us to take over some tables in the bar area to serve and feed the hungry sporty types.  Each staff member I approached during the 4 days was pleasant and professional. 

The rooms were big, not the flashest, a bit tired in places, but certainly good for our needs, and ours was very clean.  We were in the middle of a corridor and did not hear much noise from other guests. The kids all collapsed in the indoor pool and spas one evening (you would think they would be sick of water from all their games!) and they were happy with the facilities.

Thanks to the staff for going out of their way to help us out.  The location was excellent with Waterworld 5 minutes walk away so no worries about being delayed in traffic trying to get to games!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments regarding the Hotel and the way the staff responded to your requests. It is really pleasing that staff went out of their way to accommodate your group and make for a memorable stay with us.

We look forward to being able to accommodate you again in the future.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Good value for money
text: I have stayed at this hotel many times over the years. It is in a quiet suburban setting and a few minutes drive to the city centre. Staff are friendly and helpful, rooms spacious. It has the feel of an overgrown motel rather than a typical hotel. Overall the building design has not dated well and some of the maintenance has slipped. In my room the aircon and the extractor fan in the bathroom were not working and the fridge seal poor, meaning it was noisy and leaking. On the plus side there is plenty of free parking and the breakfast has a wide selection.

title: Great Value
text: Stayed 1 night, 27 April 2013. This is not the most modern hotel and when it was built in the 1970's all the open space inside would have been so futuristic. However it appears to be well maintained. The rooms are large and have a good shower, clean and very fluffy towels. It seems to be in quieter area. All in all a good overnight stop off for 1 night on the way north to Auckland.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments and it is pleasing that you enjoyed your stopover in Hamilton. Of note the Hotel was built in 1997 and opened in 1998. However I understand your thinking in that in the 70's everything was big and spacious, as the Hotel is, and in more recent years space is a precious commodity and needs to be used.

Again I appreciate your comments and wish you well in your travels.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Good value for the price we paid.
text:
The reception staff were very welcoming. The room was a bit old fashioned but clean and fresh with a good shower room. It was nice and quiet too. My husband made use of the pool and enjoyed it. 
It was a bit annoying having to use a key to get into the building before you get to your room.
hotel_response:
Thank you for the kind comments and best of all its great to hear you felt you got good value for money. It is much appreciated and will be forwarded to the staff who always gratefully receive positive feedback.

We look forward to you staying with us again.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Lovely Staff and Experience
text:
Had a lovely stay here for our anniversary.  The staff were very courteous and helpful.  And everything was fresh and clean.  Facilities were great too, with a well decked out gym, steam room, and pool. Spa's were a bit on the cool side though.

Our room was large and spacious, and we were upgraded to a King room for free as bookings were light, being a Sunday.

My only gripe would be a bit of noise that made sleeping difficult - the fridge was loud and spouting leaked gushes of water outside our window when it rained.

But overall we had a wonderful stay and highly recommend this Hotel.
hotel_response:
Happy anniversary and its great that we were able to make your day even that little bit more special. Thank you for the kind comments and constructive comments regarding some maintenance issues. By letting us know these we will be able to take action and ensure future guests are not inconvenienced.

After the drought it was actually very pleasant to have the rain and the Waikato sure need it.

Thank you again for your comments

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Great value stay
text:
Spent a single night here on a Sunday. The facilities were fantastic -  a full gym, two restaurants, 3 spa pools, an indoor pool, saunas and changing rooms.  Well worth the price we paid.

The rooms were clean a spacious. The staff were fantastic and extremely helpful.

My only gripe is the doors to the rooms seem to not block out hallway noise that well. This wasn't too much of a problem as it was a Sunday night and pretty quiet.
hotel_response:
Thank you for the kind comments. Generally the rooms closest to the entry/exits to the accommodation wings do get some noise when the main doors close heavily. We ensure they do shut for security reasons but with your comment we will look at the closing system and assure it is adjusted properly, as it may be losing some of its tension.

Thank you for bringing it to my attention and happy to hear you enjoyed the Hotel and its facilities.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Needs upgrade
text:
My husband and I attended a wedding in Hamilton. We booked into the Kingsgate in Te Rapa.
I found the place hadnt changed since I was last there about 15years ago, the decor was still the same. We stayed one night and found the room very much 70's, the bed was okay and the bathroom had a great shower, abit dissappointed in the bathroom where the toilet is situated it didnt alow for much room to manouver as it was tucked away beside the shower. The hotel needs to be desperately upgraded. 
The rate was $115.00/night and the only positive was they allowed us a check out time of mid-day at no extra cost which was fab.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments - you must have stayed just as it opened in late 1998. I have been at the Hotel for the last 5 years and in that time we have re-carpeted throughout the Hotel public areas and rooms  (used to be red & orange carpets). We have replaced all the lounge, restaurant and rooms furniture, fitted new buffet tops in the restaurant and new bar top (the reception is next). All rooms have new blue heavy curtains and headboards to match and the old TV's have been replaced with flat screen TV's. Broad band has been installed throughout the Hotel. The bedspreads have been replaced with new boxed bedspreads and entry ways redecorated and new pictures put up throughout the hallways. Next to be done are the coffee tables and desktops in the rooms and painting of room walls. Given you stayed 15 years ago you would also have been able to notice that in 2001 the 600 block was added with indoor swimming pool, spa's, saunas & changing rooms and a gymnasium for guests use.

It is disappointed that so much has been done and not been recognised and can only advise that continuous upgrade is planned when funds are available.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Not impressed
text: Stayed in a family suite and the room itself was huge but that was the only positive. The several signs in the room advising us to keep our windows closed at all times due to criminal activity was not a welcome sight. The room was not very clean, the decor, bathrooms etc were old and seriously need to be updated. The bed was uncomfortable as were the pillows.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments and it is disappointing we were not able to meet your desired standards. We do not have a problem with a criminal element as you allude too, we are merely advising guests that it is advisable to have the windows closed, this also helps with the guests who use the air conditioning with the windows open. We also advise on entry to the wings that if they leave their rooms should also do so. It is surprising the number of guests on the ground floor that go out for the day with their windows wide open when staying among a large numbers of strangers. As for the bathrooms we get many very good and positive comments regarding having the spa baths and showers and being very spacious.

Kind Regards
Murray Cook

title: What a cool retro venue....
text:
Attended a two day training forum, the facilities, luncheon and service they provided was spot on!
I must say when I walked into the foyer it was like walking into something out of the 1970s, but in a very cool way; wood paneling, wide spaces, well dressed staff, friendly atmosphere and boy is it big (reminded me of some of the places I've stayed in China).
If you want to hold a function in a place that is relaxed and with genuine real character I'd recommend this place. Loved it, don't go changing!
hotel_response:
It is pleasing to receive positive feedback and thank you for taking time to comment. the only area we are currently looking at in the reception area is to replace the front desk counter top and housebar counter top. Your comments regarding the staff have been passed on and gratefully received.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Needs updating
text: My daughter was swimming across the road at Waterworld.  Location was perfect as you just have to walk across the road to the pool.  I booked a triple room which was large, roomy and had air conditioning, however the decor and bathroom were very old fashioned and in need of updating.  The corridors were also very dark and unappealing.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to comment and happy that you enjoyed the spaciousness of the triple room you stayed at. Our next maintenance project is for a repaint of the hotel corridors. I can only assume you stayed in our 600 wing where the bathrooms are not as nice as the main accommodation block where we get many positive comments regarding the size and makeup of the bathrooms. 

Kind regards

Murray Cook
General Manager

title: Friendly checkin staff
text: The hotel is a bit far from the town center but it is closer to Te Rapa shops which is a plus also there are some small shops at the end of the road for groceries and takeaways. The checkin staff were very friendly and very informative and welcoming and the room was spacious and very clean thanks to housekeeping. I would rate it 9 out of 10.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make positive comments regarding the staff and Hotel. These comments will be passed onto the staff concerned and I am sure they will be very grateful to you for them. Praise is certainly a motivating factor for anyone and I am sure your comments will lead to continuing good service for our guests, from the staff concerned.

Thank you again.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Great Budget Hotel
text: We loved the fact that this hotel had 24 hour check-in as we ended up doing a longer and later tour out in Waitomo. Our room was massive!!! My only complaints are that the shower stall floor was quite dirty with stray hairs which were not our own. I was too tired to complain so gave it a quick wipe with one of the face cloths! The other one is that we chose a room with a refrigerator as we had some food items to keep cold (advertised on their website)...only it was in reality a fully stocked mini-bar fridge. We just moved things around to accommodate our own items. It would have been nice to know!!! Just as well we couldn't find a price list for anything even in the hotel's portfolio. So we stayed away! Other then that it was a fairly quiet hotel and would definitely consider staying here again. Cheers
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to pass on your comments. Usual practise for rooms with mini bars in them is that they have a price list amongst the food items. Housekeeping will check to ensure all rooms have the list and thank you for bringing it to our attention. Not all rooms have mini bars and if you wish to store items we can also remove mini bars from rooms.

I am pleased that you enjoyed your stay with us and look forward to accommodating you again in the future.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook
General Manager

title: Had a peaceful And great time
text:
If you can describe this hotel in one word  then that word would be "Amazing".

Stayed there for 2 nights.Very quite place.Heaps off room space.Good facilities

they have 3 spas
1 not so big pool but very private and clean
1 gymnasium 
big locker rooms with steam bath facilities. soooo clean

the hotel is old but if your looking for space and peaceful moments away from all the crowd then this is the place,

And guess what water world is right behind the hotel just 2 min walk. there are heaps of take a way shops next to it. so try it out.
hotel_response:
It is pleasing to read your comments regarding your stay with us.

I would just note we have thre options regarding room servicing. If you put out the "Do not Disturb" hanger a bag of towels and room amenities will be left outside the room door. If you leave the "Going Green" hanger outside the door the coffee and teas and toilet paper is replaced as required only. If no hanger is left on the door handle the rooms will receive a full room service.

It is good to see you had the opportunity to use the leisure facilities and the two sets of hand weights that have mysteriously gone missing over the last month have now been replaced.

We look forward to being able to look after your accommodation needs again, in the future.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook
General Manager

title: Excellent value, A++
text:
I had read the reviews before booking on Expedia, and took the good comments on board and made my decision.

The room we had was a triple bedroom (x2 adults, x2 kids) one queen, one double and one single and was spacious, clean and nice.  Bathroom was modern and we had both a fan on the roof and an air con unit that we used for a little bit, so the room was cosy and not hot at all.

For the deal we got, we had x2 adult breakfasts free so only paid for the kids.  Food was great, eggs, bacon, breakfast sausages, hashbrowns, mushrooms, lots of different juices to drink, yummy coffee, fresh fruit, yoghurt, toast with 3 diff of breads, cereals... nice decor, and fabulous service..  Staff were friendly at reception, and at breakfast.

Kids and I enjoyed the pool, partner and I loved the Maccona coffee in our room... Used the hairdryer in the morning, watched a movie on Sky (TV was old, but that didnt worry us at all)

Beds were comfortable and all of us had a great sleep :-)

Dispite comments of old decor (with other reviews) - I loved it.. And without a doubt will look at staying again and will try to use the gym, sauna, and the bar next time...lol...

To all the staff that worked on the 19 / 20 Jan - Thank you, see you next time

 Partner and I loved the Maccona coffee

My kids and I enjoyed the pool and the spa and
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Its a pity we only have 13 of the rooms you have described as they are so popular with families and I'm happy that we were able to accommodatre you in one of these rooms. As I write this the new flat screen TV's are being installed in all the rooms with completion expected over the next week or two. 147 rooms take a while with all the freeview channels now available and all the Sky channels being tuned in.

Thank you for taking the time to post positive comments and your kind thoughts have been passed onto the staff.

Murray Cook
General Manager

title: Great value for money!
text:
We chose to stay here because it was the closest hotel to my sister's house (Christmas at her place this year!)  We had two nights here and it was more than adequate for our needs.  We had a standard room with a kingsize bed.  There is plenty of room to move and the ensuite bathroom is also big and spacious with thick white towels.  Clean and tidy room with air conditioning, mini bar and only about 5 minutes drive from the centre of town.  Free parking, pool and spa, bus stop just out the main entrance and also Waterworld pool complex 200 metres away, oh and also Te Rapa racecourse is just down the road.
We had dinner in the restaurant on the first night, the food and decor was fine.
This is a great place to stay with a group.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to pass on your comments. It is pleasing when someone stays with us and we meet their expectations and receive positive comments regarding their stay.

We look forward to being able to accommodate you again in the fuiture.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook
General Manager

title: big
text: big hotel nice facilities although decor a little  dated - good value - breakfast buffet cold corridors very warm had to leave room air con on all night. Would stay again with a group as can feel a little lonely in such big place.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments and yes the hotel is very spacious. Regarding the breakfast buffet, we checked all elements and heat lamps and isolated the problem of the air conditioning vent above the breakfast bain marie putting our cold air. This was being used to the extremel humid weather over the period of your stay. We now try to limit the usage of the air conditioning in the restaurant to a minimum and thank you for bringing it to our attention.

Kind regards

Murray Cook
General Manager

title: pleasantly surprised
text: We weren't going to stay at this hotel, due to the many negative comments we read online about the hotel, however we decided to give it a go and stay, due to its great location, and we are so glad we did. We absolutely enjoyed our stay 100 %. The staff were wonderful. From the man on the front desk (Jian) to the lovely lady working in the restaurant who wished each diner a merry christmas. The room we stayed in was huge ,clean, great air con and just loved that spacious bathroom. The breakfast was included in our price, which consisted of a full breakfast with a great selection , delicious... and a nice big dining room to sit in. Free parking was a definite bonus, having being charged $20 per day at a previous hotel we had stayed in the week before, in Hamilton. For the price we paid to stay at the Kingsgate it was definitely worth it!!!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments. It is always positive for the Hotel staff to receive such comments as generally people are more likely to comment negatively rather than praise.

Your comments have been passed onto all the Hotel staff and very much appreciated.

We look forward to being able to accommodate you again in the future. 

Kind Regards

Murray Cook
General Manager

title: Big but friendly
text: having travelled round and stayed in quite a few hotels/motels since we came to New Zealand, this hotel for it's price lived up to it's expectation and more...nice big room, all clean, nice white fluffy towels....lots of TV channels for the kids, great air con which was well needed. Friendly staff wherever we went, we used the free pool and Spa which our little one loved. We paid extra on the 2 mornings and enjoyed a continental breakfast which was really nice and quite a variety too. I will definitely be staying again on my next trip, they say you get what you pay for, we felt we got more here

title: Clean, comfy but no wow factor
text:
stayed here on an overnight stop in Hamilton. I had a double room which had a double and a single bed in it, good facilities in terms of plenty of tea/coffee etc. and milk sachets were real milk not UHT. Iron and board in room. Hairdryer available however attached to the wall inside a drawer so you have to do your hair in front of the mirror in the bedroom whether you want to or not! 

The room was clean however the bath seemed to have had a cursory pass over with cleaning products. 

My room was on the ground floor which meant I had cars parked right outside my window, not too bad as I had an early start but if I had of wanted a Sunday lay in this wouldnt have been possible with the car outside my window being revved into action around 6am !!!!

Breakfast was included in the price of the hotel, went down for breakfast around 8.30, starts at 7am. Personally had to ask twice when items were going to be refreshed, staff not onto it. Seriously if you have the option to pay for just a room do that, there are plenty of great cafes to eat in nearby with better value for money, fresh, hot food cooked to order.

This hotel is huge, plenty of parking.
