The hotel bar was shut when we returned to the hotel at 11pm on Saturday night, very disappointing. 

Oh, and they charge 4% extra if you pay for your room by credit card (!)

they have a pool which is a slim pool with jets so you can paddle against a tide, so to speak. a couple of hot tubs too and the gym looked to be equipped well with bikes, runners etc.

title: OK Conference  venue
text: Large room which worked well sharing with a colleague.  Uncomfortable bed.  Good cooked breakfast included in room tarriff but lunch provised with the conference was mediocre, sparse ran out of food and not worth $25.  Certainly is retro but not enough orange or purple to be really "cool'

title: Great Conference Venue
text: We had a convention at this hotel and found the facilities excellent.  Our room was clean and comfortable and the room servicing was top-class.  However the old TV could certainly do with updating - you expect the modern style TVs these days.  The Conference food (morning and afternoon tea and buffet dinner was superb).  Breakfast was included in our room rate and we couldn't fault that either.  We would stay again.
hotel_response:
I am pleased you enjoyed your conference with us.

If you had had it a month later the new flast screen TV's would have been installed. An order has just been placed for 142 new TV's is response to comments like yours and in an effort to increase guest satisfaction.

Thank you agin for your comments.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Find somewhere else to stay
text:
I travel a lot so have a reasonable idea of what to expect for the price and standard rating of accommodation - this hotel was way below the minimum standard.  I'll like to be objective so these are the facts so you can make up your own mind.  The ironing board was broken, the cover was stained and dirty, apart from one pair of small hand weights in the gym their range of weights were all over 25kgs (not sure if most guests could in general manage 25kgs or more), the equipment was outdated.

The rooms were outdated - nothing particularly wrong with that except, the tables stained and chipped, wallpaper in the corridors ripped and marked, corridors smelt of smoke (although the room didn't), the bed was very firm and the pillow cases crumpled and pillows flat. The hotel is quite a long way from the city centre, no restaurants around the hotel.

There is no public free wifi or at least if there was it was not widely advertised.

You know some very small inexpensive changes would improve the hotel, like a new set of weighs for the gym.  Right now it sends a message to guest that 'we really don't care' and I am sure this is not their intention.

The bathroom was clean

You can get better value for money elsewhere in town, just note many of the motels line very busy streets so careful for potential road noise.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments regarding the Hotel.

I have received no comments regarding the ironing board so will have housekeeping check every room for the board. As is often the problem when something may fail and we are never informed of it. 

Regarding the smoke smell in the corridor,we have 2 smoking rooms out of the 147 rooms and no smoking signs everywhere but cannot control all the perople all the time. The one pair of weights have only recently been taken and we are looking at replacing the one pair rather than the entire set, which is expensive.  I believe the gym/fitness room is a great addition to the hotel along with the sauna's, spa's and swimming pool I do not believe that other hotels and motels in the area have the same level of facilities on the property as you have mentioned. 

There is 20 minutes of free wi-fi is available within the reception lounge and this should show up automatically on your laptop, after the time has elapsed you would be required to purchase one of the packages available. 

I appreciate your comments and thank you for the lack of attention to detail that you have pointed out and the issues will be addressed. 

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: BEAM ME UP SCOTTY
text:
What a quaint place the Kingsgate in Hamilton is.Stayed 5 nights on business,so payed for by work. It was built in the70s I believe,so if you want to know what the 70s were like,this is the place for you.The rooms ,big and comfortable,bed ginormous and firm.
The whole place is biiiig-as in biiiiig.Gym ok,and spa pools handy.
The cleaning was fine,but the carpet throughout seems to have been chosen by the retirement home up the street and plonked in here.
As commented on by other reviewers,the tvs are like a microwave box gone wrong.The manager always comments they're being replaced as they break down-lame-hello,theres a thing called being pro-active?.21 century now buddy,heard of flatscreens?your opposition has.
The meals were fine,amazingly the best desert-the berry trifle-is only on the room service menu,which we got by mistake one mealtime-recommend anyone to ask for it,its beautifull,can't understand why its a secret.
All in all an ok place to stay-back off main drag so no road noise,obliging friendly staff,comfortable surroundings,a bit like going to nanas to stay
Did I mention the CARPET ?-ooouuugh,just dont look down haha
hotel_response:
Your comments have been greatly appreciated.

I am happy to advise that we have placed an order for 142 flat screen TV's for installation in the near future. I would hope that you would be able to appreciate that this is a considerable expense for the hotel for that many rooms. Yout comment and others regarding the TV's have been identified as a requirement in our continuing upgrade/renewal policy to seek guest satisfaction.

Again, thanks for your comments.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook.

title: A good, cheap conference venue
text:
I have stayed at this hotel, for the New Zealand annual bridge championships, for many of the last 20 years and, to be honest, it hasn't changed much in this period. This month I did notice a bit of refurbishing of the lounge furniture and the installation throughout the hotel of one of the most hideous carpets ever seen.

Nonetheless, the Kingsgate has many advantages as a conference venue. The rooms are huge and generally well appointed, although the range of TV programmes available on the antiqueTV sets is disappointing. The beds are comfortable and the bathrooms, although not elaborate, are adequate and spotlessly maintained. There is adequate storage space for clothing and luggage, a good coffee making facility and (a nice touch) free drinking chocolate is provided, along with a nice sized fridge.

As one would expect, parking is more than adequate, even given the size of the property. A word of warning, though - the hotel is a fair distance from the centre of Hamilton and there is very little in the vicinity by way of restaurants, so you really do need a car.

Service is consistently pleasant, and the conference ran like clockwork, with the organisers going out of their way to express their thanks to manager Colin McLaurin and his staff. Importantly for a bridge congress, lighting in the conference rooms was excellent.

I never tried the hotel restaurant. They did provide a $20 roast for congress attendees in the evening, which was just OK.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Disappointing that you don't like the new carpet throughout the Hotel but happy that your stay with us was an enjoyable one.

I have passed your comments onto Colin MacLaurin, the Hotel Front Office Manager and to the staff who looked after the congress throughout your stay. Feedback from the Board and organisers throughout the event was very positive and there were numerous good comments regarding the service provided by the Hotel. I Hope to see you next year and may the cards fall your way. 

Thank you for taking the time to advise us of your experience when staying with us.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Old but clean
text: The hotel is old and does require a update. However the rooms are very clean and are a good size. The staff are very friendly and very helpful.  We had a special deal that included breakfast so we were not disappointed in the price we paid.
hotel_response:
I am pleased that you were able to take advantage of one of the special offers the Hotel and the Millennium, Copthorne and Kingsgate Chain is able to offer.

The hotel is constantly upgraded, as allowed, and we have just received the first shipment of new furniture for the main lounge. The new breakfast buffet unit is now in use and the 2nd one will be completed as soon as possible complementing the new restaurant seating.

Thank you for your feedback

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: not for the "weak"
text: we booked a suite - phoned at least 3 times to confirm that there will be 2 single beds in the lounge and a king size bed in the masters bedroom - at check in I was assued by the person whom I spoke with at least twice with a tone of exasperation "ÿes, we spoke on the phone twice, remember?"  Lo and behold when we got to our room, there is only 1 single bed in the living room.  we decided to move the single bed ourselves to find holes on the wall which the single bed was covering.  no wonder they did not want to move it.  the remote of the tv was mising - housekeeping came and started looking under the bed and under the sofa cushions - i thought it was so "barriotic"especially considering we are paying well for the room.  breakfast is okay.  apart from the reservation staff being rude and unable to follow requests and the room and furnishing being tired, it was all in all okay.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to comment. Yes there was a mis-communication and the reservationist remembers you calling 3 times to confirm your reservation. He is apologetic but thought that on each occasion he was being asked whether the suite was a two bedroomed room with a king sized bed and 2 single beds, which it is. He failed to pick up the requiement for the two single beds to be in the lounge. 

Thank you for bringing the matter of the hole in the wall to our attention, our maintenance team have now fixed it. It was not being hidden but down low next to the skirting and not picked up by housekeeping. Nice of someone to punch a hole in the wall and not advise us of it.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Tomato-Onion-Mushroom-Spinach breakfast SURPRISE
text:
Have been staying at this Hotel on and off for over two years now, the company gets a cheap dinner bed and breakfast deal so I guess we'll be back
The rooms are huge but in real need of a make over. The TV in still an old glass tube 19 inch type, the lack of wall sockets is annoying but remember to look behind the curtains as there you will find the only socket on the bed side of the room, still just a bit far away from the network port so remember to take a extension cord or plug box with you.
The hot water in the 300 block is for some reason 10 degrees less than all the others so no matter how hard you turn the shower lever it is never quite hot enough
The toilet in the on suite is jammed in beside the shower so if you are of a larger build then you'll probably find the toilets off the bar to be more suitable
The beds may look King size but are two single mattresses and sometime of varying quality, one I had you almost fell out of one half of the bed onto the other
Breakfast was good but they are now serving a tomato-onion-mushroom-spinach SURPRISE which tastes and bad as it looks, install of the standard selection of each and NO BAKED BEANS how un-kiwi is that
Dinner at the restaurant 4 nights in a row gets a little boring with Meat and 2 vege - potato and bok choy  and the soup that is invariable always the same shade  of yellowy orange and tastes almost, but not quite, what it is meant to be
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. As a regular guest please feel free to make comments direct to the Hotel in future and we will endeavoutr to help you. If you have a preference for room (some have split kings some don't) or wing we would be more than happy to accommodate. Your comment re the difference in temperatures between the wings is the first we have been made aware of this and will be looked into. TV's will be replaced on failure, some have already been replaced. The menu served in the restaurant has many varied main meal choices including 3 different pizza and 3 different pasta meals, shepherds pie, fish & chips, caeser salad and these are all available in addition to the grilled options. A new menu will be in place within the next month. Baked Beans are now back on the breakfast buffet and the mushroom mix changed. Thank you again for your comments and feedback.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Return to the Kingsgate Hamilton.New Zealand.
text:
Had to go to Hamilton's Biggest Night Ever.
The Chiefs ate Shark that night and kept it down, winning the Rugby Super 15 in the process.
The Kingsgate was available, inexpensive and as professionally managed and run as our first visit here.
Our room, was as spacious as the last had been, quiet, warm and equipped with every available lotion potion and individual bathrobes.
  Can't speak highly enough of this establishments staff and their professional manner.
Despite it's size, it feels welcoming and happy.
Thanks to management and staff for another great night away.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments and we appreciate the positive feedback. Of note we have just ordered new furniture for our lounge area, our breakfast buffet units are being refitted, new curtains will be puit up in the breakfast restaurant and the brick wall at the entrance to the Hotel will be finished. 

As always , when funds are available, every effort is made to ensure the property is maintained and improved where possible.

Once again It's great to hear you enjoyed your stay with us again.

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Two different keys to access your room ?
text: This is a huge complex. You get two different keys to access your room! the first key is to unlock the wing and the second the room. This is made worse when you are a family of four and you are only issued with one key. It is time to move on and change to access cards which can be swiped at the doors. This will mean you don't have to stop, put down all of your luggage and wrestle with a key that won't unlock the door while trying to keep out of the driving rain. Now besides the keys the rooms are pretty basic with a small TV, but comfortable. Please sort the keys!!!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments regarding the key system. Unfortunately it is very expensive to install card systems for the entry doors and all 147 rooms, but certainly the entry doors could be looked at. Internal access throughout the Hotel can be gained form reception or from the reception canopy area and it is disappointing that this may not have been conveyed to you. Thank you again for making your thoughts known to us.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Good value
text: Clean, quiet, well appointed room with comfortable beds, breakfast very nice, staff friendly and helpful. We enjoyed the indoor spa and pool facilities. Decor a bit tired but I would definitely stay here again for the same price.
hotel_response:
It is pleasing that you enjoyed your stay with us and managed to use the facilities the Hotel has to offer. I hope you were able to take advantage of one of the regular specials provided by the Hotel and are happy that you felt you received value for money.

We look forward to accommodating you again in the future.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Great value for money
text: We stayed for 1 night with our 3 children aged 9, 7 and 4. The room was clean, the children were happy to share a bed and they loved the swimming pool and spas. They spent lots of time between the cool swimming pool (too cold for me!) and the spa pool. Although our room was near the road, there was no traffic noise and we used our entertainment card so got a fantastic rate! Only down side, there were no electric blankets but the heater warmed the room quite quickly.
hotel_response:
It is pleasing that you have taken time to provide positive comments regarding your stay with us. Its great that we were able to provide a place for you to be able to take the children away and have an enjoyable time. The spa and pool area is certainly popular with the children who stay with us. 

We look forward to accommodating you and your family again in the future.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Affordable and adequate!
text:
My wife and I stopped in Hamilton onour final leg home of our road trip. The Kingsgate Hotel was reasonably priced and included a breakfast option. It is not near to the centre of town, with google maps suggesting it would be a 35min walk to the 'restaurant district' so we chose to dine at the hotel's restaurant. The food was adequate but as with most hotel restaurants, quite pricey. Just main meals, a glass of wine and one desert was close to $100. Our room was huge and clean. A basic minibar and an old tv where the only thing that let it down. An electric blanket might've made thing's consider but the individual heat pump in every room helped keep room toasty all night. 

As a stopover hotel it's great. I wouldn't recommend it as a base, there are far nicer places for not a lot more money. Great staff really help you feel welcomed in a reception that's obscenely large. Would certainly stay again if passing through but avoid the very dry brekkie.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. The comment re the breakfast being dry i believe is in regards to the bacon on the buffet. We recently changed to another brand and have found with the new brand that it does not keep well under the buffet lights and in the heated units. We have tried to replace it as often as possible each morning as it quickly goes dry and hard and is substandard. 

We are currently sourcing different brands and and the current product will be replaced.

Of note when staying with us there is a complimentary casino shuttle running from 6.00pm from the hotel to the casino and return. This will drop you off in the centre of the city where you can wander through the restaurant area.

Thank you again for your comments

Kind regards

Murray Cook

title: Cheapish and sort of cheerful!
text:
The Kingsgate is in need of a facelift, as it's 70's decor and design is not cool enough to be retro!

But on the whole, it's facilities are relatively clean, the bar is comfy, and it's close to town.

Staff are pleasant enough, and rooms are quiet.

title: Very dated, noisy room
text: Stayed at Kingsgate as just about every where else was full for Rugby test. Room was really dated, old carpet, beds, TV etc. Went to go to bed and the noise in the room was terrible, called reception who said it was the people next door using their aircon and there was nothing she could do except call them to turn it off. Expensive because of the rugby test.
hotel_response:
It is disappointing that your stay was spoilt by noise generated from another guests room and I apologise for this. This was a particular problem over the rugby test with many guests showing little concern for their fellow guests and due to the Hotel being fully booked there was no option to move you to another room.  

I am at a loss to your comments regarding old carpet as the Hotel was completely re-carpeted finishing May 2011 and as always fixtures and furnishings are upgraded on an ongoing basis.

Thank you for making your concerns known

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Dirty sheets
text: I booked a room and breakfast at the Kingsgate for three adults. When we checked in, we were told that our booking included only two breakfasts and that we would need to pay $35 for the third breakfast. We showed the receptionist our booking and pointed out that the booking said nothing about only two breakfasts. We were told it must be an issue with their website and that they could not do anything about it. The cost of the breakfast then changed to $22 and then finally $10!? We ended up just paying it. The rooms are spacious but dated and cold. The worst of all was that the sheets on one bed had not been changed. There were makeup marks on the pillow and hairs in the bed! I will never stay in this hotel again! There are lots of nicer places closer to town.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. As I am unable to ascertain how you booked I cannot follow up  on the number of breakfasts included in your booking. I have checked all the sites that we advertise on and all clearly state the Bed and Breakfast package is for 2 breakfasts only. There is a charge for a 3rd person in a room of $35 but this covers room only. Full buffet breakfast is charged at $22 and it appears you have been given a discounted rate on this. 

Housekeeping have been spoken to regarding checking all beds in a room whether they appear to have been used or not. On occasions we get guests booking for two people and then having extra people stay and re-making the bed to avoid the extra person charge. Not checking every bed is an oversight by our housekeeping staff and not acceptable. my sincere apologies for this and I regret this spoilt your stay with us.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Very tired decor, poor TV's and reception
text:
Stayed here because of others reviews and a good deal but very disappointed in the dated rooms. On the bright side the staff were fantastic - just sad about the facilities.  The TV's were old CRT 25" and the reception on the limited Sky channels wasn't the best.  We changed rooms but this did not help.  As we don't have Sky at home wanted this feature to add to our two day break from home.  The next morning decided to change hotels.
The rooms were clean but it would have been good to have two pillows as the one supplied was very large (high) and I ended up not using it.  No soap holder in shower either.  Its the little things that make us happy.
Just to reiterate the staff here are very helpful and pleasant - all credit to them!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments and it was pleasing to note your comments regarding the staff. Yes the TV's are in need of replacement and are being replaced as they fail. Unfortunately to replace all 147 rooms at one time is not a current option with a large amount of capital expenditure spent on new carpeting, chairs, curtains etc recently.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Great stay at Kingsgate Hamilton
text:
I got a really good on line rate to spend the weekend with my kids in Hamilton, so I was already feeling good about this hotel.Also, after I booked I e-mailed them directly to ask if the room would accomodate myself & 2 children & they were very helpful, saying they had rooms that would sllep 3 so would put us in one.
The room we had was huge and very clean and quiet.Plenty of space for the teenagers to spread out.
The bathroom was very clean too, and the toiletries provided were above the normal hotel standard.
The kids loved the pool, the spa and the gym and made good use of them.
I went for a cooked breakfast one morning & it was really nice-a good selection of food and juices,
I definitely recommend this hotel and will try & book here as my 1st choice from now on- it comes down to price and value for money for me & this hotel definitely has that.

title: Best Night away We've had in ages
text:
Arrived at the hotel just after 2pm, booked in with the front desk staff, awesome service. Stunned at the room(double bed room with amazing Super King bed) we were allocated.Spa bath in a massive bathroom with full shower, cabinet and hand basin services, beautiful white robes, full replete mini bar and snacks.Television in both the "lounge" and the bedroom. Bed so big you needed a street map to find your way from one side to the other.
Most comfortable Hotel bed we've slept in, ever, rooms quiet, clean and pleasant to be in.
Breakfast was another great experience, the kitchen and restaurant staff were courteous and friendly while doing a great job of making sure we knew where to find our preferred eats.
Overall we were magnificently looked after and treated with utmost courtesy and respect by all Hotel staff.
We will be back and I'm sure that the staff and the Hotel will not have lost their edge.
Well done the Kingsgate.
Would not hesitate to recommend the Kingsgate to anyone, go there and be treated as guests should be.
10/10

Unique Qualities: Super quiet rooms, no road or other noise all night, pleasant rooms and grounds, ample car parking, impressive restaurants and bar, indoor swimming pool, spa, gym, the works and all included in your room price.

Address: 100 Garnett Avenue, Hamilton, North Island, New Zealand
Comparison: about average
Directions: Closest Hotel to the Te Rapa Horse racing Track in Hamilton.
Phone: +64 7 849 0860
Price: US$40-80
Theme: Hotel
Website: http://www.millenniumhotels.co.nz/kingsgatehamilton/index.html

Read more: http://members.virtualtourist.com/m/p/m/21f5b5/#ixzz1tUVuw2N2
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to pass on your kind comments. Yes our suites are large and very comfortable and the only problem we have with them is not having more of them. 

We look forward to seeing you at the Hotel again in the future.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Very quiet & pleasant
text: Kingsgate is priced exactly right for what it is.  Rooms could do with a bit more of a thorough clean but bathrooms spotless and the suite is huge and fantastic value.  Would stay here again if you want reasonably priced accommodation that doesn't claim to be anything else than exactly what it is.  Lovely & quiet.  Fantastic Breakfasts!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments regarding the Hotel, it is always pleasing to receive balanced and constructive comments. As mentioned in a previous reply we are still waiting on the new chairs for the restaurant which are due to land this week, this will give an added lift to our breakfast restaurant. The headboard material has arrived and currently being put into the rooms. Planned painting/wallpapering of the rooms are next on the list and as you will  appreciate the maintenance and upkeep of the hotel is an ongoing operation.

Thank you again for the comments and taking the time to make your feelings known.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Very tired......
text:
Pleasant staff and well located close to Te Rapa. 
The rooms and whole complex is well over due for a total over haul. Reminiscent of a school hostel, tired dated and cheap interior, the room also smelt, possibly associated with stale water sitting in pipes/drains.
The in room fridge was about as quiet as a mini jumbo jet in your room.
Attentive staff, gym type facility and swimming pool available.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments, within the last year the entire Hotel has been recarpeted, All rooms have been recarpeted, had bedspreads, curtains and chairs replaced. Material for new headboards is stuck on the wharves but due in the next two weeks. New chairs for the restaurant are also awaiting arrival from overseas and have been for some time but waiting for a "full container". Upkeep on the property is ongoing and it is disappointing that you have not recognised the efforts put in.

Kind Regards

title: Excellent night away
text: Thank you for a very good stay. Food was excellent and staff very helpful. Love the gym on the property

title: An awesome, friendly and welcoming Hotel!!!
text: When we arrived we were greeted by friendly staff and a very inviting atmosphere.  We were promptly checked in at the front reception and showed to our rooms which were clean and spacious and the bathrooms were spotless.  The mini bar was handy to have in the rooms and a great attraction for the kids.  The staff in the restaurant were efficient and friendly and kept the dining area in a neat, clean and tidy condition. The food was good value for money and well exceeded expectations.   My kids enjoyed the swimming pool and the idea of Waterworld being just a short walk away was perfect.  I would recommend anyone visiting or staying in Hamilton to visit this great hotel!!!  Thanks very much to all the staff there and keep up the awesome work!!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind comments and I am happy you enjoyed your stay with us  The Hotel is popular with families, with the large triple and twin rooms and the indoor swimming pool, spa pools, steam rooms and gym facilities. We look forward to accommodationg you and your family again.

Murray Cook

title: Place is going down
text: I have stayed here many times and over the years I have seen the place go down, I have arrived here today and already want to leave  when I arrived I noticed a smell coming from the bathroom someone had just checked out and used the toilet the shower curtain is mouldy on the bottom and the mini bar isn't topped up  the check in lady was good. I don't get room service it's too expensive so I don't bother with it anymore
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Unfortunately without room numbers it is difficult to respond to the specific comments which may relate ro check in times, whether the room had just been serviced, whether the room allocated was a late check out and mini bar stocking was delayed. My apologies for the shortcomings and housekeeping staff will check on all shower curtains.

Murray Cook

title: Another Kingsgate Pearl
text: Waitangi weekend we went up to Hamilton for a women's duathlon event.  We checked accommodation rates online and the Hamilton Kingsgate were offering rooms for $79 for 2 or $99 with full breakfast for 2.  We took advantage of the breakfast option and were really impressed with the spaciousness of the rooms and the same friendly service that we have received in the Palmerston North Kingsgate Hotel.  We would reccommend this hotel to people who don't mind being right in the middle of town as it helps make for a nice quiet stay at a great price.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Just to clarify we are 4 kms from the centre of the city which is an easy 5km drive down the main road. Special weekend and bed & breakfast rates do come up regularly and we happy that you were able to take advantage of them.

Murray Cook

title: Great for large groups!
text: Me and my staff of over twenty stayed here for two nights in the last week of January.  I was really impressed with how well they managed such a large booking.  The staff were friendly and helpful.  The rooms were really large and well maintained. The hotel had great amenities including a bar and restaurant.  We received an excellent deal which included a low room cost and free breakfast. We would definitely stay here again!!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Special rates are available at various times and its great that you could take advantage of them and visit Hamilton during January.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: huge rooms
text: My family (2 A, 2 C) stayed here in November. We stayed on the first floor and there is no lift so some lugging up stairs required. We had the most enormous hotel room we have ever seen: 3 beds, bedside tables, a full-sized round dining table with 4 chairs, a coffee table, 2 arm chairs plus plenty of room in between everything! Not luxurious (the hotel in general is a bit threadbare in places) but very, very comfortably furnished and clean.  The kids loved the spa pools (several 4-person ones available) and there was a small indoor pool as well. We didn't try out the jets in the main pool but serious swimmers might appreciate them.  Mini bar prices were very reasonable and reception was helpful with directions, maps etc. We booked with wotif and paid about $NZ110.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. The room you stayed in would be room 607 or 613 and are indeed large. The bedding for these rooms is a queen and 2 singles. The other triple rooms we have available are made up of a queen, double and single bed and also large, but without the dining table.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Comfortable
text: Found the hotel to be clean and serviced well (tea/coffee and make up of the room, generous with the toiletry products). Liked the fact that the rooms we were in had a heat pump (A/C) with it's own controller. Wing 5 only had stairs to entrance (a ramp would have been better for wheeling heavy luggage - may have had one elsewhere but did not see). I quite liked the 80's decor of the reception restaurant - it looked clean and in well repair.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to make your comments regarding the property.  Of note is that new chairs for the Gamekeepers restaurant have been ordered and we have been advised of a January delivery date. 

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Good Accomodation
text:
Stayed the weekend at the above hotel.  It was comfortable and tidy,  the rooms were tidy and beds comfortable.
The only disappointment was the reception did not give any information on the hotel and what amenities were available for guests.  
Would recommend this hotel if you are looking for value for money, this is the place for you.
hotel_response:
It is expected of our reception staff to explain the amenities of the Hotel to our guests and this will be taken up with the Front office staff. Due to your comments we will also be putting up a pictorial display in reception to help promote the gym, spa's, steam rooms and indoor pool. Thank you.

Kind Regards

title: Good sleep, Buffet food good, Restaurant Poor
text: Good place to base yourself from while in Hamilton.  The Front of house  and Bar staff helpful . Only bad point the Restaurant menu prices are high for what you get and wait for food is long as they were not busy that night,  But the Buffet that was served the other nights was good and filling.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments, especially re travelling in groups. We do try to accommodate people of the same group together, however when arrival days are different and the group is in for a longer period we need to try and accommodate any special requests other guests may have and this may mean we cannot keep everyone together. Your comments regarding the buffet available and ala carte menu are appreciated, I would hope that you would have been advised that there is a Bar menu available, which you may have found less expensive and the service faster.  

Kind Regards

title: Great if travelling with kids
text: I have stayed here on many occasions when visiting Hamilton for hospital appointments.  I quite often am having to travel with my children and have found the Kingsgate to be a great hotel tostay it.  we often book the room with 2 x queen beds and a single and they also allow 2 children under the age of 12 to stay free.  You can also get deals that will include 2 free breakfast, though it can be quite pricey to add on breakfast for the children
hotel_response:
Thank you for the comments. Yes our triple rooms are very popular with family's and do provide plenty of room to relax in. Many family's choose to stay due to the indoor pool and spa's which help keep the children entertained while away. We look forward to accommodating you again in the future.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Solid place to stay
text: Although this is located a long 3+ km walk from the center of town; not much around the immediate area, but this hotel is worth it.  The room we had was excellent: 3 beds - 2 queens and a single; comfortable beds, roomy bathroom, good TV selection standard $30/day internet. Reception area is huge, lots of couches and TVs, with a well stocked bar and at least one restaurant (maybe two).  Staff was very helpful.  We would stay again, but will bring our walking shoes.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments. Of note is the arrangement with the Hamilton Casino for pick up and drop off from the Kingsgate Hotel to the Casino and back again. Save the wearing of your feet and shoes.

Kind Regards

Murray Cook

title: Adequate for stopover
text: Stayed in this hotel for 1 night on the way down south. Service very good: we asked to change rooms as ours was close to the stairs - accommodated with no problems. Room amenities good (include tea, coffee and hot choc in the room) but decor in room and throughout hotel somewhat dated. Couldn't find any lifts so heaved suitcases up and down staircases. Breakfast options were reasonable. Did not eat a main meal or use the pool facilities. Overall stay was adequate for 1 night but for longer we'd look for other options.

title: Pretty Average
text: Stayed at the Kingsgate Hamilton in May 2011. Service was good, staff friendly. Ease of checking in & out were a breeze. Room was clean but had a terrible chemical smell, so bad that is gave me a headache, bad ventilation. With windows open smell was still there. Our room window was very low and next to the drive way so was somewhat noisy. Not close to Hamilton CBD.. plus was that it was cheap.
hotel_response: Thank you for your comments - I have checked with housekeeping over the use of chemicals in the rooms and the only product we use outside of the Hotels preferred supplier range is exit mould, which we use on a regular basis in the bathroom area. We would have offered an alternative room if requested and I apologise for what seems to have been an over use of cleaning product. It is disappointing that this seemed to ruin an otherwise pleasent stay.

title: Good value for money
text: Stayed overnight with my husband and found the studio room to be very spacious in comparison to other motels we have stayed in.  Service was very good, room was clean and the price for the room included 2 x cooked breakfasts, which was EXCELLENT value for money!  Will stay here again.
hotel_response: Thank you for the kind comments and we look forward to accommodaing you again. Special rates do become available on a regular basis and I think some of the Bed and Full Breakfast rates are very good value for money

title: Nice hotel
text: I think this is a nice hotel in Hamilton, though it may think it is more posh than it actually is.  The front desk area is impressive, and I checked in relatively quickly.  The room was nice and clean, and very spacious.  The internet is not free, and is rather expensive.  Otherwise, I have no complains about the room.  There is a restaurant at the hotel, though I decided not to eat there due to price.

title: Excellent
text: Good service and the bed was comfortable. The customer service was friendly. Heaps of free carparks. Shower pressure was good. Will recommend it to a friend

title: Tired, soooo tired of 80's flashbacks.
text: The suburban location is handy to parks, the pool & TeRapa, but not the CBD. Checkin friendly & reasonably efficient, but once past the entrance area, there is dated decor pretty much everywhere! Nice indoor pool, not too large but rarely shared...rooms are reasonably sized but dated & in places showing serious signs of ageing. Unfortunately, on the two occasions I have stayed here, neither room had been cleaned properly - with toiletry item wrappers needing put away & vacuuming not having been done since previous occupant had been in there. Also, one bed had suffered structural failure, thus resembling a banana more than a bed. A bit musty too... however, the hotel is undergoing complete recarpeting & some maintenance TLC, so things might get better.
hotel_response: Thank you for your comments. The hotel has now completed re-carpeting through all public area's, conference area's and all bedrooms. Over the period from December 2010 to May 2011 all bedrooms have had new carpet, new boxed bedspreads, new chairs in the room and new darker curtains which block out the light far better than the previous ones.. Currently on order are new restaurant chairs for our breakfast restaurant.  Your comments regarding the bed is appreciated as in many cases of maintenance issues we are not aware of the actual issue until informed by the guests.

title: Pleasant hotel a long way from Hamilton CBD
text:
A large conference type hotel some way from Hamilton CBD. Rooms are in annexes adjacent to the main building. Rooms are large and purposeful, nice bathroom. 

Reception area is huge as are the rest of the public areas in the main building, rather “cold” with no atmosphere. Breakfast adequate.

title: Good value for money!
text:
We have just spent a very pleasant weekend at the Kingsgate in Hamilton, and were impressed by the refurbishment that is taking place.  The room we stayed in had new curtains and carpets and this gave the room a fresh lift.  The staff were very friendly and helpful in the restaurant/bar and especially the reception.
 
We recommend this hotel for a weekend getaway.

title: I enjoyed the 80's but Kingsgate is stuck in a time warp
text:
Yes this place is in desperate need of a revamp but a good clean would go a long way as well.  2 days and the entrance way to wings never got touched just dirtier and dirtier.  
Where do we start, the scum in the shower, the dirt on the vanity, the expired chocolate in the mini bar, the ripped bath mat, tatty towels, noisy extraction, toilet roll just put on holder without starting the roll...this all seems to point to a hotel on its last legs, which is a shame for such a major hotel chain.  
We can say the majority of the staff were great, after our fawlty towers experience in the restaurant the manager on duty dealt with us in a professional manner.
We got the accomodation and food/beverage deal, and we still had credit left come our second night and there was no way that we were going to eat dinner there again.  So we decided to use it for breakfast....should have just left the credit untouched.  
We cannot honestly write everything that this hotel has not got going for it as we could full a notebook. 
Yes we filled in the comment card...oh that is right the comment card covered in coffee stains (yes was already stained well and truely when we arrived).

title: Dissapointing, Staff great, cleanliness poor
text: Stayed 2 nights. When we checked our room out it had mouldy grouting and silicone in the shower and the sheets on one bed didnt look like they had been changed. Staff very good about giving us another room, the beds a lot better but the shower was just as bad, mouldy grouting etc. The pillows on the bed flat as pancakes, clean but had seen better days. Very tired hotel, we can cope with old but cleanliness should be seen to. They are redoing the carpets but how about the bathrooms??? and some new pillows, they are cheap to replace. We had read similar reviews from April last year and thought the hotel management would have seen to the problems. Once again, staff good

title: Pretty ordinary
text: I stayed here with my partner who has to use this chain of hotels when he's working. The room was large with a queen sized bed and two singles, but it would have felt way too small if we'd had enough people to fill all the beds. There were little niggles about it - hairs left in the bathroom, no body moisturiser provided (usually it is so I hadn't packed any) and the breakfast was sent up with no milk for the cereal (luckily we had brought our own). I think this chain gets enough business from companies and tour groups so they don't really need to try. I'm sure there's a lot better out there!

title: A Pleasant Surprise.
text: We stayed here on a special deat for Fathers Day for only $45.00, so we were not expecting very much at all. The room was really large with two queen sized beds and tons of room for us to set up our infants port-a-cot! Yes, it is a little dated, but what do you expect, it is not a high priced hotel and it suited us fine for the one night stay. The room was tidy and clean and the bed was quite comfortable. The main pool was too cool for us and we were told by another guest that it was too deep for our little one, but that didn't matter as we went in the spa instead which was absolutely fabulous. We ordered Room Service dinner, which wasn't flash, but it was nice and the service was quite quick. We found all the staff to be lovely, smiley and very helpful!! We would definatley stay here again.

title: good value
text:
My friend and I stayed in Feb. The rooms are dated, but I felt the pool and Spa made up for this.
The breakfast was great...Real good value.
Going again in August.

The room was big and the bathroom seemed a bit more modern.  The info guide in the room was very basic and didn't really tell you anything about Hamilton - there was no hamilton map provided ??

title: Great value hotel accomodation for 5 of us
text:
We chose to stay in Hamilton instead of Auckland on our first day of our NZ holiday. I have problem finding a good accomodation in Auckland for 5 of us and chance upon Kingsgate Hotel in Hamilton.

The hotel is easy to find in the town. It has 3 wings of hotel room, which we were put in the oldest wing, probably due to the size of room we requested. The hotel seems to have many rooms but very few guests. My guess is this hotel caters mainly for business conferences. We were in luck no business conference were held during our 1 night stay.

The room has 2 queen beds and 1 single bed, very roomy compared to a standard double bed room. the furnishings were not exactly new looking but acceptable. The hotel is situated off the road so it is quiet.

For $99 per night for 5 of us, it comes with breakfast for 2. This is the best value accomodation for our 12 days holiday in NZ.

title: Only if you have too!
text: I was here with a conference group, and there would be no way I would choose to stay here.  I understand they have good deals, but I'm yet to see any advertised.  The place is old and dated.  The rooms are huge, so might be suitable for a family instead of a motel if you get a good rate.   The complex is large and if you are with older people make sure you get a downstairs room, as there are no lifts.   The location is miles away from any thing decent.  If your a tourist to New Zealand don't even think about selecting this hotel as you will be very disappointed, it won't enhance you stay.

title: We have had 2 return trips here since my last review -The 500 block is WAY bette
text:
We have been fortunate enough to have 2 more return trips to the Kingsgate Hotel in Hamilton since my last review . 

The Hotel had some more great deals which we could not resist but take advantage of ! 

Our party consisted of my husband and I and our 9 year old son. We checked in before the 2.00pm check in time both times and our rooms were ready . We were put into the 500 wing this time and it was way better than the room we were put into on our first experience. The rooms in the 500 block are less tired and are cleaner and they seem to be newer although I am not sure if they would be, maybe they looked newer because the condition of the rooms were way better than the last block we were in . 

Our rooms were nice and clean, the bathroom had tiles right to the ceiling theshower was much cleaner in these blocks. There was no peeling paint like the room we were put into last time. 

On our visit my in laws came along as well and their room was opposite ours, in the 500 block as well and their room was in lovely condition too .

 I now ask to be put into the 500 block knowing the difference in room quality. 

We used the laundry . The Hotel has 2 guest laundries and one is in the 100 wing and one is in the 500 wing so It was really good for us as the laundry was just down the hall from us .

We went swimming and the pool is really clean and the spa pools are too, the changing rooms are also well cleaned and the staff were once again really friendly. 

My husband and our son used the computers in the lobby and they cost $2.00 for 15 minutes. 

When we had a drink at the bar, well they had run out of straws which we thought was quite funny for a bar to do ! 

The groundswere kept lovely there and I had to fill in a maintenance form as one of the lights in our room had blown, this was fixed the day I put the request in which was really good. 

Our wake up calls came on time and when we checked out it was all correct each time we stayed. 

I would definatly recommend staying here but  I reccommend to ask to be put into the 500 block for sure.

title: Tired looking
text:
The Kingsgate was the hotel used for a conference that I attended.
Check in was smooth going and easy.  Parking was plentiful and free.  The hotel is low rise accommodation with the main entrance to each block off the carpark.  There are steps up to this door.  Which meant lugging your suitcases up them (I did not see any ramps).  The front door is locked - you have a key for access.  This is good security.  There are two storeys but no lift.  So more lugging of suitcases up stairs.  
The rooms are a good size, but the decor is very dated and tired looking.  The soft chairs in the room are worn out, you feel like your going to hit the ground when you sit down.  The beds are hard (way past firm).  It was like sleeping on a wooden slab, pressure points became an issue.  Broken sleep was a regular occurrence.  The pillows were not much better very hard.  The duvet on the bed was thin and there was no blanket so as a result I woke up freezing on the first night.  Slept with the heater on every night after that.  The heater was constantly turning on probably because it was placed beside the window.  
The cleanliness of the rooms was okay.  But the hallways were dirty, the carpet along the edges was thick with dust. I was there 5 days and they were never vaccumed. 
The restaurant continental breakfast was the usual you find everywhere.  The padded chairs at the tables were worn out as well, you could feel the wooden bar along the back of your knees.
A group of us went to have bar meals, some of the orders came out.  Then after about 20 mins some of the group were informed that they had run out of food!  They knew they had a big group in for the weekend surely they would have stocked up for it.  I can recommend the bar meals when they are available though.
My summing up of this establishment is that you will find better elsewhere if you want to be comfortable and warm.  Lets hope that the powers to be in this chain spend some money on the Kingsgate by gutting the whole place and starting again.

This place does not quite get there however, compared to others we have stayed in when visiting Hamilton.  At around $110 per night it is reasonably good value though and adequate for a night or two, if you are looking for a reasonably good budget motel, this will be OK for you. title: An awesome stay
text:
Searching on the web for accommodation in the Hamilton area we came across the Huntington Stables Retreat in Cambridge and booked ourselves in. And what a pleasant stay it was. No; that doesn’t do it justice. It was an awesome stay.
Robyn welcomed us in person on arrival and brought us to our accommodation, a well-appointed unit with all required comforts and fully-equipped kitchen. Strikingly designed crockery is a feature. The stock of breakfast provisions (and very generous they were, too) was pointed out, as were the compost and recyclable bins (Robyn and Andy are clearly conscientious in this regard). A shelf of books was there with an exchange option; a TV and a sound system were tucked away in cupboards. The requested roll-away bed had been set up (there were three of us in our party); towels and wraparounds were available for those using the pool, spa or sauna – amenities much valued after a tiring day.
From the deck, views of gentle open countryside are there to enjoy; the surrounding gardens and their myriad nooks and corners make for interesting places to sit and take time out – and take in the presence of abundant bird life that makes the Retreat their home. And for those interested in wildlife, ask Robyn to show you the aviary, housing a variety of birds, some rescued and awaiting a new home.
I would highly recommend the Huntington Stables Retreat as a place to stay. We have delightful memories of our weekend there.
John Hunt

title: Wow, Wow, Wow
text:
As is obvious from my title, I loved this place! I am quite a fussy traveler so am rarely as satisfied as I was with our two nights at Huntington Stables. There were the things I always expect but rarely get such as hooks, tissues and adequate storage in the bathroom, good clothing and luggage storage, plenty of good hangers, adequate bedroom side tables with good lighting and plenty of good pillows. Not expected but so appreciated were things like really nice soap, toiletries in case you forgot something, DVD's, games, books, magazines, the kitchen stocked with everything you might want, and all of good quality. A fridge and pantry fully stocked for a really great continental breakfast plus extra drinks and snacks available. There was even a special lap pad for my iPad - so useful and something I didn't even know existed much less expected to find in a hotel room!

And that's just the room. The grounds are beautiful and are in process of becoming even more so. There is a bird aviary and a beautiful swimming pool. And although we picked The Loft partly for the advertised views, the whole property has lovely pastoral views of the countryside. I could go on and on but suffice to say, we will be back. title: Simply perfect
text:
My husband and I just needed a couple of relaxing nights away after a difficult few months of health issues, and I'm delighted we found this place. We stayed in the smallest accommodation option, The Stall, which is a charming little gem but with plenty of space for your luggage and clothing, a kitchenette area, a beautiful tiled bathroom with a spacious shower, and a private balcony overlooking the valley. The whole space was absolutely clean as a pin, super comfortable, and providing everything we could have needed, including dressing gowns, spa towels, extra blankets and pillows, numerous tea and coffee options, toiletries...  I should also mention that the bed was amazing. The mattress was supportive, so there was no partner disturbance at all, but with a pillow-soft top layer you could snuggle into for pure comfort. Best bed we've had in a hotel. Ever.
The breakfast was, I believe, a bit simpler than that provided in the larger accommodations, but it suited us perfectly, with three different cereal options, tinned fruit, delicious 'The Collective' yoghurts, orange juice and fresh milk. All these were replenished daily into refillable containers, which we loved as an eco-friendly way of doing things. 
The property overall is lovely, with lots of pretty garden areas to relax or wander in. And the owners are currently putting in even more plantings and seating areas, all with those gorgeous rural valley views. The pool area is superb too, and would be amazing for larger family groups, with lots of seating areas around it, but the highlight for us was the big spa pool. Both nights we sat in there for ages, luxuriating in the heat and bubbles and massage jets, looking up at the stars. 
The whole place, inside and out, is beautifully cared for and presented, and offers a truly peaceful, restorative retreat - and although it's rural, it's a quick drive to town, restaurants, the Te Koutou lake (gorgeous!) and Maungakawa Scenic Reserve. We recommend it highly.

The bed was new when you stayed and we're so relieved that we bought it (we've had brilliant feedback about it ever since).  Thanks again, see you soon, warmest regards, Robyn

hotel_response: Sorry to hear you weren't happy with the room you booked.   As clearly advertised this room is a basic guest-room, intended for those guests simply needing a bed & shower for the evening. We supply provisions for a light continental breakfast - which is completely complimentary!  These complimentary provisions include x6 boxes of assorted cereal, a tin of fruit, a litre of juice, a litre of milk, a tub of yoghurt, a bottle of fresh water, a small dish of chocolate dipped cream-cheese filled apricots, & a duo of designer biscuits. This basic guest-room also has free unlimited wifi, & full use of the spa, sauna & pool.  I showed you through your room, pointed out the information folder, the Smart TV for you to attach any device you might have, towels for the spa, sauna & swimming pool, the colouring book & pencils, the laptop/kindle cushion, magazines, & the complimentary breakfast provisions. I asked you if you were interested in using the pool area & if there was anything at all that you needed. Your response went from total disinterest in the room to blatant rudeness - asking me if "that is it for breakfast? Just one tub of yoghurt?" I explained very calmly that the provisions were complimentary, that it should be more than enough for two people, but if you would like another tub of yoghurt I would bring another to you immediately. I also offered to bring you toast in the morning. Your wife said the extra food was not required.  In regards to your other criticisms, we are not "in the middle of nowhere" - we are 5 mins drive from the centre of town - I'm sorry that you went the long way to get here. The coffee in this basic guest-room is Moccona - & yes it is instant coffee. There was also a full container of Jarrah coffee - sitting beside the selection of black tea, green tea, lemon tea & the drinking chocolate - located behind the bowl of fresh fruit we gave you. If you had wanted full breakfast provisions, plunger coffee & beans, air conditioning, & all the other things you felt were missing in the room you booked, you would have found them in any of our other rooms - at a lot more than the $155 you paid for The Stall ($135 if you had booked directly).

title: Perfect overnight stay
text: We stayed one night in 'The Stall' on our way back to Auckland for a flight home. Perfect overnight stay. The room was exactly as described (plus lots of unexpected extras - treats, breakfast items, lavender bath products, even the kettle had been filled by our thoughtful host!). Room spotless, bed very comfy, lovely bathroom that was much larger than expected. Setting is gorgeous (a very short drive out of town and very peaceful). Robyn could not have been more helpful with dinner suggestions etc. Would come back to Cambridge just to stay here again.
hotel_response: Many thanks for leaving such a lovely review of The Stall.  We are so glad the room met expectations and that you enjoyed your stay here.  We hope you will return in the near future (perhaps treat yourselves to a night or two in one of the luxury stables)!  Warmest regards to you both - Robyn, Andy and Eden.

title: Lovely place in Cambridge
text:
This was a lovely little retreat in the small town of Cambridge.  We were a little taken back by the information we read on booking.com as it stated all units had tvs etc, yet ours, the Stall did not. This however wasn't all that bad, as it did provide a get away from it all, and did encourage us to get out and do more in Hamilton and Cambridge.

The room itself, small but plenty of space for the 2 of us, was comfortable and had a nice little shower room and fridge. We did however think the art for sale on the walls made it feel a little less special, a tiny bit like staying in an art gallery.  Not a big deal, just a little disappointing to see prices on the bedroom wall.

Location was great, owners were lovely and the room was comfortable....all in all I'd book again
hotel_response: Many thanks for taking the time to leave a review.  We advertise clearly on all sites that The Stall is a basic guest-room, does not have a television, & that the room is intended for those guests simply needing a bed & shower for the night.  Most of our guests have welcomed not having a television as it means they must find other activities to keep them amused - having a sauna or spa, playing Petanque or Badminton, having a wine down in the gardens, going for a walk, catch up on reading, talking, colouring in the book provided, or walking around the lake & reserve which are four minutes drive either way.  However, as this detail about the television is often missed upon booking, we will add one to the room.  I'm sorry you did not like the art on the wall.  As it states in the information folder, we support local businesses & artists where we can.  When guests purchase the prints the money goes straight to the artist, & what better place for her work to be seen but on the wall.  Many guests have bought a print to give as a gift, or keep as a momento of their time in Cambridge.  I'm glad you enjoyed your time here & hope the rest of your honeymoon in NZ is wonderful!

title: Friendly and comfortable stay
text: Beautiful setting and very friendly host.  Unfortunately we weren't staying long or able to spend much time at the accommodation so the Stall room was great for us.  It's a very comfortable room with everything you need for a comfortable stay including quality toiletries, tea and coffee making supplies, OJ & treats.  Plenty of glasses and a fridge allow for easy refreshments while you enjoy the views.  It's a few minutes drive to the town of Cambridge and well situated for travel to Hamilton.  A nice change from a boring and sterile hotel or motel room it has some home comforts and a human touch.  Would love to stay again if we visit again.
hotel_response: We truly appreciate this lovely review & are so glad to hear you enjoyed your stay in The Stall.  We hope you will come back this way again - many thanks again - Robyn & Andy.

title: A lovely stay in Cambridge!
text: After reading wonderful reviews of Huntington Stables, we booked the North Stable room for three nights in early June. We were traveling to the area for a wedding and some sightseeing, so we wanted a location that was centrally located. Our host, Robyn, was ready to greet us when we arrived. We were shown to our room, spacious spotlessly clean, and lovely, with a ful kitchen stocked with eggs from her hens, bacon, and all the trimmings for a delicious breakfast. A large sitting room had a bookshelf full of interesting titles, and a shelf of DVDs movies, with a list of others available for loan. Robyn showed us how to operate the heater, stove, and where all needed items were located. She lives in the house next door, so she was close if we needed anything. We loved the gorgeous claw foot bathtub and spacious shower with plenty of hot water! Our bed was comfortable and warm with just the right number of blankets for a perfect night's sleep. Our room was within a 30 minute drive from Hobbiton and Hamilton, easy to find, and located in a beautiful area. Robyn made sure we had fresh provisions daily, and was a great source for additional information and insights about the places we were visiting! We highly recommend a stay here!
hotel_response:
Thank you so much for this wonderful review.  We are so glad to hear that you enjoyed your stay.  The North Stable is a beautiful room & is definitely my favourite!
See you again - Robyn

title: My Favorite Place in New Zealand
text: We spent two weeks in New Zealand and it was all wonderful, but Hunting Stables Retreat was my FAVORITE place we stayed! The owner met us as we pulled onto the property. She had opened all the doors and windows of our suite to the fresh air and had French jazz playing on the sound system to greet us. The room was beautiful and had a wonderful balcony with a lovely view. The bathroom included the most fragrant locally-made lavender soaps and lotions. Breakfast ingredients were provided for us in our kitchen including bacon, fresh eggs from the owner's chickens, tomatoes and lemons grown on the property and the most delicious homemade lemon curd. The only disappointment we experienced was that our schedule only allowed us to stay one night. Stay several if you can. You won't regret it. I dream of going back someday.
hotel_response: Oh my gosh - thank you so much for this wonderful review of your stay here.  Hopefully you can come back this way again & stay a little longer.  Warmest wishes to you both - Robyn, Andy & Eden

title: Amazing place, great owners
text: We stayed for 2 days on our honeymoon and had a wonderful time. The grounds and rooms are absolutely beautiful and the owners could not be more accommodating. They drove us into town, made homemade snacks, let us hang with their dog, etc. If you are traveling in the area, I highly recommend staying here - we'd go back in a heartbeat!
hotel_response:
Thank you for leaving such a lovely review & for choosing Huntington Stables Retreat Accommodation as part of your honeymoon holiday.  We are so glad you enjoyed your stay & that Wally (the collie) added to the experience!  
All the best to you both - Robyn & Wally

title: Excellent Accomodation

Little thoughtful extras also left in the room. If in the Cambridge area a definite place to stay especially if you like a rural retreat. Kim and Anne (UK)

We are so glad to hear you enjoyed your stay in The Loft.
Many thanks to both of you -  Robyn & Andy

title: Huntington Stables. Excellent, Exquisite and Exceptional

hotel_response: We truly appreciate your time in leaving a lovely review, & for choosing Huntington Stables Retreat Accommodation.  All the best to you - Robyn

title: Nice location but lacked the B&B feel
text: We stayed at the loft which was nice overlooking lovely scenery. Good room space and gd location to Cambridge town for dinner, and about 30 min to Hobbiton. Self catering breakfast in the room was alright. But what we found missing was the interaction with the hosts and that homely feeling. We were shown to our room with some options for dinner, but that was pretty much it. Perhaps this was an outlier and it was our expectations of what a B&B should be like compared to other places we've stayed in NZ and elsewhere.
hotel_response: (At the time this review & response was written our accommodation was listed as 'Specialty Lodging'.  This has since changed & is now listed under Bed & Breakfast.  The following is the original response).  While I appreciate you taking the time to leave a review, I am somewhat disappointed you have commented on the "lack of B & B feel". Huntington Stables is not a Bed & Breakfast, and it is not advertised as one. If you have a look online, on our website, and on Trip Advisor, you will see this is listed as Specialty Lodging. As clearly advertised, it is self-catering with continental breakfast provisions supplied in your room for you to prepare at your leisure. Regarding "interacting with the hosts", I showed you to your room myself when you arrived and went through The Loft carefully showing you where everything was. I asked you if you had any questions and what you were going to do for dinner before offering to book a restaurant for you. I also said that if you needed anything at all, you only need come over to the house a few metres away. As this is retreat-style accommodation, we give our guests as much privacy as possible. If guests choose to interact with us we are all too happy to do so - and have done so many, many times. But that call must be by guests otherwise we could be viewed as being nosey, intrusive, indiscreet, or inconsiderate. We have an excellent reputation as warm and generous hosts, so to receive a low rating and a review that states you were disappointed, is a hell of a blow to us. We apologize sincerely for not meeting your expectations but suggest that you read the description carefully to avoid future disappointment. Thank you again for choosing to stay at Huntington Stables Retreat Accommodation, Cambridge. Warmest regards, Robyn

title: Quiet, pleasant retreat
text: This is a place we really wanted to spend more time. Beautiful self-catering apartment with all the stock and amenities you could want or ask for of you need more. The hosts even drove us into town for dinner and did a return pick up so we could have wine with dinner. We will definitely return.

title: Highly highly recommended!!
text:

Beautiful rooms, beautiful views, very peaceful and quiet! You wake up to birds chirping and gorgeous rolling vistas. Very little traffic noise during day and none at night. Very comfy beds and room-darkening blinds so our sleeps were excellent.
The gracious hosts went way above and beyond to make our stay perfect! We had forgotten one of our bags at a car rental place in Auckland and they arranged to have it shipped overnight so we didn't have to worry about a thing!

hotel_response: Thank you so much for taking the time to leave such a wonderful review of your stay here.  We wish you both the very best - Robyn & Andy

title: Stunning retreat with 5 star service
text:
Last year we stayed for 1 night, and liked it so much we came back this year for 2. It is the perfect place to arrive at after a frenetic drive from Auckland airport along the SH1.
The accommodation.is beautifully furnished. There is a large sitting area with a flat screen TV and DVD player opening out onto a verandah with views over the garden and countryside, with a large table for Al fresco eats/drinks-a wonderful place to sample the delicious cold platter and wine provided.
The kitchen area is well equipped, and the breakfast provisions generous and fresh; we also enjoyed the chocolate covered apricots as a treat!
The bedroom has a king-sized bed with crisp white linen, and ample storage place for clothes; the thick and fluffy robes and slippers were also much appreciated. The spacious modern bathroom has a free-standing bath and a shower enclosure, and a good range of toiletries.
Outside is a lovely.area with a swimming pool and hot tub and comfortable seating for further relaxation.
What really makes this place special, however, is the care and attention of Robyn(and her daughter Eden-a dab hand with TV controls!). She cannot do enough to make your stay perfect; she provided us with some freshly-cooked bread and butter pudding on our second night, and posted on trousers I had inadvertently left in the wardrobe.
It is definitely one of our favourite places to stay on our Australia/New Zealand trips.
hotel_response: What an excellent review - thank you so much for this (I'll make sure Eden reads this as well).  We're glad you enjoyed the apricots & pudding - I'll make you Sticky Date Pudding next time!  See you again - Robyn, Andy & Eden x

Robyn, the host, is very nice and helpful (and her homemade muesli is fantastic!).  She made us feel very comfortable.  I would certainly recommend this place if you are staying near the Cambridge area or just need a getaway retreat in the countryside.

hotel_response: Thank you so much for taking the time to write a review - we truly appreciate it.  Andy, Eden & I are glad you enjoyed your stay & hope to see you back here in the future.  Warmest wishes to you both.

title: A great place top stay
text:

Everything about our stay was excellent.

hotel_response: We are very glad you enjoyed your stay & hope you will stop here again at Huntington Stables on your next holiday!  If you want to make the muesli & apricots for yourselves (or impress your friends) - the recipes for both are on our website (on the Sundry page).  Many thanks again x

title: Expectations Exceeded
text:
This hotel is just superb. The accommodation is clean, comfortable and well appointed, the views are fantastic and the hosts just can't do enough for you.
We will definitely use this hotel again when we return to Cambridge.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to leave such a positive review - we truly appreciate it!  We're so glad you enjoyed your stay here - warmest wishes to you both x

title: wedding anniversary
text: Stayed here to celebrate our wedding anniversary. Platter and bottle of wine on arrival. Ingrediants provided both mornings for a full cooked breakfast as well as muesli and fruit for continental breakfast. Pool was great for a cool off after a day cycling and spa a welcome sight after a long drive down.  Everything you could ask for, perfect!
hotel_response: Thank you for choosing to stay at Huntington Stables for your anniversary.  We're glad you enjoyed the facilities and hope to see you again in the near future.  All the very best to you both - Robyn, Andy & Eden.

title: Tranquility
text:
Great decor with wonderful attention to detail & every thing you could possibly want.  Tranquil setting makes it easy to relax and rest. We loved the surprise treats - biscuits, chocolate apricots!  Breakfast supplies were extremely generous and the wine especially appreciated after a heavy day touring.
Robyn was very helpful and accommodating.  I made some mistakes with our arrangements & Robyn was extremely kind in rectifying the situation to ensure we had a stress free stay.
Just far enough out of Cambridge to be in the country but close enought if you want some of the restaurants or shops.  Easy comfortable drive to Hobbiton & Glow Worm Caves.
hotel_response: We're glad to hear you both enjoyed your stay.  I'd like to thank you for the wonderful chats we had - you both have led very interesting lives!  Hope you'll come back this way again.  Warm wishes to you both x

title: Thoughtfully appointed rooms - beautiful surroundings.
text: My partner and I stayed in The Loft for 2 nights, which was the standalone guest house. We absolutely loved how many small details had been considered when setting up this room. There was delicious home-made muesli, chocolate covered apricots in the fridge, candles throughout the room for our use and many more thoughtful details that made the loft feel so comfortable and inviting. Although if you're tall like my partner and I, perhaps select one of the other guest rooms, as we did bang our heads a few times on the slanted ceilings (they would have switched us over but were fully booked while we were staying). I would highly recommend staying at Huntington Stables for a relaxing getaway.
hotel_response: Many thanks for choosing Huntington Stables and happy to hear you enjoyed the little treats in your room.  Good luck with future cycling events!

title: lovely well equiped accommodation
text: we stayed for 2 nights in the loft. the weather was beautiful and the loft had everything that you could want from the delicious home-made muesli to the lovely range of toiletries.   the pool and spa were both superb.   many thanks to Robyn, a most hospitable hostess.
hotel_response: Happy to hear you enjoyed your stay in The Loft.  The muesli recipe is on our website if you'd like to make this at home!  Best wishes to you both x

title: Excellent accommodation with wonderful views
text:
The accommodation was superb-a comfortable lounge area leading out on to a terrace with table and chairs overlooking the garden and distant hills. The bedroom was spacious and comfortable, with a superb ensuite bathroom with a wide range of toiletries.  The kitchen area was the highlight -very well-equipped and full of treats; chocolate-covered apricots, chocolate crispies, iced biscuits, as well as a full range of teas and coffees.
Robyn provides a pre-dinner platter of cold meats, cheese, dips, crudités  and biscuits which was absolutely delicious.
There was also a swimming pool and jacuzzi, but unfortunately the rainy weather prevented our using them.
It fully deserves its 5 star rating.
hotel_response: Thank you for choosing to stay in one of our luxury stables and very glad that you enjoyed all the extras that come with that package.  We appreciate the lovely feedback x

title: Wonderfully relaxing stay
text: We only stayed for one night but came very close to booking another as the accommodation was so fantastic and the hosts so friendly and generous. One of the comfiest beds ever, and the complimentary food and wine (plus the wonderful offer by the hosts to pick up food from town for us) mean that we didn't have to leave the property and could just enjoy the time we had there. A real treat of a place to stay.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to leave a review - we truly appreciate it.  Glad to hear you had a comfortable sleep in one of our beautiful beds.  Hopefully you can stay two nights next time!

title: The Loft: a self-contained cocoon
text:
Just had overnight in the Loft before my international flight the next day and definitely hope to return to try out the Stables with my husband. The view from the loft balcony of the Maungakawa Reserve and mountains is wonderfully peaceful and reflective.

Echo all the rave reviews from past guests. The design and thought behind all the small touches you find in this beautiful self-contained apartment show the hosts clearly understand the nature of the hospitality business for travellers - bathroom lotions, bathrobes, generous portions of complimentary drinks in mini-fridge, more than sufficient breakfast provisions, DVDs, books, etc.

Met Wally the family pet but was not able to try out pool and spa area. Wasn't feeling all that well and Robyn was quick to help with hints and OTC medications. Definitely only a few minutes drive from Cambridge town, yet you really feel far away from the stress of modern life. A definite upgrade to the motels located in the town of Cambridge and on par with other luxury B&Bs without any pretensions.
hotel_response: What a lovely review - thank you x  Sorry you weren't feeling very well and weren't able to use the facilities.   It's a great excuse to come back again though!

title: Great stay at Huntington Stables
text:

We really felt like part of the family and enjoyed our stay  very much!!
hotel_response: Many thanks for the lovely review of your stay here.  We're glad you were comfortable in The Loft and we hope you will stay here again when you next visit NZ - (perhaps treat yourselves to one of our luxury lodges).  Warmest regards to both of you - Robyn, Andy and Eden.

title: Absolutely Fabulous!
text:

I would highly recommend staying at Huntington Stables and I hope to spend some time there again next year.  Liz C., Cirencester, UK

We're glad you enjoyed the muesli and if you need the recipe to make the muesli yourself (it's really quite easy), you will find a print-out version on the Sundry page of our website.  Many thanks again - Robyn, Andy and Eden.

title: Bliss
text: We recently stayed here for 3 nights and it was wonderful. The room is so well appointed and guests are treated with wine and antipasto on arrival. hotel_response: Many thanks for the wonderful review.  We are so glad you enjoyed your stay and utilised the facilities.  I hope we will see you here again in the near future.  Warmest regards, Robyn, Andy and Eden.

title: Lovely place to stay
text: We recently stayed two nights at Huntington Stables.  The Stables are very well appointed and comfortable, in a peaceful location with a relaxing view.  We were very pleased to find such a comfortable place to stay, and where our small dog was also welcome. We would love to return one day.
hotel_response: Many thanks for the lovely review.  We're glad you enjoyed your stay and that your little dog was able to accompany you.  I hope you will stay again in the future - warmest regards, Robyn, Andy and Eden

title: Wonderful New Year trip
text:
We had 5 nights in the South Stable and also booked the Stall for our adult daughter to have some comfort and privacy.
