hotel_response: Many thanks for taking the time to leave such a lovely review.  The Stall works very well as an extra room when staying in one of the Stables.  We're glad that you were all comfortable having your own space, but also able to hang out together in the luxury lodge. We look forward to seeing you again - warmest regards, Robyn, Andy and Eden.

title: Sweet as
text:
My boyfriend and i stayed in the appartment loft for two nights, 
it was very cosy and comfortable. It was perfect having breakfast and dinner out on the little front deck with the beautiful view of hills and farmland. We made great use of the tv and dvd player for movie nights, and the pool was great to cool off on a hot day. Also the place wasn't too far from Hobbitton which was awesome!
Overall our stay was totaly worth it and we had a great time. Thanks.
hotel_response: Thank you for this lovely review of your stay in The Loft.  We are well placed as a base for lots of adventures including Hobbiton only 30 minutes drive door to door.  We're glad you enjoyed yourselves - warmest wishes, Robyn

title: Staying here was one of the best decisions we made!
text:
We booked the Loft at the Huntington Stables from the 20th through the 24th. Our iPhone GPS gave perfect directions and we had no trouble finding the place. We arrived a bit late and had to call Robyn a few times--she was really kind about it and we made an after-hours arrangement. The Loft was really charming, clean and well-apportioned, not to mention a great price. While 'm not sure why she did it, Robyn upgraded us to the South Stable--a considerable upgrade. The rooms were gorgeous and had everything we needed: great drink and wine selection; lovely clawfoot tub; fabulous shower; exquisite deck; great kitchen--everything was perfect. While we never found (shamefully) time for the sauna, pool or hot tub, they were at our fingertips and ours for the taking. My boyfriend got sick on the last three days of our trip and Robyn brought some amazing ginger wine over for him which I think helped. 

The location is great. Not only is it an easy drive to the Waitomo Glow Worm Caves, Matamata (Hobbiton), Pio Pio (more Hobbit and LotR filming locations), Rotorua and the Auckland airport, but Cambridge itself has a nice towne center with good restaurants and shopping, and is really close. 

The pastoral setting was peaceful and picturesque--and not only were we charmed by unbelievable birdsong, bleating sheep and cows, the night sky was breathtaking.

Truly, you can't go wrong staying at Huntington Stables. New Zealand is a wonderful place filled with beautiful, non-traditional places to stay, and this is definitely one of them. I'd choose it again in a heartbeat.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for this wonderful review - we truly appreciate it.  We're so glad you enjoyed the South Stable - it is a beautiful room, which hopefully helped a little with being bed-ridden.  We hope to see you again should you return to NZ.  Warmest regards to you both - Robyn, Andy and Eden.

title: Go on ... spoil yourself, you won't regret it!
text:
We booked at Huntington Stables with a view to indulging ourselves on our last night in NZ and we weren't disappointed.

We were expecting a relatively remote (farm-like) location, so we were a little surprised when we pulled into the driveway having barely left the centre of Cambridge! There are hints of suburbia, with a few homes in the near view, but the peace, serenity and spectacular landscapes are enough to transport you to a rural paradise, with the added benefit of convenience to the beautiful town of Cambridge.

Only 30 minutes from Hobbiton and less than 2 hours from Auckland airport, this was a perfect spot to spend our last night in NZ.

My wife and I stayed for one night in the South stable; a beautiful space with every amenity considered. We were pampered with a beautiful anti-pasto plate on arrival and we felt so relaxed and comfortable that we didn't want to leave! So many lovely and luxurious touches to the service provided my Robyn and her family, too numerous to list. Suffice to say that you will not want for anything.

Yes, it's a little pricey but you get what you pay for and we will certainly stay here again. As the title suggests ... spoil yourself, you're worth it!!
hotel_response: Many thanks for this excellent review!  We are so glad you enjoyed your stay in one of our luxury stables and that it finished off your time in NZ on a high note.  Warmest regards to you both - Robyn, Andy and Eden.

title: Top draw
text: My partner and I stayed in the North Stables the night of our wedding. Being a last minute guy I only booked the room the night before on an external booking website. The next morning Robyn the host called with bad news that the room was already booked and she wasn't sure how my booking was aloud to go through, and only one night was available. She offered to call around other places close by for me to see if we could get a two night stay elsewhere, and I said not to worry one night would do. She offered to charge the night at a discounted rate. However later in the day she contacted me to let me know that the other booking had fallen through as the others had missed there flight so we were able to stay the two nights, and my new wife and I are stoked we did. Very accommodating hosts, we arrived late on the first night and Robyn was there to great us and show us around. The room was very homely and relaxing, food offered in the rooms was so fresh and tasted delicious. My wife enjoyed all the lotions and rubs which were in the rooms and the exterior surrounds were beautiful. Had a very relaxing and beautiful time, highly recommended to other couples for a romantic getaway.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for the lovely review of your stay here.  We are so glad everything worked out and that you were able to enjoy the beautiful North Stable for longer.  Many thanks for choosing Huntington Stables for your wedding night, and hopefully you will return to celebrate an anniversary!  Warmest wishes to you both - Robyn, Andy and Eden.

title: Cosy Interior – Beautiful Garden Views – Attentive Host
text:
We stayed at “The Loft” for 4 nights and it was a memorable one for us.  Robyn has been a very warm host and her attention to details has impressed us.  She took very good care of us and is always ready to share travel tips with us.  

“The Loft” is tastefully designed and it is a cosy home away from home with beautiful garden views. Imagine having a hearty breakfast on the balcony, looking at the greens, breathing in fresh air..... what more can we ask for !  Sleep quality was great too with the electric blankets that came in handy.

Everything was well provided for within the apartment – from a good selection of DVDs / CDs, generously stocked up pantry to the finest details of face wipes, body lotion, eye shades, ear plugs and many more!  Continental breakfasts are included and we love the “Home Made Muesli” to bits !! Thanks Robyn for the yummy home-made treat and for sharing the recipe. Have to also mention that we were pampered by the hot showers and good quality toiletries that were provided.

Absolutely no regrets choosing “The Loft” as a “base” for our travels within the North Island.  The quality of this accommodation and hospitality has well exceeded our expectations.  It is definitely a perfect place to conclude the last leg of our holiday.  Once again, thanks Robyn for being such a wonderful host.

All the best, Gareth & Anna (Singapore)
hotel_response: Wow - such a wonderful review of your stay here - thank you so much for this!  We are so glad that you enjoyed The Loft and that it provided a great base for your adventures.  We hope you will stay again when you are next in the Waikato.  If you need the recipe for the muesli there is a print-out version on the Sundry page of our website.  Many thanks again for your generous review - we truly appreciate it.  Warmest regards to you both - Robyn, Andy and Eden.

title: A perfect end to our holiday: The Loft
text:
My partner and I just stayed at the Loft for two nights while visiting Cambridge. 

Absolutely lovely, it was quaint and cosy, well-decorated with a simple but lovely colour scheme, and had a number of personal touches that made it all the more cosier. An absolutely lovely view from the balcony out towards the rolling hills, and not far from Hobbiton, Hamilton or Cambridge, the Loft was a fantastic place to stay. 

Robyn has thought of everything, from a fully stocked pantry to robes to a stocked bathroom, we were not left for wanting. Guests at the lodge have access to the pool and spa, and though we didn't get a chance to use them due to the rain, we did get a chance to explore the gardens a bit when the sun was out. 

The loft is a great option if you're on a budget but would like the unique experience, though next time I hope we can stay at the stables as they look lovely in the photos.
hotel_response: Many thanks for the lovely review of your time here - and for choosing Huntington Stables.  Warmest regards, Robyn

title: The Loft
text:
Just stayed the one night in The Loft.
Owners were fantastic, nothing too much trouble.
Lots of special touches that made it an exceptional stay.
Nice and quite.
Perfect for a couples weekend.
Highly recommended.
hotel_response: Many thanks for this!  Glad to hear you enjoyed our cosy Loft.  Warmest regards, Robyn

title: Perfect for a romantic weekend
text: We stayed at Huntington Stables for three nights to celebrate our wedding anniversary. We stayed in "the loft" apartment. Lovely view from the balcony, comfy kingsize bed, huge bathtub, home made cookies and best of all a hot tub to relax in and watch the stars on a cold winter's night. I only wish we could have stayed longer.
hotel_response: Many thanks for the lovely review and for choosing to stay at Huntington Stables!  We hope you'll be able to make it back here soon.  Thanks again - Robyn

title: "A cut above"
text: We had a lovely 2 nights in "the loft" which is smaller & separate from the main, more up-market accommodations. The quaint sloping ceilings add a touch of cosiness and it's super quiet for sleeping. It's elevated with really nice rural views, and Robyn's thoughtful personal touches make it feel like "home away from home". Very private and all the comforts abound, complete with electric blankets for the cooler months, and great DVD selection. The Kitchenette covers all you would need, with a well stocked pantry. Just a few minutes drive into Cambridge. Highly recommend for anyone weary of the standard hotel/motel experience.
hotel_response: We're delighted to hear you enjoyed your stay in The Loft.  Many thanks for taking the time to write a lovely review - warmest regards, Robyn

title: Perfect!
text: We had the most amazing stay at Huntington Stables. The loft room is ideal for a few nights in Cambridge and Hamilton. All the comforts of home in a clean, pristine, cozy hotel overlooking gorgeous farm land. Robin and her husband are fantastic hosts - helpful and attentive. Our stay was just superb!
hotel_response: Cambridge is fortunate to have so many wonderful places for people to stay - we are so grateful you chose Huntington Stables!  See you again - Robyn x

title: We will be back!
text: We had a fantastic 2 nights staying in the Stables. Robyn was great and voluntarily upgraded us from the Loft to the Stables. We had the best sleep we've had for a while in is peaceful relaxing environment and we appreciated the attention to detail with all the little extras like candles and lavender. This is definitely a place to revisit for a break away from work and home.
hotel_response: Very happy to hear you enjoyed the South Stable - thank you so much for this lovely review.  Warmest regards, Robyn

title: Attention to Detail!
text: Huntington Stables is an ideal location for a ‘getaway’ or if you are doing business in and around Cambridge.  We stayed in the Loft Apartment for a week and it was ideal for two people.  The property is well-appointed, and the Loft has everything you require (it is the smallest unit and has a ‘kitchenette’, which was more than adequate).  It is Robyn’s little ‘extra’ touches that really make the difference at Huntington.  The ‘larder’ was well-stocked and replenished daily.  The weather was somewhat inclement while we were there, and to come home after dark and in the rain to lights on and the room all warmed-up was really appreciated.  The availability of a sauna, spa and swimming pool in a boutique property is an added treats.  Importantly though, it is Robyn’s attention to detail which really makes the difference – and is what makes the Stables a great place to stay.
hotel_response: Many thanks for this review, and for choosing Huntington Stables for your stay.  You were wonderful guests and we look forward to seeing you back here soon.  Warmest regards, Robyn

title: Boutique - Private - Pampered
text: Our family just had an amazing weekend at this extraordinarily well appointed property.  Boutique and luxurious in style we marvelled at the features offered.  Privacy, and a view to die for, free wi fi, pool and heated spa, (and sauna), petanque court...the list goes on.  We were spoiled by the amazing attention to detail in provision of the "little extras" which are often missing in higher priced establishments.  We took advantage of airport pick-up and drop-off which was agreeably priced, and at other times Robyn was only too happy to drop us into town for meals or necessities.  The continental/cooked breakfast options were impressive, especially the home made jams and fruit bowl.  Thank you so much Robyn for your service and friendliness - you made it a magical weekend for us, so memorable!  Can't wait to come back!
hotel_response: Thank you for this wonderful review - we're so happy to hear you enjoyed the room and your stay.  We look forward to seeing you back here again x

title: Perfect in every way!

When we arrived, Robyn had a bottle of wine waiting for us, the fridge stocked with all sorts of goodies, the heated floors turned on, and all of the candles on this wonderful candelabra lit! hotel_response: On behalf of Carole (the previous owner) thank you so much for taking the time to leave such a lovely review of your stay here.  Warmest regards, Robyn

title: It's the little extras......
text: We have just celebrated our 40th wedding anniversary at Huntingdon Stables. Well we like to go somewhere really different and get away from it all.  No big flash over priced lodges for us, but the accommodation was superb, home from home with everything provided.  We did not want to drive onto Cambridge for dinner so took our own simple meal, sat on the deck and indulged.  Wine, chocolates, fresh fruit was all provided along with very very substantial breakfast provisions.  There was a swimming pool, spa, barbecue for our use.  The gardens were lovely. hotel_response: Thank you. Its gratifying to know that the little things get noticed !. So glad you enjoyed your Wedding Anniversary. Come again any time.

title: Pure Bliss!!
text:
what a beautifull place to spend your time!! carole is so warm and welcoming!! it was wet and rainy but it was so accommodating.we were in the hot spa a few minutes after we arrived and it was just so relaxing.hubby even had a swim in the pool!! our welcome platter and wine was so thoughtfull and the breakfast provisions ample. we enjoyed our cooked breakfast on the deck and enjoyed the stunnig views.the north stable is very welcoming and the flowers,fruit and lovely toiletries were a real treat.the bed is very comfortable and good quality linen and robes were available.the whole place speaks of quality and thoughtfulness.thanks so much carole and neil.
we would love to come back and spend some more time.
hotel_response: High praise indeed. I'm blushing at your compliments, but thanks anyway. Pleasure to host such lovely people, welcome back anytime !.

title: Beautiful part of the world.
text: My husband and I stayed here for 2 nights.  We stayed in the North Stable and it was everything it said it was.  Absolutely gorgeous.  Bed was comfortable, views were beautiful, kitchen was well stocked.  Cambridge is a gorgeous town and its worthwhile to stroll through town.  Very close to HObbiton, Rotorua etc.  We got a discount, otherwise I would not have stayed it was rather expensive.  Our host was very friendly and helpful.
hotel_response: Thanks for your review. It was great that you enjoyed our Winter Break. Hope to see you again some time in the future.

title: Lovely, peaceful spot
text:
My husband and I stayed a night here in the loft with our 8 week old baby. We were greeted by Carole who was lovely and so accommodating. As we walked up the stairs to the loft we were then impressed by a stunning outlook of countryside. I couldn't wait to wake up in the morning and sit down in the sun with a coffee and the amazing continental breakfast that included yummy homemade muesli, and look out over the lush green grass and rolling hills.
The heater was already going when we arrived so we were nice and cosy. The loft was beautiful, clean and luxurious. Care was taken in so many areas to make us feel really treated - lots of plump pillows on the bed, amazing smelling shampoo, conditioner, and hand and body wash, heated towel rail, chocolates by the bed, CDs to listen to and of course the divine breakfast.
I would thoroughly recommend the Stables to anyone wanting a quiet, relaxing time away in superb, quality accommodation.
Thanks so much!
hotel_response: Thanks for those kind words. Glad you enjoyed your stay.

title: Luxury Plus !!!!
text: We had a wonderful stay, fabulous cottage, beautifully appointed and thoughtful touches, delicious welcome platter and wine. After a tiring day at the Field Days in Hamilton it was wonderful to come"home" to Huntington. Carole and Neil were extremely helpful and kind enough to rescue us when we got lost in the mist !! Exceptional service. We'll be back.
hotel_response:
Thanks Lisa,
It was lovely to meet you, sorry the fog set in at the end of your long journey. Glad we could be of help.
See you next time !

title: Wonderful Retreat
text: We really enjoyed our stay in the Apartment, tastefully furnished and a wonderful breakfast, only 5 minutes to Cambridge for dinner, and a lovely peaceful stay. Would definately stay again if we are in the area.  The host wasn't there but her sister came over and settled us in, which was lovely.
hotel_response: Thanks Margo for the kind words. So glad you enjoyed your stay, sorry we missed you, but glad Paula was around to  greet you. Look forward to meeting you some time in the future

title: Exceptional
text: Stayed in the Loft Apartment which was more than adequate for our needs.   Extra touches like bathrobes / bubble bath and luxurious linen seaedl the deal for me.    The spa and sauna was an awesome bonus after kayaking at night on Lake Karapiro.    The swimming pool would be devine in summer.     The continental breakfast supplied was terrific and enjoyed looking after the countryside vista.    Would definitely stay again when in the Cambridge area.
hotel_response: Glad you enjoyed yourselves. Sorry we couldn't have arranged better weather for you ! Better luck for the cycling next time

title: A real Retreat
text: A top option if you're looking to get away from it all. The tranquil rural setting is complimented by Carole's welcoming and super friendly service. We stayed in the loft which had a warm cosy feel, was tastefully decorated and very well appointed. The delicious continental breakfast, including home-made muesli, made a great start to the day !
hotel_response: So glad you enjoyed your time with us. Thanks for the kind words

title: Simply Excellent
text: Home away from home. We stayed in the loft which we loved.  Everything you need and feels like you are away from busy life but yet everything is as close as you want.  Cambridge only a short drive, internet (free), SKY to watch the tennis.  Homemade muesli and the jams and fruit were a very nice touch to an already great place.  The bed was VERY good and so were the pillows.  Thanks so much for sharing with us such a great place to stay.
hotel_response: Great to hear you enjoyed your stay with us. The Loft is quirky, but everyone seems to love it . Hope the tennis result was what you wanted!.Look forward to seeing  you again sometime.

title: Absolutely Stunning!
text: My partner and I stayed here for two nights and were blown away by the stunning setting. fantastic views surrounding the stables and the apartment was immaculate with everything you could possibly wish for.
hotel_response: It's great to hear our guests have enjoyed staying with us. Makes it all worthwhile!. Thank you.

title: Fabulous
text:
We both thoroughly enjoyed our stay at huntington stables, Carole was so welcoming and friendly from the minute we arrived and was very helpful. The attention to detail with everything from the antipasta and wine on arrival to the housekeeping throughout our stay was great. 
Fantastic location and gorgeous setting. Would recommend without a doubt to anyone visiting the cambridge area!
hotel_response: Thanks for your kind words. I am so glad you enjoyed your stay with us. It was lovely to meet you both and, I hope the rest of your trip was as enjoyable. Maybe see you again sometime ?.

title: Modern and comfortable
text:
We stayed in the north stable which is furthest from the main house where the owners live. The north and south stables overlook the swimming pool. It has a nice kitchen but no laundry facility. Fridge was stocked with milk, juice, bread, eggs, bacon and a meat/cheese platter. There was also coffee, teas and a bottle of wine all complimentary. Sitting room was open plan to the kitchen with doors opening out on to a balcony with a dining table. Bedroom was comfortable and bathroom was modern with a bath and a shower. It was all very comfortable, clean and modern. We could hear the people in the south stable snoring in the night, so the bedroom wall is a bit too thin.
Wifi was an issue as you could only get a signal standing by the main house, no reception in the stable.
Cambridge is a beautiful place to visit.
hotel_response: Thanks for your comments.Regarding the laundry, we dont have individual laundry facilities in the cottages but there is a laundry at the back of the house available for guest use with a washing machine and tumble drier. Sorry to hear about the Wireless Internet. Unfortunately we can only get a satellite connection and this can vary with weather conditions. There are certain spots in the North Stable where guests have used their Ipads etc successfully. I am surpirised to hear about the snoring, and sorry if you were inconvenienced. The Stables are actually built with double thickness gib to avoid just that !.Maybe I should pop some ear plugs in the bedside drawers just in case. Hope it wont deter you from visiting us again sometime.

title: worth every penny!!
text:
i booked this  luxurious accommodation for my daughters anniversary gift, Carol was so lovely to deal with she tried to help in every way. i pop in to see the place and it was amazing!! i knew that my daughter would love it! and they sure did! they couldn't believe the amazing setting the beautiful stylish modern furniture. when they arrived Carol had lit the candles and had wine fruit flowers and a platter ready for them.   
The pictures don't do this place justice! if you want a 5 star weekend this is the place hands down!! 
So glad i found this accommodation the best in the Waikato!
hotel_response:
It was an absolute delight to host your daughter and her husband on their Wedding Anniversary. So glad they enjoyed their stay. Thank you for your kind words.

Guests stayed in the South Stable.

title: Everything you could ever want...
text: Gorgeous and luxurious accommodation nestled in a picturesque location. Relaxing, enjoyable and absolutely spoilt! The breakfast provisions were more than generous and included an array of fresh, tempting fruit and Carole's exquisite home-made strawberry jam. The bed was heaven, the view was even more so. Close to some lovely day-trip locations - we recommend the Sculpture Garden, Mystery Creek Wines, and Palate restaurant in Hamilton. Thank you for an amazing start to our honeymoon!
hotel_response:
Sorry I didnt get to meet you. Glad you had such a good time, and that you went to Palate, ( our favourite restaurant ! ). All the best for your future married life together.

Guests stayed in the South Stable.

title: Serenity!
text: What a fantastic weekend my partner and I had. Carole was so welcoming and kind. She showed us around and gave us all the details we needed.This place is amazing for winter (I imagine it would be fantastic in summer too with the pool). The attention to detail is fantastic from the platter of cheeses and nibbles/ Wine on arrival to the service and extra towels we needed, (and the home-made chutney and jams!) The spa is a perfect temperature and great in the rain or on fine evenings. The underfloor heating kept us cosy warm the whole time and we had such a good nights sleep on the most comfiest bed. The breakfast provisions were exactly what we needed there was nothing missing on this whole trip. It's the most relaxed and happy that we felt in a long time. I didn't want to leave !
hotel_response:
So glad you enjoyed what was a pretty wet and wintery weekend. Thank you so much for the kind words.
These guests stayed in The South Stable

title: Wonderful weekend away
text:
A wonderful weekend! Restful, quiet, but plenty of fun things to do. So near (7 mins) yet far from lovely Cambridge.
The Loft was perfect, great facilities, and lots of extra little things that make a special stay (like the fabulous homemade muesli!).
Carole was so helpful, despite booking late, and always warm and friendly.
hotel_response: Glad you enjoyed our quirky little Loft. It's a bit different from the norm I know, but has its own charm. !. Hope to see you again.

title: Peace & Quiet
text:
Stayed for 1 night, the Loft was pretty, private, with peaceful rural outlook. The bed was so comfortable, the unit clean.
A very warm welcome from the owner.
Would definitely stay again.
hotel_response: Thanks for your feedback. Glad you enjoyed your stay. It was a pleasure to meet you.

title: Everything you need and more!
text: For a slightly different take on the traditional B & B type accommodation this is superb. They have thought of everything, you are stocked with plenty of breakfast supplies in your own room and you have all the comforts of home. We quite like being independent so being able to prepare our own breakfast at a time that suits us with lovely fresh ingredients was more than pleasing.  Lovely rural surroundings but just a short drive from the town of Cambridge, quiet and tranquil, bliss. If you want to snuggle up on a couch and watch a DVD, there are plenty to choose from. We stayed in the loft apartment so might be slightly different to other rooms on offer.
hotel_response:
Many thanks for the kind words. For review readers information, the Loft is our entry level apartment. Our Stables are more luxurious and spacious and offer more inclusions.
Glad to hear you were so happy with our service.

title: Peaceful, romantic, amazing amentities - a special place we will return!
text: We went for an anniversary in 2010 and what a perfect spot!  There are two identical rooms next to each other next to the full size swimming pool and spa - and we were lucky enough to have the place to ourselves.   The amenties and goodies in the room are the best!   The setting is private and peaceful.  Homemade produce, lots of supplies to make your own breakie and lovely bathroom amenities.  Spotless and clean - well thought out in every aspect - only wish we could have stayed longer!!  Highly recommend taking your own takeaway dinner and bottle of wine to enjoy every minute of it without leaving the premise!
hotel_response: So glad you enjoyed your stay. Hope to see you again sometime !

title: Couldn't have asked for anything better!
text: My partner and I had the pleasure of staying at Huntington stables for 2 nights and we could not have asked for a better experience. The setting was absolutely gorgeous, the service was extremely welcoming and the self contained loft was particularly romantic. We especially enjoyed relaxing in the spa surrounded by the beautiful farm side. The attention to detail is what makes Huntington Stables stand out. It absolutely exceeded our expectations and we highly recommend it. Thanks to the staff at Huntington Stables for making our stay so pleasurable. We will definitely be returning for another romantic getaway.
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind words. Glad you enjoyed your stay with us.

title: Awesome romantic quiet place to escape
text: Thank you for a pleasant three night getaway. The Loft was just lovely. The yummy home made jam and muesli (thanks again Carole for the recipe). Highly recommended!
hotel_response: Thanks for the kind words. Glad  you enjoyed the homemade goodies.

title: A very cool place too stay
text: The loft was a great place to stay, very quiet with lovely rural views, it had everything we needed and some nice touches of home.
hotel_response: Thank you. Glad you felt at home.

title: An absolute pleasure to stay at Huntington!
text:
I had the great pleasure of staying at Huntington Stables for almost two weeks on a business trip to N.Z.  The place was nothing short of incredible.  

The stable room was beautiful, spotlessly clean and very well appointed.  The hosts Carole and Neal were wonderful and offered famous N.Z. hospitality.  From the best breakfast anywhere to sightseeing advice they were wonderful.   

I have had the luxury of staying in some top notch places around the world but this is certainly one of the very best and is one place worth a return visit.
hotel_response: On behalf of Carole (the previous owner) thank you so much for taking the time to leave such a lovely review of your stay here.  Warmest regards, Robyn

title: Wow! An amazing, re-energising experience for a weary traveller...
text:
I just want to share a few words about an experience I had recently at a wonderful place called Huntington Stables. After several days of travel and massive delays all week, by the time I got to Huntington Stables I was absolutely exhausted to say the least. Wow! What an experience from the moment I arrived!

Carole and Neal are extremely welcoming, warm and attentive to every need. There is nothing they haven’t thought of. The food is superb (not to mention the wine!). The accommodation made me feel right at home with everything I could have wanted and then some.

The surroundings are totally inspiring, the facilities are top notch! The hospitality left me feeling like I was visiting good friends, and yet had all the privacy I could want. 

For anyone needing a recharge, an inspiring weekend away, or a romantic get away I would highly recommend Huntington Stables. I fell in love with it from the moment I arrived.

Thank you Carole and Neal from a very weary traveller!
hotel_response: On behalf of Carole (the previous owner) thank you so much for taking the time to leave such a lovely review of your stay here.  Warmest regards, Robyn

title: Unbelievable place to stay, fantastic owners, awesome service, must come back!
text:
I was so impressed by this accommodation I can't believe this place and these people are for real!
Everything was perfect, Carol and Neil are Awesome Host/ Owners! Very clean and well kept, impressive service, everything you need and hope for in a B & B. Beautiful setting, I would definitely recommend this place to anyone for business or pleasure. I woke every morning to a nice dip in the Hot tub, with great WiFi, followed by a Fantastic breakfast. Easy to relax , very nice amenities and Fantastic people. Thank you Carol and Neil! I will definitely be back to stay again!
hotel_response: On behalf of Carole (the previous owner) thank you so much for taking the time to leave such a glowing review.  Regards, Robyn

title: A truly wonderful 3 day stay
text:
We stayed for 3 nights in this beautiful accommodation. Carole is a marvellous hostess, leaving you to do your own thing but always available for advice if needed. Her advice was spot on as well with recommendations for great restaurants and places to visit. Her easy going charm was such that it was just like staying with friends.
The stables have been furnished (and maintained) to a superbly high quality with great attention to detail. Altogether a wonderful place to stay either for business or pleasure.
T & P. Northwich - England
hotel_response: On behalf of Carole (the previous owner) thank you so much for choosing to stay at Huntington Stables Retreat.  Warmest regards, Robyn

title: Generous and thoughtful hospitality
text:
We were beyond impressed with thier generous hospitality, we arrived to an array of georgous (expensive) complimentary treats, which set us off on the right foot for a great weekend.  The rooms are tastefully decorated with "impreccable attention to detail" couldn't have been said better from a previous reviewer.

We were uninterrupted, and the hosts were nowhere to be seen the entire weekend.  Being such a short trip from Hamilton, made it easy for us to drop our one year old off and pop out of town for some much needed R & R.

The facilities are fantastic, the no expense spared, well done, we will definately be back, and be sharing this experience with our friends and family.
hotel_response: On behalf of Carole (the previous owner) we are truly grateful for this wonderful review of your stay.  Warmest regards, Robyn

title: Amazing hospitaliry - impeccable attention to detial
text:
Thank you Carole for your amazing hospitality. We were so impressed by the stables. Thanks for making our stay in Cambridge so pleasant. I hope to return soon. 

 Amanda, Goldman Sachs JB Were

text: Don't bother booking here as they are permanently closed and you only find out this the day before your stay. Told me untruths they had a problem with the room, when questioned further they told me it was double booked. Very disappointed, alternative accommodation was more than double to stay in Hamilton.

title: Charming Renovated Motel with Modern Comforts
text:
Pros:

Modern, spacious, and clean rooms
Well-equipped new kitchen with all necessary utensils
Large, newly renovated bathroom with a roomy shower
Very comfortable bed
Complimentary tea, coffee, hot chocolate, milk, and bottled water
Smart TV with access to Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, and TV channels

Cons:

No housekeeping service, and no clear communication about its availability

Check-in requires contacting reception and waiting for someone to come to the motel to provide the key

Overall:
Despite the check-in process, my stay was very enjoyable. This motel is one of those “don’t judge a book by its cover” places—though the exterior looks dated, the rooms have been beautifully renovated. I highly recommend this motel and would definitely stay here again.

title: A Home Away From Home, Hamilton Motel
text:
We were absolutely blown away by our long stay at Hamilton Motel! 🏨 This gem is a hidden treasure in the heart of Hamilton, and our family feel so lucky to have found it by chance last month😊.

The rooms are spacious, clean, and cozy - perfect for a relaxing night's sleep & even work from home throughout the day as we experienced . The beds are comfy, the linens are fresh, and the decor is modern and tasteful 👍.

But what really sets this motel apart is the amazing owners, Nutei and Zubin! 🙌 They're incredibly friendly, kind, warm, and welcoming - they made us and our toddler boy feel like part of the family 💕. We stayed for over a month while relocating, and they went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable.

Their service is top-notch - they're always there to help, and the motel is spotless every day. I love how they take such great care of their guests 😊. We stayed so many places throughout our life, but this place is something else.

If you're looking for a top-notch place to stay in Hamilton, look no further than Hamilton Motel. 🙌 Nutei and Zubin are the best hosts you'll ever meet. Highly recommend! 🏆
Thank you so much for everything you’ve done for us. From our little family 💕

title: Friendly, obliging, clean and a free upgrade when we returned.
text:
Normally 1500 check in, arrived early, 1000 ish. Can we? Yes 👍
Off road Car parking underneath, lift, fob entry to a well appointed apartment.
Adjacent to Waikato Stadium, Pak & Save, 2 minutes away with lots of entertainment close by too. Returned three days later.
Free upgrade.
Impressive friendly service.😇

title: Great motel
text: My wife and I really liked this motel: very tidy new room, amazing beds, nice kitchen and perfect A/C. Located in a quiet neighbourhood very central to town. Best value for money. we will use it again when in Hamilton

title: Toxic, overpowering plastic/ chemical new-build smell. Stuffy room with fragrant cleaning sprays. Couldn't open window!
text: Went on glowing reviews. A nightmare for Asthma and allergy sufferers! We had a very bad night and couldn't wait to leave in the morning, although we wanted to stay 2 nights in the area. The window covered the whole wall but couldn't be opened for fresh air. Converted office building. Heavy drapes added to the smell! New carpet and building products from China were affecting my allergies and asthma badly!  Very hot and stuffy- air con just moved it around. Weird check-in with manager not there- took a while to find the details of phoning him. We were given room at back which was quieter, but overpowering. Phoned back and the manager let us try another (Bigger) room at the front. Not much difference in smell but bigger, so we took it as we had little choice elsewhere! It was quite noisy with traffic doing a "Cut-through" rat run to avoid lights. Beds comfy and kitchen modern.

title: very good
text:
Stayed here for 2 night's very recently and was very pleased over-all with the place.
It was easy to find and parking was no issue with parking available underneath the building and straight outside. Reception area was unattended but staff arrived promptly after a short phone call (there is a notice saying to contact if reception is unavailable). Checked into my room easily and access is by key tag so safe and secure rooms. The room I had was sufficient for me as a solo traveler and would be comfortable for 2 people. It was spacious but compact and the room was clean, tidy and smelt fresh. It was no issue but there was no milk available so had to buy a little one but wasn't a issue for the first night and was given one the next day when I asked for one. Everything worked properly including the all lights. There was some sign of liquid spill on the bottom of the  white curtain. The bed was really comfortable and had good sleep on it, pillows were a little on the hard side. The bathroom/shower was clean and scrubbed clean, There are 2 shower heads to choose water pressure from and I had both going it is that good. My room had a great view looking out towards the stadium and rugby sports grounds with big windows which was good, there are no window's to open for fresh air but A/C is available.  Over all It's a place I would stay if I ever visit Hamilton again..

A couple of things I noticed was that there was no booklet or information binder in the room letting visitors know what's happening / going on in the district or things to do and see, or history of the Waikato/Hamilton or places to have a meal/ takeaways which would be great since it's situated close to the cbd people have to option to have a look and see what eatery's there are, and a couple extra sugar sachet's as there was only 5 in the room but other than that it's a lovely place

title: Unhygienic, Loud, Dirty
text:
Location and staff were great, the place itself was a let down. 

It was very noisy, the extractor fan, walls were full of dust/ dirt and cobwebs inside. The floors were stained, there was no amenities provided. The lights outside also shine in disturbing sleep. The pillows were hard as rocks. The TV lagged, was extremely difficult to use/ watch.

I haven't recommended this to my family and wouldn't stay here again sadly.

title: Smelly room, no on-site parking as advertised
text:
My room was on the bottom storey. It looked like it had been recently painted,  it was tidy but it STUNK! It smelt like a Tom cat had been locked in the room for a week. 
They advertise on-site parking, but there isn't enough parking on-site. I had a very restless night as my car had to be parked on the road. I messaged management about this and got no reply until I threatened to block everyone in with my car. Management told me they would edit their listing to show there's not enough parking and 2months on,  they haven't.  

The facilities in the room were inadequate,  1 teaspoon, which was dirty, no sugar, no knives. 

DO NOT RECOMMEND

title: Sparklingly clean and spacious
text:
Very happy to recommend these airy well appointed motel rooms. Good sized kitchen with a stove and microwave, big fridge and cutlery and crockery provided as well as tea and coffee
Beds were comfortable and plenty of pillows and towels provided. Very quiet at night

title: Modern apartment type motel
text:
My go to motel whenever I’m in Hamilton.
Modern rooms, smart tv, free wifi, comfortable beds, well equipped kitchen for cooking meals, large bathroom, free parking onsite, apartment style motel, across the road from pak n save & eateries.

Check in is at a different motel which is close by. 
Only issue with recent stay was the room I had this time around had no kitchen island. 

Other than that, I enjoyed my stay

title: Modern, Comfortable, and Perfect for Business Stays
text:
Pros:
Great location
Free parking 
Large apartment type room
Large comfortable bed
Kitchen with oven, stovetop , microwave , kettle & dishwasher
Smart TV

Cons:
No reception onsite therefore check in is from another motel nearby 

Overall experience:
I’ve stayed here a few times for business, and it really feels like a home away from home. The rooms are modern and well-equipped, with the option to cook your own meals and free Wi-Fi for work. There’s a petrol station next door for a quick coffee fix, a supermarket across the road, and plenty of eateries nearby. It’s also within walking distance to the city centre. The motel feels safe and secure, and even without a reception onsite, it’s a great affordable and clean place to stay. I’ll definitely be returning.

title: Warning!!!
text: I was extremely disappointed at this premise and will never stay again, I struggled to find it although clearly signed. Then with no receptionist and a rubbish dump in the basement feared what have I booked. The room was closed up and has no air conditioning - I managed to get a breeze going by opening the windows. Not a place I would recommend to travelers.

title: Modern, spacious apartment type with a kitchen
text:
Very spacious, modern and clean. It was an apartment type. Plenty of parking onsite. Secure access to the building. Note: key is picked up from another motel nearby.
Across the road from pak n save and restaurants. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Loved the room and location. I would highly recommend and would definitely stay here again.

title: Cancelled our booking
text:
We booked in to stay here for the night when down in Hamilton attending an all weekend event. We arrived late Saturday afternoon about 4pm to be told firstly they had no booking for us, had booking through Booking.com, then told that booking had been cancelled by Booking.com. When I said that I had not been informed by either themselves or booking.com, receptionist said booking.com cancelled and they had no rooms available. In hindsight this was a blessing as have since stayed there and it was terrible, should have learnt from this experience.
On accessing emails, it appears the motel tried to charge my credit card that morning and when it declined ( as old card had been used) the motel emailed booking.com to cancel booking. No phone call from motel who had my number to discuss this or ask for another credit card number. Got apology from Booking.com but motel never thought they did anything wrong. Have stayed at many places in NZ and never had this bad service before.

title: Noisy because of poor sound insulation
text: If you want a quiet motel, this is not the one. The footstep sounds from above are very loud, and sometimes constant. This is not a fault of the people above but purely that the sound insulation is totally inadequate. Factor in the road noise and this is not a relaxed place to stay. And although one cockroach does not an army make, it was disconcerting.

title: Modern today with good workspace
text: We stayed for 2 nights and found this a pleasant and convenient spot. Comfortable with modern facilities, good parking and plenty of hot water. Beside a busy-ish road so if you’re a really light sleeper it might bother you but I slept really well - 85/100 on my Garmin.

title: Avoid
text: I guess you get what you pay for. If you are on the ground floor then expect to get no sleep as the whole room shakes when the person upstairs walks around. As for house keeping - they will only replace your towels. Stay almost an entire week and the bed was never made - the sheets were just thrown across the bed. Worth paying more and staying somewhere decent.

title: Style over substance - modern but very disappointing
text:
This is a modern property with good parking & easy to find. But it is further out of the central city than expected - about 35 minutes walk. 

No hot water for shower or in bathroom.

We stayed on the ground floor & the people above were banging from 6am. Could hear every footstep which meant we had very disrupted sleep.

Overall a disappointing stay.

title: Shocking
text:
My experience was shocking
It states pet friendly so we booked 6 day.
when we arrived they said no pets in the cabins so we slept in the car the 1st night.
I had to find another pet friendly accommodation which we did and it was amazing.

Any one going to stay there BE AWARE

title: Well Placed near the Central city of Hamilton
text: Very nice spot. Close to the City / Supermarket / Even a Bus route to take you most places around the City.   The Camp itself I stayed in a Motorhome was fantastic own Privacy individual sites. Nice clean Showers maintained Amenities Usual Facilities Kitchen / Laundry / Free Wi-fi. Lovely staff friendly & helpful, looking forward to returning thanks guys.

title: Our first night in NZ set the standard for other holiday parks to aspire to.
text: As advised by our motor home rental company (the excellent thl), we booked our first ever motor camping night at Hamilton City. The welcome by Jessica was warm and help and advice was consistently freely given. Throughout our stay we found  guaranteed professionalism, cleanliness, efficiency, friendly staff, every facility imaginable, and all in an attractive location. Hamilton City's high standards encourage and set the example to guests to enjoy themselves respectfully of others - a virtuous circle. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and are very grateful to all the Hamilton City team.

title: Well Situated in The City of Hamilton
text: Lovely Park, I was in a Motorhome the site was fantastic private. The Amenities were well maintained clean no complaints. I used the Public Transport (Bus stop right outside the Park) Easiest way to get around Hamilton Gardens , The Base , & the city center. Only 15 min walk into city.  So whether staying for a night or a few days Hamilton City Holiday park is a Place worth checking out. Wonderful Friendly staff, thanks guys looking forward to returning

title: Wasn’t happy when having a shower the whole ablation block floor gets wet
text:
Ablution blocks could do with update and improved cleanliness
For what we pay as opposed to other campsites would probably avoid staying here

title: Great location
text: We had a self contained unit which was a good size for two ladies in town for a concert and some shopping. Older unit and in need of a revamp but still ok. Had everything we needed. A double bed and a set of bunks - both very comfortable but the bunks are not great for a cup of tea in bed! But we managed. But very disappointed that the prices were more expensive because it was Field Days week? Went back down again the week after. So prices were the same as a motel.

title: Home away from home
text:
We booked many unit at the park, as we had an family event to attend. Fast communication, quick and easy check in. Very accommodating at the last minute. Family friendly, clean and organized. All units had everything it said it would. Lovely, friendly staff. And we were allowed to have our elderly dog with us too. So close to all amenities, highway, city center, markets, etc but still away from all the noise.
Highly recommend staying here.

title: Inadequate
text:
This place clearly puts a very high priority on making $ at the expense of guest comfort. There are so many tiny cabins everywhere. Very crowded. 
      I found the reception staff to be friendly & helpful.
      I was shocked to see only 1 sink to support the use of 6 toilets in the toilet block next to my tent site 23. Twice I had to move aside while brushing my teeth so that other women could wash their hands. Not good. Totally inadequate. Also only 1 shower in that block. Again, totally inadequate for the huge number of people on site. 
      The kitchen is also tiny for such a huge number of people. I did not see any lounge to hang out in. However, maybe I missed it as I was not offered a map & nor was the lady checking in before me. That is not good. They should offer everybody a map so they know where they’re going. Or at least post a map outside on a sign.
     There is black mold in the one shower in the female block…next to the window & the seat & floor in that shower stall are grotty & the seat needs fresh paint. Great water pressure though.
      They have crammed in so many cabins yet don’t provide enough space allocation to the basic requirements of their guests. Profit making over guest comfort. Not good. 
      Toxic diffuser sticks at check in desk & in all cabins said the reception staff. 1 in every 3 people are highly allergic to the unregulated toxic chemicals they contain: VOCS, carcinogens, hormone disrupters & neurotoxins. Not happy to have 1 right at the check in desk. I had to leave the door open & wear my mask but still those chemicals made my eyes & face burn. 
      Air fresheners do not freshen the air they pollute it and cover up smells with toxic chemicals. Open a window instead. If you are not aware of the toxic chemicals these items contain check out the free website of Dr Ann Steinman at the University of Melbourne as she is a top researcher on this issue. She has a free fact sheet in the dangers of air fresheners.
      I really would have preferred to stay in a cabin the two nights that I was in Hamilton but I didn’t specifically because the reception staff told me those chemicals are put into all your cabins. So they missed out on more of my money because of these unnecessary chemicals that they pollute their accommodation with. I got a tent site instead.
     Research from Australia shows that the third of the populace who are sensitive to these chemicals prefer not to go to businesses that will expose them to these chemicals so I am not alone in my concern.
     I was really shocked that I had to pay like $40 bucks or $49, I can’t remember, for a tent site for one person. That is shocking. In Kaikoura I had a beach site for my tent and they only charged me $20. I think their prices are ridiculous for the poor level of comfort they provide guests. I was very clear to tell the woman I was using the tent site by myself and that I think that rate is really high for one person. That is a total turn off. It feels like Price gouging.   
       Would I stay this site again? Not unless I had to. It’s too tightly crammed in. Too expensive for a tent site for one person. There’s not enough of the basic facilities - not enough room for people. It clearly seems the emphasis is all on making money and not guests being comfortable so I wouldn’t stay there again unless absolutely necessary. 
I don’t think they have any competition in the Hamilton area so maybe that’s why they function this way but it’s really offputting.

title: OK and certainly convenient
text:
The site was fine and certainly convenient to explore the area.  The facilities were OK but no better.  They were clean, and the staff were friendly, although sometimes hard to find.
We stayed in several sites during our stay and this was one of the less good ones.  Its location is really its saving grace.

title: Overpriced but convenient!
text:
$49 for 1 person on an unpowered site is a lot, and I assume that’s almost entirely because of the proximity to the city centre. And although it is close, there is nothing much in the immediate vicinity, apart from a Countdown!
Bathroom facilities were very basic in the small block, slightly better in the main block.
And the grass needs cutting! 
Wifi was poor in the afternoon, but very good early morning, and unlimited, the saving grace for this expensive stay.

title: Hamilton City holiday park
text:
Visited in May 2023

Location was great in Hamilton city, not too far form the main roads when using Hamilton as a base for exploring the North island. There is also a Countdown (supermarket) 5min walk away for convenience. 

We had our campervan in a campervan spot which was close to the communal kitchen and shower block. Laundry was unfortunately down during our stay but it did not affect us as we did not use it. What was great about this communal shower block was the water pressure. Excellent water pressure and overall the facilities were clean.

title: Beware
text: Be very aware of their terms and conditions regarding cancelling or rebooking.  No money back at for cancelling and costs $$$$ to rebook.  Have never come across this before.  We got caught up in the ferry debacle but got across then lost our brakes on the caravan and had to head home rather than continue on our trip.  It was a fight that we chose not to fight.  Way too much was going on. They hide behind their T and Cs.  Will never book with them.  Should have gone to Cambridge where they are sooooo much better!

title: Ok as a 1 night stopover
text:
Stayed here for 1 night before dropping van off in Auckland. 
Site is ok with all the required facilities but not in great condition.
It’s also not in the nicest place.
As in many other NZ sites fellow campers seem to ignore personal space & walk through your pitch

title: Sleazy, greedy operation looking to take advantage of disabled cyclist
text: I’ve visited New Zealand a half-dozen times over the past decade, always staying at one of the many holiday parks located on both islands.  In that time, I’ve enjoyed hundreds of pleasant stays that ranged from budget to deluxe - always traveling by bicycle and tent campling.   But I just experienced a first for me - being gouged by a holiday campground: Hamilton City Holiday Park.   Ironically, the Holiday Parks Association of New Zealand prides themselves on being ‘bike friendly’.   I’m an American journalist, and on this most recent visit, I was doing a series of articles on cycling in New Zealand for several U.S.A. magazines.   I’m also disabled from a cycling accident and use a modified bicycle now to get around.   At the reception, I was told that I had to pay the price of two even though I was traveling solo - because it was the “high season”.   No holiday park for the previous month (or for the following month) had tried to scam me like this (a solo disabled cyclist using non-powered sites for tent camping - not using inside lodging).   And, usually, the “two person minumum charge” applies to accomodations inside, not solo camping.   So not only wasn’t it the ‘high season’ but I shouldn’t have been charged double like this for solo tent bicycle camping.   THIS HAS NEVER HAPPENED IN ANY PREVIOUS STAY WITH A HOLIDAY PARK!   The woman handling reception duties knew - like I did - that this was just a greedy money grab; she also knew that being on a bicycle and disabled that I didn’t have an option to locate other lodging late in the day.   This is a real ‘black eye’ for the tourist trade and all the legitimate holiday parks that are ethical and honest.   This park should be ashamed for charging an extra $25 like this when no one else does for solo tent camping in the ‘shoulder season’ - and other parks I discussed this situation with afterwards where livid that a business would operate like this and take advantage of a visitor.   Fortunately, I’m doing a series of articles on cycling in New Zealand and will make sure to bring this unethical business to the attention of others - including the New Zealand tourist board that is trying to promote cycling tourism in the country.   Ironically, not only did I have to pay double the normal charge, but the facilities were basic at best (the ‘TV room’ was the size of a closet so any kind of social interaction with other travelers wasn’t possible).   The bathrooms were tidy however.
hotel_response:
Hi Rob, many thanks for taking the time to review us. That caption certainly is heavily influenced to incorrectly draw attention to say the least. 

I, as a local have stayed in countless amount of Holiday Parks across NZ and could named 10 off the top off my head where a single rate does not exist. Despite your experience it is not uncommon to find campgrounds not offering single rates, especially in heavily visited areas such a tourist towns and cities. You have been quite fortunate you to not have encounter this before. We look at prices based on the city we are located in, and our tent site price is bar far one of the cheapest options. Despite being on a bike, you were in a city surrounded with many options close by such as airbnbs, hostels and hotels so should we have been that disappointing with the price offered you did have the option, many of them, to go elsewhere. Instead you chose to stay and to insinuate you have been taken advantage of due to be disabled is simply not the case. 

It is a shame you did not have the best experience with us, but we wish you all the best in the new year and hope you have many more fantastic trips in New Zealand should you see yourself back here.

title: Hidden gem
text:
Great hidden gem. A quintessential kiwi holiday park with nothing on site that you don’t need.
Public areas are pristinely clean
Individually hedged caravan sites are very private but would not really work if say a caravan and a tent want to share one site (which for our visit, they didn’t).
Dog friendly yet not over run with dogs
hotel_response: Wow Hellen, what a fantastic review. From all the staff many thanks for such kind words and recognising the work put into the park. We hope to see you again soon!

title: dissapointed
text: I stayed here last week and had to pay $42 for a unpowered site for 1 night for 1 person the site was tiny .just thought it was bit expensive as the park had nothing nice like pool or spa etc .wouldent stay here agein
hotel_response: Hi Aidan, thanks for taking the time to review us. It is hard though to take much away from this review though as its just you expressing your disappointment in a price. As it seems price is a big factor to you it may be worth pointing out that in the local area we are one of the cheaper Holiday Parks. Regarding Hamilton, staying with us at $42 is bar far cheapest option to legally lay your head down for the night, as I am sure you were probably aware which is why you chose to stay.

title: Clean and comfortable
text:
We had a small cabin only and then moved into a self contained cabin
Everyone was very helpful and happy to do what they could to accommodate us....
Rooms are very clean and have everything we needed.
The bathroom block is extremely clean and obviously checked frequently and the kitchen is also well equipped and clean
Supermarket is just round the corner and the hospital is close which is why we were there. The grounds are clean and well maintained
I'm sure it would be a great place for families to stay
hotel_response:
Hi Juliaan, many thanks for such a lovely review and for picking out how helpful and friendly our staff are. We really pride ourselves on making sure all our guests are looked after and have a great stay and I’m glad you had just that!

Thanks for choosing us and we hope to see you again soon.

title: Comfortable and friendly
text:
We booked in for an event and decided to stay over in a fully self contained cabin - came with all the linen and cooking facilities (which we didn't utilise).    Room had a stand up fan which was great given the temperatures when we were there.

Nice park, clean cabin and ensuite with dedicated carpark.

Recommend and would stay again.
hotel_response:
Hi Nicola,

We’re thrilled to read you enjoyed your stay with us here at the park and thank you for taking the time to review us. We’ll be sure to pass your kind words on to the rest of the team and look forward to seeing you again soon we hope. 

Many thank

title: Thank you!
text:
I just wanted to say a big thank you for all you guys are doing in the park! 
We come here every once or twice a year for a hockey tournament. 
The new management and staff are making such a difference. The park looks so much more tidy and little changes like some plants and colour around the place. 
It can still do with a little bit of an upgrade, but the main thing is that everything is very clean. 

We will be back again!
hotel_response:
Hi Sarah,

we just wanted to say a big thank you for you taking your time to write such a great review. It really is amazing to see people such as yourself who come stay with us year upon year notice the differences through out the park, something our team is very proud of.
We look forward to hosting you again next year!

title: Ok
text: Unfortunately I cannot say I really enjoyed my stay. The standard site for a non powered car was one of the most expensive I've come across & when compared to other campgrounds the standard of the (dated) facilities & grounds were far inferior.  I had asked to be somewhere near lighting & was told all the lights in the campground are broken. It was a wet day, grounds a bit uneven & autumn leaves around so lack of lighting is a bit of a hazard. The bathroom ceiling & walls could do with some attention as they were covered in dead bugs. The location was handy, the receptionist was pleasant and I did like the little book library idea.
hotel_response:
Many thanks for your review, it’s a shame you didn’t enjoy your stay, but I would imagine if you did not agree with pricing then you would go on to not enjoy your stay and find faults. Our pricing is based on the main factor we are located in the centre of a city, so I imagine comparing it to a campsite that is not is such a desired location there would be a price difference. 

Happy to take on any feedback to further improve the guest experience, we always want to be better, though to exaggerate you points such as saying the ceilings and walls are covered in bugs is not true. Our facilities are cleaned daily and as you’ll see by many of our reviews we are complimented by our high level of cleanliness. 

As for the lighting, again not ALL lights were broken, we had one street light broken which since has been fixed. We have also since taking over our seperate lights on all 15+ power points through tour the park meaning that it is more lit up at night than it has been before. We will continue to monitor this to see if more lighting is needed, but again to mention ALL lights were not working is untrue. 

I appreciate you taking the time to write to us, and that you had something positive to say about us, our staff pride themselves on delivering great service to all customers.

title: What a difference new owners can make
text: I have come on and off to meet family back in Hamilton and often stay at the park in my camper. All i can say is what a difference the new management have made in such a short time. Great to see such improvements and care being made around the park, Thank you for such a pleasant stay, looking forward to coming back.
hotel_response:
Hi John,

what a lovely review, the management and owners have really worked hard to improve the park and glad you have noticed it, we do have to say much is down to our amazing staffs hard work to make the park what it is!

We will be sure to pass on your positive words and thanks to them and look forward to having you soon!

title: Loved the place
text: Amazing stay! The hosts and staff were such a friendly bunch and the park was in great condition. We stayed in a four berth cabin that was really clean and cosy. Location was brilliant not far at all from the Claudelands event centre. Most definitely will be staying again
hotel_response:
Thanks for such a great review! Our staff really appreciate it when people have such lovely things to say about them, we will be sure to pass it on!

We look forward to welcoming you again another time!

title: Never again!
text: Spent a week at this camp. I get it’s autumn but there’s been no attempt to tidy up the site for leaves. The ground is very uneven and dangerous at night when walking around as there’s no lighting. There is also no lighting in the very old shower room through the day and there’s no natural light coming in so couldn’t put make up on or dry hair as cannot see. The management are uncaring. Had issues with the wifi and the owner was terribly rude. Would not recommend this site to anybody.
hotel_response:
George and Jill,

I had thought to address each issue you have created, but came to the conclusion it would not help either party as you are not looking to give us feed back, rather give us a bad name.

If we are to address the elephant in the room, the reason you are pointing and looking for problems is the simple fact is the internet was down for a day during your stay. As we explained several times when our internet was not working, Spark had a nationally fault in parts of the north island.
You approached us almost daily in an unpleasant manner, and because spark could not fix this in a time frame you saw fit decided to let this ruin your trip. 

Even after a 14 hour shift, management still came and speak to you when they had finished for the day, just because you demanded it. Hardly the actions of a team that does not care.

It is a shame you did not enjoy your stay, we want people to enjoy their time away and management will be taking your points onboard to further improve the park, but to say we did not care is not the case. It was just despite our efforts we do not care to be spoken to like we were, especially when the problem was out of our control.

None the less thank you for your stay and we wish you all the best.

title: needs work!!
text: this holiday has not changed at all in about 12 years except for some new cabins, the amenities need  a total revamp, when you have a shower, your clothes etc get showered as well, pathways are dangerous in the dark as tree roots are pushing the concrete up and breaking it, and the kitchens need work as well, won't be back again!!

As stated we are under new ownership and under new ownership our goal will be to continue to improve the park and experience of all future guests.

title: RuthW
text: Very welcoming and helpful hosts. Cabin clean and tidy. Bunk bed wire so very saggy for an adult. Showers and toilets always clean. Good lighting at night walking from cabin to kitchen/toilet block. Lovely big trees. Good location close to supermarket and Uni and surprisingly quiet considering the busy road. Thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend.
hotel_response:
What a lovely review, thanks so much for taking the time to write such positive things. The whole team really does pride itself on delivering top service and it’s great that you have recognised that. 

Glad you picked up on our great location and the fact that we are so peaceful here in the park, you wouldn’t even notice we was in a city!

We hope to see you again soon.

title: Stayed for a hockey tournament
text: Lovely place, the owners were friendly, gave my daughter an extra mattress as her one was very thin. Cabin was clean and tidy, toilets and showers were clean and tidy, good shower pressure. The only negative was the ants and cockroaches were prolific in the cabins, plus we also found a white tailed spider in our cabin!
hotel_response:
Hi and thank you for such a kind review. We are glad you enjoyed your stay and had so many nice things to say. 

As for the cock roach and ant problem you suffered one of the first actions the new management and owners took when taking over the property was hiring the services of an exterminator. We are glad to say since your visit these problems have gone and guests are enjoying pest free cabins. 

The new team and owners are determined to continue park improvements so people such as yourself can enjoy the park. Thanks again for taking the time to review us and we hope to see you again soon!

title: Change of ownership
text:
After reading the reviews I was very hesitant about staying here!
When I arrived I asked for a tent site without power...I was told that would cost me $42/night!
When I said that was way too expensive the guy looking after the site said ,yes ,this was based on 2 people and as the place has just been taken over there were changes needed to be made by the new owners..
He then offered it to me at a great price of $25/night...
There was definitely a lot of tidying up going on , I found everything very clean , great amenities and great free hot showers...
I believe the new owners are now on track to make this a great campsite in the heart of Hamilton...
hotel_response: Many thanks for such a kind review and choosing to stay with us. We hope to see you again soon!

title: OK for a night
text: Very basic. Small kitchen and not much other space to relax or do anything. Room ok. Very limited car parking. You can hear through the walls so lots of noise as people go up and down the corridors and TVs on in other rooms. Good enough for one night but not ideal for an extended stay.

title: Ok for a night stay
text: Very basic. Feels a bit like a prison cell as the rooms are quite small and the double bed was very small. The customer service was not great on the desk but ok for a night stay. There is a common area however it isn’t very clean, think the whole thing needs renovating.

title: On a budget
text:
Is Backpackers Central the best hostel in NZ? No, far from it. Is it as dire as some reviews tend to paint it? Also no.

Choices of hostels in Hamilton are very, very limited, so you get what you're given. It's not upmarket by any stretch of the imagination. Downstairs in the basement of dorms, it's lacking in life. The kitchen is stocked to a point (bit light on cutlery). The bedroom is warm. There is a weird smell. It's cleaned occasionally. The bathroom is a communal affair, but there are designated male and female toilets and showers.

It's not somewhere that you'd want to spend a whole heap of time, but it does what it says on the tin and that's about all you can really hope for. At the very least it's a good excuse to get out and enjoy the sights and sounds of Hamilton... and yes, there are some.

title: They treat the top floor different from the rest
text: The beds are comfortable and the place is always clean but the prices are a rip off. Some of the rules they make in this place I wouldn't agree to them all. Alot of the people that stay on the top floor are good people but the owners and managers don't like it when these good people like to help someone in need.

title: Never again
text: We stayed at this hostel for one night while travelling through New Zealand. The hostel seems to be quite old and there was still a Christmas tree there when we arrived? The rooms are dark and cold since the air conditioning is so strong and the air isn’t very good in the hostel either. What was even worse is that I got bed bugs from the very unconfortable and old bed. I can’t recommend the hostel to anyone, I didn’t feel confortable at all.
