Thank you for staying with us. Your feedback is important to us. We do apologize for any inconvenience. Air conditioning could be adjusted from every individual room. We are surprised to notice that there were bed bugs. We check our beds on regular intervals and spray for any insects. 

See you guys next time. Safe travels!

Kind regards

Ajit Lakhman
Manager

title: Overnight stay
text:
Excellent location, easy to find, great little room with toilet, pedestal fan and tv.
Fabulous kitchen/lounge facilities, great parking on a Saturday night, wifi and good security.
I was off to the rugby, so Central backpackers was close by and a walk up the road from town afterwards.
I parked right outside the front door as the meters aren’t monitored Saturday nights and I loved the free wifi.
hotel_response:
Thank you for booking with us. Your feedback helps us to improve our services. See you guys next time. Safe Travels!

Regards

Ajit Lakhman
Manager

title: First timer backpacker dissapointment.
text:
As I booked a cheap room I would have expected also a clean room by New Zealand standards. So I had a room with a toilet and wash basin there was a screen to separate the bed from the washing and toilet. One towel for a shower and a hand towel there was a clothes cupboard and a small side draw The bed and sheets and a blanket were ok but I brought my own Linen. My carpet looked like it had seen better days.
The fan was a life saver as the room was hot and stuffy, there was no window to open but a small exhaust fan in the window. The air conditioning was in the hall way so had to open my room door. I stayed for 2 nights. The shower had excellent pressure and the desk staff are cool.There are permanent residents onsight. I did not have breakfast and eat out. Good location to CBD. 
My room was #26 and cost me $69.00 per night. Depending on your own personal expectations the over-all cleanliness of the facilities may be something to be aware of, other than that I did have good sleeps.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your feedback. 

We always strive to provide the best amenities and hygienic conditions for our distinguished guests. We will definitely put more effort to make it more precise.

See you next time!

Kind regards

Ajit Lakhman
Manager

title: Located on the main thoroughfare in Hamilton,
text:
Located on the main thoroughfare in Hamilton, the property has both shared and solo rooms available.
The bunk bed room I stayed in had no windows.
There are eggs, toast and coffee available in the morning.
hotel_response:
Hi there,

Many thanks for your feedback. 

We hope you enjoyed your stay with us. We would like to host you again in the near future.

Have a great holiday!

Regards

Ajit Lakhman
Manager

title: Cheap but dirty
text:
Poor quality hostel, dirty communal areas and with largely a non-backpacker crowd (people who maybe live there).

Had upstairs room, no windows just skylight, and got very stuffy in the day. Had a room fan but didn't work and had sellotape holding it together.

Bathroom was communal, and didn't seem to be cleaned over the weekends. Some toilets were out of toilet paper for a few days, but there wasn't too many guests so wasn't an issue per se. There's 1 hand towel to dry your hands on, which was not changed daily 🤢, but also not a sanitary solution for a hostel.

Breakfast was ok with good options for cereal or toast. Lots of kitchens with lots of pans, crockery, and utensils ... But felt like needed to wash before use as the general place was a bit grotty.

The management photos are not what you'll get here!
hotel_response:
Thank you for your feedback.

We are extremely sorry for your not so good experience with our facilities. We apologized for the fan but we would have replaced it at once if reported to Reception.

We will definitely tighten up our cleaning team and these cleaning standards are unacceptable.

we would like you to stay with us again in the future. You will definitely notice a marked improvement.

we wish you have a great holiday.

Kind regards

Ajit Lakhman
Manager

title: Staying in the city centre
text: One room with 2 bunk bed, 1 double bed and 1 single bed. The cheapest room that we have got with free breakfast. Clean and tidy with a good wifi. Friendly staff. Have a big car parking slot and free towel.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback. Enjoy your holidays. See you next time.

title: outstanding night porter, above and beyond customer service and satisfaction
text: this is my third stay here, and by far this has been an amazing few days, it was like a home away from home, staff friendly, facilities were excellent, thoroughly enjoyed being able to cook home cooked meals. my partner had  emergency surgery done, so we actually ended up spending alot of time indoors. But we felt like we were at our own home. the night porter regularly checked on us, even during the day time, i got upo in the middle of the night to make a coffee and he was washing the floors and sanitising benches etc in the kitchen, then going to do the other floors, id like to add the cleaners wash the floors after 10am.  Im shocked to read other reviews because i just cant make sense of them when i have stayed here 3 times and each was for 3 days minimum. I absolutely HIGHLY recommend this establishment for any potential traveller. pricing was perfect, room just what  needed. had fan and heater so struggling to believe some of these reviews. Thankyou for absolutely outstanding hospitality, will definetly be back again.
hotel_response: Many thanks for your feedback. Such words motivate us to a great extent. See you next time!

title: Very average and pretty run down
text:
The only place we stayed during our year abroad which had bedbugs. Not a good experience. 

Overall the place is a little run down. Certainly the area we stayed in need some attention. 

The staff were welcoming and the WiFi was good enough.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback. We apologize for the inconvenience. We check our rooms on a regular basis. Definitely, we will pay more attention to it. Have a safe journey.

title: Absolutely rubbish
text:
Management rude and unresponsive. We got reprimanded by the hostel staff for arriving too late. (Left a message on Booking.com beforehand)
The hostel isn't in a great location. It's about a 30 minute walk to the city centre.  
There's nothing to make it stand out, except the fields day, but they charged us  such a high price. This place could simply be described as 'rubbish'. The hostel smells like paint and made us headache. If you want to save your money and book elsewhere.
hotel_response:
Dear guest, Thank you for your feedback.

So sorry to hear that you did not have welcome from the reception. Our reception opens until 9 pm. From the Transport Centre in Hamilton to our backpackers, it is around 700 meters away, it could take up to 10 mins for walking. 

also, apologize for paint's smell. we are working on renovations there would be a huge improvement after finishing the renovation. Our room prices change daily based on occupancy and it comes up with higher rates for special-event days like Fieldays. 

we'll do our best to make it better and hope we can welcome you back again in our hostel where we can exceed your expectations.

Kind regards
Sam

title: A Dump - Avoid - This place is a ripoff
text: This place is a Dump.  There is No Heating in the middle of winter and the room was freezing cold.  The walls are Paper Thin.  The blankets in the room smelled bad.  The private double room was ugly and very old feeling - very slumlord feeling.  The mattress was a piece of junk.  The floor of the mens bathroom constantly had a puddle.  They have no way to dry your hands except some old dirty cloth towel - no paper towels, no air dryer - extremely cheap!  The women's bathroom had nothing at all!  They inflated the prices for some stupid "farm technology convention" and even at the regular price it would have been an absolute rip off.  They ran out of parking and made no apology.  The front desk guy was an idiot who could care less about anything (that's what happens when you give backpackers free lodging without pay for working because the owner is obviously a cheapskate).  I had to call for the manager and the front desk guy was rude and condescending about it.  The next morning all we wanted to do was Leave!
hotel_response:
Dear sir, 

I am sorry to read this review, we are currently in the process of renovating our hostel and heaters will be placed into all the rooms today, as I remember, I was more than happy to get you one once you let us know you were cold and I will definitely be looking at getting hand dryers in the bathrooms. 

Unfortunately, the high demand for accommodation over the field days do push our prices quite high over these 4 days thus we are able to cope with the demand, it does, however, become quite difficult to provide all of our guest's free parking and we are on first come first serve basis. The working of the front desk at a hostel is not an easy task, caring for over 100 guest relations when we are at high occupancy can be stressful and overwhelming at times, this is understandable when there are issues and language barriers communication difficulties will be had. I apologize for this and I am glad I was able to solve your issues and communicate with you in a clear and kind fashion 

Regards 
Cody.

title: A good location
text:
Backpackers Central Hamilton is a pretty big hostel in a city centre. It has a nice location: just 10 min walking to a bus station, ISite, shopping malls and superstores. The botanical garden, the lake and the river are in a walking distance as well.

As for the hostel itself, it's nice. Helpful and friendly staff,  big kitchens with a spacious dining area inside and on the terrace, There's also a chilling out area with a TV, CD and DVD players. Clean bathroom with showers and toilets. Even there was a hairdryer, but it didn't work. 

Free breakfast was quite usual, but very handy: it's always good not to cook in the morning, but eat your breakfast and go exploring :)

We stayed in a room for 2 people and luckily there was a window, but it looked at the staircase. There was a double bed, a table, a chair, a wardrobe, a TV and a fan. 

Some negatives:

1.No extra light, as a wall lamp or a desk lamp. It's wierd! The ceiling light was not really bright and even it was hard to see what you read with that lamp.

title: Dirty Sheets
text:
From top to bottom.  My wife and I booked a private double.  The website layout was nice and easy to use and it was recommended by Lonely Planet.  Arrived and it is a well secured nice quiet place.  It should be noted that they have a strict 'no alcohol policy' which is not clear on their website.  

When we checked in with the on-site manager and another individual were located at the reception.  It was not a warm and welcoming feeling.  Very cold and transactional.  We checked in and were shown to our room.  Our room appeared clean with the exception of our bed sheet having a very distinct stain on it.  We asked the on-site manager for a new clean sheet.  He was busy and our comment was met with a slight eye roll and him saying he will come to our room to check it out while we headed out to the Hamilton Gardens (which are really great if you have some free time).  We came back to the room noticing that our bed sheet was turned inside out.  After a quick check, we were able to confirm that it was indeed the same sheet and was simply turned inside out.  This maneuver made us question how clean everything was in the hotel.  

We went back down to reception to explain what had happened.  After a little back and forth about why we wanted to change our sheets he said he would change it out personally.  Our sheet was picked up and after a few minutes, the on-site manager returned with a 'new' sheet.  The new sheet looked dirtier than the one we previously had. We basically gave up and decided we would sleep in our clothes on the bed and hike out in the morning. 

In all this place is safe and amenities are adequate; the sheets were dirty and the manager is a bit hostile. We have stayed in a lot of great hostels in NZ and this one certainly falls short.

title: Strange hostel
text: This hostel is one of the stranger ones I've stayed in. It's on Victoria street but at the wrong end, a good 20 min walk to the first set of bars and resturants. It's clean and comfortable but the rooms are small, I satued in a 6 bed dorm and it was excruciatingly hot even with a fan on 24/7 and the window open. The only shortage is low underbed or a school type locker, neither of which accommodates a travellers bag. The staff are the strange thing, the man on the front desk is very pleasant but doesn't really seem to know what's going on. The older lady who cleans the rooms kept coming in and opening our door, curtains and window and saying it's hot and we had to leave everything open, no privacy at all and kept telling me to move my bag and unpack it into the lockers to make space, which I'm not going to do as its a large bag and I was only there for two nights. The hostel seems to shut down from 11-1 when everything gets cleaned so no kitchen, bathroom or even your own room. But they are not exactly quick or apologetic. They fold all the laundry in the front room at this time aswell so you can't even watch tv as all the sofa spaces as they are all full of bed sheets and two ladies are having a discussion about how they havnt had a Sunday off in weeks. Also the fridge isn't nearly cold enough so all my food went off. Overall the hostel itself is clean and adequate but not the organisation of it. Hamilton itself is a boring place so I wouldn't recommend going in general, it's just full of students and bogens getting drunk. Wifis good though.

He refused to give a refund, with no particular reason. We believe we are entitled to our refund. Upon looking at some reviews online we found we were not the only ones to experience this. A very disappointing experience, we will not be returning to Central Backpackers ever again. Very poor customer service from the owner of the hostel who was not compassionate to our circumstances, no windows in the bedrooms, no atmosphere and terrible wifi. title: Basics not right, fab location but needs work
text:
The location of this hostel is great - 5-10 mins to the transport centre and close to most thing you'd want in Hamilton. Past this however, I was completely unimpressed.

Most importantly: sleep. We were in a room with a skylight and no blind or curtain. Or way of opening it. There's a fan, but the room was like a sauna constantly whether or not this was on and we were woken by the sun early every day. The room has a fridge and a TV but not enough sockets to use them simultaneously - they're also unnecessary in a hostel. I'd much rather the basics (I.e. Blinds) were there since primarily I'm bothered about sleeping here. 

Staff (past check in) were a non-existent presence - if you want them for something it's a phone call. Not ideal if you want simple directions / advice on the locality. We got this type of info from other guests. They were friendly / helpful when you did speak to one however. Checking out is leaving your key card on the desk - hardly secure when this door is unlocked and the key card gives access to an area always needing swipe card access. 

Free breakfast basically toast and cornflakes - adequate but find the practice of having this between 730 and 830 a little cynical. Why provide it if you do it in a way that many backpackers won't be up for? We didn't bother mostly - buy a loaf for 1.50 and have toast at your leisure. On the one day we did there was a predictable rush of sleepy people in their pjs at 825. PCs for internet access and the vending machine were located in a lounge guests staying in the other part of the hostel didn't have access to outside of reception hours. None of this a massive issue for us, but felt a bit like false advertising. 

And everything just feels a bit tired with no atmosphere at all - especially the communal areas - old, out of date signs signed Eagle Lodge (? Who knows). Mostly clean though the first hostel I've stayed in where when inconsiderate guests leave washing up it could be left for a fair while before being dealt with. Seems to be a problem here as never went in the kitchen when there weren't some dirty dishes around. Part of the problem could be that the relevant equipment didn't seem to be kept stocked up - there was no washing up liquid one day and only a single sopping wet tea towel another. Difficult to clear up when these simple things aren't available. 

Alcohol policy is none at all - would have liked to be able to have a beer with dinner and don't think this is unreasonable. 

Wifi pretty bad - cuts out constantly, constantly asked to log back in - frustrating and irritating. 

Would find somewhere else were I to come back to Hamilton.

The kitchen and communal area are definitely adequate and there are two PCs available for use, and also WiFi (although a bit slow). Free breakfast in the mornings. The toilets and showers were possibly the best I've seen in a hostel.

However... The room and beds were TERRIBLE. Squeakiest things I've ever come across, either with barely enough wooden planks or awful quality springs under the mattresses. Every time anyone moved or rolled over it'd wake me up, and I'm a heavy sleeper. My friends i was with also agreed. The room was cramped and smelly. The walls creaked constantly.

Unfortunately, the good facilities and friendly staff definitely didn't compensate for such a poor night's sleep.

title: Great place for a good price
text:
II spent two nights in Hamilton upon my arrival in New Zealand and found Central Backpackers Hamilton to be one of the better backpackers I´ve been to. The rooms, common room and bathrooms were clean, they have a laundry where the two washers are free to use(!) (dryers cost 2 dollars) and my room had a fridge and a tv in it, along with a comfortable bed.

It´s run by a family and they were really friendly and professional, I immediately liked them.

Location is perfect, easy to find (very green building), plenty of free parking in the back lot for those of us with a car and 2 minute walk from Pak´n Save should you need supplies.

The only downside would have to be that the rooms get a bit warm in summer, but even my intolerance for sleeping in warm spaces wasn´t bothered here, so it can´t have been that bad ;-) The manager leaves the backdoor open to make a draft during the day and that helps a lot.

Definitely a place I´d come back to if going to Hamilton.

title: Cosy like home
text: Dorm room is small but sheet is quite clean. Bathroom is OK. I like the big kitchen, clean and tidy. Free wifi with limited usage. 15 minutes walking to downtown, but there is a bus stop of free shuttle bus nearby. Packnsave supermarket is within walking. I am glad to stay here.

title: Average backpacker accommodation
text: Not great value for money. The staff are friendly but a bit unorganised. There is limited parking at the back so if you stay out late expect to park on the street and get up early to pay the parking meter. Walls are paper thin and rooms are very basic for the price we paid - NZD80 for a double room without ensuite.

title: Friendly but dirty
text:
Stayed here for a couple of weeks and was appalled to notice the lack of cleanliness in this place. On weekends a number of stag/hen night guests would come in and when they left the room would be in a state that any reasonable person would expect. What I did not expect was to discover that the sheets were changed but the duvets were just moved from one bed to another! In the many weeks I was there they were not washed once! If you're ever unfortunate enough to be placed in the dorm upstairs in the lodge area be mindful of the dirt in the carpeting as that wasn't vacuumed while I was there if I didn't do it.
The manager is friendly and helpful, great attitude!

title: Good, clean place to rest.
text:
The hostel itself has the feeling of security and comfort. It is not a hostel for partying as we were told Alcohol and drugs are strictly forbidden. The rooms are nicely laid out, clean carpets, clean sheets, clean bathrooms. All rooms have a keycard access system and there are plenty of video cameras around. 

One of the staff helped us plan the next few stops in our journey providing plenty of detailed information about food spots in Rotorua.

The location is fantastic though. It's within walking district of the CBD where there are plenty of restaurants, bars, and activities. I would highly recommend staying here, great value for money.

title: Cheap, Clean, Convenient
text: In my experience you rarely come across a hostel where everything works and is clean. This hostel is the exception. I was almost bummed I was only staying one night because the place was so nice. Clean and working bathroom and kitchen and the beds were comfortable. Convenient location on the free shuttle line and a short walk to the bus terminal, couldn't ask for more.

title: Highly recommendable
text: I was extremely happy after a tiring day of travelling to stumble across the Backpackers Central in Hamilton.  The staff made me feel very welcome, and they cheerfully helped me out with all my needs.  I had a single room with a private bath.  It was affordable and clean.  I also liked the common area, which was very comfortable and bright.  The free internet coupons I received were measured by data transmission.  It was enough for email correspondence.  The Backpackers is in a central location, and a lot of things are in walking distance.   When I left I was treated like a friend.   I would definitely go back there in the future.  I highly recommend this place.

title: Cheap, clean and friendly!

Still, I'd gladly recommend this place to anyone!:)

title: Clean, tidy, great price, I'll be back!!!
text:

The host and staff are all very pleasent and helpful, I turned up early in the day and they were happy to let me have my room right away with not complaints or fuss. 

The kitchen was clean and well stocked with any equipment you might need along with a very large flat screen tv and a large selection on books and games. 

I stayed in the new wing and the room was clean, tidy, spacious,and secure.  It also had a tv  an ensuit at an extremely affordable price. 

Give it a go for yourself you won't be dissapointed :) I wasn't.

title: What a fantastic place to stay
text:
We have just returned from a 10 day holiday in NZ. Our overnight stays were a mix of hotels,motels and B&B's.They all had plusses and minuses, but we write in relationship to just one. Bubble Lodge in Cambridge. Our stay here for two nights was exceptional!
We thought we had contracted for B&B only. Quite wrong! Our host David, after a coffee, insisted that he act as chauffeur so we spent the next hour or so learning about the delights of Cambridge. Our next surprise was that both Margie and Dave became our personal tour advisors and gave us expert advice on what would be good for us and virtually planned our entire onward trip including booking our motel in Coromandel.
Their home and hospitality was a delight and we very much hope to meet them again in the future as friends.  Kindest regards, Kirsten and John.
hotel_response: Thank you very much for your kind comments. We love helping people get the best holiday in our country, that's why we enjoy being B&B hosts.

Close to travel to the zoo, gardens, Waitomo Caves etc. Would highly recommend and look forward to coming back.

We will definitely come back when we're in the area again.
Highly recommended.

title: Dingy and undesirable - not worthy of 3 stars
text: A frightening experience! This Motel is being used for Emergency Accommodation which wasn't mentioned. There was lots of shouting and cursing.  They appear to be double dipping government funds. Dingy

title: Motel needs a complete makeover
text:
Friendly staff but the motel needs a complete make over. The price is way too much for the standard of the rooms. 
- Stains & marks on carpet 
- There was hair on the floor & in bath in the bathroom. I don’t think it had actually been cleaned.
- Brown water came out of tap
- Bathroom sink had brown stains all through it 
- We both got a sore back from the bed
- There was tea etc & milk which was great 
Overall, they shouldn’t be charging $130 a night for this standard of room. Wow.

title: Beware of being eaten alive
text: I have stayed at this motel years ago. They properly has dated since without being revamped. The room gave the impression of cleanness. The bed was comfy but the spa had to be filled from shower as couldn't get to come out of tap and room filled with steam, but was lovely to soak on. The morning I was to leave pulled back the covers to find blood spots on sheets and pillow, found bug jumping around on bed. I told staff they laughed and said they must have jumped through the windows. Not good enough, I won't stay there again

title: Absolutely terrible
text: Absolutely terrible. The room was dated, the bed very uncomfortable, to get to the shower you have to climb in and out of a huge spa bath which is slippery when wet, burn marks in the sink, broken bin, cigarette filters in the random hole in the bathroom furniture, stained toilet, and the room had an overpowering smell of air freshener which I guess was to cover cigarette smoke. The smell was so strong I couldn’t stand it and slept in my colleague’s room in the end. The noise from the neighbours spa bath late at night was only overshadowed by screaming children, people shouting and banging doors all night. Parking was crowded. I have travelled extensively over the years and this was hands down the worst place I have ever stayed, I can’t believe they charge $253 for one of these rooms!

title: Deceiving appearance
text: Phone booking for a room with disabilty shower.  The clerk wanted payment up front, instructions to the room wasn't clear.  Room nice two beds, double and single, soft mattresses meant poor sleep.  The tiled bathroom with disabilty shower had no seat, evidence of one being there and plastic mat. Tiles were dangerously slippery when wet, a two piece curtain didn't prevent water spraying to the vanity opposite. The vanity basin had no plug.  An aside the grout in the tiled bathroom dirty. A sign in bathroom said for clean towels on the shower floor, we had to go to reception for towels, housekeeping there wasn't. Alcamo booklet says renovations underway as restaurant/bar closed, thus wasn't made clear when booking.

title: Comfy just tired
text: We enjoyed our stay. Overall feel was tired but clean. Pool was clean and well kept. Kids enjoyed their chilly dip. Clearly used for emergency accomodation but everyone was friendly. Beds exceptionally comfortable and staff friendly. Nice and quiet. We enjoyed our stay.

title: Inspect before you book!
text:
Horrible condition for the money we paid.
I woild never revisit. The furnishings in the "deluxe" room look like they haven't been changed or maintained in many years.

There was no heat pump like the photos and an old bar refrigerator which runs loud so you have to turn it off to sleep at night. There is no extractor fan in the dirty bathroom and light fixtures sit loose in the ceiling covered in cobwebs.

The carpet and beds are the only positive mark for this room.

I highly suggest you look at a to prior to booking here. The photos on their advertisements are completely inaccurate of this tired run down hotel operating on the cheap.

I will never revisit

title: I was expecting g the worst.
text: Having read the Trip Advisor reviews I was expecting the worst. It was the last decently priced motel in Hamilton and there were no refurbed rooms left. BUT on the upside it was clean and very very quiet right at the back of the motel. The room itself was like stepping back to the 80’s. You could almost make a feature of it. But it is pretty tatty; fridge and wardrobe doors are pretty wonky and the toilet seat needs replacing. The hairdryer is a real novelty, so is the beside-the-bed control panel, and the enormous round spa bath also a novelty. More like a spa pool really. The shower head is wonky but the shower itself has great pressure. The room and bathroom are very spacious and the bottled water a nice touch. Check-in was good too. Overall I think $150 is too much, but it was clean and we had a laugh and a good nights sleep.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review. We are gradually doing up the rooms and we have completed about half. The rate is determined by the market and the city had been full for ten days due to the Maadi Cup (rowing) and the Super Rugby.

title: Not good
text: wasn't at all the like the pictures...wasnt what was described...was cold...the door to balcony wouldn't lock and the breeze through it was harsh...lack of sugars etc..had to buy our own...the bath took skin off leg as its like sandpaper on the bottom...will not be using this place again...nor recommending it to anyone...

title: Not as bad as people say!
text: We stayed in the Alcamo for 3 nights. It was clean which was the main thing for us. Would recommend for people travelling the country wanting somewhere cheap and not expecting a lot. As it was very basic and run down.

title: DISGUSTING BEWARE
text: My family and I booked 4 separate rooms, first impressions when walking into our rooms were dirty, dusty and looked out dated and not cleaned very well. No sky, no phone,3 spa baths broken out of the 4, toilet not clean, dust all over the one chair that was in our room, old rubbish from previous stayers under the beds I could go on. After our day out Saturday and coming back to shower and sleep we had all asked for our rooms to be made up and cleaned. We walked to our room to see our door left wide open with door stop under the door and someone had used the toilet leaving their business (urine) in the bowl. Wine cork rubbish sitting at the entry, beds not made properly carpet not vacuumed and bathroom not clean. All 4 rooms weren't cleaned or beds made. We will never stay there again as we talked to management and they refused to give any refund and tried to make excuses instead of fixing and apologizing for their cleaners lack of cleaning.They eventually remade and cleaned all rooms but what kind of a motel do they think they're running. Dont bother using the free wifi its signal barely loads fb. Outdoor smoking area looks as if it hasnt been tidied in months. Spend a little extra and stay somewhere else.

title: Don't recommend at ALL!.....
text:
Good grief! This place is unbelievable. Firstly, I had used Expedia (yeah,I know, bad move - never again). Had requested ground floor unit away from traffic. Person checking me in had not been advised of this by Expedia, but did find me a ground floor unit.
The corridors smelled incredibly musty, with carpet looking very dirty & wrinkled (a H&S issue). The room? Stifling hot, only 2 small windows that had security locks hence could only open a small amount. Manager brought me a pedestal fan. No milk, hotel compendium, A/Con, or phone, hairdryer in bathroom broken, no microwave, beds unbelievably 'lumpy' & I checked the mattress- severely stained! The webbing underneath was actually hanging down towards the floor & there was a cake of soap lying there also. Holes in the walls, paint peeling badly and worst of all, directly above the shower head the downlight was 'open' so I could see into the roof cavity & the bare bulb. Again a H&S issue with water so close. I had visions of a mouse coming down (- or worse) during the night. This was a wet floor shower but the shower head was angled so most of the room was covered in water, including in front of the toilet (so wet feet). But the room was clean enough & the white bed coverings (sheets) were spotless, and an excellent pillow (down/feather). (had 4 pillows, all different, but this one was great). I would have given this hotel a zero if it hadn't been for the Manager & his family who were very helpful & very friendly. I felt very sorry for them really, and the actual owners should be ASHAMED of themselves allowing this place to deteriorate so badly. Spend some of that money you're making from this hotel on refurbishment!!!! Hell, even fixing the walls & repainting the walls would help! (I had stayed here previously years ago when it was relatively new). Until I retired, I travelled extensively in my career, both domestic & international, and this would be the worst I have stayed in. Don't go there is my advice.......

title: Not clean - left with 24hr Vomiting
text: This place is not looked after. Pretty sure we caught a bug from the pool. Non smoking rooms had been smoked in. Long black hairs all over bathroom floor. Tobacco remnants on bedside table. Pool area never swept. Weeds & cigarette butts. Window locks loose & in some cases gone & replaced with chains... need I say more. Oh upon booking over the phone I had to chase confirmation email, twice, when it arrived they had booked me on wrong dates... I have changed Hotel name to "in-adequate hotel"

title: Never again
text:
This place was absolutely horrible! It gave off a dirty feel throughout the entire complex. 

The bathroom was horrible and outdated. There were cobwebs in the corners of the room. Something had obviously been spilt on the lopsided table in the room and the drops down the wall had not been cleaned up. 

The cleaning lady I spoke to was absolutely lovely but the receptionist on checkout was rude and unwelcoming. 

Will not be staying here again or even remotely recommending this place to anyone!

title:
OUTDATED, RUN DOWN & EXPENSIVE
NOT RECOMMENDED..
text:
Highly disappointed in this motel. When it was raining there were leaking coming through the lights.
Pool was not very clean.
Staff are highly rude and  it very accommodating.
Spa bath jets DO NOT work when you pay for spa unit.
Very old run down units
Rooms are not always cleaned nor is rubbish removed.
T.Vs are very small 17" tv's and always losing signal.
WIFI is horrible ( very low signal or no signal at all )
NO phones in room for emergencies or anything. 
Pillows & Linen were outdated & very used.
Old style building & rooms.

I would not recommend this place to stay for children or a get away weekend for a couple.

title: Outdated but comfortable
text:
We stayed here overnight & although it's very outdated it was certainly comfortable & clean.

Spa bath didn't function as a spa but made for an amazingly spacious bath which we throughly enjoyed.
Outdoor pool looked clean and well kept but unfortunately for us we were far to tired from travelling to make us of it however if we had time we most certainly would have!

Beds were comfortable & room was clean and tidy.

Although very close to town there was next to no street noise which was great as we had been travelling since 5am and needed some rest.

Staff were great and overall we enjoyed our short stay and found it to be great value.

title: Absolutely disgusting
text:
Checked in late afternoon, decided to have a nap before supper. Felt itchy, but thought it was just the bedcover. WRONG, BED BUGS ... all of differing sizes! 
Photos and video taken, collected some in a glass, to show the receptionist, and left. We were offered another room but declined and received a full refund. Staff told us they had recurring problems with bed bugs in that room. We will never return.

title: Disgusting!
text: Our room is absolutely disgusting!! Carpet looks and smells so disgusting!! There is carpet in the kitchen which is gross!! Bathroom has a very musty smell as though it has never been cleaned!! The lounge sofa is DISGUSTING!! Old, stained, ripped and yuck!! Beds are old and gross. Microwave was dirty, ants crawling all over the kitchen bench, spiders up on the ceilings. Very old, stink room. Disgusting..... Oh and the receptionist isnt very nice either....

title: Good value for money
text:
Stayed here for just one night, and very comfortable.
15 minute wAlk to the free city circuit bus into town centre
Comfy beds, clean rooms, great water.pressure in the shower, friendly staff. 
Would stay here again

title: Clean but tired
text:
The room was very clean and room but very dated, it was like stepping back into the 80s. The mattress on the bed sagged in the middle so we had to work hard not to slide into each other while we were sleeping.

However we were very appreciative of the suggestions for dinner. We were exhausted and able to order in the night we stayed there. I think the staff deserve recognition for doing a great job with what is there.

title: Mr
text: The worst motel I’ve ever been in. Very tired with paint peeling, tiles missing and plain dirty. Shared my room with a colony of ants and whilst we were booked for multiple nights abandoned ship after only one night. This place is terrible and should be avoided

title: From bad to worse
text: The elderly gentleman at reception was very friendly but he was the only good thing about our stay at Alcamo. The light in out first room hummed very loudly, after we complained and we were promptly moved to another unit. The unit we were moved to was terrible. Wallpaper peeling off everywhere, holes and dents in the roof and walls, the spa tap and jets didn't work, the air-con didn't work, the beds were far too soft, no Sky and the restaurant no longer operated despite being advertised. It was very noisy with people coming and going all night and the place stunk of alcohol in the morning. This place is horrible and way overpriced, do not waste your money.

title: Would have been great in it's time
text: Very worn motel.  Looks great in pics but room was beat up.  The spa would be no good with someone with joint issues as its a climb to get in (shower is in it).  It's just old.  Must have been flash in its era.  Wouldn't recommend - am sure there must be something better available in this price range.

title: Cheap and not good
text:
Needed to find somewhere to stay quickly that wasn’t too expensive and was near the cbd. It quickly became apparent why this place is cheap. 
I dropped my bag off early in the day before I could check in, so I didn’t have to lug it about. The person at the desk just told me to place it down beside the counter (in a place where he couldn’t see it). When we came to check in, my bag was still in the same place. There was a different person behind the counter and when I said that was my bag, his response was “I wondered who’s that was”. I’m very surprised my bag wasn’t taken during the day!
Going to the room, although it was a non-smoking, it smelt of smoke badly. The carpet in the room was rotting. The spa bath didn’t work. The bed was ok, but only 1 thin pillow to sleep on. 
Only positive is that it isn’t too far from town. However there must be better places to choose that are just as close and not that much more expensive.

title: Poor old place
text: A moldy smell greets you and everything is really old and somewhat falling apart. Only thing keeping this place going must be location. We should have checked the review before booking but were tired from travelling.

title: Night Trip
text: It is algood for a basic stay. It has comfortable Beds and good space. Reception was friendly and has a spa bath and shower in one. It has a swimming pool and free WiFi. It is on the main road but really quite we stayed in room 22 which is at the back and we heard no traffic

title: Acalmo motel avoid it
text: We had the keys in the morning. When we arrived at 8h30 the acces card was not working. We had to call a phone nbr as reception was closed. A very rough old guy, was trying to explain me to use my key on the corridor door, like I should know that place like my pocket. Finally he came, using is own card showing it was working. I had to put mine to show him it was faulty. He told me he was comming from Cambridge and I should be happy to have that sorted ???
hotel_response: Thank you for your response. Sorry to hear about your dilemma. This does occasionally happen and we are sorry this ruined your experience.

title: 25 year revisit
text: The staff are super friendly and helpful and went to great effort to decorate our room after we explained we were revisiting the motel we spent our wedding night in. However the rooms are run down and sadly past their best. The complex was noisy with people coming and going late into the night. The restaurant was long gone but still signposted and the sprinkler head was wrapped in gladwrap!

title: Great stafd
text:
The staff were a great help when the room was not fit for a young family, I was shown a studio unit that was not perfect but much better than the first unit we were booked in.
Cheaper units have been left in the 1980's, recommended you pay a bit more and book a studio unit when staying here.

The free wifi only works in places, so check you room before settling in.

title: More quality professionalism and service needed
text: I would not recommend this motel even at the cheap rates until they start looking after their customers and upgrade their facilities. Do not get me wrong, it was not a terrible place, It just was not pleasant either. I got a room that apparently was just cleaned, but I could not rest from my long trip as the disinfectant smell was so strong. When I mentioned this to the attendant, he said he would do something about it. but he took nearly an hour, and I had to question him in the hallway about it before something would be done quicker. I ended up moving to another room and the sleep was better. I suggest more professionalism in quality cleaning and service. I wish them the best in the future,  but would not go back.

title: Disappointed
text: I liked the sound of this hotel but for a family doesn't suit no bench space, no smokes alarms anywhere in the room, tiny tv no sky, if you plan to stay don't bring your kids come with alone or with a person likely to get a better experience here thanks.

title: overpriced and broken down dirty hotel
text: This would be one of the worst hotels I have ever stayed in.  The price was $139 though they advertised $99.  The spa bath didn't work and the next day we got told we had to pay more to use it, even though we did pay higher than usual.  The lights in the hall didn't work which made it difficult to try and unlock your room at night.  The room was filthy and the bed rolled together in the middle.  When I went to have a shower in the morning it wouldn't work.  We told the manager and he just said "why didn't you come and tell me", This is just something you don't think about.  There was no offer of compensation either another words tough luck.  We should have read the reviews as they are all the same. Advertised free internet but didn't have any.

title: Refurbishing long overdue
text:
Simply this place is falling apart. After trying several rooms and several beds in each room, we concluded that they are from mediocre to terrible and none are confortable. Mattress are flat, soft and very tired. pillows too soft, and two people are falling on each other and suffocating in the pillows. Bathroom are either equipped with these old out of fashion huge round bubble bath (quite difficult to jump in) or hospital paraplegic bathroom. Both are complete nonsense. Decoration is mediocre or inexistant, starting with a sloppy one coat of white paint over a previously green wall, evidently an amateur job with poor result. In spite of what is advertised in the Web Site and on the panel outside the motel, Wi-Fi is a permanent problem. half of the hotel room (those across the corridor) simply do not have any signal at all. Reception is unable to help, simply indicating that the person in charge of the internet connection is a computer enthousiast while a computer professional is required. Parking is uneasy in spite of being a Motel where cars are expected. There is no view from neither of the 4 rooms we tried. The swimming pool is small, not heated and the pool beach is only furnished with 3 small tables and no chair. There is only one long chair for the whole Motel. Smell is terrible in most part of the hotel, and particularly in the corridors. Understanding that we were unhappy and prepared to go elsewhere, the manager was trrying to make us pay immediately while the documentation available in the room clearly indicate that providing we leave a visa card print, which we did we can pay at check out.
I am desperatly looking for something positive to say about this place but it is really hard. Probably the staff are to be congratulated for being able to work in these conditions. It must be tough for them to try and provide a decent service in a place that is no longer designed to do so. 
This place should be closed, totally refurbished from top to bottom and reopen when able to fubction normally, in the meantime whatever the price (from 99 to 160 NZ$ for a double room) it is no good value.
hotel_response:
thank you for your feed back.
this hotel has recently come under new management and is being refurbished in stages.
unfortunately when you booked there was not much choice available as the accommodation was near capacity. therefore while we tried to do our best for you but were not able to offer you the best due to ongoing renovation work in progress.
we have taken note of your concerns constructively and these changes are already on the cards.
we regret any inconvenience caused.

title: Average
text:
We stayed here on labour weekend while attending a wedding.  The bed in our unit (room 23) was awful.  It was clearly very old because it was uncomfortable and had roll-together.  I've never experienced roll-together in a hotel bed previously.

This unit is not suitable for anyone who isn't fairly nimble as it's a mission climbing in and out of the spa bath to take a shower - particularly climbing out when you're wet.

The rooms would have been extremely fashionable in the 1970s or early 1980s.  Not much has been updated with the decor ever since.

Room 23 is in a handy location on the bottom floor for getting in and out to the car park.

title: Most disgusting place to ruin your experience
text:
I had a quick look which was $120 a night, paid before check in.  When checked in room was smelly, mouldy and linen was disgusting. I had sick child with me so I checked with manager if they have any other better  room. He showed me another room which was disgusting.  Corridor was stinking of cigratte smell.  So we decided to leave.  Manager charged us $50 for staying 10 minutes in that room.  We didn't use a thing in the room.  Still we got charged $50. 
Very unprofessional and rude staff.   
Not recommended at all.  This place is complete waste of money.

title: Stay somewhere else
text: I wished we'd viewed the hotel before booking in.  Its dated and needs a huge overhaul, actually maybe demolished. Massive stains on the carpet, lumpy beds, air conditioning unit that made a noise but nothing much else and a spa bath unit that was disconnected. I couldn't wait to leave in the morning.

title: Good for an overnighter
text: Checked in last Thursday 18th Aug at around 5pm, Reception lady friendly enough. Booked the 2x bedroom apartment at good rate discussed prior to booking and the room was certainly worth it. Full kitchenette with limited cooking resources however done the trick and managed to cook ourselves a good feed of steak etc. A back door would have been ideal for the smokers in our group although just a minor issue. Left reasonably early so didn't get to say goodbye but thanks Alcamo, will stay here again when in Hamilton next.

title: Very neat hotel with helpful staff
text: We stayed here overnight on our trip south. For this price we were amazed by the luxury of the room. Big comfortable beds, big bath, all the kitchenary you need as a basis and very helpful staff. Definitely recommendable.

title: Older Establishment with pool and Restaurant
text: Furnishings are very dated. Price good if get $99.00 rooms advertised. Pool is lovely. The Management is very helpful. Location excellent for walking to most places. Pak n'save supermarket near by and pro drive driving range golf across the road. It is surrounded by other motels and hotels near Rugby Park for chiefs games. If you are looking for flash or trendy this is not for you. More suitable for travellers on a cheaper budget of families.

title: We loved our stay
text: We let our 4 children decide on our way into the city where they wanted to stay and we're glad they chose here! The owner's son greeted us, he was very friendly and accommodating. Our room was spacious, clean and comfortable, we all loved it. The kids had a swim in the pool which was great. We will definitely stay there again.

title: family Hotel
text: The best motel I've ever been to. The staff where very helpful in so many ways the owner was one of the best. It's close to buses and supermarkets and golf drive and just a walk away from the  centre of Hamilton shopping.

title: elegance
text:
i have been reading the previous reviews and i must admit that had i seen these i would have chosen another place to stay.... luckily for my husband and i i hadnt.
the room we were checked into have a giant private spa and the bed was plush and CLEAN. 
i was happy to find that the owner was actually friendly and not like the grumpy type u seem to encounter at privately owned places.
we dont go to hamilton often but if we do again i will be going back.

title: Dirty & Old.
text: We drove in from the street, the sign said rooms from $99. When my husband went into reception to inquire, he was told that there were no rooms left at that price, but they could give us the best room for $120. The room was very dated, as was the rest of the place. First thing we were told was to put on the little fan heater, even though there was a air con unit on the wall...obviously didn't work. The bed looked clean & tidy. We went out for dinner & when we arrived back, I decided to have a shower. The shower was above a huge spa bath that was so deep, you basically needed a step ladder to get in & out of. The old tiles in the bathroom were very mouldy & dirty. The toilet wobbled when you sat on it. When I turned down the covers & sheet on the bed, the bottom sheet was all crumpled, like someone had been laying in it & there were at least 3 dark hairs on the white sheet. We decided to sleep on the top sheet as that looked clean. In the morning, upon opening the curtains, I noticed that 1 of the leather arm chairs had a white, glue looking mark on the seat ...yuck. We packed our gear up & went to reception with our complaints. We were told that we should have called them straight away & they got very defensive. The old guy told us that they would have been clean sheets & will we be back...we both replied in together...NEVER. We have travelled all around the World & never come across anything like this. Guess we had to come home to experience it.

title: Poor motel
text: The decor is dated, there were broken things in the room including a broken heated towel rail and broken window clasp. I had to walk quite a way to my room in the rain and could not find anywhere to park. in the end I got a car park but then got jammed in in the morning when I went to leave. The furniture was stained as was the carpet. I had asked for a refurbished room but am hoping this wasnt it! Really disappointed in the standard of accomodation.

title: YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED....STAY AWAY
text:
Booked a   "Two bedroom Delux"   through Travel Bug and my credit card charged.
Got a call from motel to say they had double booked.  I asked them to sort the problem. 
I received a call to say a "permanent tenant" would be gone by June so problem solved. 
I emailed the motel at the end of April to confirm our June booking.
 I received an email saying we had to pay an extra $40 for a family room or we could go into a one bedroom at no extra costs. 
I phoned the motel and as there were 3 adults I declined the one bedroom unit .
We agreed to two seperate units. I was told these were beside each other being units 42 and 43. I was asked to pay the additional $130 of which I did and this was charged to the credit card.  Sorted...NOT.
Arrived and were directed to our unit?  Unit NOT units !!
What we were given was a disgustingly filthy old rundown unit so called the "family Unit"... Unit 12 so be aware. 
At this point I made the staff aware of my disappointment and explained that I would speak to the owner when they were available. 
I spoke to the owner the next night and explained my disappointment and asked for a refund on the extra that we had paid for the two units. 
He flatly refused. He said that we ere in a family unit that was worth more than what we had paid. Really, in that state I would not even make it rentable. 
I explained this is not what we had asked and paid for so it was not my fault.  
He acknowledged his mistake and tried to get us to eat burgers in the dining room. We declined this as we were not in the mood for burgers in the dark outdated dining room.
Staff said that this has happened before and they even said he needed to honour what he advertised. The reply was I have rates to pay. 
A long story short he argued and argued until we walked away without our refund. He also stared to get personal with his comments. 
So at this point we paid an extra $90 which should bed refunded.SHAME ON YOU ALCAMO!!!!
Now to the unit. Gross filthy carpet and sofas. 
Small as TV hidden under the stairs
No wifi connection in our unit
Bathroom old and mouldy
Shower door was broken so a shower curtain was hung inside the shower which was so mouldy 
First motel that I have been in and run out of toilet paper 
The toilet and bathroom had a window with a broken latch which opened into the 3rd bedroom
Towels thin and the shower walls were rotting off
The 3rd bedroom consisted of a single bed and broken heater
The door to this room had broken glass so had been boarded up and was coming apart
Bedroom 2 consisted of a double bed
Mouldy and ripped curtains holes in the wall
A roller door that just slid right off
No furniture lamps etc
Bedroom one on the mezzanine had a very old uncomfortable bed
Bed positioned 6" out from the wall to accomodate the 3 point plug
Old built in radio?? Not sure what it was beside the bed
A heater above your pillows... Looked to dangerous to turn on
The light for this room was at the bottom of the very steep narrow dangerous stairs
Cups etc very basic, no wine glasses
Overall this unit needs a total makeover. 
I just can not fathom out how as a customer we paid for a two bedroom Delux and then paid an extra $130 more for two units and ended up in a dog kennel. As that's all it was fit for. 
I am sure if the owner ordered and paid for a BMW and a Honda was delivered he might be slightly annoyed. 
Come on Alcamo play honest. I have your email that states $40 extra for the family room Not $130.  And especially after you admitted your mistake.

title: Tired out and no resting place
text: We stayed at this motel recently, arriving very late afternoon weary after a long drive, so the viewing of our room was cursory, but after having dined out and getting back found to our dismay that the room was very well below  ours, or anybody's for that matter, expectations - the bathroom had certainly seen better days, wide cracks in between tiles by toilet, most unsightly and unhealthy for that matter, light over bath/shower didn't work, a hard crusting of some sort lying in bottom of toilet, towels were thin and musty.  Carpet in main room very stained, as were the chairs.  The reputed tv channels were non-existent. The light fitting in the entry hanging down, not secured to ceiling.  Poor quality bedding including pillows and mattress.  Were quick to vacate the room at first light next morning.  The tariff of $110 was not commensurate with the room.  Although the men at the front desk were very welcoming and helpful, that didn't compensate for the state of the room.  The new owner needs to update and totally refurbish the rooms in the annex where our room was, in order to qualify the prices being charged. Also the free Wi-Fi was a mission to access and when finally did, was advised by the wifi site that had to pay.
hotel_response:
we are very sorry that you had an unpleasant experience staying with us recently,                             however,
our room rate of $110 is for budget accommodation- there for the prices reflect the quality of the rooms.
we have 56 rooms in total and have done refurbishment to all but 4 which unfortunately seems to be a room which you have stayed in.       we would love to have you stay with us again to give us the opportunity to make your stay relaxing and comfortable.

title: So bad but nice people
text: This place is so bad I don't know where to start its run down, there is a outdoor Windows I  the bathroom going to a bedroom, the sliding door is broken, hasn't been painted I  I don't know how long and to top it all off everything was frozen in the fridge in the morning so couldnt have my coffee and the long life milk was off.  So glad we are only staying the one night!!!!!!! ONLY SAY HERE IF YOU HAVE TO!!!!!!!
hotel_response:
we are sorry to hear you were unhappy with your stay with us .

title: Great service, great value

title: Loved it!
text:
I've stayed in this motel 3 times in the past year and it was always great!
Managers behind the desk are always friendly and very helpful. Plenty of off-street parking.
I am a solo female traveler, so really appreciate double security: hallway has a security door accessible only with a valid room key, so no one who doesn't belong can get to your room door.
Rooms are truly very spacious: queen bed, couch,coffee table, not one, but 2 desks (so I had plenty of work space for my computer,notes,diary,etc) and still plenty of room to move around freely. There was also a balcony with table and chairs (individual for each room).
Jacuzzi tab deserves a special mention: HUGE. There is also a shower for those who prefer and it has great water pressure and gets hot in no time at all.
Bedside table has controls for lights in the room and build-in radio-you don't need to get out of bed to switch them on and off.
Super clean everything and new linen.
Decor is a bit dated, but I travel a lot all over New Zealand and you will be hard-pressed to find a truly modern motel: they are very,very few. Besides, cleanliness is way more important to me than aesthetics.
Restaurant on the premises is not always open, but I am a foodiw and much prefer sampling the many restaurants Hamilton has to offer, as the motel located just a short walk from CBD.
This trip I noted brand new heat pumps w/remote control installed in the rooms-fab!
I will definitely stay there again on my next trip to Hamilton.

title: Avoid this hotel.
text:
On arrival shown to a room overwhelmingly smelling of smoke. Very dated furnishings from the 70's. Bed linen not overly clean. Hair (not mine) amongst the covers. Pillow slips had smears of what looked like black grease stains. Spa broken. TV reception terrible. Unable to fill kettle as too large for basin. Again spa broken so unable to fill over bath. Was told by management to use a cup to fill. demanded another room but the decor was the same and the ceiling in bathroom badly water damaged. Looked like it would cave in. Bed uncomfortable and only one blanket provided. Pillows were like rocks.  Very cheap and nasty. Needs lots of upgrading. 
Original personnel on duty at checkin was hopeless. Fortunately replaced by a lovely man who tried his best to make things right. He had little to work with however. 
My advice is to steer clear of this one. Does not deserve its star rating. 
Bad experience altogether.

title: Good value
text:

title: Cochroaches in the bed!!!!

text: Needing somewhere decent to stay for a week long business trip my colleague booked myself and my partner in at the Country Comfort Alcamo. She had heard good things about the place. text: Paid 140 a night for a double room with a spa. thought I had stepped back in time to the 70's.  Yuck. outdated tv, linen, radio , even the walls were lime green. title: Great service from generous friendly staff in hotel AND restaurant !!
text: Lovely room and situation with on-site restaurant serving the best steak ever !! .... The little generous touches from the friendly staff made the stay more special.

title: Arrgghhh!
text:
We stayed at the Alcamo on a Friday night, having booked through the Wotif website. Our main objective was to have a quiet night in a comfortable bed.

The first room we were given had not been made up, as we found when we opened the door, so we were given another. The replacement room seemed ok if a little tired looking, but when we returned from visiting family that night, we found that half the room lighting didn't work, the bedspread was very stained and the bedding extremely worn and old. My partner felt that he would rather leave the cover on the floor than have it near him, so we had rather a chilly night. The spa bath, which we had been looking forward to after a long trip, didn't appear to work properly. No instructions were provided for its operation.

On the up side, the room was very quiet, given the Ulster Street location. This may have been in part because there were very few guests.

I have worked in the travel industry writing website copy and photographing hotels and motels for the web, so have a good working knowledge of quality and pricing. I didn't feel that the listed normal price of $180 was a realistic indicator of quality; the $89 'bargain price' we did pay was much more reflective of the room's general condition. Definitely not a good room at a great price.

Because of the state of the bedding, I would not return to this hotel in any circumstances.

title: This is not the place it used to be!!! :(
text: The hotel also know as Country Comfort Alcamo Hotel has been taken over by new owners apparently 4 years ago. The place is run down (once Hamilton's pride and joy), and not particularly clean in either the restaurant or room. The stains around the base of the toilet pan were off putting to say the least. The place is tired and in need of a major make-over - bring in the Hotel Inspector. title: Awful Stay
text:
I have been traveling all over the world for almost a year and a half straight, and this was by far the worst stay I have had anyplace in the world! 

First, there was absolutely NO VALUE for the money. Reception told me that I would be in a very nice room, when I asked if the room was modern with clean facilities. Well, there was absolutely no way to take a shower without the whole bathroom floor completely flooding, the tub was not clean, the heat lamp in the bathroom did not work, and I could not blow dry my hair since you can't use an electrical appliance while standing in a puddle of water.

Also, the furniture and bed were abominations. The counter tops were all filthy and burned by cigarette butts, and the bed was extremely soft and uncomfortable. And, there was a very small heating unit that was not sufficient to warm the room. 

The worst part of my stay, though, was dealing with the insulting manager who hates Americans. When I very respectfully brought the room's faults to his attention, upon check out, he asked me if I was looking for a free night because he always has this problem with Americans -that they always complain to try to get a discount! This problem had nothing to do with WHO stayed in the room, but THE ROOM, itself. No one, at any accommodation, any place in the world, should have to put up with a flooded bathroom, and then be expected to just happily pay the bill without mentioning it. I thought that management would be happy to know about the problem so that they could try to rectify it, but I was just insulted, instead, without any concern, at all,  from the manager as to the fact that it was an unpleasant stay due to the room's faults.

As a an avid traveler, I know to expect the occassional problem with accommodations, but I will never expect, nor accept, insults from the management because I choose to mention the problem. Stay away!
