title: 5-Star Service & Room Freedom in a Hotel with 4-Star Logistics and a 3-Star Shell
text:
We recently stayed in Room 425 (the corner room suite) and experienced a blend of top-tier hospitality, thoughtful amenities, and a few operational hiccups that brought the rating down to four stars.

Service:
The service was truly outstanding. A loud disturbance from Room 422 at 1:30am on Saturday (21 June 2025) was dealt with promptly by staff after I lodged a noise complaint—turning a disruptive situation into a positive reflection of the hotel's responsiveness.

On the Thursday evening before Mātāriki, the restaurant staff kindly let us enjoy the Mātāriki dinner special using our prepaid dinner package. The spare ribs entrée from the regular menu was especially good, and it was appreciated that we could take the complimentary bottled tap water back to our room.

Housekeeping maintained an exceptional standard throughout our stay. One of the biggest highlights was the room’s A/V flexibility, we brought our own streaming device, and were delighted that HDMI inputs were unlocked, allowing us to project content across both in-room TV's and giving us great access to our own lighting routines (using our own lights). 

We were also grateful for the complimentary one-hour late checkout—thank you.

Logistics (4-Star):
However, a few logistical issues stood out. The lack of transparency regarding the hotel bond was frustrating. It would be helpful if this was clearly stated on the website, rather than discovered upon arrival. If it’s intended to encourage on-site purchases, well, it certainly worked.

On Mātāriki morning, I attempted to step out into the courtyard between 10–11am, but the door was locked. With the lifts overwhelmed by departing guests and no stair access to reception, we were left waiting unnecessarily.

Also, a quick note, the spa pool near the InBalance centre seems to have mysteriously disappeared. Last seen in 2020–2021, the staff have no knowledge of it's disappearance. 

The Building (3-Star):
While the service shines, the building is starting to show its age. The carpets feel worn, the window seals may need checking, and the top of the curtain lets in too much light, especially with overhead courtyard lighting shining directly into the room. These are better suited to productivity than rest. A solution could involve proper curtain fittings or simply providing eye masks.

The bath also appears to have a slow leak issue. Once the plug is removed—even briefly—the water slowly drains away after reinserting it. Likely a maintenance issue worth inspecting.

Side Note:
The room offered excellent daytime views of the Waikato River and some entertaining scenes at night, overlooking Skycity, where you’ll catch glimpses of pokies and punters lining up. If you’re browsing the photo gallery, you might just be able to guess which one is Room 425.

title: Great Location, But Missed Opportunities and Subpar Housekeeping During a Special Stay
text:
We recently had to make a last-minute trip to Hamilton for work, which unfortunately coincided with our 20th wedding anniversary. While it wasn’t how we imagined spending such a special day, we noted the occasion both at the time of booking and again during check-in, hoping the hotel might acknowledge it in some small way. Sadly, nothing was done to mark the occasion—a real disappointment, especially from a hotel that’s part of the Accor group.

The room itself was nice—the bed was clean and comfortable, and the pillows were soft. However, housekeeping was a major letdown. Upon arrival, there were no sanitary bags, toiletries, slippers, or a bathrobe in the room. I had to call housekeeping to request these on the first night.

On the second day, I returned to find the bathroom still had hair on the tiles, and the room had clearly not been vacuumed. On the third day, I was still in the room when housekeeping arrived. While they made the bed and did a quick tidy-up, they again skipped vacuuming the room and bathroom. I assumed they had stepped out to fetch the vacuum, but they never returned. Eventually, I had to go out and call them back in myself. It felt like the housekeeping staff were more focused on checking tasks off a list than actually cleaning the room to a proper standard.

Additionally, there was no complimentary bottled water. While I understand Accor’s commitment to sustainability, many hotels still manage to provide eco-friendly bottled water or filtered alternatives. After a long day of work and travel, this small comfort would have been appreciated.

On a more positive note, the location of the hotel is great, and I do want to commend the front desk staff—they were polite, welcoming, and helpful throughout our stay. Their kindness was one of the few bright spots in an otherwise underwhelming experience.

Overall, I expected more in terms of basic hospitality and cleanliness. Given the occasion and the hotel’s brand, it was disappointing that several simple opportunities to enhance our stay were missed.

title: Budget motel posing as a nice hotel
text: Terrible service. While checking in I asked about car parks and the receptionist looked me up and down and said they were only for guests. I repeated that we were checking in and she told me there were no car parks available. We had to leave and park ten minutes walk away and walk back over with our bags. Then my  partner asked about car parks for the other nights of our stay and she told him that they could valet the car for all nights including that night. We weren’t able to book a carpark in advance or we would have done so.  We asked for a receipt and were told we’d have to get it at check out. When checking out the receptionist said that she couldn’t give us one as we’d booked through a third party. We explained that we had not and had booked directly with Novotel but she clearly couldn’t be bothered to do it and said no still. The breakfast was very expensive and not very good. The bathroom was terrible (no shower door, greasy amenities). Only upside was the bed was very comfortable.

title: Reliable Novotel Tainui
text:
Here again for conference for a week. It is one of the better accommodations in Kirikiriroa- appearance, professionalism and offerings- but it's not hard.
Alas there is no spa [or pool] anymore 
The staff are friendly and efficient.
The decor is bright and fresh. My room had a river outlook. The bed big and comfortable. The bathroom recently upgraded and looking smart.
They get points for multi use bathroom products and in room recycling- but loose them again for housekeeping replacing the towels, despite following the dont replace
instructions.
The breakfast buffet offerings are great. And the patio over looking the river is a great point of difference.
Will stay again- it's inevitable!

title: Overpriced and underwhelming.
text:
Novotel Hamilton
The location of the hotel is convenient, the staff are friendly and the decor is appealing but that’s where it ended for us. My partner is a long term Accor member and despite requesting a good view in our booking we were given a very basic room with a view of a brick wall. While everyone knows that requests are not guaranteed, you would like to think there could be just a bit more of an effort for members. The room was incredibly plain and small, and really expensive at $360 per night (mid week). It was devoid of any amenities at all. No mini bar, no toiletries, not even a shower cap. Apparently these are only for ‘executive rooms’ but at this price that is seriously stingy and it isn’t stated anywhere when you book. Didn’t stop the hotel taking a $50 fee in case we used something and didn’t pay for it though. The food in the restaurant was ok but the service was painfully slow. The breakfast buffet was not appealing. A very ordinary hotel for the price.

title: Family holiday
text:
The accommodation was great , but the bed could be better..

 Free  parking is  limited and most times full. Factor $40 a night parking. 

The  front office staff were excellent

The location is convenient, close to the casino and shops.

Definitely one of the best hotels in Hamilton and recommend it highly. 

Ask for the room with the lake view.

title: Friendly and Helpful
text: It was only a one night stay but enjoyed the stay. Staff very friendly and obliging. Hotel is in a very convenient location, close to a host of eateries and restaurants. It was also spotlessly clean. We would stay here again.

title: Charm and comfort at the Hamilton Novotel
text:
Very nice time in this complex very well located, just by the river, and quiet, close to all shops, in downtown Hamilton.
Very nice welcome, the rooms are spacious, comfortable, and we also appreciate the services to stay in shape during the stay: a gym and spa on the 1st floor.

title: Great option for a night or few!
text: Hotel room was very modern looking and had comfortable amenities, despite the put of date appearance in the hallways. AC was powerful, beds were comfortable, and service was great. We did not have a chance to try out the restaurant. Only complaint was the minimal parking; they did offer about a dozen spots though, and valet was cheaper than other hotels at $40 a night.

title: Comfortable stay with engaging staff and pleasing facilities
text: Novotel Tainui Hamilton experience was very good with engaging staff, good room facilities, spotless cleaning, and secure valet parking at $38. At time of stay full occupancy was booked. We enjoyed lunch, dinner and breakfast selections. Comfortable stay and enjoyable experience.

title: Fabulous best Novotel
text: Have stayed in lots of higher rated hotels in NZ and Novotel around the world but this takes some beating. Booked myself online cancelling where my travel company put me and am delighted. Location fabulous, The reception staff unbelievably efficient and helpful. Lovely room with all facilities and great breakfast and service. Absolute credit to Hamilton and New Zealand

title: Best hotel in Hamilton!
text:
This was our third stay here and it's definitely our fave in Hamilton! 

The staff are very professional and helpful. The older Maori gentleman guest services/Porter and the lovely restaurant staff. Special mention to the breakfast waiter who we saw from two years ago. He is Tainui proud and so friendly! 

The rooms are very comfortable and we had a room along the river. Bathrooms fitted with NZ made lotion, shower gel, shampoo and conditioner. They're fixed to the wall so there's no need to ration with bottles of toiletries. 

Breakfast is a very good selection of hot food, bircher/cold cuts, a pancake machine and a gluten free section! Always a good selection of fresh fruit and also nice to try the cold cuts and antipasto. 

Dinner is cosy and I tried the famous Jamal burger which did not disappoint! If dining out, two Italian and a Thai restaurants are immediately across the road. Skycity is also next door and has some options.

WiFi is fast in the rooms and hotel areas. So is the valet service that we used. We will definitely stay again!

title: Nice busy professional hotel, good central location, not enough parking.
text:
Almost everything you’d expect from a Novotel experience. Happy with everything except parking. Because of limited spaces being available downstairs and valet parking was fully booked we ended up eventually finding street parking around the corner. Parking garages are available a couple of streets away but it was raining and I considered that too far given the weather.
I would suggest having more capacity available.

title: Attended the darts masters
text:
I was part of a small group that stayed who were attending the darts. We arrived and went to reception to check in. There was a queue, and it took about 15 minutes to get to the front of the line.

Upon getting to my room, the card would not work so back to reception  and into the queue again.
Once into the room, it was a nice room with a comfy bed and a great bathroom.

We had drinks in the bar, and they had a good selection of spirits, including some nice rums.
 
The breakfast was excellent with a good variety and plenty of tables to choose from.

 After our two night stay, I went to check out. All I wanted to do was hand in our room cards and go as we had had nothing from the mini bar. But here was another 15-minute wait.

The novotel is actually quite a nice hotel but needs to sort out its reception.

title: Good Spot in Hamilton
text: We stayed for a few nights and it was very pleasant. Food was good, staff were courteous and professional, and it was located very close to lots of restaurants and cafes, a mall and the museum. Lovely little walkway by the river right behind the hotel too.

title: Perfect for a short stay
text:
Excellent service from the greeting at the door to the check in at reception. Then the restaurant staff and a very entertaining drinks waiter whose knowledge and cheery personality was great. 
The food in the restaurant was excellent and service was efficient. 
The room was smaller but very modern, classy, fresh and of a great standard for a short stay.

title: Just ok
text: This hotel is clearly understaffed as Reception and especially restaurant staff seems to be stretched.   Rooms are definitely not worth the price.  The hotel clearly celebrates local culture but there is no easy to find information on the why and what of the decor.  Ordered room service.  Never showed as only one person in kitchen.   Asked car to be put on the charger and not done.

title: Very comfortable and convenient for our stay in Hamilton
text:
Recently visited Hamilton with friends and stayed at the Novotel.
The rooms were comfortable, the staff very helpful and it is well situated within walking distance of several restaurants.
The lobby bay and their restaurant are both good and in house breakfast is great.
Certainly worth recommending to friends when they visit Hamilton.

title: Best stay in Hamilton city centre
text: We have stayed here three times. Great place in the Hamilton city centre. It overlooks the river, is close to restaurants and has parking for guests. Rooms are very comfortable. Breakfast is good. Easy walk to the centre restaurants, Waikato museum, along the lake and has a great Italian restaurant opposite it.

title: good location , nice rooms and excellent dinner and breakfast
text:
we arrived to a quiet evening due to it being a public holiday. new rooms nice incl usb ports which were handy. 
restaurant had a great selection and we had the privilege of being served by Jordan for our meal. such fun and a lovely guy as were the bar staff and others we dealt with.
car parking is free but limited to first in first served basis . we secured one .
breakfast buffet offers a great selection.
thanks team for an enjoyable stay 
.

title: Good value for the price and location
text: Booked last minute and was surprised to find this hotel to be in a great central location with a plentiful choice of restaurants close at hand. Room was spacious and clean. Great secure valet parking. The hotel was very peaceful with a nice relaxing bar area with all of the hotel  staff very friendly and helpful. Would not hesitate in choosing this hotel again.

title: Value and Service
text: We had a 1 night stay on our way to Hobbiton. The room on 4th floor was very clean and comfortable and met all our requirements. The bar and restaurant on site were great, and there were 3 restaurants right across the road. The staff were all very pleasant, particularly the guy on the bar who was so warm, friendly and hospitable, and the breakfast crew also were very kind. Our stay included welcome drinks and buffet breakfast, and overall gave us great value for a family of 4.
hotel_response:
Dear 444bcm,
Thank you for taking the time to provide us with your feedback following your recent stay with us. We very much appreciate the comments you made and we hope to be of service again in the near future.
Regards
Philip Hilton
General Manager

title: Very nice hotel in Hamilton
text: Very good hotel choice in Hamilton - probably the best place in town. Very central to many eating and drinking options and less than an hour to Hobbiton and the Waitomo Caves. We were kindly upgraded to a newly renovated executive room as Accor Platinums which was appreciated. Air conditioning was ancient however and made a loud rattling sound that affected our sleep, and the restaurant was underwhelming - dirty plates and cutlery were left uncleared from tables and they charged an extra $6 for a barista made coffee on top of the $37pp buffet charge!! If I didn't get breakfast for free as a platinum I definitely wouldn't pay for it here, simply not worth it. Staff nice, and gym quite good. Valet parking nice and easy.
hotel_response:
Dear s4172249,

We are constantly reviewing all aspects of the guest experience to ensure we are meeting the expectations of our guests and your feedback on this is very much appreciated.
Regards
Philip Hilton
General Manager

title: Great hotel in a great location
text:
Stayed for 2 nights as a last minute booking that morning. The only room available was a large suite and the price wasn't too bad considering. The room was excellent with a large lounge and separate bedroom that could be closed off if you wanted. The large windows in both rooms let in loads of light. The bed was huge and very comfortable and the bathroom also large with a big bath and large walk in shower. All of the bedding and bathroom linen were of a high quality and made for a very comfortable stay.
The staff at check-in were great and the breakfast had a good selection and on the whole was pretty good.  The location was great for anything you might need in downtown Hamilton. 
Highly recommended.
hotel_response:
Dear GBoy912,
Thank you for choosing to stay with us recently and for taking the time to provide us with your feedback.  It was great to read you enjoyed your time with us and we look forward to being of service again in the near future.
Regards
Philip Hilton
General Manager

title: Ok but by no means great
text: Room was clean when we arrived, we stayed for 2 nights but no house keeping either night. Parking is an issue, first night we got free parking but the second night all parking was taken and we had to park at the casino. Staff were hit and miss, one lovely lady who checked us in but other staff weren’t friendly. You could walk in and out past staff who would let acknowledge you.

Please accept our sincere apologies and be assured we will work harder moving forward to ensure we are meeting all our guest expectations.

Once again thank you for the feedback and we hope to be of service again in the near future.

Philip Hilton
General Manager

title: Awful and Appalling Customer Service received!
text:
Received the most awful customer service! Absolutely appalling for a 4.5 star hotel. Facilities and rooms were okay, the room was tidy and had all the amenities. Arrived early before 2pm to check in and paid for valet parking and receptionist that checked us in was welcoming and assisted us with no concerns apart from no mention or discussion re the terms and conditions of valet parking. Half an hour after check in we left to grab some food my car was still in the main parking when we arrived back at around 4pm. We had dinner reservations and requested for the car to be brought up at around 6:20pm, when jumping into the car to leave for dinner, IT WOULD NOT START! Prior to this we had driven from Auckland all the way down with a couple of stops along the way and had no problems with the car. We then told this to the staff out front to which she said that the valet driver had an issue with the car and said she would get the duty manager. After explaining what was going on to Warren (Duty Manager), he did not know what to do or say to us. After asking for help he only then offered to check the camera footage to see if they were at fault for this but was unable to find the footage of the car entering the valet parking area! No time stamp on our valet ticket at all or for their own record which is very unhelpful for situations like this, the only footage found was the valet driver bringing the car up at a poor angle. NO further resolution or compensation offered as we told him we missed our dinner reservation with family and he said he could call a taxi and told us to pay for it! He then asked if we wanted to call AA but at our own expense, we asked him to at least call AA - he then told us AA would be arriving in an hour.
We then explained to Warren again that Anne out front said the valet driver - Dean was having an issue with the car, we asked why this was not communicated to us, to management or noted down on the valet card about the car having issues. During our discussion with Warren, Pare the other receptionist at the time spoke for him in a rude manner, she also did not offer any resolution but only pointing the finger back at us saying it’s our car and told the team not to touch it! We expressed the displeasure that we paid for a service and got back a problem with no compensation or solution offered. Once the conversation pointed back to Warren, Pare then left the front desk and went to speak to the valet driver who drove my car without us going to speak with him all together first. After the valet driver had finished moving another guest’s car he then finally came up to us and told us that he had no issue with the car. At this point we were very confused as one staff member said otherwise. I then asked to speak to both the staff members. When clarifying what had been said to us the valet driver looked confused and the staff member who said he had an issue clearly was trying not to say something to avoid putting any liability towards them! We then expressed to Warren that the situation was stressing us out as we needed to drive back to Auckland the next day and he replied back with “you are stressing me out”. HOW RUDE and UNPROFESSIONAL coming from a duty manager to tell YOUR CUSTOMERS that they are stressing you out. We did not pay $250+ in this economy to stress you out. In my years of working in customer service/hospitality I would not dare to say to my customers that they are stressing me out! That is not how you communicate or treat your customers how embarrassing for the company you work for! This whole situation was handled poorly and could have been avoided from the start if the manager and staff members acknowledged the issue with the car when it occurred and had it noted down on the valet ticket, offered solutions. If you decide to book this hotel our advice is to take extra care and get anything and everything explained to you verbally and in writing as they only point the blame back on their own guests which clearly shows on the other reviews on google and with no resolution or compensation mentioned or given. A refund for the valet parking would atleast have been something substantial to us however we received 0 compensation and this has put us off staying at this hotel again or recommending it to friends/family.

title: Rude and aggressive staff, please take care
text: We reserved three rooms for our family. Arriving after a long drive we asked at check in where to park. We were informed that parking was available at the side of the hotel in the private marked bays. We parked in one of the bays marked with “Reserved for Novotel”, walking back to reception where we were attacked by a chap in a hi viz, telling us we were “ parked illegally” . We explained that we simply parked where we were instructed to, and in the bay marked for Novotel. The response was that the bay was marked “Novotel Hotel “ and not Novotel and was actually reserved for “more important guests”. The chap continued to be aggressive and inappropriate, threatening us with legal action. We were amazed and wonder how this hotel will survive a competitive environment. While a manager did intervene we did not receive an apology.
hotel_response:
Dear K1681SPsimonr,
Thank you for choosing to stay with us and for taking the time to provide us with your feedback. We very much appreciate the comments you made and I can assure you we are working hard to source additional parking options so that we can provide this service for all of our guests.  

Please accept our sincere apologies for the lack of service you encountered from one of our team and we will work harder to ensure moving forward we are meeting all our guest expectations across all areas of the guest journey.

Once again, thank you for the feedback.

title: Ok Stay
text: Easy check in & lovely friendly staff. Room had food under the chair from previous guests & power points on 1 side of the bed didn’t work. Fridge not very cold & terrible dining experience in the Restaurant. Disappointing for Novotel as ruined our Xmas Day evening meal. Breakfast was good but probably wouldn’t stay again

title: Excellent Service, Great Room and Flexible Stay
text: We stayed at the Novotel for my Hubands work do, the check in was easy and fast. Service of Employees was amazing, and helpful. Room was super clean and they accomodated a last minute request for a late check out

title: Novotel Hamilton Tainui. Stay here if you like tired rooms and disappointing service.
text:
We recently stayed at the Novotel Tainui for 1 night to attend a wedding. After returning from the reception in the evening, we were getting ready for bed. On pulling the sheet back, there was a large mark on the sheet near the pillow, which seemed to be a sticky gum-like substance. We made a call to front desk (unanswered) and then room service (also a 40 minute wait by the way) to address the issue. We then had to get dressed again and wait for housekeeping – who dealt with it quickly and remade the bed for us. They expressed their regret and apologised. They assured us this would be followed up as it was not a good standard. On checkout the next morning, no mention was made from staff around this housekeeping issue, nor the interruption to our stay (and the feeling that our room had not been setup to a clean standard). I brought up the matter and received a quick and insincere apology before being presented with our parking charges. Whilst we were happy the matter was dealt to – and the housekeeping lady that attended clearly was unhappy with whomever had made up the bed with dirty sheets, we were not happy with total lack of remediation at checkout. Paying what we did for a single night, an insincere apology really didn't cut it. To have such a response from the staff member at checkout was both insulting and completely unsympathetic. To add further insult to injury after we sent feedback, we were offered a free breakfast 'on our return'. Since when does a future discount remediate poor service? I raised this again and the hotel disagreed with any kind of cash recompense. This could have easily been satisfactorily sorted by comping the parking but they managed to make it worse. We won't be back. Hotel is tired and shabby and our floor smelled of Ammonia.

Note - Housekeeping response and communication was excellent. It's a shame the same couldn't be said for those whose role it is to be frontline customer service.

title: Modern & Well Appointed
text:
For our last night in NZ we splurged on an Executive Room with king size bed. These rooms are in the newer part of the hotel so they're very modern and well appointed. Lots of marble and timber accents.

The bed was super comfortable with a good choice of different pillow thicknesses. The staff at the hotel were also friendly and approachable. With the hotel being located in the centre of the city it makes walking around easy.

However, the bathroom could have been bigger for an "executive" room. I wasn't overly happy with the position of our first floor room facing the car park below and building across the way. Ask for a river view room if you can get it.

We noticed that the door to the room didn't self-close properly and I had to really slam it shut so the latch held. I think there's been some movement in the building which caused this as there was a large crack in the plaster next to the AC vent in the room.

title: A Beautiful Hotel
text: The decor was beautiful! Extras like handcream and chocolate were gorgeous.  The service was great. Room service meals were great. The river view was pretty. Would definitely recommend this hotel. The only negatives were the  uncomfortable pillows and the nearby local beggars. The beggars of course were not the hotel's fault but, there were so many dodgy people nearby, on our short walk,  that it created an unsafe, depressing atmosphere. Definitely not good for Hamilton nor NZ tourism.

title: A pleasure!
text: The loveliest welcome, superb service, very comfortable room, central and convenient, good restaurant.  Bed and pillows super comfy. Room service delightful, quick, polite.  Parking was no problem. What a pleasure!

title: Parking issue.
text: Parking is impossible. Service was ok but just ok. The room was nice and plenty of pillows. But I was rung at 1030pm on to occasions asking me about paying for the parking. I thought this could have waited until the next day. I had the burger and fries and then found out they had a special that would have given me a free drink. I was never told. Burger was good.

title: Lovely stay
text: Friendly staff at check-in. The buffet breakfast was delicious and had lots of variety. Valet parking was quick and easy. The beds were comfortable enough, and all facilities were of good quality. Convenient location to break-up a trip from Auckland Airport to Rotorua.

title: Need parking don't choose here
text: We stayed at the novotel for 3 night while I had surgery. The hotel is clean and  tidy. The rooms are great with everything you would need. We didn't get milk but saw them on a service cart so might have been missed.  The rooms were quiet but wouldn't say sound proof. The only issue was parking. We paid 32 for valet parking  and it's was fine first night as it was kept in the basement but then it got busy and they took it elsewhere. Hubby was trying to come see me after surgery and he waited 40 mins outside for the vehicle. He isn't someone who likes to go back and follow up he hates confrontation and he waited till 30 mins then went and asked. Staff were friendly and there was always someone on the desk. Room service was good and hubby had dinner but was quiet expensive.  I wouldn't stay again if I needed parking. But if I didn't I'd stay there so close to town and hospital

title: Good if you want are ok to spend more than you get
text: Stayed for 4 nights, costed around 1.5k nzd. A tad bit overpriced for the service, quality of breakfast and beddings. Carpets does not seem to get vacuumed or deep cleaned enough...for this price, not too worth it.

title: Nice hotel, lovely stay
text: Stayed here for a couple of nights, had a room on the fourth floor and no complaints. The room was a generous size with a massive bed and I heard very little noise from outside which is always a big plus point. The complimentary internet was speedy and more than fast enough for Netflix. All of the staff that I encountered were fantastic, check in & out was a piece of cake. Also top marks to the restaurant and bar, both were very good. Not a heap of parking at the front but the valet parking solves any potential problems there. All in all a very pleasant stay and I wouldn’t hesitate to return

title: Quality hotel near downtown.  Very comfortable rooms.
text: Very comfortable room and great location.  Easy walking distance to downtown shops and restaurants.  Friendly service staff.  The hotel restaurant included an excellent breakfast buffet.  Continental breakfast was part of the cost for a room; full buffet was available for an extra small fee.

title: Relaxing
text: It was just a quick stopover for the night for us.  Lovely modern Room, great facilities. Jordan in the restaurant was great.  Food was good. Will definitely stay again and highly recommend to others.

title: Perfect
text:
From customer service, food, cleanliness and location, simply awesome Just near everything. Bed is super comfortable, not too firm not too soft. Cleanliness is 10/10 but the best thing of all, they prioritize their guests needs & make you feel special.

It was our 25th Wedding anniversary and they upgraded me into the suite room. Truly amazing. Now Novotel will be forever be part of our special memories. Thank you so much Novotel and shout out to their front desk receptionist  Angelika & supervisor Bev. Your kind gesture was well appreciated. 
Accor Lines of hotels you rock!!!

title: Loud rooms, skip Hamilton altogether. head to raglan on the coast instead
text: Loud hotel likely due to poor soundproofing of windows. Our room smelled of mold. Would not recommend if you want a quiet area. The hotel lobby is nice but would not suggest staying here or in the entire town of Hamilton.

title: Very Good Night's Sleep
text:
When you go to a Novotel you can be anywhere in the world. Basically they are the same wherever you are. I stayed at this one whilst on a Riviera Tour of New Zealand.
The beds were comfortable. The rooms were clean and a good shower as well. Air conditioning worked. We were only here one night. 
The breakfast was good with hot and cold buffet. Plenty of choice of fresh fruit and juice and pastries. All food was well cooked and tasty.

title: Good enough
text:
It’s a nice hotel, comfortable bed, clean and comfortable however for the price it’s lacking. 
Missing the dressing gowns, bathroom extras like hair cap etc and very basic tea/coffee supplies. One towel each, was bare minimum. 
Staff very friendly though. Buffet Breakfast was 7 out of 10 in the category of standard hotel breakfast. 
Parking is very difficult and expensive.

title: Very comfortable, good location
text:
As part of a tour group here for the NZ Derby we were all given rooms on level 1. Each floor has many rooms so a bit of a hike. 
Room was spacious and the king bed comfortable. Plenty of room and couldn’t hear any noises. 
Buffet breakfast had a big choice. 
We had drinks at the bar and that was fine too. 
Central location. Friendly staff.

title: Satisfactory stay.
text: The room was clean and adequate.  I was surprised at how difficult it was to access plugs.  In a time when electronics always need to be charged, it was a hassle to get down on your knees to access a plug buried under a side table.  Water was hot and plentiful. bed was comfortable and staff was cordial.

title: Very comfortable
text: Only here for 1 night but would have stayed longer. Small but very comfortable room. Breakfast was first class & we managed to see most of the England cricket squad who were staying there before their warm up game in Hamilton.

title: Central location, comfortable room
text:
Very good location in the middle of town. Novotel has valet parking service. Friendly service at reception. Comfortable and quiet superior room, nice decor and practical bathroom. Nice view to the river. 

We had dinner at hotels restaurant. Super friendly and easy going service! We enjoyed also breakfast, very good.

title: Nice place to stay
text:
This hotel has a good location in Hamilton Central near many restaurants 
The room is nice and well designed, the bathroom is amazing
The mattress is very comfortable
The only "bad" point is the parking. You have few spaces available down the hotel (always full) and the parking is $32

title: Solid as you’d expect from Novotel
text:
Hamilton isn’t blessed with the unique, design-centric boutique hotels of other cities, but Novotel is a decent option for those wanting a no-fuss night in the center of town. 

Check in was a bit slow. Breakfast fees were a bit high. The view wasn’t good from the second floor. The art in the room was downright awful. But almost everything else was decent. Comfortable bed. Fantastic bathroom. Quiet. Good Wifi and entertainment (although my laptop wouldn’t plug into the tiny power grommet). Plenty of space. Best location you’d find.

title: Excellent service
text:
I loved this hotel.
Staff was friendly and rooms were clean.
Bathroom was clean and there was plenty of towels.

We had dinner at their restaurant and the waiter was fantastic. I have restricted diet and they were amazing in meeting my dietary requirements.

Would stay there again.

Thank you for an amazing time 😊

title: Good value
text: Spacious room, spotlessly clean and the staff were friendly. Some of the common areas were a little tired but overall was a lovely stay. Breakfast was good with plenty of choice and valet parking made life easy.

title: Ok
text: Quite loud with the casino next door. Slept with ear plugs. Platinum member did not receive a room upgrade (there were rooms available). Paid parking not included. No complementary coffee for breakfast which many places do for platinum guest. Room was satisfactory. Breakfast buffet might have been good if I had of been able to get a table.

title: Dated tired hotel
text:
Stayed here for four nights in November 2022.
Great location in the very centre of Hamilton.
Hotel seemed in need of a refurb, some areas of the hotel were dated and tired.
Room size good with a comfortable king size bed.
Limited and expensive parking.
Staff not very customer focused. Hamilton, like most of New Zealand are very short of experienced  customer facing staff. More in house training needed.

title: Well designed room
text: We recently stayed 3 nights at the Novotel and found it to be very comfortable. The bathroom was well designed with a great shower and lots of storage. The bed was comfortable as was the sitting area. Breakfast was good although a bit busy with a tour group staying. The valet parking was very convenient and efficient. Good location for walking along the river but the view from our room was not the greatest. This hotel was a pleasant surprise for a city/business hotel.

title: Comfortable but very few extras
text: Clean room. Nice shower. Good breakfast selection but nothing remarkable. Limited teas and coffees in room. A decaf and herbal option would have been good. No eco option for servicing the room. No instructions for television. A tv guide/listings would have been appreciated. A liner in one of the bins would have been good, for containing teabags etc. It was good to have a bin for recycling. The parking area in front of hotel was cramped. Difficult to negotiate when being dropped off.

title: Not delux more like de rip off!!
text:
When we turned up to the Novotel we had paid for valet parking no one was there to great us we waiting a couple minutes still no one so we blocked the area as there was no where to park and went inside we asked about who will take our car the lady said well have you paid for this service!!!  it should be in your system!!!!  we told her no one is there to take our car!!!!!  Really bad start.
Decided to treat ourselves to a Delux Room - really small for a delux, lighting was really bad in the room, pillows were the worst, cleaning was not the best which i would expect better from a 4 star Hotel.  There were brown drips on the door in bathroom and on the walls in bathroom.  The shower head had white scum all over it, they didn't bother putting in new toilet rolls so left the tiniest bit on the roll not even a quarter left.  We stayed 2 nights so on the second day we were expecting towels to be changed bed made, bathroom cleaned etc, by 2:40 still no cleaner we had gone out for the morning so they could do this.  By the time they turned up 2:50 we just asked for a change of towels and more toilet paper and also milk.  Didn't get the milk had to go back and ask for toilet paper as they didn't give it to us.  Staff we not a very happy bunch at all.  For the $728.60 we paid for 2 nights will not be returning.  I expected more for that amount of money.

title: Bad service
text:
Stayed 2 nights. No room cleaning although sign was out  we were 5 hours out. Simply that forgot about us No one entered the room to change towels. Called them not even apologizes. Even when checked out No asking how was our stay.
No parking either. All full. Very bad experience. Never again Room 262

title: Hamilton”s best hotel
text: Couple of nights in the Novotel Tainui in Hamilton . Nice hotel. good service , decor in new rooms is particularly good. the only place to stay in Hamilton really. Restaurant was good but not as good as sone otter local offerings  maybe eat out if you want something special.

title: Comfortable stay
text:
The Novotel hotel overlooking the river is well located within walking distance to shops, cafes and restaurants. We stayed in a suite 419 which was very comfortable with separate living room & bedroom. It also had lovely views of the river below with ceiling to floor windows. 

The staff we found were all extremely friendly and efficient. We had breakfast every morning and found the food to be good with a variety of selections. We also took advantage of using the chef to cook us up yummy omelette’s. 

There is so pretty river walk below which meanders around the city fringe. I used this numerous times instead of walking the streets with traffic. 

Overall - Excellent city / business hotel with super facilities.

title: 4 Night break
text: We stayed for 4 nights in Room 314 overlooking the Waikato river.  Had buffet breakfast and were so impressed with the food that we returned for dinner on three of the four evenings. We particularly enjoyed the Man-O-War Pinot Gris wine that we bought to accompany the dinners

title: Best place to stay in Hamilton
text: Absolutely fantastic. Staff so helpful. Rooms are Absolutely outstanding. Beds comfortable and bathroom and shower so lovely. Definitely recommend. Breakfast is amazing, great valet parking. Just cant compliment the place enough. Such a fantastic hotel

title: Hamilton adventure
text:
Excellent venue for that special break away
Great add on options especially for parking and breakfasts that were superb
Very close to the main CBD and Sky Casino a good location
I look forward to returning to Novotel Hamilton in the near future

title: When your looking for that extra touch in your hotel accommodation. Hamilton City Hotel with Waikato River outlook.
text: Fantastic and Caring!! Central Hamilton City Hotel.  I cannot believe praise them enough. Janine you are a star. Catherine thank you and the GM shows huge amounts of compassion.  Because of our situation, I also booked for my brother. They were absolutely humbled by the understanding and compassionate care of the team but also loved their room with a river view.

title: Nothing to rave about
text: Not worth the money paid for this room. Room very small, was informed by Reception that they had given us a River View. The River was dirty and the banks of the river a mess. Don't know why the receptionist thought a River view was so great. Parking is $28 night - this parking is out in the open, running along the River, with Public access, most certainly not worth $28. We parked across the road on the street for free.

title: Excellent hotel by the river in central Hamilton
text: I regularly stay at the Novotel for business and it is always a pleasant, peaceful stay. I feel that they really look after frequent visitors very well.  The rooms are modern, pretty, well furnished and very clean with comfortable beds. Housekeeping is excellent. Reception and restaurant staff are friendly and helpful. Breakfast buffet has plenty of choice. The restaurant a la carte meals are good except that they need more vegetarian options - something more exciting than pasta. Bar staff are reluctant to make cocktails for some reason.

title: A pleasant, bustling place.
text: I had a good experience here earlier in the year and found that the Novotel was a sensible choice in terms of accommodation in Hamilton. The rooms were clean and airy while the staff went the extra distance to make sure all was well. The Lobby was spacious and well-illuminated.

title: Nothing to  fault
text: I am a regular at his hotel, the service and overall service is getting better and better. They are going above and beyond to cement their position as one of my favourite places to stay when travelling.

title: Simply the best
text: We stay at NHT whenever we visit Hamilton. Nothing else comes close. The food is sensational - tasty dinner with good local touches and a generous breakfast buffet. The rooms are spacious, clean and comfortable. We enjoyed the complementary drinks and the free room. Tip- ask for a room with a river view. You won’t be disappointed.

title: My opinions as requested
text:
Staff friendly.Front staff were genuinely busy so I sorted my own luggage which due to my wife in wheelchair was a little difficult.Took me several trips.We carry our own Comode & bed levers to stop wife falling out of bed .
Porter didn’t seem interested so neither was I .Failed to provide one night free.as arranged.Charged for one nights Valet parking which wasn’t required or provided.
Hotel clean,Food great Location very good.With an Accor Silver card and a suplimentary I expected a better meal discount.
I have no complaints with front desk and dining room staff who are generally great.

title: Very much short stay
text: Rooms are good size with newish furniture. I was on 4th floor and the room had high ceilings. Bit disappointing that I was allocated a disabled room. No shower caps were available (even on request). Customer service from both the staff (check in and out) was amazing. Free Parking is limited and next option is paid parking at Sky city.

title: Family Vacation
text:
Fantastic location, clean and spacious rooms. Friendly and helpful staff. 
Perfect accomodation for a family of 5. We booked the family connecting rooms (1 king & 2 doubles) We all enjoyed the daily use of the sauna. Housekeeping was super efficient too. The kids also got given the cutest kiwi toy! Will definitely be back :)

title: Great hotel well located
text: Stayed for two nights whilst attending Ireland Māori rugby match. Rooms were clean and spacious but what made the stay was the friendliness of the staff, who couldn’t be more helpful. Breakfasts were great and you could order bespoke omelette and other eggs. The hotel was far from full, yet breakfast time was busy so I’m not sure how they would cope if they were full. Same goes for the bar area in the evenings.

title: A lovely stay
text: Overall we had a good stay. The only issue we had was, we had booked for connecting rooms but the interconnecting door was locked and we tried to contact the reception where they didn't answer. And we got in unlocked by evening.

title: Customer Service Worth Coming Back To
text:
Stayed at Novotel for 3 nights during the Queens Bday weekend. We were 2 families   with kids and it was our first time in Hamilton. The rooms were modern, fresh, clean and very comfy bed and pillows. Staff were friendly and approachable.

However, our hotel experience was greatly enhanced by the customer service from Leslie at the front desk. She was professional, extremely helpful and
her proactive  approach in assisting  us with just about anything - from parking, check-in, complimentary drinks, food, direction, check-out, etc. was such a welcome surprise. It is very rare that we are made to feel at home in a hotel. Very grateful for going the extra mile to do that.  We also noticed she has the same passion and enthusiastic demeanor with other guests as well. Such an asset to your team. Top-notch customer service  worth coming back to.

title: We will go back
text: Very nice hotel, staff are friendly and helpful. Rooms are clean and spacious. Bathrooms are good , as is shower but lighting is terrible. Difficult to put makeup on in dim bathroom with steamy mirror. Buffet breakfast was outstanding, first time we have experienced a buffet with food at safe temperatures and beautifully presented. A bit pricey for standard king size room.

title: Excellent stay
text: From the very start the hotel staff were nice to deal with. I don’t normally sleep well in another bed, but I actually slept in way pass my normal wake up time. I recommend the full buffet breakfast as well  👍🏼 Thank you for an awesome weekend stay.

title: Short stay
text:
Nice quick stay, room was lovely but we were on the top floor and the air conditioning was really noisy, particularly when we were trying to sleep. 
Great to see the buffet breakfast was back.  
Very smiling, helpful, happy team  members.

title: Disappointing
text: Very disappointing that a 4.5 star hotel foes not have dedicated parking for staying guests. There are a few parking bays downtrend Hill but even these are not secured for staying guests. Looks like anyone can park there. Spent over 30 minutes trying to find street parking for the night but all limited time parking. Has to eventually park at the Sky City Casino parking and walk back to the hotel. After a long day working, it's the last thing I need. Novotel need to make some effort to secure guest parking.

title: Very enjoyable stay
text: My wife and I spent a night at the Novotel Hamilton Tainui Hotel as we had a night available on our Accor Plus card. On arrival we were greeted by a cheerful young man at the front desk who  quickly and efficiently checked us in and we drove to the underground carpark. After a long walk around the area which included a very interesting visit to the Waikato Museum we went back and enjoyed our complimentary drink and booked for dinner. On arrival at the restaurant we were greeted like long lost friends and shown to our table. We then met for the first time our waiter Jordan and he turned out to be a real star. From introducing the specials nothing was too much trouble for this super pleasant young man. He took the time to talk to us in a genuine manner as he did to all the diners around us. To be honest, Jordan spent more time talking to us and sharing a joke and a story than we have any previous waiting staff combined in several hotels. This young man is worth his weight in gold and is a real asset to the hotel. On other aspects, the food was to a very high standard and very tasty and well prepared and presented. Overall, the restaurant was a real treasure and we were very glad that we chose to eat here. Our room was of a good size, well set out and presented with a lovely bathroom. Overall, a very pleasant night spent in Hamilton with the highlight our restaurant dinner.

title: Let down by service
text:
Lovely clean, modern room with all expected facilities. No parking available so had to pay additional for use of neighbouring sky city parking.

Breakfast was an absolute shambles with a severely restricted menu (presumably due to covid precautions although this was not advertised or noted on check in) and a sole flustered server whose bar attendent refused to assist with ordering. Food arrived promptly once ordered and was pleasant.

title: Disappointing customer service
text: This property is definitely our go to when staying in Hamilton.  We checked in and found the room to be excellent, however, as my husband pointed out there were numerous long dark hairs all over the bathroom floor and in the shower.  I mentioned this to the guy on reception who had checked us in as we were heading out for a walk.  I was taken aback at his flippant response as he merely laughed and said he would send someone up to check.  That person never appeared. As we were checking out I mentioned this interaction and received a far more appropriate acknowledgment.  Very disappointing.

title: Much improved with renovations
text:
The hotel has had extensive renovations and feels more modern cleaner and fresher. The rooms are greatly improved, bed comfortable and all elements required for business travel. 
Excellent service by front of house staff.
Good location for central Hamilton and close to the river for a walk.

title: Would go back in a heartbeat!
text:
My sister and I arrived in town without having any accommodation and, as everything was booked out, we decided to splash out and stay at the Novotel. We’re so pleased we did! It was the perfect stay. I’d stayed at the Ibis before, just a few steps away, but this time it was unavailable as it was being used as an isolation facility.

We booked online after driving around and arrived after 10pm to a professional and friendly reception. We were delighted to be upgraded to an executive room in the brand new wing of the hotel (because of being an Accor member) and received a free welcome drink. The hotel is modern and attractive and is right in the middle of the city.

Our room was large, modern and nicely decorated, with big windows looking out over the car park to the river. The room had everything we needed: espresso machine, rainforest shower head, plenty of USB ports. Two double beds with masses of pillows… my sister thought she was in heaven and didn’t want to leave! 

The food on offer was very reasonably priced; we both had eggs Benedict for brunch for $15. Next time we’ll definitely go for dinner there as well, as the menu looked excellent.

Sarah on reception was particularly wonderful and the housekeeping team on the 3rd floor were terrific too.

We’d go back in a heartbeat!

title: Best place to stay in Hamilton
text: Centrally located , clean well appointed rooms , friendly helpful staff , secure basement parking  , Recommend upgrading to a suite , large rooms with river views , very quiet . Easy walk to a variety of restaurants , although in house dining was also excellent . Covid compliance is managed very well with a high standard of cleanliness , spaced seating within the restaurant and Al a carte breakfast delivered in a timely manner .

title: Comfortable and central
text: Nice hotel, modern and well equipped with pleasant staff and secure parking.  Central and good access to restaurants. The rooms are comfortable and quiet.  very reasonably priced at short notice and so could not fault it. Thank you!

title: Great place to stay!
text:
Located in central Hamilton.  Great shopping, nice and quiet (as you miss the hustle and bustle of the Malls) 
Service was fantastic, friendly and genuine.  Willing to go the extra mile.
Rooms were clean and well serviced.
Very happy - will go back.

title: Christmas shopping in Hamilton Central.
text: Centrally located,close to all amenities (CBD, some great restaurants, river walks,Malls,Parks), everything in walking distance. Park and Go. Easy drive to other tourist attractions, Hobbiton in Matamata.

title: Pleasant stay
text:
Great service, bar staff helpful and accommodating, very nice rooms. nice central location but quite rooms.
We only stayed one night but found the staff very nice and bar and restaurant were pleasant and inviting

title: Overall friendly and considerate
text: Nice clean rooms. Good location. Fresh food. But the thing that always makes it an enjoyable stay is the friendly and helpful staff. A bit sad that this stay was cut short by the move to Level 3 COVID.

title: Comfortable stay
text: I stayed at Novotel for work for 5 nights. There are renovations occuring but they were not disruptive in any way. The rooms are clean, quiet, and comfortable. I would like to mention the hero of a barman, Jordan, who moved heaven and earth to make me a much needed old fashioned. Very friendly and provided service above and beyond.

title: Hamilton Tainui novotel
text: Visited for my wife's birthday. Great service good food easy check-in conformable rooms for family. Location was extremely central and my request for Riverside room was sorted by complimentary upgrade to a riverview. Exceeded expectation.

title: Outstanding staff
text: Every staff member we encountered, from the front desk to the room attendants was friendly, welcoming, helpful and professional. Special mention must be made of Poppy who served us in the restaurant and bar area. Not only was she very pleasant and enjoyable to chat to as she served us, but from observing her interactions with not only other guests but also her fellow colleagues shows she is exceptional staff member on every level and such an asset to your team.

title: It Only Takes One Employee to Negate the Whole Experience
text: We decided to stay one night as a thrill for my 7 year old granddaughter - we were staying in Hamilton visiting family so it was a little treat. The check-in was great and she was given a kiwi which was most appreciated. All was going well. One of the treats was a proper “mocktail” in the bar before dinner. She even put a dress on for the occasion! We went down and then everything went downhill. We went to the bar and there was no one else in sight so no waiting time. The bar tender “served” us. I asked about a drink for Isla who was all smiles – we were shoved a menu book and told to look. I asked if we took one of the mocktails or a simple drink for her, if the glass could be jazzed up with an umbrella etc – the sort of thing we are totally accustomed to as we travelled a lot. We were told that there were no umbrellas. If this a covid thing then I don’t buy it or if it is to save the planet, I don’t buy that either as they are a natural product as well as being given a plastic straw later. I suggested some fruit i.e. pineapple etc and was told very rudely that they only thing she had were lemon slices!! Excuse me?? Is this a four star hotel??? I suggested that the kitchen may have some – no go there either. In the end Isla had a can of coke plonked in front of her with a thin straw which she had trouble sucking on, no coaster and not one word said. Not even put into a glass. There was no table service to ask us what we would like to order or to suggest options for Isla. Our cocktails were not very nice either – overpowering amount of passionfruit syrup in a martini glass but that is not my issue here. We had built up the experience and a little girl was disappointed – something I cannot forgive. Otherwise the hotel was fine - good room service, nice room, great bathroom, good breakfast and reception excellent -  it only took one to drag it into the realm of huge disappointment. Hospo is short for hospitality - redo Hospo 1.1 please. Also revise what Manaakitanga means in terms of hospitality.

title: The staff are great and are 5 star , the hotel itself I would give 3.5 stars to.
text:
The staff make this hotel. All the staff we came into contact with from the concierge staff to the cleaning team, to the staff in the restaurant (especially Poppy) were just lovely. 
The hotel itself was certainly comfortable enough but some things really let it down. The curtains in our room had stains on them. The parking at the hotel is awful, twice we had to park at the casino nearby, the other times we parked on the street.  We had booked a buffet breakfast included for the time we stayed there (5 x nights). The buffet was good, but the room it was in gets streaming sunlight which sounds lovely but there was no where to escape the heat and light, so we learnt to eat quickly so we weren’t uncomfortable for too long. The hotel building seems a little tired, but the staff are so kind you try to overlook issues

title: Could  do  better.
text: Thia hotel is certainly situated in a cental location.The rooms  There is valet service.My gripe is the  hosekeeping service .There is nothing worse than returning to your room after a day of activities to find your bed not made and your room not serviced.On two occasions I had to  r equest that this be done , and that was after ringing and ringing and getting no answer from  reception  and  housekeeping .I dont think that when you have to vacate the room at 10-11 am you should have to wait till 4 pm to have your r room serviced.  We didnt eat in the . hotel chosing instead to dine at Adrianas across the road,  buit did have a coffee in the bar before retiring and the wait person was very efficent and very smily and nice.We will stay again, because of the great location, and the fabulous Adriana restaurant .

title: Good Central Location
text:
First time here but based on reviews and being an Accor Plus member we chose the Novotel for our short stay in Hamilton (hadn't been here in years) - good location - close to shops, bars etc

Nice welcome and we had the car valet parked.  Room over looking the river was nice and clean and well presented.  Dinner in the Alma Restaurant was good value with friendly wait staff though it didn't feel too cosy.

If in Hamilton, we'd go back to the Novotel.

title: Great Stay
text: First time we have stayed there and would definitely go back. Cleanest Hotel I've stayed in for a while. Rooms were very spacious and the only thing that would have made our stay even better would have been a river view.

title: Dated hotel but otherwise okay
text:
Hotel location is very good - right in the middle of the city and easily walkable to all the good bars and restaurants. 

Hotel itself is very dated - the rooms and particularly the carpets are quite old but otherwise clean.  There is a new renovated side of the hotel - if possible, request for this as they are much nicer. 

Service though is slightly disappointing. Some rooms get bottles of water, others do not. I requested that I please get a bottle of water every single day - even if it's a small one. Got it 1 day, did not get after that. Had to ask every time. Every other hotel I've stayed with, this comes with the room. I also stayed 9 nights (as I was there for work) and hence requested for every day. Room cleaning also was inconsistent. Whilst the room was generally quite clean, you could tell when different people did it. One day I came back and beds were made but rubbish bins weren't emptied. Other times, beds were roughly made and things that had fallen on the floor (I dropped some paperwork as I was running out) not picked up. I appreciate these are very small remarks, however, I have stayed at other Novotels and they faired better. 

Stock standard buffet breakfast. 

Gym quite small. Very limited machines. Spa is good but was packed with kids every time I went. 

Not a bad overall stay.

user_location: Westland Tai Poutini National Park, New Zealand
title: It’s the small things . . .
text: It’s the small things that let this hotel down a bit. On check in - the receptionist said she would call us when our second booked room was ready. We never heard anything all afternoon and ended up getting the keys for the room at 10pm when we returned from a wedding.  There was other people’s hair on the skirting in the bathroom. The tables aren’t cleared promptly at breakfast meaning people arriving were walking around trying to find a clean table to sit at & weren’t having much luck. The customer computers in the foyer are a great idea but you can’t use them because there is no mouse. Ordered a coffee from the bar and the lady forgot to make it. Service just needs a bit of polishing overall.

title: gold accor plus benefits?
text:
Very disappointed that my accor plus membership and Gold status were overlooked, felt a bit let down actually.
I found parking arrangements awfully confusing and limted and didn't feel very safe walking alone outside in a public space from the parking late at night.

title: Anniversary
text:
Anniversary with my wife and spent the weekend in Hamilton . The unit was very spacious and was nice and clean .
Ordered room service  , was disappointed with the food as it didn't seem it be very fresh 
The staff were very helpful and front desk was very efficient when booking in and arriving 
Enjoyed the quick exit on the Sunday morning when leaving , thank you

title: Well worth the experience
text: The services we experienced (at reception, at room service, at the bar and at breakfast were very professional, warm and welcoming. The room (overlooking the panoramic view of the Waikato River) was very comfortable with the standard amenities - air conditioning and heating; tea, coffee, hot chocolate, sugar milk, an iron and ironing board, a box of tissues, shampoo, conditioning, show gel, body lotion and a hair dryer available. The best was having a nice room to stay in. The least liked was having to check out!

title: Amazing
text: Always stay here when in Hamilton it is in town so plenty of shops and restaurants. Staff are always friendly and the rooms are great.Breakfast is great and Poppy is amazing makes a great coffee. Good selection for breakfast

title: What's the point of accor membership
text: I spend the summer travelling NZ and stay at a lot of Accor hotels as a result. I have accumulated points to attain Platinum status yet I consistently been forgotten about and not provided any benefits. It's disappointing as I find the service across the Accor Novotel's incredibly inconsistent and it is frustrating when people I travel with receive benefits and I don't and when I question it I'm told they don't have my number which I have registered numerous times before and they still don't acknowledge the points I have accumulated. So I ask you, what is the point?

title: Best in town
text: I have noticed a big improvement in the attitude of the staff since lock-down , the new rooms are good (if you are lucky enough to get them) - it is the best place to stay in the Hamilton CBD - breakfast is good

title: Lovely room
text: Lovely, modern room which we had paid to upgrade to. Great bathroom.  Shona on reception needs some lessons on friendliness. The young, female reception ladies were lovely.  Super handy to the CBD & the river walk. Comfortable bed & pillows. Complimentary water was a nice touch.

title: Once again Excellent
text: And (once again) was a really great stay. Staff were always friendly and helpful, service was fantastic, and the room/beds very comfortable. We were lucky enough to be staying when 3 national sports teams were also there, so it was a real treat to meet and talk to these team members away from there usual media based answers and questions they must usually get.  Truly awesome experience!  Central to all sports minded people, grounds all in a walking distance, bars/restaurants all very close.

title: Long weekend away

we had a room in the new section and these are beautiful .

we will be back soon, have to support local Accor hotels

title: Fantastic place to stay
text: Amazing dinner at reasonable price. Fabulous breakfast. Lovely clean comfortable room. Great view of the mighty Waikato river from our window. Lovely staff lovely atmosphere. We felt welcomed and valued.

title: Good customer service
text:
Every once in a while, you encounter customer service that completely changes the hotel experience.

We had that kind of customer service from Tamara.   She was friendly, professional, and extremely helpful.

Tamara helped us with parking (we arrived with 2 exhausted young children, so were VERY grateful for the assistance) and also assisted us later with a noise issue.     Top knotch customer service.
hotel_response: Thank you for choosing to stay with us recently and for taking the time to provide us with your feedback.  It was great to read you enjoyed your time with us and I will certainly pass on your feedback to Tamara and the Team. We look forward to being of service again soon.

title: One night
text: Reception excellent. Nice room overlooking river. The bar makes a good margarita. Pleasant dinner. Breakfast was buffet style - okay. Everything was as we would expect from a Novotel. It would be our fist choice if staying in Hamilton again.

title: Fantastically suited our needs
text: The executive king suite overlooking the city was devine, staff were very helpful and our 3 night stay was very relaxing. We stayed at few other waikato establishments while on this family trip, and Novotel was by far the best

title: Not a clean hotel
text: I have stayed in hotels all over the world and most have been very good. This particular hotel was a sad surprise. Travelled to Hamilton for a couples weekend and to support local businesses but never again to this establishment. Let me say first that the staff were very polite and friendly except one person who I will come to later. On our arrival at our room, which was facing the Main Street, (never allow yourself to be put in a room facing the Main Street, I suspect no double glazing, traffic and even foot traffic kept us awake all night,) my wife found that her bedside cabinet was covered in crumbs, disgusting, obviously never been cleaned from previous resident. The bar goods had been removed from the room , covered with a printed explanation that I didn’t read. There was only two small coffees and teas with two tiny pottles of milk, stingy. My wife asked a male that had come out from what appeared to be an office behind the counter, could he please arrange for some more milk to be sent up to our room, he was grumpy and we never got the milk so ended up going to the kitchen ourselves and getting some later in the evening. There is an outside deck for drinking and eating which is a very pleasant area observing Hamilton’s beautiful river, very peaceful except they have allowed a large table to be a smokers table right beside the main door to this deck. The wind blew and we had to move as we were choked with smoke. Why why would an international hotel place a smokers table by the main doors when it could be placed right down the other end where it would bother no one. They do advertise absolutely no smoking, well that’s a laugh. At breakfast time we sat at a two person table and it was so wobbly and I mean really wobbly, we spilt our coffee every time we ate off our plate. I politely asked waitress if their maintenance man could fix it at some stage, her response, “I will mention it but it is problematic with all our tables” What??. Whilst in the dining room the sun was shining at the right angle and you could see what is a very beautiful wooden covered floor, covered in dust and there were scraps or crumbs of food laying in the corners. The staff were placing cutlery for dinner and standing around talking with no attempts made to clean or sweep floor. Our room along with the corridor and passageways needed a darn good vacuum, I saw a vacuum cleaner outside one of the rooms supposedly being cleaned and it looked as old as the hotel. Very disappointed as I thought a hotel with this branding would be right up to the mark but it’s not. This could and should be an icon for the Tainui people but it’s not. Management need to take a good look at themselves as I believe the state of this hotel reflects upon them and their management staff.

title: Terrible service
text:
We arrived to Novotel by 3pm after 8 hours of difficult driving. Check I time here is 2pm. But our rooms were not ready when we arrived. They started cleaning our room we arrived and it took them 2 hours. Room was finally ready by 5pm. We had to wait for our room at the reception, sitting at uncomfortable chair, which gave me back ache. All we were offered as apologies is complementary drink, which we didn’t want. What we wanted after 8 hours sitting in a car is rest and lie down in bed, but had to wait for 2 hours for room to be ready, sitting in a chair.
We travel a lot and find this level of service unacceptable. 
Breakfast is ridiculously expensive here too
hotel_response:
Kia Ora annapW8420JE,

Thank you for taking the time to write about your recent stay with us here at Novotel Tainui Hamilton. 

On behalf of the hotel please allow me to express my sincere apologies for the long wait you encountered whilst trying to check in. We can certainly appreciate the expectation of being able to check in after 2PM, I am very sorry you were left waiting after a very long trip. This certainly should not have occurred and further solutions should have been found in this scenario. 
I would like to discuss your stay further but unfortunately am unable to see your information due to TripAdvisor being a separate platform to Accor Hotels. Should you wish to discuss your stay further, please  do not hesitate to get in touch directly via email. h2159-fo1@accor.com
Thank you again for taking the time to provide us with your valuable feedback.
Kind Regards,
Novotel Tainui Hamilton.

title: Poor stay
text: The hotel was clean and tidy. However check in was slow. No parking despite being prebooked. Double charged for breakfast. No linen available as the had run out of towels. The room was also not ready on time, it took a further few hours

title: Modern, Clean & Comfortable
text: Our Executive King Room with city views was obtained under our AccorPlus free stay option. The room was well appointed and looked fresh and clean.  We had v.g. SKY TV, WIFI, as also were the bathroom  and bedroom facilities. Our use of the dining facilities for dinner and breakfast were overall also very good. Staff were seeking to please and delivered an overall pleasing stay.

title: Only place to stay
text: Amazing hotel.  Location is perfect.  Rooms are comfortable, clean and quiet. Staff are friendly,  accommodating and professional.  Services are superb. This is the only hotel I stay at when in Hamilton!!

title: Do Away with the Card
text: Great location, nice restaurant and food was reka (nice). Staff friendly. But having to use your card every time you use the restaurant or bar to have the membership discount applied? There has to be a better system.
hotel_response:
Kia Ora Amy7137,

Thank you for taking the time to provide us with valuable feedback regarding your recent stay.

In regards to your membership card, you can download the ALL Loyalty App onto a smartphone which will store a virtual copy of your membership card. This saves you having to carry your physical membership card around with you.

We look forward to welcoming you back soon.

Regards,
Novotel Tainui Hamilton

title: Middle of Town
text: stayed 1 nite. The service excellent the room excellent the bar excellent I could not fault anything. We stay here lots. Couldn't fault anything. Well done Novotel Tainui. Undercover parking good. Reasonable price.

title: Not meet expectations
text: Bed felt like it needed replacing, felt like staff were all inexperienced and needed training.  Room we had was very noisy re street noise.  However no issues with presentation and cleanliness of room .
hotel_response:
