At Novotel, we strive to provide a superior service experience for every customer; therefore your feedback is very important to us. Please rest assured that we are taking the appropriate measures to address the problem and prevent future occurrence.

We appreciate your sharing your concerns, and it is our hope that you will give us the opportunity to better serve you in the near future.

Regards,
Novotel Tainui Hamilton

title: Novotel Hamilton
text: I had the standard 1 queen bed studio suite, with the city side view. Size of room was decent for a standard room, came with I nice bathroom with a shower basin and toilet. Also mini fridge, jug, 2 cups, 2 glasses, 2 wine glasses, sugar, coffee, hot choc, tea etc. The mini fridge took forever to get cool. With being on the town side, I had a problem with the noise, heavy bass but eventually stopped at around 12pm-1am. Didn’t come with a car park so finding one being in the city was a bit of trouble. There is a jacuuzi there which the water didn’t really look clean so I’m not sure if I’d recommend that. For the price of the room 250 a night, it wasn’t worth it. The breakfast buffet was amazing 😍 Also the decor in the place very upto date. Probably won’t stay again. But will definitely go for breakfast.
hotel_response:
Dear ShannonGO1,
Thank you for choosing to stay with us and for taking the time to provide us with your feedback. We very much appreciate the comments you made and we hope to be of service again in the near future.
Regards
The Novotel Tainui Team

title: Enjoyed immensely
text: I had 3 days in the Novotel Tainui and enjoyed them all. Staff all friendly & efficient. Room very nice although I do like to be able to open a window. - got a bit hot. Adequate gym. Hot tub was a bit scummy at the end of the day but the hotel was very busy.

title: Enjoyed my stay
text: Got a huge room that was so comfortable and felt so clean. I was booked in one night for work, and it was so comfortable that I paid for an extra day to just chill and relax after a long and tiring week. The staff were so accommodating. They managed to keep the same room for my new booking and took my bags up while I was attending my workshop. Really great place. Would definitely come back!

title: Clean rooms
text:
Room was nice and clean and had everything need. Checkin and express checkout was hassle free.
The hotel must have been full though as there was no parking available at hotel, so it pays to request parking in advance.

title: Fantastic service and central location
text:
A very clean and tidy hotel which is very central to Hamilton’s CBD.
Valet parking is offered at a very reasonable price and staff are welcoming, friendly and helpful.

This is one of my preferred hotels when I stay in Hamilton. The rooms are clean, spacious with great water pressure and amenities.

title: Break for wife
text:
I have been to your wonderful motel 3 times now and am pleasantly satisfied with your such great service , very helpful staff and upgraded units 
Upon arrival my wife was pleasantly greeted and was instantly recognized as a Platinum member and was personally greeted with minimal waiting , thank you to the front desk staff .
Upon entering our unit was also pleasantly surprised with a welcoming greeting card  with some nice personalised chocolates , thank you management for that thoughtfulness  
Will continue to use your service and my wife enjoys the great service and great motel

title: Great Hotel for a Break Away
text: Great Hotel.  Staff very efficient and friendly. Lovely room with very comfortable beds. Housekeeping staff very good with great attention to detail. Nothing was a problem. Valet parking service very efficient.

title: Comfortable central hotel with good restaurant
text:
Modern comfortable room. Not large but enough for a short stay. The hotel in the centre of Hamilton and is close to the river and there is a walk along the river that is very attractive. 
Restaurant has reasonable choice and food is excellent

title: Great stay
text:
I have stayed here a couple of times for work over the last few weeks and thoroughly enjoyed my stay. The rooms are really comfortable and decently sized , beds were really cozy. I had room service both times and the food was delicious and arrived pretty promptly despite being very busy. Staff were awesome , very friendly and professional you felt like nothing was too much trouble. Only small issue is parking, definately book ahead if you want valet parking or a car park because it is quite limited.
 I had to park at sky city which was a wee bit of a walk back to the room , not the end of the world just a minor thing to mention.  Hope to be back some time soon!

title: Wouldn't enthuse
text:
Selected this hotel as wanted a central location and to be by the river. The hotel delivers on these but the parking arrangement doesn't work well. Take your chances outside or pay an extra $25. I was already feeling the nightly rate, particularly on a Sunday, was pretty high for a fairly basic hotel outside of Auckkand and Wellington.

Check in and check out was rather a slow painful fprocess and the valet parking adds to this.  More reception staff needed when busy.

Room was fine and we were fortunate to have good views. Bed a bit spongy for us but okay.

I note the good comments about cleanliness. I would agree apart from dust on the shelf with cups and glasses, a bit off-putting.

I did object to cleaning staff working late into the afternoon on the floor and being very noisy calling out to each other. I don't want that as I am lying on the bed resting after a long trip.

Would I stay again? Probably not but it was okay.

title: Lovely friendly staff,rooms nice & lovely & clean
text: Lovely friendly staff,rooms nice & lovely & clean. They new it was my Birthday and left me a lovely chocolate surprise beautifully arranged on a oblong plate with a card from the staff.This was such a lovely thing for them to do and was trully appreciated.

title: Pleasant stay
text: I have had great stay at the Novotel Hamilton property. Check-in was swift and quick and whole process took me less than 5 mins. Room and lounge area was clean and tidy and social distancing was maintained throughout. Only issue I had with the parking spot and I have learned my lesson to book the parking well before I arrive at the hotel. Morning buffet was great and had lots of options. Would surely recommend to my family and friends.

title: Lovely First Break!!
text: My daughter met up in Hamilton to spend a night at Novotel.  The first "Treat" for a while - it was eagerly anticipated and did not disappoint.  Warm and professional welcome at reception;  the room was very pleasant with comfortable beds and a nice bathroom.  We enjoyed a couple of pre dinner drinks and our meal was delicious.  The highlight was the scallop starter and our snapper main was yummy.  Breakfast was fine with the usual buffet offerings which were a tad cool but OK.  An efficient checkout on morning of departure.  The little plate of welcoming goodies was a lovely touch with the personalized card.  The stay was much enjoyed.

title: Nice as always - just a bit of a mix up with rooms
text: The only issue this visit was they got our rooms wrong and had to wait 20 minutes to correct however we did check in early but had requested early check in via email. They did give us free drinks vouchers to compensate!

title: Great weekend stay.
text:
Stayed here for the first time, for a weekend. Great welcome, and room. My room was above the road, on the second floor, which I thought was a very quiet spot, considering the close proximity of the road.
Breakfast was different to usual, because of covid 19 restrictions.
The evening meal was superb, and I couldn't fault what I received.
The location is perfect for walking to the retail centre, and the  transport hub.
In all I found the hotel good value.

title: Great stay
text: My colleague and I had a one night stay for business recently.  We were treated exceptionally well.  The food was excellent despite all the hassles with COVID restrictions. The only hiccup was a delay in getting room service breakfast, which was understandable in the circumstances.Over all a great stay.
hotel_response:

We very much appreciate the comments you made and look forward to welcoming you back on your next journey to the Waikato.

title: Well situated in the heart of Hamilton
text: The Novotel staff are warm, friendly and helpful.  The hotel is well situated in the heart of Hamilton and is close to all shops, cafes, restaurants and the casino.  Our room was well furnished and nice and quiet.

Front Office Manager

title: Excellent friendly service from enthusiastic and thoughtful young staff
text: We stayed at the Novotel Tainui for four days as part of a business trip. The staff were friendly and helpful with our many and varied queries, and the hospitality staff quickly learned what we liked and remembered us for  the next meals. The food was very nice with a wide variety of nicely cooked and presented foods for breakfast, and tasty soups and salads for lunch. Arohanui ki a koutou, your manaakitanga made us feel so very welcome. The rooms were a good size and the bed very comfortable, and the shower a good pressure.

title: Great Hotel
text:
Awesome hotel the room was big and clean the staff were very friendly could not fault the hotel
Was in a great position to the town and all the restaurants also the hotel bar was great for a drink and our car was parked up for us

title: Great staff
text: Check in was easy. The staff were very friendly and professional.   Rooms were super clean and comfortable. The Breakfast was great with a huge range of food available. Close to an abundance of restaurants and bars.

title: Tidy and clean
text: Nice clean and tidy hotel. Good views of the river. Parking can be difficult. Was a little disppointed with the bar service as my wife and i had a beer each and the bartender handed over 2 beers in their bottles. We had to ask for glasses.

title: rates
text:
good place to stay.Very high price to pay,Have to pay for parking too.
Rates should be lower than this ,whereby every one could enjoy the stay.
I am ACCOr menber ,but no benifit beeing a member.Very sad.Hope some one will look into this.

title: Fantastic
text: Great service. Staff were super friendly. Loved the suites and the bed was heavenly. Would definately recommend. Everything is accessible/ walking distance. Room service was excellent. Would visit again

title: A bit hit and miss with the rooms
text: I have stayed several times but will be wary of doing so again. I could hear music all night even 5am and this is the second time that has happened. I suspect it was the room location but I had no idea and no choice on that. It wasn't external music sounds (the noise was generated by the hotel and my guess it was coming from the restaurant/bar area which closed way earlier. Heaven knows why they would have the music going all night and it wasn't load but enough to be annoying and disturb sleep.

title: Standard novotel in Hamilton
text:
I stayed here for a weekend. The hotel had a great location and is central to the cbd with everything in walking distance.  The rooms were clean with very standard novotel decor, color coordinated basic furniture.  The beds were very comfortable and the room had adjustable air conditioning.  The bathroom had a shower,  single sink and toilet.  One shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided for toiletries.  The shower pressure wad good and offered both rain shower and hand held shower options which wad good.  However the one ply toilet paper was cheap and the towels were worn.  No bathrobes or plush towels here.  
The restaurant offered a nice buffet for breakfast.  The usual cooked bacon eggs hash browns and a selection of cereals.  Everything is self service.  Not ideal in the age of coronavirus but nothing you could do about it.  We had dinner in the restaurant at night.  Meals were good standard food,  pork, fish,  chicken, steak options for dinner.  Not a lot of options for vegetarians or other dietary requirements.  
Parking at the hotel is an additional charge so budget this in. 
All in all a pleasant stay for one or two nights. Not luxury.  But better than the other options in Hamilton. 
This hotel hasn't embraced coronavirus precautions.  Other than hand sanitizer everywhere no changes have been made.  They could do a lot better in this area.

title: Business trip made easy
text: Hadn't stayed at hotel for a couple of years but the welcome, amenities and general tidiness was still as I remember outstanding. Staff are great, friendly, helpful and ready for a chat. located in the CBD and near great restaurants always worth a stay.  Parking is the only issue and if I'd know valet booked prior would secure under hotel parking then I would have booked, sky city carpark and walk back interesting!!

title: Very friendly welcome in Hamilton
text: The staff here were very welcoming and helpful. A credit to the hotel. Rooms and facilities up to Novotel’s usual standards. Central location. Parking at front a bit tight when checking in and could have more staff on when checking out to avoid long queues.

title: Abrupt Welcome
text: I do like Novatel Hotel generally but the one in Hamilton needs to get its act together with customer service. When you prepay your stay online as an accor member, and you can have that supposedly seamless check in and check out, you do not need to be told at the front counter on your welcome, that you have only paid a deposit for your room. The girl at the front desk of Novatel Hamilton is not a very welcoming sort of person who has an abrupt tone and an impatient persona.  She needs to welcome you with : Your stay in the room is all paid for (she can see that its been done with a credit card days before and it has come out of your own credit card)  and now we need a credit card to put on file for any extras you may incur during your stay. That is clear, precise and exact. Rather than insisting you have only paid a deposit on your room. That is confusing and appears that you have more to pay on your room stay. She needs instruction in customer service so her persona is welcoming, cheery and exact. Other than that, the stay was fine.

title: Disappointed in cleanliness
text: The bath wasn't cleaned at all upon our arrival. The carpets were very dirty -even dirty marks on the walls. Even when we specifically requested the bath be cleaned properly the next day, it still wasn't done properly. Especially in light of Covid-19, one would expect the hotel to have far higher standards on cleanliness and hygiene.

title: great location,  friendly staff , spacious suite
text: nice spacious suites, this hotel is our hotel of choice.  Overlooking the river and with the new rooms also this hotel offers plenty of choice. Friendly staff and good food if you want to try the restaurant.

title: Style & Comfort
text:
My partner and I reallly enjoyed our stay here at the Novotel. I arrived to be greeted by the Valet. So polite and helpful. I left her with my keys and went into check in. Was greeted warmly by the reception staff for priority check-in. Lobby area and even the toilets were very clean.

Our room was clean and tidy. Loved our bed. Very big and spacious, but best of all so very comfortable. Our ensuite was quite compacted, however, I absolutely love the shower space. The room had the bare essentials which we were both happy with. Very chic interior. Our room service we ordered was promised to the estimated time. Our attendant was such a busy man but maintained such a bubbly and professional persona to him. He was fabulous.

Thank you so much to the staff for their generous hospitality. I look forward to staying again, but hopefully for a longer duration.

title: Very average stay
text: First stay in this Hotel and ouldn't stay again. On the Saturday morning of checkin received an email for pre checkin so was expecting fast service on arrival at Hotel. Quite a few people arrived at same time as we did. Front office manned by 2 staff. At one stage one left to Valet park a vehicle. Being unfamiliar with where the free parking was asked and had to figure it out after checking in. Told first in first served. Was expecting to pay but we  investigated anyway. All full so I then had to queue again and got the 2nd staff member who said just a minute and checked security camera to confirm nol free parking left. Why couldn't staff member no.1 have done this. Organized valet parking and headed to the room. Pretty standard Hotel room. Found the heating turned on and off a little noisy. Heard noisy guests running up and down the corridor after midnight as we were close to the lift. The shower was an open disability type shower. Great pressure but water spread all over the floor. Decided to have a drink in the Bar. Asked for the cocktail list. Told could only make some. No idea why. The ones I would have ordered I.e mojito in the  not available list. Gin and tonic was a safe option. Didnt eat in Hotel. Next morning rang around 9am for car to be brought up. 5 minutes later phone call to the room asking what my parking tab number was as 2 guests with our surname. Go downstairs to Front Office and only 2 staff. The one I went to had headphones on and told me sorry I needed to queue at the other desk. Thus girl appeared to be manning the phone for the valet parking and collecting the cars. The checkout procedure was slow and a queue forming behind me as one staff member processing credit cards for the added room charges I.e in my case the parking and drinks in the bar. Very poor front office. First impressions count. For a Hotel this size should have 2 on the desk plus one parking valet.

title: Stopover
text:
Great communication from the hotel including a text message with directions, very thoughtful.
Really quick and easy to check in and exceptionally friendly staff. 
Rooms very clean and really comfortable beds. Excellent meal experience in the on site restaurant.
 Fab stay, thanks

title: Daughters 21st
text:
I needed a Hotel in Hamilton township close to the restaurant where my daughter had her 21st dinner 
Checkin was a breeze with very friendly staff, room was fantastic with a great view
Valet parking was simple and when I called up to get my car it was done very quickly 
Highly recommend

title: Clean and comfortable
text:
We were in Hamilton as a couple to celebrate a birthday.  Check-in experience was not the best... queue jumpers and people not showing respect or consideration to others.  Maybe nothing new there, but staff should've known who was next to check in...

The room was spacious, clean and comfortable.  Nice bathroom... but not overly plush.

Our visit was during Covid-19 restrictions, so we had to sign a Tracing Register not only at check-in but also at the bar.  Seems a bit of a double up, but not worth sweating over.

The lifts were small and again, owing to Covid-19, a queue of 12+ quickly assembled.  Some waited their turn, others took the first opportunity and travelled in the lift alone.  Again, a respect and consideration issue.  It just isn't there for some travellers.

Some of us elected to use the stairs, but the stairs are hidden on the other side of a conference facility and we had to be shown there by the porter... who initially said that there weren't any stairs until I challenged him.

The one-night room rate was a bit high, we thought... about $40 more than we have paid in large towns and cities elsewhere in the country.  It was nothing flash, but generally very adequate in terms of sleeping, dining, drinking and location.

title: Will not be going back.
text:
Arrived to find to have to park out in the rain,appreciated.😳
And to top it off find out a Hotel this size makes them pay $10 for a 24 hr time slot knowing fully well no guest is able to take that up on an overnight stay,won't be back it won't be recommending it to anyone else.

title: The best meal every here
text: There was so much food i was not sure where to start, however the steak was fantastic perfect medium and the pepper sauce was to die for. The staff were so kind and the service excellent i was welcomed by Charlane and served Azzan both ambassadors of this hotel of the highest caliber  and a credit to Novotel as a brand

title: Clean and Modern
text: Everything you would expect from this hotel chain only marred by the significant construction work at the entrance to the building. Rooms clean and modern with friendly accommodating employees. Good breakfast buffet.

title: Modern, contemporary and clean
text: We usually travel on our own. This trip we were on a tour. This hotel was our first in NZ. It is modern, comfortable and clean. Being our first night we stayed in and slept. Bd was comfortable, bathroom was clean and modern. Shower was great. Bed was comfortable and the AC temp settings were accurate. Breakfast was provided, very tasty, good choice and plentiful. Good choice for a stay in this city.

title: Convenient location with a staff that addresses problems
text: This property is clean and meets or exceeds expectations. Our room was not the one we had reserved.  One call to the management and the issue was resolved with complimentary valet and breakfast offered for their inability to provide room reserved. Buffet was good and diverse selection of food items. This hotel is in a great location. We walked to Hamilton Gardens and nearby Palate Restaurant which was recommended by hotel and fabulous. Management of hotel gets an A plus!

title: Clean, Convenient, Friendly, Too Soft Beds
text: Staff was friendly and helpful, check-in was easy.  Due to construction there was an issue with an assigned room being occupied, but it was fixed quickly.  The beds were very soft and caused all 3 of us some discomfort.  Breakfast was good.

title: Most uncomfortable beds I have ever experienced
text:
Overall the hotel isn’t bad, but when it comes to the beds and comfort, it is an absolute miss. The beds are so soft that when you climb onto one, you go straight threw and hit the base. Couple this with the unknown reason of them using 5 sheets which the duvet is wrapped in, I’m not sure what their thought process was.
Stayed there for a week, then went to Tauranga, and came back for another 3 days on business, and on both occasions my bathroom was dirty and covered in someone else’s hair, so cleaning standards are also not up to scratch. Other than these factors, the hotel was pleasant enough, close to the mall and a good selection at breakfast with friendly enough staff.

title: one night stopover - fantastic
text: stopped over in Hamilton and opted for the Novotel - we liked it, friendly service, reasonable rates, good open common areas, very nice coffee and the rooms were well presented and very comfortable - there are some additional rooms going in but that didn't impact our stay, we would definitely stay here again

title: What you see is what you get....in a good way.
text: We stayed here for one night on 8 February 2020, as we were attending a wedding nearby. Great hotel all up. Friendly helpful staff, even managed to get us an early check in without extra cost so that we could get ready for the wedding. Room was nicely decorated, light airy, modern and clean. Bed was SUPER comfortable but pillows were abit big for me. Lovely bathroom and shower, could've done with better lighting though (for those wanting to put makeup on in there). And the price was good value. Check out was a bit slow but that was because the Crusaders were checking out also, so hotel staff were under the pump a tad. Valet parking cost $25, the only other parking option is at the Sky city casino which is nearby and that costs $20, so we went with the hotel valet being more convenient. Would definitely book here again.

title: Lovely
text: I enjoyed the "small town" hospitality where hotel staff want to help make you settle in without being too intrusive. The restaurant is cosy and the food is good. I certainly recommend this place to anyone travelling to Hamilton.

title: Good comfortable hotel
text:
The hotel is currently a building site, but it’s proof of the soundproofing that our room overlooked the builders and we could barely hear a thing as they started up early on Monday morning.

Parking is awkward. We were lucky to get a self park space the first night and used the Sky City car park ($22) for the second night. The hotel will do a valet park for $25.

The room was smart, comfortable and clean. There’s a guest laundry up on the third floor ($2 for a wash includes soap, $2 for a dry... Reception will change notes into coin for you) which we were grateful to be able to use.

We had breakfast in the hotel and that was fine too.

Staff were friendly and welcoming and we would certainly stay here again.

title: Loved our one night stay here
text: We only stayed one night as a stop off before driving to Auckland the following day.  Our family room was very large and modern with 2 queen beds, a dining table, a desk and a sofa.  The bathrooms were a good size with a bath and a shower.   We ate in the restaurant for both dinner and breakfast and service was very good.  Valet parking was also excellent.  Only downside was that the mini fridge was a little too small.  We would recommend this hotel and would definitely stay again.

title: Great Front Desk Service But...
text: The rooms were not clean well, dusty carpets, dirty towels in the bathrooms. We had to keep ruining front desk to get housekeeping to clean the room, We had a  full mini bar one night and the next night it was empty even our own alcohol and water bottle was taken. Front desk recovery was great they replenished the items but by then we had enough. Breakfast was not great, no variety, just bland.

title: Overpriced and rude
text:
The room was so overpriced and the staff (well manager) at reception were rude. I felt so unwelcome on arrival. 
Parking arrangement and cost was not explained.  
Room was good but terribly overpriced and what is considered normal to peovide was all an additional cost. 
Would not stay here again.

title: Good Central Location
text: Stayed 2 nights whilst on our holidays. Able to park the car & walk around town area. Short drive to see Hobbiton whilst we were there. Good service by staff and restaurant was quite good. Loved the bed and pillow. had a nice relaxing day

title: Great location
text:
Great location - close to everything - park, lake front playground, museum, cafes and restaurant.
Rooms are also clean and the staff are very welcoming and considerate. The hotel restaurant is surprisingly good too. Reasonably well set out breakfast buffet too with good selections of food.

title: Great hotel for local touring
text:
The staff at the hotel provide an excellent level of customer service being both personable and professional.  The rooms are reasonably sized and the breakfast provides a good spread.  The restaurant menu is more than adequate for most people's needs and food is served promptly.

There is valet parking available which operates well and the hotel is adjacent to a river and local shops including a large variety of restaurants.

I will be recommending this hotel to friends.

title: Nice venue and staff but breakfast very poor
text: The majority of my stay was great but for the terrible breakfast.  I had a buffet cooked breakfast which was cold. the scrambled eggs and bacon were look warm at best. I will seriously consider not havong breakfast here in future.

title: A WONDERFUL OVERNIGHT STAY
text: This is our very favourite place to stay in Hamilton. The location is excellent and the staff are so friendly in every department. Good size rooms and the food in the Restaurant is first class.From the moment we checked in till we departed we received excellent service and we received a lovely little platter of chocolate and berries when we first checked in to our room.

title: Parking headaches, sub par breakfast - but cheap!
text: I think part of my problem with this hotel just stemmed from the incredible hassle with parking. I would’ve forgiven more as the service was kind, but there was literally no easy way to get into this hotel. There’s so much construction, you are forced to valet. And it was nice that that was free. However, to try and get my vehicle out of the ready space took a Herculean effort as many cars were parked around me.  This was unfortunate as we had an appointment to get to.  Our hotel rooms were clean however, you can tell this is an older hotel, and the smell of smoke lingers in the worn down hallways.  Of the three Novotels we stayed at in New Zealand, this breakfast was the most mediocre. Just limited like a more typical US small roadside hotel. It was hard for me to mark this hotel down to a three though because of the value.  This hotel is cheap. There is no question. As long as you’re paying around $100 a night as we were, I guess you really can’t complain too much. Just give yourself a lot of time getting in and out of the hotel.

title: Novotel saved our bacon!
text: We walked in off the street after walking out of our previously-booked hotel (which was NO good) and were booked straight in without any fuss. Room was clean and breakfast was basic but great. Highly recommended.
hotel_response:
Kia ora  Tracey.

Happy New Year.

So pleased to have you on your return stay and to hear back from our guests.
Glad your stay was a breeze.See you soon. Have a great week ahead.

Ngā mihi nui | Warm regards 
Niraj Kumar- Acting General Manager
Novotel and Ibis Tainui Hamilton

title: Christmas Dinner (no accommodation)
text:
We booked for 3 adults & 1 child for Christmas Dinner 2019.
Met with a glass of bubbles (or non  alcoholic bubbles) - great.
Buffet opened.

title: Over priced and Disappointing
text:
Booked a basic room with a king bed and requested a high floor with a quiet room and early check in, pre organised this before arrival only to arrive and have my booking reinstated as it was cancelled prior to turning up. 

Having hotel experience didn’t think much of it as it’s a simple fix....hotel is getting refurbished so parking is limited and hard to find but it’s acceptable..that’s where it stops.

Paying $60 extra to check in to a room that is $220 a night without breakfast and you can see a pub from your bedroom window is a bad sign, that along with people and traffic from Saturday night was not pleasant. Clearly was placed in the only room ready at 10am for a pre requested early arrival. Room itself was ok looking but not the best. Hallways need work certainly not 4 star level and you can hear everything from the hallways at any hour of the day.

Breakfast was busy as expected but where are the staff? Buffet was unappealing, coffee machine options limited and machine needed urgent attention, dirty tables all over the place and a front desk staff member resetting tables.

To be frank. Not worth the $60 extra for checking in early that should be free of charge, wouldn’t get breakfast included that’s money you could save on a room and wouldn’t pay more than $150 for the basic room we had to pay $342 for by the time you take in parking.

Will not stay again.

title: Central city - close to everything
text: We used this hotel to go to a show. $20 per night for parking and an added $5 per day for valet parking. We used the valet parking as it saved us time, especially when returning late at night as the parking is a 15 walk away. The rooms were well heated and the ac was easy to use if too hot or cold in the night.  Great beds with feather pillows and feather duvets.  Spare blanket and pillows in wardrobe, however with 2 beds, 2 extra blankets would be good as one of us had to used a coat, before we realised we could just turn the heat up a bit!!! (WE were half asleep!)  Great breakfast which we got for $2 on a winter special and the meals in the restaurant were similar prices to surrounding restaurants. The main street is really a food street just a little further down so have a wander and find other food if you wish.  Straight across the road is a Thai restaurant (where we ate as it was light and just like what we felt like) and 2 Italian restaurants.  The casino is a two minute walk if that floats your boat.  We visited the Hamilton Gardens the next morning which will be even more stunning later in Spring and during summer. They were just budding. However the Indian garden is a Spring garden as was in full bloom with tulips etc.  Great staff, very helpful, free fast internet and lots of free news papers in the lounge.  Lovely bathroom with a rain and a handheld shower - it was a bit too high for us - last person must have been tall. Lovely and clean, complimentary toiletries and good hairdryer.  A night light for the toilet would be nice so we can find it in the night without waking up the other person or leaving the bathroom light (with fan) on.  Will definitely stay again if needing to be right in the city.  Very close to so many amenities.

title: Don’t expect service unless you’re an All Black or Suit
text:
Awful disrespect from from desk staff when we needed another (!!) room key after it stopped working (when will hotels realise it’s an awful system??).  Only one person on the desk at 9pm (!) - all other staff running round sucking up to the All Blacks who happened to be staying here.   After eventually getting some service to get a new key card to be told “that key card stopped working yesterday” I was gobsmacked !!!  For starters that was the only keycard I’d been using all day today (so it clearly didn’t stop working yesterday!!!!!!) but even if she thought it did stop yesterday WHY ??? Why would it stop yesterday (it didn’t !!) when we were always booked in for two more days ???? and even worse clearly no thought to actually say sorry for the inconvenience!!!!!  No apology at all - until I rang reception after getting to the room and complained .... at which point the same staff member then decided perhaps an apology was warranted - too little too late for me.  Completely Disingenuous !! So why bother ?

Luckily the All Blacks and suits don’t have to put up with such disrespect - apparently if you wear shorts and a hoodie you’re not important !!

We stayed in 2 rooms and  for 2 nights at this hotel.

title: Good Location, Nice room.
text:
We arrived at the novotel at 5.30pm on a weekday. With the hotel extension parking out the front is limited. There was no valet, even though this would be a peak time for check ins. No bell boy came to help with our bags. We found a spot to park and  proceeded to check in. 

Check in was reasonably quick and easy, however the small things count. We were not greeted with a smile. Our pre paid booking included breakfast, but that was not confirmed on checkin, nor were we told where breakfast was held or at what times. Nor were we told of the internet passwords. We asked for a valet park, for which we paid $25. I advised them our bags were in the car, and I was told to give them the keys once we removed our bags. There was no offer of assistance. 

The room itself was clean and bright. The shower was large and had good pressure. The bed was a little on the soft side. A pillow menu was available. Our room had a coffee pod machine with a variety of pods available. Room 5/5. 

Downstairs in the bar we collected our free drinks. The girl at the bar was friendly and guided our choice for a drink. Good service here. 

Breakfast was a buffet located on the ground floor. It was a typical western style buffet; eggs (fried or scrambled) , bacon, hash browns, sausages, tomato, mushrooms and beans. etc. All lukewarm. The pancaake machine was a nice touch. Coffee was available from a machine ( nice coffee) or ordered separately ( a little bitter) . We would rate the breakfast as a 3/5.

Location was great. A short walk to many restaurants. I would consider staying again, however would choose to breakfast elsewhere, especially with the proximity of many restaurants.

title: Novotel Tainui Hamilton
text: Had an excellent stay. Everything was great. Excellent room service. The room was very clean and had everything we wanted - great views too. The bed was the most comfortable ever. Thanks we will be back.

title: Cleanliness is next to godliness
text: This was a 1 night stay, front desk people do friendly & helpful, location right next to the sky casino and lots of places to eat on a saturday night. Room decor, so clean, it was stunning. Spa was amazing overlooking outside area of a big chess board. Full continental breakfast at $32 had soooo many choices fruits eggs bacon muffins. Our stay cost $239 for 2 adults, money well worth spent.

title: Enjoyable with a Picturesque View.
text:
I spent a night in a Riverside Room overlooking the Waikato River, which in my opinion is better than the city views the hotel has to offer.  The room was light and spacious, and a very comfortable bed.
Quite a few restaurants nearby, and Centre Place (an odd shopping centre) is just across the road.

title: Enjoyable stay
text: Very friendly and helpful staff. We had great nights sleep on a very comfy bed and thought their facilities were perfect for our family of 3. The restaurant dinner was delicious too. I would definitely stay there again if we go back to Hamilton.

title: Wonderful
text: We had booked for one night with some of our family.  As it was a Saturday night Management went over and above to accomodate our vehicle. The rooms were spotless likewise the bathroom and toilet.  The breakfast which was included in the price, including a "proper" coffee was set out beautifully the dining room clean and welcoming.  The staff were quietly there and helpful if needed.  The only down side to our stay was one room was near the lift and all night it sounded like a whale in distress so there was not much sleep in that room, however knowing that when booking again I would make sure we were well away from that area in case it had not been rectified.  Another room was near the gym area but there was no noise from that room the door kept it all quiet which was nice.

title: weekend away
text: classic novotel great service quick and very polite room was great clean as always very nice memory foam mattress breakfast buffet also amazing just fantastic always stay at novotel when in a new city loved it close to mall and close to skycity hamilton and close to resturants aswell great stay

title: Wonderful staff a very big thank you
text: We were only meant to stay one night.  Unfortunately my dad took a bad turn and ended up in hospital.  The staff and everyone at the hotel was wonderful.  We were able to extend out stay two more nights with no trouble and they gave us the same rate as what I had already booked.  With the option of just staying as long as needed.  I just want to give them all a very big thank you from all of us.

title: Exciting stay
text: Being my first stay in a hotel I was blown away. From check in to check out, the staff were very friendly and always ready to help. The room was amazing and I greatly enjoyed the whole experience. I also want to shout out the reception staff name of Buddhika he seemed to love his job, he always had a smile on and had a nice manner. Thanks Novotel Team

title: Novotel Hamilton
text: Very nice accommodation and very good restaurant. Customer service in reception and bars areas could be better.  Great location and good rooms. Food and service in the restaurant was excellent. Buffet breakfast was very good too.

title: Great location
text: Stayed here for a conference. The room was a good size and clean. The staff were friendly. The breakfast buffet had many choices and included espresso coffee. The dinner menu was tasty. Overall, it was an enjoyable stay.

title: Poor value for money and poor service
text:
Small, tired rooms and expensive for what you get. Poor service from the Indian man at reception. A smile would be nice considering we paid $250 for a very small room and had to pay for parking.  

DO NOT STAY HERE!!

title: Disappointed with Restaurant - Alma
text: Was greeted by lovely reception staff on our arrival to the hotel. Offered to help with the luggage but we were ok to carry our own luggage. Gave the key for valet parking and went to our room. There is construction at the hotel at the moment but was no problem to us. Called to book in dinner at the restaurant and was told that the restaurant was fully booked till about 8pm so I booked for 8.30pm. Went back to the bar for a drink and there were empty glasses everywhere on the lounge tables. There were staff just doing nothing. Only person working was a little blonde lady. We left the bar around 7 and came back at 8.30 for dinner. The restaurant was a mess and there was no one at the desk to greet us and take us to our table. Another group of people were leaving and wanted to settle their bill as well but no one to be found. The lovely lady from the bar had to go get someone from the kitchen. She was clueless. The whole restaurant was empty. We had to pour our own sparkling water and wine. With the whole restaurant empty she sat another couple next to us. Which was very disappointing. I will stay at the hotel but won’t be dining at the restaurant. There are much nice and cheaper places you can dine close by. Checkout was amazing. Our car was ready for us by the time we came downstairs.

title: Average for the price
text: I recently stayed at the Novotel Tainui & found the whole experience disappointing. Firstly when taken to our room we went in & it was 30 degrees & the air conditioning fan was on full !! it was like a furniss inside. I thought maybe the cleaner had left it on earlier in the morn when cooler so tried to set it to cool. After about half an hour 2 air conditioning personal arrived to say they needed to check the ducting etc as there was a problem with it. They had a quick check then told us they were coming back to fix it. I just don't understand why we we were even booked into that room when they were aware there was a problem with it. When I rang and asked to change there was no apology from the staff just a grumpy woman telling me she would do what she could as they were fully booked. After some time we we moved to another room suitable for someone with wheelchair ie not the original spec of room we had booked. Another gripe is they advertise on their website valet parking for $15 when in fact they charge $25 for it, again no apology, just a grumpy statement that it is $25 & they also advertise on the website pay per view tv which they no longer offer. I felt at $260 per night plus an extra $25 to have my car parked in a park I could have put it in myself for no charge was pretty steep & to top it all off when I left I was not even asked how my stay was, Please note I am not a stuffy old grumpy person expecting 5 star service & I do not usually do a lot of reviews I just thought on this occasion the Novotel Tainui did not deliver & did not apologise or care about it for that matter. For the record I did bring up all of these issues with them at the time but no one that worked there gave a s*@t.

title: ANOTHER PLEASURABLE STAY
text: Always opt to stay here at Novotel Tainui Hamilton for the yearly Field days - never disappoint with the fast check, friendly staff and comfortable room and bed once again.  Evening meal in restaurant was so delicious - our waiter went over and beyond with his service to help us choose from menu etc!! (cant remember his name - lovely guy!!).

title: Noisy, tired, dirty and no room service
text: Going to be making regular work visits to Hamilton but won’t be to this hotel. No one answered the room service phone despite regular calls, the neighbours in adjoining rooms might as well have been in mine as I could hear every word and their TVs, workmen were fixing ceiling pipes in corridors do there was debris and gib dust everywhere. Stay in lots if hotels around the world and thus was substandard.

title: Great Location in Town
text: We stayed for one night in this city centre hotel, parking outside a bit tight due to extending the hotel, checking in was ok, not so friendly has other Novotels we visited in New Zealand, room on the small size also the bathroom not great, the only good thing about this hotel is the location to shops, cafes and restaurants, plus sightseeing in the area.The Novotels in Wellington and Hamilton both soulless hotels but in great locations, all the other Novotels we stayed in, very good with friendly and helpful staff.

title: cold night out
text:
it took a long time before anyone came to the counter. 
weren't many in this night but as time went on there were a lot of staff around.
we were finally seen to and shown to our seat. 
another couple came in and were seated right beside us. they may as well have joined us at our table because you could hear every word said and
felt most uncomfortable. 
the waiter took our drinks order  and came back for the Starter and Main.
when the main was delivered if he had taken note that our glasses were empty
we would have ordered another drink but never saw him again for the rest of the
night until our plates were removed and decided to go home for a wine instead.
normally I would have waved a hand to draw attention but this night I thought
this is their job and didn't feel comfortable drawing attention to our table and 
I guess it may have been due to the other table being at arms distance .
the food however was lovely.

title: Good location otherwise disappointing......
text:
From check in (two staff helping now man who wanted an upgrade as he didn't like his room - while ignoring the queue building up) things were not great.
Room key didn't work so had to go back get it reprogrammed. Room very small and while clean, decor looking a bit tatty.
No robe. No shower cap. things you would expect as standard.

Bed comfy...but no sleep due to the noise level - there was an area on the hallway with couches etc which people were using until very late, and the walls felt very thin. Between loud drunk people and slamming doors i got no sleep. Air con was noisy - but at least that covered some of the background noise.

Then after breakfast my key card didn't work again. 

Would not stay again.

title: Restaurant lunch substandard
text: Went for lunch with 5 of us. Slow service, terrible delivery of food, average to poor quality, hard to find anything redeeming, waiter more interested in talking to two girls dining than ever seeing if we had needs, and then we struggled to find someone to take our money for the overpriced rubbish.

title: Hotel In The Centre Of Town
text:
Situated right in the centre of Hamilton the Novotel is next to the beautiful Waikato River. It's an easy walk to the shops with several malls nearby. 
Now this Hotel was built when space was not a problem, the rooms are huge with the Executive Suite having 16ft/5m ceilings with windows to match. All rooms are large & the Executive Suite bathroom has a giant tub & grand walk in shower.
The foyer, bar area & dining room all combine in a setup to give you a feeling of openness & space.
The restaurant serves quality fare & the bar area overlooks the Waikato River. There is an out side dinning area so you can feel that you are in the wild.

title: Disappointing service this time around
text: I stay at this Hotel frequently for work commitments.  The room and restaurant  was as per expected however I did find the front desk service disappointing this trip.  I requested via email prior to arrival a tax invoice for my prepaid room and received the response that "it was not possible until I had stayed in the Hotel", I suggested that I did not have a problem receiving one from Novotel Auckland Airport and suggested that they could inquire how to do so.  I did not receive a response and upon check out I had to request the same.  It was the 20th Birthday of the Hotel during my stay and a large birthday celebration was in full swing only problem was it was held in the restaurant main bar area and the guests were shunted off to the convention room and the service was very slow and poor, I would have thought that the guests took priority.  Check out was slow and the usual friendliness was absent.

title: will not return
text:
We stayed only the one night thank goodness
The room was clean but the décor was extremely dated
Great room size but that’s where it ends 
Close to the CBD and reasonable secure undercover parking at a cost 
Otherwise its first in first served in an open area.
I appreciate there is renovations and extensions were occurring but overall the hotel has really reached it’s use by date

title: Awesome stay
text: We loved our stay, we enjoyed the relaxed environment, we were left to our own devices, our room was pleasant.  The friendly staff was there if you needed them. We also enjoyed the fine dining. We would go back again

title: Great location but tired hotel
text: Stayed here overnight on the way to Rotorua. Great location in the CBD being very close to good restaurants within walking distance. Had a difficult time trying to find parking as the hotel was busy on our arrival. Hotel was very tired looking but was good value for money. Staff were friendly and food was ok.

title: Stay at Novotel Hamilton Tainui
text: Only gripe I had with my stay was that my door keys didn't work on the morning I was due to check out. I was in a hurry and had three attempts before the keys worked. This meant running back and forth from room to reception on several occasions. The young girl on reception looked as though she was the person being inconvenienced  - no apology, expression of concern or smile.  Not the best person to put on the front desk of a hotel.

title: First Time stay
text: First Time stay for 3 nights.The staff were super friendly, The areas provides plenty of places to eat and there is a shopping mall about a 10 minute walk. The room was clean the bed was a bit soft for me, not good for my back, the shower on the 4 floor kept loosing the hot water as it would turn cold for no reason.

title: Nice room and facilities although a little noisy
text: I stayed here for four nights recently while in town on business. I enjoyed my room - nice bed, furnishing and bathroom although I found it a little noisy over night. Fortunately this didn't end up stopping me from sleeping and I realised later on that my room was right next to the lift well so I wondered if it was the lift I could hear - sounded like dragging or someone playing a computer game...

title: Great hotel
text: We spent a few days at this hotel and found it convenient to everything,central.We even went to the pubs and clubs and they were all just a walk from the hotel,down the road.The best thing was we were invited to a wedding and the reception was in the hotel.The food and venue was good.

title: perfect 👌🏻
text:
Good location, perfect for family stay . We had rooms with breakfast.
However , breakfast buffet was very limited options. Hope they will look into it . 
Rooms were nice and comfortable. 
Overall very good .

title: Good central location
text: Good central location in the heart of Hamilton CBD.  Close to many family friendly eating establishments.   Room was clean and comfortably furnished.   Breakfast was included and was a great array of dishes to suit all palates

title: Has dropped in standard
text: I have stayed here a few times for business and it was always a good experience, this last trip I found the standards have fallen plus there is building work being done which was NOT advertised on their site. I found the staff need a refresher on customer relations, a few times they would continue with their own conversation/task before asking me what I needed. The building is showing signs of tiredness and overall I was disappointed this time.

title: Always Great at Novotel Hamilton
text: The hotel is centrally located in Hamilton and allows for easy walking distance to all major restaurants along Victoria Street. The hotel itself is modern, spacious and has great helpful staff. Although it only has valet parking at the moment, it’s usually very fast to get your car. I can recommend this hotel enough for the business or holiday traveller.

title: Business overnighter
text: Good dependable place to stay for business and leisure. Free Wifi (Accor members), $25 valet parking, on-site restaurant and bar, in the heart of town near good place to eat. Rooms get a 4 out of 5 for cleanliness, surfaces a little dusty and vanity could do with the toothbrush treatment around the joins but generally nice and fresh. Shower pressure lower than some but adequate and eco-conscious. Staff are helpful and pleasant. Was here in June and it seems the renovations are still going so a little bit of construction site both times. King size rooms are good, the twin share beds suffer a bit of roll together and two beds in one room is a bit cramped for working at the desk.

title: Over night stay in Hamilton
text: Great hotel if you need to stay over in Hamilton. Close to the CBD and major shopping centres. Fine restaurants within walking distance. Good value for money. The hotel is adding more room at the moment so, a bit of construction going on at the moment but it is not a problem at all. The breakfast was fantastic.

title: Great hotel, exceed expectation on Novotel Brand
text:
Booked 2 rooms staying 2 nights, i'm a silver member of Accor group. Arrived around 4pm and the front office team has kindly arranged the room based on my preference (room close to each other) despite the fact that the hotel is expecting full house. Welcome cookies was placed on bed, room was clean and beds were comfortable.

Dine at the restaurant for one of the night, food was great, customer service at high standard. overall i found hotel staff are friendly. 

The only downside is the expensive parking, during the time i was there, the only onsite parking option was valet parking which cost NZD25 per night. Other than that, everything was great.

title: Night Out for Time Out
text: The Novotel Tainui Hamilton is one where we have stayed before and without a doubt is exceptional and well worth staying at in such that everything can be accommodated. The service once again was not but professional, courteous and all the staff well presented. whether one stays for a night or longer in my view the Hotel is certainly a place to stay.

title: Centrally located
text:
Hotel location is very handy...no free parking and also limited paid street parking. Hotel offers parking at a reasonable rate.lots of eating and night out options available.
Breakfast at the hotel is really nice,lots to choose from.
Rooms are nice and clean, they have a little gym onsite.
Overall good place to stay

title: Not worth it
text:
Ok, I have a rule of not giving one star rating unless someone has been rude to me. So yes here, two stars. 

So come on, follow my experience at Novotel Hamilton:

To start with, when making reservations they offered an option to choose river side or street side. I choose riverside. On my arrival, they have assigned me a street side room, OK I get it's request only, not guaranteed, totally fine. All I am expecting is a simple sentence: sorry your request for riverside room hasn't been met. Then I would be ok no promblem. All they did was giving me the key, and that's it. And of course, Saturday night Street music kept me awake till 1am.

Parking: on their website it claims there are outdoor parking, indoor parking and valet parking. However onsite only valet parking is available and of course I pay as it is a service from hotel. What I am not impressed about is that you should not advertise if you don't offer other parking options. 

Port: again false advertising. Porter service is available according to the website. However no one is available to help as everyone is busy with valet parking and of course it happens with only one porter on shift. Not my position to judge the manning, but when I asked for help, instead of saying porter can help me later, they told me everyone is busy with cars, you need to do your own luggage. So here I am, a fat Asian dude struggling with his 6 bags: in and out. 

Check-in staff is cold faced, quoted from him "please give me your credit card. " For what? I know pre-auth is common practice, but at least you should tell me! 

Lift security : highlighted in a sign in the lift "for your security, you need your room key to active the lift after 10pm. " and then? 11pm on Saturday night, no one needs to use key cards, anyone can get into the lift and go to any floor they want. Sorry, but the security seems a joke especially if you claim you are on it. 

Room smell: strong sewing smell in the room. Didn't bother to ask, cause the answer will be "let's move you". I have 6 luggage and don't want to move it again as I am a fat Asian dude who won't get any help from porter. 

Room amenity: bed sheet is broken, see attached the picture.

Again, I don't rate one star unless someone has been rude to me. So two stars here and you can make your own call on this hotel.

title: Very clean and comfortable
text: Whenever we are in Hamilton we like to stay at Novotel as its always clean and comfortable. The room is spacious enough for my little family of 3 with soft cushioned beds that puts you in a deep sleep straight away. Good gym and spa but the icing on the cake would be a swimming pool but overall a great place to stay when exploring Hamilton.

title: Underwhelmed
text:
Firstly credit should be given to the floor staff- the guys and girls who were actually trying their best to run this place who were the ones stressed and dealing with all the issues.
We did not have a good stay at all. 
They are majorly understaffed for the amount of people that stayed this weekend. It was crazy!
From arriving into the forecourt because let’s face it, if you have a car which most travellers would, you need to valet park as there simply is no realistic options in this central city location... the forecourt was a joke- bumper to bumper cars in the smallest of areas- cars were all jammed in, no one could move. Nightmare! 
With the proposed renovations the forecourt is halved however, if this is going to take 2 years as advertised they need to sort this car/valet issue out ASAP. It was a joke and will obviously only get worse once all the trucks etc start arriving. 
Check in was relatively smooth and quick but perhaps too fast as I didn’t get any info on WiFi and didn’t realise until once upstairs that I had to pay $10 for access to WiFi for 24 hours. 
This can be bypassed if your a member of the Accor group. I didn’t know and was a member but the booking didn’t have my number for some reason. 
Rooms- great size,clean, carpet very stained but perhaps that’s getting done when renovations start?  Had everything you could need for a comfortable stay.
Very quiet rooms, hotel was chocka but didn’t hear movement above, beside etc like you often do in hotels.
Bathroom was good, clean and tidy. Tick tick.
Beds were a little different- hard at the top then suddenly soft and squishy near the middle area. Couldn’t get used to that, didn’t work out why the mattress changes- both beds the same but we slept ok so not a major issue.
Breakfast - beautiful buffet, the staff were lovely. Only ever saw one waitress and she worked so incredibly hard. A few guys helped here and there but definitely could have done with more staff over the buffet area, cleaning tables, stocking up supplies etc.
Saturday wasn’t too bad, manic busy but food was kept flowing. Sunday- nightmare. Getting a table for breakfast was a mission, there is no process except sign in, and grab a seat so you have to hover like seagulls waiting to pounce on a free table and then can’t leave your table unattended for a second otherwise someone will swoop down on it ! Nightmare. The supplies were also not great- we were there an hour and in that time the milk ran out for 20 mins so you couldn’t have cereal or coffee, there were no jams for the toast, croissants, no plates for hot food- my husband actually went into the kitchen himself and asked, no cups only paper takeaway ones, the hot food kept running out and the table wise- the salt mills were empty and the cutlery was sparse. 
Definitely would not recommend the buffet breakfast on a weekend morning. Plenty of nice quiet cafes nearby that would do a relaxing breaky.
Sadly, the staff on- cooks, waitresses etc were doing their best but they just needed more support.
So in a nutshell- I wouldn’t recommend this hotel sadly. I have always wanted to stay but this will be my first and last time there.

title: Central location...great breakfast
text:
Our daily stayed here for 5 nights in a family room. The room was large enough to provide us with a sitting area and table, which a nice change to hanging out on the beds. 
The beds were a little soft compared to what we are used to, but relatively comfortable. 
We scored a deal through the Accor website which included breakfast, which is also quite delicious. Remember to ask for an espresso coffee made by one of the staff, which was much nicer than the pod machine. 
Probably one of the better options to stay in Hamilton.

title: Great location and very friendly staff.
text: My stay was nice and I easily got to the places I needed to on foot. The only problem was with the hotel room service. They never answer the phone, so I was forced to ring the front desk or the bar to take my order.

title: Another great stay
text:
We once again really enjoyed our stay at this Hotel and even though they were super busy with the Black Caps staying as well as the Bangladesh cricket team and the Sunwolves Rugby team their level of service was still the very best ! We were were also impressed with our room especially the nice new walk in shower. 
We had Dinner in the Hotel and the food was outstanding ! A waiter by the name of Karl was super friendly and a great asset to this Hotel. The buffet breakfast was excellent and even though the restaurant was very busy the food was constantly topped up. There was an exceptionally hard working young man by the name of Jordan who was forever clearing the tables and always smiling, we have stayed at many other Accor hotels where this doesn’t happen and dirty dishes are just left on tables for ages. 
There was no recognition of my Accor Platinum Status which isn’t a big deal but it takes a lot of stays in Accor Hotels to get that level but the service and food was so top notch I barely gave it a thought !

title: Be aware they are building
text: We were a bit surprised to find that part of the front of the hotel was boarded off as they are creating 40 new rooms for mid 2020. The building work did not affect us but may affect people in the future. The only real affect it had on us was the availability of parking and meant We ended up using valet parking. The beds in our room were a bit weird as it felt like there was a dip in the mattress at the point you sit on when getting in to bed but comfy when in bed properly.

title: Modern Hotel in Good Location, but ...
text: Centrally located, this hotel is charge without asking me how I was paying, could only be described as surly.! Nice hotel, well located, but a lift in the welcome attitude is overdue. convenient for city business or walks along the river pathways. Parking space, however, is in short supply and expensive. Valet service, which does operate quite efficiently, is available for $25 every day. Rooms are good size with standard amenities and comfortable beds. A spacious lounge seating and bar area adjoins the well-laid out dining room . The food and beverage menus and prices are typical of the Novotel brand. Check-in was quite quick but lacked attention to detail. No mention was made of; where the lifts or dining room were located; times for breakfast; a room upgrade [which was not forthcoming] ; connection to Wifi; any information about the city, etc. The first time in over 50 Accor hotels we did not feel particularly welcome. Our room was a good size and contained the usual amenities; bathroom clean and modern; but there was no complimentary water in the room. Check-out was slow and surprise was expressed when I asked for an invoice copy to check.. When I paid by Eftpos the response to having to pass a credit for having added a credit card

title: No soundproofing and transient pricing
text: Firstly the staff like to tell you different prices for add-ons depending on who you speak to but when it comes to settling the bill you will always pay a higher amount. The rooms were dingy and cheaply done. The worst part was the noice from neighbouring rooms where you can clearly make out complete conversations people have at 2am

title: Great stay
text:
Extensions are underway but don’t let this deter you, just park up and the wonderful valet staff will move your car, regardless of the price I found this service very professional and helpful.
Welcoming staff on arrival into a lovely lobby.
My room was comfortable, comfy bed.  Not the tidiest room which was disappointing, the bathroom hadn’t been cleaned properly, there were pubic hairs all over the floor 🤮
Dining is top notch, delicious food for dinner and a wonderful buffet breakfast.
Great staff, very friendly, thanks Novotel I will be back.

title: All very good accepts for ...................................................???
text:
We stay here often through Acor and have always had a nice room and very good meals in the restaurant. However on the last occasion a week ago we were extremely disappointed with the outside balcony next to the restaurant where we sat for a drink and with the lovely weather were going to have a meal.
Every pillar had a "NON SMOKING" label and below the label were ashtrays with the majority with used cigarette butts. The floor was very dirty with ash and butts as well as black areas that obviously haven't been cleaned for some time (we stayed 2 nights and the floor remained the same for the entire visit (ashtrays has been emptied at night)..this put us off eating outside and and damper on the whole accommodation experience as the costs are more in the high end.
On a positive note the accommodation was nice ( we finally got an upgrade after only havng double beds and not King s stated), food was great and staff very friendly.
Clean the outside tiles more frequently and we are happy to stay again, ( we will ask next time before confirming a booking)

title: Just ok for the price
text: Stayed one night it's great where it is situated right in the middle of the CBD. Rooms are nice and clean but basic and quite small. The spa pool was very dirty and brown when we went to go and have a soak after dinner so decided against that idea and had a bath in the room instead. Service was very professional.

title: I like Novotel
text:
I like Novotel and the Novotel in Hamilton, New Zealand is no exception. 
Friendly staff throughout the hotel. Clean and spacious room. The breakfast choices are immense. Love the pancake machine!

Centrally located along the river, so handy to CBD.

title: Good !
text: Room Cleaning worker did not clean the towels actively. Bed mattress is too soft.Location is good, breakfast is good, welcome drink provided.Car park is chargeable and parked by the staff, not convenient.

title: Very disappointing
text: Hoping for an above average stay whilst travelling for family wedding, condition of hotel and rooms very disappointing. Cracked glassware, dirty carpet in room,television didn't work, high charges for car-parking,marks all over the walls,general decor tired and not worthy of high room rates.

title: Weekend away
text: I chose Novotel as usually they are outstanding, unfortunately I booked a family package and didn’t get what I thought, I wanted a room with two beds and one with a king, this is what I booked but in check in there were none available, the lady at check in to her defense did try her best to accommodate us so we ended up with a roller way bed, I was disappointed because it was a treat for our family to get two rooms where we would all have a beautiful beds to sleep in, as the beds at Novotel are very comfortable. In future I have learnt that I won’t use the website to book but ring, so I know what I will be getting.

title: Comfortable stay
text:
Recently stayed in the novotel hamilton.
I found the room was a reliable novotel product and had no complaints.
Buffet breakfast was excellent and enjoyed using the oversized chess board.

Only disappointment was having to pay, either $15 outside or $20 underground parking, however I guess when your right next to a casino parking is at a premium.

title: Solid Choice
text:
This hotel seems to be the best option in the downtown area with a good location and a new or perhaps recently renovated refreshed look.   We stayed in a suite with a living room that included a table with four chairs, a modest sized bedroom, and a large modern bathroom.  In fact for a mid-level hotel, the bathroom was surprisingly sexy with two sinks, large separate shower, big bath tub, and some faux black marble. The suite also had high ceilings, big windows, and a spacious storage area.       

The rest of the hotel is also nice looking including the hotel restaurant where a large buffet styled breakfast is served.  The one weak area of the property is a small uninspiring gym near a raised hot tub that was uninviting.  The location of the hotel is just off the main street in town and a few blocks from the area’s restaurant row.  

Valet parking is $20 and in December 2018 the motor court was partially blocked off as an addition to the hotel is just getting underway.  The limited space made for a difficult exit, but overall this is probably a minor problem most of the time.

title: great stay
text: friendly warm welcome at reception. Clean well presented room and lovely bed. Had dinner at the restaurant and meal was lovely. very good service and it was a busy night. Overall a very pleasant stay for the night

title: Average
text: Stayed here for one night and it was ok for a stopover on route South from Auckland but glad we didn't stay for longer. Hotel was very nice and we are in the restaurant but because we arrived late we managed to get a table but good took a long time to arrive and it was lukewarm but we were starving and ate it anyway although my brother ordered wedges and had to wait longer for them to arrive as staff were dealing with people paying their bills as well as serving at tables. Breakfast was better although still lukewarm but plenty of it.

title: Cleanliness and food
text: Stayed at Novotel Hamilton Tainui on 1st January to 2nd January 2019. We ordered dinner which took a long time to come and when it did the plate was cold and the food was luke warm. A side order didn't arrive and we had to get another waiter to find them. In our room the bathroom floor had a handful of long black hairs on it. There was also lots of long black hair in the shower!! Breakfast was nice with a good selection, however, again the food was only luke warm. Very disappointing and concerned as we have another Novotel booked on our tour for 6th January at Wellington!!

title: Very nice
text: Lovely newly renovated hotel, stated one night as a putt stop on our way to Auckland, staff where lovely and helpful. Didn’t get the chance to try the food, in close proximity to shops and cafes. Will be happy to come back again.

title: Well looked after by the friendly and helpful staff
text: The team at Novotel Hamilton was excellent from the moment I entered the lobby, to check-in and valet parking. The breakfast was expansive and a wide selection of options available, and did I mention the "real" coffee from a barista. The beds are comfy and the room was spotless. The staff was friendly and helpful. I liked the guest laundry which was handy for longer stays.

title: Great service. Friendly staff.
text: Great customer sevice. Terrific staff, very friendly. Great atmosphere. Great resturant, quality food for dinner and a great buffet breakfast. Cleanliness of rooms, cleaned everyday. Checkout very easy.

title: Excellent hotel in CBD
text:
A great hotel when staying in Hamilton! Located right next to the river and in the centre, it was perfect for my husband, son and I. 

Rooms are great - very spacious, modern and extremely clean. The bathroom was amazing; very spacious shower and good counter space. 

Staff was also wonderful. The only negative was the hotel construction so there was very limited parking in front of the hotel. There was plenty of parking beside the hotel, however. And the construction is temporary. 

Oveeall, a pleasant stay!

title: Travelling overnight
text: Excellent service,very friendly professional staff and most efficient at check in, lovely spacious clean room. Room. Nice bathroom with great shower. Bedroom particularly roomy ,very comfortable bed, great range of  snacks and beverage in the mini bar.,lovely comfortable bed.

title: Convenient location and wonderful service
text: My family and I stayed at the Novotel Hamilton Tainui recently for three nights. We were initially slightly concerned by the renovation works that were going on outside the main entrance, but it turned out to be fine as most of the time we were out in the day, and construction works would end by late afternoon. What we enjoyed most about our time here was the fact that this hotel is so conveniently located near the main part of town, with many dining options available within walking distance. Service was also very helpful and friendly, and the generous spread at breakfast every morning was a great way to start the morning.

title: Excellent.  Great rooms, great location, excellent service
text: Only stayed one night, and wish we could have stayed longer, but our NZ trip was coming to an end.  Fantastic location right on the river and only one block from the CBD this Accor hotel is excellent - modern decor, fabulous service from staff, very reasonable rates, nice modern room and very comfortable bed, and excellent breakfast the next morning.

title: Very nice hotel in the center of town, across from the Center Mall our n Hamilton,N.Z.
text: We spent two nights here while wee plowed the center of New Zealand’s North Island. The bed was comfortable, the room spacious and the restaurant has an excellent buffet breakfast for over $30.00. I deducted a star because hey charged $15.00/ day for parking and $10.00/day for WiFi, although they advertise free WiFi.

title: Building works - horrendous
text: I would strongly advise to avoid this hotel until the extension works are completed mid 2019. The room I was in was constantly vibrating and rattled with noise due to major construction works taking place 5m away as part of the hotel extension. Totally unacceptable by Novotel to allow booking of these rooms at full price, with no apologies, knowing they have their own initiated major construction project taking place. Stay at your own peril!
hotel_response:
Dear Mr. Pumperman,
Thank you very much for your comments in regards to your stay with us. I hope that you have noticed that the hotel is trying to minimize the inconveniences for our guests and once you are in our lobby, you will noticed that it as normal.The demolition of the forecourt is completed and we are now moving into a phase of preparation of the site. Hope that answers your concerns and wishing you a good year end. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Beautiful rooms
text: Rooms were beautiful and clean. Comfortable and cozy. Had nice view of waikato river. Close to centre can walk to restaurants etc. Facilities and buffet breakfast was awesome.Friendly staff. Went with kids aged 8 and 14 who couldnt sit still so didnt get to enjoy much of our room but would be a great stay for couples.

title: Expect more for the Prices
text:
Booked in using complimentary nights stay with accor card. The room was nice, actually spacious and had a table and chairs as well as the standard furniture. However not well maintained and the shower floor needed repair as neither of us were unable to stop the water leaving the shower and soaking the bathroom.
The car park was full, which from what i could see with only 15/20 odd car parks was not a surprise. 
We ordered room service, the staff were friendly but the food wasnt great. The dips and bread selection was merely a few microwaved (and now rock solid) buns hummus and oil. Wont be making that mistake again. 
More than enough options for breakfast at the buffet. Only let down was other guests that push you out of the way to get to what they wanted. 
Wont be staying again, but wasnt terrible.

title: Abysmal Concierge
text: Overall the Tainui is a nice place to stay , rooms tidy, restaurant nice  and staff are generally very good but the concierge is another thing . We have stayed here before and noticed that the concierge are allergic to work. This last visit was the last straw. This hotel is supposedly a 4.5 star. Pulled up to the front door with several pieces of luggage, The concierge at the door did not come out even though he did see me. He was not actually doing anything.  When I notioned   that I had luggage to come out of my boot he ignored me. WhenI went up to entrance way all he did was push out a trolley towards me and then that was it. At no time did he come out to assist. There was also no one else there at that time with luggage so he was not doing anything.  I then had to take it to the checkin where my wife was registering . Another person brought your luggage up to our room. On checking out I asked for someone to bring a trolley up. A young lady did bring a trolley up and then just stood there waiting for me to load the trolley. Even though there were two of them by the door I had to take the trolley out and load my car myself. They all of a sudden looked "Busy " doing nothing. There was no greeting by them , no hello , no nothing. The concierge is abysmal. The main gentleman in question has been in that same position for a number of years , how I do not know. The level of service in that area is totally unacceptable. Tainui  Novotel must have had complaints about this previously. I wonder why nothing had been done. They are amateurs and not good ones even at that. We did lay a complaint with the front desk but I do not imagine there will be anything done about it.

title: feedback
text: Continuity is the big tip that Novotel needs to look at.Nothing is the same for Le Club members.It changes from Hotel to Hotel.Stop you members from experiencing any disappointments by having things the same.

title: BEST hotel downtown
text:
Everything I've read in other recent reviews was accurate for me. Smooth check-in, comfy bed, GREAT pillows. 

I also found my room well-appointed, staff most friendly and helpful, and could find no fault. Comparatively, when one looks at where else there is to stay, this Novotel may be the Tron's best option for the money.

title: Overnighter
text:
One night here - smooth check in and check out.

Very comfy bed (best night’s sleep in ages) and pillows. Although facing the street my corner room 146 was quiet.

Good bathroom great products and lots of fluffy towels.

Stain on the carpet was disappointing and conference staff absent (it was a Sunday but still no water provided no tea or coffee for a 2 hour meeting) but overall the hotel was very pleasant and handy to the riverside walk and downtown.

title: Overnight Business
