text: Great location and albeit construction work being undertaken was no inconvenience.Service staff require some training with dinner staff not knowing what the seasonal vegetable were and breakfast staff almost non existent. All other aspects good

title: Great Base to visit Hamilton and surrouns
text: Standard Novotel - clean, good quality rooms. As a family with two boys (15 & 13) we got interconnecting rooms which was fantastic. It provides a central place to explore Hobbiton, Parks and Museums. Breakfast was standard buffet but good and well prepared. Parking provide at a cost so be aware.

title: Great hotel
text: I was in a large group travelling for business, check in was very quick and friendly.  I needed the car valet service and was very easy process and great price of $25 per day.  Room is very nice and spacious.  Restaurant dinner was yummy - would recommend the scallop entree and the salmon main.  Huge breakfast selection.  The fast check out process is exactly that.. fast.  Highly recommend.

title: Exceptional customer service. Comfortable rooms and beds
text:
Highest recommendation for excellent customer service. We arrived early after a long flight with loss of luggage and were greeted by a wonderful young man by the name of Reece who did his very best to accommodate us and have us check in early so we could rest. 

The room was very comfortable. Beds were softer than usual, but we spelt very well. Bathroom and rain-type shower head were lovely. Shampoo, conditioner and soap were available. In the absence of my baggage it would have been nice to have the access to a toothbrush and toothpaste, but cannot fault.

Excellent ambiance. I liked the addition of valet parking for $20 per day, which we used once. Easy, no fuss check out. 

Great location. Well priced. Lovely staff.

title: Quality find
text:
When we checked in we were greeted by lovely staff that offered us valet parking. I would definitely recommend because they make sure the car is ready for checkout and even put our bags in the car. Making check out smooth. 

It is close to a few great restaurants such as Mexico and river kitchen. 

We booked the superior room which meant that I could spread out the suitcases and relax. 

The showers are walk-in and not over a bath. Very modern and super clean.

title: No Problems Here!
text:
We (2 Adults 1 12 yr old child) stayed here over labour weekend and were very impressed! Staff were very friendly, well mannered and helpful in anything that we requested. Sure the hotel is getting a little tired (probably why they're building a new one just down the road!) but it is still clean and tidy. Breakfast was wonderful and plentiful. Hotel was very busy with a NZ Dance Championship going on but we still got good service. The valet parking was wonderful and saved having to find a park close to hotel when returning from our ventures around Hamilton. Close to all amenities, restaurants, bars etc. 

My only little gripe is they ask ALL guests to either use the valet service or try to find a park behind the hotel so they don't use all the spaces outside the front of hotel (which 'supposedly' have a 15 minute drop off-pick up time frame), but a lot of guests chose to ignore these requests and park there car in these spaces for the whole weekend!! It seems like there is 1 rule for some and not for others!

Would we stay here again; you betcha! Great staff, great location!

title: Central location, friendly team, spacious and clean rooms
text: The booking and check in process was easy and efficient.  All the members of the front desk team that we met were all very friendly, helpful and welcoming.  We asked for a quiet room as we stayed for 5 nights and were fortunate to have a lovely corner room.  It was spacious with two double beds as we were travelling as a couple with our teenage daughter.  The rooms were very clean and well maintained, the bathrooms looked fairly new and the shower was great!  The amenities were also very good.  The only issue we had were that the beds were a bit soft and the sheets never changed, despite putting the note on the bed requesting this.  We would definitely recommend this hotel, great value for money, central location, friendly and clean.

title: Great place
text: Stayed here while my husband was at s conference. Very nice friendly staff.  Handy to shops for a wee wonder. Weather wasn’t the best but nice river walk just outside hotel. Rooms very nice beds very comfortable. Highly recommended

title: Work in the Tron - stay here.
text:
Had to go to the tron for work, so why not stay here.  And then went back the following week for two more nights.  
Loved it.  Next time i will explore the running tracks.  
Great service.  Actually FANTASTIC service.  we left something behind on first stay and when i came back they went and got before i even opened my mouth.
Great restaurant too.
I am going back

title: Top-stay at Tainui
text:
Stayed at the Novotel hotel as part of a business trip and used the facilities for a meeting and training session. 

Great location. Turn left and your into the adjacent main drag, bars  and eateries. Turn right and you walk down to the riverside walkway. 

Comfortable hotel, pleasant rooms and friendly staff. 

Suggest a walk to main drag for a pleasant breakfast or brunch.

title: Birthday surprise
text: We travelled down to Hamilton to be with our friend for her birthday and it was my partners belated birthday present too. Hotel lives up to its name, its ll ovy and clean and its staff are first class. A big thank you for Ange on the front desk, she helped me find balloons for our birthday girl. The restaurant staff were all fantastic too. Ana is the only one wearing a name badge, but the others were fantastic too, many thanks for a memorable time.

title: Very Disappointing
text: Stayed at this hotel as had medical appointment at the hospital the following day. It was very hard to get a car park just to check in. However we did eventually get one but wasn’t told it was for short term parking only, in fact couldn’t see any signs advising this either. If they are there they certainly aren’t prominent. After putting our bags in our room we went down to the bar for a relaxing drink before dinner. While we were at the bar my husband saw the front office staff putting a note on our car, that’s when we found out we had parked in the short term car parking. The woman was not that pleasant about it either. When my husband went to make a dinner reservation for 6:30 he was told quite brusquely that there was nothing until after 7:30pm. We weren’t offered any alternative earlier time. The taps for the beers at the bar had been switched to the wrong kegs so instead of getting a lager we got IPAs. All in all it wasn’t the usual welcoming experience we get at Novotel hotels. The hotel looked a bit shabby for a relatively new hotel as well. On check out after mentioning all of the above to the manager we did get a good response from him so a thumbs up to him but otherwise a thumbs down overall for the hotel and the majority of its staff.

title: Great location with a good restaurant
text: Staff are efficient and helpful, location in town and close to the Claudelands Event centre make it my first choice when in Hamilton. Restaurant is probably one of the best in Hamilton. The menu changes regularly so have eaten there several times on my own and with others. Some of the rooms overlook the river so have a great view and get the sunrise (warning if you are not an early riser).

title: Overnight stop before returning to Australia after 2 week holiday
text: Great classy hotel with modern up to date vibe, in a perfect central to shops, Movie theatres and river walk, the staff were most helpful in providing a car park for our campervan overnight, thoroughly enjoyed our very comfortable bed.

title: OUTSTANDING SERVICE
text: We were in need for a room after an unexpected trip to Hamilton.  We turned up at the hotel at 3am in the morning without a reservation, and we were accommodated so well.  While we were in the hotel for less than 6 hours, our stay was so pleasant and the staff we just amazing.  We've stayed here many times before, however this time the team exceeded every expectation.  Would highly recommend!

title: Very worthwhile
text: Lovely clean room. We had valet parking which was good, as our car was safe. The service was great. We got a deal with $1 breakfast, and the food was fantastic. A very good selection and so much to choose from. The hotel is nice and central to restaurants.

title: Great spot, fantastic dinner
text: Stayed one night. Check in was very fast and efficient. We got a room upgrade. The room was spacious and very clean. The beds were nice and firm. We had both dinner and breakfast in the hotel restaurant. The food and service at the restaurant was fantastic, we were very impressed with the meals we had. The hotel is also in a great spot - close to the river and walkway and close to the shops and mall. Was a great deal for us to stay and we will be back.

title: Better than ever
text: It was a lovely stay just the one night, but very successful. There were two couples and it was an ideal place to use as a base. Nice hotel, nice bar outstanding breakfast!We booked the standard rooms but they were better than most top rooms in other hotels.

title: Great hotel with central location
text: Great hotel in the heart of Hamilton CBD. Very friendly and helpful staff. Good buffet breakfast. Nice and well lit room with good bed. Some great restaurant just opposite the hotel. Definitely staying here again soon.

title: Central hotel
text: This hotel offers comfort in the heart of the CBD, near the Waikato River.  Rooms are spacious and well lit.  They offer a nice breakfast buffet and the wi-fi connection was good.  My only complaint was the heating, which did not work properly.  When I complained, it was "fixed", but the maintenance person then set the thermostat to 5 degrees.  When I returned to my room, it was a frigid 17 degrees.

title: Prime location coupled by excellent comfort
text:
Arrived  at the hotel at about 11am on a Saturday morning. While there were quite a few other guests awaiting check-out, I did not have to wait too long for my turn, the staff were friendly and professional, and I was happy to learn that my room was ready.

During the time of the booking, I had indicated preference for a room away from the elevator lobby (just to avoid the amount of traffic right outside my room), and I was surprised (in a delightful way) to see that I had been assigned to a room furthest away from the lifts, which was 80-100metres away. 

The room was of a good size, high cleanliness (apart from a feel strands of hair in the bathroom), and conveyed a high comfort level. The room utilises plenty of natural light through the windows during the day, but the room was not under lit in the evenings, which was great. Wifi was complimentary, only if you agree to join as a member (which was free) to their loyalty program, and connection speed was acceptable, playing Youtube videos at 720p was without lags.

The location of the hotel was also excellent. With a convenience store nearby, the hotel was also next to a number of restaurants, and was a short walk away from Hamilton Centre Place, the Artpost, and Waikato Museum. It is also within a walkable distance to the Hamilton Transport Centre.

The hotel also offers room service, to which I had given a try to. Quality of food was slightly above average, but what was shocking to me was the need for a chaser call, with the cheeseboard and pasta arriving some 1.5hours later after placing my order. Hopefully this was just a one-off mistake, but otherwise, Ubereats may be a more reliable option.

What was commendable was the hotel’s commitment to sustainability. This is something many corporations talk about, but rarely action effectively. It was apparent that this was well considered, from the recycle bin, in addition to the rubbish bin placed in the room.

Overall, an enjoyable station, and will likely be my go-to for future stays in Hamilton.

title: Awesome! Apart from Check In
text: Everything was on point apart from check in. Tried to check in just before 2:30pm and got told room was not ready could I come back later, to which I replied "when later?" The answer I got was "I don't know" Surely my ears were failing me. I asked to speak with someone else, but someone else was out the back and on the phone so no luck there. I had already prepaid the rooms but really wanted to be somewhere else as 'in that moment' I felt the situation was ridiculous! Not even an offer to call when the rooms ready? A gesture to use facilities like the bar or restaurant Just "Come back later?" whenever later maybe!

title: Good deal with breakfast included
text: Last minute decision to stop off at Novotel as we were going to drive back through to Auckland. We got a good room rate on line including breakfast. Sometimes breakfast included offers don’t include cooked breakfast  just continental.This one does and is worth enjoying. Constantly being replenished. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay . Clean rooms good location. Would stay again.

title: One night stay
text: Novotel Tainui is a great place to stay. The rooms are really nice & clean, the bathroom looks new & modern. Breakfast was awesome, a huge selection of food. A great restaurant & bar area. I definitely would stay here again.

title: Chris Davis and Franklin
text:
Chris Davis the Food and Beverage Manager at Novotel Taunui is absolutely brilliant! His warmth and hospitality to my cousin and I looking for a place for breakfast this morning 9 August having a break from Waikato Hospital where my uncle is recuperating from surgery was everything you’d expect to find in a person such as Chris (who we didn’t even know at the time that he was the Manager of Food and Beverage at Novotel Tainui in Hamilton) 

Novotel Tainui. This Manager of yours Chris  Davis represented your Organisation with finesse, dignity and integrity. He truly brings to your Organisation a sense of pride of who he works for and who he is as a person and how he generally interacts with people no matter who they are.  If he could take the time out like he did with my cousin and I and treat us the way he did with such courtesy and dignity, impacts so positively on your Organisation. 

My cousin and I have nothing but respect for this Man and by association Novotel Tainui. Ka nui te mihi Chris.

title: A comfortable week
text: My stay this past week at the Novotel has been great! My room is very spacious (a standard) and clean. The beds are super comfortable with lovely soft pillows and the bathroom is well appointed. Meals at Alma Restaurant are well priced and the breakfast buffet has everything you’d want including a great coffee. The hotel has made a hectic week of work a little easier.

title: Very nice & comfortable
text: Nice, clean, fresh & comfortable bed!! location in the middle of the city, good service! three minutes walk to the casino!! best hotel in hamilton! special offers for breakfast which is very very cheap

title: Great location
text: 2nd stay while hubby attended a work conference in Hamilton. Location great, we mainly walked to nearby places for dinners. Bed was too soft for my likings, we opted for buffet breakfast at hotel for 2 days. Staff friendly and helpful

title: Overnight stay before our tour
text: Stayed here for one night at the start of our trip and arrived at about 8pm so not much time to see anything apart from our room. Helpful staff and a large, bright restaurant that served a good buffet breakfast. Room a bit small but clean and comfortable. Many restaurants to choose from for dinner within walking distance.

title: Great rooms and spacious.
text: Definitely stay here again.  The rooms are very spacious and tidy.  The staff are all very helpful and cheerful.  Probably the best buffet breakfast I have had. The only thing that let them down, was arriving in the restaurant one evening at approximately 7.00pm.  There was only two other tables of people and our meal took over an hour to come.  But there are so many restaurants around that area, you won't have a problem finding something you like, elsewhere.

title: A gem of a Novotel
text: The hotel is right downtown close to everything and a short drive to see all the things in the area. The staff and rooms are nice. The lunch and dinner in the hotel was a little lacking for variety, but it was still good.

title: Central Hamilton Comfort
text:
Centrally located accommodation with both in house dining as well as many very handy quality restaurants within walking distance. Rooms are comfortable and modern and the staff friendly and helpful - incredibly comfortable bed.
Valet car parking was a nice touch and well priced.
A great stop for business travellers and anyone wanting to spend time in Hamilton.

title: MAGNIFICENT
text:
Great place to stay.   Very welcoming.   Very Friendly..Staff very helpful.   Busy property at this time but staff always very happy to accommodate .   Restaurant with young children was very pleasant.  Good location.
..

title: Saturday Nighter
text: Excellent position , right in the middle of Town with many close Restaurants and the Casio just a few minutes away . The rooms where excellent , very clean and well presented , a credit to the Staff involved.  We found all the Staff to be very friendly and helpful and to get out of Auckland and stay in such a nice Hotel was fun and something we will do again in a few Months.

title: Enjoyed our stay
text:
In NZ and doing as much as possible in the North Island as well as enjoying their accommodation with Hamilton Novotel our first stop on our ‘island dash’ beyond Auckland. 

The drive was pleasant as was the staff at reception. The option of valet parking was appreciated and at a reasonably cost, though was confused that vehicles still parked out front.

Even though we had requested a king size bed we were given 2 queens beds and were simply too weary to bother about why that was or requesting a room change. Not sure what happened there but the beds were still very comfortable as was the room.

From what we could tell it seemed to have more people there on business then tourists like us, but also seemed satisfied.

title: weekend break
text: awesome. love staying here. central location. walk to restaurants and bars. easy valet parking. comfortable beds and pillows. nice river views. excellent buffet breakfast. my go to hotel in hamilton. friendly staff

title: Nice but slow
text: Good location near the CBD and room was fine. My only negative is the extremely slow check in and check out, and the chaos in the car park out the front. One person on the desk, plenty of people waiting to check out, cars blocked in the driveway and staff just walking past - surely there is more than one person who knows how to work on the front desk.

title: Great hotel
text: Fantastic staff friendly and helpful nothing is too much trouble. excellent clean rooms hotel is in great location close to restaurants and casino. have staying here many times and always received great service.

title: Does enough
text:
Nice rooms, bar and restaurant. Reception staff where attentive and helpful with reasonable valet parking at $20.

Great location near bars and restaurants.

Needs to update gym and is disappointing that a well established hotel makes you pay for wi-fi in room.

title: Enjoyed our stay there!
text:
Overall - good quality staff and facilities. However, there was two major problem with the room. 
1/ There was NO power point at the desk - where work gets done on a laptop! There HAS to be a power point at the desk to make the room acceptable.  
2/ There was a slight sewerage smell coming from the toilet. The bathroom did not vent the toilet smells very well either.

title: Clean, comfy and central
text:
We stayed one night en route back through to Auckland. 
* Our room was bright, well set out, modern and clean. 
* We also enjoyed some late night room service which was reasonable - price and quality - by room service standards. 
Our rate included a full buffet breakfast which was also well catered bar the lack of coffee - that was located in a different part of the restaurant which was not pointed out to us - disjointed and confusing.
* Hotel itself is situated with a river backdrop which was quite beautiful in the morning. Hotel is also within easy walking distance of shops and other eateries.
* Main complaint - our room was located on a floor undergoing a significant renovation. Although our room wasn't near those works we still had to navigate our way around trades that were in the hall. The rooms around those being refurbished were clearly still in use - we'd have been annoyed if we were woken by early trade works. That wing should probably not be used until refurbushments are completed. 
We were essentially in and out overnight. Our priority was for comfort and cleanliness and we got that.

title: Just as good the second time!
text: We stayed here this weekend with family and really enjoyed our stay!This is the second time we have stayed here.....the last time about 2-3 years ago,This is a very clean,comfortable hotel,reasonably priced and in a very handy location in the city.The valet service is excellent!Very helpful staff.We will definitely stay here again!,

title: Right spot in the city
text: Standard quality hotel in the city. Room are clean, bed ok, breakfast average, etc... good to spend a night in Hamilton if you need to do so. Nothing bad about this hotel. Close to casino and river as well.

title: Average every time, not clean
text:
For $240-300 per room for a nights stay, I expect the bathroom to be clean. This is rare, and I stay here quite a bit with work - only when I can’t get into the Ibis (a much better deal if you want standard hotel quality for an average price). The location is central to a number of restaurants but attention to detail in the rooms let’s the place down. Very over priced for the poor standard, stained carpet and crappy pillows. Why have a pillow menu when you could just supply a range of decent pillows to start with - who wants to call room
Service once you’re in your pjs to get a better pillow?!

title: Worst mattresses ever!
text: Small room (2 dbl beds) but high ceilings. Incredibly uncomfortable beds. New mattresses needed ASAP. Carpet also needs replacing. Shower door inadequate, water gets everywhere. Good location but rooms need some upgrading

title: Was ok
text: Room was good. Bed too soft. Pillows too fat. Bathroom was great. I must have been put into a recently refurbished room. Breakfast was adequate. The hallways, lifts are a bit dated. You can hear people in the hallway at night. Wasnt anything special or spectacular.

title: Convenient stay in Hamilton
text:
The rooms have been upgraded since our last stay they were clean and tidy, plus the bathrooms now have a walk in shower instead of bath.
Parking can be a problem with the forecourt being used for long term parking at certain periods, there is a valet parking service which is good.

title: Yummmm
text:
Kia ora,
We walked in off the street on our way home from a holiday to Hamilton, to try the buffet breakfast. We were absolutely thrilled with the selection on offer and agreed this was the best buffet breakfast weve had yet. The atmosphere was also lovely with comfortable seating and good light.

title: Great room!
text: Awesome room - large, spacious and modern. Bathroom was great - minibar prices were acceptable, great views from the room too. Was also great having two room cards so I could have the room warmed up whilst down at diner (was very cold outside!).

title: Great hotel for business trips
text:
The Novotel Hamilton Tanui is a great choice for business trips. The staff are very helpful and the location is very convenient. Check in was quick and painless. My room was a bit of a walk away from the elevator but I got used to it. The newly renovated bathroom was really nice.

The breakfast was good and so was the gym/fitness area, surprisingly well-equipped considering the size of the room. They also have a spa and sauna. The conference area was also decent, the equipment worked and the staff were always on hand to assist.

title: Construction noise
text: Really in a half full hotel they put up next to the room with drilling going on all day. This does not seem a reasonable approach when they know construction is going on. Even during the day. It is very annoying and not up to scratch for one of the supposed best hotels in Hamilton. No apology when it was mentioned to them
hotel_response: Dear Michael, Thanks for your feedback on your recent stay with us. I am really sorry about the construction disturbance. We are almost at the end of the bathroom renovations and you have probably been allocated a room due to the room configuration. As said, we will finish before Fieldays and have the project completed. My apologies again for the inconveniences. Regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Wedding reception
text:
We had our wedding reception here and we also had 5 rooms for overnight stays for our out of town guests and ourselves.
The rooms were very clean modern and comfortable, our suite was beautiful and roomy.
The food was unfavorable our guests said they'd never had such a wide range of food at the quality it was. Seriously unfaultable food and service. They even put together a dance floor and the tables were dressed beyond my expectations. 

Only criticism is that parking not great unless you want to pay for it and not great views either even though it's next to the waikato river...we couldn't see it from our rooms or reception room.
hotel_response: Dear Lisa, Thanks for your comments around your stay with us. Really pleased to read that you have enjoyed your stay and wedding with us. My apologies for the views; the council has already trimmed some of the trees and this certainly has opened the view of the river a lot more. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Great hotel in fantastic location
text:
My wife and I stayed here for three nights. the primary reason for the visit to Hamilton was to see the cricket between the Black Caps and England - the second was Hobbiton. 
I booked the hotel several months before arrival via the Accor website and made a stupid error with my dates booking a non-refundable room. I feared an expensive lesson, but the Indian call centre were brilliant - they were able to transfer the money i had paid to the new dates - it helped that i spotted my error immediately, but kudos to them for helping me.
The hotel was busy on our arrival, as both the England and Kiwi cricket teams were staying, as well as the South African Vodacom Bulls, who were playing in Hamilton while we were there. 
We arrived about 1pm but were given a very nice room straight away. The only negative I have to say about the hotel is the parking - there is no free parking anywhere near the hotel, and we elected to use the hotel valet parking, which was very good but the front of the hotel can be a a bit chaotic at times. 
Without exception, the staff we encountered from reception, through room cleaners to the restaurant were excellent - helpful and friendly. 
The hotel was ideally situated - a very short walk to the many restaurants and shops in the centre, and only a slightly longer walk to Seddon park for the cricket. 
All in all a great place to stay - i would not hesitate to recommend it, and we hope to return next time England play cricket in Hamilton.
hotel_response: Dear Nick, Great to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. I am sorry about the restricted car parking; you can however leave your car on the street with a two hour free parking and no fees after 6 pm. Sorry a bit late for this information, but hopefully other guests will read it. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Any improvement
text: After few year I come back to this hotel . And nothing has changed . The rooms are very simple and need heavy maintenance . For the price you pay you should have something better . The breakfast is ok.
hotel_response: Dear Giannma. Thanks for your comments after your stay with us. Hope you have seen our newly refurbished rooms; they really look very nice. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: A great stay in all respects
text:
We stayed here for two nights in April 2018 - two adults and two teenagers in a room with two beds.

The hotel is extremely well situated right in the centre of Hamilton close to shopping, restaurants etc.  The river walk is just below the hotel.  We walked that route to the Hamilton Gardens, which took about 40 minutes.

The hotel was very quiet - absolutely no noise.  The room was clean and comfortable, although it would help if there were instructions in the room on how to work the air conditioning!  Wifi in the room and common areas worked well.

The breakfast offered a wide variety, and the lattes were superb.  The gym area on level 1 has a spa pool, which looked very appealling, although we didn't have time to use it.

We will definitely stay here again if we are back in Hamilton.

title: Just like home
text: Everything was to our enjoyment and comfort check in was waiting vallee car was great breakfast is the best ever Lounge is comfortable and the staff are great and do feel like family We always stay here when in Hamilton

title: Centre of town and full of Class
text:
It is in the centre of town, but still 50 or so metres from the main thoroughfare and set back a little, so it is not noisy. The rooms are nice and staff are very friendly. We had some drinks in the bar and then ate out across the road (there are 4 restaurants immediately across the road). We paid for the $20 valet parking as that seemed the easiest option and it was fine. We would happily stay here again. 
Note - there was renovation work going on, (some noise) but it stopped around 4:30pm and did not start again until about 8:00am.
hotel_response:
Dear Robert,
Thanks for your comments in regards to your stay with us. Great to read that you have enjoyed if. We are indeed working on the renovations of the bathrooms and the noisy works start at 09.30 am and finishes at 4.30 pm. In the month of June, we will be mostly finished with all rooms. Hope to welcome you back again.
regards,
Dick Breukink, GM

title: Nice Stay
text: This is a nice hotel. The location is perfectly set; being easy to reach the travel depot, shops and restaurants whilst still being off the main street and is very quiet. The room was really nice and a great size, but a fan in the bathroom is recommended. The staff were quite helpful and the meals were excellent. Staff happily accommodated our food allergy without issues.
hotel_response:
Dear Digi,
Thanks for leaving us with your feedback around your stay with us. Hope to be able to welcome you back in Hamilton.
Best regards,
Dick Breukink / GM

title: Renovation
text:
Just be aware they are doing renovation on the 3rd floor , dust,smell and workmen 
We were never told this on booking or checkin .
The toilet smell form each room stinks . Such a Loverly way to start your day on the way to breakfast 
 And the noise at 7am. Do expect a sleep in 
Not what I expected from Novotel  sad 😢 when I mentioned to reception 
They had nothing to say just we are doing renovation.
Why would you put paying guests on the same floor as renovation 
Never again .
Upset Accor member
hotel_response:
Dear Guest.
Thank you for taking the time to provide us feedback around your recent stay with us. I am really sorry about the disturbance around the renovations works; we are trying to minimize the disturbance as much as possible and have set times that our contractors are allowed to work. If we want to upgrade all our bathrooms however, we need to go through this process, so that in the future, we are able to enjoy much better looking rooms. We are almost finished with the third floor now and have one floor to go. Again my apologies, but noisy work is restricted between 09.30 am and 04.30 pm. Regards, Dick Breukink / GM

title: Enjoyable family stay
text: My family and I quite enjoyed our one night stay, our room was really clean and tidy and the location was great as it was central to everything. The buffet breakfast was good too. We will definitely return when we are in the area next.
hotel_response:
Dear Guest, 
Really nice to read your comments in regards to your stay here.
Hope to be able to welcome you back again.
Regards,
Dick Breukink / GM

title: Just Average
text:
We stayed two nights at Novotel Tainui as it was convenient to the Waitomo Glow Worm Caves and Hobbiton. We liked that it was close to restaurants and the River Walk.
We liked that we could valet park the car at a reasonable price and service was efficient.
Catherine at the reception desk was very helpful and we appreciated her assistance.
Breakfast was adequate. The decor is minimalist, but the bed was comfy. Unfortunately, the bathroom is ridiculously small even though it was recently remodeled. There is construction on the third floor, but it did not interfere with our stay except that the laundry room was in the middle of the construction area on the third floor. Very nice that laundry facilities are available. Our room was on the River Walk side but the view of the river is obstructed with trees. That said, it was very quiet.

title: One night only
text:
A very busy hotel. Check in was great and fast. 
My room was on he top floor and didn't have much of a view. But that was ok as I wasn't there for the view. 
Staff were very accommodating which was great. 
While waiting for my room I had lunch in the cafe downstairs. I ordered the steak which was slightly fatty sadly. I ordered a coffee in a takeaway cup. Served in a glass. Attention to detail is needed in this case.
Bed was very comfortable but room was noisy. Was nice having a bath, shame the plumbing was so loud when emptying. Overall quite pricey for what ultimately is a basic hotel.

title: Over-priced and service lacking.
text: This hotel is very average. Bathrooms very dated, no shower cap and old towels. No coffee machine. Room had a stale smell. Vastly overpriced at $340 per night! Breakfast only average. But worst was the service. Had to hunt for a staff member at breakfast to take a coffee order. One person on checkout at 8.30am. No taxis, they had to be ordered. Hamilton, surely you can do better than this?!

title: Clean and modern hotel in central Hamilton
text: The hotel is centrally located in Hamilton. Rooms are spacious, modern and clean. The bed had a  comfortable mattress. Rooms are quite and even if facing the street do not have noise pollution coming from the street. The restaurant in the hotel is decent and serves nice food. Hotel staff is friendly and helpful. Only negative is that parking is not included and you have to spend between 10 to 20 dollars per night you park your car at or around the hotel.

title: "Comfortable bed”
text:
I have stayed in Novotel Hotel for two nights and it was pleasant stay. The hotel is located in central of Hamilton city near the Victoria street and vEry near to the river crossing the city. 

The hotel is sarounded by a nice commercial area with lots of restaurants and shops on the Victoria street. The two big hyper markets are also very closed by.

title: Average Hotel
text:
Modern, clean facility. Very friendly and helpful front of house staff. Rooms above average.

We came to Hamilton to meet and host a celebrity Dame of New Zealand. Our PA made a restaurant reservation for dinner several days before our arrival. It was confirmed. At the last moment the hotel called cancelling the reservation saying the restaurant was not available. We then had to find a last minute alternative which proved impossible.  On our arrival, we were advised that there was a large sporting team at the hotel and no meals were available for other guests.This despite the fact that we had prepaid breakfasts. We were directed to another hotel within walking distance for meals.   A quality hotel would NEVER overbook to the disadvantage of other guests.

title: Very convenient
text:
I have stayed in this hotel on a few different occasions, every time it has been for the same event which is located in the Sky City hotel, which is located right next to the hotel. The service has always been awesome, the staff always have a smile on their face no matter what department they are in. Which is awesome to see from a hotel.
I have enjoyed everything to do with this hotel, the rooms are always very clean and tidy, and even then they had to cater for one more person - which they provided me with a rollaway bed. Very good of them since i didn't actually inform them of this until i moved in.

title: Motels Offer Better Value and Service!
text:
As an Accor Plus Platinum member, please be aware that individuals like us stay at least 60 nights around the world and know your brand quite intimately. The service and the welcome at this hotel was just not upto the mark. I arrived a bit late at night, had a lot of luggage with me. Originally had booked this for 4 nights. Just the whole experience was atrocious, the night time manager just was more interested in having a siesta at the back rather than check me in properly. Got his sidekick to try and check me in. She was having issues, then he got called. Said he gave me a family room as an upgrade. Platinum members, be warned, that is just a twin bed room, not an upgrade. I asked him repeatedly, what is the room called - Superior, Executive or Suite. He said its a Hamilton Novotel Family room (Which doesnt exist as a room on the advertised pages). So all i get is a smaller bed aka Superior Room with twin beds (which I hadnt even ordered). And at 6 ft+ with someone sleeping next to you, it was a not so good experience! You end up sleeping in separate beds, and no I dont have kids!

Then didnt even help with the luggage, just didn't care. Imagine at 1 am checking in with 6 pieces of luggage. Then the room i get hadn't been cleaned properly. Enter and I see an empty water plastic water bottle lying on the floor. Then try and have a shower in the morning. Two conditioner tubes is all we get (no shampoo or bath gel). And to think of it, here i am paying 240$ NZD per night for a twin superior room with a partner? Lucky I had my stay over two bookings and I promptly cancelled the 2nd half of the booking and checked myself into a local motel (Ashwood Manor). Sorry guys, but no point spending close to 750$ overall (not including food) if this is to be expected. I dont mind if you dont have a room upgrade, just dont bs with your clients. Say you dont have it but next time you will try. That would have gone down well. Not this sort of rubbish. A Superior twin room is not a family room nor an upgrade to a couple! Secondly if this was a family room, there would be an adjoining door leading to another room. Nope wasn't there either. Extremely disappointed!

title: Good quality hotel in the centre of town
text:
Great location, friendly front desk and a great room. Air con, 2 large beds, good shower, flat screen TV, safe and tea and coffee making facilities. A gym and laundry on site. Valet parking available.
Very comfortable, great bed.

title: Romantic Getaway
text: The Hotel room was amazing and had a great sleep. The next day however, we were booking out at 11 so just stayed in the room. Housekeeping knocked at the door about 4 times and opened it. We did not have the sign out as we were checking out this day and felt rushed to leave due to this. I was very annoyed as we have stayed at many hotels and this has never happened on check out day.

title: Novotel Hamilton Tainui
text: This was a very comfortable hotel in a handy location. Great river views and all amenities. Staff were both welcoming and accommodating. Did not use the guest facilities so unable to comment however the hotel was very clean and comfortable and the high quality I have come to expect from Accor hotels.

title: Great Downtown location
text: Upon arriving, car park in front is for check in only. You either have to pay $20 NZD for valet parking or $15 NZD for self parking but was warn that there may be limited amount of self parking. We chose valet parking. I had pre checked in, so the physical check in went smoothly. We had room 448, which was fine, overlooked where the cars are parked and a slight obstructed view of the river. The room itself was clean and because of the high ceilings made the room feel bigger than what it was. In the bathroom was a tub/shower combo with the half glass shower door, these tend to end up with water on the floor otherwise bathroom seem to same as any other hotel. The bed was very comfortable, as tend to like beds softer than plywood with a bit padding that a lot of hotels try to pass off as beds. There is access to Wi-Fi. There is guest laundry room available as well. $2 NZD for wash and the same for drying. Beside the dining in the hotel other services were not used by us so cannot review those.

title: Excellent service
text:
Stayed two nights at this comfortable, well-located hotel. For those familiar with Novotel, you won't be disappointed. The rooms are quiet and well-appointed. The restaurant offers a good breakfast with barista-style coffees available. An all-day menu is supplemented by a dinner menu. 
The staff were excellent. On checking in, they took the time to advise on local attractions and restaurants and even booked some tickets for me!
If I'm in Hamilton again, I'll be staying at this hotel.

title: Very comfortable
text: My daughter and I stayed here while she was playing volleyball in Hamilton. Reception staff were polite and helpful. Our room was very comfortable, two queen beds and lovely linen. The bathroom was modern and clean. A wide variety of foods for breakfast. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend.

title: First time Novotel
text: It was our first stay in Hamilton and in Novotel too. When we arrived to Hamilton Novotel Tainui hotel we're very positively surprised. As a member we've sooner check in time and it was great. I've booked superior room with two double beds and breakfast included. After check in we went to room at third floor. Room was sufficiently spacious, bathroom with bathtub. The best part of this room are beds. Very comfortable, spacious for family. Restaurant has a varied menu and tables were excellently arranged. The best breakfast menu were pancakes for our children. Thanks a lot. Hotel has own parking places or garage. Next to the hotel is casino, very close to city center,there's a lot of bridges over the river and beautiful Parana park, Soldiers memorial park and many others.

title: Only if you dare.
text:
Arriving with a Corolla Hybrid car and getting free parking for electric or hybrid vehicles was excellent – however, after a pleasant check-in, everything went downhill from there.
We went to the room where management had kindly left us a cheese platter – but- it had been out a long time and was warm and tasted off. Why not leave it in the fridge?
As Gold members, we expected complimentary water in the room – nothing. Asked reception for it, and was told it will be brought up to room – no show.
Had a hot chocolate – didn’t taste right.. found use by date had expired.
We went to the restaurant, and found flies everywhere and bees inside the room. Had a complimentary drink from the bar, but the bartender shorted the scotch giving us only ¾ tumbler. When asked about it I was informed that she had filled it full…not. Also wife ‘s complimentary wine was only just a taste – not like other hotels.
Asked for Garlic Bread – arrived cold.
Ate Pork Belly from the menu, found normal barb-q sauce all over it. Didn’t taste nice, and pork was stringy. 
Tried breakfast, saw cleaner washing windows on the inside with a cleaning spray – while breakfast was in progress! Not good. Also had a glass of orange juice – found a big chip on the glass edge!
After this my wife was physically sick, so we left a day early – any discount on the room for early departure from paid room  – no it was prepaid so nothing back.
Would not recommend at all.

title: Central location
text:
We had a 4th floor room overlooking the main street. However there was little street noise. The room was comfortable, the aircon not too noisy and the beds were very comfortable. We didn't have the breakfast buffet but it seemed to be well stocked. There was a good selection of fresh fruit.
I left something behind in the room and when I rang the hotel they confirmed this and couriered the items to my home address (at our cost of course) but the service was friendly and helpful.
hotel_response: Dear Kleonz. Thank you very much for sharing your comments in regards to your recent stay with us. Happy to read that you have enjoyed it and look forward to welcome you. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: High Standards
text: I've stayed at this hotel 6 times in the past few year and every stay has been a good one.  I've generally been upgraded and well looked after.  The bar and restaurant are excellent and so are their breakfasts.  Room quality is up there and always clean and tidy.
hotel_response: Dear Marcustrusler. Thank for taking the time to review your stay with us. Look forward to welcome you back staying with us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General manager

title: Novotel Tainui
text: Excellent reception staff on arrival & departure. Very comfortable bed, room facilities excellent, handy to walk to other restaurants. Great location, parking facilities were very handy, access to this was explained thoroughly when checking in.
hotel_response: Dear 763pmh, Great to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Hope to be able to welcome you back at some stage. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: good stay
text: Best customer service in the country, ideal location, great meals and bar value for money, most helpful staff the best hotel i have stayed in, would definitely stay there again next time in Hamilton a really enjoyable experience from check in to checkout.
hotel_response: Dear Tom. Really appreciate your kind words and the great feedback on your recent stay with us. Look forward to welcome you back with us. Regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: 3 night stay
text: Went with friends after booking through Accor. Check in a little slow as just 1 person on. Rooms good size and very comfy bed. Had meal there on first night which was nice. Very friendly staff especially in bar/restaurant. Used valet parking as was raining and didn’t know best area to park.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for taking the time to review your stay with us. Sorry about the delay during the check-in; I will provide this feedback to my team. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Perfect
text:
I emailed a few days before to ask for early check-in close to Christmas as we had an overnight flight from Australia. The email back said they would request it but couldn’t guarantee. 
After landing in Auckland at 4.45am, we headed to Hamilton in the rental car & lobbed (bleary-eyed) at the Novotel. The receptionist (Alya?) was fantastic - friendly & checked us in early with an upgrade. Lifesaver! Particulary as we flew in to go to the races. So we caught a few eyes of shut-eye then headed out to reception, where they called a taxi happily for us as we had our car parked up by valet.
On return to the hotel, we had a quiet drink in the bar which is a lovely spot before we had a quiet night in. 
The room was freshly renovated & nicely appointed, even to the point of having USB data points. If anything, the towels needed an upgrade (but that’s being picky). 
Breakfast the next morning was an extensive spread. Much better than most buffet breakfasts. 
Staff were great, hotel great location, would definitely recommend. 
PS there is a lovely riverwalk adjacent to the hotel which is a must-do
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thanks so much for the extensive review on your stay with us. So happy to read that you have fully enjoyed it. Hope you had a great time in New Zealand. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Family trip
text: So the hotel is nice and the staff were accommodating, now this is it. The food at the restaurant is a total miss. It was slow and poorly thought out menu. The kids spaghetti was just awful tasted like ketchup. The Wife’s steak was over cooked and my salad was hardly dressed. Put simply there are several much much better places directly across the street, trust me as a normally good reviewer that you should make the effort and walk 10 meters across the road.
hotel_response: Dear Robert. Really appreciate your feedback on your meal at our restaurant. Really sorry that we did not do this too well. I will provide this feedback to my chefs as well and work on improvements. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Our kids love this hotel, especially the buffet breakfast
text: We make an annual trip to Hamilton and try to stay at Novotel when we can. The breakfast buffet is excellent, the pancakes, croissants and cereals are our favourites. The kids really enjoy their experience at the hotel, mostly due to the breakfast but also the little play area in the dining room while the grown ups are still eating. The beds are comfortable and the rooms are clean and tidy.

title: Good 1 night stay
text:
Good reliable hotel in the middle of Hamilton close to the city centre and food establishments.
Great friendly check in.
Outside hotel car parking quickly fills up with valet or covered car parking in the adjacent Skycity car park ($15/night) the remaining options. Pass out for Skycity car park available from reception which makes things easy.
Good clean rooms - no complaints.
Breakfast - better than average for hotel buffet breakfast with many options.
Overall a very good experience and would stay again.

title: Lovely as always
text: Novotel Hamilton is central, clean, fresh and provides a great buffet breakfast. Always stay there when in Hamilton.  Highly recommend to anyone for business or pleasure and the staff are always helpful and friendly

title: 50 metres from a best restaurant in Hamilton
text: Centre of town, rooms spacious and staff very helpful. a nice restaurant(we didn't eat there) and a nice bar serving many beers and cocktails,. Around the corner from main street so access to all is close by, including Casino

title: Average
text: Staff fine at checkin. Room was nice and lovely new refurbished bathroom. Gym was in a small space and although two treadmills, one bike, one rower, one cross trainer and a selection of weights, would not want anymore than three people in the space at any one time. Spa looked unclean. Bed was comfortable. Towels vey ordinary. Had our car valet parked and had to ask twice for it to be brought to us. Disappointed for a hotel of this calibre.

title: An Average Hotel
text:
An Average hotel, a little expensive, a little tired, but nice staff. It's about time this place had either the carpets cleaned or a bit of a re-fit, new pillows would help too!

OK it's central location is good!
hotel_response: Dear Tim. Thanks for your feedback and hope I can provide you with some actions. We recently have changed all the pillows in the hotel and provide additional pillows in our cupboards in the room. Hopefully that will help. We are also in the middle of a total renovation of all bathrooms and look at renovating all bedrooms in the year following. However, do appreciate your feedback. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Restaurant under par
text:
6 friends were invited to lunch by paying hotel guests .. table booked, almost no one else in the resaturant.
Our simple lunch meal took 2 hours .. It was a litiny of errors and the poor waitress apologising!
The orders were "lost', screwed up, badly cooked and special requests got lost in translation!
The coffee order was completely messed up and then we are told that they no longer supply straws for drinks, because of the policy to save the planet !!.. umm try politely drinking a tall iced coffee with cream and chocolate on top without a straw!
hotel_response: Dear Mrs. Clarkie, Thank you so much for your feedback around your lunch at our restaurant on Alma. Really appreciate the feedback and I will share this with my managers and staff to review. We have indeed stopped providing plastic straws in everything, as they would mostly end up in waste. However, I do appreciate your feedback and will review. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Nice hotel
text: Novotel is located in the centre of hamilton. I stayed for 3 nights. Staff was very friendly. Rooms are good. You have to pay for wifi. Breakfast is good (but not special).  All in all a convenient hotel.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thanks for taking the time to inform us about your recent stay with us. Glad to see that you liked it. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Rennovated and improved
text:
The renovations have given a much needed new lease of life to the hotel. The bathrooms look fantastic and modern. The breakfast buffet has improved with a better selection of items. The checkout staff are very friendly and helpful.

Management is seeking feedback on the room renovations and I think the water run off from the shower is a design problem which needs addressing now before the other rooms have been completed. Novotel Management to initiate dialogue in reply to this review. Room 138 was where we stayed, checked in 28 November.
hotel_response: Dear David. Thank you so much for your feedback and also my thanks for the form that you gave us in regards to room 138. We are in the middle of renovations and getting some great feedback, but also some very valid comments around the layout. Thanks again for sharing this with us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Great place to stay
text: Staff at the Novotel Tainui were extremely friendly and helpful. The hotel is located close to plenty of dinning options and also has a great restaurant. Was in NZ on business and found it great place to come back to and relax
hotel_response: Dear Adrian. Really appreciate the time you took to review your stay with us. Great to read that you have enjoyed it. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Probably the best in Hamilton- which is not a high bar
text:
It’s a Novotel. Clean. Serviceable. Max 1-2 night stay. 

Below average gym facilities. 

Decent location- can be a bit noisy. 

It’s probably the best hotel in Hamilton, but that may not be saying all that much
hotel_response: Dear Steve. Thanks for your comments in regards to your stay with us. Really appreciate the feedback on the gym. We are looking at upgrading this, so that is helpful. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Lovely Place
text: We stayed in a King Room which was excellent and very large. Restaurant has excellent food and staff are very friendly.  Close too all amenities . Highly recommend. Plenty of restaurants etc close by. Close too sightseeing attractions.
hotel_response: Dear Mick. Thank you so much for taking the time to review your recent stay with us. Glad to read that you have enjoyed it. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Construction site - avoid until work finished
text: Arrived for a 5 nights stay, 4 weeks into a 7 weeks trip through Australia and New Zealand, to find the hotel has recently started refurbishing the bathrooms in it's rooms. Had to walk through dirt and dust to get to our room then, on the 2nd morning, Friday, rudely woken at 8am by drilling and banging from the builders. Spoke to reception who said they shouldn't start until 9.30 and they would speak. Thankfully no work done at the weekend as, come Monday morning, it all started again at 8.30. This might be fine if you are stopping at the hotel on business and would be up by then but some people are on holiday and would like a bit of a lie in at times. Work is scheduled until June 2018 so, unless you are on business, I would avoid this hotel until after then. One of those times when you think you would have been better off booking a cheaper option (Ibis, part of same chain, just across the road)  rather than going for what is meant to be one of the best hotels in town. Shame as the staff were excellent, really friendly and helpful, and, without the work, it would be a nice hotel.
hotel_response: Dear Ian. Thank you very much fro your comments after your stay with us. At present we are renovating 20 rooms at the time and the work hours are indeed from 09.30 am to 16.00 pm . There should not be any other disturbance otherwise. It is true that we are working until June 2018, but we are also doing our utmost to limit the inconvenience to our guests. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: First time stayer
text:
I thought your customer service was outstanding, the cleaners are incredibly friendly when passing them in the hall way, the front desk were welcoming and incredibly helpful and witty, the food was superb.
I had a self inflicted head ache so the drilling was the only discomfort, definitely will recommend to colleagues to stay in your establishment.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you very much for taking the time to review your stay with us. Look forward to welcome you and your colleagues at our hotel. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Full house
text: Yep they were busy but service was still good all round. They are going through a room refurbishment programme and we were in one of the original rooms. We are not fans of shower over baths but I think that is changing with refurbishment.
hotel_response: Dear Scott. Thank you for your comments in regards to your recent stay with us. Indeed, we are renovating and have removed almost all baths, with fitting the rooms with showers only. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Nice hotel in center of town.
text: We stayed here for two nights in order to go to Hobbit movie set. The staff was very good. The furnishings in the room looked to be new. They are renovating the bathrooms and we were put next to one that was noisy all day. They said they were fully booked and I believe it but we made our reservations nine months ago and requested a river view room but got a view of the business building next door instead right next to the hotel construction. The other problem was the almost total lack of electrical plugs. The new desk had a usb outlet that could not charge an iPad (but could charge a phone). If staying here I would suggest checking out the room before finishing check in. The breakfast buffet was very good.
hotel_response: Dear Ron, Thanks for your comments after your stay with us and I am sorry about the disturbance of the renovations. We are indeed renovating all bathrooms and have almost finished one floor already. In regards to the power outlets; there is a box inside the desk with three power units; sorry you didn't see that. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Great easy stay
text: We always stay at Novotel every time when we need to stop a night or two in Hamilton - Satisfied every time! Convenient location and children friendly, helpful staff and good value breakfast.Highly recommended to all. Thanks ☺
hotel_response: Dear Guest, Thank you for taking the time to respond to Tripadvisor with a review after your stay with us. Look forward to welcome you back with us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Friendly Staff, Great Room, Bathrooms being renovated.
text:
Located in the CBD of Hamilton, the hotel is within walking distance to many restaurants around town.  Parking is not free, valet parking was $20/day with in and out privileges. The hotel validates $15 parking at the nearby Skycity parkade but it is charged at exit so not very convenient if you are coming and going throughout the day.

Room was very nice and comfortable. We had a corner unit with lots of light as well as views of the Waikato river. Bathrooms were a bit dated with chipped tiles and a shower tub, toilet was old and used way too much water...it splatters when you flush it. 

There was a sign in the lobby saying the bathrooms were being renovated very soon which is a good thing. 

Breakfast was included in our rate. There was a good selection of fruits and cold items.  Standard breakfast items were in the buffet breakfast--eggs, sausages, bacon, pancakes, etc. You can create your own smoothie with the fruit items and yogourt and the staff will blend it for you.  Ample selection of gluten free bread and pastries were also available and lots of fruit juices.

Coffee machine was not working when we were there, but staff made espresso drinks at the bar and served those on request.

Front desk staff were very nice and friendly.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for your feedback after your stay with us; really pleased to read that you have enjoyed. We are indeed renovating the bathrooms and have almost completed the first floor already. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Excellent stay to celebrate my husband's birthday
text:
We Hamilton locals generally consider Novotel to be one of the nicest hotels in town (I've lived here for nearly 4 years now).  So, I was looking for something special when I booked a night here to stay with my husband to celebrate his birthday.

I made my booking online.  In the comments part of the page, I mentioned that we were celebrating my husband's birthday.  I asked for a view of the river.  

When we arrived, the check-in process was quick and easy.  The reception staff members were friendly and warm and wished my husband a happy birthday.   She even said, "We managed to get you a room with a river view."  Awesome - I love places that pay attention to details!

We got to our room and it was beautiful!  It was spacious and the decor was modern and comfortable.  I was amazed that there was a "pillow menu" to order form (although, mine were fine so I kept what I had).  

The staff had also (at no charge to me), left a gorgeous fruit, nut and cheese plate in our room, with Happy Birthday written in chocolate around the rim of the plate.  Additionally, there was a handwritten birthday card beside the plate, addressed to my husband.  It was incredibly thoughtful and again, I really appreciated the attention to detail.

As part of a online booking special, we had breakfast at the hotel the following morning for $1 each!  That's right, $1.  It was a huge buffet style breakfast with an incredible amount of variety of options - cold cereals, eggs, sausage, bacon, potatoes, cold meat slices with cheese, pastries, muffins, breads (and even gluten-free ranges).  Coffee was included and we each had a flat white.  It was all very, very good.

I will definitely return and encourage any visitors I have needing accommodation to stay here while in Hamilton.
hotel_response: Dear Rachel. Thank you so much for your very kind words to describe your stay with us and your celebration of your husband's birthday. I am glad that all worked out well and that you have enjoyed it. Look forward to celebrate the next birthday (or an earlier event, of course). Best regards, Dick Breukink, General manager

Our dirty room service crockery was left in the room, bed unmade etc. However, interestingly the mini bar was serviced. We had a knock at 4.30 and an offer to have it cleaned, which we declined (very intrusive). The compendium had no details about a laundry and we were not aware that we had to swipe our key card to operate the lifts at night. Guest services staff were helpful throughout our stay and Cassandra on reception was excellent - very warm and friendly. Not a bad stay, but a bit inconsistent in terms of service.

The restaurant was somewhat of a disappointment. The dinner menu had minimal options and they all seemed over priced. We ended up going to the hotel next door. We did eat breakfast here however - that definitely lived up to expectations.

Parking was the biggest issue here. It would have been good to be told about the relative lack of parking in advance. In the end, we paid the $20 for valet parking but outside of this our options were quite limited. It created a stress that I typically like to avoid on holidays.

Ultimately, it was a comfortable place to stay but overpriced for what we received. Next time I'd look for something out of the city centre that was a bit better value for money.
