Rooms are great though and we did appreciate the laundry service. 
That said, this Novotel is centrally located, along the river.
hotel_response: Dear Eric. Thanks for taking the time to let us know about your recent stay with us. As in a lot of cities with limited car parking, we also charge for valet parking. This means that we park your car and bring it back up for you at any time for a fee of $ 20.00. Nice to read that you have enjoyed the room and laundry service. best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Getting dated shocking restaurant
text:
So we come down to Hamilton for a family gathering the beds on our double a double beds to small for two adults. 

The check in process was too long and only one person on so delays no car parking and Valet was $20 a night expensive. 

Breakfast was a shocker no where to sit and the buffet was like a feeding troff overall a nightmare. When I asked where can I sit I was told "we need a bigger restaurant " 

Won't be eating here again
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you very much for taking the time to inform us about your stay with us. I am really sorry about the experience in our hotel and will talk to my managers and staff about your feedback. The valet parking is at a cost and is there for your convenience where you bring your car to the front of the hotel as many times as you want. The restaurant breakfast can be busy but that does not necessarily mean that we need to expand. Again, really appreciate your comments. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Good location and room quality
text:
Geat location in the river. Next to casino. 
Room quality really good. Bathrooms a little tired but are about to be upgraded. WiFi speeds food. Breakfast good standard as well. Loads of restaurant options nearby. River on door step.

title: Convenient location, clean & good service
text:
Stopped for a 2 days stay at Hamilton on our North Island holidays. The hotel is conveniently located in the city center with plenty of good restaurants in walking distance. Plenty of car parking options, even free of charge at the back of the hotel. Hotel staff was very welcoming and friendly at check in and check out, the restaurant and bar alike. Breakfast options are great with plenty of choices.
Guest rooms are spacious, well maintained and clean. 
We had overall a very nice stay and would come back again.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. It is really nice to see that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Do look forward to welcome you back with us. Just let me know if you need any assistance. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Great place to stay
text: We have stayed here frequently and always are made to feel so welcome. The staff and rooms are great.They have a super restaurant and the food is delicious. Also next door to Hamilton Casino and the shops are just next door. Very convient. Beautiful restaurants so close.
hotel_response: Dear Jan. Thank you very much for reviewing your stay with us. I am really pleased to read that you have enjoyed it. look forward to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Clean & comfortable but service could be improved
text:
Location-wise, this is great if you're looking for a place right in Hamilton central. Rooms were clean & the bed comfortable. It's a good hotel, we just experienced a few things that might have us consider staying elsewhere next time:

* Toilet flooded / blocked on first flush

* Check-out time is 11.00am - we had cleaners knock on our door to try come in & clean it just after 10.00am 

* Another staff member knocked on our door (before 10.30am) & walked right into the room unannounced and with no apology, instead using an excuse that the (very much shut) door was open 

* Upon check-out we were informed the room needed to be checked before we could get our bond back. We were asked to sit & wait and someone would be over to us within minutes. After waiting half an hour & anxious we were now late for the event we had come to Hamilton for, we went to the reception desk to enquire about the status of our check-out only to be told the room had been checked a long time ago & the staff had forgotten to tell us (despite us sitting in front of the reservation desk)
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really appreciate your feedback on your stay with us. My apologies for the fact that you were disturbed on the day of check out and the fact that you had to wait so long for the room check. I will point this out to my manager and ensure that we attend to the room check more promptly. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: A real mixture of good and not so good points
text:
Booked and paid for Superior Room and given a Standard one - Check before heading to room next time. Receptionist appeared near the end of her shift and over it.
Car Valet $20 but good for car security and valets were lovely.
Room was clean but carpet looked like it could do with a refresh.Beds were very comfortable and clean. Only one extra blanket for 2 beds.
Bathroom needed small amount of mould removed around bath but otherwise very clean.
TV was a Smart TV.. I am not 'smart' but managed to find channels but not the guide to see whats on.
My computer would not allow me to access Internet even though I could connect to Wifi but I had better things to do then 'sort' that out.
Airconditioning/heater was also a lot 'smarter' then me and noisy so I turned it off.
The evening staff were very friendly, helpful and professional.
Two young Housekeepers entered our room at 9.00am without knocking and catching us in the middle of dressing. Put a 'do not disturb' sign out at all times, I guess.
Breakfast was a mad house, staff person said "Good luck finding a table" Hmm.. No marmalade, no sugar, no cups and saucers and no utensils for those of us perched on coffee tables. Food servers were on very high tables and difficult to access unless you're over 6 feet tall. I would recommend a Maitre D for breakfast service when its chaotic.
Overall there was a real mixture of very good professionalism and some not so good. I might try the IBIS next time and not expect so much.
hotel_response:
Dear Guest. Thank you so much for your feedback and really appreciate the time you took to provide us with your feedback I have shared your comments with my staff and we will take some action around the breakfast. I understand that it must have been around the time where we had large groups in the hotel, but that should not have an affect on your stay. My apologies for the "not so good" parts of your stay. Best regards,
Dick Breukink
General Manager, Novotel and Ibis Tainui Hamilton

title: A getaway.
text: Done this review so many times before. Have been a customer for over 10 years with Accorr. So its the same feedback. No dramas to list. Enjoy the Novotel. A perfect location. Ayla the staff member on the front desk is the best person I have ever dealt with in the hospitallity industry. Will be back again Ken. Stayed 10.6.17
hotel_response: Dear Ken. Always a pleasure to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. I will share your feedback with Ayla; she will be really happy with that. look froward to welcome you back. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Central Location, good for business and visitor alike
text: This is the second time I have stayed at the Novotel Tainui, and it was as equally good as the first time. The staff were welcoming and pleasant. The Hotel itself is modern and contemporary and the rooms are a reflection of this. The bar area is well laid out, with high tables, low tables and soft furnishings areas, with a nice out door area if the weather is being kind. There is ample parking around and the hotel is such that you can eat in or Hamilton central is merely a few steps. Would stay here again for sure.
hotel_response: Dear Darren. It is really nice to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. As you mentioned that you are planning on coming back to us, look forward to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Comfortable mid-range room
text: Bed was large and comfortable, linen fine except towels were too few and a bit thin and ragged. Amenities all good except the bathroom in need of a makeover - which the hotel is doing. On first floor quiet - no intrusive noise but curtains did not block fully the light from the atrium next to it. TV good quality. Breakfast very good and all staff in the hotel were excellent. We paid upgradedfrom classic card to Silver on checkout but this still hasn't come through - 4 days later.
hotel_response: Dear Margaret. Thank you very much for your comments in regards to your stay with us. Really pleased to see that you have enjoyed it. If you need any further assistance with your card, please let me know; it takes a couple of working days to update. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Friendliest staff
text: I have stayed in many hotels from six star to those lessor ones. I've not stayed in any that has better customer service than the Novotel in Hamilton. From the moment I checked in to the wonderful dinner I had (Asian style pork belly to die for) to the breakfast, parking and check out, the team at the Novotel were outstanding.  the staff weren't just helpful and friendly they were genuinely happy to help. Smiles everywhere. And a lovely room etc etc. I had valet parking and when I got the car back there was a complimentary bottle of water for my drive south. Such a nice touch. Would I stay there again? Oh yes!
hotel_response: Dear Trevor. What can I say? It is really nice to get good reviews, although it is sometimes also good to get feedback how we can improve. Your review however is absolutely amazing and really appreciate your kind words. Hope to be able to welcome you back. Cheers, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Nice hotel, but bedding and towels need a refresh
text: Facilities are good - food is excellent and some of the best in Hamilton. The bathroom linen was threadbare and the duvet on the bed was so thin it was almost a sheet. An expensive stay in what could be really great.
hotel_response: Dear Raymond. Thanks for your comments after your stay with us. Really appreciate to read your feedback and I can inform you that we are changing our linnen soon as well as our pillow set up. I am sorry that we haven't done this as yet. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: As good as it should be
text: For the price one expects high levels of service and facilities, the Novotel achieves this and beyond. Great reception, well organised and although busy very professional. Good restaurant, very good breakfast. Excellent room.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you for taking the time to review your stay. The focus points you mentioned in your review are indeed the areas we want to concentrate on.It is fantastic to see that you had the same comments. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Wonderful Hotel to stay at
text: We were greeted by very friendly staff at Reception and in all parts of this hotel.Our room was very comfortable and clean. The bed was amazing. Our breakfast was included in the room rate and was delicious. Loved staying here.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really nice to see your comments in regards to your stay with us. Fantastic to see that you have fully enjoyed it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Novotel Tainui
text: Really good staff, a nice place to stay in Central Hamilton. The lady at reception was very friendly and helpful both when we arrived and checked out.  She told us where everything was located from the restaurant, bar and gym.  It was a very pleasant experience. I would definitely stay here again.
hotel_response: Dear Ena. Fantastic to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. It is always good to get some feedback from our guests. Hope to be able to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Great stay
text:
This was my first stay at the hotel and it was fantastic.
The staff very friendly and helpful.
The food was great
The room was great.
Will stay again.
It was great being close to the stadium where I attending the warriors game.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thanks for commenting on your stay with us. Very nice to read that you have enjoyed it. Sorry about the result of the Warriors game. Hopefully they will come back soon. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Fantastic Stay
text:
Had a really good one night stay for work here. The rooms were huge, well appointed  and had all the things I needed - great heating/cooling and blackout curtains. Bed was comfortable and plenty of pillow options via the pillow menu. Staff were great - much better than other places I've been to recently. Everyone was happy, professional and really willing to help. 

For those Accor members you'll be happy to know you'll be treated really well. Got a room upgrade and drinks vouchers without asking - in fact when I checked in they ran through the benefits with me. Also some nice chocolates and a note from the GM which is always great. Breakfast was very good as well with options ranging from cereals, toast, cold cuts and a lot of hot options. 

I'll definitely be using the Novotel whenever I stay in Hamilton from now on.
hotel_response: Dear Harry. Great to read your comments in regards to your stay with us. Really pleased to see that you have enjoyed your stay with us and even more happy that we will be looking after you in the future. If you need any assistance, just let me know. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Business Trip in Hamilton, NZ
text: Great hotel and location and the staff are always great.  I always stay at the Novotel Hamilton as long as they have available rooms which is often a few times each month, My only complain is they need better pillows as they are always flat.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you for reviewing your stay with us and I really appreciate your comments in regards to the pillows. We are nationwide reviewing all our Novotel pillows and happy to let you know that soon we will have a total new range of pillow in our rooms. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Novotel Hamilton
text: A very pleasant Hotel to stay at. Staff are very helpful and cherry to speak to. The rooms were excellent and very clean and tidy. Car parking was very secure. The restaurant and meals where great, with  a good selection.
hotel_response: Dear Denis. Really appreciate the time you took to review your stay with us. Glad to see that you have enjoyed it and look forward to welcome you back with us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Best in Hamilton
text:
Hamilton is a small town, expect lesser branded hotels. Therefore Novotel is probably the best choice here. Location is good, in middle of the main market area. Breakfast spread is limited, unfortunately no Indian dish, may be not many Indians frequent this hotel. 
An Indian restaurant band opposite the hotel is a good plus point. 
The only issue I faced was with laundry, they accepted the laundry on Sunday only to tell me later that Sunday is not a laundry day. As I had the check out next day, I had to leave without laundry being done. 
Housekeeping needs to be improved as they keep forgetting refilling toiletries and supplies. 
Overall a nice stay indeed.
hotel_response: Dear Saurabh. Thank you so much for leaving some comments around your stay with us. I am really sorry that we were unable to do your laundry during your stay; my staff should have informed you about this. I am glad that you found the Indian restaurant across the street a good option for dinner. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Overnight stay in Hamilton
text:
Overnight stay in Hamilton, great service, professional staff. Return visit to the hotel we always enjoy our stay. Clean hotel good facilities 
Exceptional service from reception regarding parking we will keep returning
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for taking the time to review your recent stay with us. Great to see that you have enjoyed your stay. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Nice hotel in the town
text:
The hotel is nice and in the central of the town, so very convenient to go around. A lot of restaurants nearby offering a wide variety of Chinese, Thai, Korean, Italian, Indian...it's also close to the river and very peaceful for a walk along the river. Staff are professional and friendly.
However, the carpet on the corridor is quite old, I think it needs to be replaced; the walls, doors are also needed a new paint. I noticed a few rooms are being refurbished, but not noisy at all.
I stayed there for 2 nites and was happy with my choice.
hotel_response: Dear Lan. Great to receive some feedback from you after your stay with us. It is always nice to get some comments after your stay. We are indeed starting to renovate our bathrooms, but will do this with the minimum of disruption. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Friendly warm welcome
text: Warm and friendly check-in, well prepared room, helpful friendly bar/restaurant staff.  We had dinner that was delicious, maybe could have been little faster service, but nothing to really complain about. Could recommend the hotel to all.
hotel_response: Dear Elna, Thank you so much for reviewing your stay with us. Really pleased to see that you have enjoyed it. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Good hotel
text: Stayed here 2 nights for a conference.  Rooms are good, comfortable, clean.  Pillow menu available which is helpful.  Good location, plenty of cafes around.  Nice view of the Waikato River from my room.  Full range of Sky TV channels.  Conference was well run, no issues from the hotel. Conference catering good.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really appreciate the time you took to review your recent stay with us. Look forward to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: One Nights Stay
text:
I noticed upon arrival that all rooms are going to be refurbished. 
So that's a plus 
Had breakfast and the waiter "GABOR" was very helpful and accommodating 
I would like Management to commend him first his helpfulness and was always working , always tiding and doing something constructive .
He is a true credit to the Tainui Novetel
hotel_response: Dear Dean. Thank you so much for the feedback after your stay with us. I will share your comments with Gabor; really appreciate this. Hope that we are able to welcome you back at some stage. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: For Lack of Hotel Choices in Hamilton It Might be Considered the Best
text: Lots of motels in Hamilton, very few hotels. Clean, comfortable, and central to restaurants. But the rooms connect and they are very very noisy. Parking was lousy - and virtually non-existent. My husband was on business and my daughter and I rented a car to travel each day so this was a sticking point. They pointed to a garage behind them where I could pay $15.00 each time we went in and out - uh no...Staff was lovely once the warmed up to us. Tasty full buffet is pricey. I think there are a lot of in and out for one night people that might be traveling by bus etc. I would have preferred less transient venue with less traffic and noise but all in all given this or a motel I'd choose this hands down...
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for providing me feedback on your stay with us. Your comments have been very valuable to me and I will share them with my managers. With this feedback, we are able to improve our service. Thank you again for your comments. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Great Location and Very Comfortable
text:
After a long haul from the Bay of Islands it was refreshing to pull up at the Novotel Hamilton Tainui.

Service at reception was fast and extremely polite.  

The car was left to valet parking as it would be undercover overnight.  Vehicle was ready and waiting the next morning we'll in advance of the 15 minutes they stated they required.

Dinner was in the restaurant that night and it was delicious.  Breakfast was the same with a buffet.  Not sure why but buffet breakfasts encountered never seen hot and sometimes a little stale.

The room was super comfortable and spacious.  The light built into the bed head was unique.

Would definitely stay here again and use as a base to explore around Hamilton.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for your feedback around your stay with us. We really hope that you are coming back to stay with us and do some exploring around Hamilton. Within 45 minutes drive, we have Raglan, Waitomo caves, Zealong tea plantation, Hobbiton and of course within the city the beautiful Hamilton gardens. Hope to welcome you back. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Nice central hotel
text:
Stayed one night on our way to the glow worm caves.  Hotel is standard Novotel, comfortable beds, good shower and tasty breakfast.  Parking can be found on the street if prepared to wait until 6pm.  Great local restaurants within walking distance.

Pool looked  inviting if it was warm or sunny.

We enjoyed our stay and would recommend.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. It is really nice to read your feedback on Tripadvisor in regards to your recent stay with us. Hope you enjoyed the Waitomo glow worm caves. They are so nice and just 45 minutes away from us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Probably the pick of Hamilton
text:
Small town, 2 night stopover on our way back to Auckland from North Island adventures.

Friendly staff, location good, rooms fine.  I'd stay again if in Hamilton - but really would probably have been better staying another night further south and having a big drive to Auckland.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for reviewing your stay at our hotel. Really appreciate the time you took to post this. Hope we are able to welcome you back again. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: My hotel choice when in Hamilton
text: I like to stay at this hotel when in Hamilton as being in the city centre the shops are virtually adjacent and the city restaurants are all within walking distance. The rooms are typical  hotel rooms but are clean and fresh, the staff I find are always very friendly and helpful and valet parking is reasonably priced. The hotel restaurant does a good buffet breakfast, and i did enjoy one evening meal.
hotel_response: Dear Terry. Thank you so much for reviewing your stay with us and really pleased to read that you have enjoyed your stay. Look forward to welcome you back with us in the future. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Best last night in New Zealand
text: All the staff here have exceptional customer service. We had a lovely walk around the hotel by the river and city and then dined at the hotel. This was an experience in itself. All the meals were fantastic but I chose the lamb and it was absolutely sensational. Christian looked after us and he made our dining experience very pleasant. We had buffet breakfast the next morning to get us started for the long day ahead and the staff were lovely and engaging. This was one of the best hotels we stayed in during our holiday.
hotel_response: Dear Mrs. Kell. Thank you so much for reviewing your stay with us and providing me with comments around my staff members. I will make sure that we share this with Christian. Hope you had a good trip back home; it is great to see that you have enjoyed your stay. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, general manager.

title: Badly run hotel which need to sorting out
text: The hotel is 'ok' but management and the facilities need to be sorted out! Trying to get a drink in the bar took 3 staff members ignoring me before I was served. The Internet (both wireless and wired) didn’t work (they acknowledged they were having trouble). The breakfast area in the restaurant was untidy with food on the floor. Trying to contact reception or the operator or the concierge between 8am and 830am resulted in no-one answering the phone - which, as I discovered, was because they only had 1 staff member on the front desk (the poor lady got an earful from me). They also failed to provide the benefits I get from being Accor Platinum member. This was the first and last time I will be staying here (but unfortunately there are not many choices in Hamilton).
hotel_response: Dear Guest. First of all, I would like to thank you for providing me with feedback on your recent stay with us. I am really sorry to read that your stay was not at all what it is supposed to be. I will share your comments with my department managers and will ensure that this does not happen again. If you would choose to come back to Hamilton and possibly stay with us again; please let me know and I will look after you. Again, my apologies and although we have had internet problems, we need to make sure that we resolve them for you. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Once again great stay !
text:
We had a function on in Hamilton over Easter so stayed here one night, we have stayed a number of times before but not since becoming a Platinum Accor member and we appreciated the fact that they recognised our loyalty with providing us with the little extras such as chocolate and a nice hand written note from the manager along with robes and slippers and a drink at the bar for both my wife and I , much more than the IHG brand give for the same level of loyalty.  
The Restaurant has greatly improved, they had a top chef and the food was as good as one could get anywhere. Christian was fantastic , he greeted us straight away and we had our wine within minutes of sitting down, very impressive ! He makes sure everyone is happy and his off siders were also great at doing their job. Christian is a great asset to this hotel and takes the level of service up to 6 star.  As others have said and I have reviewed before , fantastic location and very good Hotel.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. What can I say? It is really great to get your comments around your recent stay with us and the fact that you have enjoyed it so much. I will certainly make sure that I share the feedback with Christiaan; he is indeed a great asset and we are happy that he took care of you so well. Hope that we are able to welcome you back soon. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Very good choice for a stopover
text:
Clean,comfortable, spacious  room
Room internet access was plug in rather than wifi
Friendly reception staff but  staff to assist with luggage would have been appreciated
Bar service was fine as was the restaurant & food
Car parking facilities well catered for
hotel_response: Dear Stewart. Thank you so much for providing me with feedback around your recent stay with us. Really pleased to read that you have enjoyed it. Hope that you had a good trip back home. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Better
text:
Nice surprise as I was apprehensive from a previous Negative experience in a Novotel in the UK
The hotel is centrally located though the high street here appears deserted and neglected
The hotel room is comfortable and clean.Soft mattresses and pillows, tea  making facility , air con and fridge 
Ironing board also available
Buffet breakfast and dinner very good with   fresh fruit , cereals and cooked breakfast
Friendly staff.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for your comments about your stay with us. really pleased to see that you have enjoyed after a "not so good" stay in the UK. Glad you tried our hotel and we really hope to see you back with us at some stage. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Thumbs up
text:
Thumbs up means, all are good. 
Food, service, room, amenities,staff,location,wifi.
Looking forward for our next visit in Hamilton. 
Perfect stay. Had my 2 nights sleep absolutely great. A relaxing place to stay.
hotel_response: Dear Shan. Thanks for your comments after your stay with us. Hope to see you again soon. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Tired
text: This hotel is very tired and needs upgrading.The room we were in had a vibration in a light socket that i couldnt  fix,the bed linen while clean was old and worn and just generally a bit tired the whole experience.Even the lifts need attention.
hotel_response: Dear Peter. I really appreciate your feedback, posted on Tripadvisor after your stay with us. I have taken note of your comments and will see what I can do about this as soon as possible. We are going to renovate our bathrooms in July, so that is a start for renovations. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: conference
text:
we had our annual conference here, it was great the lunch provided was lovely so was the evening meal specially prepared for our group. thanks to the staff they are great and we al felt like vip.
however if one gets a meal at the restaurant then the staff is nice the setting is nice the music is bad and the food is also disappointing so writing about this before but they obviously do not want client of the street so get your dinner elsewhere 3 frogged legs is very good
hotel_response: Dear Frans. Thanks for your feedback and I am happy to feel that your conference went alright. I will share your comments around the restaurant with my manager and we will review what actions we can take to improve the food quality. Again, thanks for your feedback. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Convenient location however needs some updating
text:
We stayed here for 5 nights, Friday to Wednesday. Checkin was simple and efficient however we were surprised to find that parking cost $20 per night (Valet secure undercover parking) or $15 uncovered self parking (beside the hotel but by sky city casino).  
We booked a Superior room which was allocated to us on the 1st floor looking out toward the river.  It was not big however it did have a chaise lounge and a king bed.  The bathroom had shower over bath which was looking tired and in need of updating. The tiled floor was cracked.  
The gym was very well equiped although the Swiss balls could do with pumping up.  I did tell reception however it was not done before we left.  I am not a sports person but do need to alleviate back pain by using floor mats, Swiss balls, weights, bench and treadmills.  
The restaurant breakfasts were very good with a terrific assortment of cooked and continental.  We dined in on 3 evenings and found that the meals were very enjoyable, with good service.
Check out was friendly and efficient.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for taking the time to let us know about your recent stay with us. It is always nice to hear back from my guests. We are indeed planning on renovating all our bathrooms and are starting this process in July 2017. Thanks for your comments around the gym. I will follow up on that personally. Hope to be able to welcome you back. with kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Good Hotel
text:
The Novotel Hamilton Tainui is a good hotel just off the main street close to the Casino and numerous places to eat.

The staff are friendly, and I must say that Christian who manages the Restaurant is truly a great asset to the hotel. He takes care of everything efficiently and always with a smile. He makes you feel welcome, and as a business traveller, you can't ask for more than that.
hotel_response: Dear Graeme. Fantastic to read your comments around your stay with us. I will pass on the comments to Christiaan. You are absolutely correct on the way Christiaan looks at his job. He is doing really well with us. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Very pricey for what it is
text: I stayed in a Novotel in Leeds and loved it, therefore I was hoping that this would be a similar experience but unfortunately it wasn't. The bathroom was definitely not suitable for the amount of money we paid for our stay. I think it needed a bit of a refurnish. The room we had was of average size, but as the hotel is quite expensive we were hoping for a larger room. On the other hand, the hotel staff were very helpful as it turned out we had booked the wrong dates for our stay! Ideal parking right next door to the hotel and walking distance to many places to eat.
hotel_response: Dear Charlotte. Thanks for your feedback after your stay with us recently. Really appreciate your comments. Really happy to let you know that we are starting a renovation of all our bathrooms in the hotel. Glad that we were able to change your booking dates, so that you were able to stay with us. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Ed
text: I'm staying at this hotel right now the room is very comfortable but the internet is the worst I've experienced in the 3 weeks we've been here. Location is very convenient and our room looks out to a beautiful river with very nice walking trails.
hotel_response: Hi Ed, Thanks for your comments around our internet. I am sorry that this does not meet your requirements. If you would like to contact the front desk, we can see whether we are able to put you on a plan that suits your needs. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Great Hotel
text: Novotel Hamilton is well appointed with so many attractions/shopping/cafes adjacent to it. Welcoming reception, excellent parking arrangements and a pleasure to stay at. The rooms are very spacious and well appointed with every requirement for a comfortable stay provided.
hotel_response: Dear Kenn, Thanks for reviewing your stay with us. Really pleased to read that you have enjoyed it. Look forward to welcoming you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: There is definitley room for improvement
text:
My first time to this hotel, but not a first to Novotel.

The carpark cost us $15 and was in Sky City next door, so not as convenient. I suppose that is what you get when you need to park in a city hotel. The WiFi was a disgrace, but because it was complimentary, there was a limited amount of stink I could create.

Often the wireless was not available, in the lobby or in the room. I also contacted Front Desk to have it resolved. Then when I could connect, there was no internet access. I suspected it was a DNS problem. Then on the odds times it did work, the throughput was so bad, I could hardly load pages or connect to my company's VPN. I did a couple of speed tests and almost managed 1Mbps down. My speed tests were done after 10pm and around 6.30am and were to a Spark Hamilton server, so there can be no excuses.

I had requested a firm mattress, but the bed I chose wouldn't have come close, so I put a pillow under neath me and slept on that for extra support. And the pillows were mostly air. I crumpled one to the size of a soccer ball, so that tells you how little substance there was. All 3 pillows were like that.
Breakfast was good, an awesome selection of items and generally good quality.
Other than that, it was fine, but not brilliant.

I will look into the speed of the internet; even though it is free, we are providing a certain speed, which should work better than you described. I will certainly work on improving that. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Great accommodation for our family trip
text:
This is my second stay at this hotel and the first for the rest of my family (2 adults 2 kids). We selected the family room for this stay because we thought we would need the space and the 2 double beds configuration suits us.

Check in was again uneventful the gentleman at the reception was very helpful. We had a lot of bags and the porter was very helpful with our luggage. We went with valet parking ($20 per night). Very easy just leave the keys at the reception and our car was looked after.

The family room is quite large, the usual 2 beds plus a good area at the end of the room with has a couch and dining table. Very spacious. Bathroom was slightly dated, shower pressure was certainly on the low side but reasonable. The downsides were though the beds were definitely of the soft side and the pillows were far too soft. After our first night with the soft pillows we discovered that there is a health and well-being pamphlet at the bedside which listed a set of five types of pillows you can choose from. Naturally after our first night we decided to try something a lot harder for the second. Housekeeper was easy to get hold of, got us 3 harder pillows, made our second night sleep a lot better.

We had breakfasts with our room and they were fantastic. Excellent selection of food ranging from the usual bacon and eggs to fruit and cereal. Gluten free selection we noted in a separate area of the restaurant which I thought was very attentive. The staff there was very polite and helpful.

Internet was available with the room for free. It was available at my last visit but I thought the free version was pretty slow. This time there was no other selection option but the complimentary one and the speed was much improved, much faster. It was complimentary for 5 devices which is very useful for our family with all our gadgets. No dark areas in the room to speak off internet service was a major improvement from my last stay.

The location again was fantastic right in the middle of Hamilton CBD. The kids loved Timezone down the road. There are 4 restaurants just across the road from the hotel. 2 Italian, 1 Thai and an Indian one. We went with the Indian restaurant. The banquet there is highly recommended.

Suppose the only small complaint was that there was no pool there. In the summer with children that would complete a perfect stay. It does have a spa and gym there.

Check out again was straight forward. Once again the staff was so polite and helpful.

We would definitely return here again at any other season but if it was summer again we may look for somewhere with a pool :)

title: 3 Night Christmas Escape
text:
This was our fourth year that we have escaped the maddening rush of Auckland to the friendly relaxed air of the Hamilton Novotel on Christmas Eve for three nights. Every year the experience of the stay would get better for us. Which is why we would return. Our families are too far away for us to visit for Christmas and get back to work on the 28th so we would use this time to have the Christmas festivities taken care of for us and destress the last few crazy working weeks and recharge for the New Year. The staff and the meals were always exceptional. Not this year. We had given up writing reviews on stays around the world because it seemed that there has been a general malaise infecting the hospitality trade where ever we travelled. We were getting a bit tired of drafting sad and bad reviews, so we didn't have the heart to post them.  Then this stay propelled us back into action. There was a general lack of care and professionalism missing from the hotel that we have previously experienced over the last four years. There was a mix up with the room booking that my wife made when booking on line. But it took nearly 25 minutes to clear up we we arrived very tired from a 12 hour working day and 3 hour trip at 8pm. This issue could have been cleared up with a phone call weeks in advance after the booking was made on line with the requests included in the booking. I should also mention that it took serval phone calls and emails in the months previous to contact the Food and Beverage Manager regarding the Christmas booking. Once we finally made contact we then had to field multiple phone calls repeating the same details about the Christmas dinner booking.  The Christmas lunch food was as expected exceptionally good.  But there was a very long wait for the drinks and the call to the buffet, utensils disappeared from our table after we visited the salad course of our meal and we sat with our main meal for 10 minutes waiting for them to be delivered after two requests to staff. We felt the pressure of being pushed out before we even had the opportunity to get to desert. 
During our stay there was only one stand out staff member. Gabor, in the restaurant. It seemed like he was at every meal sitting.  His professional but relaxed personal manner was heartening to see. This is was we were used to experiencing from the staff at all the previous visits.  It was what brought us back the last four years.  But sadly the rest of the Food and Beverage team were completely distant and disinterested in service and hospitality engagement. It was extremely noticeable on Christmas Eve in bar as we listened to 4-5 staff gossiping behind the bar. Even then getting another drink seemed like a bother and hassle to them, as we watched glasses and plates build up around us.  As our table was never attended we had to go to the bar, no nuts bought to the table or conversation, something was amiss. 
The room was adequate, not the one that we expected but that was my wife's mistake when booking, even though she did request the same room we had stayed in the last two years. We could have received a phone call many weeks prior to our arrival or even two days prior when we electronically checked in. But we did have the quiet peaceful sleeps that we were expecting and required. 
The new spa pool was filthy. But it was good to see for the first time a range of tables and chairs out on the 2nd floor patio. Other than list a sad whiny list of complaints we have no other way of expressing that the hotel has dropped it previously fantastic level of service. The atmosphere was tense and the staff were complacent. It was not the standards we have previously grown used to at this hotel or received at other Novotel's
We asked ourselves as we travelled home, will we return next year? We both fell silent.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. First of all my apologies for the late response, as I have been on a trip away. I have discussed the comments from you with my manager and will see what we can do about the remarks you have made. It has been a busy time (year) for us, but that certainly does not mean that we can drop morale. I appreciate your comments and will work on improvements. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: My new Fav in the Tron
text:
The Novotel in Hamilton is my new favourite hotel for business trips and I’ll tell you why!
For starters I travel regularly for work and am exposed to many of NZ’s hotels so was very pleasantly surprised when I checked in at the Novotel.

Concierge staff, checking in, Parking…
I was greeted warmly and my luggage was whisked away (I had arrived early in the morning for a conference which I was only checking in for later). There is a large bowl of Jaffas at the front desk and cold water available in the lobby for the parched traveller.

I used the valet parking which is only $5 more than the underground parking at Sky City. All very easy and convenient. Later when I was checking in, the lady who attended to me at reception was friendly and patient and oozed service (with a gold shiny star). She checked me in and had my luggage to me quick smart. I felt cared for and welcomed. Top marks.

The Room
The décor in my room was awesome. Really modern and contemporary without being uncomfortable and fringe. The lighting solutions were abundant and obvious. Everything was where it should be and the room was very clean and spacious. I felt very at home.

Room Service (RS)
I ordered room service on a night there was a dinner of 30 people booked in and at around about the time they were ordering (19h15). The Room service attendant told me over the phone that it could take an hour. I was going to opt out and he said that was worst case scenario but he would do his best for 40minutes. Well I had my food in 32minutes! Good customer service!

RS Food
I ordered the soup and the fettuccini. The soup had noodles in it which were abundant, so probably not the right choice with the pasta as a main however the soup was very well favoured. Spicey chicken laksa. Not too spicy and very yummy. The fettuccini was on the right track with olive tapenade and tomato salsa but the sauce was a bit chunky and not wet enough for me. And I think the flavoursome soup had my tastebuds a little let down at the pasta.

Restaurant 
The restaurant was pleasant enough. The breakfast foods were actually awesome.  I was very impressed. 
At dinner I ordered the steak dish which comes with prawns and oysters. The waitress commented that it was really huge in a way that made me feel a bit chastised but I soldiered on and had a go.  The steak was flavoursome but not the best cut. Prawns were tasty and the oysters were good. Big fat chips too which were the perfect texture. There was a lot of options on my plate so I think it was worth the price of $45 even though none of the components were stand out…Maybe the chips were!

Activities
The hotel is situated right next to the Waikato river and you can toddle down the steps outside the entrance and go for a long run along the river on an excellently made pedestrian path. I loved this path and ability to walk along the river after work. Such a great travel perk.

title: over priced for what you get
text:
I’ve been to a number of Novotel hotels around the world, and this one legs far behind.
The room was specious and the service by  all staff (reception, bar, cleaners, dining area) was remarkable. But the hotel falls short on a number of fronts: the bed was too soft, and one cant get a decent sleep on it. The shower had no water pressure and the bathroom’s look was old and out of date. 
The room supposed to have a tea and coffee maker – and it seems that it does. If you consider a tiny kettle and a bunch of tired tea bags and two bags of instant coffee as such. In such a hotel, I would have expected to see a decent mini coffee maker, where you can put some coffee pods. Any half decent hotel has one these days, surely a rather up class hotel as a Novotel – which is one of the more expensive hotels in Hamilton.
Wifi connection wasn’t reliable. You could stream video when connection wasn’t lost, but for some odd reasons you couldn’t do video conversation over skype or facetime. 
Breakfast was ok, and nothing more. A wide selection of hot and cold dishes, but none of them had much of a taste. The coffee machine provided a somewhat instant version of coffee (you press a button and within 2 sec you get a cup of coffee. The taste was as you expect from this instant process). 
So nothing was terribly wrong (except from the bed and water pressure), but I just expected much more from this hotel.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really appreciate your feedback around your stay with us. My apologies for the inconveniences and although not fixed immediately, I would like to provide you with feedback as well. The bathrooms (including water pressure) are going to be done in 2017, where all the bathrooms will be renovated. This has been on our planning for a while, but we need to ensure that we plan this properly without too much disturbance. Coffee machines are only in deluxe rooms; I am sorry but that decision was made for Hamilton. Hope this clarifies a bit. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Nice stay in the heart of Hamilton CBD
text:
This is my first stay at Novotel Hamilton and because it was my first stay, the week before I had several emails to the hotel asking them about features such as parking etc. Gemma was brilliant with her replies they were prompt and clear. 

I paid extra to get an early check in which worked out well for my schedule. I got there in the morning but the forecourt was full of cars. The forecourt was suppose to be a 15 mins drop off zone but I'm sure most of those cars are there way longer than that. Not wanting to wait I paid $1 to park on the street so I can unload my luggages with minimal working. This hotel offers $15 self parking (on the street) or $20 valet parking or $15 parking at Skycity next door. I wanted covered parking so I took the Skycity option.

The male staff was very friendly upon check up, offered me several times to take my bags but I declined. The only thing he forgotten was my welcome drink voucher as I'm a Silver Le Club Accor Member. I came back and retrieve that later that day. Also while we are on that subject, being a Silver Le Club Accor member one of the benefits was to have free internet access. I did get the complimentary internet but the free version was capped at a very slow speed. Normal patrons gets this free slow option too so what is the benefit of being a Silver member? I think Silver member should get high speed free internet but that's up to this hotel and Accor to sort out.

I stayed in a suite room it was very spacious. Got a lounge area with table and workstation and a separate bedroom with king size bed. My first impression of the room was that it had the dated feel, old carpet and old walls, bed was okay slightly soft, pillows too fairly worn. Bathroom was spacious it has a separate shower and spa bath tub. Air conditioning works well but it was rather noisy especially the bedroom one can definitely disturb someone's sleep.

The location is perfect you are right in the middle of CBD. Centre place is a few minutes walk away with 2 movie theatres there. Eateries all over Victoria street. Two convenient stores close by too for simple drinks snacks etc if you don't want to use the in room stuff. Skycity as mentioned before just right next door. The transport centre is close by too you can get buses etc if you need to.

Breakfast they offer was a bit pricey but certainly very comprehensive. It even has a make your own smoothie option which I've never seen in other hotels.

One other good thing was that every Sunday they offer a free 5pm check out, again worked out really well for my trip. Check out was better than check in there were spaces in the forecourt so I was able to bring my car up to load my bags.

Overall it was a pleasant experience. The location is brilliant but I have to say I have stayed at other accommodations in Hamilton which is nicer. Hopefully the rooms are due for an upgrade soon. If they offer faster internet to Silver or higher members and it fits my travel plans I may return here again.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really appreciate your extensive review of your stay with us. It is so nice to get all this information, so that we can improve our services. I have already asked my manager to look into the internet speed and we will change this if needed. Thanks again for the great feedback and hope to be able to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Business trip
text:
Having stayed at this hotel many times over the past 18 months on business I find the service level up and down.
Firstly the good, the restaurant meal was good and the room comfortable.

title: As good as you would expect from any Novotel
text:
I was born in Hamilton and feel relief to be able to use a full-service 4/5 Star Hotel coming home to visit.   The Casino next door makes me feel like the city has finally progressed.

Coming back from mostly using Asian hotels I felt the concierge was lacking.  I found their cart and piled 5  of our big bags onto it without being offered any help.  I pushed the cart up to  the room laughing with my wife that I felt like a bell boy.   The lift was very small… we could not fit the pram and the luggage cart in one car so we took different ones.

Lovely front desk service staff,  once we engaged them we we offered help with the bags but the work was really done.   Using a booking agent on-line there was only one room type on offer, and the only price was around $170 NZD.   Apparently there are different room types and sizes available.  It would be nice to have one from where you can see the river.

The room was as you would expect from this brand, only really rather small.  We have an infant so once we added the cot and the pram to the room there was little space and we found it hard to move around.    There was all the usual nice fittings, towels and sheet this brand typically provides.

We used the restaurant and bar and both were nice.   The food was good and the staff were all very delightful.    It wasn’t written in the menu that fries came with the steak meal, and so I ordered fires as a side.  Realizing we had way too many fries, I offered the bowl to the staff while they were hot, not expecting any refund… but they offered and refunded us for the extra fries!   It would have been an awful fight to get any credit to happen in Asia, even at a Novotel there.

The wifi was free to begin with but very quickly run out.   After and hour I got a message that I had used all the data i was entitled to and according to the rules I had apparently agreed to that was not ‘fair play’. Huh?  I queried at reception and because I am a Acor member they released more data to me without charge.

I thought it was a bit unfair to ask $15 to park our car, as Hamilton is not exactly a big city that can impose as such.   However for $20 they Valet parked for me and it was at the front door the next morning on check-out.  So to me that was worth $20NZD.

Of course we will come back and use this hotel again.    Only I will make sure we get a larger room on the river side.

I write in detail to help other travelers, and that shows with the huge amount of helpful votes I attract.  I get nothing else but these.   To keep me going serving fellow travelers with useful advice please encourage me by clicking my helpful button?  Thank you.

Very helpful for future guests of mine as well as great for me to see what we can do to change things in the hotel. I appreciate your feedback around the views on the river. It has been on my wishlist for a long time to have the trees trimmed, but no luck so far. The restaurant comments are taken on board and will be shared. Hope to be able to welcome you back at some stage. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Lets itself down in so many ways
text:
I'll start with the positives. 
Sleep quality and bed in my twin double room were surprisingly good. 
There was very little noise from the street or from other rooms. 
I liked the little bottle of chilled water left in my car after the valet brought it up for an early morning start. 
The iron was clean and worked well. 
Then there is the rest. 
The rates are extortionate. $500 for two nights in a 'superior' room which is in fact entry level and superior to nothing.  
The valet parking at $20/night is sheer piracy and poorly communicated via the Accor website, which I used to book this last minute business trip. 
Check in was painfully slow, lengthy and complicated. It's never a good sign when they say 'are you sure you have a reservation?'.
My card keys were not activated properly so I had to traipse back down to the lobby and get new ones, which in turn took a few minutes to work. At the end of a long day, pure frustration. 
Service was very mixed, from forced friendliness to near-sullen reticence. 
The carpet in my room was badly stained in several places, and heavily worn. Absolute gross-out. 
Lots of flash newish looking bling lighting and fittings but obviously the carpet never got replaced at the same time which is just silly. 
Elevator was dirty. 
Torn pillowcase. 
Room was cramped with unnecessary furniture (see bling above) and had a faint musty smell. 
Shower screen was designed to ensure you got soaked while trying to turn the water on.
The second morning I thought well, at least I get a nice little bottle of water in the car... only to find my empty one left from the previous day! 
All round, a fairly major fail. 
Judging by my fellow guests, Novotel has a captive market between tour buses and functions and doesn't really care about independent business travelers. 
Never again.
