title: Business and Tourist hotel
text:
We have stayed at the Novotel on several occasions.  It is one of the best hotels in Hamilton.  
We have always stayed in a King room, so find the beds comfortable.  Good pillows.  Good aircon.  Limited range of TV stations.  Free in-room WiFi is reliable and appreciated. Smallish but functional bathroom (although I would prefer a separate shower - not one over a bath).
The hotel is well located just off the main street of the CBD so within walking distance of most things.  We have always found our interactions with staff have been very positive and what is expected of a hotel of this standard.
The only disappointment has been the restaurant.
Breakfast is fine with a fairly good range of options (although when you stay more than a few days there is a monotony to the offerings as they are exactly the same day after day).
Dinner however has never been particularly good.  The menu reads nice, but the execution is less than expected.  Scallops are broiled rather than seared.  Fish is a bit dry.  Prawns are meagre (so why even put them on the menu).  They do better with their meats.  But generally speaking, we don't like eating there.
In our experience, Kiwi's love eating out and restaurants in Hamilton are generally of a very high standard.  If you are staying at the Novotel, you are within easy walking distance to a whole range of great quality restaurants of many cuisines and price points.  So unless you especially feel the need to eat in, I would take a walk down the street and see what else is available.  You won't be disappointed.
hotel_response: Dear Lorri, Really appreciate your feedback in regards to your stay with us. I do appreciate your comments in regards to our restaurant and will discuss these with my executive chef. Although we do not get a lot of critical notes on our restaurant for dinner, I believe that with your feedback, we can improve what we offer to our guest. Thank you very much for that. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Excellent city centre hotel
text:
Excellent city centre hotel. Room was light and airy. Clean and the air conditioning was not too noisy. Mini bar and kettle with tea and coffee. 

Shower over the bath.

Restaurant was busy at breakfast times $31 for breakfast in the morning. Dinner at night was ok. Small functional bar.

Plenty of places to eat and drink within a 5 minute walk.

Parking available at the hotel. If you're lucky you can park across the street after 6pm and be away before 8am for free.

Free wifi for accors members, free to sign up.

Would recommend this hotel.
hotel_response: Dear Ian and Helen. Thank you so much for reviewing your stay with us. Glad to read that you have enjoyed it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Single night stay
text:
The hotel was fine for a one night stay. Check-in was fast and efficient and car was parked for us.

Room was modern and clean and the bed was comfortable. Bathroom had a shower that was set up like a wet room.

We had breakfast, which was a large selection of hot and cold buffet items.

Stay was spoiled slightly when some drunken wedding party guests decided to shout in the corridor at 2am, which is not the fault of hotel.

Good place to stay when visiting Hamilton.
hotel_response: Dear Mark. Really appreciate the time you took to post your review on Tripadvisor after your stay with us. I am very sorry about the disruption at night after the wedding party; I really hope that you have called the night manager to talk to the guests to respect other people's sleep. Hope to be able to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Nice staff, good breaky, partly crowded by bus tourists
text:
Some nites in this Novotel. The room was ok, only the walk from the elevator to the room was looong..but that creates also some silence. There was a gym, not very big, but sufficient. The hotel is in the middle of the town center. Bed was great, shower also. Breaky was buffet with fruit, cereals, bread, beans, fried eggs, sausages, cheese, jam honey, juices and milk and coffee. Everything there. With bus tourists the service was without a chance to clean up the desks.
Next time again !
hotel_response: Dear Guest. It was great to get some feedback from you in regards to your recent stay with us. We indeed do have a number of tour groups at the moment, but that will slow down now as we are approaching the end of their season. Hope to be able to welcome you back to our hotel. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Comfortable hotel but rooms quite small and stuffy!
text: We stayed at this hotel whilst visiting for our friends wedding.  Whilst the room was comfortable, the rooms were quite small and felt clostraphobic.  We had breakfast in the restaurant a couple of times where there was a good selection to chose from.  Cooked breakfast was very nice.  I would however not return to the hotel if I was visiting the area as it just did not suit me personally.  Ok for families, but if you want somewhere special, then this is not the place.  Cheap and cheerful is how I would describe it!
hotel_response: Dear Bryn. Really appreciate your feedback in regards to your recent stay with us. I am sorry to read that we have not been able to impress you with our hotel. The room sizes for Novotels are standard in the world, apart from the suites in the hotel. Hope that clarifies. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Quality of the food slipping
text:
My wife and I have stayed here a number of times over the past 12 months and were disappointed to find the food in the restaurant has changed significantly... For the worse.
I suspect they have a new chef now, the presentation and the quality are nowhere as good as in the past
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for your review around the restaurant of our Novotel. I can assure you that we still have the same chef for the last 10 years, but had recently some challenges in the kitchen with one of the chefs. That has now been resolved, so would be happy to hear from your next visit to our restaurant. My apologies for the last visit. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Mystery Creek Stop Over
text:
Stayed here with my husband while we attended a music festival at Mystery Creek. 
Great Place! One of the nicest Novotels I have ever stayed in. 
Bed was so comfortable, the sheets were soft and lacked that typical hotel 'starched' feel. The coffee machine was an asset. The cleanliness and interior design was light and refreshing. View over the river and greenery was appreciated. 
I would stay here again. 
Thanks for Novotel Hamilton for providing nice, soft, comfortable bedding.
hotel_response: Dear Clumont. Great to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: all Good
text:
Just a one nighter - one of the most comfortable beds my wife & I have ever slept in.
Just a bit peeved we had to pay for wifi having paid a reasonable amount for the room. Room was nice and clean and quiet given the hotels location in town.
hotel_response: Dear Phil, Really appreciate the time you took to post a review around your stay with us. I hope that my staff has mentioned to you that wifi is actually free for our Le Club members, which is a free loyalty program. Hope to be able to sign you up next time. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: helping a friend
text: nice hotel. comfortable. central to pubs and main street. pleasant and helpful staff. spa not available and ladies sauna not working when we stayed. considering price no plunger coffee available in rooms.
hotel_response: Dear Sandra. Thanks for your feedback around your stay with us. Happy to let you know that we have installed a brand new spa on our deck, which is fully functioning now. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Very good value for the busy traveller
text:
This is a new hotel, well situated and geared up for the one night over. The staff are welcoming, the rooms, cleaned and functional. Breakfast was a bit chaotic but represented good value.
The location is quiet by the river and parking/valet parking is available
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thanks for taking the time to review your stay with us. Really pleasantly surprised that you called the hotel new, as we have been here for 16 years. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Rest easy in Hamilton, NZ
text: Had the chance to stay at the Novotel Tainui in Hamilton, NZ, twice recently.  One both occasions I was pleasantly surprised at a few things.  The hotel staff was pleasant and accommodating.  The rooms were clean and comfortable.  The food at the hotel restaurant was good.  Totally recommend if you are in Hamilton.
hotel_response: Dear Lindsay. Thanks for the wonderful comments around your stay with us. Hope you had a good trip back home. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Fair
text:
A good place to stay, central to most of Hamilton and the staff very friendly and mostly helpful.
Expensive parking was one problem, the valet service was okay.
No view from my room, the shower is average and the chair rock hard.
The food was above average, the furnishing okay.
Overall room comfort was above average.
hotel_response: Dear Rory. Thanks for your comments on Tripadvisor around your stay with us. Appreciate your feedback. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Favourite place on the north island
text:
We stayed here for one night of travels on the north island. The staff on checkin were brilliant! So friendly and helpful! They advised me to join their loyalty program to take advantage of the free wifi which was awesome as I was able to use it to speak to family back home. The room was really clean and well presented. Only down side was having a view of the car park but that didn't effect our experience. The hotel is literally central to everything, so popping out for dinner was super easy and convenient. The valet parking here was the cheapest we had paid and they pop a bottle of water in your car on check out which was a Lovely touch! I didn't want to leave this place! 

Overall I would stay here again without a doubt!
hotel_response: Dear Danielle. Thanks for the great comments about your stay with us. Really pleased to see that you have enjoyed it. look forward welcoming you back. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Large Comfortable Rooms.
text: The rooms here a really spacious and the beds are also extremely comfortable. The hotel is just of the main street so you are in walking distance of lots of cafe's, restaurants and pubs. If possible always try to get a deal with breakfast included. The continental breakfast is $26 and the full breakfast is $31, so depending on how many are travelling it might be worth getting breakfast included. The rooms are nice and clean and also quite. Well worth a stay.
hotel_response: Dear Rob. Thank you very much for taking the time to post a review of your recent stay with us. Indeed, we believe that our breakfast included rates are a good deal and thanks for pointing that out. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Weekend beak
text: Wow. We have stayed here a few times and every time staff remember us and are so thoughtful and service is excellent. Nothing ever too much trouble and always have a laugh together.In such a central part of town. Love staying here.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really appreciate the nice comments in regards to your stay with us. Really hope to be able to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Nice but not great!
text:
I stayed in a suite and the room was big and I with a good view, but 1980 style! It cost 400 NZD, and it was a bit noisy from fan.
The breakfast was nothing special and don't take the fresh made juice...all skin was in the juice and staff wanted to add water in it.
hotel_response: Dear Marco. Appreciate your feedback around your recent stay with us. We hope that you had a good trip back home. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Nice comfortable stay in Hamilton
text: We are members of the Le Club Accor/Advantage Plus so the Novotel was an obvious choice for us when we travel to Hamilton since the rates are very good for the level of stage compare to other Hotels and Motels of the same standard. We have stayed in this Hotel in the past and our impression of the level of comfort have not change. The rooms are very nicely maintained and of a very good standard.  However, the restaurant service level and the knowledge of the staff in the Bar and restaurant area does not seem to be the same with the Check-in, Check-out service.  We had a really pleasant and quick check in/out experience.  We had to wait a long time for service at the restaurant and bar and although the staff were very courteous and pleasant, the speed of service and the confidence of what they offer seem to be very poor.  When we ordered our free drinks, the waitress had to keep calling someone on the phone to check the type of drinks we ordered. Overall , a nice hotel to stay in in Hamilton especially if you are a member of the Accor Club.
hotel_response: Dear Jade. Thanks for your feedback in regards to your stay with us. I will talk to my staff about the service levels in the restaurant and ensure that we improve this as soon as possible. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Good basic hotel
text: This must be my 5th stay; good functional, tidy hotel in good location. I was lucky enough to get a view of the river but did think sound proofing not so great; I was away from lift yet loud noises from other guests still audible in the room. Bathroom is quite small - definitely couldn't fit a couple in it at the same time! Breakfast team seemed a bit chaotic, unsure of what I meant when I ordered a herb omelette and lemon and hot water was almost too difficult too ( think this was a language issue )!
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thanks for informing us about your stay with us and really appreciate your comments in regards to your experience. We will use your comments to improve our services and will discuss them with the staff concerned. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Good and not so
text: Pleasant rooms in a great location, smiling staff, nice touch of bottled water in car after valet park.  A couple of gripes: I got to the hotel at 1pm and as room not ready I asked for a call when it was. I didnt get one before I returned to the hotel at 7pm. As an Accor member I'd expect more. The bedding under the duvet was messed up meaning that it was made very quickly and I had to remake both beds which was not how I waned to spend my time. Breakfast had lots of variety, but quite ordinary quality of food (dried out hash browns, only scrambled eggs been there too long, fatty beef sausage - but nice homemade yoghurt!). So a 3 star rather than a 4 star experience imho.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. My sincere apologies for the challenges you have had, while checking in to my hotel recently. I am sorry that it took so long for us to get your rooms ready and I can assure you that we have taken action on trying to prevent this from happening again. Really appreciate the time you took to let me know. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Nothing Special
text: Stayed here 2 nights over Christmas and found there wasn't anything on the hotel side that made this a stand out. I was travelling with my partner to introduce him to my family in NZ. I found it very difficult to get through to anyone on the phone and found this frustrating as I work in hotels myself. Very annoying to have to go down to front desk to request the valet parked car which could of been ready had I been able to get through on the phone, when I got to reception there was only one staff member there dealing with a guest and when they were free the phone rang and I had to wait for the one staff member to deal with the phone which no one answered from my room before I was taken care I found this very rude. The breakfast at this hotel was a standout and your food and beverage staff are an asset to your hotel. I enjoyed the fresh hot cooked choices but found that the toast station was situated awkwardly and was very busy even with only a couple of tables in the restaurant. The hotel offers a pillow menu and but wasn't able to get the pillow I would of liked and housekeeping seemed confused by the request for firmer pillows. The room we stayed in must of been close to water pipes as we were woken around 6am from someone else's shower and a loud pumping noise which would of been fine but we arrived at 3 am to the hotel. We were also given vouchers for complimentary drinks but these sent to our room in the middle of the night on our last stay and we were checking out early so really a waste of time. The service level is a little lower than expected but the food and beverage staff really hold your hotel together
hotel_response: Dear Ainslee. Really appreciate your comments, particular coming from somebody that is also working in our industry. I have taken note of all your comments and will discuss these with the relevant managers to ensure that we improve from here onwards. As I am unable to trace your booking, based on a first name, I would appreciate it, if you could let me know what room number you stayed in, so I can check the comment around the water pipe. Look forward to hear from you. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Comfortable, Spacious and Well Located
text:
The Novotel Hamilton Tainui is a well appointed hotel in the central business district. It has many good quality restaurants and cafes in close proximity. The hotel is relatively modern, and is nicely presented with a welcoming foyer. Our room was spacious, comfortable, clean and very quiet. We had a good night's sleep. Car parking is available on site, and we were able to leave our car in the car park after check out. This allowed us to visit the museum and gallery. The staff were very helpful and friendly.
Thanks for your vote if you found this review helpful.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for proving us feedback on your recent stay with us. We hope that you had a good trip back home and look forward welcoming you back in the future. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Tidy and modern
text:
Friendly staff, good reception. Location is good for walking into the centre of the city's. Hamilton gardens well worth a visit. Parking arrang meets good.
Clean and tidy hotel areas and rooms. Wifi was restricted to lobby area but time unlimited
hotel_response: Dear Colin. Really appreciate your comments around your stay with us. Hope to be able to welcome you back. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Nice hotel in centre of town
text:
Me and my wife stayed here for two nights for my daughters wedding. Our 2nd floor room was clean with very a comfortable king size bed. Could have done with more hanging space in the wardrobe as it was quite limited for two people and also some drawers for clothes. Breakfast was included and was a buffet style and was reasonable. Avoid the coffee out of the machine as its horrible, ask and they will get a barista to make you a proper one which is very good at no extra charge. 
We were asked at reception if we would like to join Le Club AccorHotels loyalty program, which we did. Problem with this was they send you and email at midnight to confirm your membership, consequently my phone woke us up to inform us of this fact !! Surely they could arrange these sort of emails to be sent at a reasonable time during the day? 
Apart from this sleep quality was good and staff were polite and efficient. Valet parking was $20 per night and worked well. Would stay here again and I would recommend this hotel
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thanks for taking the time to inform me about your recent stay with us. Your feedback will be used for a review; particular around the timing of sending membership confirmations, although i do think that it is a world-wide system which generates the emails. Really appreciate your feedback. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Less than impressed but not terrible
text:
Tried to pass this info onto staff at the hotel but received no response. Toilet bowls were really dirty both in the room and lobby. Parking is a nightmare as you park in a different building and then come out on the other side of that building and have to find your way back. 
Room serve was good and the lady that delivered it was amazing and should've been front of house staff as the front of house staff member said I was crazy in a really loud voice for driving "all the way" to wellington the next day. 
Room was nice and bed was comfy.
hotel_response: Dear Sarah Jane. Thanks for your feedback on your stay with us. I will follow up on your remarks around the way my staff addressed you. Really appreciate this feedback so we can work on this. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Great location, comfortable stay
text:
When our agent asked us to stay at Hamilton on last one day of our stay in NZ, she could not arrange our stay at Auckland for the last day, we were very apprehensive. But our apprehension was belied when we reached Novotel, Hamilton! The location, next to river and very close to main town as well, really made us feel great about the place. It took a while to get the rooms and chek in process was a little longer than expected. But rooms were really big, clean and nice. 

For a location, midway from Auckland to Rotorua, Hamilton offers the best place to stay in North Island. My recommendation to travellers, if they do not have any particular reason to stay in Auckand, they should take a car to Hamilton, stay there, go to Rotorua/ Waitomo/ Auckland from here. The hotel and place are great.
hotel_response: Dear Prasanna. It is really nice to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Particular around the travelling between all the major tourist attractions and our hotel, is much better from Hamilton than Auckland. Really appreciate your feedback. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: GREAT LOCATOIN
text:
We stayed at The Novel for two nights. The staff at the hotel are extremely friendly and most of all helpful in every way. We have stayed at a number of hotels around the world and this would be one of the best.
I would like to thank management and all staff for making this such a great stay.

a memoral
hotel_response: Dear Guest. That is really amazing to see that you have rated us one of the best hotels you have stayed so far. Thank you so much for this wonderful review; much appreciated. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Good location
text:
We stayed for two nights over new year.  A very comfortable hotel located within walking distance of the main high street where there were some good restaurants.  The room was very clean and modern, good size and with a comfortable bed.  Parking was available either next to the hotel or under the casino for $15 a night.  Reception staff were extremely helpful.  Wifi free for those part of the Accor loyalty scheme.

We had breakfast once in the hotel and it was fine.  We also tried somewhere local for breakfast too.
hotel_response: Dear Gemma. Really pleased to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Hope to see you returning to us in the near future. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Very comfortable and functional hotel
text: I stayed three nights at the Novotel Hamilton which is a relatively small property but with full service such as 24 hour reception and valet parking ($20/day). Overall a very good experience with very friendly and capable staff. I had all my meals in the restaurant and enjoyed the quality of the food and the speed of the service which is nice when you are on business and on your own. You are able to run or walk along the river straight off the door steps of the hotel which was awesome on a beautiful summer day. The only minuses were the gym/spa area which is small and dated. Also the tv and movie selection and picture quality was underwhelming. Internet speed of 512kb is not exactly fast either. Nonetheless I will be back.
hotel_response: Hi Peter. Thanks for your feedback around your recent stay with us. Glad to read that you have enjoyed it and will be returning to us. Look forward to welcome you back. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: A most splendid overnight stay
text: This hotel chain can normally be relied upon to provide a certain level of service and comfort but the Novotel in Hamilton exceeded our expectations. We were looking for a hotel for our final night in NZ before flying out of Auckland Airport after walking away from our prebooked hotel down the road on a wet Sunday afternoon when we found the Novotel.  Check in was brilliant – the staff member was so helpful, cheerful and friendly that she managed to upsell valet service and breakfast to us (at very economical rates).  The bedroom was light and fresh with a very pleasant décor scheme.  There were so many plugs for power and technology that the business traveller and teenager would both be impressed.  The king-sized bed was comfortable, cupboards large with heaps of hangers, full length mirror, iron, hairdryer, tea & coffee making facilities, good sized flat screen TV, high speed internet and free Wi-Fi, etc.  The bathroom was probably the only let down with the shower over the bath – a minor detail really.  We enjoyed both dinner and breakfast in the hotel restaurant during our overnight stay.  Valet parking brought our car around at the designated time slot in the morning of check out and even provided complimentary bottled water. The Novotel Hotel Hamilton seems to successfully offer a high standard of facilities for both the business traveller and family on holiday, and I would happily recommend it.
hotel_response: Dear Guest, It was a pleasure to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Really nice to see that all worked out very well for you. Hope you had a good trip back home. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: A VERY GOOD HOTEL IN THE HEART OF HAMILTON
text: This hotel is clean, the staff are very professional, the breakfast in the morning there is nothing lacking for you to eat, it has plenty of parking, and you walk to the main street, for restaurants shops etc.
hotel_response: Dear Adonopoulos, Thank you very much for the time you took to review your stay with us. Glad to read that you have enjoyed it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Excellent accor property
text:
Stayed here at Novotel Tainui in hamilton again for three days of business. Always pays to stay at Novotel. Everything just works and you can count on the fundementals being great . Super breakfast spread and just minutes to the main restaurant strip. 
When in hamilton i always stay here and will be back in two weeks !!
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Great to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. See you again soon. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Location, service and amenities...
text: Great location near bus station, restaurants, mall and walk along the river....don't hesitate to stay at hotel. Staff is great and morning breakfast is excellent. Hotel has all the amenities you need to make your stay comfortable.
hotel_response: Dear Jeff & Barb. Great to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Hope to be able to welcome you back with us. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: It's the Little Things that Count - Always
text:
It's always the little things that count. I spent a night with Novotel Tainui last Friday the 15th of January. Could have stayed anywhere. Last minute trip for the night, down from Auckland for an urgent family dinner, money not really an object (not being big headed, just honest), saw the Novotel had a very reasonable suite rate so thought, why not ? (Plus, as we know in Hamilton there is no Museum Hotel, no Bolton, no Sofitel, No Hilton ect ect (they are in order by the way).

Needs must, so Novotel it was.

And it was great. Few drinks at the balcony bar. Parking over night. Early start.

Highlights - Drinks at the bar, good natured table service for what were, I'll be honest again here, patrons who could be considered on the demanding side. My companion travels a lot, stays in a lot of quality hotels, and is,quite frankly, demanding. The capable young gentleman barman, first name begins with a C (and also happens to be the name of a worldwide religion), kept pace and maintained a jovial but attentive front. He even managed a cheerly hello several hours later when I wandered back from the casino. Full marks - great service -he'll go a long way.

Low lights - not really any. Overall good Accor standard and staff with a friendly and outgoing manner.

Passing comment - The decor in the suits are showing their age a bit, but only a bit. And they are spacious. The Mini Bar could be a bit more "Fulsome". (Remember - there is no such thing as an overstocked Mini Bar). And no, for the record, I'm not raising this because I did an impersonation of  Denzel Washington's Character from "Flight" and sent the mini Bar to a better place. Just a Muesli bar....Pun intended.

The little Things - Early start for me on the Saturday. 06.00 departure to get on the road back to my lovely partner and beat the traffic. Pleasant surprise to find, when they resurrected the Audi from valet parking, that there was a complimentary bottle of mineral water on the centre console.

It's the little things...
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really appreciate the extensive review of your stay with us and really pleased to see that you have enjoyed it. Yes, they are the little things that count and that's one of the things we try to accomplish when you stay with us. Hope to be able to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Has to be the Best Hotel in Hamilton
text: Stayed here in December 2015. Room was excellent and service second to none. The casino is attached to the hotel if that's your thing. It's right in the middle of town so you can walk everywhere. But you'll need to remember that the town is pretty deserted now with a lot of the shops closed down.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thanks for the feedback after your stay with us. Glad to read that you have enjoyed it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Comfortable

Two queen size beds in our room which means space was compromised.   Would be better to have king size and two comfy chairs.    Likewise the bathroom had a shower over the bath - okay except for someone who is 6 foot.   Would stay here again.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. We really appreciate the time you took to review your stay with us. Look forward to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Convenient & Clean

hotel_response: Dear Caz. Really appreciate the time you took to review your stay with us. Glad to read that you have enjoyed it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Spotless with great service

The room we stayed in was spotless, it was also very large. We booked more than 30 days out a they threw in a full buffet breakfast, so if you know your going to be in Hamilton well in advance, it's worth booking early. The hotel is near door to the casino if that is your thing.

hotel_response: Dear Mark & Rosa, Thanks for your review which you posted on Tripadvisor. Glad to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Central location and noise free which is great for a good night sleep!

title: Enjoyed Our Family Stay

title: Impressed!
text: We booked in here after checking out of a another hotel we were unhappy with and i must say we were very happy with our stay. The room was tidy with modern decor, simple but clean. title: Wouldn't stay again

I am pleased to let you know that we have started re-tiling the whole first floor balcony with also getting a brand new spa. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: I would not recommend this hotel as a 4.5 star rating.
text:
My friend and I were part of a large party (100+) staying three nights.   We were in room 140, which appeared to be directly over a function room.  Unfortunately there was a function on the Saturday night and after our return at around 9pm the party was well underway and any soundproofing in place was not working.  Sleep was impossible until they closed down at midnight.  Then we were awakened by an argument in the corridor at 3am (ok, this is not the fault of the hotel or management), THEN, between 5am and 6am we were again awakened by other guests who were leaving early discussing the noise and lack of sleep.  The irony was not lost to me.

I am surprised that this hotel has a 4.5 star rating.  The pillows on arrival were very soft with no support. The ones in the wardrobe were identical to the ones on the beds.  We ordered what appeared to be firm ones from the 'pillow menu'.  They were about 5cms deep and did not give good support.  This needs to be addressed as we were not the only ones affected by this.

On Sunday we left our room at 11am, when we came back after 4pm nothing had been done to the room.  It was, however serviced when we got back around 10pm.

The location is great.  My bed was comfortable (excluding the pillows).  The staff were helpful.  The food was ok.  There were people in our group who had disability issues - I wonder how they coped with the shower being over the bath.
hotel_response: Dear Dianne. Thank you so much for your feedback; I really appreciate to hear what we can do to improve our hotel. I am very sorry about the disturbances of other guests; I hope that you understand that it is quite difficult for us to control their noise levels. In regards to the shower over bath; we do have disability rooms, which have no bath and just a shower, which makes it easy to access. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, general manager

We waited 2 and a half hours. I complained to the front desk. Told them how pissed off I was and this isn,t the first time it,s happened. title: Best place to stay in Hamilton
text:
We were in town to attend a wedding and a number of the guests were booked to stay here at the Novotel Tainui. Whilst we have stayed in Hamilton dozens of times, this was the first time at the Novotel and now I wouldn't stay anywhere else- it exceeded expectations in every way. 
When we first checked in, it was to quickly settling into our room & dress to attend the wedding. The ladies at reception kindly let us leave our car out the front to avoid unnecessary time parking for only a very short time. The room was clean, smart, modern, and fresh. I loved the turquoise accents in the art and furnishings. The iPhone docking station was also a nice appliance to have. We thought the mini bar prices to be quite reasonable too. The bed was super comfy & whilst our room overlooked Victoria Street (the Main Street in Hamilton) we didn't notice any street or traffic noise. Valet parking at $20 is a real bargain compared to Auckland prices. This includes multiple entry/exits. So convenient. 
A special mention to Aaron on reception who was a true life saver organising room service late that night. Best toasted sandwich ever! Thank you. 
The buffet breakfast which was inclusive of our special room rate was brilliant. Definitely one of the better in many we've had in hotel stays. Loved the fact that barista made, espresso coffee made to your liking was available and included with breakfast.
I've travelled a lot for business and pleasure, and for either type I'd be happy here. Highly recommend.
Service and standard was above and beyond for Hamilton and we'll definitely return to Novotel Hamilton Tainui.
hotel_response: Dear Amber. Great to hear that you have enjoyed your stay here while attending a wedding. I have shared your comments in regards to Aaron with him and he is delighted that you are so pleased about his cooking skills. Hope to be able to see you back again soon. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

We were given a free glass of wine which went with the deal we had, and enjoyed it at lunchtime, sitting out on the deck adjacent to the bar, in the sunshine. The surroundings were just what travellers need to help them relax- lots of trees and birds around, so a lovely outlook when sitting in the lounge area or out on the deck. The hotel is on the edge of the river which meant just a few metres to walk down to join the river walk below. Parking was provided at $15, or if valet parked, $20 per day. The breakfast, which was included in our room rate, was delicious and with plenty of choices. One downside to our stay was the price of the drinks in the bar. We would have spent more in the bar, had the prices been more reasonable. Also, free wifi in the rooms would have been good.

text: I stayed at Novotel Tainui for a couple of nights and really enjoyed the experience. The valet parking was easy and the car was available the next day at the arranged time. Registration and checkout was easy and fast. My room facing the river was very quiet and exceptionally clean. Buffet breakfast provided many choices and was excellent. Unfortunately the dates for my next planned stay (in October) are completely booked out.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for your feedback around your stay with us. I am sorry that we do not have availability during your next stay in Hamilton. Hope that we will be able to accommodate you when you return after that. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: The Place To Stay
text: This was my second stay here and again, I can't fault this hotel. Great and on to it staff, very good sized rooms and everything clean and tidy this all contributed to a lovely weekend in Hamilton. Location is very handy also as an easy walk to shops and restaurants. Give it a go 😀
hotel_response: Dear Sandra. Really pleased to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Hope to be able to welcome you back again. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Feeling Special
text:
When the reason for your trip is very personal you need every thing else to be stress free, including your accommodation. Our stay with you was wonderful, thank you. 
Very impressed. The room was spotless and we had plenty of space. The minibar was well stocked. The view of the river is stunning. The staff were always smiling and so helpful. The food in the restaurant amazing, We had dinner with family and everyone walked away happy and full. 
The hotel is in a great location right on the Main Street so you can walk to the shops and bars. You must go for a walk along the river, just beautiful. We used the valet parking which for only $20 per day was a great service ( we had a fresh bottle of water left in the car each day). 
Really happy with your hotel, the service and the staff. 
Looking forward to returning.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for the great review that you have posted on Tripadvisor. I am really pleased that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Hope you had a good trip back home. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: A good stay
text:
Nice hotel which we stayed in during a conference. It was clean, comfortable and centrally located. The breakfast buffet was also very decent. The rooms could be a bit noisy if facing the main street, with the occasional drag racer or "hoon"! Otherwise would recommend for a comfortable and pleasant stay. 

The restaurant is actually also really good for dinner; my steak was cooked to perfection and our meals were fantastic.
hotel_response: Dear Natty. It is really good to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Hope you had a good trip back home. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Love this hotel - home away from home !!
text: Stayed here again last Saturday night.  Once again, lovely stay.  The rained stayed away so we were able to have a wonderful leisurely walk along the river after checking in.  This is the first time we have done this, and I thoroughly recommend it.  The walkway along the river and through the bush is so peaceful.  We always ask for a room over looking the river now.  Customer service is excellent.  I left a t-shirt in the room by mistake and when I rang the staff member looked into it and I sent down a courier bag, and my t-shirt arrived back 4 days later.  How often does that sought of thing happen these days !!
hotel_response: Dear Jan. Thank you so much for the great review and it is really pleasing to see that all went well, including sending you the shirt that stayed behind. Hope to be able to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Welcoming and very comfortable.
text: We stayed 2 nights at short notice in September. We had originally booked in to another Hamilton establishment but, on arrival, found that it was neither central nor a hotel - which had been our impression when booking on-line. We phoned the Novotel and were assisted immediately. We were able to get a tasty meal in the hotel very early that evening before we went to our appointment. The concierge/reception staff were very helpful when we enquired next day about various restaurant and shopping matters. The room, although a good walk away (Rm 361) was reasonably sized, well-appointed, clean and comfortable. It was serviced well. I would be happy to stay there again. It's very central and the valet parking was worthwhile.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really pleased to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Hope to be able to welcome you back again. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Best Business Hotel in the Waikato
text: Top marks for cleanliness, good sized rooms, some with views over the Waikato river, If you are wanting a good place to stay either for business or pleasure, you will find it difficult to beat what this hotel offers. Central location next to a number of good restaurants.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for your great comments about your stay with us. Really pleased to read that you have enjoyed it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Nice Hotel - poor service
text:
Hotel is comfortable and nicely furnished, however service is poor - the HDMI plugs in our room weren't working which they could not fix.
We ordered room service two nights in a row and had to remind them about our orders as they didn't arrive.
The buffet breakfast is good, and front staff pleasant, however the tech and service was very poor.
hotel_response: Dear Ruth. Thank you very much for taking the time to inform us about your stay with us. Would really appreciate it, if you could let me know the room number that you stayed in, so I can fix the HDMI port. My sincere apologies for this not working in your room. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: PLEASANT STAY
text: We had a very pleasant stay on Saturday.  The hotel was well appointed with a spacious room nicely furnished.  Bar service and restaurant (dessert only) was good.  Check-in friendly and fast, as was check-out.   Valet parking was attended to promptly.   I only had one niggle and it's a very little niggle - I would have appreciated a shower cap being supplied.  Otherwise, ticks the boxes and we will return.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for taking the time to review your stay with us. Glad that you have enjoyed it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Was gifted a night at the Novotel
text: When we received a free night, we chose the Novotel in Hamilton.  We were greeted with a smile and a lovely how are you today, and have you travelled far, etc.. very friendly.  Quickly and professional we were processed.  The room was lovely and clean, and oh so quiet.  I would recommend the Novotel to anyone.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. What can I say? Really much appreciated your comments in regards to your stay. Hope to welcome you back soon. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Better than most in Hamilton
text:
We stayed here for 1 night and had a pleasant stay.
On the positive the room was clean and tidy and the food in the restaurant was very good.
On the negative the aircon made a rattling noise that woke us up around 2.30am, I managed to stop the rattle by jamming a facecloth in the grill, a couple of screws by maintenance should fix it.
Parking is an issue here, the options are either $20 Valet parking, $15 self parking in an open air carpark or as I found a metered park on the street which is free after 6pm and before 8.00am(not many of these though), this suited me as we arrived late and left early, however you would usually have to factor in the extra cost of parking
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really appreciate your feedback on your stay with us. Your comments in regards to the loose aircon grill are much appreciated, but would really like to know the room number though, so we can fix this. Hope to be able to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, general manager

title: Overnight stay
text:
When I arrived I was greeted with a huge smile, wonderful personality and outstanding customer service of Norrell.
During the evening I was attended to by my waiter Raghav at the Novotel Tainui Restaurant. Raghav showed exceptional customer service with a calm, quiet manner and he was knowledgeable of food and wine.
My meal was superb with the Salmon cooked to perfection. The side dish of garlic prawns were a delightful explosion of flavours - compliments to the Chef.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really pleased with your comments in regards to your stay with us. We hope that we are able to welcome you back soon. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Beautiful River Views.
text:
This Hotel in the heart of Hamilton City, was a delight to stay in.
Our large Suite gave us beautiful River and City Views. It was spotlessly clean with all the modern accessories required. Two flat screen televisions in separate rooms ideal for 'remote hoarders' lol. Reception Staff were very friendly and helpful. Room service offered a good selection of meals/snacks.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for your wonderfull review on this website around your stay with us. Really appreciate your comments around the location of the suites and the views. Hope that you are able to visit us again. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General manager

hotel_response:

title: Overnight Stay - Not Accor Standard
text:
Stayed here for 1 night before heading onward for the rest of our journey.

Firstly the pros - centrally located, staff friendly, check in & out fast

Other than the above I see the below issues

1 - as a Platinum Accor member I have become used to the benefits of my loyalty status,  and felt that I was not welcomed back to an Accor hotel as a loyal guest.

2 - Parking - was $20 for valet parking, and I was more an happy to pay as this is the only way to receive secure underground parking, all other parking options are outdoor parking options that still cost. However on heading for a walk at 7pm I was disappointed to see my car parked outside, after making mention of this to reception I was advised my car was being used to block car parking for a function, I advised this was not acceptable & the man behind the counter couldn't really care, I also asked for my car to be ready at 7.30am, and on heading down at 7.35am I still waited 10minutes for the car to be brought up.

3 - Bathroom is small, and location of the toilet in this bathroom for someone of my height (6foot 2) meant my knees where up near my ears.

All in all I wouldn't recommend this hotel, and would not stay here in the future.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thanks for your comments in regards to your stay with us. We have addressed the feedback concerning the parking and will ensure that does not happen again, if we are not full in the parking underneath the hotel. In regards to the size of the bathrooms; I am sorry but our bathrooms are standard size with our brand. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: A Week Stay in Novotel Hamilton
text:
Stay for a week in Novotel Hamilton. Room is spacious and clean. The staffs are very friendly and helpful. 

Check In and Check Out were good where they have all your information and time to check in and check out is fast.

Too bad that the Hotel does not come with a free parking for it guest and internet is not included. Breakfast is also not included.

Overall stay here is good.
hotel_response: Dear Ivan. Thanks for your feedback after staying a week with us. I am sorry that my staff has not informed you about the possibility to have a "breakfast included" room rate. The other comment is that all our loyalty members are now getting free wifi, so hopefully we can include that during your next stay. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: No free parking for customers
text: Check in, check-out, rooms, meals &  everything else  were good. Services were good. Only issue is the car parking. No free car parking.  I was so disappointed. Had to park my car at work walk to the hotel and return to work on foot. Lucky my office was nearby. Staff good. Services good.

title: dinner

hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you for your comments in regards to your stay. Very pleased that you have enjoyed the majority of it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Business Trip
text: I stay at the Novotel in Hamilton, New Zealand regularly sometimes up to 3 times a month.  The staff are usually excellent apart from the face that as a Gold Card holder I'm sometimes not allowed to pickup my free beer at the bar and take it to my room unopened.  As I'm always staying over on business I like to pickup the beer when I check in and head out for dinner/drinks with my clients and when I return I can relax and have the beer afterwards in my room as I catchup with emails and paperwork etc.  I also like to use the gym and once again on 29 April the men's sauna wasn't heating up properly and it's not at all very clean.  I find this unacceptable as this is a 4 star hotel.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for the review you wrote in regards to your recent stay with us. The comments that you have made in regards to the drinks taking to the room, as well as the sauna which was not working properly, have been taken on board and will be dealt with. Really appreciate that you brought this to our attention. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Average
text: We live in Hamilton but wanted a nice place to stay locally for wedding ..2 nights one the night before with girls and then 2nd night after wedding with new husband. Everything very average.. corner suite was nice not very big and windows were filthy. No free WiFi.. which should be a given really. Cleaners arrived whilst we were trying to get ready for wedding.. not enough towels or dressing gowns/slippers for the 3 of us... extra beds set up all fine.. but then when we arrived back after wedding to find extra beds still in room... beds made but no fresh towels laid out or new robes etc... it was just below average really.. nothing done to make you feel special or welcome or appreciated for picking there hotel... sydney service on our honeymoon was just absolutely amazing!!! Put this place to shame. Just dissapointing. Breakfast was nice though.. and lady who took my booking was very helpful and pleasant.
hotel_response: Dear Carl. Really appreciate all your feedback in regards to your stay with us. I am very sorry that we did not deliver on your expectations and have discussed your comments in our management meeting. We will put actions in place to change the services that we can alter. Thanks again for taking the time to let us know. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Well Located, Great Service but Lacks Luxury
text: Upon our arrival we were impressed with the CBD location and super friendly staff.  We also found our room to be clean, however once we jumped into bed, we were disappointed with the lumpy bed and flat pillows.  That is really the only thing we can fault the hotel for but when the prime reason you are staying there is to sleep, it's disappointing that the sleep quality is not what you would expect.
hotel_response: Dear Karen. Thank you so much for posting a review on Tripadvisor in regards to your stay with us. I am sorry that the bed was not as comfortable as what we normally have. Would it be possible to let us know your room details and we will definately replace the bed. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Careful- everything extra -
text: We checked in and had a prepaid rate. They wanted to charge us again.  We purchased the rate including breakfast and we had to show them our confirmation to get that too as they said it wasn't on the reservation.  Wifi is free for 30 minutes in the lobby every 24 hours.  A limited amount wifi is available or 19.99 NZD (wow!) in the room but has a mb limit on it. Oh, you could get an upgraded pillow but not sure what that would cost...

I am sorry that you get the impression that you have to pay for every additional service in the hotel, but charges like parking and additional internet are normal charges for us. As of May 1st however, all Le Club loyalty members will have free wifi during their stay with us. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

hotel_response: Dear Valerie. Thank you so much for your feedback in regards to your stay with us. Really appreciate all the comments and can assure you that we are working on a good solution for internet. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Good Hotel but still not there
text: My second stay here and to be honest the air conditioning is one of the big draws for me.  Each room stayed nice a cool the whole day, although you have to leave a room key in the shutoff slot or it shuts down if you go out for dinner.  Plus my favorite Indian restaurant is across the street!  The rooms are nice but the wall mounted electronic connections for the TV (HDMI, PC connections) never work (hotel said it was a compatibility issue but I bypassed the wall connections and it worked fine) and the outlet on the desk is sketchy but will work if you fiddle with it. Oddly enough this was true of both stays at this hotel.  The sink drained slowly, there were stains in the toilet (looked like hard water), some hair on the bathroom floor, all stuff that doesn't bother me that much but I've been watching Hotel Impossible and know how to look at a hotel room! Had to negotiate a deal for the internet and parking but they did work with me as one of my service guys had been there almost two months. The hotel service is still very good and friendly.  Bought breakfast with the room but the price is still high (my service guy would not eat there as the price consumed too much of his per diem). Still, the bed is good and the pillows work (I used all three at night).  To be honest i was going to stay at a different hotel but with my service guy there, this was a better choice. There were more homeless/beggers in the area of the hotel then I remembered.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. We really appreciate the time you took to inform us about your recent stay with us, via Tripadvisor. Thank you so much for all the feedback and I will discuss this remarks with my managers to see how we can improve all these points. With your feedback, we will be able to rectify some of these comments. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Conveniently located, friendly staff, standard Novotel quality
text:
Booked through Qantas.com for stay between 27-29 March 2015. Breakfast included in price. 

Check-in effortless. We were given room 161 on floor one. It was a five minute walk from lift to room. Had car so paid $20 each day for valet parking. A call to reception had car out front by the time we got to reception from our room. 

The room was spacious, Queen sized bed, air conditioning and was easily regulated. 

Bathroom contained shower over bathtub. The hot water was almost instant and no waiting. Toiletries were standard Novotel issue as you'd find in any Novotel hotel. 

Buffet breakfast served in the restaurant. Great variety. 

Only negative I can report is the pricey wifi internet in the rooms. Just ridiculous - no value for prices charged. Best going to the 7-11 shop around the corner and getting a data pack. Fortunately our iPad and phones had data.

Having said that, we would recommend this hotel to anyone wanting decent accommodation, good night's sleep and convenience of being in town. This is our second stay at Novotel Tainui Hamilton. When we come back, we will stay again.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you for posting a review on Tripadvisor around your recent stay at Novotel Tainui. It is great to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Highly recommended accommodation option for Hamilton

hotel_response: Dear Steve. Thanks for your comments in regards to your stay with us. Great to read that you have enjoyed it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Overpriced and disorganised

title: Top class service
text:
I recently stayed here over night. This review was a pleasure to write.

THE ROOM
Slightly dated but very comfortable plenty of room and felt spacious. The beds arw firm but also very comfortable.  Tjeres also a well placed plug for the ironing board for business traveller's. 

THE FOOD
To be honest the menu options are pretty slim and kinda un original. There wasnt value for money and the food felt thrown together rather than made with love! I paid around $60 for bruchetta, steak and vegetables. The steak was over cooked and had gristle through it. Id recommend finding a local restraunt for dinner. Thw meal was ok but disnt have that beautiful hotel meal quality to it.  However I do like that they really try for healthy options and have a couple of lower sugar / carb options the breakfast was great. The coffee devine!! 

THE SERVICE
This is what seperates this hotel from the rest. The staff here are well trained, extremely polite and have a real desire to help.  I had a bad day, was grumpy and when I had a fault with the tv I was moved to another room without any fuss and really felt look after this really cheered me up.

There wasnt a single staff member that didnt look like they didnt want to be there or was "just doing their job".  The night manager and breakfast staff really stand out and are an asset to this business.

The bottle of water in my car was a really nice touch and the first timeni had ever seen this but with a 2 hour drive ahead it was an awesome touch!

Over all a really a nice stay and i would recommend this hotel to any business traveller. Other than an average dinner I couldnt fault the place.

title: Lovely hotel
text:
Stayed here for 13 nights after the house we had originally rented for our stayed turned out to be unsuitable.  Staff were all very helpful and eager to help with any request.  We had twin deluxe room which was spacious and comfortable with a good sized lounge area. The bathroom was large and bright with complimentary toiletries. All areas of the hotel were modern clean and well maintained.  The breakfast buffet was excellent value with a wide variety to suit all tastes.  We ate dinner and lunch in the restaurant which has an Eco friendly and healthy menu, all our meals were delicious and portions were generous.  Room service was excellent and the guest laundry room very economical costing only $2 per load for the washing machines or dryers.  This was very helpful as we had originally planned to stay in a rented villa and had only brought a certain amount of clothes expecting to be able to wash them half way through our visit. The machines load capacity was massive and I was able to do all our laundry in one load.  I cannot praise the staff enough for all the help they offered us, they were all a wealth of local knowledge willing to map routes and offering advice on local attractions.  The hotel itself is situated just off the main high street and perfectly located for public transport, shopping and dinning out.  Turn left on the high street and walk  a few minutes up the road and you will find yourself opposite the town centre here u will find the local tourist information centre - called the I-site - everyone here was lovely.  They will book hotels cars trips and generally help you with any aspect of your holiday that they can.  They will provide maps of any area you want to visit and offer advise on access for disable/elderly which was very handy considering we were travelling with my husbands parents who are both 81 years old and diabetic with limited walking ability.  They were able to secure golf carts for every trip we booked through them. There services are free and were an absolute god send.  Continue walking down the high street and you will find the entertainment quarter with the casino, art gallery museum and a host of restaurants and bars.  There is an extensive range of cuisines to choose from- Italian, Mexican Chinese Asian as well as your typical steak house and burger bars as well as quaint cafes serving afternoon tea.  If you turn right on to the main high street you will find plenty of shops and again bars and places to eat. Cross the main road and follow the signs to the central shopping mall where unwilling find everything u need including a pharmacy foreign exchange and a mass of gift shops. The hotel is indeed well located and Hamilton Gardens which won Garden of the Year in 2014 is a five minute drive and a must see while your in Hamilton.  It is free and the themed gardens are spectacular.  The gift shop was a disappointment not much there really mostly postcards and a few other bits but no books or magnets etc depicting the gardens. I had to buy a cookbook to find images of the themed gardens.  The cafe and public convenience areas are good and clean.  You can take a river boat cruise from the gardens but I have to admit whilst it was quite relaxing floating along the river on a hot afternoon there was not much to see other than a lot of lovely foliage and a few people enjoying themselves dotted along the banks.  There were no impressive landmarks or monuments so if you want to spend an hour and $26 enjoying the ride but in my opinion it was a bit boring.
Finally while we were staying at our hotel the rugby team The Crusaders spent 2 nights because they had a match against the local team The Chiefs.  All the players ate breakfast along side the other guests both mornings and they were all very friendly posing for photos and signing autographs.  There were a few players who play for the national team The All Blacks and when  met them around the hoel and in the lifts they were pleasant and chatty.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. That was really a very extensive review of your stay with us. Great to read that you have really enjoyed it, especially when your rented accommodation was not available when you came here. Hope you had a nice time in the Waikato. regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: A very comfortable night in Hamilton
text:

The room was very comfortable - we had upgraded to one with a king bed and free Wi-Fi. Everything worked well - Wi-Fi was very slow but we put this down to two Cricket World Cup teams staying and possibly all connecting with families at home in the evening. We had breakfast before we left - possibly not the best we have experienced at a Novotel - and seemed expensive - fortunately the Advantage Plus meant we only paid half - it was not worth over NZ$30 - bacon not crispy - 'same old same old' assorted melons and pineapple  for fresh fruit - a shame when there was lovely local stone fruit in season.  Only sliced bread available - usually there is freshly baked loaves. Mustn't forget to mention the vouchers for a drink in the bar which we enjoyed when we came in from dinner.

title: Beside the waikato river
text:
In central Hamilton the hotel is right beside the waikato river so views from our room were superb. We booked for xmas day with check in at 2pm. With only 2 staff on desk and one of them on phone for considerable time there was a delay in checking in. Unfortunately when checking in we were asked to provide a credit card so it could be charged $50. When we questioned why we were told it was to cover any unpaid mini bar goodies or damage to room. It would be refunded back onto the card after our stay.  As there was no notification of this charge when booking online or on Novotel Tainui website we were not happy about this surprise. I know of only one other hotel that had this practice and it now has ceased it due to feedback from customers. Cmon Novotel trust your customers and drop this charge. The room itself was spacious, including the bathroom with a couch available for comfort to watch tv. There were some lovely freebies, including a lovely scrub, shampoo etc and a pair of slippers. We booked in for the xmas buffet meal on the 25th Dec (there are two different times available) and went to 6pm session. At $65 per head it was one of the  best buffets I have ever had. There was a large variety of dishes and the food was amazing. Staff did not rush to clear the dishes so those people having a few drinks on the decks outside went on enjoying the food for quite some time. Although there were waitressing staff in plenty, clearing dishes and refilling them, when we asked to order a drink we were told you had to go into the hotel to buy them. Maybe next year the hotel could have some staff available to take drink orders and deliver them to the customers.  
There is valet parking (at a cost) and it was a pleasure when we checked out the following day to find the hotel had already brought our car around and it was right outside the front door. Overall a pleasant stay. We will definitely return next year for the buffet meal again.

title: Best service of any hotel I have stayed in!
text:
Recently stayed at this Hotel for a friends wedding, flying over from Sydney for the weekend.

Unfortunately our flight was delayed out of Sydney and we missed our connecting flight leaving us stranding, having to stay the night in Melbourne before flying into Auckland the following morning. 

After picking up our hire car from Auckland airport and making our way down to the airport, approximately 1 hours drive down to hamilton we checked into the hotel.

We were greated by the front office manager, who was lovely and helped us check in and find directions to our wedding. There was lots of other guests attending the wedding, and we had all arranged to take a bus out to the wedding in rural country side. Unfortunately as our plane was delayed and we were well behind schedule, and as a result missed the bus that was to take us to the wedding. 

Hotel staff printed instructions to the wedding, and it was just over 1 hours drive to the wedding venue which was devastating - as we had already come so far, missed the ceremony and were hoping to at least make the reception!

The front office manager offered to ask if any of the staff finishing for the day would consider driving us to avoid a very expensive cab ride. We had planned on driving out to the wedding, though one of us would not be able to drink as we would have to drive the car home. 

We headed up to our room and after showering and getting ready, our telephone rang in the room and the front office manager had arranged for the hotels reservation manager to drive us to the wedding, and then drive our car back to the hotel. All up this was just over a 2 hour return trip!!!

We had a great chat all the way, seeing some beautiful countryside and laughing about our horrible luck with delayed flights. We managed to make the reception just in time, and I managed to snap a quick photo when we finally made it to the wedding venue :)

The next morning we had a big sleep in to recover and on checkout everyone was amazing and extremely friendly. Staff pointed us in the direction of some good shops, a great cafe with unbelievable food/coffee, and even brought our car up for us!

Best service I have ever experienced from a front office team and I will most definitely be back to explore more of the region and spend more time at Novotel Hamilton.

In view of the fact that the Victoria Street was actually a free wifi zone the hotel should be more generous in this sense.  What I did was I went out to the street to use the free unlimited wifi instead of staying in the hotel and strangled by the 30 mins restriction.

title: Great Central Place to stay
text:
We stayed there for 3 nights in November and had a great time.  It is not cheap but we had breakfast included.  i think in this day and age free Internet should be included.  We seem to get it at most hotels.  The staff were very friendly and went out of there way to help us.  A friends dad died the day we arrived and they offered to let us call her for free.  We didn't take up there offer as our friend called us.  But is was such a nice gesture.

There isn't a lot of parking but you can park in the casino and pay the Novotel $15 per day.

The breakfast was really nice and they would do special cooked breakfast for you as well in the price and coffees were included to which is great as my wife is a coffee addict.

The room was a normal size hotel room and the furniture was really nice.  We were at the very end of a long walk from the lifts and were able to look out onto the Patio where you could play Chess..    

It s also right near the river and has a really nice walk jogging track outside. The shops are just across the road and if you walk to the city square there is free Internet there.  Love Library's with free Internet.

Also heaps of restaurants nearby as well.

Would stay there again.  Ibis is a stone throws away if you want something cheaper.

title: Better Than The Usual Novotel
text:
In the centre of Hamilton City, this Novotel is definitely a cut above the usual Novotel standard.  It's a modern airy hotel with good sized public areas which exudes a comfortable relaxed atmosphere.  Rooms are the usual cramped size of a Novotel, and were it not for this and the minuscule bathroom I think this hotel could well be rebranded to Accor's Sofitel 5 Star brand. 

Reception was somewhat understaffed at both check-in and -out; but very pleasantly handled despite the delays. Valet parking was super-efficient, although  self-parking might be a challenge I suspect. Bar and restaurant staff were friendly and very helpful.  

The room was immaculately clean and I suspect had been recently refurbished, and was well equipped, my only room complaint was the minimal supply of near end-of-life bath towels.

All in all, a good value, central located hotel in the farming heartland of New Zealand.

title: Adequate but overpriced hotel
text: I stayed here twice over the course of four weeks - 4 nights each time. The first stay was in Room 208 which is one of those strange rooms with two double beds which take up lots of space. The second time in room 130 which had a more suitable king bed. First impressions in both rooms was the worn carpet. Room 208 in particular was tatty with dirty marks and a patched area. There was a natty little reading table with overhanging lamp in room 208 but it difficult to access because it was jammed between one of the beds and the window. The rooms are fairly standard hotel fare with wall mounted TV, conventional work desk whilst the bathroom has a shower over bath but nothing to stop the mirror from steaming up. Room 130 had an intermittent unpleasant smell from the little grate in the bathroom floor - it smelt like the ablutions from other rooms. It would have been nice if the windows could be opened a little for fresh air. When staying in room 208 I returned one evening to find that someone else's drycleaning had been left in my wardrobe. As an additional observation the female staff members uniform is less than flattering - rather masculine with long trousers and a waistcoat that looks like a man's outfit gone wrong. Looking at the positives the hotel is very well located with the river on your doorstep and a very nice riverside path to enjoy the environment. My job takes me over the country and I am restricted to where I stay by my employer. However I have stayed in better places than this Novotel and for $20-40 less per night.
