title: Great hotel
text: Good location in central Hamilton, easy check in and out, friendly and helpful staff, great food, great chefs, clean modern and quiet rooms, hassle free valet parking. Good venue for meeting and entertaining people.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for writing a review on Tripadvisor in regards to your stay with us. It is really great to read that you have fully enjoyed it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Home From Home
text:
Its a great place to stay eat and relax before a busy day on the road.
comfortable room, terrible tea but thats Novotel. Dinner was lovely and great they serve till late as i was really late arriving.
hotel_response: Dear Thomas. Thank you so much for the comments in regards to your recent stay with us. Glad to see that you have enjoyed it, apart from the tea. I am sorry that our tea selection is not quite what you are looking for. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Average room. Nicer drinks area looking out to river.
text:
Room like any other. Nothing special. Tidy and everything in its place. Drinks area downstairs pricey but nice. Good atmosphere.
Good a good priced room then stay. Come back?, nothing drawing me again. Nice but forgettable.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. I am very sorry to read that you not overly enjoyed your stay with us. We are certainly trying to impress every guest who is staying with us and I am sorry that has not happened with you. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Great Hotel
text: We stayed last night in this hotel as we had a late afternoon meeting and then met up with family for dinner so worked for us because of its great central location. The hotel has been done up and is very modern with a great bar. Our room was nice but our bathroom old and had one of those awful climb over the bath showers which didn't have the greatest pressure and the tiles were very slippery so could be rather dangerous, that aside the service was as friendly as one could ever get , everyone gave us a cherry hello and the location just the best !
hotel_response: Dear Graeme. Thank you for your comments in regards to your stay with us. Really happy to read that you have fully enjoyed it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: First rate Hotel
text:
Stayed one night on way home from holiday and wow it was such a lovely way to end our break. The staff were so friendly and helpful, the room was so clean and comfortable.

We had dinner in the Hotel Restaurant - Alma - and it was georgous - the walnut bread entree was divine and the main fantabulous. Thank you Novetel Hamilton NZ yu were totally great. We are so happy that we belong to The Accor Group YaY
hotel_response: Dear Philly. What a fantastic review you have written about your stay with us. Really nice to read that you have totally enjoyed it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Overnight bliss!
text: This hotel offers a great stay. Booked 20 days in advance for $169 ( non refundable etc). which included a deliciousl buffet breakfast. Lovely appointed room with 2 queen beds which were wonderfully comfortable. This hotel is in the CBD but very quiet and peaceful, ensuring a great nights sleep. Efficient, pleasant staff and our room had a full length mirror! The hotel does an outstanding buffet breakfast, with a great selection. The only criticism I had was that a staff member was stocking up the bread baskets by hand, without gloves! In this day and age I would have thought that unacceptable. Tongs or disposable gloves would be the norm I would have thought? Apart from that a lovely stay and better than expected.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for your comments in regards to your stay with us. Fantastic to read that you have enjoyed your stay. Really appreciate your comments in regards to the re-stocking of the bread; I totally agree with you and we will implement that right away. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Over-delivered
text: I had been expecting a very standard stay at this hotel, but I left very pleasantly surprised.  The staff were genuinely friendly, the breakfast buffet certainly surpassed my expectations and the hotel itself is modern and well located.  Two things would have earnt it a five star - no full length mirror in the room and only a standard chair for the desk, rather than an adjustable office-style chair.  I'd definitely stay again.
hotel_response: Dera Guest. That is great to read that you have enjoyed your stay so much. We really appreciate your feedback and it is good to see that all services worked for you. Novotel is a standard four star brand, so we will do everything possible to deliver as good as we can wirhin our brand. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Excellent location and hotel
text: Nice, friendly, helpful staff.  Hotel rooms has been updated since we last stayed here about a couple of years ago. Any requests were easily dealt with. Good location and comfortable bed.  Would happily stay here again.
hotel_response: Hi Diane. Really appreciate your comments in regards to your recent stay with us. Always good to read that my guests have enjoyed their stays. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: WEEKEND GETAWAY
text: It is a great place just to get away from the kids for the weekend without having to go into Auckland City.  The service was great, the only issue was that we ordered hamburgers from the late night menu and can you believe they did not have any hamburger buns.  Apart from that hiccup all was great.
hotel_response: Dear Tracy. Thanks foir your feedback in regards to your stay with us. I also really appreciate your comments in regards to the hamburgers on our menu. They should always come with buns, so my apologies for this lack, of course. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General manager

title: Great stay had in Hamilton CBD
text:
Lovely hotel with modern room/ensuite at this Novotel chain, in great central location next to the river. Staff very friendly and efficient. Parking not complimentary,  however was able to get at park beuind hotel every night.  Bed was sooooo comfortable! ! Highly recommended for your stay in the CBD
I attended a Conference nearby at Claudlands and this is within walking distance (aprox 10-15 min)
hotel_response: Dear Shelley. Thanks for your nice comments around your stay with us. It is indeed a short distance to Claudelands, which makes it easier for the conference guests. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Weekend Treat
text: We spent two nights at the hotel and the staff were excellent from start to finish. The reception staff, cleaners, restaurant and bar staff were helpful and very friendly. We would stay again in the future and recommend to our friends and family.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. It is really great to read your comments in regards to your stay with us. Nice that you enjoyed it so much. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Friendly helpful staff
text: Enjoyed stay in this hotel. The room was clean and tidy. The bed and pillows comfy. Great having the espresso maker. Breakfast reasonable value. Have stayed here a few times now and would return again.
hotel_response: Dear Sue. Thanks for your nice comments in regards to your stay with us. Look forward to welcome you back with us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Friendly Helpful staff
text: I attended a conference at the Novotel in Hamilton and the staff were so helpful and thoughtful well done to you all! The room were comfortable and stylish. The conference equipment and facilities were of good quality and the food interesting.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really appreciate your comments in regards to your stay with us. Hope you had a good trip back home. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Excellent Room
text: Stayed here the last night of the business trip. Wes quite tired so really enjoyed just staying in and catching up on my work then watching the V8 Supercars and Super 15 on Sky later in the evening. Room service was great and the room facilities were very good.
hotel_response: Dear Doug. Thanks for commenting on your stay with us. Hope you were pleased with all the sports results. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Attending conference
text: Staff were outstanding throughout our Conference - am sure staff in all areas were constantly smiling and helpful, nothing was too much trouble.  My room was immaculate and kept so by staff.  Enjoyed the restaurant for breakfast and dinner.  Thanks Novotel...just confirms why I am an Accor Advantage member!
hotel_response: Dear Valerie. It is great to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us as well as attending the conference. Of course, we also like to read that you are one of our loyalty members. Look forward to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: One Stop Shop
text: I attended a conference in August 2014 and it was great to have everything in one place.  The reception and waiting staff were efficient and friendly.  The room was well appointed and clean and above all quiet. I had full breakfasts which were good. Having the accommodation, food and conference in one place meant it was a pleasure to stay here during a wintery few days.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for your great comments in regards to your stay and conference with us. Glad to read that you have enjoyed it. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: " A Great Place to Stay "
text: A Very Welcoming Atmosphere as All the Staff make you feel at Home, from the Hotel Decor to its  Surroundings and Amenities ,it is A " Good Feel" place to Relax.....that's why My Wife and I, and Family and Friends who are up from Dunedin, will only Stay at the Novotel Tainui when in Hamilton. The Food in the " Restaraunt on Alma" is always Fantastic so we always have Breakfast there and Dinner is a great experience......I Highly Recommend  the Novotel as a place to Stay.
hotel_response: Dear Douglas. Thank you so much for your kind review. Really nice to read that you enjoy staying with us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Best Place to Stay in Hamilton
text:
This hotel is consistently good. It is right in the middle of town so everything is easy to get to. The breakfast is the best start to the day you could possibly have. The bedroom was of a very high standard and the bed itself just lovely..
It was the perfect start to our break away.
hotel_response: Dear Sue. Thank you very much for your comments on Tripadvisor. With all your comments being so levely, I am not sure where the scores come from in your review. I hope that you meant to give us the high scores. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: simple hotel
text:
The room is standard for most of Novotels.
- When we arrived we got the room with twin beds though we booked double bed. It was far away from the lift and we had to carry our heavy bags again back to the reception and ask to change the room. 
They have only valet parking for money.
hotel_response: Dear Kuzma. Thank you so much for your comments in regards to your stay with us. I really hope that you have a good stay in New Zealand. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Broken bed
text: I was expecting more. We paid for valet parking, however I needed to self park the car. The TV reception was terrible. The bed was broken. The room decor was not calming. The hotel is close to the casino, however the area seemed rough and was not a safe area to walk around. The staff could not recommend a good family place to eat. Not happy.
hotel_response: Dear Troy, So sorry to read that you have not enjoyed your stay with us. I can assure you that the matters which you brought up in your comments have been rectified. My apologies about the bed; we certainly have replaced that. We working very closely with the council to get the city centre a better outlook. Thank you again for your comments; very much appreciated. Best regards, Dick Breukink, GM

title: Accor Hamilton
text: This was a very nice Hotel indeed, riverside location and right in the centre of town. with excellent service with Staff who did everything they could to make the stay enjoyable.  Good sized rooms, lovely king sized beds and perfectly selected linen and pillow options.  The only area to think about is parking.  Its free in the river car park, but we were unsure security wise, but it was quite a price hike (by Kiwi standards!) to use the undercover parking option.  We didnt, on cost grounds, and the vehicle was fine.  Dont let that put you off going as this review is after three visits to this particular hotel.  Superb breakfast, and sometimes thew will include this in the room rate, so negotiate!  This is a reviewer who uses a lot of hotels rarely gives a full five stars across the board.
hotel_response: Dear John. Thanks for your comments in regards to your stay with us. Glad you mention that the two options of parking. Our valet service is only $20.00 and the riverside (self park) is $15.00. We hope that this will explain your comments. Look forward to welcome you back soon. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Normally good but not always
text: I stay in this hotel many times a year but this visit was not good, the room 130 had a very lumpy bed and the room service dinner was less than acceptable, the soup  uneatable the lamb shank from a old ewe and the salad dried up, then the breakfast was also terrible, the fruit looked old and dry, the bacon and sausages tough and dry and the eggs had a dry crust on them.  I must say the staff were great and the service friendly and efficient.  Not sure about the food though and I would say that normally the breakfasts are good just not this stay!
hotel_response: Dear Chris. Really appreciate your feedback in regards to the stay with us. I have shared your comments in regards to the food service with our executive chef as well as the food & beverage team. We will definately use your comments for improvement. I am glad to read that you have had better visits at our hotel. Hopefully we will show you next time that we have improved. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: A good business hotel
text: A very central location, and up to date facilities and decor make this a pleasant place to stay. The food in the restaurant was better than average, and the service was very attentive.  My only gripe was the cost of the wireless broadband, although the 24 hour cap was generous.  I would definitely stay here again.
hotel_response: Dear David. Thanks for your comments around your stay with us. Look forward to welcome you back soon. Kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: No Wifi cant believe
text:
Couldn't believe a top hotel like this don't offer free Wifi, and for the parking, you should offer free parking for guests. Nice clean rooms, and loved the deco of them. Loved the nice comfortable bed

I travel and stay at lots of hotels and motels, and most of these have free WIFI. Think this hotel needs to get up with times in technology. this would attract more people to stay there.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thanks for your comments in regards to your stay. We are working at the moment with a low cost internet package and hopefully soon switch to free wi fi. My apologies that this has not taken place as yet. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Centrally located quality
text:
Stayed here for one night on a Saturday.  Lovely hotel and well situated,  super comfy bed, and nice terrace for a drink in the sun.

Service on checkin was good but had two unwelcome visits to room from staff. On one occasion I was out for a short time and returned to find the door propped open while the minibar was being checked - while my wife was in the shower (we'd only been there for a couple of hours). The second was getting awoken by housekeeping banging on the door at 10.00, when checkout was 11.00.

Checking out was a shambles,  had to wait in line for 20 minutes which was a real nuisance and fell short of the level of service expected from Novotel.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really appreciate the time you took to review your stay with us. I am glad to read that your stay was alright, just to see that check out was not organized properly. My apologies for this and we have dicussed this internally to avoid this from happening again. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General manager

title: Novotel Hamilton
text: A very nice hotel, very comfortable and by a business colleague's account, very luxurious and the best in Hamilton.  The service was excellent, note that there was cost for parking so if you have a hire car it will cost $20 per day for concierge parking or $15 for validated parking.  I recieved a deal throught the Accor group so was pleased with value for money.  The menu was alright, orered room service and the chicken was overdone.
hotel_response: Dear Steve. Thanks for your feedback in regards to your stay with us. My apologies for the room service dinner being overcooked; glad to read however that the rest of your stay was to your satisfaction. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Attentive service
text: Excellent service from day one which never faltered in the six days I was there. Nothing was too much trouble from housekeeping to room service to the bar staff and the front desk. It was an absolute pleasure to stay in this beautiful hotel and I look forward to returning, hopefully soon.
hotel_response: Dear Sandra. Great to read your comments in regards to your stay. Look forward welcoming you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: No free wifi what can I say
text:
Comfortable hotel, quiet room overlooking the river. 

It's been about 5 years since I have had to pay for wifi worldwide. This is terrible service and bit if a rip off, as most traveller are wireless.

Breakfast was adequate and the staff great. Come on management, it's wireless world, makes you look out of date.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for your comments in regards to your stay with us. I am very sorry about the cost of internet in my hotel; we are having a package at the moment at a very low costs and hopefully soon, we switch to free internet. My apologies for this but hopefully soon we have this fixed. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Lovely Hotel
text: We stayed 2 nights here.  The hotel is situated in a great stop, right in the heart of the city.  Our room was comfy, spacious and quiet.  We had breakfast on both mornings and dinner on one night.  The food was fresh, delicious and plentiful and the staff were attentive and friendly.  We had a lovely stay at this hotel.  Thank you to all.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. I really appreciate your feedback on your stay with us. Hope you had a good trip back to Melbourne. Regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Excellent stay
text: My husband and I had one night here on the 11/7/14. A quiet room and very comfortable bed. The best nights sleep I have had for a while. The hotel was very clean. I met a friend for a drink in the bar, the staff were attentive. The breakfast was very good. The hotel is in the middle of town and there are plenty of restaurants to choose from. The staff were helpful.
hotel_response: Dear Theresa. We really appreciate your comments in regards to your recent stay with us. It is always nice to read these fantastic feedbacks. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Done it again
text: I'm a regular guest at Novotel Hamilton and what I like the most is the consistent level of service I get.  I've never really had a problem as every request I've ever had gets a positive answer and they're always accommodating.
hotel_response: Dear Dreydon. Thank you so much for taking the time to review your stay with us. Great to read that all went well. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General manager

title: Great Stay we will be back again Highly Recommended
text: My wife and i stayed one night in a one bedroom suite on 5/7/14 the value for money was excellent the service and smiles from the extremely pleasant staff overwhelming The front desk did everything for us- complimentary drinks , all bags delivered to room while we had the drinks and the breakafast at this place is something else. The rooms are clean and well maintained Special Thanks to Kumar at the front desk we will be back soon this place is highly recommended
hotel_response: Dear Bruce. Thank you so much for your kind words in regards to your stay with us. I will let Manoj Kumar know that you have recommended him. Look forward to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: A beautiful place to stay in Hamilton
text:
A fresh, clean, sophisticated hotel. Close to the river for waking and running, in the middle of town for shopping and food but you can stay in-Room Service was fresh and yummy with lots of options and you can choose how you want to eat-and fast welcoming service-thank you Tiffany!!
Check-in was fast and the team is professional and friendly.

Clean, big rooms with very comfortable beds and a good little gym. Great for a business trip or a fast get away holiday trip-Hamilton is a fun little city.
hotel_response: Hi Robina. What a great review you posted on Tripadvisor in regards to my hotel. I am really happy to read that you have enjoyed it. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: 60th B/day Bash
text: Frndly welcome buy front desk. The room was fresh & tidy. The location of the hotel is very central to the middle of Hamilton. No Road traffic as this was in a one way street. Good selection for buffet breakfast.
hotel_response: Dear Chris. Great to read your comments in regards to the birthday stay you had with us. Hope we will be able to welcome you back on the next birthday celebration. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Three and a half star.
text:
I would really like to give this hotel a 3 and a half star rating as it was good without being anything special. We had a suite which was huge and looked over the river. The decor is very 90's with a ridiculous neon headboard and bright blue wild grass motifs!?!?
It was good value for money and the staff were friendly and helpful.
It is a good central location if you are here for business.
hotel_response: Dear Libby. Really appreciate your comments in regards to your stay with us. I am sorry that we were unable to give you the four star plus feeling, which we would like to stand for. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Lovely dinner, comfortable bed
text: Room clean; check in and out efficient; dinner and breakfast better than good; bed comfortable.  had to have the air con on to cool the room; TV remote tricky to get to work so 2 replacements.  Staff willing and cheerful.  More expensive than other hotels of similar standard
hotel_response: Dear Janice. Thank you so much for your comments in regards to your stay with us. Really appreciate your feedback which I will share with my managers. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Great service but some issues with rooms
text:
Not a great start. Booking 2 months prior to stay I requested a suite with adjoining room so my family could join me and was told this configuration didn't exist. On arrival I thought I'd check this again, and one front desk agent said "no" but was quickly corrected by another who told me that there was such a configuration but it was of course now booked out. 
That said, the staff responded admirably and gave me free valet parking. In fact the staff here were all great, very friendly and obliging. The hotel is also great for traveling with kids, with free breakfast, a play area in the restaurant, activity packs etc.
Unfortunately the air con in my room made a terrible rattling sound which meant I couldn't use it at night and the room became very stuffy. Each morning I reported the fault, each afternoon I was told it was fixed and each night it rattled again. Combined with a "standard room" that felt small, I didn't sleep well here.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for providing us with feedback on your stay. Really great to read your comments in regards to our kids program; we are glad that it worked. As far as the interconnecting room to a suite; there are actually only two rooms in the hotel who do interconnect and I guess they were booked on the day of your arrival. Sorry about the maintenance isses; please let us know your room number where you stayed and we can fix these. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Nice upgrade
text:
If you can afford the price the top rooms are superb. Very roomy, super comfy, great sleep and very very high tech. Why do these hotels charge for parking, internet and films? I am here because they upgraded me from the brother Ibis. Well done on the service, but such a low base to start from.

I am on a crusade here. Ten years ago NZ hotels were wonderful welcoming places, but these multinational chains don't cut the mustard. Stay away and support the great local hospitality. Stay a few km away, pay less dollars and enjoy the warmth of a great Kiwi motel.
hotel_response: Dear Neil. Thank you very much for your comments in regards to your stay with us. I really appreciate your feedback and I can assure you that we are working constantly on meeting the market demands. With our newly introduced service training, we certainly want to be as welcoming as any of my collegaes. Hope to welcome you back to us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Be very wary of self parking
text: My car was hit while in one of hotel carpark spaces and the immediate reaction was 'we are not liable'. After my four requests and one from my insurance company hotel reviewed CCTV footage and 'couldn't see much'. I would also be concerned about personal security given the close proximity to the riverside walkway which is frequented by some dubious individuals.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thanks very much for providing us with feedback in regards to your stay with us, I will look into the accident you had with self parking, as it depends where around the hotel you have parked. Let me assure you that we have a thight security system and will do our utmost to guarantee an enjoyable stay for our guests. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Enjoyed my stay
text: Great location.  Got a room on wotif and got good rate, so expected a room near the back but had one on river front.  Snuggly bed, room nice and clean but room could have been vacuumed bit better round the edges, but otherwise nice and comfy and all I needed.  Staff helpful.  Enjoyed my stay, would definitely stay here again if wotif rate
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for taking the time to provide us with some feedback on your recent stay with us. Look forward welcoming you back. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Much improved since my last stay
text: Much improved since my last stay, room clean and comfortable, pod coffee maker in room, good service. Towels could have been improved (quite worn) but other than that good quality accommodation in central Hamilton.
hotel_response: Dear Andrew. Really appreciate your comments in regards to your stay with us. Glad to read that you have enjoyed it, particular in regards to your comments about improvements compared to your last stay. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Great Help and Service
text: I own a large SUV that I found to have a puncture on the morning we were booking out.  Norrel (Duty Manager) said she would arrange a strong man to give me a hand to change the wheel.  A couple of minutes later, Sven, the Food & Beverage Manager turned up.  There was odd hiccup not of our making that Sven did a great job of solving.  Would have had a lot of difficulty without their assistance.
hotel_response: Dear Alan, Thanks for the wonderfull comments in regards to your stay with us and particular about the service that Norell and Sven gave you in changing your flat tire. We are always happy to assist. Look forward to you coming back to us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Always great service
text: We have stayed here before and the service is always great. The rooms are always clean, we always have the 2 double beds which is great for us. We have also eaten here and the food is great, the waiter is very helpful, the last time I stayed he made me a special meal as I didnt feel like anything on the menu....no trouble. My daughter wet the bed and the staff attended to it without a problem. I would recommend this novotel anytime.
hotel_response: Dear Jodie. Really appreciate the time you took to review my hotel after your stay with us. Hope you had a good trip back home. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager, Novotel Tainui Hamilton

title: Stay here
text:
This is the spot to stay in Hamilton.
Nice restaurants over the road and by the river, clean rooms, comfy big beds, efficient reception team (maybe too efficient ... Slow down and chill s bit), centre of town, good bar (though you feel as if the fella may like to close at 11 and head home). 
All in all, a nice spot that I'll stick with.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you very much for your comments around your recent stay with us. Look forward welcoming you back with us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Not just a nice place to stay!
text:
The rooms were spacious and clean.  The staff were very helpful and the hotel was conveniently located in town.  

For entertainment, just down the road you had the local Casino and there was a great little pub just outside the main doors.  The locals are a little funny with Aussies, but we are also a little funny with them!
hotel_response: Dear Sean. Really appreciate your comments in regards to your stay with us. Hope you had a good trip back home. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager, Novotel Tainui Hamilton

title: 3 day conference & AGM
text: I was very impressed from the time I walked in the door. Reception staff looked up, smiled & said hello (basic but sadly a rare thing in NZ). Nothing was a problem. The meeting room was great, with varied food options at break times. The accomodation was nice - clean & tidy. I would definitely stay here again:)
hotel_response: Dear Denise. Thank you so much for your nice comments around your stay with us. Look forward to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager, Novotel Tainui Hamilton

title: Good Location and Relaxing
text: Very "Novotel" as usual but added the relaxing essence due to the location of this hotel which is just along the river where you can have a good breeze walk in the evening. Breakfast is good however the serve is too slow. Not able to get a good cup of coffee. Standard pillow provided in room is too soft. Do remember to request but you might not be lucky. :-/
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for taking the time to review your stay with us. I appreciate your feedback and will share this with my staff in order to improve our hotel. We hope that you havd a good trip back home. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Hard to believe the Wi Fi Policy
text:
I cant get my head around your policy of charging for Wi Fi.....its not the cost............  its the fact that even coffee shops , motels, provide free unlimited Wi Fi.in down town Hamilton. While using the FREE 30 Mins Wi Fi doing payroll back to Sydney the Wi Fi disconnected me & then staff 30 got paid a day late.
I my self receive some 100 emails a day , my business wife similar , so the pay for Wi Fi concept is simply unacceptable........to tell me I might down load a movie was ridiculous hence the stupid policy to business guests.
Then every morning the breakfast table was set mostly with SOUP spoons......told dessert spoons in the dish washer.!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! 3 days in a row ??????
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for providing me with feedback on your stay with us. I am very sorry that the internet set up is not been working for you. We are currently working on a new arrangement for all our guests and hopefully this will be implemented as soon as possible. The breakfast comments have been discussed with my restaurant staff and will be improved immidiately. Thanks again for your comments. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Novotel Hamilton Review
text: Nice property but overpriced. Imagine having to actually pay extra for Internet connectivity!! Add a $20 valet parking fee and the total bill really staxs up. Way overpriced for what you get. Breakfast was good and overall, a fairly nice stay but you can shop around and still get "nice stays" for  less.
hotel_response: Dear Jeremy. We really appreciate your feedback on your stay with us. As we have dynamic pricing in our hotel, we can suggest that you look out for our special deals on line, when booking next time with us. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Best Buffet Brekkie in NZ
text: Great friendly staff - wonderfully comfortable King bed and without doubt the best buffet breakfast in NZ. Choices of middle or streaky bacon - chicken beef or kransky sausage etc etc etc Top location as well The Minstrel
hotel_response: Dear Minstrel. It is great to read that you have enjoyed your stay and particular our breakfast buffet so much last time you stayed with us. Hopefully we will be able to welcome you back soon. best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Very comfortable and friendly
text: Very comfortable clean and well appointed rooms, friendly staff, central location and the best buffet breakfast we have experienced anywhere! Would definitely stay again when in the area.aaaaaaaaaaaaa
hotel_response: Dear Guest. It is a real pleasure to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Hope to be able to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: A Week of Perfect
text: It must be a very difficult thing to have a number of different people responsible for making someone's whole weekday stay perfect, but that's exactly what Novotel Hamilton Tainui was able to achieve for me. title: Excellent service but facilities slightly lacking
text: In writing this review I am aware that I am possibly being a bit tough in that I am comparing this Novotel to a number of others in which I have stayed in various places.  This is a pleasant hotel with excellent staff.  All staff were smiling, instantly accommodating without being obsequious, well presented and a delight to deal with.  My wife and I were here for a conference in the hotel over a weekend so the meals we ate, apart from breakfast were prepared specifically for the conference participants which meant we did not eat in the restaurant for lunch and dinner.  The food we did have served was pleasant enough.  Breakfast was typical hotel fare that you will find in hotels throughout Europe, Asia, America and Australasia.  We had a basic deluxe room with a king sized bed.  The room was not particularly big and appointed with a rather "plastic" look but it was was clean and fresh and the bed was comfortable.  Air conditioning worked well and there was a blanket supplied for those who did not wish to use the duvet - a good touch.  But why do hotels  persist in having only one space for a suitcase in a room.  Are we odd in travelling with a case each?  The hotel is well sited in a main street.  There is a nice walk along the river beside the hotel, a number of pleasant restaurants very near the hotel and easy access to shops.  The factor missing which I have enjoyed in other Novotel Hotels was a lounge and foyer that was spacious, accommodating and inviting.  If you have stayed in Novotels in Thailand for example where a band or string quartet is common in the evening and there is a spacious lounge in which to relax then this place may disappoint.  Apart from that this is a pleasant hotel with a wonderful staff and is a bright, clean and reasonably priced place to stay in a good location.  It is a pity there is not a rating between "average" and "very good" because this is better than average but perhaps not quite very good.
hotel_response: Hi Jack. Thanks for your comments in regards to your stay with us. Not sure whether I agree with your comment that you have been tough on us. We are looking forward to sincere reviews and yours is as valuable as others. In regards to the band in the lounge; guess it is a bit of a cost factor for a 4 star hotel, as much as what we would like to provide you. Hope you will be able to visit us again. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Wedding Night
text:
Stayed the night here with brand new hubby! Woman was absolutely lovely when I booked- via phone from Dunedin. She did her best also to schedule an early check in time as my husband and his groomsmen wanted to get ready there- I explained to the lady that the wedding was at 2 and was half an hour out of Hamilton, so the earlier the check in the better. She said this shouldn't be a problem as it didn't look as though they were especially busy on this date.
We booked a superior room- even though the lady on the phone did recommend a suite. I should have listened to her! Although the room was fine for myself and hubby at the end of the night, I don't know how four men + photographer managed to get ready together in the space! Also although the room was tidy and modern, it would have been nice to have something a little more special for our wedding night, so I would advise others for a special occasion to spend the extra money and get a suite. 
My one complaint was that although I had asked and been told that hubby could check in at 11am, when they showed up to do that they were told they'd have to wait for the original check in time. It would have been nice to have been made aware of this before they turned up as there were other members of the bridal party with rooms at other hotels that they could have used. Caused a bit of a panic as it meant they only had around an hour to get ready! 
On the other hand this was more than made up for when my husband (not so organized) decided he'd like to get me roses after every florist in Hamilton had shut. The miracle worker at the desk managed to get this done and have them in the room waiting when we came back from our reception. 
I would definitely return, but probably wouldn't expect and kind of flexibility with check-in etc and would upgrade if you are looking for something special.
hotel_response: Dear Mrs. Sarah. First of all, of course congratulations on your wedding. I really hope that you had a good time in Hamilton. Sorry about the timing of your room; it does sometimes help when making a reservation for a suite, as they provide you with more room. Thank you for staying with us on your wedding night. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Very "Put Out"
text:
Although this hotel ticks all the boxes it is neither great nor bad it is simply what one comes to expect from a Novotel chain hotel.  The problem we did have mind you was the fact that on check in without our consent the lady blocked $4500 on our credit card.  If we were told this we would have stayed some place else as for a six night stay this is terrible, hence the terrible score.  To make a bad matter worse on the third day my wife queried the block and they did agree this was terrible and removed it but not before asking her to pay the bill up to date.  As it was over Easter the block was not removed and our credit card useless.  On checkout the duty manager did apologise and emailed once we were home to say the block was removed once queried and it was up to our bank to release the funds.  It was not the banks fault $4500 was blocked in the first place.
If a tourist holidayed in New Zealand and this happened to them, blocking them from their own money they would not have a very good impression of New Zealand, this must not happen again.
Other than that the hotel is fine, we would recommend to others and we would stay again.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you very much for commenting on your stay with us and the mistake we made in regards to the bond for your room. I am terrible sorry that this has happened and I do aplogize for this. We normally take a small bond for incidentals, but this was certainly not the right policy in your case. Again, I am very sorry this has happened and hope that you enjoyed the rest of your stay in New Zealand. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Bad Service Rude Assistant Manager
text: We booked a room for Easter Monday on the Trivargo website.  The rate was excellent at $109. We managed to phone Expedia and they said they were happy to swap the deal to the 21st. They advised the manager of  this who then insisted we pay a extra $62 straight away. We said that it was a mistake we would not have booked at that price. The manager was very unhelpful and rude and enjoyed the power he had over us as we had already paid the initial amount and we were half way home to our destination in Taranaki. We then paid but decided we would not eat or drink at the restaurant or give them another cent.  I feel that he was not bright enough to work out if he had looked after us he would have had a customer for life we would have eaten and had drinks in the hotel. Also we would have paid for parking. We will not use this hotel again while he is in employment. I would recommend eating at Portofino's

Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager, Novotel Tainui Hamilton

title: Handy to city restaurants
text:
Stayed just one night and it was pleasant enough. The staff on the desk were exceptionally friendly- the best customer service I have experienced in a long time.
The room was nice and modern with an outlook to an area below with an outdoor chess board. The bed wasn't as good as I had hoped- a bit saggy. Also the shower was over a bath which was slightly annoying to get in and out of.
We went to the hotel bar before we went out and sat outside which was a nice way to spend an hour- shame there was no view of the river though. The check out is 11am which is nice for a sleep in. Overall it was a nice stay and would definitely stay again.
hotel_response: Dear Julie. Thank you so much for taking the time to let us know how you have enjiyed your stay with us. Look forward to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Good Hotel not business friendly
text: The rooms are very nice and clean.  Pillows are not hard but have substance. Baths are spacious and well constructed.  But this is not a business friendly hotel and for that natter no Novotel seems to be business friendly.  Wifi is extra and the free wifi in the common areas has to be reset every 30 minutes, annoying. It is a very nice hotel otherwise and is located in a good area with lots of restaurants within walking distance.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. It is great to read that you have taken the time to review your stay with us. Since February 24th we have changed the set up of our internet and have made the packages a lot more affordable, which hopefully you will enjoy next time staying with us. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Great stay.
text:
Was a wonderful place to stay.
We booked last minute & didn't arrive till 11pm, but the staff were very friendly. As we drove through the Main Street we were very concerned as we could hear the music getting louder from the clubs & bars over our music in the car & the Novotel getting closer, but we couldn't hear a thing once we arrived at the Novotel. It is so central to everything & highly recommended.
The room was very nice & the bed was so comfortable. We ordered late night room service & it would have to be one of the best I have ever had. We just got the ham & cheese toasted sandwich for $15. At first I thought what a rip off, but it was so hot when it arrived unlike other places I have stayed & it came with two toasted sandwiches, chips & ranch sauce, so definitely value for money.
The room layout & design was very nice just like the hotel. Definitely recommend staying here.
hotel_response: Dear Kylie, Great to read that you have enjoyed your recent stay with us. It is always nice to see that our services are appreciated and work as they should. Look forward welcoming you back with us. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Great hotel and well positioned for a comfortable family stay
text:
Stayed here recently and was impressed by the location of this hotel. Easy to access most restaurants and the main shopping precinct via foot. 

Room nice, clean and modern. Beds extremely comfortable...perhaps the nicest i have ever slept on! Breakfast was good too, plenty of selection and a very pleasant restaurant setting.

Just a note that car parking is additional on top of the price of the stay. Also, there is no pool.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for reviewing your stay with us. Glad to read that you have enjoyed it so much. Hope you had a good trip back to Australia. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General manager

title: A tranquil oasis for the business traveller
text:
This is a fine hotel in the centre of exciting Hamilton. Well, may be not so exciting but still a good base to explore the tantalizing Waikato region. Well, maybe not so tantalizing after all. So, why the hell are you here? Ah, business!

The hotel is quite modern with really a very nice lighting layout in the rooms, making it very vibrant and constricting your pupils to the max. The restaurant is a bit lacking in atmosphere, but it serves food. The river (Hamilton River?) runs just beside the hotel and makes for a nice little foray, in case you didn't seal the deal and want to spend some time staring at running water.

The main city drag is just off to the side of the hotel. Shah was told that weekend nights tend to get rowdy with the local yahoos coming in to drink and loudly extolling the virtues of drinking. So it might not be the best place to be with your young family. "No Emily, he is shouting because he is very happy". If you are one of the local yahoos, well then never mind. Just don't scare little Emily please.

Shah Rukh's tip: Walk to the Starbucks about two blocks away for a nice cup of Starbucks.
hotel_response:
Dear Shah,
Thanks for your comments in regards to your stay with us. Great to see that you have enjoyed it and yes, the river is right next to the hotel. Hope you had a good trip back home. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager, Novotel Tainui Hamilton

title: Great place

hotel_response: Dear Guest. It is great to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Always nice to get feedback from my guests, which I share with my staff. Look forward to welcome you back again. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager, Novotel Tainui

title: An excellent getaway

we were very well received and welcomed, we throughly enjoyed our room and the spacious bed and TV was enjoyed by grandson.

It was nice not to have to drive anywhere.

hotel_response: Kia Ora Guest. Great to read that you have fully enjoyed our hotel. It is always nice to get good feedback and to be able to share that with my staff. Look forward to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Treat Yourself

hotel_response: Dear David. Really great to read that you have had a wonderfull stay with us and enjoyed staying in one of our suites. Looking forward to welcome you back. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Good location

title: Great Hotel and excellent service

hotel_response: Dear Guest, It is wonderfull to read that you have had a nice stay with us and really enjoyed it. We hope that you had a good trip back home and look forward to welcome you back. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager, Novotel Tainui Hamilton

title: Sport Trip
text: Was a very lovely hotel to stay at.  Kids wished there was a swimming pool but i didn't look into this before booking.  Will have to remember this for next time.  Meals were lovely and the bedding was absolutely comfy :-)

title: Great Hotel
text: Fantastic hotel, great location.  Very clean and extremely helpful and friendly staff. I would highly recommend this as a place to stay in Hamilton.  The location is central city so very close to all pubs, shops and easy trip to the suburbs from here.
hotel_response: Dear Karen. It is great to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us so much. Always nice for me to share your comments with my staff. Hope to be able to welcome you back. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager, Novotel Tainui Hamilton

title: Very impressed, by staff especially, breakfast and room
text:
The staff have been excellent.  From Checkin staff who were friendly and welcoming, especially restaurant staff who on 15/1/14 saw we were late checking in as a group of 8.

On asking what time the restaurant closed , told us 11 even though it is apparently 10 and gave us faultless service from 9:30 to 11:30.

Just coming back from breakfast, even the room service staff gave us a hearty" Cheerio"

The food was excellent, and the breakfast Buffett was one of the best we have had at any of the Novotel hotels and we stay in them wherever possible.

The room was modern and at a cheap rate.  We did not spend much time in Hamilton, arrived late, awoke early and walked along fiver and back through town, but appears to be well located.

Somehow we got a twin room , but this could have been our fault. I having checked the booking.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. It is really appreciated that you took the time to review your stay with us. Great to see that all went well. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager, Novotel Tainui Hamilton

title: Great room but parking not so great
text:
My husband and I stayed here for one night during a trip around the North island in November 2013. The hotel is clean and staff are friendly, like all Novotel hotels around the world. The bed was comfy and the room was very big compared to other Novotel hotels and located close to many eateries.  

The only downside of this hotel was the parking fee of $15 per night. You can park on the street for free between a certain time; as we had arrived almost to dinner time, we got lucky and managed to find a car space in front of the hotel which stated it was metered parking only to a certain time. We qualified for free parking on the street but had to put in a few dollars in the morning as we were running late and didn't want the fine to add to our already accumulating expenses. 

All in all, a great one night stay.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for taking the time to review your stay with us. I am aware that extra costs of parking are sometimes not expected, but we also want to take away the hassle for you to park your car and you don't have to worry about the time. Hope that explains it. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Happy 2014!
text:

The room was great the bed was so comfortable and the staff were very helpful. hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really appreciate the time you took in reviewing your stay with us on NY eve. Sorry that I have not answered you earlier, but the year has started really busy. My apologies. Hope you had a great start of 2014. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Excellent Hotel
text: We often stay at Novotel Hamilton  & find the location is perfect as with the rooms & we also love the Restaurant - Staff are extra friendly & its very pleasent to walk the riverside for a bit of daily exercise - we can't fault it-We now have an Accor Advantage plus card which we find extremely good for value/perks/deals etc - the perfect break away from Auckland

hotel_response: Dear Guest. It is great to read that you have enjoyed your stay with us. Hope you had a great time in New Zealand and had a good trip back to the UK. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager, Novotel Tainui Hamilton

title: Great room, great stay!
text:
We recently stayed for 5 days at the Novotel in Hamilton visiting friends and enjoyed our time at the Hotel.

The Novotel chain seems to be getting better and better, our booking had a very comfortable bed and the living area was very well appointed with large and spacious including couch and desk area. The bathroom has a decent sized bath with room to move.

The lobby area has a 30 minute free login for your own device, with computer kiosk's offering another 20 minutes if you want to use them. internet available in rooms at cost.

I had no issue with valet parking at $20 NZ, it was secure and our rental car was available very quickly. This seems the more secure option to me than on street or other parking.

Staff were very helpful and friendly throughout the 5 days, we got to talk to a number of them and can say they were all consistently good.

We would stay again based on the location, service and great rates.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you for taking the time to inform us about your recent stay with us. Great to read that you have fully enjoyed it. Hope you had a good trip back to Australia. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Central location but difficult parking
text: We stayed here for a couple of nights in early December when the hotel was very busy. If you have a car there is no on-site parking although a valet service is provided at a cost. There are much cheaper options within a couple of blocks if you need to park for extended periods. Although situated on the river bank, the river itself is blocked by large trees, so you do tend to feel very enclosed. Breakfast buffet had a large range and was priced about right. Hamilton has plenty of free wi-fi zones so avoid using the hotels internet if you can.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Really appreciate the time you took to provide us with feedback after your stay with us. In regards to the trees along the river bank; I am really happy that you mentioned this. We have been trying to convince the council to trim the trees, but so far no results as yet. Have a great start of 2014. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Top location and service
text:
We love staying at this hotel - rates can be expensive, but the quality of the rooms and the location are hard to beat.  Never had a bad meal either so we keep returning.  The charges for parking in what appears to be a street location can be a minor irritation, but then the location is in the CBD.  The casino nearby provides a bit of fun too.

We will be back!

Have a great New Year and hope to welcome you back at the hotel in 2014. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Great location and service
text:
We stayed here for the weekend. Check in was an efficient breeze, and the staff gave  us all excellent advice on where to go and what to do. 

I had a twin room on 3rd floor, others in my party were on 1st and 3rd with river views. All rooms were quiet, and clean (as you would expect). The bed was absolutely perfect with pillows to match. 

The gym / fitness centre is small and basic with the spa pool over looking the outside area. Nothing flash but a welcome  soak at the end of the day.

Didn't eat breakfast as heaps of cafes in the area.

Valet parked the car for NZ$20 a night.

Overall worth every cent, definitely a very nice 4 star. Would happily stay again.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. We really appreciate your comments in regards to your stay with us. Really happy to read that all went well. With kind regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Good hotel undermined by ridiculous internet prices
text:
I have stayed at the Tainui Novel many times over the last 10 years from when it was an absolute gem of a hotel that now is showing signs of decay with carpet wearing out and visible scuff marks on the room's paintwork. Don't get me wrong though over 3 nights I had a very comfortable stay, and there are still the friendly, familiar faces among the hotel staff who are excellent by the way.

I have one major gripe though, Tainui Novotel offers the following pricing plans for connecting to the hotel's internet connection: 2 hour plan; 68 cents per minute up to NZ $14.90. 24 hour plan; 68 cents per minute up to NZ $29.90. 7 days; 68 cpm up to NZ $115. Why on earth do NZ hotels continue to charge for this service? This would have been understandable some years ago but in this day and age?

On my recent travels through Kuala Lumpur, Hong Kong, Guangzhou, Shanghai, Beijing, and Chengdu where I stayed in a mixture of 5 star, 2 star, B&B and hostel accommodations I did not have to pay an extra penny for fast Wifi. Just saying. NZ hotels take note.

This used to be a great hotel, now its a good hotel. Maybe I'll stay at the newer, cheaper, Ibis sister-hotel across the road next time.
hotel_response: Dear Cletus. Thanks for taking the time to inform us about your stay with us. I am very sorry that we were not able to satisfy your requirements in regards to internet. Although we are presently working on a new plan, that obviously did not satisfy your needs. We hope that we are able to change this very soon. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: A consistent stay....just a few things to work on
text:
We have stayed at this hotel many times and it is consistent in the Le Club Novotel chain. The cleaning has definitely improved in the bathrooms in the past few months, well done Novotel and staff are mainly happy to be there it appears.

Beds are the usual BEST, Novotels have awesome bed mattresses that are hard to beat.

Only bug bears for us this trip were we were placed in an inter-connecting room and the people either side of us and across the hall were all together, so there was a fair bit of door knocking and back and forth around us.  These rooms are always less sound proofed with the door between rooms and we could plainly hear next door yahooing and yelling together which sounded like they were in our room. It would make sense to place these groups travelling together - all together, so other guests aren't affected. Will be ensuring we dont have this type of room again in the future.

Staff didnt notify us that, as Le Club silver members, we had complimentary wi fi in our room or that there were two complimentary drinks cards on the desk. These had been stapled upside down in the card, so we missed them, instead distracted that they has mis-spelt our short surname!  However, once we realised about these two things and rang staff, they were helpful. We also found a newspaper outside our door, which hadnt been offered at check in so we werent aware, until we we left to check out. 

Staff need to raise these types of things at check in to ensure guests are aware and can enjoy the benefits while staying, as those little things make a difference.

Since our last stay 3 months ago, the large room windows have become so covered in thick dirt and dust, that it affects the view! They badly needed cleaning.

Other than those things, a good stay at a consistent hotel in a great spot in the centre of Hamilton's CBD.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for reviewing our hotel after your stay with us. Sorry that we did not give you the recognition as the Silver Le Club member. We have addressed these comments with our staff and they recieved additional training as well. At the moment, we are repainting the outside of the hotel, which was the reason that I waited with the building wash. This is all been taken care off now. Hope to be able to welcome you back in 2014. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: So relaxing!
text: We had a couple of nights and found our big double bed incredibly comfortable and luxurious that we had the best ever sleep, waking up feeling energised and relaxed. The room was very light with floor to ceiling windows and plenty of cosy lamps and spotlights to set the mood. It had air conditioning and was airy and comfortable. The TV selection was great with Sky Movies and pay per view movies for all tastes. The bathroom was large with a bath and shower and generous quantities of complimentary toiletries. The breakfast was included in the room cost and everything was really freshly cooked and tasty. The pancakes were delicious and the chefs provided freshly cooked eggs to order, any style and could serve bacon crispy or soft which is a must for me. We are REALLY fussy about food and dining and the evening meals were creative and beautifully cooked and presented. My partner had a fillet steak, cooked perfectly to her request with a gorgeous wine jus and I had lamb shank with a succulent caramelised gravy, that fell off the bone and had no fat or gristle. The desserts were lush even if a little small and I had sticky date pudding with salted caramel sauce which was wonderful. The only criticism we could make was our Kapiti cheese platter was freezing cold, straight out the fridge, so lacked any flavour or character, but we could have ordered some extra wine and waited longer for it to warm up and as I say we are incredibly fussy over how food is served, so cannot moan.  The hotel is very centrally situated, has plenty of parking underground that is shared with Skycity and has three wonderful restaurants right opposite, a particularly lovely ambience and amazing food can be found at the Italian restaurant called Cafe Centralle. The waiters are authentic and make a wonderful fuss of you as if you had known them all your lives and the food was just amazing and very inexpensive. Do not try the other Italian restaurant next door, the menu is cheaper but very dull and the atmosphere is very boring. The staff at the hotel were always polite and the cleaners did a wonderful job and we always felt we were the first people to ever use the bathroom as it was very nicely cleaned and polished. Overall, an excellent stay, good value for money and you feel like you have been welcomed and well looked after from arrival to departure. We will definitely go back.
hotel_response: Dear Guest. It is great to read that you have enjoyed your stay so much. I really appreciate the extensive review of the hotel and restaurant and find it very nice to see that all we are trying to achieve his worked. We hope that you had a good trip back home and look forward to welcome you back. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager, Novotel Tainui Hamilton

hotel_response: Dear Guest. Thank you so much for taking the time to review your stay with us. I very much appreciate your comments in regards to some of our services and will see how we can improve these. Best regards, Dick Breukink, General Manager

title: Nice but avoid using Internet
text:

People are extremely friendly, food and drinks are of good quality, though wines are on the low side, at least for someone coming from France.

title: Pleasant Stay! Dine Elsewhere...
text: Big smiles with great customer services. Not a bad price for a family of four. The hotel room we stayed in was overlooking the pool area and courtyard. Clean, tidy and warm the room had convenient facilities for tea and coffee with a small but adequate bathroom that had a bath, shower and toilet. Centrally located near the city, this hotel is full of 'life!' During our stay there were many families, sports teams and frequent users that contributed to a 'lively atmosphere' for the hotel and in-house restaurant "Retrospect." This seemed quite inspiring so we decided to dine in at the restaurant to get the full experience. The retro decor although quirky needs more flare and the food unfortunately was questionable at best. Another diner remarked, "Don't order the squid! It tastes old." We shared the 'Whitiora Platter' for a starter and could only compare this to a surf and turf on a bed of shredded carrot and red cabbage. Olive oil and lashings of it was the main feature on this platter. The sauces that accompanied the platter were good as they cut through the oil. We both ordered lite-meal options after that oil overload but unfortunately it was more of the same. Did we enjoy it? Not really...but we were hungry. Over priced is all we can say about the mediocre food we received. Would we stay here again?  'Yes' ...Would we eat here again?  'No!'

If you are arriving after 9pm, call them ahead of time to make arrangements. The front desk person I spoke to gave me specific instructions on opening a lock box that contained our room keys. It worked out great! Room is simple, clean. Bed was quite comfortable and +air conditioning.  Wifi is free. Fridge and kettle are always a nice addition. Nothing fancy about the shower or the bathroom, but otherwise clean. Nice, thick towels.  Location- based on other reviews, I asked for the rear tower due to noise complaints from the other building. If you sleep with the windows open you will definitely hear morning traffic. We heard some street noise, despite leaving the windows closed, but it didn't wake us up.  The hotel is located less than 10 minutes from downtown and the restaurants by car. Also, there is a grocery store across the street. The area seemed safe. Overall, comfortable stay, good value, friendly staff, and decent location.

All our windows are double glazed, and our team now offer complimentary ear plugs for those guests who require an extra sound barrier. Additionally our newly completed Clarion Suites are located to the south of the reception area and therefore enjoy a peaceful location for guests disturbed by sound. I do hope we see you again soon!

BUT when I rang the next day to find out I didn't have that room prior to driving thru to Hamilton I was upset & told them I better have it sorted before I arrive. When I got there no luck. I had 2 seperate rooms, not the connecting rooms I asked for, staff told me sorry I couldn't have the rooms not avail. We attended a beautiful wedding & came back to the motel with my granson to babysit, I had to drag the cot a few metres away into my room so I could have him sleep with me, what a hassel that was. I suggest that when you give information over the phone and tell your customers that you have booked according to what they asked that it should be exactly that. What a disappointment to find otherwise & to arrive to organise an alternative there or elsewhere.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking  the time to review The Ambassador.
General Manager

title: Basic & Clean
text: Good location, clean room and comfortable bed. Convenient location. Overall an average motel, nothing much outstanding.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking  the time to review The Ambassador.
General Manager

title: Refreshed and refurbished
text: Our previous stay here was 4-5 years ago when the motel was looking very tired. It has been freshly painted and fittings/furniture modernised since then. It certainly looks refreshed! A few little things annoyed us though-only Freeview TV, no facial tissues nor an alarm clock. We chose to stay here for its proximity to Waikato stadium to see the All Blacks play. However we were disappointed that the on site restuarant seems to have closed (for evening meals at least) and the bar was not interested in offering meals or even snacks that particular evening-they would have had a lot of business as the city was packed with rugby supporters wanting food before the evening game. Quite reasonably priced especially for itas location close to the city centre and the sports ground.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking  the time to review The Ambassador.
General Manager

title: Great location for a game
text:
Didn't actually realise how close it was to the stadium for the All Blacks v Ireland game, very handy indeed especially with KFC and a Pak'n'Save supermarket across the road!

Price was a bit steep but then everything in Hamilton was that weekend, think its the norm when an event is on.

Free wifi included which was a bonus.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to post your feedback regarding your recent stay with us at The Ambassador Motel in Hamilton. We're happy to hear that you enjoyed your stay with us during the Ireland vs All Blacks weekend. If you also follow the Super 15 we've got more great games at Waikato Stadium coming up soon! Again, thank you for your feedback and we look forward to having you stay again in the future.

title: nice and very safe place to stay....
text: Just wanna share my wonderful moments of ambassador motel inn during my trip to NZ last May 2012. Nice and very safe , peaceful environs and delicious breakfast meals...Dinese and other staff are very friendly and accomodating. My gratitude to everybody...thanks thanks...
hotel_response:
Thank you for staying with us in May this year and for providing us with such great feedback, it really is appreciated by our whole team here at The Ambassador Motel. Also thank you for your tip for other travellers and we have passed on your compliments to our cook.
All the best, 
The Ambassador Team

title: Very basic
text: Found this place online, needed a room which slept 4 adults.  Room was advertised as Business Executive.  Room was very tiny and had two queen size beds side by side and the decor is very dated.  Bathroom very basic and small, a small fridge - no plates, only cups and glasses.  It did have a balcony which was nice.  Would only give us one key between the four of us which was very difficult to manage.  We were charged $200 for the night, which was very steep for what we got - however it was a busy weekend for the town, so perhaps they were capitilising on the fact that rooms were not easy to come by.  Only stayed one night, as we were visiting the town to attend a birthday party.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to post your feedback, this is valuable as it allows us to improve our product. We would like to clarify that the room charge was $175.50 not $200. The room type selected was an express studio room with tea/ coffee making facilities only, as clearly stated on our website. We have 5 different room types available. Our studio rooms are spacious for two people, perhaps a wiser choice for four people would have been a two bedroom suite, which we did have available at the time of booking.
It is standard practice to provide only one set of keys per room. An additional set is available with a security bond payment.
Kind regards,
The Ambassador Team

title: Please don't stay here
text:
My immediate reaction to the room was an overwhelming smell of janola.
I had to shut the door to the bathroom and put the bathroom fan on.
Really didn't feel safe here.
Could not lock the door from the inside!
Positive news was that Woolworths is across the road.
Towels changed daily, but bed wasn't made!

I don't recommend this motel.
Only if you're desperate!

title: Smelly
text:
Room appeared clean and tidy and just with that slight cheap motel muffly smell, but the bed turned out to have a more than subtle damp smell, clearly coming through when lying on the bed, and clearly located within the perimeter of the bed. So annoying it kept me awake for far too long. 
Otherwise, good location, reasonably quiet except occasional car racing going on, okay friendly reception. Parking options are good. Reception desk and area would benefit from a serious tidy up session.

title: In Hamilton for Surgery
text:
Luckily I had not read the past reviews but they’d last been done a few years ago.

Friendly reception.

Motel is being upgraded and was very clean and tidy.

Well situated close to the cbd and hospital I was having surgery.

Stayed 2 nights.

Room was spacious and clean.

Comfortable bed.

TV 

Air conditioning heat pump.

Couch, table and office table.

Good bathroom but not much room over sink but good shower, plenty of pressure and good size.

Good parking.

Great value for money.

title: Amazing
text: Best accommodation in Hamilton, couldn’t fault anything.  Sky and the spa bath was a bonus lovely and clean, had everything you could want for a night to relax after a long weekend, and value for money! Close to town 10/10

title: Not my cup of tea
text: Agree with recent reviews. This place isn't a nice environment to be in.  Travelling with a workmate and her room smelt heavily of cannabis on entry. My room was OK, but It would seem that this hotel was  now being used for a lot of emergency housing bookings and just wasn't a good fit for business travellers

title: Terrible
text:
also emergency accomodation. Lots of kids running around til well after midnight while parents partying, drinking, smoking and loud music on balconys and carpark areas. noisy, cockroaches, rubbish lying around grounds and rooms poorly maintained, one of the bedrooms had no curtains, stained carpet. 
terrible experience. room backed onto laundry, we could hear all conversations and see everything thru gap in door. Not very comforting as this means our privacy was as compromised as theirs.
All in all... never again

title: Three bedroom unit
text: Booked a 3 room unit for one night. Very spacious with comfortable beds. Two bathrooms, both with barely luke warm water. One bedroom with no curtains. Towel rails hanging loose. The whole place shows deterioration with washing hanging on balconies, boom boxes going on balconies with children tearing around the car parks on scooters and bikes until well after 9pm. Room was clean but smelt strongly of cleaning fluid. Have used this motel for many years but unfortunately it seems more like a boarding house now.

title: Don't bother staying here.
text: Wanted somewhere quiet. Stayed at motels near hospital while my husband was having monthly treatments at hospital. Previous motels had people staying who were swearing & talking loudly and kids running around til late at night so thought this 4 star motel would be quieter. Wrong! People smoking, noisy & toddlers running around using the carparks as a playground. We could have easily run them over if I didn't get out to direct my husband to dodge around them with the mother shouting abuse at us. Office staff ambivalent about it. Pool wasn't available in spite of website stating it was.

title: Be careful!
text: Pulled after after a long day driving, $200 for the night! Should have moved on to somewhere else. Room clean and tidy but mould in bathroom. Car park untidy with rubbish laying around, full of children running around - with no care for traffic or other guests,  adults lounging around. Appeared to be long term residents. Parked our car in supermarket car park across the road. Find somewhere else to stay for the night!

title: Disgusting
text: On arrival there were a lot of children running around in the car park and vicinity also very noisy. Also several adults lounging around outside and in open door ways.ap Appears this place is used as emergency housing for winz. Seems like these people have taken over the place.  They do not respect other guests. We checked out after the first sleepless night when they were partying all night and were very noisy drinking all night and still drinking at 8.00am. Avoid this place at all cost there are much better places in Hamilton as we found out.

title: Dated and housing temporary residents
text: Our business group had this motel booked for some time. We arrived with the group spread across 3 blocks. People on long term residency live there who are rude, noisy, drunk and abusive. Would not recommend staying here as very noisy and not a nice atmosphere.

title: KEEP CLEAR!
text: Pulled up to place. Tidy but dated.  Went into reception area,  how I would describe the smell that hit me was that off overcooked microwave popcorn. Although friendly it took a while for the young receptionist to sort our room,  appeared to be a mixed up.  After leaving reception it was very obvious that this hotel had allowed themselves to house welfare people. I am not judgmental however I would not have booked into this place if I knew this because I was looking for a quiet,  relaxed environment. There were lots kids running everywhere,  people arguing here and there,  people all over the place smoking etc. The accommodation was clean and presentable however the air conditioning was not very good and it wasn't until after 9 that the room cooled down (despite abandoning the air con and opening doors and windows which allowed the outside dramas bellow in). Would not use the pool as overrun with people.  Staying here was a real experience I do not wish to repeat!

title: Good location
text: Stayed one night at this motel.  It was a convenient location to central Hamilton and for exploring the area.  The room was clean, quite spacious with a kitchenette, large screen TV, small table with two chairs and free wifi.  The bed was comfortable. There was a large supermarket across the road, very convenient if you needed any supplies. Would stay there again

title: Never again
text:
I spent a night here late Feb 2019. I was able to check in at 1pm which was good. It’s quite a big place. 
$180 per night for a motel room for 1 person is expensive! I’ve stayed at the Hyatt in Perth for less.
After registering at reception and making my way to my room I noticed what seemed like quite a few permanent indigenous residents sitting around outside their accomodation, kids bikes and toys etc. I wondered if a lot of people who were staying there were the overflow from the current Housing NZ crisis in this country.
In fairness my room was clean and spacious.
It was a warm summers day the day I checked in and during the evening at approx. 8.30pm I had the entry door open to create some airflow, sitting by the open window enjoying a drink I heard a rustling of plastic and turned to see an indigenousboy of around 9 years old at the kitchenette in my room searching through the complimentary tea/coffee/biscuit tray. He’d startled me and I said in a firm voice “ oi what are you doing!” ...he turned and looked and casually walked the 5m - 6m to the door and left my room, dropping a packet of 2 biscuits on the way. 
If I’d known he was hungry I would have fed him.
I’d never stay here again, my room was clean but the whole place had a ghetto feel about it.

title: Showing it's age
text: Showing it's age and lack of maintenance. Everything works fine, but dated and knocked about. Needs a better comfort bed. Travellers should be told at time of first enquiry that the motel is being used for welfare housing.

title: Friendly staff. Large room with kitchenette.
text:
Property is decent. Location is quiet even though it is a short distance from main boulevard into city from state highway. Yet, neighborhood seemed a bit sketchy.  

Clean, large room had full kitchenette, large screen TV with premium channels, free WiFi. 

Good location as base to explore Hamilton and take scenic drive to Waitomo Caves.

title: Clean and comfy
text: Nice large room . Big tv . Nice bag of plunger coffee on arrival good size bottle of milk . Bed comfy . Room smelled great nice and clean . Staff friendly . Good stay thanks  would definitely go back and recommend

title: 1 night stop
text:
A perfectly adequate overnight stopover.  Large room with the usual self catering facilities.  A supermarket close by and main shopping street not far away. 
Situated on a backstreet so was nice and quiet,  at least whilst we were there.

The advertised pool is really small and only suitable for cooling off and splashing about.
