Very pleasant and welcoming reception.

title: Not BAD, but not great either
text:
The 3 bedroom town house was a fantastic size for a large family. The layout was great and the amount of space in every room was huge! Towels were replenished daily, and the beds were re-made. 
But that's where it stops :( the townhouse had so many large cockroaches - alive ones. We counted 9 over 3 days (that we saw) with one crawling on my husband in his bed! The dining chairs were broken, bedroom lights didnt work..shower in ensuite had barely any water pressure. The fridge barely kept anything cool let alone cold. And the freezer was not cold enough to freeze our water bottles even though it was turned as cold as possible. Quite a few holes in walls and in ceiling etc that havent been fixed, and curtains half hanging off and cant pull together. It's in desperate need of some TLC.

title: A Great Stay in Hamilton
text:
It was such a great stay. I found Anglesea motel in my google search for a budget motel to stay for one night in Hamilton. I was quite doubt when I saw the price below 100$. I kind of expect that the motel will be rough. We got special discount rate from the booking website as well so it came down to 86$ only. 
When I arrived, I was amazed of the cleanliness, the great amenities that this motel provides. I read the review about it is not really quiet, I agree. Me and my husband spent about 15 minutes to find out what noise that came from the bathroom but it ended up someone next door opened the tap for their spa and it could be heard to our room. It is good that the management put the noise ban from 10 pm to 7 am, however, you can't forbid people to take shower, of course. 
Other than that, I have no complain. The staff, Varun was really nice and did call us to confirm our booking. And the private spa is GREAT! The pool needs to be tidied up more often though, because when I sat in the morning I found children's undies around and that was pretty disturbing. Definitely a great stay and will come back. Great value for money.

title: Adequate, not exceptional.
text:
This hotel is a self rated 4 stars, which to me as an avid and experienced traveller gives you an idea of what you're going to get. (To put these ratings in perspective, the Ibis down the road is rated the same and the room pictures look immaculate!). My advice for Anglesea is bump this rating down a bit - it might allow for lower expectations. The facilities and experience was adequate, not exceptional. 

The bedroom was great for weary travellers to get a good nights sleep. A comfy big bed met the expectations I went in with. Other facilities were adequate enough - no great complaints besides some small repairs needed. While some parts of the various rooms look fairly new, others look old and tired.

The hotel most of the time is rowdy, busy and not particularly peaceful. (It reminded of me staying in a caravan park as a kid where families were socialising and children playing together which is great is that's what you're looking for). With the rooms providing an abundance of sound systems and television sets, better soundproofing needs to be in place. 

The location was good enough in terms of being walking distance to town (approx. 10 mins), but the actual area didn't give me the confidence to walk through there alone at night time.

I would only recommend this hotel for a short stay - you may get some good rest if dropping by for the night. Just bring your earplugs in case.

title: Would stay here again
text:
From the time I booked until we checked out I was impressed with this place.
We needed a place just to crash for the night, usually I wouldn't book a 'cheap' hotel per say but I would happily stay here again! The gentleman on reception was very helpful, great customer service, we turned up late and left super early, we had a studio spa suite and it was very roomy, warm, comfortable bed and big bathroom. Pleasantly surprised

title: One night in Hamilton
text: Friendly staff, nice clean room, comfy bed, clean bathroom, easy to get to from state highway one and close to town. Given the number of cars in the car park it was surprisingly quiet. Great reasonably priced breakfast.

title: A week in Hamilton
text: Quiet location close to supermarket and resturants. The first room I was allocated had had smokers in previously. I was moved without question.Great service. Rooms clean and tidy. May be ready for a freshen up but for the value for money  they are great.

title: MAJOR DISAPPOINTMENT,
text:
Booked 3 bed rm apartment. Was spacious and good kitchen, good heating and sky in every room & supermarket across the rd...but that's where the good ends.
There is no parking near the 3 bedroom units..we had to park the furthest you could possibly park frm the units on the other side of the place then make 4 trips of about 3 properties away to take all our stuff in with young kids and lug it up a flight of stairs. Wld never had booked here had that been made known. The room looked nothing like the picture..the next door unit did. It had a huge lounge but only a 2 seater couch and 2 cane out door chairs an 2 other miss matched chairs and a TV in it.  Their were ants coming out of the insinkerator, holes in some of the bedroom walls behind doors and beds, our fridge worked but cldnt get cold as the freezer fan had frozen (replacement was brought in the next day), the queen bed was very soft and so close to the floor I actually checked it had legs on it. The bathrooms needed a spring clean as there was mould on ceilings, they use industrial toilet roll holders & paper despencers which make it feel like public toilets. House keeping came in at 10 to clean while we were still sitting at the table eating breakfast, and came back in several times that day as instead of cleaning in 1 go they return later to replenish linen. Not on. They also hve all these rules you have to sign on checking in which yr basically held ransom to sign cause if you dont you cant leave as you will get no refund. Theres some odd rules for example if you got kicked out they wld charge you $100..that's on top of what you already paid. There is very little English &  communication from front desk when we  told them about the holes in walls, ants  fridge and housekeeping coming in while were still eating breakfast. We had booked for 2 nights and had to stay..preferably we would hve liked to have left on arrival. We left an item behind so they rang and told us about it...3 ph calls within minutes from them to try sort out sending it back in a pre paid bag we gave up & had some one go pick it up for us and post it. A few days after arriving home I had an email from the booking place to tell us we had not turned up to this motel for our booking. The motel cancelled the booking after we stayed to try stop us leaving a review as we had mentioned a cpl of things wrong with the room..very deceitful and upon reading reviews had done this to others. I would never return to this place or recommend. There are not many reviews for the 3 bed rm apartments, wish there had been cause we never wld have stayed. Also coin machine is Out of order in laundry and probably been like that for ages and the tiny pool on sight for those people contemplating staying in summer is attached to the back of laundry at the side of carpark up the front next to rd. Playground is tiny..not worth a mention. Again far side on carpark. Quite frankly one of the worst motels I've stayed at and ruined the end of our 2 week holiday.

title: Clean and tidy
text: We had stayed here many many years ago, when it was in fantastic condition. However it is now rather tired and the whole place in need of some good tlc. The room was spotless but very basic. The liquid hand soap in bathroom empty,the bedside light didn’t work and was rather unsafe. As it is a very large complex and many guests we found some not very thoughtful of other guests,laughing and smoking under other units at 6.30 in the morning. We asked for a paper,the response astounded us “ oh I am not sure there is one “ but there were papers at the door when I returned the key ! Hamilton has lots of top accomodation ,if you want cheap it’s a good stay,if you like attention to detail then try elsewhere.

title: Clean and functional townhouse
text:
A very large townhouse with 3 bedrooms, but a little tired and dated.  Could really do with a bit of an update as the decor is stuck in the 80's.  A nearly functional kitchen, but lacking a few  utensils - makes it a bit hard to actually prepare a meal!

Overall a reasonable place to stay with a family as plenty of space,  but would expect something a little more modern for the money.

title: Pleasant Stay
text: Stayed in a large studio room with heat pump, equipped with all the basics.  Was clean and tidy, and access to free sky, wifi and parking  There is also an onsite self-service laundry. Excellent shower and I love that there are paper towel dispensers in the bathroom and kitchenette.  Full length mirror inside the small wardrobe which is always a bonus! Had great nights sleep - bed was lovely and soft. Noise level wasn't noticeable at all.  Within walking distance to two major supermarkets, two bars and a cheap taxi ride into the centre of town to visit the casino.  Easily walkable though on a warm summers night. Was well priced and I would stay another night here again.

title: Very basic with repairs needed.
text: Bathroom was the worst; fan heater did not work, shower had to be entered in order to turn it on & squirted water from a D.I.Y. repair at nozzle, no shelves to put anything on in shower and no hooks for hanging clothes in bathroom. Also beware: "en suite" simply means a basin in your room! Booked to stay in June (Winter) but electric blankets were folded in cupboard rather than on beds. Some of the furniture looked as if it had been purchased from a 2nd hand dealer. Ordered cooked breakfast came with 2 slices of bread in a plastic bag which you have to toast in the unit!

title: Most enjoyable relaxing rest
text: I had the most delightful long hot soak in the spa bath. I was in unit 4. I requested for down stairs because of hip disability. Easy parking. Easy wifi. All amenities were fresh clean and high standard. Sky TV easy to use remote. Large double size bed crisp sheets. Great value for money at special deal price $110 instead of $165.00.

title: My new favourite in Hamilton
text: We have stayed in many places over the past 2 years in Hamilton, this one definitely takes first place and our place to stay from now on.  Excellent rate, rooms are very spacious, wireless connection is awesome as is the choice of TV Channels.  The shower, which is always one of our criteria for ratings, is great, beds are comfortable , everything is very clean.  Excellent breakfast choices and love the little things, complimentary cookies, hot chocolate (not just tea & coffee).  Nice and quiet and so close to supermarkets, gas stations, rugby stadium, restaurants, and river walk.  Definitely returning

title: Wouldn't recommend
text:
Booked into a 3 bed townhouse as attending a nearby conference ( not here).
Was very basic, NOT like the pics on the website.
The "spa bath" wasnt nice, the noise from across the road ( ? Recyling? Processing plant) was continuous and kept us awake from 3am!! 
The kitchen cupboard doors were loose, a hole in the ceiling and wall, curtain rails were loose. Bleach? Stains on carpets upstairs. Felt like a punishment.
Beds ARE clean and comfortable.
Staff were polite when we complained- other 3 bed townhouses were booked up though. Gave us a botyle wine to help us sleep.
Monday and thurs nights were the noisiest.
Sorry :-(

title: Excellent value for money
text: The motel amenities are excellent. The room is spacious with everything provided in the kitchenette and bathroom. Very hygienic.  Very well placed close to supermarkets and the rugby stadium. Heat pump worked perfectly and efficiently. Everything was excellent and we will definitely stay here again. Amazing value for money.

title: Crispy clean sheets and lovelt staff
text: When we arrived at our location, tired after a long day, it was great to have such helpful and friendly staff behind the counter. The room was on the ground floor with easy access from the car park to the door. The fragrance in the room was mild and not irritating to the sinuses which was a pleasant surprise as some hotels are so over powering. This was a well equipped room with a small kitchen area, with microwave, stove top and cooking needs.  The room also had a small dining table and the TV on a swivel so the you could watch it from the dining table or the bed. The sheets were crisp and clean, with great pillows.  Overall a great room for our stay.

title: Would not recommend.
text:
We stayed here for one night with another couple and would not stay here again.  Our toilet smelt very unclean.  On arrival we were given coffee granules in what i can only describe as a paper bag with "Chips" written on it, Is that even legal?  Extremely noisy trucks backing in all around you.  A blood nose accident resulted in an extra $60.00 charge on my credit card for cleaning the sheets.
Oh dear an unexpected accident an an expensive excessive charge for it.  Will never ever stay here again.

title: Excellent place to stay
text: Stayed at the Anglesea for 2 nights for work. Very easy check in with a pleasant man behind the counter. Upstairs room which was extremely clean and very roomy.  Decent size tv compared to other places i have stayed with great reception & plenty of channels. Nice to be given a couple of bisc each day & well stocked tea & coffees etc. Lovely spa bath with plenty of towels. Excellent breakfast delivered to yr room with plenty of options. Would definitely stay again & recommend as a great place to stay

title: Just what I needed.
text: Was looking for a comfortable place to stay on a road trip around the north island and that's exactly what i found. A clean and well presented motel room with well equipped kitchenette, large bathroom. Friendly staff who genuinely seemed to care about your experience as a guest. Handy location if you wanted to go to a rugby match as the stadium as very nearby.

title: Great Stay
text:
I was having a short visit to Hamilton for the cricket so looked for motels in the area of the cricket ground and found the Anglesea Motel I liked the look of it when I was booking.
After a 22 hr flight and a short drive from Auckland we arrived at our motel , check in so easy , parking right next to your room , I could probably have slept on the floor and had a good sleep that how tired I was but when I got in the bed oh my how good did that feel, all the stress and strain just eased out of me the beds are so comfy I struggled to get up for cricket 20hrs later.
I had a great stay at this hotel it was just perfect in every way.
Thanks Anglesea Motel

title: Hamilton New Zealand
text:
We stayed at Anglsea motel in one of their town houses.
The beds were very comfortable and the kitchen was very well equipped.
The motel was very conveniently situated as over the road was a Countdown store.
It was a 5 minute walk from the Seddon Park stadium, and a few minutes walk from the river.

title: Brilliant place
text: My wife and I stayed here for three nights and found the place to be superb in terms of value for money, location and the friendliness of the staff. This place was chosen because of watching the England v New T 20 cricket match at Seddon Park - less than ten minutes away and the very easy to get to by foot. There was also a supermarket (Countdown) about three minutes walk away. I can fully recommend this as the room I was in had all you could ask for in terms of amenities as again the staff there make you feel very welcome.

title: Clean and Handy
text:
A one night stop over whilst travelling from Bay of Islands to Taranaki and we arrived around 8pm after this mammoth drive. This hotel is clean and tidy and well appointed for a short stay. 
Like many of its type, it’s on a busy road but sound proofing is pretty good. Very convenient for the Countdown store across the road and, although I didn’t notice until the next morning, there is a pub just around the corner. 
You could walk into town centre if you needed but there are plenty of taxis.

title: Excellent Accommodation
text: We stayed 1 night in room 28,  excellent,  very clean, very comfortable and friendly staff. Will definitely stay here next time we're in Hamilton. Thank you to the team.  Close to all restaurants and city centre. David and Denise (English) Fuerteventura, Canary Islands, Spain.

title: Clean and comfortable
text: The Angelsea was a perfectly adequate place to crash for a night on the way south - I had a big room with a well-equipped kitchenette, a comfortable double bed (and a single!) and a good bathroom. It was clean and convenient for coming off the expressway. There's a supermarket opposite and a few restaurants close by but the centre of town is a little way away.

title: Clean overnight stay
text: After reading mixed reviews we were hesitant about staying, but found the room very clean and attending staff extremely helpful. This place was in a handy location and would make a ideal place to base yourself and sightsee around the area. It has a kitchenette and a supermarket across the road.

title: Great value.  Friendly staff.
text: First time staying here.  Staff was so friendly even offered me a coffee.  Room was very clean and well stocked. Bed was big, tv was big and the place was very quiet. Will definitely stay here again as it's great value.

title: Top Value Four Star Accommodation.
text: This motel was a great find in Hamilton. It's a 3 minute drive to the CBD and some classy restaurants and bars.The rooms are spacious with a king size bed, kitchenette,quality flat screen TV and a large bathroom with 2 person spa... all for $94 per night. Hamilton is an interesting city and the Gardens are outstanding.

title: Loved it
text: I made a last minute booking and got a great deal on a room with a kitchenette and spa bath. the staff member who checked me in was friendly and polite and there was no charge for parking two cars. The room was clean and really well-supplied with lots of thoughtful touches. I was really impressed and will definitely stay again

title: Bad Communication Left Me Stranded
text: I rang and arranged 3 nights accommodation a week before arrival, only to find on arrival that they denied it happened.  He recalled talking to me but said we hadn't arranged a booking.  I then explained that I rang back to confirm booking, as I had to check my budget, and was then instructed to email the booking which I did through their Motel website.  He said it might have been someone else, but had no record of my email.  He only had a family unit left which would cost $400 (for 2 of us) and would reaccomodate us the next day to the cheaper unit.  I had no choice but to go elsewhere, but had to take the rest of the afternoon off from my conference to find alternative accommodation as town was booked out. Thank Goodness AirBnB exists

title: Worst motel I have stayed in EVER!!
text: So dirty!! Blood on sheets & towels, couch was disgusting and drug addicts kept us awake in room above all night!! Totally disgusting shower with blocked drain..mould on the roof and spit balls. Would not recommend under any circumstances!!!

title: RUDE STAFF
text: Unfortunately we had to cancel our trip as my father ended up in hospital - a day later he passed. I called to advise them and cancel our booking. First time I couldn't get through. Second time the person I spoke to said he will call back in 5 minutes and hung up on me - he never called back. I then spoke to booking.com who were so amazing and understanding, they tried to convince Anglesea motel to cancel free of charge but they did not want a bar of it. The rude staff were not helpful at all and I'm sure they refused to communicate with me so I would still have to pay for the room, even though because of unfortunate circumstances, I could not stay in.

title: Great size room, clean and average facilities!
text:
Easy to find, friendly front-of-house staff, clean simple accommodation.
Literally 'across the road' from CountDown supermarket and pub on the corner where WE eat.
Clean and comfortable but not 'romantic' or exciting, just a place to stay!

title: Excellent nights sleep
text: Very warm welcome from reception. very clean room , comfortable and quiet. We were provided with freshly ground coffee and a small bottle of milk as a welcome. We had no problems at all at this hotel. I have noticed the other reviews but we saw no evidence of it being used as a hostel for homeless families. We slept all night, there was a little road noise but everything else was fine. The hotel in s across the road from  Speights Ale house , we popped across there for an excellent meal and great service. A great overnight stay.

title: Average
text: My stay at Anglesea was ok. There was a spa in room and it looked outdated and wasn't cleaned well. I had to clean it before I jumped in. overall the room was big, free internet, kitchen. It's was average, not bad not very good.
hotel_response:
Hi,
Thank you for your feedback, can u tell us your room number so we can have a look at it?

title: I REPEAT, DON'T STAY HERE!!!!
text: Like a few other later reviews here off late I have never had a hideous nights stay in my life.  My son and I stayed here mid June. I knew we were in for a bad night when we got back from dinner. I was approached by a couple of drunk teens outside side our room and told I had a wrong colour t-shirt.  At 10.30 at night the party started in the adjoining rooms.  Slamming doors, breaking beer bottles, abusive language, unruley children, car boom boom music.  This carried on til after 3.00am.  I did not report this to management as these people partying were the type to trash my car.  We generally felt unsafe.  I'm not into negative reviews but feel this is justified.

title: HOSTEL FOR HOMELESS FAMILIES
text:
WHATEVER YOU DO NEVER STAY HERE.

When we got to our room there were 8-10 poorly clothed children playing outside. It was plainly obvious that they were not on vacation but that the local council had housed them at the Anglesea Motel & Conference Centre. They were running around some very beaten up old cars parked outside our room. A group of teenage mothers were smoking outside of another room. The males in the vicinity did not inspire an atmosphere of happy holidays.

Worse still our room had an adjoining door with the room one of these families were staying in. I came to the conclusion that it would not be safe to leave anything in our room, that our car was not safe outside and that personally my wife and I were not safe. We left within the hour.

IT IS AN ABSOLUTE DISGRACE THAT THIS PLACE IS TRADING AS A MOTEL. IT IS NOT A MOTEL.

title: Most hoepless motel ever
text: I was staying in this motel with my family last month ago. The Chinese Manager is the biggest idiot ever. Everytime her rates are increasing for rooms and the most hopeless customer service she has. she hardly knows how to speak in english and she is given the responsibility to manage a motel.

title: Disappointing.
text: We booked this motel for a night away, we are from out of town.  We arrived to be told we were in C block.  We made our way over and went into our unit. It had a locked connecting door and while we were there the people on the other side were trying the handle. It was very noisy and outside there were people sitting around smoking and there were lots of kids running around. We didn't feel safe.  We complained at the office and the manager changed us to the B block. It was better but when we arrived back after our night out, the heat pump wouldn't work. We called the manager and he come over to fix it. It went but it was very noisy. The bathroom window was broken and it was jammed open, very cold.  The carpet was stained and the overall appearance was old and tired. The swimming pool was broken the trampoline was torn and the general maintenance has not been done.

title: Really enjoyable weekend visit
text:
Stayed one night here, would stay again. Good value, comfortable bed, huge tv, nice spa bath, very warm, and quiet. Got breakfast delivered to our room the next day which was on time and also very nice.

Complimentary little bottle of milk on arrival was a nice touch for my cup of tea!

Bit funny that the shampoo, soap, toilet paper, paper towels etc are all on dispensers but there was plenty of everything so can't really complain! Liked the compendium of room information and nearby eateries, a nice touch.

Would come again, would recommend.

title: OK
text:
The motel is very simple but functional. Rooms are easily large enough for three, have large televisions, a full kitchenette including electrical appliances, and a dining table. Unfortunately the cupboard space is extremely limited with no shelves for clothes and only enough hanging space for 4-5 shirts. The free wifi is very fast, and the laundry room is convenient for long stays. 
The bathroom is also large, but if you do not require a handicap accesible shower make sure you request an enclosed shower stall.
Some of the items are slightly dated, such as frayed towels, furniture, as well as the out of date small fitness center available down the road (but better than no fitness center at all).
Parking is plentiful and a large supermarket (countdown) is directly across the road.

title: Good value
text:
The Anglesea is a good motel but is getting due for some maintenance. Half the rooms are on the upper floor so if you have a wife that over packs like me you will have to carry the heavy suitcase up the stairs unless you book a ground floor.
The rooms are spacious and there is good kitchenette facilities.
The knowledge of the staff on the desk if fairly limited. When we enquired about tourist activities we were met with blank looks. A motel should be up to speed with tourist questions in a tourist destination like New Zealand 
The motel rate is competitive. There is a good supermarket across the road and it is walking distance (10-15 mins) to restaurants is you are after these. Speights Ale House is across the road and has really good meals. Dominos pizza is around the corner.

title: Would never stay here again
text: My partner and I booked in here for a quite weekend away. We were rudely woken by gang members at 2am parting and swearing very loud right outside our room. Many calls were made to reception in regards to this and nothing was done.. Absolutely ridiculous!

title: Faulty eqquipment
text: The room we had been given didnt have a working element and was replaced with a portable wall one that only had 1 element and with a famiky of four took forever to cook anything,aircon didnt work and we were super cold at night and my sons bed had mould stains on the sheets.Wouldnt return here as no refund or anything was given and wouldnt want my children getting sick because there was no heating!

title: Did the job
text: Myself and my partner stayed here in April. We were greeted in a friendly way and shown to our room promptly with very nice freshly ground coffee for the following morning. The room had everything we required for our one night stay, it was clean. The TV was fantastic, we had Sky Movies as well as Sport. The bed was comfortable and the hotel is located in a semi quiet area. I am a light sleeper and didn't get woken all night, which was great because it doesn't take too much to wake me up. The room could have had bedside lamps to make reading easier before bed, but it was manageable without. Very good security with the room, swipe card instead of a key. Good option to stay here if going to FMG Stadium because very close proximity. I will stay here again next time.

title: 3 Bedroom Townhouse - Comfortable and Spacious
text: Easy check in with friendly staff. The three bedroom townhouse was very spacious and warm with comfortable beds and an excellent kitchen/dining room space. Had a lovely balcony and got great evening sun. Wifi was fast and the unit was very clean - would happily go again! Location was excellent with the supermarket right across the road.

title: Average hotel
text: Unit was alright. Needs some cleaning and maintenance badly. Leak stain in the roof, switchboard cover taped on, light covers falling off etc. Bed seemed clean and good selection of channels. Definitely not a 4.5 star hotel. More like a 2-3.

title: Holoday
text: Fast checkin and checkout. Excellent front office staff and house keeping. Spa room was spacious. SPOTLESS!! Excellent position with a supermarket across the road and very close to the hub of town with amazing restaurants. Five star service as far as I  concerned. Highly recommended

title: Large comfortable room, fine for a short stay
text: The room was larger than I expected and the kitchen was adequate. Having a Countdown supermarket over the road was very handy. The motel is on a nice quiet street near town. Furnishings a little tired and I found the bathroom supplies in large "public toilet" type dispensers a little incongruous.   The bed was comfortable and the aircon quiet and efficient. I appreciated the free wifi which worked well in my room. Front desk staff were helpful enough and not unpleasant.

title: Best towels ever!
text:
We attended a wedding in Hamilton and wanted something close to the venue, but not too close (too many family members hahaha). We got to the motel and was really surprised about how big it is, clean and tidy. Their pool cleaner was even working in the rain, clearing the pool after all the rain and wind we've had. Our room was big, spacious and clean. But my favourite...the towels... We have stayed in plenty of hotels, motels and resorts in the past but never, ever, have we had towels this soft. I just wanted to walk around in it all day.

Friendly staff and helpful. Really a good place to stay for a good price.

My only negative was the mini fridge in our room. Made really annoying sounds every now and again and woke us up a few times during the night. However, wasn't that bad that I felt I had to complain :)

title: Great Value For Money
text:
Stayed for 2 nights, room clean and serviced well.  Very handy location with walking distance to all amenities. Reception and house staff friendly and helpful.
Kitchen equipped with necessary appliances.
Fresh ground plunger coffee given on arrival.

title: Two night stay
text:
I had to take my 22 year old daughter to Waikato Hospital for a cornea transplant so flew over from Perth to New Plymouth and we drove from New Plymouth to Hamilton the day before her surgery.

I only booked this place via Agoda one day earlier and thankfully there were still a few rooms available. I booked a spa room for us. The room itself had a Queen bed plus a single bed which my daughter slept on. I must say, I was very impressed with the entire room and hotel overall. It is really well serviced and equipped with a laundry ($3 per load for washer or dryer), air con, kitchenette with fridge and microwave, small dining table and chairs, laundry basket, and Countdown and Pak'n'Save a two minute walk away. 

It was only about a ten minute drive to the hospital - so well worth the location.

I would definitely stay again if required. Price good for what we got. It made the short trip enjoyable and stress free.

title: Room ok, reception a little cold
text:
Another work stay, can't complain about the room, clean, tidy, spacious, good bed, free wifi,  shower & spa bath. Close to town and the speights ale house is about 100mtr from reception.
Why I couldn't rate higher was that the reception lady whom was possibly Chinese or Japanese was as cold as a stone, didn't look up once, made me sign in and asked me if I wanted milk. I personally think as the reception is your you first point of contact, a better effort is required. This is not the first time I've stayed here and had a cold reception. Oh well they could do better, as far as that the rooms they are really good.
hotel_response:
Hi,
Thank you for the feedback. Sorry for the way we made you feel. We will definitely improve 
 the quality of our service team!

title: Awesome staff spacious rooms highly recommend
text:
Really enjoyed our stay we had to wait 2 hours after checkin time for our room to be cleaned .but that got sorted and we were allowed a late check out which was awesome. 
We also had a swim in the pool while waiting
The reception man was very helpful and friendly 
We stayed in the 3 bedroom townhouse which was townhouse 2 
It had flat screens in every room and 2 bathrooms
Just needing astrays and a few utensils that were missing but not worth complaining about because everything else was perfect.
Rats traps were a bit scary lol i recommend pest control for that one.
Thanks for having us!
Can't wait to come back

title: Did the job....
text: Good value for money all in all. It was very clean although the previous guest had obviously smoked inside....very evident when we turned on the sir conditioning unit and we found ash and matches in the back of the plastic table plant.... no complaint however with the way staff assisted in managing the discomfort of this, they were suitably empathetic and came and sprayed air freshner. We had two TVs with limited sky channels and unlimited free wifi.The bed was firm but comfortable but the pillows were a bit hard for my taste..... my partner was happy with them. Sadly they never delivered my ordered complimentary newspaper. In discussion with my partner we think in all, this was fine accomodation for the price and would recommend it particularly given easy walk to supermarkets and speights ale house!

title: Poor
text:
Our family of 6 stayed in the Townhouse apartment and it was lovely and spacious and appeared to have everything required. Upon preparing dinner the first night we discovered all the power points in the kitchen not working and in the master bedroom. Kitchen being an issue with toaster, jug , dishwasher etc not working.  I let them know early next morning in hopes while we were out all day it would be rectified but no. Spoke to manager this time and she was full of attitude.  We booked in for 5 days and at $350 a night I expected them to be more helpful. They did offer for us to move to the conference facilities but with being a large family, we didn't want to pack and move. They did get someone in the next day and all points  now worked. 
Our next major issue was coming back on the 3rd night to find an iPad and phone missing out of a drawer.  Of course when I let them know they fully backed their staff. They were the only people to have access to the room and all doors , windows etc were still locked. Issue was reported to.the police.
So overall it wasn't a total pleasure staying there. Some staff were lovely but others definitely need to learn some people skills. A few other issues were mouse/rat traps in room, leaking fridge,  lack of communication from staff (language barrier perhaps)unusable  rooms in apartment full of  junk.

title: Old, tired decor, rude reception woman
text:
We were greeted by a lovely, polite young man when checking in, who also gave us some freshly ground coffee (not enough for a cup but it's the thought that counts), but the total opposite when checking out! The Asian woman at the front desk was terribly rude, lacks customer service, no manners at all and needs to learn how to smile. Also, when trying to leave our room and just about to head down to checkout with arms full of luggage and kids in tow, the room phone rings and it's the reception lady asking me when I'm going to pay? Like, what? Checkout is 10am, it's only 9:45am, what do you think I'm going to do?

Very outdated rooms but reasonably clean. Comfy beds with clean sheets but not too sure about the blankets. We had a 3-bdrm apartment which was spacious and was reasonably priced at a reduced rate of $250 p/n. Had two bathrooms which was great for six people but a few of the soap and shampoo dispensers were empty. Had a bit of a freak out when I saw in the pantry a set mousetrap and a giant rat-trap and also another one beside the fridge, so every noise I heard throughout the night I thought was a rat! No dead rodents waiting for me in the morning, phew! 

Great location, supermarket just across the road. Reasonably well-equipped kitchen. Probably won't be back.

title: didnt clean when we chaecked in.
text: the bathroom was not clean left used soap and hairs in shower room and left unwashed dishes and cups in the dishwasher. the toilet was clogged up at first night. we booked a 3brm unit  but IT WAS a MANGERS HOUSE IT CALLED BY RECEPTIONIST. A secutiry video on the fridge which was shooting reception 24/7 and many smoked cigar left just beside of an entrance door. the unit was located next reception so just one door attached to reception and laundry so we had to pass the nasty air from there everytime when we were out and in.   Clealy the 3brm unit used by thier staff.  NO MICROWAVE NO PROPER KITCHEN EQUIPMENT NO dishsoap. the unit was located front of motel so bit noisy from cars. My trip was ruined at first day. because other original 3brm unit were next building.  A indian receptionist wasnt kind and unfriendly when we asked to use a microwave! NOT OUR FAULT

title: Okay for a short stay
text: We stayed here while in Hamilton for the Phoenix game in early December, because it's nice and close to the stadium (5 minutes walk). It was reasonably comfortable, clean and tidy, and not too badly priced for a night away.

title: Does the job
text: Down for a stag do and they accommodated us well. Nice enough rooms and the rooms were a good size but would have been better to have put two double beds in the room rather than one double bed and a single bed. Breakfasts are delivered to the door and them in the two days gave two different types of cooked breakfast. The Internet is free and very close to the centre of the town/rugby/cricket ground.

title: Should have moved on.
text: We stayed in the 2 bedroom townhouse. We requested the room for 4 adults. However the room was damp and dingy. The bathroom was unclean. The whole place had a damp smell about it. The lights in the lounge/kitchen were not all working. They did put in new lightbulbs when asked. The windows were really difficult to open and one door going outside form the bedroom would not open. The room was large and could be quite good but needs some urgent work done on it. We were offered other rooms but would have had to pay an extra $200 for the night.

title: Booked for 3 nights checked out after 1!
text: Room was dark,dank,cold and not particularly clean. The shower was an explosion! I think the cockroaches climbing the wall and ceiling outside my room topped off my stay. I had paid for 3 nights, checked out after my first night. The motel owner refused to credit my account for 2 nights and only refunded me 1 as I didn't give 24 hours notice. I will never stay here again. Very Poor.

title: good size but needs a lot of TLC
text: We stayed in the 3 bedroom townhouse that could very comfortably sleep 6.  The room size was great, but the unit was was in need of some TLC. The curtain rails were falling off, the bathroom windows wouldn't close and lights not working.  The kitchen was under stocked for kitchen utensil etc. For a family room there was not any bowls, lack of glasses, a real mismatch of wine glasses and cups. For $350 / night you would definitely expect a better quality of fit out. The kitchen equipment is something you could expect at avlow quality bach, not a motel/conference centre. A little disappointing and not worth the $350/night..more like $200 - $250/night.

title: Enjoying our stay
text:
Got room number 13 and it is as described...loved the spa bath...there were room enough for the two of us. 

The bed was comfortable with heating blanket. No lack of space and non gravelled parking area just outside, so perfect for bikers too 👍

title: Great night away
text: My husband and I booked into the Anglesea for the night, we have stayed here before, we had a wonderful night , the person we dealt with on the arrival was very friendly and we got a room upgrade.Right away I have special. This motel isn't is good location and will  definitely be back. Thank you

title: Great if you like mould
text:
Where do I start?

The guy behind the counter was reading the paper when I arrived. He didn't appear to be interested in interacting with customers. Eventually someone emerged from the back office. He was friendly enough - he spent a few minutes explaining how to use the room access card and offered me 2 litres of milk.

As I arrived at the door to my room I was confronted by an intoxicated one-armed man. It wasn't entirely clear whether he was a guest or a vagrant but it was unsettling to say the least.

If I had to describe the smell of the room I'd probably go with "Railway station public toilet" - a combination of cigarettes and industrial-strength cleaning products. 

The room was spacious but dark. The view through the stained net curtains was a parking lot and some dire looking flats. That was the highlight, really. Here's the rest in no particular order:

- The pillows clearly hadn't been washed. There were hairs and a head imprint on one of them. I didn't investigate the rest of the bed.

- The television didn't appear to work so it wasn't possible to drown out the traffic noise.

- The kitchenette appeared clean but there was a fork on the floor.

- The bathroom was mouldy, the mirror was marked, a lightbulb was out, the sink was unclean. This review is starting to sound like a Dr Seuss book.

- The toilet gets its own bullet point. It was... streaky.

I went back to the desk and admittedly wasn't super friendly about things and that didn't turn out very well for me so I got the hell out of there and stayed with friends.

I can't rank the sleep quality because I stayed elsewhere but I can't imagine that it would be anything other than disappointing.

title: Go somewhere else
text:
I found the older man at the reception rather rude from the get go, so this was not a great first impression. The younger man was more polite. The rooms themselves are dated and do have a musty smell. Living area wasn't so bad, but bathrooms need doing up. Kitchen was relatively well equip for cooking which was good. 

The second night of our stay, a boozy group were upstairs and made noise until 11.30pm, then were just as noisy as they returned at 4am. 

Bearable, but I would recommend another motel to stay in if you are staying more than one night.

title: Dirty Pool! Dirty Rooms! Arrogant Staff!
text:
Staff were very rude and arrogant! My room was not serviced on my second day and third day stay.Window in my bathroom was broken and had a black rubbish bag covering it!! I had no clean towels and had to ask which seemed like a hassel to them.
Had smokers outside my room where smoke was drifting into my room. Dirty pool!
This place is a disapointment! Dont stay here and ruin your holiday.

title: Dated, but clean
text:
Decor was a bit dated, but clean, and no complaints really for the price.  My unit had a broken bathroom window which they said was due to be fixed the following Monday.
Would stay again as it's very conveniently located and quiet.  Pleasant and helpful staff.

title: Not recommended
text: The reason for my 2 stars is based on the location otherwise this review would be 0/5. The people at reception were lovely but that's about it. The room was dated and stunk of cigarettes and mould. They'd left the windows open so maybe that was why. The shower leaked which resulted in a puddle on the floor and everything in sight soaked. Bed was nasty with terrible pillows. After a long day at a conference I was pretty disappointed to return to an unmade bed. I think it's time these owners put some money into the complex because I won't be back and will recommend others do not stay.

title: Smokey smelling room
text:
The room is well appointed and pleasant. It is like all a no smoking hotel. But in the past it clearly was not. I don't think the curtains have been cleaned for many a year, and it's probably these that the smell clings to. 
Reasonable value for money.

title: Full House in middle of city but very quiet
text: Motel was full and in the middle of much goings on at rugby park, squash courts and so on, but the room was quiet, comfortable and clean.  The car park outside the room was designated handicapped parking and we were not supposed to use it but the motel was full and there were no other car parking spaces?  The window in the bathroom was broken and taped up with plastic ok for the night as there was no wind but would have been an issue in a windy night allowing cold air in?

title: Terrible Townhouse
text: Good points - 1 Litre of milk on arrival, spacious accomodation. Bad points. Dangerous chemicals left in low cupboard, Cockroaches on the wall, bathroom was mouldy,  flooring was cracked, toilet seat was wobbly, shower was grimy and when you opened the shower door, it got caught on the shower mixer and turned off the water. ( I have seen public pool bathrooms in better shape). The chair in the lounge was broken and the two red couches had a film of dark grime on them. The main bed consisted of two singles pushed together and you couldn't lock the front door from the inside, not ideal when you have a busy toddler, we had to block the door off. No lightbulb in hall light and there was a cracked windowpane. No mattress was supplied with the portacot, not acceptable when the owner charges $30 a night for hireage. This place is definitely not worth $300 a night, the owners need to clean up their act and do some adequate maintenance, this townhouse could easily be transformed with some TLC.

title: Average
text: The rooms are pretty standard but fairly dated. Functional and clean but nothing rave about. the bathroom tiles need to be updated however there was a very comfortable spa bath. There wasn't enough body wash in the shower (they have wall mounted bottles) The tv in the bedroom wasn't tuned so I didn't bother in the end. On the plus side you can park right outside the unit and the units are fairly well sound insulated. It did the job but I wouldn't choose to stay again.

title: Average stay
text:
Good points : great service from the lady on reception, clean room on arrival, motel is very central, located on a quiet street, easy to find, loved the spa, there are a variety of rooms to choose from eg, studio, 1 bedroom, townhouses.

Bad points : booked online for 3 people, with a spa, & cooking facilities, but on arrival had been booked into a room with 1 bed. Was informed this happens regularly with online bookings. Was shown a room we could have but the bathroom window was broken so was given another room.
Cooking utensils included 1 small pot, & 1 big pot without a lid. It states that rooms are serviced daily- the first day the room was serviced, but the second day it wasn't fully serviced- everything got topped up but floor was dirty- not vaccumed. Theres no allocated parking so we would park next to our room but after a day out would have to park on the other side of the complex as the parks would be taken. There is only 1 washing machine & 1 dryer, not enough for the amount of units on site. There was no storage space, & there was no towel rack- just a hole in the wall where it used to be.

title: Wouldn't stay again
text: This place is not very good, there was hair in our spa bath from previous people who must've stayed, one of the roof tiles looks like it may fall in in the bathroom you can see up into ceiling and when we couldn't get the plug put from spa bath because it was broken it had no little handle the owner just said to use a knife from the kitchen to get it out... for the price of $140 for our little room it's definitely a rip off!

title: Terrible service and smelly rooms
text: I arrived to find a Faulty Towers Manuel like character who was at the front desk ranting about parking of vehicles attending a nearby conference who were not booked in the hotel however they had made an arrangement with his son apparently. I was booked at the hotel and attending said conference. His attitiude was very rude and unhelpful. As the owner he has no idea of customer service. I have stayed at many hotels and never experienced anything like it. The unit had no couch and smelled of cleaning products and was dark and dingy. Very close tot he road and could hear road traffic. The owner's station at the front desk is like the evil eye of Sauron, very scary!

title: 1 Night Stay and Golf
text: Convenient place to stay if you are visiting Hamilton or just passing through as we were. Booked Golf Package with 1 round at St Andrew's, good value and whole process was very easy. Nice clean room, well equipped, friendly staff.

title: Cheap and clean needs a little tidying up and lighting replaced.
text: Clean and decor tidy. However it does need to have some light bulbs replaced.  easy to get down town and straight across from Waikaito Stadium so great for anyone wanting to have a group going to the rugby.

title: Lovely place to stay
text: Very nice place to stay, clean and bed was comfortable, the free unlimited wifi was brilliant! Staff were very friendly and helpful. The spa bath was just what I needed after traveling a few days in full on rain. Would recommend to all when staying in Hamilton

title: It is ok.
text: We rented the 3 bedroom townhouse and it is a spacious and clean townhouse. But I was not impressed with the service. There were 3 couples renting the property. I was given 1 key for a 3 bedroom house-which defeats logic for me. That means the other 4 occupants cannot get inside without me. I asked for another key and the property manager said if I lose it I must pay $50. He REPETITIVELY said this as if I couldn't understand him the first time. First of all, why would you just give 1 key for a 3 bedroom townhouse?? I understand single units have 1 key but not for a 3 bedroom townhouse. You must ration the keys to the # of bedrooms. So as you can imagine, it caused issues with who is coming home first and who must carry the key.

title: Over Priced for a run down Motel. Queen Beds were two singles pushed together.
text:
Over Priced for a run down Motel. Queen Beds were two singles pushed together. Motel manager was unhelpful and aggressive. He wanted to charge us $35 per day to use the BBQ.
He wouldn't put two beds into one room and charged us $300 per night for a two bed room apartment with single beds pushed together.

title: ok
text:
After booking online and travelling from Auckland, the motel hadn't received our reservation. Luckily something was able to be done and we secured our room.
Jacuzzi in the room didnt work and didn't get cribs we requested .

title: Nice and Quiet
text: Large rooms, close enough to the main drag that a taxi is cheep but far enough away that you can get a good nights sleep. Reasonably priced. Slightly dated interior. Air conditioning was amazing. Would stay here again.

title: Great time in Hamilton
text:
Excellent location. 5-10 minutes walk into town.  Have great arrangement with local gym.
Lovely staff very friendly
Wonderful cooked breakfast in our room delivered on time.
Best nights sleep in years!!  Bed was so comfortable.

title: Horrible!!
text: We stayed 1 night in January 2016. Blanket had a blood stain, the the rain came through the wall, yes the wall!!and soaked the carpet near the bed. Dead Rat outside the window and the pool looked like it hadnt been cleaned for a very long time. Worst place iv ever stayed. Stayed at Camelot the next night which was very clean, will definetly be staying there whenever we are in Hamilton.

title: great stay possible suggestion for the summertime pests tht creep into yr room..
text: We found that mosquito &sand flys also guests in our room..suggestion maybe aero spray guard in room.. automatic dispenser to eliminate any biting or flyin Insect.. otherwise enjoyed our stay, clean tidy lovely hospitable stay

title: Family getaway
text:
Polite and helpful staff.  
NIce clean rooms.     
A pleasure to stay here with my family many times.  
Location handy and walking distance to the main shopping area.
Quiet surroundings.            
Recommend to stay here.

title: Bungalo Accomodation
text: Comfortable accommodation , very friendly owners/staff. Easy flat walk to the beach (less than 50m) and shops , dining (about 7 minute walk). Good to wake up to the sound of the ocean in the morning. Basic cooking facilities including microwave. Peaceful and quiet at night all in all a comfortable , relaxed stay.

title: Great location and adorable Motel!
text: The location  can't be better... beautiful balcony view surrounded by lovely trees. So relaxing and a short walking distance to Countdown, Wellmart and other shopping centres. Not only was the room and surroundings clean, but the staff were really nice, friendly and wiling to help out with anything. We were given a lovely breakfast too!

title: best of hamilton
text:
feel like my home.
perfect stay. a year round destination
executive accommodation close to super market restaurant golf course and culture centre.
we stayed spa bath unit  for 5 night, staff is very kind, helpful , efficient.

title: Subhas c. Naidu
text: Very well set up .excellent communications with reception and staff.rooms are always clean and tidy and full of all the requirements. Great location, shopping and other facilities are within working distance .Hamilton is such a beautiful place, one who sees Waikato river as if you are standing on the banks of Ganges (Ganga).During my stay the temperature went up to 30 ,cool air conditioned rooms were so nice.I love to return there again.

title: welcoming, clean and relaxing  expereince
text: Fantastic Experience at Anglesea Motel & Conference Centre:  I attended a Medical Conference at Anglesea and was impressed by the conference venue which had a bright, sunny outlook overlooking a tree lined avenue.  There was heaps of onsite parking which was a huge bonus.  The facilities were first class as was the delicious catering( i am vegetarian and i was well provided for).   I took advantage of the discounted Conference Accommodation Package and spent the night at the motel.  My accommodation was comfortable, clean, and very peaceful! The next day I drove to The Base  , which is a major shopping center ( got some great Christmas bargains!) .  I would highly recommend staying at Anglesea Motel not just for the accommodation, or  Countdown supermarket/Filling Station across the road but also for the   pleasant staff/reception.

title: PLEASANT ATMOSPHERE
text: Our stay at Anglesea motel was an enjoyable experience. The staff were friendly and always ready to help. Located near a handy shopping centre and still able to enjoy the peace and quiet. Would not hesitate to recommend to all my friends.

title: Evening Function
text: This is our second stay at this motel and both times we were extremely impressed, we love the quiet peaceful area, a walk to shops and a large supermarket, the room we had was spacious, clean hot showers, TV and even a dishwasher, Marc & Joyce as operators go out of their way to put on a superb function, with a comfortable ambiance, their manager Dylan is clued up and very helpful, I would recommend a stay there if your are passing through Hamilton, I am looking forward to going there again as this is my choice of motel in Hamilton.

title: Lovely!
text: We stayed here and held our NZ engagement party in the conference centre as my fiance's family live in Hamilton. Everything was perfect - the decorations were beautiful and the food was amazing. The staff organised everything for us as we are in Melbourne and we're so grateful. Thanks to Marc, Jorce and Dylan. Our room was big clean and comfy too! Would definitely recommend.

title: Evening Function in Conference Room.
text: Attended a formal function held in the Conference Room at Angelsea Motel. Great ambience with good lighting and sound system. The room was spacious and confortable and well presented for the special evening. Food that the motel had catered was excellent and service good. I think it is a great venue fof personal and official functions. There is also ample parking on the premises and the location is great as it is in the city and close to shopping centres, supermarkets, gyms, sports stadiums and theatre.

title: One Night Stay
text:
Motel was in a great locality with a supermarket across the road & The Waikato Ruby Stadium,  Cricket Grounds, The Center Place Mall are in walking distance..  Plenty of Restaurants  nearby. and walk able.
Have attend couple of function the Conference Room.  Both these functions were set out really well.  Food supplied for Morning, Lunch and Afternoon breaks were delious with a great selection been offered  of healthy foods to choose from.  
Parking at the motel was good.    Great service and friendly owners..  Lovely breakfast delivered to my room.  Good lighting around the parking area at night. .  Being solo I felt safe and secure staying at this Motel.

title: Overnight stay at Anglesea Motel
text: Very nice stay and made to feel welcome - thank you. Room was very clean and comfortable. It was also great being able to walk around the corner to get a pizza and across the road to the supermarket.  There was also a restaurant in close proximity if we wanted to go out for a meal.

title: Don't book at this place
text:
Dont waste your hard earned cash here. This place is extremely horrible, amenities are total junk. As soon as we entered the hotel it had a very bad smell and the nasty smell continued in the hotel room
A lot of upgrading and detail general cleaning is required. Our family decided to book hotel somewhere else as this place was a total disaster. The hotel owners are liars and trying to hide their reputation by saying that we had family feud. Instead the hotel owners had a bad feud themselves and were trying to cover this up. The appearance of the lady at the front desk was pathetic, she wasnt friendly and wore dirty clothes.  My family didnt use anything at this hotel as they refused coz the toilets were very dirty and smelly. It seemed that this room was never cleaned and was handed over to the next guest. Please dont book here.

title: AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COST
text: False advertising,  what you see on their website is definitely not what you get. Do not book this place. It stinks, very filthy, very deceiving. This place needs upgrading,  everything is old and crazy,  extremely dirty. The hotel owners are cheats and not friendly at all. We booked hotel as the pictures looked appealing.  We didn't like the place so we decided to go within the 30 mins the owners charged us $300 for nothing and accused us of using their toilet while we didn't even use it and charged us $300.
hotel_response:
This guest reviewed under the name of “Mezigurl”  but the room booked under ‘Ali Nazeem’ at our motel as is obvious appears to be uploaded by the guest retaining a grudge towards our management team.
This Indian Family, 2 couples and a baby arrived at our Motel in a blazing family argument amongst themselves. They were loud and unruly in their manner with a crying baby. They booked a two bed room Townhouse for 3nights, one of the men paid in advance and collected the keys to the house, some members of the group went into the house except for one person who was refusing to leave the car(we later discovered that he was the son).
 An hour later, the same individual returned to the reception wanting to cancel the booking and wanting full refund. We explained to him that he will have to pay for 1 nights cancelation fee, for which he was not happy and started to blackmail us by saying he would put a bad review if we charge him. Meanwhile, the manager and member of the staff inspected the house, the family had already used the toilet facilities and washed hands and face and had used the toilet rolls and flannel towels. We tried to explain to them that he has already checked in and used the facilities. We also informed him of our motel policy of cancelation which is 24 hours prior to booking, hence we charged him for 1 night. He then began to fabricate a lie saying that the room was not up to his standard and had bad odour. Meanwhile, a member of our staff had a discussion with his son, only to find out that the family wanted to cancel the rest of their trip and head home due to their family feud. 
It is very disappointing that a person should fabricate a lie and try to blackmail the motel for following the rules. In all fairness the individual did not fit good hygienic standards to have the audacity to say the room was smelly, when he himself carried an intolerable body odour. This may have been the smell he was referring to!

title: Stopping in Hamilton?
text: We arrived later in the evening...looking for a place to rest our heads overnight.  Initially the price was higher than we had wanted, but after taking a look at the room (It included a spa tub and a kitchenette) and chatting at length with the friendliest and most helpful attendant at the desk, we decided to stay here.  And this morning, we decided to stay a second night....that speaks for itself.

title: Well worth a visit
text:
Immaculate rooms and comfortable beds. The manager was very friendly and I enjoyed my stay. Loved the breakfast too.
Good comfortable accommodation close to downtown and great value for money.
I cannimagine this is geary if you were going to an event at the stadium as it is right behind the motel.. but it would also be a little noisy on game night if you wanted to sleep..

title: Was everything we needed
text: We booked directly with the motel because I wanted to ensure that we got what we wanted for out romantic two night escape.  We stayed here because I had heard that they have 'total black-out' curtains, quiet location, and comfortable beds, and they certainly lived up to our expectations.  We were on the upper floor of the block next to reception, in a Spa Bath Studio, and we were able to park the car right outside at the bottom of the stairs.  The fittings were slightly dated, but the studio was roomy, clean, quiet and comfortable.  There were no cooking facilities in our studio, but we were eating out so that didn't bother us at all.  There was a toaster, kettle, fridge and crockery/cutlery; table and chairs, two bucket seats and a good choice of TV channels.  We loved the spa bath, the shower was powerful, and there were ample towels, which were changed daily.  We stayed on a Sunday and Monday night, and didn't hear any noise from neighbours overnight.  We would stay here again because it perfectly suited our requirements, although next time we would bring our own soft pillows.

title: conference room
text: It was a good experience in overall .The room is spacious and can accommodate around 50 people.It  has got essential utilities with attached Kitchen.Moreover,it is near to the city and easily accessible.

title: New Zealand visit
text: I found this Motel and was very happy with it. So happy I stayed 3 nights. Very good location and close to supermarket and eateries. Close enough to the centre of town for a walk. Very clean and staff very helpful

title: Didn't receive our booking
text: Booked through Booking.com 4 days in advance.  Arrived to staff telling us they didn't receive and that I should have called them to confirm.  Very confrontational as to who's fault it was.  We were told that there were no more family rooms available which contradicted what booking.com's website said.  They suggested we give them an hour whilst they quickly clean a room for us.  We really struggled with the whole thing so we left.

title: Excellant
text: We have been doing a golf weekends now for the last 5 years, this place is great and value for money. The Town houses are best for bigger groups. The range of Golf courses in the area is awesome and they will arrange the games

title: Shopping Weekend
text: Overall experience was good. Townhouse 4 was very big and plenty of room for 7,  very central to supermarket, local restaurants etc,  Plenty of parking.  Cleaned daily.  Staff very approachable, few things needed maintenance but we were provided everything we asked for.  On arrival, payment was requested by the Manager in full by the first person to arrive.  Would not split the bill and let us pay individually.  Maybe some warning on this prior to arrival would have been good as we could have sorted so that one person did not have to outlay the total amount.

title: Two nights on Business
text:
I love staying here. One of the main draw cards being that the Speight's Ale House is right across the road, the bills for which, you can have added to your accommodation bill. Just show your key to the cashier on your way out. I opted not to do it that way as I wanted to track each expense individually. But if your stay is non-business, it would make things much simpler.

It was my first stay in an Executive Suite. Not flash 5 star, but then it is a Motel and adds extra homeliness with a separate bedroom. And with the Executive Suite comes a few extra features, like sporting/recreational facilities. Not that I used them this trip but someday I might.

Overall an excellent experience.

title: Top Stay for a group
text: Service was top notch and the rooms were very clean and serviced each day with everything restocked. Staff were excellent to deal with and there was nothing that was to much trouble to do. With our group of 22 very happy customers

title: Handy
text: More than adequate for a short term at short notice stay in Hamilton.  Heat pump not working in the room, but the management quickly provided an alternate heater which was more than adequate, and advised they would look at the problem.

title: Lots of space, but very cold!
text: It had a huge kitchen, and was very well stocked with appliances/utensils.  Bedrooms were roomy, too.  But we visited in the winter, and the heating system was entirely inadequate to heat such a large area.

title: A wonderul stay
text:
Was a pleasant stay for a get away, hubby and I found the room comfortable and tidy, and the service was great, we will be back!
Location good for our business needs being close to town and we found the restaurant chargeback options really helpful.
The spa was lovely to use at the end of the night.
We found countdown good across the road too.

title: Pleasant stay in good area
text: If you want a place to stay for a business trip this would get my recommendation. Convenient for everything and over the road from a Speights Ale house. Spa bath can wind away your troubles whilst the fast wifi will enable you can keep on top of the inbox.

title: Very nice and clean
text:
I've stayed at the Anglesea a few times, and it never disappoints. Always clean and comfortable. The location is very good, near two big supermarkets and walking distance (5-10 minutes) from just about everywhere in the Hamilton CBD.

It's not the cheapest option around, but there's no denying the quality.

title: Disappointed!!!!
text: An excited group of 10 Mums in their 30's booked two three bedroom town houses to stay at while attending a concert in Hamilton. We received a booking confirmation e-mail 2 days prior to our arrival. We replied to this e-mail asking what time check-in was and that part of the group would be arriving earlier than 4pm which we initially stated. We did not get a reply to this e-mail which they said they did not receive. We got a call from the other half of our group to say they were unable to check in unless both rooms were paid in full. But it says on the booking confirmation that payment is required on departure??? And... they have a credit card number for security? When I arrived with the rest of the group the man in reception was extremely rude. He made us feel like we were 15 year olds who were going to trash the hotel, leave without paying and receive complaints from the neighbors from being too noisy. Regarding noise, all that needed to be said was "there are solicitors offices under the apartment, please be mindful of noise levels". We did not need to be threatened! The apartments were spacious and comfortable but we had to switch the batteries from remote to remote due to some not having any, in the other apartment only a couple of them got hot showers, there was no milk for our cuppa in the morning (maybe because it was a townhouse? but it would have been nice for them to inform us). We are pretty understanding about these small things but do not like unfriendliness, rudeness or being spoken to like we did. The woman at reception in the morning was much more polite. We have stayed at this premise some years ago on several occasions staying in the town houses within the motel complex (not the ones we did this time across the road). As we live an hour and a half from Hamilton but it is our main center, we always recommend these great 3 bedroom apartments but NOT anymore. I would be embarrassed to recommend this motel to friends and family. Very disappointed!!

title: very average
text: Asked for a room on top floor,got bottom floor and a room around the side with no sun at all.Room had spider webs on the wall and a fly buzzing around when we got in.The man in reception was not very welcoming

title: Modern & comfortable
text: Awesome, modern studio spa unit that suited all our needs- was very spacious, warm and comfortable.While there seemed to be many other guests, we didn't hear much noise from anyone else😀.We arrived just after 10pm and were tired and received a warm and hearty greeting.

title: Lovely place in Hamilton
text: My girlfriend and I stayed there as it was close to where we were visiting. The staff were very obliging as we needed a ground floor room as my friend couldn't walk to far. The room we had was lovely and clean, it had a double & a single bed in it. The beds were very comfortable. We would stay there again and would certainly recommend them.

title: Quiet weekend
text: My husband & I stayed Saturday & Sunday night at The Anglesea in a studio spa unit. We found it clean and tidy and it was quiet and comfortable, with everything we needed, including a very good kitchenette.  We enjoyed the motel's cooked breakfast, one of which was enough for the two of us to share. We also found the motel location very convenient to supermarkets, to lots of restaurants in town and for a walk along the river pathway.

title: Golf package
text:
On our way from the Bay of Islands to Rotorua my wife and I decided to arrange a stop over in Hamilton. We booked a one day Golf Package at the the Anglesea Motel on Saturday, 14 February. The accommodation could not be faulted and compared very favourably with more expensive places we stayed in. The advice given at check-in was both polite and helpful.
Our golf at St Andrews Golf Club was very enjoyable especially as the course was very quiet especially for a Saturday afternoon.
The Golf Stay and Play Package at a cost of 170 NZD for our Spa Studio room with free internet and modern kitchen facilities together with our round of golf - green fees 50 NZD each - made this stay an exceptional value for money and I would thoroughly recommend both the Anglesea Motel and St Andrews Golf Club.

title: Not what I booked
text:
Booked online via their own website a couple of weeks in advance. It was a Weekend Spa deal for $130 for the night.
When I arrived, I was charged $140 and the room didn't have a Spa bath. Wasn't what I booked and was more expensive. Not happy.

title: A Curate's Egg
text:
We didn't receive a warm welcome, the reception chap asked us to pay up-front because people ran off without paying in Hamilton & had stolen TV sets in the past... not sure I had room in my luggage, or the desire to ship back a tv to the UK....

On the plus side:
The room was spacious
The blackout curtains were great
The room was surprisingly quiet given the motel's positioning
It had air-con (albeit capricious)

On the down side:
The whole complex was tired
The so-called swimming pool was a plunge-pool
The bedroom was seriously dated, the bedspread must have dated back to the 70's
The furniture was in need of sprucing up a bit

I can't put a finger on it but we left less than happy, even though on paper the motel should score, we can't give it an above average rating

title: Excellent
text: I stayed here for one night with my 8 month old baby. Even though the room was upstairs and I had to carry everything up, the room was clean and tidy. Was very warm in the bedroom which meant we had to sleep with the window open and there was a lot of road noise.  Other than that reception was excellent and willing to help.

title: The small things ...
text:
Hi

Unfortunately Angelsea let itself down with small things:

1. Door locks falling out of bathroom doors - no way of closing it properly or locking it
2. Window lock on balcony slide window not capable of being locked - no sense of security
3. No soap or shampoo in the machines in the shower
4. The shampoo for the shower was situated above the wash basin - no good for in the shower!
5. TV in bedroom was clearly not connected to any SKY or Freeview - why have a TV in there that doesn't work?

title: Great Stay!
text: Went to Hamilton for an event at the Waikato Stadium (Easy walk Very close by)  Unit 32 was very tidy and well kept. Bed comfortable and the air conditioning unit was brilliant as it was mid summer.  Nice and quiet even with folk walking past after the event. People at the front desk great! Well recommended. Countdown right across the road. They also offer Blokes weekend away and Girls weekend away packages. Looked good value for groups.

title: Be wary - choose your room carefully
text:
We stayed in the unit across the road above an accounting firm. We weren't offered the wi-fi password and received a single carton of milk for 6 people. 

Be aware you are unable to leave your car outside your unit - it must be parked in the main complex back across the road, apparently it's "safer" there. There is no lift available either, so don't have too much gear. 

The unit is large and with a lovely outdoor deck that is also under cover. It's a bit on the grubby side, and there were a few bugs about (bush roaches mainly) so wear shoes. 

The rooms in the unit are all good sizes, but very shabby. The single beds we had were comfortable enough and the linen was clean. Not much in the way of spare blankets or pillows - and certainly nowhere near enough for 6 people in the rooms. There was one bedside light to share between three bedrooms, and no access to turn off the main light from near the beds. One power point for each room, and not in the most convenient of places, being behind one of the beds in our room. We didn't try to use the venetian blinds as they were very dodgy-looking. I can't comment if they worked or not. 

While we were looking for spare blankets/pillow, we found tools and paint in the storage cupboard, so one hopes it will be used soon to smarten up the peeling and dated paint. 
There are 2 bathrooms. Bathroom 1 (behind the kitchen) was used as a storage area for things like an ironing board, a couple of chairs and old fluro tubes. Bathroom 2 (across the 'entry' room) had a vacuum cleaner stored in the access hallway, one lock was on the inside (as you'd expect) but the other door lock was on the outside, so in the bedroom, meaning you can't lock the door from inside the bathroom. However, they were clean enough I guess and with good water pressure. A bit of attention to the mould at the bottom of the shower doors would have been nice. Not very generous with toiletries or towels. 

The kitchen would be better stayed out of quite frankly. There were dirty glasses in the cupboard, doors hanging off their hinges, a filthy oven and no fire extinguisher - just the space where it had once been.

The lounge was adequate, but let's hope you like a lot of light - the only lighting being 4 fluro tubes, so it sure is bright! There were three remotes for the tv - two were the wrong ones (A Sanyo and a Panasonic - the TV was a Phillips) and had no batteries. It took quite a while to figues out how to use the TV and we had to turn it off at the wall. It takes about 3 or 4 minutes to come back on, and the volume is at full - just a warning....

It can be quite noisy, as delivery and rubbish trucks are around quite late at night and start very early in the morning. 

No, would not be keen to stay here again. I have no knowledge of the motel itself though, and other reviews for that part of it are good.

title: Home away from home!!!
text: No need to search any other places to stay in Hamilton Angelesea is the place to stay our families stayed their and we all loved everything about it excellent rooms very spacious, tidy, clean, excellent service excellent everything

title: Agony at Anglesea
text:
We booked 3 bedroom unit for6 people. On checking in we were directed to unit across road behind Solicitors office. No parking there during business hours. Ground floor was concrete. Upstairs was dirty, holes punched in walls. refrigerator stank badly...rotten prawn smell.
We immediately gave keys back, obtained refund of rent and found alternate accommodation  close by. Very disappointing!!

title: Golf trip
text: We took up the golf package on offer.makes for an easy organised golf trip.Pay for your accomadation and your golf is free and 10 courses to choose from.They have a 2 story house across the road that sleeps 6 and a garage to store your trailer/golf gear.Raewyn sorted all our t offs and was really helpful.Overall can't fault it.

title: Great Location, facilities and staff
text: I have stayed here often solo on business, for leisure with my wife and twice as part of a 16 man golf trip and have never been disappointed. My most recent visit was 7th November 2014 on business. The location is great, plenty of free parking and just a 10 minute walk to the CBD for shopping, dining and the Casino (there is a courtesy van that will pick you up and take you to the Casino). Nearby there is a Speight's Ale House bar for casual dining and friendly, family atmosphere. I have stayed in a studio room, a spa room and for the golf trips, in the apartments across the road. All are clean and roomy with excellent facilities. It is located on a quiet street with a large supermarket and gas station just across the road.

title: Badminton group
text: Was a great spot to stay i will recommend that the cleaners pay a little more attention to the finer details in the bathrooms about once a mth. In behind the toilet along the walls/tiles around the showers edges and along the glass door of the shower needed a clean with tooth brushes to remove moulds and build up of gunk. A laundry in the apartments would also have been handy. But over all pretty good Thanks Pauline

title: Very spacious 3 bedroom unit but......
text:
Stayed for 6 nights in a 3-bedroom/2 bathroom unit over the road from the main complex.  But had to park in the main complex, as the spaces by the unit were reserved for the staff in the office below the apartment.  There were six of us in the unit, and we each had a single bed, which was a plus.
