However, the furniture in the bedrooms was minimal, no sets of drawers, and one of the bedrooms did not have a wardrobe. The blinds were very tatty and should be replaced.  Lounge furniture extremely dated too.  Bathrooms did have good shower pressure.  Plenty of cups, plates, glasses (though nothing matched).  The unit was serviced each day, plenty of towels/tea towels/ coffee sachets/sugar etc.  As we were competing in a sporting event, it was necessary to have access to the laundry - ONE washing machine and ONE dryer for a complex of 40+ units.  Needless to say, it was very frustrating when the washing machine was broken, but after a lot of discussion, we were offered the use of the Motel's commercial washing machine.   It seemed odd that the unit should be so large, and not have it's own laundry.  
Countdown supermarket next door was an advantage, though we did get woken early by the rubbish trucks!  Not the motel's fault.
Would I stay again????? Probably not.

title: Wedding base
text: Friends recommended this motel as a base for wedding guests. Very good choice. Quiet, clean, comfortable bed, close to food outlets, easy walk to shops and main roads.  Friendly service. Would definitely stay again. Gail D.
hotel_response: Thank you for your lovely review Gail, we are glad that you enjoyed your stay with us and we look forward to seeing you again on your next visit to New Zealand

title: Always a good option
text:
Always a good option, close to the city, without the noise & far enough away for the quiet, but without being isolated.

Good Clean accommodation, with comfortable beds & a friendly service.

I would give it a 4*, except for 2 things:-
1. The units could do with some slight cosmetic upgrading, as they are starting to look tired (mirrors, with black edges, as if chipped - just a sign of age), otherwise not shabby.

2. Previous owners used to give arriving guests a mini bottle of wine or a beer on arrival - don't expect this with the new owners though.

Don't get me wrong - I'm not knocking the accommodation - it's actually one of my places of choice to stay at - give it a go - I'm sure you won't be disappointed.

title: Roomy but Poorly Maintained
text:
Our party of 5 stayed in the 3-bedroom apartment over the road from the main complex.  Very roomy, and included a double garage with automatic door.  However:
Seems to be not well serviced and maintained.  Various bits of rubbish in the garage, like old food containers.  Bedside lamp didn't work in the main bedroom.  Two bedrooms had TVs, but these were old analogue models - so didn't work at all.  And finally, the wifi password wouldn't work (5 people tried, including two teenagers, and we double checked with the owner.)  So no wifi at all.

title: Noisy Tired Room
text:
Sadly, this motel is very tired. The fan in the bathroom hummed louder than a 747 jet. The general feel was not good. Small chips and dents. For $155/night, this was not worth it. The TV was old and had lines running through the picture. The ironing board was quite rickety.
If you are staying in Hamilton - do not stay here!

title: Average
text: Checked in to a one bedroom apartment, quite spacious but the dining table was so wobbly it couldn't be used, glad I worked that out before attempting to put a hot drink on it. Moved into the townhouse for two nights with 5 other women, staff argued we had asked for the beds not to be separated, unsure how they expected us all to bunk in when the beds come apart easily to accommodate separate sleeping. When we asked to have the beds changed we had an angry response including some words that shouldn't be used in customer service.  One small box of milk for 5 of us, heat pump didn't work and neither did dishwasher. Staff that worked at motel were friendly and helpful.
hotel_response: I am very sorry to hear that you had this experience with us.  The table and the heat pump have been fixed since you left and the dishwasher, now that I have been made aware of it will be sorted out as well.

title: Warm and comfortable
text:
Our room was light and airy, warm and comfortable - what more could you ask for on a crisp Hamilton night.

Staff very friendly.

Located close to Speights Ale House which is a great place to hang out in the evening and within walking distance of the Waikato River.
hotel_response: Thank you for your lovely review, we look forward to you staying again on your next visit.

title: Very Good
text: The hotel has just been taken over by new owners who are still finding there feet. The rooms are clean and tidy but will need upgrading in a short period of time. Room 10 has a dodgy bed and some of the remotes for the TVs would benefit from battery replacements; but apart from that all good, excellent staff and handy quite location for supermarkets and eating houses.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review.  The upgrading of rooms is a work in process here at the Anglesea at present and will be a continuing focus for us.

title: Anglesea Hamilton
text:
Staff not so friendly, don't seem too happy with large groups, but room was very clean and the spa bath was very convenient. After a bit of convincing, managed to order breakfast.... Did not offer milk. You have to ask...
Just on the outside of the city, bit of a walk to town, not too far though to Casino.
Lots of Restaurant’s  to pick from down the main street.
Don't forget to plug in the electric blankets if you are staying there in the winter.
hotel_response: I am happy to hear that you were pleased with your room and yes our spa baths are wonderful at the end of a long day.  I am disappointed to hear that you were not happy with the level of service you received it is something that I have bought to the attention of all staff as an area that needs to be improved upon.

title: Amazing spa and soak
text: Spacious room large enough to swing two cats around with a queen bed. Best spa and soak with bubbles, spent long relaxing soak before bed and before breakfast. Rejuvenated. Close city location. Comfortable. Cooking amenities, cook top and microwave. Warm and snug with electric blanket.
hotel_response: Thank you for your lovely review, it's wonderful to hear that you made good use of our fantastic spa bath rooms, the spa baths are lovely, large and very relaxing at the end of a long day.

title: Don't want to tell you all....
text:
Don't want to let the cat out of the bag coz I don't want everyone beating us to the bookings.  Staff were lovely.  Location was ideal.

One of the family units was great for our All Black crew.  It was based across the road from the Motel.  It had lots of space and had it's own deck and bbq.  Plenty of parking and like other reviews said, it's so close to the stadium, supermarket and Speights bar.  Next time we'll get there earlier to use the tennis courts which were a hop skip and a jump away.

I think I lost my bearings in town and I had just bought a couple of pies from the bakehouse.  Taxi only cost me $6.

Definitely stay there again.  Damn!!! Cats out of the bag.
hotel_response: Thank you for your lovely review, we certainly don't mind you letting the cat out of the bag.  It's great to hear that you enjoyed your stay with us and we look forward to seeing you on your next visit.  If the weather isn't great for tennis bring your squash racquets as all guests have access to the squash courts as well.

title: Great Place to stay..Especially for the All Blacks game
text: Our room was comfortable. Lovely & warm with Heat pump.Only a short stroll to the Stadium & Supermarket & Bar on each corner Only 1 thing wrong on Sunday we had no hot water for a shower which was disappointing as it let the room down..
hotel_response: Thank you for your lovely review.  I am very sorry to hear about you not having hot water on the Sunday, I wasn't aware of this issue at all so I will organise for the plumber to come and look at our system this morning to check for any faults.

title: Value for money.
text: Nice quiet room, great location and clean. Handy to stadium, supermarket & business centre. Slightly dated curtain nets & bed covers - need a bigger bin for kitchen rubbish. Overall good value & ample parking.
hotel_response: Thank you for review, We are very glad you enjoyed your stay.  We are currently working through updating our rooms which is a work in progress.

title: Impressed
text: Stayed here for one night in the 3 bedroom apartment.  Check in was easy and the girl at reception was friendly and helpful. The motel was sold out because of the All Blacks game and you can see why, it is very close to the stadium, just a short walk down the road. There is also supermarkets close by and the Speights Ale House just over the road.  We thought we might have to park car on the road as the motel was pretty full but they found us a place to park inside the complex.  We were really impressed with our apartment. It was huge, large dining / lounge area and large bedrooms which all had TV's in them.  The beds must've been super king, lots of room and quite comfy too. The only downside was in the kitchen, the oven door didn't close properly.  All in all, a very nice  stay.  Would definitely stay here again.
hotel_response:
Hi Nat,
Thank you for your lovely review, our townhouses are fantastic for large groups and families and having the number of amenities as close to us as we do makes lives for guests so much easier.  I will have the oven door checked and fixed now that you have bought it to our attention.

title: Great place to stay
text: Awesomely quiet room, great location and very clean.  Only downfall is checkout is at 10am and cleaner opened the door and started heading into the room just after 9 when we were still in bed (no knock, just key in door and opened the door), perhaps they need a better system so that they know someone is still the room.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review, as a result I have reminded the housekeepers of our policy to knock and wait at every door before entering any room they are sent too.  We are glad you enjoyed your visit with us and we look forward to seeing you again soon.

title: Excellent
text:
Stayed on night to go to a show at the Founders Theatre. Was easy walking from Motel, Motel was really comfortable and had everything we needed. Our Studio room was huge.
Went to the Helm Bar and Bistro for dinner that was an easy stroll
hotel_response:
Hi Sharon,
We are very pleased that you enjoyed your stay with us, we pride ourselves on the size and comfort of our rooms. Our proximity to Founders Theatre takes away all the hassle of attending some of the magnificent events they have, no need for parking or taxis when it is only a very short stroll to the theatre.

title: Well-appointed inner city motel
text: We were looking for a place close to the city with parking and the Anglesea was perfect. The room was spacious and well-appointed (tea/ coffee/ hot chocolate, iron, ironing board, kettle, microwave, toiletries, tissues etc). Parking was free and plentiful. It was about 20 minute walk to the restaurants at the end of Victoria St we were headed but there were some much closer. Highly recommended.
hotel_response:
Hi Emma,

It is lovely to hear that you enjoyed your stay with us and we look forward to seeing you on your next visit.

title: Great on game day
text: We stayed one night, Chiefs vs Lions ( Go the Chiefs). The location is great,very handy to stadium, supermarket and short walk to town. Staff were very accommodating. Will definitely stay again soon :-)
hotel_response: Thank you for your review Paula, we look forward to seeing you for the next home game

title: Business Stay
text: Have been staying here for quite a few business appointments. Clean basic rooms and facilities. WiFi a bit week, devices very slow to do anything, stifled work that needed to be done. Breafast was late on the first morning forgotten on the second morning. Not good if you need to be out of there at a certain time. Not sure if i will stay here again if in Hamilton for further business.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to place a review we appreciate feedback in order for us to know if there are areas that we need to focus on.  We are currently upgrading our wifi boosters to give a stronger all round signal.  We also have ultra fast broadband hardwired into every room for which cables are available at reception if required. We are also working with our cook to find a way in which to streamline our breakfast system in order to make sure the problem that you had with breakfast does not happen again.

title: Weekend stay
text: We stayed 2 nights while in Hamilton for a sporting event, 3 other couples in our group were also able to book units. Our unit was clean and comfortable, and the proprietor was friendly. We walked into the city centre easily and the nearby Speights Ale House was good for Friday night dinner.
hotel_response: Thank you for your lovely review.  A lot of our guests enjoy the fact that we are only a five minute walk to Waikato Stadium and Seddon park which makes it very easy for guests attending sporting events in Hamilton, and with plenty of parking it saves the hassle of finding a park for the game.

title: Good location if passing through.
text: One night stay, passing through Hamilton. Room was clean, comfortable and well equipped. There is a supermarket nearby and Speights Ale House at the end of the road provided good food. A long walk to the centre and other restaurants.
hotel_response: Thank you for providing your review, we are glad that you enjoyed your stay with us and yes we agree the food at Speights Ale house is excellent.

title: Great place to stay for a big group
text:
As a large extended family group in town for a wedding we stayed in one of the apartments.  We found it very comfortable with plenty of room for everyone to relax in.  The facilities are almost like being at home, making it easy to eat in if you want to.  With a supermarket just across the road its convenient.  
The playground and pool are small, but the kids didn't seem to mind at all.
The staff were mostly helpful and seemed keen to ensure that we had a lovely stay.
hotel_response: Thank you for your lovely review Lynette.  We are glad that you enjoyed your stay with us and that the wedding was a success.

title: Avoid
text: The room was ok but not very cosy. Bathroom ok. Bit of a walk into town. The swimming pool is strangely placed in the car park. Not even big enough to swim. The owner treated us badly when we challenged why he charged us twice for our room. I would advise you find somewhere nicer where the manager actually welcomes the business. A very shoddy service indeed.
hotel_response: This couple came to the motel and booked a room and gave us a Credit Card Number, the next day they left, and we processed the credit card for a one night stay $140. The Next day the lady called and complained that she paid Cash for the room, I could not remember that she paid cash, however,  I immediately informed her that a refund will be processed, which I did as soon as the phone was put down. The next day she called again threatening me that she did not get the refund I informed her that the refund was processed and that it may take a day or two to appear on her statement. She did not stop there, she started threatening me saying she was going to hand the matter to the police, the credit card, and write a bad review on Trip adviser etc., and I then sent her a copy of the processed refund. The next day she emailed us requesting another $15 for bank charges, I did inform her that we will give her the $15 she is requesting but she should do the right thing by removing all the bad review she wrote about us unnecessary. I did check the surveillance camera and I could not see any cash payment made, I don’t think she paid for the room. We gave her the benefit of doubt and did the right thing and refunded the money, but she has not stopped complaining.

title: Avoid
text:
We stayed here for one night, having stayed at a number of motels on our trip this was ok. Clean room, good facilities.
We checked out and paid the bill in cash. A few days later we checked our credit card account and were shocked to see that we had been charged for the room! Naturally we contacted the motel, the response we received was frankly unbelievable, we were accused of 'harassing' the owner and were the subject of a hysterical rant. To date the money still hasn't been refunded. 
Avoid unless you are happy to pay twice for the same room.
hotel_response: We apologise for any confusion caused caused in this instance. As soon as the guest contacted us to inform us of the error a refund was made to the credit card number she provided within 5 minutes. A copy of the refund receipt was also emailed directly to the guest within 24 hours.

title: Good place to stay
text:
Good quiet location. Close to restaurants and supermarkets- walking distance. 
Town is a few blocks away. 
Larger rooms than many motels. 
Plenty of off street parking.
Very good breakfast
Reasonable rates
Good value for money
hotel_response: Thank you for review Peter, we love having you to stay and we look forward to your next visit.

title: Friendly staff, great location
text: Lovely clean room, a lot bigger than other places I have stayed. The bed was comfortable and they have Super friendly staff. Loved the spa bath and the fact that it was so close to town. Having use of the gym was an added bonus. We will definitely be staying again.
hotel_response: Thank you for your lovely review we look forward to having you stay with us on yourt next trip to Hamilton

title: Very Enjoyable and Comfortable
text: Having now enjoyed a long stay on business in Hamilton I was very happy with my time here. The room was clean and serviced to a high standard daily and I found all staff and management helpful, friendly and ever willing to help out where possible. The wireless internet facilities and central location made for a very convenient stay. The location also made it very easy to shop and eat.

title: Short Stay with baby
text: very nice and friendly staff which granted a late checkout and stored our bags, nice quiet room with a lot of space for our little one, nice whirlpool, well located not too far from centre, price very competitive and good value for money!

title: Tired, dated, poor service from manager
text: Motel rooms were dated and very tired needed a general over-haul. Dishes were dirty in the cupboards, wine glasses and coffee mugs stained with lipstick. Manager was not overly helpful and we had to ask for our free welcome drink and he said he only gave them to people he liked. The only positive I can find is the water pressure in the shower was fantastic. We had a large family get together and had the opportunity to view several rooms all which appeared sub-standard.

title: Very accommodating and friendly
text:
We (myself, husband, 13yr daughter and 13yr friend) had been on holiday staying in Matamata (Hobbiton), Tauranga and around the Waikato region for a few days and really needed a quiet day to relax and recharge before setting off again.
I rang the Anglesea from our lunch stop at Cambridge to see if they had a room/rooms which might accommodate us at short notice.  I spoke to a very friendly lady who advised they had a 2bdr apartment which would give us the space we required.

When we arrived later that afternoon the same lady was in reception and advised she had upgraded us to a 3bdr townhouse as she thought we really might like the extra space.   She was so right, it was a thoughtful gesture which we appreciated very much.  The kids were great to travel with but at some point we all need some time to ourselves!   We were given complimentary drinks on arrival too, a cold beer, cold mini wine, and two juices for the girls.

The apartment was very big, main bedroom was large and had its own ensuite.  The kitchen was well equipped, with a separate dining area.  The unique wallpaper in the dining area was gorgeous, very clever.

The lounge was nice and big with a good sized balcony (overlooking the stadium).   It was a warm evening so we had the doors open right till bedtime, we had absolutely no 'boyracer' noise.  There was a large projector tv screen on the lounge wall so we all snuggled down on the couches and watched the Skytv movie which just happened to be The Hobbit!  The girls squealed each time they saw somewhere they'd been standing just hours before.

The remaining two bedrooms were well furnished but the girls chose to share which is interesting as they'd been very ready for separate rooms just minutes before checking in.  Just shows what a bit of space and relaxation can do.

We didn't use the breakfast menu but there was a good choice of items.  It was also handy having the supermarket across the road for our dinner the previous night.  We just bought bits and pieces and had a very pleasant platter dinner whilst watching the movie. 

We left around 9am the next morning however I would have been happy to stay here longer.  The bedrooms, bathrooms and living areas were all very well maintained and spotless.
Should we find ourselves in Hamilton again we would definitely choose to stay here first.

title: Not average, but not very good, I would say Good
text:
Location: close to the motorway 1, at walking distance from the stadium and Cole's grocery store, everything was clean but the building has an old feeling about it
Front desk: very kind and helping gentleman
Rooms : large, well equipped kitchenette, king beds available, good heater, oldish TV, everything clean
Free wi-fi, plenty of parking spaces
Would we go back? Considering the numerous other motels in Hamilton, we would try another one (and actually we did)

title: Get your act together!
text: I'm not going to go into all the details, but staying here was a nightmare. Firstly they had no record of my booking, even though I had email confirmation.They sent me to 3 rooms before they found me a room, all of which had broken locks. The final room I was told "should" be vacant, but if someone was in there I should come back to reception!? What kind of pathetic operation is this? I then made the hotelier walk me to the room, as I didn't want to be the one disturbing a sleeping guest. This was at 9 pm after walking the length of the grounds, with luggage, several times. I was angry to say the least. I certainly won't be back.

title: Excellent location
text:
Stay in a one bedroom unit. The room is spacious and well equipped with a good kitchen, spa bath, separate bedroom, and plenty of furniture. Staff is friendly, easy check in etc. Bed was firm but the pillows are slightly worn and not very supportive. Cleanliness is so so only the spa bath jets are showing some wear and tear with grime/stain in certain surfaces. Heat pump and fridge is in working condition but really need an upgrade/replacement soon. Overall the room is a bit tired because of the cleanliness and age of the fixtures - 3-stars like. Because of this the cost for this room is high considering I have stayed in a similar motel room at the same cost in Hamilton which has much better fixtures and cleanliness (see my other reviews). 
The location is a big plus though. Very close to CBD with 2 supermarkets close by. The centre of town is only a 5 minute walk away which can be useful.
This motel offers packages such as golf deals and guys weekends which can be good if that suits your needs. 
Overall a 3-star rating is suitable. Will return but likely only taking on a package or special.

title: Excellent
text: Units are modern, roomy, clean and comfortable. Met with offer of a welcom drink. The staff were really helpful. Easy parking and acess. Well located with excellent choice of reastaurants within easy walking distance.

title: Great motel
text: Great motel, clean tidy and spacious and so close to the stadium and shopping precints and bars and restaurants. Friendly staff who go out of their way to make sure your stay is comfortable. Units are spacious and very clean. A heat pump insured the room was toasty warm and loved the spa bath.  Love the packages available....golf packages, girls weekends etc.  Would definitely stay here again and will be recommending.

title: Neat, Tidy & Mordern
text:
Excellent Motel - Neat & Tidy

We stayed here for two nights. We had room number 15 & 16. The rooms were exceptionally neat & tidy. Very Modern unlike most motels within New Zealand.

Both the rooms have a heat pump. The rooms were serviced & cleaned every day by the staff. 

The motel is slightly pricey but one certainly gets a lot more value in return. As a fully equipped kitchen-ate, a modern Jacuzzi in room number 16.

title: A great hotel with little extras
text:
I was really impressed with this motel. It was clean and well-appointed with full amenities and located a 10 minute walk from Hamilton's eat street and with ample parking.

But for me the best thing was the owners had gone the extra mile to differentiate their motel. They gave us a free upgrade as they weren't very busy and offered us a free beer or softdrink on arrival. Over the Easter period while we were there they left a chocolate treat in the room - the small touches of this motel made it a great stay.

title: Great location in central Hamilton
text:
It’s taken a long time to write but stayed here in September 2011 for the Rugby World Cup.
We stayed here for 4 nights whilst watching a rugby match. The stadium is less than a 5 minute walk which was really handy as it rained that night.

The motel was just like a mini home and we all loved it and if visiting Hamilton again would go back.

It’s only a 10 minute walk to all the shops, supermarket is across the road and good location to go off exploring other areas of New Zealand.

We had a fully kitchen with most things you could ask for including dishwasher, microwave, fridge etc. A spacious lounge and dinning area with sofas, chairs, dinning table. A washing machine and dryer were available on site at a very low cost. We had 2 bedrooms that were very comfortable. 
The motel was very comfortable, clean and tidy and well looked after.

It also had a very small play area and swimming pool for small children.

The staff were all very accommodating and would help you with anything you needed or wanted with no trouble at all. We had a welcome drink on arrival and a complementary newspaper each morning.

A very pleasant stay and would highly recommend this motel to anyone visiting Hamilton for pleasure or business.

title: Good accomodation in a central location
text: The staff here were excellent. Accomodation spacious and comfortable. Nice welcoming drink. Kitchenette basic. Microwave, Toaster and kettle plus utensils and crockery. No oven or cooktop. Great location for nearby supermarket, CBD and Waikato stadium. Tariff reasonable and the place is spotless.
hotel_response:
We're to hear glad you enjoyed your stay with us. Thanks for your great review.
We do have some rooms with cooking tops and some with full ovens as well so if you come back and require cooking facilities let us know and we should be able to book a room with cooking for you.

title: Very Accommodating
text:
We spent 4 nights in the 3 bedroom townhouse (4 Adults & 2 kids) .. Very spacious, great value, very clean & the staff very helpful & friendly.
Situated in a great location - not too far from town centre (walkable or if feeling a little lazy buses are readily available). 
I would definately recommend the Anglesea Motel & Conference Centre.

title: Quiet and comfortable stay in the heart of Hamilton
text: I stayed here one night only but thought it was nice and very conveniently located. It is right smack in the city and across the street from a very large supermarket, Countdown. Also next to this pace is the Speights Ale Restaurant with good food. The motel is run by a family so you'll get teenagers serving you but they are quite friendly. Despite being in the heart of Hamilton, noise was not a big issue for me.

title: Recommended
text:
I stayed in Anglesea for 2 to 3 months for work. The rooms are clean, the beds are comfortable., and the bathroom is fantastic! (I have a jacuzzi tub :) ) The staff are very friendly and accommodating.
There is a big Countdown supermarket in front of the motel. And the bus station for long-distance buses is about 15 mins walk away.

title: Quiet Location
text: Have stayed here twice now, Good location- close to cbd- cheap $7-$9 taxi ride to hub of restaurants/pubs. Room was nice and clean and very quiet....good value for the money. Nice to have complimentary drinks on arrival too... nice touch !!

title: Highly recommended
text: Clean and comfortable in a great location.  Staff friendly and complimentary drink on arrival is nice gesture. Can't fault it.  Have stayed 4 times now and have booked my 5th stay for June. Recommend to all of my friends who are going to Hamilton

title: Good, simple accomodation
text:
Spent one night here on a business trip.  Don't choose this for view or location, but it is handy to the centre of town.
Noeworthy are the clean rooms, friendly reception service and lots of little extras such as the free, good quality wifi, free drink on arrival, free percolated coffee, paper etc.
Rooms are large, flat screen TV but furniture and fixtures are somewhat dated.
Ideal value for money business option!

title: Good value accommodation
text: Clean, comfortable accommodation - perfect for a few nights stay while in the area.

title: Nice find
text: We were traveling through Hamilton and this was a nice little stop, clean rooms at a reasonable price, helpful staff

title: Very willing
text: We stayed on and off over a period of two months amounting to a total of some 17 days and we found Mark and his team very welcoming and keen to make sure we had all we needed.  Even when a booking glitch with them left us potentially homeless Mark stepped up to the plate and was able to sort things out quickly and, from our point of view, easily. It looks like they have put investment in over recent years and are working hard to make sure it pays off.   It is well located for Victoria street and the Founders theatre.  We grew quite attached to the place. Lots of nice touches like the welcome beer/drink.

title: Would definitely recommend
text: We were here for an overnight stay and were very happy with what this motel. The check in was very friendly and helpful and the room was clean & spacious. The location of the motel is perfect with shops & restaurants close by as is the rugby stadium. We wish we had found this place earlier but now we know where to stay when in Hamilton next. Would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for motel style accommodation in Hamilton.

title: Handy to town, clean & comfortable.
text: Stayed twice, prompt & efficient checkin, nice complimentary juice. The hollandaise breakfast muffin option is tops! Rooms large & well soundproofed, easy to access & the closest motel to the CBD. Spotless too. I'd go back in a heartbeat.

title: Promised the world, delivered dreariness in abundance
text: If you book this motel on the internet you might be deceived into thinking this is somewhere special to spend a night or two. Actually, it is located in the middle of dreary industrial type buildings with the most dismal of outlooks. The rooms themselves are a decent size but bereft of any degree of style and the furniture is definitely more akin to student residence than hotel prices. We loathed our time there. It was like being stuck in a Council flat in the middle of nowhere.  We were after all on holiday and travelling with out daughter round New Zealand.

title: Good quality Motel
text: Represents the best of motels in New Zealand. We had a large room, functional kitchenette, huge bathroom with corner spa bath. Swimming pool looked inviting, but the weather didn't. Seemed to have a lot of corporate clients during the week but quite a few familys as well. Really clean- good value. Family run- friendly and very helpful staff

title: a little bit dusty
text: the rooms are big, the people friendly but with a huge layer of dust on the manual for the microwave not clean enough for more stars.

title: Great place, clean quiet and friendly
text:
Stayed many times, and as always find it a great place to stay
Staff friendly and helpful, rooms spacious, clean and have everything required

title: Home away from Home
text: I recently spent one night at Camberley B & B.  David and Lorraine were extremely welcoming and friendly.  Accommodation was clean and comfortable and breakfast was amazing.  David went above and beyond the call of duty, when I dropped my earring down the plug hole.  A quick bit of plumbing and I had my family heirloom back.  Thank you  David.  I look forward to coming back soon.

title: Lovely b&b
text: We stayed here on 12 June this year ..on arrival we were greeted by David and lorraine ,david  came out and carried my bags in.we were offered tea & coffee ,then showed to our room which was lovely,they were very helpful with information about where to dine etc..breakfast had so many choices we felt very spoilt. A very pleasant b&b and we will be recommending it to any one going to that way...thank you David and Lorraine .

title: Hamilton B&B
text: I stayed at Camberley B & B for 2 nights in April.  David and Lorraine were friendly, welcoming, helpfull and attentive.  The  amenity's were excellent.  Fantastic breakfast.   I highly recommend the Camberley Bed and Breakfast to all.  Thank you,  David and Lorraine,  Lyle.

title: COMFORT IN HAMILTON
text:
My wife Jill and I recently enjoyed our third stay with Lorraine and David, the warm and friendly hosts at Camberley B&B. We have become good friends with them as a result of our visits, and their hospitality is second to none. We are always  warmly welcomed and made to feel at home. The facilities at Camberley are spacious and very comfortable. 
The modern guest wing is very well appointed, and breakfast is a banquet!!
We would have no hesitation in recommending this establishment to prospective travelers.
When is the next cricket visit!! Derek T

title: Very comfortable B&B in Hamilton
text: We had a one-night stay at Camberley B & B in February.  David and Lorraine were kind and attentive hosts, providing us with all sorts of information.  The guest wing was clean, quiet and had a big sunny bathroom, with shower, bath and abundant free toiletries, and a seperate toilet.  The only B&B I've been to where they provided perfume as well as organic shampoo, conditioner, body wash, bath gels, etc! Lorraine also sews and makes jewellery, and David made us a big two-course breakfast!.

title: Never again!
text:
We stayed here 2 nights. Thank god it wasn't any longer! 
This motel is very clearly used for emergency housing, which we were not informed of. 

Unwelcome and uncomfortable looks from some of the very obviously 'long term' tenants. 
Banging and slamming doors at all hours of the night. 
Domestics.. Swearing, Yelling, Arguing at all hours of the night. 
Noisy cars coming and going at all hours as well. 

I didn't feel safe to leave my room after dark and had my door locked at all times, day and night. 

The owner obviously doesn't feel safe there either as he locked himself away inside and would only come out to open the door if somebody was checking in. 

Room seemed clean but the floor was absolutely filthy and turned our feet black, which would then leave marks on the white sheets etc. 

We won't ever be staying here again, and warn others not to as well, for your own safety.

title: Not impressed
text: Motel is not up to standard, old dated and broken houseware. The motel seems to be an emergency housing with rough type/dangerous people living there. Wouldn’t recommend as it could be very dangerous plus loud noise and late night parties. I didn’t realise in NZ you should always ask the manager if it is used for emergency housing before booking to make an informed decision before choosing to stay.

title: Scary night at the Arena Court Motel
text:
BEWARE: Motel seems to have several rooms (6-8) allocated for emergency housing. Owner of motel literally locks himself in and unlocks the door to let you into reception for check in (we checked in 3pm) then locks again as you leave. The guests strongly appear to live there and have a dangerous feel about them. Owner gave us no warning about the situation.

Parties, loud music, multiple cars coming & going all night to different rooms, drunk/drugged up & gang looking people until 7am the next morning. I was literally too scared to leave my room after 9pm. Made a quick dash for my car in the morning. Aside from my own safety was worried about my car all night too and didn’t sleep. So sad guests are not warned about this as it could be very dangerous for you if you walked out your room into the wrong situation!

Please be careful & if you don’t believe me at least question the owner & have a look around first at the motel before booking and be VERY careful if choosing to stay here…

title: Middling
text:
Average Motel with less than impressive service from the owners, managers and staff. 

I booked the Spa Studio - Room only for $189.00 for 1 night. There are very few good motels in Hamilton that you 100% trust to be clean.

This cleanliness was reasonable but I dare not walk on the carpet in bare feet. In the morning I tried to contact staff to get some coffee.

 No response to phone calls or knocking on door x 3 separate times within the hours of operation.

title: Do not use this if you want to sleep at night
text: Without doubt the worst accommodation that I have ever used. I was traveling for business and had three nights there.  Every night there were people talking loudly outside, noisy cars and cars coming and leaving until at least 3am. uncomfortable bed and pillow doesn't help either.  If you want to sleep at night don't use this accommodation.

title: very spacious, clean and tidy
text:
1. The reception staff is very polite
2. The room is very spacious, comfortable, clean and tidy
3. All cleaners are very polite and responsble
4. The location is very good and I can easily access to the city centre

title: Good stay
text: Booked online, requested downstairs room due to bad arthritis.  On arrival found that the type of room booked was upstairs ( no mention on website) but ilno problems changing us to downstairs.  Room had everything needed, spa bath out of order but wasn't going to use it so no problem for us. Good location especially if going to FMG stadium.  Had long term people (according to two of the children who visited our room) next door but apart from the children playing right outside unit all afternoon,  were quiet and no problems. Unit was clean, bed comfy ,would stay again.

title: Really awesome place
text: Totally pleased to write this review. From booking to check out everything was pleasant. The rooms are spotless......like legit spotless. The room suppliers...tea coffee etc are awesome quality and plenty available. The air con was amazing. Beds comfy and awesome shower. Pricing was really good too $180 for a one bedroom unit. I will Totally be back!

title: Good and clean place
text: I had a hard time finding anything available in Hamilton and this was the best of the clean. reasonably priced options. It was clean, new and basic. No frills and nothing above and beyond. I can't complain.

title: Would stay again
text:
Staff here were very accommodating for our group. 

Unit was very clean and tidy, with everything you need.  Luxurious linen and extremely comfortable beds.  Good parking. 

There was some traffic noise during the night and of course crowd noise from the stadium right next door. 

But would definitely return if staying in Hamilton again due to cleanliness and the quality of the room.

title: Well worth the stay!
text: The Arena must be one of the cleanest places we have stayed at while touring the north island. Beautiful clean rooms, kitchen, bathroom. The kitchenette was awesome especially with decent fridge, toaster and cook top making it super handy. Luxury of two televisions, really comfty beds and helpful staff to fit us all in. Would of happily stayed on. Thank you. See you again!

title: Great location.
text:
Handy location and easy to find.
Plenty of places to eat within easy walking distance or a supermarket. 
Very clean, and well appointed. 
Shame our unit didn’t have a couch or 2 armchairs to sit on to watch TV. 
Comfortable bed and excellent shower.

title: Great location & presentation but ....
text: Positives are location, presentation is amazingly clean for a competitive price however we were disappointed that they were advertising on their own website via their booking system that if you booked directly you received a complementary continental breakfast. We were advised due to COVID breakfast was not available when we asked at check-in. At the time we were in level 1 & they were happy to provide milk for hot drinks so why not packet cereal & fruit etc? We were offered a full refund if we did not want to stay however as it was 4.30pm that was not acceptable.

title: Awesome place, awesome people. Can't fault this motel
text:
I stay in quite a lot of motels through work and travel. This motel has to be one of my favourites! I was welcomed by the manager who was lovely and took an interest in why I was staying in Hamilton. I had to stay longer than expected so he juggled everything around at the last minute so I could remain in the same room even though the motel was fully booked.
The room was extremely clean and tidy (with very nice coffee) and very comfortable!
It is also situated close to town making walking ir driving around very easy.
I cannot fault the Arena Court Motel and will definitely be back.

title: Amazing motor lodge
text: I was only here for one night but this place is amazing, friendly host, warm, clean, spacious and spotless unit with fabulous shower/bathroom. Very close to everything I needed and quiet yet close to main arterial routes. I highly recommend this place. The price was incredible too. Just loved it.

title: One night stay
text: We were visiting family in central Hamilton . This motel represented Fantastic value , a great location and we enjoyed very friendly service .Everything was spotless. I can’t wait to visit again. We were offered a complimentary upgrade .

title: Arena Court Motor Lodge

title: Visiting Hamilton on a road trip around NZ
text:

We walked to the Hamilton Gardens along the river (3km) and caught the bus back to town. Lovely spot there for lunch overlooking the lake and the roses were stunning. Would definitely stay here again if in the area.

title: Clean, comfortable and affordable
text:
I stayed here for 2 nights during my visit to NZ to go to Hobbiton. The rooms are quite spacious, the kitchenette is well stocked (coffee plunger and sachet of coffee are a highlight) and has all the modern amenities: fast wi-fi, ac and for a couple of $s extra a bath with spa jets (highly recommended after walking around The Shire!).
Town is a short walk away with 2 supermarkets less than 5 minutes walk, the kitchenette has stovetops, pots and pans, so meals are cheap if necessary. Also has a Sky box in every room, not a small selection of channels piped into the room like a lot of other hotel/motels advertising Sky. 
I'll definitely be returning when I return to Hamilton!

title: Overnight stay

The spa bath is excellent and the bathroom has a separate shower also. The staff is fantastic very welcoming and courteous. The price for the unit is very reasonable as well. I highly recommend this motel and would consider staying here again in the future.
hotel_response:
Thank you for choosing to stay at Arena Court Motor Lodge Hamilton.   As the new owners, we look forward to being of service and providing for your accommodation in the future.
Please check out the ongoing up grades to meet accommodation expectations.

title: Nice, new and comfortable
text:
We were in Hamilton for a party at the Speights Ale House, which was 2 minutes walk from the Arena Court.  So this location was ideal for us.  And would be great if you were in Hamilton for a rugby or cricket match too.
Very nice, clean and modern rooms.
While we hardly spent any time in them, I would still recommend and hope to use this venue again in the future.
Very accommodating and friendly staff.
hotel_response:
Thank you for choosing to stay at the Arena Court Motor Lodge in Hamilton.   We are the new owners, and getting things right is important to us, so please come and stay again and check out the ongoing effort to make your visit comfortable.
Lloyd

title: Very comfortable
text: Stayed here for one night recently with my family. The staff were very friendly, the rooms clean, quiet and well-appointed. It's just a 5 minute walk to supermarkets. Internet was fast and easy to use. Will stay again.

title: Excellent!
text:
I would only bother to rate a Motel if it was either a terrible experience or a great one. Our stay at Arena Court was certainly a great experience - lovely clean room and super friendly and helpful owners. The motelier always had a huge smile on his face when we went to reception and went that extra mile.
5/5 for Arena Court!

title: quiet,new, comfortable. free wifi, happy owner.
text: We stayed overnight here on the way to Auckland. It was a great choice. The owner Lee Bruce was a very friendly man. He gave us a good deal on 2 rooms with a connecting door as we were travelling with 2 teenagers.  of course they loved the free wifi. srtongly reccomend this place.

title: Perfect for business or fun
text:
Stayed on 26 Feb 2013 for 2 nights enjoyed great facilities, spa tub, free wifi, close to sport facilities, lake and gardens.
Top notch motor lodge, Lee great host and helpful. Would recommend to anyone.

title: Very modern motel, great for a brief stop
text:
This motel is very new, and the owners are obviously keen to keep it looking in great condition for every guest. Positioned right beside the main stadium of the city, there is ample parking and lots of sunshine for the upstairs units. While the room we stayed in wasn't huge, it was enough for a one-night stay, and the rate was exceptionally good (which we paid at check-in as apparently a few weekend guests had a habit of leaving without paying). 
There is free wireless broadband, which performed very well. The room had a range of Panasonic-brand appliances: A modern heat pump, TV with digital channels and an SD-card slot, and a stereo with an iPod dock. The kitten facilities were good, with a modern microwave, jug & toaster. 
The bathroom was nice, with a large shower, but unfortunately the shower had problems draining the water and it kept building up at the bottom. If we had stayed more than one night, we possibily could have had this fixed by the staff. This was the only problem we encountered with the room, aside from the heatpump being positioned opposite the bed and becoming too chilly when it was running. 
Overall, this is a very nice place to stay, with friendly staff and great value for money.

title: EXCELLENT PLACE TO STAY
text: On a trip around the North Island we decided to treat ourselves and have 3 nights in a motel. The owner/manager was very nice and welcoming...he showed us a 1 bedroom unit, you could smell the newness of the place when he opened the door. WOW!! we were very impressed, just what we wanted. The unit was upstairs...not a problem, there was airconditioning, a small kitchenette, microwave, hot plates, fridge, good quality crockery and cutlery. A large TV on the wall, small sound system, and free wi-fi. Huge kinsize bed...very comfortable...TV on wall in bedroom. A good sized shower in bathroom. Very handy...about 5 mints walk to 2 large supermarkets, with Rugby stadium just around the corner...Most important of all the unit was spotless. Only complaint was from my husband who said the couch wasn't very comfy (quite hard) WOULD RECOMMEND TO ALL

title: new complex great location to stadium
text:
New complex less than year old. Our room was an upstairs room heated with a very quiet panasonic air conditioner.  Small kitchette, microwave,hot plates,fridge.  Bathroom spacious and a nice tiled shower, hard wired hair dryer.  Good sized wall mounted Panasonic TV.

Although a very nice complex and would recommend to others.  Felt the complex was built by a developer rather than persons involved the motel industry.  One could have picked up some nice ideas from other motels and incorporated them into the Arena.  Ie... Heated towel rail, heated tiles under kitchen and bathroom floors.  Toilet seats which actually bolted securely onto the toilet bowl.  Head board behind the bed head, and better lighting.

Bottom line ... Yes a nice new motel and would recommend as easy access to two large super markets Pak N Sav and Countdown... 5 minutes walk.  Rugby stadium just around the corner... Most likely less than 5 minutes walk.  We did enjoy the complimentary breakfasts.  Good car parking.

title: Great place to stay!
text: This motel is very new. Nice rooms with little kitchenettes which made it easy to save money on food. The owner most helpful and went the extra mile to make sure all was well even getting us tickets for the football. Supermarkets short walk, pub also. Comfy beds and pillows. Very clean.

title: Brand spanking new - at least for the time being
text:
My wife and I had been touring the North Island and we were on our way back to Auckland. We hadn't booked anything in Hamilton and just happened to be cruising along Willoughby Street when we spotted the neon "Vacancy" sign. The ex-dairy farming couple who currently manage this new motel were most pleasant and welcoming. We were shown two rooms but picked  the one with the queen sized bed. The other one - with the king sized bed had been cleverly designed for disabled guests.

Wow! Our unit was so new you could smell the newness. Fixtures and fittings were of a high standard and the kitchen area was well-equipped. The bathroom was spacious with a spa bath and a large walk-in shower cubicle. There was a little seated area through the French doors. We enjoyed free wi-fi and a received a complimentary copy of the "New Zealand Herald" in the morning. It was possible to order cooked breakfasts but we just made our own as we had done on all of our other lovely mornings in summertime New Zealand.

We'd like to have spent longer in and around Hamilton. It seemed like a nice city with riverside walks and a lovely garden suburb around Lake Rotoroa. Willoughby Street is much quieter than the nearby and parallel Ulster Street where I guess you'd be very conscious of passing traffic.

We had dinner in the nearby Speight's Ale House - a ten minute walk - with a reasonably priced and inviting menu. Later at Biddy Mulligans Irish Bar we saw the most depressing female singer we have ever encountered - happily murdering upbeat songs. Ah well, you can't win 'em all.

title: Avoid at all costs!
text:
We arrived at the hotel after 4pm only to realise its was outside working hours! 4pm! No one was at reception and we had to call through some help desk only to be told our key card and Instructions for parking were in an envelope on the front desk. Unprofessional!

When we got to our room the key card wouldnt work. I went down to reception and used the phone to call the help desk. When I explained the key card would not work, they told me I had been swiping it incorrectly. I then went back to the room tried every which angle I could to no avail.
I then went back and called help desk once again. This time a different person, proceeds to tell me to hold the key card in place on the reader. With growing frustration I and went back to the room and did exactly that. Still didnt work! Im no stranger to hotels and Im confident at this stage that someone from this establishment needs to address the situation.

For the 3rd time I went back to reception, dialed the help desk again. Explained my predicament to a 3rd (different) person who then puts me on hold for a considerable amount of time. He then takes me off hold only to tell me that the duty manager is not picking up his phone and he has left a message with him to call me! Now what? I asked him so what shall we do? Sit outside our hotel room with all our luggage until the duty manager calls/arrives?? And for how long? He then apologises and tells me there is nothing more he can do! I hung up, just absolutely gob smacked.

We left the hotel at that point in disbelief. Exhausted from a long day we found a lovely room at the Novotel thank god. As I am writing this two days later, I have had not had one response from this hotel for an apology or a refund.

What baffles me is that no manager called us that evening... so we would never had received the help we needed that night.

DO NOT STAY HERE!

title: The worst nights sleep ever in a hotel
text:
The worst night I’ve ever had in a hotel , it was so incredibly noisy the locals use London st as a drag strip all night long even a burn out right outside our room side our window at 1am makes you wonder if they even have a police force here as it went on all night in challenged .
If you need a nights sleep do t book here

title: Waste of a good l9cation
text: The staff were welcoming and helpful. The parking was unique in my experience. But in a good and interesting way. On the other hand,  the one bedroom apartment was not good. The bedroom was normal size but the living area was a joke. In order to get to the desk, you had to go around the sofa then into the bedroom  then back into the lounge area. I don’t think that the designers really thought this through  properly. Three is the best I can do for this hotel.

title: Didn't like!
text:
Stay away. Not friendly staff at all. Rude and refused to help when needed. Hotel untidy and left in average condition when we arrived. We will not be going back to this hotel ab will ensure to tell others. 

One star for location but other than that - 0

title: Nice place to stay
text: Lovely hotel style apartment ,clean and in the heart of the city next to restaurants and cafes. Has a little kitchenette with a mini fridge and 2 small hotplates, also a microwave and dishwasher. Also has its own washing machine and dryer. Has car park facilities for limited amount of cars at an extra charge of $22

title: Perfect location, nice apartment hotel with all required amenities (business trip) (room 108)
text:
What a great stay!

The reviews here made me nervous about my upcoming business trip to Hamilton. Our travel agents booked me into the Quest and I was pleasantly surprised!

The front desk staff both days were lovely and so helpful. I parked across the road at Wilson Parking, easy as.

The hotel entrance, first floor lobby and my room were great. Very clean and nicely fitted out.

The kitchenette in my room (108) was well equipped, as was the bathroom - the washing machine was a bonus. My bed was comfortable and I also had a work desk, small table for eating and lounge chairs.

The only downside was not being able to watch TV from bed as there's a small wing wall in the way.

I love the long list of charge back restaurants nearby and used this facility for dinner and breakfast.

I highly recommend this hotel.

title: Poor Customer Service from Sunny House Manager
text: Had a room booked for Quest Hamilton for a wedding. Unfortunately I got Covid so we were unable to go. Sunny said thats outside his control and still charged my card after the fact. I asked for a refund and Sunny was very rude and said no he can not do that. So to this day they still have my money from my account and I was unable to go. Very poor service.

title: overpriced. needs cleaning and updating
text:
Very OLD property with outdated weathered decor and soiled furnishings.

Couch in my room had a huge stain on upholstery, bedroom curtains were badly stained (I thought it was shadow  until looked closer), blanket was dirty, and apartment was generally dusty. 

kitchen was dirty on arrival so I cleaned it also. 

staff all very friendly; some quite attentive; others polite but ambivalent. 

internal phone never worked (2 week stay). wifi intermittently didn't work - but was rectified quickly once staff notified  (this was a work related stay for me so internet/wifi was essential part of the booking). 

parking a tad inconvenient (stacker system) - just need to plan your time so car is available which I did and staff were accommodating of this 

simple things like no soap/shampoo holder in the shower ... (really!).. 

bottom line:
just a really tired old property sold as a jewel in the city which I found misleading (booked through Qantas FF)

ADVANTAGES: close to city, comfy bed ,own laundry facilities and rudimentary kitchen. quiet so even though in the city it wasn't noisy. 

not worth its 4 stars. expensive for the standard of property.
2/5 stars saved by the advantages making it  3/5  at best

user_location: Emirate of Dubai, United Arab Emirates
title: SO BAD we had to LEAVE at 3am
text:
There was a structural issue with the room which made the wind absolutely HOWL through the room to a volume that made it absolutely impossible to sleep. It was a bit of a windy night but not gale force or anything. We tried to call reception but the phone in the room did not work. We called the number on our cell phone and the answer phone sad reception was closed and to leave a message. We had no choice by to leave at 3am by Uber and stay in another place. We contacted the hotel and all they could say is that we didn't inform them. When clearly there was no way to. There was no one manning the reception either. We tried 3 methods to contact them! They were just wanting to blame us for everything even when I noted that the consumer guarantees act states that anything you pay for must be fit for purpose, the room was not fit to sleep in! They couldnt care less and kept trying to blame us for not contacting them at 3am, even though we told all the things we did to try to contact them.

I don't know who owns this hotel or company, but having worked in management, I would be disgusted to see how this was handled by the staff. We gave them ample time and chance to put things right. They never returned our call as promised the following day either. Hotel room NOT FIT TO STAY IN and customer service an absolute disgrace. I hope that no tourist stays there as this would put them off NZ hospitality. The company should be ashamed!

title: Warm, safe and very comfortable
text: Had a great stay, great location, well appointed apartments,  staff were really helpful. Grest place next door for breakfast. No problem parking.  Would definitely stay again when here for business. Great having washer and dryer in apartments.

title: An okay stay
text: Studio Room - located in the city about a 15minute drive to the Hamilton Gardens and to the base. A lot of other stores nearby. Our room came with a king bed but we requested 2 single beds instead which we paid an extra $10 for upon arrival. Room had all kitchen appliances stove, microwave, kettle and toaster. Carpark costs $16 per night and is very limited so do pre-book if you plan to stay. After hours starts at 4pm so if you are parked on the top rail your car will be raised and kept there till working hours the next morning 8am - for this reason I parked out on street parking which is free from 8am to 8pm not a far walk to and from hotel. Room had no view. Paid a $150 bond upon arrival (hold transaction). Wifi is limited and you pay $10 for extra if you run out. Room however was comfortable and very clean. Staff member Sunny was very friendly and helpful.

title: A room with no view
text:
We stayed at this hotel/apartments for two night stay while visiting Hamilton, first thing you should be aware of is pre-booked your parking as there is limited parking at the hotel. As a disabled guest there is one parking space available. There are no amenities at the hotel, I think they should drop the word hotel and just call it apartment accommodation which is what it is.

Our room was very spacious however there was no view as can be seen from the picture attached, we kind of felt like we were in a prison cell, room No. 108.

title: Great
text:
My husband and I originally booked to stay at Quest on Ward but received an email informing us that our booking had been transferred to Quest Hamilton. Having read some of the less than complimentary reviews, we contacted the apartments directly expressing some concern. 
We received a very speedy response reassuring us that our apartment would be of a good standard, and it was.
The building is an old heritage building and that has to be taken into account . However, it had been nicely renovated. 
The apartment was well equipped for self catering , there was also a washing machine and dryer and supermarkets were reasonably close by. 
The bed was huge and comfortable and the apartment was clean . The free WiFi was a tad irregular and it kept switching off after minimal use but the reception staff were happy to give more vouchers on request. 
Two issues that need to be taken into account are that the reception isn’t manned 24 hours a day. Especially at weekends. So guests need to contact the establishment directly to check accessibility. Also the very limited on site parking is a stacking system. Not something that we were familiar with so we didn’t use it. On street parking right by the apartments isn’t easy. There is a loading bay where you can park to off load your cases plus parking meters where the first two hours are free. However, if you are willing to walk a little way, free parking is available near to Seddon Park cricket ground ( but you have to get there outside of working hours as it is very popular) otherwise you need to walk further to residential areas. 
None of this was an issue for us but it might be for other people.
We really enjoyed staying at Quest. Hamilton city has undergone substantial improvements since we were here several years ago and is well worth visiting.

title: Avoid if you can
text: I couldn’t imagine a worse business hotel experience. The interior is old and faded, including ripped curtains, the lift only goes up 2 floors and access to level 3 is via 28 steep stairs, soap etc is not replaced daily and, worst of all, the price is exorbitant-$690 for 2 nights. You’ve got to be kidding me. A complete rip off.

title: Visiting motor homes show
text: Off to a very bad start, after having reserved around 3 weeks before, I was kept out in the wind for around 8 minutes with a locked reception door- supposed to be manned most of the day- this was 2pm- finally let in , but no apology- also no car park- not until you read the business travellers do you see you need to book one. Was safe in the street. As we staggered in with our bags etc and headed for our room, no mention was made of the lift around the corner. It then took a turn for the better, room was great, very clean and well equipped with even a washing machine and dryer and a dish washer. Very handy to central Hamilton and a pleasant walk along the river.

title: Good one night stay
text: Husband and daughter stayed one night in top floor 2 bedroom unit.  Nice spacious room, clean, quiet, receptionist lovely and helpful.  Excellent central location. Two very minor issues, plug in sink got stuck down, managed to fix eventually and beds were pretty hard.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your lovely feedback, this is really valuable to us. We do appreciate that you have pointed out the sink issue, this was repaired as soon as we had been informed. The beds have been recently replaced with a highly regarded model which has been used extensively throughout the upper end of the hotel industry. Of course beds (and pillows) are such a personal thing, therefore we do offer toppers and a selection of pillows depending on preferences. We do encourage guests to let us know if they have preferences in this regard. 

Thank you again, in the meantime we do hope to see you again soon.

title: Not returning
text:
Beware, the 3rd floor has no lift access and 3 flights of stairs to go up. I had 3 large suitcases and 140 salesman samples! Shocking experience! Prison like windows, dark room and table collapses. 
What was most disappointing was that I am a return traveller, with my room requirements on my guest file. Cannot risk this happening again. Staff tried very hard but management were not around to explain?
hotel_response:
We are sorry that you had such a disappointing experience. On this occasion your booking agent booked a basic studio apartment not a larger one bedroom unit this was our last studio and all our one bedroom apartments had been fully booked for some time prior. In the absence of a manager our team members are empowered to make necessary decisions and we understand that everything possible was done to help. Immediately on being informed of your concerns our team member upgraded you to a two bedroom apartment, this was a significant upgrade and was provided at no cost to you.

The only option available happened to be on the third floor which unfortunately is not serviced by a lift. We understand that a number of our staff where on hand and did help with your samples both during check in and on departure. 

If a particular apartment or apartment style is required we do recommend booking well in advance in order to avoid disappointment. We do have a couple of terrific options which would be perfect for you however if they have been pre-booked by another guest then there is little we care able to do. 

We do hope that you understand that we did do everything we could have on this occasion and that we would love to host you again in the future. 

In the meantime we wish all the best and safe travels.

title: Wouldn't go back
text: Very disappointed in this place. Considering the price was quite unhappy. Very small prison like windows, giant pillar/beam in the middle of the room. Booking said it had parking, but when we got there was told the parking was full and we would have to park on the street. Reception closed at 7 so was difficult to sort anything after we checked in.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your feedback, we are really disappointed to hear that your stay did not live up to your expectations. Our hotel is located in a really special 1920's heritage building which has been extensively refurbished and bought up to date.  Not being a cookie cutter style hotel with uniform rooms means that all our fully equipped apartments are different although we are not sure which you are referring to as having a pillar in the room? Of course had we been made aware at the time, we would have been more than happy to move you to a more suitable apartment. 

We do explain to all of our guests both verbal and written when sending confirmations of our reception hours and parking. It does explain that while reception is closed there is someone available on site 24 hours, had they been informed that you required any kind of  help we would have been very happy to assist. We do recommend parking is booked in advance, however we do also have alternative off site parking for our guests however street parking is very easy after 5pm and this would be free overnight. 

Our aim is to make things enjoyable and easy for all of our guests and hope that you do come and stay with us again in the future.

title: The things they don't tell you ...overpriced under serviced
text:
No one on reception at 5pm on a Saturday. You have to use an intercom and a hard to hear response tells you your key is in an envelope on the counter.
Only 1 key so for guests with separate plans this is useless and again no reception so no options.
Parking is in a small dark area charged at $14 a night but in the in room info its quoted as$12. The parking is stacked and if you are on the bottom you are requested by a note on the parking door to leave your keys in a box at the unmanned reception. 
To put the final nail in the coffin the unit was hot and when we tried to use the aircon it went to an error message. We called the after hours number and was told nothing could be done.
hotel_response: Thank you for your valuable feedback, we do appreciate your comments as it does help us look at ways to improve our service. Our reception hours are from 7am to 7pm during the week and from 8am to 4pm on weekends and public holidays. While the front desk may be unmanned at certain times we always have a team member on call within the premises. The after after hours process is explained on all booking confirmations and generally works exceptionally well. We are fortunate to be able to offer secure off street parking at $14 within an undercover area with direct access to the hotel reception area, is is well lit and under 24 hour CCTV cover. For the benefit of our guests we have been able to double the car parking size by utilising a stacking system. We are always happy to park cars on behalf of guests if they require. Other central located hotels are charging up to $24 for parking. Of course there is always plenty of street parking which free overnight and is generally quiet after 4pm. In regard to your issue with the air conditioning system we are looking into what happened as we do have policies in place regarding these types of things and it should have been possible to move you to another apartment, we do apologise and believe this to be an isolated issue however we will bring this up at our next team meeting and ensure additional steps are put in place for the future. Once again thank you for this feedback we wish you safe travels and hope that you will continue to use Quest Properties throughout NZ and Australasia

title: Worst Hotel Ever
text: Check in and get offered ear plugs! Oh, there is construction out the front from 5pm to 4am. Now find out my room has no power in the bathroom and reception has gone home at 7pm. Called my travel agent to try ang get out of this dump - Quest won’t refund or offer any assistance whatsoever. $200 per night for absolute trash - room stinks, looks like it hasn’t been cleaned since 1987. Avoid this place.

title: Dirty
text: I have stayed in many quest hotels around nz and au  however I wouldn’t recommend this one   If you like things to be clean and at least maintained  the room it self was big and it had a kitchenette  wifi worked well  however  the hall ways in the hotel were dirty well marked dark   And the carpet was dirty in need over a major paint job the room was fine but the shower was so dirty you couldn’t see through the glass properly   The whole bathroom really was not clean at all   The carpet going into the bathroom had pulled away over time to expose the sharp  pins that they stick the carpet  down with    There is no restaurant  in this hotel  the one lady who works by her self starts at 7 and finishes at 7 pm so no one mans the building  or   Is available   If you have an issue  really it’s not a hotel  more like serviced  apartment   There is a few parking spaces they are pay only   It is at the far end of Hamilton  city   So not near anything   Much

title: Very quaint & Clean
text: Had a lovely stay here at the quest, the rooms are not huge but have everything you need. The staff at this Quest were fantastic, very helpful and friendly. Great parking options avaliable & very close to restaurants and bars.

title: Does the job, but needs a clean
text: Good location if you need to be in the city and close to a mall so plenty of shops to look around. The room itself was ok, had what you needed including a washing machine and dryer. we had a room that looked at a brick wall within a metre of the window so natural light was pretty much non existent! it could really use a re vamp the carpets were stained and the room had a bit of a dank smell to it. the cleanliness was only just ok, but they may need to take a look above the dryer it was so covered in lint it looked horrible a broom would fix that! also one suggestion.... get a  shower caddy for the shower...there was nothing to put your shower gear on, on not even a soap dish. so overall, i would probably not stay here again, the other quest just around the road is far superior!

title: Heritage Charm
text: Enjoying my stay at Quest Hamilton. A touch of nostalgia, old world charm, this building has it. I love the sitting room on the 2nd foor, with the Rooms leading off it, so inviting. It is Beautiful. My room was comfortable, tidy, quiet, with large east facing windows overlooking Victoria Street. Centrally located, close to shopping centres, cafes, diners.

title: Great service & excellent location
text: We stayed here for one night and it was a last minute booking made just 3 hours prior to check in. We requested for an extra bed in the room and it was ready (at no extra cost) when we reached the hotel. The reception is friendly & after hours check-in is hassle free. Location is close to restaurants, cafes & shops. Fully satisfied with the booking.

title: A great hotel centrally located .
text: The rooms at this hotel are spacious . An old building that has been renovated into a hotel . We reported that the hinge on the dryer was broken , the clock did not work and the kitchen tap leaked when turned on . All these faults were fixed the next day with a huge apology . There are abundant restaurants near by and car park at hotel although cars are parked on hoists . Extremely friendly and helpful staff .

title: The Quest Hamilton - London Street
text:
Stayed there for 4 nights. Large rooms and very central. Lady at reception was wonderful and very helpful. Make sure you book a parking, there aren't that many available.
Small TV, room is quite noisy at night. Clean, cooking and washing facilities available.
If you are leaving early in the morning let them know as reception only opens at 7am.

title: Family holiday
text: Was a bit disappointed with quest Hamilton NZ.  Very difficult with parking as weren't aware they park cars on top of each other,car stack?  Also had trouble with leaking air conditioner dripping water on to phone.  Staff not overly concerned.  Also opening window in room children were in was a but worrying as they could easily climb on to ledge.   Sorry quest, couldn't recommend you to others

title: The worst
text: It is one of the worst accommodation I had ever stayed in. The air conditioner leaked water all over the the table and luggage that was on it. I was unable to lock the window so it is not suitable if you have young children with you

title: Great for price. Great location.
text: Stayed one night with my partner for a little getaway. Was totally worth the money, location was awesome too 6 minutes walk to all the bars and skycity. Room had everything you need and the natural night in the room was amaze. Would definitely recommend to people.

title: Horrendous
text: We only stayed there because we had an excellent experience with Quest Wellington only a few days earlier. QUEST HAMILTON was the worst hotel experience ever. No house keeping on Sunday when hotel was advertised as full service on booking site.We were not advised on booking or check in of this. To the contrary a sign on the mirror told us to leave towels in shower. So we  came back to soaking wet towels and an unmade bed. Impossible to sleep due to horrendous road noise and uncomfortable bed, my side sloped towards the floor. Tiny clustraphobic room compared to Wellington. Monday morning 8.35 am House keeping just barged into the room without knocking. Carpark left our car covers  in bird dropping which took 30 minutes to clean off.

title: Overnight
text: The room was comfortable. The amenities in the room were adequate. The room was huge. The person at reception was excellent. The hotel is centrally located and has limited parking. Not sure if they serve breakfast however there are many cafes around.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your generous review, it is really appreciated. Our rooms are generally very large and all have fully equipped kitchens and laundries including washers and dryers. We are fortunate to be so well located in the city yet in a quiet area close to shopping and restaurants etc . We do offer limited undercover secure parking and we are happy to valet park however we do recommend booking. Parking on the street however is plentiful, two hours freeparking after 8am and before 8pm outside of these hours is free with no limit. 
Breakfast is available on request, we serve this in room. Of course as you note cafes are plentiful. 
We look forward to hopefully seeing you again in the future.

title: Two night stay
text:
Nice man at reception. If you have a car you can park on the street, obeying parking rules, or for extra ( $14.00) you can have your vehicle parked for you.
I opted for a self catering apartment. There were two hot plates, a sink, microwave but no conventional oven, fridge and utensils. Cutlery and crockery were clean but pots and pans needed a little extra cleaning. They weren’t too bad but were not 100% clean.
Unable to get sky sport on the tv which to me was important even though the nice man at reception tried to help me with this. 
Location is good and parking was easy and free at certain times.
I managed to get a brief look at the Hamilton gardens and if you enjoy that sort of thing it’s pretty special!
Overall I would give Wuest Hamilton an 8 out of 10
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, it is really appreciated. Hamilton certainly has much to offer and guests are generally pleasantly surprised at how much there is to do. We have taken note of your observations and shared your comments regarding the pans with our housekeeping team. Thank you raising the issue with the Sky channel, we had an issue with a sky decoder which was de-tuning itself however this has been rectified. Apartments are fully equipped with full kitchens and laundry facilities including microwave, convection oven and dishwasher. laundry includes a washing machine and dryer.

title: Clean, good location with great service!!!
text: The Quest you might say is basic, finishings could be updated in places, but, it was great. The staff were always friendly and helpful. I believe we got what we asked for, for the money we paid. It was clean, quiet and comfortable. If you are driving, discuss the car parking options. It is tiny with cars parked on top of each other using hoists. I did have a problem with the free wifi on my laptop but not my mobile. They tried to help but it could be me that is the problem.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your feedback, we do appreciate that you have taken the time to provide such a comprehensive overview. All our spacious apartments are fully equipped including full kitchen and laundry.  In regard to parking, we are fortunate to be able to offer secure undercover parking in the heart of the city, we are always happy to valet park for our guests for no additional cost. 

In the meantime, safe travels and we hope to see you again soon

title: Hugely disappointing
text: We were staying in Hamilton for a concert. Despite selecting two rooms and putting on notes that we needed a room that was quite flat as my mother has difficulties with stairs, we were put on the 3rd floor. 3rd floor does not have elevator access. We said that we could not do that and they moved us to what they called an upgraded room.
