Well if upgraded meant smelled terrible, had mould and did not appear to have been cleaned in weeks - then that was our upgrade. I would not stay here again. The only redeeming feature is the large room and good location. The parking is far from ideal with the disability car park being behind a car stack so you get caught behind cars and cannot get out or past the cars even with just your person. Not worth the visit.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, this is really appreciated. We are really sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations. Our online booking information does indicate that our standard two bedroom apartments are on the third floor. We have checked through your booking details and are unable to locate any request for particular requirements, we have strict procedures to follow should we receive such a request. We have discussed the issue of the room you had been upgraded to and the housekeeping team leader assures us that the room had been cleaned that morning following a previous guests departure, we also regularly run a hospital grade ozone machine throughout the property to ensure cleanliness. In regard to parking, spaces are at such a high premium in most cities in New Zealand and we are pleased to be able to offer disability parking, we offer valet parking at no additional cost and are always happy to park guest cars on request. We do hope that next time you are in Hamilton that you reconsider staying with us. Please feel free to contact us directly and we will ensure that we exceed your expectations during your next stay.

title: Not enjoyable
text: This was the low point in our NZ accommodation - had to pay extra for parking, had to lug bags up a floor of stairs as the elevator didn't go to our floor, decor tired and scratched, room smelled of fried fish, no bedside lamp, no free WIFI.  Asked for some room freshener and it eventually arrived (they had to go and buy some).  I got to spray it around once and then had to hand it back (smelled nice for half an hour then fishy smell came back).  Glad it was a pit stop - would not return.

title: Great location
text: Stayed here for a couple of nights over Easter.  We has a spacious room with cooking facilities (not that we used them).  The checking in was smooth.  The room was clean and well equipped.  The car parking was a little snug, stacking system, but no problem.  Everything in the town was easily accessible.  We had a very pleasant, quiet stay and would recommend.
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to provide feedback, it is always appreciated as it provides us with an opportunity to look at ways to constantly  improve. We are really please that you enjoyed your stay in Hamilton of course we are always very happy to valet park guests cars if required. 
We hope that we will see you again soon.

title: Great bathroom
text: I checked in at around 10am. Was great to be able to check in early. I used the bathroom facilities and checked out at around 11am. This was truly one of my better hotel experiences and would recommend it to anyone. They had great soaps and a towel specific for make up removal (I didn't use this towel). In future I would certainly choose the Quest hotel for my bathroom facilities.

title: A Good choice in downtown
text:
One the best suggestion in Victoria street, cheaper than Novotel, but you even got a bigger room.  If you do not need a luxury lobby or breakfast. I think it is a good choice in hamiltom. Wifi is good, room is very big, have washing and drying machines in the bathroom, provide all you need for cooking. They do have indoor parking , but spaced is limited. Reserved it when you book hotel. 

There are two cafe just located in london st and only like 10 seconds walk.

title: Basic accommodation
text: I chose the Quest Hamilton because it was close to Seddon Park.  Fortunately I wasn't disappointed with this.  But the room was bland & strangely shaped.  The bathroom and kitchenette were grimy.  It was adequate for the two nights we were there, but I wouldn't want to be staying any longer.  The free internet includes hardly any data and there was a strange system of having to get a voucher with a code only from reception.  The parking is $12 per day and if they put it in the car lift then you apparently can't use your car until the next day.  The room was noisy, but we were lucky to have natural light.

title: Very disappointing!
text:
I booked a one bedroom apartment in September 2017 for 2 nights in February 2018 via Booking.Com. I understood them to be light, spacious and with city views, so was bitterly disappointed on arrival to find that Room 214 had no natural light, was dark and dingy with no view. The lift at the property only goes to the second floor, a staircase then goes to the third - this room is situated underneath a section of the staircase and is very noisy.
Apparently the property was fully booked so there was no alternative accommodation available. Having booked 6 months in advance I would have expected to have been offered a decent room, but was advised that booking through Booking.Com may have been the problem and I should have booked directly with Quest, which would also have been cheaper!
A very disappointing stay, but fortunately only for 2 nights.

title: Central location
text:
We stayed at the Quest for 13 nights. Most people either stay for a few days only or for 3 months or so on work contracts. This is a fairly old building which has been sympathetically converted into apartments. We asked for a quiet room away from traffic noise and got exactly that. The drawback was that we had absolutely no view. So you have to decide which is more important to your needs.
For a two weeks stay we found the storage facilities were inadequate which meant that we had at least partially to live out of a suitcase. The other main negative is the nature of the very uncomfortable lounge sofa and chair.  Again fine for a day or two but not if you are staying for a week or more.
In a perfect world we would also have liked some kitchen scissors and a wall clock.

Now for some of the things we liked. First of all the location. It is ideal for the CBD, for the river side walks, and for Seddon Park. A supermarket is about 10minutes walk away. The Domain and lake are a bit of a trek, perhaps 25 minutes, but well worth the effort. The central bus station is about a 10 minute walk with suitcases, less without!
The apartment itself was clean, fairly spacious, and well equipped. The kitchen area boasted a microwave, oven and hot plate. A washing machine and tumble dryer, placed in the bathroom, earned high marks. The bathroom enjoys good natural light.
We had the excellent breakfast pack several times and it is strongly recommended. There is an extensive range of television channels and wifi  is free. The apartments are serviced daily except on Sundays. There is complimentary membership to a very good gym just 5 minutes walk away.
Finally we must say how much we appreciated the front office staff. They were exceptionally friendly, helpful and efficient. If only the same was true everywhere. We would certainly recommend the Quest on London Road for a stay in Hamilton.

title: Strange room layout
text:
Its only ok. Long room for the kitchen, very tight tv and lounge area, in fact cramped, and then a separate bedroom with ensuite and laundry in it. 

Hairs on the pillow and just felt a little shabby! 

No reception attendance at 6pm and had to get in via an intercom. But room key was waiting for us at reception in an envelope. 

It has no facilities other than your room.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your feedback, we do appreciate your comments as they provide an opportunity for continual improvement. 

Being a heritage building our apartments are generally larger than a typical hotel room with each having its own character. We are always happy to offer a specific type of room to suit our guests. As you do mention every apartment does offer a full kitchen and laundry making us an excellent choice for both long and short stay.  

We are disappointed that you found hairs on the pillow, our housekeeping team are usually scrupulous about cleaning, we have discussed this with our head housekeeper who will bring it up with the team to ensure it doesn't happen again. 

Reception is manned from 7am to 7pm during the working week and 8am to 4pm during weekends and holidays. However we have an excellent after hours service and a phone on reception, our on site staff are available 24 hours should our guests require help.

We hope to see you again soon, we are sure that you will find things much more enjoyable.

title: Great night’s stay
text: Stayed here as closest big town to Hobbiton tour (and had driven from Bay of Islands and didn’t want to drive all way to Rotorua). We had 2x interconnecting rooms for 2 adults and 3 kids. Perfect set up, huge, clean, 2x kitchens, bathrooms and 3x tvs!!! Didn’t explore Hamilton town as left early next day for Hobbiton.

title: Great location
text:
I love the location of this place, right in the heart of town, a bit noisy with traffic but that’s to be expected given its location.
Very modern and clean apartments.  Spacious and includes all amenities, gym passes to local Les Mills.
Great service on the front desk!  Love my stays!
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback it is appreciated. We are really fortunate to be so well located close to everything yet much quieter that you would expect. We note your comment regarding the noise. We do have rooms which are very quiet, if you prefer one of these please don't hesitate to request this. We are always happy to add this preference to your booking.

title: Surprisingly good
text:
We were not expecting a 5 star stay, and certainly were not disappointed- it’s a real billy basic bed for the night. The lift only goes to floor 2, reception is only certain hours, wifi is slow and parking additional.

But, what it is: a hotel with large rooms, washing machines, kitchenettes, exceptionally tidy and staffed by a friendly team. My room on floor 2 was quiet and airy.

Would I stay again? Yes, it’s a decent 3 star hotel, with all of the trappings.....

title: Great location and fantastic room
text:
Located within walking distance of restaurants, movie theatres, the river and inner city shopping mall the apartment was light airy and spacious with a compact but very useable kitchenette and own washing machine and dryer in the bathroom.
The King size bed was comfortable and the heat pump welcome as the room was warm with the afternoon sun streaming in.
The check in staff very friendly and helpful. We will stay again when visiting
We stayed in 203 on a Saturday night and didn't encounter any street noise

title: Apartment in the city
text:
Great very reasonably priced apartment in hamilton. Good location with great cafe (machina) and sushi spot nearby. Clean and had everything we needed. Great to have a separate bedroom. Customer service was great. Apartment was light and roomy. Would definitely stay again. 
The only downside is parking as there’s minimal parking at the hotel. But lots of free parking on the street.

title: Adequate but noisy
text:
The rooms are ok but a lot of street noise. Single pane windows and a building that is located along Hamilton's Main Street = a lot of road noise. 

Kitchen facilities are adequate. Beds firm. My wife found a kit Kat wrapper in the sofa so cleaning could be improved. 

On the plus side, it is centrally located with lots of eateries nearby. The staff were very friendly and helpful.

title: Good location, comfortable stay
text:
Good central location. Building has been converted so all the rooms/apartments are different which is cool and all very spacious. 
Good facilities in all rooms including washer and dryer. 
Staff friendly and helpful. 
Columbus Cafe next door is convenient for breakfast. 
Would happily stay there again.

title: Quirky
text: We had a 2 room apartment on the 3rd level.  Huge room with good bed and linen.  You must realise this building has been turned into a hotel so has some quirky bits to it.  The lift only goes to the 2 level so you have to lug up your bags up stairs which is not biggie really.  Not much in the way of parking so had to park on the street.  Very clean and tidy and overall a pleasant stay.

title: Clean, tidy, well serviced rooms
text: I have stayed at this hotel twice now with work (for two weeks at a time).  My highlights have been the very helpful and friendly staff, and the beds as comfortable as anywhere.  The rooms are well equipped for longer stays, with the exception of inadequate shelves/cupboards for food storage in the kitchenette.  Rooms are equipped with a washing machine and dryer as well.  Car parking is available; it is a stacking arrangement which requires drivers to leave the keys at reception (in case they need to move them to allow other cars' entry/egress).  This works OK but requires some pre-planning if you need the car in the evenings, due to the limited reception hours.  Again the staff are very good keeping up with the guests' movements to prevent disruptions.  The only thing I found to be below par at the Quest is the WiFi, seems to just drop out intermittently, but only for short periods.  Overall a pleasant experience staying here.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comprehensive feedback, this is really appreciated. We take on board your comments and where possible we will always look to act on this to improve guest experience. Unfortunately the wifi modem may have been an issue during your stay however I am assured that this is now be functioning correctly. 
We look forward to hopefully hosting you again in the not too distant future.
Kind regards Larry and the team at Quest Hamilton.

title: clean, older hotel, poor wifi
text:
This is a service apartment hotel with spacious rooms, full size washer dryer and kitchen. The hotel is in an older building that was not built as a hotel.  My friend's room has only a side window that causes one to feel as if in a windowless basement.  The usual things are 1) reception is not open and staffed 24/7, it closes after 7PM on weekdays and after 4PM on weekends.  In fact front door is locked and accessible with your room key. The second thing is free wifi i(150 mbyte) s extremely limited and short, and even when one is agreeable to pay NZ$10/day, the staff struggles to provide an username and password.  This was my first to NZ for official business.  I picked to stay here from a shortlist provided by the host.  While I planned to stay a week, wifi is absolute importance than the washer dryer and kitchen.  

There are lots of places to eat close-by and the grocery store is just two blocks away.

On check-in, the one person at the desk was patient, willing, and helpful.

title: Light and airy serviced apartments
text: We booked these apartments for our family and enjoyed the extra space compared to a hotel room. Kitchenettes are included in the apartments making them handy for meals. Staff were extremely friendly and helpful and the beds were very comfortable. Washing machine and dryer were also in the bathroom. Very quiet. A great spot to stay.
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind feedback, we really appreciate your comments. Hopefully we will see you again in the not too distant future.

title: Excellent Overnight Stay.
text: Due to us being involved with the Dragon Boating over last weekend we stayed in the centre of Hamilton at the Quest - the man at reception was very obliging and helpful. The appt. was imaculate with everything we needed!
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind comments. We are fortunate to have such a great team who are passionate about delivering the best service possible.

title: Great apartments in a historical building
text:
Husband and I stayed at this lovely accommodation for four nights whilst visiting Hamilton.  
Our one bedroom suite had everything needed for short or longer term stays.  Small kitchenette, microwave, dishwasher, electric cook top as well as tea bags, coffee, sugar and milk. The bathroom had a lovely shower, fluffy towels, towel warmer and toiletries. It also had a washing machine and a dryer. 
There are limited parking bays undercover for $10 per night and the staff are happy to park your car for you as it is 'stackable' parking. Alternatively Wilson's parking is across the road and street parking is free from 3pm to 9am week days. 
Internet costs $10 per day and has a very fast connection. 
We had a suite facing the street and street noise did not bother us (or any other noise). 
There are quite a few nice restaurants within easy walking distance. We ate at Classic Thai, Jaipur Indian, Londoner Pub and all were great. Some restaurants also have a charge back agreement in place with Quest Hamilton. I also thInk they are happy to deliver. 
There is a cafe next door which serves breakfast and lunch and makes terrific coffee.  Even had it delivered to our room one morning. :)
Larry and his team did a wonderful job looking after all our needs and we would like to extend our thank you to all of you.  
If ever we visit Hamilton again, Quest Hamilton will be our port of call.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, it is lovely to receive such a complementary review. We are lucky to have such a great team who really love what they do. We look forward to looking after you again hopefully in the not too distant future. All the best Larry.

title: Noisey! no privacy
text: This place is average! some rooms have no view unless you stand on a chair as the windows are extra high. Very noisey vehicle traffic throughout the night. Cleaning staff seem to think its their right to just walk into your room without warning you first, a simple phone call to the room would have been perfect. There's alot of hang around street people (homeless) in the area so watch your bags.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, it is appreciated. We are lucky to enjoy a lovely heritage building rather than the typical smaller cookie cutter style accommodation. Each of our hotel apartments are generally larger and completely different, many of our regular guests have particular preferences for certain rooms and this one is often specifically requested. We did investigate your concerns in regard to housekeeping at the time of your stay. Daily housekeeping and room servicing takes place after 10 am the staff always knock loudly twice and wait for a response before entering. Unfortunately in this case no one responded and they entered the room. In every room we have 'Do Not Disturb' signs located on the inside door handle, if used our housekeepers will not enter and they will come back later to service the apartment, if the sign is still displayed reception will call the room to ask permission to service the room.

title: Very pleasant hotel
text:
We stayed in the Quest Hamilton for four nights and found it an excellent base for our visit to Hamilton.
The staff on the front desk, Eugene, Larry and Sunni were the highlight of our visit.  They were all exceptionally friendly and helpful, ready at all times for advice and assistance.  They made a very pleasant stay even more so.  Thank you.
The apartment was well organised - a comfortable bed, lounge area, kitchen and bathroom/laundry.  All in the centre of Hamilton, a short stroll from restaurants, galleries and the museum.
The only thing that let the hotel down was the WiFi - totally unusable in our apartment (211) - totally inexplicable in that easy solutions to the problem, that extend coverage of the WiFi network, are readily available and cheap.  The problem is well known to the staff.  For goodness sake, fix it!
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, your comments are really appreciated. We are fortunate to be in such a fantastic location. Close to the heart of the city yet in such a quiet position to escape.  In regard to the wifi there was an issue a faulty modem, we are pleased to report that this has been rectified and wifi coverage throughout the hotel is excellent once again.

title: Never again
text:
Arrived at 1.45pm, checked in. Got to room to find it not cleaned or bed changed. Went for a walk while this was addressed for me.

As this is a city centre hotel you would expect the facilities to be plenty - not if you want parking....you must book in advance as they have very limited parking and certainly no where near enough to cover the amount of rooms they have. Again a city centre apartment I expect the majority of their customers travel from outside Hamilton. So they more then lightly drive cars.....you can park on the public road if comfortable leaving your car out all night

Beds very uncomfortable and with cheap poor quality pillows makes for a patchy nights sleep.

Checking out is also fun when being charged for 4 nights wifi when only staying one night and not using wifi.

It's not central to where the bars and restaurants are. Better places to stay in Hamilton and closer to everything
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, sorry that you had been so disappointed with your stay. We do however appreciate the opportunity to address your concerns. Our check in time is at 2pm our audit trail indicates a check in time of 1.18pm. We would normally be happy to check in a guest earlier however unfortunately at the time of your arrival our new junior receptionist didn't check the time or talk to head of housekeeping to see if the room was ready. We do apologize for this and we have since used this as a training opportunity . On check out our receptionist simply sought to clarify with you which room you had occupied as she hadn't met you till this point. Rest assured that at no time would we have charged for anything other than the night you stayed with us. Unfortunately beds and pillows can be such a personal thing, for most they seem exceptionally happy, however they are certainly not inexpensive.  In regard to parking we are fortunate to be able to offer 15 secure carparks on site, these are booked on a first in basis and prior to arrival, this is made clear when booking online. Parking is free after 3pm to 9am many people prefer to park on the street and we often find ourselves with few cars in our car park. We are fortunate to be so well located a short walk to everything in the CBD but more peaceful. Of course we are really unhappy that you did not enjoy your stay this time however given another opportunity we are confident things will be much more pleasant for you.

title: Fantastic Location
text: Stayed just the one night, & overall happy with our experience. The room was large, & had everything you would need from a small kitchen, washing machine & drier, & even an iron & ironing board. The don't have the full range of Sky channels in their setup, with only 2 sports channels. Car par is stacked, but that was no issue on our visit, was just like parking normally for us. Best of all, great value for money
hotel_response:
Thank you for taking the time to provide us with your feedback. We are pleased that you enjoyed your stay and that you benefited from our extra facilities. People are pleasantly surprised that we offer washing machines and dryers in every apartment, especially for longer staying guests. Sky works well for us and for most part they feature the key sports events on these two channels.  Value for money is paramount for us so it is appreciated that you have included this in your feedback. 
We hopefully look forward to seeing you again soon.
Regards, The team at Quest Hamilton.

title: Central hotel in Hamilton
text: The hotel is centrally located, minutes walk from skycity as well as the river front. There is also a night market nearby on saturdays, and street parking is free from 3pm to 9am on weekends, so it was a pretty good deal!
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, we are really fortunate to be so well located to a variety of terrific facilities. Yes the night market is a real treat. Parking is generally quite good at the weekends however don't forget that we have secure valet parking too. Hopefully we will see you again soon. All the best Larry.

title: Central to City but Parking an issue.
text: We stayed on the third floor for three nights. The lift (small) only goes to the second floor then you must take the stairs up to the third. This was not an issue for us but would be if you are elderly or incapacitated in some way.  We were told the lift issue was because the building is heritage listed and the alterations could not be made. Our room (303) was reasonably large and well appointed. There is a small kitchen sink and cooking facilities along with laundry equipment and a hair dryer! Unfortunately we wanted to watch the Australian Open Tennis and were not able to because the Sky TV only had two sport and one movie channels.  There are some lovely river walks close to the hotel and gym facilities are available.  Car parking is an issue with "stacked" parking next door. I chose to park on the street and battle the parking inspectors. It is because of this and the lift issue that I give the Quest three stars but it is better than 3 star. We would stay here again.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your feedback, it is appreciated. We are very proud of our beautiful old building, especially that we can offer such a variety of large individual apartments rather than the small cookie cutter type hotel spaces typically on offer. 
Unfortunately we have no control over Sky schedules and understand that this would be disappointing as a tennis fan regardless.
While we do offer stacked car parking, this enables us to almost double our available space enabling more guests to benefit from the secure car parks. They are similar in size to a normal parking space, of course we are always happy to help and offer valet parking at no additional charge.   Once again thank you for the feedback and we really look forward to seeing you again in the hopefully not too distant future. Regards Larry.

title: Shaky time
text: Stayed at the quest hamilton for two nights. The room and amenities are pleasant. But the curtains don't block out the street lights. The room i had was well lite from light getting past the curtains. The stsff were pleasant and helpful. There isn't much near the hotel in the way of food. A couple of coffee shops for the morning wake-up. But for dinner, its a bit of a walk. Ok on a good night, but not good for raining nights. Its in the city centre but a tad far from the food end of main drag. Plus the building shakes during earth tremors, quite considerably. The lift is tiny
hotel_response: Thank you for your comments, We do use thick insulated curtains which do prevent light getting in however light can get around them if not completely pulled. There are a number of great restaurants within close walking distance, our team are always available to make recommendations and provide directions depending on your preferences. Rest assured our building was recently renovated in the past few years, it was required to meet new building codes. I think the whole country felt the ground shake with the quake you refer to. All the best, we look forward to welcoming you again soon. Larry

title: Location great but ho hum!
text: The location of this hotel is excellent and ready walking distance to everything. I booked parking but there was none upon arrival and thank goodness as the stacked parking arrangements mean early leavers are in trouble. The Room was spacious and overlooked the street but was very much in need of renovation into the late twentieth century. Compliments on the cleanliness of the room. Reception was fine but not very obliging and we parked across the road in the Wilson Parking lot which is not very secure but convenient and meant we didn't have to wait on reception to get our car. Cost about twenty dollars but at least no hassle. This is a place to stay when you are tired, need a laundry and are not planning on staying long.

title: Central but a little inconvienient
text: We stayed here for a stop over to Wellington. The room was comfortable but very small. The addition of a washer and dryer was very useful, however we didn't require them. Reception hours aren't the best, being to about 7am to 7pm from memory. The parking is stacked, which means it is very difficult to move your car between 7pm and 7am. This would be a massive inconvenience for early leavers. Service staff were very friendly when we spoke to them during hours. We checked in after hours so we couldn't get access to the WIFI.

title: Clean great location
text: Great place to stay. I decided to stay here while visiting friends. I find quest a good place to stay where ever I am because they have a kitchen and washing machine. Parking is available, although it is stacked parking. Eugene was very helpful. Service was friendly, room was very big and clean. Would stay again. Helen

title: QUEST a great choice in Hamilton
text: Dealing with the Management of the hotel from the time of booking - I knew, as a small group, we were going to be looked after - and we were.  We were welcomed by Robert and Sunny and assisted with parking as well as given good information about the rooms, WiFi, local coffee shop next door, etc.
hotel_response:
Hi Tricia

Thank you for this review. Your group was a delight and it's our pleasure to be of service. It was nice of you as well to give tickets from your show which we enjoyed and got to know a bit more of the group. It was a bit busy for you because of your constant touring but we're glad that you enjoyed your stay with us. Hope you'll visit us again soon and congratulations to your successful tour. It was amazing! We look forward to be of service next time. :)

Kind regards, 

Sunny, Reception

title: Good for a Business Trip
text: As with all Quest Apartments this was clean, tidy, well maintained and centrally located. My room had additional laundry facilities which was welcome. Staff were friendly and helpful giving me all the advice i needed, including a great run along the river walkway. Restaurants are just around the corner giving a good mix of cuisine, including Indian, Thai and Italian. Parking is the only issue as they use the stacking system which can be inconvenient, but I had no issues as I was only here for one night. Happy to recommend for business or a short stay.
hotel_response: Dear Swooty.  Thank you for your time to review your recent stay. Quest is always a great option for business or personal visits to Hamilton with Kitchens and Laundry facilities in all apartments. Great to see you enjoyed a healthy run on the boardwalk next to the river. A lovely spot and so close by. We enjoyed your short visit and hope to be of service again. Robert

title: Central location, great for business travellers
text:
Have stayed here many many times over the last 5 years or so, always been comfortable. Most rooms are quite spacious and well equipped, which is great for long travel stints as you can wash and dry your clothes, eat in if you want etc. Rooms facing Victoria str can be very noisy, especially when the street sweeper comes by at 4am! Ensure the windows are closed. All other rooms are generally quiet though.

The parking is always interesting- generally full and always challenging, but the staff are usually happy to park for you- just remember to let them know when you need your car by in the morning, as they use lifts and if your car is on the top above another one, you might be stuck for a while as they shuffle them around.

Good selection of coffee shops in the vicinity for breakfast (their breakfast pack is a bit slim), and easy walking distance to all the main restaurants in town.

The two Quest buildings (London and Ward streets) are managed by the same staff, so there may not be anyone at the front desk, so I tend to call them as I enter Hamilton if arriving after 7pm or so, rather than take the chance of having to wait at the door while they make there way across.

Overall, very good value.
hotel_response: Hi Anthony H. We value your visits over the last 5 years.  We enjoy catching up with our regulars each visit.  Our continental Breakfast Pack is a pretty good value for those who want to enjoy a few more minutes relaxing before rushing out into the day.  Of course Columbus Coffee are next door and there are lots of breakfast options around for a hearty hot meal.  Just a note on our staffing, as with most Quest properties, we are open until 7pm at both properties with dedicated staffing at each.  After that time, arrival is and easy intercom at the door and you are home sweet home before you know it. For arrivals after 7 we will try to give a call if we have a contact number, unless you are regular and know the ropes.  Parking is a great system as long we we all communicate.  Busy yes, but with your great help all goes well.  Thanks again and see you next time in paradise Hamilton!  Robert

title: Good size, friendly staff
text: We had a comfortable stay in this hotel. The reception staff were all helpful and friendly offering many tips about where the supermarkets are, what is a good area to explore. The housekeeping was good, they even helped clean out unwashed dishes for us! Ample towels and toilet amenities for in the apartment. Kids thought the apartment was a cosy hidey hole for the family. Only thing is, the elevator goes to only to the 2nd floor. While the staff helped us move our luggage to the 3rd floor when we checked in, we had quite a time moving them to the 2nd floor when we checked out.
hotel_response: Dear Zippingeverywhere.  It was lovely to meet your family and hope you enjoyed exploring the wonderful Waikato region. I believe you went to see Hobbiton and the Waitomo Caves but there is much more to see in our area also.  Our 2 bedroom apartments are all located on the 3rd floor.  So the lift goes to the 2nd floor and then a staircase up to the 3rd floor.  Another option is to book an interconnecting set of apartments.  Also great for a family and located on the floor serviced by elevator. Thank you for staying.  Warm regards from a sunny day in Hamilton.  Robert

title: Nice old building, spacious rooms
text:
I stayed in Hamilton for seven nights for business. This was my second visit to Hamilton and I chose this hotel over where I stayed previously, not because I was unhappy with the other hotel, but because Quest was so well located.  And (in the pictures) it looked like a nice old building renovated.
The location is indeed excellent.  There's an OK cafe beneath the hotel, and it's a short walk to the main area of restaurants and cafes of Hamilton.  It's also only a minute or two walk to the pleasant walking track along the Waikato River, which I walked every day of a morning.
The staff were very friendly without being intrusive.  Parking is limited and utilises car stackers, but the staff are happy to park or extract your car if you want them to.  However, reception is not 24 hour, and I am not sure what you'd do if your car was on top with another car underneath, and you needed to go out.  Fortunately this didn't happen to me, and the staff are careful to enquire as to whether you are likely to need your car when you arrive of an evening.
My room was a one bedroom apartment on the first floor.  It had two of the bay windows visible in the official photos of the hotel, which are actually not so easy to see out of as they look, as presumably due to renovation floor level changes, which left the window sill at chest height, and the window extended well up past the high ceiling.  The room was spacious and modern inside, and was clean, quiet and comfortable.  My only real issue was that the fridge was switched off at the power point when I arrived, which I didn't notice, so my milk and juice for breakfast were warm on my first morning.  The switch was hard to reach so I've no idea how this came to be.   The room also used those annoying light switch master controls where you need to insert your room key in a holder to turn the lights on.
The wardrobe was also too shallow - I couldn't fit my suitcase in there at all, even closed and upright, and any clothes on hangers protruded out past the sliding doors, which could have been easily gotten right when being built.  But now I am nitpicking.
The bathroom had a washer and drier, so I didn't end up taking home a case of dirty laundry.
Outside the room, there was a large and pleasantly furnished lounge area, which was never once in use any time I passed through, but looked nice, and would be good if you were in a party of more than one room staying there.
I had a very good stay, and would certainly stay there again.  The hotel was very good value.
hotel_response: Dear Thealphabet. Thank you for taking the time to review your stay with us recently. We enjoyed having you here with us. Quest Apartment Hotels are an excellent option for travelers with kitchens and washing facilities in all rooms as you have pointed out. It is good to see you got to experience the river boardwalk for your morning stroll. With only 38 apartments, we do value the opportunity to get to know our guests.  There are several great places for breakfast or other meals close by and we look forward to welcoming you again when you next need us here in Hamilton.  regards Robert

title: Field days visit
text: Have stayed here for last three years. Always have same room as home for four days. Good size room, with washing machine and dryer etc. bed not the best. Asked for extra topper pad, that solved the problem. Small walk to the hub of Hamilton. Prices increase hugely like all accommodation at this time of the year so be prep aired to pay more.
hotel_response: Dear Vicki97. Field Days is a fun but extremely busy time here in Hamilton of course.  We thank you for staying with us over the last 3 years and have enjoyed getting to know you both. Events like Field days stir up the place, but even at other times, there is a lot to do in this area.  With Hobbiton only 40 minutes away, Waitomo Caves, Raglan Beaches are also a short drive.  It is a great base to explore the region and come home to a meal at one of the excellent restaurants in the entertainment precinct close by.  Don't forget that at both our Quest properties in Hamilton, we offer free passes to Les Mills gym.  It will be great to see you and be of service again.  Regards Robert

title: Clean and well appointed rooms
text: These apartments are of a good size, well appointed and close to good cafes.  The staff are friendly and very helpful.  Ideal for couples or the business traveller with laundry facilities provided within the apartment also.  Highly recommended.
hotel_response: Dear Ruth K.  Thank you for staying at Quest Hamilton. We enjoyed having you here.  Quest is a prefect choice with our full kitchens and laundry facilities in all apartments and spacious rooms. We look forward to being of service to you again, make sure to call us directly for best rates and personal service.  regards Robert and Chern

title: Ok but a few problems
text: The staff were freindly and obliging but the room itself was cramped, gloomy with minimal kitchen amenities. The tv had very poor reception and a couple of channels were impossible to watch.  We stayed in two other Quest motels in our travels and unfortunately this one did not match their high standards. Ok but a but disappointing
hotel_response: Dear Peter.  We thank you for staying with us on such a busy weekend. We enjoyed having you here.  A big game of rugby in Hamilton and other events made for a fun time. Our lovely heritage building is usually appreciated by our guests and I am sorry if you found your room a little dark due to a smaller window in that room. I have noted this on your profile just in case you are in our area again.  TV channels are being reviewed at the moment as we look at options.  We have the usual Sky channels at the moment but we are looking at other ways to keep in touch with the world and be entertained.  It is great that you enjoyed Quest in NZ.  There is lots more to explore so we hope to see you again.  regards Robert and Chern

title: Great Location Excellent Service
text: Stayed for one night in a one b/r apartment. Room was immaculately presented and a good size for two people. The bathroom also featured a washing machine and dryer which would be useful if staying longer. Great facilities including free parking and wifi. The bed was a little on the hard side but what you would normally get in hotels. The first floor featured a meeting area with seating which would be great if you were staying with other people. We stayed on the first floor, next to the lift..we were initially worried about noise but it was very quiet on both fronts!The staff were very helpful with special mention to Robert. Thanks for an enjoyable stay!
hotel_response: Dear Raylene.  It is wonderful to see you enjoyed Hamilton and the Quest. We were happy to get to know you over your stay.  Being so close to everything in the city, but away from the noise of the south end pubs makes our location perfect for any visit. Being an apartment Hotel it makes all the difference to have the space plus washing machine and dryer and of  course the kitchen.  It is good to see you felt at home here with us. You are welcome any time!  warm regards, Robert and Chern

title: Old and new world. Great place to stay
text: Our studio room was spacious, very clean, had great amenities including dishwasher and washing facilities. Had retained the lovely grandeur of a bygone era on the outside with the modern apartment internally. Fantastic staff. Very helpful and friendly. Went out of their way to make us feel welcome after difficult start with our trip. Centrally located. Easy parking. We parked in the street. Saturday night was more noisy than usual but not bad enough to stop us sleeping.   Good price and would recommend this to our friends.
hotel_response: Dear Morris52.  Our lovely heritage building is complimented well with a modern interior and it is great to see you felt at home here. We enjoyed your company also over the couple of days you spent here. There is plenty to do in our region, from Waitomo Caves and Hobbiton and a central base to explore Rotorua, Taupo and the beaches to the East and West.  I hope you got to explore the charming Casabella Lane with it's special boutiques just around the corner, before the Mall. Please be sure to contact us directly either on our website or a phone call to secure direct booking privileges and great rates for all bookings.  We naturally prioritize direct bookings.  There is lots more to do in our area, so please drop in again!  regards Robert and Chern

title: Good quality
text: Good standard of accommodation and service as expected from Quest apartments. Loved the big old windows, with modern decor. Super close to the river, restaurants and coffee shops. Secure parking is good, although if you're not confident in tight parking spaces, might pay to ask reception to help you park. Only issue was the some wall damage from the ceiling almost to the floor which had been half fixed.
hotel_response: Dear explorer95549. Hamilton is a great base to explore this wonderful region and Quest Apartment Hotels are a good choice in 35 locations in NZ and Fiji plus Australia of course. This lovely heritage building was lovingly restored and Quest opened in 2012. We love our location close to everything but away from the noisy area of the South part of Victoria Street. It is great to see you enjoyed your stay.  email or call us always for the best "Book Direct Rate" and we will continue to look after you!  regards Robert and Chern.

title: Tons of Space
text: If you like very spacious, modern, high-ceilinged accommodation in an interesting historic building, in the centre of the city - this is your place.  There are plenty of cafes and restaurants within a short walking distance north and south of the Quest.  Two large supermarkets are a two-minute drive away.  We had the two bedroom interconnecting apartments (205-206) on level two overlooking Victoria Street.  Room 205 is in the north/east corner and has two huge windows that let in plenty of light.  Our two adult sons stayed in the twin room in 206.  Both apartments have their own kitchenette, bathroom and laundry.  The great thing about this Quest is the open guest areas with interesting furnishings and massive amounts of space.  If the two large apartments are still not big enough for you - you can spill out into the shared guest areas.  Secure parking is within the complex with a reasonable daily charge of $10.  The staff are very friendly and professional - when at short notice we asked to extend our stay by three nights, they kindly accommodated us.  I have a lot of experience as a business traveller staying in Quest apartments - I like the concept and the quality of the accommodation - and especially the professionalism of the staff.  Having extra space, a kitchen and a full laundry is an unbeatable combination for tourists and business people alike.
hotel_response: Dear AbhayHamilton. Thank you for staying with us and your great review. Being a recent development in a marvelous heritage building, we enjoy our modern set up with the space and features you mentioned that make it something special. We enjoyed having your family stay with us, and of course will always do our best to accommodate changes to assist. As you found, it is always best to book directly with us for best rates and flexibility.  Our guests also enjoy our free passes to Les Mills gym around the corner from us ( when they are not enjoying the great cafes close by! )  We trust all goes well for your new adventures and hope to be of service to you and your family again sometime.  warm regards, Robert and Chern

title: Awesome Quest
text:
Stayed several times since September 2015 for week at a time.  Fantastic service from Robert and his team made these stays incident free and a stress free which allowed us to focus on our training conferences. My rooms were always clean fresh and tidy.

Great location close to the CBD, excellent variety of charge back retsurants, covered parking available. Free gym visits with our stay.

I would highly recommend Quest on London Street.
hotel_response: Dear Tom. it is great to see that you have enjoyed your series of stays over the last several months. We enjoyed getting to know you and were happy to support your busy work schedule here in Hamilton. Our complimentary Les Mills passes are a real hit with our guests and is a fantastic gym. Have a great holiday and we look forward to being of service again sometime in the new year perhaps!  regards Robert and Chern

title: Hidden Gem
text:
Our family stayed at the Quest on London St (right in the CBD), a few weeks back for the first time.

From the phone call to book a room, the warm welcome, fabulous room along with location, I can't honestly not fault this hotel at all.

Both Robert and John's customer service was excellent.  Both gentlemen were highly knowledgeable on the area and activities available and knew their jobs inside out.

We booked a studio apartment which we assumed would be reasonably small, however when we walked through the door the apartment was more than spacious. We had a fabulous kitchenette with everything you could wish for, a shower room equipped with both a tumble dryer and washing machine.  The room was exceptionally clean and well presented.

They also offer off street parking for $10 a night which is a great option, especially when most things are in walking distance. 

We'd recommend the Quest Hotel to anyone and will definitely be returning in the near future.
hotel_response: Dear Lizzie. Fantastic to see you loved your short break away to Hamilton and enjoyed the Quest Hamilton for your accommodation needs. We value our great location, a close stroll to Cassabella Lane for boutique shopping or the Centre Place Mall 1 block away. Did you get to take the river walk? You can walk for miles along the mighty Waikato River and enjoy the peaceful sights. We were happy to be of service and get to know you whilst here. always remember that you get the best rates and best rooms if you book direct with us. Free unlimited WiFi only for those who book direct is an added bonus as a thank you from Jono and I.  Can't wait to welcome you again.  Regards Robert and Chern.

title: Great service and great property!
text: Nicely located in the Hamilton CBD, very close to a lot of eateries. Check in was smooth and hassle free. Staff very accommodating and friendly at all times. Room was spacious and tidy. All in all comfortable stay would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Hamilton.
hotel_response: Dear AsifC1985.  We love to see local Hamilton people treating themselves to a well deserved break at Quest Hamilton. In our busy lives we sometimes forget how many fantastic eateries there are in our wonderful city. So nice to enjoy a great meal with friends and family and not have to drive home as we are an easy walk to everything. A late breakfast / brunch is a very civilized way to spend a Sunday morning as well. Thank you for choosing Quest Hamilton.  Drop in again soon!  regards Robert and Chern

title: Wonderful stay, felt like home!  Lots of aloha!
text:
We stayed at the Quest Hamilton (London Street) for our recent conference and had a wonderful stay!  The rooms were perfect - nice kitchen to cook and prepare meals, 2 TVs, spacious rooms for 3 beds and centrally located in Hamilton.  Near bus stops, grocery stores and the free shuttle.  Loved the washer/dryer combo in the bathroom.  Robert, the owner/manager even found us a rice cooker from their sister property.

One of our highlights was the management and staff.  VERY professional, helpful and fun to return home to each evening.  We even made a return visit later in the week (after we checked out) and couldn't get a night's accommodation in Auckland.  Driving the 1.5 hours was worth it!

The free shuttle picks up around the corner, nice way to tour Hamilton, go to Countdown or Pack/Save to shop.  Check schedule and times during weekend or later hours.

Strongly suggest this place to anyone visiting beautiful New Zealand and staying in Hamilton.  We had a perfect stay, loved it and the price is right too!  Mahalo!
hotel_response: Dear Denice and the rest of the gang!  We so enjoyed your extended stay for the conference.  You were all so cheerful even with your busy days. That is what we love about Quest is that we get to make such nice friends with our guests being a smaller property. Your return for one night was a surprise but glad we could find space on another busy weekend. We miss your smiles morning and night and hope to be of service another time.  warm regards Robert and Chern

title: Said by the manager to be the best hotel in Hamilton but that is not my impression
text: My apartment was spacious with big windows but on one side of the bed the springs were evident which is not the mark of the best hotel in town. Also had a broken power outlet in the kitchen. Location is convenient and my check in was easy but not so for my colleague
hotel_response: Dear KiwitTraveler. Thank you so much for staying with us! We appreciate your choice and feedback too. Quest Hamilton is a beautiful heritage building with a modern 3 and a half year old Quest property in the business heart of Hamilton. I note some concerns about your room and would love to have discussed this with you so that i could have got the details ( like which room ) and assisted you on the spot. Our beds are only 3.5 years old so I would like to know of your experience naturally.  As the manager here, my aim is for  our 2  CBD Quest properties be the preferred accommodation of choice for business and leisure travelers to Hamilton, As for which hotel is best I would personally not be so outspoken but would leave that to our many lovely guests to decide.  warm regards and chat with me next time you are here, I look forward to that.  regards Robert

title: Perfect
text: Perfect location and well appointed rooms. Excellent reception with friendly and accommodating staff! TV, Wifi all works perfectly well. Unfortunately was raining heavy for the night we stayed but hotel has no umbrella service.. Just a hint!
hotel_response: Dear Franz C.  We enjoying your visit last week and thank you for your review. It never rains in Hamilton!  oh well, yes it does, and thanks for the hint :-)    We do have limited numbers of umbrellas for that rainy day but will increase the stock held to help out.  we look forward to being of service again sometime soon in sunny Hamilton.  regards Robert and Chern.

title: Gross
text:
I was greeted on arrival by a very pleasant chap who advised the hotel was very busy  so I was given a 2 bed appt even though I was on my own.

I arrived in the room lifted the toilet seat and was greeted by floating faeces and a very stained toilet.

The bet curtains were stuck to the window where there were patches of black mold - this was a feature in both rooms. The walls were covered in marks where people had brushed past them or knocked into them over the years. The carpet looked pretty grubby. Bed sheets looked and smelled clean an the bed was moderately comfortable. The skirting boards had a layer of dust on them and looked like they hadn't been cleaned un a while.

I was woken at around 2 or 3am by someone moving bins or something outside.

Overall a pretty unpleasant experience and I will not be staying there again.
hotel_response: Dear darwin1905.  We thank you for choosing Quest Hamilton this week and for taking the time to review on your stay. I was pleased to meet you  when you arrived. We are very concerned to read you comments and note some serious housekeeping issues you encountered.  We have recently taken over this business and are enjoying the wonderful heritage building with a lovely 3 years young project of this serviced apartment.  Our feedback has been positive thus far as we get to know regulars and new visitors also.  So with your report we are taking this seriously with our housekeeping team to ensure this is an isolated case and not  repeated. We know you are very busy with your work, but we are here to help and i would have loved an opportunity to hear from you and assist the moment you found any concerns.  I do apologize for causing you discomfort and assure you your words are appreciated  as our Quest Properties work towards becoming the preferred choice in accommodation for Hamilton.  Your feedback will help us to reach this goal over the next short period.  Thank you once again.  Robert and Chern

text: q For Those people that are Fussy about Cleanliness, and have Time management issues and like myself spend there time servicing people to make a living  .. .. If this is you  or your Wife .. Well let me tell you this venue is absolutely BRILLIANT '' value for money and more '' I had the Dual suite and affectionately called it the PENTHOUSE ''  seriously '' BOOK '' you will not be Dissapointed
hotel_response: Dear Derek.  It is great to see you enjoyed your adventures in Hamilton over the weekend and found lots to do.  There are so many choices of scrumptious breakfast options and memorable cafes for dinner also. Did you discover Casabella Lane with all it's boutiques around the corner?  We enjoyed your visit and hope you venture forth again from Townsville another time to visit all the activities to be found in the Waikato region. We look forward to being of service again some time.  regards Robert and Chern

title: lovely roomy accomodation
text: We were impressed with the roomy studio room including bathroom.  The shower was excellent! The staff were friendly and the location is good - so close to the base. Would stay again even though we found the bed in our room a bit too firm.
hotel_response: Dear Lois M.   we are happy you enjoyed our wonderful Quest Hamilton and did some exploring or the cafes and shopping around the corner. Our beds are firm but good news is we will have heavenly toppers on the beds in the next couple of weeks.  I am sure you will love the experience for your next short break to Hamilton. Great food, shopping and lots to do so email or call us direct for special rates.  We look forward to  seeing you next time.  Regards Robert

title: Super nice staff and lovely accomodation
text: We were more then happy with our one bedroom apartment. Quest is nicely located to Bryce Street restaurants and shopping centre and on a relatively quiet part of the city. The room had all you need to self cater. Only downside was the bed was harder then we are used to. Was very impressed with the staff - super nice and helpful.
hotel_response: Dear Nedine2012. It seems like you have some good retail therapy in Bryce street; Casabella Lane is a really wonderful surprise almost hidden away and the Centre Place Mall is just s few steps away. Did you discover Mavis & Co or the River Kitchen for breakfast or brunch? Food is a great hobby and lots of great places to enjoy a meal and good company.  come back soon for another short break.  comfy beds are on the way soon!  regards Robert

title: excellent Stay
text: we arrived at the hotel after reception was closed.  It was an easy and pleasurable checkin. the young guy who check us out was pleasant and a real pleasure to deal with. I would definatley stay here again.
hotel_response: Dear JPS0414.  It is great to see you enjoyed your short stay with us recently. We enjoyed having you here. Next time you plan a visit to Hamilton, please contact us directly for the best deals we  can offer. Our regular guests are part of our family so we can thank you with special rates when booking on our website or directly by phone or email.  Did you discover Browser's Bookshop? It is open until 9pm in the cafe precinct near by and full or rare and interesting books. We hope to welcome you again some time for more adventures in Hamilton.  regards Robert

title: Very good Service
text: We went there for an exhibition and could store our equipment for an extra night without charge. Professional service and Robert was very cooperative. Perfect place and value for money. I can recommend this place.
hotel_response: Dear MichaNZ.  Thank you for your time to post your thoughts on your stay at Quest Hamilton and it is great to see you found our facilities and service were a good support to your busy days. We enjoyed having you both here also and getting to know you. Business, conferences and short breaks are a perfect match for Quest Hamilton.  We are glad to know you got some time to hit the snow at the end of your hard work. see you next time, Robert and Chern

title: Conference trip to Hamilton
text: Very pleasant helpful person at Quest reception, informed us about facilities, carparking and other aspects of Quest. Room was clean and tidy, well maintained. Quiet room, close to city centre. Worth staying here.
hotel_response: Dear heathermB4898II.  It is great to see you enjoyed your conference in Hamilton and you found Quest Hamilton perfect for your needs. With full kitchens and clothes washing facilities in all apartments, our spacious residences are great for a short or longer stay here in the CBD of Hamilton. An easy stroll to the Mall and cafes, yet away from the night time noise of the southern part of Victoria Street, we were happy to be of service during your busy time and hope to see you again soon.  regards Robert

title: Peaceful
text: loved staying at the quest in Hamilton, lots of nice close little shops, not far from shopping mall centre, manager was friendly and helpful, rooms were a nice size, clean and comfortable. I will be back :)
hotel_response: Dear denisek84   We are happy to see you had a great stay at Quest Hamilton.  It was good to meet you both as you explored the area and caught up with friends. 3 days gives you time to see the city sights and also visit Hobbiton, Waitomo Caves, Raglan Surf beaches and the thermal pools of Te Aroha.  Sanctuary Mountain is also really worth a visit.  Did you find the River Kitchen cafe for breakfast or wonderful Browsers Books for the rare and interesting novels? See you again next time you cross the ditch  warm regards Robert

title: Great apartments and amazing staff.
text:
My partner and I recently stayed here for 2 weeks after moving to NZ for work, (we stayed here until we sorted out a house)
First impressions were good, Robert the lovely gentleman greeted us at reception, he got us through the check in process fast as he knew we had just got off of the plane from the UK.
The room was fantastic, great size, comfortable, quiet and warm, you really couldn't have asked for more.
Bearing in mind we stayed during a particularly busy period due to a large agricultural show but even with this being the case nothing was ever to much hassle for Robert, he always had a smile and was always chatty and happy, more like a friend.
He arranged reference letters for our banks, received post and happily let us know if we had any even after we had left.
I really can't recommend Quest Hamilton enough, and as for Robert........ well he is a credit to the business and his profession, without his help, advice, friendly nature and just his general happy and smiling personality our stay wouldn't have been as memorable as it was.
hotel_response: Dear auditech1983.  We really enjoyed your stay with us recently as you discovered Hamilton region and started to settle into a new life here.  It was great to see you explore what is to be found near by and get to know us too.  Quest Hamilton is a great place to be based in the heart of Hamilton city.  Easy to walk to boutiques and cafes or along the river.  A short drive to Hobbiton or Waitomo Caves and the beaches either East or West are a great days adventure.  Our little team were glad to be of service to you and hope to see you again as you pass by.  warm regards, Robert and Chern.

title: Great little hotel in the heart of Hamilton City
text: My partner and I decided to stay in Hamilton overnight and came across this hotel online; it had great reviews on Tripadvisor so we decided that it would be a safe bet. The whole experience would not have been better; from cheap secure undercover parking, speedy and polite check in, to the clean modern rooms. Also only a couple of blocks from the city's casino and nightlife.
hotel_response:
Dear Jenny P
thank you for sharing your break away to Hamilton with us.  A weekend's break at the Quest means an easy walk to shops and great food. Best of all, leave the car behind and walk to one of the wonderful restaurants close by.  Best part of the weekend is a leisurely breakfast.  Try the famous Mavis and Co or River Kitchen for an amazing brunch.  Jenny, we hope to welcome you again soon.  warm regards, Robert and Chern

title: Awesome to have these new rooms
text: Lovely large rooms, newly decorated and furnished with all the amenities of a permanent residence. Great downtown location with free parking. It's a great idea to convert old buildings into beautiful modern units like this. We shall return!
hotel_response: Hi David T.  Quest Hamilton is a near new property located in a wonderful heritage building in the city centre of Hamilton. We are happy to see you enjoyed your stay and found it perfect for your needs. Central to everything, yet in a quiet neighbourhood, Quest Apartment Hotels are a fantastic balance of hotel quality with all the added space and features of a private residence in the city heart. see you again next visit.  regards Robert

title: Over Booked
text:
After receiving early confirmation of our booking ( 3 adults in a two bed-roomed Apartment) we arrived to find people already in our rooms and no other rooms available for us. The girl on the desk said that they had had problems and the room should have been empty and ready for us. To give her, her dues she tried hard to find other accommodation but as the cricket was on, it was impossible to find both the space and the 3 nights that we required.  The best suggestion was one night at another hotel then moving us again. This did not suit us as we were attending a course that began early and did not want to be moving. We waited over one hour, after a 5 hour drive and were not offered any refreshments as we sat there. The manager was away and the girl on the desk had just started, and tried her best. She knew nothing about Hamilton.
Finally we said that we would go out to the Airport Hotel, which added to the distance that we had to travel each of the three following mornings. Yes the hotel looked nice, which was why we booked it but we had booked early and didn't get any accommodation at the Quest.
Sort out your booking system please.

title: Good stay
text: I found this a very convenient and cosy stay as we were in a family of 7 with 2 rooms but still got to stay tgthr.. had a  really warm and home like feel.. would hv given the extra star if only they supplied free wifi..:(

title: Pay it forward
text:
We usually stay here when in Hamilton for work but found ourselves in need of accommodation when our new grandson was admitted to waikato hospital suddenly under stressful circumstances.  Imagine our complete surprise when arriving late to the room to discover a voucher for a nights accommodation.   Thanks so much to the kindness of staff and management here we have felt supported.   Maybe a small gesture to them but meant the world to us.  

The apartment like facilities like washing machine have come in handy too. Comfortable bed and pleasant decor.  We won't be staying anywhere else from now on and will endeavor to pay the kindness forward.  Outstanding!  And baby doing well.

title: Perfect for a short stay
text:
Our room was spotless, with every thing you need including washing machine and dryer. Lovely decor, tho the bed was a little firm for my liking, but lovely clean crisp sheets and bedding.
There was no view, so the room felt a little closed in , but we were out and about, so it didn't matter for a short stay like ours. 
There are two cafés either side for breakfast, and dinner just a short walk away.
Secure parking was another bonus, and we did not mind paying  the $10.00 a day.
We would definitely stay there again.

title: Very poor servicing considering the price
text:
I travel often for 1 week to Hamilton, so normally stay at the Hotels. Staying here for 2 weeks March 2014 I decided to get an apartment hotel. Very disappointed!

They often did not refresh or replenish dishwasher powder or soap and shampoo when finished. Worse than that, twice during the week (not public holidays), they did not service my room at all. 

Very poor service for higher rates than similar in Hamilton. I understand from mates, that Quest on Ward is a better option, although not stayed there yet!

title: Convenient one night stay
text: Great find and centrally located in Hamilton.  Perfect for one nights stay, although apartments are well appointed with kitchen and lounge to make one  or more nights stay comfortable. Amazing choice of restaurants and staff really helpful.  Secure parking available nearby.

title: Quest Hamilton
text: we arrived quite late and had a bit of trouble connecting the after hours operator but once in the night receptionist arrived and gave us a lovely room.  Very spacious and clean.  The whole hotel seemed very spacious.  We would definitely stay there again.

title: Ideal for a city visit
text: Great accommodation clean and fresh. All the facilities you need. Washer/drier very handy after been traveling. No traffic noise and slept very well. Staff smart and helpful. Parking handy in attached secure garage. Our room on first floor only had view of a brick wall but we had no traffic noise and a great sleep. Would certainly use again if in Hamilton.

title: Nice, clean & quite @Quest on London St, Hamilton, NZ
text:
We arrive very late in the evening (after midnight)...transfer dropped us in front of Quest, and across the road there were these two guys shouting - they were already drunk!  I press the call bell and Quest was quick to reply and allowed us in.  Check-in was superb and fast..e-key was on the reception with room number all ready.  Cheers to this!!  

Room is very clean, and I like they have everything that you need, microwave, electric stove, dish washer, washing machine and dryer.  

Quest on London Street is okay for us, walking distance to a shopping mall, Colombus cafe is just next door, if you wish to grab bfast and comes with free wi-fi.  No free car park, and quite small but not a priority for us.

All in all, we love the place albeit on the 3rd floor (we have to carry our luggage up...phew as both of us (me and hubby) are senior citizens).  PS:  Area is too quite after 6pm...(maybe we are not use to it as we live in SG - crowded and noisy).

Thanks to Lee, Astyn and Donna for the great service they given us.

title: Spacious and clean
text:
The Quest has large sunny rooms with modern decor, clean and tidy. Beware of rooms on the 3rd floor as the lift does not service this area and it requires lugging suitcases up 2 flights of stairs. Parking is also not for the faint hearted- one small garage which requires good parking skills with some cars going onto a hoist system- so not quick and easy to come and go. However, staff were obliging in doing the parking for you. 
Handily placed for town with a great breakfast option at Columbus next door.

title: Clean, Spacious and well equipped
text: I stayed here last February for over a week when on business in hamilton. The room was spotlessly clean. I was very impressed with how well the room was equipped. The staff were always very friendly and accommodating any dealings that i had with them. I really enjoyed my stay.

title: Watch out for the car park!
text: Very central serviced apartments with large, clean and comfortable room. Very functional with washing machine and dryer for longer stay. However watch out for the car park. It's only $10 but  very small with  car lifts in bays that require pinpoint accuracy to enter. I managed to back into a post in the process!  Probably better to park on the road outside

title: Spacious, clean and central
text: The largest studio room we have ever stayed in. Well equipped and very clean. Only small gripe is that being so central you do get the Saturday night hoons in their noisy cars and party goers. Didn't really bother us much but if you need total quiet then stay outside of the city. Good value for money here.

title: So/So for me
text: I stayed a week for business. I initially changed rooms as the cleaning hadn't been finished, change of room and that was very pleasant. Like the apartment services, washing machines etc and kitchen.etc.

title: Beautifully redecorated
text:
I stayed for 4 nights in room 201, which is a studio apartment.  Plenty of space, everything I could need and appliances appeared to be new.  Room very clean. Bed very comfortable.  Staff polite and helpful.  Breakfast was included in the cost which was a pleasant surprise, as was the 2x mini choc bars on day of arrival!
Made great use of the complimentary Les Mills pass, and attended a group fitness class each day, it's only 30sec walk away.
The only 'complaint' I have is that the air con wasn't great, I had it on 30deg and it took ages to heat the room.  
Will definitely be back when I return to Hamilton.  Excellent value for money!

title: Great Service
text: Very impressed with helpful friendly service from Ashtyn - gave us a room that was very well suited for our what we wanted.  Clean, spacious, well equipped units.  Perfect as a base for attending an event in Hamilton.  We had executive unit which was very spacious.
hotel_response: Thank-you very much for all of your positive feedback. Happy to hear you enjoyed your stay with us at Quest Hamilton and I shall pass on to Astyn your appreciation of her friendly helpful service.

title: So new! So nice!
text: Very spacious. Central city location. Great to have parking available. Everything so new. Great shower. Very accommodating staff. Highly recommended for business visitors. We had the one bedroom apartment and were met 11pm arrival with welcome chocolate!
hotel_response: Thank-you so much for all of your positive comments. Great to know you enjoyed your stay with us at Quest Hamilton and we look forward to seeing you again in future.

title: New deco and very clean..Just perfect
text:
I stayed here two nights (room 104) and the whole place looks like a brand new fit-out in a beautiful character builing. The staff were extremely polite and helpfull and room was cleaned daily. I also liked that my room (a studio) was very spacious with large windows.
As others have mentioned you do hear the odd car pass by but hey...if you don't like the city don't stay at a city hotel.
hotel_response: Thank-you very much for your review. I am glad you enjoyed your stay in one of our spacious studio apartments with an outside city view. And if you dont mind the odd traffic noise then these apartments with large georgeous windows are great, adding brightness and warmth to the room. However, for those guests who prefer the quiet and would much rather be away from city noise all together, we provide a number of inside apartments away from the street. These apartments are located in the centre of the property, offering guests with a more quiet and relaxing atmosphere. Thanks again and we look forward to your next stay.

title: Well equipped.
text: Stayed here during the All Blacks V Ireland test match. Pleasantly suprised when we entered the room, spacious, well equipped, very clean and comfortable. Good location, easy access to stadium and local bars/restaurants. Carparking availalbe at an extra charge. Limited availability of accommodation around this time so probably paid a bit more than we wanted, good value if more than 2 people in the apartment but otherwise too expensive for a stay in Hamilton!
hotel_response: Thank-you very much for your review. I am glad you enjoyed your stay with us at Quest Hamilton and I hope you also enjoyed the All Blacks vs Ireland Test Match. With regards to the car parking - because we only have a limited number of on-site secure spaces available, we have seperated this cost out from the room rate so that it is a separate fee on its own. Then only those guests who use the car park are paying for this service. Thanks again for your review and we look forward to your next stay.

title: Perfect location
text: Immaculate brand new Quest.  Right in the city centre, easy to find, cafes and arthouse cinema nearby.  River walks along the banks of the mighty Waikato minutes away. Extras such as chocolates in your room.  Massive bathrooms and I always appreciate the laundry.
hotel_response: Thank-you very much for your positive review. I am glad that you enjoyed your stay, appreciating the spacious apartments with full laundry facilites. Always good to be able to do your washing when away on holiday! And we will be sure to keep up with the chocolate treats...its nice to treat our guests with a little treat on arrival. Thanks again and we look forward to your next stay with us.

title: What any NZ Business should look like.
text:
Amazing service, beautiful rooms, excellent breakfast facilites, grounds were manicured to the enth degree and you were able to wander about at your leisure.
Kim and Alan are amazing hosts, they welcomed us early, they made room for an unexpected 3rd person and their room was made up and thier trademark bottle(ok, it was a miniature, good practical drinking etiquette) of bubbles and choc's were in the room upon their arrival.
We will be back guys many thanks for your extra efforts and Allan, your words were just what was needed.
Thank you both again

title: Friendly and thoughtful
text: A cosy place to stay when checking out the local attractions. Chris's cupboards are generously stocked and she is truly the Queen of muffins - fresh-baked and she keeps them coming! The spa is a brilliant feature to use after a day of exploring.

title: Wonderful hospitality!
text: This place is lovely.  Chris and Bob went out of their way to help us and the breakfast and the flat were exactly what we needed after three hectic days in Auckland. More food than we could eat - Chris even offered to do our washing for us! Go and see for yourselves - you will not be dsappointed.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your  great review.  Please note potential guests - I only offer to do tourists laundry!!!  :)

title: Would stay again
text: Really enjoyed our stay at Muffins.  Christine and Bob extend a really warm welcome and provide everything you need for a relaxed stay including delicious muffins.  The hot tub is a nice extra after a hot day out and about.  Despite being a self contained unit in the owners garden you have your own screened off area so have privacy. Close enough to town to have gentle stroll for dinner at one of the local restaurants.   We would definitely stay again
hotel_response: Thank you so much for taking time to post a review about Muffin's!

title: Annual visit to Cambridge
text:
For the past three years my family and I have been fortunate enough to experience the best hospitality and service from both Christine and Bob at their B&B.  The facilities and service are second to none and my children and I always feel welcome and loved at our little home away from home. With the accompaniments of fresh fruit, juices, breakfast foods, condiments and not to forget the freshly baked muffins daily and the spa to finish off a hard days work at Lake Karapiro. 

I highly recommend Muffins B&B to one and all from near and far 😀
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your lovely review! We love to hear families enjoying their stay at Muffin's, kids in the spa, adults catching up with friends or just chilling. Thank you our wakama champs!!!!

title: Fantastic B&B with all you could ask for.
text: Lovely facility with lots of nice little touches, as far as the facility is concerned this is probably the best B&B you could stay in. this may not be for you if you are wanting complete privacy as this was the only down side to our visit we could find. its not a major its just that the owner comes in to the apartment un announced. they are real attentive hosts but maybe need to consider this that some people want some privacy... to explain, my wife and I were having some "adult time" in the bedroom and we came out of the bedroom we could see that the owner had been in the property! albeit it looked like it was to place some muffins on the table however we felt this was a little strange and we could not completely relax after this, on the not so often chance the wife and I get some time alone we would normally walk around the apartment wearing next to nothing / naked but we felt we could not do this incase they came in! and just one other time when we nipped to the shop, this was the only time we left the apartment all weekend and we locked the door. when we returned we could see they had been in the apartment again... like I said not an issue for most people but maybe it just doesn't suit a "romantic getaway". however everything else was 10/10. all in all this is a great place.
hotel_response: Here at Muffin's we do our very best to respect our guests privacy. We do service the unit whilst guests are away & we do like to provide muffins.

title: Would definitely come back and invite others to do so.
