text: We loved our stay! Cute, Cozy and Friendly are the 3 first words that would come to mind. The owners are so thoughtful and nice, always looking for ways to make their guests more comfortable. It is a separate unit from the house with a enclosed fence so space is quite private. The room itself is set up very nice and thought out. It is perfect for a couple given the smaller size but we brought our one year old and the owners were very accommodating and welcoming of him too. The 3 things that stand out would be the private hot tub out front, the nice, large bathroom and the great variety of food that is kept in the room from breakfast items to fruit to fresh muffins. Naturally it has free wifi. We would love to stay here again if we were to ever pass on through again. We would definitely suggest that our friends go there.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your awesome review!!

title: Extremely comfortable B&B
text:
I've been to a few B&Bs and this is the best one yet. All the luxuries you need and in a quiet setting. We even had fresh muffins which makes sense with the name.

Breakfast is part of the stay with several options to eat and fresh fruit. You have free Wifi and cable as well. There are bikes to borrow if you want to cycle a bit.

If I'm back in this area I will definitely try to stay here again.
hotel_response: Awesome! Thank you! So glad you enjoyed your time at Muffin's!!

title: Outstandingn B&B, highly recommend
text:
Chris and Bob run a very efficient B&B with many personal touches.  This is an free standing 3 room apartment.  They furnish all the ingredients needed for your breakfast...including fresh fruit and tomatoes from their garden.  Chris even put some yogart and sorbet in the refrig for us.  We had asked for eggs before we arrived and she gave us 1/2 doz of very fresh eggs.  They went out of their way to accomodate any of our requests.

You will not go wrong staying here.

Also, this is at the end of a dead end street and very quiet.
hotel_response: Wow! We do appreciate your informative review, thank you so much.

title: We'll be back to "Muffins"
text:
Read all the reviews since 2011 and after staying one night , the "Muffins" is just getting better. It's superb- clean , quaint , and everything you could want for in an overnight accommodation venue. Run"rings" around a motel room. Loved it . Keep it up , Bob and Chris. 

Wayne and Rosemary Lyons (27/11/2016)
hotel_response: Thank you so much for taking the time to write us a review Wayne & Rosemary! We enjoy sharing our little 'home away from home' with people like you!

title: Comfortable and Easy-- All I needed!
text: Very comfortable self-contained rooms with all the details thought through and nothing missing! Some nice personal touches that you don't get in motels, and at a much better price. An easy walk into town for dinner too, and I was even offered to be picked up afterwards by the owners. Recommended.
hotel_response: Thank you so much!

title: Absolutely Wonderful
text:
B&B stands for bed and banquet.
Every need catered for.
We loved it right from the welcome muffins (can I have the recipe?) To the amazing array of breakfast items.
We had our little dog with us and a furniture trailer and the owners were happy to accommodate our needs, Bob even backed our trailer in for us 😊.
We will definitely come back again.
Our little cottage was spic and span with a great attention to detail .
Thankyou
hotel_response: Thank you so much! Look forward to your next visit!

title: Private, Relaxing, Quiet and Very Welcoming
text: Extremely welcoming and very well serviced. The breakfast choices are vast and fresh. The unit is very private and very clean and tidy. Easy to find and close to everything. Will always stay here when in Cambridge and highly recommend to everyone. Thanks so much for our lovely stay.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your glowing review - we love it!!

title: Nice place
text:
Very kind and helpful owners. Great welcome muffins. Great variety of available food. 
Clean and cozy. Quiet, away from main road. Peaceful neighborhood. Good quality bed. 
Outdoor spa looks tempting. Must come back in summer to try it. ;-)
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to write a great review for Muffin's self-contained B&B! The spa is really great in the winter too!!! (If you don't mind the cold before you hop in!)

title: Lovely hideaway
text: We stayed here one night on our way north from Wellngton. Chris was very welcoming and had muffins all ready for us when we arrived! The accommodation is a sweet guest house in her garden, with a superbly well stocked ktchenette with sink, microwave, and toaster, and packed with breakfast foods - bread, granola, jams, tea, coffee, juice, milk, honey.... . The beds were comfy and well furnished, and the bath was full of fluffy towels. Soap and shampoo were provided. The house is in a very quiet location full of birdsong. Outside the guest house there is a private patio and even a hot tub! We felt very pampered.

title: Absolute relaxation
text: Muffins was a breath of fresh air. Whilst considering local hotels we came across this wee gem. Chris and Bob took our last minute booking it was easy to find. Close to highway 1 Cambridge township nearby river walks and yes, Muffin's is truely a retreat. Muffins hosts Chris and Bob are so friendly and made us feel immediately welcome ensured we were catered to and allowed us to chill and enjoy the peaceful environment.  Muffins is a breathe of f close to river walks nearby town, tucked away in the desireable area if Leamington The private and cute little patio is great for alfresco dining and the breakfast which is more than sufficient with personal options available as to preferences. We recommend Muffins a worthwhile experience. We will be making this accommodation a regular stop in future. Bookmarked now..Thanks Chris and Bob you made our day.

title: Get away weekend
text:
It's such a cute and cosy place at the back back private road with very private spa 
Great spot with lovely friendly host !! 
Reasonable price for the night or two 
Lovely  fresh homemade muffins 
Lovely bathroom plenty of space 
They was helpful with booking with restaurant and show us where the place 
Thank so much will shared with others
hotel_response: We are so pleased that you enjoyed your stay ay Muffin's & we look forward to seeing you next time!

title: #1 in my books!
text: My first BnB stay...the best place ever.  Beats all the hotels I've stayed at hands down.  Our host Chris was so lovely and welcoming.  Greeted with freshly baked muffins, fresh fruit...absolutely spotless, cosy and well appointed little cottage.  The attention to detail and all the little touches, Chris has thought of everything! As for the private outdoor spa...devine!!  Beautiful gardens and surrounds, free wifi.....I could go on and on, but you really do need to experience this place for yourself.  I've already rebooked for next month!
hotel_response: Thank you soooo much for your lovely review!

title: Muffins gorgeousness
text: I have stayed here twice now, it is just the loveliest, cleanest place with the sweetest hosts. Home made muffins, wonderful selection of delicious treats. The garden is gorgeous and the spa pool on the private deck is devine!
hotel_response: Thank you so much for lovely review - look forward to seeing you next time!!

title: Simply fabulous!
text:
I don't normally choose to stay in B&Bs because I'm a business traveller and want business facilities, but this accommodation was booked on my behalf.  However, it turned out to be a great choice and I'd certainly go back.   I was greeted with a plate of freshly baked muffins (delicious!) and got more each day - not great for the diet, but too good to resist!  There was fresh fruit on the table and a fridge stocked with jugs of water, fruit juice and milk as well as a selection of yoghurts for breakfast.  The cupboard also had a range of cereals to choose from.
I had a great stay.  Chris and Bob could not have been more friendly and hospitable.  The accommodation is like a mini cottage, with its own bathroom, lounge and bedroom.  It is very thoughtfully equipped and furnished with everything you could possibly need - even a bubbly spa pool in the little courtyard.   A simply great stay - thank you, Chris!  By the way, you're really under-charging!  I couldn't believe the price - really excellent value for money.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for this wonderful review!

title: Wish we stayed here longer!
text: This place is WONDERFUL!  Chris brought us baked goods each morning (mince pies first, then blueberry muffins), plus a nice selection of yogurts, juice, milk, cold cereral and fruits.  The cottage is cozy and complete, with comfortable beds.  Cambridge is a lovely town that allowed us to visit Matamata (30 min) and Rotorua (55 min) easily, while being 'away' from the touristy feel of both those places.  Chris also offered to run a load of laundry for us, returned nicely folded (thank you!).  We stayed here at the very end of our NZ trip, and would certainly choose to stay at Muffins B&B again (for longer!).  Next visit, we might have more time to try out the hot tub!
hotel_response: We look forward to your next trip to NZ!

title: Attention to detail and genuine hospitality
text: Prior to arrival, the owner Chris emailled to check about how we would like the rooms configured and as to dietary requirements etc which was a great start. On arrival we were warmly welcomed to a lovely little seperate apartment surrounded by fragrant gardens and in a quiet area of Cambridge. We appreciated the attention to detail, from the plethora of soft towels in the bathroom, to the wide variety of fresh condiments, to the detailed visitor booklet with information on absolutely everything in the area. There is a fan and heater to use if required as it has no air con, and a lovely outdoor spa in a private location. Beds were comfortable; large shower room, flat screen tv and plunger coffee. Breakfast was freshly baked delicious muffins which were a big hit with everyone (thank you Chris!), a generous supply of bread for toast as well as yoghurt and cereal choices. Muffins b&b is obviously run by someone who loves what she does and it really shows. We are international visitors but if back in the area we would not consider staying anywhere else.
hotel_response: Wow! Thank you for this review!

title: Deserve their great reputation
text: This is the first time I have stayed in a B&B and if this sets the standard. This has opened up new accommodation options to me. I was in Cambridge for a wedding and the friendly hosts offered to do ironing and even to drop me off and pick me up from the reception venue! The separate unit is cosy and fully equipped with lots of nice touches including flowers, fruit bowl, an extensive self help breakfast range and muffins. Didn't get a chance to use the spa pool and too soon had to head back to Auckland. Delightful and highly recommended.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your  review! We are delighted that we were your first B&B experience & that it was a positive one!!

title: Excellent
text:
When we arrived, the spa was already heated, and the very friendly hosts brought us plenty of muffins.

The separate unit was very clean, comfortable and cozy, with a lot of attention to every detail. 

In short: a perfect place when you are visiting the area around Cambridge!
hotel_response: Thank you so much for taking the time to write a review for 'our cozy haven'! (All the very best for your new life adventure in Australia!!)

title: Ross and Julie
text:
What an awesome couple and a beautiful set up that they have. This is the first time we have stayed at a B&B and we will most certainly stay here again.

The hospitality was second to none and the muffins Chris made for us each day were the best.
5 days wasn,t enough we could live there forever
hotel_response: We so appreciate your review Ross & Julie!

title: Great hosts, great venue
text: Have stayed at Muffins several times over the last few years and have always found the place to be immaculate.  Chris and Bob are great hosts and go out of their way to ensure their guests have a great stay.  The delicious muffins on arrival are an added bonus.  I cannot recommend Muffins highly enough.
hotel_response: Sue comes to Cambridge for the dog shows. She sets up the patio area, which is secure,  especially for her beautiful dogs to be free in the daytime and then they sleep in their special beds in the truck at night. We enjoy our repeat guests very much - it's like our extended family has increased! Thank you Sue!

title: Honest and Caring
text: Our stay was a short one due to a sick family member.  Unfortunately, we were not able to stay the night and had to leave early.  Chris & Bob have now looked after us and I would definitely recommend Muffins as a place to stay.  I would love to go back there one day and enjoy their hospitality.
hotel_response: Thank you! We look forward to a happier, longer stay, and with youir little ones, next time!! Go well.

title: Pleasant Stay
text: We booked at Muffins as we had a 60th birthday party to attend locally.  We were most pleasantly surprised at the cleanliness and quality of the B&B.  We were warmly greeted on arrival with delicious muffins and the owners kindly drove us to our nearby party in the evening (even though there was a big rugby match on TV).  On the drive back to Auckland we played golf at the nearby Lochiel Golf Club (only $20 a round) which was a great course to play.  I would recommend Muffins and would definately stay there again.
hotel_response: So pleased that you enjoyed your time at Muffin's and topped the weekend off with a great game of golf. Must be due for a repeat trip . . . . .  !!!!

title: Wonderful hospitality
text: The family, 2 adults and 2 boys (2 and 4 year olds), stayed at the cottage. Hubby had a conference and we took the opportunity to do a bit of sight seeing around beautiful Cambridge. The property was immaculate and self-contained, and while compact it had a lovely big spa and the bathroom was spacious. The linens were crisp and clean, very nice. We were given fresh baked muffins in the morning, hence the name, which were instantly devoured. Our hosts also left toys for the boys to play with which was very much appreciated. It is close to town and very quiet, would stay again.
hotel_response: Bob & I both enjoy having 'little people' come and stay at Muffin's. Thank you for taking time to write this lovely positive review - we appreciate it very much.

title: Great hideaway
text: Muffins B&B is a great choice if your in the area. A quiet separate unit away from the house allows you to come and go without fuss. Bob and Chris are great hosts and the warm muffins on the table when you arrive are an added bonus. We are repeat visitors and have no hesitation in recommending Muffins (except on rowing weekends when we want to stay!)
hotel_response: Thank you for your positive feedback. When you come regularly you start to feel like family!!!!

title: Home Away From Home
text: My daughter and I stayed at Muffins B&B a couple of nights and found our hosts to be very welcoming, accomodating and cheerful. Our accomodation was spotless and everything we needed was there. The spa pool was an added bonus as was the lovely muffins supplied fresh daily.I have already booked a 5 day stay there for my family and I for Jan 2014. May also book a weekender during the winter to get the most out of the spa pool, & some time away. Highly reccommended to all.
hotel_response: We love having champions staying in our B&B!! We look forward to your next visit, hopefully the whole  family this time! Go hard champ!!

title: Waka ama paddlers
text: We returned to Muffins because it provided the little luxuries we neeaded: a private SC unit; quiet; separate bedroom; a large bathroom / shower; separate dining/lounge area; patio; spa bath; delicious muffins / fresh fruit; welcoming / friendly hosts - just the ideal place to return to after a day's racing at Karapiro! thanks Bob & Chris
hotel_response: We enjoyed following your wakaama progress and being the 'custodians of the waka' whilst it was parked on our back lawn. Thank you for choosing Muffin's and for your positive words, much appreciated!

title: Perfect spot
text: My Mum and I had a lovely stay at Muffins. Our hosts were very obliging and couldn't do enough for us. They rearranged the bedrooms to suit our needs as we prefered to sleep in separate rooms. Breakfast was tidily provided in a custom built cupboard with heaps of choices.I did appreciate the fresh fruit. They even returned the DVD we left in the slot! Thanks for that!
hotel_response: It is such a delight to be able to offer a little hospitality to such lovely people, thank you for your review!

title: We wish there was a Muffins everywhere we went
text:
We stayed at Muffins after a Waikato Hospital appointment and it was the perfect unwind. Well worth travelling a little out of our way for the hospitality, relaxation, privacy, peace and comfort.
Spotlessly clean. Great muffins. Lovely spa setting.
hotel_response: Thank you for you positive encouragement. Please come again, we so enjoyed your visit! Especially the gardening, composting & butterfly tips!! The best of health to you both.

title: Travellers' Rest, Peace and Quiet
text: We have stayed at Muffins twice now, and would do so again if once more we find ourselves in the  Cambridge area,  Cambridge is a delightful town, but can get extremely busy with quite heavy traffic.  The location of Muffins, conveniently close to the town but tucked away in a secluded and peaceful cul-de-sac, is ideal.  The Gilroys were charming hosts, totally unintrusive but very ready to interact with us also.  The accommodation was scrupulously clean and very comfortable.  Breakfast provisions (including the famous muffins!) were generous and tasty.  The unit is not large, but excellent use has been made of available space.  We were particularly impressed with the reasonable tariff.  Highly recommended.
hotel_response: Thank you, thank you for your kind words! We so enjoy sharing our garden with lovely people like you!! We have need of a monarch butterfly nurse, can we tempt you back again!!!!

title: Visit to Balloons over Waikato
text: We spent a night here while going to the Balloons over Waikato event.  Really enjoyed our stay and appreciated the fresh muffins on arrival.  All rooms clean and comfortable.  Also enjoyed relaxing in the hot tub!
hotel_response: Thank so much you for your review. It is nearly time for Balloons over Waikato again. . . . . .!

title: Best B&B I've been to in a while.
text: I totally dig this place. It was everything we wanted and more. We enjoyed the muffins and breakfast provided and also the hot tub. We were surprised to find a really nice place within aA reasonablee budget. Looking forward to going back when there's an opportunity.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review of Muffin's! We look forward to your returning visit when opportunity arrives, go well!

title: Super service plus a spa :)
text: We stayed at Muffins in June for a quiet weekend away. On arrival we were surprised to see how close the unit was to the house BUT in fact, it turned out to be very private and comfortable. The hosts were friendly but read us well - contact when we wanted it and space the rest of the time. The unit itself is really cute, with lots of clever inbuilt storage, more provisions than we had anticipated, very clean and tidy. The bathroom is spacious and light, the bedroom a bit bare but comfortable. The lounge area is compact but fine - our only complaint was that it was awkward watching the tv/dvd screen from the lounge suite due to its height on the wall. The highlight for us, however, was the spa pool - deliciously hot, very clean (the hosts even refilled it while we were out on Saturday because they had spotted a tiny bit of grit in the bottom) and all ours. The muffins were lovely, along with fresh fruit, yoghurt and cereal/toast for breakfast, all packed away shipshape for us to have at our leisure. We would definitely stay again.
hotel_response: Hey guys, a late response to your reviews! (Only just  found out about them!) Thank you soooo much for taking the time! Hope you will come back & check out the new bedroom decor & I think the flat screen TV/DVD may be a new addition too! Cheers!

title: A separate cottage makes for a great B&B experience
text:
We stayed here for a night in September 2011 and loved it.  The hosts, Bob & Chris Gilroy, did everything they could to make us feel at home.  The B&B unit is separate building behind their home, but fully equipped for a comfortable stay.  It has a sitting room, bedroom (a bit spartan, but we were only there at night and unconscious), and a large and well-equipped bath.  It does not have a separate kitchen as all the kitchen amenities are tucked into shelves and alcoves in the sitting area.  But it has all the basic appliances, including a small dining table, and Chris makes sure it is well-stocked.  On our arrival (a cold, rainy winter afternoon) Chris brought in warm chocolate muffins.  She & Bob also helped us with local directions, since we had to head back into Hamilton for that night's Rugby World Cup match.  

The unit has an outdoor hot tub which we did not have time to use (and it was pretty cold to be outdoors, even in a hot tub) but it looked very inviting.

Cambridge, by the way, is a lovely little town in NZ horse country with a charming central area where had a great lunch.  It's worth a stop if people are driving between Hamilton & Rotorua.

At NZ$120 per night, this place is a real bargain.

title: Never ever stay. Please.
text:
Main issues:
1. No access. Key card not working, stuck outside our room at 11.30pm.

2. Ants in the bed in the lounge.

3. No hot water at all. Couldn't shower.

Bonus round:
4. Kettle cord isn't log enough to reach any kitchen plugs
5. Extremely rude staff. No apologies. Straight to telling us 'no refund'.
6. We thought they were there to fix our hot water, they were actually there to kick us out 1 hour early.
7. The only way to get a refund is to speak to the manager. But the manager isn't there. And also can't be contacted by phone. You have to email the info email lol.
8. No extra blankets/anything in any of the cupboards.

title: Keep looking don’t book here.
text: Don’t book here!!! This place is terrible. You have to check in from another place a few blocks away? Rude service at check in. When you get back to the hotel it isn’t like what they have in the website photos. Lacking cutlery, no milk, no dryer or washing powder (advertised full laundry facilities) . No couch to sit on. Weird elevated shower that is awkward. Electric wires hanging out of each apartment. The cleaners tried to hurry us out before check out time. Definitely do not recommend.

title: DO NOT STAY HERE!
text:
This place should be shut down, DO NOT STAY HERE! 
To check in to this property, you are firstly directed to another address offsite where there is a reception. You’re then told to drive to your apartment a few streets away. Upon arrival at our room we found it to be FILTHY DIRTY, with built up grime throughout the property. The kitchen is falling apart and most definitely NOT what they use in their advertising. There were stains on most walls/doors, some looked like food, some I don’t want to know.  Had intended to cook dinner but there was no way I was using anything as it was so dirty. 
Contacted Reception immediately and was told there were no alternative rooms and staff member could not offer a refund. I was advised that the Manager would be at reception at 9am the next morning if I wanted to speak to them. When I arrived at 9.30am I was told the manager hadn’t arrived and they had no way of contacting them and there was nothing further they could do. 
Terrible property with equally terrible service.

title: Horrible
text:
It's an old, worn out property that is managed remotely. Which means you need to go down 2 streets to the reception, which os actually a reception for another motel to get the keys, check in, check out, extra pillow or towel, etc.
Reception staff are rude and lack hospitality to say the least. 
Prices for the rooms are comparatively cheaper, that should have been our first red flag, but I have stayed at cheaper properties that atleast offer basic amenities. 
We stayed in a 1 bed room apartment that lacked heating or cooling facilities in the bed room. We are a family of 4 with a baby and a toddler.
Bathroom has a dated shower with a very high step and is extremely slippery. Disaster waiting to happen.
Location is the only positive thing about this property.

title: Not a good option for business travel
text: I'm no snob when it comes to accommodation, and this place was clean enough, but it is battered, tired, feels unsafe and the service is awful. They require a deposit even if you have booked through a business travel agent, and checkout time is only between 9 and 10am, meaning you have to go back to reception - which is in an entirely different building a couple of kms away - to get your deposit back. No good if you have to leave early! Guy on reception spoke to me like I was stupid, not a pleasant experience. Second guy was much nicer. The apartment had no living area - where a couch should be were two beds, not something clear from the listing. The free Wi-Fi, ordinarily a good thing, was on an unsecured network, meaning I absolutely did not want to use it for work. 100% do not recommend.

title: Revolting and disgusting
text: This place is disgusting. We had our 4 children with us and we a literally contemplating driving the 5 hour drive home instead of staying here. The oven is foul and behind it is even worse. Toilet is revolting. Rotting everywhere. We couldn't even eat our dinner in the room it made us feel physically ill. I'm nervous my kids will get bed bug bites. We don't want to even shower in here. Most revolting place I have ever seen. How it is still operating is a mystery to me 🤢

title: DO NOT BOOK INTO THIS HOTEL, Asked for $100.00 bond then changed it to $200.00.
text: my kids and grandkids went to stay here. they charge 100.00 bond for this place. Its worn down. they have there own rules. this place is dirty the upstairs balcony is falling apart not safe for my grandkids. They saved for this trip and when my daughter n law got angry he told them to leave. there was no where else they could go so they charged them 200.00 bond. trip advisor should not have them on there site. mold in bathroom. dirty floors. people partying in the next room. now my kids are stuck in Hamilton with no money for there kids to enjoy it.  Trip advisor  I know now not to use your site for my vacations now

title: STAY AWAY
text: Dirtiest filthiest motel ever stayed at manger was the most unprofessional person we have ever meet it isike a winz meth head housing stay away you wont receive your bond kids have gotten rushes from staying in the room

title: Dirty disgusting horrible place
text: These apartments have been old flats built about 25 years ago. Very old mouldy curtains , chipboard doors hanging off units. Bathroom sealing compound mouldy. Shower mouldy , all doors looked as though they had been splashed with water and left. A disgusting horrible place . Not reccomended at all, needing complete revamp before I would let my dogs stay there. We threw the key card on the table , forfeited our money and walked out. Also no towel rail in bathroom although the ends were there to hold one. Just a dirty horrible place and we didn't even like to touch the walls.

title: Dated but adequate
text:
Very dated apartments.  Basic accommodation needs are met, air conditioning, washing machine, iron, fridge and microwave worked. I didn’t try the stove because of the limited cookware available.  Ironing board was damaged and didn’t open out fully. 
The kettle didn’t work when I arrived, so I drove back to the motel reception (on a different site from the actual apartments) to request another one, which they provided.  However it was the cheapest nastiest plastic kettle that made all the water taste like plastic, no matter how many times I rinsed it out, so I gave up on that. The bathroom exhaust fan needed a good clean, but everything else was clean, with fresh towels provided daily. 
There is parking on site which is a plus, but it is difficult to negotiate the narrow driveway when cars are parked outside the apartment doors.  

The noise from adjacent rooms and driveway can be heard through the walls and front door of the apartment which made for poor quality of sleep. 
Location is good and not too much traffic noise.

title: FOR THE PRICE IT WAS.....
text:
For the price of this horrid room for 5 people it was very disgraceful and unprofessional. There were only 2 towels, even though we searched for more, the toilet was dirty with cobwebs in the corners, the rooms were fairly clean however smelt funny and for someone who is immune compromised ended up with red itchy eyes and a horrid cough from the disgusting atmosphere! The service of the people working was quite terrible, they are not helpful, they do not seem they care at all and it’s very disappointing because it has left a bad impression and we will make sure to tell other people never to go here. When we checked out the staff were very rude and had no idea what they even have in the room, customers always come first and clearly this place has no idea about that. Also there is a huge safety hazard with a hot water tank inside the house behind an open cupboard, if the cupboard was locked I would not think it was too bad, but the fact it was easy to open and very easily accessible this is a HUGE safety hazard and if you have children it can be very dangerous! In conclusion I would stay WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!! 
PS: $491 for a S$*# BOX is a huugee rip off and these people need to be told what’s what!!

title: School staff stopover
text: Rooms were modern, super clean, very comfortable and extremely practical for our needs. We were able to relax after a long drive and head off to our end location with ease. Close to shops and restaurants. We'd all decided that we will bring our families back!

title: Awesome. Super clean, quiet, beautifully presented and dog friendly.
text:
Just a great place to stay. We had our dog with us they are pet friendly. The unit was immaculately clean and well presented with everything we required in it.
There was a pool was beautiful and a beautiful spa. It was so nice we stayed again 4 nights later on our way home. It was super easy to book and pay with them explaining the procedure of arriving with the covid regulations.
We would recommend them to anyone wishing to stay. We stayed in unit no 1 first night that was down the back and really quiet. The second visit was in the front unit which was also very quiet.
Thanks Leamington Spa Motel. A great place to stay.

title: Great, clean, dog-friendly place!
text: Lovely and clean with everything that you need, this motel is a great option if you’re traveling with pets. Friendly staff, fluffy white towels, and fresh, tidy decor, it’s good value & I return time and time again when I visit Cambridge with my dog.

title: Grwat cycling base
text:
Great place to stay off main highway north but close enough to everything.
Nice rooms, clean and well presented with pool, spa and pet friendly, presumably as saw some around. 
I used as a base for cycling some of the Waikato River Trails, good location for the Karapiro - Arapuni part

title: family experience
text: Very good place to stay would recommend to others great price great location spa pool plus pet friendly another added bonus apartments we stayed was comfortable a home away from home feeling great for families

title: Great for families/pets :)
text: What a great stay. Very accommodating and friendly hosts. Tidy grounds and inside just immaculate. Dog friendly which is always a plus. Thanks so much. We will definitely stay again and recommend to our friends

title: Clean, cozy and welcoming.
text: My mother and I were very impressed with the unit. Everything we could possibly need including a decent sized fridge/freezer. The bathroom was modern and bigger than most that we have experienced and the heating was excellent for us northlanders whom never experience -3°. Impressive contactless booking, with very good communication with the motel management.  We also enjoyed that we were very close to restaurants and entertainment facilities.

title: Clean, tidy, basic accommodation
text: We stayed for one night on our way down to Wellington. They were very accommodating as it was a same day booking. Plenty of parking for our 4WD, furniture trailer and car right at our door. The motel unit was very clean and tidy, warm and comfortable. If your looking for good basic accommodation this is a great spot! We were also able to have our small dog with us which is hard to find.

title: Good value
text: We stayed one night. Clean and tidy. Not the flashest we've stayed at but mostly happy with unit. First time we've come across unmanned office, where we phoned the owner as the text didn't come through until midnight that night. Not her fault. Fridge was a bit noisy at night, shower was quite high to get in to and would've liked hot chocolate or milo option. Didn't have time to use the pool/spa area. We were upgraded to a bigger unit. Shops not far away. Yes, we certainly would choose Leamington Spa Motel if we were staying in Cambridge again.

title: 2 Night Pet friendly getaway
text: The whole experience that Lyn and Casey provided for my dog Ollie and myself, was quite simply phenomenal. The welcome Lyn gave us was incredibly moving. The check in process was so streamlined and stress free for Ollie (my dog) and that made an enormous difference. The unit itself .......... im not sure how to say this but the cleanliness is hard to describe. It was IMMACULATE. I mean even the cutlery shone! The location was perfect. Everything you need within walking distance, parking immediately outside your room. We just want to say thankyou. Its easily the best motel experience ive had, and the fact it was pet friendly says it all. Daniel

title: Simple, but lovely.
text: A great little spot. Top service - friendly and informative.  Very nice single room that was recently refurbished. Very clean and simple with modern amenities. Had a great night's sleep as the room was very quiet and comfortable.

title: Recommend
text: We enjoyed our stay, pet friendly was the important feature for us. Nice and quiet no road noise. Self check in made a very easy process no hassle drive straight to your unit. Recommended and we will come back.

title: Leamington Spa motel
text:
Agree with the previous comments,  very clean, tidy, comfortable, location fantastic, management happy to go extra mile to help.
Its slightly older but has been refurbished and is well maintained. 
Warwick

title: Good Quiet Stay
text: We loved the stay here.  The motel is a 60's style motel so the basics can't change but were impressed with the extras - lovely new bathroom, nice new toilet, great heater, great new handles on the doors, good quality crockery and cutlery etc.  The bedding was comfortable and I liked the chairs around the table.

title: Comfortable
text:
We had self check in and out which seemed to work well -  The unit was small but very clean and tidy in a great location for us as we were visiting family in the area.
Would stay again and recommend this Motel

title: Great stay
text:
Comfortable unit with everything we needed for 4 people for a 1 night stay. Beds were comfy.
Very friendly accommodating staff. Plenty of food options and supermarket within walking distance.
Highly recommend.

title: Clean and comfortable.
text: Room was on the roadside but double glazing reduced the noise. The rooms were very clean and tidy, well appointed with an excellent small kitchen which I am always looking for in a motel. Comfortable bed and good shower. Only thing missing was a small table to set up my office work at night, but still, I'd certainly stay again, very good value for money and friendly people.

title: Very pleasant and hospitable stay
text: I have stayed at the Leamington Spa Motel on a few occassions in February and March 2021. The rooms are well serviced, comfortable and cleaned to high standards not lacking anything. The manager Lyn and her staff always were fantastic. I enjoyed using the pool and jacuzzi too. Will be returning again soon!

title: Adequate, but expensive given facilities at $150
text:
Studio, clean and tidy, but basic and tired.  Fridge had not been wiped - while not dirty, had marks and crumbs.  No heating in concrete block room - what’s it like in damp Waikato winter?Scratches and tears on sofa bed - result of pet-friendly motel?? Swimming pool (needing a clean, lots of leaves) and spa bath in  spartan concrete surroundings.  Garden areas in need of tidy and weeding.   Bookings responded to by email instructions - result of Covid or just avoidance of guests?
Wouldn’t recommend.

title: Leamington Motel
text:
Very accommodating to accept us to stay at 12:30am. Lights turned on and milk supplied for our 2am arrival.
Thank you Lyn, it was very much appreciated.
Lovely clean unit and all we needed for the night.

title: If in Cambridge this is the place to stay
text:
Easy friendly service, rooms are clean tidy and presentable if in Cambridge this always my first point of call for accommodation .
The pool was added bonus to escape the heat.
Highly recommend this place is the place  to stay

title: Clean venue, close to Lake Karapiro and a variety of shops on Shakespeare Rd.
text: Good location - close to small town amenities in Cambridge . A woman can get her nails, eyebrows, hair , pedicure done on one street, visiting shops on Shakespeare. Staff are friendly, rooms are clean.

title: Leamington Stay
text:
My 2nd year staying at Leamington Spa Holiday Motel for Te wananga o te Aotearoa waka ama Nationals at Lake Karapiro.
Very clean and close to amenities.
Family are wonderful and friendly.
Will be back again in 2022🤗😊...

title: Family Wedding
text:
Clean and tidy, bed was comfy and loved that there were fans in every room was a warm weekend.Pool was an absolute bonus chrystal clean. Friendly staff and great communication with booking made a year in advance. Some finishing work in kitchen still to be done and probably my only issue would be the step into the shower needs replacing,large shower Wash and shampoo nice added touches. Nice and quiet family unit back off road and car parking right outside .Thanks Lyn and team.
.

title: So tidy
text: We stayed there for a night and my Family was so surprise for the cleanliness and tidyness of the room. and Lyn is so Helpful and easy to talk to. The Spa is perfect for a day long drive to relax and recover.

title: David Oliver
text:
Great place to stay. Very clean, in a good spot for town. Our kids loved pkaying in the pool. Staff very friendly. We will definitely be staying here again when in the area.
It was an added bonus that we were able to bring our dog !

title: Great Service
text: I booked a room for 2 staff members, then work changed and needed to add 2 extra adults to the room.  They were very accomdating and friendly to deal with - this is now our go to place for the team to stay in Cambridge. The room was big and clean 👍

title: Well placed for 1 night stop over with dog
text: Tidy, clean with well equipped kitchen.  Surprised that it was more expensive than a similar pet friendly facility in central Auckland ($150+$20 for pet v $140 all up). Grounds will be more attractive when work finished and hopefully a few more plants/trees.

title: Great location, very clean and comfortable
text:
One bedroom unit worked well for a couple and our adult son with a queen size bed in the bedroom and a single bed in the lounge.  Kitchen was small but adequate for simple cooking or reheating.
The unit was really clean and tidy, parking right outside the door. There were local shops and restaurants just along the road so a good location.
We stayed one night on our way to Mystery Creek and the motel had everything we needed.  We would definitely stay again.
Only 15 mins drive via back roads to Mystery Creek, so definitely a good option.

title: well located for our needs
text: This motel was chosen because of location and the fact we could make our own coffee in our room - we were not reliant on the instant provided.  The room was clean and spacious but the kitchen area was tiny, water pressure in shower very poor and there may have been wifi but in our room it was patchy and slow so we tethered to our phones.  Bathroom would have benefited from some hooks on the door for towels or clothes.  Positives warm and comfortable bed.

title: Comfy clean pleasant
text:
Easy booking via phone and email with Covid rules.
Averagely priced.
Nicely refurbed unit with everything required available.
Parking outside unit.
Close to town and local shops.
Easy access to main drag North or South.
Would def stay again.

title: Modern & spotless
text: I stayed in one of the lovely studio units for two nights.  It had everything you need and with a comfy bed it was fab.  Lynn the owner is great and there are shops & restaurants across the road.  Have stayed before and would come back again.  This is a gem in Cambridge!

title: Lovely units & very friendly staff
text:
We had a fantastic stay at this great motel. A family group we booked 2 x 1 bedroom units & a Queen studio. The motel was fully booked & they shuffled some rooms around to upgrade my brother & his family to a spacious 2 bedroom unit since they had a young daughter & infant. The 2bdrm unit had a very spacious lounge which was great for the wider family group to hang out in.
The receptionist was absolutely lovely! Showed us through our rooms and had set up a porta-cot for the baby and they also provided the baby bedding & a baby bath. The units are immaculately presented, clean and the nice light decor showcases this. Modernly renovated the units have a great kitchenette with everything you need to be self sufficient. All rooms come with a complimentary glass bottle of milk. Beds/pillows are comfy & lots of extra bedding. Nice spa & pool facilities. Quiet & couldn’t hear any road noise or other guests. Very well priced, I would highly recommend staying here for either a short or long trip.

title: Bad experience
text: Booked and paid in FULL  in advance for a room tonight ... unfortunately due to circumstances had to cancel ... didn’t expect a full refund but not even a partial refund was extended ... they also demand 50% deposit in advance .. not accepted practise in my experience... live and learn .. won’t book there again

title: GREAT FAMILY ACCOMODATION
text:
The unit was very clean and tidy with comfortable beds.
The Pool was perfect for cooling off and staff very friendly.
Local cafes, takeaways within walking distance.
Definitely recommend whether its for short or long stay

title: Enjoyable stay - good value!
text: The rooms are extremely modern, clean, spacious and well furnished.  There are well-appointed kitchenettes and newly renovated bathrooms with all the equipment that you could need. The staff were extremely helpful, also offering laundry services when needed!  In walking distance from local shops and restaurants/cafes etc. The property has a medium-sized swimming pool and a whirlpool behind the units, kept clean and nice!

title: Good for the price, spacious rooms
text: Stayed with my kids and parents in a 2 bedroom. Lounge was spacious, nice linen on beds, and good kitchen equipment. Bathroom had recently had new floor and update. Kids loved the pool and spa. Nothing flash, but very serviceable for families

title: Very comfortable
text: Very comfortable home away from home feel.  Hasle free!! the staff are friendly and helpful.  Quiet rooms, we never heard any of the other guests. Pool and spa available to use, tho we ran out of time.  Next stay we will make use of these enimities.

title: Fantastic Stay
text: The people were very friendly and helpful. They went beyond what we are used to. The room was clean and tidy. The bathroom was excellent. The bed was comfortable. We were given lots of good ideas as to what we could do in Cambridge and shown maps and the best way to get there. The local restaurants were excellent, with lots of choice and close by. We walked. Love the Indian.

title: quiet but good location for hobitton and waitomo caves
text: Clean good room and friendly service. They did our laundry for 4 bucks as well (saving us so much time). Got all the basics right. We stayed for 4 nights. It is not a posh spa place but spa and pool were usable.

title: Great Refurb.  Lovely and Quiet
text:
Lyn has done a lovely job of updating the rooms.  They're comfortable, clean and quiet.  The pool is lovely and the location is ideal.
All the amenities you could need.
The staff were friendly and helpful with advise about the area.

title: Great motel
text: We have stayed twice at the Leamington Spa, it is a really nice place.  Clean, well appointed, quiet.  Nice staff, who are very helpful.  Good that our dog, Max, could enjoy it with us.  Highly recommended.

title: Hidden treasure
text: Recently because of late road closures we needed to stop over night in Cambridge. We saw The Leamington Motel, although the front of house is still work in progress dont let that put you off. The staff were wonderful and offered us room options. The unit was tastefully modernized and very clean. Our bed was great and the location good. Pub/restaurant/shops within walking distance and a great area for a riverside stroll or run. We have no hesitation in recommending this hidden gem. Will definitely stay here again. Thank you team.

title: Two Nights In Cambridge
text:
Very clean and well presented. Refreshing decor and comfortable allround.

Handy to supermarket bottle store and 3 choices of takeaway foods.

This place punches well above its weight, and i would easily recommend it to family and strangers.

title: Great stay
text: Had a one night stay at the Leamington Spa Motel.  It is fantastic. Modern clean & tidy.  Great staff!  If you are ever in Cambridge this is a great spot to stay.  Spa pool!  The summer would be even better with the pool.

title: Highly recommended motel
text: I recently spent 4 nights at the Leamington Spa Motel and was very impressed. The unit was exceptionally clean, the host and staff helpful and friendly, and the quietness within the room was much appreciated. All facilities needed were available, making my visit a very pleasant one.

title: Solo Overnight Stay
text: Had a very comfortable stay here overnight with my doglet. The room was clean, recently decorated with separate shower and bathroom. Good kitchen amenities  need and a comfortable warm bed. Loads of places to eat nearby and a very friendly and considerate motel manager. It was quiet and peaceful, highly recommend

title: One of the BEST
text: This is one of the BEST Motels I have stayed at in North Island.  I was able to have my Border Collies in the unit with me and the staff were very friendly and respectful not to disturb my dogs.  Will definitely be promoting this Motel to other dog owners and will also be returning in the future.  This is coming from someone who rarely writes reviews!

title: Recent stay
text: We had two very good stays at Leamington Spa Motel this month. The Motel is very clean, tidy and well set up. The beds are lovely and comfortable The staff are so friendly and accommodating and we will definitely stay again

title: Superb
text:
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Leamington Spa Motel. Exceptionally clean rooms and outstanding customer service. 
Refurbished one bedroom room was very comfortable and warm for a chilly Autumn weekend. Close to a supermarket and lots of food outlet options.
Would definitely stay again!

title: Great pet friendly motel
text: Would definitely return to stay at this motel. It was our first time travelling with our big dog and nervous about the experience. The motel was was clean and very accommodating regarding our Great Dane, telling us about dog exercise areas close to the motel. Thank you

title: Leamington break
text: Absolutely lovely people to deal with, top notch customer service.  Rooms very very clean, tidy & well presented.  Rooms looked like new refurbished so was an absolute delight to walk into, too cold for swimming, kids did hit the spa.

title: Great place to stay.  Spotlessly clean, freshly decorated and great hosts.
text: Our friends and family (total of 5 different rooms booked) stayed here.  All rooms were spotlessly clean, and all were refurbished to a high standard. The furniture and bedding was of very good quality. We had a great stay, the hosts were very accomodating and friendly - we will definitely be returning.  Do not judge this book by its cover.  The front of the motel does look a little uninspiring - but the facilites are fabulous.  Highly recommended.

title: Lovely clean comfortable units
text:
We haved returned to stay at this lovely ckean comfortable motel. Nice and handy to shops and fabulous restaurants.The units have a very good kitchen with all the utensils should you decide to cook yourself. 
If you are staying in Cambridge we thoroughly recommend you stay here. 
A big plus for us it is pet friendly.pooch thinks this is a awesome place as well.

title: Warm welcome and comfortable rooms.
text: Lyn made us very welcome and made sure we had everything we needed. The unit was serviced daily and was very clean and comfortable. Loved the outdoor pool and spa as I was staying over during a sports tournament. Relatively quiet location and not far from river walks and Cambridge town centre. Would certainly stay again.

title: Waka ama Nationals
text: My family and I have stayed at the Leamington Spa Motel for a number of years now. The owners are always friendly and helpful. The rooms are clean and have been recently upgraded which is a lovely improvement. The linen is plentiful as are the condiments. Having the pool and spa makes it a relaxing and inviting place to return to after a long day at lake Karapiro. Looking forward to our 2020 stay🤗. My Son and his family will now become frequent guests as of 2020.

title: Clean and comfortable
text: We stayed here as a family and found it to be clean and comfortable and have everything we could want. The room was well set up and supplied more than what a lot of places do. There were fans supplied for each room. There was also a lovely pool and spa to use. Would definitely stay here again. Thanks very much.

title: Great stay over Christmas
text: My wife and I stayed for 3 nights whilst celebrating Christmas with my family. The motel does not present well when you first arrive but it does not take long to appreciate that the owners are working very hard to renovate the motel from the inside out. Our unit was immaculate and recently redecorated. The staff were very helpful and gave us a choice of units when we arrived. We will definitely stay here again. The website was also very easy to use and well presented. I booked via the website and made enquires on the website All was very easy and the staff responded to my enquires within a short timeframe.

title: Wonderful place to stay!
text: Our third stay with Leamington Spa Motel and never been disappointed. Super friendly management even HOLLY (fur baby) looked after us very well! Had our room ready when we came in late one night added that nice personal touch! Very very clean and tidy not to mention modern with everything one needs! Very handy to shops and supermarkets.Highly recommended to all! AAA++++

title: Great place
text: We just stayed for a night - hubby, dog, and myself - on the way through. Clean friendly motel with everything you need - WiFi, Sky, a little kitchen. Nice and quiet to! Will stay again if in the area.

title: PET FRIENDLY IN CENTRAL LOCATION
text: The motel is in the process of being refurbished to a high standard. My room was a newly refurbished one, so everything was fresh and new. Sky TV and Wifi was great. Good sized kitchen with all cooking amenities so you if you didn't want to eat out you didn't have to! Excellent bathroom facilities too with good sized towels and a 'real' hairdryer! PET FRIENDLY is a huge bonus - no need to leave the dog at home!! My wee girl, Stella really enjoyed her stay with resident dog, Holly. There is a swimming pool and a spa which I can imagine will be very popular in the summer months. I really recommend the Leamington Spa if you are coming to Cambridge - pet friendly, family friendly and super lovely hosts.

title: PET FRIENDLY
text: We stayed a few nights here as our house was under renovations. We have a very much loved dog and chose leamington hotel as they are Pet friendly, we weren't disappointed staff were very friendly and went out of there way to make sure we comfy and had what we needed. Room was serviced daily and was super clean and spacious value for money. super comfy beds and very quite great location.

title: Vintage style with comfi beds
text: We stayed at this motel for 1 night. It changed management and the new owners are upgrading/renovating this place. I would call it a vintage style, very spacious and spotless clean motel with new comfi beds. Best night I had in days so very happy! The service is very friendly & worth the experience. Location is central but quiet.

title: EXCELLENT VALUE
text:
Not too many bells & whistles, but good basic accommodation. Well equipped, clean & comfortable.
 The bonus of a few Sky TV Sport channels, and our back-from-the-street unit nice & quiet. The only significant negative was abysmal water pressure in the (sparkling clean) bathroom.  
But overall, excellent value, & more than happy to stay again

title: Worst Motel Ever Stayed In
text: Being Tradespeople we stay in many motels around NZ.  We could only book Leamington Motel two days before arrival.  We booked over the phone for two nights (Thursday & Friday) with a possible need for Sunday.  On Friday we advised we did not need Sunday.  Their out of date policy is that you forfeit the room if you cancel within 30 DAYS!! We didn't have 30 days and they did not point this out when we tentatively made the booking for Sunday. They took half the room cost for Sunday cancellation; never come across this before. Then they had the nerve to email us at 3.14 in the morning suggesting we give them a review. Well here it is. The room was bare, basic, cold, unwelcoming and very over-priced. "The Boys" said they never wanted to stay there again

title: Great service
text: Our large family stayed in a number of rooms while in Cambridge last week/end for a funeral. Great, friendly service, very accommodating staff, warm rooms and close to town. We will definitely stay again when in town.

title: Excellent Transit Accom - Dog Friendly
text: Exactly what we needed in transit accommodation, pet friendly and the staff were lovely.  We really enjoyed our stay. As a Cambridge local i did have places to stay, however taking your dog isnt always ideal - so this was 100% stress free. Lena and Tilt

title: Welcoming
text: We had 2 dogs with us and we were made to feel most welcome. There is  a Domain nearby so a great place to take the dogs. We didn't use the pool but it was a nice extra. Also nearby are some eateries and handy shops.

title: Sports Group accommodation
text: Our Marching team stayed at the Leamington Motel for 4 nights from the 14th March - 18th March, while competing in the Marching NZ Championships in Hamilton.  There was plenty of room for our whole group of 30 and we appreciated the units been serviced every day during our stay.  Everything was at our fingertips as we prepared meals for everyone, 3 times a day.  Thank you Lyn & staff for hosting us. Storm Marching Team

title: Fantastic
text: We had a lovely great big room with plenty of space and couches. Kitchen was great, as was the bathroom and bedrooms. Plenty of fans which were needed as it was muggy.  The kids loved the pool and spa! We really enjoyed our stay and the extra people and trailers/camper were no problem. Thanks!

title: Beautiful renovated room
text: We spent 6 nights at the Leamington motel over the Christmas break visiting family and friends. We were lucky enough to stay in one the renovated rooms and it was great, modern, clean and comfortable. The service and staff were fantastic too. Would definitely recommend the Leamington motel to our family and friends!

title: Perfect!
text:
A spontaneous get away saw us stay the nite here at Leamington Motel. We wanted a place that was going to be pet friendly and this place certainly didn’t disappoint!
We checked out a cpl of rooms before settling on one that was easily accessible to the pool. (Esp for our water babies). 
Rooms are very clean, spacious, provided sky tv and free wifi! 
Shops a few minutes walk up road or a short drive into Cambridge. 
Relaxing spa and owners made us feel very welcome! 
Will def return😊

title: Four of us stayed 4 nights. Spacious, clean, towels changed daily, friendly. Excellent kitchen and bathroom facilities.
text:
We would use these motels again, renovations exceptional. Very friendly owner.
This is an older style layout which is ideal for four or more people. Kitchen fully equiped.
Sky TV, sofas comfortable, table sitting for four.

title: Underwhelmed, needs attention...
text:
I can say that the positioning of this place is ideal, but I struggled (from very initial time of booking to when we departed) to find anything that redeemed this accommodation in my mind. It was clear the new owners are upgrading in some areas (pool, paving) but we perhaps had the misfortune to stay in a very tired unattractive unit. 
During our overnight stay we noticed; piece of timber shoved under ranchslider attempt at a step (which dropped out when I stood on it), outdoor furniture that had a broken leg when you sat on it and a bedroom window latch (above head of bed) was also broken which meant security was compromised. We struggled in our unit's very dated bathroom, with 2 elderly parents who stayed with us, for safely getting in/out of shower (step up) and it was cold in our unit despite us heating it with old heaters provided...sure, there were plenty of rugs provided. The 2nd bedroom had another bed in a small room with a large kingsize, which prevented us opening the wardrobe door. The kitchen was well supplied though. 
As another additional point (considering it's sole reason we selected this accommodation), I found it not especially ideal for pets...it's right on the road without fencing and there was nowhere obvious to take your pet to toilet ?
 I also think, having our credit card through booking.com to secure the booking the request for 50% deposit over a month out from our date of stay felt more like we were "cash cows". This feeling was repeated at check-in, the Manager actually stated; "we need you to pay in full, because we have alot of people who leave and don't pay" - hardly a welcoming first impression for my Mother who had sent them her 50% deposit payment as requested !!? I think given we spent over $200 including $10 extra for dog (which I couldn't even find anywhere to dispose of dog poo bag outside) the value proposition for me anyway was not met. 
As a disclaimer, I stay in hotels across NZ frequently and do know what good quality accommodation needs to provide to ensure positive word of mouth from their customers.

title: Pet friendly, easy, comfortable accommodation
text: We stayed here on our way up north and there is nothing we could fault. Upon arrival we were unsure on what to have for tea, we were recommended a beautiful Thai restaurant which we also couldn't fault. The main reason we stayed here was due to having a lab and a retriever with us so being pet friendly was a huge plus! Would 100% recommend staying here and will definitely be back!

title: A very pleasant and restful overnight stop
text: Pet friendly which was pre-requisite for us. Clean and comfortable and quiet. Amazing owner who could not have been more helpful. We arrived in the dark from Auckland and didn't know the area - she stayed on the phone with me and gave step by step directions to the motel. Showed us to the motel and put lights and heating on. Parking down the driveway which was ideal for us not wanting to leave our vehicle and trailer on the street.

title: Nice homely feel but out dated
text: Average price. Our room was at the back so quiet. Parking a bit difficult - had to drive onto patio to get off driveway. Very friendly staff and dog :-) Very out dated decor - still waiting for redecorating. Shower curtain too short so water went on the floor - shower pressure not great. The queen size bed would not go against the wall due to electrical plugs sticking out so pillows kept disappearing! No seating to watch TV. Only one bedside cabinet and lamp. Portable heater - difficult to regulate temperature and it made a loud clicking noise as it regulated the temperature. Office driveway turnaround too tight; we had to back out onto the main street.

title: Flipp Ltd
text: Booking over the phone was so easy. Our driver stayed here and came back to us to say it was really good place and loved the meal he ordered. Excellent. We will definitely be booking here again. Highly recommended
hotel_response: Many thanks for taking the time to post such a lovely review.

title: Easy, comfortable accommodation every year
text:
We prefer to stay here for Waka Ama instead of campgrounds with our club because it makes travel and meal times easier and we are always well looked after. We have full sized fridge-freezer, kitchen & bathroom. Pool to cool down the family after a day at the lake plus unlimited WiFi & Sky TV to wind down my kids in prep for their races. Yes, decor could do with a re-vamp - which I know is underway - but to be honest I'd rather stay in an affordable motel than a pricey 'boutique' hotel. It's clean, secure and spacious.
My only criticism this year is that the lights in the room were all out, otherwise, great as always. See you next year!

title: Fantastic accommodation
text: Had a great stay at the Leamington Motel this weekend.  The room was awesome with modern decor and very spacious for four of us.  The kids loved the pool and had a great time.  Thanks Lyn, you are a great host, will hopefully see you again this time next year.

title: Accomodation
text:
As we were working in Cambridge over the weekend, Friday - Sunday late, we needed easy no fuss accommodation for ourselves and employees. The staff at the Leamington Motel met all of our expectations and more, they were very accommodating. Our Unit was very comfortable, everything we needed was right there, and we had a wonderful home cooked meal prepared for us on Saturday evening. Great stay! We will be back! 
Spellcaster Wooden Toys Ltd

title: Pet Freindly
text: Awesome place if you have a pet with you on your travels, they make you feel so welcome and comfortable with having them with you, my room was excellent and very clean. i had a german shepherd with me and even though i had a crate with me i was told he was welcome to stretch out wherever he wanted to. I wish there were more places like this around New Zealand, Thanks & have already recommended to others.

title: Nice Family Visit
text: Very friendly and helpful hosts. Older motel but priced well. A very roomy unit for a family of 5 which was welcome. Very clean. We had unit 7 and double bed was very soft which we aren't used to but slept OK. A queen size bed would be an improvement. For some reason shower was very weak. Very good free internet.  Enjoyed our stay and would stay again.

title: Looking forward to our next visit!
text:
Lyn was wonderful and looked after us like family. Our room was spotlessly clean and comfortable with everything we needed. Several local restaurants and takeaways to choose from which Lyn made sure we knew about.
I highly recommend this motel and it is the one we will always stay at when we are visiting Cambridge.
Until next time ...

title: Comfortable accommodation
text: We broke our trip by staying i9n Cambridge and found our unit clean and comfortable. Lyn welcomed us and we were able to travel with our dog Cassie! Shops were close by and the town centre is only a five minute drive.

title: Thank you very comfortable . Has everything you need
text: We enjoyed our night at Leamington  We were welcomed on a wet night Some are saying the rooms are a bit tired in decor but we thought it was cool and we think that they should be left just as they are. They will be iconic one day and could be a good selling point. We were welcomed on a wet night and shown to our room. Lovely hospitality. Thank you

title: Friendly,convenient and pet friendly
text:
The service is excellent, friendly and helpful. Our room was warm on arrival, we were given a room that was easy to park in front of. They are new owners so we were aware they have plans to redecorate the rooms at some stage, even though the rooms are a bit tired they are comfortable and roomy enough, and it's great that our dog can stay too!
Even though it is close to the road it wasn't to noisy.

title: Pet Friendly Hotel
text:
The room that we had was nice and clean and was able to accommodate our medium sized dog! Décor was a bit tired and could have done with a fresh lick of paint. Location was handy for us. Cooking facilities could have been better, but there was no lack of options in regards to eating out.

.

title: Not too much good to say about it
text:
While clean and tidy, it's really tired and takes me back to the mid seventies for decor. Beds OK but a number of lights don't work - no bulbs!
Loose switches and in bathroom that is a no go.
Surroundings are rough and ready with pot holes and muddy.
Driveway needs sealing and not enough paving. Sadly the view as you drive in would cause some possible clients to drive straight past. A 3 star at best.

title: Simple but simply cool
text: To the untrained eye, or someone who's a critical, miserable bugger, the Leamington Motel is old and not that nice. But they'd be wrong. Very wrong. It's utterly lovely in an old school 50 - 60's motel way (Not a Norman Bates way though). Un-renovated, but spotless, the beds are comfortable, the kitchen is fully stocked, the shower is hot and steamy and the telly works. The host is just lovely and cooked up an amazing full breakfast. It's like time has stood still for the Leamington  and you've walked onto a movie set with the art department being told - make me a 60's motel! Apparently it's going to be renovated soon. I hope not too much. The very fact it's a genuine example of motel culture from years gone by means I'd stay there again in a flash. I absolutely loved it.

title: Convienient location, clean, neat, comfortable.
text: Friendly service, comfortable but not real plush (a bit dated, but good value).  Pool was cold when we were there, brrrr.. (April).  Convenient location for walking to good places for eating.  Would return, but probably look at other options as well.

user_location: Bay of Plenty Region, New Zealand
title: Excellent clean units and friendly staff
text: This motel is a little dated but units are generous in size and sparkling clean.  The unlimited free wifi is an awesome plus in my books and the staff go out of their way to make your stay as comfortable as possible and nothing is a problem. A+ from us

title: Lovely stay again
text: Once again we stayed here and we're not disappointed, very comfortable and clean .The staff are amazing, very helpful and understanding of our needs.Close to all the shops and restaurants and is very quite.

title: Very clean and comfortable with friendly staff
text: This motel is a little distance over the river from Cambridge town centre via one of the narrowest bridges I have yet come across in NZ. Parking is a little tight with a big car but everything else is spot on. Renovations are proceeding but there is no disruption to guests. Lyn who checked us out, and the other staff member who checked us in couldn't have been more helpful.  Beds are excellent and the Wi Fi is all it should be. Would stay there again anytime.

title: Very tidy and lovely staff
text: A handy location and very happy with the presentation of the unit. Very tidy and comfortable. The staff are all friendly and always on hand if anything is needed. I'd stay there again for sure. Pool facilities are very clean. Laundry and clothes line is also available!

title: Great beds, free WiFi and national phone calls, very clean just let down by how tired it is
text:
On arrival the owners were very welcoming and helpful.  The motel is oddly laid out and parking is not the easiest.  The rooms are rather tired but very clean and fans were provided in both the lounge and the bedroom which was great.  The beds were very comfortable and the sheets cotton, giving a very nice sleep.  The pool area is also a bit shabby but you could see that improvements are being done around the place.
We stayed for two nights and found that the location is fine with a quick drive into town or a gentle walk.   I hope the owners continue to make improvements as these units could be quite nice.

title: home away from home
text: lovely clean and comfortable units. Lyn is an excellent host, breakfast was great,  very quiet, yes up grades are continuing but this did not affect the quality of our stay.  Thankyou and will se you again.

title: Very welcoming and accommodating new owners
text: Our stay was very good.  The breakfast was excellent.  Renovations are ongoing and will serve to improve the experience.  Rooms are not ostentatious but are clean, comfortable and well provisioned.  We felt warmly welcomed and that the owners genuinely appreciated our comments and feedback.

title: One nights non-refundable deposit required when booking
text:
I got they impression that new owners were running the place. I didn't end up staying here - and will not. Despite wanting to booking over a month in advance this motel wanted one nights non refundable deposit no matter when I cancelled (I said I would provide at least 48 hours notice or more - if I needed to cancel at all). They did say I could have a refund if they were able to re sell the room. Get real. Would rather stay in Hamilton and drive to Cambridge if need be. 

Not impressed - you are providing a service - not holding people to ransom.

title: Thank you! Perfect!
text: Its a great motel, so close to the Lake, and much nicer than others we have stayed at in Cambridge.  Breakfast was 1st class, rooms were clean and tidy, and well presented, thanks Lyn! We think you have made a huge improvement to the place. Looking forward to staying again when we come past next time!

title: Dont book online - left without a place to stay
text:
Absolutely disappointed!!.
My husband and I were travelling through to Cambridge for an event at lake karapiro and decided to book a room with this Motel because it was conveniently located to the lake. So I dis what I've always done for all my accommodation in nz and internationally and booked online. its convenient, and would generally be a good way to secure accommodation (so I thought) because you provide  credit card detail...which can be debited if its a no show.

Anyway my husband and I booked at 9am or thereabouts and went to the lake for the day knowing check in would be 2pm.

2pm rolls around and im greeted by a young girl who checks the book.

the young girl explains her mother is getting milk and calls her on mobile. I get handed the phone only to be told that"im very sorry but we have booked all the rooms...we had a walk in???...at that point im thinking where the heck are we going to stay and uttee dissapointment sets in.

I explained my dissapointment and said we have no where to stay further weve driven a long way. the owner tells me I shouldn't book online I should call her....?? 

if you dont like online booking systems then dont use them. 

I then getquestioned as to what time I booked because she didn't see anything...apparently this is my fault??.

Now I know the extent of your service

I will never recommend this place to anyone.

title: Great new management.
text: My wife and I stayed here over Christmas 2014. I have been staying at the Leamington Motel on and off for many years and for most of those years it was a very disappointing experience, but I am glad to say with  new management it has gained a new lease of life, new beds, clean and comfortable units, great service, reasonable rates and management who seem to enjoy what there doing.

title: NEW OWNER GREAT SERVICE COULDN'T HAVE BEEN MORE HELPFUL
text: On arrival I was greeted by a very cheerful lady who couldn't de enough to help and accommodate my stay.  She (Lyn) had just taken over and the motel in fact she was in the middle of moving in.  She found me a room.  I asked about breakfast she said it was her first day but why not.  A lovely continental breakfast arrived on time with a huge choice to choose from.  Our unit was down the back so there was no road noise. Yes it is a little dated but great changes are planned.  I will definitely be staying there again and bringing some friends with me.

title: Shabby Chic?
text:
Shabby chic or just shabby? So dated I felt it must be on purpose!  We stayed overnight in a one bedroom unit. No complimentary milk on booking in (dairy across the road).Soap only complimentary toiletry. An array of notices stuck on wall  "do your own dishes", "turn oven off" "no smoking" and others.
Narrow lounge area full with single bed/ set drawers/sofa/dining table/full size frig/small table against wall  holding multiplugs for TV, fan,DVD,lamp. Concrete block walls. Horrible plastic flowers. Stains on carpet/mat.
Freeview/ no Sky TV.  Located handy to town.
In the drawers was a folder of places to dine - sticky dirty folder and a mess of papers. Broken overhead lamp above bed in bedroom. 
However -  bed was comfortable  - not sure what size but  it seemed smaller than a Queen.  The shower was adequate - not much pressure.
Overall  - a tired motel badly in need of some cheering up and a more welcoming atmosphere.

title: For one night - perfect
text:
All we needed was bed for the night as we were travelling on the next day.  Very helpful staff - room nice and clean - just what we wanted.

Only criticism would be the the door lock was very fiddley to use....

title: Shocking Motel to stay at
text: Room dirty, things were broken (doors did not shut, oven door broken, holes in walls) to name a few).  Motel staff told us not to check out early as she did not do mornings - we went to the office at 8.15 am and were greater by staff in their PJs.  Decor very tired ands needs upgrading.  I would not stay here again and would not recommend to anyone else.

title: Very handy to Karapiro
text: We stayed here to get to Karapiro easily. The room was clean and suitable accomodation for our needs. We were welcomed with a friendly greeting. There are some shops just a walk away from the Motel to pick up a few needs. There is good easy access to get to the Cambridge town centre where there are some nice eating places.

title: Would stay again
text: Very nice clean unit. Good dog friendly emvironment..Staff very helpful and friendly to both us and our dog.Lovely pool area .Walking distance to shops and cafes.Our every need was met and have no hesitation to staying there in the future or recommending to anyone that requires accomodation in Cambridge

title: Great spot to stay
text: I have recently stayed at the Leamington Motel and found it a most relaxing place . It is very reasonable ,clean and tidy. Very friendly staff. Clean swimming pool was most inviting. I can recommend to anybody looking for place to stay in Cambridge. My little dog was also made very welcome.

title: Expensive for what we got
text: We stayed here because it was pet friendly.  We were the only ones staying at this motel during what we would have thought was peak season and now we know why.  The room wasnt clean and badly needed a refresh.  For the expensive tariff charged paid we were disappointed with the room.

title: Find somewhere else in Cambridge to stay
text: Do not stay at this motel unless there are no others available in Cambridge. Stayed here recently whilst touring around North Island and it was the worst motel we stayed at, although the location isn’t too bad as it is within walking distance of the town. The units are shabby and could really do with updating. Screws sticking out from the back of chairs, lights which didn’t work & TV (3 channels) with bad reception all added to the run-down ambience. It was the only motel we stayed at whilst touring in New Zealand which was not cleaned or the beds made during our 3-night stay, only the towels were changed and the rubbish emptied. Definitely do not recommend this motel.

title: Beautiful grounds and perfect hosts
text:
It was a really relaxing stay at this beautiful manor house. We got two adjacent rooms that open up to the grounds, where you could walk around to explore the greenery and also the farm. The hosts Margaret and Allan are kind and welcoming. They also made us the best breakfast spread in the morning! 
Not far to drive to Hobbiton and Hamilton Gardens and other highlights.
hotel_response:
It truly was our pleasure to host you for your stay and we very much appreciate your kind words of praise.

Our location definitely benefits those seeking rural tranquilty and the proximity to visit the above tourist attractions.

Thanking you once again.

Allan and Margaret

title: It doesn't get any better!
text:
The grounds are reminiscent of an English 'estate'. They are well kept and comprehensive.
The home is 'IMPRESSIVE'. 
Our hosts, Allan and Margaret are relaxed, well spoken, well educated, gracious, and welcoming. 
Margaret is a most excellent cook. 
The 'expansive' views from the floor to ceiling windows, allowed us to bring the outdoors inside. The patio, with it's Italian stone paving evokes memories of Europe.
hotel_response:

Receiving appreciative, kind words are always well received, thank you.

Wishing you well.

Allan and Margaret

title: Amazing
text: Was a stunning place, gorgeous view, and amazing hosts. Snacks were provided, and breakfast was amazing. Allan and Margaret were very accomodating as we were surprising my father for his birthday. They were very friendly and ensured that we had an amazing stay. Would defiantly return, and would 100% recommend this stunning hidden away gem.
hotel_response:
