Obviouly a happy ,united family, who know how to celebrate a birthday.
Choosing to do so at Blackwood House, it seems, made for an enjoyable, memorable experience.
We thank you for selecting Blackwood House, feel free to do so again.

title: Couldn’t Do Better
text: Wow. Just wow. What a stunning place - in every way. The house itself was absolutely beautiful inside and out, the view from the house picturesque, and the hosts themselves were wonderful. I don’t think I’ve ever been in such a nice shower - or slept in such a nice bed! It was a good distance from everything and not too hard to find. Margaret and Allan are such lovely people, 10/10 would stay again, thank you so much for having us in your stunning house.
hotel_response:
In the words of the popular song,"Its hard to be humble "when you tell us the "Blackwood House experience "is perfect in every way!
Having your family visit was our pleasure, thank you very much for your kind words.

title: A stand-out among 10 different accommodations on the North Island.
text: This is a very unique and lovely home.  It's uniqueness is guided by the hosts themselves: an interesting couple who seem to appreciate experiencing what their guests bring to their home.  They truly seem to enjoy their role and go to great lengths to make sure their guests are comfortable.  We stayed in 10 different accommodations during our three weeks on the North Island and our accommodations here were the most outstanding in terms of quality and attention to detail.  We thoroughly enjoyed meeting Margaret and Allan and greatly appreciate the outstanding breakfasts Margaret prepared and Allan's careful guidance in planning our days.  Hamilton is a hidden gem and this home and couple allow that gem to sparkle.
hotel_response:
My apologies for the slow acknowledgement.
Blackwood House really enjoys welcoming guests of the caliber of Candice and Bruce.
To get to share ones adventures and travels make the business of welcoming ,initial strangers to depart as great friends, all the more worth while.
We very much enjoyed the Fergusson visit.
Wishing you both all the best.
Margaret and Allan at Blackwood House

title: Stunning rural property!
text: Allan and Margaret were kind enough to have us stay with them for a night at their beautiful rural estate. They made us feel very welcome, were always attentive and made the perfect hosts. Their house is something else and I highly recommend staying there if the opportunity arises! Thanks again Allan and Margaret!

It truly was a delight to welcome you and Sophie for your brief visit to Blackwood House.

Wishing you both well, for the rest of your holiday.

Allan and Margaret at Blackwood House

title: Great stay at the lovely lodge
text: The lodge was surrounded by a wonderful scenery and we truly enjoyed a wonderful stay. Margaret made us a lovely dinner and Allan showed us a exciting  videos and we had a great time! We love to visit the lodge again.
hotel_response:
Dear Mai and family,

It was our pleasure to have you visit all the way from Tokyo ,Japan.

Being able to show you the farm animals and later to entertain you and your family, was enlightening and enjoyable.

We hope that we met your expectations, returning to Japan, with great memories of your visit and New Zealand.

Wishing you all the best for your future travels,
Allan & Margaret at Blackwood House, New Zealand

title: Elegance
text: Nestled within a manicured arboreal estate, the Blackwood House is a private respite hosted by Allan and Margaret. Our sleeping space was spacious and comforting, with soft chairs and an ottoman that faced sweeping views of the palate of late fall trees, fading to silhouettes when the stars to the north began to glow. Breakfast was made to order, served at a grand table with proper place settings. Our stay at Blackwood was a pleasure seldom savored in this age.
hotel_response:

Thank you both for excelling in all aspects, your visit has been most appreciated.

Wishing you well in your future travels.

Be sure and consider visiting again, when planning your next trip to New Zealand.

title: Peace and Pampering
text: Blackwood House is a blissful peaceful country House yet only short journeys to Cambridge Town, Hobbiton and Raglan beach. The standard of accommodation was spacious and beautifully maintained with all the little extras you would expect in a high quality Hotel. The views in all direction is of manicured gardens, trees and green field. A Balm to the soul and "sore eyes" we came away restored. Nothing was too much trouble for our hosts with breakfast and the evening Musical Concert a highlight.  Contact the hosts direct for expert attention and bookings.
hotel_response:
Carole and Murray, we thank you for being superb guests.
It truly was a pleasure sharing three days with you, initially as guests, departing as friends.
Your kind words are most appreciated.
Wishing you both well, cheers,
Margaret and Allan

title: Wonderful B&B
text: We stayed here for our last two nights in New Zealand and really enjoyed our stay. Allan's and Margaret are excellent hosts and did everything they could to make our stay enjoyable. Allan even lent us his SatNav so that we could find the way to meet our niece and family as we weren't sure of the route. Their house is beautiful, our room was really comfortable and the bathroom was luxurious. We really enjoyed talking to them when we came in after our evening out. The breakfasts were delicious and we really appreciated them getting up early as we had to get to the airport. This was the perfect end to our stay in New Zealand and we were very sorry to leave.
hotel_response:
Dear Pam & Colin,

What a pleasant surprise, for a nicely penned review all the way from the Lakes District.

Your sentiments of your stay are very much appreciated and your kind words about us, are more than mutually similar to those we have of you both............thank you very much.

As seasoned travelers, as the Mansfield's are, sharing your adventures and experiences to places we have yet to visit, engender plans and aspirations, which all make for a diverse lifestyle for us all.

Margaret and I thank you for your visit and very positive review.

Yours,

Allan & Margaret at Blackwood House, New Zealand

title: Blackwood House, the perfect start to our vacation.
text: The beauty of the countryside, the luxurious details of the home and the warmth of Margarat and Allan welcomed us to New Zealand. And, it was the best breakfast of our two week vacation. Thank you both for a lovely stay.
hotel_response:
Having the Johnson family from Massachusetts, was truly a pleasure....we are pleased that enjoyed your visit to New Zealand.

Margaret and I are even more pleased that you have been comfortable in writing a wonderful review, of your stay while here at Blackwood House, thank you.

 We like to think that the hospitality and efforts we make, have our guests, very pleased that they elected to stay with us, even though, we may initially be considered more expensive.

Thanks again, from Allan & Margaret

title: The Ultimate B&B Experience
text: Located within a quick drive to Hobbiton, this Inn is the ideal place to spend a night or two. The proprietors, Allen and Margaret have a spectacular home on 20 plus acres of well manicured gardens, orchards and fields. Our room had an amazing view of the sunrise. The bed was incredibly comfortable and the shower had great water pressure - something you dont often find in hotels. From the heated towels to the homemade breakfast, their attention to detail is welcome. They are lovely hosts offering a lovely home. Our schedule did not permit a walk around the property but there were trails available. A very peaceful and relaxing location.
hotel_response:

In doing so, we set about advising and suggesting how, we can best add to your experience in visiting Hamilton, Cambridge and the very popular, Hobbiton movie set.

You are obviously 'Worldly travelers', so may you have many more fine reviews for others to take direction from.

Wishing you both, all the very best for 2017, yours,
Allan & Margaret at Blackwood House

title: A masterclass in how to run a b&b
text:
This was simply put perfection!
Our room was beautiful. Located on the first floor it had a stunning view of the grounds.
I loved the privacy of the location of the house. So peaceful but only a short drive to both Hamilton and Cambridge.
Breakfast was delicious, fresh fruit homebaked banana bread, eggs and so on. 
Our hosts Allan & Margaret were lovely and we ended up staying longer than planned because we enjoyed talking with them so much.
My only regret is that we only had one night, I would have liked to stay at least one more night at this amazing place.
hotel_response:
My goodness me..........it is" hard to be humble" when Winnie is writing an excellent review !

It truly was a "delightful Danish" experience, having Morten & Winnie visit the Waikato, after travelling from so far away.

Sharing anecdotes and stories with "worldly travelers" makes for a memorable, experience for guest and host alike.

We thank you both once again, feel free to visit at anytime, in the future.

Safe travels,

Cheers,Allan & Margaret @ Blackwood House

title: Heaven on Earth
text: 100/100 for recharging the batteries and experiencing luxury country hospitality. So easily accessible yet the feeling of being away from it all. Perfect way to spend our holiday away from our city life. Thanks Allan and Margaret!

Because Foxgloves is nestled among the rolling hills and surrounded by beautiful trees and garden we woke each morning to the sound of glorious birdsong and, a little later, to a rooster crowing.  Pure magic!!  Raglan was only a 25 minute drive from Foxgloves and well worth a visit with local art and craft for sale, trendy cafes, historic buildings, a fascinating Museum and a famous surfing beach.  We will never forget Grace and Patrick's wonderful hospitality.  We felt pampered and cared for in their warm, comfortable and beautifully furnished home and as a result we long to return....

title: New Years at Foxgloves... we loved it!
text: We stayed 2 nights at Foxgloves over New Years. We absolutely loved it!  The house is beautiful, and it's in a great spot.  Our room had lovely french doors opening out to the hillside.  Watching the sunrise out the doors from the comfort of our warm bed was amazing.  Grace and Patrick were very gracious hosts and we were surprised with a bottle of Moet on New Years day morning! Patrick took our daughter out both mornings to collect eggs for our breakfast and she had a blast (we also had some time to enjoy a quiet coffee which was great as well!).  We were impressed with the quality of wine Grace and Patrick provided.  We also appreciated the after dinner liquer which had originally been made by Patrick's father.  We would absolutely reccomend Foxgloves, it is a special place and Grace and Patrick are delightful!

title: Christmas at Foxgloves....Fabulous!!!!!!
text:
We stayed at Foxgloves Christmas and Boxing Day and what a wonderful experience. To start with Foxgloves is magnificent... the Victorian homestead is so comfortable and with amazing decor. You step back in time when you enter the door, from the lavish bedroom and bathroom to the stunning living areas, everything is Victorian splendor! 
Set in a beautiful, peaceful surroundings with lovely gardens. A nice spot to sit and forget the hustle and bustle of the city, listen to the birds, resident sheep and chickens. 
Food, wow what a feast! Homemade pizzas from the pizza oven and for Christmas, roast pork, turkey and all the trimmings. Dessert was to die for, the best pavlova EVER! 
Grace and Patrick are wonderful hosts, wonderful people who make you feel totally at home. Spending Christmas with them will go down as one of our most memorable Christmas's in a very long time. 
If you are wanting a peaceful retreat in a luxurious homestead Foxgloves is the place for you!!!!

title: Absolute Peace & Quiet
text: We stayed 1 night at this beautiful B & B and I wanted to stay much longer.  The decor is in keeping with the victorian theme, all the way through the bedrooms, bathrooms and living & dining areas.  It is just beautifu.  We enjoyed dinner by way of the wood fire pizza oven, our 10 year old son especially enjoyed that.  We got to then enjoy a soak in the hot tub, and then a quiet drink by the open fire in the courtyard.  Our sleep was great, so quiet and our room had black out curtains which made it very easy to sleep in the next morning.  Breakfast was also very, very good.  As we had our young son with us, it was a treat for him to be allowed to feed the chooks, and check on the baby chicks that were there at the time.  Patrick & Grace are such wonderful hosts, ensuring everything we needed was at hand.  They have great knowledge of the area and things to see & do if you feel like getting out & about.  A definate treat to stay here, and we will most definatley be back as soon as we can.

title: Delightful place
text:
Where to start? There are so many good things to say about my stay at Foxgloves. The location may seem out of the way but that adds to the experience. The silence at night is amazing, so, so peaceful. Even during the day, it is rare to hear any noise other than nature during the day. 

The attention to detail regarding the decor is second to none. It is clear that a lot of love has gone into Foxgloves. The cleanliness is immaculate and you just sink into the beds to have a really good nights sleep. The food cannot be faulted, with fresh eggs from the resident chickens everyday and fresh vegetables from the garden.

Finally, the owners Grace and Patrick. They are so accomodating, they made me feel so welcome and at home. It is truely a great place to stay.

title: The reviews are correct!
text: Following such great recommendations we stayed for two nights at Foxgloves and loved it. Tony was busy but Cheryl looked after us like family. The Victorian themed room we stayed in was full of character and the accommodation comfortable. The location is ideal as a first or final stop before Auckland. Thoroughly recommended.

title: A wonderful 5 * experience!!!
text:
More like a 5* hotel than a B&B. The dinner was first rate! If described as a 'lodge' or something, they could & should charge double. Please go!

A little difficult to find. My sat nav sent me the wrong way round....

title: They Love What They Do
text:
After a month in NZ, this was one of my most favorite stays. I only met Tony as his wife was away on business. I was attended to like a King. The place itself is about 30 minutes from supermarkets and the like, but you will not need to bring food as Tony cooks up meals full of fresh ingredients from his garden, his chickens, and most importantly, from his heart. 
Peaceful, relaxing, and so friendly. I hesitate even to review it so fondly as I don't want it to be sold-out the next time I come around, but Tony and all of his efforts should be rewarded. You will be if you book this location. 
If there is perfection in a BNB, this is it. (Ive stayed in about 50 of them.)

title: Peace (sic) of paradise.
text:
These people are living my dream - 3 themed rooms with great attention to detail. There was only one other couple staying at the same time as us. Dining room (beautifully set for meals) and lounge available. Our room had french doors onto a verandah - we slept with the doors open.  A hot tub (quite hot!!) and an open fireplace outdoors - lovely to sit under the stars, so peaceful. Wander around the garden, admire the vege patch, talk to the hens or sit on the landing and read. The dogs are really well behaved and are not at all intrusive - Tony and Cheryl are very welcoming and friendly and also not intrusive! We dined in one night - a lovely meal - too much for me. Homemade vinegarette/marmalade/relish.  Breakfasts were also yum.
The surrounding countryside is scenic rural NZ - we drove back to Auckland on the gravel back road exiting at Port Waikato - well worth braving a metal road. Raglan ( 30 minutes away) is an interesting seaside village - not just a surf beach, plenty of choices for swimming and watersport. The local pub (next to the Waingaro hot pools) served up a decent pub meal "real ham, not that sandwich stuff you get in town" said the chef. This was our first B & B experience - loved it.

title: Highly recommend!
text: We sneak away from the kids and come and stay once a year or so and it is gorgeous! beautiful rooms, great food (Tony & Cheryl are happy to cater to my fussy dietary requirements too), love the outdoor spa pool, totally relaxing place to be. Highly recommend to anyone who wants to get away from it all for a day or two.

title: Absolutely  fantastic!
text: A beautifully refurbished and furnished Colonial Villa with lovely mature plantings and garden, and in such a pretty ‘secret’ part of the North Island too! Tony and Cheryl were wonderful hosts, providing us with sumptuous dinners and breakfasts, and a very warm welcome, with both a relaxed atmosphere and unobtrusive attention to detail – well done! We’d be very happy to come back and recommend you to our friends.

title: Great Hosts, Great Getaway
text:
We had a weekend here recently. Very impressed. Cheryl and Tony the owners are great. We stayed for dinner both nights. If you take this option (and we recommend you do), make sure you eat nothing during the day as Tony cooks up a huge meal! Saves having to travel out for food and the meals were lovely.
The house is cosy and very nicely done up and the bedroom large, comfortable and immaculately clean. The weather wasn't that condusive to being outside, but the spa pool was great to relax in before dinner and you can feed the goats and sheep any left over toast after breakfast. Oh yes, breakfast is huge and tasty too.
Located out in the "wops", it's in a good location for exploring the Raglan/West Waikato area, or just reading a book and lazing about.
Close enough to Auckland to make it good weekend away destination.
We plan to be back before too long.

title: Truly amazing
text: I treated my wife for an evening sleepout. This place (and their owners) were amazing. Upon entering the doors, we were transported back 60, 80 years. The authenticity of the decor, furniture, the bathrooms,  even the cutlery were true to some time way back in the past. Tony & Cheryl are right on the money with this gem in the middle of almost nowhere. Tony cooks the most amazing food, and Cheryl has done something amazing decorating this B&B. Their friendlyness and hospitality surpasses most that I have experienced. It is a lovely country setting to just get away. Just do it, you'll be surprised!

title: Thank you for a lovely time
text: Perfect B&B about 90 minutes from the airport. We stayed there for our last night in New Zealand, and wished we could have stayed longer. Perfect hosts, lovely room, idyllic location and a glass of red in front of the outdoor log fire in the evening. A truly great last night in NZ.

title: A Little Piece Of Heaven!
text: It is difficult to say what we loved most about Foxgloves, the location, the house, the service, the hosts or the dogs. If you are looking for an amazing place to stay in the most idyllic location, with great food, fabulous hosts and the cutest dogs, then this is the place for you! Foxgloves is off the beaten track which only adds to its appeal, within about half an hour you can be in various places such as Raglan or the Waingaro Hot Pools and Brides Veil Falls are worth a look. I was a bit concerned about the lack of cellphone coverage but it actually just added to my relaxation. You can't fault Cheryl and Tony who are the most fantastic hosts, who make you feel so at home and yet still manage to forsee your every need and some you hadn't thought of yet. If you thought you had experienced great hospitality and food before think again as you haven't seen anything until you've been looked after by these guys, we have a 15 month old who is into everything but they even got us to relax about that and catered to her every need aswell. And I can't not mention the lads, the fox terriers that is, Rocky, Baxter and Pluto are gorgeous wee fellas, happy to play with you if you are willing but aren't in your face. We loved them and the other animals around the place. And of course for the kids, there is Flutterbys treehouse, quite probably the best treehouse you have ever seen with toys for all age ranges inside, I could have happily slept in there and I think the 12 year old with us tried to! We have discovered heaven on earth and are planning our next trip there as soon as we can. Thanks for everything Cheryl and Tony, we'll see you again soon and as for anyone out there thinking of paying Foxgloves a visit, do it, go on book now, you won't be sorry!

title: So perfect we didn't want to leave
text:
Where to start?
The rooms were individually decorated to the highest standards and were absolutely gorgeous.  We had a combined family holiday so booked out all 3 rooms.  
Tony and Cheryl are outstanding hosts, nothing is too much trouble and the service is incredible.  We felt like we were in Downton Abbey!
Tony's breakfasts each morning (cooked and continental) leave you feeling very satisfied.
The dinners are superb, we had Tony's roast beef one night and Cheryl's butter chicken the following.  
You bring your own alcohol which makes it even more ideal as you can have a truly nice bottle of wine with your meals and not be paying restaurant prices.

There are three lovely little fox terriers on the property (they have their own area to stay in if you are not a dog person).  They bounced around us very happily and enjoyed cuddling up on the outdoor chairs as soon as invited.  We were travelling with a 15mth old, the dogs didn't bother her at all.  They are very comfortable with children.

At night Tony and Cheryl lit up the outdoor fire and we sat around enjoying a glass or three whilst star gazing.  There is a spa pool in this area too but after two days of being waited on hand and foot we didn't dare try to squeeze ourselves into our togs.

We would definitely stay here again and again.  Would love to spend a week so we could visit all the attractions around Waingaro such as Raglan and Waitomo Caves etc.

Honestly couldn't rate this place high enough!

title: Serge
text: Service is great! BEST EVER B&B we've ever stayed! Breakfast and dinner were incredible. Thanks a lot! Recommended to everyone!

title: Time to Relax
text: We had a wonderful two night stay in Paddlehouse Suite 1!  Our host, David, was very responsive and helpful with our booking and also provided us with great restaurant recommendations.  We arrived after a tour of the glowworm caves (about an hour away) and enjoyed the nearby town of Cambridge for the day before a late afternoon tour of Hobbiton (about a half hour away).  Our time spent at the Oar and Paddle was delightful!  Commanding views of the lake from the living area, bedroom and outdoor seating areas.   Quiet, clean, private, serene accommodations including black out curtains and air conditioning.  Wish we could have stayed longer!

title: Reminded us of the Cotswolds in England
text: We comprised of 3 retired couples venturing from Auckland for a few days golfing and camaraderie.  We stayed in the Oarhouse Chalet and the Scullers Suite.  The Chalet was simply magnificent - wonderful views of Lake Karapiro.  The Scullers Suite was beautifully furnished and functioned well in providing us with 3 ensuited bedrooms.  The accommodation is set in a tranquil location surrounded by well established trees and garden.  Simply stunning.  Where else can you get up in the morning, sit on your deck and watch and hear the scullers and rowers training?

title: A hidden gem near Cambridge with stunning views and great hosting
text:
We’ve spent a lot of time around rowing over the years, so it’s surprising we hadn’t come across The Oar & Paddle before now.

We were looking for somewhere to stay near Cambridge for a weekend and found it to be a really special spot. Set high on a beautiful farm overlooking Lake Karapiro, the location is both scenic and peaceful. There happened to be a rowing regatta on while we were there, which was great to watch, but the accommodation itself still felt private and quiet.

The accommodation was excellent — very comfortable, well appointed, and clearly put together with care and attention to detail. It’s the kind of place where everything just works, making it easy to relax.

The welcome from the owners was warm and communication was quick and helpful throughout, which made the whole stay seamless.

A great option for a weekend away, or as a base if you have activities around Cambridge or the lake. We’d happily return.

title: Perfect stay on returning to NZ
text:
Only able to stay one night as we were passing through but it was absolutely perfect!! Peaceful, gorgeous views out on to the Lake. The Chalet has all the amenities, and a lot of care has gone into making sure all the little things have been thought of. The place was clean and well presented. 
Had great communication with David and he helped us arrange the booking. Great value for $$ and would definitely like to stay again one day.

title: Karapiro's Best Luxury Accommodation
text: What a stunning place, from the view, to the gardens and the beautiful decor in the Oarhouse Chalet. It was absolutely immaculate and luxurious, a wonderful place to unwind. The hosts are wonderful too, so friendly and supportive. We can't wait to return. A definite 10/10 from us.

title: North Island Paradise
text:
We stayed in the Paddlehouse for a 9 day stay Dec-Jan (2023-24).

I’m not sure if we got the best of New Zealand weather, but the lush green grounds and the pristine view of Lake Karapiro from our bed and lounge area were nothing short of paradise.

David and Sue were non-intrusive and also super responsive if we needed anything. The perfect hosts in our opinion.

Beds were very comfortable in both rooms, super large plush pillows, good water pressure in the 2 bathrooms, soft linen, all very clean and well maintained. 

The kitchen is a small galley kitchen but has everything you need for managing basic meals or a decent selection of takeaways from the restaurants about 10-15 mins drive away. 

Loved this property. Loved the area and the friendly Kiwis. 

A good central place to stay on the north island if Hobbiton (30mins drive) and Rotorua (1 hour drive) are on your list.

title: Awesome weekend
text: We had a wonderful time at this amazing property. We stayed in the Oarhouse Chalet and the views were beautiful! The grounds and property were immaculate. It is a very attractive looking chalet. The kitchen was well stocked with pots and pans etc. The cycle track started just across the road. We will be back!

title: Excellent accommodation with amazing lake views.
text:
We had booked into the Paddlehouse, but when we arrived we discovered that David and Sue had “upgraded” us to the Oarhouse chalet.  The accommodation is excellent and very spacious, with “million dollar views” of Lake Karepiro.  All of the facilities in the chalet are of a very high standard and it was very comfortable. 
This is such a stunning location and we really enjoyed relaxing on the deck watching the activity on the lake.  We would unreservedly recommend the Oar and Paddle.

title: Absolutely stunning property and location
text: Absolutely exceptional accomodation in a stunning location. David has thought of every amenity you could need to make your stay truly wonderful. The view of the lake is breathtaking at all times of day! The property was immaculately clean and it was just an absolute dream to stay there. We loved every minute and cannot wait to return. Thank you!

title: Amazing!
text: Incredibly satisfying stay. The place is immaculate and with a very nice decor.  The check-in process was smooth and Dave made sure we had everything clear regarding the place and appliances. I highly recommend it.  When road tripping across NZ, it is a great spot to stay at!

title: Holiday perfection
text:
Faultless accommodation and great host. Cannot find one negative thing to say about this property. Our two bedroom house was beautiful and had everything we needed. The owner was very helpful and accommodating whilst giving you all the privacy you could wish for.
I would not hesitate in recommending this stunning property. Book immediately!

title: Perfect place, amazing setting, we'll be back.
text: We only had 2 nights, and a busy time while we were there, but the Oar & Paddle was the perfect place to check in, come back to in the evening and wake up in the morning. The views of Lake Karapiro are amazing and the rooms very comfortable. We will definitely be back!

title: Bliss and relaxation
text: We had a beautiful weekend here and it is definitely a place we would return too. It is nicely appointed and comfortable, with everything you need in the well set up kitchen if you plan to cook. Gorgeous views to wake up to and lovely bathroom and a super comfortable bed. We both agreed we had the best 2 night sleep in months in the bed. The well thought out design of the cottage makes for easy relaxed living here. You can also walk along the path/bike way towards the rowing club and Podium cafe.

title: Magical place
text: This is a magical place stay and perfect for a weekend gateaway from Auckland. The house and the views are magnificent. Its very close to Cambridge which has great cafes and restraurants.  will definitely come back.

title: Beautiful Boutique Accommodation
text: Stunning location and beautifully appointed.  We had 2 nights there as a surprise birthday present for my husband. Quiet and peaceful and a wonderful getaway.  Planning a girls weekend with my sisters later this year. Perfect! Wouldn't hesitate to recommend to anyone

title: Friends Getaway
text: What a perfect choice for a 2 day getaway for rest and recreation! Our hosts David and Sue recognised 2 hard working Mums & nurses by ensuring our stay was memorable. No detail has been spared at Oar & Paddle - ensuring that this is a 'must' destination for any traveller.

title: Stunning, beautifully styled lake view accommodation
text: This is the second time we have stayed at the Oar and Paddle. It is an amazing place. The views of the Lake are stunning and the house is furnished to a high standard and has everything you need. David is a great host. We will be back again for a third time!

title: What a find! Luxury by the lake
text: To celebrate coming out of lockdown I organised a night away with eight friends at the Oar and Paddle. 5 star luxurious accommodation in a stunning setting. Everything is of the highest quality, the rooms are very spacious and the furnishings very comfortable. Would highly recommend staying here - great for groups as the bed configurations are very flexible and all the rooms are very spacious. Can’t wait to visit again!

title: Wedding accomodation
text: Beautiful accomodation and such a hospitable, accomodating owner. The views are incredible and the house is so clean and tidy. Perfect place to get ready for our wedding. Highly recommend and will definitely be returning soon. Thanks.

title: Fantastic quick getaway
text:
We were fortunate enough to win a nights accommodation at the Oarhouse in a charity auction. My, what a spot. We snuck away there ( from Hamilton) for the Sunday night prior to Xmas.

The accommodation is first rate, with great views & an awesome deck for chilling out on. We spent the late afternoon relaxing, having a couple of wines with a platter of nibbles enjoying the peace & quiet. Mint !!!

Would absolutely recommend this place & Dave the host, very friendly & obliging.

Hope to stay there again in the future 👍

title: A very special spot
text: We very fortunately stumbled across this accommodation while planning our short trip to Lake Karipiro for the Christmas rowing regatta. A beautifully appointed Paddle house was our home for two nights and we just wish it had been longer. A stunning view close to the start line and to the Rowing club - it really was so welcoming, comfortable and modern but still sympathetic to its surroundings. Would highly recommend this to anyone.

title: A hidden little paradise
text: If you enjoy a World Class boutique experience, this little piece of heaven is for you.Can not believe I have not read about it before.. The  Rose we enjoyed as we sat looking out on the most serene lake view amongst the manicured lawns and rose filled hedges,will stay with us for a very long time. Tasteful and private, I would recommend this property to anyone who enjoys a luxury boutique experience.

title: Spacious Sculler Suite with two queen beds
text:
We managed to book Sculler Suite for last minute booking. It was worth paying $260 per night for such a quiet, clean spacious suite. 

The house is located on a hillside with beautiful view of Lake Karapiro. It has Oar House (two bedrooms self content house with car porch, living, dining and kitchen), two bedrooms suite with kitchen and living and two queen beds Sculler Suite. 

Our suite has no view but it is very nice accommodation with plenty of space for four of us. There are two queen beds in the Sculler Suite, a mini fridge, tea and coffee making facility. The air cond/heat pump is a plus to the suite. The huge bathroom comes with shower (no bath tub) and the only downside of the suite is the water coming out from the rain shower was not concentrated. Thanks for the heat towel railing! 

David is a very friendly host. We were welcome to move around in the property compound during our stay including the working farm. Podium cafe recommended by David served very good and large portion breakfast. 

Thank you David and Sue for this beautiful suite.

title: Superb Stay
text:
What an amazing short stay we had at this beautifully appointed stylish, comfortable and gorgeous B & B. Truly no words really can capture this gem.  Manicured gardens greeted us as we drove up the driveway, David the owner was there to walk us through the facilities.  What a top bloke he is.
The accommodation was second to none.  Spacious bedrooms all with ensuites, luxurious linen, dreamy beds and views to die for.  The functionality of the living areas were perfect, especially the stand alone cottage with the deck overlooking the lake, opening the area up even more.
We were a family of 8 plus a baby and it was just perfect for us.  It was a family gathering we will all treasure and remember at this beautiful venue.  We do feel very blessed we have had the privilege of staying at the Oar and Paddle.

title: Perfect base for our Waikato retreat with friends.
text: A beautifully appointed property in a peaceful farm setting that accommodated our group of 3 couples perfectly. We all had our own bedroom and ensuite with shared attached communal lounge and kitchen exclusively for our group.  Lovely river walk in front of property, great base for Hobbiton, Sacred Mountain, Waitomo, Cambridge and Hamilton.  David and Sue are excellent hosts, they are there if needed but privacy is discreetly maintained. Thank you.

title: Book to stay TODAY
text: What an amazing place! We felt so at home, left so relaxed but didn’t want to leave. Great for all and absolutely amazing. You will want to try it out, and like us, you will return. Thanks David and Sue.

title: VERY WHANAU FRIENDLY
text: The attention to detail in this home was exquisite - heated flooring, huge gasfire, beautifully balanced fittings and faciilities, luxuriously comfortable furnishings - especially the huge beds - and automated lighting.  Then there's the spacious grounds and the "to die for" view.  We felt welcomed by David and will definitely stay at this lovely home again.

title: Don't hesitate - book it now!!!
text: I stayed here with my mother and my 4 year old over Labour weekend 2018, and we couldn't have loved it more.  The hosts, Sue and David, were incredibly welcoming and that only just eclipsed the view....oh good grief, that view - many hours spent gazing at the lake and all the rowers out practicing!!  The cottage is beautifully styled and appointed, there's nothing we lacked (even plenty of ice for the gin and tonics, brilliant!).  Having a herd of angus cows in the backyard was an added bonus - the 4 year old very taken with them.  We really couldn't have chosen a better place to stay, just stunning from premises to hosts to location - don't hesitate to book this accommodation, you're going to fall in love.

title: Slice of Heaven
text:
We stayed at the Oar and Paddle for 3 nights as a group of 10 (5 couples). David and Sue have created a stylish and peaceful place to stay in this most amazing location on Lake Karapiro. We woke up to picturesque views over the lake, an occasional rower down below us and the sun glistening over the water. A perfect place to explore the surrounding countryside and then return and enjoy a BBQ on the private deck. 

Everything was new and clean, the beds were extremely comfortable and we didn't want to leave.

title: Outstanding accomadation
text:
We were a group of 6 paddlers competing at the Waka Ama National at Lake Karapiro.
Our Hosts Dave & Sue we were wonderful. Nothing was too much trouble.
The accommodation itself was superb, well set up with the most comfortable beds to fall into after a hard days paddling.
Everything was spotlessly clean and well provided. We would definitely stay here again.

title: Absolutely picture perfect
text: Our 3 night stay at the chalet (family of 5) was just magnificent. It’s the perfect location to enjoy the views and serenity of Lake Karapiro and the lush hills of the Waikato region. The detail and quality of the construction of the chalet was much admired by my husband who spent an hour wandering around and marvelling at the workmanship. Luckily the chalet has all the facilities to eat at home as we didn’t want to leave for meals, and an afternoon drink on the deck is unrivalled for relaxation. The comfort of the beds has to be mentioned as all of us felt like it was the best sleep we’d had. And then you pull the curtains in the morning to be delighted by the view! David and Sue were fantastic to deal with - nothing was a problem but every detail was attended to. We hope to return someday as our stay was so memorable.

title: What a View!
text:
What a fab place to stay- we wish we had longer!
We stayed in the Oar & Paddle Suites with some friends, we were lucky enough to have the Oar Suite which has the gorgeous lake Views- I also think the photos/description might be out of date as this room says it has a Queen bed but were were pleasantly surprised with a KING sized bed and it was extremely comfortable!
So definitely pick that room if you can because you get the view AND the King bed.
Our host Dave was fabulous, warm and welcoming, and even brought over a full length mirror and and ironing board as he knew were were going to a wedding that day.
Accommodation was lovely, luxurious, everything you need and more.
Will definitely come back and stay for longer next time!

title: Stunning setting
text:
This is an excellent place to stay with stunning views over Lake Karapiro. The Oar House is amazingly well set up with very comfortable beds and great views from all rooms.
I wish we could have stayed longer.

title: Serenity :)
text: What a lovely clean modern place to stay with beautiful views to top off this location.  David was wonderful to deal with and the beds and bedding were of excellent quality which is important if you want a good nights sleep.  Thank you for providing this fabulous experience to us and will definitely be back :)

title: Small class reunion or girls weekend away a must do!!  Top notch, Highly recommend
text:
We had the pleasure of staying at the Oar house for one night and it was amazing.  There were 6 ladies so we all had a single bed each, 3 beds in each room.  There was plenty of space and each bedroom had an en-suite with beautiful shower facilities.

We had such a lovely time reminiscing and would highly recommend for a girls weekend away.  The facilities are first class, beautiful views, and warm house.  The beds were super comfy and warm.  The place has lots of windows and really makes the most of the beautiful views and sunshine.  Beautiful Escea inbuilt gas fire which you can have running on low for ambiance while you have wine and cheese before dinner.  Lovely cutlery and dishes etc also.  We just can't rate this place highly enough.

The Podium Cafe just down the road does lovely meals and great coffee,  the Boatshed Cafe is across the river and also does lovely meals.  It is not far to town to do some shopping and if you time it right once a month is Market Day in town on a Sunday, so take some time to explore the shops.  For those who like to walk or bike there are some fabulous walks/rides along the river.

title: Very pleaseful stay.
text: We stayed in David and Sue's beautiful place for 2 nights during our short trip away from home. It was a very nice and relaxing ambiance. The place we rented was absolutely spotless and full of all facilities, like dishwashing machine, dryer, and even a perfect barbeque, very useful when you have a young baby! Many thanks to the hosts also a very welcoming fruits and eggs basket :-). We'll be back!

title: Wedding Prep
text: We hired the chalet and one of the extra rooms to get ready in for our wedding. Eight of us stayed. The Chalet and rooms are spacious, Immaculately presented, amazing views, with great lighting for make up and photos. Sue and David are great hosts. Highly recommend. Actually did not want to leave. Felt so relaxed and homely.

title: Awesome Getaway
text: We recently had the pleasure of staying at the Oar & Paddle for two nights.  It was beyond our highest expections.  The view from our Oar Suite was stunning.  It was totally private, spotlessly clean and absolutely perfect for a totally quiet getaway. The grounds were beautifully kept with lots of areas to sit and take in the view.  Our hosts David and Sue were very lovely and full of information about the area.  We will be back.

title: Crisp NZ Oasis
text:
We stayed in David and Sue's beautiful chalet for 2-nights during our Outrigger Canoe National Competition early this year. 2-minutes away from the venue, you could see the event from the chalet, all the right amenities and more, 10-minute drive from the city centre, close enough to get what you needed but far enough to feel like you were out of the thick of it. Nothing short of perfect.

David was an amazing host and made sure our team were welcomed well and knew where everything was and how everything operated. Super friendly. I love the Oar and Paddle and it was such a privilege to have been able to wake up to beautiful pink sunrises and crisp lake waters in this beautiful country I call home.

title: Absolutely perfect
text: Stayed for three nights in January. Gorgeous location. You will need a car to get into town or take a local cab.  It’s only a short drive.  The accommodation is spotless and has fantastic amenities such as a fully fitted kitchen with freezer, dishwasher and washing machine and dryer. Really useful if you are travelling. Very spacious rooms. Amazing views. Friendly hosts. They even let us use the bbq one evening. Really enjoyed our time here. Cambridge is a super place to visit.

title: Amazing views in the middle if nature!
text: We had a wonderfull time in Oar and Paddle!! The views of the lake and the mountains was amazing!the smell of nature and the sounds made us feel so relaxed and disconected. We have everything we needed to cook and have delicious meals with an astonishing view!and we were near Rotorua and Hobbiton movie set! We definetely recommend this place to stay!

title: Amazing Accommodation
text:
We were so very lucky to have chosen the Oar and Paddle as our accommodation over the weekend. Our group was quite large as we gathered for a Wedding in the area. There was plenty of room for everyone and the accommodation is so beautiful, perfectly placed over looking the lovely Lake Karapiro.
David and Sue are fabulous hosts, such great people to deal with.
We would highly recommend this piece of paradise.
Hoping we will return again for another magic weekend.

title: Stunning lake getaway.
text: Beautifully built and furnished, warm and spotlessly clean chalet with magic views of Lake Karapiro, set on a lovely rural property close to Cambridge. Extremely helpful, friendly and accommodating hosts. Highly recommended.

title: a fabulous lakeside weekend with friends
text: We travelled as a group of 6 for a birthday celebration and the Oar and Paddle worked brilliantly using the Chalet and one of the suites. The Chalet was most comfortable, and we utilised the fully functioning kitchen. One of our party used a wheelchair and the property worked well - we did take our own shower chair. David, the owner, was most helpful in the planning and booking of the accommodation and we really appreciated that. A most relaxing place to be, even in the middle of winter and in the rain. Good proximity to Cambridge, cafes and other activities. We all had a great time and look forward to returning to the O&P for another weekend.

title: Wedding preparations
text: David and Sue are lovely to deal with and will ensure that you are well looked after during your stay. Myself and my bridal party stayed at the property the night before my wedding and got ready there the day of. The views from the property are spectacular and each room has a really beautiful feel to it. Staying in the chalet was a real highlight and it was such a beautiful place to gather with family and friends. My photographer was able to capture all of the amazing moments in the build up to my wedding ceremony with the beautiful Lake Karapiro as our backdrop. Staying at the property added another very special element to what was an incredible day. I would highly recommend this property for either a special occasion or simply a relaxing and peaceful getaway - it is stunning!

title: Perfect Weekend Getaway
text:
This place is amazing.  My partner and I and his parents came down to Cambridge so we could do the Lake Karapiro Glow Worm Kayaking trip.  Stayed in the Oar House.  It was fantastic.  Warm, clean, comfortable with an amazing view.  

The owner David is extremely friendly and couldn't be more helpful and accomodating with our needs.  We highly recommend this to anyone traveling in he area.  You won't be disappointed.  

We will be back.

title: Just Stunning
text: A stunning property overlooking Lake Karapiro. A brilliant location to enjoy with good friends. The Oar House contains a wonderful open plan area for entertaining and the Oar and Paddle provides separate luxury accomodation.

title: Contest winner my wife took me and our daughtet
text: Delicious food with fast and friendly service. I had the southern fried chicken and my wife had the burger and onion rings. I will be back to try the more option on the menu. Also they had an excellent assortment of different beers on the menu.

title: Gorgeous slice of paradise
text: I stayed for a Saturday night break from Auckland and David was the perfect host. The Oar Suite is definitely the one to book for a solo traveller or couple - the view over the lake is stunning! Will definitely be back.

title: Paradise !
text: Had the pleasure of spending 3 nights in this wonderful establishment in this glorious part of New Zealand. Sitting above the picturesque Lake Karapiro just 10 mins from the Cambridge town centre, The oar and Paddle has everything you need for a relaxing holiday away from the city, but with plenty of facilities within a short drive. The rooms are beautifully appointed with all mod cons including a compact kitchen/laundry, stylish living/dining area with quality TV (apple and WI FI ), very comfortable beds and best of all, an amazing view from all windows. Add to that a super friendly and helpful host, and an adorable Jessie, the canine visitor, I reckon you have the best place to stay in the area. Hopefully will be back again soon, perhaps at the larger new villa , just completed next door.  In a word,  brilliant.!

title: Relaxing with a wonderful view.
text: I stayed at the Oar and Paddle with my mother and son in early January. The views are stunning and the quality and comfort of the place are second to none. We were able to use the Oar and Paddle as a base for visiting Hobbiton (The Hobbit/Lord of the Rings film set), the lovely town of Cambridge and to shop in Hamilton. We would very much like to return when we are next in New Zealand.

title: Peaceful and Luxurious
text: This cottage, which adjoins the owner's beautiful home is located 10 mins from Cambridge on Lake Karapiro.  Very spacious and modern with lovely bed linens and walk in shower.  There is also a large tv with Sky access.  The back of the cottage has french doors that open up onto a patio and large lawn area with a beautiful view of the lake,  Sue, our host, brought us a lovely bowl of plums, tomatoes and limes from their garden.

title: A quiet and beautiful spot
text: We recently stayed there for 2 nights. The host was friendly and helpful. His house is definitely very nice. Full kitchen, washing machine, dryer, everything we need is there. We had a very good stay.

title: Stunning....
text: Really well designed modern luxury accommodation.  The views are to die for - right on the stunning Lake Karapiro.   We stayed for two night and loved the well thought out design place.  There are two bedrooms - perfect if you have friends with with - but the other bedroom is locked off so you can have the lounge kitchen to your self - ie they only rent out one bedroom at a time if you are not traveling with friends - so you are assured privacy - which indeed it is.  Lovely lounge - comfy sofa and brand new TV set up.  Very friendly and helpful hosts.  But take your earplugs if the sound of a rooster crowing at night and in the morning bothers you - but you are are in the country!  The only thing I would say think for the money you spend there should be daily servicing and replacing of the towels and a few little 'extra touches' - I'm comparing this to other places we have stayed out for similar money or less.

title: Great Spot
text: A great spot just outside of Cambridge. Great views of the Lake, thick curtains means you can have that sleep in, very comfortable. Relaxing. Dave, the owner also gave us some plums of the trees, they were fantastic. The only improvement would be a queen bed instead of a double, but that's not a complaint in anyway. Would recommend and stay again.

title: Fabulous
text:
What a great spot for a getaway weekend. Stunning views of the lake. The accommodation is perfect with everything you need on hand. Very spacious, clean and modern. 
Great spot for exploring Maungatautari mountain, with its awesome bush walks. Highly recommend. Thanks for a great stay David !

title: Stunning views
text:
Superb two bedroom self-contained accommodation overlooking Lake Arapuni, sliding doors open fully all round this property to give a lovely airy environment in summer.  Huge TV, sky included. Great location for Cambridge, and surrounding lakes.
By the time next summer arrives, the brand new Waikato River trail cycle path should be complete and passes in front of this property.

title: Lovely stay
text:
We really enjoyed our stay here, the whole house was comfy, lots of nice small detail made it really homely. 

A nice area to take a walk and enjoy all the animals near by in the local fields! 
Lovely breakfast and friendly host.

title: Perfect in every way
text:
Booked for only one night (regretfully) due to Hamilton being booked out for a conference.
What a find!! A most beautiful property, immaculately presented, spotlessly clean and dripping with quality.
Mike made me feel very welcome and was a great host. The bonus of a continental breakfast was marvellous.
Only 15-20vminutes from Hamilton means this will be my go to accomodation.
I cannot commend Angus Road Barn highly enough.

title: Quiet country getaway in comfort.
text:
My sister and I found this place and enjoyed one night in the 2 bedroom barn style unit here which was very modern. The rural outlook was great with paddocks that had different coloured sheep in them and one horse.
The owner Mike was very friendly and chatty and brought us a full continental breakfast at no extra cost. We had everything that we needed there.

title: Stunning cottage B & B in the countryside
text: This is a hidden gem! The cottage is beautifully set up, owners are really lovely and the rural setting just delightful. Located between Cambridge and Hamilton near Mystery Creek this was a wonderful two night stay. Breakfast is included.

title: Awesome little B & B cabin in a great location
text: This was one of those real gem finds. The cabin is next to the owners house but quite separate and private. It is beautifully set up - comfortable and with great amenities. The location is between Cambridge and Hamilton in a lovely rural setting and is nice and quiet. The owners are just delightful and delivered a really nice breakfast each morning.

title: Excellent value for money, done up, with new management
text:
I must admit, I was in some trepidation, as while the reviews more recently are very good, the ones from not so long ago are frightful.  I noted, however, that the place was under new management, and seemed to have turned a corner.

  I can now state, emphatically, that they have, and they provide excellent value for money.  There are very few places in this country, where you can get a king-size bed, and an ensuite, AND a modest breakfast (weetbix, cornflakes, rice bubbles, or porridge, with toast and spreads), for $126.00

  Yes, the toilet and shower are very cramped.  Yes, there are a few reminders of the hostel type accommodation it once was, here and there.  But it has been economically done up, the mattresses are new, the staff are kind, and it is very clean.

  It is on a busy road, so I would recommend you get rooms at the back, as my family and I did.  We booked two rooms - a king room, plus a queen room, and it was nice and quiet there.  It even had air conditioning, which I did not expect at such a low price.

  When talking briefly with fellow guests at breakfast, they too were pleasantly surprised at the level of comfort, considering the modest price charged, and commented on the cleanliness and excellent pricing of the motel.   Hopefully no-one expects luxury for such a low cost, but it is comfortable, clean, and - at the back - quiet, too.

title: Surprisingly perfect
text:
Highly recommend this motel. I received a warm, friendly welcome on arrival. The room was very clean and had everything I needed — fridge, kettle with tea/coffee/milk, extra pillows and blankets, and air-conditioning/heating. Secure locks added peace of mind.

The shared bathroom was absolutely spotless, with plenty of fresh towels and no mould anywhere. The shared kitchen and dining area were also extremely clean.

Complimentary breakfast was available before 9:30, including cereals, toast, and tea/coffee.

A great, comfortable stay — would definitely return.

title: Cosy and Nice
text: The rooms are modern, well  updated , and cozy just the right size for our one night stay in the Executive  King Room perfect.

title: Perfect break away
text: The rooms were clean, and tidy. Beds are comfy and decent pillows. Great kitchen facilities with a nice balcony to sit on and enjoy the local atmosphere. The new owners are very hospitable. Good amount of off road parking. Lovely cafe near by and a beautiful Thai restaurant next door. Convenient to walk into town or head to the local Saturday markets

title: Don’t do it to yourself
text:
Basic rooms, barely comfortable bed, un ventilated ensuite, check in staff ‘cold’ and clinical. Had no sleep due to loud noise in walls and when I complained of no sleep to manager in the morning he  didn’t really care and I think he knew of the noise ( air conditioning pipes he said??) and still gave me the key…. No wonder he was as he was at check in. 
Don’t do it to yourself!!!!

title: More boarding house or hostel than motel
text:
We did not feel overly safe here and suspect this may be used for emergency housing as well as paying guests which is far from ideal.
The room was fairly clean but very basic, felt a little like a prison cell and was in need of some maintenance. The staff we dealt with were pleasant, however I would not stay here again and would not recommend for families. 
I would not call this a motel at all, more of a hostel with shared facilities or a boarding house.

title: BED BUGS!
text:
BED BUGS! We booked 2 rooms. About midnight my travel companion staying in another room woke up to find bed bugs crawling all over her and through the bed, bitten everywhere.
She came and woke me and we then found one bug in my room too. The bugs in her bed ranged from tiny flea sized to big one the size of a pea.
We woke up the owners who offered us another room but we decided we wouldn't be able to sleep without worrying about them climbing all over us so told them we would be leaving, and we drove all the way home (4.5 hour trip) arriving about 5am. They did give us a refund thankfully... but would avoid altogether in future.

title: NOT A MOTEL
text:
This is not a motel, this is a dormitory/hostel type of accommodation that is on the second level. Not ideal for elderly people (there was at least three elderly couples who I saw when I stayed, who thought it was a motel too). There is a lift but still!

A family member booked our accommodation not realising that the room booked was for just a room with a shared bathroom. 

We paid $109 for just a room (queen and single), yes we had a TV, kettle and the usual tea/coffee amenities but no bathroom in our room.

Definitely not what I would call a motel.

title: Not a Motel
text: The Motel is not what I would call a motel more like a Hostel or a Backpackers, not all rooms have their own bathroom there are shared bathrooms and a community kitchen and tables and chairs on a balconey. Our room had an ensuite as we paid extra for it, the room was clean thanks to housekeeping and the bed was comfortable and the shower had good water pressure. Carparking was tight especially as some people dont know how to fit into their own car park bay. There was no sign of recycling. Check in was pleasant and friendly but the biggest disappointment was the noise as walls are thin and other guests walking down the hallway are inconsiderate and loud. We booked 2 nights but left after one as it was too noisey and there was not much privacy  Dont stay in room 10 as your window looks out onto the kitchen balaconey and you need to keep your blind shut to experience privacy also room 10 shares its wall with the community kitchen which is loud. Location id good so that is worth 5 stars but overall its a 3 for us. Its probaly okay for a 1 night stay but dont expect too much there are other places to stay in town for more money. We wouldnt stay here again or reccommend i.

title: Terrible! Don’t do it! Unless you like flea pits and incredibly rude staff.
text: This place is not up to standard. On arrival, I was told to go upstairs. The communal areas have a terrrible aroma and carpets are filthy. I’ve actually stayed in better hostels. It seems that this place might also be used for emergency housing. It was hectic, dark and very sketchy. The manager refused to give me my money back for me to cancel and did not accept that I was cancelling due to the poor standard and not because I had found elsewhere. They are very dishonest and couldn’t even take the call from Expedia in front of me and instead had to disappear to speak to them. Very unprofessional people. When, I said that he had the opportunity to do the right thing and agree to a refund, he flatly refused and said he didn’t care if he got a bad review. Never come across such arrogance. Even if they were giving the rooms away free, i wouldn’t recommend staying there.

title: Comfortable & Clean
text: Stopped for the one night while passing through Cambridge. It was not expensive, handy on main road & free parking out the back. Wasn't 5 star but clean shared bathroom & beds comfortable. Suited us well for a stopover sleep. Would stay there again.

title: Budget motel walking distance to town
text:
Booked at last minute, budget hotel with no frills. Was initially worried about the location  on the main road but my room was at the rear of the property and was quiet.
Room was a bit depressing as the window was tiny but it was warm and clean.
Walking distance to town and right opposite Good George pub which was handy.
Off street parking around the back and takeaways and cafes on the door step.

title: Confused organising
text:
I had organised a large group to stay here, booked well in advance when there were more than enough rooms to accommodate all our requirements. Not sure how, but suspect they were not monitoring the online bookings against the direct, we turned up on a very busy weekend to find they had  completely mucked up our booking and given our room away. We accept mistakes can happen! But, there was no apology or any effort at all to try and repatriate us to another motel

Hopeless!

title: This is not a motel but more a hostel
text: This should really not be called a motel.   It is more like a hostel and it is too expensive for what is offered.  Only positive thing I can say is the location.  The rooms are poorly decorated,  There is a huge communal kitchen,  but I hardly dared to touch something.    I would never ever go here again.  I mentioned the price already, and to be honest, it was one of the cheaper options for Cambridge,  but I paid $118 dollar a night,  and this was not worth it.   It it would have been a budget motel studio, it would have been ok,  but as it was actually just a room with no real comfortable chairs or other facilities, it was way over prized.  No, I dont recommend this place.

title: Cheap place to stay
text:
Came to Cambridge last minute, and chose here because it was close to the Good George bar that we'd seen and wanted to try out.

Our double en suite was clean, which was a highlight, but the room was dingy, and the mattress on the bed had certainly seen better days. We didn't dare look under the bottom sheet, for example. It's also one of those places where you have to lock the door behind you as it isn't automatic.

Common areas were aged and carpeting in need of replacement.

Front desk tried to overcharge us for the room. We'd looked online and it was $100 for the night but when it came to pay, the rate was $110. We showed the manager our online pricing and they agreed, blaming the mistake on her husband updating the computer without telling her.

Wouldn't go back, even at their rates. You get what you pay for.

title: Avoid avoid avoid!
text: To be fair we booked in a hurry and did not do enough research on TripAdvisor but this is not a motel. At best it rises to a guesthouse in very poor repair: bathroom had multiple issues including soap scum rising through the drain the floor and a scary (for children) shower screen that slammed shut. No aircon in our room. Only 1 tiny shower between two rooms. Never had a motel that gives no tissues or shower cap. No plates. 1 spoon and need for a communal kitchen. Fire station siren was right outside window. Don’t bother coming here.

title: Read the fine print, use of the name motel is misrepresentation galore
text:
We booked this place online and paid around  $250 for something called a studio 2 bedroom unit motel for our family.This motel was listed alongside and at the same price as other motels with two bedroom units which contain a kitchenette / tea and coffee making facilities, a small lounge and, importantly two bedrooms.  What we got was two small interconnected hotel-style rooms, one tiny shower and toilet, a tiny kettle, two cups (for five people), one teaspoon and one glass.  Anything more than drinks for three people required us to use the shared kitchen, which is something of the like only normally seen in a hostel, a camping ground, or a guesthouse complete with the fatty smell. On seeing my surprise that we didn’t in fact have a two bedroom unit like what would normally be expected when booking a motel, and the tiny en suite-like shower in one of the rooms, the host pointed me to the his and hers communal bathrooms down the corridor, which he suggested my eight year old twin daughters and ten year old son could use if there wasn’t enough room in ours!!!  

This place should not be able to be called a motel as it is more akin to a guesthouse.  Whilst sharing facilities is great for those getting cheap rooms, I don’t consider we got a cheap room and this is not what you expect to have to do with a two bedroom motel unit.

We clearly didn’t spend enough time looking at the details as we were in a hurry to book.  Maybe the one thing the owners of this motel have truly done for us is to encourage us to check further before booking any accommodation in future.  Sadly, as a New Zealander, this is not the way things once were in my beautiful country. 

As we sat in our room, seething, we went back to check the pictures on the site we booked from.  The picture of the tree-shaded front of the building doesn’t show the sign on the side which says, in peeling paint “rooms from $79”.  The pictures of the rooms looked big, light and spacious, neither of which they are in reality.  

My observation is that the owners of this establishment are aware of the true quality level of their offering, and that they use a sophistry-based approach with the information they provide consumers ahead on of time on it. On further perusal of their website, under the nice shaded photo of the front of the building, they claim it is “motel / hotel” accommodation, that there is “free tea, coffee and toast”. There are also “executive beds”, “air-conditioning”, and there are “two bedroom studio units”.  Further down their homepage, possibly because they have had trouble with complaints in the past, they however, include a customer quote which refers to a communal kitchen.  For the reasons stated above, it is not motel or hotel accommodation, and is more akin to a guesthouse. Clever use of the word studio aside, it is not a two bedroom unit.  Juxtaposition of two bedroom unit with motel is plainly misleading.  We had no air-conditioning, and regardless of wording buried further down the page, tea, coffee and toast facilities in a motel are usually available in your room and require the provision of enough cups and teaspoons so they can be consumed all at once.  Toast also requires provision plates and knives.  I recommend the owners of this establishment familiarise themselves with the provisions of the Fair Trading Act.

A few other things to note for the owners from a maintenance side are as follows.  The pipe under the shower is clearly blocked as foam came out through the (broken) overflow grate in the floor (the picture below is of the impact of one shower alone.  The foam coming out of the floor was much more immense the night before). The door in the kids’ room was also broken. There was only one eighties-style heated towel rail for all five of us.  As far as we can tell the other three towels needed to hang above the beds in the other room on broken hooks.  The ceiling vent in the bathroom clearly hasn’t seen a clean for while.  I haven’t seen a plastic shower screen like the one on the shower since the  eighties either, and it’s snapping closed action nearly frightened my eight year olds out of their skins. There are also advice on the wall of the bathroom that the hot water can take up to two minutes to start - good grief!!!!

Finally, if you want to use your caster to cast onto the tv don’t bother, and watch out if you have small kids.  There are second floor windows, which you will be driven to open in your un-air-conditioned room (if reading the other comments you aren’t  fortunate enough to have got one of the few air-conditioned rooms).  The one at the front which opens out over a small piece of un-railed roofing has no brackets limiting its opening aperture and kids could climb right out of it and fall off the roof.  A huge health and safety nightmare which I would not think passed any safety inspection.

Oh, the good things about the place, as I need to be balanced. The “executive” beds were quite comfortable with quality towels (although there was nowhere for most of us to hang them) and sheets.

Sadly though, we won’t be returning again to resample them. For anyone else looking for a good budget place to stay? I would recommend they read the fine print, are sure that what they want is a guesthouse, and only pay budget rates. The $79 from the side of the building would be, I think, quite reasonable.

title: Basic & handy to town
text: I stayed as part of a group while in Cambridge for the Tissot UCI Track Cycling World Cup.  The rooms were basic with a bed, small fridge and ensuite bathroom.  There was a shared kitchen and a basic breakfast was provided in this Kitchen.  Some rooms had air-con - others had an opening window and fan.   Laundry facilities were available out the back.  Off street parking was available however you could not always find a park there. Location was easy walking distance to town and the supermarket.  It can be noisy at times.  Room was serviced daily.  Staff were very friendly and helpful.  Overall a good budget option.

title: Budget place to stay with more positives than negatives
text: I have stayed here a couple of times with sports groups. All our rooms had ensuites which were small but serviceable, take note that some rooms have shared facilities so if you see someone in the corridors wearing a towel, that will be why, so book with care! Some rooms have AC units but not all, so perhaps ask when booking if you are not a fan of the heat. It's right in town and seconds to cafes, fish and chips, a Thai restaurant, BP, and only a few minutes to McDonalds, more cafes and the supermarket. There is a shared kitchen/dining room which has a light breakfast available free and is good for preparing meals. The laundry and washing line are around the back if you are looking for them. As with any place right in town there can be road noise or noisy people in other rooms. For someone wanting to be right in town or on a budget this place still has more positives than negatives and I'd be happy to return.

title: the community dining and kitchen area as well as the other people staying in the motel at the time loved sharing the are
text: The parking area was a shared area with the shops that operated beneath and below the motel all the rooms were upstairs and sometimes there were no parking spaces  available, the staff were very helpful and friendly

title: Revolting
text: As soon as we saw this place we knew it was a mistake but by then it was too late. Sits right on the main road. Do not be fooled by pictures on the internet. Room was smaller than it looked. One small window that didnt open. Sliding door into shower room and toilet, which wasnt nice at all (see pics). Stained cover on bed and the whole place looked like it needed a good scrub down. To sum it up Yeuch!!!!!  To be avoided.

title: Would Stay Again
text:
Stayed last Thursday night, stopover to break the trip from Hawkes Bay to Auckland. Great value for price paid, $115 included basic breakfast. There is a communal kitchen, not usual in a motel. Balcony out from kitchen with 4 tables overlooking main street, nice to talk to other guests, couple from Australia traveling to South Island, truck driver stopping over for early morning start. Situated right in town, walking distance to supermarket, restaurants etc. Thai restaurant in the complex. A previous reviewer mentioned no air-conditioning, there is a pedestal fan supplied, we managed fine on a very warm night. 
Would most definitely stay again. Suggestion, book directly with motel.

title: No 1
text: You should forget about the "." In the name "No.1 motels". Read it as "no one" should stay here. The no's include no AC, no quiet, no good restaurants near by, no comfortable beds. I cannot recommend the No one motels on Victoria.

title: A good experience in central Cambridge
text:
No. 1 Motels is in central Cambridge. Close to food store, restaurants and shopping. Lady back and friendly staff. Reasonable price, we payed about 60€ for a double room with toilet and shower.

Our room was big. Nice bed. Room had a fridge and coffee/tea making amenities. Some noise from the street.

Big and well-equipped common kitchen. They also offered a basic free breakfast. Table and chairs both indoors and on the terrace.

I can recommend this motel.

title: Rude owners
text: Didn’t actually stay here but definitely wouldn’t after speaking to the manager on the phone. Called about 8:45pm (15 minutes before reception was due to close) to see if there was a room available as we were tired and 5 minutes away from Cambridge. Phone was answered by the rudest manager I have have ever dealt with. Told me he was in the shower and what time did I think this was to call! I see I’m not the only one who has experienced this so I’d say they’re definitely in the wrong game!!

title: Pleasant room
text: Decent room in Cambridge for a reasonable price but the room was above a restaurant which proved to be quite noisy at the weekend. Wi-Fi was a little annoying as it limits how much data you can use each day for “free”.

title: Clean and handy to services
text: Stayed a night and was happy enough. Had the tiniest ensuite i have ever seen but servicable. It was well placed to walk for food and coffee but parking was dreadful so just as well. Very few carparks and squashed into the parking space at variable angles. Unfortunately the rooms were not soundproofed and I found the socialising of other guests a bit too noisy for sleep and this went on until after midnight. Reception not covered after 8.30pm and no phone in the room. All managable though and the noise was happy  not frightening.  I would stay there again if I needed to stay inCambridge but given that I can stay in a central Hamilton hotel with breakfast provided for the same price $110, I would need to consider the importance of staying in Cambridge with Hamilton only 15 minutes or so up the road.

title: Great town, good rate but avoid sleeping over the noisy Fish and Chip shop
text:
The place is clean and spacious with a fridge and kettle in the room. Although, there is also a well equipped large shared kitchen and dining room. Some rooms are en-suite, others have shared facilities. 

Our original room was over the fish and chip place downstairs. However, due to a noisy extractor fan (which the shop refuses to attend too,) we were moved. (Because audio torture isn't compatible with a good night sleep, after a long drive and an early start the next day!) This seems to be an ongoing thing between the businesses, as the motel was well aware of the issue when they gave us the room. If your unlucky enough to get stuck with it, we were told the fan gets turned off around 10pmish.

Good location within what feels like a small English town. Food, drink and shops close by. Also handy for Hamilton and its tourist attractions.

The siren noise people have mentioned is used to assemble the fire volunteers, in the instance of a fire.

title: Great value for money
text: We stopped just one night - so easy to get in and out of on our way back to Auckland airport.  Large, clean room; I think you need to specify the room type you want, given some earlier TA reviews.  The communal kitchen is great for making (free) breakfast and preparing snacks.  Good off street parking and take-aways and supermarkets all within a 5 minute walk.  Would stay again when next we have to get to or from the airport.

title: Room okay, smell awful
text:
I stayed three nights. The room was clean, the bed was comfortable. However I was not aware that I had booked a room without a bathroom. So there was a common bathroom for some rooms. The shower was clean and okay to use.
But most unpleasant was the smell in the room at night and in the morning. There was a restaurants kitchen underneath the room’s window which was producing gas at night and a bacon-eggs-toast smell really early in the morning. Because the room was heating up a lot during the day, it was not possible to sleep without open window (which could only be opened a 10cm gap, so not a lot of fresh air came through). Opposite of the Motel was an other restaurant whose fans were running all night... luckily I am able to sleep with ear plugs. 
Hot, nasty smelling air and a lot of noise during the night - not worth the money in my eyes.

title: Break the joirney in Cambridge
text:
Well worth  stopping in Cambridge on the journey North
Beautiful town and architecture from.art Dec era
Antique ahops to peruse
Lake Karapiro to enjoy
And fabulpus eateries

Accommodation is very central and convenient

Stairs only to the upper rooms so access .ight be challenging for some
Plenty of off road parking

Communal breakfast room for complimentary self seve breakfast is a bonus.

title: Good location, clean, friendly, quiete
text: Centrally located in Cambridge within walking distance to all restaurants etc. Room had all you would real ably expect, including kettle, good shower, comfy bed. Window not extra large, but sufficient. Great shared balcony and kitchen. Self service breakfast (tea, toast, butter, jam, cereals provided by motel).

title: Traveller's overnight stay
text: This is an ideal place for a traveller's vernight stay in Cambridge. Central, good parking, clean, comfortable bed, all required amenities including good, free internet, plus excellent kitchen, seating areas and bonus breakfast supplies in the morning. Jarrod was efficient. Easy key drop on the way out. Very good price. I was happy and would readily stay again in similar circumstances.

title: Central, convenient, economical
text: More like a hostel really, with some shared facilities. Range of accommodation types offered. Clean and  well maintained, with friendly reception and service. Right in town, but noise not an issue. Used by groups such as for sports or weddings.

title: Better then expected
text: Great central location with walking distance to all eateries. Nice clean rooms with great Wi-Fi. Love the big communal kitchen with complimentary continental breakfast. Has everything you need long or short stay. Would happily stay again as the price is great.

title: Clean, convenient, friendly, & inexpensive
text: A perfect place to stop while traveling with my wife and 20 year old son. We rented a two bedroom with private bath. The price was great and the free communal kitchen was helpful. Contrary to other reviews, the innkeeper was outgoing and helpful. There is a decent Thai restaurant outside the door and a brewpub across the street. Check out the weekly market about 3 blocks away on a cricket field.

title: great motel,
text: great motel, central to shops, great hosts, very friendly, great prices, and love the shared kitchen, it is huge and i have met lots of lovely people there, I stay at this motel on a regular basis if i am visiting cambridge

title: Great place to stay
text:
