Went to Cambridge for a wedding at the Town Hall in Cambridge - locality was perfect.
Staff very friendly & helpful.  Price was amazing - $115 - I had a suite which consisted of a double bed & also a single bed.  Tea & Coffee making facilities & cookies in the room - also air conditioning.. Good sized TV & WIFI (not that I used it but was there for anyone that does).
Everything was spotlessly clean, bed very comfortable & linen & bed covers very nice & fresh.
There is a dining room with a deck (all on the 1st floor)  There are free cereals, bread & butter & jam etc for toast in the morning.  When I went there, a group were cooking bacon & eggs etc - all the facilities are there to do just that - amazing.
My daughter in law realized a few hours later that she had lost her diamond earring - she phone the Motel & a staff member went immediately to the room they were in & found her earring on the bathroom floor - a huge relief to her when we picked it up on our way out of town. A great place to stay - close to shops, cafe's etc - I highly recommend it.

title: No air con, one small window, rude management
text: I would not recomend staying here for many reasons, the rooms have no aircon, one small window, fire station siren just outside and goes off alot, manager makes everyone go to bed at midnight, feels like a prison.

title: Excellent place for large groups
text:
No 1 motel is a well kept, clean and tidy no frills accommodation.  There is a clean and well resourced shared kitchen, which is almost like a commercial/marae kitchen.  It's large and has a lot of space for around 20 to sit and eat.  It has a dishwasher and plenty of plates/cups for around 20 too.  Simple breakfast cereals, bread for toast and hot drinks (tea/coffee/sugar) are available, PLUS a fridge with condiments like mayo, butter, aioli etc for guests to use.

Great place to stay.

title: Excellent place to stay
text: Lots of amenities in our clean,spacious room, the bed/ bath linen had an expensive feel about them. A huge  communal kitchen  with lots of complimentary breakfast food, and the dining area  overlooked the courtyard...very relaxing. Easy walking distance to all the shops and cafes. Thoroughly recommend it !

title: Great find
text:
Driving through not knowing the town we came across the Motel, it was a great find check in was easy and pleasant, room was good size clean and quite, even though there were a couple of families with small children running around.
facilities in the room were good with the added bonus of a free breakfast of toast and cereals and as much tea and coffee as you require, the large guests kitchen room had all the facilities to make your own full breakfast / meal all you had to do was supply your own items.
the motel was in a great location only a few minutes walk to the town centre a large supermarket was only a few minutes away and there was a lovely lake across the road and a couple of minutes walk away for your early morning stroll, in all we had a very pleasant stay and would certainly stay again

title: Great Value, Great Location
text: We stayed here for 2 nights while visiting family in Cambridge.  We often have problems finding accommodation in Cambridge and this was a great find.  This is a "No frills" motel but we were pleasantly surprised.  It is very clean and comfortable.  Manager very helpful and other staff very friendly.  Great communal kitchen with plenty of space and we'll equipped.  Nice to see basic breakfast items as well as a selection of basic condiments.  Great location, just a few steps to cafe and a short walk into town. Will stay here again next time we visit Cambridge

title: Good Value, Good Vibe.....
text: Great location in Cambridge. We noted the differences at this hotel. It started with checkin and the warm greeting from the owner, a former professional cyclist with his many cyclist bibs behind the counter.  Then we came to the room - comfortable bed, a towel warmer, wonderful shower and all those little goodies left for us to use. The place had laundry facilities, restaurant, SKY TV, a conference room and studio suites. Then there was a well stocked kitchen to use and self service breakfast included beverages, pastries, cereal and fruit. Not bad; good value, good vibe....

title: Great Value. Great Neighborhood!
text:
Drove down from Auckland to position ourselves to go to Hobbiton. I knew we'd be arriving after dark and I was worried Cambridge would be dark and this place sketchy. The other reviewers, however, didn't let me down tho! It's a classic older accommodation surrounded by antique shops and other retail nearby. The rooms are plain and clean and exactly all you need. We'd def stay again. And we loved the neighborhood, free parking and free wifi.

I like my night photo better than the one on their listing.

title: Clean and affordable
text:
I booked a room for a work colleague that was down in Cambridge for a meeting. The room was clean and the size was ok. Bathroom was also clean and well presented. The staff were efficient and helpful. The price was very affordable and location is very good. Do ask for a room towards the back as the front rooms do look out on to a busy road. 

Very good value for money.

title: Very unhelpful.
text: On route from Auckland to Cambridge l phoned to book a room. I was greeted at the other end of the phone by a very unfriendly, miserable man who replied to my request for a room with " we are closing up now & hung up !!! " This was at 9.15pm on a Thursday night.... The website states they close at 10pm. This guy is in the wrong job.

title: One nighter
text: Husband and i stayed for a night clean room small bathroom but fine for2 people,free continental breakfast in large lounge kitchen especially for guests and very clean and tidy,close to all amenties in cambridge, only problem i had was dealing with grumpy manager over wi fi not connecting.

title: Perfect if just wanting somewhere to sleep
text: Great if just using the place for 8 hours sleep. Very small rooms but clean and comfy. Fantastic shower pressure , no hair dryer thou.  Wouldn't recommend if needing space to move around. Suited us thou as we were only using it for sleeping while attending a competition.

title: A lovely place to stay
text: We recently travelled through Cambridge, and stopped-over here at the No.1 Motels on Victoria.   What a lovely room and comfy night we had staying there!  We'd arrived quite late - after 7pm, on a Monday.  Our room was very clean & comfy and although the road outside was a Highway,  we were not bothered by traffic noise at all.  Nice & quiet.  There was a very sited communal kitchen for guests to use, so we enjoyed our muesli & toast and chatted to other guests.  Very lovely stay.

title: Average
text: Stayed here for 1 night. It's ok but room could do with an aircon. We did have an electrical fan which helped. Overall, it's very basic, clean and suitable for those who are not fussy about presentation and quality. Great location tho!

title: worth an overnight
text: This place is a bit odd. It’s not a top of the line luxury unit (places with names like number one rarely are), but it is on the main road, quiet, safe, clean, comfortable, handy to the town (such as it is), and the amenities are just fine. Unlike most motels there are no facilities in the room other than a hot water jug, cups and a small fridge. But there a large kitchen, with some bread, spreads, milk, and jams provided. Make your own and tidy up after yourself (the sign says so). The sun streams into the eating area and the kitchen could handle large parties. We suspect that it caters for school parties and sporting groups coming to the town to use the Olympic standard velodrome and rowing facilities. The wifi is free and works well. On checking it we were told that our room was upstairs at the far end of the corridor. Was there access from outside, I asked thinking that parking right outside a room is common in motels, and even when one is upstairs there is usually a flight of stairs. No, the receptionist said, there isn’t. “This is just the way it is,” she added with more than a hint of smirk. She also didn’t mention the shared kitchen facilities, or that there was a lift in reception (its location not being obvious), but she did direct us to a good restaurant. Those matters aside, this is a good spot, reasonably priced, clean and seemingly well run.

title: Interesting motel
text: Good basic hotel type room, king bed, fridge, hot drink facilities, en-suite. The room was clean and tidy with little noise. There is shared dining facilities and a deck with table and chairs, we chose to eat out.

title: Exceeded My expectations, just like a 4 star
text: Very friendly welcoming at the reception (free upgrading of our room), free parking, free - unlimited - fast (!!!) wifi, bathroom included in the room, common very well equipped kitchen area With different herbs, oil, cereaels, and things For breakfast. Has a quiet streetview. Very well equipped room: Water boiler with coffee/ tea / cookies in the room, program caralogues, extra towels. just like in a  four star :) Tidy, net, just loved that hotel!!! They pay attention to small details :) nice touch ! And also Was a very reasonable price For 70 bucks!

title: Business visit
text: Ok. Stayed for one night. I found that I had to wait for a while when I rang the bell at reception. Room was average, king bed with a single as well. TV, coffee making facilities and fridge. NO TABLE TO EAT AT. Personally I found the bed to hard, didn't have a good sleep, and also had traffic noise. I'm not saying don't stay as you need to make your own choices.

title: Perfect for  a one nighter
text:
This place was ideal for a one night stopover and you get what you pay for.

There was a choice of accommodation with en-suite or shared bathroom. 

We stayed in an upstairs queen room with en-suite bathroom located to the back of the motel. The room was very clean. Room amenities included TV, tea and coffee making and heat pump. 

The en-suite bathroom was small. Soap and shampoo provided.

There was a communal kitchen with adequate cooking facilities and a dining area with a number of tables and chairs. 

Bread, tea and coffee and two types of breakfast cereals were on offer for guests and included in the room rate. This set up would be well suited for travelling teams.

Conveniently located close to supermarket and fast food outlets, and a short walking distance to the town centre. 

Free WIFI available.

Reception friendly and efficient.

Good clean basic and comfortable accommodation.  Great for a one night stopover.

title: Excellent value for money
text:
A nice greeting and quick check in.

 A basic room but all we needed at an extremely good price.

Bed was clean and comfortable with good pillows, bathroom was small but excellent with strong water pressure and plenty of hot water.

The large shared dining room was excellent with breakfast food available, plenty of tea/coffee, large fridges and good seating.

title: Bit of a surprise
text: We stayed here with friends and found the reception staff very helpful and friendly - and sometimes difficult to locate.  We only had studio rooms which were a bit basic but clean and warm - and were most impressed with the common dining area which compensated for the lack of a table in our room - and were than pleasantly surprised to find that it was stocked with basic food supplies for guests.

title: TALK ABOUT VALUE FOR MONEY FOLKS
text:
We had a one night stop at No 1 Motels and exceeded our expectations. Yes, it is basic but also is well equipped, clean and tidy with a comfortable bed and separate en suite.
Fit for purpose I would say - the initial greeting was relaxed and casual, location ideal although level of noise will worry some.
We will use no 1 Motels again.

title: Para Cycling
text: Nothing was a problem (typical Kiwi), friendly staff - totally taken back to have bread, cereals, spreads etc supplied. The rooms had everything that was needed and were spacious and clean - what more could you want for the price. To hear they are getting a make over shortly (bonus). Being on the main Rd, I thought noise would be a problem (No Sir Ree) ! A great night sleep ready to race the following day. Being in a great location, the supermarket was 5 min walk inc Pizza hut etc and with bakery and coffee shop down below - who could want more ?

title: Good value for a group get together
text: I was part of a large family group that booked out a large number of rooms at the motel for a wedding. The booking process was a bit complicated with so many of us but it was no problem for the staff. The layout worked really well for us, especially the big communal kitchen and dining area. The rooms are no frills but very clean and comfortable and great value.

title: Awesome stop off
text:
Great little last minute stop off.
Manager/owner was really nice and helpful. Gave us unlimited wifi and room was very clean and comfortable. We stopped off on way from auckland to rotorua. We were going to hobbiton the next day. Great Thai restaurant downstairs aswell.

title: Good stop from Hobbiton
text:
This place is an easy 30min drive from Hobbiton and pretty much the cheapest, close, with good reviews I could find by Hobbiton. That being said, it didn't disappoint. 

It's set up more like a hostel then motel with shared bathroom, shared kitchen facilities and form style bedrooms. I stayed in a three person dorm room which ended up nice for us because no third person arrived so we had the room to ourselves. The room was really hot, didn't see any ventilation in the room, but they do provide a fan. The bathrooms were really clean and showers had good hot water (although it took awhile for it to get hot). The kitchen is also a good size with free coffee, tea and breakfast (toast and cereal). 

All in all, I think it's a bit overpriced since I stayed in very comparable places thought my time in NZ that were almost half the price this place was but if you need a place to stay before or after Hobbiton it's a good choice.

title: Great place for a get together
text: Just had a weekend here with a group of people for a bridge tournament.  Accommodation was perfect for us, close to the venue, friendly staff, great community room for eating and socialising.  Great food at nearby Thai restaurant and super breakfast menu at cafe downstairs.  Staff friendly and helpful.  Very comfortable beds.

title: Basic, clean and comfortable
text:
Stayed one night before going to Hobbiton. Reception lady was welcoming. The rooms were fine, clean and beds comfortable, tea or coffee available though no sink so you have to go to the shared bathroom to get water.
There was some kind of event going on when we were there and so a torrent if people going in and out of rooms, there are efficient door hinges that close the doors, so everyone lets them bang close. Quite noisy really, though just from guests and not much that the motel can do about that. We happened to be next to the bathroom so would suggest a different location for others as some people take noisy and lengthy showers it seems
I am not sure I would stay again, think that Youth Hostels cost about the same and have a bit more character, but wouldn't want to out anyone off as it has it's own market, if you want to be in or near Cambridge and stay in a basic place, then this is clean and comfortable

title: Great Stopover
text: Unfortunately due to car trouble we needed to stay away from home another night.  This was the first hotel we contacted  and Jared, the Duty Manager, was extremely helpful.  He gave us two room options as there were 4 of us adults.  We checked in and have nothing but praise for the rooms we stayed in.  We had 2 adjoining rooms with a shared bathroom.  Both rooms had a super king bed, flat screen TV and most Sky TV channels.  The rooms were spacious, warm and the beds were comfy.  There was a large communal kitchen down the hallway with plenty of tables and chairs and a great full equipped kitchen if you are planning on staying for a few days.  Definitely recommend and definitely stay again.

title: Comfortable, but...
text: I stayed with my wife for one night at this motel in an ideal location within Cambridge. The receptionist was a very casual gentleman who, on our arrival,  gave the necessary information in a bland, disinterested and uninviting manner. On entering our room we found it to be quite satisfactory considering the price, but showing no vibrancy or positive feeling - a room in need of an update and make-over.There appeared to be very little insulation as we could hear noise from the adjoining room, but heating was more than adequate and the bed was comfortable to sleep in. Unusually, there were no breakfast making facilities in the room - this could be done in a communal kitchen down the corridor evidently, but we took the option of eating at the cafe nearby.
hotel_response:
Hi Chris, 

Thank you for your review, we will take everything you have mentioned on board for future improvement. All our units are studio's with tea/coffee making facilities. This suites allot of people but not everyone, perhaps we should have shown you the room before finalizing the booking to ensure it was to your liking. 
The communal kitchen also works well for our guests and we offer a free basic self catering breakfast of breads, spreads and cereal.
We are also in the unique situation in that we have 'Instone Cafe' directly downstairs who do a fantastic breakfast and coffee's.  We encourage our guest to take advantage of this if it suites there needs and budget.

Take care, 
Regards, 
Jarrod

title: good location and price
text:
We were made very welcome by front line staff, we were disappointed that the toilet did not
flush and it is time the pillows were renewed they were well passed their used by date. The carpets were due for a good clean, I seem to be complaining but this is such a good establishment, and so well located, Overall the accommodation was good value, but with only a minor few improvements it could be great.

title: Nice and Comfortable
text: Stayed her form couple of time in April 2013 and 2014.  good and convenient place to stay.  Good price.  Rooms at the back are good noise proof. Cafes and restaurants are handy.  Nice shared kitchen on the premises. I would definitely go again.

title: Great stopover
text: Our workers need accommodation at  short notice all round the country. Our guy who stayed here last night said to me to definitely give this place a tick. He said it was great. Very helpful with the booking too,

title: A great place to stay in Cambridge
text:
My daughter and I stayed here for a couple of nights while she played in a golf tournament.

The rooms were clean, tidy and modern, with a heat pump - which was great as it was below freezing outside, but very comfortable in the room.

The hotel offered free unlimited wifi - which was great, as I had to work.  I can't believe there are still hotels in NZ which do not offer free unlimited wifi - it is always a major selling point for me.

The shared kitchen/dining area worked really well for us. Ensuite facilities were all clean and worked well.  We were in a room at the back, so traffic really wasn't an issue.

There were no additional charges for using a credit card, which I think are ridiculous in this day and age. 

The owners were really friendly and helpful and I could not fault them.

We'll definitely stay there again.

title: Late review for February 2013
text: Had no problem with our room and kitchen/bathroom facilities however service from the owners themselves was appalling! No friendliness at all which made us feel uncomfortable and unwelcome. I do hope they have changed the owners as I can now see good recent reviews.
hotel_response:
Hi Alasdair & Charlotte, 

I am please to let you know that No1 Motels has changed ownership as of August 2013. As you can see our reviews have been good since. I hope that we will see you back again or that you can recommend us to your family and friends. I can assure you that we run a very positive and friendly business in every respect.

Regards, 
Jarrod

title: Pleasant stay
text: We stayed here one night after a visit to the Waitomo region before heading up to Coromandel Peninsula. The hotel was in a great location, easy to walk around the town for dinner. The free parking was nice, as well as the free breakfast. The room was clean and spacious. Our room was a little chilly but the electric blankets on the bed were nice and were sufficient to keep us toasty while sleeping.

title: Great Location
text: We stayed for three nights and thought it was value for money.  If  you don't like traffic noise this is not the place for you, we got used to it by the second night.  The staff and host we all vey friendly and the room although basic was very clean and was serviced daily.  The communal kitchen was clean and tidy.  It's a great location for shopping and cafes and ample parking.  Free wifi was a bonus.

title: Enjoyed our stay
text: Everything was lovely and tidy, and very clean.   I enjoyed being able to sit in the communal kitchen/dining instead of being stuck in our room.   We also enjoyed a free upgrade to a room with an ensuite, which was a real bonus and appreciated.   We had a roadside room and even with the window open the traffic didn't keep us awake.   Hosts were lovely, looking up directions for us on the internet, and wouldn't hesitate to stay again.

title: A nice place to stay
text: My friend and I stayed there for 4 nights to attend Schottish Country Dance Summer School held in Cambridge around 2014 New Year. The place is centrally located with clean and tidy rooms. The beds are comfortable and rooms are done very nicely. The communal toilets and showers are always kept clean. The host was very friendly and happy to assist. The communal kitchen is well equipped with a nice balcony to have a drink and hand out with friends. Free internet access and good supply of towels are also appreciated. A definite stay-again place if I go back again.

title: Very basic
text:
I have stayed in many motels and hotels in my life and this had to be one of the worst.  Thankfully we were only staying for one night.  I accept that the rooms were very cheap but there was very little to them.  The bed was uncomfortable and, despite there been numerous notices around the place telling people to be quiet after 10pm, I was disturbed several times during the night by people coming and going and talking down the corridor.  I dont think they were very noisy - it is just that the rooms have no soundproofing whatsoever so you hear everything happening outside the room and next door too.  

I judge places by their shower - and this one was pathetic.  I suspect that it was fitted with a water saving device which meant that you had to stay in the shower longer just to get wet.

Would not recommend to  anyone.

title: Really useful place to know about
text: We stayed one night with my brother and his wife  while we were all going to races. Near our horses and a quick drive. No difficulty getting in and out. There is a lift for one of us (disabled) People were friendly, the communal kitchen and balcony was a good place to meet others. Overall  quiet even though on a main rd. Will stay again. Light in bathroom not great for putting on makeup though,

title: John mahia
text:
We stayed for one night in October.  Our host was friendly and welcoming.The basic room was clean and bed comfortable.  We were able to use their well equipped communal kitchen and sit on the balcony to enjoy a balmy evening with a glass of wine.  
This motel is centrally situated, has good off road parking facilities ,and is reasonably priced. We would stay again .

title: Good place to stay
text: Stayed here for a night.  Reception person was good and helpful.  Very quiet being on the busy road.  Central kitchen was a bonus.  Car parking was not a problem. Good cafe is downstairs. Carpet was little stained but not too bad for the money I had paid.

title: We will be back
text: The owner was awesome the place was great staff were friendly loved the atmosphere will be back

title: Avoid this place - I've stayed in hundreds of places in NZ over the years, and this was the worst.
text:
I've been to NZ 15 times over several years. This is literally the worst place we have ever stayed. My sister and I booked a room for 2 nights in March 2024 through Booking.com. The place was awful - very dirty, cobwebs everywhere, and there were no windows, only a door to go outside which you could not leave open as there were animals roaming about, thus no ventilation. Another big issue was the shower drain was blocked, so you literally were standing in dirty water. That was awful. The next morning the water still hadn't drained. Steve was called in to fix it the next day, but even after that it was still gurgling and we were not convinced it would work. There seems to be a major plumbing issue with this place, as there were drainpipes scattered around the property, which I took photos of.
                                                     
However, the worst thing of all was, given the issues above, we advised Steve that we were not happy and asked him if he would honour a cancellation and give us a refund, which he said he would do. Of course, when Booking.com contacted him, he reneged on his agreement. Another earlier reviewer said he did the same thing to them.

When I posted a review on their website, Steve - who has several Asian people working there - instead of addressing the issues, he totally denied them and then proceeded to accuse us of being racist! Obviously he didn't remember us clearly, because we are Asian too, and 100% against racism. He denied there were pipes lying around on the property or animals roaming around, though they were clearly in the pictures I posted. I even gave him the name it was booked in (my sister's) and that it was mid March, and he said he didn't have any booking for us. Again, a complete lie.

title: Tourist trap
text:
The place is beaten up and old and poorly maintained. We booked the barn house - which is literally the back of the house where half the barn is converted to living area and the other half is actively being used for home construction and storage. The backyard area is full of half used construction materials, wood planks and trucks. 

The  barn house  is poorly maintained, really old furniture and dirty. To add to the insult,  there are pigs and goats in a really small area right near the barn and the stench of refuse is overwhelming and nauseating. We were relieved to get out of this place.

title: Host very friendly and accommodating
text: Nicely presented house, happy to let us arrive later than originally planned. Generous breakfast menu, have recommended this place to work

title: AMAZING
text:
We loved our stay with Jay & Ali. They are warm, intelligent, funny and extremely friendly people. It’s seriously like staying with great friends.

I must admit we stayed here about 18 months ago, but we still often talk about our stay. The house is amazing, it has such a warm and friendly vibe to it, it’s like going home. When we stayed it was the height of summer, so after a day exploring Hamilton we loved just sitting out in their immaculate garden reading. I think Jay and Ali might have been worried that we didn’t feel comfortable, but honestly that’s not the case, they allowed us to feel right at home, and sitting in the garden is home, to us. 

The bedroom is very comfortable, clean, bright and airy, as is the bathroom, which is just across the little hallway. 

Breakfast was a great treat. Jay and Ali both work, and although we paid for B&B we were more than happy just to help ourselves, although they both offered to cook for us. We were happy to sort ourselves out. There were loads of fruit juices, breads, cereals to choose from, as well as the sausages eggs bacon etc. 

Now I will make the point that the B&B is not in the main city, its more like a 10 minute drive away.

I honestly can’t stop raving about Jay & Ali’s B&B, please stay here, you will not be disappointed.

title: Great little spot
text: Nice little bed and breakfast with a two lovely ladies. I asked when booking for dinner and great value had a lovely lamb rack and veges followed by a chocolate pudding. Room was nice and had electric blanket. Breakfast was a feast with cereal and fruit followed by a beautiful home cooked breakfast. This is just like staying in a home without the dishes. Highly recommended

title: A Lovely Surprise
text:
Beautiful place!  My reservation was switched and I was disappointed but I was pleasantly surprised.  There’s a new development being built around it but her property is completely closed off and private.  The grounds are lovely and the unit is spacious.  The pictures don’t do it justice.
I’m writing on tripadvisor because booking.com kept sending the wrong place to write a review on.  I highly recommend Cambridge Coach House 🏠

title: Disappointing
text: Very disappointed as seemed like a lovely place to stay.  On arrival the room did not smell nice at all...... will not go into that.  The Wi-Fi didn't connect to my husband's phone and only connected for a few seconds to my phone.  We didn't get the room we thought we were getting either.  We were booked into the Orient room and ended up in the Eastern room.  There is no iron or ironing board, so spent the day in a very creased linen shirt that looked like I had slept in it.

title: Delightful stay
text:
Lovely rooms, clean, furnished with small refrigerator, electric kettle and a few dishes/cutlery/ tea and coffee. 
The grounds are nicely landscaped. Staff was friendly and helpful. Great location if going to Rotorua or Hobbiton. Definitely would recommend!

title: SUPERB ACCOMMODATION IN CAMBRIDGE NEW ZEALAND
text: Excellent location, very friendly and quiet.  Accommodation is of the high standards - Due to location, this being in the Countryside, very peaceful. Highly recommended.   A car is a MUST or 30/45 mins walk to Cambridge- taxis unreliable!  Overall my stay was excellent.  The grounds of the Accommodation are well maintained and awesome for people who love a stroll.    A very romantic setting.

title: A lovely cottage
text: This was a very comfortable cottage in a rural setting just out of town. The cottages located close to the main house open onto a lovely garden. Checking in was easy and the staff very helpful. The only criticism we had was that the lighting in the bathroom was a little poor.

title: Nice setting and garden though needs updating and maintenance.
text:
Nice greeting and lovely scenery  although not  alot of privacy if someone staying next door, can see walking past or hear them on yr patio as close by.
Nice bed, bedding and some luxurious things but some furniture worn and needs replacing so we wouldn't call it luxury.

title: Comfy but noisy
text: Unit is private and comfortable. Good bed and facilities. Smart decor. No fuss greeting etc But the road noise is intrusive and the unit even shuddered from passing truck a few times in the evening and morning. Fridge sounds like someone snoring at night. Definitely a once only visit.

title: Nice setting in open space
text:
Certainly not Stunning Boutique Accommodation in our view. While the setting is pleasant enough the cottage and grounds needs simple maintenance - we expect light bulbs for example in all fittings and a clean dish cloth - not an old ratty thing which looks to have been used by plenty ahead of us.
These things are not hard to fix and at $185.00 per night we were disappointed.

title: Peaceful Country Setting
text: We arrived with no booking but we were able to get a room. Room was themed (Bali Room) and suited its theme. Comfortable and spacious. Lovely setting in the country yet so close to town. Everything you could need for a night stay was provided. Would recommend.

title: Stunning Boutique Accommodation
text: What a gorgeous property, tucked away just out of town. Beautiful rooms with large bathrooms and little kitchenette with everything you need for early morning coffee. Charming hostess. IMMACULATELY presented rooms with comfortable beds. We slept very soundly with no traffic noise outside. Woke up to lovely gardens and lawns. Highly recommend.

title: Pleasant setting but some things were a let down
text:
The location was pleasant with a nice outlook. During the day and evening it was quiet. The cat was good company. But he needs fattening up a bit.

Disliked · 1. Although not directly on the main road it was close enough to be woken at 4am each morning by the noise and vibration of heavy trucks passing by.
2. The lighting was poor. Three bulbs (LED) did not work and of those that did they were quite low luminescence.
3. There was no holder for soap or shampoo etc in the shower. Having to bend down to the floor is not the best thing to do while showering. Surely a shelf could be installed in the cubicle.
4. The inside of the windows looked like they had been cleaned with a dirty cloth, as had the mirror.
5. It seems that the owner has taken a "cottage", put some second-hand items in it and markets it as a luxury stay. Luxury also means attention to detail.

title: Lovely garden setting with short drive into town
text: Stayed here one night in January 2020 as a stopover to visit the Hobbiton Movie Set.  The place has a selection of unique cottages which are very nice,  Ours had a patio out the back with entry to an open area and surrounding gardens. Very peaceful location and just a short drive into the town of Cambridge.   We will stay here again if we are in the area.

title: Counrty retreat
text: Set in a beautiful garden location in the counrtyside are these holiday cottages. The one we stayed in was The Bali Cottage. It was tastefully furnished with a Balinese style and contained everything you need when staying away. We had the continental breakfast - this was beautifully presented on a tray to our room and consisted of fresh fruit, cereal, yogurt, bread, butter, jam, marmalade and peanut butter and apple juice. The portions were generous and very fresh. I would highly recommend this as a very nice place to stay

title: Amazing!!!!
text:
What a find. A little out of town surrounded by paddocks. We were in a Balinese inspired room.  Just beautiful.  Lovely furnishings.
Quiet surroundings and beautiful gardens.  We only stayed for 1 night, but would definitely love to come back one day.

title: Lovely quiet location just out of Cambridge
text:
We stayed two nights here for a mini break over New Year. Our room was comfortable and well appointed with Tv (Freeview only, no Sky TV), kitchenette (microwave, fridge, toaster and kettle). There was plunger coffee and tea, and chilled water in the fridge. The bathroom had a shower, toilet and basin. Our room had a garden outlook and the resident cat was very friendly!

The breakfast option is good value at $10 per person, and presentation was excellent.

The only improvements I would suggest are a pillow top for the bed (we found it a bit hard), and there is no smoke alarm in the room, nor an evacuation plan in case of emergency.

title: Quiet
text: We found this place very quiet and easy to sleep. The beds were comfortable. The unit contained everything we needed for our one night stay. Only a 5 minute drive to the shops for dinner. Lovely garden and swimming pool for hotter days.

title: Luxury in the countryside
text: Set in beautiful gardens amongst rural properties Cambridge Coach House was a wonderful surprise. Our cottage was immaculate and felt very cosy and homely but at the same time luxurious. Every aspect was well maintained and presented. Our host was so helpful and recommended a great place to eat locally.

title: Unique, quiet, cosy
text: Three unique motel units in the country, but close to Cambridge, beside a old farm house. Units decorated to theme, clean, tidy, comfortable bed, great amenities. Owners always willing to help. Something different, a unique experience. Just would like to have unit serviced each day - bins emptied, clean towels.

title: Outstanding accommodations
text: This was our first stay in New Zealand during a 4 week trip. An exceptional spot with great service and rooms. A great introduction to New Zealand hospitality. Plus the breakfast was truly outstanding.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your review. Hope to see you again when you come back around here.

title: Luxurious country B&B
text: Extremely comfortable. Perfect for three couples travelling together or just on your own. Annette is a wonderful host. Her home provides a lovely country retreat with lots of luxurious comfort. Breakfast is fantastic. Would love to stay there again and would highly recommend this B&B to anyone looking for a quiet, comfortable retreat.

title: Lovely place to stay
text: A beautiful little cottage with great facilities. Nice and secluded, with a gorgeous garden outlook from the room. Located a few minutes drive from town. Definitely recommend for a couple, or for a bit of a luxury treat for an individual.

title: Would be great if no-one was else was booked in
text: Lovely setting. The walls are very thin between the 2 cottages and you can hear the guests next door. It would be fantastic accommodation if no-one else was booked in to stay! Wifi wasn't working and communication from the owners was basically zero. I wouldn't stay again unless there was no-one else staying.

title: Not luxury
text: This accommodation needs a thorough clean,  shower door had mould, dust and dirt on windowsills and ornaments, cobwebs.  Smoke alarm had been removed in cottage - not good.  Also don’t have cofffee pod machine if only one decaf pod available. Not impressed.

title: Overnight stay during Maadi Cup
text: Perfect location for our purpose.  The room was very stylish, clean and comfortable. Very private in a beautiful garden setting.  Staff very friendly and helpful.  Continental breakfast was offered at $10 per person but we had to leave first thing next morning.  We shared a wall with the next door Chalet.  This would be my only complaint as the walls were thin. Otherwise accommodation perfect! Great for couples.

title: We enjoyed how bright, clean and friendly the property was.
text: This was such a nice surprise.  It was clean and bright and quiet.  Each unit was its own cottage.  It was a little out in the country but close enough to town for easy access.  The price was very reasonable.

title: Very Pleasant and Cozy Stay!
text: We found this cottage without booking in advance while driving through Cambridge. It was accessible from the road and very beautifully decorated outside and inside. Each cottage came with its own garden and had heater and kitchen facilities. It also had free parking and wifi. The room was super clean and cozy with a very English ambience. The host was also super friendly and helpful and offered tips on how to reach our next destination and also other places to check out on the way. Very closely located to Hobbiton and easily accessible from here. We loved our stay here! Thank you for the cosy stay! =)

title: Most comfortable stay in Cambridge!
text: These self-catering "cottages" offer private accommodation, a comfortable stay in a serene setting.   We stayed a couple of days and felt truly at home. The cottage is surrounded by a beautiful garden, beautiful manicured lawns and trees.  The bedrooms are spacious and the bathrooms offer great showers and warm towel rails (which were most welcome).   The bed was comfortable and the kitchenette well equipped.  The cottage was serviced daily.  I would have liked to have the use of a cupboard in this cottage, a place to hang and pack some clothing especially if one stays a couple of days would have been welcome. The hosts are most friendly and we would return again!

title: Booked but nobody home so stayed elsewhere
text: We booked this property in mid May as were going to a wedding close by.  Tried calling the owners for an earlier check-in. Discovered the property had changed hands a couple of weeks before and still had the old owners number on the website.  Tried the landline and went straight to answerphone.  Turned up there 15 mins before check-in  (2pm) and still no one to be seen. Tried calling again and straight to answerphone. It was getting close to time to dress for the wedding so decided to call Expedia to see if we could find somewhere else to stay. Expedia were amazing.  Arranged for alternative accomodation at a similar property close by.  Property itself was nicely kept and the rooms looked nice enough from the outside.  Being able to make contact with a property is really important to travellers so I hope the new owners learn from this review.

title: Really lovely location
text:
I stayed here with my daughter in the bali suite. Set in stunning gardens. Lovely room which was immaculately clean. Super comfortable bed.
There was some slight noise from the room next door but it did not stop us sleeping.
hotel_response: So pleased you both enjoyed your stay in Bali Suite and had time to take in the gardens!  Really appreciate your time taken to review us and sincerely hope to see you again one day :-)

title: Delightful
text:
Delightful stay in the “Blackberry Cottage” where we picked fresh Blackberries to add to our dessert!
The cottages are comfortable and beautifully decorated. The gardens are both peaceful and a visual treat. We walked in the evening and in the morning.
Everything we needed in a calm, peaceful setting only minutes from the centre of town.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a lovely review.  Great to meet you both and happy to see you collected your pillow :-) - looking forward to seeing you again one day.

title: Great location and great stay
text: Had a couple of days stay in this beautiful cottage. We chose this since it was close to both the Waitomo caves and the Hobbit set. The rooms were small but cosy and the view outside was fantastic. The early morning sunrise from this place was beautiful too. The host was very friendly and provided some good homely breakfast. Their cat Pokey is also fun to play with.
hotel_response:
Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a great review.  Pokey is missing you, he thinks all our guests just come here to play with him LOL!
Delighted you enjoyed your time in the Waikato and all it has to offer and of course, that you were comfortable here at the Coach House :-)  Sincerely hope to see you again sometime, meanwhile, have a wonderful Christmas!
Warmest Regards
Vicki

title: PERFECT!
text:
We recently had the pleasure of staying at this beautiful accommodation. 
Cambridge coach house is perfect! We stayed here for my pre and post wedding night. The room was spotlessly clean, stylish, very comfortable, well maintained and looks very luxurious. Vicky ensured that the room was immaculate. She was very friendly, kind and accommodating.
She ensured i would have left with a good impression. 
 
I could go on but suffice it to say we were very pleased with our stay, and although short and sweet, I hope to be back for a longer visit in the future.
 And would recommend it to everybody.
hotel_response: Always a delight to accommodate a wedding party!  We are so pleased you enjoyed your stay and have taken the time to write such a fab review.  Thank you so much for choosing us and of course we'd love to see you back anytime.  All our very best wishes for your exciting future together :-)

title: Peaceful beautiful excellent location
text:
I chose this location because we wanted to visit a few spots nearby - Waitomo, Hobbiton, Rotorua. After researching a few areas, for the price, this looked luxurious compared to other near by like Mata Mata.  My research paid off! It was more than I expected for the price.

Our plans changed because I didn't realize school was out so the Waitomo glow worm caves were sold out! We were able to check in early (really early) and the owner gave us excellent tips. My 13 year old made a face when Hamilton Gardens were mentioned and she caught on so quickly! He actually enjoyed them.  Her best advice was the waterfall west past Waitomo glow worm caves. That was spectacular.

I got to use the bathroom before we headed out and it was such a treat to see a sparkling heart sticker over the toilet paper! It was these small details that made this stay special. When we got home after a late night with the Hobbiton evening tour, the heat was turned on and the lights were on!!  I felt like I was staying at my sister's or my best friend's except they aren't as talented in decorating as our room was.

I could hear an occasional truck but the birds chirping were more a predominant sound. We enjoyed the plunger coffee and the ramen packs for a snack!

I suspect these rooms would go fast if there are any horse events in the area since we passed a large horse arena/stadium so book early. She only has 3 cottages/rooms.

Google maps steered us to the wrong side of the road. There is a large sign but it didn't catch our eye. At night, the red in the sign does catch your eye. If you aren't traveling by camper, this is a great place to stay for the sights in this area. The sights are still a bit of a drive.
hotel_response:
Firstly, it was such a pleasure to meet you and your family - a rare treat to meet a child with such excellent manners and personality!
I love to let our guests know of the 'free' sights available in the area and its great to learn that you took my advice and enjoyed them all, you certainly have made the most of your Waikato experience!
Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a thoughtful and thorough review, we really appreciate it and sincerely hope to see you again some time.
Warmest Regards
Vicki

title: Convenient and elegant country retreat just at edge of town
text:
Only a few minutes out of town - very convenient to Cambridge town services and Karapiro and beautifully quiet and relaxing with farm estate views. I stayed in the Acacia Suite furnished with French provincial decor although all suites looked similarly lovely and well-designed.

Everything considered for a modern short-stay with great shower facilities, warm duvet and a strong heat pump for cold nights. Breakfast supplies not included but Cambridge cafes available less than 10 minutes away and there is a mini-fridge and toaster also provided. No tissues or hand cream (not an issue as I had brought my own) but a bathrobe might have been additionally useful.

Lovely high-quality stay. Definitely consider as an alternative to in-town options.
hotel_response:
Delightful to meet you both and so pleased you enjoyed your stay with us, we really appreciate our guests who wander the gardens and take advantage of the sunny outdoor spaces.  Thanks very much for taking the time to write such a lovely review and great to hear your thoughts on extra little items - we'll definitely be putting some thought into that, thanks again and trust the remainder of your travels will be safe and happy :-)
Warmest Regards
Vicki

title: Immaculate, beautiful and peaceful
text: Spent a night in the Bali Suite, beautiful decor, from the gorgeous duvet fabric to the couches and chandelier. Spotlessly clean, large shower with great shower head and a small kitchenette area with pretty crockery. The gardens are beautiful and peaceful, well kept lawns. Nice and quiet , away from road and traffic and was lovely to wake up to chirping birds. A beautiful view to look at while lying in bed. Just perfect, thanx
hotel_response:
My goodness!!  I can't thank you enough for taking the time to write such a lovely review :-)  We are so lucky to have such a beautiful spot here, sometimes we feel we have to pinch ourselves LOL so pleased you enjoyed your stay and thank you, most sincerely again.
Warmest Regards
Vicki

title: Great place and very helpfull and kind owners
text:
Me and my husband were in this house in January 2014 and I forget to write the recension. I hope you could forgive me.
Our stay was very plesant and the room very well equipped and clean. Fabulous the garden.
Well done
hotel_response: Can't tell you how happy we are that we've popped into your head again after all this time!  Thank you very much for taking the time to write such a lovely review and we sincerely hope to see you again one day :-)

title: Excellent
text: Four of us rented two units.  This is a truly exceptional acomodation done at an extremely high quality level.  The location is just outside of Cambridge and is in a lovely spot with beautiful grounds.  Highly recommend.
hotel_response: We really appreciate the time you've taken to write such a fab review!!  Lovely to meet you all and couldn't be happier that you enjoyed your short visit with us, hope to see you again one day :-)

title: A warm welcome
text:
Our travel agent found the Cambridge and we stayed at the wonderfully appointed Blackberry Cottage.

It really is an ideally placed peaceful retreat. Vikki provided Breakfast and was very welcoming. Within the cottage there was a small kitchen should you prefer to eat in. Close to the town a five minute drive and close to Hamilton and Hobbiton.
Definitely recommended.
hotel_response: Always a pleasure to meet couples such as you two!  Thank you so much for your lovely review of us, we couldn't be happier to learn how much you enjoyed your stay. Sincerely hoping to see you both again one day!

title: Beautiful accommodation with gorgeous garden
text: We stayed overnight in the Bali Suite and it was beautifully appointed and so comfortable.  Hosts Vicki and Karl were super friendly and accommodating.  Vicki told us about a couple of free attractions nearby (Marokopa Falls and Natural Bridge) which we visited and are so glad we did as they were amazing.  Wished we could have stayed longer at Coach House and will certainly stay there again when we are in the area.
hotel_response:
Couldn't be happier to hear you enjoyed the Falls and the Natural Bridge!  Its a shame, I think, when guests/tourists travel to Waitomo Caves and don't realise how close they are to these two beautiful (free!) attractions.
A real pleasure to meet you both and thank you so much for taking the time to write such a great review, hope to see you again soon!

title: All the beauty of the countryside so close to town - a Great Stay!
text:
Cambridge Coach House offers boutique cottages in lovely gardens, just a few minutes out of Cambridge. We booked at the last moment for a weekend break & were delighted with our choice. The owners property is a large villa set in landscaped gardens with 3 cottages nested close by; 1 cottage is free standing with a second larger cottage divided into 2 separate but quite private apartments. The owners have decorated these beautifully and everything from the bedding (very comfortable bed!) to the china in the kitchenette was in great taste.  Each cottage has a small patio outside & looks out onto rolling garden. 
Loved that the room was spacious with comfy armchairs so we didn't need to sit on the bed to watch TV!
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your lovely review.  Delighted you enjoyed your stay and sincerely hope to see you again soon!

title: Simply superb!  Beautiful accommodation and location and amazing hosts!
text:
From the moment we arrived our host Vicky made us feel so welcome.  Nothing was too much trouble, even when we asked for some champagne flutes, which Vicki generously sourced from her own kitchen, so that we could open a bottle of bubbles to celebrate a very special event!

The Bali cottage was beautiful and nestled in amongst Vicki's (and I am sure that Karl has had a hand in creating this beautiful setting too) peaceful and beautifully crafted gardens.  The cottage has everything you could need and it is handy to all that Cambridge has to offer (see my review on Alpha St Kitchen).

The Cambridge Coach House  will always have a special place in our hearts, as it was in those beautiful gardens that my man proposed in the late afternoon sun as we sat in the garden seat beneath the pergola.  (And of course I said 'Yes').

I get the feeing that this property might stay hidden but it won't be a secret for long.  Make sure you book an escape there soon - you won't be disappointed.

Thanks Vicki and Karl - we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and will be back.
hotel_response:
Thank you so much Elle, we are so flattered that you chose us for such a wonderful occasion!  An absolute pleasure to meet such a perfect couple, can't wait to see you again soon :-)  Oh and delighted you enjoyed Alpha St Kitchen - our very favourite!
Take care
Vicki xx

title: Fantastic hosts and accommodation. Highly recommended!
text: Beautiful cottages with garden views. Stayed for 5 nights in the Bali suite, very comfortable and relaxing accommodation with everything you need. Very welcoming and helpful hosts and a very convenient location. Thank you Vicky!
hotel_response:
Thank you so much Yannis!!  Can't wait to meet your family when you are back next time!
Warmest Regards
Vicki

title: Quaint cottages
text: Quaint cottages with a garden view.  There is a sink, microwave and BBQ outside and you have all the utensils except a wine bottle opener.  There were fresh flowers on arrival with proper coffee with fresh milk.  There is a pack with take away menus also. as you are out of town.  The lady who runs it is very accommodating and friendly and her cute, fluffy dog meets you on arrival.  Internet didn't work at all which was very frustrating as I was waiting on news from home.  I would also have loved to have had some bathrobes or blankets to enjoy the patio outside.  We did have a lovely stay though.
hotel_response:
Hi there Lisa, 
So kind of you to write such a lovely review and delighted you enjoyed the cottage.
I know it is far too late now but there are blankets stored in the chest in the living area and yes, it has become too chilly to sit outside at night without them.
As for the internet, hmm, occasionally the system needs rebooting, its a 5 minute job but I do have to know there's a problem before I can fix it - I'm so sorry you experienced difficulty with it.
Oh and thanks for mentioning the wine bottler opener, we don't have wine with corks in New Zealand anymore so I removed the corkscrews but of course, we are not the only country the makes wine LOL and I know some Australian Vineyards still use corks so I will pop those back in the cottages and thanks for bringing that to my attention - much appreciated, can't think of anything worse than having a lovely bottle of wine and no cork screw!!!!

title: Little hidden gem
text: This place is incredibly beautiful and peaceful. My sister and I stayed in the Bali suite, it was beautiful decorated. The owners were so inviting and friendly, very accommodating. We absolutely reccommend this place. It was one of the nicest places I've ever stayed at. I will most certainly be back again
hotel_response:
You honey Ellisha!  Thank you so much, it was lovely to meet you both, thrilled to bits that you enjoyed yourselves here and so grateful you've taken the time to write such a lovely review - love to see you again - anytime :-)
Warmest Regards
Vicki

title: Our New Zealand 2017 holiday
text: We loved this place. Spent 2 nights in Blackberry Cottage enjoying the comfort and luxury. Vicki was most welcoming and helpful, and we met Pokey (the ginger cat) and Gracie (small, fluffy, friendly dog).
hotel_response: Thank you so much and of course we are delighted you enjoyed your very special time here in the Waikato!  Thank you for choosing us and we certainly hope to see you back some time :-)

title: Highly recommended
text: We stayed in one of the cottages last week. Arrived to a warm and friendly welcome. The accommodation was spacious, inviting and spotlessly clean. The bed was the most comfortable we have experienced in any hotel stay around the country.  It would have been nice to have stayed longer to experience the beautiful garden and swimming pool.
hotel_response:
Thank you Tricia, delightful to meet you both and so pleased you enjoyed your stay.  Hopefully we'll see you again one day?  Thanks again for taking the time to write such a lovely review :-)
Warmest Regards
Vicki

title: Great location and lovely gardens
text: This was another unplanned stay due to weather when our itinerary was forced to change. We were lucky to find such a nice place and Vicki was very accommodating. Cambridge is a cool up and coming town with surprisingly great eateries. Rooms here were quite spacious and nicely appointed. Do beware there is no breakfast at this place, but there is a fridge, a toaster and some other basic equipment for breakfast if you were so inclined to bring your own fixings. No common room either, but the gardens more than make up for that.
hotel_response:
Hi there and thank you so much for taking the time to write such a lovely review.
I'd just like to clarify that we are not a B&B - we are 'cottage accommodation', we certainly don't mean to mislead anyone but Tripadvisor has chosen this category for us and it does seem to cause some confusion - sincere apologies.

title: Freindly and rooms to die for
text: The stay here was fantastic Vicky was so hospitable and even offered to drop us off at a wedding by far the best stay in Cambridge. If I could give them 6 stars out of 5 I would, the grounds are gorgeous as are the views, also no traffic noise !
hotel_response: Such a pleasure to meet you and your gorgeous wife Mike, thank you so much for taking the time to review us so generously, we love it when our guests explore the garden and enjoy their stay, sincerely hope to see you again some day :-)

title: Peaceful and tranquil
text: We stayed here for a couple of nights. The rooms were lovely, clean and chocolates on the bed daily. Vicki was fabulous and so helpful in many ways. She was such a lovely host that welcomed us. If you wanting to stay somewhere very peaceful, relaxing and good old fashion service then this is the place for you. Beautiful gardens and buildings.
hotel_response:
Oh my goodness!  Thank you so very much for your time to write this lovely review.
We love it when our guests take time to enjoy our gardens and our gorgeous little country town, so pleased you enjoyed yourselves and sincerely hope to see you again :-)

Warmest Regards
Vicki

title: Fantastic location and very peaceful
text: Only a few minutes drive to Cambridge town centre but situated in the beautiful countryside. The cottage I stayed in was very well maintained and so peaceful and quiet. Perfect place to stay if you're looking for a quiet location, which is very well priced for luxury level accommodation.
hotel_response: An absolute pleasure meeting you and delighted you enjoyed your stay with us, hope you did well in your trials and we hope to see you again soon!

title: lovely garden setting noisy road
text: We loved the garden setting and furnishings in our very large room however there is a busy road near the property and that wasnt great. Also it wasnt cleaned very well - there was dust and looked like vacumming wasnt done behind things just around. For the price I think you could find somewhere better.
hotel_response:
Thank you so much Bianca for taking the time to write your review and I'm delighted to hear you enjoyed our gardens and your comfy suite.
Not so happy to hear you managed to find dust somewhere but I can assure you all furniture is vacuumed behind - not every day, but twice a week without fail.  We have a very strict cleaning regime and my housekeeper is a professional with her own high standards, however, her and I will definitely be having a wee chat regarding your comment so I thank you again :-)  As for the road noise, hmm, I'm at a loss as to what else I can do to point out that we are on a fairly busy road, I've specified everywhere I can think of that we are on the Cambridge/Te Awamutu Highway, suggesting it carries a bit of traffic, particularly mornings and early evenings when locals are travelling to and from work. I would like to point out that - other than Blackberry Cottage - both other suites are double glazed and the traffic can't be heard at all once you're inside, also, we are high above and set well back from the road so the noise is minimal when you are wandering the garden - but not the tranquility of a country lane - I agree.
Thank you again Bianca, we very much appreciate the opportunity to address these issues as, of course, the comfort and happiness of our guests is our top priority.

title: Comfortable, practical mid-way stay
text: The farm style home, cottages and gardens are lovely and relaxing. The rooms are well appointed and there is ample parking. We had to drive the short distance into town for dinner,  but didn't mind that at all. All in all a very practical place to stop over while traveling around New Zealand.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for your lovely review!  We are delighted you enjoyed your time here at the Coach house and took in some of the sights and restaurants of our gorgeous little town.  Hope to see you again some day!  Vicki

title: Well decorated room but bad service
text:
We had 3 people in a group. The host was saying that there will be an additional charge.  I think it's fair.  So, I paid $50 for the additional person (although we stayed in 5 motels/resorts/hotels in this road trip and we were being charged $35 usually for the additional person.)

After paying $50, we were told that they will leave additional bedding for the 3rd person.  We were happy and went out for our activity.  When we returned to this couch house at around 6.30pm, we saw a thin single mattress and a blanket being left on the floor in the room (see pics).  I was wondering if they were in the process of coming to our room and making a rollaway bed or something.  So, I went to their main house,(pls note,there is no reception but guest need to go to the host's main house to ask for help if required.) and wanted to ask if there will be a rollaway bed provided.  The main house was locked and no answer after ranging the bell for a long time.  

I heard laughter and people chatting behind the fence. I saw the host was having a drink/party with their friends at their poolside.  So,they weren't bothering to attend to the guests.

Got no choice, my daughter was sleeping on the floor with the thin mattress and even without a pillow provided.  

Yes, room was nice, well decorated.  But the host was very arrogant and doesn't care much about customer service.  So, altogether I paid $215 for a night stay but sleeping on a thin mattress without a pillow. 

What do you think if you were me??
hotel_response:
Thank you so much for taking the time to write a 'review', perhaps the full story would give a clearer picture for readers to make their judgement, starting with you making and paying for a booking in two rooms for 4 guests but turning up with 6 guests (not 3) including a baby.
I know you weren't happy about paying  for 1 extra guest and insisted you didn't understand our language that well, although when it comes to a review, seems you've managed the language very well LOL 
You have forgotten to mention that there was a double sofa bed with full linen in one of the suites (hence the $50 extra charge) which was used and the mattress you refer to, in the other suite, which actually did come with beautiful pressed sheets and a blanket (didn't think it necessary to supply yet another pillow when there are 4 on the bed) and was completely free of charge!
Finally, as it was 2 days prior to Xmas yes, we may have had friends around - we do live on the premises and we do have a bit of a life at times :-) but clearly did not hear you knocking on the door at the other side of the house,  I would have been more than happy to attend to your further needs as you can see from the majority of our reviews - our guests comfort is top priority to us.
I thank you again for taking the time and giving me the opportunity to tell the full story and I wish you and your family all the best on your travels elsewhere in the future.

title: Loved the House
text:
Vicky has done an excellent job turning the Coach House into a wonderful home-away-from-home. There were four of us staying at the Coach House and we each though the house was well appointed for our stay. We were there is early November and all her roses were in gorgeous bloom and we enjoyed oranges from her tree each day.

It was convenient to have a washer and dryer available to us and we appreciated parking our car in the garage. The property was just a short walk to a large grocery store and we are looking forward to Good George Brewing being opened for our next visit.

Thanks Vicky for making the Coach House so welcoming!
hotel_response: Such a pleasure to meet you all and of course I'm delighted you enjoyed your stay with us. You'll be pleased to know the Good George has started construction of their 'Garden Bar' and will apparently have it completed prior to Xmas so we'll try it out for you and let you know :-)  All our very best wishes to you and your family for a wonderful Xmas and thank you so much for taking the time to write such a lovely review!

title: Amazing room, location and service
Comfortable stopover
text: We stayed here as a stopover between Taupo and Auckland. Vicki was most helful in providing advice in the lead up to our stay, including information about driving routes (she recommended a great cafe Rhubarb in Arapuni which we stopped at on the way). The rooms were comfortable. Lovely landscaped gardens to enjoy. It was a bit out of town so you need to drive to dinner etc but it's only a few minutes away.
hotel_response: So pleased you enjoyed your stay with us!  It was lovely to meet you both and I'm delighted you sampled Rhubarb Cafe on your way up the country!

title: Freewheeling among the Cambridge Camellias
text: Our room was situated amongst landscaped gardens and about 3 km from the centre of Cambridge. We stayed in the Acacia suite which was at the end of a set of two overlooking the garden, its pathways and with a view of the countryside of Cambridge.The camellias were in flower and the mandarins flourishing on the trees alongside our room. We absolutely enjoyed meeting Phil who was standing in for the owners - his Rambler was incredible and we loved his free spirited philosophy - wish we could emulate his outlook one day.  He suggested we go to the Lake - about 6-8 kms away and spot the huge carp at the base of the dam - we need to return! Thanks Phil and those who created this beautiful environment.
hotel_response: It is an absolute pleasure meeting people like yourselves. Vicki and Karl have done an amazing job here. I am so pleased you enjoyed your stay as much as I enjoyed meeting you.

title: Country location minutes from Cambridge
text: We arrived early evening, having travelled for five hours and really needed a nice dinner and a comfortable bed. We were greeted by the owner who made us feel very welcome and showed us the Bali Room which we took straight away as it had everything we needed. Bathroom was a good size and the shower was great. We found out later the bed was really comfortable too. She gave us a couple of recommendations for places to eat in Cambridge, a few minutes later we were having a lovely meal and then headed back for a sound sleep. Couldn't have been better -this was a quiet location and we didn't hear any noise from other guests even though all rooms were occupied. Would recommend -the Coach House is in a great location -rural but on the edge of the lovely town of Cambridge.
hotel_response: Firstly, sincere apologies for this late response, we've been having a break and just arrived back.  Karen, thank you so much for taking the time to review us so generously, we really appreciate it and hope to see you both again some day!!

title: Terrible sound insulation
text:
Stayed one night in Bali room. Sadly could hear every movement and conversation from the people staying in the room next door! Put the TV on and up loud to drown out noises. 
Nice location but would not stay again.
hotel_response: Firstly, thank you so much for taking the time to review us KLM254.  Needless to say we are mortified to receive such a scathing review as we go out of our way to make sure all of our guests are happy and comfortable.  I am somewhat surprised to read your complaint as my husband Karl built Bali and Acacia Suites when we first arrived here almost 7 years ago and I can assure you that the very best of insulating product  was used to avoid this potential problem, walls and ceiling are chokka full of sound deadening Batts and in all that time, from memory we've not had another complaint of this nature.  Also, we have sacrificed many bookings in the interest of our guests comfort by not allowing children to be accommodated in these two suites - just in case. It is indeed a pity that you didn't mention this to us at the time, we would have been more than happy to move you to our free standing Blackberry Cottage and refund your payment as it is of utmost importance to us that our guests enjoy a pleasant experience here.  Thank you again for letting us know and please accept our sincere apologies.

title: FANTASTIC accomodation! - Most picturesque location, immaculate accomodation and OUTSTANDING service!
text:
Our stay was in the middle of June so we expected the weather to be cold and rainy. Having driven from Auckland, it was indeed quite cold but we were lucky with the weather as it only really drizzled as opposed to heavy rain.

As we approached our accomodation - The Cambridge Coach House - we were astounded with the entrance, including a gorgeous big tree with its beautiful yellow/red autumn colours and a large wooden countryside style arch that leads us to the front of this stunning property. 

As we approached the reception we were greeted by the most friendly and lovely Vicki, her super cute dog and an even friendlier and charming cat. 

As Vicki took us to our accommodation we could not be happier and were even more amazed with the level of detail in terms of decor, comfort and of course... the amazing views we had from our double glass door in the living room. 

The garden at the back of the property was a piece of an art! As you walk towards the garden you find steps to lead you down into this beautiful and exquisite garden with a huge variety of plants and flowers and again you will encounter an amazing view of the stunning Cambridge countryside. 

It was a long drive and we were starving and Vicki was happy to give us some fantastic recommendations on the best places to eat in town. We would be exhausted after our daily adventures and every time we would get back to our accomodation we would find it immaculate... our bed was made, the towels and bathroom were dry and warm and the cottage was also warm after a long cold day outside exploring the unbelievable beauty of the area. 

As we left we felt we were leaving a long time friend... we wished we could take Vicki back with us to have her as a neighbour just for selfish reason really. We loved our staying at the Cambridge Coach House and as we promised, we will for sure be back to catch up with Vicki and her family.

Vicki thank you so much for all your help with everything during our staying! We could not have met a better (because you are the BEST) hostess than you. The little farewell "bird gift" you gave me will always remind me of our special time in Cambridge NZ! We will be back!
hotel_response: Oh my goodness!  Thank you both so much for such a lovely review - the pleasure was all mine and I wished you could have stayed longer so we could have had time to share some more wine!  So pleased you took a wee stroll in the garden, I never get enough time out there but when guests comment on it, I'm so pleased that they enjoy it.  Thanks again and I can hardly wait until you return :-)

title: Peaceful
text:
Well located in close proximity to Cambridge township but in a nice rural area. We had a wonderful stay and found Vicki to be a delightful host . The accomodation and ambience are excellent , modern and clean set in beautiful gardens.
We travelled to Rotorua which was an easy one hour drive it is also very close to Matta Matta and about one and a half hours to Tauranga and Mt Mangani.

The Lily Pad Cafe and Art studio is two minutes by car for great coffee and food , also in a nice rural setting, Cambridge town is very much like an English village is only 4 minutes by car.
hotel_response: So pleased you enjoyed your stay at the Coach House, we do our best to make sure our guests are comfortable and we really appreciate you taking the time to share your thoughts.  Hope the remainder of your holiday was wonderful!

title: Beautiful and comfortable room
text: We had a fantastic stay at the Cambridge Coach house. The room we stayed in was so beautiful, clean, and comfortable...we wished we could have stayed longer! There were great amenities including chocolates on the bed, a little kitchenette with tea, coffee and milk in the fridge. We would love to come back!
hotel_response: And of course, we would love to have you back! Thank you for leaving your suite in such perfect, tidy order, you were a complete pleasure to accommodate - see you soon we hope!

title: Quiet place in good location
text: We stayed here 3 nights while in New Zealand.  The pictures online perfectly showcase this place as it is exactly how looks in them.  We got here and were treated by the host who was very friendly. The wifi worked great here for us to be able to find nearby places to eat.  We ended up actually not spending much time at the hotel as we were out sightseeing but we did enjoy our time here.  It had everything any other motel/hotel would have.  It is a short ways outside of town so it is nice and quiet there.  It was a nice change for use after spending the last several nights in the city.
hotel_response: Lovely to meet you both and thank you for your great review of the Cambridge Coach House.  Delighted to see you make the most of your short time in NZ and we very much appreciate you choosing us to accommodate you.  Hope to see you next time :-)

title: Comfy, cosy rooms and friendly host.
text: We only stayed one night at the Cambridge Coach House, but really enjoyed our stay there. After a long day travelling, we really appreciated the incredibly comfortably bed, great shower and peaceful surroundings. The property is a 5-10 minute drive from the restaurants and cafes in Cambridge so it's very convenient, and our host was most friendly when we arrived. We would very much recommend The Coach House for a stay in Cambridge.
hotel_response: Hi Holly!  So pleased you enjoyed your time in our awesome little town and thanks heaps for taking the time to review us - much appreciated, hope we can catch up again one day!

title: Perfect place
text: Definitely highly recommended. We found that place while surfing on the internet. When we arrived there, we were fascinated. Who really pay attantion cleaning, peacefull area and also comfortable bed, this place must definitely choosen
hotel_response: What a fab review!  Thank you so much, actually, mostly we have to give credit to our wonderful housekeeper Anita for keeping the cottages spotless, she's an absolute treasure.  So pleased you enjoyed a comfortable, restful night and thank you again :-)

title: "Tranquil in a picture book setting."
text:
We were greeted by a very friendly host, who showed us to a very tastefully decorated suite. The surroundings were beautiful with a peaceful setting. It is very close to the main shopping centre which has many nice shops and cafes. We had a delightful stay and explored the local area. We enjoyed the ambiance of the Acacia suite and we look forward to coming back again.
Barry and Kelly
hotel_response:
Thank you both so much, it was lovely to meet you and catch up with the news from your hometown!  Sincerely hoping to see you again - perhaps you'll be our neighbours??!!
Warmest Regards
Vicki

title: Gracious, comfortable, friendly hosts
text: The location is in the country but within 5-10 minutes of Cambridge so still handy to restaurants and cafes etc. The grounds are delightful on a terrace above the river, with well established gardens to explore.The cottage was well appointed with high quality fittings and delightful ambiance. Tea and coffee etc were all provided but also a microwave oven and toaster. The hosts were very welcoming and went the extra mile to help us store our gear before we checked in.
hotel_response:
Thank you so much Sally, trusting you enjoyed some shopping time in our little town and pleased you were able to find time to wander the gardens during your busy cycling stay!  We really appreciate your very kind words and thank you for taking the time to write such a lovely review.  Wishing you a very happy and safe new year.
Warmest Regards
Vicki

title: Quality accommodation
text: Lovely attention to detail in these rooms with excellent quality furnishings. Very friendly owner who provided a good insight into local eateries. A peaceful location and we would thoroughly recommend for a relaxing stay.
hotel_response: Wow!  How lovely of you!  Thank you so much and all our very best wishes for the new year!

title: Nice, little place in Cambridge
text: We stayed in the Acacia room which was nicely decorated and had a soft but comfortable bed. The bathroom was also nicely decorated with plenty of towels supplied. The owners seemed lovely as well as their little dog and cat who wander about the grounds. A breakfast was also on offer for a reasonable price which you could book on arrival.
hotel_response: Trusting the rest of your travels were safe and exciting!  Thanks so much for the fab review - we really appreciate it!

title: A peaceful quality offering
text:
A lovely host greeted us and guided us through the Bali Suite.  The room was immaculately clean with a lovely bed covered in quality linen.  Small kitchenette adjacent to a large bathroom.  Heating and cooling via a spilt system A/C.  Free wi-fi.  Nice outlook over gardens.  Good sized television.  Cambridge (a lovely town) about 5 minutes drive over the skinniest bridge ever!  Continental breakfast available at minimal extra cost.  No noise leakage from adjoining room.  Car parking adjacent to the room.

We liked Cambridge Coach House and it deserves the good ratings it receives and we would happily stay there again.
hotel_response: Thank you very much - thoroughly enjoyed meeting you both and sincerely hope to see you again one day - all our best wishes for a happy & healthy 2016

title: Quintessential NZ
text: If you are in the area, this is a must stay place.  We only stayed one night but it was the best ever!  I was so sad that we had to take off the next morning first thing.  I so wanted to stay, walk in the gardens and sit and enjoy the spectacular view.  I felt like we were staying with family.
hotel_response: We totally felt the same Janelle - really appreciate the time you've taken to write such a generous review - maybe next time you can stay a little longer! xx

title: Perfection
text:
Stunning property. We stayed in Acacia room, and everything was simply beautiful.
