Excellent value, spotlessly clean and attention to detail showed the owners love what they do. The gardens are extensive and so lovely and we thoroughly enjoyed walking through the grounds.
hotel_response: Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a lovely review Lesley.  We love it when the garden is appreciated, we are so lucky to live in this little paradise!  I know this was your first time to NZ but sincerely hope to see you again one day!

title: NZ holiday September 2015
text:
We stayed here three times,4 nights,3 nights and 1 night, diuring our holiday as we had relatives in the same area. We were allocated all 3 rooms in turn. All were very well equiped,clean,comfortable and welcoming with lovely bathrooms and great showers (including toiletries)The cottage on our third stay was larger and included a dining table and chairs.
Vicki and Carl, our hosts couldn't have been more welcoming and friendly, nothing was too much trouble. We felt like we made new friends!
We had a delicious breakfast provided each morning and no time constraints as to when we could eat!
The location was perfect as our relatives live 2 minutes drive away but Cambridge town centre was also very close and there are plenty of lovely restaurants, shops and amenities.
The setting of the Coach House is beautiful, overlooking scenic countryside.
Thank you Vicki and Carl, you made the North Island part of our trip very enjoyable!
hotel_response:
Firstly I'd like to thank you guys for your lovely big fat booking with us LOL!  We're so pleased you enjoyed the North Island as it was your first trip and trust the South Island was as impressive!
It was indeed a treat to be able to spend so much time with you two and meet some of your family and we sincerely hope to see you again soon.

title: Amazing Accommodation
text: Stayed in the Bali Suite which is beautiful with everything you could need for a relaxing stay.  There are several heating options which were most welcome as we had lousy weather.  Vicky is lovely and made us feel very welcome.  The breakfast was delicious and brought to us the night before so we could enjoy at our leisure.  Perfect location for visiting Cambridge, Hobbiton and Waitomo Caves (we found the accommodation in Waitomo to be a bit basic with paper-thin walls and wish we had booked 2 nights at the Cambridge Coach House and driven the 50 mins to Waitomo in the morning).  Would recommend to anyone, especially couples who like a bit of luxury.
hotel_response: A pleasure to meet you both, albeit short!  Thanks for your generous review and we're so pleased you enjoyed your stay - we to,  wish you could have stayed longer - thanks again, much appreciated

title: Booking cancelled at last minute by manager
text:
We booked the Cambridge Villa in June for a September visit.  Having not received the promised confirmation email, I emailed Vicki myself 8 days before our arrival.  I was surprised to find that our accommodation was no longer available.  Vicki was apologetic and tried to find us alternative accommodation, but I remain extremely disappointed that I had to contact her, and that she did not contact us well in advance of our arrival to warn us of a potential problem and to allow us time to find another place to stay.

We found some accommodation ourselves through the Cambridge website - it is excellent and we would recommend it: Victoria Villas - Dee is extremely helpful and communication was great.
hotel_response: My goodness Susannah, I must say I am rather surprised and disappointed to receive such damaging negativity from you. Of course I understand your disappointment and can only, once again sincerely apologise for the inconvenience. Unfortunately maintenance issues do come up from time to time and cannot be ignored or postponed.  As you know (although you've said the opposite) I went out of my way to secure Victoria Villa for you (thank you Dee) and even offered to pay the difference in tariff, I'm not sure why you have completely discounted this point in your review but I am very pleased you finally enjoyed yourself here in our lovely little town.

title: Luxurious Home away from Home
text:
Vicky is awesome and the rooms are just beautiful, luxurious and comfy. The heater was on when I arrived and nothing was a problem. Yummy breakfast too!
The beds are very comfortable, and the bedding delicious!!
hotel_response: Oh that's sooooo lovely of you!  Thank you so much, nothing makes me happier than to know our gorgeous guests will return next time they're in sunny Cambridge!

title: Excellent Choice
text:
This was our first experience with a home stay/coach house style accommodation and we were impressed.  Vicky was a delight who after a warm welcome gave us the privacy we wanted.  The Bali room is well appointed and offers a very comfortable large bed.  The two heating options are perfect for the room and it was one of the best sleeps we have had away from home.  Great shower and roomy bathroom. 
We will be back.
hotel_response: It was indeed a pleasure to meet you two and delighted you enjoyed your stay, can't wait to see you next time and thank you so much for taking the time to write such a lovely review, it means an awful lot to us :-)

title: A touch of class
text: Stayed here for two nights en route to Taupo.... Wow pure luxury, what a lovely setting. Just a brisk walk away from Cambridge but far enough out for a bit of peace and quiet. Couldn't fault the welcome from Vicky & Karl and would recommend the Coach House to anyone travelling in New Zealand.
hotel_response: Wow David!  Such a lovely review - I LOVE my job because of guests like you two, sincerely hope to see you both again one day - thank you so much!

title: Beautiful setting
text: We stayed here over the busy time of wedding preparation for our daughter.  Vicki was very accommodation with our requests (extra fridge space, hanging up the wedding dress) and we were able to have some lovely photos taken in the gardens.  The pets are friendly as well. The house and grounds are so beautiful, the location was central and being set back from the road, was quiet.  Highly recommended!
hotel_response: We were totally delighted and flattered to be part of your exciting wedding celebrations - thank you Karen you and your family were a treat to meet and we couldn't be happier that you've enjoyed your stay  with us!

title: Lovely spot, lovely hosts and beautiful gardens
text:
Right from the get go, knew this place was going to be great.  I had accidentally booked the wrong night (Sunday instead of Saturday) and Vicki was most helpful in amending the booking for me, no problems at all.

We stayed in the Bali suite and it was really well appointed, with lovely lighting and a hugely comfortable bed. The whole room was decorated in a really tasteful way that had been put together with great thought.  The bathroom was also most excellent, with a massive and powerful shower, and lots of room by the basin to put your toiletries! 

We'd been driving all day, so arrived quite late and were welcomed very warmly by the hosts - and even invited to join them for a drink out on the deck! We also got some good recommendations on where to go for brunch the next day, before we started day 2 of a long drive day. 

In the morning we looked around the gardens which are quite spectacular and again, lots of love and labour have obviously gone into making them look really good. The place is just off a reasonably busy road which I had thought might make it noisy, but didn't hear a thing during the night and barely noticeable during the day. 

And there is a very friendly cat on the prowl, who loves to say hello to guests and receive a bit of love... and do its best to sneak into the room on more than one occasion.

Would definitely stay here again... and this time for a bit longer to really enjoy the space.  One night wasn't long enough!
hotel_response: We'd love to see you both again anytime you're heading this way!  Thoroughly enjoyed meeting you both and many thanks for your fab review!

title: Great Find
text: We stayed in the Cottage, which was well kitted out for a few days stay, microwave, small fridge.  Each day there was a fresh jug of milk for us in the fridge and plenty of tea and coffee.  The gardens, BBQ, and outside seating were a bonus and was the pool. Only five minutes drive from Cambridge ($14 taxi). Really enjoyable stay with huge comfy bed, Vicky was lovely and welcoming. There was a little traffic noise during the day (in the garden) but this died away in the early evening. Would stay there again.
hotel_response: You're a gem Gill!  Thank you for your lovely review, very much appreciated and just delighted you enjoyed your time with us - see you next time :-)

title: WOW
text: We just love Cambridge and this was a very quiet and convenient place to stay. Vicky was a perfect hostess and could not do enough to make us feel at home. The cabins were very nicely furnished and the bed was very comfortable. The grounds were beautifully kept. A real gem.
hotel_response: Wow you!!  Thank you, thank you, thank you!  Delightful to meet you both and thanks so much for taking the time to tell others about us, we really appreciate it :)

title: Beautiful Rural Setting
text: We loved our stay at the Cambridge Coach House. From our room we had a picturesque view of an open green space with flowers and walkways. They had a beautiful little garden path to explore which went down the hillside. The pool was perfect for my boys, and provided a beautiful view of the valley. We were there in the summer, and the air conditioning unit was perfect for quickly cooling down our room.The owners were very helpful and friendly.
hotel_response: Loved having your family stay with us, so pleased everyone enjoyed themselves.  We are most flattered when our guests take time to wander the garden paths and enjoy the summer flush of flowers - thanks so much

title: A hidden gem
text:
This is a boutique property at an affordable price.  They have a cottage and 2 suites, all located separate from the owners house.  We stayed in the cottage which has a comfortable queen sized bed and a sofa bed.  It is one room, separated by a short wall.  There is a kitchenette and TV and it opens onto a lovely garden.  

Best enjoyed when you can sit outside.  

The property is on a hill and has a little traffic noise as heavy vehicles brake going around the hill.  It is  minor and should not put you off.  But it is not an isolated 100% quiet location.

The hosts are excellent and very easy to deal with.
hotel_response: Wonderful to meet you both and hope your trip home was short and sweet!  Thank you for your very kind words, much appreciated.

title: Wonderful Stay
text: Beautiful accommodation in a rural setting yet only 10 mins from centre. Our family booked all the suits but I personally stayed in the cottage. This suit had a Queen bed and a pull out couch which was large and comfortable (it was set up whilst we were out which was nice) and a good sized kitchenette. Only downside was the toilet was leaking onto the floor but we were only there one night for a wedding and didn't have time to bring it up. The Acacia room was gorgeous and so was the Bali suit. These two were connected but separate from the cottage. All the rooms looked out to a grass patch and garden which gave way to views over Cambridge. Little chocolates on our towels, cosy feel, early check in, lovely furnishings and friendly owners made for a great stay. Only wished we had more time to relax and appreciate the place.
hotel_response:
So pleased you all enjoyed your very special night away.  I do apologise for the dampness on your bathroom tiles - the wee tap behind the toilet suite had sprung a leak but we were lucky enough to have a plumber replace it the next day so thankfully no one else was inconvenienced.
Sincere apologies again and if you decide to stay at the Coach House again, there'll be a complimentary brekky waiting for you :)

title: Delightful in every way
text:
A delightful experience, from the first conversation to leaving the following morning.
Absolutely lovely people, beautiful immaculate room, comfortable bed and we loved our stay! The only thing we would change would have been to stay longer... as the pool looked so inviting. 
Thank you for making us feel so welcome.
hotel_response: Couldn't have been more of a pleasure to make you feel welcome, such lovely guests - we are blessed!  Would love to see you again one day when perhaps we can share a glass of wine in the sun :)

title: Lovely guest hosue
text: Stayed here recently with friends - 3 couples in total.  Very lovely guesthouse with beautifully appointed rooms and very cordial hosts.  Stunning gardens surround the house and a seat to stop and smell the roses recommended.  The breakfast was hearty and very well cooked and presented.
hotel_response: Thank you so much!  Hope to see you both again some day

title: Gorgeous accommodation !!!
text: We stayed here for our last night before flying back to Brisbane - wow it was so pretty and Vicki was a lovely hostess who gave us good advice on where to dine that evening...  The room was beautifully presented, and well equipped.  Brekkie was so yum the next morning... I would definitely recommend staying here, wish we had stayed longer.
hotel_response: Too generous of you both!  We wished you'd stayed longer also, pity we didn't have time for a few wines in the afternoon sun - maybe next time!

title: Purrr...fect place in heartland New Zealand
text:
You won't be disappointed if you stay awhile at the Coach house,it is everything you would expect, and more from a top class accommodation venue in one of NZ's most picturesque regions. Tucked away between the rolling hills, the Cambridge Coach House and owner Vicki stand proud as both showcase the classic beauty and character of a bygone era brought to life for all to enjoy.Charming and friendly, the attention to detail is evident with well thought out decor reflecting sophistication and luxury. If you are looking for a romantic week-end away or you are a wary traveller, this is the place for you.

I will be back- Tui
hotel_response: Tui - you rock!!  Loved meeting you and look forward to your next visit :)

title: Outstanding accommodation
text: About 10 minute drive from Cambridge centre. Delightful, well appointed units. Tastefully decorated in either romantic or Asian themes. fabulous beds and linen. Beautiful grounds with pool available. Adequate continental breakfast available.Vicki the owner is very pleasant and attentive.Good car parking. Highly recommended!
hotel_response: So lovely of you to take the time to write such an awesome review - thank you so much and we can hardly wait to see you both again!

title: Home away from home
text: I travel a lot for work and like to have all the comforts of home, this place was just what I needed.  I spent the past 3 nights here and would definitely stay again.  The room was beautiful and had everything I needed for my stay.  Vicki was lovely and didn't seem at all phased when I arrived an hour early.
hotel_response: Delighted to meet you and so pleased you enjoyed your stay, thanks for the fab review!

title: So Beautiful and Affordable
text:
The cottage was beautifully decorated very warm and cosy.
Everything was clean and tidy.
Best bit was the shower we all agreed ( we had to find a reason to get out)
Beautiful gardens and very peaceful 
Very comfy beds and gorgeous sheets (Heaven!!!)
Lovely hosts
hotel_response: Oh WOW!!  You girls rock!  Delighted you enjoyed your stay in the Cottage and thank you so much for leaving it so beautifully - your respect is really appreciated and yes, we'd love to see you next time!

title: Stunning! Absolutely Recommend!
text: One night was just not enough!  My best friend & I & our daughters stayed just recently and were just in love with the rooms - so gorgeous - decorated just beautifully. Everything we needed was provided. Lovely view, beautiful setting, lovely welcoming hosts, Karl & Vicki - what more could you want! We will definitely be back - my 1st choice of places to stay in Cambridge.  :-)
hotel_response: Hi Carole!  Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a lovely review! You girls were an absolute pleasure and we're so glad you enjoyed yourselves - of course we'd love to see you next year for the Stallion Parade and hope you made some excellent contacts for your young Stallion!

title: Rudest Lady I have ever met
text:
We were a little early for check in (an hour), due to having to be at a wedding half an hour later and after driving up from auckland (which took us less time than we thought) we needed to get ready for this occasion. The room was ready but the host was so rude her first words were "you are an hour early" I said yes i was sorry we got here quicker than we thought, she responded with a massive huff and turned around and stormed off, to which we sat in our car for 10 mins while she obviously tried to calm herself down then came and said our room was ready and to come pay the remaining due. There was no offer for the breakfast service as it says they would do in the folder in the room. 

The room was fine, nothing great and certainly not worth $170, maybe in a city not in the middle of nowhere!! We checked out a day early but had already paid for the night, we received a similar response to when we arrived when we told her we were checking out early. Not sure why it was such a problem since we had already paid??? Some friends of ours were also booked to stay in the other room that second night, they had decided they wouldn't stay and never arrived so instead of Vicki calling me to tell me that because my friends didn't check in she still required payment she just took the matter into her own hands and charged MY credit card..!! How dare you!!! That is unauthorized charging of my credit card. I did not agree to that charge on behalf of my friends… A phone call or an email would have been the correct thing to do, just shows how unexperienced and unprofessional this crowd is…I decided i would call her to ask why she has charged my credit card to which she basically rose her voice at me got all pissed off and HUNG UP ON ME…..!!!

I will not be recommending this place to anybody, in fact quite the opposite!!!
hotel_response:
Jaimee, we are very proud of our little business and even more proud to hold Tripadvisors 'Award Of Excellence' 3 years running, we don't achieve that by being rude to our guests.
You arrived here at 12.03 with a truckload of  attitude and without the courtesy of a phone call - check in is at 2pm 
You left without paying for a suite you booked.
I would like to say though, that all other members of your group were totally delightful, respectful and very complimentary about their stay with us and are more than welcome back here anytime.

title: Fantastic B & B!
text:
We stayed at the Cambridge Coach House for 2 nights in June and had such a lovely experience. We felt welcomed, the room is incredibly well equipped, and the view of the countryside is spectacular - next time we come to the area we'll stay here and spend more time at the B & B (we were visiting lots of relatives while in Cambridge)! The B & B has all the modern features of a hotel without the price tag and it was one of the most impressive places we have stayed in New Zealand. The room we stayed in had a fantastic bed, electric blankets, a reverse cycle air conditioner, TV, tea and coffee making facilities, mini fridge, hair dryer and even a heater towel rail (which, in the cold, is a lovely surprise), and when we arrived, we received chocolates to welcome us which was a lovely touch!
We ordered the continental breakfast which was lovely - came with (what appeared to be) homemade fruit compote - and very reasonably priced.
The hotel isn't far for Hobbiton and Rotorua. We travelled to both during a day trip - lots of fun - .
hotel_response: Thank you Alexandra for your lovely review, we are so lucky to have delightful guests like you both staying with us, we loved having you and can't wait to see you next time you're over!

title: Wonderful stay @ cambridge coach house
text:
I recently stayed at the coach house for some days and i was really impressed by the cozy & warm atmosphere. The hosts - Vicky & Carl - :  2 people who clearly understand the word hospitality. 
I travel a lot for work but the treat and the helpfulness of the owners is unique . 
The view you got on the terrace outside over the town of cambridge -waw- something i can't forget . 

Vicky & Carl,  thanks once again for this nice time  !

Greetings from Belgium.

Peter
hotel_response: You're a sweety Pete!  Thanks so much - we loved having you stay with us and look forward to perhaps meeting your gorgeous girlfriend next year!

title: Beautiful Hotel
text:
Last October we visit Cambridge and stay in this hotel. The wonderful classic Kitchen is unforgetable. Breakfast is also very good. Although it's the low season at that time, we all treat very well there.

Good to stay there.
hotel_response: We so appreciate your kind remarks and we're delighted you and your lovely family enjoyed their time here with us.

title: Top End!
text: This property offers very well presented accommodation. We could not recommend highly enough as it's modern, clean and spacious. We would absolutely stay here again and it's very close to the town centre if y are heading out from here.
hotel_response: So lovely of you!  Thank you for your very kind words and let me say we loved having you stay with us and thank you so much for leaving your suite so beautifully - look forward to seeing you again soon!

title: Cozy in the Countryside
text:
Lovely cottages in a countryside setting. Just what we needed after a long flight and then drive from Auckland.  This was our stop over to Hobbiton.  Our hosts were warm and friendly and did everything to make our stay enjoyable; shared information about the area, Hobbiton, restaurants  and weather.  The cottages are very well built (looking to be brand new), furnished with class, comfortable and spotlessly clean. (Lonely Planet described them as chintzy - not at all)  Lovely grounds with gorgeous views and a relaxing pool lounge.  The mini kitchen is well thought out and handy if you need it.  

If you will be having breakfast, please remember this is an additional charge per person.  Also, if you would like breakfast, please inform your hosts before 7pm.  As stated in their room information, they need to know early in the evening so they can bring it to your room before you go to sleep as to have a nice continental breakfast for in the morning, in your room or on your patio.  (The room isn't really suited for dining, but it can be accomplished) Of course, we didn't read this info until returning from dinner around 9pm and it was much too late to order.  Although, if you aren't able to enjoy breakfast at the Coach House, there are many nice restaurants in the quaint little city or on your way to Hobbiton.  

Definitely recommended for a visit.  Just follow the rules to avoid any disappointment.
hotel_response:
Oh dear, I must have slipped up that day, so sorry, we usually ask if breakfast is required so this situation doesn't occur, my sincere apologies but along with that come grateful thanks for your lovely positive remarks - very much appreciated!
Next time you come by, a complimentary breakfast will be waiting for you :)

title: Serenity
text:
We a family of 9 booked 3 room for a night.. stayed here as a stopover to hobbiton before moving down to taupo..upon reaching the property..we were told that the rooms we book were not mean for a big group..nevertheless the owner allowed us to stay with an additional cost..abit dissappointed about that issue..but all rooms are clean..nice garden to walk around..

Didnt get to try the pool..dont know if we are allowed to use it or not..abit of a distance to town if you have no transport..

Overall..a nice place to stay...

Muslim will find it abit challenging to stay here as its scarce to find halal food around here..we got ourself ready..we had cup noodles..

Owner is nice..hoping she would erect one more family rooms so bigger group could enjoy..will return if given opportunity...
hotel_response:
Hi there and thank you so much for reviewing us - I am very sorry to hear that you were disappointed that I charged you extra for two people - I thought you would be pleased that I didn't charge you for the extra 3 adults and 1 baby, who were unexpected and over and above the 6 people you had actually booked for. 
I was most concerned that we had misled you, so I checked our listing on Expedia, which you booked through, only to find that it is quite clear, as on all of our sites, that we charge after the first couple $50 per person.
I do thank you for your kind words about us and thank you all for leaving your suites so tidy, considering the squeeze LOL  I don't think we'll be building another suite any time soon but we could pitch a tent next time you're over :)

title: Wished we could have stayed longer!
text:
We had a very flying visit here - staying one night, arriving quite late and leaving early, as we saw Cambridge as a convenient place to stop en route to Waitomo.  Vicki was so welcoming on arrival and we were pleasantly surprised by the rooms.  They are spacious, well furnished, light and clean.  Lonely Planet described this place as "chintzy" and either they misused the word or they haven't been for a while, as I thought it was classy and tasteful and would be quite annoyed if I were the owners and saw that!  (We stayed in several chintzy hotels in NZ - this was not one of them!)

On arrival, Vicki recommended a few restaurants in town and then kindly offered to book a table for us.  We then came back and enjoyed a drink on our patio before a great night's sleep in a very comfortable bed.  The location of the Coach House is beautiful - I just wish we had had more time (in daylight hours!) to explore!

We had a slight problem with the guest wifi dropping out when I tried to Skype home, I ended up having to sit in the car to use the wifi!, but that is a minor quibble in what was excellent accommodation.  Also the pool closes to guests quite early on - we quite fancied an early evening swim when we arrived but were too late (again a minor point, we just went out for a glass of wine instead!)
hotel_response: Thank you guys so much for taking the time to review us so generously, we hope we'll have the opportunity to show you around the gardens in daylight one day LOL!

title: Excessive road noise
text:
Like a fellow recent reviewer, the recent choice to stay here, based upon tripadvisor reviews was disappointing.  

I have come to the conclusion that the average reviewer in NZ will be harsh on impersonal hotels and generous with individual owner/hosts so take that into account.

For this property, am amazed so few have mentioned the pervasive road noise.  The property is situated above an amazingly noisy road corner.  No fault of the hosts but the garden and swimming pool area although visually pleasant could never be described as peaceful and relaxing.  The windows of the cottages are not double glazed, our first night on turning the TV off, my wife thought a plane was taking off, no, just a large truck passing!  I am a light sleeper and ear plugs were essential.

Our cottage, was very nicely furnished, but what appeared to be a thick luxurious mattress on the double bed, was a spring mattress placed on top of a foam mattress.  Really uncomfortable.

Cambridge is ideally situated for many local attractions, we particularly enjoyed Hobbiton and Hamilton gardens and the accommodation choice is limited so may even return but the frequently gushing praise, in my opinion, overrates this choice.
hotel_response:
Hi there David, thank you so much for passing on your opinion, we are most grateful.  As a light sleeper and coming from a quiet country location yourself, I would have thought, as you did book via our website, that you may have noticed our position on the map, we are on a secondary road in Dairy country so yes, we do have passing milk tankers as do most roads in the Waikato. The Queen bed in the Cottage has a foam mattress with a memory foam mattress on top which we have never had a complaint about in four years and I'd like to point out that Bali & Acacia Suites are double glazed if you ever do return.
We are most proud of our reputation as No 1 in our area and don't receive Tripadvisors Excellence Award two years in a row for nothing. Almost all of our guests who leave reviews are from all over the world and love visiting us as much as we love having them.  However, we are not resting on our laurels but continuing to upgrade and improve things as we can, including the installation of reverse cycle heat pumps and new flat screen TVs just last month.
Thank you again David for the opportunity to clarify things and we sincerely hope to see you again one day.

title: Disappointing!
text:
We used Trip Advisor to choose top rated places to stay on our trip to NZ and until Cambridge Coach House we found the accommodation and service on each occasion to be excellent.  Comparing just the B&B type accommodation (a sample of four places), our hosts at Cambridge Coach House were far less welcoming and far far less accommodating.  

It is clear enough from the website photographs the term “luxury cottages” is used in an extremely generous way. You can also appreciate from those photos that the term “suite” refers to a bedroom with ensuite shower room.  Unfortunately between the time I booked and the time we arrived, I had forgotten the room did not actually have a comfortable seating area that I had come to expect in a “suite”.  There is a choice of sitting on the bed or on dining chairs but this just added to our disappointment.  The two rooms detached from the main house have a light timber construction with giant windows one end that afford zero privacy when your fellow guests walk by.  The premier room is attached to the side of the main house and looks as though it was it could have been converted from a timber garage.  On the positive side the rooms have tasteful decoration and the garden view is pretty.

We have not scored this place highly for value.  If we were to order the breakfasts we enjoyed at the three previous B&Bs we would have needed to choose all three options offered by Cambridge Coach House.  As each option is $20 it makes Cambridge Coach House seem expensive in comparison.  Breakfast is 7.30 to 8.30 am here and even if you try to arrange it otherwise, even with good notice, you may well find that you get a flat unapologetic refusal as we did.  You do get let into the main house at breakfast though, which allows you to see where the best photos on the website were taken...
hotel_response:
Heavens above!!!  We certainly must have got you on a bad day!  We are of course completely mortified that you didn't enjoy yourselves here and felt it necessary to write a volume of negatives about us.  I do apologise for not being able to cook you breakfast at 9.30am, although our breakfast hours are very clearly stated on our website.  We don't include breakfast (also on our website) so our guests can make their own decision and not have to eat breakfast. 
We have never before had a complaint that there is no lounge suite in two of the Cottages, I'm afraid there's simply not room!!??
Now, just to set the record straight - the cottage you refer to as attached to the house, is not and most of our guests love the huge windows and French doors in Bali & Acacia and I think you'll find other guests will have to walk past your room wherever you are staying.  
Thank you anyway James for taking the time to let us have your opinion, we have taken all your remarks very seriously.

title: The perfect place in Cambridge
text:

title: A Charming Retreat
text:
Our 1 night stay in this charming B & B was perfectly enjoyable.  Clean, comfortable & quiet surroundings on a beautiful rural property. It is located perfectly for a trip to Waitomo Caves (about 50 minute drive).   

Unfortunately the free internet was not working & the caretaker hosts were unable to fix the problem despite their best efforts.  We like to plan our next days activities, (directions, things to do, local attractions etc) & this left us a little unprepared for the day, hence my 4 star rating.

Would have liked to have spent more time here & would definitley stay here again.
hotel_response:
Firstly, thank you so much for your kind review and we are so sorry you encountered difficulty with the wifi, had we been here we would have suggested coming into the main house to get a link up to organise your day ahead, we do understand how important that is.  Graham & Janine our stand in Managers did mention their concern to us on our return, we are now organising another repeater to be installed so this doesn't happen again.
Trusting the remainder of your holiday in New Zealand was pleasureable and we do hope to meet you if you're ever back this way.

title: Perfect hosts for a wonderful stay
text:
Cambridge is a lovely, friendly place in beautiful picture-postcard countryside only a couple of hours from Auckland. When we were researching places to stay, the Coach House looked and sounded great, and it lived up to or exceeded our expectations. We are a family of three from Sydney, and thought the cottage was superb accommodation, the breakfast was just what we wanted and the free wifi was very fast and convenient. Vicki's background in design is abundantly evident in the perfect presentation of the rooms and immaculate servicing of them. The Coach House is just a couple of minutes from the main street in Cambridge in a lovely rural location.  How good is it when the wild little rabbits greet you as you turn into the drive.
Cambridge is such an easy drive to the legendary Hobbiton, Waitomo caves, Rotorua, Tauranga and Lake Taupo, it makes for a very nice hub for leisurely sightseeing. On a visit to the Waitomo caves we took Vicki's suggestion to take short walks to the spectacular Marokopa Falls (32km) and Mangapohue Natural Bridge 26km west of the caves, and greatly enjoyed the experience.
We would highly recommend Cambridge as a place to stay, and the Coach House as beautiful, excellent value accommodation in lovely, peaceful surroundings. Above all, the hosts Vicki and Karl just made us feel so much at home, happily gave us any information we needed (Onyx Restaurant and Fran's Café were great recommendations), and did everything to ensure our time at Cambridge was everything you could wish for.
hotel_response: Such a pleasure to meet you and your lovely family Dennis!  I love it when our guests take our advice and thoroughly enjoy the results.  We trust the next leg of your travels was as pleasurable and happy to see you're all home safe and sound. Thanks so much Dennis for taking the time to write such a lovely review of us :)

title: Review of Cambridge Coach House

hotel_response: Wow!  Thank you so much, I'm so pleased Hobbiton was all you expected, as you know, its my favourite!  Wonderful to meet you both and thank you again.

title: Beautiful B&B
text: We just had two nights in this wonderful place, everything the previous reviewer said is true a truly lovely experience. Would recommend to anyone we left here feeling we had known Vicky and Karl for ages they are great people and their attention to detail is brilliant. A joy to have stayed here.
hotel_response: Thanks so much Kath & Doug, for taking the time to review us, we loved having you stay with us and sincerely hope to see you both again someday.

title: Fabulous!
text: Stayed three nights in the 'Bali' Room last weekend to celebrate a special birthday. Had never stayed at a B& B and weren't sure what to expect but loved it. We so enjoyed our time.  What a fabulous environment for a getaway 'spoily' weekend!  From the chocolates on arrival, to the luxurious linen, awesome bathroom...and looking out to beautiful gardens.  And still close to town.  So relaxing; was just the retreat we both needed.  Breakfast by the pool and gorgeous villa was fantastic and all the little touches made it really special, freshly picked flowers, real serviettes, vintage crockery.  A lovely experience, it was amazing and great food!  Thankyou to Vicki and Karl for being great hosts with the perfect blend of hospitality and ability to let their guests retreat and enjoy, next time we'll fit in a drink together!  We felt really looked after. What a great job you do - thankyou guys!  We so enjoyed meeting you and will be back.

title: A wonderful experience
text:
So enjoyed our two night stay in the stylish and comfortable cottage.  We had had a busy time with a family wedding and a lot of sightseeing  so to relax and sit on our little terrace outside the cottage was a delight.  The garden is stunning and there is a pool in which we swam in one evening.
What makes this B&B so delightful is the warm welcome and friendliness of the owners who have the knack of making one feel very at home.
Vicki  recommended supper at Onyx which we enjoyed and as everyone has said , the breakfasts were beautifully presented and delicious.
Just wish we could have stayed longer.

 
Swim
hotel_response: Thank you both so much for such a lovely review, we certainly enjoyed meeting you and spending a little time chatting, thank you Jenny for leaving the Sainsburys Mag - love it, full of foodie tips and ideas!  Take care and we hope to see you again someday.

title: Something special
text: We stayed overnight in the "Accacia" room at the Cambridge Coach House, on our way to conference in Auckland.  Since this was the week of our wedding anniversary, we had decided to treat ourselves to something a bit special for this night. Cambridge Coach House is just out of the township and was easy to find. I loved the decor of the room and ensuite (so romantic with lduring the evening, enjoying the peace an quiet, the beautiful gardens and a lovely home cooked meal.  Vicki and Carl were delightful hosts - we would highly recommend this venue to anyone looking for something a bit different.
hotel_response: Thank you Steph, delightful to meet you both, wish I'd known it was your anniversary prior - there could have been a bit more spoiling up my sleeve haha!

title: Simply the BEST B&B in Cambridge
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our first stay with Vicki and Carl in the "Bali Chalet" - it was extremely well presented and tastefully decorated and the setting of their property is divine.  We enjoyed a swim in the pool and had a few drinks with our hosts before heading off to a local Thai restaurant recommended by Vicki - the food was divine!  We know where to stay whenever we're heading back to Cambridge and would recommend Cambridge Coach House to anyone who is looking for a peaceful retreat!  We've booked another stay later this month and are looking forward to it.
hotel_response: You two are legends! Thank you so much for your awesome review and I thought we were just having a nice time with new friends!  Its great to have had the opportunity to accommodate you several times now and looking forward to cooking dinner for you on Sunday.  Hope the new school is working out well!

title: Great meeting point.
text: Vicki's response to my initial enquiry was warm and welcoming. We'd have liked two rooms but only one was available and she was more than happy for us to park our motorhome in their lovely grounds. Breakfast next morning by the pool was delightful and plentiful. Highly recommend Vicki and Carl's hospitality.
hotel_response: That is such a lovely review thank you Judith!  You and your friends were so easy to please, it was indeed our pleasure and we sincerely hope to see you all again for the next meeting!

title: Lucky find passing through Cambridge
text: We needed a stop within reach of Auckland Airport and a helpful local at the iSite booked here after we selected it from the brochures.  The standalone studio cottage was perfect, Vicki cooked us an evening meal at very short notice and after swimming their pool we enjoyed a lovely, peaceful evening on our patio.  We will certainly return!
hotel_response: Thankyou very much for those kind words.  We too are very pleased you found us and gave us the opportunity of getting to know you both a little.  Hope to see you again sometime.

title: Marvellous service and facilities
text:
Excellent service from the start set the tone for the weekend.  Beautifully presented canapes preceded our departure for our group dinner in town.  The breakfasts were outstanding: stylish presentation, enormous servings if required, and served poolside.  Very memorable.
Our room was elegant, the location peaceful and rural.
hotel_response: Simply fabulous meeting and chatting with you and your lovely friends Alastair and we're so pleased you enjoyed your weekend with us.  You guys are the very reason I LOVE my 'job' haha!

title: Comfort, Hospitality, Location
text: From the initial correspondence with Vicki we felt at home.  She and Karl (and their dogs Grace and Spud) have found a way to blend a homey welcome with a sense of private relaxation.  While breakfast seemed a bit of an extravagance for our budget, I would recommend that you indulge at least one morning as the ambiance sets the tone for a great stay.  This is also a prime location for day trips as we went to Hobbiton, Rotorua, Hamilton Gardens and other nearby destinations.  We will make it a point to stay here again.  When we left, it felt like we were saying goodbye to friends--and I guess we were!
hotel_response: We are very flattered by your kind words Vicky (what a great name!!) haha, and we very much enjoyed your company.  We are pleased you managed to squeeze in so many local attractions but there are still many more we can show you when you return some day.

title: A lucky find
text: We only stayed one night but would have loved to have stayed longer. Highlight was the hospitality and warmth of the reception by Vicky and Carl. We stayed in one of the beautifully appointed cottages which was a real treat given it was so beautifully furnished and decorated.  Vicky has great taste and tremendous attention to detail and the little extras.  From the cottage we looked across to a lovely view of the valley and the garden enticed us to wander and relax with a glass of wine.  Definitely a place to search out and not to miss.
hotel_response: Thank you very kindly for your most flattering review!  We love being out in the garden, pottering around, so when our guests take time to wander through it or even better, take a glass of wine and watch the sun set from the lawn, it makes our hearts sing!  We'd love to see you again one day.

title: Great hospitality
text:
Stayed 2 nights and were welcomed by hosts Carl and Vicky who were delightful. 
This is a bed and breakfast with a difference. We stayed in the Cottage which is separate from the main house that opened onto the attractive garden. The room was beautifully appointed with fine linens and fabrics, tv, cd, kitchen with minibar, very nice indeed.
The breakfast by the pool with friends on a sunny morning was generous and tastefully prepared enjoyed on fine china.
Highly recommended if visiting Waikato and Cambridge.
We will return......
hotel_response: We were so delighted to be chosen to host your very special birthday bash!  Just loved meeting you all and spending time 'helping' you celebrate - look forward to seeing you again soon.

title: Class without Pretension
text: We had the opportunity to stay with our large family at a local motel but could not resist the seclusion and quality of this classy B&B. Our initial hesitation upon arriving at such a beautiful location around the potential for pretentious owners was put to ease upon meeting Vicki and later meeting Karl (who cooks a fantastic breakfast) only cemented the fact that we had made a great decision. A cab to the wedding venue or to the other side of Cambridge cost around 15-20 dollars which we thought was great value. We recommend the Cambridge Coach House without hesitation and will certainly look to return in the near future.
hotel_response: Thank you so much you two!  A pleasure indeed to meet you - it is your lovely friendly smiles that make so easy to LOVE our work here!

title: A night in the Bali
text: My partner and I spent a night at Cambridge Coach House back in September.  I gave him some options and he chose CCH because the bed looked "plush".  It certainly was!  The Bali Suite was lovely, beautifully decorated and our hosts Vicki and Karl very welcoming.  The room was warm, clean and the minibar was very tastefully stocked.  A lovely environment to relax and unwind at the end of the day.  We would definitely recommend it to friends and family.
hotel_response:
We are so delighted that you enjoyed your break away with us!
Thank you so much for taking the time to write such lovely comments about your experience, we truly appreciate it :)

title: Wonderful
text:
Spent 2 nights at the Cambridge Coach House, was wonderful.  Our cottage was lovely and clean, everything we needed, the chocolates on the pillow were a special touch thank you.  Breakfast in the main house was very nice and it was just like talking to an old friend, thank you so much Vicki for making us feel so welcome. 
We hope to be back again one day soon. 
We will regard your place to all our friends.
hotel_response:
An absolute pleasure to meet you both and thank you so much for your lovely kind words.
I really enjoyed our time chatting and I'm only sorry I wasn't there for your last evening with us but I'm sure Karl will have taken the best care of you.
Thank you for the laughs, you both looked so stunning when you left to attend the  wedding, we sincerely hope to see you again sometime.

title: Cosy, charming, we'll be back
text: Just spent a fabulous night at the Cambridge Coach House, and everything was first rate. The rooms, the decor,  the food, not to mention our hosts (human, canine and feline. Highly recommended... my bed was like sleeping on a cloud. We hope to see again. Thank you.
hotel_response: Thoroughly enjoyed getting to know you a little, hope you enjoyed the rest of  your weekend cycling and laughing your way through the Waikato. Of course we'd love to have you visit us anytime!

title: A fabulous treat!
text: Our second stay at this warm and welcoming place, a thoroughly enjoyable experience yet again. From the comfortable rooms,the mouthwatering food, the obliging pets and the lovely owners - I can totally recommend this home away from home.
hotel_response: You're a treasure Izzy!  Loved having you girls to spoil, can't wait to see you next year - the 'babies' will miss you!

title: B&B More an experience
text: I've been twice over the past two years & will continue to return as often as I can. If a place can change a "die hard sleep under the stars" veteran like me to a "well I never", imagine what to expect from people who like their comforts. It begins with the warm welcome from Vicky & Carl to staying in either the gorgeous themed rooms or (as it was this year) four of us sharing the cottage. The setting is so ethereal,relaxing & tasteful. Apart from stealing Vicky's superb relish recipe, I've copied a lot of Carl's landscaping designs. The breakfast choices are beautifully presented & this year we had dinner as well. If the weather allows, there is dining on the patio beside the pool or as in our case we ate in their house which is a comfy,quirky kiwi colonial. The atmosphere is one of peace. I've never returned to a place in my travels but more than happy to state I'll be back again & again. It's become like visiting friends. Oh and the rates are very very reasonable. This place is addictive.
hotel_response: My goodness!  Vicki, thank you so much!  Such praise is so appreciated especially when you girls were such a treat for us to spoil!  Lovely to see you all again and sincerely hope to catch up again next year - I so love it when people enjoy my cooking!!!

title: Delightful
text: I am so pleased to have arranged our one night stay with Karl and Vicki (although we never met Karl! ;o))  Vicki was waiting for us even though we were rather late arriving - thank you! The Bali suite was just perfect, but THAT garden!!!! Wow!! Loved it, felt truely at home!  Was made to feel so welcome, with a beautiful breakfast for two.  We will certainly be back and keeping in touch!  :O)  Thank you so much Vicki.
hotel_response: Thank you so much Chrissy, what a pleasure to meet such lovely people as you and Grant!  Hope you made your meeting on time and we sincerely hope to see you both (and the kids) another time soon! Take care and have a great Xmas

title: Lovely B&B
text: We stayed in the Bali suite for one night. We were really impressed by the decor of the room - simply gorgeous! Everything we needed was in the room and the bed was very comfortable. The owners were very friendly and helpful and even offered to post us something we'd left behind. The surroundings are peaceful, so it feels like the countryside, yet it isn't too far from Cambridge. It was a wonderfully relaxing place for a getaway, and I would definitely recommend it to others. Thanks!
hotel_response: So happy you both enjoyed your stay - despite the weather, a pleasure meeting you and thank you also for leaving you suite in such perfect condition - looked like no one had stayed LOL!  I'll pop your parcel into the post tomorrow as its a public holiday today.

title: Cambridge's hidden gem
text:
We stayed at the cottage and absolutely loved it from the moment we walked in the door.  Everything was clean, tidy and provided for.  The hosts Vicky and Karl were superb, friendly and down to earth.  They treated us like family.  This was the best B&B we've ever stayed at.  Would go back again and again :)

P.S Even Spud and Gracie (family pet dogs) were friendly and welcoming!
hotel_response: Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a lovely review, we so appreciate it and can hardly wait to meet the remainder of your delightful family in January. Spud and Gracie miss the cuddles they love so much from Stephanie!

title: The Best B&B we have ever been to!
text: From the moment we first contacted the Cambridge Coach house we knew we were in for a  treat. Friendly and exceedingly swift email response to make our booking and order a meal for our first night. Upon arriving we were made to feel extremely welcome. The room was beautiful (we took the 'cottage' suite but they all looked amazing) and the attention to detail throughout our stay was first class. Food was fantastic (both dinner and breakfast) and our hosts couldnt have done more for us-Including sending us the recipe for an amazing berry crumble! We will be back to visit Vicki and Karl again, and would recommend the Coach house to anyone looking for a luxury, elegance and great service at an extremely reasonable price.
hotel_response: Absolutely our pleasure to spoil you both - we feel so lucky to have been chosen to host you on your very special and rare weekend away together - sincerely hope to see you again and thankyou so very much for your dazzling review :)

title: Luxury cleanliness B&B with friendly host
text: We stayed in Bali room for our 10th anniversary trip. The room is very beautiful, it is also very clean, no doubt Vicki has put so many efforts to make the room more than comfortable for the guests. She is very attention to details which make our stay very relax and enjoyable. The B&B is best of the best!
hotel_response: Wow!  Thank you so much!  What a lovely review, you were so easy to please and we loved the opportunity of meeting and talking with you both! Sincerely hope we meet again!

title: "Gorgeous Spot"
text: Stayed here a year ago on our honeymoon and loved it so much we came back to stay a year later for our anniversary! Beautiful country spot, lovely hosts, handy to Cambridge, gorgeous rooms to choose from, beautiful gardens and excellent service! Best B&B we've been to! Perfect for anyone looking for a place to stay around Cambridge:)
hotel_response: We are totally flattered that you chose us, not only for the most important night of your lives, but also for your 1st anniversary!  Thank you so much for your very kind words, you are both an absolute pleasure to spoil!

title: Our Perfect Wedding
text: Ian and I (Angela), chose this beautiful location for our wedding day,from our computer in England. Imagine, then our pure delight at seeing this wonderful oasis,and, meeting Vicki and karl our hosts who could have done nothing more to make our wedding weekend perfect. A marquee was errected and decorated by Vicki as a suprise, and the arbour in the beautiful gardens was to be our alter, perfect in every way. Our party of 6 were catered to in every way possible even to Karl taking up a camera and clicking away for posterity, marvellous.  The 3course dinner was as good as any restaurant we had been to and service was impeccable.Our rooms were stunning with touches of love on the pillows, and sumptuous towels to wrap up in, and comfort was the order of the day in the big sumptuous beds As young mature people we had been married before, but,never in such beautiful surroundings and with as much hospitality, warmth, love and thought for our every need by our wonderful hosts Vicky and Karl. We intend to return to renew our vows in this wonderful warm loving place. We look forward very much to seeing you both again. As well travelled people we would reccommend this venu a 10 star it was just so perfect in every way - Thank you for making our day so vry special Vicki and Karl.
hotel_response: Such an absolute honor to be chosen to host your gorgeous wedding.  We are delighted you were happy with everything and so look forward to seeing you both again some time soon.  Thanks very much for taking the time to review us, we are most flattered!

title: A Hidden Gem
text: We only had one night to fill as we headed west towards the Waitamo Caves from the Bay of Plenty and we found the Cambridge Coach House almost by chance. Lucky we did, as this is a classy little B&B (just 3 rooms) run by a delightful couple, Vicki and Karl, who both have a great sense of humor. The location is on top of a hill outside Cambridge, down a long private driveway and only very slightly impacted noise-wise by the road below. The rooms, separated from the main house, are well-furnished and very comfortable and the modern bathroom has a great shower. Breakfast was excellent, served outside on the patio next to the pool. Vicki is a charming hostess and full of suggestions on what to see and where to go. We would definitely stay there again.
hotel_response: Wow, Rod, thank you so much for that glowing review!  You were both an absolute pleasure to accommodate and we love the fact that you took all my advice and had a fab time here in the sunny Waikato!  Sincerely hope to see you again some day.

title: Wonderful location, accomodation and hosts
text:
From the first contact via hotels.com to our arrival the hosts make you feel so welcome it is hard to leave.  We booked one night but stayed two.  Breakfast was delicious and the ambiance and the location of the separate cottages opening out onto the gardens is surperb.  We will definitely return and have no hesitation in recommending anyone to stay at the Cambridge Coach house.  .

Jeff & Chrissy

title: Excellent stay, lovely hosts
text:
We stayed for a week and didn't want to leave!! lovely setting and location, clean rooms, great service nothing was a problem. superb breakfasts it was hard to choose what to have and lovely setting eating on the deck. dinner there was also a bonus definitely better than a restaurant. the hosts are  lovely people, great company it was sad to leave . + great passionfruit vine!
definitely worth the visit the best place to stay in the waikato!

title: A fantastic place to stay, beautiful location and amazing service.
text: We stayed in the Cottage and it was like an oasis. Beautiful sunny weather, amazing facilities and the best hosts you could ask for. We were attending a wedding and when we asked to book a taxi Vicki insisted she drive us herself! I would recommend staying here anytime and what a beautiful spot for an intimate get away.

title: Feeling Right at Home
text:
After a fun day of caving at Waitomo everyone said, "stay in Hamilton". But I couldn't really find anything there that seemed to feel cozy and comfortable.  That's when I looked at a map, saw that Cambridge was on our route, and discovered the Cambridge Carriage House.

What a treat.  Karl and the dogs greeted us when we arrived exhausted and grungy from our caving day with warmth and humor.  We checked into the Acacia Suite and settled in for a relaxing and comfortable evening.  The room is beautiful and spacious and is a steal at the rates they are charging.

Breakfast by the pool the next morning was delicious and to tell the truth we would have loved to stay the day and just hang out.

Stay here if you have the chance

title: Fantastic Kiwi Hospitality
text: Vicki and Karl were perfect hosts from start to finish.The rooms were spacious ,extremely comfortable and spotlessly clean.The setting was gorgeous and very secure. The breakfast was delicious with creamy scrambled eggs,crispy bacon and home made chutney with a beautifully set breakfast table with linen and fine china. Don't look any further for comfort amd value if your looking in this general location. /Steve and Dave

title: Best we found in NZ
text: We booked this at short notice as a stop between New Plymouth and Auckland and we were glad we did. Easily the best accommodation we stayed in during our trip to NZ despite the price being similar to all the others. As others have mentioned the breakfast, served by the pool, was excellent and Vicki was the perfect host

title: 3rd visit
text:
It has been my third stay in the coach house and everything was like before : PERFECT
Very good hosts, clean rooms, nice service, nice city

title: Wonderful Place
text: We decided to stay at Cambridge Coach House for our wedding night. The owner's were very friendly and extremely accommodating. They enabled us to decorate the room as we wished and even added some of their own finishing touches! The rooms were very clean and comfy and breakfast on the patio was delicious. We would definitely recommend it highly to everyone who wants a taste of the beauty of rural Waikato.

title: Total relaxation
text: Fantastic and relaxing setting, Very friendly hosts with exceptional service.... Poached eggs were the best I've eaten!

title: OUTSTANDING
text: In essence, you should believe all of the good things that other reviewers have said about the Cambridge Coach House, it is very good, it is outstanding value, the best we experienced during a 30 day stay in NZ. Vicki and Karl are wonderful hosts, they are a great team and I know that they are working to make the Coach House even better. My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed everything it had to offer including the pool which we used at every opportunity during our 2 night stay. We look forward to returning one day, on our next trip to NZ, what a great country it is.

title: Absolute Gem!
text: Thankyou Vicki and Karl (and Spud and Gracie). I can say without a doubt that this was the best place we have ever stayed in. Stunning settings, beautiful accomodation and the best cooked breakfast this side of the hemisphere. We will definatly be back.

title: Great place to stay
text:
We spent four nights at the Coach House - for a family occasion. Set in lovely grounds we loved our stay in the cottage. Friends stayed in the other
two well appointed rooms situated in the grounds.
Vicki and Karl were very helpful and hospitable and served us a wonderful
breakfast each morning, which we enjoyed on the deck.

title: Best stay in New Zealand
text: Vicki and Karl B&B was GREAT.  Best place we stayed in our 2 week trip to NZ North Island and best breakfast we had in the two week on the Island.  The pictures can not show how great the place is...

title: A delightful stay
text: This B&B looked lovely from the Internet photos - but the photos don't do justice to this spectacular setting and beautifully fitted rooms/ home. Vicki and Carl were extremely helpful and hospitable to us, as 2 cyclists arriving from Auckland on our NZ North Island tour. The rooms are tastefully decorated, clean and provided every convenience required. Breakfast was served with style! And provided a delicious and sustaining start for the next leg of our cycle journey. We'd have absolutely no hesitation in recommending this B&B. Prepare to be surprised and delighted.

title: Wonderful place to stay!
text: We stayed at the Cambridge Coach House in September 2011 and immediately loved it!  It's a bed and breakfast situated in the beautiful countryside  a few hours south of Auckland. The rooms were lovely,  and complete with every comfort-even an honest-to-gosh coffee maker for this desperate American! The owner, Vicki, was sweet and friendly and cooks a terrific breakfast-all for a reasonable price!  We were very pleased and would love to return some day.

title: Simply Excellent!
text: What a wonderful little find, a spectacular rural location but still so close to town. Our rooms were beautifully decorated, clean and comfortable, the scenery simply stunning. However, the icing on the cake had to be Karl and Vicki, who were friendly, helpful and accommodating in every way (not to mention great cooks, the breakfast was superb!). Our only disappointment was that we couldn’t stay here longer, but we would definitely visit again!! Highly recommended!

title: "Hosts with the most"
text: We stayed at the cambridge coach house as we were attending a friends wedding down in cambridge, as we arrived we were greeted by the lovely hosts Karl and Vickki who showed us to our room The Bali suite what an amazing room, very beautifully decorated and the most comfy bed. We were heading back into town to the wedding reception and asked vicki for a taxi number and they very kindly offered to drive us into town, and even offered us a couple drinks with them before we left and some great conversation. We awoke after the best sleep ever and went explored their awesome landscaped gardens and went to have breakfast in their home which is to die for, the oven in the kitchen itself blew our minds. The breakfast was so delicious best scrambled eggs ever and vickkys homemade chutney was so good. By far the best place we have stayed in, and what makes it so good is the welcoming hosts karl and vickky would have loved to have stayed longer. Will definately be staying there again, hopefully soon.

title: Wonderful B&B with Wonderful Hosts to Match
text:
We recently stayed at Cambridge Coach House for one night and had a lovely time. We stayed in the cottage which was spacious and beautifuly decorated. The hosts Karl and Vicky couldn't have been more accommodating, with Vicky even giving me painkillers for a sore throught. Our breakfast was delicious, best scrambled eggs of our trip! Thanks Karl.

Nick, Gen, Mark and Kim

title: Excellent all round
text: This B&B is in a nice tranquil setting but just a short drive from the town centre. Immaculate and modern rooms, lovely service and the breakfast would put a lot of cafes to shame. You can't go wrong here.

title: Would have liked to have stayed forever
text: This was an amazing place to stay.  Absolutely loved this place.  It could not have been better - a fantastic cottage, beautifully appointed, wonderfully decorated and lovely touches make for a wonderful stay.  The breakfasts are brilliant, yummy and served in a gorgeous setting, whether you are indoors or out by the pool.  Could happily have spent our whole NZ trip just staying here.  Loved it.  Very highly recommended.  Thank you Vicki - don't change a thing.

title: Great place to stay
text: The Cambridge Coach House is located just outside Cambridge, on a rural road. The setting is lovely - there is a view over Cambridge and a wide expanse of lawn - and the standards impeccable. Vicky is an absolute sweetheart and did everything she could to make us feel welcome and at home. Her eye for detail is amazing, as are her cleaning skills - the place is spotless! The only thing that prevents this from being a five-star review is the fact that the bed I slept in was very hard and not terribly comfortable, which was a shame as everything else was perfect. Highly recommended for anyone staying in the Waikato.

title: Cozy, Comfortable and Friendly
text: This is  B & B accommodation (but they do provide dinner upon request) with a cooked breakfast included in the rate. They have 3 little cottages on the property, two are just a room with an en suite and another is a larger cottage. I stayed in the Bali Room (they all have their own names), it was tastefully decorated, it was warm and clean. The hosts, Karl and Vicki are friendly and welcome you into their home - which is an 1890's original Coach homestead  which has been tastefully renovated. Certainly worth a stop over if you are visiting the Waikato region. The breakfast was good too!

title: Amazing Truly Delightful B&B
text:
This wonderful B&B is truly a delight to visit. The hosts Vicki and Karl suit this place perfectly. If you are a motorcyclist like myself  you would be heading to the right spot as these people are bike enthusiasts there selves, and assure me that like minded people are very welcome. The rooms are wonderfully decorated, the beds and linen is heavenly and the surroundings are the great. The family pets which is a large dog called Spud and a cheeky Cat are also very friendly. It is very central to lots of out lying areas you can explore.
I cant recommend this B&B enough. I would gladly go back there any day, or move in would be another option perhaps,  lol

title: Absolutely as Advertised!
text: My husband and I spent one night with Vicki and Karl on a recent horse buying trip to Cambridge.  Having had some interesting experiences finding B&Bs on the internet, this one was absolutely as advertised.  Vicki was warmly welcoming when we arrived somewhat early and somewhat damp from trying horses - a warm shower and a great recommendation for a lunch spot that worked well for my husband's gluten intolerance, soon fixed that.  After a very peaceful night, next morning, we had a fabulous breakfast on the deck in the sun overlooking their pool and Cambridge.  So easy and so relaxing!  Happy to recommend and will stay there again when we visit Cambridge or Hamilton!

title: Absolute perfection !!
text:
Although we could only afford the time of one night at Coach House, we were so impressed with the friendliness of Karl and Vicki and it is quite evident they both enjoy the B&B experience of meeting travellers ( althougfh we are are NZ ders.

Most importantly, the room we had ( The Bali Room ) was IMPECCABLY clean and well maintained ( quite nes as we undestand it...18 months ?)..and the bed VERY comfortable and the shower clean and good pressure.

We were also lucky enough to have dinner with these charming hosts and excellent Chefs!..Lamb...so yummy!

Clearly Coach house is conveneantly located in the horsey district of Waikato but close also to the Coromandel Pininsula so that you can easily use them as a base for day trips..so no need to pack up and move on..we should have stayed longer!

Absolutely spot on!..Thnaks Karl and Vicki!
Paul and Barb

title: Two nights at our best accommodations in New Zealand.
text: Vicki and Karl are wonderful hosts, who went out of their way to make us feel at home --- even providing my husband with a bicycle to ride. They really cared about our comfort and provided a superb breakfast by their lovely pool with its great view. The recently built cottage was clean, roomy, private and modern. We enjoyed chatting with Vicki and Karl over a glass of wine. This was our most enjoyable accommodation during our six weeks of touring in New Zealand and staying at many lovely places.

title: perfection with all the touches
text:
We stayed for one night and it was absolutely everything we could have asked for.  Room was great, spotless and beautifully decorated.  Friends stayed as well in two other rooms and all were equally delighted. Breakfast as you overlook the river in this peaceful environment was spot on, the little touches are cool.  Carl and Vicky are a fun, charming couple who make great hosts. They were extremely helpful, even ran our friends up to the wedding when in a rush.

WIll stay again for sue, cool pad!

title: Fabulous rooms, breakfast and hosts!
text: The Cambridge Coach House is a relaxing, beautifully presented property. Vicki and Karl are natural hosts. We felt totally at home. This is an absolute gem all round!

title: Absolutely Fabulous
text:
Located just outside of the center of Cambridge, this place is amazing, I thoroughly reccommend staying here.  The rooms are spotless, bathrooms huge, and the grounds are beautiful.  Breakfast was delicious.  

Vicki and Karl have gone to great lengths to make this place beautiful and comfortable at the same time.  Guests are treated like family friends.  I definitely reccommend staying here.

title: Awesome B&B
text:
We had a lovely stay at a beautiful B & B in Cambridge.
Vicki and Kyle greeted us with a glass of wine and were wonderful hosts.
We had traveled from the Hamilton area and had been to the caves in Waitomo.  
Vicki prepared a delicious meal that night.  The next morning we enjoyed a breakfast beside their pool on the deck overlooking the perfectly manicured garden.
The accomodations were comfortable and decorated very nicely.
I would definately recommend at stay with Vicki & Kyle!

title: Quiet, bucolic setting and warm, friendly hosts
text: This B&B on the North Island of New Zealand offers travelers a wonderful opportunity to spend the night in a comfortable, well-decorated suite and then breakfast in a handsome kitchen/dining area. There is a nice choice of three types of breakfast and meanwhile, gracious hosts Vicki and Karl provide interesting advice and information. They are bikers so this might be an ideal place for people biking through gorgeous NZ to stay. Although their home is located a bit off the beaten track outside of Cambridge, the rural setting with plentiful acanthus, a swimming pool, and lovely views is restful and restorative after a busy day of sight-seeing. (The Waitomo Caves are nearby.)

title: A comfortable, beautiful home away from home
text: A beautifully furnished, comfortable room, pleasant gardens, delicious breakfast and friendly, helpful hosts. I would stay there again and recommend to anyone. Good value for money.

title: PERFECT accommodation
text:
We stayed at Cambridge Coach house the night before my friends wedding and it couldn't have been more perfect. The rooms were exquisite with every detail luxurious and perfect and the grounds were stunning.

We were made to feel so welcome by Vicki, enjoying dinner and wine on the deck and waking to an amazing breakfast on the day of the wedding.

Vicky went out of her way to make our stay wonderful which helped make getting ready stress free and fun.

Would recommend this B&B to anyone who wants a luxurious break with the best host I have ever experienced.

title: Wonderfully Relaxed
text: This was our second stay at the Cambridge Coach House and we were warmly welcomed yet again by our hosts, Vicki & Karl. Our last visit had been made in the sunshine and we had enjoyed the wonderful grounds and pool (a luxurious setting for a delicious breakfast  or pre-dinner drinks!!). This time the weather was not so kind but the hospitality more than made up for it. We enjoyed the comfortable accommodation and the relaxed but attentive care of Vicki & Karl. The area also offers some great activities including market days and cycling along the new Karapiro cycleway. We are really looking forward to our next stay at the Cambridge Coach House and would warmly recommend it to any travellers from NZ or overseas.

title: Brilliant service, perfect location
text:
We travelled to Cambridge with friends to check out the newly built cycleway to the Lake Karapiro and decided to stay in the Cambridge Coach House (our friends have recommended it to us). The weather was not very good, but we still managed to get to the lake and enjoyed the Maori Whaka race. We came back to the Coach House dripping wet. It was wonderful to have a hot shower and then to enjoy very nice dinner prepared by our hosts Karl and Vicki. They turned out to be extremely friendly and intelligent people. The cleanness and comfort of this place is just sensational. They also have a nice swimming pool, and do not forget - it is only a short distance by bike (10km) from their place to Lake Karapiro. We had a great time!
Viktor

title: Great Vicky and Karl
text:
We discovered this B&B through the i site in Cambridge, NZ.
For our best luck, a room was available and we unfortunately spent only one night. The hospitality of our hosts was great and charming. The rooms and bathrooms are very confortable and nice looking. All was prepared for your satisfaction. We were lucky enough to share with Vicky, Karl and a couple of their firends a wonderful and delicious Xmas Breakfast.
We do highly recommend to stay there if you pass by Cambridge NZ.

title: Friendliest service in the world
text: I travel for work, domeatically and internationally. I have for years. Seldom,  if ever actually, have I met a manager like Judith. She was generosity personified, uber professional and a delight as a human too. Ably backed by John the gentleman  this recently refurbished establishehment as abvery lucky find during a busy fieldays season. Q0 out of 10 would stay again (or will follow Judith whereever shebgoes next)

title: Poor Experience
text:
When we arrived I discovered that there was no soap in the bathroom, my wife asked the young lady from reception for some soap - she said she would bring some to us. Over an hour later, we went to organise our dinner, my wife asked again for soap and was told that housekeeping had run out. 
As for dinner, we along with a group of 30 were meeting for dinner, because there were so many of us we had been advised that we would have a choice of 3 meals - roast pork with vegetables, lamb chops with vegetables or fish (pan fried, battered or crumbed) with salad and chips - we ordered at 6.20pm and I got my roast pork an hour later, my wife had ordered the crumbed fish and finally settled for pan fried at 8.10pm after they tried to give her the wrong meal three times (there was no apology).
For dessert, we had both ordered apple crumble, when my wife’s was brought out one was put in front and then quickly snatched away and told that one is not for you - another dish was slapped down with melted ice cream for her. 

One of our group had to wait until almost 9pm for their main meal. 

No discount was offered for the mess up!

The only reason I give 2 stars is that breakfast the next morning was much better.

title: Family wedding accommodation
text:
Aaron Court is in a great location, central to Hamilton CBD, a short walking distance to a number of yum cafes along Grey Street.
The super king size bed was so very comfortable. The spa bath an added bonus.
Friendly and helpful staff
We have stayed here previously and can highly recommend

title: Needs a tidy up…fantastic chef though😎
text:
Lack of maintenance in the rooms is pretty obvious. The rooms are well appointed, but need to be updated. 
Things like bathroom mirrors cracked from one side to the other, and when brought to owners attention, response is “oh yeah, I know...”, but after a few months, still not fixed. Things like that.
Brilliant staff, awesome meals.
 At the end of the day, my employer pays for my accommodation, so it’s all good. 🤙

title: Wonderful Management!
text: We had booked to stay here while in Rotorua but we did not have a contact number.  We arrived late in the afternoon and it turns out that there was a water problem with the suite that was earmarked for us and the the Inn was full.  No being able to contact us the management at Aaron Court arranged for alternate accomodation for us at a nearby, quite new motor inn - a bit more expensive but Aaron Court took care of that.    Too bad as the newer units at Aaron Court looked quite nice.  Hard to rate the property as we didn't stay but kudos to their management -  we sure appreciated their looking after us.

title: Awesome
text: Absolutely awesome clean tidy room. Even got a free upgrade from small room with bath to big room with a spa bath and 2 extra beds. The fan in the bathroom didn’t work but no worries. Opened the windows and it was fine. Outstanding service will return

title: Like me,a bit tired!
text:
Used this motel as a base for one night to do a family pickup from Whatawhata. I didn't book the unit, if i had might have stayed at a different place.
Showing it's age, very outdated decor and old fashioned fittings. Bathroom mirror peeling away at the edges, no plug for main basin( there was 2 so had to use the secondary one,a bit strange). 
Having said that, the room was very roomy, comfortable bed, Sky tv and airco if required( didn't need it so wasn't tested.)
Wifi wasn't an issue as i had my own.
Quite a bit of noise(talking mainly) and had an experience of someone banging on doors at about 1am, mine included, don't know what that was all about but sister next door didn't hear it,maybe it was a dream.
Restaurant on site which was very handy, food was nice but service slightly lacking, topic of a separate review.   
Motel is on motel mile with good access, check-in not manned but a phone call from the reception soon got some attention.

title: Pretty Good
text:
We stayed 2 nights the room was good,  comfortable and clean but had a very strong smell of what smelled like odour remover which was very over powering.
I couldnt get the spa bath to work and we had to have our jug replaced, breakfast we ordered had been forgotten about on the morning we needed to be gone by 7.30.
Reception was very friendly motel is close to town and short drive to the base . very well appointed and  a comfortable place to stay, even has a pool for the hot summer months. Would definately stay again 😊

title: Cheap but needs work
text:
Booked here last minute. Good price but that reflected the quality of the accommodation.
Very dated, smelled old and musty. Bathroom was mouldy - tile and non slip mats mouldy(accessible unit). Cockroaches had made their way in from the garden. Paint chipping of cupboards and doors. Curtains (full length) hard to close/open and were mouldy in places. heating was a small radiant heater which had to be left on constantly to keep the room warm. Bed was comfortable. Kitchen sink was in the bathroom. Didn't feel comfortable eating or preparing food here. Very disappointed. Would not stay here again or recommend.

title: Only used for conference
text: Place is ok, a bit dated (toilets etc.) Wifi is the massive issue. Slow as dial up and limited coverage. Have had to tether the two times I've been here. Good to see they had extension cords set up for out laptops.

title: Great service but requires maintenance
