text: I found the staff at reception very helpful and they always greeted me with a smile.  The room was great for what I needed and I appreciated having a kitchenette.  While I understand this was just a standard room, I did wonder if anybody had stayed in it recently or used the facilities, because there were a lot of broken things.  The toaster would not work.  The plug for the sink had a big hole in the centre of it so was not much use!  Quite a few of the lights had blown bulbs, or bulbs were missing.  The alarm clock would not work at all.  One of the pillows had almost no filling, so we had to get it replaced.  The fry pan was not working properly.  There was not enough crockery for the number of people staying in the room.  The staff addressed my concerns in a friendly fashion, but some of the things were fixed or replaced while others were not.  A good maintenance check would have resulted in a much higher review from me for this property.

title: Another great stay
text: We come up to Hamilton regularly for grandsons surgery. Room is large and plenty of room for all of us. Staff are always friendly. Location is great for us. The main bed could do with an upgrade as could the shower.

title: Dated but good !!!
text:
Aaron Court was very dated but clean and tidy and staff were friendly. The breakfast and dinner meals were very good and priced reasonably, the only negative would be the shower was dated but had good water pressure the bed was dated and sagged in the middle ( well used one would imagine) and the toilet seat/lid looked pretty old and crusty the plastic was yellow in colour when it should be white . 

Over all it suited my needs but really could do with an overhaul by up dating the rooms .

title: good stay
text: nice clean centrally located place. Was a bit disappointed that there was a towel from the previous visitors in our room. Also waited over an hour for breakfast at the restaurant otherwise enjoyable stay. Very close to stadium.

title: Friendly service
text:
Staff kindly allowed an early check in time (30 mins) and upgraded to 2brm apartment.
Very friendly service.
The room was large which was great.
Points to improve:
The fridge froze our food
The shower was dreadful 
The bed was very old and sagged

The unit was clean and comfortable and good value for money in quiet location.

title: Very accommodating
text: We have stayed here 4 times now. 2 nights at a time.  Receptionists and owner have always been friendly. As there are usually 5 of us it is value for money for us. And has everything we need while we are there.

title: Great place
text: Great place to stay for myself and friend for weekend away out of Auckland  and very affordable everything you need and only a short drive to cbd comfortable beds little kitchenette outside chairs swimming pool laundry restaurant what more could you want

title: Rude rude rude
text:
Worst service I have ever experienced. Very rude owners !! I was over charged 60$ and when I went to confront them , they hang up on me and I was told to shut up. I can't believe how rude they where. I have be scammed $60 and they are not giving my money back. 
Don't give this hotel a chance.

title: Let's not talk about it
text:
Receptionist almost booked us in as another person. His company would not have been pleased if our bill had gone to them. Room very tatty, paint chips on almost every surface. 7:30 and the unbelievable racket of road saws, grinders, planers and black top trucks revving woke us from our slumber. Apologies and a free breakfast offered and accepted but the day had already been ruined. Temporary exit via rear entrance as front now blocked off whilst the resurfacing set and entry to our room via the restaurant kitchen. Main road noise continued well into the night and any silence was filled in by the local boy racers using both the side road and the main road as a practise 'who can do it faster' track with the exhaust switch set to max.
Upside, the in house restaurant was good otherwise 2 stars would now be one star.

title: Enjoyable Stay
text: Up stairs studio, open plan bedroom  1 room with a pleasant view over the pool.  I have stayed at this venue a couple of times and because of the clean pool and great service (receptionist Kimberly) I will be back again, it has never disappointed my expectations. This was a last minute reservation which I paid a little more then I usually would when staying here.

title: bit of a let down
text: smoke detector went off and when we told them they were like well no one really cooks in here.  The rooms clean.  My mum however did have a expensive necklace go missing from the room and they didnt seem to give to hoots about it.  Spa pool was not that hot.  Rooms were very loud from people upstairs.

title: We had four rooms
text: We were in Hamilton because my daughter was in a serious car accident. We stayed in comfortable rooms with excellent beds and very clean bathrooms and kitchens for eight nights. The management accepted our extensions to bookings in their busiest time of the year with kindly concern for my daughter. The pool was clean too.

title: Misleading
text:
Very dissapointing. Place is tired and worn out.
Old tv that didn't work, dirty pool and worst of all, advertising that there is a restaurant on the premises BUT it's closed down!
Perhaps they should update their website and information in the rooms "advertising the restaurant".

Beds uncomfortable and no extra pillows provided.

The who place needs an upgrade.

title: Woldnt recommend
text: Poor standard of accomodation pretty dated decor and saggy looking bed....impeccably clean as evidenced by the cleaninng rags left in the bathroom. We decided to find alternative accomdation having been advised there would not be a charge for the booking by check in staff. Sadly despite this reassurance we were charged full price and the venue was not willlling to reimbuse this despite being offered a reasonable time frame to negotiate a solution.

title: Best place I have stayed in New Zealand
text:
I have stayed in hotels and motels  from Auckland  to Wellington. Out of all of them  Aaron Court Motel  Is by far the best  . 
The  room was warm comfortable clean and just what I wanted for my family. 
Service  was fantastic .  And staff friendly. The Chefs chicken meal  amazed me not many places can keep chicken   tender  . My son loved the pool and the big spar.  This place is value for money and I'm coming back with friends soon.

title: Tired
text:
The double bed was more tired than we were after the poor night's sleep, tolerable on your own in the middle but as a couple it sloped towards the edges
The single beds were as hard as concrete
The shower looked like the tardus and leaked more water than the titanic out of the one door that wasn't screwed shut - huge step down onto tile floor that then had water running towards the toilet that the seat was falling off - room so steamed up because the extract fan wasn't working just buzzing away with a seized motor
Room was clean and bedding felt to be clean and of good quality

title: Handy restaurant right on the premises.
text:
I've stayed here in the past prior to it's update and the main drawcard for me was the restaurant right there in the premises.  The restaurant food is very nice and a good sized serving.
I asked for my room to be one of the updated studio's by the reception / pool area.  Whilst the room was a perfectly ample size, nice comfy armchairs and really comfortable bed and pillows, the bathroom and kitchenette areas had not been touched at all during the update.  Old and run down, in need of more than some TLC.  Bathroom didn't look or feel overly clean. Someone else's hair in the spa unit. Chipped doors and cabinetry. The shower itself, whilst quite flash with the options of jet sprayers could make some people feel quite claustrophobic as it's a smallish corner unit.  A good lick of paint throughout the rooms would have been nice just to freshen everything up.  TV died sometime during the night and would not program back into any channel (which is not good for someone who wakes up alot).  To be extremely fussy, the dinnerware had some chips off the plates and cutlery all completely mismatched.  Thankfully I didn't need to use it.
The staff are very friendly and courteous so it's a shame the rest lets down my review rating.  I would definitely come back to the restaurant but as there are a number of other motels closer I would probably use them instead I'm sorry to say.  Probably better for families with young kids as the pool there is nice to use in the summer.

title: Great value
text: I've stayed at this motel several times. The rooms are clean, spacious and comfortable with great lazy boy chairs, and the bathrooms modern and impressive. Great location close to supermarket, takeaways and town, and the service is friendly. I'd give 5 stars if it weren't for the relentless ant infestation i've had to put up with every time i've stayed, regardless of which room i've been in. It's disappointing they don't see fit to deal with this problem, and on my last stay the cleaning staff didn't bother to help with the quite visible and obvious infestation in my unit. Other that that this motel is good value for money.

title: Clean but very cold
text: We stayed as a family with 2 kids. Found it very cold, just a convection heater. Big gaps around the doors and no curtains just blinds. And the bed was very uncomfortable (old and very springy). On the upside it was very clean. Re towels i thought we would get 4 towels (one for each one) as we paid for four of us. however there was only 2 bath towels and 2 hand towels and 2 face towels.

title: Basic and Tired
text: I didn't think this place was very good value for money.  The rooms were cramped and although the kitchen had been modernised the rest of the room needed some serious love.  The bathroom areas which had a very odd layout was in need of a total refit.  It was very dated and shabby.  I don't know where the photo's of this place were taken because it the photo's do not look anything like the place we stayed.  It has an impressive façade but that's about it.  The reception staff were lovely and friendly.

title: Spacious but uncomforyable
text: We stayed here as a group using 3 rooms. The room we had was an old run down room, the shower didn't feel clean and there were a lot of spiders possibly indicating dusting wasn't done? The bed was very uncomfortable. However, the rooms my friends had were very upmarket with a clean feel. We all paid the same amount for completely different rooms?

title: Comfortable & Value for Money
text:
We stayed in a standard one bedroom unit, it was well furnished & comfortable although clearly old & tired. It was good value for money & had everything we needed. The reception staff were excellent, made us feel very welcome - more motels should be like this!
The room was very clean BUT the one thing that spoilt the experience was that one of the beds was made up with blood stained sheets - very off putting, not comfortable about sleeping in sheets like that, luckily there were 3 of us in a 4 person room so had the option of moving beds. The other problem was the standard units back onto the rear of the restaurant so it was quite noisy - mainly from the sound of glass clanging very loudly(bottles being dumped maybe?) and people sitting at the outdoor tables under the room window talking loudly late at night.

title: Well appointed for families
text: This was a random find on Wotif which we selected because the bed combo suited perfectly for a good price. It was well appointed with a nice if unheated pool. The one strange thing was that despite booking for 3 we were offered comp breakfasts for only 2!! So the kids ate and I didn't. Extra breakfast $9 but I had something later.

title: Just What We Wanted
text: Our 4-person suite offered one private bedroom and a good-sized bed with comfortable mattress in the "living" area.  Everything was basic but clean.  The exterior looked like a cement blockhouse and access was maze-like.  Shower worked but bathroom was cramped and no hair dryer in evidence.  We cooked our dinner in the room's kitchenette and enjoyed the "trim" and whole milk in the little bottles our home delivery milkman brought when I was a child.  Fun

title: we got what we paid for!
text:
We were looking for a place to sleep after a party in the city so we booked a room that was on a special rate through the entertainment book.
the unit was very basic, a bit dated but very clean and that was all we wanted! For $79 we couldn't have asked for more! there was even a complimentary continental breakfast but we decided to go elsewhere.
Overall good value for money if you want a cheap place to stay.

title: Comfortable Stop-over
text: We stayed for two night. Rooms were nice and comfortable and one of the best beds so far. We all had a good nights sleep. Kitchen is basic with "breakfast bars" but wish there were a proper table. Not sure about the shower....very small and cramped. Lovely spa outside to warm you up on a cold evening. Check-in and check-out was no problems. Would recommend to anyone not looking a 5 star accommodation. Definitely staying here again when next in Hamilton.

title: Dated
text: The place looked great in photos and was on arrival clean and warm. But tired and shabby dated unit that we were in. Some at front seem more modern. Ours was real tired concrete block with ply panelled painted bathroom area that was basically hall to second room.  Not unhygienic or anything just  not flash

title: 10 out of 10 Motel
text: Lovely hosts where nothing was a bother. Arrived after hours with a truck and trailer and was able to get parking which is usually hard. Lady at reception had left my key for me as well as turned on the heaters and lights. Check out in the morning was a breeze and the room was lovely. Would stay here again anytime. In fact this is my 3rd time at this Motel and will return.

title: Cheap and cheerful
text: Value for money, would be good for families. Restaurant had good selection of bistro style food well cooked. Uncouth customers in dining room totally unnecessary! No shoes and bad language as well as trashy treatment of the poor waitress, some building removal firm needs to get a grip on there staff! I would be interested to see chefs performance in a more up market place, he was very good. Cleanliness of units poor, brown stains on white towels, dirty plates and cups a little off putting. Generally ok but with very little effort could be very nice.

title: Great family motel
text: We stayed 3 nights. The compact rooms were clean and well laid out. The bathroom was very clean. Only 2 elements, microwave, toaster and kettle so not good for cooking anything more than breakfast. Would definitely recommend. Pick the back rooms.

title: Nice experience
text: We stayed at this motel for one night while visiting to see Balloons over Waikato.  Although decor may be a little dated, we found it good value for money; clean, very comfy bed and very nice staff.  Would recommend this motel which is also pretty central to the city area with plenty of nice eateries nearby.  Enjoyed a very nice Indian meal at Jaipur Walla on Victoria St for a very reasonable price and excellent friendly service.  Thought Hamilton was a great place to visit, every shop keeper without fail were pleasant and friendly.  Looking forward to returning.

title: Nice place to stay with a few minor hiccups
text: After driving from New Plymouth and on our way to Auckland we chose Aaron Court to break up our drive. I was pleased with the appearance of the hotel. It was very nice but it happened to be very warm the night we stayed. There was a fan in the bedroom but no outlets to plug it in. The only outlet was right alongside the end of the bed where we place our heads. There wasn't much room from the wall to the bed and impossible to set up the fan, not enough space. It was so hot I had a very hard time falling asleep. The bed in the room we stayed in, no. 59 was so uncomfortable. It was incredibly soft and that coupled with the heat made it very hard to fall asleep. The next morning after a shower I was a bit disappointed to find out the hair dryer didn't work. Location was very easy to find and the place was very clean but those few things made it a bit of a disappointing place to stay.

title: Very nice motel
text: Was looking for a place to stay to brake the trip up driving.  Found this motel on wotif for under $100 . Walked into room and was very pleasantly surprised fantastic shower and spa bath and free breakfast the next day ... very clean and tidy room and staff very friendly.  Well Done will be back .

title: Clean, comfortable, good value, great service
text: This is my 2nd stay at Aaron Court, I chose it because this trip I was travelling alone, and knew that the staff were very friendly and helpful.  They didn't disappoint this time either!  Studio room was clean and comfortable, and my car was parked right out the front of the room. Full sky tv was great too, and complimentary wifi with my booking.  Thanks for a great 2 nights - I will be back again next trip!

title: A great place to be....
text: We (in various family formations of 2 generations) have stayed at Aaron Court on 4 occasions in the last 12 months.  Ok, so the rooms we stay in are a little tired in places and the housekeeping isn't always perfect.. but remember you aren't paying $300 a night!!!  The rooms are comfortable, clean and have everything you need. The staff are simply AMAZING and make guests feel so very welcome - which is the most important thing in the world to us.   Have dined in the Restaurant for dinner on 2 occassions of the 4 stays and found the food of great quality and good pricing.  All in all, an excellent place to stay, very handy to just about everything. Loads of FREE parking (which you don't get with the overpriced hotels in the area) and the best hosts!

title: Pricey food
text: We were with a group of friends. We only ate there so can't comment on the accomodation. Food was basic but well presented. We thought is was a little expensive for what it was. Good service & friendly staff.

title: Nice cosy place
text:
A very lovely place to stay with onsite restaurant and bar.  Lovely Breakfast.

We did have an unfortunate experience on arrival, as we had a late check in 11pm, and our flight was delay making it 11:45pm when we arrived.  I had phoned ahead two days prior to say we would be late and made arrangements for unit to be left unlocked, lights on and key on the table.  Unfortunately none of that happened and we were just lucky there were still some staff there to let us in.  

Lovely girl, was very apologetic.

Good value for money

title: Okay for the price paid!!!!
text: Bed is comfortable! Spa bath has no spa. Cleaning is not very good but is fine. Room that we stayed at needs updating. A bit confusing on the booking (Thought Bacon and Egg is included but really not). Having said that, value for money!

title: Room a bit tired!!!!
text: Went for the Rugby final. Staff is friendly, helpful. Very close to stadium. Howvere, room is a bit tired. The whole motel needs updating. Spa didn't work. Quiet! Value for money! Would recommend to everyone!

title: Value for money.
text:
We drove directly down to Hamilton from Auckland on the first day of our trip. We reached Aaron Court Motel at 1345. Check in was at 1400 so we decided to head out and do a bit of exploring round the area. The whole street was full of motels and lodgings. The hotel is about 10 min walk from a giant PaknSave Supermart, with a few restaurants and pub near the mart. 

We checked in to our rooms at around 1410, only to find out that the room was still unkempt and not cleaned. They gave us a chilled bottle of complementary milk though.Nonetheless we settled down to unpack. The housekeepers showed up 15 minutes later to clean. They were pretty efficient and cleaned up the room of 4 with 15-20 minutes.

Besides that, the room itself was sufficient for the 4 of us. Basic amenities such as water heater, heating, stoves, SkyTV, medium sized fridge, complementary parking for guests is provided. 

Overall, great value for budget travellers. We stayed for 3 nights, drove around to Hamilton center. Quite a few restaurants available but nothing much to see.(We drove out daily for other activities) One point to note: they could at least get the room cleaned before passing us the keys.  

We paid about 26 nzd per person per night. 4 person room: 2 single beds, 1 double bed. 4 guys: average height 174cm, 21 years old

title: Good value for money
text: Stayed here on a Sunday night and managed to get a room with spa bath for $81 which also came with some free internet. This was great value for money. The room is quite old but bed was comfy and TV came with lots of channels. Really happy with what we got for this great price :)

title: Average
text: No rubbish bin in bathroom.Not enough towels.Just thought it was pretty average accommodation. Paid $140.00 for a 2 bedroom upstairs unit (2 people).we arrived after 9pm and didnt have time to look around at other hotels and like other people said it looks ok at the front but definitely more average out the back.

title: Probably not worth it.
text: We weren't expecting much for the price of the room, and we weren't disappointed.  The bed was advertised as a king, yet thought it was a queen.  It was very hard with tired linen.  The shower was tiny.  When you opened the door to turn it on, the water shot out onto the floor.  With only 2 towels it was a wet unpleasant experience.  When you stood under the shower yr bottom kept knocking the mixer tap off.  At 4 am a group of very noisy people arrived back and had a long loud conversation.  I wouldn't recommend this motel.

title: Extremly Overpriced
text: The website looked fabulous the reality was entirely different. There was no bath, back packer accom have better showers, it was small and built in the 70's, with shower curtain not door. The toilet roll holder was public toilet variety. Absolutely no attention to detail, paint peeling off windows and window frames. Kitchen knife so old and blunt it couldn't cut a bread roll. No airconditioning and windows that wouldn't open. Only good thing that can be said was it was clean.

title: Lets do the time wrap again
text:
Looks can be decieving, What you see not what you get. It was a bit like a Hollywood movie there is a facade but when you go around the back all is not what it seems. However...it was clean and for our purposes (somewhere to sleep) it was fine, We did not use the restuarant or the pool. The beds were comfortable and the sheets were not polyester. 

Good value for the price and handy to town. Nice Website...

title: Perfect for a short stay
text: I give the 3 circles rather than 4 only because the room didn't ahve A/C.  The host was accomodating and friendly and stored my chilly bin in the chiller while I was out and about before checkin.  The rooms were clean and tidy and perfect for my late arrival and early start

title: Just what we were looking for
text:
We rang up on New Years Eve booking for Jan 1st and 2nd. We explained our requirements to the staff and they suggested a deluxe spa room. We had a separate room for our 9 month old, where the staff had assembled and made up a Portacot so he could go to bed early without us disturbing him. The curtains are dark and thick too, so we weren't woken up by the light. They had also given us a room as far from  the road as possible so our son wouldn't be disturbed by road noise.
On our second night we had takeaways and the staff readily recommended a place to my husband, again after listening to what we wanted.

We would happily return to Aaron Court if were staying in Hamilton again

title: Lots to recommend
text: There is a lot to recommend in this motel - spacious rooms, very friendly and accommodating staff, a decent complimentary breakfast in nice surroundings, a beautiful spacious new bathroom with spa bath and extremely comfortable bed. The downside included a whole wall of glass, exposing you and your room to others (which felt quite uncomfortable), a rather dowdy interior with chipped paint, sagging plaster (due to flooding in the upstairs unit), worn carpet and a small old fashioned television with separate Sky modem (which twice fell off). There was also no electric blanket and a very noisy heating system (which just seemed to blow out cold air) so I was cold in the evenings. For the money you pay it was adequate, though on the whole the motel room lacked charm and warmth.

title: excellent friendly place to stay
text:
We have stayed twice at this motel and will be back.

We originally stayed at a nearby motel and went here for dinner.  My son decided to jump into their pool which is next to the restaurant.  We were not guests and the staff could not have been more welcoming, offering us towel and telling him to stay in as long as he wanted.

We decided to stay the next time we were in Hamilton and were again very impressed by the friendliness of the staff.  They are willing to go 'the extra mile'.  The rooms are comfortable and have all you need if you wish to eat in.  The restaurant is reasonably priced with tasty family meals.

On our next visit I was picking my son up from camp in the area and so really wanted to check in before the usual allowed check in time, they sent the cleaners to our room first and had it available to us well ahead of time.  We were outside of normal restaurant hours, but they had no problem delivering a snack to our room.

We will be visiting Hamilton again in the next couple of weeks and will look forward to staying again.

title: Spacious and Comfortable, A great place to stay in Hamilton
text: My family stayed with other families at the Aaron Court for one night because of a cycling competition close to Hamilton. Arriving and checking in at the motel was very quick and easy and took under 10 minutes. We had a 2 bedroom unit that could sleep 5 people comfortably. While the 2 bedroom units do not have spa baths, they do have amazing showers. The room had cable tv which was useful as the fist stage of the Tour De France was on that night. Gerards Restaurant at the motel was very nice and the food was delicious. The spa pool was an excellent way to relax. The big pool looked good and as a dare I swam in it, it was freezing! Overall I had a great stay at this motel and I look forward to staying here again next time the cycling is on.

title: One of the best places to stay in Hamilton!
text: We stayed for one night in the 1 Bedroom Double Spa room. On arrival reception was neat and tidy and the staff were very friendly and helpful. A good vibe right from the start. Great parking space for vehicles. The room was inviting and extremely clean and had a nice feel to it. We chose this unit because of the spa and we weren't dissapointed. Definately the best in-room spa we have ever seen. The kitchen was fully equipt and roomy and the bathroom was even bigger. Lovely couches and great to have the full range of sky tv channels, not just a selection. Didn't eat at the restaurant but it looked really nice and we did get room-service for desert which was good. The room was worth more than what we paid for it in my opinion. Wish we could have stayed longer. Highly recommend!

title: What a great place to stay!!!!
text: Stayed at the Aaron Court Motor Inn this weekend with my husband and young kids. It was great and would def stay again if in Hamilton. The pool (which we didn't use as it wasn't warm enough) was very clean looking as was the surrounding area. The room was good and had everything that you would expect in this price bracket. We stayed two nights and the cleaner did a great job servicing the room on the second morning, the people super friendly and reception even lent us felts and colouring in activities for the kids. The reception food was excellent, the waiter very friendly and the food superb and it was super cheap.

title: Disappointed
text:
The unit was tired with black mould in bathroom and lino lifting off in several areas.
Booked accessibility unit with allocated carpark which was occupied by other guests/staff vehicles.

title: A sleepless night
text: There were incredibly noisy guests until 4.15 am. I contacted management but nothing was done hence a sleepless and stressful night. I am a regular user of Bella Vista, but no longer in Hamilton. The sound insulation between top and bottom floors is incredibly poor.

title: Overpriced and shabby
text:
I've stayed at lots of Bella Vistas over the years and I've actually stayed at this one before. I was shocked to see how much it had deteriorated. My curtains were absolutely disgusting, covered in black mould. All of the furniture looked cheap, worn and chipped. In the bathroom, the vinyl on the floor was peeling back from the wall. I've attached photos of all of these issues so that you can see what I mean.

On the plus side, the linen and the carpets were clean, and the woman who checked me in seemed nice.

Also, and I know this is not the motel's fault, it now seems to be in the middle of an emergency-housing area. I witnessed two distressing incidents on the street (one violent) in the two days I stayed there, both involving women with small children. The police were called to the later. I reiterate that this isn't the motel's fault, but it does affect the enjoyment of the stay.

In addition to that, this was the most expensive motel I stayed in on my trip: $200 for a studio unit! At $100 I may have overlooked some of the problems, but I couldn't believe what bad quality it was for the price. I actually chose it due to its 4.5 rating on Trip Advisor, and this is the first time the rating has let me down.

title: Great motel
text: This was one of the cleanest and most modern BVM’s we stayed in. The staff were all very helpful. The room was clean and tidy. It is a good 20min walk into the town. The only downside (not the motel’s fault) was some loud neighbours drinking outside their rooms but this was only on one night.

title: great staff
text: Was booked to stay at this motel last weekend and due to unforeseen circumstances had to leave within the first hour. Money was refunded and receptionist was extremely understanding. Thank you so much.

title: Quality and clean
text: clean comfy rooms with modern amenities, eco friendly standards. excellent service when needed, great location. High standards. Kitchen was great with everything a cook would need even a coffee plunger with the proper coffee, large modern bathroom ours had a spa bath, shower had great heat and pressure We highly recommend for any type of guest

title: Hamilton
text:
A nice motel with clean facilities and nice disabled bathroom, ground level and car park at door, 
About 5-10min walk to main st of city,
Only problem do check if your booking says breakfast included that it is we had problems and was not until I showed my booking which included breakfast that the female receptionist that to back track from saying they never include break in their rates to blaming last minute for com for not telling them, she reluctantly said it was only continental and not cooked breakfast, a big let down 
Will look else where next time

title: No sheets on our bed
text: We booked a family unit for 3 adults and 3 children. We had 2 bedrooms, one with 2 single beds the other one had a king size bed and a single one. In the lounge there was a very uncomfortable sofa bed. We had asked for six beds. We asked for sheets for the sofa bed and were told that they were in a drawer. Unfortunately we didn't check until 9.45pm and then began a major hunt through every cupboard and drawer in the apartment. There were no sheets anywhere. We went to reception but it was closed, tried ringing them but no answer. So no sheets for the night. When we complained in the morning there was no apology or redress. The manager blamed the housekeeping staff. The other complaint we had was it was an extremely hot day, there's no air conditioning and only 2 small fans for the three rooms.

title: Comfortable
text: We had a one bedroom unit on the ground floor. Room was clean and fine for a few nights. Kitchen area was good, bathroom was huge. Wifi great. Location; within driving distance to town centre. Beds were very very soft and not very comfortable. Windows could’ve done with fly wire and perhaps an extra lock on door for security. Also a lock on bathroom door is much needed. Overall stay was good and comfortable for the price.

title: Clean and good value
text:
The staff were very friendly and helpful. 
The room was warm and clean when we arrived. 
Only stayed for one night but was well worth the value for money. 
There is also wifi which was quick and easy to use.

title: Adequate
text:
Room was ok with everything you would need.  What I found  unpleasant was the heater ... noisy. I was also led to believe that the room had cooking facilities but the only cooking facilities was an electric frying pan in the microwave. I travel with my stovetop Espresso maker and since there was nothing I could use the espresso maker on I had to resort to instant coffee - I stayed for a week.  
With that said everything else was really ok Andrew most spacious and clean and a well maintained complex.  a tad out of town but that's neither here nor there for me. Reception was prompt and friendly. All in all a good experience except for the heater.

title: Good value, clean and tidy
text: Our room was warm, clean and tidy on what was a very wet visit.  The staff were nice and the wifi was good.  The only thing is our bed was a little firm but then I don't like a super firm bed but others may.
hotel_response: Thank you for your stay, looking forward to see you again.

title: One night stay
text: Greeted on arrival by the owner nothing was an issue. We found a light that wasn't working which the owner fixed while we went for dinner. A good quiet place to stay for the right amount. Rooms were spacious with a usable kitchenette.
hotel_response: I'm glad you enjoyed your stay, hope to have you again.

title: Amazing service, excellent quality rooms.
text: Very courteous, friendly, and accommodating staff. The rooms are perfect, clean, and warm. Definitely a winner in my books! Internet is ultrafast and has a good range. Beds are comfortable. And the rooms are warm enough not to worry about the heater.
hotel_response:
It's great to hear you love the accommodation, we will keep it up, hope to see you again.
Thank you.

title: Well done Bella Vista Hamilton
text:
Welcoming on arrival.
Rooms clean an spacious.Comfortable beds..Everything you could possibly need supplied.Lots of information in rooms of places to see an visit..
Restaurant delivery options. .Friendly management.
Would definitely recommend..Couldn't fault it..
Located close to bus routes an town..

title: Helpful staff
text:
We call down from the road, to see if there were accomodations for two nights, and then were warmly greeted by Li, the manager.  We went to our assigned room and settled in.

We had trouble sleeping because the drapes covered the open windows and the room was humid, with no air moving.  Additionally, the bed rocked & rolled every time one of us moved.

When I mentioned the sleepless night, he said that there was a fan in the room, and promptly went over to the closet and pulled it out.  The second night was better.

The shower was a curtain on a rail, and my wife was certain that the water would get all over the room, but true to Li's word, the curtain contained almost everything. 

This motel is almost "there" and I hope that these words bring improvements.  Li is certainly trying hard, and I wish him success.

title: Well maintained hotel
text: In an age where there is a lot of foreign investment in hotels, I have experienced a number that have not been good. This hotel is managed by internationals but it was lovely and the hotel was very clean and well maintained. The rooms were spacious and had reasonable amenities. The bed in my room was a little hard but the pillows were good and there were a couple of different styles to choose from.

title: Bella Vista
text: .I was staying with friends . Reasonably priced.Unit clean and not too far from facilities Hamilton is a nice place to visit. Room service was efficient. Beds comfortable and very good bathroom facilities.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review, it's great to have you with us, I'm looking forward to provide the good service again.

title: Great Place. Very nice
text: We stayed 3 nights. Very beautiful. Very clean. Helpfull and friendly staff. Near to the city center. A lot of bars and Restaurants 15 minutes to go from the motel. Laundry service avaiable. Microwave in the room. Everething looks new and in a good condition. Thank you. I would stay there again.
hotel_response: Hi Christian, thank you, looking forward to service you again.

title: A bit of a disappointment
text:
Stopped here on our way to Auckland to break the long drive.
We stayed here a couple of years ago and it was interesting to return. Our previous experiences were repeated.  It was clean, comfortable and conveniently located with safe parking, plus the rooms were of a decent size. This motel is located on the TeRapa road where most of the motels in Hamilton seem to be located. Close to the main road, but very little traffic noise. Our only disappointment was the fact there was no hot water for a shower before we left next morning.

title: Ms
text:
Bella Vista Motel

We arrived at Bella Vista Motel Hamilton on 11 Jan 2017, and the warm, well-kept marigold facade of the motel gave the impression that we would have a good stay there. 

And we found out later, that Bella Vista would live up to this expectation. 

Initially there was a little confusion when we were checking in, not because carelessness or incompetence on the motel's part but simply because our tour agency had registered our booking under not just my name like I'd thought, but both mine and my husband's names.

The motel receptionist remained cheerful and understanding despite the hitch, and was very prompt in assisting us. She called one of our two hosts, Roger to the office to help when we still couldn't find our booking. 

Just like the receptionist, Roger was friendly and helpful and soon enough we managed to find our booking and checked into Room 2.

Upon entering the room, we were chuffed at how spacious and clean it was, consisting of one main area with a double bed, kitchen facilities, dining table and desk, with a smaller adjoining room containing two single beds - just nice for our family of four. 

We put down our luggage bags in the living area and still had lots of room to move about. The room was well ventilated and cool despite the late afternoon heat, and even then there was a small but very efficient portable fan stored in the cupboard by the door.

The beds were made up immaculately with soft and pristine sheets, blankets and pillows. The kitchen, on top of being spick-and-span, was also quite large. While the floor was largely carpeted, it still looked and felt clean. 

We were impressed once more when we checked out the bathroom. Just like the rest of the room it was big, airy and practically spotless. There was both a shower stall and a spa bath in the bathroom, and a nice clean sink with small bottles of shampoo and conditioner and packets of bath soap lined up neatly next to it. The towels were fluffy and fresh smelling and also placed neatly on the towel rack. 

Perhaps I risk sounding like a broken record repeating "clean and spacious" so much, but those two words best sum up the motel and I feel that the standard of the motel does warrant this praise. 

In addition to the room itself, the staff and hosts, as previously mentioned, were also wonderful - specifically Roger (who kindly let us have a late check out the next day, 12 Jan, at 11am rather than the usual 10am) and the the receptionist who helped us check in on the first day. 

To conclude, Bella Vista Motel Hamilton is a lovely place to stay in with staff to match, and I'd recommend it to anybody visiting Hamilton. Thank you Roger, Jenny and the rest of the motel staff for a pleasant stay!

- John and Megan, Jan 2017

title: The place to stay while in Hamilton!
text: Very comfortable and clean. Spacious room and bathroom. Friendly and helpful owner. We spent 3 nights here and very happy with everything. We reccommend this motel to all travellers! Book directly with the hotel is the best way to do.

title: Friendly and clean
text: On arrival I was warmly welcomed. The room was very clean, comfortable and well equipped. Although located on the main road outside noise was minimal. Shower fittings could do with a bit of an update.
hotel_response: So pleased your stay with us was a pleasant one.

title: Great Motel, great service
text: We made a late booking at the Bella Vista Motel, after arriving at our previously booked motel (Boundary Court Motor Inn) where it was nothing like the advertising & decided it was so bad we couldn't stay there.  The Bella Vista Motel was perfect - clean, modern & great value.  The service was lovely, with a great sense of humour & the cooked breakfast we ordered was wonderfully yummy.  Unlike the other, the pictures of the rooms is what you get.  Very nice.
hotel_response: Great to have 'Made the Difference' with your stay in Hamilton!

title: Work
text: Great accommodation, large room, clean & tidy, with everything you need to look after yourself and family. Parking outside of rooms for ground floor rooms or within 5-10m other wise. Very friendly manager.  Close to city and other locations.

title: Great place to stay
text:
Stayed 1 night in a one bedroom unit.  Great motel, good sized unit that was spotlessly clean with very comfortable beds, plenty of towels/soaps etc and well equipped kitchen.  
Helpful and welcoming hosts.
Would definitely stay again and highly recommended.
hotel_response: Pleased to have you stay with us and enjoy our hospitality and appreciate your great review.

title: Great value! Clean and comfortable!
text: We stayed only one night, but the gentleman host was very friendly and helped us find our way. The upstairs room was large with a comfortable bed and a large bathroom. We then stayed at another Bella Vista in Queenstown, but this one in Hamilton was better.
hotel_response: Great to have you stay and have you to prefer our Bella Vista Motel Hamilton hospitality.

title: Super motel
text: Booked this stay from the UK so not sure what to expect. We were not disappointed. We arrived early but that was not a problem. The room was large and clean with all the facilities needed for our stay including a guest laundry. Our visit to Hamilton was over the new year and it appeared that the whole place was closed for the holiday so we needed to use everything in the room including the cooking facilities. The hosts were very helpful and friendly so would recommend this motel to anyone visiting Hamilton.

title: Bella Vista Chain offers Excellent VFM
text:
This was the first of four Bella Vista motels we used during our road trip in New Zealand. 

This one set the standard that was later matched by all the others. 

Decent sized, clean accommodation with the usual features you would expect in a motel; nice sized bed with spotless linen and towels, fridge, cooking facilities on-site parking. Friendly, helpful management happy to pass on information about their area.

This Motel provided everything we wanted at a value for money price.

title: A lovely, friendly and impeccably clean motel
text:
Our family of 6 stayed here for 2 nights in December 2016. We had a one bedroom room with a double bed in the living room and an additional rollaway bed. It had a very clean kitchen and wonderfully large bathroom with both shower (great pressure) and spa bath!

The gentleman running the place was very friendly and helpful. I was very surprised when we returned after being out for the day to discover everything had been cleaned and we had fresh towels and replenished biscuits by the coffee and tea! A great touch.

It is conveniently located on the main motel strip and is just a 5-10min car ride from the centre of town. It was very quiet and we thoroughly enjoyed our time here.

title: Perfect
text: I travel to Hamilton a lot for work, but this was my first time at Bella Vista. The internet was the stand out - fast wi-fi that doesn't cut in and out and can actually stream video (including Netflix!) A must for business travelers. So many accommodation providers do not realise how important good internet is. The rooms are clean and tidy and the one bedroom places are huuuge. Most importantly - the owners are friendly and go above and beyond to help you. I will be back!
hotel_response: Thanks for your favourable review and great to hear our highspeed / wifi internet helps make the difference.

title: Still "Convenient, comfortable and quiet"
text:
I stayed here a couple of years ago and it was interesting to return.  My previous experiences were repeated.  It was clean, comfortable and conveniently located with safe parking.  On the main motel 'strip' close to the Waikato Stadium but it does not seem to be effected by traffic noise.

Friendly, helpful staff.

title: Great staff, no-fuss stay
text:
Very helpful staff, last minute booking and late check were not an issue. Rooms were clean and well equipped with standard kettle, microwave etc. Complimentary milk on check in is a nice touch in the middle of dairy country. 

Remember to ask for the wi-fi password!
hotel_response: Pleased to have made your stay a fuss free one!

title: Easter Holiday
text: Units exceptionally well presented and owner went out of his way to help us with all our questions. Information in the rooms was plentiful, very good King size bed and very spacious room. Would highly recommend Bella Vista Hamilton.

title: A good place to stay in Hamilton
text:
Nice large rooms well equipped. We had two bedrooms, kitchen unit and bathroom with a tub. Very clean and quiet for sleep. Beds very good.

Large parking area for cars, although late in the evening it was completely full of cars as the motel then had no vacancies.

The manager was very helpful and advised us to have dinner at "The Helm" just down the road. A very good tip.

Walking distance to shops etc.

Price was quite ok as we had like a suite....

title: Great Place for a quick stay
text: Checkin was very smooth and the caretaker personally took us to our room, showed us all the amenities and things related to our room. He told us about the various things around town and was helpful with the navigation around town. The beds were a little small but manageable for a night. The bathroom was sufficient and the experience was a satisfying enough and probably a better than what you would expect from a motel

title: Great spot to stay in Hamilton
text: Rooms are very clean and relatively modern. Attention to detail maintained with information package well placed and relevant. Beds are very comfy with good thought put into making it a comfortable stay. Well positioned to main road and Waikato stadium - short walk to CBD and supermarkets. Nice friendly relaxed welcome too!!

title: Great place to stay!!!!
text: The room is so clean, highly recommended! Roger and Jenny are really great hosts. My family had a great stay here. If you have to stay in hamilton, you should go to Bella Vista, and you will not regret.

title: Great place to stay
text: Spotlessly clean room. Ideal for the stadium around the corner. We stayed in the one bed studio, which was perfect as the kids had their own room. Very friendly host. Would definitely stay here again next time we are in Hamilton. Few minutes drive into the town centre and there are supermarkets within walking distance. Overall highly recommend this motel.
hotel_response: Hi Vicki,  Really pleased you enjoyed your stay in Hamilton and to hear that staying with us was part of the experience!   We'd  certainly love to accommodate you next time you are in Hamilton!

title: Best Bella Vista Motel
text: This motel was recommended to us by i-site. We stayed in a few Bella Vista Motels throughout our NZ trip. This motel is by far the best one. The room was very clean and neat. Laundry facilities was free including the dryer. Wifi was very good and free. Location was great, 5 minutes drive to town. Highly recommended!

title: Great place to stay
text:
Due to the role I am in for my company, I am out of Auckland every 2 weeks. I stay at the Bella Vista when I'm in Hamilton every time (usually about 2-3 nights) and it's my favourite  place to stay whilst on the road.
Roger and Jenny are great hosts, very clean and tidy, hygienic, nice facilities, good internet data and speeds, high pressure shower, and secure. 
Any person or family who has to stay in Hamilton over a period, I recommend Bella Vista. I will continue to go there.
hotel_response: Hi Shaun,  Thank you for your support.  We really do appreciate your comments and look forward to seeing you soon!

title: Good motel
text: Nice, neat, clean and comfortable. Family of five and looked after us all comfortably. Well equipped and good location. Close to main road with plenty of restaurants to choose from. Good stay. Recommend.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review and recommendation.  Pleasure to have hosted you.   Hope to see you again soon!

title: Fairly Standard Motel Offering
text:
As far as motels go, this is a pretty good bet, especially if you find yourself in Hamilton for a night or two. Located on what seems to be the motel strip, the place was clean and check in was efficient. Complimentary milk on arrival to complement the complimentary tea/coffee in room was a nice touch. Room itself was a large sleeping/living area with tiny (but adequate) kitchenette, and separate bathroom. The room was clean, as was the premises, with off-street parking included in the price of the room.

Overall, I'm not a motel kinda guy, but for a night in Hamilton (or even two, or three), if you're going to go the motel route I would suggest that this is a pretty good option.

title: Great motel
text: Great Room it was huge beautifully appointed  and well equipped. Beautiful linen on the bed .It had a fully equipped Kitchen which was ideal because we had been to lots of expensive resturants so it was nice to have a meal in the room. Very quiet which is what you want after a busy day travelling.Fully recommended.
hotel_response: Thank you for such a great review!   We're so pleased you enjoyed your stay with us.

title: Convenient, comfortable and quiet
text: Located on Hamilton's main motel strip this is a convenient, quiet motel.  Clean and bigger than average rooms with good parking and free WiFi.  Booked at short notice the rooms were very reasonable in price.
hotel_response: Was a pleasure to have you & your family stay with us and we  hope to see you again.   We have recently refurbished all our rooms so you will notice the difference if and when you choose to stay with us again.

title: No exhilaration
text:
Location : where other dozens of motels are located, not a far drive from city center, gardens, stadium, grocery store
Front desk : nice man, but nothing out of the ordinary
Rooms : small bedroom, small bathroom, no roof over the balcony/walkway (upstairs), so you can get very wet going to your room, average overall
Free wi-fi, ample parking
Would we go back? I don't think so

title: Big well equipped rooms: a hidden gem
text: Fantastic service, excellently equipped room, with good lighting, heating, a fan, and even an oven!  There was heaps of room, and nothing was too much trouble.  A pleasant 20 minute walk to many fine restaurants in downtown.  Fully recommended!

title: Appearances can be deceiving...
text: ..but this place is nothing short of great!  This motel is pretty unremarkable in appearance and is located in a long strip of nondescript hotels in the lodging district of suburban Hamilton.  I made a reservation there because I stayed at the airport Bella Vista in Auckland and felt it was a good hotel for the money.  We got a two room unit with kitchenette for my 17 year old daughter and us (50+couple) for USD132 per night.  The place was spotless and looked brand new.  There were no nicks or dings in the walls and everything we needed was provided.  We were able to save a lot by preparing simple meals in the room--there was a gourmet grocery across the street from a warehouse grocery about 1/2 mile away.  There was an older man in the office, who I presume was the owner, and he was very helpful with information about the local area.  We had planned to move further South to the Waitomo cave area, but ended up staying here because it was worth the drive to stay in a better property.  Street noise was not a problem at all, and the heat and cable TV worked well.  Hamilton itself is a pleasant town, although there are not any major tourist sites there.  We had a car and the property was close to downtown;  I cannot say whether it is well served by public transit.  All in all, I would recommend this place highly!

title: Comfy stay while on business
text:
I stayed in a studio room for 5 nights on business and enjoyed my stay very much. 
My room was quiet and warmed up quickly with the wall heater on, and there was an electric blanket too. 
My collegues complained of traffic noise from the road, but my room was furthest from the street and I didnt experience noise.
I ordered the continental breakfast each day and it was great. Parking was abundant and Laundry facilites were very good too. I was able to charge back meals at local restaurants to my room.
The staff were always friendly and went above and beyond with my requests. I would certainly recommend this as a nice place to stay.

title: Good place to stay
text: We had a good stay in the two bedroom unit, it was very nice and clean with all the usual facilities. Our sleep was disturbed due to a noisy party going on in the motel behind ours which faced our bedroom. This of course can happen anywhere and was in no way the fault of the motel. Location is excellent, very close to the stadium to watch the Warriors lose yet again!

title: Nice stay, comfy bed and helpful staff!
text:
Stayed here during 5 days as part of a businesstrip to the university. Loved it, the service was 5 star, small but fresh and functional breakfast. Slept well and had wonderful 'morningwalks' in the nice (urban) surroundings!
As i mentioned, a short walk from the main street with nice restaurants and bars. Nice casino too! If i return i will definately comeback back!

title: How motels should be run
text:
I spent 3 nights in this establishment.  It was very well appointed, extremely clean and well organised.
I feel that I cannot stress enough the friendliness and helpfulness of the staff and management, which, together with the qualities of the motel itself, made my stay in Hamilton an extremely enjoyable one.

Michel Bazin
Mackay, Australia

title: Liked this place
text: Bells Vista consistently good. Stayed at four (Napier, Fox Glacier, Wanaka and Hamilton) and they were all great. There is always a bit of risk in picking motels out of the blue so being able to stay with a well managed chain may seem somewhat mundane to the B&B/hostel crowd but comfort, good sleep are important. This one was no different from the others in terms of quality and comfort.

title: Way more money than expected!
text: We pulled into this hotel after having a great experience at a Bella Vista earlier in the week.  Everything turned out great except for when we went to check out, the price was suddenly $130, so much more than we had planned on.  Earlier in the week when we had stayed at the Bella Vista near the airport we were told that if we got the Extra "frequent Stayer" card instead of being $99 a night they hotels would be $89.  When we had checked in last night we showed the man at the desk that we would be using the card.  He said he would just get it from us in the morning.  We were shocked when we checked out  that he charged us $130 when we were told that it would be $89!!  We asked to get the price back down to $89 from what we were told but he said he couldn't do anything about the price because he wasn't the owner......VERY disappointing!!  We will not be back there nor recommend anyone else go there!

title: Excellent base
text: In Hamilton from Western Australia for a couple of days,  (April 16, 17) looking at property and chose Bella Vista on the strength of Tripadvisor reviews.  Great choice.  Initially when we tried to book the website said full, so not to be deterred, we emailed them direct.  Immediate response with our required choice being available.  V8 Supercars on the following weekend so some mixup with the website booking system.  One bedroom apartment - plenty of room, only minutes from the "eating" part of town and very pleasant hosts.  Complimentary paper each morning and a cable for the free internet - $29.99 for 24 hours at Crowne Plaza in Queenstown!!!!!!  Go figure?????  Importantly it is only minutes from excellent shopping and wine supply!!  Definitely our base for future visits to Hamilton, until we find a place of our own.  Well done guys and thank you.

title: Great Motel
text: We stayed at this motel on 13th and 20th February. We chose to stay here because of our other pleasant experiences at Bella Vista motels and we were very pleased that we did. Jenny was lovely and went out of her way to help us and we would have been in trouble if Roger had not given us detailed instructions of how to get to Auckland airport, Our accommodation was excellent and included a Spa bath. We would have no hesitation in recommending this motel.

title: Great value
text: As always, it's a pleasant experience to stay at a Bella Vista Motel. We really enjoyed the free internet access. Friendly owner and clean and comfortable room. Would stay there again if ever back in Hamilton.

title: Perfect accommodation
text: We had a very pleasant stay at the Bella Vista Motel. Very friendly owner and clean, tidy and spacious rooms. We can really recommend this motel to everyone.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to post this review.  We hope you enjoyed the rest of your holiday with your parents and maybe we will see you again one day.

title: Great value
text: Stayed here for 2 nights in December.  The room was very clean and large (2 bedroom).  The street is busy and a little loud if you are in a room on the main street, as we were.  Staff was very nice and the location was great, about a mile to center of town.  I would stay here again.
hotel_response: Thank you BossMan for taking the time to comment.  Hope you had a safe journey home and when you come next time will put you in a unit back off the street.

title: Accommodation with Heart
text: I was very pleasantly surprised by the personal attention. Starting from the warm and welcoming reception to beyond the time of check out. Although there is a 20min walk to town (think: healthier option) the walk by the river makes the extra time worthwhile. The breakfasts were hot and always on time. The supermarket and Helm for dining are but a few minutes stroll from this location. Thank you Roger and Mrs Roger !
hotel_response: Thank you Carol, hope you had a great xmas/new year and you were able to meet up with your husband in the States.  New Years Resolution - keep up the walking!!

title: My Motel of Choice In Hamilton
text:
Have stayed at this Motel twice so far and will be staying there again in November 2011.
Roger & Jenny are always smiling, nothing is to much of an issue for them. If the beds and showers are not the best I have ever had in any motel, then they certainly rank in the top 2
hotel_response: Hi Dan the Man, thank you for your kind response, we aim to please.  Best Wishes for 2012.  See you next time when competing with all that mud!!

title: Lovely Stay
text: We stayed at the Bella Vista Motel in Hamilton with our 4 and 5 year old daughters.  It was great.  The rooms were clean, the facilities fantastic and everything we needed was supplied in our room.  We were made to feel welcome and told to let them know if we needed anything else, which we didn't.  Very friendly, convinient to town by car.  Great place to stay.  Would go there again without a doubt.
hotel_response: Thank you for your response - you are most welcome, would love to host you and those two little cuties anytime.

title: Fantastic accomodation
text: We stayed in the Bella Vista motel during our stay in Hamilton and were not disappointed.  The rooms were well equipped with microwave, fridge and kitchen utensils so you could easily make your own food or get takeaway from the local shops.  Supermarkets nearby and although a little bit further to town its a lovely walk and no different to most motels which are mostly altogether.  The room was lovely, clean and light with a really good sized and spotless bathroom.  You can even borrow the BBQ and sit outside if you like which is fab.  Plus, really close to the river walk which I would highly recommend.  Hosts Roger and his wife were so friendly and helpful.  Would definitely go back!
hotel_response: Thank you for your lovely comments - it was our pleasure.  Hope you had a great xmas and best wishes for 2012.

title: Great place to stay!
text:
We've enjoyed our 3 different stays at the Bella Vista.  Roger and his wife are the happiest moteliers I've ever struck.  Nothing was a problem, and they just made you feel so welcome.  Room had everything we needed.  And the walk to the CBD is only 15 minutes away.  Definitely recommend the Bella Vista!
Lisa Smith
hotel_response: Thank you ladies, hope the course results were what you were expecting.  Best Wishes for 2012.

title: Bella Vista chain
text: After staying at the Bella Vista in Blenheim we decided to stay at the Bella Vista in Hamilton. We were not disappointed, the room and hospitality were great. However the motel is a 20 minute walk into the town centre. On the recommendation of the host we went to The Helm about a five minute walk away and had a lovely steak dinner (although we did find the drinks abit pricey compared to other bar/restaurants we had been to).
hotel_response:
Thank you for your comments, glad that you enjoyed the NZ Beef too.  We trust you enjoyed the rest of your time in New Zealand and look forward to welcoming you back.
Warm Regards
Roger & Jenny

title: Excellent Choice
text:
Just spent two wonderful nights at the Bella Vista having received a cheerful welcome from Roger who by the way was ever so helpful with the choice of restaurants available in the area.
The room was all I could have wanted, very clean and  well equiped with a good selection of TV channels and a comfy bed . It's in an ideal location for rugby fans with Rugby Park just around the corner. Overall this was an excellent choice and I will definitely be returning maybe next time for a rugby match.

title: Good place overall
text:
Came here after reading the reviews and saw its pics on Wotif. Was in Hamilton for a one night stay. Overall a nice, cosy place. Had the 1 bedroom motel room, inside was clean and comfortable. Close to town and Pak n Save was just a block away. 
My only thing for them to improve is that they could have more than 1 fan in the 1 bedroom motel, it can get quite hot in the summer. 
Nonetheless, I would come back again.

title: A good choice
text: I chose and booked this motel online after comparing dozens of motels of a seemingly similar price, standard and location.  The host was very welcoming and helpful, providing a cable for the free broadband and FRESH milk for tea and coffee (I can't stand those horrible liitle UHT pottles).  The king size bed was fairly comfortable, the unit was clean and the flat screen TV was appreciated.  The spa bath was a welcome bonus after a very long day on the road too.  All in all, a good choice and I would stay here again.  If you like Indian food, there is a fantastic Indian takeaway place about 500m north of the motel at a large intersection on the RHS.  Really good food and good value too.

title: Second Class Citizen - treatment
text: Drove from Auckland @ 5am, arrived at Reception w Lizze on a personal call. After 5 minutes of us standing at the front desk, she ended the call. We felt like 2nd-class citizens, under valued. Lizze’s behaviour bordered on racism. Very very sad.

title: Loved it!!
text: Absolutely loved our stay! Receptionist were lovely! Check in was easy peasy! We camped at the Lake. Views were beautiful! Great for kids! We have a 2yr & 4yr old. Had a playground, although I feel a lot of it is more suited to older kids, our babies found a way to have fun! Need your own cutlery, pots/pans etc. fully functional kitchen! Fridge, freezer, stovetops, oven, kettle and toaster and a large dining table to accomodate our family, and others as well!  Super safe as well! Our site was well away from the lake, close to all the amenities. I could go on! But absolutely loved our stay, and hopefully will be back again next year! Thank you Mighty River!

title: Another great stay in the Rob Waddell Lodge at the Mighty River Domain
text:
For the 3rd year in a row we have travelled to Karapiro for school trip to go kayaking and have stayed overnight in the Rob Waddell Lodge at the Mighty River Domain.

It is an awesome, well-equipped lodge for big groups and has all the amenities you need. There is plenty of space around the lodge for our kids to play and a playground, which is a lifesaver. 

We have thoroughly enjoyed staying here over the past few years and will continue coming back.
hotel_response:
Good afternoon, 

Thank you very much for your review! 

We enjoy having your group stay, and look forward to your return visit. 

Kind Regards, 
Rachel Scott 
Lake Karapiro

title: Peaceful by the water
text:
This is a beautiful spot, clean facilities, helpful friendly staff, and a good kitchen with zip and microwave.
Very peaceful on flat grassy upper and lower fields, looking out to the water. 
Take insect spray as lots of midges at night, attracted to light.
hotel_response:
Hi Latenighter2,

Thank you for your review! Glad you enjoyed your time at Mighty River Domain, Lake Karapiro. 

Yes, we do tend to have aquatic insects by Lake Karapiro, so a good idea to have insect spray during the evenings. 

Warm Regards,
Rachel Scott
Mighty River Domain, Lake Karapiro.

title: Wonderful event venue
text: We held an event in the Don Rowlan Centre and our guests and staff stayed in the lodge and chalets. Venue itself was immaculate and the kitchen was good for catering. Staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Lodge was as expected and all the facilities were working and the kitchen meant we could be self sufficient. The chalets were open and have a nice ensuite for convenience. Overall we had just under 40 people staying on site and 87 people attend out weekend long event and all had a great weekend and were more than satisfied with the venue. The beautiful view of the river helps! Also there is a wonderful cafe on site which meant easy access to delicious hot drinks and very nice food which we experienced first hand and highly recommend.
hotel_response:
Good afternoon Sammy, 

Wow, sounds like you had an amazing time during your event at the Don Rowlands Centre in 2021!

Happy to hear that yourself and guests enjoyed the Rob Waddell Lodge & Chalets. Glad you could be self sufficient.

We love the view of Lake Karapiro, which is also our everyday office!

The Podium Cafe is always a lovely spot, us event and accommodation office staff love to pop in for a coffee. 

We are so glad you enjoyed your event. If you have another event coming up in the future, we would love to have you back!

Kind Regards,
Rachel Scott
Mighty River Domain, Lake Karapiro

title: Great short stay
text:
There were 3 of us and we stayed for 2 nights and very handy that the 3 bedrooms had access to 3 bathrooms which we have never had before.
The beds were very good as was just about everything else just a bigger tv in the main area would have been nice. The host was very helpful and said we could even park outside the garage except someone at no 6 left a note that we shouldn't park there but we didn't see anyone?
It was very handy to the bike trail as we rode  north to the end then back to the gardens for lunch then back to charlemont st so a pretty reasonable ride.

title: Recommend!!!
text: Amazing place to stay. Host was lovely and responded fast. We enjoyed staying there.I would recommend coming to stay here. Loved the outside patio and living room area. The place was clean and immaculate.

title: Worst motel experience of my life
text:
This place is a complete nightmare. After a six-hour drive, we arrived at Beetham Motel only to find a closed reception and a note telling us to check in at Hygate Motel next door. The room was disgusting, but it was too late to find alternative accomodation, the bed smelled like stale urine, and the chemical air freshener they put in the room was so overpowering we had to put it outside.

The air conditioning was filthy and full of dust and we woke up feeling sick. The shower was so small it felt like it was made for hobbits and it leaked all over the floor which was made worse by the fact that you have to step down from inside a bath to the floor which is surely a slipping hazard.

The place looked like it hadn’t been cleaned in ages, dust everywhere, a leaking vanity, and walls in awful condition. To make matters worse, the fire alarm went off at 9:30 PM with no explanation of whether it was serious or not. We complained first thing in the morning about our horrendous room because we had booked for 2 nights. We were told absolutely no refunds and that we could get a "refurbished" room.

The next room was just as bad, with even more filth, with cockroaches on the toilet in the bathroom, dirty aircon, and a light switch so greasy they'd give KFC a run for their money. When we asked for a refund instead of staying the second night, the staff were unhelpful, rude, and said only the manager could offer refunds on Monday and to email them.

The whole experience was a nightmare, and we’re now out of pocket with no resolution in sight. It's been almost 3 weeks trying to get a refund and they just refuse. If you pay before checking the room you will NEVER EVER get your money back.

This motel should not be listed on booking.com or any other booking website. It’s an absolute scam, and the service is appalling. DO NOT stay here, save yourself the misery and go anywhere else.

title: Extremely Overpriced
text:
Hamilton was completely booked out, and over 30 phone calls later I was about to give up hope. 8.30pm and needing accomodation after a family member had been helicoptered to the Hospital there. The lovely man at Beetham Park said he had a room available with 3 beds that would fit us. 
He was very honest and said that currently the motel was being used as WINZ emergency accomodation. He said that the current tenants were respectful and would pose no problem. And if they did, he would be onsite overnight, and we could ring anytime. Didnt fill me with much hope, but I was very grateful for his honesty. Check In was next store at the Hygate Motor Lodge. The lovely gentleman had kept reception open until 10pm for us to check in. 

Lots of parking, including directly outside the unit. There were a few kids running around screaming outside, among the beaten up, unregistered unwarranted cars. However once inside, we didn't hear anything, including any road noise from the busy main arterial. 

Room was dated, and probably not as clean as it could have been, with cobwebs and hair. But the beds were comfortable, and the linen spotless. Good water pressure in the shower. Had a Sky Decoder, but could not get the TV to work at all. There seemed to be a cable missing. 

At $220 for the night, we found it to be SEVERELY overpriced, and probably taking advantage of a booked out city. I mean really, it was a dated room, in a emergency accomodation motel. Far to expensive for the product received. 

Probably would only give 2 stars, but have decided on 3 stars purely based on the Gentleman at Reception and his honesty and friendliness.

title: Perfect
text:
Beetham Park Motel

Hamilton

Relaxing

767391683

amazing...clean...relaxing...the shampoo made my hair silky soft...more than enough sugars coffees etc which is lacking in some places...super friendly...shower was like a massage 🙂🙂...definitely be recommending to others.

title: Winz Housing provider
text:
Place was nice clean and tidy but beware most guest are staying through winz. Full of broken down unregistered cars. Police visited in the morning. My take is if are going to provide winz accommodation dont mix in paying guests. Although we had very little issues with the other guests me and my wife dont work full time to pay lots cash for holiday to be put in social housing. 4 stars as it was clean and tidy but if I read the last review I would of stayed elsewhere as I want to stay with other tourists not in a social housing unit.

*rant*
Please dont take this as welfare bashing. I am ok paying taxes to help out the needy but putting people in motels seems crazy. Couldnt book another night in our rotorua hotel as that was getting fenced up to become another covid hotel. Kind of hard to support local economy with travel when a bunch of the hotel we stay in are becoming covid hotels and the motor lodges are full of winz clients.

title: Weary
text: Currently this motels primary business is to providing emergency housing. They continue to take bookings from the traveling public for the Very Few vacancies. Providing this housing service is necessary - and lucrative if you maintain near to full occupancy. It’s just not smart to put travelers/tourists in this motel under these conditions. Be aware. It cost us $$$$ in stolen property.

title: Great value for the price
text: We were literally on our last night in New Zealand and didn’t want to overnight in Auckland so we just booked something on the way to crash. This place was much more tho! It was spacious and convenient, clean and very quiet! Got a bit confused at check in as you do so in the motel next door, but other than that, very very nice stay!

title: Great value for money
text:
We had a large, spacious studio for the night while our house was being renovated.
Clean, comfortable, well equipped with a big TV.
Bed was comfortable, the location quiet and parking was fine.
Yes, we would stay again without hesitation

title: What a wonderful experience A+
text:
Was suppose to be staying with relatives but at last minute had to find a place to stay. Beetham Park Motel had a vacancy and was 1 minute drive to my relatives so we booked.. To be honest I wasn’t expecting much as it was a motel... BUT this place has proved me wrong and has provided A+ Customer service. Everyday we got clean towels and room was tidied. My cups were cleaned and put away. After a day out I called in in the afternoon to put heater on to warm room for when we got in later and it was already done for me.. 
I just want to say Thank you for making my stay relaxing and making it feel like home away from home... 
Definitely recommend this place..

title: Excellent motel
text:
We had a spacious king studio , very clean and very comfortable.
Quite location.  Well equipped. Wi-fi had a reasonable speed,  Owner very friendly and made us welcome, will certainly visit again if in the area.

title: FANTASTIC FANTASTIC!!!
text: We recently stayed 2 nights at this motel everything was fantastic. Extremely comfortable beds very clean and tidy and also nice and quiet. We had booked online for 1 night and then were moving on with a school group but after 2 nights in a hostel and not a lot of sleep we decided to go back so after a late night phone call the owners were so pleasant and helpful!!! They had been down to our room turned the lights and made us feel very welcome even though it was as after 10pm. Highly recommended this motel to others

title: Comfortable and quiet
text: We stayed 2 nights here recently and were very happy with value for money in a quiet location. The reception staff were very friendly and helpful. The unit had a bath which was really nice. Only comment was the pillows were too soft and uncomfortable but apart from that it was a pleasant stay
hotel_response:
Thank you for your review. It was a pleasure to have you stay. Next time we are happy to swap out your feather pillows for others - only happy to oblige!
regards,
Management

title: Great stay
text:
Was booked to stay at another motel on ulster rd but with the heat & humidity the room with no air con meant I wasn't prepared to stay even one night so walked down to this motel !! 
So glad I did was greeted by lovely lady on reception (sharon) who I took to be the owner & she quickly got me booked into a room. I was in room 8 which was immaculate from top to bottom with all the fixtures & fittings you would need including all the sports & movie channels as well as a Californian king bed !!! 
Bathroom had plenty towels & lots of products for showering & something that they did which I've not seen before was room service was every day although as I had to work shift they worked round that for me which was again above & beyond 
Would recommend this motel in a heartbeat & hope to come back some time
hotel_response: Thank you for your wonderful review! You are the classic example of a model quest. We hope to welcome you back to Beetham Park Motel in the future.

title: Peaceful rooms and very clean
text:
Beetham Park Motel stands out amongst the plethora of motels in the area just by how well the exterior is maintained.

The first thing I noticed as I entered was how big the accommodation was, then how clean everything was, then I gasped at the MASSIVE bed that proved to be very comfortable.

Our bathroom was decent in size and had a good bath/shower combination. The kitchen was fully equipped, although I found it a little ergonomically awkward with not so much work surface. I successfully prepared breakfast each morning and cooked for two on two out of three evenings. (The final night I ordered pizza from Hell Pizza to be delivered - much recommended!)

The room had quiet and efficient air conditioning, a very large tv with 50+ channels, and free Wi-fi.  The free use of the laundry facilities was really appreciated!

I was most impressed with the daily room housekeeping service - very thorough! In fact, I’d say the best room refresh I’ve experienced anywhere!

Everyone at Beetham Park Motel was really friendly, and we had a pleasant stay overall.

title: Hamilton Sevens
text:
We found the Booking lacking in Professionalism
Motel was over priced
This Motel is an older Motel
Motel is very Clean
Shower was over the Bath and at a very low Height even for a short person. Water was luke warm in Shower
This Motel does not suit a Family as outside space is limited to driveway only
There is no Spa Pool or Swimming Pool
hotel_response:
Thanks for your response. We will contact you personally to see what the issue was with professionalism as we pride ourselves on being friendly and accommodating to our guests as all of our previous feedback can attest to.
