We do cater for adults mostly, both corporate and private bookings, however on the odd occasion there are children. Guests appreciate the facililtes we do have of air conditioning, the 42 inch TV's with 52 channels of SKY, the huge beds, the comfy furniture, high standard of cleanliness and the excellent room service they get. We are a small quiet motel, the units are situated back from the road,  and we do not cater to those that wish to disrupt others. Guests can park right outside their units and access it without stairs. As an aside we are very proud of our beautiful row of conifers !!!! 
So future guests you can be assured we will look after you.

title: Comfortable and spotless Motel
text:
Australian couple mid 60's.  

We were in Unit 1, smallest unit in the motel complex and closest to the road.

The room was spacious and spotless.TV had excellent reception with Sky. Shower was hot with very good pressure. The bathroom was also spotless with no "off" smells. We did not hear any road noise during the night. Free WIFI was available in the Unit  but as we did not use the Internet I cannot comment on speed or reliability. 

Bar fridge, 2 hot plates, microwave oven, toaster, kettle, iron and ironing board. Cutlery crockery also provided. Washing machines are  available in the guests laundry.

Overall a very nice motel which I can recommend without hesitation.

title: one-night stopover
text:
A family-owned motel. Management and staff very cooperative and friendly.
An older style motel which has been extremely well maintained - rooms scrupulously clean and tidy. Large TV with Sky available - free wifi internet.
Cannot recommend too highly - an extremely pleasant experience for a reasonable tariff.

title: Value, location and unlimited Wifi with 50+ SKY channels
text:
Very friendly staff. Room was large with a king sized bed. The shower was powerful and nice and hot. We stayed two nights.  It was nice and quiet. Our towels were replaced daily.
Even had an ironing board and iron which we made use of. Thanks.

title: Good value quiet motel
text: Called in seeing they had a vacancy. Very helpful and polite. Room very good and value for money. We were in no14 so away from the road and no noise at all. Easy to find off the SH1.Near the centre of Hamilton with all its facilities. Motel offered free washing machine, powder and drier. Good to see in the room that it had comfortable sofas to sit on in the evening so not having to sit on the bed like a lot of motels. The electric job was but worked but an upgrade to halogen or induction would be nice. Much easier to control the cooking and faster. Would recommend this to anyone in the area looking for a good nights stop.

title: Comfy Hotel
text:
A nice overnight stop. And all one needs for a good nights sleep. 
I just wish the motels would discount for solo travellers. 
But other wise no complaints

title: Unlimited Wifi, Clean
text:
Excellent stay in Hamilton. We stayed 10days. All staffs at motel are    kindhearted. The motel has guest laundry room for free of charge. 

 Each room has a green view through window. Quite, Neat 
Big bathroom. Shower pressure are awesome. 

Close to town center, Hamilton garden.

title: A pleasant stay
text: Family of 4 spent 2 nights in the motel on Ulster st. Check in was seamless, wifi provided and beds and room clean. Shower nice and hot. The only negative Is that is a little dated but a very very minor point. Staff very friendly and accommodating and tv has most of the pay TVs channels. Well recommended

title: Lovely home away from home
text: Lovely homely motel.  We stayed four nights and the service was friendly and nothing was a problem.  Coming home late at night and finding curtains shut and heat pump on was wonderful.  Big rooms and lots of space.  Californian suite bed was amazingly big.

title: Amazing Hospitality
text: My stay in Hamilton was stressful due to a very sick husband in Hospital. I could not have found anywhere better to stay, the unit was spacious which allowed me to have family and friends to stay with me when they visited, the beds were very comfortable and it was quiet & peaceful during the night to allow me to get the sleep I needed to cope. The management and staff were kind & caring during the five weeks I stayed there.

title: Good Guest Parking
text: This motel is very nice, showing it's age a bit in some ways, but was clean & the bed was comfortable, a good size bathroom & our unit had a kitchen. It was very handy having parking right outside the unit as the day we left  it was raining.

title: Huge!
text: I feel like I've just taken a step into the USA!!!Everything is huge. The bed, the rooms, the units are like houses with everything you need! Close to town and minutes away from everything thing. Highly recommend.Great stay and will be back!

title: A hidden gem
text: Fantastic room for  family of 4. Comfy beds, ample space, tidy, warm and very clean. Will be visiting again. Very quite rooms and unlimited free wifi. A hit with 2 teenagers. Easy to find and fantastic parking directly outside of the room.

title: Quiet and spacious
text: this hotel is lovely. We arrived booked in . We were given 1 gb of date for each of our phones and iPad. We walked into our room and the heater had been turns on for us . The room was spacious great kitchen.

title: Nice & cosy
text:
Enjoyed my stay here for work.
Unit spotless and tidy.
Fantastic big bed, unit was beautiful and warm with the heat pump.
Kitchen was well appointed.
Bathroom was a good size.
I will be back to stay on my next visit

title: Undependable, book elsewhere
text:
Despite booking 8 months in advance and receiving a booking confirmation, we pulled up jet-lagged to the reception just after noon and were told "we're full up".  This is the last thing you want to hear after a long international flight to NZ!  Was told alternate arrangements had been made two doors over, like I should be grateful to be plonked in some place I have done no research on, and no apology either.  When I pressed for an explanation I was told that these things happen, and when I asked how I was told that guests had decided to stay on longer.  Really? I'm not sure why they bother taking reservations if it's first come, first served?

Btw, the alternate accommodation motel tried to charge me the same rate as the Beetham, despite the fact that initially their paperwork showed a price 30$ cheaper ("oh, that's a mistake").  When I checked the rates online they were also 30$ less, so in the end they offered me the lower rate.  Guess you have to be on your guard...

I suggest you book somewhere that understands the concept of a reservation, and that way you can avoid a fiasco like this was for us.
hotel_response:
We sincerely apologize to this customer for the way in which their booking was handled. Unfortunately there were circumstances that were beyond our control and we were forced  to locate this customer to another motel. This other Motel was well regarded by ourselves and we felt that the customer would be well treated at this establishment. Unfortunately we had no say in the price that the Motel chose to charge the customer. 

If you check all our our previous reviews and comments you will see that we receive glowing reports. This is a one-of incident and one that we will strive to never let happen again. We again apologize to this customer and would like to welcome them back to Beetham Park Motel in the future.

title: A good palce to stay
text: We stayed here for three nights over Queens birthday weekend and found the motel a warm and friendly place. It well met our needs for the three nights. It was close to the shops and the river cycle way

title: Amazing
text: Lovely service and the californian king size bed was like lying on a cloud. Had the best night's sleep in a long time.  Nice and quiet and no road noise. More than enough channels to choose from on sky.

title: Great Value For Money
text: Had a week of holidaying and this was our base from which to see the sights and also pop up to Auckland for the day. The various units were full every night yet never any noise to disturb us. Room was well appointed with good TV & Sky. Comfortable bed, good sized table, roomy bathroom, free daily paper available and heaps of free WiFI - superb package. We were impressed by the courteous and friendly house keeping staff. Recommend this motel for providing great value at a reasonable cost. Cheers!

title: Exceeded Expectations
text:
Was looking for a cheap motel for one nights stay in Hamilton after a long tiring week. Booked this room because they had Sky Guest Select and an in-house movie felt like a good idea.
Felt welcome from the moment I stepped foot on the property. Very clean tidy property, well maintained gardens. Warm friendly welcome at reception. Was escourted to my room and shown how to work the TV and how to negotiate the tight driveway (was easy once shown how!)
The bed was possibly the most comfortable thing I have ever slept in! I want one for my own house.
Perfect water pressure not to hard adn not to soft. The only thing I noticed wrong with the room was the paint was peeling off the ceiling where it met the walls. I only noticed this becuase I washed my hair adn had to look up! Otherwise everything was perfect. Room was clean and smelled nice. All amenties in the room clean and well presented. Room layout was perfect everything where it needed to be. 
Breakfast was fresh, and served promptly.
Will be back.

title: 2nd time at the Beetham
text: This was our 2nd time at the Beetham. The staff when booking and checking etc in were very friendly and helpful. The decor could be more modern or contemporary, The unit was clean. The issue that I have is that the very bright very white lights were fitted in the living area & kitchen of the type I would expect in a bathroom.

title: Surprised
text: With lots of motels to choose from, my daughter and I liked the look of Beetham Park Motel and enjoyed our overnight stay here.   Comfy beds, well appointed motel, friendly staff, but most of all quiet, considering the main road.   Grateful for free wifi having travelled for 7 days without internet.   Received a good recommendation from staff re evening meal - Speight Ale House - which we really enjoyed.   Would return to Beetham.

title: Full Of Conveniences!
text:
I didn't know what to expect from Beetham Park Motel since I had never booked a motel in New Zealand. It turned out to be a good value for the money (approx NZ$115 a night plus extra person charges). We were able to use the mini kitchen to save money on dinner and breakfast. There was free WiFi as long as you had a code, and we received an extra code since two of us had Internet-capable devices. The flat-screen TV was mounted on the wall and came with a lot of stations that you could flip through. 

The room and bathroom were also clean. The towels were soft and not too thin. The bed was comfortable. The sliding glass door was a bit odd to me, but the location seemed safe and our car was parked right in front of our room.

Overall I'd suggest this to other travelers who want a quiet and clean place to stay in Hamilton!

title: Very well equipped motel
text: Our unit was spacious, with a settee for relaxing; not something you often find in a motel. The staff were most helpful, immediately going online to find the solution to one of our queries. It is some distance from the city centre, but there are two restaurants just across the street if you want a lazy evening.

title: Check this one out!
text:
Travelling through Hamilton to attend a wedding, This was a stab in the dark, and what a lovely surprise.
Tastefully decorated, spik as,  quiet, and a hostess with real kiwi cheer.
Thanks for the stay, shall come again.

title: Highly Recommend, Wonderful Stay
text:
We have stayed at this motel quite a few times and we go back because the motel rooms are clean, comfortable,the beds are huge,and there is parking outside each motel unit.  The owners are always helpful and friendly. It is very well located for getting into the town centre, and easy access to main highways and the railway station.If we come back to New Zealand and Hamilton we will definitely stay here again. 

Sue & John W

title: Brilliant motel - clean, comfortable and quiet
text: We have stayed in many,many motels all over the world and we were really very impressed by Beetham Park. The rooms are very large and absolutely immaculately clean. The beds were very comfortable - even the pull out ones for the children, the linen was good quality and we had a great nights sleep as the rooms are off the main road. The lady at reception was very helpful. It is a huge bonus that they include free wireless internet and you can use their washing and drying machines for free. Overall, i can't imagine ever bothering to book anywhere else if we are passing through Hamilton again.

title: Highly Recommend!!
text: Awesome place to have stayed. The staff were friendly and the rooms were extremely clean, roomy and welcoming. Thanks so much for having us, We hope to be back again soon. From Nicole & Ants

title: Great value, clean stay in Hamilton, NZ
text: For a $115/night stay, my husband, 2 year old and 6 month old are enjoying a stay in a Studio California King.  It is a bit dated, but all furniture is in excellent condition and very clean.  Reception was very friendly and was the room was ready for us at noon.  Probably want a car if you want to go to Victoria St, but still close (I imagine a cheap taxi ride).  Great value.

title: great service
text: i think this place is great because of the very friendly owners, they are very polite and helpful. I picked the motel because of the california king bed which was just awesome to sleep in. the service was excellent.

title: Everything we needed
text:
Just the best host's, attend to everything you need
Beds and TV soooo big
Warm and comfortable, quiet with a central location, we book 5 rooms every year and are very happy

title: Huge bed and flatscreen but nothing special
text: Bed was enormous but too soft. Room large and nice to have a couch too. Bathroom large and spacious but a bit rundown. Nice hosts and overall a pleasant and positive stay but nothing out of the ordinary although would stay there again.

title: Not bad but could do better
text: I booked this 2-bedroom unit on Wotif for $190 and apparently the normal rate is $280.  I would definitely not pay that, and actually I think it is worth more like $140-$150/night.  Good points - free internet and a cable supplied to you, comfortable chairs in the lounge, comfortable beds, spacious, huge TV and all the Sky channels.  Points that need work - bedrooms back onto the lounge wall of the next-door unit so got woken up early by breakfast TV from next door, couch uncomfortable as is typical of most couches that are actually fold-out beds,  Full kitchen but not that well equipped (e.g. no bowls to mix anything in), shower over the bath with a broken sliding door (definitely not suitable for anyone slightly elderly or unstable on their feet), and the noisiest air flow heater I have every heard (you need to turn the TV up to hear over this, also the air pumps out at about head hieght so nice and warm up by the ceiling and not so warm at seating height).  Not bad. but I have stayed in better for less.

title: Central location yet quiet
text: I chose this motel because it is located close to yet off the main road. The rooms are spacious and quiet, the service excellent yet unobtrusive.

title: Best motel in Hamilton, so welcoming and comfortable, all one level.
text:
Spent two separate nights with husband and two friends and found Beetham Park the very best motel ever!  Shaaryn and her partners welcomed us so warmly and when shown the rooms where we were staying in, it was WOW.  Huge comfortable beds, comfy couches, not hard chairs or the bed to sit on while watching the very big flat screen tv. 
We were very impressed with the cleanliness of the rooms.  In fact we were so comfortable we ordered in our dinner so we could relax and unwind after many hours of travelling.
Definitely recommend Beetham Park and would be happy to stay there again.

title: Spotlessly clean, spacious luxurious rooms, value for money, excellent service
text: Stayed here for 3 nights and loved it. Quiet location but within easy walking distance of both CBD,  the river and supermarket. My husband enjoyed the 42" flat screen tv and 40 Sky channels whilst I took advantage of the free internet and laundry facilities. We've been travelling NZ for the last 5 weeks and this is by far the cleanest, most up to date motel unit we have stayed in. It is also the cheapest. We felt very secure too with surveillance cameras and lighting on the premises as well as an alarm system in our room which could be activated if desired. Reception and housekeeping staff were extremely helpful and they couldn't do enough for us. Added bonuses were the beautiful pictures in our room which had been painted by the lady owner and the Scrummy Hamilton Rugby team who train for 2 hours every morning in the field adjoining the motel.  We'll definitely make a BEELINE for BEETHAM Park Motel if we ever return to Hamilton again.

title: Great in every way
text: Stayed here only one night but would use it again as a base to explore this beautiful area. The motel ticked all the boxes for us.  Most importantly we had a great night's sleep - BIG, comfortable bed and the place was peaceful and quiet. Professionally run - genuine care for their guests comfort, this included directions and what was available and open on a Monday night for dinner. Room was spacious, large table to work on with free internet, couches to relax and watch a large screen TV. Everything available to prepare meals if you should wish. CBD a short walk away.  On top of this incredible value for money.

title: best around
text:
We found this motel on Jasons website,the room was LARGE and airy with airconditioning,heating,FREE broadband & laundry facilities and really clean and with 42" TV ,ofa and chairs. in the room was a queen size bed and 2 singles and still had plenty of room,lastly we found the owners very friendly and helpful.

specsaustralia

title: Great motel with
text:
Stayed here last week for business and was most impressed with the facilities.
Lovely spacious room, quiet, and parking right outside the room.  Nice big tv.  Had a couch in my room too, nice not to have to sit on a bed or a hard chair!
Free broadband - what a bonus!  

There is no restuarant here, but it seemed that there were plenty of options for ordering in.  Victoria Street is just up the road (literally) and there are lots of great choices there.

The ladies on reception were very friendly and helpful.

Would def recommend this motel to other travelers, for business or pleasure.

Maungakawa Villa is an outstandingly beautiful bed and breakfast near the lovely small city of Cambridge.
We stayed in the Kauri Room which had an exceptionally comfortable king size bed and was decorated with wonderful art.  The owners, Kaye and Grant Bezett, are art dealers and collectors and the lovely garden is full of sculpture and the public areas also are full of lovely paintings and art objects.
We really appreciated all the hospitality and generosity provided by Kaye Bezett.  Not only were there hors d'oeuvres and wine in the room's fridge, but Kaye made us two delicious dinners featuring fresh vegetables and fruit from their gardens.   We enjoyed talking with her about art and local artists.  She also suggested interesting back roads to places we wanted to visit, and actually helped me find an audiologist when I needed one.  What can I say except that it was a terrific stay.

title: Perfect Stay
text:
What a great place to base yourself in Waikato.
Beautiful old house with such a gracious and helpful host in Kay.
Cambridge is such a great location, only an hour to get to Raglan on the west coast or Mt Maunganui on the east coast, both stunning 
Enjoy a sumptuous breaky cooked by Kay at anytime you request. Her homemade sourdough is to die for, and don’t get me started on those cookies….
Be sure to book Alpino in town for dinner, amazing food but always busy.
Enjoy

title: Surprise Luxury
text: After a visit to Hobbiton (awesome) we found Kaye’s place.  Kaye called to make sure we were safe and on the way. She was so gracious and welcoming.  She had lots of goodies.  Her place is a beautiful property with lovely rolling hills and a pond.  You stay in a separate house with a great bed and shower.  Breakfast to order the next day was stunning.

title: Quiet and beautiful setting.
text: Relaxing, quiet guest quarters a short drive from Cambridge.  Excellent breakfast prepared and served by our friendly host.  We had a great view of the hills surrounding Cambridge from our room.  If you're going to Cambridge to enjoy the cycling and scenery, this is an excellent place to end your day.

title: A wonderful experience, highly recommend!
text:
Amazing experience. 
Kaye and Grant are an incredible couple who were so welcoming that I felt I was part of their family.

Lovely gardens, accommodation and delicious pancakes for breakfast. 

So much more of an experience than a typical hotel, I will definitely be back!

title: Amazing stay at Maungakawa Villa
text:
We were in Cambridge for an impromptu night away and came across Maungakawa Villa. I called Kaye and she got back to me straight away and we were booked in. We stayed in the Kauri room and it was absolutely lovely. Kaye and Jonathan are amazing hosts; Jonathan offered to take us into town for dinner, we enjoyed a glass of wine in the spa overlooking their block as the sun went down and woke up to a very generous breakfast cooked by Kaye.

The house itself is beautiful, with an incredible art collection and the room is spotlessly clean and very well appointed.

We’d love to come back and definitely will if we’re ever in Cambridge again.

title: Lakeside in Hamilton
text:
Yes, it's a home stay, not a Hotel. This could be better communicated, though the pictures do show rooms in a home! 
We weren't bothered by it.
Our room was clean and well appointed, facilities were clean and well presented, the shower had great pressure too.
Our host txt'd our security code and asked us to let him know when were had arrived, which we did, no problems getting in and were invited to make ourselves at home, which we did.
The deck was amazing and the lake is exactly 4.68 Kilometers around, yes, we walked it. 
For the price, it's well presented overall cleanliness and serviceability, location and proximity to everything, we've  rated James's home stay 4 out of 5.
We would not hesitate to stay again.
Cheers James for a great place to stay at an affordable rate.

title: Sooo dirty!
text: In Hamilton for family occasion and thought we had booked a special treat by the lake. While the view is fabulous, the beds comfortable and the house really spacious ...it was sadly very very dirty! There were bottles and tins everywhere, rubbish was spread across the back lawn, the cupboards and drawers were dirty, there was empty shampoo bottles in the showers, old bunches of flowers on the deck, the bins were full and cigarette butts everywhere! In their defence they may have just had a big group stay but I'm afraid the rubbish looked like it had been there awhile. Such a shame as could be a really nice place.

title: Listed as a hotel but is a homestay
text: Why is this misleadingly listed as a hotel on Trip Advisor. This actually not a hotel but rather a homestay. After making a booking my pregnant wife and I showed up on the day to a house. When asking the owner why it was listed as a hotel he immediately became irate obviously having experienced this before as we found later with more reviews online. He told us if we don’t like it we can find somewhere else to stay which we had to do making is late for a wedding that afternoon. Short of knocking him out for his immediately confronting attitude and denial of any responsibility the best next thing is to make anyone else about to fall for this to NOT. Here’s another complaint online for reference

title: Fabulous Guest House
text:
This is one for anyone looking for freedom without rules - I say that as the guest house is owned by the nicest person I have met in a long time - this is a house with lots of rooms - come and go as you please - use the kitchen and washing facilities if required. The view from the front is breathtaking as it is literally on top of Lake Rotoroa. Which in itself is a great walk/jog around - full of wildlife.
I was in a small single room - travelling solo - so i only needed a bed to sleep and a base for my case. The town of Hamilton is only 10 mins walk away - I mapped out the route and found it easy. 
Used the main house lounge and kitchen - cooked food for myself and watched T.V in comfort. Got to say this was my ultimate favourite hotel/guest house of my time on North Island visit. 
Big thanks to James and his brother -- such nice people made my stay all the better.

title: it was OK for a night
text: We only stayed one night to break our journey. Functional and clean, but rooms are dated. Very quiet location in a residential area. Not much choice in Cambridge when we stayed as workers have booked out a lot of the accommodation in the town.

title: A good stay
text: Overnight stay while on our way to Auckland. Was a small way out of main town so had to take car to get food etc. Room was an older style with block wall and older style facilities however it was large and clean. Had standing fan instead of air con. Good kitchenette, had swimming pool which looked good but didn't use, couch in lounge had one end collapsed so unable to sit on it, overall a good stay.

title: Pleasant but wouldn't return
text: The 3 things that let this motel down are the Beds the Wifi and the TV.  We had a room with a queen & single and it was just to small for our height and way to bouncy.  Even though they say they have Sky Tv it does have some channels but no Sky remote and no guide so you don't know what is on at any given time and the TV is so slow to use.  The WiFi is not really fast or unlimited either.  On arrival you are given a few tokens, each token is 3Gigs after that you have to keep topping up all the time which is beyond irritating and then once outer tokens you go up to reception and ask for more.  There was no fire alarm in our room which was concerning and the motel does not have any Air Con apart from a pedestal fan and an electric heater.  The wooden blind over the kitchen window was a bit iffy and didn't work properly which was a pain.  On the plus side this motel is lovely and quiet and the rooms are a good size but it didn't have a table to sit at if you wanted to sit together and have dinner or play cards etc only a small bench and chairs. The pool is great and we loved a swim in it, its over 6 feet deep at one end and shallow at the other and a good length.  The grounds are lovely and well kept and there were areas where you could enjoy a drink in the sun at a table.

title: Good accomodation, great hosts and good amenities
text: I booked six rooms and we stayed here in Feb and again in March. We will stay here again, the rooms were great, amenities were good and the hosts were fantastic. The motel is a bit out of town centre but nothing a brisk walk didnt fix. We would recommend this motel without hesitation.

title: Clean and tidy motel room
text: The room was very clean and tidy, and quite spacious too. Had terrible problems with the internet, both with the supplied Wifi as well as using my own data - I gave up in the end. This is something that needs addressing, as internet access is a basic expectation in a motel in NZ nowadays. Quiet at night. Pool was lovely.

title: VERY GOOD ACCOMMODATION
text: Excellent quiet location, close to town centre. Very happy helpful proprietor. We were with family and had 2 separate units, both were immaculately clean, very spacious, good shower, toilet and basin. Excellent large kitchen bench and area with breakfast bar and very comfortable bed. Lovely grounds with swimming pool. Good value for money.

title: Only quiet from road noise
text:
Stayed here for my son's soccer tournament at St Peter's. Nice friendly staff. nice adequate for our needs motel, but I understand you get what you pay for so won't be too harsh. 1 issue though is that walls are thin, we could hear next door talking and also road workers off to work for the day started talking at 5:30am and we heard everything. Also shower was not the best, no pressure and a small nozzle, took me a minute to get the whole body wet. Mobile phone reception is very poor, and SKY tv reception was just as bad. 
Basically nice budget motel, but will stay elsewhere next time.

title: It's great, depending on your needs
text:
The room was fantastic; immaculately clean and well appointed.  The bed was comfortable and there was good heating (it was cold when we were there).  Hosts were friendly.
The downside was the lack of internet.  Rooms were advertised as having internet.  The signal was so bad as to not be workable.  We had work to do and had to resort to hotspotting off our phones.  Even that was problematic because there was very little reception in the room.  Phone calls were impossible.  We had to position the phone right up against the exterior door to get any signal.
Providing you don't need reliable and constant internet, this motel is lovely.  We were in room 13 so suggest avoiding that

title: This Is a quiet motel
text:
We have been staying at this motel for many years now and never had any problems.
This is still a very quiet motel with high standards of cleanliness and service from the hosts. Surroundings are immaculate with a pool available.
Rooms have the usual facilities with excellent shower and comfortable beds.Free wi -fi is sometimes slow.
Very close to Cambridge shopping area and parks.
Highly recommended.

title: Average
text:
- Quite dark room, needs brightening up, very stained and low couch. 
- 200 mb of wifi, have to ask for more, not sure whether your charged for it.
- 5 channels of sky, 2 sport, uktv,1 movie, 1 kids channel

+ Nice spacious main room
+ comfortable bed
+ clean unit, apart from couch!

title: Perfect for family with teens
text: Great size family room. Beds were really comfortable and motel was quiet, set away from busy roads/streets. Cleanliness could not be faulted. Had great ammenities. Affordable and hosts were lovely. Would definitely recommend.

title: Pretty popular motel
text:
We only had one night there but it was very comfortable, very quiet, easily accessible and a very warm welcome.The unit was well supplied with cooking utensils and there was a wide selection of channels available on the TV.
It is an older motel and could do with a bit of a refurb but good value for money. My only complaint was the thickness of the pillows - I like a thin pillow but these were all quite thick.

title: Quiet and clean
text: We stayed here for 2 nights; 4 adults in a family unit. The kitchen was well equipped with cooking untensils, cutlery, plates, hotplate, microwave, toaster and jug etc and a full sized fridge freezer. The bathroom was small but there was plenty of towels and toiletries provided. Beds were ok as were the pillows. The unit was a bit dated however it was fresh and clean. There was plenty of parking and no road noise. There was a guest laundry which we didnt use but good to have. The motel owners were friendly and helpful. The motel is on the outskirts of Cambridge but as its a small town it was only a short drive to the cbd. We would stay again.

title: Cambridge for one night.
text:
After a very long hot day in the sun, we booked here last minute to save the drive home to Auckland from Tokoroa as we had more work in the Waikato.

The room Tarif was very reasonable.

Staff were very friendly and helpful.

Nice quiet motel set off the side road off SH1.

Good size room with spacious parking in front of the unit.

Families were enjoying the pool as it was a very hot day.

The room had nice comfortable bed and pillows.

Good size bathroom which did need a little paint but in all the room was clean.

There was no air conditioning, only a fan which we had going all night.

The staff warned us that the wifi which was free was intermittent but we found by choosing the connection with the strongest signal we had no problems.

title: Good sized rooms and friendly staff
text: We booked two nights with 1 bedroom unit first night for 3 and studio on second night for 2. The third person didn’t turn up and the owner reduced the price despite us not advising him until check in. Very nice surprise! Rooms were clean and very spacious, including the studio. Staff were very friendly, and location was 10 min walk to trotting track and about 30-40 mins walk to town. Downside was wifi was not great and reception  for xtra network weak. I would stay here again.

title: Free wi-fi -  what wi fi
text: I booked this motel for a night off their own website.  Well, photos on website do not reflect the rooms.  The room I booked and the room I was given were two very different things.  I asked to change rooms, which was done, only to find the new room had no wi fi at all.  Oh, just sit outside to get wi fi.   I had two hours plus of administration and paper work to do.  It was not suitable to sit outside.   So I asked for a refund and left.   Warning, see the room and check wi fi  before paying.

title: Clean and quiet
text: Nice owners very friendly and helpful. Bed was a little hard and sounds travel though walls.  No rd noise so u get a good night sleep. Found couch was to  low for a person who has limit mobility, motel was clean and Tidy and your Nice and close to village for takeaways

title: Quiet Motel
text: Stayed two nights at this motel. The internet was very sketchy but they gave us lots of internet codes to use. Nice clean rooms, the pool was warm and nice. Sitting area around pool was good. The only complaint is my son was feeling really sick the next morning and I was trying to pack up and help him and they were trying to rush us out of the room so fast. I know there Is rules but was a little upset at how they didn't seem to care. I let my son lay in the room anyways till a cab came to get us. We took a cab to Hamilton and stayed in the best Motel ever. And they were constantly asking how my son was while we stayed there for 3 days. Just the little things help when we are travelling from across the world.

title: Missing sheets??
text: Four adults (two couples) were booked in online for a one night stay in a one-bedroom unit that had a queen bed in the bedroom and a fold-out couch in the lounge plus an extra single bed in the bedroom as well.  When my partner and I returned from our local wedding around midnight we were surprised to find that even though there was a single duvet and two pillows provided for the fold-out, there were NO SHEETS!  We were tired and it was a bit late to wake the manager so we toughed it out.  Disappointing.
hotel_response: Sorry for your unpleasant stay with us. We may have overlook your requirement during your check in.

title: A Quiet Motel
text: My wife and I stayed for 2 nights and had no complaints at all. Very friendly staff and well serviced. Bed very comfortable, wi fi a bit patchy but free. Complimentary paper if ordered. We have stayed several times and will continue if we can  book as sometimes they are booked up.

title: NZ Holiday
text:
Best motel I have stayed with reasonable price ,staffs friendly , rooms clean provide with kitchenette facilities very accommodating for muslim family would definitely stay again in the future
Quite environment not too far from all the scenery beautiful NZealand

title: Value for Money
text: Owners were lovely and friendly and the Motel was clean and well kept. Price was perfect, kitchenette had all that was needed to cook a lovely breakfast. Shower had great pressure, Wifi vouchers were provided free which was handy as for some reason I had very limited service on my phone from inside the room. Location to town was not quite walking distance but was perfect for my requirements. Would definitely stay again if in that area.

title: Very Pleasant Stay
text: We stayed for four nights to attend a birthday function and had other family members and friends stay there as well.  It was convenient to where we needed to be and was in a nice quiet location.  Although an older type of Motel we found the rooms to be spotless and well maintained.  Towels were changed daily and the staff were very friendly.  A newspaper is available daily on request and breakfast can be ordered the night before.  Limited free WiFi of 200MB/day but you can obtain extra vouchers on request.  A laundry is available and the Motel has a pool.  Only complaint was that the bed was too soft and sunk in the middle so is in need of replacing.  Would also like heat pumps on the walls rather than smaller mobile heaters, although we found they heated up the room fairly quickly.  We would definitely stay there again and found the pricing to be reasonable.

title: Clean & Pleasant
text: We stayed here for one night recently. The room was clean and tidy and the area was very quiet. We decided to have breakfast in our room and it was plentiful and served at the time requested. The staff were friendly and helpful especially with recommending local eateries. This is a good clean motel in a small country town. I would definitely stay here again when passing through.

title: Good size family room
text:
Very pleasant reception and intro to our spacious room, two adults and 3 teenagers.
Very clean but did smell musty. Every thing that we needed was available with extra towels, blankets and pillows. Shower water pressure was poor, Double bed was not great and 'roll together' was evident during the night!
Would certainly stay again and was well priced and situated in quiet street.

title: Dated room
text: Our room we could here people next door and vehicles arriving late at night. Bed was very soft and in our opinion in need of replacing. Inexpensive place to stay for one night.We decided to drive in to Cambridge due to the rain. Laundry facilities were old but useful. No instructions for only a cold wash of laundry. Door locking system where you lock the door before you leave the room.Noisy fridge. Advertised as free wifi but after a short time to FaceTime our daughter in UK, it was her birthday, the wifi limit was reached and we were cut off. Consequently paid 10 NZD to rejoin network. We feel this should be refunded. Reception empty when we left.

title: Clean basic room
text: Our room was fairly basic but was clean and comfortable.  About 20min walk from town centre. Friendly helpful staff that were obliging when we asked to check in early.  Great pool.  I would stay there again.

title: Nice place - a few things not happy with
text:
The room is light and airy on first impressions, the kitchen small but convenient with all that is needed for a one night stay.  The shower has very little pressure (Room 2), the bed comfort is okay for one night.  Wifi was free but a hassle because you have to keep logging on with different voucher numbers, which don't last long, and the connection is weak.  The television has Sky but there were no instructions on how to get to it; plus the reception for standard TV was awful (screen often froze and had jagged lines).

The worst part of our stay was the party that started early in the evening right next to our bedroom, and even though the office also backed on to this neighbour's house, they did not do anything about it - finally I rang noise control at 2:00 am, after approximately 6 hours of loud music and bad singing.  I realise this is not the motel owner's fault, but they should have taken responsibility and rung noise control themselves for the benefit of their guests.  We had to get up, look up the phone number in the book (which wasn't easy finding being not from Cambridge) and go through the hassle of saying our name etc before we could get them to do their job.

On that note, we would not come again.

title: Hotel with tranquility
text: Cambridge is a good location to be a hub for visits to Hobbiton and Hamilton. We found this quaint Hotel online and upon reaching here, found the host to be extremely hospitable. The facilities are also very good from bed, shower facilities and personal frontage car park. Though they do have a pool, we did not manage to use it. Location of hotel is about 1km from town and we found Cambridge a good size of not to busy or bustling but sufficient to get food and activities.

title: 1 nighter
text: Lovely clean motel situated in a quiet street in Cambridge new zealand. Helpful staff, close to all ameneties, off street parking, beautiful swimming pool for kids, fully fenced, just cant say enough.Big rooms with big bathrooms. The room we had also had wheelchair access and seat and was a studio big enough for 3 people.

title: 1 night stay for bmx
text: Booked for 1 night. Big room.  Sky tv. A bit cold for a swim. Friendly man on the counter, very welcoming showing me where everything was in the room. Comfy bed too. Quiet rooms down the back with no road noise.

title: 2 Day stay while visiting family
text:
Very Clean and the room was larger than the average room. The host was extremely friendly and efficient. We would definitely stay here again.Plus it was just off the expressway and was very quiet.
The cost was only $125.00 which was great value.I have stayed in more costly rooms that were way below the stand that this room was. We will definitely be going back.

title: Still in the 20th century.
text: We had expected slightly more from a motel in Cambridge, although to be fair, it wasn't expensive so that should have indicated to us that it was not top of the range. This is a very average motel, with dated decor, a bit too far from the centre of town to be a comfortable walk in winter.

title: Good place to stay
text: I booked a family room for a night.  This motel a bit far from the town but quiet.  The room was clean and comfortable and the amenity looked luxurious. However, there were some tiny bugs in the toilet in the morning as there was no screening installed on windows. The Wifi was free. There was a parking space right in front of our room.  The owner was very informative.  There was a swimming pool but not heated.

title: What you get and don't get pfor $125
text:
What you get is:
Good WiFi
A pool which we didn't use
TV which we didn't use
Bugs - kill count was 2 flies, 1 moth and 1 spider 
A fridge and kitchen equipment
A shower that has very low water pressure 
A floor tile that your shoes will stick to
A wall paper border that is coming off the wall
Good parking
A quiet location, a bit out of town

What you don't get is:
Kleenex 
Air circulation unless you want to leave the window curtains open
A firm mattress

I reckon it is worth $90.

title: A Real Gem, highly recommended
text: This motel is situated a bit out of town, but is in a beautiful quiet setting. Rooms are clean, comfortable and quite large with all the basic facilities. The gardens are lovely, and there is a good sized outdoor swimming pool with separate towels provided for this on request. Wi-Fi is free and there is a good signal. There are no shops or restaurants in the immediate area, but the Clubhouse Sports Bar and Grill at the local race track is a comfortable 10 minute walk away and is well worth a visit

title: Quiet and comfortable
text: Nice little motel tucked away in a quiet street. Was easy to locate with a GPS. The streets were wide and there was no traffic. We booked 2 rooms for 3 adults and 3 children, overnight for the dinner tour at Hobbiton. The staff were very friendly. The rooms were very clean, modern and had everything we required. Peaceful nights sleep. There is a pool, however we did not use it. Gardens are immaculate. Few minutes drive to get to the shops. Hobbiton was a half hour or so drive. Not the closest accommodation to Hobbiton, however did not take too long. Highly recommend this motel.

title: Very peaceful
text: A lovely quiet motel , very clean with a lovely pool and most helpful owners.Cambridge a delightful small town with an array of good shops and excellent selection of restruants, coffee shops etc. Our favourite was Onyx. Cambridge is an easy 2 he drive from Auckland and an excellent centre for cycling and water sports.

title: Highly recommend
text:
This is a very nice place to stay. Rooms are very nice and comfortable. Good swimming
Pool with swimming towels supplied. Would stay again if in the area. Highly recommend .Cambridge town and area is a lovely area to visit.

title: Great Service
text: We have stayed at a number of motels in Cambridge and Hamilton but we keep coming back to Colonial Court.  The owner is very helpful and even turned the outside lights off at night so that the room was dark enough for us to get a good night sleep.  The rooms are comfortable and reasonably quiet.  The outside pool was clean and inviting for the summer months.

title: Comfortable stay
text: Although older the place is well maintained with only a few minor issues with paint. I didn't spend much time in the place but it seemed good. There was a fairly new TV. Good kitchen with utensils, plates and cutlery.

title: This is a quiet motel
text:
My wife and I stayed 2 nights,having uninterrupted sleeps in a very comfortable bed. The owners have not been there long but are very well organised,very friendly and helpful.Very clean with all cooking facilities and also serviced each day including a morning paper.A little dated but this was no worry.

The sofa was a bit low which might be hard for the elderly to use but chairs ok,,free wi-fi.As it was cold weather we did not venture to the pool! Heaters kept the rooms warm, no complaints and will stay again if we can `get in`! Very handy to Cambridge.

title: Quiet place to stay with friendly staff
text: We stayed at The Colonial Court for three nights. The rooms were very clean & the beds were made for us every day whilst we were out. The staff were very friendly & helpful & the pool was superb ~ the kids loved it. You also have your own personal parking space outside your chalet. Reasonably priced & just a few minutes drive from Cambridge town. Can't really fault it.

title: We enjoyed The Stay!!
text:
Stayed for 3 days 2 nights with a family of 5. The room was spacious, cosy, tidy & clean. The room was complete with cooking utensil which makes my wife occupied for the whole stay :). We had a good quite rest & enjoyed the stay. We ordered breakfast & it was delivered to our room. There's a laundry room available in the motel.

The host Rizal & Faiz was super friendly & even our kids make friends with their daughter. We have a great time chit-chat with them. They were so generous with information on places to visit around the areas. 

It is very recommended to stay here. If we have the opportunity to come back to NZ we'll definitely stay here again.

title: Quiet and spacious
text: A sign on the main road to Hamilton pointed us in the direction of a quiet Motel. And it was lovely and quiet and very spacious. The kitchen was well equipped and we really appreciated the plunger with coffee supplied. Good information was available regarding dining options in Cambridge.

title: Quiet, clean and roomy
text:
Quite a sizeable unit that was well equipped and the amount of natural light was also good. It is located off the main through road and was quiet. It was clean, in good condition and included a full electric stove in the well equipped kitchen area.  The bedroom was separate.
The shower head was low which was a bit awkward and the water pressure not strong.

There was no free Wi-Fi and costs $10 per 100mb.

title: Comfortable and Clean
text:
Older style but spacious clean rooms. Very satisfactory for our 2 night stay.
Pool looks lovely and the kids were keen to swim but was still a bit chilly!! Nice and quiet location with good park area across the road to kick a ball around.

title: Overnight Stay
text:
Clean & tidy but a little outdated. In a nice quiet area of Cambridge. Relieving Managers were very pleasant. Only stayed in Cambridge as visited relatives. Would normally stay in Hamilton.
Good Irish Pub in town though for an evening meal.

title: Quiet tidy motel
text: Old style motel with plenty of space in the family room. Very clean , tidy and well maintained. TV in lounge only. Vodafone 3G coverage kept dropping in and out perhaps due to our room location. Good location for access to velodrome.

title: Overnight Cambridge
text: In a nice secluded quiet location. Studio unit very large but  a little dated but all necessary amenities provided. Very friendly host. Nice big swimming pool although we didnt have time to make use of this

title: Lovely hosts, clean & comfy but a bit overpriced
text:
Good quiet location, great pool. Rooms were clean and tidy it quite dated. Need a fan at least in rooms for sticky Cambridge weather. 
On the expensive side for just a very standard room. 
Hosts lovely and very friendly. 
Awful wifi that's impossible to get working.

title: Quiet and peaceful stay
text:
This motel is located on a side street off the main road at the northern end of Cambridge.  I stayed in a one-bedroom unit that had a queen bed and single bed in the bedroom and a single bed in the lounge. The kitchen had a microwave and also a stove so there was an oven for cooking. Bathroom has a shower box.
Although this is an older motel, it has everything needed and is very pleasant, clean and well maintained.  The lounge is small, but certainly adequate.
Being away from the main road was a bonus for us.
Would definitely stay again.

title: Lovely peaceful place to stay.
text: This is Glynis from Kapiti 4 Seasons Tours. On our first night going up to the Bay Of Islands our senior group had nine units at the Colonial Court Lodge in Cambridge. A charming lodge in a beautiful city, our stay was quiet and very comfortable with spacious rooms on ground level. Very good value, modern and clean, our hosts made us very welcome and we do plan to return...

title: Happy travellers
text:
Cambridge was the last stop on our road journey from Christchurch, and my family stayed for one night before returning to our home up north.  Cambridge is a delightful town with its pretty parks, central lake and leafy streets.  Colonial Court is located on spacious site, amidst a well established northern suburb, and is convenient to both the main road north through Hamilton, and the alternative route north through Gordonton. 

Our motel unit was the 1 br corner one that I had read some remarks about by a previous reviewer.  However, the central skylight and extra large kitchen window does provide plenty of light to make up for the lack of windows along the front of this particular unit.  The motel unit was well equiped, although the lounge area is a little restricted in size to accommodate a couch, a single bed and a dining table as well.  As we only stopped for the one night, the confined space was a minor issue only. Besides we are tidy travellers anyway.  

The motel grounds are delightful, and the owners take a lot of pride in presentation and customer focus.  Although it was late April, and the pool wasn't heated, my son declared it to be wonderfully refreshing and a decent size for swimming.  We enjoyed our stay at this motel, and will return for a future visit.  Thankyou Greg and Sylvia for your friendly hospitality.

title: Quiet clean refurbished motel
text: The hosts/ownwers of the Colonial Court are friendly and helpful. This motel is a nice size, is quiet and is located 150m back off SH1 at the northern end of town. It is across the road from the soccer grounds are nearby to the race course. Very clean refurbished rooms with good bathroom and new flat screen TV with Sky. Comfy bed, a nice swimming pool and plenty of parking space.

title: Quiet and Comfortable
text:
I have an aversion to cockroaches so when a large one popped out from behind the microwave oven as we were cooking, it slightly ruined what had been a good experience in this motel.

We stayed for one night to break our journey from Napier back to Auckland.  The motel units are well equipped and quiet.

As I have written in other NZ motel reviews, the vinyl and tiled floors need to be wet mopped from time to time as well as vacuumed and Colonial Court's kitchen floors are in need of this treatment.

Despite the above I would have to say that it was value for money and well appointed.

title: Quiet, Friendly, Excellent Value
text: Four adults stayed here for one night on our way up North.  Everywhere else in Cambridge seemed booked out due to a local event. We spotted a sign saying "Quiet Motel" and were lucky enough to get a room due to a cancellation.  Motel owners were very friendly and we received a free wifi voucher. Motel was clean and very tidy.  Design was the basic 'block' type of many similar motels.  Lovely swimming pool, which was much appreciated after a hot day driving.  Motel had everything we needed without being ostentatious or luxurious.  Being off the main road, where many motels normally are, meant it was quiet, which I really liked. Beds could have been firmer for our tastes.

title: excellent stay, very quiet.comfortable and clean
text: Friendly and helpful staff, nice flatscreen tv, plenty of channels, wi-fi by voucher,(given free as a favour), reasonable rates and overall a great stay.Wouldn;t hesitate to recommend this motel to anyone.

title: Vacation--Of a very high standard
text:
My wife and I spent 3wks at this motel. Greg and Sylvia were very helpful and nothing was too much trouble. The accomodation was excellent i.e Beds, cooking facillites and bathroom features, the cleaning staff were most helpful. The Motel is only 5mins from the towncentre and 20 mins from Hamilton. It is also centrally located for the Waikato area. I would highly recommend this quiet motel. There is also a large swimming pool.

graham evans

title: Spore Count High- Experience Low
text: Their website says "clean" and "stylish" ...Room 8 was far from it.  Black mould spores galore on curtains, windows, and rotting timber in the shower. (Google 'black mould health problems' and hold your breath). Inadequate ventilation in the bathroom so the mirror fogs up (which was in front of the hand basin, so I had to lean over it to apply my makeup, and with terrible lighting), and there is no other mirror anywhere. Antique TV with terrible reception. Dirty floors (I wiped them to convince myself that I was not imagining it). Horrible 'trampoline' bed (everytime my husband rolled over I became somewhat airborne). Desert plate had food stuck to it. The outdoor hanging plants are too low, so prepare to duck if you are over 5'7" (which my busband is). To avoid confusion, parking spaces should be numbered for each room. The uneven tiles around the pool are a hazard. This is not value for money as we can stay at the Millenium in Rotorua for the same price with top class rooms. The positive side... Sylvia was lovely, and it was "quiet" as advertised.  Sylvia...please get new cleaners.

title: Very very ordinary!
text: Substandard with minimal facilities, poor TV, poor internet and needed a good spring clean and full makeover. Curtains and windows dirty and moldy. Reasonably quiet.

title: One of the best
text: What a find!  Large, comfortable rooms with good cooking facilities, Large swimming pool. Situated on a quiet street yet within easy reach of the town centre. Friendly and very obliging managers. An ideal centre for touring the beautiful Waikato valley.  Highly recommended.

title: Very good value
text:
Traveling home and just looking for somewhere to stop overnight.  Priorities were for
* Quiet - peaceful sleep is so important when traveling.
* Clean -  very, very important for us.
* Genuine hospitality 
* Good service  
Although the decor is 'dated' it was spotlessly clean and we enjoyed our overnight stay here.  It met all our requirements and their referral for dinner was excellent.  (At the local trotting club) 
We would definitely stay here again without hesitation.

title: Will definately be staying here again.
text: A lovely little motel well away from the main road traffic, but close to the town.  The rooms are well appointed and have all the amenities you need.  It is an older style motel but it has been refurbished beautifully and there is no noise carry over from adjoining rooms that is so common in modern places.  The hosts are lovely people.

title: First Class Service
text:
My husband & I stayed here at the start of August for 1 night and could not fault the beautiful service we received here.
The WIFI was excellent.
Great help from Reception with a place to eat for dinner within walking distance.
Again great help from Reception with making calls for us to go to Hobbiton the next day.
Thank you for making our stay a memorable one.
Regards,
Jo & Mick :)

title: Perfect location, lovely host
text: The apartment is perfect.  Well located to easy walks around the town green belt, playground just around the corner, close to supermarket and even a little coffee cart down the road.  Off street parking which suited us as we had a kayak on top.  Andrea makes wonderful preserves and these were waiting for us as well as homemade lemonade, bacon and eggs for breakfast and a woodburner all set ready to light.  The Tuis play in the trees just outside.  Andrea goes above and beyond with equipping the apartment.  We basically wanted for nothing.  Highly recommend staying here, we will definitely be keen to stay again when we are back up this way.

title: Amazing stay, perfect host and an apartment with everything you might need and more! Like being at home but better :)
text:
Everything was absolutely perfect! The host, Andrea, is a really kind, thoughtful, polite and sweet lady. She made us feel at home from the very beginning. The apartment has everything you might need and more. Just like your own house...really, everything. They are so thoughtful that they have a first aid kit, sunscreen, make up remover, whatever you can think of! They also provide you with breakfast: bacon, eggs, fresh homemade lemonade, milk, butter, jam, toast, cereal, coffee and tea. They even had rice, some canned goods and all the kitchen utilities you might need. They even had board games, books, take away leaflets...
They had free WiFi that worked perfectly.
The house was spotless clean, which seems hard for such a big place. They had extra blankets, towels, pillows. 
In the morning, Andrea greeted us with some fresh strawberries too and she was really kind to us during the whole stay. 
The apartment is located at a 4 minute car drive from Cambridge center so everything is quite close if you needed too. Otherwise, you can enjoy the peace and quiet of the area. 
I would definitely recommend this apartment if you are visiting the area. Especially comfortable if you are traveling from Auckland to Hobbiton/Waitomo Glowworm Cave or viceversa.
To sum up, you will feel even better than at home. Stay here if you can.

title: Beautiful stay, love our time there
text:
Owners - Andrea is a lively elderly lady. We also met Bill her husband and Andrew their son, all very friendly and accommodating. 
Room - A beautiful spacious two bedroom unit attached to the main house with individual entrance. Very clean and cosy with a real fire place in the living room to keep both the living room and kitchen warm. Both bedrooms have heater which is much needed when we were staying there on 28Sep. There is no fan or air conditioner, something to note if staying in summer. 
Bed - Firm and has electric blanket which is so good on a cold night. We slept like logs. 
Shower/Bath - Very powerful water and warm too. Shampoo and shower gel provided are of good quality. Even cotton pad and makeup remover lotion is provided. A not so ideal is the separate hot/cold water tap at the wash basin. Challenging to wash your hands with either hot or cold water. 
Location - Perfect, less than 5mins drive from town and has street lights meaning you can return late after dinner. 
Breakfast - Ingredients were plentiful in the pantry with eggs, bacon, a variety of cereal, yogurt, fruits, baked beans, canned tuna, toast with butter and jam spread. We loved the home made honey lemon ginger drink and cookies. Enough for us to cook a very sumptuous breakfast. 
Wi-Fi - Sadly, not working during our stay and we needed the Wi-Fi to catch-up on work. Andrew loaned us his local phone as Hotspot and came to ask for it after dinner which we understand as these days, no one can live without their phones. So we had a night without internet. Hopefully their modem is fixed before the next guest checks in. 
All in, glad we stayed here among the many accommodation options in Cambridge. Keep up the great work Andrea and we hope to visit you again.

title: thanks to this lodge for its exceptional service and genuine care
text:
We had an unexpected car breakdown yesterday and didn’t manage to check in until very late at night, almost early morning. Despite the late hour, Ben at the reception welcomed us with incredible warmth and kindness.

He personally escorted us to our accommodation, helped carry our luggage, and was extremely thoughtful in considering our situation. Ben patiently talked through various towing-related concerns with us and made sure we felt supported and reassured after a very stressful day.

His professionalism, empathy, and genuine care truly made a difficult situation so much better. This level of service went far beyond our expectations. Highly recommend Podium Lodge — and special thanks to Ben for his outstanding help and kindness!

title: BEST LODGE EVER
text:
The best lodge We've stayed at so far, the rooms are spacious, clean, really modern just so amazing, the fact you can take your dogs is the BEST, we love Benji and his awesome management, big shoutout to you Uncle Benji you made our stay worth it, and we can't wait to come and stay again what a beautiful peaceful lodge with amazing facilities, always clean and spotless and the workers are always tending to our needs this place is great hardly noisy even though there's dogs all around. 
Perfect location for a getaway stay if you're on your way to Hamilton or Auckland. All amenities were perfect condition.

title: Absolutely superb
text: The service was outstanding. I was looking for accommodation with my dog. I rang Ben at Podium Lodge to absolutely make sure that dogs are allowed, (as some other websites had differing info). They are and he helped me with my booking straight away. It was stress-free, the room was cosy,  warm, super clean and super comfortable! Private enough and it lets in lots of sun and light. Olympic themed. It has a heat pump/air con. The bed is luxe. It had a TV and everything you need. No USB port but that's a small thing. Free parking. Quiet. Insulated.

title: Fantastic stay
text: Excellent hotel service was fantastic rooms where beautiful site was well looked after lay out was great highly recommend this hotel

title: Top class setup and location
text: The Lodge is owned by a charitable trust and if that's not a good enough reason to stay there, then the facilities, including common room and pool is.  Located very close to the velodrome and on the Te Awa bike trail.  Nicely proportioned rooms and very good bathrooms.  It also has accessible units.

title: A great place to stay
text: I had one night here when doing the Te Awa River Trail over a weekend. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the room was clean and tidy and had everything I needed. Plus the surrounding area is very quiet. I'll stay here again and I recommend Podium Lodge to anyone wanting to stay in or near Cambridge.

title: Industrial design in green New Zealand
text:
Grey industrial area instead of green beautiful New Zealand. It's some sort of the office space not even classical cozy New Zealand motels. Black boxes with offices inside - ugly terrible design. You need to wash your own dishes and clean your own room too. Didn't provide us two rooms as we requested instead put in one small apartment together, didn't provide refund because of that and didn't even apologize.
Owner is quite a grumpy person. 
Not recommended to international tourists.

title: Comfortable stay in a quiet, rural setting
text:
I stayed here for one night in August 2023.  The lodge is about a ten-minute drive from Hamilton airport, and a couple of minutes into Cambridge.  It would probably be a half-hour walk.  The lodge is located on a quiet rural road, just off one of the main roads into Cambridge.  The setting is very peaceful.

The room was very large with a kitchenette and separate bathroom.  It would be ideal for a long stay as it has all the conveniences.  In the complex there's a room with a large-screen TV and kitchenette and vending machines (a social area where people can mix), a laundry, charging point for electric vehicles, and plenty of carparking.

I chose Podium Lodge given its closeness to Hamilton airport and would certainly do so again.

title: Wonderful Stay with Comfortable Bed
text: First of all the staff are just fantastic at this motel😀 Friendly and helpful. The studio unit was clean and comfortable and at a reasonable price. There was plenty of grass area for our dog which was easy to get to and the location of the motel was great just being a quick drive from the Cambridge township. Good quality comfortable bed too😀 Thank you Bill for a great stay😀

title: Overnight in Cambridge
text: Very warm comfy units. Everything you need on hand. We flew into Auckland then drove down to Cambridge, new motorway makes it a easy drive. Easy to Find, modern luxury apartments.  Would definitely stay again.

title: Exceptional place for cyclists
text:
Simply perfect..    we had a couple of nights while cycling mainly the Te Awa Trail. The Podium is well located; very comfortable accommodation units; and a well appointed 
central block for groups to gather, self cater, and share stories of experiences.
All well supported by an exceptionally supportive team of staff.
Highly recommend…

title: A lovely stay
text:
A lovely motel. Spotlessly clean room. Lovely linen, comfortable bed. TV and air conditioning in room. Nice pool to cool off too. Helpful and polite staff.
I stayed one night as part of a team bein trained in Karapiro. 
Cambridge is a nice town with plenty of choices for shopping and leisure.

title: Booked 2 nights -stayed 9 !!!
text: We booked into Podium Lodge initially for two nights, We had a large family group of 3 x couples, a pet dog & parents in a campervan.  Unfortunately one of our group was admitted to Hamilton hospital unexepectedly before we had even booked in.  The staff went out of their way to help us & regularly checked in with us for updates on how our family member was doing.  They kept the rooms pencilled in for us - ensuring that we didn't have to change rooms at any stage & in one case charged us at a lower rate than what they could have.  They even left flowers & mandarins in our rooms - ontop of this the actual accommodation was fantastic with lovely clean, quiet rooms & very comfortable beds.  All the staff were exceptional to deal with - even down to the cleaners who were awesome & took a personal interest in our welfare.  We would all highly recommend the Podium Lodge as the only place to stay in Cambridge.

title: Trip to Cambridge
text:
We stayed one night and found the staff friendly and rooms tidy. Lovely spot, quiet and well off the main road 
A few small things let the review down. 
Both lampshades were not working with one needing a new bulb and the other was faulty. The beds looked new but were soft and sagging in the middle.

title: Lovely modern new units in peaceful location
text: The room was very modern, nice and clean and relaxing.  There is a large kitchen dining room on site.  Outdoor swimmig pool and set in a peaceful country setting. Good amount of car parking.  This accomodation is suitable for large groups for example school groups, sports group,s or in our case a car club outing.  Staff very friendly and helpful.  Also, 100% of the profit goes to charity which is fantastic.

title: Sporting event
text: Needs more general Maintenance done as many small things are broken such as doors not shutting properly, shower heads broken, pool was green etc. For the price/night paid we would expect better maintained facilities.

title: Eco minded, comfortable, fresh and clean
text: A few km's from Cambridge, the Podium is a lovely place to stay.  The staff are very relaxed, and the amenities are brand spanking new, clean and well thought out.  Perfect for a sporty, family or business trip with common area facilities and a well equipped kitchenette.  Thoroughly enjoyable and would recommend to all.

title: Shhh...keep this place a secret, it's a fabulous place to stay
text:
We stayed for one night on a recent cycling trip to Cambridge.  We immediately wanted to stay longer.  Podium Lodge is perfect for cyclists, sport groups and anyone else exploring the local area.  

I love the fact that it is owned by a community trust and throughout our cycling trip I saw plenty of evidence that the same trust is very committed to the Waikato - the Perry Bridge, The Perry Bike Park and Podium Lodge among a few.  

The staff were so friendly on check in and were more than happy to open the pool for us.  We had a fabulous couple of hours relaxing in the sun and swimming, with a just a cow for company across the fence.  

The rooms were modern, had plenty of space and were spotlessly clean.  They were also surprisingly quiet despite the facility being full due to a local rowing regatta.  The air con was also useful as it was a hot evening. 

The lodge is located on the outskirts of Cambridge on a quiet rural street, close to the Avanti Velodrome.  It was just a short drive into Cambridge for dinner.

We had a studio unit with two single beds (very comfy with excellent pillows - unlike many hotels).  It was in a group of about 5 that opened onto a courtyard with seating.  Close by was a shared kitchen if you wanted to self cater.  Our room had a microwave and kettle which was all we needed.

The cycling in this area was also much better than I expected and I'm looking forward to going back and heading South towards Karapiro this time.

Overall this is just a perfect place to stay and very reasonably priced.

title: Nice property nice owners
text:
This large modern motel in very spacious grounds on the outskirts of Cambridge was a very pleasant experience. The large self-contained studio apartment was impeccable. The owners/management welcoming. Nearby is the Bikery - a huge new and state-of-the-art Velodrome with all the ancillary fitness facilities and an excellent cafe for breakfast /Coffee.

Worth mentioning is the fact that Cambridge is only a short drive from Rotorua and makes, in my opinion, a far more attractive base for visiting the geo-thermal and many other attractions that Rotorua has to offer. I will not bother reviewing the motel in Rotorua where I stayed a week earlier. It was probably no better and no worse than a hundred others.
Podium lodge offered far superior accomodation at a much better price.

title: Weekend Getaway
text:
Utterly, utterly wonderful...this one year old complex is fantastic. From the amazing staff, the super friendly greeting, fabulous facilities to the beaut room. Everything about the Posium Lodge is perfect for a weekend getaway.
We hired bikes and they dropped us at the start of the Te Awa trail, at the end of the day they recharged the bikes ready for the next day exploring.
Seriously great place and a credit to the Brian Perry Trust.

title: Definitely ' a place with a view'
text:
Superb summer venue overlooking the picturesque Lake Karipiro. Excellent cafe faire coupled with friendly service makes this out of the way venue well worth the effort to find it. 
Word of advice, make sure you are heading to the correct 'Podium' as there is another establishment of a similar name located near the town of Cambridge, this being an accommodation facility only, don't confuse the two.
hotel_response: Oooops you have posted on the Podium Lodge's TripAdvisor page.....but we agree, Podium Cafe is a fabulous spot to relax, eat and enjoy the amazing Lake Karapiro!  Podium Lodge is an accommodation facility also in Cambridge, we might not have the views but we absolutely have the same friendly service and awesome accommodation solutions for teams, groups and travelers pit stopping Cambridge.

title: A wonderful Quiet location and much more
text: We booked this Motel for 4 nights on a black Friday deal (great price) and when we arrived we soon realized that this brand new Motel was an excellent choice. It is close to Cambridge, the Velodrome, SH1 but far enough away to be in the countryside and oh so quiet. The grounds are immaculate, the decor brand new, the bed was super comfortable, the bathroom was pristine and i cant rave on enough about how quiet the location is. The unit had a basic kitchen in it but "The Hub" was only 10 meters away which has a fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher, fridge, freezer etc etc etc. They have electric hire bikes for hire at very reasonable rates and you can ride them around the large complex or in the safe and quiet surrounds of the countryside. This complex caters for all types of people and groups as there is single rooms with king size beds, family units with two separate rooms and a lounge and it appears to have a dorm style complex for larger groups as well and they are all named after different Olympic games venues. we stayed in room 4 of the Sydney block, there were four rooms all the same then the family unit (#5) in a quad style set up but all with their own entrances etc. The part I liked the most about this complex is that it is a community project and ALL proceeds go back into the community. Well done Cambridge, very forward and community thinking right there. I will go back to this complex in a heart beat and recommend this venue to any couple, family, group who wants to stay in a new, comfortable and attractive Motel but don't forget about that lovely quiet location!!!!!
hotel_response:
Well thank you so much for you positive and comprehensive review!  We are always delighted that the vibe and vision of Podium Lodge is appreciated and loved by those who stay with us.

Now a year old, we look forward to enhancing Podium Lodge's offering further with lots of new developments over the coming months. 

Come again soon!

Regards
Anne and the Podium Team

title: Perfect Cambridge Adventure Base
text: New, clean, comfortable and elegant, Podium Lodge is handy to Avantidrome and is also excellent if you'e exploring the Waikato by bike, or even just passing through. And it's run so that all profits go back to the community, which makes it a wonderful enterprise to support. You can also hire bikes, electric and regular, so if you don't have a bike, you can  do some amazing cycle trails, like the beautiful Te Awa ride. Plus the staff are lovely and welcoming and the breakfast i ordered was delicious and healthy!
hotel_response:
It was fabulous meeting you Elisabeth and thank you for taking to spare a few moments to review us! Podium Lodge is the new kid on the block in the Cambridge accommodation scene.  We are proud and excited to offer a vibrant purpose built space for people to base themselves, no matter what the purpose of the visit to this very cool part of the country. 

We look forward to welcoming you again sometime soon.

title: Great new little lodge just on outskirts of Cambridge
text: This place is modern, new, clean and comfy. Really friendly and welcoming staff who gave us some great suggestions for eating in Cambridge. It is a short drive from the centre of Cambridge, but means it's very quiet and peaceful setting. All of the rooms are themed on the Olympics. Good facilities with mini kitchenette in the room, but full cooking facilities in the hub, and laundry if needed.
hotel_response: Hey thanks so much for taking the time to review our place and are delighted you enjoyed your stay with us.  We can't wait to offer a pool to our guests to enjoy this summer as a new offering.  Cheers Team Podium

title: Brand new, well appointed, clean and welcoming lodge.
text: Stayed here during the annual fielddays festival. It was a very easy drive to Mystery Creek events centre and very close to Cambridge a pretty town with great restaurants. The staff and owner operator were very welcoming, very kiwi hospitality big smiles and banter all around. Rooms are tastefully designed very large bathrooms and the bed linen was so comfortable and I'm a bit of princess when it comes to thread count lol. The main common room was great to use for a quiet after work drink and chat with workmates and to watch the game on big screen. My only gripe is that a USB outlet close to the bed would have been nice as I had to unplug my lamp to plug my phone in. But that was it really. 10/10 would come back again next year.
hotel_response: Hi Jeremy,  Thanks for taking the time review us.  Was great meeting you during your stay, and  you are right we love to chat and have a giggle with our guests here at Podium Lodge.  We hope to welcome you back sometime in the future.  All the best Team Podium.

title: Sleepy Head - finds mattress to suit
text:
As a corporate traveller I thought it would be a change to try out the Podium for my Waikato business trip this week.

Long story short, I will be staying here again based on the tranquil surroundings which provided an abundance of quiet. #awesome! 

All room amenities are as needed, and a great nights sleep is included at no extra charge.

Team Podium, cheers for the Awesomeness. :0)
hotel_response: We love your header!!  Thanks so much for giving us a chance to impress you and are delighted your expectations were met!! We look forward seeing you again soon and as always a great nights sleep on our new sleepyhead elegance beds is promised!  Team Podium

title: Warm welcome
text: The Podium Lodge is brand new, clean, and well priced. Wonderful friendly staff who know the area well and so very helpful. I was travelling alone and felt very safe and secure. Close to town and biking distance to everything. Next time in Cambridge this is where we will stay.
hotel_response: We so appreciate the time you took to review our shiny new place.  Friendly welcoming staff is a given at Podium Lodge and you are always assured a friendly smile and "can do attitude".  Thanks for staying with us and look forward to seeing you again.  Team Podium.

title: Fantastic and peaceful stay!
text:
Myself and several others stayed at Podium Lodge for 3 weeks during which we were so well treated, from the friendly staff at reception to the cleaners who always asked if there was anything else we needed. I would highly recommend this place as it was always kept very clean, and it is so convenient being a street away from the velodrome and it’s delicious bikery cafe, and so close to the centre of Cambridge. We often took the Te away bike ride/walking/running track to go from Podium to Cambridge as it was really scenic.
