As for the staff, Anne and the team at reception were incredibly kind, thoughtful and accommodating, whether that was by ensuring we were well hydrated and had a nibble after a long flight, giving us a little package with details of things to do and see in the area or opening the common room early so we could follow a rugby game really early in the morning. I couldn’t recommend this place enough, regardless of the reason of your visit, you will be made to feel at home in the beautifully styled and peaceful rooms at Podium Lodge.
hotel_response: Oh Sorcha, thanks so much for your generosity and kind words.  We absolutely loved having you and the crew with us for your extended stay, getting to know you all and off course ensuring you felt the kiwi welcome and were able to feel at home at our place .  Good luck for your exciting future.  Would love to see you again sometime soon.  Anne and the Podium Team

title: Excellent!!!
text: Fantastic little lodge on the edge of Cambridge. Very new and still spotless. The hosts that greeted us were super friendly and made us feel very welcome. Parking was right outside our cabin - a big plus. It has been furnished and decorated very well, comfy beds, very good linens and there was everything we needed in the kitchenette. We booked a 2 bedroom cabin, both rooms with 2 single beds. Although compact the layout made it feel roomy and light.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to review us Tina. We are glad to hear you enjoyed your stay in one of our Two Bedroom Apartments, we hope to see you at Podium Lodge again soon!

title: Past its prime
text: The Inn has a musty odor upon entering and continues throughout the house. At one time it was an amazing spot it seems from pictures we saw, but it needs lots of work inside and out. Breakfast was subpar, we were locked out when we returned from dinner and only later learned there was a code on a sticky note by our bed. I would not go back nor recommend.

title: Nice Garden
text:
Our room was a bit on the small side with only one small space for a case
that could be opened up for more storage, it did have two big windows tho that looked out over the gardens. Our hosts were welcoming and pleasant
and the house is very nice. 
You have breakfast with the hosts and any other guests in the morning that we were not aware off, it’s served on the table in covered glass dishes that you help your self too, it was ok.
We met and fed the Alpacas that come running over when you rattle the food container that was quite nice they have the softest lips and are very careful eating from your hand.
The Garden is quite nice I had binoculars in my case and some of the birds there were lovely.
The plants and shrubs on the drive way to the house could do with cutting back as our hire car’s sensors were constantly on when driving up.

Would benefit from private breakfast room.

title: A lovely stay in an old style manor house
text:
We planned our trip to the NZ North Island to indulge ourselves, and that included special accomodation (not just normal hotels). Our daughter picked the English Cherry Tree manor, and I have to say it exceeded our expectations. The first sight was a sign of things to come - just turning into the driveway was an indication of that. The manor was a beautiful period piece, and we enjoyed the stay. 
Apart from the house, just wandering through the gardens was amazing - an incredible job in creating that all. and as a bonus - we could feed the alpacas!
This was a bit out of the way - but well worth the visit, and we were definitely made to feel at home - Anne is a great hostess, with an interesting story herself.

title: Brilliant experience
text: Beautiful grounds, so lovingly thought out. Well designed and so pretty! Made extra special by face painting, crafts and balloon modelling. The dancing was fantastic and hosts Anne and Paul so friendly along with a great team who made the day special

title: A perfect and amazing Christmas stay at English Cherry Tree Manor
text: Right, I don't know where to start, we were supposed to be spending Christmas with family in London and wanted to take our minds off where we should be. Annie, from first contact, met every single one of our requirements for a family Christmas away from home. The house and garden is so beautiful, stately and homely and Paul, Annie and their charming son Jared could not have been more welcoming, it was better than being one of the family, we felt like honoured guests. We adored the Alpacas and could not believe how close we could get to them, lots of bunnies, a lovely inviting swimming pool, amazing varied breakfasts and even Christmas Dinner and Christmas tea with all the trimmings. Great conversations when wanted but also a lot of privacy if we needed it. Easy trips to Hobbiton, Waitomo, Raglan and the beautiful Hamilton Gardens, close to great restaurants and shops. Any problems solved in an instant, I really feel we made good friends. Out of all the many great hotels in different countries we have stayed in I'll never forget the care, consideration and love we felt at the magical cherry tree manor.

title: Beautiful stay in 1930s home
text: Just outside Hamilton. Everything was splendid. Our host Annie gave welcome and given access to house at any hour. Our dog was treated as a friend. Our room looked out over an orchard and swimming pool. Guests are welcome to sit in large lounge. Breakfast was a treat with bacon and eggs-and selection of breads. Annie joined us and we were told about the house history and its beautiful cherry blossom. Met and fed the Llamas making a memorable visit. Thank you Annie.

title: This place is a GEM!
text: Delightfully refreshing to stay in the peaceful surrounds of a garden for all seasons. It is not manicured, it is like home, natural  and inviting. Spacious, light and airy rooms overlooking the garden and pool.  I have traveled extensively and it is rare to find hosts like Paul & Annie who also join you for breakfast and a chat. The spacious living areas, veranda for shade on a hot day or for a drink in the cool of the evening are part of a very enjoyable experience. Simply lovely !

title: Best Quality English High Tea in Hamilton!
text:
I had a wonderful day in English Cherry Tree Manor. Hostess Annie prepared me a very beautiful and delicate Traditional English High Tea! After the High Tea, Host Paul showed us their great and large garden which was built up little by little for 23 years!

Highly highly recommend English Cherry Tree Manor and you will see many precious plants in the large garden which you might not find in many places!

They do provide exquisite accommodation B & B with each bedroom decorated by  different window ---- garden view plus seperate bathroom and should have a try!

title: There are magnificent and beautiful manor
text: We have a comfortable and kind of luxuriant high tea, the hostess made English cake are very nice. Sunshine and joyful be full of entire afternoon. they have five alpaca that are cute and lovely. See you next time Sweet Manor.

title: High Tea
text: The drive way would look beautiful when in flower.  Could do with a gardener to go and tidy up a lot of the over grown plants.  The area for afternoon tea under a gazebo could do with a good sweep, not that appealing.  Nice swimming pool for the summer.  Very average high tea, very average service, very average setting.  Not best value for money

title: Stongly recommend
text: A great day in English Cherry Tree Manor, they have a lovely garden with lots of plants and flowers... The host offer warm welcome & personal interactions! A quiet fantastic place for friend and family!

title: Very poor.Think of Fawlty Towers without the humour.
text:
Yes the gardens and setting are very nice however !!!!!! 
We went solely for the High Tea (can only prepay as you book on line) the chap who one assumes was the host popped us in a Gazebo with two others and offered a choice  of two only teas. Then the wait began four others arrived and one pot of tea was placed on the table and the chap disappeared. Luckily the  other people were good company. A full 30 minutes passed  with no communication from the chap, 45 mins passed and I rang their phone number as this group were getting annoyed (Politely ) I asked why such a long wait and could we at least have some more tea.. Meantime one of the ladies ventures out to another group who had arrived before us who were also waiting patiently. The chap had dashed out to a food store for more supplies but did not bother to convey this little matter to us. The owner finally appeared (very nice woman) apologized  brought the food and had to be reminded that more tea was required. I'm sure you're sick of this long epistle lots more to say.  Just DO NOT go there.
hotel_response:
High Tea is traditionally a social affair. Because of that and the fact that the art of conversation and being civil to others is clearly on the decline in society, we try to sit strangers together. There is fair amount of resistance to that idea, but in every case without exception, people end up really enjoying such encounters. 

Ironically, social media has made us less social: people readily denounce and ridicule others without trying to understand a differing point of view. Let’s be less judgmental and let’s create a more harmonious world.

title: love the cherry blossom
text:
this is one of my favorite place to visit during spring,
the cherry blossom looks magical and picturesque..
you can come here to take photos that will surely look great as s facebook profile picture..

title: Very good and nice
text: This place is a really good place nice cherry tree quiet and the owner are really nice and there is even alpaca in here, and there is the nice pool. We had share breakfast it was fantastic  and there is a pool, sometimes is really good to walk around in the garden ( Best Motel for couple and family and kids  )

title: wonderful trip
text: Had a wonderful afternoon at the manor with my family！ Nice experience to visit for all season especially when the cherry blossom tree are blooming  . Host was very friendly . The whole place is quiet with a stunning English style garden.

title: Great host
text:
Stayed with a group of friends for training.

Hosts were very nice, and property has great surrounding with alpacas out the back.
Spa and swimming pool, nice place. Would be at its nicest once the blossom blooms.

title: Group trip
text: We went as a group for one nights get away.  This lovely old house surrounded in beautiful gardens was perfect.  Proprietors were very welcoming  and gave us a guided tour of the garden.  Tranquil and relaxing yet close to Hamilton and short drive to shops. Awesome pool.  Lovely breakfast and comfortable facilities.

title: Tourists in our own Country : A Cherry Tree Festival
text: Yesterday was a rare fine Saturday morning with blue skies and the hope it would last all day , so five of us set off from Hamilton on the drive to Tamahere to visit the Waikato Cherry Blossom festival at English Cherry Tree Manor - Beautiful Gardens and also providing accomodation A flowering Cherry Tree lined avenue in full blossom lining the lane,  made for a very impressive entrance to the property with interesting walks with lots to see including the Alpacas, pool, pond, dry stone walls lovely gardens well planted and tended Also for the festival there were food and drink vendors , and competitions to take part in - This was the first year opening the Gardens  to the Public and it was Magnificent Definitely a "must do" Only 6 kilometres from Hamilton and a short distance from the airport an ideal and idyllic place for accomodation

title: Lovely all round
text: We stayed in a delightful cabin, that had absolutely everything we needed, with a gorgeous view out every window. The hosts were super helpful, and breakfast awesome. We would thoroughly recommend!! A++

title: Wonderful stay
text: We spent two nights in the Cottage at Ohaupo Olives - the photos don’t do it justice. It has every modern convenience, including a washing machine, air conditioning and great wifi. Spotlessly clean, quiet, with a very comfy bed and linen sheets and seats outside for enjoying the late afternoon sun and view. And fresh home baking to welcome you from a hot day at Waitomo or exploring the local area. It’s really well situated to do a lot of sightseeing from. Roger and Liz are wonderful hosts and invited us in for a complimentary glass of wine the first evening - that was very welcome. The cooked breakfast was superb, thanks Roger! We didn’t want to leave and took home a bottle of their olive oil!! We have no hesitation in recommending. Enjoy!!!

title: 2 nights for business
text: Ohaupo olives is exquisitely furnished with every mod con you could imagine.  Liz & Roger are delightful and make you feel at home immediately.  The rooms are spacious, exceptional furniture, comfortable beds with fresh, top quality linen.  The views are awesome and an afternoon on the patio with a glass of wine is fantastic.

title: Part Of The Family
text:
From the moment we arrived, we were made to feel so welcome. It wasn't long before we were sitting down with a complimentary glass of wine and tasting a selection of their cold-pressed homegrown virgin Olive Oil! Will be staying there again as soon as possible!
Thanks for making our trip to Hamilton even more special

title: A modern B&B
text: We arrived late in the evening. Liz (the host) was very nice, preparing a tray of bread, herbs, and olive oil from their own yard. It was very delicious! The house was modern, luxe, yet cozy. The assistant manager was Margareth, a cat, who came to our room to say good bye. Roger (Liz's husband) cooked great scrambled eggs for us. We really wish to come back during better season.

title: Fabulous
text: The place is modern, new, tastefully furnished. The total is luxurious, better than at home. The hosts are really friendly, perfect, share time with you. The offer glass of wine and superbe breakfast. They propose informations and so... I am sûre that spent your time here is THE PLEASURE

title: Don’t want to leave!
text:
I can’t recommend Ohaupo Olives enough - beautifully decorated, spotlessly clean, great location near Hobbiton, Waitomo 
Caves, Hamilton, but most importantly wonderful hosts.  Above and beyond service, friendly and unobtrusive and a wonderful breakfast.

title: B&B, 5 Star Standard.
text: The hotel closest to the CTC / L3 training centre at Clearways was full at the time I was making a short visit to my son who is pilot training, Ohuapo Olives was very close by, 5 minutes away so I booked it for two nights. On arrival I was warmly greeted by the owners who made me feel very welcome for my entire stay. This isn't an ordinary B&B, the standard and attention to detail is higher than many 5 star hotels I have stayed in! There was absolutely nothing missing and I am sure if there was it would have been provided, it wasn't too cold while I was there but noticed an electric blanket on my bed. The property is set in an olive grove of 400 trees and home produced cold pressed virgin olive oil is available to buy. The view from my room was overlooking the olive groves across to the hills into the distance, amazing! I think there are three guest rooms in the main house and a couple of guest lodges in the garden? The breakfast in the morning was served in the open plan kitchen at the family dining table, this made for a very relaxed and comfy atmosphere! The breakfast was more than adequate, fresh fruit, muesli, toast, pancakes, bacon and juice, coffee and tea. It is unfortunate that my stay was so short as I would have liked to have enjoyed Ohaupo Olives for much longer!

title: Luxurious B&B
text: A stunning B&B overlooking the countryside with beautifully appointed rooms (super king beds, linen sheets, flat screen TV, wifi, ensuite bathroom). Lovely hospitable hosts who provided coffee, treats (try their own Olive Oil) and a delicious breakfast. So quiet and peaceful - a wonderful stay. Beats staying in a hotel any day!

title: Quirky accommodation with on site cat (and dog)
text: The property is a massive modern home which had been divided in two. It is ultra modern and furnished with taste. You really feel you are 'at home' a sensation added to by the on site cat, Mosey, and Buddy the dog. (If you're not an animal fan the owner says they can be kept out of your way.). PAll necessary amenities plus a wood burning stove.

title: Avoid
text: This is not a 4-star motel! Beware if you are a professional (who they seem to cater to based on their online advertising ) - look elsewhere! Great campus location though and the building is newish, which should be enough to give guests reasonably ok experience. However, already the outside is filthy - unswept parking lot, looks more like a no-tell-motel with a dirty ‘vacancy’ sign. Inside - walls that haven’t been cleaned for a long time. Strange smell coming from the plumbing system. Bathrooms with mold on shower doors - clearly nobody cares. No reception on site - everything is paeudomanaged by some Indian employees (maybe owners - who knows) from another motel located 6 miles away. You even have to pick up the door card key from there. Overall, quite unprofessional, unpleasant for a guest and one of the worst motel experiences that I’ve had over the many years of coming to the city of Hamilton for my business trips.

title: Worst motel in Hamilton/Waikato
text:
We booked via booking.com for 1x night checking in 19th January and out on the 20th January 2021. It would be our stop over in Hamilton before heading to Cambridge. Everything inside the room (except beds) was dirty. Walls were filthy with staina like they hadnt been wiped down in years. The floor was gross -it was sticky & our feet got so dirty & dark frm walking on it we ended up wearing shoes inside. I raised the uncleanliness with the duty manager who said they'd start checking after the cleaners had been but couldnt do anything else as it was the only room available. The paper thin walls meant we could hear every thud every time someone walked around upstairs & could hear every convo from the neighbouring rooms. It was so noisy. The lights inside are so dim and even during daylight hours with the curtains open, its still quite dark. The sinks are slow to drain (probably blocked from lack of maintenance) and shower was just gross, make sure you wear your jandals inside. 
The automatic lock on the door was annoying as hell as you need to use the key to re-enter every time you leave the room. Our door lock was shoddy (lack of maintenance) that our key got stuck while trying to unlock the door. The duty manager called the locksmith who got there at 9.20pm and needed to be inside our room to fix the lock temporarily. It couldve waited till the morning but the duty manager insisted it be done then and there so my children who were tired and shoulve been in bed had to wait until nearly 10pm for the work to be completed. The locksmith even said to the duty manager at one point that if we were paying customers this would be unacceptable. We shouldve received half rate on our room after all the trouble, lack of cleanliness or alternative but was only offered a $10 discount. I informed the duty manager i wouldnt be leaving a positive rreview, and shortly after we checked out i received a notification via booking.com that our booking was cancelled to prevent me from leaving a review on booking.com site. So im leaving this review here as i wouldnt want other families falling for the inaccurate pics online and having the misfortune of staying at such a disgusting place. The pictures online are not an accurate portrayal of what it really looks like.. and when my booking was "cancelled" by the motel via booking.com although we actually completed our stay there, it makes me wonder how many other bad reviews have been kept off booking.com by the motel through cancelling other guests' trips. 
The DM was friendly enough, but not forthcoming with any positive solutions/alternatives to all the problems with the room, and was more interested in speaking to someone on his phone 80% of the time. After i asked to speak with the manager or owner he kept telling me he was in charge and there was noone else.

title: Good for a night
text:
We were only staying for a night and had very low expectations. We checked in easy enough and were given a 250ml bottle of milk for tea and coffee. The room was clean a d modern, the sofabed was set up as well as the double bed although only 2 pillows between 4 people was disappointing. The bathroom was clean, although having a toilet paper and hand towel dispenser as you would find in a public toilet was a bit strange.
As other reviews have said the walls are paper thin and you can hear other guests but the noise was minimal after 10pm and we managed to have a good nights rest.
For a night this motel is fine and I would stay again

title: Function Night Stay
text:
A group of 6 of us had been attending a 3 day Badminton  tournament in Hamilton. We had a celebration function so decided to stay the night rather than driving back to Auckland.  We booked 2 rooms stating clearly 3 Adults. Whilst the rooms were clean.... newish Motel. Everything else was well below standard. We had to ask twice for extra sofa beds to be made up and 3x to get extra towels. NO HANDSOAP on basin... during Covid. In fact not shower gels/shampoo etc of any sort. Only 1 hand towel. Basic tiny amount of milk suitable for 1 cup of tea/coffee each. Only 2 water glasses & coffee cups. Barely provided any utensils. Despite advertising WIFI... was not functioning.
Would not recommend this Motel at all.

title: You get what you pay for & I still paid too much
text:
Pretty poor place - it should be so much better.  Is a new building, but already feels quite dated & worn.  It seems to be run as a hobby than a business - basic things like having a welcome desk staffed in business hours, having an inviting entrance etc are all missing. 
It's pretty cheap ($105 for 1 night), but still felt like I paid too much for what it was.

title: Not happy
text:
We had a very unfortunate experience at the Uni Hotel. We had payed for a a 'deluxe' room for a family of 4. We were shocked to have one of the beds as a pull out sofa bed which was extreamly squeeky. The room was full of dust and had a strange smell. The side table had a fresh coffee cup ring which was not cleaned, ripped wallpaper stuck back on with duct tape and the toilet brush was black with filth. 

The bathroom was outdated and was nothing like the photos advertised (especially for a deluxe room.) Rooms had paper thin walls. We were up most of the night as the above room tenants were walking around. We could hear every footstep, drawers opening and toilet flushing. We only stayed 1 of 2 nights that we had booked and managed to get most of our money back for the 2nd night. We won't be back

title: Worst Motel I Have Ever Stayed In
text: Due to late arrival into Hamilton, the office was closed on arrival to the motel. There was a note at the office asking me to phone a given number to obtain the key to my room. I called twice and no one answered  my call for about 5 minutes. When I received a return phone call, the service was a little blunt. I then went into my room to find a note about the shower head being broken. I went to investigate the issue and was really disappointed. The shower head was not broken but it was no longer attached to the wall, meaning that I had to shower with one hand holding the shower head. Having paid the full room price, I believed this was unacceptable. Why would I have not been put in another room? Then I sat down on the bed and could practically hear every word of the conversation next door, the walls are super thin. I was woken up at 4am and 5am by loud footsteps on the floor above me. Then as I was about to check out I looked under the beds to make sure I had not dropped anything, to find that the floor under the beds have not been cleaned for a really long time! Really disappointed with the experience at this motel and will never stay here again.

title: Perfect
text:
This tiny little motel is awesome. There was an issue with the website i used (never again. Ill always go direct now) and Yolanda at the desk was perfect and sorted everything out. 
Room is large and equipped with new furnishings. 

TV AC WIFI all worked a treat. 

If i ever come back to Hamilton, ill stay here

Dont use “trustworthy” websites 
Call the hotels

title: Funky smell
text:
I would not recommend staying at the Uni Motel for several reasons.
1. The apartment had a funky smell coming from the bathroom so much so I had to sleep with the bathroom window open, yes, in the middle of winter. 
2. The walls are paper thin, so much so I could have joined in the conversation next door with no trouble. 
3. Very noisy as flooring is only hardwood.
4. Narrow hallway with washing stored there, which appeared to be both clean and dirty.

title: Clean and tidy but ......
text:
Booked this motel on a booking site where it was a room advertised as a double bed and sofa bed (which I needed).  I booked it and then received a phone call saying if I want to use the sofa bed there would be an additional $20 charge.  I said that was misrepresentation and that I would cancel the booking, they then said because it was my first time there they wouldn’t charge me.

When we booked in I was told that the key was special, if I lost it there was a $20 fee!  I was also told that we couldn’t use the generic free wifi code because our room was special, I assumed that meant more money. So didn’t use.  Got up to the room which was very clean, tidy and big only to find a sign in the bathroom wall telling just that we had to hold the shower carefully and if we broke it we would be charged $90.  (The shower was amazing BUT the slider and nozzle were very wonky).  There are no soap trays in the shower and no towel racks in the bathroom.  No double glazing and the walls are very thin!!!!  There is also not enough parking for all the units, first in first served.

Overall the room was great but I don’t like being threatened with being charged for things beyond our control at every turn.

title: worst motel ever
text:
I would not recommend this motel to anyone. It was so incredible noisy, the walls must be paper thin. What's the point in paying for a bed if it's too noisy to sleep? The walls were so thing I could easily hear conversations and the TVs of my neighbours as well as people walking around and the carpark outside my window. One of the nights I stayed, the student home next door also had a loud party with thumping bass. 
Other issues: WIFI was useless and only worked half the time. Shower drain semi blocked, shower filled up with water. Kitchenette understocked eg it had a hotplate but no pots/pans. Room cold due to thin walls, so you had to run heater all the time.
Redeeming feature: staff seemed friendly.

title: Good Value Motel
text: Stayed three times over two week period. Rooms clean and spacious. Bed was comfortable. Yolanda on the desk very helpful and friendly. Ask for upstairs room as hard floors can be a little noisy. Easy access to Hamiton town centre.

title: Exceeded my expectations
text: The motel is quiet and modern. We had an unexpected late check-in but it was easy to contact the place who then happily arranged something for us. The room itself was pretty modern and quite spacious. I remembered we had Netflix on TV so we were able to really enjoy an overnight with friends. The location is close to universities but if you want to get to the central part of the city, you'll need to drive. There are just enough parking at the back of the hotel - no room for extra (literally as it is a tight fit as well). It was fully booked when we stayed and since there were a few SUVs parked, it was difficult to maneuver around the parking. There are plenty of off-street parking right in front of the motel, though, so that is still an option. Overall, super happy with our stay. Thank you!

title: Excellent value
text:
Had an overnight stay our room was very modern and clean spacious great value 
Slept our family of four 
A little noise from upstairs at times but we weren’t bothered by it at all 
Would definitely stay here again.

title: Best motel bed I’ve slept in.
text: The best motel bed I’ve ever slept in. Excellent air con and huge wall tv. Modern, clean decor, helpful staff. Would definitely stay here again. Booked through Agoda.com and the price was only $112 nz for one night.  Arriving back to our room after 8 we found the parking a bit tricky, due to our larger vehicle, but other than that excellent stay.

title: Very Comfortable
text: Got room 11 which is at front near road. Surprised that this was very quiet and had a good sleep in the very comfortable bed.  Good hot water supply and heaps of pressure. Very clean and had dining table and two chairs together with a double couch. Would stay there again if in the area.  One suggestion to be better is there should be towel rails in bathroom and a soap holder in shower

title: Pretty nice
text: The staff we met at the front desk were really friendly. The rooms would be nice for about 2-3 people but as I was staying in a family of 5 the rooms were a little bit small. There could maybe be a littl bit more seating to eat food at, other than that this place was quite nice.

title: Awefull! Better to look other optiin
text: The walls are so thin that you feel you live in the next room's family. We had neighbors who did so much noise we simply couldnt sleep. In the bathroom in 2nd flour there is no hot water pressure. The floor is uneven so all the water stays there. The loo is the cheapest I had in NZ and anatomicaly suits for a kid, not for elder people. In the dark narrow entrance there is a bin collect with filse pouring to the ground. After a sleepless night we just to be away from this cheap-cheap-cheap place. Not recomended indeed.

title: Noisy . Upstairs wooden floors means you hear every footstep. A simple alteration of  carpeting all would probably help
text:
Nice two bedroom apartment although no soft furnishings so noise travels.  Very comfortable beds. Very large TV. Basic kitchen facilities but adequate.  Shower great but no soap dish.!
Told receptionist about the noise from footsteps and chairs scrapping on floors upstairs.  Said was a common complaint but the owner didn't seem to care as nothing has been done since opening a year ago. 
Very nice receptionist who apologised. I felt sorry for her. Expensive at $200 compared to staying last week in Paihia in Family apartment with full kitcheon on the waterfront  complete with heated pool and undercover parking for similar price.

title: Nice Hotel, especially when visiting Waikato University
text: The hotel staff is very nice and helpful. The hotel is brand-new and in very good shape. Rooms have a good size and are equipped well, with kitchenette, toaster, microwave, cooking plate, and fridge. Thus it is easy to cater for breakfast and evening meals for yourself, in particular since a Foursquare supermarket is across the street.

title: Value for money
text: Our stay he was very pleasurable. One of the nicest motels we have stayed in. Room is very modern however was smaller than expected but it still met our expectations. The staff were very friendly and the bed was so soft and comfy. Like others have said it is quite nosey & quite far from the city centre however it is near a fe shops. Will stay again next time we visit Hamilton!

title: False Advertising/Language Barrier (Convenient or not?)
text: I booked this for 5 people on booking.com as the description was of a '2 bedroom unit'. When the confirmation came through I phoned as it stated the booking was for 4 people. The Asian lady eventually seemed to understand that I had booked for 5 and only 4 were on the confirmation and offered to upgrade us to a '3 bedroom unit' for the same price. I couldn't believe my luck. When we arrived we found the place to be smell even though it looked new and the reception was clearly set up in one of the tiny studio units. We payed and my partner took the key upstairs to find that the unit was one room with 3 beds in it. After a furious 10 minutes talking to the receptionist and the lady I had spoken to previously on the phone we were eventually given a refunded. I'm not sure whether this was a language barrier issue or a convenient language barrier issue...... ensure you can either speak their first language or you are 100% sure what you have booked.

title: STOP RIGHT HERE
text: Booked through the internet and this Motel exceeded all our expectations.  We are a retired couple and wanted accommodation within walking distance to the University.  We had additional family from Australia with us and they too were delighted.  Plenty of car spaces, and our 2-bedroomed unit was spotlessly clean;  the staff were extremely friendly.  Would definitely recommend this Motel and also would be our first stop over again.

title: Perfect!
text: Quick stop through Hamilton and this was the perfect place! Free parking and WiFi and the rooms are spacious and modern! Everything we could’ve asked for. Quiet location and very friendly staff. Thank you!

title: Different but also excellent
text:
This is a small hotel, not a motel.  A new build, this little place seems to cater to long stays.  The reception is rarely open as the receptionist is also the chamber maid, and then goes home.  Very odd!
There are no phones in the rooms, on the theory that everyone has his/her own anyway, but for us it was very inconvenient as we were avoiding cell charges.  We resorted to email to make plans with our friends.
BUT the room was absolutely huge with a kitchen but no iron and barely any cookware or china and glassware.  We are assuming that it's due to its newness.
There was a huge TV and air conditioning.
If you want to be near the university, it's ideal and busses abound and parking is available too.

title: NOT IMPRESSED
text:
We arrived at 14:00 and were told the room ain't ready. Can we come back in maybe 30 minutes. Returned 45 minutes later with the room still not ready. We were given another room "upgraded". The room were big and comfy. We had some family business to attend that night and returned late.
The next morning we slept in a bit and by about 09:30 we got out of bed, both still naked when the cleaner walked into our room, couldn't even knock.

title: Comfortable enough
text:
The uni motel was chosen as it was very close to the venue of a sport tournament we were attending. 

The room was spotlessly clean and the staff very friendly. 

Only downside is it is pretty noisy. We were in a ground floor room and - with rooms and hallways all having hard flooring - every noise of people walking in other rooms or hall was very loud. 

Coupled with the location on a busy roundabout and the driveway right outside the room did not make for a peaceful stay. 

So - great location for us, clean and tiny room, great staff - but noisy.

title: Good first step.
text:
It appears that this location had its opening night for our visit to Hamilton.  

The building / rooms - all incredibly new.

beds - incredibly comfy and good facilities, with kitchen, lounge, etc. 

Location - is your call. We were here for the Lions 2017 tour which meant the accommodation was all booked up in Hamilton and would prefer to have been walking distance of the stadium... but we all have different requirements.

Good accommodation overall but feels a little unfurnished in areas, e.g. No bed side tables. A great first step and I am sure it will be approved quickly.

Only real complaint. Wooden floors on first floor means you can hear heavy footed people walking around. 

Tip- ask for a first floor room.

title: Beautiful Home and Great Hosts
text: Sakura is an amazing cottage in Cambridge . It’s about 20min from Cambridge and in a real rural setting with a beautiful compound and landscape . The house itself is tastefully done and the rooms are very comfortable and luxurious. You can feel the personal touch in the service and rooms. It makes you feel at home and relaxed . Gwen makes great breakfasts. A place to relax and close enough to matamata and rotorua. It tooo is an hour to rotorua . Best place to stay if one ones a quiet peace haven.

title: Never Forget B&B
text: Not far from Cambridge, really greats hosts here , they will cook a nice breakfast for you , very quiet at night ,Sasha’s chilli sauce is awesome!!, 2 very friendly cats , the main road can be quite hard to cross  at certain times of the day .

Unique Equestrian Lifestyle is a lovely place to stay. Stayed in the Twin Room with Shared Bathroom, very comfy beds with a view out of the window to the horses and alpacas. Bathroom was great with a really good shower and bath. Kitchen and lounge area were nice, with tea/coffee making facilities and fresh milk provided. Jackie and Larry the dog were very friendly and welcoming, place exactly as described and shown in pictures. Peaceful location, the centre of Hamilton isn't walkable but we knew that when booking and there is free parking onsite if you drive as we did. Only negative was that we were only staying one night. Would definitely recommend and happily stay again!

title: Bliss
text:
Cant rate this gorgeous place enough. We loved this BNB. With 3 kids it can be hard to find a child friendly but stylish location. This hit all the buttons.  Family is delightful, house is stunning. Kids loved the loft bed, the toys, boards games and animals. 

Breakfast was the best we've had in NZ, beds were super comfy, close to town but still like a farm stay. 

Oh and Cambridge town is delightful as well.

Thanks for a great stay!

title: This has to be one of the best B & B
text: This B & B is located about 5 minutes drive from Cambridge set on about a 5 acre farm. Having stayed in B & B in England, Ireland and France this is by far the best. You are totally left to yourself in a relaxed atmosphere. The kitchen has a microwave, dishwasher, toaster, electric fry pan, kettle and kitchenware. Thus giving you the option of cooking your own meals.  Eggs, bread and jams etc are provided. The living area has 2 separate bedrooms, bathroom, kitchen/dinning room and outdoor patio & bar-b-q. It is beautifully furnished & comfortable with a play area for kids. There is also free parking and WiFi. The owners are most hospitable and we wish we had a longer stay than our 3 days. Given the area a car is essential. Cambridge and the surrounding countryside provides heaps to do and see.

title: Not as good as expected.
text:
This place wasn't quite as good as I expected although if you were going to watch or participate in rowing it would be fantastic. It's just over the road from the domain. However, I was disappointed overall. The room was smallish and a bit shabby with not particularly good quality bedding or furnishings. It was cold when we stayed and there was only a small oil radiator that took a long time to warm the room. No electric blanket. The bathroom was absolutely frigid with no heater at all. The kitchen area was  adequate but poorly lit, and you could only have room lights all on or off at once, so getting up to make a cup of tea meant the person in bed also had to have full lights. The breakfast was 'continental', left in the room the previous evening: canned peaches with yogurt, bread for toasting and friands, bananas etc, but no hot option. We did have a lovely time in the spa pool out under the stars and robes (synthetic not cotton, so rather unpleasant on the skin) are provided.
Overall I think this place is too expensive (we paid $250 a night) for what it provides, especially compared to other similarly priced places we stayed at. The price would only be worth it during rowing events.

title: Excellent accommodation
text:
Situated near the dam, a short walk to lake & coffee shop, this excellent accommodation is set in a lovely garden with pond and waterfall and hot tub. 
Megan, our host was very friendly and welcoming.
The self - contained accommodation has a separate kitchen area with fridge, microwave and cooking facilities. There is a bathroom with shower & toiletries.
 A continental breakfast is an option and was put in the fridge the previous night.
The patio outside our room had an overhang which enabled us to sit outside whatever the weather.  Robes were provided in the room and we had use of the hot tub. 
We had a very enjoyable relaxing 3 nights.
Highly recommend.

title: Most amazing B&B
text: We stayed here for a week during Maadi Cup. Beside being 2mins walk from the rowing action we felt like we were at home.  The hosts were more than hosts and went above and beyond.  We could have been staying at a friends house!  Great part of the country to visit so much to do!  The house is well laid out and is the best B&B we’ve ever stayed at!  Thank you Sarah & Mo
hotel_response: Thanks Sarah & Mo, we are so glad you enjoyed your stay as we certainly loved having you here and look forward to our paths crossing again sometime!

title: Fantastic!
text: What a great property in beautiful gardens across from the stunning lake. We were immediately made to feel at home by hosts Lizz and Vaughan, who both certainly went the extra mile to male us feel welcome and relaxed. Nice clean rooms, well stocked with wonderful attention to detail. Cambridge is a beautiful area, so convenient to Hobbiton and Waitimo Caves.

title: Fantastic
text:
I stayed 2 nights.They make me very relax natural atmostphere feel like home.
The host look after us very well and exteamly beautyfulsurrounding with the lake and the tree.
I would to recommend to traveler...
hotel_response: Thanks so much - we are glad you enjoyed your stay

title: B B&B
text:
Best B&B around! My partner and I had a wonderful stay here such a beautiful spot and great hosts! Couldn't fault anything about the property, thoroughly enjoyed the hot tub, the grounds and the comfy bed. Now we know where to stay when we're in the neighbourhood
Thanks so much
hotel_response: So glad you enjoyed yourselves - we look forward to welcoming you back!

title: Magnificent Hosts
text: Vaughan and Lizz make you feel at home the moment you meet them.  Their warmth and hospitality permeate everything they do.  From the small details to ensure a comfortable stay to the fact that you will never be hungry around Lizz, every moment spent will be a treat.

title: Maadi Rowing Week
text:
I stayed at Conach House Lake Karapiro which you couldn't get a better location for the Maadi Rowing Event

The accommodation was fantastic, very clean, modern and vey comfortable. The surrounding was very peaceful and beautiful and you wouldn't know you were off the main road.

The hosts- what can I say they were absolutely amazing. Nothing was a problem, very friendly and welcoming. Whilst there is plenty to eat in your  room for breakfast if you require they will cook a breakfast for you. They also offer evening meals, where you eat with them if you want. I took up their offer to eat with them, what a fantastic family, food was well presented and tasted fantastic. All this for a very very reasonable price.

If you like comfort, quality, peaceful and family host you wouldn't find better.

If my daughter continues to row I will definitely be staying there in two years time.

Michelle Noonan

title: Amazing stay!
text: Beautiful B&B!! Absolutely love the room - gorgeous outlook, comfy bed, with everything you need - so relaxing. The hosts are so welcoming and friendly. Fantastic location too! Definitely recommend staying here!

title: Excellent motel
text: Very nice and quiet motel. Reception was excellent.... everything we needed was there!!

title: Excellent clean and comfortable stay.
text:
We have stayed 3 nights and would strongly recommend the hotel. The rooms are spacious, clean and very well kitted out.
The staff are extremely friendly and helpful.
Well positioned for exploring the area and very well priced.

title: Won't disappoint!
text: Very pleasant - well appointed (good size) room and bathroom.  Very comfortable bed and friendly, helpful staff. Little shop next door if you need some provisions. Good parking. Short trip into town for wining and dining and purposes.

title: Lovely motel - clean and modern!
text: Great location - shops right next door and 15 minutes from the airport. Quiet area. Plenty of car parking. A couple of minutes from the centre of town. Well equipped rooms with dishwasher, toaster, kettle and coffee machine. Large rooms and bathroom. The facilities were so clean and fresh! We had a lovely 2 night stay here. Would 100% recommend staying here.

title: Kelly Rd something special.
text: Thoroughly recommend - stylish & elegant, immaculate, spacious bathroom, comfortable bed, friendly staff, great location

title: Great place to stay
text:
Spent a great night here whilst transmitting from Wellington to Auckland. Great rooms and very, very clean.
The only downside was the noise coming from the adjoining room via the connecting door.
It needs to be much more soundproofed for anyone sleeping on the sofa beds but all in all, a good experience.

title: Very pleasant place to stay
text: Staff were helpful and pleasant. The room was clean and had everything I needed. It had good parking, access to wifi and was quiet. The room was serviced every day so there was always enough of everything. I would definitely stay there again.

title: Just The Best
text:
We Stayed at Kelly Road Motel Cambridge  last night
Its a really Lovely Place to stay--The units are spotless-the bed is so Comfortable with Decent Pillows--Sky Tv too which is a Plus as most motels do Freeview now

Thank you Kelly Road for your Hospitality and a  clean lovely unit to stay in-we will be back

title: A very comfortable stay
text:
I stayed here for one night in July 2024 and chose this hotel as I was flying in/out of Hamilton and travelling to Tauranga.  From Hamilton airport it's about ten minutes by car.  From the centre of Cambridge it's about a 1-minute drive, probably 10 minutes if walking.

The hotel is very new and modern and I felt very comfortable here.  The rooms do not face the street, so there is no noise.  The room was large, and the bathroom also was extremely large.  Wifi worked ok.  I appreciated the coffee machine.

I would certainly stay here again.

title: soiled - blood on the sheets.
text:
Room was tidy. Everything looked nice, until I turned down the sheets later that night and found soiled - few drops of blood smeared on the sheets.   Revolting. Nearly made me sick. 

One expects clean, freshly made sheets. Obviously not the case here. 

No refund. Worse still they offered me 20% off my next visit. Why would one want to go back. Yuck yuck yuck.

title: Upscale Hotel!
text:
Spotless!
Comfortable bed, nice linens. Well stocked mini kitchen.  Hotel provides basics plus small milk, enough for two cereals.
Wish we stayed longer.
We felt comfortable the minute we stepped in it.
Cambridge is a beautiful town!
We stopped here on our way from Christchurch to Auckland.

title: Modern, clean accommodation & very helpful staff.
text:
This was a last minute booking because our Rotorua hotel was cancelled. The accommodation was modern, clean so lovely that we stayed here the last three days of our New Zealand holiday.

Modern accommodation with modern shower & bathroom I’d love in my home.  Great location for travelling to other areas e.g. Taupō, Rotorua and other tourist highlights. Cambridge is a lovely town with variety of good  places to eat, unique stores etc,.

title: Great Place to stay
text: My room was spacious, clean, well equipped and in a great location.  The bathroom was huge (I had a Disability unit).  Close to Hamilton but away from the hustle and bustle of city life.  Staff were friendly and helpful.  Would stay again

title: A wonderful hotel for our visit
text: This is a wonderful property for a short visit or extended stay. The bed was very comfortable and the bath and shower refreshing. Our room was a one bedroom suite. It is minutes from the city center shops and restaurants. I highly recommend it.

title: Highly recommend
text: We checked into Kelly Rd on the afternoon of ex Cyclone Gabrielle & it was a perfect shelter from the storm. A wonderful friendly greeting was made even better with the offer to extend our stay if the weather saw it necessary. The studio room was spacious, very clean & well equipped with a small kitchenette. The building is quite new so it shut up tight against the overnight storm but it would be wonderfully ventilated on a milder day whilst still staying private. I highly recommend this property, it was just overnight for us but we look forward to returning to explore picturesque Cambridge another time.

title: Nice Location and friendly staff
text: My wife and I spent 2 nights at Jelly Road Lodge which was conveniently located near Cambridge.  There was free parking and laundry facilities.  The room was spacious and tidy with good sky TV.  The laundromat was very good and took thirty minutes to wash at $2 per wash and drying machines which must be set at high temp and need a couple of 20 minute spins to get clothes dry. The shower facilities was good too.  It is a very good location if you wish to break up the drinking from Auckland to Rotorua.

title: Excellent host and facilty
text: Excellent host and nothing was any trouble. The unit was really spacious and there was a large amount of thought with regards to what was available in the unit. Well worth the price and if the need arises will not hesitate to book here again. Clean and very tidy too. Thanks 😃

title: Pleasant, Clean & Convinient
text:
Book directly with them, with zero hassle and a small discount... so a bonus.
It is located a minute of the State Highway One overpass and the same amount of time to the town center.

Their amenities were 5 star; clean & spacious bathrooms. Beds were comfortable and after hours access was 100%.

We would 100% stay here again.

title: Very attentive owners that responded promptly when needed
text:
I had two units to accommodate myself and my teenage son and a separate unit for an elderly relative. The TV volume would not go past 20 as it was pre-set. This made it impossible to be used by my elderly relative. The owners spent ages trying to find out how to change the setting. Eventually they got on the phone to the people they were rending the TV from and got instructions on how to change it which was good of them to make that effort.

The unit my elderly relative was in had a walk in shower with a fold down seat which made it extra safe.

Considering there was road works right outside the unit the double glazed windows kept almost all of the sound out.

Overall a very good motel and the attentive friendly owners never showed any annoyance at the many requests for assistance that they got. I really appreciated their patience.

The pillows are a little large and solid. If you are a pillow fuss pot like I am you should bring your own favourite pillow if possible.

title: Excellent. Modern, clean and well maintained.
text: We had an extended family group stay, including adults and children. At every step of booking and confirmation the service was exceptional, efficient, friendly and accurate. The rooms were all spacious. Exceptionally clean, and we are quite particular about cleanliness of accommodation. The layout of the lodge is great, there's a wee basketball spot that the kids loved. The bathrooms were massive and clean. Had a good hot shower. The pictures show what you get, no camera tricks at all. We did find the beds a bit firm, but that doesn't deter us from wanting to stay again. Modern, clean and well appointed, run by lovely people.

title: Nice enough - over priced?
text: Modern, comfy bed, fluffy white towels but there were a few let downs. The shower needs some cleaning attention, the plastic strip on the glass door was green!  Needs removing and a good clean.  The Jasmine everywhere many look and smell nice to some, but not good for those with allergies or asthma, and the biggest let down was there was not seating outside the unit to be able to enjoy your morning coffee or evening wine.  Not really worth the money they are asking for a studio unit with a basic kitchenette, more like what you would pay for a one bedroom unit with a full kitchen with out door seating

title: Clean, tidy, but that’s about it
text:
Stayed one night. Booked online with their website and paid the required 50%. When we checked in there was no sign of the deposit. Worked it out but it was a muck around we didn’t need after a long drive. 

The building is new and on entry, the unit was well presented and clean. Everything looked inviting. That’s where it ended. The shower had less pressure than our caravan shower. Real shame as it was quite a good size tiled shower so real disappointment when the pressure was the worst I’ve had. The bed was initially kind of comfortable but after an hour was incredibly hard. We both had a lousy sleep. 

Motel is quite a way from town with no restaurants etc nearby meaning driving is a must. TV channels amounted to possibly 5.  I’d expect at least all of the Freeview channels. If you smoke you’re out of luck. No smoking anywhere onsite and no where to have one offsite that’s out of the weather. 

We returned to Cambridge two nights later and stayed at the Hidden Lakes. Chalk and cheese. For the same price, go there. Worlds apart.

title: Great accommodation - would stay again
text:
Was slightly surprised on booking via their website that you needed to pay a 50% deposit and on first passing, we wondered if it would be noisy being near a main road. But once we were in the room we realised we'd found a great place to stay.

The place looks brand new, with everything in immaculate condition and cleaned to perfection. There was no noise from the road at all. We loved how comfy the bed was plus the great sheets. If we ever build a new house, we'd model the bathroom on the one we saw here, it was just about perfect.

There was a slight disappointment with the free internet which had a relatively small data limit which soon ran out leaving just expensive paid options, compounded by the mobile data signal being pretty poor.

However we'd stay here again without hesitation.

title: Fantastic accomodation.
text: We loved the accomodation.  It was modern,clean with friendly hosts.  It was peaceful and my husband and I would definitely stay there again and recommend it to anyone that is looking for accomodation in Cambridge or Hamilton.  The shower was awesome to use as well.

title: Detour Evening
text:
We had a trip to Auckland from Whitianga and decided to return via Cambridge to check and clean the headstones of my wife’s Mother and Great Grandparents and as we had run out of daylight we stayed in Cambridge.

This motel is relatively new and decor is modern.

Very clean, double glazed windows makes them very quiet.

Spacious with large double bed.

Heat pump and air conditioning.

Kitchenette, dishwasher etc.

Good bathroom and shower.

Good unlimited WiFi, Tv has Sky TV.

Good parking.

Only disappointment was there was no electric blanket and it was an exceptionally cold night so the heat pump went all night.

title: Clean and new
text: Fresh, clean room. Modern decor. Great heatpump, room warmed up quickly and stayed cosy. Well equipped with nespresso coffee machine, real milk and selection of tea. Comfortable bed with extra blankets and pillows. Key card entry.

title: Lovely stay, private, excellent
text: Came away for a night in Cambridge, to go out for dinner and somewhere nice to stay overnight, Have wanted to stay at Kelly Rd for a while, it was really lovely. Very clean rooms, well thoughtfully decorated and stocked, gorgeous bath, helpful staff, highly recommend.

title: I usually stay at hotels, but this was great.
text: We are usually a hotel family when travelling, but I thought we'd take a chance at a motel in Cambridge New Zealand; and I am very happy we did.  My family (wife, 11 yr. old and 6 yr. old) stayed at Kelly Rd. Cambridge Lodge just as COVID was starting up in New Zealand.  The staff (and I'm guessing owners) were very nice and hospitable.  The place was spotless, very well done, modern and had all the amenities we needed for a couple days stay with a little kitchenette.  There is laundry available (extra) if needed.  The bath tub was deep and very large.  Our little one loved it.  It is just on the edge of Town a short drive from the main street.  Cambridge is also the prettiest Town on the North Island.  We loved our stay even as the world was chasing with the COVID.  Thank you.

title: An excellent overnight stop
text: Realative new its situation on Kelly Road makes it an ideal venue if visiting the Cambridge Velodrome. The rooms are spacious, well appointed  maintained in excellent order and can be adapted to meet most possible combinations of sleeping requirements.

title: For a concert
text:
Ate an evening meal and it was awful. Got refunded the total meal price.
Room was cold and asked for extra blankets and these were provided with no problem.
Staff were friendly and helpful.
I use different Travelodge's in the country and this left me less than impressed.

title: The best in Cambridge
text:
After my 3rd stay, I think that I have seen enough for an honest review.

A warm and friendly check in. Enough free parking on site. A modern, clean and comfortable place to stay. A small kitchen with cooking facilities if required. Nespresso coffee supplied as well.

The location is handy to access Cambridge township and also a short drive to the Freeway to get to Hamilton.

It is also right next door to a very good cafe.

Highly recommended.

title: Excellent studio accomodation
text: Stayed one night after a wedding at Red Barn about 25kms away. Quiet location on old SH1 in Cambridge. Very comfortable bed and quality amenities. Lots of quality cafes for breakfast in Cambridge. Recently built about 2 years old and hosts very accomodating to early check in for wedding preparations. Recommend and would stay again.

title: Clean modern and quiet
text:
We were welcomed by Lindsay on reception and given the choice of whole milk or trim. (Real milk and none of this long life rubbish) 
The room was was well set up with a super comfy king bed with gorgeous clean crisp sheets. Pure delight. 
The bathroom was modern and again fresh with all the toiletries necessary and products were of a good quality. 
The property was quiet and our bikes were stored away safely overnight for us. We cycled and returned for a quick shower before leaving. 
Myrtle and I will definitely stay again and will recommend to friends too.

title: One bedroom apartment with pullout sofa bed
text: This is a very beautiful motel. It is located just right at the corner of a main road and a residence road. The check in was very smooth and quickly. There is guest laundry but we do not need it because we just spend a night here. It is centre of our Blue Springs, Hell’s Gate and Hamilton trip. Just 20 minute drive to Hamilton centre for meals. You can actually cook simple meal in the unit. The bed is soft and comfy. The bathroom is huge with separate shower cubicle and large tub. Bubble bath was provided. The sofa in living room was pulled out for my children for that night. The only downside of this motel is no sound proof windows installed and we could hear the traffic crossing the main road very clearly. Oh yes, there is an air cond in the living area. The motel is a bit overpriced but happy to return again.

title: Absolutely Stunning
text: Not your run of the mill chain motel... this is pure class! Everything is top quality from the furniture and bedding to the cutlery and crockery, fixtures and fittings the attention to detail is beautiful! I only wish my stay was longer. Most impressive and value for money couldn’t believe my luck!  I will be back!

title: Modern, clean and very comfortable
text: Super comfortable bed and spacious, well laid out bathroom. Quality toiletries and a well equipped kitchen. Everything very new. Very quiet and a short(ish) walk to town. This property is highly recommended.

title: Clean, comfortable, rooms need a lamp
text: We visited en route Rotorua and were impressed to find a newly renovated and tastefully decorated motel. Our room was spacious and quiet, and the bathroom was very nice. My only criticism is the rooms were fairly antiseptic and the lounge could have done with a lamp, as the only alternatives were excessively bright or pitch black.

title: Quite Accommodation
text:
Rooms very clean, modern complex with Sky TV, off-road parking.
Units have full kitchen facilities and no road noise. Nice big beds and clean facilities. 
You can get breakfast delivered and there is a coffee/cafe shop next door.
Friendly staff.

title: Spot on
text: Everything is new and up to date. Friendly staff and easy check in. Tidy and well outfitted rooms. Very close to both Cambridge town and the Velodrome conference centre. a class above most motels on the road, hotel standard.

title: Top Accommodation in Cambridge
text: We had one night here and Samantha, who was our first point of contact, couldn't have done a better job of making us feel welcome. From my telephone reservation to check in, then arranging for me to stay in my room a little longer on day of departure, it was nothing short of amazing and I wish every motel offered the same service! Nothing was a problem and Sam was on call whenever we needed. Lovely clean room, comfy bed and huge bathroom, it's worth a stay. Sloth cafe next to motel, I can recommend, lovely coffee and food. Thanks Sam for making us feel so welcome.

title: Very nice place to stay
text: The Kelly Rd Cambridge Lodge was a very nice place to stay! We stayed in a lovely unit and found it to be very accommodating. The bed was comfortable and the bathroom was also very nice, it was so spacious! The receptionist who showed us to our unit was very nice as well. We were made to feel very welcome when we were staying here.

title: Nice
text:
Stayed here for four nights.
It is very clean - the towels, bed, the kitchen.
Ample parking. Laundry n dryer available at $2 and $4 respectively. 

Few min drive to Cambridge town.

Highly recommended to stay here.

title: Excellent
text: This lodge is a little out of town, but worth it. Easy walking distance to restaurants and bars. The property is feels new. It was immaculately clean, with good wifi, and helpful staff. A great experience.

title: Excellent location.
text:
Beautiful new motel with excellent facilities. Very clean and the bathroom was a large size with a lovely walk in shower. Bonus in room coffee pod machine.
Staff very obliging. Great parking and handy to Cambridge raceway.

title: Lovely motel, very good location
text:
Had a night away from home Found this to be a lovely modern motel. Service was very nice and the rooms tidy and had everything we needed. Would definitely stay again, 
King size bed and very large bathroom and shower. Kitchenette had all the mod cons

title: Nice quiet neighborhood
text: The hotel is a short distance from the main commercial area of Cambridge, in more of a residential area.    The room and bathroom were spacious, clean and well-maintained.   The woman at the front desk was friendly and helpful with recommendations.   Definitely a good choice!

title: Wonderful Hotel
text: This hotel was wonderfully appointed and the rooms modern and super clean. It was no frills and the staff very pleasant. The hotel was 5 min away from the shops and restaurants. I would stay here again without any doubt.

title: We wish we were staying longer!
text:
It was our first trip to New Zealand so we had absolutely no idea what to expect from their hotels and service industry. Staying in a small town in NZ could have presented us with some interesting accommodation options. 

I was so pleased when I found the Kelly Rd Cambridge Lodge, and even more pleased when we checked in. This place is an absolute GEM! The rooms look brand new, clean, and spacious. The bedding was top notch, and if I could have taken the bathroom with me on the rest of my trip--I would have! Being so close to down town Cambridge which was adorable shops and great restaurants is also a lovely perk. The service was impeccable as well, and our front desk attendants could not have been more helpful. We only stayed one night, and quite frankly I wish we had the opportunity to stay longer.

Seriously, if you're in the area, stay here! You won't regret it!

title: New modern and perfect (well nearly lol)
text:
The Motel is situated on the outskirts on Cambridge so a car or taxi or a long walk into town, The Motel itself is brand new and a perfect model for future motels.
We arrived a bit early for checking but the receptionist put our hilled provisions into the reception fridge and our luggage into storage. when we returned from town everything had been placed in our room and fridge. great way to start.
Our room was huge #19 spotlessly clean, the bedding is of top quality and so comfortable. everything you will need is in the kitchen and the coffee delicious,  The bathroom is big enough to hold a party. not sure why they didn't put a bath in it as there is plenty of room but the shower is great. The AC is great it was really hot outside and the room cooled really quickly.
The only thing I can fault (and it's not the Motel's fault) is that for some unknown reason cell phone reception is terrible on both 2 degrees and vodafone. that said the hotel internet is fast and easy to access though not sure why guests are limited to 4.5g's  maybe this is just nominal and can be refreshed if you use it up
I can highly recommend this Motel without hesitation.

title: Clean, quiet and modern
text: Great spacious modern room with all the amenities you could want, including Nespresso machine and a fold out couch for our daughter in the lounge. Easy walk into town if you want to have a few drinks with dinner. Opportunities for improvement would be addition of a kids channel from Sky or increasing the broadband data from 100mb/day as I found my Vodafone reception to have black spots.

title: Perfect Stay In Between Mata-mata & Waitomo!
text: We did Hobbiton & Waitomo on the same day, putting the night at a town in between sounded like a decent idea. Cambridge fits perfectly, and Kelly Rd Cambridge Lodge was definitely the perfect choice. Front desk was helpful and friendly, we had a two bedrooms suite and it was clean and almost in pristine condition! Couple of minutes drive to the town centre and you could get almost anything.

title: Great Lodge
text: We really enjoyed our short stay at Kelly Road Cambridge Lodge.  Very positive experiences with the front desk both at booking and check in/out.  Modern, very comfortable rooms.  Cambridge is a beautiful town.  Would love to visit again and would definitely stay here again.

title: Fabulous 👌👍
text:
Once again Kelly Rd has lived up to high standards on all aspects. This is the second time I have stayed here and both times my and my family were more than happy with everything. The staff are so so helpful, friendly, warm and welcoming to high standards. 
PROS: Mod cons ✅ cleanliness ✅ Replenishments ✅ Friendly Staff✅👌 Close to amenities 🛴🚲🚗 ✅ or if you’re into a nice walk✅
CONS: hmmm 🤔 try ask for room away from road as this time round I had a good room away from the road as my 1st stay that was the only negative where my bedroom was close to road where I heard the road traffic while trying to sleep.
Overall A++++🏅

title: Lovely and Fresh
text: Lovely Rooms as all still brand new. Comfy bed and good sized room. Had an upstairs room which is hard when you have a lot of bags, but was very clean. Only fault is that if you are a smoker you have to walk quite a long way to the gardens. Also at night time if guests downstairs dont have the thick curtains closed, you can see them through the blinds. Which the poor guests lying in bed didnt realise everyone could see them, so DO shut the curtains. Was lovely to be shown to the room and shown how things work.

title: Beautiful room and amenities
text:
Myself and my partner stayed here as we were in desperate need of rest after a music festival further north.

title: Lucky find

title: Excellent hotel in a very picturesque area!
text:

Only drawback – out of town and you need to drive to go out for meals, except for breakfast which can be obtained at the adjacent Sloth café.

title: Stunning Accommodation
text:

title: Here for the Christmas regatta
text:

title: Very well appointed, clean and quiet room

text: Stayed with my wife and niece in the two bedroom suite for one night while visiting local sights. Very convenient to the Hamilton Airport yet quiet. As others have noted it’s quite new and appointed in sleek modern style with nice artwork and other touches that made our stay great.

title: A Great Find

title: Nice hotel

title: Classy
text: Absolutely impeccable, quality furnishings. The cutlery, linen and crockery were all beautiful and seemed expensive. The Daily cleaning was great. My only niggles were,  the room was too dark so I would have preferred a glass sliding door 🚪 instead of the wooden one;  also the laundry machine use required coins - I think if that hasn't been advertised as such,  it should have been free.

title: Very Pleasant Stay
text:
I was given a warm welcome at reception.
This motel  is only 18 months old. Very clean and modern facilities. Lovely spacious shower and an excellent range of toiletries available. After working on thoroughbred racehorses all day, it was lovely to come back and relax in a quiet environment. Definitely will be back.
hotel_response: Thanks for your awesome feedback Karen

title: Indulge yourself
text: This is a gem of accommodation around the North Island. After staying in some very below average places for similar money Kelly Road was 5 star quality. The bed is a dream to sleep on; it's quiet even though on a busy road; there is a well equipped tea/coffee area; plenty of space in the room; a huge bathroom and shower with excellent toiletries. There is even a great cafe next door for your breakfast or just a good coffee. I can't rate this highly enough. The hosts have ticked all the boxes with this one and they are a friendly helpful couple which is the icing on the cake.

title: Friendly and we were upgraded. Excellent value for money
text: Beautifully presented. Spacious with 3 TV's, top quality fittings, crockery and appliances. Quiet even though on the main road. The best I have stayed in and I definitely will book here again. Deserves an Excellent rating.

title: Brand New
text: I was planing on staying in Tauranga however the AIMS games were on and most accommodation was completely boooked. Last minute I decide to stay at Hamilton. None of the Hamilton city motels or hotels were jumping out at me so I found that there are quite a few motels in Cambridge just about 25min from the city. This motel is practically brand new and well designed, very modern and quite large rooms. I was surprised the price was so high as it’s in a quiet town away from the city but none the less still worth the 5 stars for sure, in all honesty I have been in some big name 5 star resorts which wouldn’t match the rooms here. My only suggestion would be to request away from the road if possible, bit noisy up until like 7:30pm and starts again at 7am, quite manageable though. All in all I would be back in a second if I come this way again.

title: As good as it gets in Cambridge
text: New place so in great order.  Good loctation. There are two new places - but this is as good as you will get... even provided an umbrella.  Has all you need.  Typical motel room. Nice bath room.  Good parking.

title: Very nice
text: A lovely new motel with spacious rooms, well appointed kitchen (lovely dinnerware and nice glasses etc plus a great Nespresso) and bathroom (large with very nice toiletries), pleasant decor, comfy beds, friendly hostess, all resulting in a very comfortable quiet evening and night.

title: Upmarket accommodation
text: Nice, new, spacious motel accommodation. Presented in mint condition, spotless with large comfortable bed, modern bathroom, heat pump and Sky Sport channels. Quiet location a short distance from town centre. A very comfortable and enjoyable place to stay.

title: Comfortable, Easy Accomodation
text: We spent two nights at Kelly Rd and had a great experience in all respects. As our travel plans evolved we booked, cancelled (within the allowed cancellation period) and then re-booked this hotel and the staff was cheerfully accommodating of all the changes. They were helpful and welcoming throughout our stay - even offering us use of their umbrellas for our rainy Hobbiton tour. Kelly Rd was a very easy place to relax and unwind at the end of a long day of traveling - parking is free and convenient, the suite was modern, clean, cozy and comfortable with great bedding on the king bed AND the sofa bed. There’s a tv in the bedroom and another in the living room, reliable WiFi, great kitchenette with refrigerator, coffee and tea (we also ordered a cold breakfast delivered to the room one morning). The Sloth Cafe is next door for breakfast and lunch and we enjoyed the walk (maybe a mile) into town for dinner. This was a convenient location for us as we toured the region - Rotorua, Waitomo Caves, Hobbiton, with a flight out of Hamilton.

title: 100% Recommend Kelly Rd
text: We needed a Hotel to break up our drive from the top of North island NZ to south and decided on Cambridge. We arrived in pouring rain to a beautifully lit, warm Reception with (my favourite thing) scented candles. Lindsay (?sp) Manager on duty offered us a room but told me it had just been cleaned and may smell. He wanted me to view the room prior to booking the room, in case I found the smell overwhelming. So courteous.OMG the room was amazing and the "smell" was sheer cleanliness. This Hotel has been beautifully styled, enormous comfortable bed, pod coffee machine, kitchenette with dishwasher, massive TV. Bathroom massive too and again beautifully styled. In fact if it wasn't illegal, the bedside tables would have come home with me! Lindsay recommended the Good Union Hotel, for dinner, 2 minutes drive away, which capped off a thoroughly enjoyable nights stay. Funnily enough we had to return on our way back to fly home, 4 days later, as my dear husband left his phone charger there. The Hotel called us and it was waiting for us at Reception. Perfect.

title: An asset for Cambridge
text:
Kelly Rd is one of the nicest motels I have stayed in. Good sized rooms and bathroom, well appointed and very clean. We arrived late, and the heater had been turned on in our room, which was a very nice gesture. The extra detail has been well thought out with lots of handy power points, and a shower you can turn on without getting soaked. 
The only thing I would wish for is a few hooks in the bathroom for hanging things like toilet bags on.
When we were leaving, we realised there was a cafe right next door which was open early for breakfast. We will definitely try this next time we stay.

title: Excellent
text: Great accommodation, fantastic sized, nicely done out rooms with everything you need, BIG bathroom, BIG comfy bed, super clean, friendly people. What more could you ask for!? Highly recommend and if we’re in Cambridge again then this is where we’ll stay.

title: One night in Cambridge

Easy access to Cambridge and Sloth cafe next door makes early morning breakfast simple.

I would highly recommend, if just for the night or a few nights while you explore the beautiful surrounds.

title: Found this place by chance.
text: New hotel so very fresh. Very friendly owners that were more than helpful even though we turned up quite late. The rooms are very well equipped, (self contained). King size bed which was very comfortable. 2 kilometers from town. But a nice pub down the road.

title: Excellent stay, close to Cambridge Harness Track for Harness Jewels
text: We went to Cambridge for the Harness Jewels weekend first weekend in June.Really enjoyed our stay at Kelly Rd, staff were friendly and helpful. Room was spacious, tastefully designed and was warm and comfortable. Café next door had yummy breakfasts and other meals. Taxi drivers were friendly and accommodating. We were close enough to walk to the Cambridge Harness Track, but taxis were easy and available. Certainly will come back and stay here again. Highly recommended.

title: Cambridge at it's best
text: A beautiful new motel with good size rooms that are tastefully decorated to give that homely feel. Staff were very welcoming and were quick to resolve a small problem with the aircon. Would definitely stay there again.

The room has a microwave, toaster, kettle etc.  the bed was very comfortable.  It represents very good value for money and we would stay here again.

There is good off-road parking and we were even offered parking for the horse float (if we'd needed it). Super friendly and helpful staff.

Expensive, but for us worth it for our last two nights this trip to NZ.  Cambridge main Street very walkable, as is the park.

title: Kelly Rd Cambridge
text:
Facility wise this is one of the nicest  Motels we've stayed in. It is brand new, modern, clean and well designed. The rooms are spacious with thoughtful touches. 

The biggest downside was noise from other guests. The second night of our stay there was a party until 3.45am and then guests noisily leaving their rooms from 8am (which probably wouldn't have bothered us if we hadn't been awake so late)! In saying that we appreciate it's a shared space and we're going to be in proximity to other guests - but it might be something to keep an eye on for future. Breakfast is  expensive for what's on offer but it's close enough to town to go and get your own.

We wouldn't hesitate to return and recommended to others.

title: A great stay

The Lodge is only a few minutes by car to the centre of the city where you can find restaurants and a supermarket.

I would definitely recommend to any one visiting Cambridge.
