text: It's the little things that count. Things like a full-length mirror, ample coathangers and an iron and full-size ironing board in the room. We were attending a wedding so these things were important! The room was very clean and tidy, and we loved the air con (it was 30 degrees outside!). Great location only 2 mins drive from town, and Sloth cafe next door meant we didn't need to go far for coffee.

title: Staying in style
text: I recently stayed just the one night when in transit between 2 other North Island towns. It is a lovely new, modern and spotlessly clean motor lodge.  The interior fit out and decor are very nicely and tastefully done as are the grounds.  The room was well equipped with extras like a little coffee machine and dishwasher. The towels were thick and luxurious and crockery/glassware the sort of thing you’d enjoy in your own home rather than the basic utilitarian items you’d find in most motels.  All the little extras give the place a sense of a quality establishment.  Also free wifi which is great. Accessing this was a little clunky but not difficult. Only other very minor negative would be that it’s not situated in the most picturesque part of Cambridge but not a bad location either.  Only other point I would make is that I had planned on ordering a cheese platter on arrival (having seen this option on the website) but when I arrived it was not in the motel compendium under room service. So presumably no longer available and the website needs to be updated. I didn’t take any photos of the room as the rooms are well represented by the photos on the website.

text: We hit on this lodge by chance, as we usually do. We are not into pre booking. The rooms are large and airey with king sized beds which are very comfortable. We only stayed one night but would have stayed longer but we were travelling through.

title: Greatness all the way around
text:
Where to start ... I arrived in Cambridge a little jetlagged after a direct flight from the USA.  Even though I arrived well before check-in time, Tene greeted me with a huge smile and Kiwi warm approach and made sure I could get into a room immediately.  I was shown to my room and I was given some amazing milk for a snack.  The room was quite big unlike many rooms where there is barely any room to walk around the bed.  The bed was extremely comfortable perhaps one of the best hotel beds I have slept in since 2015.  There is a kitchenette area with dishes and silverware for 2 people and a very nice assortment of glasses.  As others have stated the bathroom is very very big.  Lighting system is clever and well appointed.  If you forget your travel adapter there si no need to worry as Tene has one to loan out to travelers like myself who had never been to New Zealand and that did not have the right adapter.  Service from all the staff was amazing.
There is a cafe next door but if you feel like walking 15 minutes into town you will find many other options for cafe and restaurants with great food and service.  Remember that all meat in New Zealand is grass fed unlike US meat.  It was pointed out to me at a restaurant where I ate some amazing food.
If you are looking for a clean, new, hospitable Hotel/Lodge conveniently located for your travels in Cambridge I would strongly recommend Kelly Road.  I am planning another trip back in March and I will not look to stay anywhere else but Kelly Road.

text:

Our room was spacious, comfortable and quiet. The shower is equipped with a hand-held nozzle and has plenty of water pressure. The king-sized bed is comfortable. Our room would have absolutely perfect for stargazing had it not been rainy and cloudy outside. Our hosts, Brendon and Jalena could not have been more hospitable and courteous. Breakfast was delicious and our hosts joined us in very pleasant conversation. Wonderful!

title: Well Worth a Visit
text:
We stayed at Grasslands for one night. It was our first B&B experience so not sure what to expect. We were meet at the gate by Brendan, who took us through to our room which was nice and spacious, with our own private en suite.  The room was 
meticulously clean, fully equipped with tea/coffee (with biscuits) making facilities, huge TV and heat pump. The  hosts even delivered special gluten free biscuits to accommodate a gluten intolerance. The B&B is set up so that everyone has their own private access to their room, and there is a huge communal lounge if extra space was required - with  games, magazines, books, maps etc... that leads outs to a swimming pool and spa.
After a peaceful quiet night, the morning breakfast was just superb! An array of cereals, yogurts, fruit, pastries, meats, cheeses, toast and spread - all sourced locally so all fresh and delicious. Again, they catered for special dietary needs.
Brendan and Jalena were fantastic hosts and no doubt we will visit them again when we are in the area.

I have now found a lovely motel in North Hamilton which will be much more inconvenient for my husband and myself, but they didn't think I sounded dodgy which was really nice.  Unbelievable. Extremely rude.  Don't stay here.

title: Lovely Stay
text:
Conveniently situated across the road from the RSA our entire family stayed here it was such a good stay
Rooms were spacious and well equipped
Along with kitchenette 

Perfect for my grandmother
I would returb

title: Recommended place to stay.
text:
We have a great time at the Arrow Motel lodge, our room is tidy and thoroughly CLEAN, very homey and comfortable. Arrow Motels provide a play area for children which is a bonus.. The couple who are the owners they were very friendly and professional. 

Thank you for the great time.

title: Comfortable night
text:
Nice and cosy place to rest after a busy day.
Good to know you have a great place to stay at Ngaruawahia.  So close to Hamilton and affordable comfort.
Arrived late at night and was checked in and taken to my room in less than 3 minutes. Super efficient.

title: Pleasantly Surprised
text: The young lady who greeted us gave us a very warm and friendly welcome, escorted us to our unit and made sure we had everything we needed. The unit was fresh and spotlessly clean. The beds were very comfortable.The same friendly service on our departure, the owners take such pride in their family  business  :)  We would love to stay there again

title: So nice and carry people
text:
I arrived there on the 24th of December on the afternoon after a day of trekking. Mike and Anna made sure I was well set up with my tent. 
As I had bad blisters on my feet, Anna brought me a bucket of warm water with healing plants inside. 

They always asked me if I needed anything. 
On the 25th on the end of the morning, Anna offered me a box of chocolates!!

Mike, Anna and their friends and family were so nice with me during my stay. 

You don’t feel as a customer but as a friend here. 

Thank you so much for everything. 

I really recommend Arrow Lodge Motel.

title: Highly Recommended
text: We were part of a group of 11 people who stayed here to attend a 2 day conference at Turangawaewae marae. The accommodation was very reasonably priced, comfortable, clean, pleasant and warm. This is a family business and we were very well  looked after by the owners/hosts.. Would highly recommend this motel.

title: Great Find
text: Looking for last minute accommodation in the area and Arrow Lodge was very accommodating.  Very reasonably priced for a studio unit.  I arrived late, room was warm, clean, comfortable and welcoming.  Photos on website doesnt do it justice as i was put in a newly refurbished room which was tastefully redecorated.  If need to stay in area again ill definitely be back here.

title: you won't believe this place...
text:
we arrived 30 minutes before we were due to be at a wedding. kori & nick - our hosts - suggested they drop us off & pick us up as there is no taxi service in the area. we went 'thanks. add it to the room please.'
keys to family car are missing but nick can take you in the work truck' kori says. we just happy for the ride so we head out & she has covered our car seats with towels & bed linen so not to dirty our wedding attire. 'we been spoilt' my wife whispers.
we call kori after 9pm & she arrives in the family car 5 minutes after to take us back to the lodge. kori offers to take us anywhere for refreshments. we decline but the fact she was looking out for us was great.
our modern room had a comfy bed & had fresh linen throughout. the shower had adequate pressure & iron & hairdryer was available in room. the flat screen mounted on the wall had clear freeview channels - & we needed nothing more (the rsa club across the road promoted all sky channels)
nick drove me back to the wedding venue the following morning as i left gear behind. on our return i settled our account & asked to add extra for the taxi service. they provided they politely declined & charged us the room rate only.
awesome hosts going the extra mile to accommodate us. we highly recommend this facility to everyone visiting the area and thanks again nick and kori for your hospitality.

title: Great place!
text:
Previously came here a few years ago and now it's under new ownership. The place has changed a lot, for the better. New owners are lovely people. They are redoing the units. 
My partner and I were lucky enough to stay in one of the new units and it was beautiful. 

The entire place is a lot cleaner and tidier. Doesn't seem to be as much riff raff around. Prices are very reasonable. 

So happy we decided to come back and give it a second chance. Highly recommend!

title: Arrow lodge motel Ngaruawahia.
text: Stay at the Arrow lodge motel. Very quite and lovely and clean. Lovely owners, would gladly go back. If you are looking for a place to stay in Ngaruawahia, I highly recommend the Arrow Lodge Motel 13 Market road.

title: Quiet location at a great price
text: We had a function to go to one Saturday night so stayed overnight at Arrow Lodge Motel.  It is tucked down a long driveway off SH1 - very quiet location.  Our unit was roomy, clean and very good value.  The sisters who attended to our booking were friendly and efficient.  The RSA across the road provided great meals at a super price

title: .decline to stay
text: Have stayed at better. Too pricey for my liking especially when you only are getting the basics. Your host was nice and friendly explain what was available and will it came down to one thing "PRICE" she said the room had the basic, she wasn't wrong.

title: Foam mattresses as beds - $150 a night
text:
I would have loved to say that this was a great place to stay...but it was far from great. 
Yes sure the hosts were excellent, friendly and did go the extra mile whist being at the motel but tired decor, a board with a thin double mattress as a bed and being overcharged at check-out are just some of the things we did not like about this motel. 

Room-service....upon returning to our room in the late evening we discovered that someone had been in the room, moved our belongings around eg keys,wallet,cellphone,reading book,tablet which were all left on the kitchen table and the side draws of our queen bed in the room.  5minutes after discovering this, the hosts comes down and let's us know that she had serviced the room. To this day, we are not happy with this. 

Over charged at check out - one price was given when booking was first made and another price was given when it came time to check-out.  Not good at all!

SPIDER AND INSECT PROBLEM BIG TIME! Come on down to insect-ville if you dare! Spiders creeping up and down the wall, insects crawling in the kitchen and kitchen sink....was just eeww and gross! Had to end up going down to New world and getting fly spray and insect repellent for our kids sake!

Overall My family and I will never be returning to stay at the Arrow lodge again.

title: Good overall
text: Good accommodation if perhaps a little pricey for what is on offer. Clean rooms and friendly staff but the town itself is a 'little rough'. Rooms serviced daily. Staff go the extra mile to help. Good experience overall.

title: Clean, Tidy but a Bit Tired
text:
Ngaruawahia is about a 15 minute drive from the Waikato City of Hamilton. The Arrow Lodge Motel seems to be the only real accommodation option in this little town nestled on the banks of the Waikato river. Ngaruawahia itself is steeped in history and is a very important settlement for the Maori people. The Maori 'King' lives in Ngaurawahia. 

The Arrow Lodge is scrupulously clean and tidy but more than a little dated with decor. The interior design is straight from the 1970s and is probably unchanged from the day it was built. Having said this, it is comfortable and a good option if other accommodation in Hamilton is not available. The motel is very close to the banks of the Waikato river, a short walk from the main shopping area of Ngaruawahia.

A cooked or continental breakfast is available each morning. 

The hosts were very friendly and accommodating and the two lovely cats were lovely, making me feel very much at home.  

In short, the Arrow Lodge is basic, clean accommodation set in a very quiet neighbourhood. It is a good option if you are in Ngaruawahia for business or pleasure.

title: Fabulous Motel.  So quiet!
text:
This motel is very reasonably priced.  When opening the door, we were thrilled.  Such a lovely fresh smell, beautifully clean, gorgeous comfy bed, well equipped kitchen and bathroom.  SO QUIET!  Being down a long driveway, we never heard any traffic on the very busy main road outside.  A short walk to shops and supermarkets.  Very friendly hostess.  This is a great place to stay and great parking and very central.
We will be back!

title: Very good place to stay
text:
Very good place to stay - clean, well maintained property and spacious room, reasonably priced; comfortable and quiet.
We only stayed one night, but would definitely stay here again.

title: A quiet hideaway in the town center
text: Room was very clean, tidy and fresh, and so quiet.  A short walk from the town center. Lovely hosts, really friendly, and a nice pool too!  We would definitely stay again.  Thank you!!

title: Met our Expectations
text: Clean, tidy, well located and very friendly staff. Perfect for our needs. Traveling as a family we had plenary of room, sky TV, kitchenette and good bathroom

title: Good Budget Stay
text: Studio units are larger than most, furnishings modern and clean. The bathroom could do with an upgrade, a bit tired and shabby and the water pressure in the shower was not the best and the vinyl on the shower floor was lifting.  Could do with some work on the outside appearance, the driveway had potholes and the gardens and pool area need some attention, first appearances always count, and we really wondered if we had made a good decision booking until we saw the room. Very friendly host, just needs some TLC

title: A handy resting place
text:
We stayed just for one night on our way from Auckland to New Plymouth.

The room was spacious and clean, with a large, comfortable bed.

Cambridge was an interesting little town and we would have liked to spend a bit more time there.

Good value for money!

title: Family stay
text:
Great location and great facilities.
The pool was clean and.perfect for the kids.
Comfortable beds, ample space and great service.

Highly recommended if you want to stay in Cambridge and explore the surrounding.

Thank you for a lovely stay!

title: Perfect place for a stopover
text: We found this motel in the evening to break a long journey.  We were so pleased to have selected this place. We had a 2 bedroom unit.  Beds were super comfortable.  Place was super clean. So much space.  Warm on a cold night.  Down a driveway so no road noise. Hosts were so welcoming and friendly.   Would stay again.

title: Great place to stay.
text: This place was spotless. The hosts were lovely people and very helpful. Our room was a good size and had everything that you would need. Comfortable and quiet and in a good location. We did turn into the wrong driveway a few times as there were two side by side.

title: A lucky find for me.
text:
This little hotel tucked away is so quiet.  There is no traffic noise. The hosts were so polite and obliging. My room was very large and sparkling clean. It is in a great location with an easy walk to Good Union for dinner. 
I wouldn’t hesitate to book there again, in fact I had planned to stay one night and then go to Auckland to be closer to the airport but decided to stay an extra night at this hotel and drive straight to the airport on my last day in New Zealand.

title: Large quiet unit and everything you may need.
text: The host was most pleasant. There was a big WOW when we opened the door; the unit was large, a lot of room and all so spotless. More utensils than most others supply and little extras that make a stay satisfying. Nice and quiet and not far from the city centre for eateries etc. More than happy to revisit or recommend to others. A most pleasant night and 'We will be back'.

title: Great for families
text:
A very spacious motel perfect for a family. It was well equipped, well heated, clean with plenty of room and lots of spare blankets. The host was lovely and welcoming.
It was very quiet as it is set well back from the road and it's a short walk into town

title: Great Beds, nice Motel
text: The Motel looks like a building from the Mediterranean & is well looked after and maintained.  Its very quiet as its off the roadside but only about a 5 minute walk into town.  We were in room 5 the motel has 8 rooms I think differing in size.  Our room had a super king bed and a single, it was so comfortable & the sheets and pillows were also very nice, it is the second-best bed we have ever slept & I've travelled all over the world. It had bedside tables each side and an alarm clock.  The ceiling height was about 14feet high (no exaggeration) and so the room felt so expansive and open.  The TV was about 45inch with SKY and the WiFi was fast and unlimited. Our room had a table with four chairs so that was nice having somewhere to sit we also had 2 other cozy chairs as well.  The kitchen was nice and new with a coffee plunger my only complaint is the size of the fridge is was small only about a 50litre and so we had to utilise our chilly bin for the stuff we couldn't fit in.  The room had a good size Air Conditioning unit and the bathroom was a good size with a nice walk in shower with a glass side & great pressure.  The motel provided shampoo and body wash both in pump bottles in the shower and both smelt really nice.  The owners took our rubbish, changed our towels and replenished soap & tea coffee daily. There are blinds you can roll down for privacy in your room but can still see out and the curtains aren't quite black out but not far from it for those who don't like being blinded by the morning sun like us.  We had a little table and two chairs outside our room which is under cover from the weather and it looks over the pool so that was nice.  The pool was 6 feet deep and shallow at the other end for the kids and there's a table and 5 chairs in where the pool is so parents can sit there while the kids have a swim.   We had a very pleasurable experience here and the owners were very happy and helpful, we would definitely stay here again.

title: Pleasantly surprised
text:
Better than expected. Older style motel. We had room 3 which was a two bedroom, very large bedrooms and lounge. Bathroom was also large and updated with new shower. Even though it's old rooms very clean and tidy, no chipped paint or worn carpet etc.
No hesitation in staying again. A short drive into town or 10min walk. Room away from main road so nice and quiet.

title: Penny
text: Just stayed for 4 nights nice quiet rooms and tidy.   Only complaint is very shocked to find out when we arrived they were very quick at taking payment and charging us  extra $80 for a porta cot and high chair.   Which was in my view over the top so if you have infants beware  that this is a added extra and was not quoted online.  And also new owners and haven’t changed it on the website it . It is in a very good location.

title: Wow this was a lovely find
text: Arrived at Captain's Quarters Motor Inn at around 8.10pm on a Saturday night and we did not book, very happy to see them open, and they had a vacancy for a studio unit, and wow, it was lovely, so big and spacious, warm and clean and had everything we needed, great people to deal with, very friendly and helpful,, loved our short stay, thank you Captain's Quarters a pleasant surprise

title: Lovely quiet motel
text: This motel is quiet and well positioned near Cambridge town centre. The owners, Keith and Trudi are friendly and helpful, rooms are spacious and clean, beds comfortable. The outdoor pool is an added bonus and very welcome at the end of a hard day's sightseeing!

title: Lovely motel
text: Warm welcome from the owners and a lovely clean unit. Very quiet location. Would stay there again. Close to the town centre. Comfy bed. The pool looked inviting but I’d left my togs behind. Well equipped kitchen

title: Great stay
text: We stayed with 3 kids for two nights and were very pleased. The rooms were very spacious and clean and the staff friendly. It was a great place to stay as it was close to the Hobbiton set. We'd stay there again.

title: Quick, but nice stay!
text: The motel owner Keith was very warm and welcoming. He made a few suggestions of things to do in the other towns we were visiting and offered us fresh milk to take to our room. The room was spacious, clean, quiet, and comfortable for the one night we stayed.

title: Great stay
text:
My husband and I stayed here with our teenage son in a 2 bedroom unit for 3 nights. The unit was very clean, spacious and comfortable. Well equipped kitchen, plenty of extra towels in the bathroom and pillows in the bedroom. 
Pool was excellent and we enjoyed using it. Tables and chairs outside each unit are nice touch. We enjoyed being in a smaller complex and the location so close to town was great. 
We would definitively return and would recommend this motel.

title: The Perfect Location!
text: Having stayed at the Captain's Quarter previously, my young son and I returned in December 2019 for yet another superb stay. The owners (Trudi and Keith) were lovely; welcoming in all respects and professional with regards to the accommodation that they arranged for me. The experience was perfect for our 9 night stay. I thoroughly recommend this location.

title: Comfortable and easy
text: First stay in a motel and would definitely do again... clean, great location - easy walk to restaurants, friendly host, very comfortable bed, parking was easy.  Would recommend adding a couple more pillows to the beds.

title: Miami in Cambridge
text: Wow!  Fabulous hosts. Fabulous accommodation. Clean. Tidy. Best ever comfortable beds. Safe pool for the family.  Highly recommended.  Quiet and peaceful.  2 minute walk into town to local shops, restaurants and cafes.

title: Excellence and efficiency
text:
I really liked the architectural style of this motel. Down a driveway, it was quiet and peaceful. 
Designed in the neo-Spanish style popular in the 1970s (I'd suggest renaming the place to El Capitano's !) they have retained the original key features whilst upgrading all facilities to current expectations. I loved the generous proportions of the room with its lofty ceiling. However, it was the cleanliness and overall neatness that made a big impression on me. It seemed to me to be operated with care, pride, and excellence and I like that.

title: Enjoyed It Enough to Book Again
text: We were three people traveling together, one couple and one single, so having a 2-bedroom apartment was a must. We booked on the fly as we were on our way from Matamata to Bay of Islands and needed a place to rest our heads for one night in transit. The manager was superbly nice and accommodating (and even remembered us when we returned a week later for our second stay). The rooms are large, with vaulted ceilings in the living/dining room. We didn't use the kitchen. It is close to town (definitely eat at Good Union, a church converted into a pub/restaurant!), walkable to town and in a quiet residential area. One drawback is tight parking. Laundry machines on site for a fee.

title: A 1st class Venue
text:
Having spent eight days at the Captains Quarter Motor Inn in July with my young son, we had a fantastic time at this lovely motel.

Having stayed at other motels in Cambridge, this motel is by far the best in all respects, with the owners (Trudi and Keith) providing that personal family touch. In short, a 1st class venue, which I will definitely be revisiting in the future!!

title: Great place to stay in Cambridge NZ
text:
Made to feel very welcome. Very Spacious facility. Extremely clean. Well stocked (real wine glasses). A magnifying make-up mirror with facial cleanser tissues. Heat pump. Very comfortable beds with lovely linen. Highly recommended.
Handy location, walking distance to Cambridge town area.

title: Great location and clean and comfortable
text:
Stayed as part of a large group of 23.
We booked out the entire motel for the nights.
The motel is very centrally located in Cambridge and within walking distance to shops and restaurants /take aways
The units are spacious and very clean.
Shower and shower pressure is good.
Recommended place to stay esp with a large group.

title: All that I needed was here
text: Greeted by a friendly and organsied reception lady who knew who I was before I needed to tell her, the room I had was spacious, clean and had everything I needed.  It was light and airy and had reading lights over the bed (which I don't often find).  The bed was comfortable and shower had good pressure and plenty of room. Cannot find any fault and will stay again

title: A Great Place to Stay!!
text: We loved our stay there! The rooms were spacious, they had great facilities including: free wifi, pool and a kitchen. I think the owners were extremely helpful and friendly to us. It is walking distance to the local countdown, Briscoes and Bunnings. It is quiet and peaceful after a long day as well. I would give them a 10 star recommendation. We enjoyed our stay there and think everyone else will.

title: Great value for money.
text: Totally enjoyed our stay. Large, clean rooms. Comfortable beds. Great fascilities. The owners were extremely helpful & friendly. Would stay here again in a heartbeat. Walking distance to shops. Would totally recommend this motel to anyone.

title: Best Place To Stay In Cambridge
text: When staying in Cambridge, I won't stay anywhere else.  The owners are friendly and helpful, the rooms are quiet and cozy, and it is within walking distance of coffee shoppes, restaurants, pubs, and shopping.  It's also a good place to stay if you're visiting Hobbiton, The Glow Worm Caves, or Rotorua.  You can make little day trips and return to the hotel.

title: Walk to town
text: We stayed for 1 night in Sept. Very friendly lady on check in. Easy walk into town.  Nice & Spacious clean room & bathroom.  Sunny day outside but a little gloomy inside but seats & table by each room to sit in the sun.

title: Excellent
text:
I turned up to this motel before the recommended check in time, they were very accommodating and informed me that they would make sure my room was cleaned first as I had a wedding at attend and therefore needed to be in and out very quickly.
I was there 5mins after the check in time, they had stuck to their promise and had actually cleaned my room ahead of schedule. This was above and beyond what I was expecting and therefore made me very happy to have chosen to stay here. albeit not spending a lot of time in the room I was very pleased with the service I received, the staff were very pleasant and they accommodated my every need. Very happy with this indeed. recommend to anyone who is staying in Cambridge for a long time or a short time as the pool looks very appealing and the rooms are very spacious.

title: Nice and clean large room
text: We stayed here for one night over Easter. The motel is in an excellent location close to resturants etc but is very quiet and well set back from the road. The room was large and everything was very clean with well equipted kitchenette. The bed was reasonably comfortable and there was a range of different pillows to pick from. The owners were friendly and helpful. No problems here at all and would stay again. One point to note is parking is limited if you are travelling with more than one car however this didnt appear to cause any problems.

title: GOOD LOCATION, VERY QUIET
text: Located on a side street, set back from the road, this hotel is very quiet, even when fully booked.  Nice pool in courtyard, although not heated, so when the temp. drops it isn't used much.  Short walk (2 blocks) to the main street, where it is easy to find restaurants and stores.  Recommend and would stay here again.

title: The best bed in unit #1 of a two week visit to Auckland to Taupo
text:
A king bed not quite Asian-hard, but wonderfully firm, after night after night of saggy offerings at other places.  

Lovely welcoming host, who was cleaning the pool when we arrived.  We had a two bedroom family unit, very spacious but also very little privacy - tinting the windows would fix this, or some net curtains on the main sliding door and in the bedroom.  The unit was reasonably clean, other than some cobwebs and debris around the back door, which looks as if it is rarely used.  Good bathroom and kitchen facilities.  In a wonderfully spacious two bedroom unit, only one desk fan supplied, first time on our travels home this time we have been offered a DESK fan.  We live in Perth, where it is very hot in summer and windy all year.  We have noticed the humidity and stillness when we have travelled around here.  Why, why, why do motels (most definitely not just this one), if you are lucky supply ghastly Warehouse/Bunnings-type plastic fans, and unlucky not at all (never enough anyway - usually one fan per unit for multiple bedrooms).  I realise air conditioning is a bit over the top for NZ, but some aesthetically pleasing and efficient ceiling fans would be so much better than these rubbishy cheap and nasty offerings.  

Very quiet motel, close to the centre of town, which has many antique and op shops to explore.  Not modern, but well maintained and the carpet looks clean (we stayed in a motel in Rotorua with a carpet that looked as if it had been used as a weed blanket in the vegetable patch and had then been repurposed, so we are carpet-conscious).  

They only had one night available here, else we would've stayed  for another.  Obviously a deservedly popular place for the price (very reasonable).

title: Clean and Tidy
text:
Not super fancy, but huge room, nice and tidy. The staff(owners) were very pleasant. The pool looked nice for a quick dip in summer. We would definitely stay here again if we are ever back in Cambridge.

Just one thing, we couldn't watch a movie in the evening, because it was adult rated, and the TV had a parental lock on it.

title: Last minute late night booking so very pleased.
text: Last minute late night booking so very pleased we did could not ask for more, clean room comfortable bed very friendly helpful staff. You could not ask for anything better after long day driving. The staff stayed open late to let us in after hours.

title: Super Quiet
text:
Stayed for 2 weeks with my work. I have stayed in many a Motel around the country and i have to say this is up there as one of the most quietest i have ever stayed at. 2 minutes drive to the town centre and 30 minutes to Hamilton. 
Rooms are slightly dated but tidy,clean and very spacious, free wifi and sky tv.
Recommended to all visitors.

title: Comfortable and Warm
text: Stayed here for work and it is my 3rd time back. Good location, the heater looks small but does a great job heating the room. Good amenities and a swimming pool if you are keen. I went in winter so there was no way that was happening. Room is clean and bed is comfortable.

title: Good solid Kiwi motel
text: Stayed 3 nights this time (have stayed here several times before).  Friendly owner, clean, warm room (Cambridge was cold) and close to town centre and the velodrome.  They have a good selection of different room types.  Set well back from main road, so quiet.  Expect to be back.

title: Comfortable and clean
text: Very dated motel in Cambridge but comfortable, spacious enough and clean. 2 bedroom unit had large bathroom . Free wifi was appreciated. Good for an overnight stay for sporting events at the nearby cycling velodrome. Cafe's and restaurants in close proximity.

title: Clean, comfortable with very helpful managers
text:
Stopped here en route to Rotorua. Found the room very clean and comfortable. The place was quiet and the manager lent me a tool kit when I had a luggage malfunction. 
Would not hesitate to stay there again

title: lovely space
text: Just one night in a lovely room with high ceilings and very spacious with wood details and all i needed, free wifi, very friendly and accommodating owners. I had a very comfortable night, short distance from town, very easy and pleasant

title: Great little swimming pool. Very clean, good value room.
text: Easy to find in central Cambridge yet quiet and away from the main roads. Nothing fancy, but the room was very clean with a nicely renovated bathroom :-)We had the large family room which was really spacious with seating for six guests inside and out on the patio area. We found everything we needed for our overnight stay. Lovely clean well maintained swimming pool with lawn around it.  Also great to have recycling bins provided in the room.

title: The last night
text: We stayed here for the last night of our stay on the north island, a tidy and clean motel, located a little too far from the Main Street, also starting to show signs of its age but very clean and tidy. A good place to stay if you need a good quiet motel and not fussed about being a little wary from the centre of town.

title: A good stay!
text: We stayed at the Captain's Quarters for 1 night while on business in Cambridge. Really very comfortable, clean and roomy. Great comfortable bed and good facilities. Lovely pool in a quiet area. Location is perfect, a short, pleasant walk into town if looking for a place to eat or have a drink. Would definitely stay again if back in the area.

title: Value for money
text: Stayed for one night on our way to visit the Hobbiton movie set in Matamata. The motel is quiet, clean and spacious suitable for family of four. Only 20 minutes from Hamilton. The weather was quite cold for us but thanks for the heater provided that keep us warm. Value for money. Wished we could stay longer.

title: Lovely end to our holiday
text: We stayed here on our last night in New Zealand. Cambridge is a lovely town and the Captain's Quarters is a very nice motel. The weather had been hot for us an the pool was welcome. Large room. Bed was comfortable. Fresh milk for a nice cup of tea. We went on to Hamilton Gardens on our way to Auckland airport. Lovely. 😀

title: Quiet & Spacious
text: We stayed for 3 nights & were very pleased with our stay. The motel is back off the old main road into Cambridge, just a few blocks from the centre of town, & was very quiet. Our room was more than twice the size of many hotel rooms & very comfortable with a table & chairs, king size bed & two comfortable leather armchairs. The kitchenette had just about everything you'd need including a microwave & portable electric hob. The bathroom was very clean with a walk-in shower & large bottles of shampoo & body wash, the only issue was the water pressure was quite low so it took a while to wash shampoo out. We had a couple of lights not working when we first arrived & the owners not only had them fixed right away but replaced the energy saver bulbs with much brighter LEDs. Overall we were very happy with our stay & impressed with the service.

title: Nice little motel with the most comfortable bed ever!
text: A great little motel with a huge room and great comfortable bed.  Super hostess offering fresh milk for coffee and she would sell you breakfast if you want it. A small comfortable nice place that is just plain homey.

title: Great motel
text: My Husband & I had the pleasure recently to stay at Captains Quarters Motor Inn in Cambridge on New Zealand's North Island this was the cleanest Motel we have ever stayed in & also one of the spacious Highly recommend to any NZ travellers

title: AWESOME STAY
text:
this motel was awesome...quiet..just what we were looking for....brilliant service..located right where we needed to be...
Didn't realise when i booked how well located it was to our needs
Look forward to staying here again

title: Comfortable, Clean and Quiet
text:
I booked this one night stay from Australia after reading the reviews in Tripadvisor.

It was a great selection with large well equipped rooms, very comfortable beds and was very quiet.  Although a rather old style building, it has been well maintained and is as comfortable as new.  The operators were very pleasant and provided all the required information on where to go and what to do.  It is an easy walk into the town for dinner and breakfast.  We were there on a Saturday evening and were surprised by the large Sunday market and the large number of people visiting there.

Keep up the good work

title: Fabulous
text: This place was a great last minute find. The room is huge and well furnished. Everything you need in the kitchen and it was nice to have a plunger coffee in the morning. Also liked getting real milk in a glass bottle! Easy check-in/check out and super friendly hosts. Will definitely recommend this place to others

title: Very Quiet and Clean
text: A huge room but cold. Arrived after dark, no windows shut and the bed was cold, needed the electric blanket on for a day to air it out. Very quiet great for us rural dwellers. We arrived in the dark and left early the next morning for a meeting. I would stay here again.

title: No fuss place
text: Has all what you expect from a place where you park your self for a night or two. Spacious rooms, cool pool, small kitchenette. Free parking, wifi. Could do with a hot tub for the winter months. Also the force in the room shower was low. Will revisit.

title: Pastor G
text: Great accomadation and aminities well priced and worth it . Our room was modern and  spacious. The complex is away from the road and is quiet. This room accommodated six adults with ease. All the linen was supplied clean and fresh.

title: Good over nighter
text: Arrived at 7.30pm on a Monday night and were fortunate to get the last  unit. Check in was quick and efficient from a lovely lady who  was most helpful with directions to local restaurants. Unit was very clean and tidy and well appointed. Agree with others regarding bathroom, needs more shelves for wash bags etc. Recommend this as a good spot to stop.

title: Nice place,great location
text: Nice spacious rooms, very clean and comfortable beds. Accommodating hosts and laundry facilities all within walking distance of the City Centre and great food. If you need to stay in the Cambridge area, this is the place!!!

title: Cotton sheets
text:
The night we spent here was very hot so cotton sheets were very welcome as was the fan. The bed was large and comfortable. The unit we had seemed vast for the amount of furniture. The kitchen served our needs. The shower was fine but the bathroom was a rather cramped on space to put razors, etc. We did not use the swimming pool but it was popular with other guests. Parking was tight as some places were not available and the motel was full. We liked the peace and quiet.

There is a dairy just round the corner which is handy.

title: Spacious older style accomodation
text: Very friendly and helpful staff. Room I had was very large in an older style. Bathroom OK and kitchen area  were clean. If you get a room with an adjoining door don't expect it to be quite if people staying but if you want plenty of space then this is a great option. Pretty outlook over pool area and didn't notice any traffic noise.

title: Clean and spacious
text: Although the motel is somewhat dated it provided us with plenty of space for luggage and a reasonably comfortable bed (although with such a large studio room a king size bed would have been perhaps a better option. The motel was very clean and everything we could want was there. Reception were helpful and courteous. Had a swimming pool.

title: Clean & friendly
text:
Nice place to stay on the way South. Huge rooms with the opportunity to cook. Bathroom quite new and very clean. Bed comfortable as well.
The staff was really friendly and gave us a Lot of recommendations.
The town itself is quite Nice but actually only a One Night stay.

title: Spacious rooms, clean quiet and tidy with very accommodating owners
text: We have stayed a number of times at Captains Quarters and on each and every occasion we have been impressed.  The rooms are spacious, clean and tidy, they are a little dated but to be honest the space makes up for this.  The owners go out of their way to ensure that your stay is a pleasant one.  I would recommend Captains Quarters to anyone who wants to have a comfortable place to stay in Cambridge.

title: Clean as a Whistle, stopover
text: Spotless room, bathroom and appurtenances. Architecturally both bland and somewhat quirky owing to its Spanish arches style it opens to capacious internal comforts, including a cute kitchenette, along with furniture to suit all 3 bears and Goldilocks if such a family should stay over.  What it lacks in style it makes up for in mechanics: all the lights switch on, the taps turn and the bed supports the body. Quiet amenity too, as featured in the signpost at the front, as it is a longish driveway but just off the highway.

title: Top little spot in Cambridge
text:
I can highly recommend Captain's Quarters as an accommodation option in Cambridge. I've stayed at a few places around the area and this is my favourite. 

The rooms are nice, clean, and have everything you need. The service is fantastic. There is a pool and all in all its a very quiet place to unwind.

title: Quiet, comfortable motel
text: We stayed here for a night in January. Huge room, comfortable beds, sparkling clean pool and washer / drier for guests which was great as we had been travelling for 10 days. The place is dated, but the bathrooms have been modernised and it's super clean. It's well situated up a long driveway off the main road and totally quiet. Cambridge is a beautiful town, with town centre within walking distance and this motel was a great place to stay.

title: Good basic accommodation in Cambridge, quiet and close to town.
text: It was 9.30pm and we had to find accommodation in Cambridge.  Phoned the Captain's Quarters Motor Inn and got a very pleasant and helpful man on the phone.  He was happy that we were still 40 mins away.  The owners were waiting when we arrived with a smile.  Our room was basic but had everything we needed, liked the large shower.  Quiet and very handy to town.

title: Quiet and comfortable
text: Our weekend stay here was great.   The unit we had was very quiet and comfortable giving us two good sleeps.   We appreciated the generously sized room which gave us plenty of room for our travel bags etc so we weren't tripping over them as some times happens in smaller sized rooms.   The unit provided all that we required and was clean and tidy as were the grounds.   A pleasant place to stay and we will be happy to stay there again.

title: Space & Comfort!
text: This place is nothing flashy but had lovely comfortable beds, HUGE spacious studio rooms, was clean and tidy and the owners were great, very friendly. Easy to find, plenty of safe parking. Will definitely stay again.

title: Quiet
text: We travelled without booking before hand, and luckily found the last unit here late in the afternoon. This is a very quiet motel set back of the main highway. It is clean and tidy, well priced, and the hosts are very accommodating. But it is tired, it really needs a refresh!

title: Very Quiet
text: So I travel a little on business and this is the third time I have stayed here. The rooms are spacious and quiet, I would love to come here in the summer to try the pool. I can imagine that when the field days are on this would be one of the first places to book out!

title: Friendly helpful Hosts.
text: Stayed 2 nights in 2 bedroomed unit which was very clean, spacious and comfortable. Appreciated the free Wi-Fi and inconspicuous cleaning and replacement of towels etc. A great location with an easy walk to the shopping area during the day and good restaurants at night. The hosts couldn't have been more helpful. Would stay here again.

title: Good Value, Great Location
text: Spent only one night but would have been a lovely place to stay longer.  We were on our way to Auckland for our return home after 3 weeks traveling through both islands.  The Inn is in a great location, well maintained, and very comfortable.  The room was large and welcome after a few we had stayed in that were half the size.

title: Excellent Cambridge Stay
text: Great motor inn, large spacious rooms and excellent facilities. Owners were super efficient and helpful. A very pleasant stay and we would gladly recommend this place to any and all.  When next in Cambridge, we will stay here without doubt. Easy walk into the shopping area of Cambridge

title: A good stopover
text: Got there very late on Christmas Day. The hosts were very helpful and accommodating since we were arriving long after office hours. Very clean and comfortable. The 2 beds were in one long room - not a lot of airflow in the room, but a fan was provided.

title: A little dated, but spacious and clean
text:
The feel of this place is definitely dated (nothing modern), but the suites are very large and tidy, with a lovely porch area to sit in. Given the size of the suites, we were surprised we only had a small apartment-sized fridge, which was a little frustrating as we were stocking up and cooking all our own meals.
The pool is great (although only about 8 strokes per lap). The proprietors (from England) were friendly, and responsive to our requests. It is very quiet here (quite set back from the street). There is a beautiful park nearby with a large pond and ducks.

title: Two fab nights
text: We had a wedding to go to booked this last minute pretty good value we had two double beds but only one was needed. The high ceiling made the room seem very spacious. Bed was ok. Shower was hot and good pressure. Staff were very friendly and the free wifi is great. Kids were playing in the pool about 8.00am so not that great for a hangover cure but overall a good motel :) cheers!

title: A bit dated but clean and roomy
text:
While the room certainly could do with some modernising, we could find little to complain about the cleanliness, lack of noise and the amount of space in the room. The high ceiling and spacious interior made us feel relaxed. No security concerns. The inn is located next to a retirement village within the town, so it probably contributed to the quiet neighbourhood. The inn is also very close to town, just two to three blocks from Victoria Park where the Farmers' Market is on Saturday mornings.

The hosts were helpful and pointed us the way to Hobbiton as well as some of the restaurants and amenities within Cambridge. Would recommend this if you want a roomy place to stay in and aren't too fussy about decor.

title: Needs refurbishing - not great value
text: Very pricey for quality of rooms. Really dated - looks like as furnished in early eighties and untouched since. Staff nice enough.  Pool nothing like as big as in photo. Ok for overnight but wouldn't spend longer.

title: Better than expected.
text: Great little motel. We stayed in a unit that by the owners own admission is due for an upgrade however it is more than adequate in its present state. Clean, tidy, with lovely friendly hosts who did everything to help. Also amazingly quiet especially considering the location. Recommended to all looking for a genuine inexpensive small town experience.

title: Wonderful Motel!
text: We stayed here only one night but wished we could stay longer.  The staff were so friendly and eager to make our stay comfortable.  We had a 2 bedroom unit that was very large and very clean.  We would recommend this well cared for and maintained motor inn!

title: Great hotel and hosts
text:
We stayed in a 2 bedroom apartment for one night as we were passing through Cambridge. The facilities were impressive and very clean. The hosts were very friendly and inviting and made us feel very welcome
I would highly recommend staying at this motel. Thank you The Budd Family :)

title: Comfortable, quiet and very well run
text: Stayed here for a total of 3 nights. I arrived with 3 lads that were taking part in rowing trials at lake Karapiro so 4 0f us to 1 room. Although one of the lads was my son, you still wonder what level of comfort you are going to enjoy or not! I have to say, the room was easily large enough to accommodate all of us with 3 singles and 1 double bed. The room was very clean, well equipped with toaster, kettle, fridge + knives forks etc. Good shower and plenty of hot water. Having driven for 4 hours and with a an early morning start, we needed a good nights rest before the hard work of the rowing trials. We had a great nights sleep in a quiet room even though the hotel is right on the main road. great owners - couldn't do more for you - very well recommended.

title: Excellent small town motel
text: Everyhting you'd expect (in a good way) and more fromm this lovely small town motel. Exceptional service, spacious rooms and lovely bathrooms, Great location back from street sp peaceful. One of my favourite motels.

title: Great Motel
text: Nice location, on State Highway 1, but up a long drive way and no road noise.  Nice clean and large room.  Clean pool for the kids.  Rooms have been maintained and upgraded with new kitchen units.  FreeViewHD Flat Screens TV, with Sky channels as well.  Wireless was available, but I did not need it.

title: Excellent motel, great value.
text: We stayed here for one night on our way up north as we wanted to break our trip, we had driven a long way and Cambridge was the perfect distance for a nights stop. I am glad we chose this motel, it had was so clean and tidy, comfortable  and so quiet at night. We stayed in a very large two bedroom unit, with only the three of us there was so much room, well equiped kitchen and bathroom, plenty of towels etc. The pool is just a step outside all the room, well fenced of course. It is a well kept pool area, as clean as the rest of the motel areas, and so refreshing to jump into after the hot drive we had have. Would definitely come back to this motel if we are in the area again.

title: Would be excellent were it not for the bathroom
text:
Motel in Cambridge, so close enough to Hamilton but a pleasant small town with less hustle and bustle.  Motel is set back on the block, and large rooms have very high ceilings, so all is peace and quiet.  Good food preparation area, everything clean.  Beds very comfortable which means a good night's sleep in the quiet surroundings.   The bathroom was very clean and had a vanity unit and a shower over a bath, but there was no bench space, the shower pressure was so weak it was quite infuriating (hence the average rating for the room), and there were no power points, not even an outlet for shavers, so hair drying etc had to be done elsewhere.  It seemed to be an odd initial design given the huge sleeping area could easily have been reduced to give better space in the bathroom.  
The town was pleasant to walk around, and if you happen to be there and are just looking for a quick takeaway to take to the lovely park or back to your accommodation, try the Noodle Canteen.  We chose it as the best of a rather dodgy looking lot and had low expectations but were pleasantly surprised - the food was freshly prepared and delicious.

title: Top place to stay for Ballet Comps
text: A quiet, clean, warm and comfortable place to stay.  Excellent hosts and in a very convenient situation to get to and from the local Ballet Competitions.  It was also close enough to get to Hamilton and back for a bit of retail therapy!  Many thanks and see you again next year.

title: Best in Cambridge
text: Love this place, this is the 2nd time we have stayed here.  Lovely warm room, soft comfortable bed.   There is even a bath.  Being down the driveway it is very quiet even thought it is on the main road.  Excellent host, very pleasant to talk to.  We have stayed at other nice places in Cambridge, but this is the best.

It's Quiet like it states it is. lovely swimming pool, rooms are always clean. plenty of room and a perfect place to relax. hosts are always willing and available to help. would stay here again if i visited Cambridge again.

title: great place to stay
text:
have stayed here many times family owned motel very friendly and helpful nothing
is a problem for them.
rooms are always clean, tidy & well presented.  we always stay in the family unit and this
is a great motel specially if you have kids.

title: A very nice motel
text: Stayed here recently. A very clean motel with modern frunishings. Comfy beds. Owners were very obliging. Had a great swimming pool. Would definitely stay here again. Even though it is main highway is it nice and quiet, being set back off road.

title: Beware! Rip Off!!
text: We booked that place many month in advance for the Fieldays and they just cancelled our booking with no reason or explanation which causes huge troubles to find alternatives for that busy period. They don't even answer the phone.

title: Not at all a B&B experience, more like expensive couch-surfing
text:
Booked this in booking.com while touring New Zealand. Pictures and description looked great and the first impression on arrival was equally good. Friendly host and clean room, BUT:
- Place felt like a model home, with the host being the house sitter
- as for being labelled "B&B": Some half empty cereal boxes as breakfast, some tea, toast and jam – all self-service
- rancid butter!! half a year past its best-before date
- Dishwasher full of dirty old stuff
- Kitchen furniture and appliances dirty to the touch, sticky
- Constant smell of wet laundry and cat pee
- Advertised as 'flatscreen tv in every room' - reality: no tv, just a bed, no bedside table, nothing. Free toiletries as advertised consist of 2 family sized Dove dispensers

Maybe our timing was weird, but I cannot see where the positive feedback on the web is coming from. Utterly overpriced for something that's more of a couch-surfing place than a B&B.

title: Wonderful Hospitality
text:
We received a warm welcome on arrival with tea and homemade cake and after settling in Raewyn took us and another couple on a brief tour of Hamilton Gardens and the surrounding areas. 
The accommodation was excellent in a lovely spacious house overlooking the river and the breakfast was freshly cooked to our requirements.
Raewyn was an excellent host, sharing her home with us and making us feel like part of the family.
Probably the best host we have ever encountered at a B&B and wished we could have stayed for more than one night.

title: Fabulous BnB
text:
We spent two nights here and it was fabulous. Beautiful location right on the river. There is a lovely patio overlooking the water for a relaxing drink in the evening. Our room was very comfortable with a spotlessly clean private bathroom. 
Raewyn our host is a fabulous cook and her cakes are delicious as well as the generous and delicious breakfasts which, importantly, include good coffee. 
Raewyn gave us excellent advice on where to visit in the area and things to see. We really enjoyed our stay here and intend to return.

title: ONE OF THE BEST
text: What a wonderful B and B. The house is stunning and right on the Waikato River with lovely river views from most rooms. Our host Raewyn could not have been more welcoming with tea and cakes on arrival, coffee in the evening after returning with our daughter who we were visiting. The breakfast was a feast you will not need any food for the rest of the day. Room was well appointed and very comfortable. Go here you will love it pity we only stayed one night but will return.

title: Highly recommended- one of the best
text:
We like staying at B&Bs to make a connection to locals. Raewyn’s home is gorgeous! She is a delight-kind and generous! She had asked cake for our arrival; recommended places to eat; drove us there/picked us up and then provided a tour of the town.
Oh and there river views from every room! 
Just go!!! You won’t be sorry

title: brilliant
text:
‘Brilliant’

➕ Raewyn is an exceptional host. She offers home baking and nothing is too much trouble. A very pleasant experience. Highly recommend for a place where you are made to feel like you are at home when you are away from home. Oh and the shower is magnificent.

title: Lovely place right on the river
text:
Raewyn was the perfect host. She made us very welcome and attended to everything we needed. We were greeted with coffee and delicious home made cakes. 
The house is very impressive and Raewyn encouraged us to make ourselves at home and use the delightful lounge areas etc. during our stay. 
The bed was very comfortable and en suite facilities good. 
It’s a short drive into Hamilton from the property and there are a number of restaurants that are again a short drive away. 
The breakfast was excellent. 

Finding the property, although straight forward in terms of street location, was a challenge as there are three properties sharing the same entrance. It may help if there was a sign (or number) on the house clearly showing which it is. We knocked on one of the other properties first.  
Whilst the house was clean, something had gone a miss in the cleaning process in our bathroom before our arrival.

title: Rate 5 plus plus plus
text:
A beautiful home enhanced by the most delightful host you could want. 

3 adults (one couple and one single) travelling together we were welcomed as family.  Our rooms were splendid, well decorated, stylish and comfortable at the same time. Everything - bed linen, floors, carpets and bathrooms were clean and well presented. Breakfast was well prepared and the choices were varied.

title: A surprisingly great gem
text:
We were a group of four who occupied the two rooms that were available.
The beds and pillows were extremely comfortable, and the house itself delightful.
Raewyn Baker, our hostess is what makes this place exceptional in everything she does.
The unexpected personal touches were most appreciated.  Breakfast was the best we had while we were on our holiday.
Whilst slightly out of the town, it is handy to know that the Casino will provide free transport to and from this stunning B & B.
Thanks
Dave, Sue, Lee-anne and Gary

title: Lovely Place to Stay
text:
We thoroughly enjoyed staying here.  Beautiful home.  We were made extremely welcome.  Our host is very creative in handcrafts and we had much to talk about.  Very handy to shops and town.  
Our room was very comfortable, clean and tidy.  We could look out to the Waikato River.  Very restful.

title: Nice stay
text: What a fantastic host! She was so kind and helpful. Always in for a chitchat. Made a lovely breakfast. We had a fantastic time. The room is great. We only thought that the head of the shower was small.

title: Lovely stay
text: Our stay was superb. We were visiting from the US. The home is beautiful modern architecture with a welcoming feel. The location is tranquil, great place to relax. The proprietor went out of her way to make us feel totally at home. The dinner and breakfast was sumptuous.  Accommodations are top notch. Highly recommend!

title: Value for $
text: Delightful hosts. A spacious, tidy unit, a great shower, and a short walk to town (10 minutes),  And we noticed a pool at the rear, so if we're back in Cambridge in the walmer months that will be a plus.

title: A regular stopover
text:
A comfortable unit with wet area shower. Good kitchen with crockery and cooking utensils all supplied. 

2 seater couch gave an optional place to sit when reading or watching tv. 

Manager is friendly and very helpful. A little dated, but still clean and comfortable.

title: Great for a family stay
text: Clean and comfortable! My daughter and I stayed in the family suite, which worked well. We both had a private sleeping room. The full kitchen was very clean, and the bathroom was clean with great water pressure in the shower. The quiet heat pump/AC was much appreciated!

title: Mixed Bag
text: Just a one night stay....overall condition was good with comfortable bed and clean decor....was a mixture ofvold and new fir example these days you dont ofen have an electric free standing range in the kitchen ....bathroom had decent shower but some of the fittings were rathet old and you could not lock the bathroom door...overall reasonable place to stay bit pricy though...think there would better options for next time

title: Would not return
text: We had a room with a king size bed and it was very comfortable. The room was clean and tidy but the kitchen oven was something from the dinosaur era (no joke) and this is not a purposely built motel its old flats that have been turned into a motel.  The shower had great pressure but oddly it had a window half way down the wall so the water goes all over the window sill and you cant open it to let steam out as then everyone would be able to see you.  They didn't supply any shampoo or conditioner only soap.  The TV had sky but is small and there is no where to sit outside to enjoy a drink or have any privacy.   We paid $170.00 for the night and I think that's terrible for the quality of this motel.

title: Great motel
text: Stayed here two nights, very close walk to town ... units very comfy, spotlessly clean and the owners very nice and most accommodating towards our show dog... would recommend to any show people .. just ask when you book 👍

title: Friendly owners, excellent facilities, very comfortable bed!
text: This was a very nice motel and we would stay here again. Owners were very friendly, the room was tidy an included a separate kitchen with stove. The bed was extremely comfortable, there was a heat pump/good air con and a pool.

title: Cheap but dayed and tired
text: Friendly hosts and very reasonable prices but the place is dated, a bit scruffy and very tired. Bed was ok, pool was a nice bonus on a hot evening. The location is certainly central and wasn’t noisy despite being on main road but coukd hear the next units tv through wall.

title: Overnight stay
text: We stayed at Cambrian motel lodge on 11th June. Can thoroughly recommend this motel. Our unit was spotlessly clean, new carpet/furniture/bedding. Although we didn't use the kitchen facilities, they were all immaculate.  The owners were cheerfully and friendly. We will definitely stay there again.

title: Incredibly convenient.
text:
We booked 1 night in this motel late in November. The staff were helpful and friendly and the bed was comfortable. The decor was  a little tired and the skirting boards hadn't been cleaned in quite a while. 
That said, it was only a short walk into town, to any of the attractions.

title: Not recommended
text: Wouldn't recommend - very tired and in need of a major makeover. Unit we were in provided microwave and means to cook a simple meal BUT no sink except for in bathroom - absolutely not OK. No milk provided. Shower curtain mouldy, shower temperature hot then cold. Pillows thin. And not super cheap.

title: A Comfortable Sleep
text: Ticked most of my must have boxes: comfy bed, shower with good water pressure and walking distance from cafes and restaurants. However over all the unit was a little tired, particularly the bathroom with threadbare bath mat and a facecloth that I wasn’t sure whether it’s purpose was for washing dishes or washing faces.

title: Modest, comfortable and central motel.
text:
The Cambrian  Motel is a great place to stay in Cambridge, very close to the CBD.
In the last 2 weeks we have stayed there twice. We went back a second time because the units were spotlessly clean, warm with very comfortable beds, and the hosts were friendly and helpful.
We certainly recommend the Cambrian Motel for your next stay in Cambridge.
Thank you.
Jan & Jamie

title: Great motel
text: Stayed here two nights, very close walk to town ... units very comfy, spotlessly clean and the owners very nice and most accommodating towards our show dog... would recommend to any show people .. just ask when you book 👍

title: overnight here was great
text: Loved the location, easy  stroll to town, clean and fine overnight stay, would stay again. Friendly service, everything you need. Nice Hot water in the shower, good prices here, might need more space if staying longer.

title: Great budget motel
text:
Great little budget motel in a fabulous location- easy 10 min walk to the centre of town for lots of cafes and restaurants.  Whilst the kitchen and bathrooms need refurbishing, they are clean and serviceable. Kitchen had fridge, freezer, microwave and oven and all the utensils you would need. The shower had good pressure and plenty of hot water. 

The carpet, curtains and furniture seem to have been replaced relatively recently so the unit looked quite fresh. Beds were comfortable. 
We had a unit at the end of the drive and had no road noise at all. Owners were very friendly and very happy to assist. If you’re after a budget option in an excellent location you can’t go past the Cambrian Lodge Motel.

title: Clean and Comfortable
text: This motel is outdated, but we knew this prior to booking. Everything was clean and tidy, including the bathroom and kitchen. There was plenty of hot water for showers, an aircon (heater), electric blankets. The rooms were made up every day. Walking distance to town.

title: Ok for 1 night
text: Stopped here visiting family who didn’t have room for us to stay. Really just needed a bed for the night. There was a clean pool and a spa (which we didn’t use) as a whole felt like we had been transported back in time to the mid 90s. Everything was from way back when but functional and in good condition

title: Clean comfortable walking distance to shops and restaurants.
text:
We stayed one night in a two bed room unit number 4.
Clean,kitchen well appointed with full stove,fridge freezer plenty of cutlery and crockery.
Owners very friendly and helpful.
Has a swimming pool.
Easy walk to town to shops,supermarket and restaurants.
Quiet if you have a unit at the back.

title: I'm not sure how this got a rating of 4.0?
text:
Ok, well maybe my expectations are high as I do travel a lot, but this motel didnt excite me. It wasnt cheap so i expected a normal motel setup. What i got was a bathroom with a shower and toilet, no sink. I had to shave in the kitchen sink? Heating was average, lucky i like flat pillows because these were so old they were, threadbare towels and bed coverings...
It wasnt the end of the world, but for the price it should have been much better

title: Good in a pinch
text: We stayed one night at the Cambrian in a twin room. Price was very reasonable and we were grateful to the owner for accepting our late booking quite late at night. Clean and comfortable. My only issue was a broken window lock in the kids room which meant the window was slightly open all night. Not very secure. Otherwise would have been 4 stars.

title: Basic, but comfortable and very clean, nicely located.
text: We had a room looking over the garden in front. Parking was a bit short, but adequate. The room was comfortable and very clean, with everything we needed for a couple of nights. Welcome was friendly, and service throughout stay was quick and cheerful. Only hiccup was the coffee plunger, as the plunger was too loose and did not compress the grounds (and I forgot to mention to the owner). Otherwise, we would happily stay again. Plenty of local restaurants and takeaways, and an easy walk into the town centre.

title: Very Central
text: A very easy place to find, nice and flat for Wheelchairs with good concrete driveway. Set back from the main road with nice shrubs & trees, so no road noise. Good kitchen, good kitchen facilities,  very comfortable bed. Good shower. A little more than what we would normally pay, but well worth it.

title: good motel but check the fridge
text:
When one arrives at a motel in New Zealand it is a custom to provide some milk, presumably for a cup of tea or coffee

It is a quaint custom which is appreciated. I hope it remains

Arriving at this motel the quite friendly lady offered me the milk and proceeded to open the unit and place the milk in the fridge. When she departed I settled in and put a lot of other articles, drinks, butter etc in the fridge. Some hours later when I opened the fridge to retrieve the items, I realised it was not on !!!  Obviously this was a cost cutting measure. 

Apart from that, the motel was adequate for the cost. The couple were quite friendly and nice. The motel is clean and within walking distance of amenities 

Cambridge is a lovely town, certainly one of the prettiest in New Zealand

title: Weekend in Cambridge
text:
We have stayed here before and have always been satisfied. Receive a friendly welcome and have a clean and tidy room. 
Not the most modern motel but satisfying and verr handy to town.One day the Avocados might be ripe.

title: Great value for money, friendly staff
text: Whilst this might not be the poshest place in town, this is a really great little motel. The welcome was friendly and the lady was very helpful. The room was clean, well equipped with aircon and sky tv, a good kitchen and comfortable bed. I slept very well indeed and would definitely  reccommend this motel when in Cambridge

title: Friendly owners, clean & comfortable
text: Yes, it possibly needs a little updating, but for the price, this was a great motel. We stayed for 5 nights. Owners were very friendly & helpful & went out of their way to make us comfortable. Comfy bed, large room, full kitchen & decent shower. Well located a few minutes walk from town & a selection of bars & restaurants. Would stay again.

title: clean and comfortable
text:
The rooms are  spacious and clean, with reasonable rates.
A flat easy 5 minute walk  to town.
Overall  good value for money-ideal for families-with some adjoining rooms available.
found the manager to be very helpful,in arranging a last minute room change for me due to changing requirements.

title: Value for money
text:
Even though the unit was basic, the rooms were clean and quiet. 
Staff were friendly and accommodating to my needs as I needed a disability access room. Free WiFi and Sky tv were a bonus. Would happily stay again.

title: Sufficient
text:
Great facilities including a pool however there was a bit of mould in the bathroom and awkward stain on the ground under the shower head. 
Price seemed fair for the size and availability but I'd suggest wearing jandals in the shower.

title: Visited before
text: I booked two rooms while on a road trip. I had stayed a few years ago and was very happy. The rooms were lovely and clean, although a little 'tired'. The hosts were great and offered transport to and from a local restaurant. In the end we had friends drive us, but 10 out of 10 for the offer. We were also given the rooms at a discount, another 10. A top class restaurant is 200 metres away - fantastic. I would recommend this as a stop.

title: Very Terrible
text: The bathrooms appear to not been cleaned. There was smudge on the bed cover, the bathroom floors have not been cleaned, there were dirt on the freezer. It appears that they are not cleaning after a guest leaves and just arranges the pillows and bed. Very outdated too

title: All you need
text: Stayed her for one night  -an unexpected stay in Cambridge. All we needed -clean, good beds, telly with heaps of options, Handy to town. Just wish some of these motels would get on to the gardens. To me that first appearance is so important,

title: New baby
text: 4 of our family stayed at Cambrian Lodge while visiting  Cambridge. After a warm welcome the motel was warm,clean and well appointed. With sky tv and free internet at A reasonable cost it was a very pleasant stay.

title: So good to find
text: I was loking for a motel in a town I had not expected to be in that night. A man in a pub ( there is always one) suggested the Cambrian Lodge. What a pleasant surprise I had! Exceptionally clean and tidy,well above the norm at the price. Swimming pool OK, spa more than OK. Thank you Cambrian Lodge, thank you man in the pub.

title: Overnight stopover
text: The room itself was basic and clean. It had everythng we needed bed, shower and heatpump. However the owners were not very friendly, we were travelling as a group and both had seperate bookings the others recieved a phone as were running late but I recieved nothng and on arrival was told we had no booking (a bit of a worry at 9:30pm) then handed key and told room was round the corner, not very helpful as dark and owner then proceeded to take friends to their room. The service was not there :-(

title: Clean and tidy motel
text:
I took 10 ladies here for the night. Motel was extremely clean and comfortable.
Was very quiet, no road noise.
Herman was very helpful with booking in my ladies and giving me a very good price.
Would recommend

title: Small clean quiet
text: Stayed here for one night. Small clean slightly dated room. It's got all you need for an overnight stay. Easy walk into town . Only issue it need thicker curtains as it is very light in the room. I will stay again.

title: Good comfortable clean accommodation
text: This is the second time I've stayed here and co-incidentally stayed in the same room as last time.  The motel is clean and warm, if a little dated.  The front office service was fine, my reservation was all ready to go.  Perfect for my needs, happy to stay again.

title: Quiet,convinient and inexpensive motel
text:
I agree with previous reviewers that this not especially modern but its been updated and all in good order.
The owners were friendly and helpful. The motel is close to town. Plenty of off road parking.

title: One night stay for BMX
text: Tidy wee motel. The owner is so accommodating, makes us feel at home. Nice room. Spa pool is a hit with my daughter. For its age, its holding up well. Plenty of parks. Close to town. Would totally recommend!

title: Great motel, fabulous owners but a little tired and needs a spruce up
text:
I have stayed here twice now and the owners really go out of their way to be helpful.  The rooms are ok in size and I love the little kitchens that some of them have.  So great to have a real oven to use!  The oven would be even better if there were some oven trays inside them to stop food falling onto the elements.
However, the paint needs a refresh as do the beds.  The beds are uncomfortable and need to be replaced.
The wifi is great and worked really well.  The guest laundry is also very handy and has everything you need.  I would stay here again but hope they do give it a refresh but keep the kitchen and ovens.

title: Spotless, warm, good value
text: This is not especially modern, but makes up for that with spotlessness, nice quality bedding and towels, electric blankets, heat pump, and wi-fi. The road noise wasn't  bad by nightfall despite the busy road. It was a cold winter's day and the room warmed up very quickly. Friendly proprietors.

title: Value for money
text: Clean and comfortable. Very quiet, and perfect for an overnight stay. The unit was very roomy with a separate kitchen and bathroom. Bed was very comfortable too! Within walking distance of town where there were plenty of restaurants and good shopping.

title: Large unit with plenty of room
text: This motel is an older one that has been tastefully interior renovated. The unit we had was large and plenty of space for everything.  Most amenities' are catered for and the hosts are friendly - good location and easy to find. There is one carpark per unit and the carpark is a little tight if you had a larger vehicle.

title: A bit dated but good place to stay
text: This motel is conveniently located within a short walk of the Main Street on Cambridge. We had a front room but any traffic noise didn't worry us. The bed was comfortable but only a fan and no air con for hot nights. The motel offers a guest laundry. We didn't use the pool area. The owners were very friendly and helpful with suggestions of local restaurants.

title: Not bad
text:
This motel looked quite nice. We were given a front room. Very comfortable except for the road noise from being in the front of the motel.
Room was good and had everything we needed. NZ $110.00. Very reasonably priced.

title: Dear owners: Don't update! Just keep it clean.
text: This little motel is a flash back to US roadside motels along Historic Route 66 for us. The fixtures, service and general feeling are indicative of a small family run establishment and these places are hard to find. We'd stay here again over a chain motel with brand new everything. Hooks within reach of the shower, the sliding shower door, the original stainless kitchenette, the bathroom sinktop all contributed to the atmosphere, and must not be updated. Competing with a brand new chain will be impossible, keep the old school and keep it spotless and this little motel will be full more often than not. Loved it.

title: You won't be disappointed
text: Motel is very clean, the hosts are very amenable and the pool facility is excellent. T.v. Has 50 channels and their high speed wifi (logging on is easy with the information in the room. The only 'downer' as such is the Om could do with a makeover but if you can live with that, well worth the money. Recommended stay.

title: Uncomfortable and Not Recommended
text: The room (No. 10) was adequate.  There was no hand basin in the shower/toilet although there was enough space for one.  The only water source was a hand basin (not a sink) in the kitchen area where we were expected to wash dishes as well as washing hands and cleaning teeth.  The bed was the hardest we have ever tried to sleep on. The accommodation was booked on line by our daughter-in-law (Michelle Tappin) and when I asked, after the first night, what the tariff was I was told $110.00 but we were charged $360.00 for three nights and the manager said that was because the on line booking charge was $10.00 per night.  The hair-dryer had a loose wire and would only work if held a certain way.  On the positive side, the manageress was very helpful and went the extra mile

title: Good place to stay
text: Booked in for 3 nights but had to extend our stay so the staff were really accommodating and finding us another room so we could stay on even though they were fairly full.  Good location - about 5-6min walk to town and restaurants.  Rooms are clean and spacious with all the basics that you need.  Would definitely stay here again.

title: Great value
text:
We stayed in Unit 1 for 1 night. This had a kitchen, bathroom and separate bedroom which we didn't use.  The shower was amazing, and kitchen had a full oven.
