It is an older style motel and some of the walls were a bit rough but as a whole it was tidy and comfortable.
The owners were very friendly and helpful and we really enjoyed our stay.

title: Great place to stay!!
text: Had a great stay at the Cambrian.  Was well set up with beds and lovely linen, very nice people and great facilities.  Had a lot of added extras such as free wifi and a wide range of television channels to watch and reasonably priced washing and drying facilities! Had an excellent stay here would definitely recommend!

title: Great Accomodation
text: Great little place with very welcoming owners. The establishment was exceptionally clean as was the bed linen. The motel was close to the main shopping centre and eateries. Would definitely recommend staying here. Parking is no problem as each unit has a car space at your door.

title: 'Disabled' Unit
text:
The exterior and grounds are tidy and within easy walking distance of Cambridge.
We pre-booked 3 nights in the unit for those with disabilities. Space for manoeuvring the wheelchair was tight. The bed was comfortable.The washbasin in the shower-room is positioned too high up the wall for ease of access from the wheelchair. The standard of housekeeping let them down. A visit from "The Hotel Inspector" from the TV series would be beneficial.

title: Average :-/
text:
We stayed 2 nights in a unit towards the back. Kitchen & bathroom was clean & simple. About here it will be easier to list the negatives:
* Insulation tape on the handle of slotted spoon * Lack of sugar/salt/pepper sachets & not replenished * x1 small milk for 2days stay? * Lack of hangers * Cockroach in b/room * No phone in room * 70's headboard with carpet on the back as it touches the wall * bed looked new but was cheap & hard * flat sheet on mattress & not a fitted sheet * Hideous industrial public toilet style toilet paper * lack of space on vanity - needs a small shelf below mirror * old soap dispenser hanging off wall & was empty.......

Doubt that we will be returning customers !

title: Value for money
text:
We needed a place to stay for one night and we choose the Cambrian as the lawns and gardens were tidy and well-cared for.  Having experienced a bad nights sleep the previous night in Hamilton we chose a unit at the end of the driveway away from the road.  The unit had everything we needed including a hot high-pressure shower.

We were glad they have the 50+ Sky Guest Select so we didn't have to miss any more of our favourite programmes while on holiday.  We also appreciated the free Wi-Fi.  We will stay here again.

title: Good, clean, value for money
text: Good size room, comfortable bed, well appointed and very pleasant staff. No table to sit at to have breakfast and no sink in the kitchenette, But overall we had a very enjoyable stay and it was good value for money.

title: Clean and comfortable
text:
We stayed at Cambrian for 2 nights.
We had booked online and after an initial mix up at check in (our rooms were not configured as we had requested) we were shown to our rooms.
This aside, the rooms were very spacious and clean. Showers were great and even though they are on the main road, there was little road noise.

title: Older style basic motel
text: but very friendly service from the owners. Unit 8 where I stayed is a small studio with a couple of office-type chairs, no table and no cooking facilities other than a microwave. There is no sink in the kitchen and you would need to use the bathroom sink for any dishes. The bathroom sink has separate taps and no mixer which is inconvenient.  The shower was modern but the water pressure only very average (but this is not unusual in the cheaper motels). Shampoo and soap are budget quality, but again this is what one would expect from a lower priced motel. The highlight - and the most important aspect for me - was the very comfortable bed with good quality duvet and covers.  The road noise was not too excessive for a Saturday night. I would recommend this hotel for the budget-conscious traveller who does not intend to do any cooking and who wants to be within walking distance of Cambridge cafés and restaurants.

title: Average
text: We stayed for two nights in a unit towards the back of the complex so although we heard the road noise wasn't too bad except when trucks came by. With the express way being built by passing the motel the road noise will not be a problem to the same extent. The separate kitchen and bathroom were spacious. We felt the unit was dated and could do with a make over. The main room had a queen sized bed with a hard mattress and a single bed ,an armchair, two seater couch and lounge table all in one room which left only enough room for one bed side table. The room was serviced daily with clean towels and tea towels.

title: One of the better
text:
This motel was great, very neat and spotlessly clean with pretty gardens and very friendly hosts.  I made an error with my booking and they were very helpful and forgiving.  The motel is very attractive and close to everything, easy to find, quiet and comfortable.  The bathroom was simple but spacious and private.  We had one queen bed and a single as it was just a one transit night with my parents, the lounge/sleeping area was spacious, tv and furniture modern and comfy.  
I can definitely recommend it.

title: lovely people, nice and clean, good value
text: After the disaster of the Riverside in Cambridge, we nearly went home. Thank goodness we found this lovely motel, such warm friendly people, clean and excellent family size rooms. It changed our view of Cambridge accomadation. We highly recommend, you won't go wrong staying here, it was good value.

title: Worth a Stay
text:
Like most accommodation in New Zealand this is expensive by European standards.  However, when comparing others in Cambridge it is well worth it.
The room is well laid out but lacked real cooking facilities.  We knew this when we booked so were not disappointed.  We still managed scranbled eggs and bacon and toast for breakfast.
The decor is starting to show its age and the black mould in the bathroom was disappointing.  The bed was absolutely supurb abd I would rate it as one of the best that I have slept on in any accommodation that I have been in.
The heater, needed in any Waikato winter, was very effective.  I am not sure that the electric blanket worked and did forget to mention that when I checked out.
The TV tuning was not easy and it took awhile before mastering this and finding the channel that I wanted.
I must say that the hosts were real friendly.  I almost felt that they were long lost friends.  I have always said that the places I remember are those where I have found the hosts friendly.  Well done.
I would stay here again.

title: Basic but with friendly service and very clean
text: We have just returned from New Zealand where we spent a couple of nights at the Cambrian whilst we visited the local area, including Hobbiton. We had a side room which had separate bathroom and kitchen facilities with all the fittings we needed for this short stay. The lounge/bedroom was of a reasonable size. The owners were very friendly and helpful. The rooms were serviced daily with fresh towels and tea towels provided. We felt that this was good value for money. It is good, basic, and no frills - but with everything we needed to make us comfy and with a great Kiwi welcome.

title: Looks OK on the outside but...blackmail
text: This place is furnished from the charity house.  Continental quilt ragged, head board from the 70's.  No sink to wash dishes - you had to do it in the bathroom sink where in the cupboard was the dish washing liquid - how hygienic is that.  Fridge in the bedroom noisy.  Shower curtain mouldy at the seams, towels ragged.  But worst of all the hot water cylinder is so small you can't have two showers and when one is standing covered in soap and the water runs cold it makes you mad.  Owners offered a refund but only if we would not make a trip advisor statement.  Real good blackmail. They would only give us a cheque and that is no good to a person leaving the country.  They did not know how to refund us on our credit card. We tried to have them cancel the credit card charge but they would not.  Best you go to a Qualmark facility.
hotel_response:
Yes this couple did have a very temporary unforseen issue with the hot water. 
I apologized and explained to them that this would be very temporary.
When they checked out she was very angry and said she was going to put a review on Tripadvisor. She was not happy with other aspects either.
At that stage i did not want them to leave unhappy so I offered a refund.
I questioned her about what else she was now unhappy about.
Her criticisms were so unfair that i withdrew the offer of a refund.
The unit is well appointed and has a new bathroom,new vinyl,new carpet new bedding,and the bed is only three years old.
No mould in the curtain,- it is a lead cord in the seam to weight it.
By there own admission they tried to get the credit card charge cancelled but were refused.
she did what she said she would ,No blackmail from  us

title: Handy location with nice tree/ garden at front.
text:
Dissapointed with our dated  front Studio which had ensuite handbasin in bedroom/ eating area rather than in ensuite. No sink. No power point for fitted Electric blanket but owner happily provided 2 extension leads. Owner couple very friendly & obliging. Location good & Huge tree among gardens dominating front most effectively. Consider ours  a basic motel room with bonus of a microwave , minimum cutlery etc ,not really kitchenette style.
In fairness, Owner said other Studios at side of building had proper kitchen facilities so ask for them if wishing to cook.

title: Clean but basic
text:
Having rejected two motels in Cambridge due to poor rooms and high prices chose Cambrian because of TripAdvisor rating. 

Owner Diane was lovely, room was immaculate but typical of older NZ motels with basic fittings and no real design. 

Close to main road with some road noise but not too bad. 

All motels in Cambridge seemed expensive to us with much better deals up the road in Hamilton. But if you must stay in Cambridge then the Cambrian is probably the best.

title: nice and friendly
text: nice location not to far to walk to town, nice and cozy room , lovely people to deal with on phone and in person, will be back to stay again thank you, sharon.

title: Very clean, nice location, better than their website suggests
text:
This motel was excellent - far better than we thought it would be from their website.  It had an unheated outdoor swimming pool, indoor hot-tub, and *free* internet which is always a bonus.

The hosts were really friendly, and when they saw we got in the pool they came and bought us towels. The room was spotless and clean, and had a cooker, microwave, and fridge freezer.  There was a modern flat screen TV with Sky.

We used this hotel when visiting the Hobbiton film set which is nearby.  The motel is on the main road into Cambridge, but is set back from the road so was very quiet.

title: Lovely clean and cozy
text:
Had just returned from Thailand and was heading home to the Hawkes Bay. Had to stop in Cambridge over night, the weather was cold and really raining hard.
The owners of the motel were warm and welcoming. The rooms were older but had been done up and were very very clean and cozy.

Great place with a reasonable price to stay at if you are passing through Cambridge.

We will stay again, many thanks

title: Worst of all.
text: On our last year's trip to Hamilton, we booked the basic category room here and we were shocked to see the terrible situation of this motel. By far the worst I have stayed in. I guess now either the management has changed or it has been shut down but just wanted to share my past experience.

title: The Long Acre....Commercial Hotel
text: Had lunch in the new revamped Commercial Hotel with a group last week.  They have done a great job of the décor but need to bring their food and service standards up to scratch.  The waitresses need to look as though they care, the one taking our orders took most of our orders went away and didn't come back consequently most of us had our food and had finished before the rest got theirs.  The chicken burger I had was definitely not the best Ive had.  For the prices they charge I expect better quality.

title: Worth the price!
text:
Couldnt ask for much better for $85.00 . Location is really good .Toilet wasnt that clean. The guy at reception  rather the manager was very helpful- very good service from him.
I would def recommend others.

title: Executive Twin Suite with Ensuite?
text: Clean room. Clean, but VERY small bathroom.Door into shower bangs onto basin when opened.Step up to shower is high with no handle/rail to hold on to, extra dangerous when floor is wet. No where to hang wet towels. Not room enough to stand at basin or dress / undress/ dry off after shower.Micro oven at floor level in a cupboard, was not clean. Fridge in clothes cupboard. Only one chair, one suitcase rack and one bedsidetable.No safe for valuables. Room is too small for two adults, seems like single room with added extra bed. Very noisy all night, with lots of loud voices and slamming of doors.There is no reception as it is under renovation as most of the hotel is. Telephones are not in working order (beg. of Feb. 2012).No way of communicating with our home country.Guestbook says settle on night before, if leaving early in morning. We had to pay on arrival for the four nights we had booked for. Our booking was done aprox. five months prior to our stay.The cleaning-lady was very nice and did her best to help us. In-house Bar and lounge on hotel brochure are non excistant. To top it all: We found, by accident, that the key to our room also fits lock on the next room beside ours! We wondered how many keys fitted "our" door!

title: Not a place to stay at peak prices!
text:
Firstly, I should note that we stayed in a double en-suite room during the Hamilton 400.  I think the standard price is around $100 per night, but I paid $175 per night being the only place with a vacancy (booked 3 months ahead of time). 

Service was terrible. The only words spoken were "$575", other than that, just a few grunts and sighs. 

Cleanliness obviously not a high priority. As long as it looks good at a glance, then it seems to do. The pillow cases had unidentifiable stains (one could have been chocolate or blood).  The towels had small stains and smelt real strong of cigarette smoke. As for the bedspreads, I highly doubt these get washed on a regular basis. Double bed that was like a trampoline.

En-suite was kinda new but very small. Couldn't swing a cat around in there, thats for sure. The shower was affected by anyone running water, so it went from ice cold to very hot constantly. I didn't experience a nice temperature at all. 

It had what they called a kitchenette, but all it consisted of was a kettle, cups, bowls, tea and coffee. No basin. Fridge was in the wardrobe. 

Noisy. Was kept awake by hearing all the conversations in the reception area, or woken up by all the slamming doors (all the doors need to be planed). 

I would not recommend this place at all. Even at the lower price of about $100, for an extra $20 - $30, someone could stay in a really nice clean hotel with all the mod cons, and great service.

title: Outstanding Staff
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 Stars
If you're travelling from Sydney to New Zealand, do yourself a favour and skip the stress of Auckland traffic. Fly direct with Jetstar Australia and New Zealand into Hamilton and start your holiday the relaxing way.
As a solo traveller, my stay at JetPark Hotel Hamilton Airport from 27th–29th June 2026 was outstanding. The hotel was immaculate, peaceful and surrounded by beautiful countryside — so quiet that you would never believe you were beside an airport. The location couldn't be better, with the airport terminal and car hire facilities just steps away.
A huge bonus is the hotel's private parking, meaning guests avoid costly airport parking fees altogether.
The reception team delivered some of the warmest hospitality I have experienced, offering a genuinely friendly welcome along with helpful information about the gym, sauna, restaurant and local attractions. The housekeeping team were equally wonderful, and the restaurant served delicious meals that completed the experience perfectly.
Hamilton deserves far more recognition as an international gateway to New Zealand. It provides easy access to the world-famous hot springs, spas and geothermal attractions of Rotorua, the stunning lakes and scenery of Taupō, and even Hawke's Bay is only a comfortable three-hour drive away — barely a road trip by Australian standards.
What stood out most was the incredible hospitality. In a world where genuine customer service can be hard to find, every staff member delivered a truly memorable experience with warmth, professionalism and kindness. As a solo traveller, this level of care and friendliness made all the difference and made me feel genuinely welcome throughout my stay.
This was my second trip to Hamilton in just two weeks, and each visit has only reinforced how enjoyable and convenient travelling through Hamilton can be. I'll definitely be returning later this year for another long weekend and look forward to staying again.
Hamilton is one of New Zealand's best kept secrets and the perfect gateway to explore the North Island. I highly recommend travellers choose Hamilton for a smoother, quieter and more enjoyable start to their New Zealand adventure.
— Melodie Prakash 27th–29th June 2026

We pride ourselves on providing genuine Kiwi hospitality, and your kind words about the warmth, professionalism, and care shown by our staff will be shared with the entire team. They have been thrilled to know they made such a positive impact on your stay.

We're also pleased you enjoyed our peaceful location, comfortable facilities, and the convenience of travelling through Hamilton Airport. Your enthusiasm for Hamilton as a gateway to exploring the North Island is wonderful to read, and we couldn't agree more that it's a fantastic alternative to the busier airports.

Thank you for choosing to stay with us again and for recommending both our hotel and Hamilton so highly. We look forward to welcoming you back later this year for another relaxing long weekend.

Warm regards,
Ashlyn Nair
Guest Services Manager

title: Great place to stay, quiet, clean and convenient
text:
Awesome place and convenient to the airport and town. Hanbi on reception is fantastic and so welcoming.
The rooms are very clean and peaceful. I have stayed here before but forgot to post a review. Coming here again reminded me that Jetpark Hamilton is an excellent place to stay in the Hamilton area.

title: Good full service room including breakfast daily.
text: the twin room with 2 double beds in it is sizeable, comfortable and has everything you need for your stay. We were on the airport side and heard not a single peep the whole time we stayed (sound proofed rooms) from either airport, cars or neighbouring rooms it was really pleasantly quiet the whole time. The pool was amazing! not heated but had a cool sitting area, sauna, coloured lights in the pool etc. Our stay included a beautiful cooked buffet breakfast each morning which was really nice. great service from everyone we encountered, always helpful and going the extra mile. The only comment we had to make to move it to a 5 star, was the room felt damp in the mornings and evenings (even with leaving windows open etc) so it needs a bit better ventilation, and also some bug control. Lots of dead insects on the bathroom floor each day. Nothing we couldn't handle. Over all we loved our stay and would happily recommend. :)
hotel_response:

Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed review of your stay with us.

We're delighted to hear you enjoyed your spacious and comfortable room, our peaceful location, the pool and sauna facilities, and our cooked buffet breakfast. Thank you again for your recommendation. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back for an even better stay in the future.

title: Amazing stay
text: Our stay was amazing, the receptionist was so nice and helpful. Super grateful for the chefs working after hours so we got some food after late arrival and waitress team was lovely.
hotel_response:
Kia Ora,

Thank you for your wonderful review!

We're so pleased to hear you had an amazing stay with us. It's lovely to know our reception team made you feel so welcome, and that our chefs were able to prepare a meal for you after your late arrival. We're also delighted that our restaurant team looked after you so well.

Your kind words mean a great deal to our team, and we'll be sure to share your feedback with everyone involved.

We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back to JetPark Hamilton Airport Hotel again soon.

Warm regards,

Guest Services Manager

title: Great access to airport.
text: Great room, airport is quiet at night and room was semi-fancy, bed was comfortable.  Room was very nice, clean and well stocked. 2 minute walk to airport check-in.  If you book through JetPark, you might get discount on parking, they advertise park for free, but I booked through Expedia and was given 20% discount on Hamilton Airport Parking

title: Amazing - Can’t Fault!
text:
Amazing! Can’t fault anything. Rooms have recently been refurbished and are very clean and spacious. Simple but sufficient. 
We even had a spa bath in our superior king room. 
Staff were first class! Customer service wonderful! Propeller restaurant is an absolute must - beautifully designed and modern and our meal was better than some meals I’ve had in five star restaurants. Would highly recommend a stay here. Thanks so much.
hotel_response:
Kia Ora kiwibok25,

We sincerely appreciate your business and your valuable feedback. Your satisfaction is what drives us, and we can’t wait to welcome you back for another outstanding experience! Thank you for making us a part of your journey.

Warm regards,
Ashlyn Nair
Guest Services Manager

title: Good for a night
text: When needing a hotel close to Hamilton airport this is a great option. We arrived late and left early but staff were great, rooms were clean and beds comfortable, cannot ask for much more for a quick overnight stay. Free parking is a benefit, especially when close to an airport

title: Wonderful value for money
text: I was extremely impressed with the value for money at this hotel. The rooms are spacious and comfortable. It is environmentally conscious, with water in carafes, not disposable bottles, and bathroom products in large refillable bottles. The shampoo etc is an NZ brand (I cannot recall the brand) and is of high quality. We brought our dog, and while the dog care package was somewhat expensive at $65 it was good with a bed, blanket, towel for walking in the rain, treats, a small jar of biscuits, dog bowls and a toy our fur baby loved. The staff were lovely. We have stayed there twice and would stay again. We also thoroughly enjoyed food and service at the Propeller restaurant.

title: Great Coffee by the Barista!!
text: My family stayed at the Jetpark hotel after our NZ cruise.  We picked this hotel because it was close to the airport and had shuttle service.  The hotel and staff were very nice and helpful, but the best thing of all was the coffee we had from the barista, Igor.  It was the best coffee we had since the beginning of our trip.  We would stay here again!

title: Great Customer service, amazing hotel
text:
Was greeted by the young amazing receptionist, who went above and beyond to accommodate me my wife an 2 nephews, who stay for the 1 night. The Room was perfect for us..

Really great facilities, pool laundry area. We didn't really have time to use the other facilities.We had dinner in the Restaurant, food was delicious.

title: Perfect
text: What a perfect motel. Beautifully clean and really great facilities. The room was enormous with a well stoked tea, coffee,  biscuit station. The on site restaurant was wonderful. It also has a lovely pool, tennis court and basketball hoop- perfect for the kids. Thanks Jetpark for a wonderful stay.

title: A Great Experience
text:
I was here overnight and I have to say the service was just brilliant.
We arrived late and the restaurant had closed and there is no room service here. I was starving. The beautiful woman on the front desk checked in with the chef who was leaving and they heated me up a Lamb Shank. OMG - it was so good and well eaten I can assure you. Secondly, the bathroom had been revamped and was really nice so I expect there's a refurbishment plan underway?

text: When I first entered the room it was dim and warmed up. The room looked clean. Kitchen is quite dated. The bed was quite soft but I slept okay. The one thing that irked about was the stained and worn sofa bed in the room. I felt uncomfortable sitting on it. The shower head is very low and I had to stoop down to wash my hair. Reception is very polite. I can't say I like to stay there again.

title: Short no stay
text: Sorry to say that we paid for the night at this motel but did not stay. It is a very tired motel and the room which we were directed to secondly smelt as someone had been smoking in it. The advertising is somewhat quite different to what lies behind the facade. One would hope that there is an upgrade for this motel as it was simply not up to our standards.

title: Couple in studio unit for 2 nights to accommodate husband attending a Wintec course.
text:
Strange mix of dated and tired decor with some modern revamped facilities.  It was
clean with a comfortable bed. There is a modern heat pump and decent dining table with superior chairs. Sky TV and free WI-FI.  The en-suite was tiled and modern but with the shower shelf loose and useless. The vanity unit drawer was broken. The hot water temperature was set dangerously high with danger of serious scalding. 
Living area lighting abysmal - kitchenette area very dark.  Power points scarce and one broken, but a power-bank was located in the wardrobe under spare pillows.  With no security stays on windows, night time ventilation was zero.
This unit needs some serious repair and redecoration. There was a defunct cook-top under a boxed frame but there was an old portable one in a kitchen cupboard.
A pleasing outlook over the lawn and very pleasant staff.

title: Family booking
text: The staff were friendly and helpful. The unit was exceptionally clean and tidy. The living area was spacious. Beds were small, couch pull out bed was dilapidated. Place was central and looked out onto a park.

title: Great Motel
text:
We stayed in the family two bedroom apartment. It was a wild eclectic mix of brand new and classic motor inn circa 1970.  The added fun element was that any one swimming in the pool could look directly into the apartment (so close the curtains!). The stand out was the bathrooms - brand new and perfectly appointed. Best shower throughout rural NZ! The apartment was huge, and had a massive kitchen (but its age did not inspire any cooking!). I thoroughly appreciated the plunger coffee!!

The bedrooms were spacious and the beds a wee tired. But each room had AC available and were a quiet retreat.

title: Comfortable stay, a pleasant surprise
text:
We stayed at a standard studio next to the lawn, which was spacious and well-equipped. The building itself is old but as other guests noted it seems to be being revamped. The bathroom was practically brand new and fully tiled - very clean and modern. The heat pump (which we used for air con) and large TVs were also very new. Plus free wifi! These are what matter to me the most when I’m away from home. The kitchen and bed (the true king size) seemed to be dated but very clean nonetheless. The room provided us a comfortable, refreshing stay between hiking at Hakarimata and cycling along the new Te Awa cycleway. We were pleasantly surprised.
There was ample space for off-street parking, which seemed pretty secure (cctv monitored). They also had a pool and laundry but we didn’t use them so can’t comment.

title: Excellent
text:
I have stayed here a few times now and have always been impressed!
Rooms have always been clean and spacious - even the economy rooms. They have also being upgraded so the bathrooms are lovely and new.
Staff are super friendly and helpful. No restaurant on site but there are plenty of places to eat nearby.
Already booked for the next trip.

title: Average
text: Lovely big room, which appeared clean, but both the room and bed smelt bad and the linen and pillows were rather grimmie.  I had also booked a room on the park side (on a special rate) but was not given the room I booked, I guess they had someone paying more, so got bumped into a lesser room. I would not recommend

title: Lovely staff but dated decor
text: Maybe this hotel has recently changed hands and is in the process of being renovated???  Still has a little way to go ....  Our room was warm (heat pump installed) and had a nice view across a park, plus we had free Wi-Fi (yay).  The beds were OK (after one of them had to be "repaired" before we could even use it), but the decor was old (cracked tiles in the kitchen etc).  However the bathroom was lovely - obviously new shower, basin and toilet (with soft close lid) all tiled with new fan and lights.  Pity the towels were threadbare, thin and scratchy.  The staff were friendly and helpful though, and we enjoyed our stay (which was short).

title: Stopover in hamilton
text:
Really, really disappointing. 
For a non smoking place - our room absolutely stunk of stale cigarettes. Right down to the linen including the towels. 
Had to spray the room with perfume to stomach the smell. 
Even questioned whether the bed was freshly made - crumpled sheets were not a good look. 
And the loud banging music in the middle of the night which made the bed and walls vibrate was exceptionally awful. 
We have never, and I mean never, stayed in such an awful place. 
Would not recommend this to anyone. 
If there was a way I could put nothing in the ratings circles - I would have done that. 
Our clothes still smell - very unhappy.

title: Affordable, comfortable and clean
text: Friendly and helpful reception staff, very comfortable, clean room with comfortable king size bed. Liked the "green space" outlook of my room. Good kitchen and other facilities including free Wi Fi. Shower was modern and top class. A reasonably priced continental breakfast delivered at requested time. Roomy parking. Would happily stay there again.

title: Just average motel
text:
The room is pretty average. I was a bit disappointed as the king bed was 2 single bed put together - so annoying when sleeping.
Toilet seat broken. Unsure if extractor fan in the toilet bathroom worked - it was smelly

title: A bit tired
text: My room was quite dated and kitchen facilities not what they could have been.  The bathroom was tired and not quite as clean as it could have been.  The carpet in the hallway wasnt the best and pool area needs a real clean up.  Staff were friendly but explanation  on room locality and parking wasnt the best.

title: Okay for a short night
text: We didn't like this place that much, pretty dated and unstylish. Good kitchen and wifi though. We had an early checkout so no big deal. If you get a good price it's fine for just a night. Guess there is better places to choose if you book more in advance

title: Very dated and not good value for money.
text: We had the 2 bedroom unit by the pool. It was very dated. The couch was very uncomfortable with a board in the middle. The decor, flower arrangement and pictures on the walls were depressing. The sheets weren't crispy but very creased. It didn't have a nice feel and if you drew the curtains you could see what people were doing in the pool. The bathroom had been renovated and had new cabinet, shower and floor but no where to hand your clothes or towel. Toilet was so small difficult to squeeze in and shut the door. Staff very warm and friendly and helpful. I wouldn't stay here again sorry.

title: budget motel
text: lady at reception was very friendly, place a little dated, good value for money, large rooms, just needs a revamp, sky tv, pool was not my cup of tea, great place for $130 per night, you get what you pay for

title: Disappointed
text: Was extremely disappointed in this Motel. It was a very depressing room with all brown colours in the room. You need to put some bright colours in your rooms to brighten them up. Sheets on the beds weren't crispy white, but were dirty looking white and I hated getting into the bed as it didn't seem clean. Stove cook top and kitchenette were horrible too. We were there for 3 nights and I couldn't wait to get out. Different find the receptionist on when we arrived all that pleasant. Would never return.

title: Budget motel
text:
Cheap as chips but clean. Bed was reasonably comfy. Reception staff were fabulous. Very friendly and helpful.

Walls and floors are thin. We could hear someone clomping around in high heels on the floor above and every time they went to the toilet and flushed it was so loud like it was in our room. Glad I took earplugs.

Does this motel allow dogs???? Cause someone had one barking in their room. 

Bathroom sink was cracked and horrible. Shower was designed for short people. Towels a little threadbare. 

Came back after dinner to no space in the carpark.  Maybe it’s time to paint some lines on the ground. 

It was cheap... just somewhere to stop for a night.

title: Pleasant place to stay
text:
A very pleasant and convenient place to stay in Hamilton. The unit included 2 hot plates, so was able to cook basic meals 
I enjoyed the wide range of tv channels, and the easily accessible wifi.
The house keeping ladies do a great job.
The only problem I found was the step into the shower. It is quite high.

title: Was it me?
text: Renee, Upon arrival I had paid $520 via mastercard for two nights accomodation in room 6.  After I had paid in full you asked me for a bond of $100.  That caught me off guard and I wasnt happy.  You said it was standard proceedure and then proceeded to tell me that im lucky its not $500 which you could ask for. That unhappy experience stayed with me for the entire stay.  Then my uncle found out we were staying here and also booked a room next to us in 7.  However he was not asked for a $100 bond.  So what was it about my appearance that made you demand a bond from me? My age, my brown face? My size?  Looking in your guest handbook it says that you will only ask for a bond if we dont provide a credit card or id.  You never gave me those options you straight asked for $100 and threated $500 when I showed resistance.  That took $100 out of our pockets for the duration of our stay that I did not plan for.  The only nice thing about our stay was the wonderful friendly delightful cleaner who is clearly the most valuable asset to your staff.   My family and I will not be returning.

title: Great service
text: Very welcoming staff. We arrived way too early to be checked in (we were there for friends wedding), the nice lady in the reception quickly found us a room, so we didn't have to stay outside. We got to one bedroom room, there was a large comfortable couch, large tv, and behind a partitioning large n comfy bed. Extremely helpful and honest hosts. Big rooms, clean, good sky channels, giant bed. Would definately stay there again.

title: Disappointed
text:
I have been using this Motel for ages and for what we were charged I have always rated it highly!  Now I see they have upgraded some rooms which look great but we scored a dud. The Formica in the shower had a big dirty hole and the bathroom ceiling was covered in black mold.  Nice powerful shower though if you are 5ft tall!

Sorry to say we won't be staying here again. I guess it's the luck of draw which room you get is the moral to the story.

The bed was a super king I think and the room had a heat pump which was great,thanks.

title: Overnight
text: Wow what can I say, this Fountain City Motel Inn was in my eyes just as great as it was advertised, the service at the front desk was so warm and inviting just what you want after a long day of traveling this amazing country that is NZ

title: Average, but OK for the price.
text:
I have stayed at this motel on a few occasions.
This motel has a nice street frontage and also boarders a park so half the rooms (the rooms on the north side) have a nice "park view".
The rooms are getting a bit old and tired and have a distinctive "cleaning product" smell.
The beds are big but old. The furniture is getting a bit old and tired as well.
The rooms do have a nice big flat screen TV and full SKY TV channels.
The bathrooms are very 70's feeling, and could definitely do with an update.
The upstairs King rooms (these are the rooms that I have stayed in) are quite largs, and have reasonable kitchen facilities, and they do provide a jar of ground coffee and a plunger.
The staff are nice and friendly, and the room rates are very reasonable.
There is also a indoor heated pool and outdoor spa, but these look a bit old and dirty so I have never bothered using either.
Free WiFi available.
So in summary, this place is good for the price but is definitely getting a bit tired and shabby.

title: great place
text:
great size rooms.  cooking facilities were a plus,  extra large comfy bed,   gigantic shower,   was a great place to stay,  friendly staff.  close to shopping facilities,
has clothes washing facilities on site :) 
nice big field that rooms open onto welcoming if you want to sit outside and have dinner in the fresh air.

title: Excellent
text:
Stayed for one night. Room was exceptionally clean, large and comfortable. Shower had wonderful pressure.
Will definitely stay again.
Lady at reception was super brilliant, funny, friendly and helpful.
Plenty of parking and close drive to the city.

title: Disappointing
text: We stayed in Room #1. The bed was very soft and uncomfortable. Facilities were basic and the room felt cramped with limited space. However, the room was clean and the staff friendly. Only a short drive to the centre of town.

title: Dated
text:
Room was comfortable with large bed but definitely dated decor especially the bathroom.

Shower was very low so hard to wash hair.

Room was a good size with plenty of car parks.

Reception hours were limited.

title: Very friendly staff. Good nights sleep.
text: Room a bit dated, but had everything needed. Staff very friendly. Slept well, bed comfortable. Free wifi internet. Lots of Sky tv channels. Handy to town. Lots of restaurants and takeaways close. Overall good value for money.

title: Great accomodation. We'll be back !
text: A bit dated but really good value for money. Spacious room with open plan lounge and kitchen. Really comfortably appointed. Great bed. Spotlessly clean and comfortable. Our new "lets stay in Hamilton" place. Huge TV With lots of sky channels.... can also be watched from bed. Book ahead as I noticed the no vacancy sign was out early pm.

title: Very clean and friendly
text:
The hotel was very clean and the staff were great. The room had cooking facilities and a door outside which backed onto a park. We had a large mini bus and parked it right outside the back of the unit.  The inside parking was for cars less than 2 meters high. 
The bed was very large and comfortable
Nice quiet location just out of town.

title: Cheap and cheerful, budget.
text:
Had room 11, for one night, NYE. This room is upstairs, back of reception, over car park, view of next door roof. 
It was clean. But smoking was permitted, with an ashtray on the balcony.
Not enough parking, which is disappointing for a 'motor inn', so getting out of the angle park meant dodging parallel parks outside the ground floor units. Make sure you have comprehensive on the hire car insurance as the parallel parks aren't actually marked out. 
Room was self contained but the cooking arrangements were dated, the fridge was very noisy and had to be chocked up in the front to shut it up (plus the ice box was frozen up)
Stove is also in hallway of exit.
The bathroom door didn't close all the way (nice view of tv from the loo) and the second wall switch didn't work.  Water pressure in shower was very high, and the rotary dial meant it couldn't be reduced, only temperature selected. Fine if you dont mind being needled, but not good for everyone. No extractor fan in bathroom. 
Duvet only, no sheet. 
Airconditioning points down room to door...so the bed doesn't get much airflow. No insect screen on sliding door so you can't leave it or the window open, resulting in insect bites. 
Cases could only go on the floor. Only one bedside table.
No showstoppers, and I'm sure the better rooms are good for more than one night stays, but beware you might get the tiny leftovers if you book online in peak holiday season.

title: Good stay but getting tired
text:
We stayed here for a couple of nights. The place is clean and comfortable, has the best walk in shower...a big square shower head with the most amazing water pressure. The bed was a big king split which I like when sleeping with my partner, plenty of room left over for me!!

The cleaning staff are super friendly.

The pool area, pool and spa have really been let go, which is disappointing. Such a great feature to have but no money has been spent on its up-keep.

title: Value for money
text: Clean, helpful staff.  Dated but for the price was good.  Stayed in the 2 bedroom apartment, very spacious.  Opened into a park, had a trampoline, indoor pool and spa.  Would stay again if passing through Hamilton

title: Generally well maintained and good value
text: We had a good sized, one-room motel unit. It is well maintained and generally clean. The facility is relatively modern and the staff is very friendly and helpful.  Parking is free and has lots of space. It is over-all a very pleasant stay for us, and the price is right.

title: Friendly service and clean
text: This was clean and tidy. Service was excellent and was an Ok price. But this was where it ended. Place hasn't had money spent on it in many many years and the beds were horrible. I guess price reflected this but I would probably try some else first.

title: Comfortable accommodations in the heart of Hamilton
text: My wife and I stayed here March 16-18.  We were visiting from the U.S.  We arrived one hour before check-in and they graciously let us check in an hour early.  Very clean.  Comfortable space with kitchen area as well.  Mattress was comfortable.  Couch was not as comfortable.  Good water pressure in shower.  Our room was #5--very close to the self-serve laundry room.  Personalized breakfast was served to our room each morning--really nice touch!  Very reasonable rates and pleasant staff.  Parking gets pretty tight if inn is full.  Located on main thoroughfare for easy access to Hamilton and surrounding area.  We would gladly stay here again.

title: Overnight Stay
text: Beds very comfortable, room clean and good size for 3 adults, lovely welcome on arrival. On a main road but not facing the road so traffic didn't bother us at all. Only downside was room upstairs so suggest ask for ground floor if needed. Staff very helpful so don't see it would be a problem.

title: No booking
text: Booked a room via telephone with the Motor Inn's reception.  Arrived to check in and there was no booking recorded.  Had been told it was a very short walk to the city centre but it was further than expected.  Decided not to stay there and found accommodation closer.

title: Cheap stay
text:
Very small clean room,  tiny bathroom that hasn't a fan. It's very noisy if you are near the road even on an early Sunday morning.  

The pool is small but nice. No extra towels were offered. Had to leave towels out on the coat rack to dry for the morning swim and shower but it rained.

title: Tidy but tired
text: Very friendly welcome. Room is clean & tidy but very tired, has seen better days.  Very small room but love the Sky channels available. Reasonable for the price we paid. However, would still go back to our usual Camelot on Ulster if it is not fully booked.

title: Was okay for us
text:
Our netball team stayed here. There was six of us so they gave us two units which were interconnecting.  The rooms were a bit dated but comfortable, however the dining chairs were a bit suss.  Two of the older looking ones didn't look very safe to sit on.  The ice box in the smaller unit was completely frozen and the fridge was not cold.  Luckily the fridge in the other unit was working good. The bigger unit had a good size bathroom.  Both rooms opened out onto a small narrow balcony but as we were upstairs, it was more just for standing and looking out at the reserve.

Although the swimming pool was indoors, it was actually a cold pool.  The spa pool was nice though. 

Overall our stay was ok.  The staff were good.

title: Simple and Sufficent
text: Good room for a good price, Purchased via Wotif. We stayed one night, the room was well presented, comfortable and warm. The decor was a little outdated but it was in great condition with no deterioration. Would happily stay here again

title: Great Value
text: This accommodation offers great value . Easy check in , friendly staff, good size well fitted out rooms  that are clean but do require a little maintenance . Has free Wifi internet. The location is close to most places.  Good off street parking. Great room for the price , would recommend and would stay again when passing through Hamilton.

title: Lovely motel
text:
The host wasd lovely and friendly. Studio unit clean and fresh. Everything we needed was provided.
Spa pool was lovely and warm.
The host offered advice on a nice riverside walk into the city.
We stayed here on 2 separate occasions and would use this motel again.

user_location: Bay of Plenty Region, New Zealand
title: Awesome overnight stay!!!!
text: An excellent place to stay. The city is close-by and very easy access to city center and te rapa. Room is excellent and comfy. Good value for money. Would surely recommend to my friends Overall loved it!!!

title: Overnight stay
text: Great place to stay clean and comfortable is close to everything as well .with great staff  friendly on arrival and departure be staying again is good value for money lovely unit free why fi maps of hamilton what more can you want 😊

title: Excellent service and experience
text:
My daughter and I stayed here recently.  From the moment I phoned the hotel to book (the receptionist was extremely helpful) to when we checked in. everything was easy.
The room was clean tidy and well appointed.  
I would stay here again

title: Value for money
text:
Stayed here in Nov 2015 and decided to stay here again while driving through. Good value for money. Many units overlook a large park area that creates a serene atmosphere.
Definitely meets my standards of limited street noise, soft bed and good shower.
Lots of TV channels and very good hosts

title: Excellent Overall Motor Inn
text:
This Motor Inn had a great feel to it, the rooms were clean, well supplied and appeared to be very well looked after. Parking was easy and convenient outside our room. The staff are nice and will give you information on the area. 

Well priced and should not be overlooked. 

Note: Don't skip a trip to Hamilton Gardens while in the area either.

title: Standard Motel Stay
text:
Stayed 1 night in Summer peak. This is a good spot to stay if you are passing through or if you simply need to put your head down for the night. 

Units were well set up with all the usual amenities. Kitchenette with microwave had all the usual to make full meals. Some noise from the corridor but this was no biggie. Some of the fitting are aging a bit however the unit was very clean.

Avoid getting a unit close to the busy Ulster Street. Getting a ground floor unit is usual for access to your car however this also means that you hear other folks coming and going. The rooms looking over the neighboring golf course will be preferable for my next stay.

Not many restaurants in the immediate vicinity, however there are spots a short drive up the road.

title: Excellent for a small group
text: Four of us stayed for the night here - booked the 2 bedroom unit - it was huge - two bedrooms, separate toilet (a bit small to get into), bathroom (also a bit small but more than adequate), and a very large lounge, dining, kitchen area. There was access from this latter area directly onto a large park. Little or no road noise as the unit is at the rear of the complex right next to swimming pool. Overall very good - decor is somewhat dated and it could do with some smartening up - but great value and everything you need is there. We were greeted on arrival in a very friendly manner and same on departure. We'll be back should we return to Hamilton in the future

title: Do not OVERLOOK booking this Accomodation
text: Booked in for 5 days and had to stay more, it wasn't a hardship. With staff that make this stay a pleasure, you as a guest feel welcome and with an added attitude of "maybe we can fix, help or give" what more can you ask for. The rooms are big, CLEAN - sure a little dated (but not decrepit), but being in a handy location with fantastic parking, no road noise. Excellent WI FI, full channels of Satellite TV Combined all this with a very favorable charge for staying here  I would highly recommend not overlooking booking at this Hotel.  Within a 1 min walk is mini put and a golf driving range, a 5 min drive to the centre of town and 5 mins to a major shopping mall - all bases are covered. The indoor POOLS (plural) and the spa are all clean and well maintained. On a personal note to the Staff and Owners of Fountain City Motel - Well done and Thank you for the service and your kind and caring attitude and if I need accommodation in Hamilton, I sure would stay again.

title: extremely noisy rooms
text:
My husband and I stayed here for 2 nights while visiting family. Our room was very comfortable and contained everything that we needed. However we were very disappointed with the noise. Other guests left there doors open on to the hallway and were very noisy. Fortunately they quietened down at about 10pm each night. Walls and ceiling between rooms are also very thin and we could hear our neighbours tv and them going to the toilet. Both mornings we woken at about 5am by kitchen noises( I think it was) as our room was very close to reception and I assume the owners kitchen.
The breakfast deal was great and was delivered to us the night before, with a great variety of food, nicely presented on a tray with flowers. However the yoghurts were nearly 2 weeks past the "use by" date, and the butter and 1 box of cereal was just past its "use by" date. Staff were very friendly and always greeted you with a lovely smile. Unfortunately the noise would put us off staying here again

title: Good place for overnight stay
text:
We were in need of a hotel for the night before returning our car to the Auckland Airport. Hamilton is about a 2 hour drive to the airport.
Our original booking gave us a room at the front of the motel but for $10 more we could have a larger room on the upper floor towards the back of the motel. We were glad we took up this option  as the motel is on a very busy street.

The room was quite large and had undergone some recent renovations.
There was a king size bed, large tv, pull out sofa bed and a dining table for 4.The kitchen was well equipped although a little dated.
Guests have access to a coin operated laundry. 

The staff were very accommodation and genuinely helpful.

title: Comfortable
text: Used this motel as a base over approximately 3-4 weeks while I tiki toured to visit family and friends.  Had stayed here a year ago and found it quite pleasant,  comfortable and reasonably priced.  Is within travelling distance to The Base and the city.  Is worth a stay.

title: Best experience
text: First time in Hamilton! Awesome area! Enjoyed the stay. Even though cleaners banging on your door saying we are due for our check out! But it was clean inside and out! and admin was helpful! The spa was so relaxing! Pool was cleAn. It was nice and big. Good thing not many people wanted to swim !

title: Lovely staff but a bit run down
text:
Oh the staff were lovely and friendly and so helpful. The rooms were toasty warm, the sheets were clean (Yay!), great TVs, PS2, Sky channels to keep the kids out of trouble. Pool is good (could be warmer but it was the coldest weekend in decades) and the spa pool wasn't warm enough for the coldest weekend in decades. Oh Well! 

The bathrooms were a bit tired and the kitchenette surfaces a bit damaged - but everything functioned well - great water pressure, great to have a kitchenette. So don't expect posh but expect clean, friendly and warm. All good!

title: Great stay at excellent price
text: Didn't stay long, but very happy with our stay here. Great value for money especially with the Continental breakfast deal and we will stay again. Only suggestion would be to add some stevia sachets for our morning cuppa.

title: Everything you need...including breakfast
text:
We were staying in Hamilton for 2 nights over a busy weekend. Where to stay when there were so many options on Motels? We chose Fountain Motor Inn as it was within our budget AND had a special offer including continentla breakfast.
The studio had everything we needed...and more. Although our room (22) was next to the road we weren't bothered by road noise and had rural views. The room had a great shower with good pressure (we were upstairs), had a heater plus a heat pump and an electric blanket. The breakfast was VERY generous, and was delivered to our room....the icing on the cake for this motel. Would certainly recommend this Motel. We didn't use the Spa or Sauna...but it was a bonus to have them.

title: Age is No Barrier to High Standards here!
text:
One of the institutions along Hamilton's motel strip.  This place has been there for as long as we can remember.  The good thing is, that the owners have kept us with maintainence quite well over the years, both inside and out.  The motel seems to be regularly painted and touched up outside, the units inside kept well too.  Units have been modernised over time and now include updated appliances, flat screen TV's.  Well equiped kitchens too.  Clean and tidy throughout.  Even though this is an older motel, it does still have a good feel to it.  Nice big comfy bed too.  We were really surprised that you can still get a morning newspaper delivered to your room daily.
Friendly staff.  This proves yet agin that with the right owners and attitude, older motels can be really good value, especially at the $99 per night we paid to stay here.  The units are set back from the road but you can hear some road noise at night from time to time.  The only issue we had was parking, as the parking lines are faded and many cars were not parking correctly and parking in the wrong place, meaning there was shortages of car parks because of this.  This does need to be addressed. Regardless of this, Well done to th team at the Fountain City Motor Inn.

title: Needs An Overhaul
text: We stayed here in December the week before christmas 2014 for only 2 days. I will start with the positives. The hotel receptionist was courteous and gracious enough to give us a late check in, as we had flown in from Brisbane to Auckland airport & encountered a few delays along the way. We booked a King room, which was roomy and spacious enough for my husband and I, also we loved the huge King Size bed! Unfortunately my positives end there. The Hotel and rooms are in serious need of a makeover! The air in the room was so old & musty, we had to leave all the windows and doors open as I was starting to get queasy. There was dust on the shelves and the kitchen did not appear in any way sanitary, so we ate out and didn't bother using any of the utensils. The indoor pool was not pleasant to swim in, as the floor of the pool needs to be repaired or painted, also the roof was an eyesore. The spa was not working and we had to keep asking staff to turn it on. I was also told that I could pay at the end, but noticed the money had already left my account before I could authorise this transaction. Our complimentary wifi had run out on the first day, so we therefore had to pay for extra wifi. So over all I was glad we were there for only 2 days of our entire trip. I will go elsewhere next time.

title: Love This Place !!
text: This is my third stay here. It's by far my favourite. If possible try an upstairs park side room with balcony. It's so restful lying in bed staring out at the trees. You feel like you're in the country, yet your in the city, and close to everything you may need. I found the bed so comfy I could stay there all day. Huge TV, heat pump. super clean with kitchen facilities. Super good value when compared to others of similar price but offer much less. It's like an inner city apartment with everything you need. Easy parking with a pool and spa. Apart from the great facilities, the staff are genuinely nice people, dedicated to making your stay pleasurable. If you need anything just ask. I needed an extension cord so my hair dryer could reach the bathroom mirror. So if something's not working for you ... let them know and they'll fix it. It's so relaxing, peaceful and comfortable I usually extend my stay for just a bit longer. Like an inner city retreat. It's hard to leave. Thanks Amy and Fountain City. Always a pleasure :). See you next time.

title: Nice Clean Motel
text: This is not a bad place to say - the rooms very clean and tidy, nice big TV and Sky and one of the very few motels in the area with California King Size Bed (actually, I couldn't find any others in that area which had it). It's next to the main road but I could barely hear any traffic. However, I wish they had numbered carparks for each unit as other motels do. I was quite upset to arrive late in the evening and there wasn't a single car park vacant. I had to call the manager to sort it out and ended up parking right at the door step of my room - which I wasn't very comfortable with as a car reversing from the carpark could hit mine if the driver was not careful. The carparks also need to have the dividers clearly visible with paint as the cars pretty much park in any space and more cars could fit in if it was managed properly. These are just a minor inconvenience and I would definately recommend this place.

title: Wow
text: What a fantastic place to stay.  Super friendly and helpful people, immaculate rooms, comfortable bed, big TV, great ammenities, security cameras in parking area, what more could you want?  How about the thoughtfulness of having the room toasty warm and the lights on in the room when I arrived on a cold rainy night.  Your are crazy if you go anywhere else.  Now that I've written this, I'll probably have to book months in advance - damn!

title: Excellent Service, Very Clean and nice place to stay.
text: We have stayed twice at Fountain City. We have found the service to be excellent, the cleanliness of rooms to be excellent and it is nice to be close to town. The rooms could do with more natural light and modernised but were very nice for both our stays. There is a little noise from upstairs if you are in the downstairs rooms, both times this has not impacted on our stay.

title: Peaceful, private inner city retreat
text: I've stayed at half a dozen places in Hamilton and this is my overall favourite so far. I was upstairs at the far end with a balcony that overlooks the neighbouring park. It's super quiet (internal and external noise). It's central, but you feel like you're in the country. Private with excellent security and ample parking. It was like a self contained apartment. Kitchen, plunger coffee, heat pump, large bathroom, huge tv, wifi, a separating lounge. The couch was so comfy I slept on it one night. The bed is huge. Retro/fun/quirky layout. Delivery charge back restaurant option. A direct dial to room option for outside callers. The staff are excellent. Friendly and professional. Happy to go the extra mile. The housekeeping lady was superb. She knew I liked to get up late and would leave me till last. She'd do all the thinking for me while I slowly gained consciousness and did the thinking for me. Nice people, nice place. They're there if you need them, otherwise they'll leave you to it. Highly recommended.

title: Great Service
text: We are a family of 4 and this is the second time we have stayed here. Amy the duty manager is very nice and goes out of her way to be helpful with good suggestions where to eat and made sure the sofa bed was ready for the kids as we were arriving late. The rooms have been clean and it is nice to have a big bench in the bathroom and a shower with good pressure. Please be aware that this Motor Inn desperately needs updating but the price, cleanliness and service make up for it.

title: average motel
text: We only stayed for 1 night at this hotel in mid-March.  It is located on a main road through town - on the way out heading towards Auckland - but we never heard any traffic noise.  We had ground floor room 7 with a massive comfortable king size bed.  The room was a little dated though clean.  When we first walked in, I was surprised we had a large sofa in the room.  I thought it was going to be nice to sit & watch TV on a sofa, but I was mistaken.  It was however so uncomfortable after just a small time - I can only assume it was an old style sofa bed.  I understand most people wont be concerned about the hair dryer in the bathroom, but this one is probably the worst I've ever encountered.  I don't mind that it's old - it just needs to blow some air out to dry my hair!  Our room looked out to a park area while rooms on the other side looked out to the car park.  The room also had air-conditioning which was wonderful on the hot day/night.  Free wi-fi was included in the price and we had no trouble connecting. The staff at reception were friendly and we had no complaints with their service.

title: Clean & Comfortable
text:
I had room 5, was handy to the carpark, pool, laundry & the furtherest of the ground floor rooms from the main road.  It's an ideal location for a business stop over as it's handy to all parts of Hamilton.  

The room was very clean & the bed comfortable.  I didn't take a look at the pool, but the thought of being able to take a dip was enticing, especially with the humid weather.  If the kids had been with me they'd of been straight in after a long drive.

Definitely value for money, hassle free & you don't often get shower pressure so great that you almost can't bear, almost a massage from the jets!

title: dusty sofa
text: good motel for families with heaps of stuff to keep kids entertained. Only downside was the dust which you could see exploding off the sofa every time you sit on it. Not recommended for anyone with dust allergies.

title: Great for Families
text: By husband and I stayed with extended family and our 15month old infant mid December 2013 in the Inter-connecting rooms..Rooms were very clean and beds super comfy. Large wall mount TV's were great as you can watch them from Bed. Plus table and chairs so your not just stuck with sitting on the bed. House-keeping staff extremely friendly and helpful. Balcony's over look a large grassed open space with the Golf driving range in view. Not much traffic noise and we were only 3rd room back from street. Balcony nice but would have been nice to have a chair out there to enjoy the view. Pool area needs updating as it appears dated now. Hallways are a little dark at night, but not an issue at all really. Will stay again if in Hamilton. Only downside is no spa or bath in either room. Not bad at all for an overnight stay or two. BALCONY not exactly safe for a child as they can easily fall through the large gap at the bottom, belongings can easily fall too so just keep aware of this.

title: Great value for money!
text: We stayed as a family of four on Xmas Eve, and booked adjoining rooms, which was great. Only $180 for the lot, which we thought was great value. The place is a little dated, but still very comfortable, roomy and clean, no issues there at all. Excellent central location, and nice to have a view from our rooms to the reserve and golf course next door. Very comfy beds too. Nice touch was the bottle of red wine and Xmas card that were left for us by the motel - thank you! Staff very friendly :-)

title: Good, economical place to stay in Hamilton
text: The staff was extremely accommodating, going out of their way to let us get our laundry done outside of the posted hours.  Clean rooms, comfortable beds, ours had large windows overlooking a park, very serene, quiet.  Room and parking felt very secure.

title: Great stay amazing host
text: Great place to stay, really nice hosts and very good value for money. Older than the photos would suggest on wof if website. Park next door brillant for the kids and they also enjoyed the pool (very clean) and the playstation. Could hear the road noise but it disappeared at ten thirty pm. California king very comfortable, would we stay again? In a heartbeat!

title: Excellent as always
text:
Got to love the heated pool here for a late night swim. Such friendly hosts too. 

Never would stay anywhere else!! 
Make sure you check out their website directly and book a seasonal special if available... Its a steal!!

title: Very happy with this choice
text: Our unit was spacious and very clean with twin beds, a sofa and a dining table with three comfortable chairs. The living area could also be screened from the sleeping area if guests chose to do so. We were upstairs with a balcony and a view of the golf course which was very pleasant. We were very happy with the choice and considered it excellent value. The lady at reception was very helpful and particularly obliging when I asked if we could arrive earlier than normal as we had a medical appointment to attend. We would definitely pick this motel again.

title: Cozy night at Fountain City
text:
Always a good stay at the fountain city. Great value for money!
Used the washing facilities but the dryer is not good at all, doesnt dry anything and needs a good clean om the inside!
Love the high pressure showers and the very friendly staff...see you again soon :)

title: Comfortable and refreshing
text:
Stayed here for 2 nights (on a 2 night special – great $$ value). Comfortable place, wonderfully helpful staff, very good value for money. Very comfortable bed, especially after the drive North from Wgtn, warm room with all the basics that we needed. 
Found that they offered room service meals (dinner) from local restaurants with charge back to our room account – great bonus and what a superb meal we enjoyed.
We’re staying there again in a couple of weeks – that probably give you a good idea of our recommendation!

title: Very comfortable, pleasant accommodation for solo traveler
text:
I enjoyed my stay at this property while in Hamilton. Clean, comfortable, easy and convenient from the main road, Fountain City is one of many motels lining the road that leads to the city centre. It was nice to be able to park across from the door and just roll my suitcase to the entryway. Though small (I had to carry my suitcase into the room and kept it on one side of my bed since there was no other place to put it), the studio room is nicely furnished with a queen bed, table and two chairs, and leather chair with ottoman. The kitchen area has a microwave, small fridge, sink, coffee press, hot water maker, utensils, tea, coffee and hot chocolate. The dated bathroom is a little small, but it worked fine for me. The water pressure was great, however, the shower head is a little low (I'm 5'4"). The bed is a little soft, but comfortable with a nice heating element in it. The heater is a bit noisy especially when on high, but it didn't keep me from sleeping soundly. I barely noticed any road noise.

In-room WIFI (free through Zenbu vouchers) is available up to 200 mb. There is also an indoor heated pool, spa and sauna, which I didn't experience. You can also order in-room breakfast up to 9 p.m. the night before and specify the delivery time; just ask for the form at the reception desk.

You can either walk or drive just down Ulster Street for fast food, grocery store or the gourmet Nosh Food Market. Within driving distance is the city centre with many restaurants, theatres, shops and services. Fountain City Motor Inn also provides a list of restaurants for delivery or takeout that can be added to the hotel bill or not. 

I actually decided to stay in Hamilton since it was the midway point between Waitomo Caves and the Hobbiton Movie Set, plus I'd wanted to see Hamilton Gardens. Didn't get to see the gardens, but staying in Hamilton was a good decision. You can also pick up a map of Hamilton and they'll help you with any directions.

title: Comfortable and accommodating
text: We had 2 nights while visiting family - from the US.  Very clean and comfortable room.  Major lack was no closet and very limited other hanging options.  Room relatively small but that made it easier to heat on a cold night!  Staff very accomodating and helpful when wi-fi issues came up.

title: one of the best in Hamilton
text:
will be making this my choice of place to stay every time in Hamilton - cannot fault anything, and hosts went above what was needed - recommended to all. 
Good location, next to mini golf course - 10 min walk from city centre. Good walk through a forest to the river walkway.

title: Value for Money
text: Decided at the last  minute to stop overnight in Hamilton instead of going on to Auckland.  Liked the look of this one as we drove by and decided to stay.   Was not disappointed.  The room was extremely large and the king sized bed area was separated by folding doors.  The kitchen area was spotless as was the rest of the Unit.  Large t.v. screen and the heating was quick and quiet.  Even though the motel is on a very busy road we were not affected by traffic noise in fact we did not hear it. King size bed was very comfortable.   There was a park adjoining and when we arrived there was a football team or similar training and we could hear them but it finished very early so was not obtrusive.   Good list of restaurants available in Room Folder who will deliver however we chose to ring up then go and pick it up ourselves.  Would definitely stay here again if staying in Hamilton.

title: The best in the Hamilton strip of hotels!
text:
Love Fountain City Motor Inn. The room was very clean and had a fully loaded kitchen (right down to a bottle of milk instead of those annoying sachets). Massive TV with lots of channels and good reception. Modern heatpump kept us warm on a -2 degree night! The downside is the shower head is too low and many reviews seem to mention this, but the water pressure from the shower is like a fire hose hitting you - Love it (although might not be good for kiddies).

Great warm pool and spa. 

Pros: Friendly staff, amazing value for money, easy to park, secure, warm, Large rooms
Cons: Upstairs has no lift, musty smelling hallways, not sound proof (drunk people turning up at next unit at 4am on sunday morning woke us).

title: Great value for money
text: I have just stayed here. My room was spotless, comfortable with a modern twist. Heat pump was on when I entered. Hmmmm lovely....Thanks Amy! Great attentive service..my room was beautifully quiet and cosy. I will be returning as every element of the room and service was thoughtful. See you next time!

title: Comfortable but noisy!
text: This was a short stay.  The rooms were fine for the price and clean.  The only downside is the noise from people going up and down the stairs and traffic noise as it is situated on the main road.  Might be fine if you are a heavy sleeper!

title: Great value for money
text: A group of three couples stayed here over Easter as we were doing day cycles around Hamilton.  This motel is spacious and really comfortable. The huge tv screens a bonus (42 inch).  It was great to be able to soak in the pool and spa after too.

title: Great place to stay
text:
We came to Hamilton for a family reunion & booked 7 rooms at Fountain City Motor Inn.  The rooms were a great size, modern with big screen flatscreen tvs & heatpumps.  Amy & her team were wonderful & couldnt do enough for us!
I would definately recommend this motel to anyone going to Hamilton.

title: Our favourite place to stay
text:
This is our top place in Hamilton.
We have always stayed here every three months during the past 3 years. 
Huge rooms, huge bed, great friendly people, clean, good parking, quiet, great pool, Sauna and Spa, excellent kitchen. Walking distance to Supermarket and city.

title: Welcome to the Tron - city of the future
text: We needed to accommodate the family for a couple of days to get our house ready for sale and chose the Fountain City for the benefit of the kids. Fortunately they loved it and we could hardly get them out of the pool or off the trampoline. The connecting room arrangement was ideal as there was plenty of room for five and two bathrooms is always good with three females in the group. The rooms, though a little dated, were clean and comfortable and quiet - a surprise given the central location. We only met the staff at check-in so it is difficult to comment. You could do worse in the Tron (and we live there, so we know) but probably not much better for the price.

title: Spacious room. Enjoyed stay
text:
My husband and I stayed at the Fountain City Motor Inn as we were in town for an event at Claudelands Showgrounds.  Previously being from the Waikato, had driven past this place hundreds of times, but this was our first stay. We were allocated room #17 and we loved it. It was an upstairs room to the back of the complex so furthest away from Ulster street as possible. (Ulster street is a busy strip and can be noisy with traffic at night) And overlooked the large grassy park beside and golf driving range behind. It was such a nice outlook. We had our own long, skinny balcony that ran the length of our room to enjoy it from.  The room was spacious. Large 3 seater couch, dining table + chairs, large 42" Flat screen TV on the wall, and kitchenette (complete with complimentary 'real' milk for coffee/tea not that UHT in a pottle stuff!). It was a studio/1 bedroom unit as you could actually pull across a partition wall/door to close off the bedroom from the lounge room if you should choose.  The bed was a luxurious Californian King which was enormous! Very comfy. The bathroom was spacious with a long vanity and wall to wall mirror - so no fighting for bathroom space. Some aspects of the room were a little dated, but they have freshened it up with modern bedspread, the flat screen TV, stainless mini fridge etc. And despite the age of the building - the rooms were immaculately presented and very clean. Off-street parking, indoor pool, and trampoline for the kids. Lady at reception was very sweet and friendly. Pak N Save, bottle store, takeaways just up the road if you need conveniences. The night life hub of Hamilton is at the other end of Victoria street, I would guess a $7-$10 taxi ride. So very accessible to everything. We were very pleased with our room, and would definitely stay here again. Great value too.
Points to note for getting the best out of your stay - request a room upstairs overlooking the park. Bring your own hair dryer - as the 1 in the bathroom is pretty tired.

title: Good stopover
text:
We stayed here one night en-route from Auckland Airport to Ohakune.
The place had everything we needed and was very reasonably priced.
The room was clean and well appointed.
There is a big PakNSave just around the corner.

title: pleasant stay
text: Stayed here July28th. Staff very polite and helpful. nice room next to park - would be great in summer. Room fine and spotessly clean. Bed very comfortable. Large flat screen tv and outdoor spa perfect temp. Would stay again.

title: Comfortable Stay in Mid-Winter
text: We enjoyed a very comfortable stay at this Motel this week. Comfortable bed and lounge furniture. Clean and easy to heat with the heat-pump. Helpful staff as well. Would stay again and recommend to others.

title: Fabulous Accommodation & Service
text: The Fountain City Motor Inn made our stay in Hamilton most comfortable & enjoyable. The rooms were warm, spacious & included everything you needed in a kitchenette setup. The servicing of the rooms was also of a high standard. And the reception staff were most helpful. You can't go wrong for the price you pay for this accommodation facility. I would recommend anyone travelling and requiring accommodation in Hamilton NZ to book at this place. My family and I will certainly be using them again whenever we require accommodation in Hamilton :)

title: Awesome facilities :)
text: We got a studio room, nice big flat screen tv,  the room was in very tidy and well maintained condition even though the decor was a bit dated. The only thing that we were not happy with was that both of the dining chairs were wobbly and falling apart. Great that we had our own private deck upstairs. Use of the pool and jacuzzi was awesome as no one else was in them when we went. Definitely enjoyed our stay. Room service was excellent the reception was literally only took 5 seconds to come up to our room and meet our requests. Nice and quiet would definitely stay there again and recommend to all. We only paid $89 and got more than we expected for money.

title: We keep coming back
text: Since we discovered Fountain City we've been back a number of times. The rooms are clean with a pleasing decor and the staff are excellent, from the  hosts to the cleaning staff.  As far as we're concerned, it's the best accommodation we've had in Hamilton, and trust me, we've stayed at a few places now.

title: Spacious and comfortable
text: We spent one night here in a 2 bedroom unit. The furniture is dated but it really doesn't matter as the unit was huge and very comfortable. There is a heated swimming pool, spa and from our unit we could access the huge green space adjacent to the motel. It was ideal for our family with young kids. We were also within walking distance of a supermarket.

title: Has all you need
text: Good location, good facilities, friendly staff, very clean. We'd stay here again.

title: Enter the Time Warp
text: Looks can be deceiving from the outside. We booked a budget room here, we just needed a bed & shower. It served the purpose, but this place is in desperate need of a revamp. It looks nice & modern from the outside, but once you enter the room its like walking into a 70's nightmare. For the age of the bathroom its immaculate so no worries about grotty bathrooms here. Even though the room was just under $100 for the night, we did expect it to be more modern. We had stayed at hotels for the same price the nights before & they were much nicer.

title: the best find in hamilton!!!
