text: the room was beautiful, generously spacious, and fresh! the bed was massive and so comfortable! the sky tv was huge, the couch was comfortable, the bathroom was lovely, everything was just perfect. the environment was great. and the service was great, the lady in the reception was so friendly and lovely, a true testament to the place itself. definitely stay here. actually can't wait to go back!

title: Now we know why this was the best price...
text: The room was large, but the carpet was very scary - old & stained.  Furniture & decor were very outdated (except the huge flat screen TV that was nice, but seemed quite out of place).  Many of the TV channels were either foreign language or music only.  All the rooms connect to an indoor hallway, which was was quite loud.  The guest laundry facilities were very helpful, and the front office lady was super nice. But with so many other lodging choices in Hamilton, we probably would not stay here again.

title: fantastic cant wait to go back!
text:
We had a family unit. which had two bedrooms and lounge kitchen dining area. It could actually sleep 6 people but were a family of four.
Right out side our door was a trampoline and play area and a huge area where kids could run around. The pool and spa were great.

The service received from staff was outstanding, and with my broken foot they were so helpful and pleasant.

title: Stayed as a group
text: we stayed here multiple times during the last 10 years with the gisborne BMX club families. it has a nice indoor swimming pool and nice rooms - some with decks. i enjoyed staying here as its also close to town, and has plenty of space for everything - even our bikes.

title: Needs a little updating but not bad
text: Stayed here one night with family.  Carpet, drapes, and furniture need to be replaced but the beds were comfortable and it was quiet.  There was a grocery store just down the road so we cooked meals in our room.

title: Great value and comfort for the $$$$
text: Have stayed here twice now and am blown away with the things you get for your $$$.  spacious quiet rooms with great cooking facility and equipment.  Rooms are older but have modern decor and are clean and tidy.

title: Seriously- are all these reviews talking about the same place I went to?
text: "Ewww!" (in a bad way) was my first impression of my room (no 2) upon entering. The out-dated 70's style room with carpeted walls and disgusting old saggy pink floral sofa which I couldn't even go near let alone sit on, was not what I had expected after seeing this motel from the outside and reading the reviews. My bags went straight onto the table rather than the floor as I instantly thought 'bed bugs'. Surely such an old carpet, sofa and curtains can harbor crawling nasties?  However, the linen was apparently clean on closer inspection- nice crisp white sheets, as too was the mattress (after I lifted the sheets to check the condition). Actually, the more I noticed, the cleaner it was. The bed was huge and very comfortable. Excellent TV. It was just the horrid sofa and old carpets that put me off. The front desk staff were friendly too.  Didn't have a chance to check the amenities. Don't think I'd stay here again but it was ok for one night.

title: Lovely
text: comparatively low prices.  We know - because we tediously checked out the competition - the others didn't have much to offer and yet a lot were more expensive than Fountain City.  I loved how the children were never bored, with the spacious pool, suitable for most, i feel.  my 3 year old was quite happy paddling in the mini pool whilst my partner - near 6 ft was making the most of the rest of the pool, when it got cooler we popped into the lovely hot spa pool - my kids didn't want to go back to Whangamata!! They enjoyed the tramp and little playground and there was room to run as the section over was all green - yaaay!  We also loved the A/C in the middle of summer and we made the most of the movie collection and Sky!!  The cleaners spoilt us!! - so friendly - and my lucky partner didn't have to do the dishes in morning when I had left to go to Uni. - much to my disgust!!  What a wonderful place!! Looking for an excuse to go back to Hams so we can stay there again!

title: Great Rate for a Two-Night Stay
text: If you are not staying in your room for extended periods of time or entertaining other people then the room available at the Fountain City Motor Inn for a two-night stay is a real bargain.  The location is a short drive to the casino and a great number of restaurants.  We found it a great starting point to explore the Hamilton Gardens and the other attractions in the Hamilton area.

title: Room with Excellent park view....  good facilities for family with kids
text:
Nice and Clean hotel to stay..  Staff are friendly to chat with..  
My room was very confortable and cozy with Excellent park view.  
Children's play ground and BBQ table are right next to the unit and the park.  I had no chance to use heated pool, sauna and spa but my kid's will love this place.  I would recommend this hotel to anyone... business people or family.

title: Best in Town For This Value
text:
Amazingly appointed room for the value - NZ 75-90.
We got a little discount off the King Bed room, and couldn't be more pleased.
King Bed (of course), 46" Flat Screen TV, separate kitchen/dining area with 4 seat table and 2 burner cook top and Microwave, small LR with Sofa, and very large bathroom.  And, High Speed Internet included (albeit a bit spotty in coverage -- as usual here in NZ Hotels).  Very Clean, and excellent value compared with the half dozen other hotel/motels we looked at in the area.  Definately RECOMMENDED.

title: Clean! Great Service! Good Value! Great for Business Travelers!!!
text:
I stayed there for 2 nights while in Hamilton for business. Warmly greeted upon arrival and given room with quiet and park view. The room I had was in good condition and very clean, size okay. The bed was a bit harder than I like, but wasn't not too bad. Breakfast service was great. Overall facilities such as TV, furniture, kitchen, air-condition were good. 
Would happily stay there again and think it was good value for the money, especially if you are just there for business like me.

title: Good Value & Great Stay with Children
text:
I stayed with my two children at Fountain City Motel last X-mas for 2 nights. Room was very tidy and kitchen facility was great, my children loved nice warm indoor heated pool, staff and cleaners were very kind and helpful. The room that I stayed had great park view and sunlight, also my children enjoyed free cartoon movies on big screen TV. 
GREAT VALUE overall !!!  
If I trip to Hamilton in the future, I'll definitely stay in this motel, and highly recomMend to other travelers with family.

title: Great place to stay, good value, lovely owner
text: It is a nice motel to stay. I have stayed there several times, and highly recommend to others. They have a spa pool for me to relax, and new huge flat screen TV for my husband to enjoy. The rooms are clean, beds are comfortable, and their cooked breakfast is truly superb. It is great value for money. The owner is very friendly, helpful and knowledgeable, pointing out all the great places to visit near Hamilton

title: Great Stay at Fountain City Motel
text:
Another great stay at the Fountain City Motel. 

The service was top class with friendly staff who always ensure your stay is a pleasurable and an enjoyable experience.  

The room was excellent. Mine this trip overlooked the park and was spacious and very comfortable. Always very presentable, clean and tidy with nice decor. The flat screen television is great too!!! 

Good locataion close to the Hamilton city shops, cafes. etc and to the Waikato Stadium.

Great place to stay for either business or pleasure. Plenty to enjoy at the Fountain City Motel, its all good.

title: best motel ive ever been to beautifully clean and great service!
text: We had a young child with us on our stay an were very pleased at the offer of a portrcot for our room. The rooms were spotless and all the staff very friendly and helpfull.Great value for money i wouldnt stay any where else in hamilton after staying here.Would highly recommend to all.THANKS.

title: Would never stay there again!
text: Room was cleaned while we were out shopping, my moisturiser 'Olay regenerist (RRP $49.99) was only half full (only had for 3 days and was full). It had been dropped on the floor, nearly slipped over on it.  Had been in my makeup bag with lid screwed on so the cleaner must have decided to touch my stuff. When I told the person at reception she said no no no we didn't touch it!  Yeah right, it sell out of bag, rolled onto floor, took its own lid off, spilled, then put itself back!! Also we booked a 'family room' ... ONE kingsize bed and a pullout couch, has bunk beds listed in the family deal but there were none... Also very small room for a family room
hotel_response:
My name is Amy, I'm the owner of Fountain City Motor Inn.  The comments from our guests are very important to us and we respect them, but I’d like to clarify and reply to kharlie-Marie’s claims, as we do not agree with this feedback.  It was a statutory holiday when kharlie-Marie was staying with us, and a large number of our staff were on holiday, so my husband and I took on the cleaning.  We serviced the room, I cleaned the kitchen and my husband replaced the towels in the bathroom, cleaned the toilet and wiped the floor.  While we were cleaning there was nothing out of the ordinary – ie. No accidents, nothing fell or broke – when the floor was wiped down we didn’t see any moisturiser or anything spilled.  We’re very sorry about what happened to the moisturiser, but cannot take responsibility for it, as we didn’t  touch or see any moisturiser.  

We take pride in our motel, it has been around for 40 years, and couldn’t run successfully if we weren’t honest and hardworking.  My staff and I would never go through a guests property, and if there were any accidents, they would be reported to the guest and compensated for as soon as possible.  We always receive positive feedback from guests about the clean and tidy state of the rooms, and we have a lot of repeated business.

This is the explanation of our family deal as stated on numerous booking sites – 

[Your kids will love our Indoor Heated Pool, Spa, Playground, Full HD 42” LCD TV with free hireage of Movies, PS2 & Wii. Rate is based on 2 Adults and 2 Kids (Under 15 years) 
Spacious Standard unit with California King bed & a pull out couch makes extra 2 single beds.]

There is no mention of bunks, however there was a clear explanation of the room with photos, and it was at a very reasonable price for a family. The room limit is 4 people, a family of 5 should stay in the 2 bedroom or inter-connecting unit.

title: Good Value
text: Lovely comfortable motel, well appointed and close to town area. The manager was very helpful and friendly, and nothing a bother. I would recommend the Fountain City Motor Inn to anyone.

title: Very poor deluxe room
text: Huge stain on carpet, lino coming apart in bathroom, hair in the shower, thin sheet over duvet as a cover, couch under tv on same wall as the mounted tv, no milk, phone didn't work, woken in morning by workman on roof, studio unit... and they called this a One Bedroom Deluxe Room! I don't think so! They were quick to come and replace phone, bring milk and drop price by $10 one night and $20 for the second night. But when you book a Deluxe Room that's what you expect. Don't let the nice photos on their website fool you.

title: A wonderful start to our holiday.
text: best decision we made for our recent stay  in NZ was to spend a week here at Fountain City motel. The owner/operator was extremely helpful and lovely. The room was perfect for a family stay, adequate kitchen and comfy beds, nice big bathroom and very clean . The indoor pool and hot spa were fabulous. We loved it here and would make it the only place we will stay when we next return to Hamilton.

title: Great Location
text: The room was a 1 bedroom apartment the wooden floors in every room. The 1 heatpump was insufficient to heat the whole area but did its best. An additional heater for the bedroom would have made the difference. The TV was a smart TV with apps which was great. The check in experience was friendly and helpful and even though the motel didn't have its own reception it was just across the road at another motel. The WiFi was strong and free and unlimited. Parking was good and you could park anywhere. The location was great as it was a 10 minute walk into the centre of the city and a paknsave supermarket was also within walking distance. The price was just right. I would say in summer the motel would be great to stay at but for winter an extra heater is a Necessary.

title: reveiw for 21st September for a week
text: This motel room C18 would have been ok but for the single bed in the lounge was uncomfortable and springs could be felt in the mattrass. The shower was good though the toilet system buttons kept collapsing and the carpet in the back corners of the bedroom were either eaten away or rotten from water damage which was obvious in the kitchen as the cupboards smelt very musty. The managers were very polite but I would not go back there. I was there with my daughter while my husband was in Waikato hospital for heart surgery

title: One Night Stay
text: Had an over night stay following surgery at Waikato Hospital - not 5  star but met my requirements nicely - nice people who provided friendly service - good accommodation with very comfy bed - and close to hospital.

title: well presented.
text: Lovely  old house. Clean, tidy room.  John was very friendly and helpful. Only thing needed in room would be a utility knife and chopping board in kitchenette. Close to amenities, including hospital and lake..

title: Some basics right but not charming
text: I'd have to agree with other reviewers that the attitude of the managers is among the bigger turn off's here and the establishment would probably improve under different management. Onto the accommodation... It ticks critical boxes - has comfy beds and decent showers. The units are definitely dated as others have pointed out and are a bit run down with multiple minor repairs needed and a bit of a general clean up. The regular housekeeping / cleaning is good and floors, bathroom surfaces and kitchen surfaces are all clean and usable. Noise carries easily between units. Pricewise I feel you can find better. The high maintenance colonial building hasn't been highly maintained and doesn't offer any of the homesteads charm to guests.

title: Filthy place with no sanitation.
text: This place is SCARY! We were lured in by the apparent beautiful exterior of the motel. After we checked in we discovered our room was a filth hole. Smelled like smoke, mold and poop. Pretty much everything was wrong with this motel. I would not recommend anyone to stay at this hotel unless they’re over 80!
hotel_response: Just a shame that someone who was asked to leave this motel because of bad behaviour had to be petty enough to leave this terrible review for a great motel

title: Dirty and Trash
text: I visit Hamilton quite often now and found another cheap deal but have just realized that deals are just disgusting. The hotel is just next to a trash. Couldn’t gather any information on the owners but if you are reading this, please spend some money on your room structure. The room was old, outdated, musty and full of cracks on the walls. Someone’s home would be much better than this hotel. Not worth even trying. My husband almost started getting allergies after staying here just for a night.
hotel_response:
Sooo, let’s start rating guests. You state you found a cheap deal so stayed at Colonial City Motel. Since this establishment doesn’t belong to any cheap deal sites such as Expedia, you must surely be amazing.
You want information on the owners? Just another hard working couple, trying to make a living and having to put up with the public, who, when they don’t get their own way they resort to the above behaviour

title: Handy to Hospital and Town
text: Basic accommodation but clean and tidy and Host's really nice. We had one of their $7 meals each and they were great. Plenty of food and nicely served, delivered to room as well. Lots of off street parking also.

title: Great for last minute motel
text: The host where wonderful. We had to take my son to Waikato Hospital and for convenience to the hospital it was great. The rooms are a bit tied they need updating but the outer of the build has that old colonial charm. The beds where very very comfortable. We got the last room and it was huge for the three of us and it was awesome for the price, the room can sleep up to 7. Most motels have no somking on the premises but Colonial City Motel has table and chairs with ash trays outside all rooms. We would love to stay there again 😍

title: Accommodation close to hospital
text: I presume the room was not always used as it was not very clean.  e.g. dirty grease on top of microwave and kitchen window sill.  Dust, crumbs etc between cushions on sofa. However, bed was really comfortable and excellent shower.  The electric frypan had obviously not been used for some time. I was staying with daughter who had to stay close to hospital overnight and could not be alone

title: Quick stop
text: We stopped here on the way to Taupo, the room was clean and well equipped. There had been some sort of mix up so we were most surprised to find 3 separate bathrooms and a separate curtained area containing an additional 5 beds! Easily the largest room I have ever seen. Easy to find and park,  reception staff were friendly.

title: Cosy and homely near to the Hospital
text: We stayed in one of their rooms with cooking facilities. Very welcoming hosts, the two bedroom unit was spacious enough for us with all the necessary facilities to cook your own meals. Well located with access to shops and supermarkets. Has also a shuttle service to the Hospital. Very clean, with toiletries provided and hair dryer. +++++

title: Emergency visit to Waikato hospital from 17 to 21 March 2016
text: My husband was transferred urgently by ambulance from rotorua to waikato hospital and we didn't get a bed until about after 1am so hospital organised accommodation for me in Colonial motel. At 2.30am I arrived at motel and Heather's husband showed me my room and gave me key and just let me get to rest no questions asked etc. For me that was the best bed and room as I had a very stressful day in hospital since 11am on 16 March and I just wanted to sleep.Ended up staying 4 nights.Facilities very clean, motel very handy to hospital and shops etc.Host even advised me about the hospital shuttle, which is an excellent service for a patient's family especially if you don't know Hamilton. Excellent understanding hosts who took a lot of pressure off me as my accommodation was sorted without any hassles at all. Personal touch goes a long way :-)

title: Great value
text: We stayed for one night while attending a friends birthday. We found the room large, clean, well located, and well priced. It was fairly busy but quiet. The deco was a little out of date but clearly well maintained. A great budget option in Hamilton.

title: Great Size
text: I stayed in the studio apartment which is a great size with a king size bed and two singles, separate (small but ok) kitchen and bathroom. Free wi-fi was great & the price was good. Clean & tidy but unit was right on the road front and I was kept awake by traffic. so if I was to stay again I would not book that unit. Owners were pleasant and helpful.

title: small room
text:
+ it is a family run motel. provides free wifi, 10 min to the big supermarket. and there are some restaurants in 15 min walk 

- the location is a little bit far from the town center. the room is small and and hardly to put our packages. there is no kitchen provided in the motel

title: Good value for money
text:
This is the second time we have stayed at this property. We have found the owners to very pleasant, polite and helpful. The continental breakfast is good, no complaints there, in fact no complaints what so ever in regards to all else.
Great value for money asked.

title: Quaint kinda place
text:
Cricket World Cup NZ Tour

One of those places you're really not sure how to review. I liked the building and its oldie worldy style but the room was tired and in need of freshening up. Wall paper was coming away from the wall with cracked/flaking plaster also evident (see photo's).

Our initial greeting was cool and aloof but in fairness this did get a little warmer later in the evening after a debate over whether breakfast was included in the room rate - it was and was promptly delivered to our room in readiness for the morning.

NB No credit card imprint required here....fair play to them for that and wifi was free of charge.

On departure it was a case of no one there/drop your key on the desk.

title: This Place Has Bed Bugs
text:
WARNING: This place has bed bugs. I was bit by one during the middle of my stay and kept wondering why my back was hurting so much at a particular point. A few days later in Auckland, it finally struck me that it was a bed bug bite. I still can't believe it - I'm thinking of reporting this hotel to the Hamilton's local authorities. 

Otherwise as well, this is a dump of a place with uptight owners. They could do with a little more humility and pleasantness. Stay clear!
hotel_response:
If you ask around Hamilton you will know that Hamilton at this time of the year has midges and they bite
If you were a bit more knowledgeable you would know that if we had bedbugs you would have multiple bites not just one and I could explain to you the pattern of bedbug bites
if Colonial City Motel is so bad why did you stay 5 nights
the reason the owners appeared uptight  and rude (your words) was because you didn't respect their boundaries and insisted on entering their living quarters when you had a question to ask or needed advise. As motel owner we have very little privacy and guard what we have.
As a motel owners we would say avoid this guest

title: Suited us perfectly
text: This motel has a lot going for it. It is close to the CBD, the lake, main sportsgrounds and not too far from the hospital (if like us that's the reason for your stay).  It is an older establishment but it is clean, warm and comfortable.  We found it very good value for money especially when you factor in the continental breakfast and newspaper to start the day.  The upstairs unit we were in had everything we needed and we slept well. (We thought we might have noticed traffic noise given the steepish street location but in fact at night there was little). It was easy to travel to and from other parts of Hamilton from the street the motel is on.

title: Cosy and warm
text: We stayed in one of the studio units last weekend. Although the units look a little tired and there were a few stains in the carpet, overall it is clean warm and comfortable. The couple at reception was very friendly and welcoming. We had breakfast delivered to our unit the next morning which showed up exactly on time and was good. Very good beds, and handy location as it's not too far from the city centre. All in all, we had a good experience and would stay again.

title: Must Read!!!!!
text:
To anybody considering visit Hamilton - stay at the Colonial!! Me and my Fiancé moved to NZ from the UK and needed a place to stay for a week while we looked for a flat. The Colonial provided everything we needed with an added warm welcome and a smile. The room we stayed in was perfect and we got our continental breakfast delivered to our room ever day. 

The location was perfect with the city centre only a 5 minute walk away - Bars, Restaurants and shops in abundance almost at your door step. Absolutely no faults with this wonderfully traditional picturesque hotel. Moreover the owners make all the difference here with their infectious smiles and kind attitude. I would whole heartedly recommend this hotel to anyone - and will be!!

title: Everything You Need
text: Stayed here for 1 night recently. Had to find a place where we could have our wee dog with us. Had unit 8 on the ground floor which was a tastefully furnished, exceptionally clean 1 br unit. Plenty of room, great shower with lovely bathroom. Nice white fluffy towels too :-)

title: Nice little place.
text: We stayed here for one night in late June - the room was warm once we had the heater on and the electric blankets were a god send! Clean enough, lovely people running the place; good for a stopover and reasonably priced!

title: Good value
text: Great location. Handy to the CBD, cafes, bars and arterial roads. Complimentary breakfast was perfect for our short visit.  Helpful staff. Roomy units.  Great price. Starting to look a bit tired and the bathroom could have have a really good clean.  Ran out of hot water on our second morning when they were full.  Relatively quiet, despite being full and the All Blacks were in town!  Would stay again.

title: Should these people be in hospitality?
text:
I phoned this motel as the website indicated a vacany for the nights I wanted to book.  The website blurb said the motel had been built in the 1970's and I wanted to find out if it had been refurbished at all. 
I phoned and introduced myself, said that I saw they had a vacancy, and very politely asked that "I had seen on the website that the motel was built in the 1970's and was enquiring if it had been refurbished since the 70's".  I thought this a perfectly reasonable question, and the answer would be yes or no.  There was a stoney silence, then the woman told me in a cold agressive manner that I had just asked a very insulting question to ask a motel owner and she was not going to answer it.  I was stunned, as I had been polite and thought all motel owners would get asked about their units, after all the guest is paying for the room.  So I apologised, still very politely, and said I was unaware it was an insulting question and I had no intention at all to offend.  This woman, whom I presume to be the owner, continued to tell me what an insulting question it was etc.  Overall I apologised about 4 times, giving the woman the chance to modify her manner and start a reasonable conversation.  Finally I said "well I guess it is inappropriate for me to stay at your motel then?" and she replied "yes".  
This woman was so aggressive and actually left me shaking and in tears.  I was in a vulnerable state as my husband had been transferred to Waikato Hospital and that is why I needed accommodation.  The motel is mentioned on the Waikato Hospital Accommodation Options info sheet, the motel must be dealing with vulnerable people all the time.  
After phoning another motel and getting the best customer service you could ask for (Astra Motor Lodge), I phoned the woman at Colonial City Motel and re-introduced myself, and very politely (again) told her I 'retracted my apology'.
If the motel units have not been refurbished since the 1970's the woman only need say so, she could add that they were 'tidy, clean......" or whatever she felt their redeeming features were.  The response is definitely not to attack the caller.  Why on earth is this woman working in hospitality!!
hotel_response:
you are absolutely right. At that time I should not have been running the office. it was the end of a very bad day
I know that apologies can't go far enough
I should have made an adult decision and shut the business down for the afternoon but thought I could battle through as there was know one here to take over from me
I was wrong

title: Cute as little place
text:
Buildings are older but really nice motel , roomy and well equipt . reasonable beds and bedding , great price .
Lovely hosts and good location.
Walking distance (if not raining to victoria street resturants) and decent parking.
and quiet too.

title: Customer service what customer service
text: Absolutely terrible service had Friend's get into town late in afternoon, motel was no where near full and they couldn't be bothered lady was so rude. Felt horrible for mates ,not to mention that they bought breakfast in cold wrapped in glad wrap as soon as we got there wouldn't even have fed it to my dog
hotel_response:
The reason your mates were turned away is that it was 3.00 am Sunday morning when they requested a room. the arrangement with you was that they would share your unit as you requested.
It is made clear that the office is closed at 9.00 pm. we turn everybody away after that
We at Colonial City Motel are unsure what the problem was with the breakfast. it is advertised as a continental breakfast and is served the evening before so that you, the guest can eat at a time suitable for you. 
 It is an ample breakfast of cereal, fruit to have with the cereal, 2 slices of bread for toast, butter and spread for each slice, fruit juice and milk for the cereal, yes, it is all wrapped in glad wrap as required by the food service industry
 it it your decision as to what you select from quite a wide range. we do have a cooked breakfast option available but you decided against paying for it. Again your decision

title: Excellent Value - Pleasantly surprised
text:
Excellent value, Fabulous location (near the hospital and city centre). You even get free Continental Breakfast when booking with Booking.com .  Very accommodating staff (friendly). Good comprehensive kitchen. 
Great get-away from Auckland. Upgrading of tired rooms in place which will be good for property.

title: Very Pleasant Surprise
text:
We needed a motel at the last minute.  We travel with our dog so we usually book well ahead.
The Colonial welcomed us warmly, including dog.  We had a spacious 1 bedroom unit with kitchenette.  Decor was a little dated, however, everything was spotless.  Free continental breakfast provided for those who eat breakfast.
This will be where we stay in Hamilton in  future.

title: Most dreadful experience ever!
text:
Absolutely dreadful experience!

Bedding and towels were worn thin and grey NOT white! (My floor cleaning cloths are better than their towels! Room dowdy, shabby worn furniture and very small considering it was suppose to be a double room..... The room had a table the size of child's school desk and chair so we had to sit on the bed to eat our meal........ At 8am the following morning we received a call from the owners husband to say they were turning off the water supply within 30mins. The Fire regulation sign in the room had never been completed it would be questionable if the Fire Service would have passed the electrics over the kitchen sink......... Why didn't we complain directly...... We had driven 8hrs that night and simple wanted to get to bed.. The online photographs of the hotel/rooms DID NOT reflect our experience. The following morning we rang the bell at reception but simply left the key on the desk as nobody turned up. Like other customer reviews on this hotel we had also been greeted by the owners negative comments on Booking.com as a company... Think the problem lies with them the hotel owners not Booking.com!

title: Scared!
text: Me and my girlfriend were sent out from the room by a man (I suppose the husband of the lady at the desk, maybe the owners) because we were 10 minutes later than the check-out time that was at 10 am. That man shouted against my girlfriend in an aggressive way and so my girlfriend was very scared of that and started to cry in the car. I travel a lots and it is the first time that happens to me something like that. Very disappointed of that terrible behaviour! Not recommended at all!

title: Value for money and friendly
text:
A somewhat unconventional motel (structurally) with some fairly tired facilities -  but priced accordingly, so if you know what you are going to, you should get good value.

Owners are helpful and friendly, wifi works well, plenty of TV channels and great free breakfasts.

Offsetting that the décor is a bit worn, and in our room (area) the electric circuits overloaded when put under cooking load (soon fixed, but happened several times). And the water has to run a while to get the hot water through.

Nevertheless the above is all priced in, and overall got a perfectly good, large, fully contained room, in central Hamilton for half the price of alternatives.

title: Nice surprise
text:
Was a little wary on viewing the "old" building but our overnight stay in unit 8 was very comfortable. The unit was very clean with  comfortable chairs and bed and a modern bathroom with a good pressure shower-the free continental breakfast was very nicely presented and brought to our room in the evening so we could chose what time to eat. 
Will definitely stay here again. Good location - pleasant surrounds.
We ordered dinner from Scoffers "takeaways for grown ups" - the brochure in the motel needs updating as the prices were incorrect but the meal was well worth the hassle free ordering and delivery.

title: Real Value for Money
text: A lovely motel that was well worth it for $100 per night with a free breakfast, rooms are very clean, and well presented.  It is close to town but very quiet.  The service was great and they were very polite and helpful.  The property offers conference options and catering.  Would recommend to anyone as suiteable to families.

title: Dicey Start, but Turned Out Well
text: I booked this hotel the morning of the day we would arrive on www.booking.com. During booking the stay, I never noticed anything on the site about arrival time. I was unable to get Internet or phone service after booking, so I didn't get to view my confirmation email and I never visited the hotel's actual website.  We arrived late to the hotel after getting lost on our way from coromandel peninsula after encountering closed roads. I was quite exhausted when I rang the bell at 11:30. I was greeted rudely and told it was made VERY clear that the office closed at 9:30 and that it was rude of ME to show up later than that. I asked if she would like me to stay elsewhere. She simply said, "No. You've booked with booking.com so we can't do that." It seems that their real problem is with the way booking.com does business. If they don't want latecomers, they shouldn't have rooms available on booking.com. It was clear they had encountered this problem in the past. I was dreading visiting the front office the next morning after that encounter; however, when I went up in the morning, the owners were very friendly and helpful getting me wifi passwords, laundry detergent and change for the washer and dryer. The room was very nice and breakfast was good. I'm not sure why we got breakfast for only 2 when we had paid extra for our 2 children. The beds were comfortable and the shower was hot. I appreciated the use of the laundry room, but the dryer is very slow. We sat in the parking lot after checkout waiting for our clothes to finish drying. The owner was very helpful in allowing me the use of the phone when we experienced car trouble. She also took the time to help us find shopping and a grocery store. I would recommend this hotel, but beware the booking.com confusion and don't arrive late. You will NOT be greeted kindly, but they will do their best to make up for it the next morning.

title: Don't book this motel
text: My warning to people is not to book this accommodation, worst experience we ever had. Booked through a website then found out they were overcharging us, when we asked the question, they got very offensive,  not a good way to treat your guest. Wasn't happy with their attitude as been in many hotels and motels in my lifetime this one has to take the cake. Even ripped the phone from me when they asked me to call the website booking.com to clarify, wouldn't even let me speak. Even kicked us out because we asked a question, thought we were trying to rip them off but for $20 do you really think it was worth the effort. Ended up staying at a much better place and didn't even mind paying more for it. If I could give a negative score, I would. Highly NOT recommended as there is many more better places and not worth ruining your stay in Hamilton.

title: A Local Treasure
text: This older, unassuming accommodation is full of charm and owner/ manager friendliness. Simple breakfasts brought to your room, and wi-fi included. Could not be more friendly and helpful. Rooms clean, roomy and comfortable.

title: Repeat visitor: excellent service
text:
I come to Hamilton regularly, and never bother calling elsewhere.
If I've ever had a problem with Colonial City, the staff sort it out immediately. 

Comfortable, clean, free wifi, enough milk for tea and cereal, handy location.... unique....

I do not like big noisy impersonal motels. Locally owned and operated can show attention to detail and make me feel at home. 

I'll be back!

title: really dirty rooms
text:
My experience was one of the most dirty rooms I have stayed in. Carpets not vacummed. The sofa had food crumbs everywhere, even the side arm rest. The top edges of the sofa were full of dust. The pictures on the walls were covered in dust. There were ants crawling along the kitchen benches. There were also cobwebs in most corners.There was no vanity bench in the  bathroom.The bathroom slide door was covered in dirty marks. Light switches werecovered in finger marks , Mirriors were not clean, the bedspreads and linen were old and stained with other occupants hairs. the room smelt musty. My husband and I spent 1 hour cleaning the room before we felt comfortable sleeping there. Perhaps it was a bad day from the cleaners but some of the filth seemed to have been there a while.The microwave had a layer of grease and crumbs on the top.The place was looking dated and had torn wallpaper etc. The towels were so old they were grey from the water they have been washed in. There was mould under the headrest in the spa bath. There was no operating fire alarm or smoke detectors within site of the room I stayed in. I dont know how this is safe for paying visitors?
Do not stay in room 17!! The bed was comfortable and the large TV was great.
Perhaps the proprieters should look at there cleaning staff and invest in some new linen and towels. A splash of paint and wallpaper could also improve there situation.

title: I always stay at Colonial City when in Hamilton.
text:
The homey, comfy, local feel of this place, plus the friendly hospitality, efficiency and good value.... I always stay here when in Hamilton. I've stayed on my own, with friends for Parachute Music Festival... It's easy and comfortable and clean. Why am I sharing the best kept secret in Hamilton?!
Reading chair, Sky, kitchenette, safe parking...

title: Fantastic accommodation, fantastic price, fantastic service.
text: We stayed her for 3 days while we were in Hamilton for a wedding. We stayed in a one bedroom unit which was more than large enough for the two of us. The place was tidy and the bathroom was so clean and immaculate. The bed was comfortable and there was plenty of parking. Very easy to find and close to the centre, we will most definitely be staying here again and we would recommend this place to people who want an affordable and enjoyable stay. Cheers!

title: Friendly place.
text:
A very friendly place but a little dated (renovations are currently underway).   Large sitting room , bedroom, kitchen and updated bathroom with large shower (room 1).  Good breakfast , a short walk into the center of town, wifi and a nice deck area for the summer months.
Reasonable rates and friendly service.

title: A disappointing stayin Hamilton, NZ
text:
Perhaps it was our mistake for selecting a studio for 2 mature adults.
The studio was advertised as equipped with a kitchenette, stove. 

The studio was a small  room which was enough to accommodate a twin bed not a double bed, and the small desk with a single chair was not aimed for two people stay.
The kitchenette had no hot plates as advertized but an eletric frying pot. The washroom next to the room was tiny with no heater.  The place was visited by a large cockroach, and apparently this happends when it is wet and cold outside.  The internet access was free from the motels dining place,  but their beutiful & friendly cat named Elizabeth left her hair on the computer and the chairs around as she was used to snuggling up on them, and the chairs had cloth cover.

The nice thing was the owner's  / manager's attitude , name Heather, who upon a request checked with Bookings.com and with a smile& without a penalty  refunded us the prepaid additional day's stay so we could get out and move on with our trip.  

To be fair we checked other rooms, and found the curtains old, a bit dingy, and insufficient to keep the outside lifgts from penetrating the room for a good noght stay. In fact I had to unscrew a light bulb in front of our "studio" room.

Even at the price NZ $ 85/night with breakfast ( basic food brought to the room night in advance ) we found the place disappinting and would not recommend the place to anyone.

It had planty of parking, but the street was difficult to find as it is not well marked at the roundaround.

title: Historic sleep
text: This is just what you see in most pictures. The place is just so nice and historic as it seems. We only stopped over for a night on our drive through New Zealand. But that does not change the fact that this is a clean, simple and with good space.

title: Great location, great people
text:
Since we were there in the off season, we were automatically upgraded to the next best room, which was huge and very nice for the money. 
The location is very good, within walking distance from all the bars and restaurants, the rugby field, and the park. Highly recommend having a run around the lake. 
The breakfast was also good, delivered directly to our room. 
Overall a very pleasant budget stay.

title: Great Value, Great Location
text: Friendly welcome, handily situated, clean warm unit. Stayed in studio unit which was very comfortable- free plunger coffee as well as free internet. Could not fault it- and price was extremely reasonable. Will be back.

title: Great place, great location,great service
text: I was extremely happy staying at this motel.Not only was the owners Heather & John helpful & friendly but everything was easy to get to and the service was really good.I stayed here for 6 days during the Easter period and ordered breakfast which was wonderful and always on time!!The only downfall was the shortage of parking which due to its popularity made it hard to get a park if your away for a period of time..but all in all it was a great stay and I enjoyed it.The rooms were clean and the beds were so comfortable.As for being so close to town you could here the sounds of distant clubs within the CBD but wasn't enough to keep you up at night.So a job well done I will be looking forward to booking this motel when coming back to Hamilton!!

title: Comfortable and cheap as chips!
text: Two adults for $100/night special - my daughter and I spent three nights in Hamilton at Colonial City - what a great deal.  2 hours free internet each/night, good beds, reasonable shower pressure, tidy and clean facilities, flat screen TV with some Sky.  Five minutes into the city, good parking at the motel, friendly hosts.  Rated Very Good rather than Excellent only because of dated interior.  However, would stay again without question.

title: Free Internet
text: The owners were very helpful and accommodating, they even lent us an umbrella to walk into town. Lots of local art in the town and nice restaurants.

title: Good value and quiet
text: Good clean quite accommodation with free parking. 5 miniute walk into Hamilton CBD. The staff were friendly and helpful and the facilities modern. Good value and I would stay again.

title: Vaccuum Anyone?
text: This motel is very close to the CBD, which suited us perfectly and the main reason we chose to stay here. Service was also very polite. First impressions of this motel is that it would be cheap and affordable (which it was) although I was not expecting the "budget room" to mean that the cleaners actually skip cleaning the room properly. The floor was covered in grit and had not been vacuumed-nor had the rubbish and used soaps been removed from the shower.

title: Good, Clean & value for money
text: A little way off the beaten track & road noise a bit much as it's near the hospital.  Owners friendly & helpful.

title: clean, spacious and central
text: My 60+ year old parents and aunt & uncle stayed at this hotel for a long weekend and found it perfectly met their needs. They were impressed by the cleanliness and simplicity, with money and care clearly spent on ensuring the basics are perfect with no unecessary costs for frills. Good beds, linen, towels, kitchen facilities. Slightly dated decor but all tidy and in perfect working order and clean. It's a central hotel and yet they had a view of the hills from over the treetops, which was uplifting and made it all seem more spacious. They enjoyed the quirky features like the rounded tops of the doors, and also found the proprietors friendly and eager to please. Excellent value for money, and they recommend it to all travellers.

title: Ok for the price we paid
text:
This hotel has received some fairly harsh reviews on TripAdvisor and elsewhere, and whilst we agree with some of the comments, our room was not as bad as other reviews would have suggested. We cannot compare to other accommodation in Hamilton, but believe our one night stay was acceptable for the price paid.

Firstly, and most importantly, our two bedroom room was clean, and did not smell of cigarette smoke Inon smoking room).  The beds were firm and comfortable. We did not notice mould in the room as reported by others.

However, it is fair to say that the accommodation is 'tired' overall...  it is an older style and a complete face lift would do wonders (and probably increase the room rate too).

Kitchen facilities: only one pan and one saucepan without lid, but a good set of cutlery, other cooking utensils and crockery.  Microwave and large fridge (without freezer).  The kettle smelt of bleach so we boiled water for tea in the microwave.

Bedroom: Some photos show bedside lamps, but there were none in our room, and we couldn't find any power points in the main MR.

HVAC: heater in living area only, and two standing fans provided.  No air-conditioning, which was a downside as the room was uncomfortably warm.  We couldn't' use the fan in the main bedroom since we couldn't find any power points.  Open the door and windows for flow through ventilation.

Bathroom: did have two face towels provided for four of us (other reviews report none provided, but  not having face towels is common in our experience). We agree that the water pressure was lower than average. The wash basin was large and modern.

Noise: The complex didn't appear full based on the car park, and noise from other guests wasn't noticed.  A storm water drain right outside the rear of the unit is also used for some grey water, and this was disturbingly noisy when others were using their bathroom when we were trying to sleep.

WiFi: OK

Location: Pak n Save is walking distance and countdown is close by too.

We didn't have any issues with the reception staff

Overall, ok for our one night stay, but nothing special.  We noted many other 'with vacancy' accommodation available during our stay - maybe there are other places in Hamilton that represent better value for money.

title: Not the best
text: The hotel room that we stayed in was clean, definitely not modern but it was spacious. We felt the room was a bit uncomfortable, as the room door was not secure. The hotel is located in a great street.

title: Awful
text:
This motel is awful. It is in need of some serious upgrade and renovation. The rooms smell of cigarette smoke and, although bedding is clean and kitchen is clean, the utensils are limited. Ie a pot with no lid, no colander, no sieve. Bread knives and cutting knives but no bread board etc. the bathroom looks like a dormitory bathroom straight from the 70’s and they are not cheap! 
Not recommended for families. If you have no other option then take it.

title: Horrible experience
text:
Service was crappy the male who greeted us didn't speak english very well, demanded we pay him $100 cash bond (I didn't realise this was a thing??) I didn't read it anywhere upon booking the hotel. 
Anyway the room was scungy we paid $179 and it smelt gross the bed was hard and uncomfortable the hotel was just really old and run down. My partner noticed a PowerPoint that was partially black and really hot to touch and the plastic had melted but when my partner showed the owner he didn't seem to be worried and seemed as though he knew it was there already, once we took him to our unit. 
Would never go back.

title: Crappy
text: Unit absolutely stunk of cigarette. Price was okayish. But disappointment with the smell. Wifi was weak. No pressure in shower. Says king bed, hello it's a queen bed. Only good thing was it was close to town. Said sky TV, only 2 sports channels. No movie Channel.. Disappointed to say.. . Won't be back!!!

title: Terrible service
text: Booked accomodation on booking.com a while back. Then while I was away and not checking my emails they tried to charge my credit card and it declined, so they sent an email asking me to update the credit card . I contacted 24 hours later to sort this out and they had already cancelled the booking and given the room to someone else. This booking was still a month out so there was plenty of time to try sort things out with me. They did not even try to ring me which would have got the problem sorted and avoided this. When questioned about their timing and not calling they seemed to think this was a completely reasonable thing to do and that not ringing me is ok because I had booked through booking.com

title: Substandard
text:
June 2017, our staff stayed at the Cedar Lodge Motel for business.  Needless to say, we certainly wont be staying there again.   I agree with RockinRealt0r's comments.
The photos are extremely misleading.  It states that the motel has recently been refurbished. The 2 bedroom family unit hadn't been refurbished in probably 30 years!.  There was a rug on the floor that had curled up along the edges causing a trip hazard.  There was mould in the shower.  The room actually smelt damp and unclean. There were cockroaches. The pressure in the shower was non existent.  The WiFi was very slow.  It kept on dropping off.  There was an issue with the light bulb.  It was flickering.  The bulb was replaced but it needed an electrician.  Double check their terms and conditions before booking!  We needed to change our booking, as  our circumstances had changed.  We tried to cancel the weekend, we were coming back on the Monday.  Only to be told no.  So we were charged for 3 nights and the motel wasn't used.  I believe this is because they are so sub standard that they struggle to get bookings.  They charged our credit card at time of booking in full, when we were not due to arrive for another 2 weeks.  Contrary to their booking policy!  This is appalling. Don't believe what you see and don't believe what you hear.  They mislead us.

title: Overpriced and very dated decor
text: A one night stay for one adult for $259 was outrageous.  The unit would have been perfect for the 60's film 'Psycho'.  tiny tv,  no bedside lights, no faceclothes, the water pressure in the shower was abysmal. I had stayed in a almost new motel in Hamilton the night before at $175 including ultra modern glazed shower and luxury bathroom fit out including large towells and heated towell rail,  all the bells and whistles charging unit for mobile phones, a mini kitchen with full range of items.   The on duty person was pretty much 'thats the price?'  when I made a comment even before I found out how sub standard the unit was.

title: Well situated and comfy
text:
In studio unit in front, adequate but noisy during night with traffic noise. Unit nice and clean and lovely large towels in bathroom. However no shelves or cabinet in bathroom to place anything on other than the floor. No dishcloth supplied to wipe up water etc on bench. Lovely bed linen and comfy bed.
Will stay again but would ask for a unit down back.

title: Practically perfect in every way!
text: Lovely place for a family to stay. Full kitchen, clean and spacious rooms, great location. We loved our stay here- the manager turned the heater on before we arrived, and unlike other units with kitchens, our beds were made and rooms tided daily. Laundry on site was a great bonus. We'd stay here again in an instant.

title: 2 nighter
text: We had a studio unit bit tired needed updateing but overall clean and spacious. Good size towels and comfy bed, full kitchen facilities.close to cbd casino,and rugby stadium. Free of street parking, overall enjoyed our stay.

title: Freindly helpful host.
text: Had a real comfy bed and the staff at Cedar Lodge were very freindly and helpful. The rooms were serviced daily very well. Thanks Cedar Lodge there was free 1gb a day internet and even bikkies  free good stuff.

title: Does the job at a reasonable price
text: This is just a motel, nothing flash, rooms OK, service OK. I wouldnt go out of my way to recommend it but i wouldnt put anyone off either. If you just need somewhere to stay for a couple of nights whilst you explore Hamilton then its fine, if you want somewhere you can relax and enjoy pick somewhere else

title: BAD BAD BAD!
text: I booked with my niece and family to stay 3 nights to attend her mothers funeral. Upon entering the room there was a very bad smell. Dirty mats on top of grubby carpet. The place is worn and dated. The beds however were dressed in good clean bed linen, but that was the only positive feature. During the night my niece who has asthma was unable to sleep due to the mouldy mildewy smell and had to take an antihistamine. There was no way, we could stay another night, so asked to be refunded the two nights due to unsanitary conditions. The owner fobbed us off and refused to acknowledge the situation thereby refusing to authorise the two night refund via WOTIF. Internet access was limited and very slow.  Very disappointing for all parties. Pleased be warned of the condition of Cedar Lodge at 174 Ulster St Hamilton.

title: Hamilton 3 nights
text:
Stayed 3 nights at the Cedar Lodge Motel. This is located in a zone rich with motels of which many are bright and flash.The Cedar may not be the newest or flashiest in the area but it was priced right for 3 nights ,was tidy and above all was very very very clean.We booked a studio unit for 3 nights but on arrival the manager told us as seen as we were staying longer than 1night he put us in a bedroom unit .The unit had a separate  kitchen ,very large bathroom .The bedroom was roomy and the bed plus pillows were excellent. Actually it was almost a one bed room flat.Sky tv with main sport and movie channel .Supermarket and two local bars an easy 5 or so minutes walk. 
Down side no radio 

We would as we will be going to Hamilton again this year will stay again

title: Don't below photos
text: Looked at website and thought it would be a good place to stay but were extremely disappointed. Photos looked excellent but stayed in a room with two extra beds, but one of the extra beds was so uncomfortable and not long enough for a adult.  The surroundings of the property was a bit scary walking into.  Feel for the four star qualmark rating but wondering how this was even achieved?

title: Average - NOT 4 Star!!
text: Definitely not a 4 star, fully refurbished motel. Website photo's a bit misleading. Had trouble with the WIFI, however was sorted by the Manager within half an hour. Missing Handle on the pantry door, glasses not clean and broken. Shower turned off after a minute - was able to turn back on however. Double bed was hard, needs new pillows and perhaps a double pillowcase to prevent stains! Bed Linen was ok, sheets were nice and white and beds made well. Noise - from the room next door was TERRIBLE. Have had no sleep, was not able to contact the Manager to ask to speak to the occupants next door, no number on the telephone so had to use cell phone to try call. No Answer! Please update your website accordingly. Will not be back.

title: Great value and good service
text: We came across this place late on a Sunday after a booking elsewhere fell through. The receptionist was very helpful, negotiated a good price and the room was clean and tidy. The room itself was a little tired but all the bedding and kitchen appliances were brand new. The bed was very comfortable. Great value and a good choice in front of the neighbouring chain motels

title: Bad management & drab and run down units..
text: Had a very bad experience at this motel, when we arrived, queried the spa that was advertised, was told that it was not operating, when queried if we could get the room any cheaper due to this issue were told he would discount $4, having little choice for other accommodation, went with this option.  When checked into room, found a 4 pack power box ran right behind  the kitchen sink to operate the microwave and jug. Extremely dangerous!!  Have passed on to OSH.  Manager was very rude, and constantly came walking past our room and looking in.  Room itself was quite dated, and the pillows were extremely uncomfortable.  When checking out, manager, made us wait in the rain while he checked the room over, he complained that there was one flannel missing which was never there when we checked in.  He did not query how our stay was and we left with no words being spoken.  Very rude and would definitely not go back to this motel even if I was paid to..

title: Tired
text:
We stayed at this motel for 2 nights. We could have walked out the first night as apart from the bedroom the unit was tired and smelly.The kitchen and bathroom were very old and the shower was useless.The Kitchen has an extension cord running behind the taps to a 4 multibox that went to the microwave and electric jug. Highly illegal. The window in the kitchen was a slider and did not have a lock.and no curtains.
The picture advertising this motel is of the bedroom which looks fine but wait till you see the rest of unit.

title: Not sure what to call it
text: Stayed here for two nights. Two different rooms. Both the same set up. One bedroom apartment. The bed in the bedroom is awesome pillows are great. Ok that was the good bits. The first impression was bad, its Very tired but a new coat of paint. The showers just dribble. There is no pressure. The bathroom toilet kitchen are all 1950 vintage and need replacing. The carpet is recoloured nylon. The first room i had roaches and other insects join me in the shower. Not what i consider comforting at 6am. There is no airconditioning. Do yourself a favor there are much better hotels just down the road. Or across the road or anywhere.

title: Excellent Motel in the Town
text:
Very good location and staff is very helpful and friendly. Neat,tidy,spotless. Comfortable beds. Large bathroom. Wonderful hosts.
Warm and comfortable Best place I have stayed in clean modern and value for money.

title: All good
text: We enjoyed our stay at the motel, our room was large and had every thing we needed for a family of 3 adults and 3 children 1 of whom they let stay for free, it was the cheapest motel by far in the whole of the city and in a good location. We will stay there again for the price and convenience of location.

title: Never again. As JanePete says. Very very expensive for what it is. Possibly a one star if you are lucky.
text:
This was our second visit. This time under new management. Nothing had been fixed, replaced, repaired or even painted since our previous visit of twelve months ago. The ceilings were still damp and mouldy, and the three rooms we had were damp. Broken latches on doors, extremely poor heating etc. The beds we two singles pushed together....etc etc etc

We considered $300 per night per room extremely excessive and will not be returning.

title: Very Disappointing place - wont go again
text:
Hamilton was booked out for Field Days and this place was all we could book.
It costs $450 for the one room for the night. Beds were supposed to be x2 doubles and x2 singles as it was for our workers.
When they got there the room had only three beds, and one pull down! Not good enough for four grown men!
The Manager argued the room was booked for 2 people, and had to have the booking request put in his face before he accepted he was wrong - but did nothing.
The place was freezing cold with not heating.
The room door had no latch to lock it and blew open during the night!!
There was assorted clothes left in the drawers in one room - clearly not cleaned out!
The rooms were grubby and not what you would expect in a hotel in 2015 in NZ.
$450? What a huge rip-off!!

title: Not 4 star but definitely affordable for large family
text: First impression from the outside I knew instantly I was not going to enjoy my stay, inside the décor and carpets only reinforce my view!  What drew me to this accommodation was the "extra large spa pool" and it did not disappoint.  We were a family of 6 including 4 children and booked the family room which had 2 separate bedrooms, king bed in one and 2 single beds in the other room with 2 single beds in the lounge. Cost for night $170. Alternative lowest accommodation in Hamilton was $260. The décor was definitely dated, carpets need replacing as terribly stained however the it had all the facilities and the beds were clean and comfortable. Time in the spa at 9.30pm ensured the kids were well asleep within 10 minutes after they got out. Would recommend for large families or groups wanting to stay together, large space in this unit.  Games room needed a good clean, let down by neglect on exterior and reception could do with a clean.

title: Unsatisfied
text: Friendly enough owners but wouldnt stay here again.  Shower was mouldy, didnt have proper toilet paper, main bed was rock hard and from the 1970's, jug was broken & rusting inside of it. Very uncomfortable sleep not at all what we expected

title: Great value
text: Free wifi, full kitchen, separate bedroom, clean, convenient, seniors rate and $85 a night. What more could we want! Not flash, but friendly service and we were told we could pay when we left - how many motel owners would trust their guests so much? Highly recommended.

title: Average at best
text: Did not really meet expectations created by web advertising. The service was fine, but the room and buildings are not really up to much. The are dated and not particularly clean. Things in the room were mixed in terms of what worked and what didn't. We were not greatly impressed and would not go back. As for price it was on the cheap side but not so much that you would expect a 'cheap' standard.

title: home away from home!
text: Just came back from a trip to Hamilton staying overnight at Cedar Lodge Motel. What a big difference from the other place across the road which charged us $100 for just the two of us. We thought to try a different place and decided on Cedar Lodge Motel. We were not disappointed. Value for money, fresh clean linens, spacious, full kitchen facilities and a walking distance to the CBD. Will definitely be back...!

title: Good value for Money
text: Quite an old motel but very spacious unit. Plenty cutlery and crockery for our group. Great to be able to cook dinner every nite in our unit. Unit could do with a make over as curtains rather dated. Didnt try spacious spa. Parking outside unit was great.

title: Good for families
text: the 2 bedroom units are good and spacious for families. our family of 5 stayed there no probs. nice family owners would definately stay again. dont listen to the hater feedback if your a family with kids its algud.

title: Drive straight past!
text: Over priced, dirty, dated and smelly. No exaggeration. Our room was plain nasty. Was so disgusted by the state of it, we took the loss of money, ($110) and stayed across the road. Thankfully we had only booked for one night. Definately not recommended.

title: Suited us fine.
text:
Our third visit in recent years and last weeks was the best yet.
 In our `eighties` we think it is commendable and correspondent jamben1
is a nut-case.Arrigato.

title: Great for the bills
text: I have stayed in for a couple of days there. It just was a classic motel you would often encounter throughout nz but there was a large spa I've enjoyed, and the staff was friendly. The room I stayed was one of the most spacious ones I have ever stayed in my life. Best of all, price was right!

title: Give this place a miss!!
text: This is an overpriced, outdated motel.  Hasn't been updated since it was built.  Heating consisted of a small fan heater that didn't work properly.  Had to turn on the oven and open the door to try and get some heat.  Only some of the electric blankets worked.  There were no smoke detectors in the rooms, nor any type of fan or heating in the bathroom.  A very uncomfortable stay - never again.

title: Clean and comfortable
text: Our room was very clean and comfortable and provided everything we needed. We booked it for the location as it was close to a venue we attended the following day.  We asked if we could stay the following night as well and were given a discounted price as we booked direct with the motel. The lady on reception was lovely.  Would definitely stay again.

title: 3 Nights
text:
We booked very short-term (booked in the morning for arrival in the afternoon). 
Very quiet even though it's next to the main street and safe. Basic but got everything you need and the owner is really friendly. 
Close to the golf range.

title: No access provided, charged as no-show
text:
Very disappointing experience.

I chose this motel based on its high rating, but the reality was completely different.

I made the booking through an online platform and informed the motel in advance that I might arrive very late, asking whether free cancellation was possible. My message was seen but never replied to, so I withdrew the cancellation request.

After an 8-hour drive, I arrived at around 4:00am. There was no key left, no lockbox, no late check-in instructions, and no one answered the phone despite multiple attempts.

Because I could not access the room at all, I did not receive the accommodation service. Despite this, the motel later marked the booking as a no-show and charged the full amount.

I would strongly advise other travellers to be very cautious, especially if you may arrive outside standard office hours or rely on communication from the property.

title: Highly Recommend – Great Value & Comfort
text: Fantastic stay! The motel is neat and inviting, and my room was huge, modern, spotless, and super comfortable. The bed was incredibly comfy, with plenty of space to relax. Great kitchen, big smart TV, and a lovely shower. The host was welcoming and happily let me check in early. It felt safe, quiet (even when full), and the price was very affordable. I’ll definitely be back and highly recommend it. Only small niggle — the shower head is a bit high, but no big deal!

title: AuTO LODGE-HAFLTON’S DREAM MOTEL
text:
AUTO LODGE- HAMILTON’s DREAM MOTEL

My husband and I stayed one night at Auto Lodge Motel in Hamilton on 9/7/2025. Below is our observations:

GOOD POINTS:

1.Super clean. In fact, cleaner than clean. I met the wonderful lady cleaner in early morning of 11/7/2025.

2.Excellent service provided by the lovely Korean lady owner. She gave me with a beautiful smile and greetings. 

3.Perfect location on motel alley.

4.Complimentary bottle of milk and two mini packets of Cookies Time chocolate biscuits are the highlight of this fantastic motel.

5.We are fascinated by the History of this lovely motel. 

BAD POINTS:
NONE

ADVICE: We highly recommend you to stay at this motel if you happen to visit Hamilton.

title: Clean Rooms
text: This motel is nice and clean but doesn't have cooking facilities but does have a jug and toaster so you can make your breakfast and also a cup of tea or coffee.   We were given fresh milk on arrival.   The rooms are nice and clean and comfortable.   We had a two bedroom apartment and there is plenty of car parking.   It is in easy walking of the shops and a nice hotel where we had a nice dinner.   The gentleman on reception when we checked in was very friendly and gave us some ideas where we could go for dinner

title: A very clean and comfortable motel
text: An excellent motel, very modern room and very clean. Well equipped with all you need for an overnight stay. Good location not far from Waikato hospital. Excellent manager. Lots of parking outside the units. We had a king size room which was very spacious and had everything that we needed.

title: Great work space with a long work bench and well placed powerpoints, clean and tidy
text: I loved that large work desk.  I had a lot of writing to do and this was one of the best places I have stayed at for the extra lond bench at a perfect height to work on my laptop.  So it really helped.  The room was very clean and not cluttered.  The bed was big and comfortable.  I liked it and if I have another work trip in Hamilton I know where I will go.  Thanks.

title: Great place to stay
text: Well maintained comfortable unit. Very clean and tidy.  Awesome shower with plenty of space. Well equipped with lots of electrical sockets. Wonderful super king bed. Love the dreamview milk provided. Friendly cleaner. Can’t fault it at all.

title: My husband, teen son and I had a fabulous stay at this motel, really comfortable, quiet and value for money.
text:
Very modern and tidy motel.
Nice new bathroom fittings, great shower and good hair and body wash products.
Sky chanels a bonus Freeview on extra tv in seperate bedroom.
Set well back from the main road with double glazed windows, so very quiet.
Good spacious parking, nice and central.

title: Place to stay
text:
Friendly service. Room is spotless and well.presented. HD TV with all channels. King size bed.  Booking was quick and no fuss. Plenty of parking. Reasonably priced. We couldnt fault it.  .........located at 297 Ulster St, Hamilton,,....,..................................
.

title: Would highly recommend
text: What a superb unit. It was clean spacious and warm. The bed was AMAZINGLY comfortable.  (Now to convince my husband we need a memory foam mattress.) We had made a mistake in booking the wrong dates with bookings.com and John was great with organizing the refund. Would definitely stay again and would recommend to others.

title: We had a great stay - highly recommended
text: Highly recommended, a well presented and clean room which had everything needed, a comfortable bed, double glazed to reduce noise, great shower, large TV screen with plenty of channels.  Really nice to get the Cookietime cookies and also really liked the fresh milk in the room and the story behind it, much appreciated. Great location and an easy walk to the centre of town.

title: Work getaway
text: Clean/quiet/best nights sleep.. Grt bed.. Immaculate.. Stayed elsewhere in Hamilton for 2 nights previously.. Should have picked this first.. Also loved bottle of milk in fridge rather than small cartons or even worse.. Small touches were very appreciated.. Even used the iron!! Will be back

title: Caution: In Emergency Housing Zone - very noisy!
text: Take care.  This motel is in the middle of an emergency housing area and offers emergency housing in-house as well, so very noisy with emergency customers sitting outside rooms from early till late talking and drinking.  3 motels across road all full of emergency housing occupants and noise levels were high till late with fighting and yelling to all hours.  I was a single female traveller and felt unsafe outside of my room.  Room was basic but tidy and fresh although priced highly for the area and noise levels.

title: Great reception staff.
text:
The reception staff were wonderful.
We required a superking bed,  which we got.  It was very comfortable.

The negatives we found were:
The bathroom had been re-furbished,  but was not totally finished,  There were gaps in the tiling, the ceiling wasn't painted. There were very minimal toiletries,  only 1 towel each.   The floor wasn't very clean.
An only mentioning this as the room cost $220.

title: The best value for money hotel in New Plymouth
text: Our room was excellent value for money, good size, view of the ocean, and small balcony. The reception staff were excellent, friendly and professional and keen to help with what ever we needed. We visited to walk the Pouakai Crossing and it was a great base. They do a good packed lunch for the trip.

title: We WILL return!
text: We've stayed at many motels in  Hamilton City and this one was the best. It was very comfortable and clean with  friendly professional staff. We found the location to be very handy to the City center and  though on a busy road our room was quiet. It's  easy to find and access. We thought it to be good value and were able to heat our meals there in a microwave. They provided a good fridge, dish-washing facilities and adequate utensils. There was a more extensive "shared kitchen" nearby. A supermarket is close as is public transport.  We enjoyed "Sky TV" movies and the fantastic shower. Even the sunset was a stunner! Thanks John and family.

title: Great stay
text: Lovely motel, very clean and tidy. Good parking. Been freshly decorated. Has everything we needed. Got chocs on arrival. Good parking. Would recommend staying here. Very good location. Spacious rooms.

title: Clinical
text: Clean but very clinical.  We were  surprised to find there were no cooking facilities in the room. You had to go to the other end of the motel to a very basic communal kitchen if you wanted to cook anything.

title: Super clean and friendly welcome
text:
Stayed a night to break up drive from Wellington to Waiheke. Room was lovely - super clean and comfortable. Arrived later in the evening and room was nice and warm. Really friendly welcome as well. 

Will definitely stay again.

title: Great place to stay
text: Clean modern rooms, good service and location on location just north of city centre.  Will stay again.  Helpful staff, good Sky TV in rooms.   Close to a good selection of restaurants if needed.  Nothing bad to say!

title: Great option in Hamilton
text:
Stayed for two nights. The room was recently refurbished and very clean.  It was quiet despite being next to a busy road and the in room facilities were definitely above average compared to many nz motels an air-conditioner to keep the temperature constant and a very good TV.
You can't cook in the room but a shared kitchen is provided. We went out as its close to loads of places.

title: Two day stay at the end of our visit to New Zealand
text: The motel is well placed within walking distance from the city centre. Additionally there is a bus stop outside the property if walking isn't possible.  The queen studio room which we booked was well serviced and exceptionally clean.  The manager/proprietor of the property was very welcoming and nothing was too much trouble for him.  It was great to  be able to park outside the door to our room.  The serviced laundry facility was great too - extremely prompt and good value.

title: A real Gem among the competition
text: We found this motel to be clean, quiet, and really comfortable on a recent weekend trip to visit grandchildren. Over the years we've stayed at quite a few locations in Hamilton on our visits and this one is both memorable and repeatable.

title: Excellent place, just off Ulster Street
text: Very clean, good sized room , friendly owner , would recommend , close to City Centre, supermarket And eateries , been here last three years for Fielddays at Mystery Creek and always clean and immaculately presented inside

title: Hidden gem
text: Looks a little dated from the road but units are lovely. Looks like it has been recently redecorated and is very nicely done. Unit was spotlessly clean. We arrived after reception had closed, by arrangement, and key was left out and heat and electric blankets turned on which was a lovely touch. Lots of car parking and, although just off a busy road, we couldn’t hear any traffic noise. Located a little bit out of town but is still just a $10-$15 taxi ride. Good value for money. Would stay there again and happily recommend.

title: A perfect nights stay
text:
After visiting our sea ( country) change daughter & her family in Napier my wife & I decided on a night stopover in Hamilton before driving to Auckland I/airport & flying home to Sydney the next day & chose the Auto Lodge based on previous reviews.     Nothing overly spectacular about the outside of this motel but the most important part, the inside, in my opinion was faultless. Friendly owners, updated modern rooms with high quality fittings. The queen bed was super comfortable & the larger than normal shower area was great ( no cramped nose to wall cubicle here) & the bathroom itself was very modern & immaculately clean. 
The wall mounted TV was easily viewed while reclining in bed & the small glass table & two chairs were very convenient & there is plenty of safe off street parking.
Quite frankly one of the best motels my wife & I have stayed in....well done to the owners.

title: just beautiful
text: This motel was just what I needed. Although on a major road, it was quiet, and there was ample car-parking space. The room was on the ground floor. It was a spacious well-appointed room with kitchenette and a larger size shower cubicle - space to move. It was all scrupulously clean. Good sized wardrobe with iron and ironing board. Plenty of power outlets to charge up devices. Good quality kitchen appliances, no rubbish here. The large wall-mounted TV was well-positioned for viewing from the bed. The free WiFi was very handy. The large bed was firm and comfortable with high quality bedlinen and pillows, making for a good night's sleep. I would have been happy to stay longer if I had the time.

title: Great Stay - Great Price!
text: Hamilton is full of motels but on my next visit I won’t even bother doing a comparison - The Auto Lodge was perfect and I’ll be back. There was quite a difference on line between the Auto Lodge’s room rate and some of the other hotels I had stayed at before so I wasn’t sure what to expect but I was pleasantly surprised to find that the rooms are modern with everything you need. Definitely the best value for money that I’ve ever found in Hamilton. The studio rooms aren’t huge but certainly big enough for 2. The bed, shower, TV, Wifi, a/c are all great and the room is very clean. We didn’t cook but there’s a shared kitchen on site with big tables, work surfaces and real ovens rather than a pathetic cooktops that most motels squeeze into a room. The location was perfect and the management was friendly and very helpful. Great experience all round.

title: Excellent room. Quiet and clean
text: Great room. Stayed here overnight instead of Raglan which was seriously overpriced. Very clean, friendly staff, quiet, safe parking. What's not to like. $100NZ for the room. Friendly staff and family owned.

title: Nice motel
text:
Clean room as it’s a newer or renovated
