Staff were so friendly & very helpful
comfortable bed 
Great shower & bathroom was clean 
Nice well equipped kitchenette
Free parking & good free wifi 
5 mins to town

title: Excellent accommodation
text:
Parking right outside the front. Very quick check-in and check-out. 
Good showers. Comfortable rooms. Double bed in front room and two single beds in separate room. Easy to access Hamilton from accommodation, a few minutes in a taxi. Staff were very welcoming.

title: A super motel
text: This motel has been completely upgraded. Nice decor clean and fresh. Lots of parking and a room at the back with ovens and table and chairs if you want to cook or when we here a group of cyclists. Quiet being on the main motel drag into town Te rapa end. Friendly owner in the office. Short drive into Hamilton restaurant area. Value for money.

title: Great value for money!!
text: Can't fault this motel. The rate was very reasonable . Room was very clean, bed was comfy, the location was handy to everything & the staff were very friendly. We would definitely stay here again & recommend it to others.

title: Great value for money
text:
This motel has been extensively refurbished with double glazing, heat pumps, new bathrooms and carpet etc. The rooms are exceptionally clean and well presented. 
I travelled with five colleagues and well all slept well and found our rooms more than adequate.

title: Excellent choice
text: We arrived on a freezing cold evening, tired from a long day.  What a welcome when we got to our room.  Heat pump was on to the max  which instantly warmed us, and not only that, but the thoughtful owners had also turned the electric blankets on as well.  This was so appreciated.  The room was spotlessly clean and had everything we needed for our one night stay.    In fact, being so cindirtsble here, and Hamilton temperatures being so cold, we were wishing our circumstances allowed us to stay a bit longer.  Highly recommend this motel.

title: Relaxing
text: Excellent Service at Reception, the rooms themselves - very clean, fresh, warm, all conveniences provided, big TV, even though on the main highway, couldn't hear traffic, so no road noise was a big plus - be happy to stay here again

title: Great Motel Stop
text: This motel appears a normal run of the mill motel but inside it is a very, very pleasant surprise.  Recently upgraded it is spotlessly clean, everything works, shower and general level of fittings are of high quality.  Silent and warm with double glazing and heat pump and all 52 Sky channels and free WiFi.  The owner couple were delightful and helpful in all ways.  We stayed for four nights and will definitely stay there again and recommend to others.

title: Extremely good value
text:
Auto Lodge offers excellent accommodation for a very reasonable cost. Amenities are very modern (maybe even brand new?) and spotless. Great bed and pillows, huge TV, very quiet heat pump and super shower. Easy to find and not far from supermarket and eating places.
Would unreservedly recommend this place and would always use it ourselves in future.

title: Great Motel
text: The Room i was given was upstairs and above reception it was spacious the bathroom and room actually were modern i loved that it was spotless i had driven down for work sorry i was about 15mins too late from check out time but they did not charge easy to deal with :)

title: Nice, well-appointed accommodation
text: Very friendly and helpful staff. Clean, spacious, nicely decorated room with good lighting for reading. One of the few accommodations we have stayed in with unlimited internet that just works – without the need to reconnect or re-enter passwords. Trouble-free TV too. Only five minutes' drive from city centre. Note that the unit is not set up for cooking but a communal kitchen is provided.

title: Auto Lodge review
text: Great place to stay, very modern with all your needs covered. Good location with in the Hamilton region. Cooking facilities are offered and rooms have appliances for reheating. Comfortable beds, satellite tv and aircon.

title: Good location
text: This hotel is on the edge of the sea. Great location for trips across to Devonport and other sea trips Basic rooms but clean. Restaurant and bar also but good and food basic but excellent. Staff are wonderful.

title: Great Motel in a handy location
text:
this motel has been refurbished to a very high standard and has nice bedding and very clean amenities.
Bus transport outside the motel and the staff are very helpful and friendly.
It is very close to the CBD and has a supermarket nearby

title: Booking date
text:
Made a mistake with booking date-I am travelling over for a funeral and was a little upset at time of booking. I explained this and tried to get hotel to change it. They refused and then when asked to compromise they wanted 150% of fee to re book. So they charged me to have an empty room
I see in the reviews this isn't the first time this place has done this. Be wary of a person like this. Hopefully Karma will get them.

title: Fantastic service
text: I cant thank managers enough for accommodating us so early in the morning. We had to seek accommodation in the wee hours of the morning due to my daughter going into labor, we had to travel from Te Kuiti to be near the Hamilton Hospital. The unit was beautiful fresh clean and very comfortable. After long hours of waiting around in uncomfortable hospital rooms coming back to our motel was bliss. The staff friendly and very helpful.

title: Don't judge this book by its cover!
text: Compared to others in the street, you pull in wondering if you've made the right choice! But you did - it is incredibly well maintained and very clean. Modern bedding and great new bathroom. The kids loved the TV in their bedroom too. The staff were great and the room was cleaned daily. The bed was way too firm for me but the bedding was lovely.

title: Surprise was on the inside
text: We had booked online and thought we were going to be disappointed when we drove up as the outside is very plain. However the front desk reception was very welcoming and the room was very clean, neat, well equipped and quiet. We were very pleasantly surprised and were glad to have experienced such a lovely motel. So first impressions can be deceiving!

title: Luxury on a budget
text: We stayed here for a few nights in late December. The motel is well located and close to city centre. Rooms are extremely clean and well kept. Cooking in the room is not allowed (which I totally agree) but there is a fully equipped guest kitchen for cooking. The free wifi is amazingly fast and easy to connect. They have laundry facility for guest which is quite handy if you have planned for along stay in NZ. Overall, hard to find a better motel at this price in NZ.

title: Great Overnight Stay
text: Great stay. We were in Hamilton for a medical appointment and booked to stay at Auto Lodge. Our room was clean, tidy and had everything that you could want. Comfortable big beds and a TV in the bedroom as well as the lounge. This was awesome for us as we were two friends staying together. The staff at reception were friendly and polite. Would definitely stay again. Great value.

title: Good value for money
text: Check-in was quick and efficient. Easy parking. Good room, not big but not too small. The location is good if you have a car, but otherwise the nearest restaurants and supermarket are a little less than 1km away.

title: A good place to stay in Hamilton
text: We recently stated here for 3 nights and enjoyed our stay here. The room we stayed in had been done up and was modern and clean. The host was friendly and helpful and it was in a good location with good parking spaces outside the rooms.

title: Clean but Stark and Cold
text: We stayed for just one night passing through. The unit was lovely and clean but we found it quite stark, bare and clinical. The grounds were also bare and unappealing - no gardens or planting at all. Would much prefer a cosier feel to a motel, especially during the winter months.

title: Excellent value
text:
How great to have a  fabulously clean, tastefully refurbished and spacious unit.  The aesthetics were lovely.  Double glazing kept all the busy road noise out and gave us a great nights sleep in the firm beds.  With very quiet air conditioning, we were able to get the temperature to suit us, so closed windows did not matter.  The owners were very welcoming and happy to help with even the smallest things (I couldn't reach the bathroom window to close it, they came and did it without delay).
The unit was spacious  and there was plenty of parking to choose from.  Very impressed, I recommend it, and would happily stay there again.  Oh - and free internet of course.

title: If you are on New Zealand’s north island, this is the place to stay!
text:
I could give you the stats about Shailer’s Bed and Breakfast, such as the three nicely appointed guest rooms, each with its own bathroom, air conditioning, lovely breakfast each morning, etc, etc, but you could get those things at most hotels.  When you stay at a bed and breakfast you are looking for a more intimate experience.  

So let me tell you about Charlie and Dianna Shailer.  The Shailer’s are the warmest, friendliest couple we have ever met.  Their beautiful home is surrounded by rolling farmland.  
You couldn’t ask for a more beautiful setting.  Their home is set off the road, surrounded by grassy fields and rolling hills.  Dianna keeps the house spotless, yet comfortable and inviting.  Her attention to detail is evident when you come to breakfast and find the table laid out beautifully.  She cheerfully and expertly makes your breakfast to order.  If you feel like eating in for dinner she’ll treat you to a lovely home-cooked meal featuring fruits and vegetables from their garden.  

Charlie is up and out early to milk the cows and tend to the farm.  He has a gentle and casual presence and a warm smile that makes you feel welcome and relaxed.  Take the farm tour to learn how a medium-sized dairy farm operates. 

This was our first trip to New Zealand.  Hopefully it won’t be our last.  And when we return there is no question of where we will stay.  We now count the Shailers as our friends and I believe that they feel the same about the guests who stay with them.
hotel_response:
Hello John and Sandy, Thank you so much for your very gracious review. We must apologize for not responding earlier. We missed your review at the time due to Dianna's Mum breaking her hip just after Easter and being hospitalized for 7 weeks. She is now convalescing with us which means that we have closed our Bed and Breakfast down for 3 to 6 months. Hopefully we will re-open after Christmas. We hope this little message finds you both well,
Our very best wishes, Charlie and Dianna

title: Amazing stay!
text: Highly recommend staying here! The hosts are very gracious and friendly and their home is wonderful, very cozy. We stayed in the deluxe room which was perfect, spacious with a large bathroom and small sitting area. Breakfast in the morning was wonderful! We chose fresh fruit salad, toast and eggs benedict with salmon, so good! Had coffee and hot chocolate along with orange and apple juice. We only stayed one night but would definitely stay here again.
hotel_response:
Hi Chris, We really appreciate you taking the time to submit your review and we are glad you enjoyed your stay. You definitely choose the right room for your honeymoon. 
All the very best to you both. Charlie and Dianna.

title: Great Experience
text:
I don’t normally write reviews but after staying at Shailer’s Bed & Breakfast I simply have to!  
After spending 2 weeks with our family and two very active grandchildren, we were looking for somewhere comfortable for a week to just relax and ‘chill out’ and see some more of this glorious country.  From the minute we got out of the car we knew Shailer’s had been the right choice; from Dianna’s warm welcome making us immediately feel at home, to the super comfortable accommodation and beds you just don’t want to get out of! Not to mention tea and fresh cookies on arrival and gourmet breakfasts served on the deck overlooking their beautiful garden - the eggs Benedict with salmon is simply fantastic.  All on a lovely working dairy farm set in beautiful farmland countryside and the Pirongia Mountains as a backdrop.

I don’t know how they do it, but Charlie and Dianna have that wonderful ability of making one feel really special and always seem happy to chat and/or answer questions, etc., yet without being in the least pushy or intrusive - a rare gift.  They also manage to keep everything immaculate, neat and tidy and yet it is very much a warm and homely home.

My husband loves to recount the story of his woodwork teacher at school, who would never give him (or anyone else) a grade of more than 9 out of 10. When asked, the teacher said however good it is, nothing is perfect.  Well that may be so for woodwork, but as far as I’m concerned Shailer’s deserves full 5 stars in all categories! 

We had a couple of spare days before the end of our holiday and had no hesitation in re-arranging things so we could go back and be spoilt once more!  Thank you Charlie and Dianna and hope to see you on our next trip to New Zealand.  Errol and Nicola
hotel_response: Hi Errol and Nicola, Thank you so much for your very kind review. It was fantastic to have you stay twice and how exciting that you will be returning to New Zealand. We have appreciated your emails. It is great to keep in touch. We feel very privileged to share our home and farm with lovely people like yourselves from all over the world. Our very best wishes, Charlie and Dianna

title: Wonderful, Welcoming
text:
Shailers offers a great taste of New Zealand within a comfortable drive from Auckland Airport.
The accommodation is superb- very comfortable rooms opening onto a patio and a guest lounge - all with beautiful views over the countryside. Very quiet, peaceful surroundings.
Breakfast is plentiful, fresh and delicious. The evening meal, which can be ordered, is a godsend for weary travellers. Fresh, delicious and beautifully served!
Highly recommended!
hotel_response: Hi Kathy, Thank you for submitting your review. It was great to have you and Marie stay with us and thanks also for your email. It is wonderful to hear that your trip went so well and that recipe will be on it's way shortly :-). All the best for your next holiday. Cheers, Charlie and Dianna

title: Unequalled Hosts, facilities, grounds, food and farm surroundings
text: From driving up the tailored lane through magnificent flower and vegetable gardens to a beautiful residence, we knew that we had arrived at the perfect place.  Hosts Charlie and Dianna made us feel right at home and part of their family. We had ordered pizza and spaghetti the first evening.  We soon abandoned any thought of dining anywhere else.  Dianna is a fantastic chef.  Both are consummate conversationalists.  Prepare to be pampered in style and plied with the best of food.  Setting is on a large dairy farm which only adds to the ultimate rural experience.  Do not miss this bed and breakfast.
hotel_response: Hello Weaner 123, Thank you for taking time to submit your review.  It was a pleasure to have had you stay with us and we are thrilled that you totally enjoyed your time at Shailers Bed and Breakfast. Our best wishes to you both. Charlie and Dianna

title: Great Place to Begin a New Zealand Vacation
text: Stayed one night at this beautiful Bed and Breakfast and were warmly welcomed by Charlie and Dianna and were greeted with snacks and coffee after a busy day of touring.   We had a large clean, quiet room with lots of privacy and were able to take a stroll in their beautiful yard and enjoy watching the countryside sunset. We were offered a breakfast menu and woke up to a hearty meal.  Since we were farmers visiting from Canada, the farm tours seemed to be personalized for us and were very interesting and informative. Charlie and Dianna are wonderful hosts.

title: A most wonderful BnB - home and hosts both excellent - a 5 star plus !!

Just wonderful !!!  warning to Charlie and Dianna - we will be back !!!

title: Absolutely First Class!

From the moment Charlie and Dianna welcomed us you could see they really are a great team.
Our room was gorgeous as are the wonderful gardens.

Beautifully presented,served on the patio and lighted candles what could be better!

hotel_response: Hi Heather, thank you for submitting your review. We really appreciate it and we are so glad you want to return.Happy travels and best wishes for 2019. Charlie and Dianna

title: A very personalised stay
text:
Our stay at Shailer's Bed and Breakfast was easily the best accommodation we had during our trip in North Island. Charlie and Dianna were warm and friendly and spared no effort to make us comfortable. 

Our deluxe room was spacious and plush, and there were little thoughtful touches in the room, like a magazine rack filled full of reading materials and a little tray of homemade cookies as a welcome treat. The room opened out to an outdoor deck overlooking a lush garden, and we had our breakfast and dinner on the deck. 

Dianna is a great cook who served hearty breakfasts and even homemade raspberry jam with our toast. 

We also took a tour of Charlie's dairy farm and it was mad fun. Charlie gave my eight-year-old a ride on his tractor and he couldn't stop talking about it. We also got to try milking cows using those milking machines and because it was a working farm, the tour was a very good chance to see where your milk comes from. 

On the last morning of our stay, Charlie let us pick raspberries from the plants he grew on the garden and we ate them as we went along. Freshest fruit ever.  
 
Will definitely stay again.

Our best wishes to you both for the second half of 2018. Cheers, Charlie and Dianna

title: Last Night in New Zealand
text:
My wife and I stayed one night, 28 March, with Charlie and Dianna, in the deluxe room.  This was our last night in NZ, prior to returning to the US at the end of our 5 week tour of the country.  

I see that all of their reviews are extremely positive, and we agree.   In summary, we found Charlie and Dianna to epitomize the warm, good-natured friendliness that we have come to associate with NZ’ers.  Their house and rooms are well cared for and very comfortable.  We enjoyed being able to sit on the patio, enjoying some relaxed time, and it made for a perfect place to enjoy dinner.  We had the steak and lamp chops, both of which were nicely prepared, and along with Charlie’s wine selection, made for a great last dinner in NZ.   Overall, our stay at Shailers B and B made a great final memory of our trip to NZ.  

By the way, the drive, leaving mid-day on a Thursday, to Auckland airport was easy peasy.  If you are searching for an alternative to an airport hotel prior to departure, I highly recommend Shailer’s.  Should we make it back to NZ, I know we will want to stay again.
hotel_response: Hi Gary, Thank you for taking time to submit your review. We really appreciate it and thank you for your feed back on your trip back up to the airport. We are so pleased you enjoyed your last night in New Zealand with us. It was a pleasure to host you. Best wishes for your future travels, Charlie and Dianna.

title: Beautiful Country setting with Perfect Hosts

title: Perfect home away from home
text: An extremely comfortable Bed and Breakfast, set in beautiful dairying country on the outskirts of Hamilton. It is run by a really lovely couple, who make your stay just perfect. They have the perfect balance between perfect hosts but leaving you to yourself to enjoy the comforts of their home. The billiard room, lounge room and dining room that they give guests exclusive use of is spacious and five star. The bedrooms are wonderfully comfortable. One of our party required wheel chair access and the house really catered for their needs. Dianna is a wonderful cook, which really adds to the experience. Charlie is a wealth of knowledge about dairy farming. We loved staying with them.

title: Excellent stay at Shailers B&B
text:
Our family stayed for 2 nights at Shailers B&B and we booked the Deluxe room and Queen room. Charlie gave us a warm welcome on arrival and showed us around the house, and to our rooms. The place is so clean and comfortable that we wished we had planned to stay longer. Charlie is such a friendly and wonderful host that nothing is too much trouble for him. He took care of us all by himself since Dianna was away. 
Our rooms were very cozy and well-equipped and beds were comfortable. Breakfast was very nicely done and delicious too, especially the fresh tomatoes from his garden. Every morning, Charlie would lay the table and check from the deck to see if we had waken up, before cooking our breakfast. 
The gardens around the house are very well-maintained and pleasant to stroll around. Charlie even had some toy vehicles by the garage for our toddler, who couldn’t stop playing with them. The farm tour was also extremely fun and informative. We city folks got to see how cows and goats are milked, and even get to cuddle a 2-days old kid; it was an such an enjoyable afternoon. Other times, we got to see and feed Ginger the calf at the edge of the garden. 
We enjoyed every bit of our vacation there and will return for a longer stay next time we visit New Zealand.
hotel_response: Hello TCKLY, Thank you for submitting a review on Trip Advisor. We love sharing our home and farm with families from around the world. How wonderful that you will be back in the future. It is fun for us to have revisits and see how much  the children (Abby) have grown and changed a few years later.  Next time you will get looked after even better by Dianna, the star attraction at Shailers Bed and Breakfast. My very best wishes to you all. Charlie

title: Highlight of our trip
text: One night at this beautiful B&B was definitely not enough. Charlie was an awesome host, so friendly and accommodating. The rooms were immaculate and opened onto a deck facing the gorgeous gardens. The fresh home cooking was delicious and so much better than visiting a restaurant.  Being farmers ourselves we thoroughly enjoyed exchanging farm ways with Charlie. Our farm tour was very personalized and so enjoyed by all of us. This farm stay was definitely a highlight of our trip to New Zealand. We would highly recommend this B&B!!

title: The perfect base camp for North Island!
text:
We spent six nights at Shailer's. We stayed in the Queen Room.

Charlie was the perfect host! Friendly and with a great sense of humor. His wife was out of town, so Charlie did all of the cooking and cleaning. We thoroughly enjoyed his home and the farm tour he provided. Milking cows was definitely a new experience for us!

The garden and grounds, especially at sunset, were perfect. We had dinner during our first night and is was delicious! The home is nice and quiet, sitting back at least 100 meters from the highway. It was a great respite for us from the constant noise of Los Angeles.

From Shailer's, we visited Waitomo Caves, the Otorohanga Kiwi House, Raglan Beach, Marokopa Falls, Mangapohue Natural Bridge, Hamilton Gardens, the Zealong Tea Estate, the Hobbiton Movie Set, and even Rotorua. 

We can't recommend Shailer's enough. It's proximity to Auckland Airport and all activities on the North Island just can't be beat.

Cheers, Charlie

title: A Second Memorable Stay
text: We thoroughly enjoyed a second stay at this luxurious B&B. Charlie greeted us most warmly on our arrival and was an exemplary host making sure we had everything we required. Nothing was too much trouble. Our room was extremely comfortable (even down to homemade shortbread on the welcome tray!). There was plenty of choice of teas/coffee etc. and a good choice of toiletries in the bathroom.  Charlie cooked us a wonderful steak meal that night with fresh vegetables from the garden which was delicious, followed the next morning by a sumptuous cooked breakfast. A real treat was the Royal Albert china we used. This visit we were en route to Auckland but had previously used the location as a good starting point for Hamilton and Waitamo Caves. We cannot recommend Shailers highly enough from the spacious accomodation and lovely grounds to the superior quality of the rooms and the truly delicious food on offer. Charlie and Dianna are outstanding hosts who certainly make their guests feel special and at home in their surroundings. We will be returning!

Thank you for your emails and for taking the time to submit this very gracious review. We will be delighted to see you again when you next make it to New Zealand. Cheers, Charlie and Dianna.

title: 5 Days in homely heaven!
text:
We loved it so much we extended our stay for another day.Stayed there in the end of January. Super comfortable beds and Charlie's cooking is delicious - definitely worth trying more then just a breakfast .

It is a beautiful place, surrounded by amazing garden and with amazing views on Mount Pirongia. Easy access to nearby locations like Raglan, Hobbiton and Waitamo Caves.

Most importantly the host is so hospitable and welcoming that we are missing it already !
hotel_response: Hi Chiron82, I have to say I really missed you both when you left. I know there are lots of beautiful places in the world and we feel so privileged to live in one of those and to share it with others. So, the bottom line, we would love to see you again. Take care and best wishes with your next adventure. Cheers, Charlie

title: Great place fantastic hospitality
text:
We spent 5 days at Charlie and Diana's place early in December/January. We hadn't stayed in a B&B as a family before, but right from the start my wife and I and our two girls felt very comfortable at the house. 

Charlie was the consummate host cooking breakfast and some lovely dinners for us, offering some helpful suggestions about day trips and generally making sure we were comfortable. We went on the fabulous farm tour where we got to milk cows, feed goats and ducks, and meet a new born kid. 

Shailers was well located for our purposes. We did day trips to Rotorua, Hobbiton and Waitomo Caves. It's also 15 minutes away from Hamilton which is also worth visiting. We had dinner at a nice little Italian restaurant there (Adriana's) - very tasty. 

We enjoyed our stay immensely and would definitely go back again. 

Thanks Charlie!

title: 3rd time!
text: Beautiful rooms, fresh flowers in the rooms from the gorgeous garden with views of the area, generous breakfasts and most importantly the lovely hosts Charlie and Dianna who always make the stay a special treat.  A very relaxing and enjoyable stay. We have stayed 3 times! Highly recommend.
hotel_response: Hi Jane, Thank you for placing a review. We love owning the Home-stay Bed and Breakfast. We have wonderful people from all around the world stay with us and then we have beautiful people like yourselves who come and stay again. What a privilege. Best wishes for 2018.

title: Fantastic place
text:
This is our 4th stay with Charlie and Diana, this time we took family. As usual we absolutely loved our stay and our son and his girlfriend loved it too.
Their service is second to none.
It's like coming home and visiting family.
Thank you both.....we'll be back 😊
hotel_response:
Hi Michelle,
We certainly love having you and Wayne stay. You are both amazing and this is the reason why we keep our little Bed and Breakfast running. We have the most amazing people from all over the world stay with us. It is a real honour for us when people return. Thank you so much.

title: Well Deserved Reputation
text:
After a week on the road it was a pleasure to arrive at Shailers and relax. The hardest decisions were to choose which bedroom we liked and what to drink.
We enjoyed afternoon tea, dinner and breakfast on the covered deck while taking in the scenery.
hotel_response: Hi Harper, We are glad you enjoyed your stay with us and especially glad that it was relaxing. Thank you for submitting a review. We hope you have a wonderful Christmas and wish you all the very best for 2018. Cheers, Charlie and Dianna.

title: A truly wonderful B&B
text:
We really enjoyed our stay with Charlie and Dianne. The farm tour was a highlight and undeniably authentic, particularly for us city folk. The view from the guest lounge is beautiful and the sunset was stunning.
The food was outstanding. Dianne is a wonderful cook, and Charlie is brilliant on the bbq. 
Shailers is a high quality BnB which we can't recommend highly enough. We would give them 6 stars if we could.
hotel_response:
Hi Machael and Linda, Thank you so much for your very kind review. We really enjoyed hosting you, and yes those farm tours can be almost too authentic sometimes :-)
Have a wonderful Christmas and best wishes for 2018. Charlie and Dianna

title: Lovely stay in the country
text:
This was our best accommodation on a recent trip, although we stayed in several more expensive hotels.  Charlie and Dianna were kind and generous hosts with a personal and friendly approach.  The fresh home cooking was excellent in every way.  
The house is exceptionally comfortable with surrounding gardens visible from the room, a quiet outside dining area as an alternative to the dining room (also very nice) and a luxurious lounge with a great view over fields and forests. The bedroom itself was great, with really thoughtful decorative touches.

The surroundings are cattle country (as you would expect with a farm) and very quiet apart from the birdsong in the garden and cattle sounds in the distance.   The location is good for any visits in the Hamilton area, including the Hobbiton movie set (which took us about an hour on good roads).  We had a brilliant visit as a couple looking for a relaxing stop on a touring holiday, but  wished we had been able to stay another day or two.
hotel_response: Hi Peter, We really enjoyed having you and Christine stay at Shailers Bed and Breakfast. Thank you for taking time out to submit your review. We really appreciate it and we would love for you to make a return visit. Best wishes for 2018. Charlie and Dianna

title: Wonderful hosts and farm stay!
text: Charlie and Dianna are absolutely lovely. We recently stayed with them with our 2 kids and parents occupying all 3 available rooms in the house. They warmly welcomed us to their house and made us feel at home. We went on the dairy farm tour and had a fun, educational experience. We fed a bottle of milk to a calf and got to hold a baby goat! The breakfast setting was beautiful and cooked to match if not better than any breakfast place out there! We would love to go back and stay at Shailers and would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a farms stay.
hotel_response: Hi Smiles, A big thank you for taking time to submit your review. We loved having you stay with us and really do hope to see you again one day. We were lucky to have a baby goat born just before the farm tour started that day as the birthing period is almost over again until next July.  Thanks also for your email. Wishing you a wonderful Christmas and prosperous 2018. Charlie and Dianna

title: Great farm stay
text: Great location in the heart of Waikao region with spectacular views and gardens.  Bedroom well equipped with beautifully appointed bathroom.  Really enjoyed the chance to see the farm and milking cows, also seeing the goat farm.  Charlie and Dianna are wonderful hosts with the best breakfast we had in NZ..  Thank you both for a memorable 2 nights.
hotel_response: Greetings Si and Lyn, It was fantastic having you stay with us. Thanks again for choosing our farm-stay experience as part of your holiday in New Zealand and a big thank you for submitting a review. Hopefully in the next five years we will make it back to Wales and take you up on the offer of a cuppa...... Cheers for now, Charlie and Dianna

title: Delightful stay at the lovely Shailers Bed and Breakfast
text: From the friendly welcome till the day we left it was an absolute pleasure to stay at the Shailers Bed and Breakfast. We were made to feel entirely at home, all the facilities were excellent and the food was spot on. We had our breakfast on the patio beside our bedroom and the views were a real delight. Of special importance to us was Diana's care and attention to our special food requirements (we require a gluten free diet) and nothing was too much bother. The house was warm, quiet and had many things to occupy oneself. Would recommend this B&B to anyone..5 stars for sure.
hotel_response: Hi there D. Thank you so much for submitting a review. We really do appreciate you taking the time to let future guests know about your experience at Shailers. We are glad you enjoyed your stay. It was a pleasure hosting you and we really enjoyed chatting and making sure your special food requirements were catered for. Cheers for now, Charlie and Dianna.

title: The moment of truth at Shailers Bed snd Breakfast
text: Charlie n Diana, We are glad for making the right choice at Shailers Bed and breakfast.My whole family is extremely happy and thank you for your warm hospitality, beautiful home and we enjoyed our breakfast.
hotel_response: Hi Selina,  Thank you so much for placing your review. We appreciate it so much. It was a real pleasure to have you and your lovely family stay with us at Shailers bed and Breakfast. My best regards to Elwin. Charlie

title: 2 Nights stay during Lion's Tour June 2017
text:
Charlie and Dianna made us most welcome during our brief stay with them. Wonderful scenic location in rural area - the Farmhouse is on their Dairy Farm! Had 2 wonderful breakfasts and a gourmet evening meal cooked by "Masterchef" Dianna...and Charlie makes a good waiter too!
Ask Dianna to draw you a map of anywhere you want to visit locally...far better than using a SatNav/GPS....
Thoroughly recommended for a relaxing stay...a genuine 5 star experience!
hotel_response:
Hello Malcolm, What a great Rugby series it was and a fitting end result. We thoroughly enjoyed you and Karen staying with us. Thank you for taking time out to submit a review.
We really appreciate it. We hope to see you again when England tour. I was working out how old I will be before the Lions tour again in New Zealand and it was rather sobering......Take care, Charlie

title: Felt so at home here!
text:
We stayed at Shailers during the annual Fieldays event in June 2017 so it was great to be able to fully relax after two hectic days of research.
It was very comfortable, squeaky clean and the mattress was very good too.  We felt incredibly welcome but in a very relaxed way, just like home away form home. Dianna and Charlie were excellent hosts  and were very easy to talk to.
Our dinners and breakfasts were beautifully prepared and very tasty and the recommendations from the wine list were spot on without breaking the bank ;-)
Thank you for a wonderful stay Dianna and Charlie, we are looking forward to staying at your lovely lodge again!
hotel_response: Hi JaxxiBrown, you two are awesome. We so enjoyed you staying with us. We wish you the very best in your new adventures. We have just returned from a 9 day escape to Samoa. If you get the chance there is lots to do and explore at sensible prices. Cheers for now, Charlie

title: Excellent farmstay!
text:
Arrived on a wet day after a long drive from Northlands to be greeted by Charlie with hot tea and delicious banana cake baked by Dianna set the tone for a wonderful short stay at Shailers. 
Went on the farm tour well-suited up for the inclement weather which everyone in the family particularly my two grandsons enjoyed very much, particularly the cuddling and feeding of the kids (baby goats) in the kids' pen. Only disappointment was not able to see the milking of the cows. 
Charlie and Dianna were excellent hosts. The rooms were comfortable and the meals were great. Unfortunately we didn't get to enjoy more the surroundings due to the wet weather. A good place for a return visit. 

CC
hotel_response:
Thank you C C for taking the time to submit a review. It was such a pleasure for us to have your family stay. I will forever see Shaun jumping in the puddles. Such spontaneous moments makes doing farm tours so worthwhile for me. The joy on his face :-)
Take care and all the very best to your family.

title: Absolutely fantastic!
text: We traveled NZ in a family of 9, from a 6-year-old little girl to a 80-year-old granddaddy. Unanimously, we all agree that staying in Shailers was the highlight of our trip - excellent food, comfortable beds and house, beautiful garden, and of course warm hospitality from the host Charlie and Dianna. Charlie could remember the Chinese names of some of us. The farm tour is highly recommended; Charlie showed us how a farm was operated.  It was absolutely eye-opening to the city inhabitants like us.  In sum, the experience of staying in the farm is absolutely fantastic and definitely we will come again when we travel NZ next time.
hotel_response: Hello Ernie, we enjoyed hosting you and your family so much at Shailers. Thank you for your kind review. We look forward to your returning one day. Perhaps in our spring next time. September is a good month to be involved with the baby calves and baby goats, however it is also colder and wetter.  Best wishes, Charlie and Dianna

title: Finding Our Moon Couple!
text: The Shailers home was the most wonderful way for us to begin our vacation in New Zealand!  From being greeted by name as we arrived by Diana to traveling by ATV around the farm and even learning to milk the cows with Charlie it was peaceful, delightful and fun!  We then shared a bottle of New Zealand Chardonnay and learned that we all married on the same day, year and time making them our "Moon Couple"!  We feel we have new friends for life! We just wish we could have stayed longer!
hotel_response: Hi Joyce, We were thinking after you left of the song, 'It's a small world after all....' we really enjoyed having you and David stay with us and definitely much too short a stay. You had a lot to do in a week so you had to keep moving. Thank you for taking the time to submit a review. We will be thinking of you both on our special day. Cheers, Charlie and Dianna

title: Simply outstanding!
text:
Set in lovely rolling countryside a few kilometers west of Hamilton, this small B&B does everything perfectly.  First, the premises, and especially the manicured gardens are gorgeous.  The rooms are well furnished and very comfortable.  The deck, with broad, sweeping views, is inviting. And the location (15 minutes to Hamilton, less than an hour to Waitomo Caves or Raglan, about 1.5 hours to Rotorua or Tauranga) is ideal as a base for touring in the region.

Second, the hosts Charlie and Dianna are extremely warm and gracious, always ready to help visitors in any way possible.  Staying with them is like visiting old friends.

And third, there is the food.  Not only excellent, made to order breakfasts (served at the requested time!), but optional three course (or lighter) dinners that demonstrate Dianna's exceptional cooking skills.  By all means, do not hesitate to indulge in these dinners, which are very reasonably priced considering the quality and quantity.  In addition, Charlie maintains a nice wine collection which he offers at quite reasonable prices.

Shailer's offers three spotlessly clean rooms.  Two have private bathrooms across a hall.  The third room, which is huge, has an en-suite.
hotel_response: Hi Skeptic, We were delighted to receive a personal email from you as well as such an amazing review. Thank you so much. We were also glad that you arrived home safely in Seattle.  Our son-in-law has visited the Restaurant  you recommended on his 3 day visit to Seattle last week. Dianna will gladly email you the recipe you want in the next few days. Cheers and best wishes, Charlie

title: This farm stay is better than staying at home in Denmark!
text:
The hospitality began in the doorway upon arrival and continued to the farewell scene in front of the house! We met a room with flowers and access direct to the deck.
If we ever get back to NZ our first choice will be farm stay at Dianna and Charlie.
Great dinner on the deck - Dianna spend the afternoon preparing and Charlie served with a smile and a joke.
Farm tour with splendid views and valuable information about cows and goats - and many thanks to Charlie for showing the David Brown Cropmaster!
Best breakfast we ever had in NZ.
Again - we will never forget these 18 hours at Shailers!
hotel_response: Hi Soren and Christel, It was a great pleasure to host you at Shailers Bed and Breakfast. We enjoyed meeting you very much and hearing a little of your occupation. Thank you for submitting a review and also for adding a photo to our guest gallery. We do hope you will make it to New Zealand again. Perhaps a work follow up :-) Cheers, Charlie and Dianna

title: Saved The Best For Last!
text: We stayed with Charlie and Dianna on the last night of our trip.  It was a wonderful experience.  Charlie greeted us as we drove up and we felt so welcome.  The room was beautiful and the views amazing.  The bathroom was clean and large.  We had dinner on the deck outside.  The meal Dianna prepared was one of the very best we had on our trio.  The seafood was perfectly cooked and the vegetables and salad fresh from the garden. Breakfast was delicious with lots of choices.  The gardens,flower and vegetable, were beautiful and the fresh roses in our room were gorgeous.  Thanks for making our last night in New Zealand so special.
hotel_response: Hello good people from Texas ;-)  Thank you for taking the time to submit a review. We appreciate it and are so glad you enjoyed your stay at Shailers Bed and Breakfast. Our best wishes to you both.

title: Wonderful
text: Dianna & Charlie are the most accommodating and welcoming hosts.  We booked a room for a photoshoot, what we got was way more than just a room.  It was a pleasant, safe and inviting location for our ladies to relax and enjoy some adult time.  As well as getting pampered at the same time.  Thank you again Dianna & Charlie you are guys are amazing.
hotel_response: We are thrilled that the room was suitable for the photo shoot and are delighted that you and your clients found our services and venue enjoyable and relaxing. We hope the photo shoot works out for you all. Thank you for a great review. Charlie and Dianna

title: A perfect lace tomstay
text: We were made most welcome at Shailers B&B Dianna and Charlie beds were very comfortable, shower and bathroom excellent and the breakfast was outstanding. The location is 15 minutes outside of Hamilton.
hotel_response: Thank you for reviewing Shailers Bed and Breakfast. We are glad you enjoyed your stay with us. Best regards, Charlie and Dianna

title: Great Hospitality and Fantastic Stay
text: The whole experience was wonderful from the minute we arrived. We did the farm and had the most beautiful room. At  Shailers we had booked dinner and Dianna is a wonderful cook. This was served on the deck area outside our room by Charlie and was delicious. Breakfast next day was first class. Just cannot say what a special place this is. Shailers is the most beautiful property, tastefully furnished and is superb! Don't hesitate to stay. We stayed for two nights and it was by far the best of anywhere we stopped in NZ. Don't hesitate to book. We will definitely stay there the next time we ate in NZ
hotel_response: Hi Milky, Great to hear from you and we guess you are back home in Tarland. We hope you had some great experiences in New Zealand. Thank you for taking time to review us and yes we would be delighted to have you return. Sometimes we are sure we are having more fun than our guests as we have such wonderful people stay with us. Our very best wishes for the remainder of 2017. Cheers, Charlie and Dianna

title: Very comfortable
text: A very comfortable and pleasant stay at the Shailer's B&B. Good selection of choices for breakfast and very attentive hosts. Having use of the laundry facilities was very useful, accommodation had all the utilities and amenities we needed for a comfortable me stay.
hotel_response: Hi Chloe, Thank you for placing a review on Shailers Bed and Breakfast. We are glad your stay was comfortable and that you found our complimentary laundry helpful. Best wishes for the rest of your holiday. Charlie and Dianna

title: The most wonderful and amazing farm stay in NZ!
text: The whole experience was wonderful from the minute we arrived.  We did the farm tour (you pay but so worth it) and had the most beautiful room.  As Shailers is some little way out of Hamilton, we were so glad we had booked dinner.  This was served on the deck area outside our room by Charlie and was delicious.  Breakfast next day was first class.  Just cannot say what a special place this is.  5 star at a budget price.    Shailers is the most beautiful property, tastefully furnished and is superb!  Don't hesitate to stay.  We were sorry we only stayed for one night and it was by far the best of anywhere we stopped in NZ.  Don't hesitate to book.
hotel_response: Hi Pete and Marilyn, Thank you so for taking the time to review Shailers Bed and Breakfast. We are glad you enjoyed your stay and hope you can make it down-under again. We were also delighted to receive your personal email, thank you. Our best wishes for the year ahead. Charlie and Dianna

title: A Gem!
text:
It started with a greeting of "and here is the snooker table for guests to use and here are some home made gluten free cookies for you. Would you like a tea, coffee or water to go with your slice of home made lemon cake? Can I help you with your luggage?"

It was the most welcoming of places and a superbly charming couple.

They have 3 rooms, each with its own bathroom, but on the other side of a corridor. Each room opens out onto a covered deck, where we ate evening dinner and had breakfast. The home is modern and all fittings are of a very high standard.

Evening meal was a bonus. 10-12 miles out of Hamilton it meant you didn't need a 30 minute drive and not have a glass of wine. The food was excellent - a steak, a lamb shank, starters, dessert and huge selection of wines by the bottle or the glass. All they ask is to choose 12 hours before so they can be prepared. The menu is on the website and we e-mailed the night before.

So we sat for a pleasant evening with the other guests, swopping travel stories as Charlie and Dianne joined us over a glass of port from the local vineyard.

Huge choice of cooked and continental breakfast items the next morning.

One couple had had a farm tour the previous afternoon hosted by Charlie.

They are wonderful hosts, friendly, knowledgeable and attentive. And we even ended up taking Dianne's gluten free cookie recipe away with us, as well as a few of the cookies she had made.

If there is a better place in Hamilton, there is for sure no better value place in Hamilton area.
hotel_response:
Hi Phil, thank you for taking the time to review our Bed and Breakfast and especially for giving such a comprehensive review. As a traveler that is exactly what I want to know when I am deciding where to stay. The Deluxe room has a 'in room en-suite,' but you were not to know that being in the Queen room. 
It is so easy to be great hosts when we have such lovely and amazing people from all over the world stay with us. We feel very honoured.
It has been raining here for 24 hours which is most unusual for February. You can imagine how green and lush the landscape will be next week. Of course the weeds and lawns will also be flourishing so we won't be short of having something to do ;-)
Our best wishes, cheers, Charlie and Dianna

title: A Superb Stay
text: After 3 nights in Auckland, this BnB was our first port of call, on our road trip to Wellington. We spent one night here at this wonderful accommodation. From the time we arrived, we were made to feel very special. We were so well looked after, the entire time. Dianna and Charlie could not have done any more for us. We really appreciated being in such a beautiful maintained home. We were especially impressed by the home cooking. The afternoon tea, with some delicious coffee cake and home baked biscuits, was a welcome treat. The breakfast was great. We will make a point of returning here. Thank you Dianna and Charlie for a superb stay.
hotel_response: Hi Jeanette, It was a pleasure to have had you stay with us and we are so glad you will come again. Hopefully Dianna's Lemon cake will be on the bench top next time. That's my favourite :-) I do apologize for the blustery weather New Zealand has been having. They say summer will definitely arrive for February. Better late than never. Our best wishes for 2017, Charlie.

title: Couldn't have picked a better place
text: Too many good things to list!  Warm, welcoming, hospitable hosts and a very beautiful, comfortable place to call home while exploring NZ!  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend them to anyone looking to stay in the Hamilton area.
hotel_response: Hi Angsher, We really appreciate you going to the trouble to submit reviews on various sights. Thanks again. Really enjoyed hearing what was happening in your last email. I love to visit the snow but not sure I could live with it. :-) Take care, Charlie

title: A Farm Visit with real NZ hospitality
text: The Shailer B&B was one of the great highlights of our trip to NZ.  From the moment we met Diane and Charlie their welcome and hospitality was remarkable. The room was perfect and the morning breakfast was something not to be missed (egg benedicts in particular).  Don't miss the chance to do a custom farm tour of the dairy and surrounding businesses with Charlie.  It was truly hands on and full of insights on the land, the people and the business of farming in New Zealand.  If it is a real NZ family farm experience you are looking for, don't miss the chance to visit the Shailers.  It deserves 5 stars.
hotel_response:
Hello Hugarose,
I really like your nom de plume. Dianna and I are both smiling. Thank you so much for placing your review on trip advisor. I will send a personal email to you. Cheers, Charlie

title: Great Hospitality and Stay
text: We really enjoyed staying at Shailers Bed and Breakfast. Charlie and Dianne were such wonderful hosts and the room was immaculate neat and clean. Small details like a heated blanket really warm my heart. Not forgetting the breakfast! The farm tour was amazing and my daughter had a great time holding little lamb, pepper the rabbit, seeing gypsey the puppy performing his tricks, feeding the hens and being surrounded by cows! Awesome time and look forward to being back again~
hotel_response: Hi Glien, Hazel and Clarice, It was awesome having you stay with us. Thank you for taking the time to review us which helps future guests know more about us. It is so nice for me to be able to change my farm tours to suit what visitors are most interested to see and do on the farm. This means I will never get bored doing tours. We look forward to seeing you again and wish you a happy and adventurous 2017. Charlie and Dianna

title: Best b&b
text:
We had a lovely night .. its an awesome place to stay and relax ... nice view , wonderful breakfast.. really nice people to have chit chat ... the place is nearly heaven where you really can enjoy your holidays ... will come back that's for sure .. 
thanks 
From  Gagan & remsia
hotel_response: Hi Gagan and Remsia, We are glad you were able to escape the Auckland jungle and escape to Shailers bed and Breakfast. It is such a pleasure for us to see guests relax in the environment of our gardens and enjoy summer dining just outside their room . We look forward to hosting you again in the future. Our best wishes for you both in 2017, Charlie and Dianna

title: Outstanding
text: We had a wonderful stay, the room was comfortable in fact everything was top notch. Diana showed great attention to detail, even to the extend of playing the kind of music we liked. Our meals were served on nice china. We had a lovely stay, a would stay again.
hotel_response: Hi Sue, We are thrilled you enjoyed your stay with us and we really appreciate you taking the time to do this review. Many thanks. Merry Christmas and all the best for 2017, Charlie and Dianna

title: Beautiful!
text:
Dianna and Charlie were gracious hosts who took care of everything we needed. The stay was beautiful with an inspiring view. The farm tour was a highlight-a hands-on experience to milking cows, petting goats and feeding ducks and swans. The BnB is also close to the horse trail. 

Truly recommended for a relaxing stay. Thank you Dianna and Charlie for being so warm and friendly and preparing the best breakfast!
hotel_response: Hi Rex, Great to hear from you and so glad you two had such a great time. I have to say again how much I enjoyed taking you two on the farm tour and blowing the carbon build up out the exhaust ;-) . It was a pleasure to have you stay. Happy future traveling. Charlie and Dianna

title: Perfect rural retreat
text: We spent 2 nights with Diana and Charlie who went out of their way to make our stay memorable, including a delicious dinner. A lovely setting, delicious breakfasts and scenic pastoral views.  Easy to find and 20 minutes from Hamilton Gardens ( excellent displays and all at no cost!)  Approximately 2 hours from AKL which makes it a very good choice for a last night in NZ.
hotel_response: Hello Habari, We appreciate you taking the time to place a review and for providing details that will help other travelers with decision making tips. It is amazing that there is no charge to visit Hamilton gardens especially considering they were chosen as the 'International Garden of the Year in 2014'.  We hope you have a wonderful Christmas and prosperous 2017. Best wishes, Charlie and Dianna

title: Perfect for family with young kids
text:
Charlie & Diana are very welcome and made us feel like home. We changed the booking a couple of time, they are very accommodating.

The rooms are very tidy and clean, plenty of room. Guess lounge is fantastic. Beds are comfort, showers are good. Great view and away from the road.

Food was perfectly cooked, set up was amazing, better than restaurants. 

Farm tour was very special, 100% enjoyed it for every one. One of our best holiday for last couple of years. Definitely come back again. Highly recommended.
hotel_response: Thank you for taking the time to write a review for us. We just enjoyed having you stay so much and we are so glad we will see you again. For us it is especially exciting to see how the children have grown since their last stay. Merry Christmas to you all and best wishes for 2017. Charlie an Dianna

title: Cosy place with friendly hosts
text: Lovely garden and farm views. House was comfortable, clean and cosy. Breakfast was sumptuous. Farm tour was educational and enjoyable. Hosts were very helpful and friendly. My 2 year old daughter loved it too! Highly recommended!
hotel_response:
Hi Pam, 
We really appreciate you submitting a review.  Plus your emails and photo have been very encouraging. Thank you!! We hope you have a wonderful Christmas and prosperous 2017.

title: Absolutely wonderful
text: We booked on reference from Vilagrads. Booking was simple and straight forward then we were warmly greeted and made to feel very welcome. We experienced outstanding comfort and facilities with beautiful outlooks surrounding the accommodation. Our Hosts, Charlie & Dianna went out of their way to drop us off and pick us up from Vilagrads where we attended a Wedding function. Then to top off their wonderful hospitality the next morning we were served a delicious hot breakfast on the deck overlooking their lovely garden. We would highly recommend Shailers to anyone and we will definitely be staying there again.
hotel_response: Hello C and C, Thanks so much for taking the time to place a review. We totally enjoyed having you stay at Shailers Bed and Breakfast. As most of our guests are from overseas it is especially nice to share our homestead with a couple of Kiwis ;-) . It is great having the Vilagrad winery just 5 minutes away from us which makes it very easy  to shutttle guests. We look forward to hosting you again and hope you have a happy Christmas and prosperous 2017.

title: Perfect in every way
text:
We stayed for 1 perfect night at the end of a quick trip to NZ with friends. Trying a B&B instead of other options in Hamilton was an inspired choice.
The location in the country is so much more relaxing / the beds are divine / there was cake for afternoon tea on arrival. Everything about our stay was superb.
Ordering an evening meal avoided having to worry about that. All of us were satisfied. Tasty, wholesome home cooking. 
There is a quest lounge with lovely views and we had a hoot of an evening playing snooker
Charlie & Dianna were delightful hosts - nothing was too much trouble.
hotel_response: Hello to our good neighbours across the ditch. We are so glad you enjoyed staying at Shailers.  For us, hearing guests enjoying our faciliities is very rewarding and makes it a pleasure to do homestay bed and breakfast. By the way we think perfect guests make being good hosts so much easier. Best wishes for your future travels, Charlie and Dianna.

title: Fantastic Bed and Breakfast
text: We were a party of four - Two couples.  The breakfasts were amazing.  The rooms were great and the hosts were the best !!!  I have stayed all over the world and hotels and B & B's.  Shailers is by far the best.
hotel_response: Hi Grant, we thoroughly enjoyed having you ones stay with us. We all had a lot of fun. It is very kind of you to rate us best especially when you travel so much. We feel rather humbled by such a review.  We will really have to be on the game now as I am sure new guests expectations have just jumped up a peg or two. :) We wish you every happiness and more time to enjoy the grandchildren.

title: New farm experience, lovely hosts, lovely tour
text: We arrived late and we have pre-ordered our dinner which was prepared to the time we wanted. The hosts Diana and Charlie are very nice people. The house is big and clean. The rooms are well equipped and clean. The breakfast is great too. The area with a television different activities is nice. We had a tour around the farm and all our questions have been answered and the tour is tailored to our needs. You can do your laundry and dry your clothes for any other extra cost.
hotel_response: Hi Shereen, It was such a delight to have you and the girls stay at Shailers Bed and Breakfast. It was great fun for me to see the girls enjoying the animals. It is sad that the new born only come once a year between mid July and mid September. You timed it perfectly. Thank you for placing a review. We really appreciate guests taking the effort to give us feed back. We wish you happy holidays in the future years. Charlie and Dianna

title: Lovely B&B and wonderfully gracious hosts
text:
Our party of two couples stayed at Shailers Bed & Breakfast during the first week of July in 2016.  Their home has been remodeled to afford their guests comfort and privacy.  There are beautiful views of the countryside from their home, and one of the walls in our room was all windows with a sliding glass door that offers egress to a nice deck.

The best thing about our stay was the Shailers' grace and hospitality.  They went the extra mile to make our visit to New Zealand extraordinary.  We plan to go back to New Zealand and hope to be able to stay at Shailers Bed and Breakfast again.
hotel_response: Hi Dave, Thank you so much for your generous review. We equally enjoyed your stay with us and we do hope you are able to visit again in the future. We remarked today to our current guests that we feel so enriched to have people from all over the world share our home and share their lives with us. We wish you good health and happy travels in the future. Charlie and Dianna

title: Wonderful B&B - far exceeded our expectations!
text: We loved staying with Charlie and Diana!  The food was home grown, organic and so delicious!  Really - they went above and beyond for every meal.  The rooms were so clean, beautifully appointed and comfortable!  The hosts had great information about local attractions and facilitated all our efforts to get out to see the major attractions in the area.  This B&B is close by the glow-worm caves and other beautiful places to visit.  We hope to go back and we highly recommend this B&B!
hotel_response: Hello Grant, Thank you for choosing to stay at Shailers Bed and Breakfast and thank you for taking the time to submit a review, we really appreciate it. We feel incredibly privileged and blessed to share our home with such wonderful people as yourselves. We are glad to hear that we exceeded your expectations and we do hope that you will visit New Zealand again. We may be down under but we are only a day away. Best wishes, Charlie and Dianna.

title: Beautiful place,  lovely hosts
text:
This B&B is one of the best we've ever stayed at.  Charlie and Dianna are absolutely lovely hosts,  making our entire family feel at home the instant we arrived on a cold wet winter's day. 

The place is immaculately maintained,  with thoughtful additions wherever you look.  We booked two rooms,  one with a king bed and the other with two single beds.  The larger room had a TV and attached bathroom.  The smaller room had the bathroom right across the hall. There was a refrigerator,  water,  tea and coffee in the room. 

The main guest area had a large lounge with sofa and TV.  We were treated to excellent tea,  coffee,  cookies and lemon cake the afternoon we arrived.  Dinner was spectacular... Felt like fine dining in a world class restaurant.  The lamb shanks and steak were perfectly prepared.  The side vegetable dishes we're straight from the farm.  And the accompanying wine was icing on the cake. 

There is a large common area for guests to browse the large selection of DVDs and books,  and even a pool table to pass the time should you wish to enjoy a game or two.  

We tried the farm tour the next day.  It was very enjoyable seeing the calves,  milking facilities and we even had a chance to feed goats from the farm next door.  Boots and overalls were provided for the farm tour,  so we did not have to worry about soiling our shoes.  

Overall,  this place is highly highly recommended.  A very peaceful place to rest and recharge.  Do drop by if you ever pass by this area.
hotel_response:
Thank you for placing this awesome and very comprehensive review. We are so glad you enjoyed your stay with us and we certainly enjoyed having you stay. You are a fun family.
The weather is warming up a little bit and we had two wonderful sunny days. Officially spring begins on September 1st. We wish you all the very best for the next year and hope to see you again. Charlie and Dianna

title: Lovely B&B
text: We stayed for three nights in April 2016. We were in the deluxe room and it was very nice with an en-suite bathroom. Breakfast (and the breakfast choices) was outstanding!. We found it to be a nice central place from which to visit Raglan, Hamilton Gardens, Maungatautari bird sanctuary, Rotorua (including the Tamaki Cultural Village), and the LDS temple in Hamilton.This is great place for those who like to be out in the country!
hotel_response: Hi Marcus and Gayle, Great to hear from you and thank you for taking the time to submit a review. We appreciate it and we are glad to hear you found your stay at Shailers Bed and Breakfast convenient and enjoyable. Spring is not far away and our first cow calved yesterday so the farm will be very busy for the next three months. Best wishes...Charlie and Dianna

title: Farmstay - Genuinely hospitable and great food
text:
Charlie and Dianna are genuinely nice. Dianne is an excellent cook and the meals served are generous. Do eat in at Shailers, give it a try on your first night (I did that and then told Dianne I'll be having Dinner for the rest of my stay).
Charlie is always willing to share his local knowledge. When I told him my next stop will be Taupo, he planned a route for me (My GPS/Map would have guided me through the highway) which was more scenic and made the drive much more enjoyable. He also pointed me to a pleasant hill trail nearby which many won't have known.
If you are looking for a farmstay experience you will enjoy Shailers.
hotel_response: Greetings from Shailers. Thank you so much for placing a review. We are glad you enjoyed your stay with us and especially glad you enjoyed the scenic route to Taupo. New Zealand really is a beautiful country. We just took a 4 day break and drove around the East Cape staying one night in Rotorua, two nights in Gisborne and one night in Opotiki. Some beautiful walks, amazing beaches and significant early New Zealand history. We hope you can return and enjoy more of New Zealand. Meantime we wish you good health and safe travels.

title: The Best B and B in the world
text: We have travelled all over the world and stayed at many B and B establishments, without a doubt Shailers was the best ever. The owners were very friendly, full of local information. The evening dinners were superb, home grown  fruits and vegetables. Beautiful surroundings and very quiet. If we were to go back to New Zealand, we would make a point of going back. Thank you Charlie and Diana.
hotel_response: What can we say.....THANK YOU! ..... we are honoured to be classified the best. We certainly enjoy doing what we are doing and we love meeting people just like you. So thank you for choosing to stay at Shailers Bed and Breakfast and we would be delighted to have you return....where ever you travel in the future we wish you safe and happy exploring ..... best wishes and a big hug from Charlie and Dianna

title: Our stay at Shailers.
text: Altogether an excellent stay with two brilliant people. Tip top! We could not have asked for a warmer welcome and to be so well looked after. The room was very clean and comfortable and had excellent facilities. The catering was delicious. We thoroughly recommend Shailers.
hotel_response: Hello again, Thank you so much for placing your review. We are thrilled you enjoyed your stay and we hope you may make it back here again. Best wishes, Charlie and Dianna

title: The virginia crew
text: One of the best accommodations/ farm stays on the north island. Diana and Charlie are true kiwi's.  Great hosts. Very nice dairy farm. Very knowledgeable about their great country.  Charlie gives a excellent tour of his farm and others nearby with his RTV.
hotel_response: Hi there, Great to have your review, thanks so much for taking the time..... if ever you are in our neck of the woods we would love to see you again, the coffee maker is always on call... Cheers from Charlie and Dianna

title: A little bit of paradize
text: If want you want gracious and warm hosts, beautiful landscapes, comfortable and welcoming accommodations and a chance to immerse yourself in the real New Zealand, then an extended stay at Shailers (one night is simply not enough, we stayed for 4 and still didn't want to leave) then this will be the highlight of your trip.  We immediately felt like family.
hotel_response:
Hi from Shailers, we are flattered......thanks so much, we really do appreciate you placing a review as this will help prospective guests make their choice of where to stay. The truth is if our guests stay longer we get the opportunity to get to know them better and it is so much better for us. People, people, people.....it is all about people .... we love meeting people from all around the world .... you have enriched our lives , thank you.....
Happy traveling in the future, Charlie and Dianna

title: Fabulous farm stay!
text: Charlie and Diane were wonderful hosts. The cooking was amazing. Their garden was beautiful. Our bed was super comfortable and the room was spotless. We had a fabulous time and it was the perfect home base for exploring other areas in New Zealand.
hotel_response: Greetings from Charlie and Dianna, thanks so much for placing a review......if we remember correctly you really did some exploring....hope to see you again in New Zealand. Save travels

title: Warm Attentive Hosts
text: My wife and I stayed for just one night in mid December, but it was long enough to know that Dianna and Charlie treat their guests with genuine warmth and attentiveness.  Upon our arrival Dianna served us tea, juice and cake on the patio patio just outside our room, which was clean and comfortable.  Breakfast, including a superb fruit cup, was excellent.  It was interesting to talk with Charlie and Dianna about current events in the U.S and New Zealand.  They are good folk. Their farm was just 20-minute drive from the botanical garden, a must-see site.
hotel_response: Greetings from Charlie and Dianna, Thanks so much for choosing to stay with us at Shailers Bed and Breakfast. We are glad you enjoyed your stay and appreciate you taking the time to support us by placing a review. We wish you a prosperous 2016 and happy traveling. Best wishes.

title: Excellent Farm Experience for City Guys!
text:
So grateful to have Dianna and Charlie as our host!  You two have surely created a marvelous experience for us all during our stay at your place. 

We stayed here with our friends Karen and Ling, and four of us have been very well taken care of and couldn't be more comfortable in such a warm house with such an amazingly beautiful and well managed garden! 

Indeed, there are lots of great memories to recall; first of all, on arrival, my dearest wife Shirley expressed that she'd a sore-throat, and Charlie has been so caring that he immediately treated her with a cup of manuka honey, plus some freshly picked lemon slices, as the welcome drink, and Shirley's throat got much better right after. That one is a real touching memory! 

On the first day, we had a real relaxed walk around the farm, and we'd taken lots of pictures! Our dinner facing the lovely garden is obviously the highlight of the day.

In the next morning, Dianna had prepared four sets of breakfast for us, and each of us have been overwhelming satisfied with her superb cooking skills! 

The program that followed was the Farm Tour Session, which was a FIRST to all of us, we're all eager to see how the cows were milked...just as if we were kids. Charlie took us to the milking station by a buggy vehicle, and he demonstrated to us how they milk the cow with the sucking tubes inside the assembly line. He also showed us how to feed the small calves and sheep. Charlie was extremely patient driving us back and forth all around his Farm telling us all about how they raise the 380 cows. Indeed, this is something we don't get to do when we're back home. We were especially fascinated by Charlie, he is such a talented guide!

Dianna is a very kind-hearted lady who's very passionate at introducing their Farm to us, and with no doubt, she only provides best of the best! Our rooms were sparkling clean, everything we needed was just an arm's reach away, 

The fresh air, the scenery, the animals, the warmness of Dianna and Charlie's Shailer B & B, all sums up to an amazing experience to all of us. I truly think Charlie and Dianna's hospitality exceeds even most 5 star hotels we've stayed in. 

Thank you for the wonderful wonderful stay and we hope to visit again next time.
hotel_response:
Greetings Peter from Shailers. Thank you so much for submitting a very informative review. It was a great pleasure for us to have you stay and show you around our farm. Just one small correction that the sheep you have referred to are actually goats :)
At the time of your visit there were 700 in the raising barn. 500 of those now weigh over 30kgs and are grazing in the fields. On the farm tours we now take tree cuttings and feed them leaves off the branches. Best wishes to you and your family for 2016.

title: Wonderful B&B- Everything's Perfect!
text: We stayed at Shailers right after flying to NZ and it certainly made a perfect start to our vacation.  The room was spotlessly clean and the food was spectacular.  We had dinner in Shailers one night and the mussels were the best we had ever had.  We dined at the deck overlooking the garden, a perfect setting for meals regardless of the weather- we could enjoy the sunset when the sky was clear, and when it was raining the cosy, covered deck offered a welcome respite from the rain and we could dine and drink comfortably while listening to the music of the dancing rain.  We also highly recommend the farm tour, with Charlie clearly having a passion in the business and he was very forthcoming when sharing with us all the knowledge and experience he had.  He and Dianna are such wonderful hosts we felt pampered, totally at home and were really unwilling to leave after our 2-nights' stay.  The only regret we have about the stay is that we should have stayed longer!
hotel_response: Yes, it is hard to find better Mussels than the New Zealand Green Mussels. We are so glad you enjoyed them and your total experience at Shailers. Thank you so much for taking the time to write a review. We really appreciate it and we wish you happy travels in 2016.

title: The Perfect Hosts
text:
We arrived at Charlie and Dianna's house somewhat tired after a few days of busy sight-seeing and we were looked after really well. After showing us around their lovely house and upgrading us from the room we had booked to the largest (as we were the only guests that night), we were invited to have tea on the covered deck which included a lovely homemade lemon sponge, 2 sorts of cookies and as much tea as we could drink. We felt better immediately! The deck looks out onto a beautiful garden which even the rain could not spoil. Our bedroom and en-suite had all we could want including 3 easy chairs and a table, useful for using a computer, and a large fridge. There was also a large vase of roses. We had arranged to have an evening meal there and we had the choice of eating inside or on the terrace with a very effective heater and we each had a delicious and different meal with a good selection of wine. 

There was a good choice of cooked items for breakfast next morning, as well as fruit salad, cereal, yoghurt etc and we thoroughly enjoyed our meal which can be served during a large range of times. Charlie and Dianna were very friendly and helpful and Charlie even arranged his own journey into Hamilton to coincide with ours so that he could guide us to a garage and on to where we were dropping our hire car and then he took us and our luggage to the railway station.

Charlie and Dianna really were the perfect hosts and our only regret is that we could not stay longer.
hotel_response: Hello from Shailers. Thank you for taking the time to write a review. We thoroughly enjoyed having you stay with us and it was no problem to get you to the railway station on time. We love to make guests holidays an experience that they will look back on and say, "that was really great at Shailers, could have stayed longer......" Best wishes for your future travels.

title: 5-Stars Bed & Breakfast & Dinner
text:
This is a truly a 5-Stars hospitality. We enjoyed 2 rooms with a deck over looking a beautiful garden with vegetable and herbs growing at the side. Diane is such a good chef serving full spread of breakfast with everything done perfectly and more than expected. We even admire the patterns on the tea cups. Dinner was wonderful. Thank-you for baking us a cake and serving coffee and tea on the evening we did not have dinner there. We had dinner in a 'famous' restaurant in town and didn't enjoyed it half as much as Diane's. Charlie is very friendly and make us feel very comfortable, thanks for the clearance on the road blockage and the map to the strawberry farm. Play billiards, read a book, watch TV or just do nothing, let Diane feed you, guarantee you will like the Shailers.
The only uncomfortable bit was the flies in the evenings, not sure it was the season or because its near a farm.
Happy Birthday Chef !
hotel_response: Hello from Shailers. We are glad you enjoyed your stay and thank you so much for placing a review. We really do appreciate you taking the time to give us and prospective guests, your feedback. For those who read this, the flies mentioned are actually very small midges which come out at night, are attracted to light and are seasonal and very common in lush gardens especially in early summer. They are harmless in every way.

title: Best B&B - anywhere!
text: Shailers B&B has it all - great rooms, great bed, fabulous food (one of the best breakfasts in NZ) and beautiful views.  The whole package is made perfect by the wonderful hosts, Diana and Charlie. Thank you.  We will be back
hotel_response: We are so glad you enjoyed your stay with us We equally enjoyed you staying and we really look forward to seeing you again. We cannot promise the neighbour will have 700 baby goats to cuddle next time but there is always those cows to milk  ;-)  We really appreciate you placing a review. Thank you

title: Truly our (much bigger!) home away from home!
text: It took us some time to find the place as it was not shown in our GPS. The cranky driver aka the husband commented that it's so "out of the way" but after our 2 nights stay, we didn't want to leave. Charlie greeted us warmly at the door. We took the deluxe room which is an ensuite (totally recommended!) and helped to settle us in. The place is about 12-15 mins drive away from the main restaurants. The room/house is simply wonderful and huge. Such a nice change from our usual cramped city-style apartment (I should a move there..) There is both air con and heater.There are even fresh flowers in the room. The bed feels luxurious and the bathroom is clean. Basic tea-making facilities are provided and there is free wifi. There is also a pool table and lots of DVDs. We manage to play a round of pool as we were the only guests for the 2 nights. The selection of breakfast is good. We took the cooked breakfast and it is scrumptious and filling (Eggs Ben, Continental, Bagel etc). We finished every bit of it. Dianna, we miss your breakast so much! We went on the farm tour with Charlie and had a hoot. Overalls and boots were provided and we had such a wonderful time. I actually enjoyed it better than the waitomo caves tour! I learnt so much about the industry and milked and cows and almost experienced a "green rainbow"!  Glad we managed to meet some of their family members, who are lovely as well. We were so sad to leave. Dianna and Charlie were so helpful and welcoming throughout our stay, it was almost like living with an aunt and uncle! I would give this 6 stars if possible. Hope to be back again!
hotel_response: We loved reading your review. Thank you so much for taking the time to give other potential guests insights about Shailers Bed and Breakfast and our farm tour. As you gathered we just enjoy people. Helping them feel at home is important to us and we are so glad that you enjoyed that aspect too. Glad the green rainbow missed hehehe......We do hope to see you both back here again one day. Meantime stay well and happy travelling.

title: Has it all: great service, comfort, friendly and interesting owners !
text:
