My family of 4 (kids are 6 and 4) had a wonderful stay, it was the best B&B we had in our 2-weeks trip (and that’s no mean feat, as the quality of accommodation everywhere in NZ was great – there  was a good competition :-)  ).

The breakfasts and dinners, home-cooked by the owners, were delicious ; the welcome was both warm but not intrusive ; and the owners had a very entertaining and interesting conversation. Great farm tour too, interesting to learn about the underpinning of NZ's huge dairy industry !

The views from the room and dinner patio area were fantastic, and the place, despite its convenient location, was very quiet.

We keep warm memories of the stay and hope to be back soon !
hotel_response:
Dear Patrice and Alexia
Thank you for posting a review on Trip Advisor. We appreciate your coverage of various aspects of your stay. We are so pleased you were able to stay 2 nights as there are many interesting and fun sights to visit that are close to us. Many guests wish they had stayed longer.  We also enjoyed showing you around the farm and sharing evening meals with you. Thank you for choosing to stay at Shailers Bed and Breakfast. We have happy memories of your stay with us. Kind regards Dianna and Charlie

title: homely with sophistication
text: Stayed with Dianna and Charlie in Feb 2015. What a lovely place to stay, just wish could have been more than 2 nights. They were both charming , fun and attentive. Charlie's farm tour was great......he even had little wellies to fit me !  We felt completely at home and loved meeting some of their family. You'll love it and won't want to leave in a hurry.
hotel_response:
Hi Gill and Ron

Thank you for your kind review. We are glad you managed to stay the two nights as there is a lot to do and see in and around Hamilton. We really enjoyed meeting you both, hosting you in our home and showing you around the farm. All the best for your future. kind regards Charlie and Dianna

title: Perfect stop on the way back to Auckland
text:
We stopped here for one night on the last of our tour of the North Island being a nice 90 minute drive south of the airport.  

What makes this place seem special is the genuine welcome offered by the owners Dianna and Charlie as well as the beautiful, comfortable accommodation.  Dianna greeted us with fresh tea / coffee and homemade buscuits which was very welcome.

Shailers also offers an evening menu which we sampled and believe me this is restaurant quality food at a really good price.

On the following morning we took a farm tour with Charlie who shows real enthusiasm for the business giving us a good insight into how the business works as well as taking us out to see the animals (cows) as well as those of his neighbor (goats).

We wish we could have stayed longer.

Highly recommended.
hotel_response: Hello from the Shailers, Thank you so much for placing a review. It is our policy to never ask guests to do a review, so when they do go to the effort to place a review it means twice as much to us. We are so glad you enjoyed your stay at Shailers and we hope that perhaps you will make the trip down under one more time, then maybe we will get the privilege of hosting you again. Best wishes from Charlie and Dianna

title: Wonderful hosts made for a great weekend!
text:
My husband has stayed here several times while on business and always enjoyed his stays at Shailers but this was my first stay there.  I had heard only good things about this B & B and I was not disappointed.  Dianna and Charlie are excellent hosts and made us feel very welcome and very much at home.  We had a beautifully home cooked meal with them on our first night and they were able to tell us about some good restaurants for our second evening meal.  We had the largest room which was very deluxe and had everything we needed. It was spacious warm and comfortable.  We stayed with them to go to the Field Days at Mystery Creek.  It was well located for this event and close to Hamilton City so we were also able to enjoy an afternoon at the awesome Hamilton Gardens which we thought were up there with the likes of the Butchart Gardens in Canada.  
I have no hesitation in recommending this B & B.
hotel_response: Greetings 610Margaretd. We are so glad that you enjoyed your stay at Shailers B and B and yes to finally meet the lady so fondly talked about over quite a few dinners ..... so glad to have finally meet you in person.  Thank you for taking the time to post a review. We do appreciate guests taking the time to not only submit a review but for going the extra mile to make it comprehensive. As discussed, we hope to see you again in the foreseeable future. Charlie and Dianna

title: Wonderful, the icing on the cake for us with it being the last 2 nights in NZ.
text: This was such a great place to end our 2 week New Zealand adventure. Charlie and Diana make you feel like you are home. They are truly welcoming people, most gracious, so darn interesting, - I am just so glad we stayed with them. This farmstay was a request by my husband and he is still talking about the farm tour. What a high we left New Zealand with because of ending it here. The honeymoon room was beautiful ( thank you both !) immaculate, delicious breakfast, the cheese tray and beer was so appreciated - we needed it after driving from Wellington ! Meeting them was like we knew them forever - we hope they visit us when in the US.  Thank you Charlie for taking us to Raglan - it was such a treat. The best steak in a very long time at Orca.  You two have found your calling - we loved it at Shailer's. Stay here and you won't be disappointed.. a gorgeous property, just a wonderful and much needed respite before our jaunt over the big pond !  again - it was the icing on the cake for us  :)  its the people like the Shailers that make New Zealand a warm and inviting country.
hotel_response: Hello Foursquare. Thank you for submitting your review and for your very kind comments. We feel so privileged to share our home with people from around the world and indeed it is even more special for us to make new friends and to have ongoing contact. Thank you for your letters and we do hope you have received our reply via email. WE look forward to seeing you again in a year or two. Charlie and Dianna

title: Our best stay in New Zealand!
text: We stayed here for 2 nights on a 7 week trip in NZ. From the start we were made to feel special. Charlie and Diana are excellent hosts, and made us feel part of the family. Our room was very comfortable and breakfast fantastic. We highly recommend this B&B.
hotel_response: Thank you Susan for taking the time to give us such a nice review. We really enjoyed you staying with us. Charlie has not forgotton your kind offer to catch up with you both in England for futher discussions on psychology. All the best for the future. kind regards Dianna

title: Shailers haven
text: Dianne and Charlie greeted us warmly and we were invited to tea and biscuits before we had turned around!  Charming family and a beautiful location and the evening meal and breakfast on the sunny verandah were "par excellence".  And such a comfortable bedroom.
hotel_response:
Hi Susan and John
Thank you for your lovely review....so kind and thoughtful of you! We enjoyed you staying with us on at the begining of December. We were pleased you could relax after travelling on the road then enjoy an elfresco dinner at Shailers. Charlie enjoys being able to provide freshly picked  vegetables from his garden. All the best for 2014. If you are ever tempted to come back our way we would be thrilled to see you again. kind regards Dianna

title: Couldn't ask for more
text: Me, my wife and my son stayed at Shailer's for 3 nights during our short trip to New Zealand and I must say that it exceeded all our expectations. Let's start with the location. It is situated in the picturesque Waikato county on about 180 acres of farm land. Beautiful country side views, serene yet close enough to Hamilton city.  We made this our base during our day trips to the Glowworm caves, Hamilton Gardens, Kiwi House, Hobbiton movie set and Rotorua Geo-thermal caves. It is perfectly situated for these trips. Now the facilities - The farm house is very tastefully equipped and you can feel Charlie and Dianne's personal touch on all aspects of the house. It has a beautiful garden, vegetable patch and sweeping views of the country side. Now the breakfast - They have a very sumptuous breakfast included in the rates and with that kind of a breakfast, you can easily skip lunch. We ordered dinner on two nights and I would highly recommend it. We tried the lamb, chicken and fish and they were out of the world. Next, the farm tour. I would highly recommend that you take the farm tour. The experience of riding a quad bike is out of this world and understanding behind the scenes of New Zealand Dairy farming is truly enlightening.  Last, but not the least - the hosts. Charlie and Dianne represent the best of Kiwi hospitality. They made us feel very welcome, were very accommodating of our odd timings for dinner and made sure our short stay was as comfortable as it can be. We were initially planning to stay here only for two nights and then move to a different B&B for the third night. Boy, are we glad that we stayed back! We will be back soon to experience it all over again!  - Sanil
hotel_response:
Hi Sanil
Thank you for your generous and comprehensive review. We are so glad you enjoyed your stay with us, the elfresco breakfasts, dinners and the farm tour.  We consider it a privilege to share our home and farm with you and your family. We are so pleased you could visit all the places you wanted to see plus have some time to relax as well. We wish you all the best for 2014 and hope we have the pleasure of seeing you again. kind regards Dianna

title: Great place
text: We were made welcome from the minute we arrived.  Charlie and Dianne are wonderful hosts in a beautiful location and superb house.  Unexpected arrival of guests arriving a day early to meet some one staying did not cause any fluster.  Dianne took it all in her stride and dinner was able to include them.  This is a wonderful traditional style BnB and would recommend it to any one.
hotel_response: Thank you for choosing to stay with us during your visit to the North Island of New Zealand and for your generous review. It was a pleasure meeting you both and a pleasure to hear that the beauty of the garden is equally enjoyed by our guests. All the best in the future. kind regards Dianna

title: Like coming home
text: I travel frequently for business and stay in many hotels and B&B's. Shailers is one of the most memorable. It's comfortable, clean but, most importantly, I was looked after extremely well by Diana - especially since I wasn't particularly well for 2 of my 4 nights there.  You are guaranteed a warm welcome here andI will be rebooking next time I am in the Waikato.
hotel_response: Thank you for placing your review. We are glad your stay was enjoyable and we look forward to being of service in the future. Best wishes....

title: Farm stay with passion
text:
The farmhouse is luxury the views are to die for , and then you get ...Dianna and Charlie as hosts. I. Spent 5 days with charming hosts who made me feel like a long lost uncle. Had dinner with them on 4 nights and can recommend  Dianna's cooking unreservedly. Charlie's choice of. Wine complements the meal and then. It's all taken on the deck with the superb views.
 The  bed was so  comfortable I slept so well I needed an alarm clock to be on time for breakfast.(anything you want)
Don't forget to ask Charlie for a farm guided tour.A fantastic experience...you will appreciate milk anew.
I was so comfortable I forgot when I was due to check out and stayed another night.

DON'T MISS
hotel_response:
Hi Ken,
We loved having you stay with us. We think you were more like a brother than an Uncle. The reason we love our B n B home-stay so much is meeting people from all around the world and making new friends along the way. So new friend, travel safe and enjoy every sunset. Thanks for sharing your enthusiasm for life. Charlie

title: Great location with excellent accommodation and charming hosts
text: We were looked after in style by Charlie and Dianne. Our visit was far too short.  Accommodation was excellent surrounded by well maintained gardens. Would recommend to anyone who wants to be well looked after in very pleasant surroundings by charming and attentive hosts.
hotel_response: Hi Valerie, Thank you for taking the time to place a review. We really appreciate guests doing this. We are getting very dry now with no rain in sight so the watering continues in the gardens. We wish you a happy and adventurous 2013. Charlie

title: Great Find, Very Enjoyable Experience
text: We stayed  one night with Charlie and Dianna at their lovely home/B&B on their dairy ranch which is a really beautiful property.  When we pulled up in front of the house, we were so warmly greeted, we felt as if we were visiting family.  That aura of warmth, friendliness and hospitality was present throughout our too short stay. We had a spacious deluxe bedroom and bathroom with a slider going out to a common patio.  After we were settled in our room, we were offered our choice of a beverage and  some snacks. Although we did not give them much advance notice about our interest in having a farm tour, or having dinner with them, they rallied and were able to accommodate both requests graciously.  Breakfast was delicious including fresh orange juice and eggs benedict.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and consider it to be one of the better trip choices we made when planing our New Zealand adventure.
hotel_response:
Hi Howard and Sharyn,
Glad to hear you are safely home. Thanks so much for taking the time to write a review. We had a good rain on Feb 4th and 5th but getting very dry again now. We are watering the gardens every day. Best wishes for your future travel.
Charlie and Dianna

title: Highly recommended
text:
We booked at this B&B one week before arriving. I was impressed with the organisation of Dianna and Charlie, They forwarded us their menu for both breakfast and dinner to choose from.

The property was easily found on our GPS, in the beautiful country-side of the Waikato. Rolling hills, emerald green grass, gracious trees and animals grazing in the fields. 

The access is well marked and we drove along their long paved driveway to their large home-stead. Dianna greeted us warmly and we were shown to our comfortable room which had the private well equipped and spacious bathroom immediately across the hall-way. 

Our bedroom opened to the deck to the most beautiful rural view and their immaculate beautiful garden. We were treated to some refreshments including very tasty home-made cake with tea, we could have had wine as this was also offered.

Our dinner was delicious and Dianna and Charlie joined us which was most enjoyable, they are very hospitable and made us feel very welcome.

We fully recommend The Shailer's Bed and Breakfast, you wouldn't find one better. Close to Hamilton and Cambridge and very well placed on the tourist route going north or south.
hotel_response: Thank you for your generous and comprehensive review.  We enjoy the stimulating conversations, sharing our home and garden with you and appreciate your feed back. We hope you have a successful season this summer and autumn. Cheers Charlie and Dianna

title: Room with a view
text:
Beautiful views from the shared lounge and a very quiet place to stay and relax.

The Shailers make you feel part of the family and a great breakfast.

Dianna even came and picked up myself and another guest from a wedding we were attending down the road at midnight - now that is service!
hotel_response: Hi Folks, Thanks for posting your review. It was a pleasure to host you. What goes around comes around. We believe that in showing kindness others will show kindness and the world will be a better place. All the best for your futures, Charlie and Dianna

title: Perfect spot to stay when visiting the Waitomo Caves
text: We stayed here on the way to the Caves as it was closer than staying in downtown Hamilton. The Caves are only 40 minutes away.  Charlie and Dianna are the nicest people.  We were greeted with delicious homemade carrot cake and Anzac biscuits.  We had ordered dinner ahead of time as we didn't want to have to think about finding a restaurant after a long day's drive from Paihia (with many stops along the way).  We were very glad we did. A great meal from Dianna and lovely banter from our 'waiter' Charlie.  Lots of wine talk as well.  We were sorry we didn't have the chance to go on the farm tour with Charlie.  The rooms were just wonderful (and they had the yummy Anzac biscuits, too).  I didn't realise the flowers (including the ones in our room) were real until I touched them.  We were delighted with our room and our friends were too with the larger ensuite room.  Both rooms opened up onto the patio.  Having our own lounge room and billiard room also made us feel very special.  The next morning, after a wonderful breakfast, Dianna sent us on our way with instructions and maps.  Highly recommended.
hotel_response: Hi Barbara, Thanks so much for giving such an informative review. That must be really helpful to other travelers en route to the Waitomo Caves. Needless to say we enjoyed you staying. We all had a great evening ..... and my opinion remains unchanged ..... Australia still make the best Red Wine in the world. Happy and safe travels in the future. Charlie

title: Well worth staying in.
text: This place is great.  Beautiful property, the best breakfast we had in whole 5 week trip.  The host and hostess are the best.   She left two great home made cookies in room and fresh flowers!!
hotel_response: Hi there, Thanks for posting your review. Dianna loves cooking and the home stay Bed and Breakfast is a fabulous way of sharing that gift with appreciative travelers. Glad you could stay with us and best wishes for your future adventures. Charlie

title: Wish We Could Have Stayed Longer
text: Charley and Diana are great hosts.  the room was fantastic and everything was taken care of for us.  We ordered dinner ahead of time and had a fabulous meal at a very reasonable extra charge.
hotel_response: Is it really 6 weeks ago since you were here. Thank you for posting a lovely review. We are glad you enjoyed your stay. It is raining hard so I get to stay in side and catch up on office work. Lots of cheers to you from us in New Zealand.....

title: A truly hidden gem
text: we had a fabulous stay at Shailers, Charlie and Dianna are amazing hosts, nothing is too much trouble. They are very friendly and the food was delicious and the room was fabulous.  Out of our round the world trip Shailers was the most impressive and relaxing.
hotel_response: Thank you for posting your kind review. We are enjoying our Bed and Breakfast very much thanks to great guests like yourselves for choosing to stay with us. Finished milking yesterday for the season and with winter fast approaching in N Z I get to catch up on some office work ....... Best regards

title: Wonderful
text: This a beautiful place to stay. Beautiful home in a wonderful setting. Dianna and Charlie are warm and friendly people. Really good food too. You just have to go and try it out! We would definately go there again.

title: A Fantastic Stay
text: My husband and I recently stayed at Shailers B & B and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.....it was fabulous!!! Dianna and Charlie were great hosts and there was nothing that they would not do to make our stay a memorable one.  The room was fabulous and our 'private' patio was really nice.  Much attention to detail was evident, but most of all, both Dianna and Charlie and Mary made us feel very much at home.  The food was fabulous and we would both recomment that you have a dinner there 'al fresco'.  The presentation was 'picture perfect'  but it tasted even better then it looked!!  Thank you.  We would certainly recommend it to our friends and we hope to stay there again for a longer stay.
hotel_response: How lovely to hear from you.....and receive such a generous review! It was a pleasure to host you both. We are grateful you could fit one night of your travels around New Zealand, to stay at Shailers and dine in. We appreciate there are many places to visit and a lot of distance to cover (though not as much as in Canada!) So thank you for choosing to stay with us. All the best for 2012. Cheers Charlie and Dianna

title: Excellent Food and Hosts
text: Shailers was the best place we stayed on our trip to NZ.  We stayed for 4 nights at the end of November 2011.  Dianna and Charlie were just the right amount of involved.  They were fun to talk to, but also did not hover like we encountered at some other bed and breakfasts.  Dianna is an amazing cook!  We ended up eating breakfast and dinner there everyday.  Breakfast was so filling that we ended up only eating 2 meals a day.  The farm tour was a lot fun since we got to learn about the dairy farm industry and ride 4 wheelers around the farm.
hotel_response:
Hi Betty
Thank you for the great review. It is lovely to hear from you. We are glad you enjoyed the meals and stay on the farm. We love cooking for people and serving people.... your enthusiastic response certainly makes it all worthwhile. All the best for 2012. Cheers Charlie and Dianna

title: Comfy, warm, clean and oh-so-friendly B&B
text:
Charlie & Dianna will welcome you and bid you farewell, while giving you your space and privacy. A lovely house on top of a little hill, it's 10min from the larger town of Hamilton, and 40min away from the Waitomo Caves. Dianne is a wonderful cook, and both have awesome farm and NZ knowledge. 

I wasn't able to do the farm tour, but if I make it back, I'll definitely do it. When I left I felt like I had 2 friends I can come and visit again.

-Nadja
PS. Hope you had a great Birthday Dianna, and wishing you a Happy New Yeart!
hotel_response:
Hi Nadja
Thank you for the generous review. We really enjoyed meeting you and sharing our home with you. I had a wonderful birthday, celebrating a birthday brunch with family and dined out for dinner so very spoiled. We hope you have the opportunity to come again. Meanwhile all the best for 2012. Cheers Charlie and Dianna

title: Great farm stay
text: Enjoyed this farm stay.  Informative tour of their dairy farm.  Lovely hospitality and excellent breakfast.  Wonderful hosts.
hotel_response: Hi Mary, Thanks for your review. We are really glad you enjoyed your stay with us. It is easy to be great hosts when we have such lovely guests. Happy travels for the future.

title: quality hosts and accommodation worth every cent
text:
Shailers is a family farm full or warmth and love. they treat you like they have known you for years and go above and beyond to make your stay as comfortable as possible. 

i was travelling with my mother and they asked if we wanted another bed in the room. unlike most places it was not some fold out bed where the springs poke you in the back all night but a comfortable and warm real single bed. had an extremely comfortable stay and could have slept for hour. 

Dinner and breakfast was delicious ! 10/10 would defiantly recommend to eat there. 

Could not say a bad word about it!!!!! would have loved to stay longer

title: simply exceptional
text: If you find a b&b that is good it is the best accommodation possible and Shailers is exceptional .Thankyou Diana & Charlie for your welcome,good advice,magnificent setting&facilities and great breakfast. You are very special hosts.Anne,Lois& Peter.

title: Super Hosts, Outstanding B & B, and Amazing Meals
text: We read the great reviews on TA and based on that info, we booked our stay at Shailers and they did not disappoint. This was the best B & B I have ever stayed at and what made it so special for me was the appealing location, great meals, wonderful attention to detail that Diana had with the Breakfast & Dinner and the sense that Charlie & Diana had a B & B because they love meeting and hosting people. If I was ever in the are again I would definitely stay here.

title: Absolutely Delightful Bed and Breakfast
text: We travelled for 3 weeks in New Zealand and Shailers stood out as our favourite Bed and Breakfast. Dianna and Charles were such great hosts and made us feel so at home. As we were the only guests staying we were upgraded to their luxury suite which was just lovely and so comfortable. We also had the use of a lovely big lounge with stunning views over the farm and nothing was too much trouble. Charles and Dianna greeted us with drinks on arrival, offered us use of their computer and printed maps for our onward journey. The only disappointment was that we had only booked for one night and would loved to have stayed longer.

title: Treated like Royalty by Charles & Dianna
text:
We were unsure what we would make of our stay when we did the inital booking. Thank heavens we did as this is a gem of a place.
We were the only couple there and were upgraded to the room you see on the website. The room is enourmous and of a high standard. You have the free run of a separate living room. 
When we arrived we were treated to tea from fine china cups and home made cakes and biscuits.
We had booked to eat in that evening and Dianna made everything from scratch and set the table for a romantic meal for two. The food was excellent and you couldn't have eaten better in a restaurant .
Breakfast next morning was a meal in itself with a large choice. Try the homemade sausages which come from their herd.
Charles is a great guy with a dry wit . Nothing was too much trouble and it is a pity it was only for one night.

title: Excellent Bed and Breakfast, best one in New Zealand so far.
text: We have been to over 20 Bed and Breakfasts on both islands of New Zealand and never come across such an amazing home with wonderful hosts Charlie and Dianna. Dianna is a wonderful cook and the breakfasts are awesome (will keep your stomach full all day). She can also do dinners if you require and they really fill you up after a hard day's travelling. Both hosts cannot do enough for you and are so courteous and polite and so helpful with things to see and do in the area. If you want a place to stay central to many attractions this is the place to stay, so quiet and peaceful.

title: Fantastic stay here!
text: Really enjoyed staying here, especially Charlie & Dianna's hospitality.  The farm tour was interesting and scenery stunning.  As others have said, I also recommend the food - both breakfast and dinner were really lovely.  It's a really easy drive on the way to/out of Auckland.  We were staying as a couple but this would definitely be a great place to stay with kids too.

title: Friendly, excellent B&B
text: We enjoyed 3 nights at Shailers.  Charlie & Dianna are brilliant hosts, welcoming and really helpful.  We ate with them every night and Dianna is an excellent cook, every meal was delicious, steak from their own beasts and vegetables straight from the garden.  I was able to use the computer and the washing machine, nothing was too much trouble.

title: Great Place to stay
text:
We loved our two nights at the Shailers.  The home and the rooms were very comfortable, and there were lots of games and things to do for our young children.  We loved the farm tour, and got to see the yard, and sit the kids up on the cows, and milk the cows.  It was informative and fun.  The best part was the cooking.  You MUST let Dianna cook dinner for you, and ask for the farm raised beef sausages and the lamb steaks.  It was absolutely delicious. 

Dianna couldn't have done more to help us out (found some glue, let us borrow the battery charger, use the phone, use the computer, called to check out activities, etc) and the two of them are as friendly and easy-going as anyone we've ever met.  The kids loved the stay and are very excited to stay in  B&B again.  Thanks Dianna and Charlie, and good luck.

title: Farm stay with great hosts
text:
What a pity that we only stayed one night, on our journey to the north, because we loved Shailers.  Lovely location, beautiful home, such a warm welcome: like meeting old friends!!
We enjoyed drinks on the patio and quality conversation: Dianna and Charlie have fascinating stories to tell of their life experiences - we could have talked for hours!!
They insisted that we ride up on the quad bike with Charlie to view the farm: and it was worth it and quite exhilerating!!  (Better to drive than ride pillion!!) .
Breakfast was al fresco, tasty food, great views, birdsong.  Thank you so much, Charlie and Dianna, it was a pleasure to stay with you.

title: This is as good as it gets!
text: We booked online from the Isle of Skye and a good humoured reply came back wondering we really wanted to stay for a year and a day. They'd worked out that we'd bungled the form filling exercise. The reality of the experience itself was even better than their excellent website describes Shailer's. Charlie and Dianna welcomed us like long lost family and offered us elegant tea on the verandah. Everything was spotless and efficient - power shower like a tropical waterfall and you know you're alive after a long trip. Our friends arrived the following morning to join us for an a la carte breakfast menu to die for and we ourselves only wished we had booked in for dinner the previous evening. Enjoyed the use of the snooker table and the place was loaded with games if you had the time. Great place and wonderful hosts - an overnight stay which alone will give us the incentive to save for a return trip down under.  Many thanks indeed!

title: Great accommodations & great hosts
text:
This is a great B & B/Farm stay. We stayed there right after our long Vancouver-Auckland flight and it was a great decision. The place is relaxing, quiet, clean, well maintained, with every amenity that you could ask for. The hosts, Charlie and Dianna, make you feel right at home. 

There is a laptop available so that you can catch up on your emails. There are books and games in the beautiful living room and the views out onto the farm acreage below the surrounding hillside is magnificent.

The rooms and the bathrooms are super and the little touches like coffee/tea makers in the room made it all seem perfect.

Charlie took us on the farm tour and we even milked the cows. It was fascinating and very informative. 

We used this location to jump over to the Waitomo Caves tour and for our visit to Rotorua.

We stayed in a number of B & B's in NZ and Australia in our month long visit and Shailers rates right at the top.

Highly recommended.

title: Best of All
text:
Shailers B&B was the best, and the best value, stay of our three week trip to New Zealand.  The property is superb and spacious, and our room was large, comfortable and spotlessly clean.  Shailers is on a dairy farm about 20 minutes drive outside Hamilton.

The owners, Charlie and Dianna, were friendly, helpful and hospitable; they made us feel like part of the family.  It is possible to book an evening meal at Shailers, and we enjoyed a tasty dinner, good wine and excellent conversation with Charlie and Dianna.

There are tea/coffee making facilities in the room, there is a large guest lounge and internet access was offered.

Breakfast was amongst the best we had in New Zealand, and afterwards Charlie took us on an interesting and informative tour of the farm.

If we ever return to New Zealand, Shailers will definitely be on the itinerary.

title: If you are looking or somewhere to stay near Hamilton, stay here!
text: Perfect hosts who make you feel so welcome and want you to treat their marvellous home as your own. The deluxe room is worth spending a bit more money on and would put many 4 star hotels to shame. The optional farm tour is well worth experiencing especially on the quad bikes. If having the full breakfast, don't bother booking anywhere for lunch. Optional evening meal is worth booking especially as all ingredients are bought fresh, locally , that morning. We enjoyed the company of our hosts, Charlie & Dianna, whilst eating al fresco, on the decking , enjoying wonderful views over the farm

title: The most welcoming guesthouse ever!
text:
The farmhouse is modern and beautifully styled, set in its own lovely garden,  up on a hill overlooking the farm and surrounding countryside.  Everything we could possibly need was offered, in the friendliest manner. We were made to feel at home, as soon as went in the door.  Sitting on the patio, in a glorious sunset, chatting to our hosts  and sipping our wine,  was the perfect end to a great trip on our way back to Auckland for Christmas.   I only wish we had found it sooner, as we would have loved to have stayed longer. Our room was a bit small,  as it was the only one she had left vacant (we just dropped in without booking) but v. comfortable. There was a beautifully furnished spacious lounge for guests to relax in with plenty of local NZ books and items of interest. 
Excellent breakfast with a lot of variety.  My lasting memory is having a huge piece of the family Christmas cake pressed into our hands as we were leaving,  to have with our picnic.  that's kindness for you!

title: Fantastic stay with great hosts.
text:
We booked our stay a few months ahead and from the start you could tell that Dianna & Charlie were going to be great hosts. They emailed directions and a menu for us to look over before we arrived. We rang from Waitomo Caves after we remembered we hadn't ordered a meal. What sort of meal would you like she asked? The steak and crumble springs to mind I said. No problem said Dianna. We arrived with a warm welcome and drink. Charlie cooked the steak to perfection. One of their own cows actually. One of the best we tasted in NZ. 

The room was all you could want for a relaxing nights sleep and the bed was the most comfortable we had slept in on our six week holiday. The ensuite had a lovely shower and was very up to date. The view from the window was very impressive. The full breakfast was equally high standard, as was the whole stay. 

We would certainly recommend this farm stay to anyone. 
Our only one regret is that we only had one nights stay.

Robert & Sheila.

title: Home from home with perfect hosts
text:
I visited Charlie and Dianna in mid February, whilst making a difficult visit to my dying brother in nearby Hamilton. 
From the moment I was exchanging emails with them (from Spain)about the reservation to the sad moment I left them after three days, they could not have done more to make me welcome. I was emailed directions on how to drive from the hospital to their house, and the directions were spot on.
I was unsure exactly when I would arrive at their homestead, but they said "not to worry, we understand and we´ll see you when we see you." A double room for me as a singleton? No problem. 
I arrived on the appointed day, but without notice whilst they were having dinner. No problem Pull up a chair, here´s a glass of wine and food will be with you in five minutes.
The bedroom was extremely comfortable in a newly built annex to the old house and the bathroom was sparklingly clean and bright with everything you could want. Hot fluffy towels, bathrobe, shampoos etc.
Breakfast in the dining room next to a huge guest living room suite that contained both a very large TV and, next door, a snooker table. Board games and books abounded if the weather closed in .
Waking up early (jetlag) I wandered into the kitchen and raided the fridge for fresh milk for a cuppa. When I reported my theft a fe hours later, "no problem, we´re glad that you threated the place like home". "Could I throw some clothes into your washing machine?" "Sure. No charge" And the dried clothes were folded up ready for me to iron, where necessary.
On my final morning, I was invited to breakfast with the family, rather than be on my own,  
Oh, and internet access whenever you wanted it - free.
I could not have found a more confortable place with the warmest welcome imaginable . Charlie and Dianna are a world class act. Pay them a visit.
Recommended? Sure. Many times over.

title: Experience New Zealand Countryside
text:
Our family had the priviledge of staying at the Shailers Bed and Breakfast in September 2008.  Their B&B is on an operating dairy farm about 15 minutes south of Hamilton, New Zealand.  Their home is a fantastic place to have a B&B with great views of the surrounding country side as well as the mountains. The main bedroom is large and has a very nice ensuite. There are 2 smaller bedrooms also with private baths.  The home is lovely and inviting, set up very well for guests.

The breakfast was wonderful and we had the option of ordering our breakfast the previous evening from a short menu.  Dinner is also available for guests at rates that would be comparable to restaurants.

They have internet avaialble for their guests.  We had a terrific time getting to know our hosts Charlie and Dianna Shailer. The entire stay well exceeded our expectations and we  would be pleased to return,

Our experience was a first rate stay and we would encourage others to experience an operating dairy farm and great interaction with fantastic local people.

title: B&B near Hamilton city center
text: Great hosts that know the area, nice quiet location. Free parking and the swimmingpool is a very nice extra. Be advised the McAdams family has children however we hardly heared them being around the house.

title: In need of an upgrade
text:
Definitely in need of an upgrade. Rooms are on the smaller end of the spectrum. Parking was very limited. Towels weren't changed in the 3 days we stayed even though the booklet said they would be changed daily. The booklet also warned we would be charged extra if we didn't wash the dishes. Beds are very soft. Place is looking old and thus unclean feeling. Ours had a huge stain on the carpet and bathroom looking like it hasn't seen a deep clean in some time. For $230 a night there needs to be some improvement.
Will be looking elsewhere when we next stay in Hamilton.

title: Very friendly with all comfort we needed
text: Our stay in the motel was very comfortable and we appreciated that the coffee/tea making facilities were provided. The room was clean, slightly worn but well acceptable. The receptionist was most helpful arranging a perfectly safe parking for our motorbike.

title: Value, friendly, good location
text: Very good service, clean rooms, always friendly and helpful. Rooms are big, kitchen facilities, fridge, microwave everything you want. Some rooms with outdoor areas.  Great location near supermarket, fast food and good restaurants, very safe.

title: cockroaches, smell, dirty, issues with emergency housing guests
text: Nothing like pictures advertised, note no tourist reviews for a long time.  Charged $40 to cancel a 3 night stay after the first horrendous night visit.  Business traveler and not impressed with management of the complaint.  They agreed they hadn't fumigated for a while when cockroaches mentioned.  Would never recommend

title: Grubby, scruffy and disappointing
text: We were in Hamilton for a week on business and stayed at the Stadium Motel, in one of three 2 bedroom duplex apartments located adjacent to the main accommodation wing. Lets start with the positives:  Our host was a lovely lady who was very pleasant. The motel is not used for MSD emergency housing and our unit had quite new TV's in both bedrooms and a very large TV in the living area with good picture quality. And now for the negatives: Our apartment was tired, uncared for and worse, it was not clean. Stadium Motel is a very standard type of lodging that was probably built about 20 years ago, and since then has apparently enjoyed little maintenance and no refurbishment. Many of the fixtures and furnishings are stained, dented, broken or just old and tatty. But it was the lack of cleanliness that was most concerning. Crusty  food splatters in the microwave and on a dinnerplate, dirty windows and walls, dusty grime covered appliances and surfaces, and curtains hanging off the rails were some of the faults that quite obviously have gone unattended for months or years. Much of this could be easily rectified with a scheduled maintenance and cleaning program, which I did bring to the attention of our lovely host. Stadium Motel may never be the destination for a family vacation or a romantic getaway, but it should be an okay place to stay, which sadly at the moment it's not. Instead it was a rather depressing place to be.

title: Very comfortable
text:
We stayed here for only one night, Extremely comfortable and clean.  Manager was a lovely lady. Very friendly, very helpful.
We will stay here again. Great shower too. Quiet location.
Close to town, it's not brand new, but its very Comfortable

title: Friendly owners
text: I needed milk alternative and the owner was very obliging and bought almond milk for me immediately and that is god sent if you're vegan. Rest is of the facility is same as other motels I guess. All motels are in the same area and its about 5 minutes drive to so called city centre - whats its worth!

title: One nighter
text: For a short stay this was more than adequate.  Excellent room upstairs with spa (I did not try) and shower in a big bathroom, comfortable bed and adequate fridge.  Good value for money and quiet even though several units were occupied.  Friendly helpful staff.

title: Comfortable
text:
Great location, but outside the city centre. 
About 25 minute walk into the centre.
Room was large and had everything you'd want for a short stay.
Bathroom was large and clean. 
Would recommend this place.

title: My partner me and 3 under 3
text: Partner and I stayed here 2 nights with our 3 kids aged 6weeks 1 yr and 2 yrs. we were very happy with the quality cleanliness and the price, if were ever in Hamilton again they would be our first call the staff/owner was very nice and welcoming 😊
hotel_response: It's a great pleasure having your lovely family staying with us.  Looking forward to seeing you all again :)

title: short stay
text: The staff very friendly & helpful. The room was very clean. Very quite motel to stay at with shops very handy. The only issue I had was the bed as it seemed to soft & moved with every movement. But in saying that I would stay there again

title: Best kept secret
text: The Stadium Motel in Hamilton is excellent.  I've stayed here twice and will stay here again.  I only found this place due to not being able to get into my regular hotel.  The rooms are all well appointed, very clean and the owners are such lovely people.  Stayed in in 2017.
hotel_response:
Your review is very much appreciated, Thank You, we always try to keep our guest happy. :)
Looking forward to see you again in future. :)

title: Amazing
text:
Wonderful stay.. Clean and modern. Lovely big shower. Kitchen had everything you need. Comfortable beds. Wonderful friendly staff. Could not fault it. 
Close to everything
When in Hamilton will definitely stay again
hotel_response:
It was our pleasure to host you.
Thank You for your review, looking forward to see you again. :)

title: Clean and comfortable
text: We stayed here just 1 night, location ok, rooms nice and clean, The check in was very quick and the receptionist was very friendly and helpful. For the price a nice hotel to stay. The beds comfortable and rooms fairly quite.

title: Get a new job
text: We stayed back in May, would not go back. Went to check in to our 4-berth room and some older guy, had the attitude of a manager or maybe even the owner, and was clearly training the two Asian men in the office. These two men were very kind to us and had quite the strong accent so when they mispronounced my friends name we smiled and said that’s us. When we proceeded to tell them we’d booked for four people, the manager looked at us and laughed, saying there’s no way we booked that room because they’re all sold for the evening and that we’d have to book two 2-person rooms there instead. Not wanting to be separated on opposite sides of the property for the night, we then asked if they knew of availability elsewhere and the manager then scoffed at us and said, quite sarcastically, that the entire nearby area was booked out for the rugby that night. Decided that we had no choice so paid the extra room - I asked if they were sure there was no mix up and repeated our names, and the manger said it wasn’t their fault that they didn’t receive the booking and that “the price wasn’t that much different” - well the price change was significant for us and there was no empathy or anything from him, he completely missed our point and dismissed us. We went to put our luggage away and 5 minutes later we are told - by the same rude manager/owner - that there was a mix up with the names and we had booked our original room for 4 people, but that we had to get out of the rooms right away so he could check that we hadn’t touched anything. Now I understand he required to check the room but it was done so rudely we couldn’t believe it. Went down to receive our refund and the manager was being condescending to the Asian men he was training, and there was absolutely no offer of apology or discount from the manager at all, even though he’d messed us around from the time we arrived. The only things I can’t fault were the lovely men in reception who could not apologise enough and were very friendly, and the cleanliness of the room. But to that man who didn’t have the time for us that day, if you are still there then get another job mate, it’s quite obvious that customer service isn’t for you.

title: Awesine
text:
From the time we arrived until we left, everything was awesome.  The manager made us welcome with his humour and willingness to help wherever needed.
The unit was clean and the bed, very comfortable.
Would recommend this motel to anyone wanting to stay in Hamilton

title: All You Need
text: As a motel, it has all you need.  We just stayed one night as we were passing through. We had a one bedroom with a spa bath.  The place was very clean, and the staff was very helpful.  We would stay here again.

title: Clean and Comfy
text: Stayed in the 3 bed apartment for 4 nights with my son. The apartment had everything you could need and more! Couldn't fault he cleanliness. Will definitely be returning at some point. Easy walk to town centre where there are plenty of shops and restaurants. Nice quiet location and staff very friendly.

title: Great location
text: The motel is located next to the stadium and within a short distance to hub of the city.  The room, bathroom, and kitchenette was very clean and tidy and we had free wi-fi and Sky TV.  Thanks to the staff who were very helpful.

title: Home away from home.
text:
Best place to stay with family. Very professional host.  Place is immaculate. Highly recommended.
It's located in city centre so very convenient. We had awesome time with family in this motel.   If you looking for a nice experience head on to stadium motel.

title: Arms Reach
text: Great location over the road from the stadium. Great rooms, spa bath, full kitchen, private outdoor table chairs. There were 2 bedrooms so that always a bonus. Lovely people at reception. Would go back and stay for sure.

title: Neat, clean, comfortable. If in doubt stay here.
text: Great location on a quiet street fronting green parklands. The room was neat, clean and very comfortable, the bathroom was spotless, the kitchenette was well-appointed and the bedding was clean and crisp. The courtyard was a pleasant spot for a cup of tea, although could benefit from privacy screens between rooms. Generous free wifi vouchers got us connected to the world and the cable TV was a nice touch. The staff were accommodating and even let us use their vacuum to clean our bags ahead of our return journey. Very hard to fault. Prime location if you're in town for the rugby. If in doubt stay here. Good honest value.

title: Pet Friendly in very nice accommodation
text: We stayed here a couple of times a few years ago and always wanted to review you. I used to have a 7yr old Mastiff whom travelled everywhere with us, he was a great housetrained dog. We were desperate for accommodation with our dog and when I rang this place the man could not do enough for us. We got a 1 bdrm apartment with a Spa and all the mod cons you get anywhere else. The beg was comfy and our dog had little back yard so could go outside. YOu had to clean up after him which was no problem. We really enjoyed our stay here on several occasions base mostly on the fact we could have our dog with us. Very kind propieters and a lovely stay. Our dog loved it but unfortunately he passed away. From then on we always managed to find Pet Friendly motels, it was great. My poor baby has passed away not but I am trying to relive his memories of remembering the kind people in good hole Hamilton and NZ. Enjoyable stay, have stayed twice and will recoomend to anyobe

title: Clean and comfortable
text: Great place to stay. Very comfortable and friendly staff. Great location. Shame there was no airconditioner. But all the beds had an electric blanket and an oil heater was available. Was very handy being close to the main shops as well.

title: Great location
text:
We stayed at this motel with perfect distance to the Rugby ground. Owners were just lovely but as we had booked some months earlier we did think we would all be together instead of one unit on one street and one on the other😒
The apartment was modern but the upstairs we thought could be very dangerous with no night light in the tiny area upstairs one could easily fall down the stairs not being familiar with the surroundings 
The whole apartment although modern lacked pictures it had no atmosphere at all  We would stay again but would check out the other units first next time

title: Peaceful and comfortable
text: Called at motel to make a booking with certain requirements as wife was coming out of hospital after major surgery. Able to move in straight away as room was ready at 9.15am.  Owners could not have been more obliging, nice rooms and setup.  Would thoroughly recommend to anyone.  We will be back during follow up visits.

title: Good for Our Purposes
text: We booked the Stadium Motel for only one night as a place to stay after watching the Chiefs vs. Force rugby match at Waitomo Stadium.  The biggest positive of this motel is its location to the stadium (practically next door).  The room cost might be a little high for what it is, although the room was reasonably comfortable, appeared clean, and Dorothy at the front desk was very friendly and helpful.  The wi-fi service was very poor and was not working at all the morning we left.

title: Great business trip stay
text:
Good clean units and complex with very friendly staff to make for an overall great stay.
Good size rooms but limited forced venting / no air condition (I do prefer able to open a window)
Would benefit with some more green / natural plants / trees etc to soften complex

title: Stadium Motel
text:
Well located for Hamilton and surrounding area, the management are helpful. We shared a three bedroom apartment which was unusual for having two bathrooms and a well equipped sitting/dining/kitchen area with a balcony overlooking the school across the quite busy road. When we arrived the unit was clean apart from the cooker and a few dishwasher residues on plates, but the daily servicing was sketchy both in terms of cleaning and bed making.
The worst problem is the wifi which drops out frequently with the necessity of logging in to the Xenbo network every time, frustrating and time consuming, this is a problem we experienced at several Motels across NZ I do not understand why owners are paying for this very poor service to a simple technical problem which can be solved for little money!
In summary this accomodation is ideally equipped for couples and families but could do with greater attention to detail to give a much higher rating.

title: Clean and characterless
text: Modern characterless motel like any other - clean, bland, efficient.  No garden, outside area or view of any sort - if you look out your window you can see tarmac and your car.  So there's Sky and a selection of DVDs in reception to look at instead.  Down a surprisingly busy side street, convenient (by car) to just about everything. Reception not unfriendly.  Fine as a place to sleep the night.

title: quiet and comfortable
text: My husband and I stayed here for his work.  He slept during the day and I spent the nights.  It was quiet and comfortable.  We had a room with a lounge down stairs and the bedrooms upstairs. It was comfortable and clean. Sky guest select was available so I could watch my favourite shows.  The location was great. You could walk to town. There was a kitchen if you wanted to cook.  The price was very reasonable given the size of the rooms.

title: A liitle gem..
text: If you are looking for accommodation within walking distance of the centre and off the main road tis motel may be for you. Room was spacious and fiited with a full kitchen. It was quiet and clean. Enjoyable experience at a reasonable price.

title: Nice
text:
We stayed here for 2 nights on our honeymoon while exploring this area and waitomo caves.
The man at reception seems to have dry humour so comes across as cold at first, but was a nice bloke (even though he made fun of how our Aussie accents pronounced certain NZ towns haha). He upgraded us to a spa room seeing as it was our honeymoon and had great knowledge of the area and things to do.
Nice room, the spa was lovely (the plug leaked a fair bit so had to keep refilling the bath), and was great having a dvd player and tv for after our big day blackwater rafting when we just wanted a nice night in watching a movie with the heater blasting.
I'd recommend this lovely place if you just want a nice simple place to stay which is easy to explore this area from.

title: Great Apartment
text:
Stayed for 2 nights in a 2 bedroom apartment for a Surf Lifesaving Pool competition, very nice warm accommodation, very accommodating with our booking, easy to deal with, nothing appeared to be a problem for them and in turn us. My sons enjoyed the stay including a long spa bath one evening 

Would definitely stay again

title: Disappointing but adequate for our one night stay!
text: On arrival we found the proprietor quite unfriendly; there was no friendly banter of welcome.  After we checked-in he handed over the key without any pleasantries and without telling us where our unit was located (I had to ask).  It was a cold evening when we arrived, the proprietor knew we were a half hour away so it would have been nice to have the heater turned on for our arrival.  Attention to detail in my view is important.  Nevertheless the motel was adequate for our one night stay.  We will not stay again.  Our unit was smaller that it looked in online photos.  There was an average comfort double bed in the lounge and a single bed in the bedroom; I thought this was quite odd, the single in the bedroom.  The unit was clean albeit a bit musty smelling.  Finally, I think it is overpriced, NZ$160 for three and believe one could have done a lot better price wise and value for money elsewhere.

title: Bit disappointed
text: The room was ALOT smaller than it looked in the photos, rather like a McDs Bigmac.The room smelt musty and there was not enough hot water to run a Spa Bath. The bath was cold and there was no hot water again that night to do the dishes or try and have another Spa Bath. For the price paid that is not good enough and I would not stay here again.
hotel_response: Thank you for your review, but we find it a little confusing as you did not stay with us. Your family stayed and we understand from them that they thoroughly enjoyed their stay and would come again.

title: Excellent motel
text: We stayed there for one night. We had 3 bedrooms with two hotels. The whole motel was clean with the receptionist giving us recommendations on places to go. With spacious toilets, kitchen and living room and TVs with good selection of channels, we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves there. Wished that we had stayed longer though.

title: Exactly what we wanted..description 100%
text: Won tickets to Chiefs game and as a treat we thought we would splash out on a motel, more than what we wanted to pay but it was well worth it,  Spa bath, relax, sky tv, hop skip and jump to the stadium, couldn't ask for much more than that. Made our 1 night stay feel like a treat. Hope to stay again sometime.
hotel_response: We are so pleased to hear you enjoyed your stay. Thank you for the great recommendation.

title: Great Stay at the Stadium Motel
text: A recent football game took us to the Stadium Motel and from the 1st phone call to reception to book, I knew this would be good.  Brian and Dorothy made us more than welcome, provided great information about the surroundings and really provided a good standard of accommodation in a great city - I loved hamilton, the people are so down to earth and the city really is a nice place to be.  I'll be back, hopefully for a Chiefs Final 3 years in a row.
hotel_response: Thanks for the great comments Richard, you were awesome guests, and it was a pleasure having you stay.

title: Very nice hotel, this is my second stay here.
text: The owners (Brian and Dorothy) are very accommodating and helpful.  We were staying on holiday and all their recommendations for travel and sight seeing were perfect and made the trip all that much better.  The hotel rooms are excellent, beds perfect and comfortable, the oversized bathrooms are equipped with jetted tubs and tile floors, and very large!  The kitchen area has a refrigerator, microwave, sink and utensils too, made you feel like you were at home.  Several times we walked down town to grab a bite to eat, or shop.  Brian, the owner, went out of his way several times to drive us to the airport and pick us up, he made you feel like you were part of his family.  I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone, and the price was very reasonable too for what you receive.  I will definitely stay at Stadium Motel on my next visit to Hamilton.
hotel_response: Great guests, thank you for the kind comments!

title: Just Perfect!
text:
We had a very comfortable stay at the stadium motel apartments whilst in Hamilton for a little more than a week for a family wedding . The service we received was second to none...thanks to Dorothy and Brain who we found to be extremely friendly and accomodating. 

The rooms are very modern, clean, comfortable and bathrooms are fitted with spa baths. We liked the location as it was just a short drive to the shops, restaurants and the town center but at the same time quiet enough. 

Would certainly recommend this motel and look fwd to staying there again in my next trip.
hotel_response: It is always a highlight to receive great comments, and they are appreciated, thank you!

title: Wonderful host and rooms
text: We ended up in Hamilton after leaving the Waitomo Caves where we had been on a 5 hour Black Abyss tour. ..in other words.  . while it was wonderful, we were exhausted and cold.  Brian, the host, was wonderful from the first.  Got us a great rooms for our family (family suite) (2 parents, 2 college students) and gave us wonderful recommendations for dinner. . . .realistic reviews.  Only stayed one night, but the rooms were comfortable, good price, and would highly recommend.  The rooms had dishes, kitchen, and refrigerator.  Great for a family.  The place was quiet, although I guess if there had been a game at the stadium across the way it might have been noisier.   .. . although we might have attended, so not noticed.  Brian also was very knowledgeable about the area and gave us directions to various other places too.  Thanks Brian!
hotel_response: You were great guests, and it was a pleasure hosting your stay. We do hope you were able to take home the goods you wanted to, and had a relaxing flight. Thank you for your kind words.

title: Perfect
text: Stayed here a week during which had family health issues also requiring a change to our bookings and a trip to Blenheim.  The service and friendliness of the hosts was outstanding, the facilities were fantastic, and the support in a difficult time was exemplary.  I'd recommend this motel to anyone, and certainly any time I'm back in Hamilton this would be my first, and hopefully only, choice of a place to stay.  Thanks heaps!

title: The best there is out there
text:
What a fantastic motel with very high quality rooms,service, and cleaniness.I have stayed here 3 times now and will only ever stay here whilst in Hamilton.
The owners are second to none and treat you with respect and as vip guests.These days I find great quality service hard to come by, at the Stadium Motel you get the whole package.I travel alot on business overseas and throughout NZ and if other hotels/motels demonstrated everything Stadium has to offer the accomodation industry would be booming.Definately would encourage other motel owners to take a leaf out of Terry and Yvonnes book .Very high class motel and owners and grade this place as not excellent,but very very very outstanding.

title: CLEAN, CONFORTABLE AND CENTRAL LOCATION
text:
My family and I stayed for 8 nights in one of the motels 3 bedroom self contained apartments. 

We found the motel to be very quiet, modern, clean and confortable. We appreciated the daily paper.

The managers could not have been more friendly and helpfull. We loved having the heaters on for our cold winter midnight arrival.

Would certainly reccommend this motel and will be staying again next year.

title: Fantastic, friendly service
text:
Very pleasantly surprised.  Being from Hamilton myself I had expected this motel to be a little noisy, but its just enough off the main drag to be quiet, but with all the benefits of being close to the city.

The service I received was fantastic, the manager greeted me by name and was very friendly.

The room was clean, and had everything you could want for a city stop.

title: High Tea birthday surprise
text:
The most incredible experience, my daughter and I had High Tea 
Peter greeted us at the door, and once inside he played Happy Birthday on the stunning grand piano 
He was informative and explained the High Tea to us.
I can recommend 100% this experience and will be revisiting

title: A Special  High Tea Treat
text:
From the moment you enter Willowbrook Park, you feel special – surrounded by opulence. Too much? Definitely not. Every little detail has been lovingly planned and executed with refined, careful thought at this exquisite country venue. Each item of furniture has been specially designed to fit colours & dimensions of specific areas.
 This 18th-century-styled  Georgian mansion has beautiful plaster decoration, fine china, grand pianos, rich wall coverings, imported flooring – all combining to make an experience you will appreciate & enjoy.
Peter, one of the owners, was a wonderful host to deal with both prior to & during our visit. He welcomed us, waited on us, gave us a really interesting talk on the evolution of Willowbrook & answered our varied questions. Nothing was too much, and we appreciated all he did so effortlessly & well.
The garden, when it matures, will truly complement this unique home. Table and wine grapes ( we hope a classy new wine label will be  a future venture), olives, a sunken retreat, a pool,  bluebell pathway, fountain, Badgers’ Wood ( sans badgers), a potager, varied orchard  plus so much more in which to wander peacefully!
We were glad we didn’t have to keep the sparkle on the multiplicity of chandeliers and windows.
The High Tea was enjoyed especially being able to have a "sparkling" version, with bubbles.
This elegant home is the ideal place for your special occasion, whether it be a wedding, anniversary, birthday, engagement or  whatever. Gift someone a night in the roomy ornate bedrooms as a wedding present!
The stylish  venue is also available for charitable purposes: The Dame Malvina Foundation is holding its annual concert of Waikato’s finest young musicians & singers here, 6 March .

title: Welcoming elegant high tea
text: It was my first visit to Willowbrook Park and I will be back. Elegant surroundings, stylish high tea and a fabulous host. I won't ruin the surprise of how you select your tea, but it certainly added to the occasion.

title: Mothers day celebration with family
text:
Just magnificent the moment you walk in, the presentation the greeting the chandeliers sumptuous 
The high tea was faultless and the warmth and service by Peter and co just right. Finished up with a tour of the accommodation which was awesome in the true sense of the word. All in all a great experience
hotel_response:
Thank you so much for taking the time to write a review. It was a delight to have you with us and I’m glad you enjoyed the tour. 
All best wishes,
Peter

title: Stately elegance combined with warm hospitality
text: We were impressed by the vision and hard work the owners had put into creating this unique property. The scale, detail and elegance of the stately Georgian buildings are complemented by the striking interior decor. We loved our stay in the Blenheim Suite; richly decorated in French Chinoiserie style, a luxury bathroom, a large balcony on which to laze and sweeping views of the extensive lawns, trees and sculptures. All this was enhanced by Peter’s genuine and warm hospitality.
hotel_response:
It was wonderful to have you staying and I’m so pleased you enjoyed the visit. All best wishes,
Peter

title: Superb hospitality
text:
We recently had a private dinner at Willowbrook for six which included staying the night. 
The rooms were absolutely grand and Peter and David were most gracious in the way they looked after us. 
The food was of a very high quality. I would certainly recommend the place to anyone who wants a night away or who is looking for a place to hold a small private event.

title: We celebrated a retirement with a High Tea
text: What a wonderful experience. Venue was absolutely gorgeous. The hosts were amazing, informed us about the grounds, history, facilities and allowed us to have a look around at our leisure.  Although very grande, Willowbrook has a lovely homely, family feel which makes you feel relaxed. High tea was as formal as we wanted it to be. We all dressed up so that made it feel very special indeed.  Tea and food was well presented and we enjoyed a glass of bubbles as well.  Our whole group would highly recommend Willowbrook to experience High Tea. Price was excellent as well.

title: High tea
text: Very lovely place and peaceful atmosphere,first time went there and i love that incredible decorations of the house...oh by the way it is a very good to take beautiful pictures lol ,had a relaxing afternoon thanks for the warm hospitality from host peter

title: Amazing high tea

title: Wonderful Anniversary Stay.

title: Birthday celebration

title: Six Stars ******
text:
Six Stars ******
I cannot praise this venue highly enough. We recently attended a family wedding reception at this venue, a perfect choice and backdrop for a small private function for up to 40 guests The experience was truly unforgettable, right from the vistas as you drive in to the venue, the genuine warmth and very friendly welcome from Peter and his wonderful staff and caterer. 

The initial visual feast was equally matched by the warmth and friendliness and homely feel of the place. I am not an expert in architecture, but I defy anyone to find a better example of Georgian architecture, built and exquisitely maintained to the highest standards. No details have been overlooked. 

I cannot think of a better venue for such an auspicious occasion. The grounds and entertaining facilities lend itself to ideal post-wedding photo shoots, which the photographers exploited to the full. Although we did not stay there we were shown the rooms and facilities and there was nothing to fault. Wish we could have stayed, but then again it would not have been appropriate as the bride and groom is entitled to a stay there as part of the wedding package. 

The food and wine did not detract from the overall experience. The canapes from the caterers were very good and their service faultless and all guests made to feel special. All food was prepared fresh and cooked on site. The wine and champagne were of a high standard. We sat down to a wonderful 3 course meal which also did not disappoint. 

We left thoroughly satisfied at how well the evening had panned out right to the tiniest detail. 

Full praise to Peter and his staff for a truly memorable experience
hotel_response:
Thank you for your kind words and 6 star rating!
It was a great day at Willowbrook. We look forward to your next visit. Best wishes, Peter
