title: Having stayed here, I don't understand how there can be any good reviews for this place
text:
It was bad -really, really bad! I thought long and hard about posting this review, but decided that people should know what to expect.

I stayed here for a week during the busiest time of the year in Hamilton (Fieldays).  I made the booking based on numerous good reviews, but having experienced it, I honestly do not know how anyone would rate this motel anything more than a one.  If it hadn't been that the whole town was booked out during that week, I definitely would have left immediately when I saw the place  

The room was large, with 2 beds, a table and couple of chairs.  It had absolutely no (zero) cabinets/shelves/cupboard space - none in the bedroom area so nowhere to hang clothes - none in the kitchenette, so only minimal sink space to make a drink (there are no cooking facilities either BTW) and none in the bathroom, so nowhere to keep toiletries or clean clothes.  The bathroom boasted a (non heated) towel rail located at least 2 meters away from the shower.  And some half used body wash (!).

To say the place is old and tired, is a vast understatement.  I have attached a few pics of the bathroom for reference.  Cleanliness is applied in the most visible spaces only (refer the pics again). Although someone entered the room daily to remake the bed and drop some towels, they never did any cleaning (none whatsoever, not even emptied the bin).

The bed is probably the most uncomfortable bed I have ever encountered with springs pushing through the lining around the edges.  Although there was a heat pump in the room, the battery for the remote gave up on the second day.  I replaced it since the room was very damp otherwise (see the pic of the crying window?  that was on the inside of the window) and with the temperature outside at less than 10degrees, it was intolerable otherwise.  There was a TV, but it only worked intermittently (cuts out every half hour or so) and also the wifi did not work, so I had to hotspot from my phone to watch anything when it was working.

The kitchenette had a kettle, microwave and small fridge. Everything looked like it came from a 1970s garage sale.  A few mismatched bowls and cups rounded out the kitchen space - but no teaspoons so had to stir my drinks with the dessert spoon.  Oh, I had to get my own milk, tea and sugar.  No supplies in the room.

The final straw was being randomly yelled at by another guest in the parking area when their domestic disagreement spilled outside.  They were also yelling at the motel staff and the police had to be called it got so bad.

To add insult to injury, all of this cost more than $220 per night.  A total rip off.

Why did I not leave immediately?  Because was Fieldays was in full swing and all of Hamilton and surrounds were fully booked and I had to stay close to Mistry Creek for the early mornings and traffic queues.

The only redeeming features were the friendly person at reception and a daily drop of clean towels (which was actually necessary given the constant wet weather and no heated towel rail).

title: First Impressions: "Rundown" is Being Generous
text:
When I first laid eyes on the building, the word "rundown" popped into my head—but honestly, that feels like a compliment. The place was wearing a slimy green coat of mould like it was trying to blend in with a swamp. Maintenance? Never heard of her.

I stepped into reception and was greeted by some very friendly staff—which was lovely until I received a second, less pleasant welcome… from the unmistakable stench of body odour. It hit me like a freight train. I genuinely considered running out to buy the receptionist a stick of Rexona. That’s not shade—that’s a public service suggestion.

Room for Improvement (and Fresh Air)
The room itself was a decent size and looked clean on the surface. But then the smell crept in. Musty, unventilated, and... something else I couldn’t quite place. Like the ghost of damp towels past. When I returned later from a work event, the scent had intensified to "should-I-sleep-in-my-car" levels. I toughed it out—but just barely.

The Bed Was Comfy, But...
I wanted to enjoy the bed. It was probably the one highlight. But sadly, trying to relax while gagging is not a skill I’ve mastered. The smell made sure I started my day dry-heaving like I was training for a vomit marathon.

Shower Time (a.k.a. A Mild Drizzle)
I wrapped things up with a quick shower, which was so underwhelming it may have been powered by gravity and hope alone. Low pressure, low satisfaction.

Hot Tips for a Cooler Stay:

Deodorant. Please. Like, seriously.

Clean the room with actual cleaning products—not just a spritz of "Eau de Desperation."

Invest in a decent shower head. It’s cheaper than losing customers.

Sorry to leave a bad review—it’s not my style. But y’all, this was rough. With a few basic improvements, this place could go from "biohazard" to "budget-friendly."

title: Great stay!
text:
Stayed here for a concert and absolutely cannot fault as it served the purpose of just needing somewhere to get ready & sleep PLUS the room had an epic spa bath & the room size is incredibly generous. Everything I needed was provided.
Would totally stay again (room 11)

title: Do not stay here
text: Terrible motel. Room was very dirty and run down, when we checked in lights in room did not work. Room door looked like lock or latch had been smashed in then shoddily replaced. We got a refund and left to find other accommodation

title: Friendly
text: I do not know what these other reviews are going on about but we were there for a Hospital appt and found this place perfect for our one night stay. Staff were helpful with getting a few extras that we needed.

title: Comfortable motel in convenient location
text: We must have had a different room to other reviewers. Our room was very big and spacious and very comfortable. Huge bath room. Daily serviced and clean. Kitchenette totally adequate- we cooked full meals for 3 of our 4 nights with no problems. Huge bathroom. Easy parking and good wifi. Convenient to supermarkets and a short drive to major attractions. Very friendly, helpful host. We would definitely stay here again.

title: Horrible
text: Dreadful room - like staying in a shed. Plywood and cracked concrete walls. Dirty, sticky surfaces. The toaster looked like an accident waiting to happen. The bath looked like an old tin boat balanced on some logs of wood! Nightmare. Do not stay here.

title: Don't go there
text:
Very tired, poorly appointed rooms. Random  selection of cheap kitchen utensils. Appliances old and appear not to have been checked for safety. Reluctant to use anything.  Floor wasn't cleaned the four nights I was there.  What maintenance there was seemed sloppy and amateurish. 
Awful place. The promotional material is highly misleading. Yes the rooms are big but size isn't everything.

title: Lovely Stay.
text: Nice convenient motel. Very,  big and tidy clean rooms. Has a small basic kitchenette too.  It good enough for coffee and tea. Was a a lovely get away. Really, good last min booking with a  reasonable price.

title: Maybe the worst motel in NZ, DEFNATELY the worst motel in Hamilton
text:
Please do yourself a great favour and don't book here.

The motel is becoming very run down and the rooms needed major renovations 5 years ago but nothing was done.
The mattress was very uncomfortable and in the morning we discovered to our horror stains on the side of the base - we didn't dare look under the sheets after seeing that. The only good thing is that we didn't see it before we went to bed.
The carpet had been patched very badly and was very worn with plenty of stains.
There was no AC just a small heater which struggled to keep the room warm in good weather - it would have been freezing during the winter.
The bathroom had a walk in shower that we daren't use because of all the mould around the edges.
Our room had a spa bath in it which was the only redeeming feature providing you don't mind having a bath next to the kitchen area and avoided looking at the mega amounts of sealant along the bath edges.
The location, whilst handy to Hamilton centre, is very noisy and the rooms are not double glazed. If you want to sleep take ear plugs and also an eye mask as the 'curtains' let in more light than they keep out.

Please, please look somewhere else - there are heaps of great motels in Hamilton.

title: In desperate need of refurbishment & cleaning.
text:
If you are expecting a 3 star motel this is not it. Photos tell the story.
Pros; large family size room with 1 double & 2 singles. Handy to city centre. Room warm when heater kept on. 
Cons: room dark & gloomy, chipped crockery, mattress stained on side, ripped bed cover, no phone, milk in an unsealed bottle so unsure about the contents, unit appeared clean on first glance, TV was in odd position & difficult to see from bed or couch, thin pillows, could hear children running around upstairs late at night.

title: Plenty of space for families
text: Fantastic hotel for family stopping over in Hamilton, huge room, loads of space.  Heater sufficient for warming although an extension lead would've helped to plug it in near the centre of the room.  Friendly staff.  Super handy to Hamilton Lake park/playground, kids were there for hours in the middle of winter. We tried to book in again at the end of our holiday but missed out on the last room. Very reasonably priced.

title: Stinky Sleepless Night
text: The room smelt so horrible of cigarette smoke and curry that it made it unbearable to sleep or enjoy our time here. We had to have the windows and doors open all night just to cope, this made it seriously cold to, due to it being middle of winter. It was a night from hell.

title: Road noise a little annoying.
text:
It wasn't to bad, but annoying. Rooms were big, small heater seemed to do the job. Clean tidy - pretty good for price. Desk guy was friendly. 

Would of been good if the street noise wasn't so loud. I had requested that I didn't want to be near the road if possible. Other than that it was pretty good.

title: Comfy place to stay
text: This place is a comfy place to stay in. A large room with kitchen facilities and a large bathroom and a comfy bed made it a nice place to stay for the night. It is a budget motel so it is good value for money. Close too all the shops and the heart of Hamilton as well as lots of eateries all with just a short drive or walk away. Also close to the beautiful Hamilton Lake which was great and very relaxing! The motel staff were friendly and helpful too! The motel itself looks tired and in need of doing up to bring it up to being a great place to stay!

title: Dirty, mouldy, rubbish wifi
text:
Started off well with friendly service. Then it went downhill. 

Large, but strangely laid out room. 

No aircon even though it’s advertised. 

Windows let noise in terribly. 

Mould in the bathroom. 

I’d be surprised if the stairs passed building code. 

Basically, the whole place needs bulldozing.

title: Poor quality, needs a good clean.
text: The people on reception were friendly. Unfortunately that about the only good thing I can say. The property and room weren’t terrible, but it wasn’t nice either. The room we were in was large enough for three beds in it. They weren’t very comfortable. The room was cold also. The bathroom looked like it had received a makeover which was nice however the shower curtain was filthy. It was discoloured and had mold all over it. The kitchen area was small and looked like it could do with a good clean. The room could use a good set of curtains to block out the carpark lights which were extremely bright at night and came through the very thin curtains that were there. We were happy to leave this place in the morning. This was the only motel in NZ that we have given this 2 point rating to. Clean shower curtain, better curtains and a good clean would have gotten it up to 3 points.

title: Its a No from Me
text:
Rooms were very large, the tv however was in a very odd position, it was only comfortable to watch from the couch and not while in bed, Milk in the fridge was in a glass container which is not bad but i would prefer to know that my milk has not been open previously and whether it is still fresh or not,who knows how long had it been there for or what else had gone into or been in the glass bottle

 Check out morning 9.20 am,i was asked if i was leaving yet by the Manager who was with the cleaner, must have been so she could go and clean,not sure??? which i thought was a tad bit rude considering check out was 10am, but found the Managers  tone, mannerism and approach not friendly at all and very rude.

title: Never have I ever
text: Upon checking in to this motel the owner was lovely and accommodating (excuse the pun) and we were shown to our rooms in a prompt manner which we all appreciated and that is absolutely where the hospitality ended.  Once we had arrived back at the motel after attending an event, we made our way to my room (room 3) which is quite large.  We had been back for maybe 45min when the owner of the motel stormed in without knocking and started yelling at us "I've had enough of you lot! If you don't quieten down Ill kick the lot of you out!!"  We all instantly went from jovial conviviality to EXTREMELY uncomfortable... I was absolutely shocked and a wee bit embarrassed.  Make no mistake, we just arrived back from an event and were in speech mode when he stormed in.  I feel he could have dealt with the situation in a much better manner and alot classier than he actually did.  He did not.  20mins later, the majority of the group were leaving to go into town and he stormed back in yelling at us - hell I even apologised when he said "There is a child here" and he had the audacity to respond with "You're not sorry!"  I felt even more horrible after his response.  He further started arguing with one of the girls' mothers who were in our room and then proceeded to call the police even though he knew a part of our group was leaving.  It gets waaaaaaayyyyyy worse.  We were checking out and our group manager tried to have a responsible conversation with the owners and there were unbelievably rude, obnoxious and condescending.  Never have I EVER in my almost 40 years seen any moteliers talk to anyone the way these two did to our manager.  They were very unprofessional and only wanted to say what they wanted and did not want to hear anyone else but themselves.  I do not recommend this establishment to any group, Family, Friends or even pets.  The accommodation was very below par.  No mattress protectors which is one of the first this I would check.  The bathroom was very run down and once I had seen it, instantly regretted not having my shower jandals!!!  Need I say more.
hotel_response:
The Managers of Lake Point Motel would like to respond to this Review. 
This group had booked 8 of our 19 Units, at 11pm we received complaints of excessive noise by other guests who said it had been going on for at least an hour and 1/2. The Manager went to the unit the noise was coming from and knocked on the door. The manager asked this large group of people, their visitors and guests to stop all noise, then the manager returned to his residence. At 12pm midnight further complaints from other guests were received. The manager returned to the unit and again asked for quiet. The manager was abused and on leaving was threatened by a male visitor with that group. At 12:15am a phone call was made to the Police by the manager as he was out numbered and feared for his safety and other guests safety.
One of our Policies for the Motel is ALL visitors of guests must vacate the property and there will be no noise from 10.30pm in respect to other guests.
This group is 100% correct in saying they would never book here again as their booking would not be accepted. Management will be very reluctant to ever accept bookings from Adult sports groups again.

title: Disappointment and shameful
text:
I came as part of a large team of boxers fighting in a local tournament for the night. As far as I was aware we booked all but 2 rooms and did not witness any other guests present.
On arrival we were greeted by a cleaner and a man who I assumed was the owner/manager. Everything was handled in a odd flighty sort of manner. But we eventually got our rooms sorted
Room was large and spacious. And very simple. And relatively clean.
However. When we returned, albeit in very happy spirits after a great competition. This all changed for the worst. We all had congregated in a family suite on the ground floor. And some friends and family joined us for speeches and a few drinks. At a few points our group may have been abit loud,this is granted. But the manager barged in during speeches and given no notice,told us to keep it down (in not such a nice manner)or he would call the police.
Soon after the majority of us decided to leave to go to town.
All went well for the night as far as I am aware.
Then the next morning....we were all woken by a large argument going on involving our team leader/trainer and a group of hotel employees and managers. This altercation was disgusting to hear. My team members were abused using vile language i would expect from scumbags on the street, not respectable motel/hotel owners.
Having worked in this industry for many years I am more then aware there are often altercations,but there is always a way to handle a situation with out deformatory remarks been made. 
I am so disappointed in the handling of this situation by the Motel staff. And appalled by the treatment to my team mates. 
I apologize to other guests,but dont actually believe there were any others. 
Would not recommend and definately would not consider staying again.

title: Derogatory talk
text: I’ll start with the positives. The rooms are large and spa is lovely. The negatives were the way the manager spoke to some of our team. We booked all but two rooms of the motel, we were having speeches when he burst into the room and said he would kick us all out due to noise in an aggressive manner. It continued the next morning where I have videoed the incident. Totally unprofessional and rude. We will not be going back again.

title: Disappointed
text: Stayed here for a night with friends. The room wasn’t clean. The bathroom ceiling paint was peeling off. The shower had something suspicious smeared all over it. It’s very tired and run down. I think the star rating needs to be reviewed it’s a bit misleading. The owner was pleasant when we arrived however we watched in horror the owners verbally abusing other guests which was quite out of line and very unprofessional. I wouldn’t recommend this place. Traffic noise was an issue and I would suggest giving the place a makeover as the room was quite pricey for the facilities we received.

title: very average
text:
Chose this from AA book. Should have gone somewhere else. Arrived quiet tired and looked at room and thought big enough, spa bath close to town but we wouldn't walk it.
Bed average, bathroom finishing needs work, looks like it had a quick paint job by a kid. Tv on wall by head board, wrong place. Then at 4.15 the people upstairs got up turn on tv loud, banged around one left at 5.00 but it carried on until we left at 7.30  we would stay here again

title: Avoid this place
text: This motel is more than tired. It's not clean, and it smells really unpleasantly of too much room freshener. The carpet is fraying and the tiles are cracked. The room we had booked was also not quiet - fronting onto a busy road.

title: Quiet and clean but that's about it
text: This motel is very tired and not somewhere I would choose to stay again. Our room was large, with 3 beds but there were holes in the walls and it was very basic. The bed was comfortable but the pillows were thin and the electric blanket only had one control. Only one bedside lamp beside the main bed and nothing by the other beds. The shower leaked and the towels weren't changed, although we had 2 nights there. One of the coffee cups was very badly chipped and cracked and should have been thrown away. There is no outside light and the heating was inadequate; an electric heater that we had to almost sit on top of to get warm. The room smelt although that may have been from the heater.

title: Large Room
text: Very friendly staff. Has large 3 bedded room. The room was comfortable but the pillows were very poor, flat and not enough. Up steep hill from main street but still in walking distance if you are fit. The motel is apparently being done up but they had not yet done the room we were in. I would recommend this motel if you are wanting a clean, quiet spacious room.

title: good motel; great host
text:
The key to a stay in a motel is obviously the room but sometimes also the proprietors go out of their way to assist and this makes for a pleasant stay.

I had two nights at this motel. Upon hearing that I intended to drive my car to the railway station for the Northern Explorer and thus leave the car there unattended all day, the owner offered to drive me to the station. This he did the next day.

The motel itself was more than adequate. The very large room and bathroom was most appreciated as I sorted out all my traveling gear.

Would recommend the Lake Point motel.

title: Great location and amenities
text:
Motel close to city and eating places. Friendly counter staff. Would have liked spare pillows but not much of a problem and could have asked for them.
Very quiet, huge rooms, good views, clean. The lake over the road was good for morning walks/runs

title: Good and convenient
text: A decent, well run motel with large and clean rooms. We stayed here twice in the short space of a few days. A little bit of traffic noise but not enough to be bothering. I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again. Good wifi.

title: Short Stay
text: Reasonably close to town it is walking distance but the hill down to the shops from the hotel is quite steep walking back up could be an issue for some, the motel itself is very comfortable and reasonably priced.

title: Disgusted
text: This motel was rubbish and not as advised. We only stayed one night and if we had not been going to a cricket match and was short of time we would have found somewhere else to stay. The room was spacious but not very clean although the bed and linen were fine. There were light bulbs needed changing in room and bathroom. There was a settee in the room which had a big tear in it and smelt of urine. The kitchen was basically non existent. There was a sink in the corner in some sort of wooden cupboard. The crockery, cutlery and glasses didn't match and they were just on a wrought iron shelf unit. The ironing board cupboard was locked. The place to hang clothes was some sort of contraption on the wall which you couldn't reach because there was a table below. Couldn't get out of this motel fast enough. We have travelled widely in New Zealand from the very south to top of the north in the 4 visits we have had to New Zealand and stayed in a large number of motels in a lot of places and I have to say this is the worst experience we have ever had.

title: Room needs thorough cleaning
text: We stayed for a night in this motel.  Our room was spacious but very tired.  The carpet was super dusty, as if it has not been occupied for long time and the room had a mouldy smell.  We found mites near the sink too.  Location was nonetheless very convenient and it’s a short 15 min drive to Te Rapa outlets.

title: Clean and Spacious
text: Though it was only for 1 night stay, we liked this motel because it was very clean and spacious. We were glad to  e given the unit at the bottom so we didnt need to lug our luggage up the stairs. Laundry room was open 24 hours so it was convenient for us to wash and dry our clothes. It was nearby to Pak n save, and the Kmart shopping mall. Even though it seemed to be close to road and we had read some reviews that it was noisy, it wasn't to us. We had a restful and comfortable night.

title: Road trip spot
text:
Mostly pretty good, clean and friendly staff. The only thing the wifi was very spotty. Close to local restaurants and walking distance to local bars and town centre. Staff were amazing and friendly. 

Thank you for the stay

title: Very friendly and reasonably priced
text:
The owner was very friendly and helpful when we ran into trouble with our GPS. Great location; walking distance to Pak n Save and restaurants. Lovely clean room with sky pay tv.

Would definitely use again. Thanks !!!

title: Great value for money, but tired
text:
You arrive at the motel and are greeted warmly by the person at the desk. You feel good as you are getting a reasonably priced night for your stay, and the rooms once in them, are decent, but are very tired. 

The room we had was incredibly spacious and accommodated us really well. 

The kitchenette had everything that we needed to arrange our breakfast in the morning and there was a cute bottle of milk waiting for us.

However, the room is what you pay for it, and it is tired. There were several issues that I thought could be remedied quite easily and cheaply and wish they would do, as it's a great motel in a great location but I don't know that I'd come back unless those things were fixed up. But if you need somewhere with lots of room and a decent price. This is your place.

I debated whether to give it 3 or 4 *'s but at the end of the day it's an 'average' motel unit (which is better than a bad one!).

title: Spacious
text: The plusses - Very spacious unit, clean and tidy, excellent shower pressure.  The negatives - unit was very light at night - it needs some blockout drapes plus some sort of window covering on the window over the spa (it had nothing at all), no makeup remover wipes or coloured facecloths for this purpose, no milk was left in the room for us (we had arranged late checkin), no extractor fan so would imagine whole room would get rather damp if you had a spa as this was in the main room.  The exterior of the motel could really do with a sprucing up too - if I had seen it in the daytime prior to booking I would probably not have chosen to stay here.  Good value for money though.

title: Overnight!
text: We werent able to check in before 8:30pm but they allowed a friend of ours to check in for us, wifi password was waiting on our table, so thanks for that! Lots of space, very clean and room was warm and toasty. Didn't mind the smaller kitchen as we ate out anyways. We travel to Hamilton a lot so im glad we found this place, would happily stay again.

title: Great location, great price...
text:
We stayed here on a visit to Hamilton for a function in Frankton only a few minutes from here. Without a booking, we tried our luck and got a very spacious upstairs room for only $110 for the night.
Massive bathroom with separate shower plus SPABATH! Very happy!
Small kitchenette but well fitted out with everything you need (should you wish to cook). Very large studio room with large bed and TV.
Bed was ok but not pocket spring like I'm used to but fine for one night.
Very nice motelier.  Plenty of parking for larger vehicles.

title: Overnight
text:
The room is huge and comfortable. We only stayed for a night and found the location good. Lake Rotoruta which is nearby is a good place to visit.
Our only fault is that the bathroom is oversized (think small bedroom) which only allows for a small kitchenette.

title: Overnight trip
text: Roomy but very tired unit. Could do with an up date. Bit noisy by the road. Was clean and tidy. Lovely friendly lady in reception next morning and they stored our bags at the office during the day while we were out before catching shuttle back to the airport thr following afternoon. Were given a free wifi code but were able to access it. As we arrived after 8.30pm did not want to ring and ask about it as evening reception were little grumpy about arrival time as it was. Would probably try somewhere different on another trip to Hamilton

title: Clean, Funky, Great welcome
text:
This is one of my favourite motels. I travel throughout NZ. all the time Rooms at Lake Point are always immaculate.... no room the same... yay... I do 120 nights a year in Motels...
In one direction town is walkable to good food and bars. 
In the other direction the Lake.
Always look for the backstreet gems.... this is one of them.

title: Week end stay
text: We have now booked for our fourth stay here. Amazing reception, and nice big clean rooms.  Close to town and to the university/wintec.  Nice and close to the lake for a lovely walk. Works for us everytime.

title: Adele Concert Accommodation
text: What a great find! Fabulous good sized rooms, great pressure in the showers and great moteliers too! Needed extra pillows and they were there on our return from the concert! Very clean and very friendly would totally come back A+

title: staying at the lake point motels,excellent and lovely people to see, who run them .
text: hi Russell,and partner,thankyou very much ,for the excellent stay we had  at your motels,we enjoyed it ,really did not want to go home ,also may I add a big thankyou to you both,for organising another nights stay,owing ,not getting my operation done,at the hospital,it did not seem any trouble to you to organise ,to anyone,wanting to go to the hospital in Hamilton this motel,is so close,and very easy to get to ,if your wanting accommodation. thanks also to the cleaning ladies we met ,while we were there.thanks again Russell,we will be back to see you again,kind regards from peter and lynn Andrews from taupo ..

title: Clean & spacious with a good bed
text: We had two nights here in a room with a spa. I loved the size of our room, it was large and spacious. The spa was in the middle of the room so you could chill there with the TV on and not miss out on anything. It was very easy to find and SO close to town and of course the lake, which is a beautiful area. A big thank you for having a very comfortable bed with nice quality linen (which is important to me!) Free wifi was great and it didn't lag at all. Friendly staff including the wonderful cleaning ladies. Great water pressure in the shower. The only thing to mention is the rooms really need a coffee plunger! (and a serrated bread slicing knife). Overall great and would happily stay again.

title: Will stay here again
text:
Well-located motel, especially close to the Hamilton lake where I was spending the day on business.
Very very spacious downstairs unit. Very clean. Well-equipped kitchen.
Everything one needs in a motel room.

title: Fair for price
text: For an affordable place to stay it's great. Friendly staff. Close enough to town and very close to lake/domain. Free wifi always a plus. They even made our bed and refreshed linen for a 2 day stay. Thanks heaps.

title: Very spacious
text: A very spacious room. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Basic kitchen area. Not as clean as other motels I've stayed in on this trip, nor was it quiet until very late. Convenient walking distance to the lake and a reasonable place to break the journey north. Parking is a bit tight. Free wifi.

title: Excellent base for the Hamilton region
text:
We stayed here for four nights while touring the region: Hamilton is a lovely city with all the amenities and services you could walk, within a short drive of good attractions.

Lake Point Motel is extremely well located, walking distance (although involving a steep incline on return) from the CBD and restaurant districts, and pretty well across the road from Lake Rotoroa, a lovely spot indeed for a walk or run.

Our room - we had booked a spa room on the upper floor - was extremely spacious, very clean and included all you need to cook if so desired.

Pillows were thin, but once we got a second one all was well.

On the upper level road noise was quite noticeable during the working day but did not disturb us at night.  Parking can be a little tight but is manageable.

Management is friendly and helpful. 

Decoration and room furnishings and equipment are fairly basic and could be easily upgraded: however, the room met our needs well and we would readily stay again.

title: Quiet and spacious
text: Stayed in upstairs room 12 overnight.  A hot day, we opened both front and back doors creating a lovely breeze through the room.  Appreciated the fan too, especially when we had to close the door to stop the bats flying in and out.  Generally it was clean, except for the huge cockroach, the discovery of which made me jump and dance in an embarrassing manner. Only one bed lamp (3 of us but beds for potentially 5) and the lamp/bulb was dead.  The staff would probably have fixed it but I didn't fancy a visit to the office after dark in my pjs.  Would be happy to return (next time I'll shut the door before twilight to stop the bats from visiting).

title: Can't really fault it given its a motel
text: A large motel with ample parking and all the standard facilities. Walking distance to the cricket and probably restaurants but we drove given Hamilton is so quiet. Not a five-star hotel but really good for what it is. No complaints.

title: good for what we needed
text: we needed accommodation for 3 people and also family visiting us over the 2 days we were there and the Lake Point Motel was absolutely fine. An older motel but I know they are busy doing up some of the rooms. Often older motels have more room and this one certainly did. It was clean roomy and comfortable. Proprietor friendly. Although fully booked we felt we were the only ones there as we had room number 19 tucked away and very private, and also up high so we could view the road but very quiet. Slept well. The motel is opposite the lake which is well worth a visit, lovely walk round[5k] and good children's area. Also motel walking distance to town for shopping and eating out so no parking hassles. Would recommend.

title: Family Weekend
text: We were booked into stay at Lake Point this weekend and were really looking forward to it, unfortunately our car gearbox decided to pack it in and we couldn't make the rest of our trip. I phoned the lovely people at Lake Point, very upset, and told them that we wouldn't be able to make it, they were extremely understanding and kindly cancelled our booking. We are hopping to make our trip again as soon as our car has been fixed and will definitely be rebooking with the lovely people at Lake Point Motel.

title: Large units great for group accommodation
text:
Large motel units that make this motel perfect for our group stay.  We have now stayed here over several years and staff are so helpful and accommodating of our group requirements.
Motel units are large and spacious, with a spa bath and numerous units with wheelchair accessible bathrooms. Standard motel kitchen with everything required for a weekend stay. Really comfortable beds and free wifi.
Would definitely recommend this motel for a short stay.

title: memorable stay with family
text: Stayed for 2 weeks with family. Quite warm rooms, though it was peak winter. Neat and tidy with daily house keeping and the best part was manager- Mr. Russel - very friendly and helpful. Very close to city centre, hamilton lake and to waikato hospital. All amenities and has a nice spa in each room.

title: Nice big spa bath
text: A great place to stay! Not too far away of city centre, close to lake for evening walk, traffic noise is not a problem. The rooms are spacious with a big spa bath, had everything we needed. Thanks enjoyed our 2 night stay.

title: Just what we needed
text: An older style of motel but when setup. Bed was comfortable with adequate parking. Traffic noise was an issue we were in unit 5. We were only in town for the one night BUT I would stay there again, handy to everything. Owners are very friendly and happy to answer any questions

title: Great value for money
text: We were in Unit 10, a huge room with large corner spa bath.  Despite being on a relatively busy road traffic noise was never a problem. The two nights we were there were booked out and parking was very tight. Bed was one of the most comfortable I've slept on. The free Wifi was relatively fast. It was great having full Sky TV access instead of a handful of selected channels or Freeview. Plenty of hot water for the spa bath. I've never experienced a shower with that much water pressure it stung when on full. Friendly and very helpful staff. Close to Waikato District Hospital, the reason we were in Hamilton. This will be our accommodation of choice for future Hamilton visits. Certainly not 5-star but if you're looking for roomy, comfortable , value for money accommodation you can't go past Lake Point

title: Nothing to write home about
text:
The People were lovely and very helpful.
Unfortunately the cleaning side needs to be reviewed.
Our Bathroom needed to be re-cleaned and the floor needed a vacuum.
Parking was a bit tight as well.
We were on the bottom floor rooms which do not get much light.

title: Freindly homely comfort
text: I fully recommend Lake Point. The host (Russell) is very helpful accommodating i felt welcome and catered too. The room was lovely and cosy the bed comfy. The spa bath was  an wonderful addition to the room. Overall a very relaxing stay this will be my regular. Close to town and the lake. Thanks Russell you are the host with the most 😊

title: Modern & Central
text: We have chosen to stay in Lake Point a number of times as it is easy to find and so handy to the main street of Hamilton.  Is a steep hill to return from the city if walking but great work out for those that are able.  Loved the views from the top floor separate unit.  Always content with units & service.

title: Very helpful and obliging hosts
text: I am And have been a regular guest at this establishment. I stay in unit 16.loads of almost instant hot water , great water pressure a must especially in winter to warm up. Comfortable bed   Heater hair drier sky tv, unit 16has views north , is quiet . It is up stairs so this would limit access for some and there are three steps inside. The unit is spacious as is the bathroom and shower. Close to city centre and a supermarket close by.i work in Hamilton south past the hospital , and it only takes a few minutes to get there. No traffic jams as I am going opposite to the traffic flow.serviced daily and plenty of towels this is a must for me.

title: Good motel in Hamilton
text:
Recently had to find accommodation close to Waikato hospital because of illness of my husband. Lake Point is about 1.3 km from hospital. I walked there and back because taxis rip you off. 

The room was spacious and clean with good bed and no complaints there. 

 I feel that they will even get more customers if they offer a discount to family of hospitalised people. The hospital no longer have on site rooms so a lot of other motels get the benefit. A  little bit of empathy goes far and people from outlying areas talk and make recommendations to others. Just be a bit chatty @ reception and you'll soon find out the reason of them coming to your place.

title: Great sized rooms, very clean and tidy
text: My husband and I stayed here for 5 nights while being in Hamilton for my daughters 21st. It is within walking distance to the Hamilton Lake and town , however the hill is a little steep to get back to the hotel. Management were very friendly and helpful. We had a 1 bedroom apartment which is situated in the older block but is extremely comfortable and very warm with everything we needed. The traffic noise at night is a bit loud but we just ended up shutting the bedroom door and then we could hardly hear it. The room was very clean, with a great powerful shower. Will definitely stay here again. Actually ,we have already booked :-)

title: wheelchair access room
text:
very large room .. plenty of room to maneuver ... has 1 double bed and 2 singles. bathroom has roll in shower with plastic outdoor chair to use .. grab rails by toilet and shower... roomy enough for wheelchair users and carer 
Owner very helpful .. 
only downers are
very steep drive you can only leave property by car .. too steep to wheel off ... plud steep to office if wheelchair users happens to be the 1 paying/credit card holder and large doorway lip to get over into office which owner did say he must fix

title: Comfy and Clean...
text:
When I first arrived, I thought hmm this is maybe not what I was expecting.  However once I was settled in my room, I found it to be excellent.  Really clean, really comfy.  I was on the ground floor and you could certainly hear people moving about upstairs.  All rooms and parking is quite close so it can be a bit noisy.

Nice spacious bathroom, plenty of towels, comfy bed, but I did find the location of the tv to the bed was odd.  If you wanted to lie in bed and watch tv it was a bit awkward but manageable.  I know it was set up more for people sitting on the couch.  Yes rooms are a bit dated and the downstairs rooms seem a bit dark even during the day.

Location wise it's excellent.  I took a stroll to the lake and that was lovely.  Motel staff were very friendly and helpful.  Really enjoyed my stay in Hamilton.  The thing about motel rooms is you want comfy and clean as you don;t really spend a lot of time in them so when you do you just want to relax and be comfy and this motel is clean and comfy.

title: Good value for the area
text: Large rooms although a little dated. They are clean and tidy. Staff friendly and helpful. Close to pack and save and restaurants. Quiet location out of the way but not of the beaten path. Easy in easy out from the highway as well.

title: Nice and clean
text:
We had a big family room on ground floor, beds were comfy, basic kitchen facilities to reheat food, clean, friendly staff, centrally located and easy access to hospital.
Off street parking, sky TV available and free Wi-Fi.

title: Nice spacious room
text:
Our room had king size bed and hot tub. Room was spacious and clean. No aircon so the hot days like we experienced were hot in the room also, but no biggie.

Good place to stay for a few days and use as a base for activities. Although Hamilton was less than we expected. Food wise it left us wanting.

Staff friendly. Free Wifi provided.

title: Very welcoming motel
text: We have stayed in this motel many times and have always found it perfect for our requirements, clean, quiet and comfortable. Russell has always been very accommodating and helpful. It's close to the city and handy for the lake for breakfast.

title: Best Value Motel in Hamilton
text: We stayed in the Lake Point Motel for 3 nights in early October.  We had an upstairs unit with a wonderful spa bath. The Unit was very roomy, clean and had everything we needed.  Owner was very friendly with a wonderful telephone manner and a pleasure to deal with.  We were shown to our room and he made sure the sky was working.  Very nice and quiet and only a short drive to The Base.  This Motel was extremely good value and have no complaints at all.  This will be our Motel for any future trips to Hamilton

title: We've stayed here 3 times in recent weeks
text: My son recently bought a house in Hamilton so we've spend a few weekends down there fixing it up.  We've stayed in a different studio unit each time and they have all been comfortable and clean.  Extremely spacious for a studio and Unit 13 even has a spa pool which was so appreciated after a day spent cleaning and gardening!  All the bathrooms are large and something I really like - a good supply of towels.  Hosts are friendly and helpful.  Location is good being away from the town centre and handy to the lake domain and hospital.

title: Best service ever!!!
text: I chose this hotel as it was close to the hospital for a meeting I had to go to. Russell was so awesome, he allowed us to check in early and check out late this particular time to allow my mum to comfortably babysit my 9 month old. The apartment was generously sized and easy to baby proof. The spa bath was perfect for me and the baby to have a quick dip too. Will be staying there again and recommending!

title: Home from home
text: We have stayed here on several occasions over the last eighteen months. The rooms we have had have all been spacious, well maintained and well serviced. It is close to Hamilton's CBD and central to many places of interest for the intrepid tourist/ traveller. The owners are very friendly and accommodating. So too are the motel's employees. A major plus is that this motel is close to Waikato Hospital and is always happy to provide accommodation for family of those that need the services of the hospital. This motel is one of the best in Hamilton.

title: Helpful, clean and tidy
text: We contacted Lake Point Hotel to use for family and friends travelling to Hamilton for our wedding in late October 2014. The hosts were helpful and kind, reserving a number of rooms for our guests to call and book so we could all stay together.  In the lead up to the wedding, staff were great! Rooms were clean, tidy, happy with everything. Def stay again.

title: Clean place with great service!
text: My family rented a room over easter weekend and were surprised at the value we received. The room had a kitchenette with fridge, microwave, toaster, sink and all the essentials. We were lucky enough to get two king beds with a single one to spare! Though the hotel is not new (it has some water mould on the bathroom ceiling and some really flat pillows) it was clean and well kept. For the price we paid on the weekend we went it was a great bargain!!

title: Tony S
text: We spent a night at this motel which was great.  After we left the owners discovered my partner had left her passport and credit cards in the room before we had even missed them.  They then contacted us through our next of kin in England and then sent the documents on to us by courier.  Brilliant service with a friendly smile.  We couldn't give a higher recommendation.

title: Great location with friendly owners!!
text: My partner and I arrived to find our room we had booked hadnt been vacated. We were upgraded to a spa room which was lovely. Per previous reviews, it is basic but has everything you need. Great price, location and everything all clean. The owner was a very friendly man, easy to deal with and just overall very helpful. Had a great stay, would recommend. :)

title: Central, Basic But Spacious, Quiet and Very Friendly
text:
This is a basic motel as the price suggested.  
The studio room was very spacious, so was the bathroom and shower.  As it was an upstairs room,  it was light and airy with morning sun streaming in.  There was no air-conditioning, just a fan and a small heater.  We used the heater a couple of times early in the morning and did not use the fan as it wasn't hot.
There was a king size bed, with comfortable pillows and blanket.  The TV was good with lots of sky channels. Free wifi wasn't good as it would not stay connected and often it took a long time to connect.  The management knew about this and they were trying to take it up with the provider.
There was a good size fridge.  The kitchen provided basic utensils which were on an open shelf underneath the kitchen bench.  The wardrobe was just a rack, with shelves for the hairdryer, iron etc.  and it was adequate.
Our room was very quiet and parking just outside.  All the staff were so friendly, nothing was too much trouble.  It is well worth the money !

title: OK for the price
text: The cheapest hotel we stayed in for our 2 weeks in NZ. It's nothing flash. Good for 1 night before you drive 120km to the airport. The room was large (room 5) so plenty of space. On arrival  the manager was friendly and other staff all smiles. It was clean but basic. Must say the wifi was good. ( and free ) Fair amount of noise from near by road. The portable heater did a surprising job for the large room. Only a pedestal fan for cooling, so look out in hot weather ( does it get hot in NZ ?). At the end of the day you get what you pay for.

title: So bad we left.
text: The room was stuffy and dank which is probably why there was an industrial air freshener unit running. It wasn't particularly clean. Usually NZ motels have a sparkling kitchen but this was grubby and the washing up gear dubious. We decided we would leave after 20 mins and told the owner why. He still debited our credit card (we had booked on line).

title: Reasonable mid-card motel
text:
Lake Point Motel offers reasonable accommodation fairly near to the Hamilton city centre. It is nothing particularly flash, but then it doesn't pretend to be. I had a very big room. Strange to say but it was almost too big, with a huge open space somewhat lacking in character. The extensive plain walls all became quite bland and featureless, only punctuated by a couple of token pictures. The room all seemed quite new and modern and in good condition, though construction seemed a little flimsy and fittings were not particularly high quality, so I'm not sure how durable it will be long-term. 

Lighting in the big main room was perhaps a bit much, with six lights on the ceiling that were either all on or off; it may be good to have partial control so they don't have to all be on at once, or else have a dimmer or something. Again, having to have it so bright added to the characterless feel of the room. The TV was in a weird position, on a small table to the side of the bed, but also side on to the couch, so it was really set up for neither couch nor bed viewers. At least it was easy enough to move it on its little table to face the couch, dining table, or shifted to a somewhat bit better spot for viewing from the bed, but regardless it would still be to the side of the bed if you were a real bed watcher (there's only so far it could be moved due to the aerial/cable connections). On the positive side, it was a good Samsung model with heaps of Sky Pay-TV channels available. Good free wifi was also provided, with no obvious data limit.

No air-conditioning in the room, but it did have a floor fan and small heater; not sure how effective it would be in that big room in very hot or cold weather. I don't know, but this lack of air-con seems to be a not uncommon thing in NZ which you don't really see these days in Australia or the US, perhaps just reflecting the climate. The recycling tub alongside the bin was a nice touch you don't often see. I found the bed a bit soft for my liking, and the pillows were flat. I was able to pile the two pillows on top of each other to get a reasonable lift, but with only two pillows provided in the room that wouldn't have been an option if I wasn't travelling solo. The bedside clock was not plugged in or set, which always indicates to me a slight lack of care on behalf of the proprietors. There were a couple of minor maintenance issues not worth elaborating on. 

In the bathroom was a bizarrely low toilet, perhaps designed for the visiting Hobbits from the nearby regions. The shower was super-powerful, to the extent that I couldn't help wondering how much water it was churning through and feeling a little guilty about it. There was no fan in the bathroom so the room/mirror fogged up badly. Similar to the main room, it was all quite spacious.

The motel was a 10-15 minute walk to the centre of town, or a few minutes drive. Walking back from town late on a Saturday night I felt the neighbourhood was perhaps not the best, however having said that, it was not overly sketchy. It was dark in the grounds of the motel, with no real outside lighting. In general the motel grounds were very basic outside the rooms. For NZ this was a fairly good price at around $110 for the night. In short, it's nothing great, but reasonable value for money and fine for a short stay.

title: Lake point Hamilton..truly awful
text: Having read reviews giving it 4.5 rating this motel was chosen..what a mistake! Where do I start? Not very clean, bed soft, no wardrobe ..jest a cheap hanging rail.Ants to keep you company in the bathroom and bedroom kitchen ..it says spa bath.. I really wouldn't get in it.the kitchen area had no cupboards just an open shel.. Don't bother here either!, wasn't asked how the stay was.. No wonder. Give this a miss, never stayed anywhere quite so poor, this is not for a traveller.

title: lovely stay
text:
We have stayed here a number of times and like to come back.  We find the location quiet but close to town.
 Clean, comfortable bed and friendly hosts, we always enjoy the big bath too.
 No doubt we will be back again Thanks .

title: Not a Pleasant Experience
text: We stayed in the one bedroomed apartment in the older part of the motel.  Whilst the accommodation was clean and modern, the room was hot and stuffy and traffic noise was so bad it was impossible to leave the windows open.   It was like living under a bridge and we would not have stayed there had I know the unit was near a busy road - the motel was listed as "quiet".  We didnt get back to our unit until 2 pm and had thought it would be serviced by then.  However, there was no room service on the second day and when I went to request clean towels from reception no one answered the buzzer in the office and I eventually got the towels myself out of the laundry bag. I would not recommend this motel.

title: Clean and spacious with free skycity shuttle
text:
We stayed here for one night in two rooms accomodating four and five in each room and found the stay to be very pleasant. The lady at reception was very helpful. She gave us a number to call for the free shuttle to skycity which brought us there within five minutes of calling and back as well .
The units have a parking lot in front each which make unloading and loading very convenient. Rooms were roomy and clean. Beds were adequately comfortable. (We had two king beds and a single in the room for five).Only grouse - only one pillow each and they were quite flat. Kitchenette has no stove. There was a portable hot pot, electric hot pan , toaster , microwave, refrigerator. There was a fan and an electric heater as well and all beds have electric blankets .As the weather was just nice , we did not use any of these. Bathroom was roomy and very clean . Water pressure was good and there was plenty of piping hot water. Toiletries were adequate. A hair dryer is supplied .
Altogether a very pleasant stay- will stay here again. Value for money.

title: Always a Great Stay
text: Thanks for accommodating us during our weekend in Hamilton.  We found our rooms to be lovely and clean and the beds are so comfortable.  The rooms have everything you would need for a great stay.  The motel is within walking distance to the town centre and the Hamilton nightlife.  The hosts are friendly and helpful and they go out of their way to help you out.  Thanks Paul and Susan for a great stay!

title: Two familys on overnight stay
text: We stayed at this hotel in order to be near a football tournament. Both families found the cost and cleanliness and space of the hotel to be of a high standard. Our hosts were very informative and gave us great local information. Bathrooms were fairly modern. Ground floor rooms though did not have an outstanding view of the area, but did not impact our stay

title: Modest but spotless and great location!
text:
We chanced on Lake Point by heading up the hill in Hamilton. Just over road from old water tower and the Lake and parklands, it is spotlessly clean. Room 8 is the pick - we were offered it, arriving midday, good idea if not booking ahead. Huge, north-facing picture window, so quiet. Kitchenette has frypan, dual hot plate, microwave, but hardly any kitchen tools. . . .
10 min walk down hill to City centre, 2 supermarkets, restaurants. Stacks to do in Hamilton. Short drive to Cambridge (old English), Waikato River trails,Waitomo Caves and more. Hamilton Gardens are magnificent.
We are on a week visit from Melbourne.

title: Totally satisfied
text: Motel recommended by Info centre after last minute decision to stay in Hamilton. Hosts very accomodating, helpful and friendly. Rooms clean and very spacious. Close to lovely lake for nice walks and playground for kids, also well located for proximity to town and services. Thank you for helping us out of a tight spot, we appreciated the welcome and allowing our whole family to enjoy such special memories together.

title: Best Motel in Hamilton
text: We have stayed in this motel on several occasions now and have always found the rooms to be spotless and spacious, the beds are extremely comfortable and we have no problems sleeping while we are there. The proprietors are always very helpful and very friendly. The Hamilton Gardens is only across the road and Hamiltons main shopping area and hospital are not far away. I would recommend this motel as a place to stay while in Hamilton. I know we will be back without a doubt :)

title: Welcoming place; handy for the railway station too
text: Good location over the road from a large park about 12 minutes easy walk from the station.  The proprietor was very helpful indeed, offering us transport to the station and helping us contact another hotel in New Zealand. Large clean full kitchen studio room.  Large supermarket just 10 minutes walk.  Over the road for a stroll around the lake in a lovely park.

title: Great service
text: Just a quick thank you for a lovely stay at your motel on Friday 16th November. We were greeted in a friendly way, the room was lovely, spacious and clean, and we were given excellent directions on how to find a nice Italian restaurant for dinner. Keep up the great work, we will be back. Caroline, one of the Taranaki Dragons :) but next time could you please turn on some better weather!

title: Great service
text:
Very warm welcome from lady at reception when we were enquiring about accommodation for the night.  Was informed that they were pretty full that evening but had a room in the older part of the motel for a reduced rate if we were interested in looking.  We were shown the unit and though old and outdated, it was perfectly adequate for our nights stay.  Spotlessly clean with everything we required and an awesum shower.  Its position in the comlex also ensured we had a great nights sleep as it was very quiet.
We considered it excellent value and the great friendly service will ensure we return

title: A mixed bag
text: Spacious verging on cavernous .. Sandstone block construction made for a warm interior despite Winter chill outside & facilities were adequate, However, when booking, requested a second bed for wife & self (restless sleepers) & was billed additional $20 per night, but have since discovered the unit occupied by another couple from our group included the divan style bed as a matter of course .. seems we needlessly paid more for standard configuration.

title: Excellent well priced stay
text: In the central city away from motel mile, close to the hospital, CBD, and minutes away from attractions, Lake Point was well appointed. King beds a god send. Clean tidy and good value for money.

title: Great place to stay
text: We were a group of eight guys travelling around New Zealand following the rugby world cup and we had booked three rooms, two rooms sleeping three and one sleeping two. From my first contact many months before with Paul and Susan to our departure they were simply great, the Motel itself was ideal.  The rooms were large, clean and comfortable.  The location was also close to town and I would highly recommend the Lake Point Motel to anyone considering staying in Hamilton.  Paul, Susan and all the staff were very helpful and friendly. As an example of their thoughtfulness when one of our guys left his mobile phone in the room and only discovering it missing while en route to Wellington he contacted the Motel.  The owner Paul was able to confirm that they the cleaning staff had found the phone and immediately took the details of a forwarding address then dispatched the phone to our next stop which was a hotel in Wellington.  Thank you Paul and Susan, and I speak on behalf of the eight of us that should any of us return to Hamilton, which I am sure we will, then the first thing we will do is check to see if you have availability.  Cheers

title: Perfect place to stay
text:
Friendly couple welcomed me for a stay for a month and advised me for sightseeing tips during my stay. 
Room was fine, spacious and well taken care after. Every day cleaning, clean towels, coffee/tea refill etc.; newspaper on the doorstep. 
Good internet access and SKY TV.
Perfect location to make walk around the lake (just round the corner), 10 minute walk to the city centre with bars/restaurants.
Also a god starting point for trips all over the North Island as Hamilton is conveniently located.
Sometimes some minor "noise" from cars if windows are open.
Great value for the money!

title: Best Place to stay - won't stay anywhere else!
text: If you want a wonderful, friendly couple looking after you .. if you want a spa bath, large, clean, spacious rooms, SKY TV, Newspaper every morning ... if you want to be only a 10 minute walk from heaps of shops, movie theatres, restaurants, or in the other direction, a beautiful lake with lovely gardens to walk around - then Lakepoint Motel is the perfect place for you.  I stay here every month (and have been for the last 3 1/2 years) and just want to keep coming back.  You won't be disappointed.  Highly recommended accommodation.

title: Clean and quiet but lacked character
text:
This motel was quiet, roomy, clean and the owners were friendly. However, the interior was very bland and uninviting. The walls were plain, large and blank and there were no decorative touches that made it feel homely or warm. The views from the window looked onto windows of other units, so they didn't redeem the blank decor inside. The bed was also not particularly comfortable.

The location was good, being close to a large, pleasant lake which took approximately 1 hour to walk around.

title: Lovely, economical, roomy, huge bathroom with spa bath.
text:
Stayed for 2 nights in January as a central point to explore the area. The nightly tariff of NZ$125 was a bargain. As previously stated, the room and bathroom were huge, and there is also a kitchenette. I believe the building was concrete block construction and we heard no noise from adjoining suites. My wife is an extremely light sleeper and we had expressed concerns, prior to all our accommodation bookings, about noise. The Motel is situated along side a thoroughfare (two lane) that runs along Lake Rotoroa (Hamilton Lake) and there is some traffic  but we slept wonderfully (we had the office between us and the road). The lake is in a park setting and you are only across the road from a lovely evening walk. 

If you have smaller children, be aware that there is no swimming pool on premises but the Motel is conveniently located close to many amenities. The staff personalized our stay, were very helpful, and the room kept clean and tidy. The furnishings are dated but not in tatters. The king bed was comfortable if plain. Internet is available in the rooms although we did not use it and there are internet cafe's nearby. This Motel is used by business travellers, also has long term residents, and is very laid back and tranquil.

title: Great motel with a huge room
text:
Of all the hotels I had booked for my trip to New Zealand, this was the one I was most apprehensive about, as it had no reviews on Tripadvisor!
I didn't have anything to worry about, it is a superb motel.
My room was huge (not sure if all the rooms are this big), king size bed, sofa, dining table and even a spa (in the main room, not in the bathroom) There is also a separate bathroom with a shower, and a kitchen area with fridge, microwave and toaster. A fan and a heater is also supplied
It takes about 10 minutes to walk into town, there is a small hill to negotiate, but it's not too bad.
You also get a complimentary copy of the New Zealand Herald every day.
The only minor problem is the motel is on a junction, so you do get to listen to boy racers thrashing their cars (what is it with Kiwi drivers and their obsession with throaty exhausts?) It's not too bad though, as it never interrupted my sleep and I was in the unit right next to the road.
I really liked the hotel, thought it was good value for money and would definitely recommend it to anyone.

title: If it was not for the bad smell, it would be a lovely place
text: The building is beautiful and reception was very friendly. The room was clean and modernized but one thing lowers the overall rating: the smell. Unfortunately, it smelled quite badly of old socks or something. It would be such a lovely place and the rest was all good if they could get rid of the smell - rip the carpet out - they are disgusting anyway and not up to date. Car parking was plenty and easy. These tiny milk portions should be replaced by a package like in lots of places. There was no hair dryer (I expect one could have asked at reception). And it was quiet.

title: Disgusting motel
text: It's disgusting the owners let people smoke drugs everywhere always smells of drugs fighting all the time outside inside the motel its disgusting bed bugs in the Room I wouldn't recommend it anyone lazy owners just in it for the money obvious sad to say but true

title: Dismal
text: I understand that motel owners need to make money however you can't change standard rates for rooms damaged by those in Emergency Accommodation. Terrible night's sleep as well. This property used to be a nice place to stay ... twenty years later with no visible upgrades in décor, it's a dump!

title: Full of crack heads & homeless people !!. NOT SAFE !!!!.
text: Trust your gut instinct !!. Got a certain vibe straight away when parking our vehicle outside our room,  it was like rats peering out from every room when a new vehicle arrives ??. Unpacked, stepped outside for a drink and a smoke, door was open next door, smell of mince cooking next door, no worries, then a male voice "gonna get high", WTF, nek minute, some bludger comes up to me wanting a smoke & he was high as a kite, and then we seen some dude  "blazing on his meth pipe in his car".  A couple drove in with a couple of young kids in their car, I told them straight up "go somewhere else, its not safe here", they left. Like an infomercial, but wait there''s more,  went to have a shower before going out for dinner, no hot water, that's it, we are gone. The receptionist was useless, but eventually got our money back. NEVER AGAIN !!!

title: Well recommended
text: Reception staff lovely and very welcoming. We were given a free upgrade which was a nice surprise. Place is lovely and clean spacious and awesome air conditioning unit as it was a very hot day when we arrived. Totally recommend the Grosvenor to anyone visiting whether for the rugby as stadium within walking distance along with large supermarket and a very nice eatery.

title: Quick 2 night stopover in Hamilton
text: I picked the Grosvenor motel in Hamilton as it was reasonably priced an close to the city centre. It is within walking distance of Speights Ale House and supermarkets. Ask for a downstairs room if you have a lot of luggage. Staff were friendly at check in and check out. Rooms were clean. Free wifi. I would stay there again.

title: Nope, no, dont
text: We checked in at 630pm for a work trip. We checked out at 1030pm. We stayed in room 7, the  Bathroom has clearly been updated recently but not well, huge marks on the wall, holes in the wall in the bedroom we couldn't get any sleep as the people staying upstairs were super noisy! when we checked out I told the receptionist about the noise but maybe she doesnt speak english as she just gave me a blank look, so I emailed the place and havent heard a single thing back. I 100% expected at least a partial refund. Atrocious.

title: Never again
text:
Where to begin, the whole place is tired and needs up dating.
There are permanent tenants there from Housing NZ so lots of noise, unsupervised children running around.
The swimming pool is very unsafe, the ladder into the pool is broken( not recent by amount of rust around), this is the only way to get in and out of fairly deep pool, broken whole time we were there, four days. If a child or adult could not push themselves out of the pool they were stuck in there.
Signs say not smoking in units but everyone smokes just outside others doors and you can’t have door or windows open as the smoke just comes into the unit.
The unit we stayed in with 2 bedrooms had an updated bathroom but it was very dangerous, large step up in to shower which had a very slippery floor with not mat. There were no shelves in shower to put things on so putting toiletries on floor in shower increased risk of fall. Then the large step to get out of the shower again a falls risk, my mum didn’t shower after 2nd day as to afraid of falling.
We stayed over Christmas time, at $200 a night excepted at least clean towels on Christmas Day, when asked about this got told it’s Christmas day so no service. Have stayed regularly in motels in NZ over Christmas and always been told about service plans for the day and offered free towels. The receptionist said you should have been told this when booking in, I replied you booked us in, there was no reply from her.
When room serviced on Boxing Day, beds not made properly just roughly pulled up, no sign of cleaning in bathroom, kitchen not cleaned, dirty dishes left.
We should have read the reviews about this place before booking, lesson learnt for next time.
Would not recommend this place to anyone , appears owners only increased in making money not giving people a good experience.

title: Boys golfing weekend
text: This place never lets me down. As a value for money motel there aren't many better.  The late arrival times are a big help if you are travelling from afar and the staff at reception are always polite.  The rooms are a little bit dated but you have ample room in both the living area and bathroom areas and are always tidy.  The winning factor though is the indoor swimming pool which after our round of golf or an early morning dip after a night out is just what the doctor ordered.  I have stayed before and will definitely stay again.

title: Good stay
text: Friendly staff at reception, parking on site and just outside of rooms, the room was a good size and very clean with modern amenities, but only microwave for cooking but there was a jug and toaster available also, fridge etc.

title: Cheap, but . . .
text: Havng read other reviews citing cockroaches and drunks fighting we feared the worst. Well, thankfully none of that happened. Three minibuses of dodgy looking people turned up on our first night and frankly I thought we'd be checking out the next morning, but these fears came to nought. Basic accommodation, MDF self assembly furniture, rubbish TV channels, unenthusiastic (to say the least) reception and housekeeping staff. BUT it is cheap. We were middle class tourists staying multiple nights (in town for the cricket) so would much rather have paid more and enjoyed a higher standard. Nevertheless you get what you pay for, if you're in town for the night or just passing through the rate is low and the standard is just about OK, for an extended stay this might not be the one.

title: Disgusting!
text: absolutely awful shower pressure amounted to nothing would have gotten cleaner if i stood out in the rain bed was old an saggy and i fell right into the middle pool looked dirty and old and didnt have a running filter and when the staff came to clean the room they replaced the towel and USED our toilet would never come back again

title: 10/10 Would not stay again
text: I have signed up SPECIFICALLY to leave this review. This is one of the worst places for value for money. Close to town but rooms in appalling state. The beds are old and uncomfortable, the shower has awful pressure. If the hose is on outside it makes an awful rattle inside the unit. The oven is old. The couch was visibly broken where someone has sat on it. The paint was flaking in the bathroom. The shower was missing any soap dishes or any ledge to put things on. The WIFI was intermittent. Never going back.

title: Disgusting
text: Absolutely second worst place ive ever stayed in my life. Room was filthy. Single beds in lounge both broken. Huge dip in the bed (felt like a bent staple trying to sleep). Room looked like never been vacuumed. Tea towels were disgusting with marks on them even when replaced. Feel totally ripped off. Complained to office staff and they brought a mattress from a fold out bed to try fix the situation but bed stuffed so made no difference. Certainly would not recommend staying here. I never will again.

title: Spacious rooms, comfortable and quiet.
text: Stayed here for 2 nights on a recent NZ trip. Large spacious rooms, recently refurbished. Great shower pressure. Comfortable bed. Plenty of room. Fridge in my room had a problem and froze everything, including my milk and banana ! Outside light shines through curtains and blinds. Parking available. A short walk or drive to food/ supermarket. Onsite restaurant was closed. On a busy road but very quiet at night.

title: You get what you pay for
text: The room was smelly. The wallpaper in the toilet was ripped off. The shower head was so low I had to do yoga to get wash my hair. The road noise is horrendous and the bus passengers can wave to you while you do your makeup. The extensive list of things you shouldn’t do suggests it has been a great place for a party in the past!

title: Our experience was much better than other reviews
text:
We booked 2 nights here based on some 4/5 variety reviews on the bookings.com website. A couple of nights before leaving, we were dismayed to read that TripAdvisor had rated it so badly in comparison.

Having arrived and left, our experience was much better than some other reviews suggest.  It's a big place, so maybe some rooms are considerably worse than others?

We booked a family room for 2 adults and 2 children, which turned out to be downstairs.  It's definitely aged in places, but was not unhygenic and we certainly didn't feel as if it was disgusting we wanted to get away from the place.

Our room had a modern heat pump, which works well, and walking around the buildings there seem to be similar modern units for every room.  Staff were alright -- not massively outgoing with delight, but also not abhorrently rude as seems to be indicated in some other reviews I've read.  Maybe it depends on who's shift?

Wireless was patchy on occasion, but worked well most of the time.

There were a few issues, none of which really stand out from a variety of other motels I've visited:

There's a stern directive in the room about how everything is audited after each visit, and the visitor's credit card charged for any discrepencies.  They don't seem to audit the light bulbs because we had a couple blown, both in the main bedroom and including the only bedside light.

We used the swimming pool a couple of times -- nice pool, although when it ran out of towels for the day before 7pm (using room towels isn't allowed) and the office staffer said she'd send some more, they never showed up.

The couch in the main room seems to be missing a couple of springs, and was uncomfortable to sit on.

Bring your own stopwatch for the microwave because its a *very* simple one.  The door-open button popped off at one point when I closed the door.  I had to collect the button and two springs from the floor and reassemble it.

The room we had, maybe 40 metres back from the main road, was quiet, but soundproofing wasn't too good, so if it's a popular holiday time with the place likely to be full, that might be worth taking into account.

So a few small things, but nothing that really made us want to leave in disgust.

title: Overnight  Stay
text: This motel was extremely quiet for being on a main road.  Room was comfortable and clean, newly refurbished bathroom and PLENTY of hot water!!!  Bed was comfortable and exceptionally good quality for 3 star accomodation.  Would not hesitate to stay here again.

title: Value For Money
text:
We had a newly renovated room which was spacious and clean. A microwave and air conditioner were provided as well as toiletries, jug, tea, coffee etc. We arrived earlier than thought and were given a room on the ground floor at the back so we were quite a distance from the main road. This resulted in a quiet night's sleep. We were able to park right outside the room. Staff were friendly and helpful.
The bathrooms might be next to be renovated.

title: Dont stay here
text: My marching team hosted National Marching event in Hamilton weekend of 8/9 March. 3 teams which had booked into this motel arrived only to find that their bookings had been cancelled. All 3 teams had confirmed their bookings one on the morning prior to leaving home. What is more the management didnt care. So dont book here cos you may just find you get there and there is no room for you. Pity I even have to give them 1 star but thats the only way I could write this review.

title: Would not stay again, disgusting!
text: A very disappointing experience.  Our payment for four people was deducted from our card before we had even arrived.  We had visitors from overseas with us and felt embarrassed by the standard of this motel.  We have traveled throughout New Zealand and have never experienced such a disgusting room.  We stayed in a two bedroom unit. A latch was missing off the window, curtains covered in mildew and there were no mattress covers on beds.  The wardrobe smelt musty and the bed covers had seen better days.  It was difficult to turn round in the toilet as the industrial toilet roll holder took up half the width.  Some of the towels were discoloured and dirty.  The stove in the kitchen was filthy and there was a variety of crockery and utensils and crockery, nothing matching.  The wash cloth was dirty and was worn out.  The seating and dining furniture in the lounge looked as if it had been bought from a secondhand shop and there was not enough comfortable seating for four people. The dining chairs were worn out with the filling showing through and the bedsettee/sofa was falling apart.  It was very noisy with people shouting until the early hours of the morning and cars revving up before 7 am. The whole place needs a complete makeover, even the outside looks old and dingy. We could add a lot more and would not recommend anyone staying here.

title: Horrid
text:
This place looks okay but isn’t .
The Servive is below par and the facilities are run down, moreover the staff don’t care.
The room service was only pulling up the covers. I complained as the room was dirty, dishes not cleaned, beds not made very well at all(a 5yr old would do better).
The shower was a trickle. It’s well situated but very noisy. Can hear the traffic and all the other patrons.

title: Not recommended.
text: Arrived at check in to witness a spectacle of "long term" guests having a screaming match which nearly escalated into a brawl in the car park - felt really unsafe.  This was the start of the awful 2 night stay.  Kept awake both nights by guests partying, swearing, stomping up and down hallway outside the our unit until around 3 am. Wifi did not work.
