Room was not cleaned/serviced after first night, had to request basics like towels, coffee etc. To be fair, after complaining room was then serviced (still not given basics like sugar,  etc though) and Wifi was fixed.    Didn't feel safe, poor sleep due to behaviour of "long term" guests,  Poorply equiped rooms.   Not worth the money.

title: Wouldn’t stay again
text: The minute we arrived we were greeted by other tenants having a fight right next to recption who couldn’t care less. Toilet was stained and there was a large amount of hair in basins and kitchen sink. We slept with people walking up and down outside our room making a racket all night and then woke to have no wifi (needed for business) and after calling reception they told us they couldn’t do anything until 10am... it was only 7am. We then left for the day to return to a very untidy room, our beds were un-made, floors not vacuumed, dishes still dirty, coffee and tea not replensished. Will never stay again or recommend.

title: Rundown, in need of renovation
text: The pros: rooms were big and lots of space. The cons: the motel is tired, rundown, had marks of dead insects all over the walls in one bedroom, stains elsewhere, broken and abandoned objects were left all over the grounds, doors in certain rooms were broken, and we had to ask for our towels every day. In need of a refurb.

title: Tired and run-down
text:
The "air conditioning" was actually just a pedestal fan, which was inadequate on a very hot night.
The Sky TV had only 4 channels.
One of the windows wouldn't shut properly and left the room insecure.
The frosting on one of the bathroom windows had come off, meaning the bathroom wasn't private

title: Pretty good
text: I viewed two rooms a spa unit and a a studio unit. Wasnt impressed with the spa unit...it was nice and clean but the shower curtin over the spa didnt appeal. Our studio upstairs upstairs was clean and comfortable. Really nice soft pillows. No aircon but the fan and open windows was great. Some long term  tenants (housing NZ shortage in Hamilton) evident and a number of pak n save trolleys around in the AM. All in all good value for money. Recommend for rhe travellor on a budget.

title: 3day stay, tangi
text:
Worst place ever.Staff are rude and the place is dirty.

Beds are old, place smelled, toilets old and smelly.

I won't reccommend to anybody, it's so filthy and I don't think they care.. horrible hole!!!

title: Absolutely horrid!! Should have checked reviews and viewed the room first.
text: After a long journey in the rain we paid for the room without asking to see it first. What a mistake! it was grim. It was dirty and smelly, stains on the furniture and decoration of the room was very poor. We didn't even sleep in the beds but on top fully dressed. There were bits of rubbish, shopping trolleys and used condoms littering the grounds of the motel.   It was noisy and the call girl pick and drop off continued all night There were lots of unsavoury characters hanging around the motel complex  and we simply did not feel safe. This place is unbelievably bad and expensive and I cannot understand the good reviews given .I would rather sleep in the car than stay here again.

title: Great Stay....
text: Very good, very clean  and good services. We needed a quick stay overnight in Hamilton. We booked a night before for a late check in. No hassle.. perfect setting very close to centre of town. I liked the set up of the room.  Was very practical and economical for a longer stay. I have to go back for a few more days...  for an appointment... So definitely recommend an affordable stay...

title: Avoid if possible! Poor condition
text: We were a little late getting some last minute accommodation, Since we were arriving at 4pm and checking out early at 6am we just needed something for a quick sleep and then hit the road. It is very laughable and actually hilarious that Motor Inns in this condition can still operate and charge these prices- It would be fairer to charge $79 for a single and $89 for a couple as the rooms are simply not up to date and well past their use by date. It is a pity as the current owners don’t look like they will reinvest more money into the motor Inn- a shame really as it will look quite nice with new bathrooms, kitchens, upgraded hot water system, and new fixtures inside. The location is good- I didn’t even attempt to eat at the restaurant as the condition of the rooms are so poor you second guess what the quality of the restaurant will be like. The staff seem friendly enough although I very much doubt you will see much change. Would be good if the accommodation websites can remove this from their searches and force the owners to upgrade their motor inn and meet a minimum standard. Food for thought? Would I stay here again- most likely not, if it was a real budget motor inn and charged realistic budget prices then I would re consider.

title: 55th Anniversary break
text: The management and staff were exceptionally friendly and efficient.  The room was quiet even though we were on the busy side of the street.  All amenities clean, tidy and comfortable, the Spa Bath a really lovely bonus after a long day.  We recommend this motel to others looking for price effective  accommodation.

title: Never again
text:
Very close to everything but seriously I stayed there about 10 years ago and it wasnt that great then.  I would of thought it would of been renovated by then.

Stains on walls.  Duct tape holding a wall crack by toilet.  Bed sheets well umm didnt feel clean.  The duvet cover on top stripped that off as I don't think that had been washed in a while.

Stains on carpets.  Overall not clean.  Customer service was terrible.  

Wont be back.

You need to renovate and modernise especially for the price of a room.

title: Ange
text: Family unit is old and outdated. Holes in the fabric of 2 dinning chairs. Couch old and stained. Not impressed for the price. Very disappointed at the unit unfortunately it looks better on website than in real life.

title: No care
text: Arrived at office to be told they hadn't received our pre-payment. Waited until it was sorted, but noticed two dirty cups on the table in front of us. The surrounding grounds were unkept, overgrown, broken down washing machines, broken chairs in the middle of complex. Our room smelt musty. rusty bathroom fixtures, tide mark around spa bath, shower was weak and the spout couldn't stay out so practically up against the wall to get some water. We left our towels out of the room the next day with the intent of a change and a room service. Blankets (ripped and old) were just thrown over the bed, dishes still dirty. Went to breakfast a 7am, closed! Pool was empty for maintenance. Long term tenants told me the pool has been closed for a while,  curtains in the rooms were mouldy / black. Went to office at 8.50pm, door locked. . The photos on this website are false and don't depict the current state of this motel. Very very disappointed!!! Pay a bit extra cos you certainly get what you pay for (or in this case less) !!!!

title: Disappointing
text: This hotel badly needs renovating. In our room the curtains were torn in many places. There was thick mould on top of the shower screen. Neither clock radio alarms worked. Towel rails broken in bathroom. Dirty walls. Stained carpet. Bed was OK but that is about the only positive. Both on arrival and at departure there was no one in reception. A note said back in 5 mins but both times I was waiting much longer than this.

title: Unbelievably unacceptable
text:
Booked months in advance, arrived at reception 45mins before check-in hoping to leave our luggage while we used time before check-in. 
Receptionist said we were too early, did not want our names or details and said to come back at the correct time. 
We returned to find they had cancelled our booking on the grounds that we had not answered their phone call to confirm the reservation which at the time we were in flight from Christchurch to Hamilton. 
We have travelled extensively to quite a few destinations and had never had service such as this, fortunately we were able to book elsewhere. 
I guess the majority of reviews speak for themselves.

title: 1 Star at best
text: This place is not good. Reception closes at 9PM. Pretty much tells how much the owners care about their guests. Place is filthy. Carpet worn torn and was wet, hated to take shoes off. Bathroom spelled like there was a three day frat party here and a lot of sick people. Bedspread filthy. Spend more money whatever but don't  come here unless you don't care. Picture of bedspread and carpet attached.

title: Noisy, air pollution and feeling unsafe
text:
This is not a nice motel to stay in.

Firstly, the room that we were given is on the upper floor nearer to the main road.
Hence you get the sound of traffic.

Secondly, there seems to be families like( homeless people on the benefits) 
Kids running around , up the stairs and around the car park ( which is dangerous), noisy booming music at night , cigarette smoke all the time as they smoke outside the corridor or downstairs, loud talking and loud phone conversations and playing guitar outside the corridor in the night.

Thirdly, the room has bare necessities, towels are provided, a dispenser of soap of some sort( for bathing and washing hair???? Hello, if you want to save cost on small bottles of shampoos , use couple of dispensers , indicate shampoos and conditioners)
No shower caps too, as not everybody would want to wash hair everyday.
No tissue papers available.
Cutleries, plates, glasses and dish washing liquid are provided but no brush to wash the dishes only a small, flat pathetic so call sponge ( Food and Hygiene - bateria infested old dirty sponge). 

Good thing about this motel is walking distance to Pak n Save ( supermarket) and near town.

title: Past it’s best
text: The receptionist was nice on check in especially as I’d got wrong dates. But the  room was depressing.. I booked a studio with a spa bath but didn’t want to use it because bits were falling off and jets rusty looking. Hand basin was stained looking. Bed was comfy though. . Only 1 tea bag.

title: Pleasantly surprised
text:
After the horror reviews we were expecting a hell hole.
Communication within the staff could be better.
There could be a bit more service for the money paid especially with a more thorough room service.
The pool was adequately heated with generous hours.
We were in a two bedroom apartment for a week. The kitchens could be bigger and the microwave placed on a shelf. Needs to be better equipped. 
Needs towel rails!
Tiny laundry ill equipped for such a large motel.
But all in all it was quiet, the beds comfortable and if they didn’t cut corners they could easily achieve a four star rating.

title: Choose again!
text: GROSS!  Bogies on the walls, insect droppings over the ceiling, mould on the shower curtains, dusty blinds, cold, noisy, dated and a customer is always wrong attitude at reception. No smoke alarms. Never again. Don’t stay here!

title: Has seen better times
text:
Very basic accommodation that needs a spruce up!!
From the half interested reception that would rather talk on the phone in her foreign language to rooms that are partly renovated. This was not a great experience.
The room reeked of cigarette smoke even though a smoke free policy is notified.
Has potential if tidied up.
Is handy to sports venues but suggest you try elsewhere.

title: GROSS venor  do not stay here, could not wait to leave.
text: Mouldy rotten shower, no pressure, musty smell throughout, old spa pools and furniture stacked up outside the back door of the aprartment, everything was gross at the Grosvenor. Couldn’t get rid of the cat which kept coming inside. Taps dripping, curtains mouldy, inadequate heating.  Pool barely lukewarm.

title: DO NOT STAY HERE
text: We got here at around 6pm and it took a while to get into our room in the first place. Once we finally got into the room it was terrible, it smelt horrible, the bathroom had mold on the ceiling, and it was just overall bad. We went back to the office and we got "upgraded" to a slightly better room. One good thing though was the shower, there was good water pressure and the towels were clean,this is probably the only good thing. There were shopping trolleys outside our room which put us off even more. In our new bathroom there was at least a wall between the toilet and the sink and shower, this was a much better upgrade from the last room which has just a curtain dividing the two. In our toilet however, there was a huge hole in the wall behind the door, the door which was impossible to close because there was no room. We were on the 2nd floor (top floor) yet there sounded like there was banging coming from the roof all night, there was also the water pipes which were extremely loud and disrupting. We made the mistake of not reading the reviews and this led to a horrible stay. Do not reccomend ANYONE stays at this motel.

title: A Dump
text:
Booked in here as the website said they had a spa pool. Guess what- no spa, just a luke warm grotty indoor pool.
Room had a smell. door handle fell off, no lead for the TV ( which we went to reception and got.) heaters did work thank goodness. significant roll together in the bed. Took the money out of our credit card before we arrived despite Wotif saying that we pay at the hotel. We wanted to pay by ept-pos not credit card. Too bad for us.
Would rather sleep in my car than stay here again, which is a shame as the place has potential, if they just spent a bit of money on upkeep and modernisation.

title: Horrible
text:
First I’d like to start off with the staff, very unwelcoming and quite rude. We walk into the room and it’s colder inside than out. They are too cheap to provide actual toilet paper, instead we had to use what felt like sand paper in a public toilet. The shower was just water dribbling from the head. There were holes in the walls, stains on the carpet, leaking taps and broken lights. The beds were extremely uncomfortable, I could feel the springs poking right through. 
I would not recommend this place to anyone, I wish I had read the reviews before booking.

title: Sorry - won’t be back
text:
Upon arriving at around 6pm it took us a good few mintues to even get into our room with the weird door handle lock - I have stayed at countless hotels/motels and never come across a lock like this. The room
Was freezing cold - air conditioner we spent ages trying to work out how it worked - we gave up! Bed I slept in had a sheet on matress - no matress protector - eeew!
The refurbishement they have done is ok - and I mean ok - looks pretty rough and cheap to me. I wouldn’t stay here again, I was not comfortable here.

title: Absolutely fuming !! DO NOT STAY HERE
text: I can not think of even one good thing to say about our stay here. Our unit was ridiculously cold, NOTHING worked (tv, heaters, iron, microwave) and the amount of undesirable guests and even just random people walking in and out of the street was laughable.  How this place is even allowed to operate is beyond me. There is rubbish absolute every where.  There are old couches just out in the car park, random bits of old furniture on out side balcony's and the further down the property you get the worse it seems to be which was a pity for us as we booked a family unit (if you could call it that) down the back. If you are looking for a fun filled night of loud partying, and what I can only imagine to be illegal activity going on then this is the place for you. Otherwise do yourself a favour and keep scrolling and find somewhere else to stay. We booked this hotel based on amenities, what a joke that turned out to be. I left fuming this morning after talking to the lady at reception about everything and her response was to offer me a free cookie.

title: Awesome upgrade of the units
text: The property was very run down and tired. Half of it has been upgraded and is excellent value for money! Apparently the second stage is to happen after Field Days. We were pleasantly surprised at the new look units. We will be back!

title: Dreadful experience - do not stay here
text:
Like another reviewer, I wish I had read the reviews first.  Do not be fooled by the appearance from outside which looks quite acceptable.  
I booked one night for a business trip - wish I hadn't. 
No toilet paper provided in my room, I had to ask for it. 
"Curtain" in bathroom was a piece of dirty cloth (raw edges, no seams) hanging on a curtain wire.  
Fridge - there is a note on this advising you to switch this off if the noise keeps you awake. However, there was a build  up of at least 2 inches of ice inside the fridge so no wonder it was noisy. 
Room in general - tired, outdated and unwelcoming. 
Cobwebs - multiple and large!!   
I put my complaints in writing to the management and was advised that they will be refrubishing. Apologised that the house keeper had not checked basic nesessities and cleanliness. Offered me another stay at half price - "No thank you!!". 
I am happy to a cheap and cheeerful room at $130 per night, however I expect cleanliness and basic nesessities to be provided.

title: Pretty average
text: My kids and I stayed a night here. We were made to pay a $100 bond in arrival, which We hadn't been warned about. We discovered soon after we checked in that the tv didn't work so the man from reception was kind enough to give us another room. The rooms were dated and stunk of stale cigarettes. We also had some guys from a few doors down that spent half an hour from 11pm til 11.30pm standing drinking and yelling outside our backdoor.

title: Can I give a minus
text:
The only thing I feel stupid about is not reading the reviews. I just stayed here with my partner and 66 year old mother and had the worst motel experience of my life( and I've stayed in some dodgy motels)
We returned after food to a couple of complete moronic guys drinking outside their next door apartment. After ignoring intimidating comments, soon we were confronted with banging on the door. It turned out to be,what I can only assume was a prostitute, off her face stumbling into our room. Turns out, as a joke, friendly neighbours had swapped numbers as a joke. What followed was a night of intimidation, cars screeching by,banging, drinking. The hotels response? Don't worry, the door is strong. 
I've notified the police, the place is just scary, I asked in the morning do they read their comments and was greeted with a vacant blank stare. Please don't stay here. But a tent, pitch by the side of Victoria st. You will sleep better.

title: Don’t Stay here
text:
Let me start with the positives - well the only one positive the internet is fantastic in fact cannot be faulted. 

Now to the unit isn’t it just amazing how hotel/motels can charge for vastly inferior service.  Like bathroom lights that don’t work, the buttons on the toilet are worn through, linings on chairs worn right through to the dirty foam rubber and even though they don’t serve food and when they say they have breakfasts and they don’t do that either.  The yard was littered with rubbish. All of this for just $110 per night 

When I spoke to the management they said that the chairs were supposed to be outside pity that the cleaners didn’t know that when they pulled the duvet over my bed to make it.

It really is a pity that I can’t post pictures on this site because if you could nobody would stay there!  

BTW Bookings.com has this listed as 4.5 stars

I was booked by my work into here will they ever book anyone else in there NO WAY

title: An Underwhelming Experience
text:
Visiting Hamilton for a friends birthday celebrations, we saw this Motel on the Internet, and thought it looked quite impressive from the street view, and was centrally located. 
We had driven from Hawkes Bay and I phoned them the day before, hoping we could get into our unit before our Midday function, but found the reception most unhelpful.
Our unit, also, was quite a letdown. On arrival we were met by friends who had been there from the previous night, and advised us to not check in, Unfortunately I already had, and had paid on check in. Our room was in the back unit, very quiet, but quite run down. It was quite roomy, and the bed was comfortable, but all very dated. 
The wallpaper was peeling off the toilet wall, and the toilet so small I found it difficult to shut the door as I manoeuvred around the bowl. The surroundings of the Shub were cracked right down, and the hand basin worn to the point of appearing grubby. 
The location was good, but so are many others in the vicinity.
We would not stay at this Motel again, and would not recommend it to others.

title: Look elsewhere
text:
5 rooms booked for 2 nights for 5 couples
* door to the bathroom had a hole in it roughly plastered & children’s stickers on door
* bathroom ceiling paint badly pealing off
* window above spa bath/ shower hanging unable to be closed & a hole in glass where extractor fan used to be! glass also cracked around the hole.
* poor crockery selection , no large plates, 3 small mismatched bowls etc t towel provided but no washing liquid to wash cups in the stained bathroom basin!
* fan in bedroom was covered in dirt
The plus things were, very clean white linen, shower was hot and white towels were nice plus bed was comfortable
The other 4 rooms were in much the same state, one unit had a main window pane held together with sticky tape

Suffice to say none of us will not be back!!!!!!

title: Avoid
text:
This place has friendly staff and a decent location otherwise I would have given it a no star rating.
I really don't know where to begin. The room we had was a 'spa' room. Don't be fooled into thinking this makes it classy. The place needs a drastic overhaul. The carpet was stained and had cigarette burns. The sink had cigarette burns. Paper torn and cellotaped on-a long time ago. Even the basics like changing the loo roll wasn't carried out. The best bit was the air conditioning -a ceiling fan with no blades. I will let the pictures speak for themselves.

title: Couldn’t wait to leave
text:
Unexpectedly, I needed to stay in Hamilton overnight.  Lack of hotel or motel rooms in the city this night meant I was forced to stay at the Grosvenor Motor Inn.
I got the last room which had two bedrooms with single beds in each.  

Exterior is tired and untidy.  Decor and kitchen unchanged for decades!  
Wifi completely useless.  Poor TV channel choice.  Tea towels not fresh.  Poor quality toiletries.  Terrible lighting.  Questionable shower.  

Paid $168 for the night.  I don’t expect 5 star luxury for this price but I’ve recently stayed in many better motels in towns and cities around NZ who have delivered a much better experience for a similar cost.  

Could not relax here at all.  Avoid!

title: It is OK but a bit tired
text: It is cheap and in a relatively good position being a ten minute walk from the centre of town. However it is in a street that is absolutely bursting with motels and I imagine that there are better deals to be had.

title: TERRIBLE PLACE DO STAY HERE
text: What a truly horrible place, old run down and dirty not to mention the staff who were exceptionally rude and completely unhelpful especially the receptionist.  After arriving in the rain with my baby I was made to wait in the car park, while being tooted at by the owner I might add who wanted me to move so he could park his car in the car park by the entrance and not get wet.   Then I was barked at by the receptionist in very bad English that I had to pay again, which I refused and then tried to sort the matter out only to be told that they had no idea of what sort of online system they use for payment but I was to pay again. Needless to say after consulting my bank I refused. Peeling wallpaper, no milk, slept on the bed not in it as it was so horrible and I was concerned about how clean it was. My experience of the late night wheels and swearing out in the car park was exactly the same as Lisa R.and  frankly I would be ashamed to have anyone visiting from overseas get the impression that this is acceptable or normal in the hospitality industry in New Zealand.  Up your game GROSSvenor and maybe start with some staff training, a professional cleaner and an up date of the furniture which is tired and dirty. Overall a terrible experience. On an end note it is stated there is WiFi in the room but it was absolutely useless and in the end I gave up and used my own data.

title: Awful.
text:
Wish I had read the reviews before booking. Needed emergency accommodation while my partner was in hospital habing surgery and this was the best price I could find.  Should have slept in my car!!  It is 4am and I am contemplating doing just that as I am not getting any sleep here. One of the guests has decided to change the wheels on their car at 3am (either that or he is stealing the wheels from other vehicles as he has a large pile of wheels on his ute) and is banging about with tools and swearing and yelling at the rest of his group who are on the balcony drinking and playing loud music. There is no phone in the room to contact reception to ask them to control the guests and calling the number for the hotel just goes to answer phone. I am contemplating calling the police as I dont feel safe, the window in bathroom does not close properly and the curtains in the room are hanging off the rail and there is no lock on the inside of the door.  I would pack up and leave but I had to park on other side of car park as it was full and I am too scared to go outside. The room smells of badly disguised cigarette smoke, the furniture is old and stained and bathroom fittings are all broken and stained from what appears to be flooding. The bed is bouncy and firm with no mattress covers under sheets. Not evem going to look at what condition it is in.  A sign in the room says rooms are only serviced twice a week. I am hoping they also get serviced in between guests?  From the outside this Motel appears to be ok amd the fact it had an on site cafe appealed when I booked but dont be fooled by the exterior.  
 It is terrible and I wish I had gone to a back packers instead.

title: Terrible
text:
Spent the night in room 14. It’s upstairs directly next to the owners unit, and directly beneath their illegal dwelling. We had a massive 6 hours to get sleep before our airport transfer, and managed to get a grand total of 3 hours as someone was either getting lucky upstairs, or decided that 12am to 3am was the time of night to run an aerobics class. 

Bed was old and uncomfortable, pillows had little left in them and only 2 per room so we had to supplement them with our own clothing. Decor is WELL past it’s prime. Lights do not work above the bed. Bathroom was straight out of a 90s police murder film. 

At check in we got a bollocking for asking if we could leave our bags at the motel until the room was ready, although we did get permission over the phone for exactly that since we were only in town for the 7s and couldn’t take our luggage there.

Wifi was so slow, we decided to disconnect and just use the mobile data. 

Overall a terrible experience.

title: Not worth the price
text:
Stayed here for 2 days, but it was not worth the price, outside of this place looked great, but that is where it ends. Inside the room was very run down, outdated and needs an upgrade.  Rooms where not overly clean, one of the bed 's had stains on the cover, needs replacing,  tv had no guide to it, so you did not know what sky channels it had. Rubbish was not far from our room disgusting!  Old ovens and baths all over the place.
just keep driving if you see this place.
Had ground floor unit, not good as you can hear people in the room above us.

title: Business Trip stopover
text:
Room was as expected for the price, a little dated but clean and tidy. Bang on what I needed.

Nice table outside to sit at and have a few wines 

Spa Bath + Standard room ($100) through booking.com 

Would return here due to the service and convince to paknsave

title: ENJOYED OUR STAY
text:
Enjoyed our stay here......had a lovely quiet room which was awesome....very central without being right in town.....
Have stayed here before however think it has changed hands since we were there last...
Will stay again when in Hamilton

title: Not a place to relax.
text: Very uncomfortable two nights at this motel.would not stay again.No easy chairs to sit in to relax and read a book or watch some TV.Lying on a hard bed was the only option!sore backs in the morning.Good shower pressure and hairdryer but shoddy paint job in obviously renovated bathroom.Very dated room with dirty curtains.Needs a complete PROFESSIONAL do up.

title: Linen was fresh, wifi worked great comnfortable
text: Stayed overnight in room 2, ground floor, queen size bed, separate triangular spa bath/shower, seaprate toilet and wash basin. My stay was comfortable, relaxed, rested from a very busy week of work. The free wifi worked very well, i managed to do some study. The TV had 4 channels, 4 on rugby and 1 on movies. Enjoyed watching movies as well. The bed was very comfortable, fresh crisp linen, the bathroom areas were hygienic. Yes there was some wear and tear, like curtain broken behind the down, all very cosmetic really. What was important was comfort, cleanininess, wifi, ease of access. The motel receptionist knocked on my door and indicated i had an interior light on in my car. I really appreciated that. I would have woken to a flat battery ion my car.

title: OMG
text:
This place is a shocker
Broken blind on front door, ripped bed coverings, trampoline bed, toilet seat attached by one screw, wall paper ripped in bathroom, filthy iron and torn burnt ironing board
Was dubious about using the spa bath, surprisingly worked ok
Contemplated sleeping in the car or going to Kmart to buy a sleeping bag
PaknSave trolleys used for their linen trolley- bet they'd be happy about that
This place needs to be closed down and money spent on it to bring it up to an acceptable standard.

title: What a night!!!!
text: Helpful young woman in office but accommodation was dated, scruffy, mouldy, rotten skirting beside bath. windows didn't close fully in bathroom so we had to stuff packets between handle and latch to close window in hope to close out some of the very noisy main road. 2 small milk pottles of uht milk enough for one drink!!! I had to use a knife to make my cup of tea because there was no tea spoon. Two elderly woman showed us their room because they were shocked to find 2 slugs climbing up their damp and rotting room. This place was terrible and the restaurant for breakfast has a roof that is covered in mould. We were shocked that a service is allowed to run at this standard.

title: Unexpected Stay
text:
My partner & I were attending a three day gathering of Medieval folk. We were due to be under canvas but firstly my mate got a bad cold and then it rained, and rained, and rained, so we booked at Grosvenor, which had a vacancy and that at a reasonable price.
The receptionists both booking in and leaving were very friendly and helpful.
The room was clean and tidy.
It had a spa bath! Yea.
It was near a supermarket, Dominos Piza (and other fast food outlets) that you could walk to in 5 min.
All up it was just what we needed.
We were lucky we arrived on the Friday as on Saturday it was fully booked out.
We are due to be in Hamilton for The Tatoo Cup in September and will stay at Grosvenor if we can.

title: Quite a low standard
text:
I stayed recently with 3 other work colleagues all in separate rooms. My room the toilet had a leak. One of my work mates opened her room to find it was already occupied. Her second room when she went to sleep had a sock in the bed so it's hard to imagine when the sheets had been changed. All rooms had fridges that resembled jet planes taking off that couldn't be turned off. We didn't need the fridge as the milk we normally expect wasn't there or delivered when we asked for some. 
In a city awash with accommodation of a high standard this motel quickly needs to address its issues

title: DO YOURSELF A FAVOUR AND DRIVE PAST
text: We stayed in a "king spa room". There was a double bed and a single bed that could double as trampolines. We didn't wven take the chance of turning the spa on as it didn't appear to be well maintained. The fridge was so noisy we took their advice and turned it off overnight, see the picture of the sticker on the fridge. The heater is a very small blow heater (see picture) which wasn't affective but bed did have an electric blanket, thank goodness, because it only had a sheet and thin blanket which we kept "fighting" for during the night. There was a spare blanket in the cupboard so we got a spare sheet and slept as two singles on the double bed for the second night. One positive was it had good water pressure in the shower. Do yourself a favour and drive past!

title: Rip-off
text: Booked here during Fieldays.  Normal room rate of $99.00, charged $450.00.  Not all the sky channels worked, the spa bath was cracked and stained.  The vanity in the bathroom was stained, as was the carpet in the room.  I found an apple under the single bed, whilst looking for a power point, which was brown and shrivelled.  Who knows how long that had been there.  Holes in the walls, windows that didn't close or wouldn't close properly.  I have never stayed in a motel as bad as this one.  I had visitors with me from Australia and the South Island, and it was an embarrassment.

title: not what was advertised
text: this has to be the worst place i have ever stayed at! mould in the bathroom mould on the main room curtain no blackout curtains(outside lights stayed on all night) there was no bistro as was advertised some kind of liquid soap stuff in a dispenser it was a bad decision i have ever made will never go back

title: Dated and unkept
text: Where do i start....very dated and unkept! Would not recommend or stay again. Pool was advertised as heated, it was tepid and certainly no something you would swim in at this time of year. That was 1 of the main motivators of booking. Overall pretty disappointing to say the least.

title: Much to Improve
text: I wish I had read reviews before booking. This is the scungeous motel/hotel I have stayed in. There were broken venetian blinds-not expensive to replace- shower curtains that should be dumped- again not expensive to replace and the carpet was so stained etc I really didn't want to walk in bare feet on it. The telephone in room didn't work -we did get a replacement and the plug was broken.  Rail in wardrobe came down not fixed properly.Definitely needs a great update and very dated eg enamel finish on taps gone. Would not recommend this place at all.Have stayed in better cabins in camp sites.

title: Not the best
text: This place is dated and very tired looking. How ever breakfast at $12 was amazing. Fully cooked bacon n and eggs wow. Ok for a one night stay but not luxury. Two heaters in the room but no fan and it was hot! Had that old smell about it.  Staff not very welcoming

title: Disgusting!
text:
- The first room I was allocated had cigarette butts overflowing in an ash tray and the shower wasn't working. So they moved me. 

The next room:

- No hot water. I asked the motel manager and was told it is because someone in the room upstairs must have had a bath or shower and used all the hot water. She advised me to wait until the water heated again. When I had a shower (cold again despite her advice) the whole bathroom floods because the shower curtain only covers a small area and doesn't block the water from the rest of the bathroom. 

- Filthly, old and run down.Stained carpet. Cigarette burns in the bathroom sink. 

- The curtain covering the window on the door to the room is missing. The window is kind of opaque but I looked from the outside and you can see into the room when it's dark outside so no real privacy. 

- Paint peeling in the bathroom and the laminate on the floors peeling off due to water damage.

- No air con and the ceiling fan had been broken off the fitting.

- Periodically throughout the night the fridge woke me up making a loud banging / buzzing type noise. I had to get up and unplug it. 

- Terrible mattress. Really lumpy and uncomfortable. At one point I woke up because there was a lump under my back in the middle of the mattress. I got up and took the sheet off to see what it was. It was the plug for the electric blanket. So I pulled it off so I wouldn't have the lump on my back only to find a huge blood stain on the old and disgusting mattress. Needless to say I didn't go back to bed.

title: Ghastly Grosvenor
text: Booked a room 6 weeks prior to arriving for a wedding, arrived to find NO booking and a young women who swore at me and told me to leave not so much in those words either,  absolutely appalling people, would never recommend and would never attempt another booking, these people should learn to speak English properly and learn NOT TO SWEAR AT PEOPLE.

title: Grotty Grosvenor
text:
A night in the Grosvenor Motor Inn was possibly the worst spent in our 35 years of Moteling. From the Outside and on the website it looks appealing but we should have been warned by an abandoned supermarket trolley and cigarette butts in the newspaper holder by the door of our suite. Upon entering we saw tattered and venetians which fell apart even more on being touched. The bedding was sparse with only one pillow each and no extra blankets. Although the room was spacious,the decor was shabby and outdated. There was a large spa bath, plenty of hot water with good pressure but sadly all the taps were leaking and had obviously damaged the surrounds and flooring. The windows were seized open to let the steam out, but unfortunately let the constant traffic noise in. The motel was 10 metres from a bus stop and we had to listen to foul language, breaking bottles etc due to being unable to close the windows!!
Never again... and it put us off wanting to stay in Hamilton again.

title: Very average
text: Ok to just put your head down. Nothing flash at all very old fashion, paint peeling of the ceiling in bathroom, really poorly maintained such a shame, could be a very nice place if had some TLC. Good location wouldn't want to stay there any more then a night tho.

title: Run down but okay for a night
text: On arrival I realised i had stayed here before a couple of years ago, so as it was pretty dismal back then I felt disappointed I had booked here again! But our room was clean, very run down though, and the beds are VERY old soft spring beds. The staff were helpful and nice, it would have been a great place in its heyday 40 odd years ago, and now it just needs a complete makeover. It was very busy so we couldn't park close to our room. I like my comforts so wouldn't stay here again, but its the cheapest in town so it did for the night. It was easy to find and close to town.

title: Ok for an overnight................
text:
This motor lodge is run down and although the unit we had was clean, but was very poorly maintained. The bed linen was very well worn, one very old woolen blanket on the bed, the towels good but the bath mat was very tatty and ready to be used as a rag. This is an establishment that does not provide a face flannel for each of its guests. We asked for a second one, got it but when the room was serviced only one was left. The toilet leaked due to not being secured to the floor and the maintance man just put more silicone around the base ( not solving the problem) when we complained. The sliding bathroom door  was off its rail but was fixed after we complained.
The grounds are totally unkempt, the gardens just a mass of weeds, and there was rubbish and dead leaves all around the fencelines.
In the drawer in the unit were details of facilities available- like the restaurant, its breakfast and dinner menues, the newspaper availability, the pools hours.  SHAME.. The restaurant was not open in the evenings, the pool no longer supplies pool towels (the was a request not to take the room towels to the pool).   Newspapers are no longer available.
  All in all a great shame as it could be a very good place to stay
The one good thing was that there was plenty of parking.

title: Short and Sweet Stay
text: Great location, close to the city and attractions. Safe area. I was a bit nervous heading over to Grosvenor Motor Inn as recent reviews were not the best, but my friends and I were fine with our stay. The rooms are a decent size, and facilities are decent. Our only issue was the bed sheets did have stains and were not changed throughout our three day stay. If you are of high maintenance. you should look elsewhere, otherwise we were happy with our stay.

title: Difficult situation
text: It would appear that the front of this motel is used for long term rental purposes. Our motel was in the midst of this and witnessed outside our door a domestic incident that left us feeling unsafe for the night. A request was made for alternative accommodation and were placed at the back. This was clean, spa pool worked, quiet and we had a good nights sleep. I left my pillow there and managed assured me that it would be couriered to me. I hope that this happens. The staff are friendly but perhaps the situation is outside their expertise.

title: Gone downhill big time
text: We stayed here for a night (myself, wife and 2 year old) on our way north. Having stayed there before, knew what to expect in terms of how dated everything was, but weren't prepared for how bad it had got. Chose our room due to spa bath - spa bath didn't work. Wife had to clean hairs and crud out of bath/shower before we could use it. Broken towel rail nearly caused at accident as my wife got into shower. Seemed like no maintenance had been done for a long time.

title: Cheap but bad
text:
The only positive thing I would say is that the staff were fine.

The shower was a fine mist.  Never seen a shower like it before.  Not really possible to use for showering.  Curtains let in much light.  Indoor heated pool was one very cold.  Colder than an unheated pool.

Much noise from other units.  Wifi stops working after about a minute, continously.

Everything is of lowest quality and also old.

Should have paid a bit more for something decent.

title: Used to be a fine place
text: Central location, used to have lots of families and trades people staying. Now a bit run down, half clean, just no value for money. Nice enough staff having a good time rather than focusing on hospitality.

title: Very dated motel
text: Location is good very close to pak n save supermarket.Unfortunately motel is very dated. External appearances not too bad but rooms need major refurbishment. Carpets are old,stained and dirty. TOILETS SMELL! Overall not too pleasant.Will not stay here again!!

title: Not the place if you're wanting to impress and out of town visitor
text: Staff on reception were very helpful, late check out was a great option, breakfast was a reasonable standard, BUT the room dated back to the 70's and it stank of cigarette smoke, even after being aired out, the room servicing was really poor.  It was definitely over priced for what it offered, but did enjoy the soak in a bath.

title: Place to stay
text:
We spent one night at this motel and we found the room on the lower level near the office to be of a good standard with all the things we needed to be comfortable for the night.
We were able to access the Internet when we first arrived, but the next morning we were not able to connect.  We heard no other noise from other guests even tho it appeared to be very full.  The staff we met were helpful and thoughtful to us.

title: Very poor experience
text: We stayed at this motel last year and we totally satisfied.  Rebooked again this year but what a disappointment. We arrived at 6.30pm for a 3 night stay with two studio units booked. I had asked for ground floor but we were given first floor units. We wanted to have showers before going out to dinner. Neither unit had towels. Rang reception and were told they were still in the dryer and they would bring shortly. They did arrive about 20  minutes later. We had a table booked for dinner and were late.  The next morning we had to be out early. Tea and coffee making facilities are offered on the website but no milk in the fridge. Had to wait over an hour for reception to open where I was told we should have requested milk when we checked in. Sorry but you are a hospitality industry - you should have offered it!  On the third day we returned home to take a quick shower and go out again. 5pm and again no towels. They said in drying and would bring in 5 minutes. My daugher got in shower but still no towels and eventually I went to reception. I felt like I was being totally unreasonable asking for towels. If you have not got enough towels to put fresh in the units by your check in time of 2pm then buy some more!! Ironing facilities are supposed to be available - yes their was an ironing board but bare metal with no padding or cover on it. Plugged the iron into the socket (one of two which had a heater and fan plugged in) but neither power point worked.  Tried a third one and on the fourth attempt find one that actually worked.  Hairdryers were also available but did not work. Would not recommend this place and will not go back next year when we return for the same event.

title: Amazing for Price
text: I had a spontaneous get out of town moment. the room was spacious and welcoming. good value for money. Very handy and location was easy. Had a heated pool and friendly staff. Would definitely stay again

title: Dirty, useless service, terrible place to stay
text:
i rented the spa room.
the room itself was dirty with many faults.
the bathroom walls were filthy, there were no towels, handtowels or anything in the room on arrival, no soap in the dispender. I had to move the heater because the power point didnt work. The hand rail in the bathroom, fell as i put towel on.
I had to go and ask for towels, the indoor poo. had no towels, alcohol cans and smoke butts laying around. It was very noisy. The staff were very unprofessional, all around, very disapointing. if your looking for a nice place same cost with a nicer spa and room try the lakepoint motel hamilton. much better.

title: Upgrade long overdue.
text: There was a noisy intercom speaker up on the wall that buzzed and/or hummed on and off all night, keeping us awake. Peeling paint on the window sills in the bathroom and toilet, lifting wallpaper in the toilet, the sides of the spa bath looked in danger of falling apart at any time, the lino was lifting in the bathroom.

title: Good deal for price/ Only one problem
text: Motel staff were friendly. Good reception hours (they were open until 9.30pm). Room was good for the price you pay. Clean bed sheets, tidy room. Some wallpaper was ripped in the bathroom but not too bad.Wifi & sky were good. Was able to watch youtube videos on the wifi with no buffering problems.Only problem was that the rooms weren't fully sound proof and you could hear people outside and cars in the carpark. I think it is a good room for $89.

title: Upgrade needed
text: Really disappointing. Seriously in need of an upgrade. Peeling wall paper. Mouldy blind in bath room. Stained and chipped bathroom hand basin Found A window had been left open all day after house keeping had been in. Thankfully a short stay. Won't be back.

title: nothing
text: room was not clean, sheets hadn't been changed, covered in ants, next room spa and leaked water into our room, very noisy and damp, had to ask for extra towels and milk, when discussing issues with receptionist she was getting angry will never stay there again.

title: Never again
text: Sheets had hair and dirt marks over them . Curtains ripped . Dirty cook ware no sharp knife . Shower broken had to hold nozzle to shower . Got a extra towel to roll up as door had a draft coming under . I have never made such a bad review please look around before booking this hotel . I don't even want to give 1 star

title: Extremely disappointing
text:
Probably the worst motel I have ever stayed at, and I do a lot of travelling around the country. Very run down, dirty and untidy, hair on the sheets, wall paper peeling of the walls and the list goes on. 
The wifi was free but did not work.
Would of been better off someone else with the money I had spent.

title: Mrs Hitchcock
text: Bitterly disappointed. Stayed here for one night over fieldays. Payed through the nose $380 for the night. The room was small, run down, cold and drab. Only had a fan heater. Booked a king bed but got a small double. Spa bath old and filled the entire unit with steam when running. Unit noisey from outside voices. Our booking sheet stated check out time 12pm, however got a call at 10.30 from office to say checkout was 10am due to fieldays - not happy!

title: Not happy with after hours service
text: We arrived from overseas, due to being delayed we rang at 930pm but had no answer. We continued to drive there and when we arrived we tried to ring several times with no answer. This was just after 10pm on a thursday night. We had to go and find another motel to stay in. The next morning i went over to find out what had happened, there was no aplolgy so i asked for them to cancel the rest of our nights. They did cancel at no charge to us. We ended up at the BK setllers motor inn accross the road.

title: Extremely Run Down
text: My company had no choice but to book accommodation here for me during a very busy time in Hamilton.  If I could go anywhere else I would.  This is very disappointing and shabby and hugely over priced.  The restaurant was closed so I was unable to get any meals.  The receptionist at the time of my checking in was refusing to give another poor unfortunate guest any more tea, coffee or hot chocolate.  And the price my company paid for my stay was hundreds of dollars for a two night stay.  With one night costing $398.00

title: Run down
text: We had previously stayed here a couple of years ago and it was good but now the room we had was run down - curtains ripped, and didn't cover the Windows, bedspread and towels either ripped or shabby, but the worst was the shower which worked just but had a broken shower head that dropped so it sprayed back into the wall it was mounted on. This place is really over priced in its current state and definitely needs a lot of maintenance done.

title: Very disapointing
text:
Were a party of   3 adults , 2 children and a baby . Found this unit 26 had grubby couch/ blankets and duvets unwashed ( hairs were found on blanket) hideous mould and broken wooden skirtings in toilet/filthy kitchen/ no milk on arrival/no remote for TV/black marks over most of the walls.
For $200 for the night this was the worst place we have been to.
Will not ever be going back.

title: Very pleasant stay
text: A very nice room, comfortable bed, good furnishings, perfectly clean, nice bathroom with huge bath tub. The owners were very friendly, helpful and welcoming. The motel is built around a sort of courtyard, with rooms in the attractive black and white timber framed building. Easy to find just off the main road, not far to walk into town and supermarket just on the corner. Would definitely come back here again.

title: Leisure
text: The room was very basic, wet room for shower which meant water not draining properly, so water all over floor. Linen clean but bedspreads needed a good wash, Full parking available, but if you want peace and quiet dont get front rooms as you get a lot of road noise, otherwise for short visit ok. The room was a studio which meant no cooking facilities, just microwave.

title: Good location
text: Put up a night here in the studio with spa bath. The room is spacious and very clean. Good shower, but the bathroom is a bit leaking. Full facilities with microwave, electric kettle, fridge, hair dryer and fast free internet. Comfortable bed and good lighting. Supermarket is also nearby, really easy to get around. And most of all, their staff are also very friendly.

title: Smell
text: Just an over-nighter...was shocked by the smell in the room, must have been the cleaning liquid but such an awful fragrance....what a choice though. There was a pool as well, which did not have any sign on when it was last cleaned...Oh and there was a trail of ants near the tea/coffee tray....

title: Crap
text:
This is the worst place I have ever stayed.
Dirty nappy under the bed.
Major water leak in bath.
Wet toilet paper over heat sensors.
Uninterested staff.
Very noisy.
I would not recomend this place to anyone.

title: Has seen better days
text:
Stayed for one night in a studio unit.  Reception at check in whilst not unfriendly, was somewhat mechanical.  Queen sized bed was comfortable enough, but overall appearance of the unit was tired.  There were tea making facilities and a microwave, but no cutlery or crockery for meals.  Cups were on a high shelf which a person of short stature would have had  difficultly in reaching.   There was a ceiling fan, but no heater.  A small bedside table between the bed and the ensuite wall would have been welcome.
   No tissues were provided in the ensuite.  The shower is over a triangular spa bath.
   There is an attached restaurant, which was poorly patronised.   There was only one woman on duty, and she was literally chief cook and bottlewasher plus waitress as well.  We were told to find our own table, and pick up the menu (printed on an A4 sheet of paper) from a stand at the entrance.  Surprisingly, the meal , while not pretentious, was well cooked and adequate.  We felt though that had several groups of diners all arrived at once, some of them would have had a long wait for their meal.
   Breakfast was pretty much self help for a Continental.  Again there was only one woman doing everything, so we decided not to have the  cooked option.
   We stayed at six motels on our short holiday around the North Island.   This would be the worst and the tariff was only $5 cheaper than the one in Wanganui we assessed as being the best

title: Horrible in the inside!!
text: I stayed here with my mother and aunt for 2 nights! We arrived at 6pm and our room wasn't ready even though we said we'd be there earlier!... Once we got in the room it was horrible! There was dirt on the floor and in the corners were wrappers from previous guests! One of the beds wasn't even made she had to go and get bed Lenin! There was hair on my pillow case when I went to go to sit down! The bathroom came off its hinges and never closes properly! There was also spider webs all over the walls and the paint was peeling from everywhere! The bath and shower was just disgusting!!The Windows didn't lock and anyone could get in! There was no staff ever in the "restaurant" and the pool had bugs in it!! I must admit the staff were nice but seriously this place is a horror story!!

title: Attractive architecture on a busy & noisy thoroughfare.
text: Interesting Tudor-like architecture on a busy & noisy street.  Some of the rooms facing the street have a good deal of road noise.  Staff were welcoming on arrival but owing to Enghish proficiency, could not assist with local tourist information.  The staff apologized for the slow Wifi adding that repairs have been underway for 'several' months.  Rooms were clean but some of the furniture is showing its years.  Good price, though.

title: The worst motel experience ever.
text:
The unit was very dated and had not been cleaned properly - lots of crumbs under the table. The settee was well worn and had holes in it and not at all comfortable to sit on.  The taps in the bathroom were shabby and dripped constantly.
There was a hole in the wall where a door handle had obviously gone throughl.  The décor was drab and was not a relaxing colour.
The pool was not inviting and smelled strongly of chlorine before you even entered the building.  A never visit again Motel

title: *Shudder*
text: Room was filthy and dated. Carpet not vacuumed, mould on curtains, sheets so worn that the mattress is visible through them, toilet door jammed shut, bed smells musty... PLEASE STAY SOMEWHERE ELSE!!!!

title: Dreadful motel.
text: We booked in to this motel as we were looking for one that had a restaurant on site. The family unit we were given was very dated & although it was clean & didn't smell, it was in great need of some attention. The beds were very uncomfortable, the curtains old & ripped, the shower pressure was almost non-existent (& had a cockroach join me in the shower). Generally very shabby & not reflected in the tariff. We decided to go to the restaurant for dinner with our children. To cut a long story short-the worst service & food to match. Do not stay at this motel unless you have no choice! No smiles at this motel 😞

title: No smiles here
text: A smile costs so little but was obviously more than the owners/managers/staff here could manage.  Just a smile and some communication would have made such a difference when everything else was already falling apart. Dirty sheets, items left behind from previous occupants, a shower both tiny and dirty, not enough coffee mugs (but luckily enough wine glasses), only one key, holes in the door (that's what the stickers are covering) and a cockroach to top things off.  I fear, looking back at some of the early positive reviews, that something has happened and things are now going horribly wrong here.  The only positive I can find is that it was handy to supermarket, middle of town and stadium.

title: Dirty and Disgusting
text: I have no idea how this motel is able to pass an inspection!! The shower was filthy with mould, there was a pair of trousers under the bed from the previous occupant and no one had vacuumed under there for months! The freezer hadn't been cleaned for months. The carpet was shabby to say the least as are the curtains! The sofa bed still had the sheets on it from the previous occupant but a clean set had been thrown in for the next customer to put on! The bed it's self was more like a torture rack! The mattress on it only a few inches thick! When I complained they did give me a roll away bed but it wasn't that much better but it was clean! We only had contact with one staff member and she obviously wasn't happy in her job! She did offer a $ 20.00 refund when I complained but I couldn't be bothered going back to the office to collect it! Motel of Horrors!

title: RUDE RUDE RUDE - Smiles are free
text: Booked to stay here because my block course was here and i am very disappointed with my stay as when I first arrived looking for where I was meant to go there was a lady standing in the driveway waiting for cars waving them down to park somewhere else, then I asked do you know where the block course is the lady did not smile and snapped at me which then I was not happy with the way she spoke to me. Then after course had finished I went to book into my room to another RUDE lady who tried to charge me more than what they told me, I then asked about dinner and if I could take it back to my room when I was told it would be an extra $2.50 even if I went and collected it, I took it back to my room and when I finished I took the plate back to the lady rolling her eyes at me LIKE SERIOUS what the hell. Next morning I went to check out and take key back and another lady sitting at the desk looks at me after I said good morning her reply was "YES" again very rude could of said good morning .... and then ask if I enjoyed my stay.... Then I got up to the block course when my tutor told us there was no toilet paper and the lady told them we had to wait till 9am like seriously I have never had this experience ever and made me very angry and disappointed that 3 different staff were very rude

title: Just terrible
text: Had 2 nights here. We would have left immediately but we'd paid in advance. We bought a special on line and was soooooo disappointed. Where to start! Noisy, smelt, very poor repair, drawers without handle, hole in door, totally sub standard bathroom. The only thing that was ok was the bed. Never again. Wish we'd checked Trip Advisor.

title: Three night stay
text: Average accommodation.  Some rooms better than others. No note pad or pens. Only one little oil heater. Wallpaper falling off the wall. Poor lighting. Average stay for average price. In need of an upgrade. Front units had road noise but rear ones were quiet.

title: Hamilton stay
text: Booked this Motel because it offered restaurant and pool Took my mum and one granddaughter to Hamilton for 4 days Thursday to sunday . Arrived to unwelcoming staff at check in directed to our unit and found unit was not very clean very tired looking unit needs an update cleaning not the best as granddaughter picked up a lost earing not from us . Decided the first night to go to the restaurant only to find it closed checked with reception as to why it was advertised but not open and was told she was the only person there and could not operate reception and restaurant .Reception person indicated that they would have the restaurant open the next night we arrived at the restaurant Friday night to be told that they did cater for children I reviewed the menu and found a meal that was quite adequate for my granddaughter . then decided to order 2 glasses of wine for myself and my mother to have with our meal  was told the fridge was not working and they said they could not do a glass only we would have to buy a bottle Service at the restaurant was lacking and we were the only people there. Overall not a great experience and would not recommend or go back to this place

title: Beyond disappointed.
text: One night and one night too many.  I regret to say the one and only positive aspect of the overnight stay was the lovely young lady at the reception at check in.  The carpet was dark and yet you could still see it was riddled with uncleaned patches or stains whichever is applicable.  There were cobwebs in the main area, dark head hair on the sheets and the wardrobe just stunk of staleness & mustiness.  The bathroom vent was sellotaped into the bathroom window, the window sill rotting, cracks in the sink and cracks in the spa bath/shower.  Wallpaper peeling off walls and things just obviously run down and/or needing fixing.  The heating was a very loud little plug in fan heater plug.  Returning after dinner with my little girl and I was lucky there was literally one remaining carpark across the other side of the driveway entrance from our room.  There was party rowdiness outside till a silly hour.  Because of the state of the facilities and the overall experience, I opted to pass on the breakfast that came with the booking.  And finally checked out at reception to an unfriendly, abrupt and dismissive lady.  The experience is one I do not want to ever experience again.

title: Not good enough
text:
Room was not good enough. In dire need of an upgrade, wallpaper hanging off the walls, cigarette burns in the basin, bath leaked so mouldy skirting boards. But most of all the room had large dirty grease marks on the carpet from the doorway, half way across the room. It look so gross that you didn't want to walk over it. I think any other motel would have closed this room and layed new carpet at the very least.  Sheets on the bed were not crisp and white like they should have been, overall the whole place felt dirty. We stayed there after attending a funeral, arrived quite late so couldn't leave as the reception had closed.  At check out we were reminded that we had been upgraded at no extra cost.  My goodness I would hate to think what the other room was like.  This motel used to be tops, it looks good from the road, such a shame that it is certainly not up to a decent standard.
We would never stay there again and wouldn't recommend anyone else to either.  By all accounts we are not the only ones writing a damming review.

title: Dated, unclean and uncared for.
text:
We stayed here about five years ago and had a great experience so we re-booked assuming it would be the same... well, you know what they say about assumption.

The entire complex is dated and if that were the only factor, I could get over it. But it wasn't the dated decor or in-wall radios with crackling speakers that didn't work that was the problem. Shall we start with the hair in the bed?

Tip #1 - check the sheets
Upon getting ready to bed down for an afternoon nap, I pulled back the sheets to see a long black hair on the sheet. Thinking surely this fell out when the cleaner was doing her thing, I pulled the sheet further back to notice that it was actually unclean and there was more hair. I called reception who promptly sent a gruff woman up to change the sheets. She was not apologetic and the half-assed effort made to change the sheets made it plainly obvious that not a lot of care went in to the upkeep of the place when guests weren't around either.

Tip #2 - pull the bed away from the wall before you sleep
The walls have clearly not been cleaned in many years. There were marks all over them and I'm not talking pencil... but brown dirt stains from people leaning their greasy hair on them and other unmentionables. The curtains were in a similar state - yellow from colour or fade who would know. But when pulled shut in the daytime with the sun shining through from outside, the stains were evident. Not nice.

Tip #3 - don't lose anything under the beds
I'm guessing the last time the floor under the beds were vacuumed was in 1978 as there was a stale old cracker under there and a whole lot of dirt, not just dust... When we pulled one of the beds out from the wall there was no mistaking the fact that cleaning under things was not high on the priority list.

The shower head's holder was broken, the TV was on the fritz and the small oil heater didn't really cut through the July cold, the beds and pillows were old, stained and lumpy. The pool was so full of chlorine probably from not being cleaned properly that it was murky and the bottom could not be seen.

On the plus side:
The cutlery, plates and glasses were clean. 

We were just really disappointed. We should have asked for a refund and left but had a toddler and had settled him into the room already. We don't get much time off and had been excited but that soon turned to disappointment.

I would not recommend anyone to this place unless I knew it had undergone a major overhaul. When we checked out, even after spending $320 there, no one asked whether we enjoyed our stay... 

To the owners, I would recommend some immediate fixes: a commercial clean, a professional repaint of the rooms, go bargain hunting for better quality beds and pillows (even if second hand). Use a linen service because threadbare in winter isn't cosy. I realise just those few things would cost a packet, but it would be worth it in the long run. Then you could gradually work on other matters. Getting an independent reviewer in wouldn't hurt either. They could make a priority list for you of what you can work on to improve. Why be sub-standard when you can be excellent? Especially when you have a prime location and otherwise attractive (from the road) business. Good luck.

title: Unpleasant
text:
Stayed for two nights during queens birthday weekend.

ROOM DIRTY The ceiling fan was hanging from wire, the cover had come apart from the top. When i went to turn it on, it was turning uneven. I reported it to the office as i was worried because my childs bed was under the fan. The response I got from the lady was yes we know its safe.. Did not look safe at all.  I opened the window facing the main road and the screws came out.

ROOM CLEANED DAILY - WHAT A JOKE!! We left room at 8am, returned at 3pm. Room was not cleaned. I had to Go looking for clean towels. Instead of someone collecting the towels I had to get dirty towels to take to a bag that was left in the midldle of footpath outside the rooms. I also had to hunt down plates and cutlery. 

BATHROOM DIRTY - mouldy dirt around the window. Toilet looked like someone had just finished using it before we entered the room, the bottom inside of the toilet was dirty.

POOL IS UNSAFE A young girl had cut the bottom of her foot in the POOL, a huge amount of blood was in the pool and obviously as she got out she bled on the floor. Once again reported it to the office. The response was... "We not going to do anything about it, customers will not be happy if we close it" the lady on duty didnt even bother to clean or look at the pool. There was hair clogging the fitler and was visual to the eye. I was told by a friend the same thing happen to her son last year in the same spot.. THEY OBVIOUSLY HAVENT DONE ANYTHING TO SOLVE THE ISSUE ABOUT THE BOTTOM  OF THE POOL. 

I will be contacting the hotel association and the district council.

title: Girls Night Away
text: A couple of old girls away for a night. We chose this place because of its location and price. It was okay. It is tired but it was clean and had everything we needed. Breakfast was fresh and the lady looked after us well.

title: Appalling!!!!!!!!!!
text: Hello Just an update on a shambles and a disgrace to have a motel like this on Expedia. The Grosvenor Motor Inn Hamilton New Zealand First off the owners do not speak English. Have to use a staff member to interrupt when we discussed problems. Arrived to be given an invoice for $75.00 Paid Expedia $89.00. Arrive in room, visit toilet to find wall of live ants. Next no lights on wall beside bed. Next the heater not working. Seek assistance from Asian staff member, who tried and was helpful. Unfortunately not her boss. Fly spray for ants, and gave up her and only portable heater for night.. Went out for evening to arrive back at room with another wall of ants in bathroom and lounge wall. Went to lift and change my pillow to find baby cockroach. Behind door to bathroom was also large spider’s web with ants in. All in photos attached. State of the room was old with aged and ripped wall paper Rang room service at 10.00pm to explain and was told I could go and find another motel if not happy. A bit bloody late at this stage. Next morning went for full breakfast as included in Expedia voucher and was told only continental. The cook went to owner who was not happy via interrupter about Expedia saying full breakfast. Mumbled about Expedia pricing and amount of commission etc. Did order breakfast, Bacon & eggs with Hashbrowns @ $4.00 extra. Got one hashbrown. Was not the only one complaining about breakfast. Told owner about room problems and that I will be posting to you and on facebook about state of motel. Did not seem to be bothered as no apologies etc given. It was tough luck as motel was fully booked. I have used Expedia many times along with Wotif and this is the worst experience I have ever had. We have a holiday booked at The Adina Apartments Sydney next week from the 21st May so hoping to experience a lot better. I would on their attitude to customer relations remove The Grosvenor Motor Inn from your site as do not wish other people to experience the same. Their attitude to posting on social media did not faze the owner at all. Unfortunately this is one of the worst experiences I have had with booking on Expedia and it spoilt a somewhat great weekend away. Kind regards Ian Gane Booking Ref 10146 Date 16/17-05-2015

title: Low Budget but Okay
text:
From the outside this hotel looks like the nicest one on the street. The Tudor style building is a lovely touch, parking is free and easy, and it is very close to shops. We paid $99 for the one night though it is true you get what you pay for.  

The free WiFi was a huge bonus, it worked well and reasonabley fast on our mobile phones.  The TV was large, and the spa bath worked well and wasn't as bad as the other reviews on here state. The indoor pool was a nice temperature and and great size but there were no towels, and the ones from our room were miniscule. 

We had a quiet sleep in and a comfy bed, and the late checkout at 12pm was what made us chose this motel over the others, a very welcome detail. 

Our non-smoking room smelt very strongly of cigarette smoke. There was no way we would have stayed another night in this room smelling so badly. 

We had dinner at the restaurant and although tasty there wasn't a lot of options, it was very pricey, and my 'well done' steak was blue raw. 

Overall it was an okay stay but there is room for improvement.

title: Worst I have Stayed At
text:
I have stayed at various motels in my time going from backpackers through to high end and this has to be worst of all. This was on special at WOTIF for $99 per night, I paid a little extra to get cooked breakfasts every  morning - $125. When I got there they had no compendium to tell me where things were so I went looking and found rubbish I two of the draws I looked in.  The toilet buttons were broken. We found the swimming pool which had been a draw card and my son said Yuck I am not swimming in there it is dirty.

Breakfast next morning was horrible staff in restaurant were anything but friendly and they told me I could only have a $10 breakfast, what a rip off see price paid above. Next morning was worse had ordered breakfast as restaurant didn't open until 7.30am. My son paid an extra $4.00 for a bigger breakfast which equated to one hash brown. There was no where for us to sit as there was already a big group eating breakfast.

Do not stay here a backpackers would be better in cleanliness, repairing appliances and most definitely customer service.

title: DO NOT STAY HERE
text: This is Not an establishment that I would recommend to anybody. The rooms are dated and worn, (the photos they use in advertising must be extremely old) , basic fixtures struggle to work and/or don't work, towels are small and worn, and the room smelt of mould and damp.  However it was the customer service that I found the most disturbing.  They were rude, blunt and were clearly in need of attending some formal training in customer service.  They were unwilling to admit there error when handling our booking, and were flippant, hostile and extremely unhelpful.  When you combine all these factors together, Grosvenor Motor Inn is by far thee WORST establishment in Hamilton, hands down.

title: Needs Up Date
text: Cheap Room sort of clean Needs a big do up Fixtures like taps old they look as old as the Motel Bed base had very bad stains on it Went to use sissors from draw in kitchen they wouldn't cut open a plastic bag of sugar Wifi connection very weak in room couldn't use after 10pm Fridge leaking and very noisy  Would not stay again

title: Not attuned to market standards
text:
A good motel site (probably due to early acquisition). Handy to bus and CBD shuttle stops and a supermarket. Tariff probably reflected dated room. Some guests appeared to be enjoying heated swimming pool.

Free late check out until 2pm was included on my reservation confirmation and I planned accordingly. At about 12pm a person was telling me I had not negotiated late check out and to vacate within 15 minutes. This was done in a most blunt, rude and impatient manner and I was not able to comply. The linen and towels (small size) were old and worn and the television set was antiquated. A spa tub was installed in the room which I did not use.

Not all of the staff were rude.

title: Great pool and service
text:
We stayed in a room with double bed and another bedroom with 2 singles, nice place the shower door could have used some TLC. there was sky movies and sports in out
Room, towels replaced everyday ect ect. The big indoor pool is heated more like a spa, there is wifi but our connection in room was very weak so could bearly use

title: was OK
text: it's an old motor inn, everything was just ok. i wouldn't say it's very clean but for the money we paid i can't really complain. We wasn't planning to stay here so frankly speaking this was the worst place we stayed throughout our trip in NZ. For those seeking a "good" budget accommodation this is going to disappoint you. But for the others who just wants to pay super cheap and still get to stay in a motor inn, this may be your place to stay.

title: Budget hotel, needs updating
text:
We stayed here for three nights.   The staff were all friendly and helpful, happy to open the restaurant for us if we wanted to eat, too tired on this occasion so we didn't take them up on it, although it is a good menu and very reasonably priced.
I will only be negative as I am assuming they are working there way around the rooms and updating them so people won't be put off coming to this motel, ask for an updated room and look first.  Our room was number 11, very tired but clean.  We didn't use the ceiling fan as it looked like it was about to fall off and also very noisy.  Good sized fridge and not too noisy.  The mattress was very soft so not a brilliant nights sleep.  This is a budget hotel so you get what you pay for.
Great to have a swimming pool, just big enough to swim after a long day.
You may prefer to stay in upstairs room as it can be quite noisy with children/young people (we had a mini bus full of well behaved teenagers staying at the same time as us) running around above you, only during day, they were quiet at night and considering location on main road the motel is very quiet.
Would like to come back to this motel but would check for updated rooms and beds.

title: Disappointed
text: Stayed one night and definitely would not recommend this place. We arrived later in the evening and were too tired to look for another place to stay. The only good thing I can say is that the staff were friendly and helpful. Room smelled musty and the ceiling fan was too noisy to use and we suffered a hot sticky night sleepless night. The refrigerator was very noisy as well. We felt we had stepped back into the seventies with the faded decor, peeling wallpaper and paint.

title: Not a 5 star for a budget price $85
text: Booked on booked.com, for specials. Great competitive price $85. Room we got was below average. Tired looking. If the competiveness is to get people in, I'm afraid I wouldn't come here again. I am prepared to pay good price but willing to check special deals through Booked.Com. Some obvious things were,light bulbs not working, slide door into bathroom not sliding,you have to manually move it as it jams along the slide, sheets looked tired. No spare pillows, ceiling van was so noisy, spa didn't look inviting at all. Bed was lovely and soft for me so that's a bonus, a lovely sleep.

title: For the price
text: Im a regular visitor to Hamilton for work have stayed at a few places and have to say this place ticks most of the right boxes yes some things are a little tired but if you want good honest affordable accomadation  and a nice warm pool good showers wholesome food for a very reasonable price then this place is for you. But if your a stuck up toff and expect 5 star accomadation for a cheap rate you WILL be disappointed if you want 5 star go to the Hilton if you don't the Grosvenor is more than fine

title: Aweful donot go there
text: We were there less than 2hrs while I hunted for other accommodation I have never seen a room so dirty I didn't want to touch anything.The only positive thing was they refunded all our money except deposit straight away and we booked into motel next door who lucky for us had a cancellation.

title: Gross-venor
