text: UUUUGGHHHH! one word to describe this place! Friend and I were looking for a cheap place to stay for a night whilst travelling through Hamilton. Greeted by a lady at the desk who offered us a spa studio for $100. good deal we thought. Entered the room and was highly disappointed. Room smelt funny, looked very tired. Spa was broken and looked as though there would be a good chance you could catch something if you hopped in. Toilet was broken. Mould was also growing on different parts of the bathroom and the window was cracked. We were so unhappy we asked for our money back and went elsewhere, the only positive is that they were happy to give us our money back and didn't put up a fight, maybe there used to it?

title: nightmare on ulster street
text:
booked this hotel for location ,reasonable price and amenities,,,WRONG!
3light bulbs out in unit including one above vanity,heater not working,only1 electric blanket half of bed was warm other half stone cold,ceiling did not work,cobwebs on light fixtures,booked a room with a jetted spa tub,NO! Tub got a handicap shower,there was no curtain for front door that has a glass window where the outside light shines through all night,refrigerator had a sign on it saying if it is to loud please turn off from inside. this room looked like something from the 70's that has never been kept up.the desk clerk lost all knowledge and english when i brought this to their attention.no heated pool ! under construction. no free dinner,no free breakfast as what was booked,if their restaurant is anything like their rooms i feel very lucky.  you just cant make this stuff  up,just say no and go somewhere else.

title: In need of some TLC
text: I booked this motel as it was reasonably priced for myself and 2 teenage sons and was within walking distance of the venue we were going to that night.  I also liked the sound of the heated indoor pool.  For the price we paid I don't think we really got value for money.  The room was clean but very dated.  The jug didn't work unless you held the button down for the entirety of the boil time required, there was no soap in the dispenser above the bathroom sink and the spa bath looked like it needed to go to bath heaven.  The pool area wasn't that appealing and its outdoor entrance area which was set up like a mini pavilion was really shabby.  There appears to be permanent residents also living at the motel and they were pretty noisy by 7am on the Sunday morning.  They also had a little social area set up on the lower level with broken outdoor chairs and overflowing ashtray on the table.  There is a lot of competition with many motels in very close proximity so I'm sure having permanent residence helps cover costs - it's important however that this presence doesn't detract from the main purpose of the business. The positive is that this property has many options from studio to 2 bedroom units which can sleep up to 5 and their rates are pretty competitive compared to other properties nearby that can accommodation that number of people (not many can).

title: Needs a good spring clean
text:
I wish I had read the reviews before doing a last minute booking at Grosvernor.
The good bits. Its close to the supermarket.
The bad bits
The carpets had so many stains I wasnt sure if it was part of the pattern or just ingrained stains (it was the latter)
The bathroom has mold stains on the walls and the bathroom was so damp there was mold on windows/corner of window pain/on the windows/ceiling.
The places needs a darn GOOD clean.
We booked for 3 people and got only 2 towels.
Its the small things that make a stay nice...Enough towels for guest and CLEAN the rooms they are staying in.
We stayed in a floor room which was a mistake as you could hear all the bangs and crashes from the room above.
Headboard on single bed was loose and continuously banged against the wall with every movement so we has to drape the tea towel over to stop this.

title: Pyjamarama
text:
The list of issues is quite long but you have to start somewhere.
1. Linen on beds did not look fresh.  Tell-tale wrinkles on the sheets.  
2.3 guests booked - 2 towels supplied. 
3. Sliding door to bathroom - jammed regularly - could trap you if you were on your own
4. Wallpaper peeling, Rooms very tired
5.Arrived about 10pm and greeted by Lodge staff in pyjamas.  lol
6 Room needed a good clean, bathroom especially.
7 Don't pay extra for spa-bath, very dated and needs disinfecting
8 No extra pillows 
9 Power points for electric blankets in weird places
1 good thing - TV has a USB port

title: Perfectly adequate
text:
2 nights at the Grosvenor while at an Expo in Hamilton. 
- Location was good and central. 
- The shower pressure was AMAZING and the spa bath was lovely. 
- The pool wasn't hot enough to entice me in during winter. 
- The front desk was helpful but very flustered and busy. 
- Breakfast in the restaurant was nice.

title: Staying in Tudor Style Relaxation in Thumbs Up Hamilton by Captain Rick
text: I booked 4 Nights stay at the Grosvenor recently to attend my sons National Swimming Meet, that occupied my time mornings and evenings each day. This Motor Inn is perfect for this type of required accommodation, the staff were friendly, service housekeeping timely and efficient, and due to maintenance of signage improvements, I would have expected disruption and a lessening of parking facilities, however their were none with two Coach Buses and all patrons able to park within easy walking distance to rooms which were pleasantly spacious and in keeping with the Tudor ambience overall presentation. The pool had a tropical feel with a well balanced indoor and open outdoor setting to relax in after daily activities, I highly recommend a short or longer term stay at The Grosvenor as a great base to check out the awesome sights and sounds of Hamilton NZ

title: Average stay
text: Stay was adequate at best, the room was dated and boring. The service at the front desk was borderline rude. Neither friendly nor polite, I think a smile might have cracked manageress face. The pool had seen better days. It was however clean and the shower had amazing water pressure.

title: Great staff, ideal room, handy location
text: After being offered a single room with share facilities for $80 a night 15 mins up the road at a pub in Huntly, I found this much better offer for the same price ... a really spacious room, with double bed, new large flat screen TV with USB port so I could watch my own stuff (Andromeda, for the record), one of the best showers ever, good Wi-Fi ($5 for 24 hours), work desk, and across the road from a supermarket. No microwave, but when I came back with a nuke and eat TV dinner, the receptionist was happy to do that for me in her room. For those who expect five star accommodation for $80, you'll probably whine about the few scratches on the bedside table. For those who don't have their heads up their ***** this is one of the best little motels I've stayed at. And Tudor design too! Nice. And did I mention great staff?

title: Great Value
text: Got a deal where I paid $70 & it was overall a good stay. Staff were great, room was clean, in room spa. Good example of a good old kiwi motor inn. Could do with a spruce up as everything was dated but it was clean :)

title: Stayed earlier in the year
text:
I had stayed here earlier in the year and had room at back of complex. Thought as a treat for partner and I would stay again. When checking in had to explain deal was through wotif a few times and it appeared they weren't very happy with this. This time the room was on roadside  so very very noisy.  Booked through wotif and when checking out tried to charge for breakfast which was part of the deal.  Not sure if there are new owners or ???  
Spa was fantastic.

title: Four good reasons to stay here
text: I've stayed here three times this year. The location is perfect. Close to supermarkets, restaurants, the city centre and The Base. The four things I appreciate most is free parking outside the door, the late check out of mid day, the consistent low rates, and the friendliness of the owners and staff. I've always found it to be a safe, comfortable and reliable venue. If I did have any issues, I've no doubt the owners would bend over backwards to rectify them. It's not The Ritz but you get what you pay for.

title: Great Location
text: We had a lovely stay at the Grosvenor motel which is close to all the amenities we required.  Walking distance to shops, Restaurants, supermarket and Waikato rugby stadium.  The heated pool was great for the kids to play in and costs of the room was very reasonable

title: So Old and Dated
text: We didn't have great expectations but we where so very disappointed.  The location is great and very close to town.  The room was clean but...  Everything in our room with the exception of the carpet seemed to have been there since the place was first built.  The bathroom had no ventilation so when you showered everything got damp, the floor, the mirrors, the loo.. even the windows in the room fogged up.  The bed was very old and soft, we had some serious roll together problems.  There was only one towel in the room but the reception desk was happy to give more.  We chose to eat breakfast in what was once the restaurant (they only to breakfast now).  It was great value but the dinning room was very musty smelling and there was what look like mold all over the ceiling.  This could have had something to do with the fact that the heated pool was right next door.  Over all the Grosvenor was very disappointing and it needs to have a lot of money spent on it to bring it up to spec.  We paid $110 for 3 people but to be quite honest it was only worth $80 at a push. Very sad.

title: No hot water
text: This is an older Hotel - that use to be at the top of her class. Sadly she is now rather tired looking.  The original price was heavily discounted - from $150 to $100 ( and it needed to be!). In the guide it was rated 4 star which is why we booked - sorry but it is not.  Staff were friendly and helpful.  Being given real milk a bonus. Flats screen TV in rooms  were good. The double bed was comfortable. However the rooms need a bit of work. Paint was starting to peel on the ceilings. The spa bath in 1 room was badly stained. Couldn't get wi fi connection ( were given a refund ). The worst was there was NO hot water for the shower or spa bath (since it is still winter - I was looking forward to a hot bath!!!) - I resorted to boiling  4 jugs of  water. We were given an explanation but no apology. The continental breakfast was very basic -  small selection of mini boxed cereal, sandwich bread for toast (please supply toast bread!!), 2 types of juice,  yoghurt , and sliced peaches (I have had much better).

title: We left within minutes!
text:
We stayed after finding a good online special at last minute.
Great hosts, went to our room and felt like we walked through a time machine. OLD rooms, spa bath had soap scum all through it and two lights didn't work. Went back to reception to ask for refund and the gentleman behind the counter wanted to take us to another room first. Followed him to another room and it pretty much was the same, he got angry and asked why we didn't like it I pointed at the spa and he started getting agressive saying "THATS NOT SOAP SCUM THATS CHIPPED PAINT!". He slammed the room door and stormed off to the reception where they gave us a refund whilst commenting that we were interupting their rugby game, was told that the sort of class we were after wouldnt be found in Hamilton... they were very wrong, maybe its time these owners step outside their own doorstep and investigate other hotels in the area?

The sign outside "We only look expensive" makes me laugh everytime I pass this now.

title: Cosy and quiet
text: Pleasantly surprised - room cosy, not huge, and bathroom facilities good - even had a spa bath! Very comfortable bed and although on a main road was incredibly quiet throughout the night. Indoor pool and restaurant available as well. No hesitation in recommending this as a stopover in Hamilton.

title: You get what you pay for.
text:
Very old and dated. Thank goodness we got twin beds as I doubt we could have slept on the double bed. You could have used it as a trampoline , it was that bouncy. The pillows were as thin as surfboards.
Had to turn off fridge as too noisy. Curtains theadbare. Room smelt of cigarettes and musty.
The outside security light finally turned off at 5am, so felt like lights on in room all night as glass in front door. 
Couldn't close windows on street side so lots of road noise.
All in all, first and last time staying there.

title: New Owners
text:
We checked in here for one night but ended up staying 2, due to the car breaking down...Large car park, and close enough to walk into town.
Breakfast is available, but we did not get up early enough, so can not comment!!
The new owners were very helpful and friendly people....and when we wanted another night it was no trouble at all.....
Our room was adequate, but could do with refurbishing...  They are addressing these issues though, and the price of the room reflected this...Very good value....
No problem with the shower, powerful enough and roomy...
We will definitely stay here again....

title: Home away from home
text: The Grosvenor has recently changed hands. Location fantastic. Parking free, right outside your door. Swimming pool. In room spa baths. Rooftop fans to keep you cool. Walking distance to shops and restaurants. The new owners are very friendly, thoughtful, flexible, approachable, down to earth people, who are focussed on your comfort and personal needs. You feel like your staying with friends. When in Hamilton I used to stay in town. I'm going to stay here for now on. It's clean, convenient, comfy, hassle free and doesn't burn a hole in your pocket.

title: Exactly what we wanted.
text:
Stayed 10th to 13th Jan 2013. We wanted quiet, roomy, helpful staff, everything to "work", central to everything and we got it all. Thank you. We would definitely use this accommodation again. Yes, the fittings are older but the price is in accord with it. No problems at all.
Robyn and Gordon. Rm 41.

title: Consistently good and great value
text:
I've stayed in this motel back in May and have booked it again last week.
I liked it then and wasn't disappointed this time.
Great location, very close to CBD (3 min walk) and to the grocery store.
Clean rooms. Plenty of blankets,pillows (extra ones provided in cupboards) and powerful electric heater (very important during cold winter months).
Rooms are very clean. Owners are friendly,helpful and accomodating without being overbearing and intrusive.
Plenty of parking. I particularly liked  units at the back of the property.
The place is quiet and I had a very good night's sleep.
The place has a covered pool as well as a restaurant.
I must say that I liked consistensy of service and cleanliness as well as close proximity to CBD.
Combined with the price-great value.
I will stay there again and will recommed the place

title: Clean basic cheap value for money accommodation
text: This motel has just been taken over by new owners and they're freshening up. Very lovely helpful staff and yes it's a little tired but the beds were very comfortable, good amenities and it was perfect for a very cheap nights accommodation. I'd stay there again.

title: Don't Bother
text: My parents booked us 4 nights here as we were traveling from Australia to visit relatives. We had 3 rooms in total and this review covers all of them! My parents do not know about trip adviser so relied on the photos on the website which make this place look pretty good. Tudor style buildings and standard looking rooms. The reality was not the same. Dirty. Everything was dirty. Our sheets did not get changed once during our time their and I suspect that they had not been changed from the previous occupants. No matter what you are paying and where you are staying, that is disgusting. The pillow cases were the same....dirty. When the room was "made over" during the day the maid just pulled the doona over the dirty sheets and that was it. The beds were so soft that if you were sharing then you just both rolled into the middle. The fridge in my parents rooms was broken and had a leg missing. Our fridge just froze anything we put in it and it was set on minimum. Our spa was mouldy! Seriously mouldy. We just had to use the shower which had no pressure and was too short. Breakfast was a joke...toast and cereal. I could go on but can't be bothered. The place is run down and dirty and needs a major overhaul. Trust me when I say there are lots of better options on the same street.

title: Exterior appearances great
text: But the interiors could do with a major overhaul. Sleeping arrangements good, comfortable beds with electric blankets. Kitchen facilities very good with a back door onto an outdoor area with seating. Bathroom area not very workable. No-one could use toilet if someone was in shower.  Step up into shower not safe for children, pregnant women or elderly clientele.  Shower cubicles need updating with new doors and shower head. General maintenance needs to be a priority.  Lovely desk staff.  A help yourself arrangement with continental breakfast in the dining room. Late check out is great and Grosvenor sited well, for walking to functions if one is having a few to drink, or just not wanting to drive. Basic accommodation for a Basic cost.

title: comfortable and quiet
text: Stayed here for one night with my fiancee. Room was comfortable and warm. Room was down the end of the drive so real no street noise which was surprising for a Friday night.Was so looking foward to using the spa bath but ran out of time. Great deal on wotif with continental breakfast included and 12pm check out .Would stay here again

title: Average
text:
Stayed here in June whilst attending a conference at claudelands, room was basic and getting quite dated, but clean and warm (once I found the oil column heater in the cupboard), bed was reasonably comfortable, was able to purchase pre-paid wireless Internet connection which was handy, breakfast was pretty basic, only cereal and toast on one day as kitchen wasn't open, cooked breakfast available on other day. Was a bit of noise from rooms upstairs but was well off road so no traffic noise.
Overall just OK but nothing flash

title: mid day check out rocks!!
text: We got the studio room with the private spa. The bed was comfy, was a shame that the onsite restaurant does not do lunch and dinners so we had to go elsewhere. The spa was a bit disappointing as the room was not very well ventilated and it was not very spacious when two people were in it. The room was pretty dated but it did the job. Would have liked to have had a miocrowave available to heat up our food and maybe a kitchen sink so that we did not have to go into the bathroom sink to boil the jug and wash the dishes. All up it was alright for the money we paid especiaqlly the indoor heated pool as there was no one else using it so it was pretty private. The room rate was $120 but the guy at reception gave it to us for $100 which was awesome and I don't think I would pay any more than that. It looked as though the motel was family owned and I think that they did try to go above and beyond for their guests so that they enjoy their stay as best they can which was great. I do not think I would stay there again when compared with other hotels I have stayed in that are around the same or less price range in the area.

title: Great value for money
text: It's a good cheap motor inn really close to town.  I stayed in a back room so it was really quiet.  Free car parking, bus stop just outside.  The bed was comfortable, the shower had good hot water, overall a cheap, clean, comfortable room.  The manager on reception was really friendly as well.  Yes, it is an old motel and could do with a re-vamp but for the price and what I wanted it was perfect.

title: Not clean - outdated
text: We stayed at the hotel recently and didn't check the reviews first.  We found the hotel very dated and not clean.  The bathroom floor had water damage and mold growing on it.  The top sheets of the beds were not clean and as other reviews have stated there was a musty smell to the room.  Shower temperature varied if the water was used for the sink.  We stayed in the ground floor rooms.  Management did not enquire on our stay when we checked out.

title: Dreadful Service
text: This was the worst customer expierience I have ever had at an accomodation venue.  The service was appalling and staff were rude.  I would advise never resort to staying at this motel.

title: Really needs upgrading but ok for price
text:
We stayed here recently for family reasons and chose it for price mainly.
In the past we've stayed in Hotels but decided we needed the option to self cater from now on so was confused to find the room we'd booked had no kitchen facilities.
I thought all motel units were with kitchenettes at least, however, we survived.
The room was very clean but long overdue for an upgrade.
The room was very gloomy and dark and everything was tired looking and it had that horrible wet old carpet/ years of ingrained cigarette smoke smell, even though its non smoking now.It also got very hot and stuffy as there's no airconditioning and the ceiling fan is dangerously low.I had to buy an electric fan to use.
The spa bath and shower was good though and the ensuite was very clean but the sink had cigarette burns right around the sink, at the very least this should have been replaced.
The pool was dirty-the owners need a lesson in acceptable water quality for a heated pool-
it  looked like a large bath that somebody had already been washing in, nothing like as clean as the view on the website.
Breakfast was ok-just a very basic continental but was included in room price.

title: A nice surprise
text: Having read some fairly discouraging reviews, my family and I were happily surprised with our accommodation experience. The motel was situated perfectly, just a minute's walk to a major supermarket and a dairy and minutes away from the city centre. We had two studio rooms right at the back of the property so heard no traffic noise whatsoever. Our rooms were light and spacious, we had nice modern bed coverings and contemporary sisal carpet. In the sizeable bathroom, we had a spa bath, good hot water pressure, a nice selection of bathroom usables and fresh white towels, flannels, etc. There were guests either side of our units but you would hardly have known - the motel was obviously built solidly and unlike many of the more expensive, upmarket hotels I've stayed in, we didn't hear the neighbours' conversations, televisions, showers being used, doors slamming, etc. We had free continental breakfasts - a choice of brown or white bread to toast with the standard toppings, juice, a good selection of packaged cereals and a selection of yoghurts with sliced peaches on the side - very satisfactory. Staff went out of their way to be helpful and friendly. What I would add is that yes, some of the amenities (particularly in the bathroom) were outdated, but clean and it has to be recognised that you get what you pay for. If we'd have wanted a flat screen TV, an up to date bathroom and modern decor we'd have stayed somewhere for two or three times the price. But, used as a well situated and affordable base from which to explore Hamilton, I would absolutely recommend it. We will be staying again.

title: Spacious room but terrible cleaning services and so, so old and decrepit!
text: We stayed there with our baby boy for five nights. The room was spacious however everything was soooo run-down, old, rusty if not broken. Paper on the walls was literally falling off, jacuzi did not work, windows did not close properly so there was bad insulation, noisy (we unfortunately were on the road side) and our room was cleaned ONCE during our whole stay! Managers were nice enough people but the place needs a complete refurbishing! Will not stay there again for sure.

title: In need of a refurb and management guidance
text: This place was like stepping into an 70's/80's time warp. The spa rooms are in need of referub and the colours of the room need to be changed. The spa vents were all clogged with mould so much so that we didn't use it. The contential breakfast is terrible, it is white bread and a couple of packet cereals. We ended up getting breakfast somewhere else because of this. I have seen contential breakfasts served with much more variety, in much smaller hotels. The best part was the electric blanket, but you can get that anywhere so try avoiding this place until they renivate it. Also the pool was filthy so we didn't use that. I am not a pedantic person and had stayed in my share of backpackers on this trip.

title: Great Place to stay!
text:
We stayed here for 3 nights with our two kids.  Our room was quite spacious, had a nice kitchen with prep area, everything was neatly organized in the kitchen.  Overall, our room was very clean and comfortable.  

Furthermore, the staff at this hotel was very accomodating and friendly at the same time.

The hotel also had a Restaurant that served excellent gourmet food, which was delicous and reasonable too. 

The pool was great; very clean and warm at the same time.  My kids had a great time at this hotel and we will for sure stay here in the future

title: Badly in need of a good tidy up
text: The room we were in had a leaking shower, the pillows looked like they were the original pillows from the 70s, the bedspread was grubby, blanket threadbare, the carpets were dirty,  and the bed had a serious roll together problem.  The staff were friendly though!

title: Convenient and friendly
text: We bought the Special which was $180 including 3 course dinner and breakfast for two and a bottle of wine. I have read the previous reviews and agree yes the place is not the cleanest in the world but it was ok. What we did like was the convenience of the restaurant on-site and the friendliness of the people. For example the pool opens "whenever you want to swim" and closes "when the last person has swum" which is a nice change from other places that have rules that limit how much you can use the facilities and when. Dinner was good, the lamb shanks done really well. The wine bottle took about 30 minutes to get open, the waitress/bar person had never seen a bottle with a cork in it in her life before and had never heard of a corkscrew, and when one was summoned from the office, no-one knew how to use it. Rather funny actually, a bit Fawlty Towers. TV was on all the way through dinner and breakfast and we were asked what we wanted to watch, rather homely indeed.

title: Average Accommodation Appalling Restaurant and Food!!
text:
Stayed for 1 night with my partner and parents in law. the place was basic but clean and had the usual motel feel about it.  We chose to stay there as they had a onsite restaurant which was convieniant for my in laws. when we arrived at the restaurant we sat down and were given the drinks and food menus. My partner (who is a diabetic) asked for a Coke Zero only to be told they did not have coke zero! - when my father in law ordered the beef lasagne from the dinner specials menu he was told yes thats a good dish however 10 minutes later was told that they had run out of lasagne!! even though the restaurant had only been open 15 minutes when we arrived!!.  He then had to change his order and when everyone else got there food my father in law had to wait and wait while his food was being cooked - we had all finished by the time he got his meal!  IF that was not bad serviced enough both my food (fish and chips) and my partners food (butter chicken) tasted horrid! - my fish tasted off and the chips were hard and looked to have been cooked in old oil, my partners butter chicken tasted terrible also and he had to leave most of it. We were then charged $120 for our meals which we thought was outrageous (the room only cost $180) - we may of well have gone to one of the many restaurants in Hamilton Central and had 3 course meals each for that price! the next morning we thought we would go there for breakfast - I mean no one can stuff  up toast and breakfast foods surely! well was I mistaken, I got the hot cakes which cost $15 and I got 3 little hot cakes 1 bannana and 1 bit of bacon for my $$. my partner got the "grosvenor special" for $15 which consisted of 1 tomatoe, 3 of the tiniest sausages i have ever seen - smaller than cherios! 2 eggs, 2 hash browns and 2 pieces of toast. 
I would NEVER NEVER recommend using the restaurant if you ever stay here it is over priced and the food is below poor.  With regards to the accommodation itself, if you stay on the ground floor its ok as long as there are not loads of people and children in the units above you as the noise from walking around and up and down the stairs is deafening.  a very average stay indeed :(

title: Check the beds before you get in!
text:
We booked a studio room for the final night of our tour of New Zealand. We received a friendly welcome on arrival by Deepak, received our milk but were not shown to our room. It was on the first floor & we were able to park at the bottom of the stairs, so didn't have far to take our bags. 

The room was large, with fresh pale yellow colour walls, & had a queen size bed. There was also a desk, chair & TV and a 2-seater sofa. There was provision to make tea & coffee, & a bowl for our cereal, but no facilities for washing up. There was a ceiling fan, & a heater provided in the wardrobe. The wardrobe contained the iron & board, & after doing our laundry, went to use them but the iron plate was burned & the board cover was obviously designed to fit a very much larger board: I gave up on the ironing.

Laundry - purchase a pack of powder (NZ$2 I think), & pay for washer & dryer - I think NZ$4 each load.

Wifi - available at NZ$5 for 24 hours. It was fast & usable.

Bathroom - corner spa bath (jaccuzi) for 2 people if you want. Shower head over bath, & shower curtain round bath. I'm 5'4"/1.63m & the shower head was at my eye level - had to duck down to get my short fair hair wet.  The bath & basin were peach-coloured & were looking old & tired.

Bed - looked OK, but when we turned the cover down late at night to sleep, we noted that the sheets & pillowcases hadn't been ironed. Gave it no further thought until I looked in the morning & found 2 long black hairs in the bed. My hair is as mentioned above & my husbands is non-existent. We'd like to give the benefit of the doubt that the hair belonged to the room maid & that she doesn't iron the linens, but somehow we have the thought in our minds that we were not the first  to sleep in that bedding. We also noted several screwed up pieces of paper under the bed. 

There is a restaurant on site & prices looked reasonable, but we chose to walk about 10 minutes to Speights Ale House. There are also supermarkets & liquor stores near to Speights.

When we checked out, we advised Deepak of the ironing problems, but didn't mention the hair - not a happy thought for the start of our last day in New Zealand

If it hadn't been for the bedding, I'd have given Grosvenor a Very Good rating.

title: Very clean and comfortable
text: Slept very well for five nights in this very clean and comfortable motel.  Despite being an older motel and not one I would necessarily have chosen myself (was here for work) I was highly impressed and found it a nice place to stay for a week with all needed amenities.  The breakfasts were also very good - particularly the scrambled eggs. I stayed in a room to the rear of the premises which was very very quiet - not sure what the front rooms are like that face the road. Would happily stay again.

title: A Dismal, Dark, Dirty Disgraceful Place
text:
I cannot believe the recent good reviews are about the same Motor Inn, I could not disagree with them more. 
We stopped there for 1 night (Thank God it was only one) in Feb 2011 with my family who were visiting from overseas.
Don't let the exterior or their website fool you.The two-bedroom unit with a lounge was painted in a dark mustard colour with yellow curtains (hung a different lengths on the same window) it was so dark we had to put the light on during the middle of the afternoon. The curtains had to remain closed because there were no net curtains to stop every passer by looking into the unit.
My sister found a flea in the bedding, the pillow cases were so stained she wrapped the bath towels around them before attempting to sleep.
The whole place was sweltering hot with no air-conditioning or fans. The expel air fans in the kitchen & bathroom didn't work, the shower was so small we couldn't bend over enough to wash our legs (I’m 55 kg). It simply went on & on.
When we gave the feedback to the Indian male manager he replied we had been given a good room rate & he had never had any bad feedback like this before & would offer no recompense. He simply couldn't have cared less. My family were astounded & I was embarrassed to have taken them to such a shabby place.
During our trip we stayed at many similar (and cheaper) priced motels in the Bay of Islands, Rotorua & Taupo all of which were a million times better than this.
Do yourself a favour, if this is the only motel available within your budget spend the money on a tent, you'll be more satisfied with the outcome.

title: Cheerful and helpful staff but dark and small rooms
text: Location is good and surprisingly quiet given that it is on a main through road.The owners were most helpful and pleasant but the two bedroom unit was very basic, small and dark. The shower/ toilet was barely adequate.

title: Gross
text: The first part of this motel’s name is right anyway, GROSS!  I find it hard to believe the previous comments!  The outside of the motel looked very nice, as did the Reception - nicely decorated and clean.  We were not shown to our room, the only time out of 15 accommodations.  Immediately on walking in we noticed everything looked grubby.  The walls had been ‘washed’ at some time, as far up as someone could reach, leaving smears anyway.  The bed linen was not the pristine white we’d been accustomed to in other NZ motels, but rather grey and towels were frayed.  But it gets worse.  The kitchenette was filthy.  The unit fronts were splashed with milk or fat, and inside the corners and edges had a build up of dirt and grime!  The oven glove was smelly and very dirty.  The mugs and cutlery weren’t very clean, and another cupboard had a mish mash of crockery.  The sink and taps were absolutely ancient, and also grimy around the edges where not cleaned thoroughly.  The very ‘tired’ bathroom unit held a sink that was badly watermarked.  The toilet brush was brown and disgusting.  This was enough to persuade us to leave immediately, but to add: The bedroom areas weren’t much better; with a mish mash of old hangers in the wardrobe, and a blanket untidily rolled and chucked in on the floor.  The balcony had just one plastic chair, although the apartment was for 4 people.  The TV was very grimy, no remote either.  I would be absolutely sure that there would have been cockroaches about.  The ‘leading’ on the windows had been picked off in some areas of the windows.  Whilst in reception I bumped into another couple who were also complaining about the “disgusting” state of their room, and described a similar experience to ours.  We didn’t have a close look at the pool area, but it too looked worn and tired, and the pool very cloudy.  Why is it a salt water pool so far inland?

title: great service great value
text: we really enjoyed our stay at this motel. its very quiet close to town and very affordable. the restaurant is not only convinient but the the food is absolutly beautiful we will be recommending this friendly motel to all and will be back in the future.

title: ABSOLUTE BLISS, I WILL BE BACK
text: The best service with a smile.  We enjoyed every minute of our much awaited break.  I would and have recommended this hotel to everyone i know and more.  we will be back soon.

title: Tired and now lagging behind several others in the area
text:
We had been using this motel on and off for several years as part of a sports group, but hadn't really looked at it too closely, as they always gave us a good group rate.  However, this time there were just two of us and it was a cold wet wintery afternoon when we arrived.  

Reception was extremely efficient and friendly, (I had pre-booked via their website and that worked very well) and we just had a basic room with no kitchen facilities.  Tea and coffee making was OK, with plunger as well as instant coffee and a fridge.  The room was rather dull and initially cold, with an oil filled radiator for warmth.

Large bath with shower over, but a very tired bathroom otherwise.  Bed was comfortable and fortunately with electric blankets.  Sky TV was OK, but with limited channels.

In the past , we have rather enjoyed the heated indoor pool, but we just couldn't be bothered to brave the elements, even though we were fairly close.  A spa pool would have been better on this occasion!

The night was relatively quiet which is our number one priority after cleanliness, even though there was a major night rugby match on at the adjacent stadium, so no complaints there.  We were insulated from the street as we requested a quiet room (#25).

We didn't use the restaurant at night, but as we had a match at 8am, we were grateful that the restaurant opened at 7am. 

Now poached eggs, bacon and tomatoes might appear to be a simplistic meal, but is in fact one of the most difficult to serve to a customer's total satisfaction, and I am happy to say that it was excellent, though we have rather grown out of filter coffee these days.  The restaurant waitress and chef staff were also very friendly  - but that is something we get used to, as we are always fiendly to them.

Its a shame it is a bit tired now, and there are plenty of places that are far worse, but as Hamilton as a city has raised its game over recent years, the Grosvenor really needs to do the same.

title: Basic accommodation
text:
Very basic accommodation with tired interior furnishings and bed linen. Stained carpets, noisy cleaners at 2am (Function room) 
We decide to stay at this motel after seeing the motel in free Jason Motel book. One of the reasons we chose it was because it had an indoor pool and we both like swimming. The pool was not warm enough and the bottom of the pool was dirty and uninviting. Needless to say we did not use it. The only thing that I could say was ok was the evening meal - a set price of $30 for a three course. The starter and sweet were bland but the main made up for it and on its own was worth the money.

title: Great Little BnB
text:
We stayed at the Pickering Rd BnB for four nights at the end of April while we were at the Masters Games. 

Greta and Tony were great hosts and very obliging and friendly. They are the kind of hosts who will do anything for you which made it a very pleasant stay. It is a lovely place in the country and only a short drive into Cambridge or Hamilton. 

We will definitely be staying here again!

title: We just keep coming back.
text: Always great! We just keep coming back. Everyone is friendly and they always go the extra mile for us. Clean, modern and everything we need

title: Hygienic and Happy! Comfort too
text: I really enjoyed BK. I found the staff to be lovely and kind. They kept the room clean and hygienic and the bed was really comfortable

title: Clean, friendly, handy to hospital
text: Room was clean and tidy and had everything needed. Had a room with a spa bath which was lovely. Shower pressure is really good. Managers were pleasant to deal with. Some road noise from SH1 but goes away with doors and windows shut. Easy walk to Waikato Hospital. Would book again if I needed to stay near the hospital

title: Great place
text: Quiet and very clean rooms. In fact the room was spotless.  Comfortable beds. Reception was very welcoming and friendly and very helpful. Even the cleaning staff were super friendly. Its about 9 minutes walk to the hospital. I definitely recommend this place.

title: GREAT SERVICE AND AMAZING STAFF
text:
We stayed at BK HLZ in March for a week as my daughter was having surgery. We were so impressed with Rick, Mona and also Andrea from housekeeping, who were all so helpful, kind and accommodating during our stay. Nothing was too much to ask and they made our stay feel like a "Home away from home".  When we came back after the surgery, Rick saw that my daughter was struggling to walk to the room so he raced to get a wheelchair and took us to the room. I was so thankful and really appreciated the help. The facilities in the spotless room were very good and had everything we needed. Very comfy beds made our stay enjoyable, despite the circumstances. The lazy-boy chairs were also a huge bonus and great for my daughter, who struggled to sleep in a bed for too long .  I would definitely recommend this property and would use them again. Thank you Mona, Rick and  your team for your caring, professional service, it was much appreciated. 
Fiona and Amber VH

title: Exceptionally Clean and built for comfort
text: Requested disability room. Downside was you can't open from the front and go that way, and also disability parks weren't available in the front of disability rooms. The kitchen is very low. What I will say is the bed is very comfortable. I have traveled a lot and been to many hotels and this was exceptionally clean! I've never seen a hotel or motel so clean, including walls. I was very happy with our stay and I look forward to returning.

title: Very helpful service
text: Great service and help. My husband was admitted to Waikato hospital and I was required to stay overnight.  Very close to the hospital and very comfy bed,  I would definitely recommend BK's Premier Motel.  There are several fast food outlets close by too.  I settled for a Pizza late at night after a tiring day.  Thank you BK's

title: Dirty
text: It’s dirty. Unhygienic. They skip your room when they feel like it. I saw a roach 🪳 inside the recliner couch. Cleaning days are Monday and Thursday. When you ask them to clean they say no it’s not cleaning day today. Front lady is condescending and does racial discrimination so that attitude rubs on the staff. I stayed 3 weeks

title: Top Quality Motel
text:
Top quality motel definitely one of the best myself and hubby have stayed in
Very clean, modern and comfortable even had couple lazy boy chairs 
Pleasant check in and made you feel welcomed
Also very quiet 
Would highly recommend and will definitely return

title: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
text: I stayed here as I was having surgery in Hamilton. I can’t say enough about the owners being helpful. There is a wheelchair to help you get from the car to the room. The rooms are spacious and beautifully clean with everything you need for a couple of days stay. I would stay again even without having surgery. Great motel! It’s a little more expensive than nearby motels but well worth paying the extra. Highly recommended!

title: Great management and staff, super clean.
text: Extremley well managed.  A super clean motel where staff are very approachable, friendly, and helpful.  Overall a nice environment created by the managers and staff making this a great place to stay for a short or longer stay.  Thank you Maree, Grant and team.   I would definitely stay here again.
hotel_response: Thank you, we appreciate your feedback and are pleased you enjoyed your stay with us. We look forward to hosting you again in the future.

title: Handy to everything!
text: Great reception. Super clean, modern with great armchairs for relaxing. Lovely bedlinen. Shower over deep spa bath. Spacious. Parking a bit tight as they were full, but ok. Aircon is great. I have radar ears so first night I counted 5 helicopters and a few ambulances en route to nearby hospital. Second night was much quieter. A great stay.
hotel_response: Thank you, we appreciate your feedback and are pleased you enjoyed your stay with us.

title: Close to Waikato Hospital.
text:
Spacious room. Friendly owners 
A few meters from the traffic lights that turn into Waikato Hosptial. If you're visiting someone at the hospital, definitely recommend.
Motel is easy to get to. There is a vending machine for snacks and drinks.
hotel_response: Thank you, we appreciate your feedback and are pleased you enjoyed your stay with us.

title: BK's a superior motel a short distance from Hamilton hospital
text: Many thanks to Maree, Grant and their staff for making my stay at BK's last week when my husband was admitted to hospital so stress free at a stressful time. They could not have been more helpful. The motel is very well managed, rooms clean and well equipped and beds comfortable.  I highly recommend BK's either for someone like me when family or friends are in hospital or as a stopover when travelling through Hamilton. The motel is a short walk from the hospital which saved me the hassle of daily parking. Would definitely book into BK's in the future should the need arise.

title: Really lovely place to stay
text:
A real home from home while I’m travelling for work. Maree & Grant are great hosts; helpful & a good laugh.
Had the best sleep I’ve had away from home for ages and the room was kept spotlessly clean.
Bonus for me is it’s really near my work. I’ll definitely be back

title: Clean comfort close to hospitals

title: BK Hamilton- the best!!!
text:
Seriously great place! Super clean, great rooms, adorable lazeboys, powerful shower, aircon and wonderful hosts. 
I have stayed here the past 3 years, on business  and have never been disappointed.

Close to the hospital
 
A very safe large car park. 

Love this place. Home from home.

title: Lovely stay in a clean and comfortable accommodation
text:
We had a Very comfortable stay the room was very clean. With everything  you needed including a Well equipped kitchenette. 
No elevator and bath room is slippy when you’re showering if I was being really picky.

title: Terrific motel, great facilities, spotlessly clean, perfect location
text:

Spotlessly clean, plenty of towels and toiletries. Kitchen was fully equipped, dining table large, beds comfortable and  La-Z-Boy recliners a very nice addition.
Will definitely return when I need to stay in Hamilton again.
Many thanks :)

title: A Must Stay
text:
Absolutely one of the best in hospitality, Service, spacious and beautiful rooms. So caring and thoughtful whilst our stay as our Mum was in Waikato Hospital.

Maree and Grant are superb hosts and we would refer them to anyone 😊
 
Thank you for Everything!!!

Simon Bel and Boys

title: Happy to return
text:

Very happy to return , we will be back in a couple of weeks

title: Fantastic dtay
text:
My workmates and i stayed there for three nights. Beautiful rooms lovely hosts. Would recommend to all.
It is close to the hospital, easy to find. Close to shops. If you want peace and quiet this is the place.
We didnt have to pay but did ask. The prices are reasonable.

title: Excellent accomodation
text: Excellent stay at BKs, wonderful service and no nonsense at checkin. Room was clean, warm and quiet. Everything I could need. Even no worries when I misplaced my room key and had to call to be let in, I felt very stupid, but the no nonsense attitude from Grant left me feeling fine. Highly recommend will be requesting for all my stays from now on.
hotel_response: Thank you, we appreciate your feedback and we look forward to seeing you again.

title: Get treated like a patient
text: I stayed in their access unit (801).  When I eventually got into bed, I discovered a plastic mattress protector.   After a couple of hours of failing to get comfortable, I gave up and rested on the lazy boy.   My traveling colleague said that their bed did not have a plastic protector. Having experienced accessible accommodation globally for the last two decades, plastic on the bed was a first.  If BKs do want to provide hospital-type bedding for just disabled people they ought to have it as an opt-in option rather than assuming we will all soil their beds.
hotel_response: Thank you, we appreciate your feedback.

title: Mixed bag
text:
Pro’s ... good location, great big shower, nice beds, complimentary water and papers were appreciated. 

Cons... be very aware if travelling with elderly, physically impaired, or children. There are Access issues, only a set of steep stairs, no lift?! (We did ask) and fairly long corridors to some rooms. Downstairs was better. Parking spaces Inadequate. Was reportedly fully booked and no spare car parks we had to park out on street behind overnight 
Maintenance lacking in place .. broken and sharp window latch and wobbly sink tap. 
It was just ... ok.
hotel_response: Thank you, we appreciate your feedback.

title: Expensive, but great location
text:
We booked a room at the BKs Hamilton Motel purely based on its location, walking distance from the Hospital. Ample parking, and very friendly team on Reception. Room was a 1 bedroom apartment located upstairs. Large King Bed in the lounge room, with 2 recliners and a large dining table. Small kitchenette with ample cutlery and cups etc. Bathroom was clean and tidy, however the tiles were LETHAL when wet. Small bedroom with two single beds and small TV. There was quite a bit of road noise, but not enough to be a huge drama. No Sky TV, just the basic free to view channels. Didnt really have a lot of toiletries in the bathroom, the ones provided were minuscule. The beds were a delight, with crisp clean linen. 

At $280 for the night, we found it to be EXTREMELY overpriced for what we received. At least $100 overpriced. Shame, as the value for money is really the only major thing letting it down. Certainly wouldnt stay again at that price, but would if it was cheaper. 

4 stars still, as the Staff were very friendly, Beds were amazing and great location.

title: Very happy
text: After a bad experience at bk motel Palmerston North, we read reviews of Hamilton one first. Marie was very pleasant on phone and assured us they had king size beds. We were welcomed on arrival, requested a quieter room away from the road, no problem. Rooms are spacious, spotless and comfortable. Bed was comfortable and king size as stated. Shower was good although water pressure was a little weak. Complimentary water is a bonus for travellers. We will definitely stay again.

title: Fabulous Accommodation
text: I had an access room as my daughter was having an operation.  Wonderful rooms with plenty of space and very lovely owners.  Nothing was a problem and we had a wonderful stay.  Will be back for sure. Highly recommend. Vicki

title: Excellent base
text: Motels in Hamilton are a mixed bunch at best, but this one stands out from the crowd.  Large and well-appointed units.  Friendly and helpful staff, who are there to make your stay go well and not just do the minimum.  Good parking.  Close to main roads in all directions.  Quiet despite being on a busy road.  No sound between rooms as far as we could tell.  Outdoor seating area on ground floor units.  Good internet.

title: Best Motel I've Stayed In!!
text:
This is nicest, cleanist, friendliest most helpful & accomadating motel I have stayed in hands down & the hospitality & the rooms are 5 star!
I wish there were more motels around like this.
Thanks for been such great hosts & you've certainly got a motel to be proud of😊

title: Simply Brilliant!
text:
What wonderful, immaculately clean units run by awesome hosts and friendly staff. Located close to the hospitals, we used this facility for pre and post surgery. The cleanliness of the units was of an exceptional standard. 
Nigel and Mel did everything to make our stay perfect and ensure we had everything we needed in order for me to heal. Nothing was too much trouble and their staff have obviously been educated on this too - whether it was dark towels, extra pillows, or making my support team comfortable.
We cannot sing high enough praises of this place. 
Thank you very much

title: Excellent location for hospital
text:
Had an early appointment at hospital across the road so stayed the night before with hubby.
Excellent facilities & spacious room. The only downside is the tiles in the shower room are lethal when wet. Had to be really careful in the shower as well & would have benefitted from a non slip shower mat. The accomodation is otherwise excellent & Ive deducted a star due to slippy tiles.

title: Home away from Home
text: I stayed in Hamilton as my husband was in hospital after bad accident. From the first phone call to book to the service the room the cleanliness BK's like a haven I could retreat to each night. Cant say enough about the staff or facilities, would recommend this Motel to anyone and everyone. I cant thank them enough just the best.

title: Excellent accomodation and service
text: The accomodation is wonderful.  It provided a bit more space for our family of four than a standard motel room.  We had an upstairs room that had a room with a king bed and a second room with two singles which was perfect for the kids.  Having the little bit of extra space in a small living area with a table and lazyboy chairs was lovely.  The staff were friendly and very helpful during our stay.

title: Great place to stay
text: Loved BKs Hamilton. Will definately be booking again if down that way. So clean and tidy, loved the crisp white sheets and great size bed. Bathroom was roomy and very clean and was great to get a makeup remover towel that actually worked. Shower cap came in handy also. Great little kitchen, loved the biscuits, great location, so handy to everything including malls which were only about 20 min away. The hosts were a great couple. Very friendly, easy to talk to and very helpful. Didn't try the meals but they looked good. Maybe next time. Overall I was so thankful we stayed there and didnt look anywhere else.

title: Amazing!
text: We absolutely loved our stay! We stayed in a one bedroom apartment. The staff were approachable & very friendly, the facilities were great, room was very clean, well presented, spacious and the parking was free and easy to access right outside of the motel. We will definitely be back! Thanks for having us!

title: Fabulous hosts - spotlessly clean
text: BK's Hamilton is an excellent motel. The fabulous friendly hosts who go the extra mile to make their guests welcome and comfortable are delightful people. Extra touches like the complimentary fruit bowl in reception add a special charm. The rooms are spotless, with very professional and approachable servicing staff. Conveniently located close to both Braemar and Waikato hospitals, Mel and Nig do whatever they can to assist should you be in Hamilton to avail yourself of these facilities. The only suggested addition I could make to help creature comforts for guests would be herbal tea bags (peppermint ?) in the complimentary dispenser and a box of tissues. But seriously, no complaints ! Delightful !!!

title: The place to stay
text: Thank you for a really great stay. The motel is walking distance to the hospital. Room was to a very good standard, the meals are awesome and the service is fantastic. We will definitely use when we are back in Hamilton. Thank you again. Kevin and Kerri.

title: Great motel and service
text:
We stayed at BKs Hamilton for one night with family as we had a family member in Braemar Hospital.  The one bedroom apartment was beautifully appointed with everything we needed.  The bed linen was very good which is a major plus for most people.  While on a busy road, the motel is set well back and there was no road noise.
My sister-in-law then stayed for a further night which was happily arranged by the lovely Mel and Nigel who went out of their way to make us feel welcome, at what was a stressful time.  Thank you guys !!

A great place to stay, Highly recommended.

title: The best hotel ever
text:
Thank you to Mel and Nigel - what a wonderful motel . You are just the best hosts ! So easy to deal with and so welcoming - lovely people ! 
I stayed for 3 nights while my Mum was in Waikato hospital . It was an easy walk to hospital each day and such a lovely place to come home to every night ! Very modern and lovely comfy beds with everything you need in the room .
The roast place is only a short walk to grab some dinner and very nice too. 
I would highly recommend this motel !

title: Best motel
text: It’s very quiet and such lovely people and very nice rooms. This motel is by far one of the best I’ve stayed in ever. Only thing is it’s right by a very busy road but it’s fully insulated and double glazing and very very comfortable beds. If a cot is required they supply that for you so you don’t need to take your own.

title: Modern and tidy
text: Despite being on a busy road, this motel was very quiet. It's tidy and modern, stayed in a studio room and it was more than adequate with two lazy boy chairs for extra comfort. Clean, no maintenance requirements. Friendly staff. Only issue is not near restaurants but stayed for business so this wasn't too much of an issue. Nice continental breakfast too.

title: A really good place to stay
text: The room was very nice, modern and clean.  The cooking facilities were adequate and the location was handy to the CBD.  The wifi was good and strong with adequate speed.  Definitely added to the approved motels list!

title: Great motel
text: This motel is great, we booked here because it is quite close to Waikato Hospital. The hosts are very friendly, we had a access unit which was what my husband needs. I would highly recommend it. It is very modern and comfortable

title: Number 1 Trip Advisor!
text:
Nice clean and well laid out rooms. 
Extra friendly and efficient (caretaker) hosts Ray and Josie made the stay very pleasant. What a bonus to be able to leave your property in these capable hands.
A liitle way out of the main CBD area so be prepared for a little drive to the restaurant strip of Hamilton
But the absolute best was the sign at the door - making the property no doubt the  "NUMBER 1 TRIP ADVISOR"

title: Clean and modern
text:
If you dont want the city noise then this motel is for you, just opposite to the hamilton hospital with free free parking. 

Here is cooked Breakfast at the motel but you need to book this in the day before which will be delivered to your room.

Rooms are nice and clean, they have a little gym onsite...also have cooking facilities.

There are not many options to eat around the motel so you might need to drive out.

Overall good place to stay

title: Very impressed with both the operators and the quality of the accommodation
text:
This hotel must be the closest and nicest hotel to Braemar and Waikato hospital. The operators were very sensitive to my needs for flexibility given I was the support person for someone in hospital.  They were always so lovely.
The room was fantastic.  This is one of the best layouts I've seen in a studio room and I really like how it was decorated. But best of all the bed was sooo comfortable.  I can't stand beds where you sink in and your back bends making for an incredibly uncomfortable stomach sleep.  This bed was both soft and firm.

title: Bk’s Hamilton
text: We recently stayed here and were very impressed with the helpful, friendly owners, Mel and Nigel and also Cameron.  They went out of their way to make a stressful time for us less stressful, thank you!

title: Wonderful 3 night stay !
text: We stayed in a deluxe room with king size bed and private balcony.  The duty managers and staff were wonderful, room was spotless and nothing was too much trouble.  Delicious cooked breakfast on two mornings delivered to our door.  We came to visit my son and his wife and family to deliver Christmas presents, and we will certainly be back every time we visit them !  Thankyou to these two relief managers that were on duty last week - we stayed Thursday through to Sunday, they were especially friendly and helpful and great cooks !!  We will be back, and wish you all a very Merry Christmas and wonderful 2019 !!

title: Great place to stay while visiting family
text:
Everything from booking the room through to check out was an enjoyable experience. The rooms were clean and all of the ones we were shown were of a good size including King size bed two recliner chars, a desk and a balcony.  
     The room we stayed in was a deluxe room with a private balcony with table and chairs. The staff were all friendly and attentive.wouild definitely recommend this hotel

title: Clean, large size rooms
text: BK's Hamilton we booked as a stop over on our way from the Glow Worm Caves to Auckland. We didn't want to drive all the way late at night. BK's was clean, the rooms were big and the beds were very comfortable. The reception staff was very nice and gave us a room upgrade. It's a good option for a place to stay.

title: First timers here
text: We chose to stay here last minute on the way back to Taranaki. Had often drove past, so thought this was a good opportunity. Wow, we were very impressed! The welcome at reception was lovely, the room was huge and my kids room was massive too. Clean, warm, and quiet. Would certainly recommend.

title: Perfect motel
text:
Amazing motel!
Comfortable stay in newly built motel perfect for families and couples are like.

Here they have laundry facilities close to the Waikato hospital and handy take outs if needed,

They also supply small kitchen if you feel like cooking yourself.

It is very clean tidy and modern.

in the amazing motel, the people are very  friendly and go out of their way to help you.
 I highly recommend staying here and can't wait to stay here again!

title: "Playing by ear"
text: Trying to break a return trip back to Auckland from Raglan, we found this motel on the phone, and decided to aim for it. Mel welcomed us very warmly, and reminded us that day light was starting, and told us where the eateries were, upon asking. Found room, which had easy access to carpark, and settled in. Very clean, warm and tidy, with a king bed, and an enjoyable stay. A motel to look at, if staying in Hamilton, Will stay here again, if the opportunity arises.

title: Clean and comfortable
text:
Got there early but they checked me in anyway, there is fresh fruit basket for the guests, friendly staff. The room is clean and spacious, Wifi works really well, and it was quite. I had a very good
Experience.

title: Ok could be better
text:
Place looks really nice inside and out.

The water pressure wasn’t great

I found a hair underneath my pillow when I went to hop into bed and the jug didn’t work. 

The staff were lovely although the receptionist wasn’t very friendly. We got to reception and no one was there they had a bell and we had to press it a couple times After waiting a fair amount of time to ring it the second time before we were met with the receptionist.

title: High Quality for a motel
text: Extremely clean and well presented. New fixtures, furniture and carpet throughout. 5min drive from centre of Hamilton. Very comfortable bed and pillows. Hosts, Mel and Nigel, were friendly and welcoming. Although BKs is located on a main road traffic could not be heard in the room. Total of 4 rooms booked for a business trip. We would definitely stay here again.

title: Good stay
text: Had a good stay here. Staff were friendly and really helpful. We were visiting a family member at Waikato Hospital so walkable distance. The Motel was booked out but the staff really helped to accommodate us. Nice and new with all the in room facilities needed for self sufficiency. Only criticism was the beds were too hard, that was for both of us. Overall I would recommend this motel.

title: Excellent
text: Lovely clean and comfortable beds. friendly helpful welcome and accomodating for our extra needs .superette within walking distance . although it's on the highway was very soundproof .definately recommend this motel

title: New and clean
text: This motel is quite new and is well appointed and spotlessly clean. The beds are comfortable and the rooms are spacious. The service is friendly and welcoming. Would definitely stay here again when in Hamilton.

title: Nice stay
text: Stayed for two nights with our baby. Nice and clean and quiet. Quite refreshing new looking motel outside and in. Easy to find and not far from the centre of the city. Staff friendly and helpful. Recommended.

title: Very Comfortable Stay
text: Just stayed for two nights at BK'S.   Very happy with the accommodation.  Staff are super friendly and accommodation is very clean, modern and we'll equipped.  Loved the recliner chairs which were a great addition to the room and the bed is extremely comfortable with crisp white bedding.  Definitely staying again.

title: Overnight here, nice place close to hospital.
text: Lovely rooms, clean, tidy, 5 minutes from the Hamilton hospital. Easy to find and good security.  Tiles in the bathroom, slippery when wet. They have fresh fruit in the lobby, nice touch.  Beds very comfy.

title: The place to stay when visiting Hamilton Hospital or Braemar Hospital
text:
I stayed for two nights while my husband was in Braemar Hospital, which is just across the road.
Mel and Nigel are excellent hosts.  Very friendly and nothing is too much trouble.   They provide a lovely home cooked diner, I had the roast lamb the first night, yummy and the second night I had the curry chicken, yummy as well, just perfect.  The room was exceptional clean and it had everything you need.  Don't worry that it is on a main road as it has double glazing so you cannot hear it.
I highly recommend this motel.

title: Almost excellent
text: This is a very nice hotel/motel. The rooms are big. There is a lot of generosity in the rooms with the facilities. The bed is extra nice. The heating and bathroom are all excellent. The wifi is unlimited and strong so it falls down with the Sky offering. Add the 50 channels option and i'd become a regular.

title: Spacious and well appointed.
text: I stayed here with my mother when we  had to travel to Hamilton for hospital treatment. The accommodation was comfortable, warm and spacious. (I wanted to take the bed home). Everything you could ask for. Large screen tv, microwave, fridge, toaster and tea and coffee making facilities. Spacious bathroom with walk in shower. The staff were very friendly and obliging. The proprietors, Mel and Nigel, were very obliging and nothing was a problem for them. Nigel even took us up to the hospital on our first visit. Essential shops (suprette, takeaways) and bus stops nearby. Although the motels are situated on a busy road there was only minimal noise which didn't affect our sleep. I would recommend this motel to anyone looking for good, clean, modern  accommodation

title: OMG .. amazing!!
text: Had to go up to Waikato Hospital and was looking for a place to stay.  We needed somewhere a bit special to take my mind off health issues.  This place looked like it might have a hidden secret so we called in.  Well what an amazing experience.. this is how motels should be run!! Great hosts ..Nothing was too much trouble and the rooms just took our breath away.  This is really Hamilton's best keep secret although judging by the occupancy it wasn't really much of a secret. We didn't know that you could get rooms like this!! We were just transported into another world or peace and luxury. It just seemed to suck the stress and tension right out of me..  I swear my health got better overnight and even my specialist commented and asked where we had stayed.. I don't know what it was.. maybe it was the kindness we were shown, maybe the peace and quiet, or the luxury, who knows but we will be back for sure.

title: Incredible!!
text: We were looking for somewhere special to stay at Hamilton and just happened to see this as we drove past.  It looked new and impressive so we called in for a look.  We found an amazing couple running the place.  They couldn't be more helpful and Mel showed us around.  We were blown away by the luxury and comfort and for a few measly $ we decided to treat ourselves!.. We had a marvelous stay and just blobbed out.  It was spotless and new with every facility.  We caught up on some washing.. there was even a gym to blow out some cobwebs and a huge spa bath to soak in with a big glass of red!  Heaven!!  Seriously we will be back here every time we need to recharge the batteries...

title: Large room
text:
I actually had reservations about this hotel, only because of the name... but don't be put off. The reception was great and our room was lovely, spacious and clean. 

There were two comfy recliner chairs but unfortunately we only stayed for one night so didn't get to appreciate them. 

Great shower!

title: Fantastic Stay - wonderful service !
text:
This motel is wonderful - absolutely spotless great friendly service and the comfiest of cuddly bed. Just what was needed after a very long day. 
We were welcomed by the relief managers 'Ray & Josie' full of great information and very friendly.
We will certainly be returning on our next venture to NZ! to BK's Hamilton.
Do yourself a favour if you do not feel like heading out for dinner 'Scoff's' has a menu available at reception and deliver to your door. Highly recommend the Scotch fillet, it was delicious 👍. Thank you again for the great service.

title: Sparkling New
text: Booked here by mistake but quite glad that we did - thought it was a different BKs. The hotel is only 10 months old so everything is fresh. Light breakfast available and rooms are Hughe with two rocking chairs - also have a little kitchenette and is close to shops. Could hear the traffic every now and then but didn't keep me awake. Lovely husband and wife team running the place.

title: Beautiful
text: My husband was having an operation, i wanted an enjoyable CLEAN motel. this was near the hospital, and near new, Spa bath, It was a gorgeous spacious motel room, and roomy. I had just left a grotty one, and this was amazing, So friendly too. thank you

title: Clean and comfortable stay
text: Staff were super friendly on check in and instantly made us feel welcome. The room was spacious, clean and comfortable. The hotel is fairly new and had everything you needed for a restful stay. The laz e boy reclining chairs were a very nice touch. There is no lift so do be aware that if you are staying upstairs you will have to carry your luggage.

title: Small but nice
text:
I found BKs at Hamilton from Google and checked out the facilities and recommendations from Trip Advisor.

When I first arrived, I was very surprised to see how small it was. 

But when I checked-in, I found the service at the reception was very pleasant and efficient.

The room was nice and clean, too.

title: Very clean and confortable
text:
This place is fairly new and so everything still feels fresh and new which is always nice.  We arrived at midday and had a lot of business calls and emails to respond to, and even though check in isn't until 2pm the lovely lady at reception allowed us to check in early to our 2 bedroom apartment which was hugely appreciated.  When we entered the room we were immediately impressed with the recliner chairs so we made ourselves comfortable on those with our laptops.  Unlimited wifi was a welcome bonus too given how much work we had to do.  The room was very clean, extremely comfortable and pleasantly quiet.  The beds were out of this world!  

The only detractors for us were no elevators (we had to make a few trips out to the car and carry a lot of stuff up and down the stairs, having said that the property is only 2 storeys so at least it was only one flight of stairs) and there is no shelf in the bathroom to put a toilet bag or toiletries.  We had to put ours on the floor, and between the two of us there was a lot of stuff on the floor.  

All in all though, a lovely property and in immaculate condition with super helpful and friendly staff.

title: Clean and quiet
text: I was impressed with this hotel. It seems to be fairly new. It is very comfortable and clean.  It is on a quite street, with very little traffic noise coming in the room. It was extremely spacious. The bed and pillows were very comfortable . The front desk staff was very friendly and attentive. This would be a great place for a larger family to stay.

title: Perfect For Overnight Stay on Drive to Auckland Airport
text: We were traveling in a rental car from Wellington to Auckland for our return flight to the United States. Hamilton is about 1.5 hours from the Auckland Airport and this motel is directly on Highway 1 (but quiet and in a residential area) so was quite convenient. The motel doesn't stand out as flashy...kinda wedged into a residential area, but don't let that fool you.... the facility is remarkable in EVERY way. Friendly and helpful front receptionist and very high-end luxury room in every way. One of the best we have ever stayed in.

title: Nice quiet comfortable place to stay.
text: I stayed here in Sept 2016 and I am due to return for another stay in a couple of weeks which reminded me to post a review. The motel is very comfortable and nice and quiet with plenty of parking. I had a great night's sleep, most of it in the very comfortable bed, but I initially dozed off in the very comfortable chair in front of the television! I ordered a continental breakfast which was delivered promptly and featured a great selection and plenty of it.

title: lovely, would stay again
text:
I am currently staying here while I recover from a major work accident, with my mother.

We have been here over two weeks and have just extended our stay.

The hotel is clean and very well furnished. The staff are exceptionally friendly. 
There is free wifi and parking.
 We have very very few complaints, and it is normal to have some after such a long stay.

All we are missing is an oven, and a vacuum cleaner really. We were woken up by a fire alarm going off in one of the rooms one morning, but that can happen anywhere (and at least they work!)

 Everything else has been brilliant.

title: Modern and cozy! Super clean!
text: We hired the studio with spa bath and everything was great. All kitchen equipment is there for cooking a nice meal. The lazy boy chairs are super comfy. Really modern and new but cozy at the same time. Friendly staff. Would definitely recommend!

title: Excellent Stay
text: Friendly and helpful staff. Very clean and spacious room. Near amenities. Despite being next to a major road, it was quiet and we had our first real good sleep in a week! Excellent wifi with good internet connection.

title: So close to the Hospital
text: Great place to be able to stay when having a family member in the hospital. We arrived late at night about 9pm, yet we were still greated by a lovely couple who helped us with our bags into our rooms. They told us where to get meals at that hour and also were so understanding when we seemed to be so upset. You couldnt ask for better hosts than these people. They are a credit to the Industry. We were able to walk to the hospital from the Motel instead of taking our car which was great. Would stay again.

title: Smart clean and new
text:
But very little sleep.
Lights from the Air-conditioning Unit were so bright the kept us awake for most of the night.
Staff are friendly and couldn't fault it apart from the one requirement you have from a lodge

title: Absolutely Ideal
text:
This little gem of a place has been recently taken over by a lovely couple.  It is an immaculate place on the outskirts of Hamilton.
I was here for one night and my room consisted of a massive double bed, Spa bath, fully fitted kithen amenities, 50" flat screen TV, two reclining chairs, aircon and blackout blinds.
The motel also has a gym, comprising of a treadmil, rowing machine and a exercise bike.  There is also plenty of room to do floor exercises too.  There are towels in the gym.
The location is not far from local shops and you are only a couple of minutes away from State Highway 1.
Lovely place, really friendly and I would stay again.

title: Weird service
text: Very nice place to stay , new, fresh, bed a bit firm for me but otherwise very comfortable.  Room service was weird ... The rubbish was emptied and my half of the bed was made , but that was all .... Husband side left unmade and bathroom not touched !!! Could this be a New Zealand thing ???
hotel_response: Thank you very much for the feedback.  We have reviewed our records and will undertake some staff training to correct this error

title: New and Comfortable
text: Near new premises, in a handy location close to hospital and a few minutes from town. Good facilities, comfortable rooms, plenty of free parking. Friendly staff who were helpful with a nice easy check-in.

title: Tidy and clean
text: We recently stayed at BKs Hamilton motel which was very new, tidy and clean.  Location is on a major road, but our room was very quiet.  The motel is 5 minutes walk from a small shopping centre with some great take away options, which compensates for no restaurants nearby.  Only problem was the internet was terrible and almost unusable.  If this gets fixed, BKs will be a great option for Hamilton.
hotel_response: We appreciate you feedback as this has enabled us to correct an internet system set up problem so the usability of the internet is no longer an issue.  A technician has attended our site and informed me that we were on a first in best dressed set up which meant the first person connected was getting a great connection but the last person was getting nothing.  We look forward to having you stay with us again.

title: Clean, fresh and comfortable
text: This is our first visit here. The motel seems new and is very clean and tidy. The room are a good size with good facilities, comfortable beds and good quality linen. text: I really wanted to give this Hotel a positive review, but their awful customer service really lets them down. But oh my goodness, just as we were just about to head down to reception to check out at 10am there was a forceful knock at the door, “housekeeping, its 10am you need to check out now. That’s fine, no problem, just doing a final check (we’d got the clear hint earlier when she was vacuuming the hall at 9:00am and deliberately banging the vacuum against our room door to ensure we were up already). Next minute at 10:02am the room phone rings, “Hello, have you checked out already its 10am? “, Its 10:02am I replied, how can we have checked out already if I am talking on the room phone to you? We are on our way down. Never, in hundreds of hotels, across the world, have we been treated in such a way, its 10am precisely, your time’s up, now get out of our hotel. As a middle-aged couple, we are not accustomed to being treated as irresponsible guests, we left feeling completely unwelcome. Needless to say we will never be staying here again, a nice location for the price but the rudest most inhospitable staff, I have ever encountered (especially the indignant housekeeping staff). No customer service or even common manners. How disappointing.
