title: Perfect location and couldn't fault anything
text:
If you don't have a car, then this place is absolutely perfect, location-wise. Easy and short walking distance from the river, lake, city centre, local buses, and 2 supermarkets. 
My studio room on the 2nd floor was clean, quiet, and the bed very comfortable. I liked finding a thin cushion  that was perfect for a pillow. A lot of people suffer from the large pillows that most hotels use, so I had 3 nights of pain free sleep. It was also nice having windows that properly open to get fresh air in.
The staff were very pleasant and helpful when required. The only problem I had was a slightly temperamental shower, but that was fixed almost immediately after I called reception. 
The room (223) has a shower over the bath, so it involves having to step into the bath- this could be difficult (or dangerous) for some people. It was mentioned in the room info so I knew in advance. I don't know if all the rooms have that setup.
I had the breakfast buffet a couple of times, it had a good selection for a good price. My only gripe was they suddenly removed the filter coffee for a fancy machine that made fancy coffees, but nothing plain. The lovely staff member went a made me a filter coffee especially, which was really appreciated :)  
Overall, I couldn't fault anything, and I would definitely stay there again, and highly recommend this hotel.

2. Furnishings - basic but comfortable with a small fridge which was useful, tea and coffee making faclities, iron etc. 

3. Surprised to see a very small dipping pool in the front of the hotel near reception. 

4. Like the fact that there was on-site and covered parking. 

5. Good quiet a/c and heat pump in the room and both shampoo and conditioner in the bathroom. 

6. Complimentary and generously laid out continental breakfast in the lobby 

Not so great IMO (in my opinion):

1.  My only negative comment was regarding the cleanliness. I am not completely sure that the bedsheets and pillow cases are changed daily. There were dark coloured strands of hair on the pillows on the bed and one of the pillows had an obvious large blood stain which I requested the staff change. They did immediately. 

2. Water pressure for showering was not ideal in the bathroom. 

Fair value for NZ$150 for a room for 2

title: A suitable place to stay
text:
We checked in very quickly on a Monday afternoon and having prepaid helped a great deal. We chose the Ventura Inn & Suites due to the reasonable proximity to the local hospital where a loved one was undergoing a serious procedure. We chose a share twin as the most economical option.
I often feel that some reviews can be seen through a prism of some sort. For me on this occasion the prism would be that of a mildly disabled person. A week or so prior to the stay, I had injured my neck which left me with a very sore arm. This will inform some of the following review.
The room had a fairly standard layout with a cupboard with ironing board, spare blanket and plenty of space on the left followed by a desk space, TV and a set of drawers. Beyond this there was a table and chairs for dining at or other activities such as organising paperwork. The main space had a double and a single bed. The double was very close to the window, though not onerous, it was a bit tight when windows needed opening or curtains closing. In-between the beds was a small console and light switches. When the management plan their next upgrades or refurbishments, they might like to consider where their electrical plugs are placed. At first we could not find them. Then I went on hands and knees to see them under the console. I plugged my equipment in with difficulty due to my sore arm. 
Just to the left of the bathroom door was the tea and coffee alcove furnished with a good sized fridge. 
The bathroom was spotless and cleaned to a very high standard. On the right was the vanity with a very well lit mirror. One minor point was the surface space around the sink could have been larger, as we could not easily place our toiletry bags there. 
The towels were very well laundered and clean. On the left was a combination shower and bath with a very good curtain. However, one improvement the management might like to consider, concerns the shower. I jumped in to shower and found there was no shelf space at a good height to place the soap and shampoo. There was the back of the bath with a few spots, but these were close to ankle height. Given my injury, I had to be careful managing this. So a small basket or shelf at a good height by the shower would be a big help! 
I chose the single bed and I can say that for the four nights I stayed here, I slept superbly. There was minimal traffic noise, apart from one night where the peal of sirens broke the night, not unexpected in the middle of a city. 
The mornings were spent downstairs at breakfast. This suited us perfectly, it was simple fair with enough choice to satisfy. That said, the toaster took some fathoming and I am unsure if we fully mastered it. Of commendable note was the provision of gluten free cereal. Though I do not suffer this condition, I expect anyone who does would really appreciate it!  
For evening meals, we had ours delivered by a company promoted in the rooms, dining mostly on Italian cuisine which was of a good standard and reasonably priced.
During most of the days I was working as the hospital visit times for me were the late afternoon early evenings. The hotel WiFi was my main internet connection for the stay. It was largely reliable, though it dropped the connection a few times. This did not have a material impact on my work, not was it frustrating. The room proved a good place to work, with a great ability to focus resulting from the relative quiet. At times the housekeeper came in and arrived the room as I continued to work in a very efficient and friendly manner. Indeed, all the staff were polite and proficient.
Overall, I would say this stay was very nice. Sure, a few minor enhancements would improve things, but these may already be considered for future maintenance. The good nights sleep were worth more than any of these minor inconveniences. Well done Ventura Inn and Suites!

The hotel was very WARM!!! During the cold nights (which went down to 4 degrees some nights) it was not even necessary to put the heat pump on. The hotel is well insulated & heaters are on throughout the hotel.

Unfortunately the Inn does not cater for those who are gluten-intolerant.
They only have one gluten-free cereal available which I am not particular to. No gluten-free bread so it was left to me to purchase gluten-free bread.
At the least, the staff should of gone out to purchase some GF bread.
The lobby carpeting could do with an upgrade as it is looking a bit sad & moldy in some spots.

All in all....it was an excellent stay.
Well done Ventura Hamilton!

title: Nice Motel - fantastic location, covered parking etc
text:
I will stay here again.

This motel was very easy to find when searching on line for a Motel in Hamilton with a Spa pool or Spa bath.

Ventura is fabulously located in Hamilton CBD, a short walk to all the restaurants and night life, supermarkets, Waikato Polytech and all the central commercial buildings in town.

We were welcomed by a friendly and efficient check in person who explained everything and directed us to covered parking, thank you Hone (foreign readers ->> Hone is a Maori name).

Breakfast was included and it was a very good spread of pastries, fruit, cereals, toast  and drinks. It was all fresh tasting and I think gives guests a great start to the day.

Decor is very much late 1990's but the public area's are kept clean and tidy. If you want lots of modern colours and pzazz, this is not the place for you.

The room was a good size, the bed comfortable and linen clean.

There was however one GLARING problem, THE HOUSE KEEPING IN THE ROOM WAS GLARINGLY BAD. This place is at the top of the slide down if they do not fix the following:

1. Black mold in the tile grout for the tiles over the spa bath. Clearly house keeping do not like to reach over the corner spa bath so at the furthermost point of reach/stretch for a cleaner a large amount of black mold has taken hold............ yuck (20cm line with branches off it)

2. Cobwebs hanging for 2m along one wall from window frame to corner of wall. Come on, cobwebs should not even be visible, let alone 2m of them!!

3. The single large ceiling light is a dish type that has a large pile of dead insects in it. This fitting is prominent in the room and another case of..... no care in the little things either.

Finally, something quite telling. There is a new toilet seat in the room, one of the cheapest, light weight plastic things you can buy, something you would expect to find in a school toilet. For another $30.00 people would feel they are in luxury, but instead this shows an air of penny pinching = decline in standards. (Oh..... and the lift jolts and shudders so bad that my wife only walked the stairs after the first experience = cheap servicing regime)

At present it was comfortable, great location and good food, I just hope this place picks up its game because I want to say here again.

I wonder if the owners read tripadvisor??? (it was room 220)

title: Many pluses
text: Ventura Inn is a pleasant three - storey accommodation serviced by an elevator is close to the city centre, and has mostly covered car parking. It is well equipped at this level.  In the living area we have a fine desk, smart dining table and three chairs, TV - and an uncomfortable lounge that has no place in an establishment of this standard!  There is a wardrobe and very comfortable bed with bedside tables and lamps in the bedroom.  The bathroom has a smart vanity, nice WC, and a very long bath with a satisfying shower above. The unit has good lighting, ample power points and comes with generous wifi allocation.  In the mornings we enjoy the great continental breakfast provided in the downstairs breakfast room, along with the complimentary newspaper.  This unit has many pluses.  However, the uncomfortable lounge appears to be a fold-away bed.  I feel that the present slightly cramped two room format spoils what would be a delightful unit for two, a design choice made to accommodate what would be a very tight accommodation for four.  Nevertheless, on balance, 5/5.

This our fourth stay at the hotel and would still recommend it to all. The receptionist on the Saturday afternoon always remembers us, always polite and friendly. Rooms very clean, apart from a couple of hairs on the bathroom floor, but other than that spotless. All the staff are friendly courteous and very helpful. Great location only short stroll to everything. The complimentary breakfast is ideal way to start the day. 
All in all yet another great night at the hotel and so good we booked again for May to see the phantom of the opera. See you then
hotel_response:
Dear TVNZ
thanks for staying with us once again and for another great your review recommending our hotel. We look forward to seeing you again in May. We have just released two Phantom of the Opera accommodation and ticket packages which you may like to contact us about (we can always change your existing booking if it was made directly with us).
Kind regards
Chris Parker
Ventura Inn & Suites Hamilton

title: Quick Break
text:
Third time i have stayed here different rooms each time happy every time ,
recommend.Traffic noise not to bad , supermarkets within easy walking distance.
Staff helpful and friendly.Parking plentyful.

title: our night in hamilton
text: Always enjoy my stay at Ventura, the reception was excellent and helpful with directions (as we live in Rotorua)...would love if the walls were soundproof though, people were knocking on our door and open/closing of doors and able to hear conversations.
hotel_response:
Dear Mereiro H

Thanks for taking the time to pass on your comments. I'm glad you always enjoy staying with us. With regard to the soundproofing, the walls are solid concrete and we get very few noise complaints. The sound you heard was most likely guests in the hallway which can difficult for any hotel to control. 

We look forward to hosting you again the next time you are in Hamilton.

Kind regards
Chris Parker
Ventura Inn & Suites Hamilton

title: Ok motel, ok location
text: Stayed for 1 night with two kids in a standard suite. The suite is relatively small and the cleanliness of our room was just ok - e.g. sheets had some stains left over in them, some stains on the wall, pool had leaves in it. Nice to have continental breakfast included in the rate. Overall OK accomodation for the price paid. Staff was very helpful.

title: Need to speed up the bed linen renewal. URGENTLY!
text: Imagine my surprise upon entering my room to find a big burn patch in the bedspread! Reading trip advisor I see they are about to start a linen renewal process throughout the joint but this is the poorest of poor. Went out for dinner with colleague who stayed here 15 days ago and to my surprise told me he stayed in a room with a big burn in the bedspread! What do you know, same room! Appalling at any level and irrespective of the relatively low room rate of $115. The room did however pass the bed bug inspection so well done there.
hotel_response:
Dear ClivenMel
Thanks for taking the time to post your feedback on TripAdvisor. As previously stated we are excited to be introducing new bed linen which will greatly enhance our guest experience. 
Kind regards
Chris Parker
Ventura Inn & Suites Hamilton

title: Great price and location
text: Really impressed with this hotel.  There was such a lovely helpful girl on the desk when we arrived late at night.  Rooms very clean with good facilities.  Great to have the convenience of a simple continental buffet breakfast by the pool area.  Would definitely stay here again.
hotel_response:
Dear Jo429
Thanks for your lovely review and I'm glad you had a great stay with us. We look forward to hosting you again the next time you're in Hamilton.
Kind regards
Chris Parker
Ventura Inn & Suites Hamilton

title: Mixed Feelings

Kind regards

Ventura Inn & Suites Hamilton

title: Tried and Trustworthy

Kind regards

title: Cheap and easy
text:
I stayed at this hotel with a friend because it was affordable and conveniently located.

While the hotel is nothing special, at $110/night including breakfast (a very simple breakfast) it provided good value for money to spend a Saturday night in Hamilton. It's an easy 5 min walk to all the bars and restaurants. It takes about 30 minutes to walk to the Hamilton Gardens.

Staff were friendly and the rooms were nice and clean. The bathroom is also very spacious.

Recommended
hotel_response:
Dear acarb83
thanks for your feedback - I'm glad you found our hotel to be convenient and value for money. We look forward to seeing you again the next time you're in Hamilton.
Kind regards
Chris Parker
Ventura Inn & Suites Hamilton

text: Stayed for 1 night, nice and spacious room. Free parking with breakfast provided. Location is perfect for all amenities. Reasonably priced. title: Great value for money
text:

Great package online including continental breakfast for 2, king bed, spa (but didn't use it).
Friendly staff other than the call at 10.55a asking us why we hadn't left when check out was 11a, sure it was close to 11a but we hadn't overstayed our time by any means.
There is a pool and gym but we didn't use them.
Free parking and free wireless which was awesome when so many hotels charge you an arm and a leg for both.

Ventura Inn & Suites Hamilton

title: value for  money

title: More hotel like than motel like
text:
Stayed here as location was perfect for work.  Very helpful and welcoming front desk team for both stays.  They honestly did a great job in getting everything sorted for me.
The room was decent size with nice bathroom.  First stay very clean.  Not bad on second stay (hair in shower etc but nothing to warrant a complaint).  Very good bathroom amenities.
Bed was nice.  I found it firm isn which I like.  Air con unit in my room made it much more comfortable than having to rely on open windows.
Only point of note is that there arent any in room kitchen facilities.  Could only make hot beverages.  Don't plan on being able to eat in your room unless its a snack etc
Overall nice place to stay.
hotel_response:
Dear Robert H

thanks for your review. I'm glad you enjoyed your stay and the facilities we offer. You're correct that our rooms are more hotel style, rather than motel style. Only our suites have kitchen facilities - however for guests staying in studio rooms, we have a microwave available in our breakfast area for guest use, along with trays, cutlery, crockery etc. We also have an extensive in-room dining menu available from Scoff which delivers to the hotel. 

Kind regards
Chris Parker
Ventura Inn & Suites Hamilton

The complimentary continental breakfast buffet was lovely with plenty of variety (we brought it back to our room). The staff were wonderful, I'll happily stay here again next time I'm in Hamilton.

title: Absolutely brilliant!
text:
We had to rush to Hamilton due to my brother being airlifted into hospital due to a vehicle accident. Come 8pm we realised we had to find some accommodation for the night. The Ventura Inn had a special for $99 for a room and it was close to the hospital as well. 

When I checked in the Receptionist was brilliant! She managed to take my mind off my brother for a little bit letting me relax while she checked me in. It was smooth and pain free, the best check in experience I've had any where. 

Later that night (about 11pm) we left the hospital to get some sleep. Drove straight in with plenty of parking. Straight up stairs and into our room which was spacious, tidy and well presented. We crashed into bed and were up by 7 the next morning for a quick shower and to check out. Again the check out was smooth and pain free and th lay out of the hotel was great. Everything was easy to find, well sign posted and tidy.  

Highly recommend them for price, location and staff.
hotel_response:
Dear CatM22
thanks for your lovely review. Due to our location we regularly host guests who are visiting the Waikato Hospital campus and I'm glad we were able to help at the last minute following your brother's accident. I hope he's on the way to a full recovery.
Kind regards
Chris Parker
Ventura Inn & Suites Hamilton

Kind regards

title: Great Stay
text:
We arrived at 1am in the morning from Auckland and the man who was on the reception let us in and checked us in right away.  He was very friendly and it was nice to see someone who understood that we were tired and wanted to head straight to the room. 

We were put on level 2.  We stayed for 2 nights. I stayed in the room with my parents. For 3 people it wasn't too bad.  We weren't in the room much as we were in Hamilton for the Barbershop National Competition which was at Founders Theatre.  We were out most of the day. Everything is in close proximity to this hotel by car. 

We had a comfortable stay and the beds were absolutely fabulous and comfortable. The bathroom and hotel room was kept very clean. There was a wardrobe to hang our clothes and a table to eat our takeaways.  It was very accommodating.  Breakfast was also a nice treat before we left to go about our day.  I ate the English muffins. 

I recommend this hotel for all who come to Hamilton for business or events.  I will be back again.

Thank you very much Ventura Inn :)

Ventura Inn & Suites Hamilton

title: Perfect accomodation for business travel
text:
The motel is very pleasant with good facilities for someone travelling for business. My room was on the second floor, it was really comfortable and seemed pretty clean though I didn't like their pillows (They don't use a pillow protector so there's always a faint whiff of someone else having used it) Staff were average in their welcome, they didn't ask what I was there for or if I needed any information about the motel, the area etc. At breakfast the staff didn't speak to guests at all, and there was a very quiet uncomfortable atmosphere. However, the complimentary breakfast was very nice, to be honest was one of the reasons I chose the place as I didn't want to have to worry about taking food or finding somewhere to eat before the appointment that brought me to Hamilton. I ordered dinner too, from Scoff, which was delivered in quick smart time, was hot and great value. Great idea for them to work together to serve decent evening meals for guests. 
I would definitely stay there again for work, but not sure if I'd bring family. It doesn't feel like a family place and I was woken up by loud voices and footsteps up and down the stairs at 6.30am - wouldn't be impressed if I was away for a family break or holiday.
hotel_response:
Hi Maagee
thanks for taking the time to post a review of your stay. We're glad you enjoyed the continental breakfast and were able to make use of the in-room dining provided by Scoff. I'm sorry that the staff weren't more welcoming on this stay - I'll definitely pass your comments on to the team. 
We look forward to having you stay with us again in the future.
Kind regards
Chris Parker
Ventura Inn & Suites Hamilton

title: Average Accom

Stayed here on a Friday night on our way to Auckland.  Not a bad location, within walking distance to main street etc.

Don't think I would stay here again due to rubbish trucks collecting the bins from beneath the hotel at 5am on a Saturday morning - not impressed

As for the rubbish truck, I am unsure who this was as our rubbish day is a Monday morning after 9.00 am, but I will definitely look into this for you.
Once again, I apology for any inconvenience caused.
Regards,
Ventura Inn & Suites

The rooms were modern clean and quiet. Friendly staff, safe off street parking and a continental buffet breakfast sealed topped off a very enjoyable stay.

title: A good central place for business and short stays
text: I stayed in a standard suite for 2 nights which was spacious and had evertyhing I required so was good, it would have been better with an additional TV and AC in the bedroom and not just the lounge.  The value was good at $139 p/night for the room which included a good continental breakfast.  There was a problem with the AC unit in the room not heating to a set 23-24*C warmer temp as it kept turning off even though it was still cold.  The one thing I wasn't impressed with was how dirty and stained the fabric chairs for the table & desk were.  These were badly stained/soiled with grime stains and discolouring that there was only 1 out of the 3 I would sit or put anything on.  I wouldn't choose to holiday there with my family as the pool is small, was closed when I was there, and the fitness room is very small with limited old and basic equipment and there is no grounds or additonal space/facilities for kids etc. Apart from this the location, value and friendly and helpful staff made it a good work stay.
hotel_response:
Good Afternoon,
Thank you for the feedback.  We greatly appreciate you taking the time to let us know.
I will make sure the chairs are steam-cleaned immediately, we are very sorry for the inconvenience caused.
We look forward to seeing you again next time you are in Hamilton on business.

title: All the creature comforts for a great price
text:
Coming from Auckland I stayed in a Deluxe Studio for the weekend.  Room was value for money, clean and comfortable especially the Kingsize bed, aircon, blackout curtains and spabath. Loved the plunger coffee!! Free Continental buffet breakfast was welcoming especially as nearest eatery was a few streets away. 
The rooms are not soundproof so you can hear people walking up and down hallway and stairs or chatting outside their rooms, but otherwise a quiet and relaxing environment. One let down would be that I wasnt told at Reception while making enquiries that there was a free bus that ran past the hotel every ten minutes so I spent most of the day walking several blocks to get to City centre and back so probably pays to research on public transport or the city itself in terms of eateries, banks and attractions. Overall a pleasant experience and I would stay there again.
hotel_response:
Hi,
Many thanks for the positive feedback.  That’s great to hear you had an enjoyable stay with us.
I have now added a brochure at reception with the 'free' bus route for guest convenience.
We look forward to seeing you again :)

title: Great place to launch from
text: We stayed at the Ventura as a mid way base point for our trip.  We spent our days and evenings out and about with friends and the Ventura was awesome for us.  The complimentary Continental Breakfast was a real bonus allowing us to start the day easy and there was plenty to choose. The staff were on to it and friendly, especially the cleaning ladies! The room was great with a really quiet air-con and a good bed so we had good sleeps. The shower and spa bath were excellent. It is located a 2min stroll from the night life of Hamilton, just far enough to have no noise at night and no need for taxi's. There is an awesome supermarket across the road for easy drinks and snacks. The undercover parking was a real bonus as the weather wasn't. If you are wanting a place to stay and be real convenient to the Heart of Hamilton the Ventura is awesome value for money.

title: Nice stopover
text: Staff was very nice and approachable. Rooms were clean, bed a tas uncomfortable. Free wifi and breakfast was nice. Gym consisted of three cardio machines and an old weight machine. Really close to the hub of the city, many many good resteraunts in short walking distance

title: Excellent
text: This is our preferred hotel when we are staying in Hamilton. It is conveniently located, the room is always clean and the continental breakfast included is always good value. The only downside is the road noise which can be a bit of a bugbear, but this is a problem with most of the places we have stayed at in Hamilton.

title: Weekend in Hamilton
text:
In the Tron for daughters 21st.  
Ventura is really close to the action in the Hamilton CBD.
Staff were very polite and helpful.
Complimentary continental breakfast, while not lavish, hit the spot.
We stayed in one of the suites and had another daughter and her friend in tow, so had to use the sofa bed - which was not that comfortable.  But then the incremental cost was not that great.

title: Recommend this hotel to anyone
text:
This was second time we stayed here and again we were not disappointed. We did the Skycity deal and it is good value for money. From the moment you walk through the door the staff are friendly polite and will help in any way. The same lady booked us in this time and we remembered her due to her pleasant nature. When we explained why we remembered her she thanked us and promised to remember us the next time we went.
The location is close to town and only short stroll to the city but in a quiet location
The rooms are big and the spa bath great. They are clean and tidy. The only issue we had was the two wine glasses were of different size but reception sorted that out quickly. 
Considering continental breakfast is complimentary it was great
I have nothing but praise for this hotel and its staff and I will be staying there again and would recommend it to everyone
hotel_response:
Good Morning,
First and foremost, I would like to thank you for your amazing feedback on Ventura Inn & Suites - we are so glad you enjoyed our Stay & Play Package & your time with us.
We look forward to seeing you again :)

title: Great value for money and so convenient
text:
My first overnighter in Hamilton for work and I booked the special Stay and Play at the Ventura (it came with a Continental BFast) .

A bottle of bubbles upon arrival was a treat, so was the spa bath.  the room itself was good and I was also provided with 100MB of WIFI.  It was clean and tidy and the ladies at reception were polite and good to deal with. 

It is in such a handy location, only 5 mins to the main centre.  I'll be booking another stay again next week.

title: Convenient Location
text:
I stayed here in order to attend a friends wedding.  This Hotel was very conveniently located Central to the main centre of Hamilton.  It was a very early noon wedding so after all the formalities and wedding reception we where able to walk down to a local pub where there was a great two piece band playing, we sang along to some great tunes and even tried their oysters and duck pate. 
We had a comfortable bed and the breakfast the next morning was complimentary and a nice touch to our stay, thanks Ventura.

title: Fantastic Stay, friendly staff
text: We love staying at the Ventura. Staff are friendly and helpful, and go out of their way to make you feel welcome. It's in a great location, and the rooms are always clean and well-serviced. The complimentary continental breakfast is great, and there is plenty of parking.

title: Good value for money
text: Have stayed here now several times. Very good value for money. Rooms are clean, nice clean bathroom. Close to cafes and restaurants. Breakfast is a nice bonus. Have booked our next 5 night stay already.

title: Great people
text: We always stay here on our trips to Hamilton. Never fail to get a warm and friendly welcome at reception. Rooms are clean and spacious and the spa bath is my favourite. A real bonus is the complimentary breakfast and free parking.. We will be back.

title: Lovely stay
text: Stayed for a night at Ventura, staff were friendly, the room was clean and the continental buffet breakfast put us to a good start for a new day. I would highly recommend Ventura to anyone wanting value for money in terms of accommodation, it felt like home - nothing luxurious but so comfortable it's enjoyable!

title: Convenient place to stay
text: Visiting Hamilton for a couple of days of conference.  Great location, handy to shops and restaurants.  The motel rooms are clean & comfortable. Plenty of free parking.  Would be happy to stay here again :-)

title: clean, friendly, free breakfast
text: I like the rooms, which are very clean and I like having a bath, not just a shower. The free breakfast is a bonus that makes the price worthwhile and the breakfast area is handy during the day for hanging out. Free parking, mostly undercover, which is great.

title: Convenient
text: Walking distance to lots of eateries, covering wide range of tastes and prices. Comfortable room, clean and roomy for travellers. Breakfast was included also. Good location for catching a flight from Auckland next afternoon. We walked to the lake also for a coffee and a break after we arrived - bit of a climb but worth it. Glad we asked at the desk.

title: Good location, comfortable room
text: We stayed one night in Hamilton to go to Raglan beach and to see the Hamilton Gardens.  The hotel was in a good location within walking distance of the city centre.  There are some good reasonably priced cafes and restaurants close by.  The room was comfortable and the continental free breakfast was a great bonus.  The free parking was handy as the city is mainly paid parking.  Recommended.

title: Dissapointed
text: Have stayed there many times and have never had cause for complaint. Unfortunately not this time. There has been a water leak near reception and the corridor from there to the accommodation wreaked of wet carpet. Our deluxe suite room was clean and tidy as per normal.All was fine until about 10.00pm when one of the rooms above us decided to turn on the jets in their spa bath for 45 minutes. It felt like our whole room was vibrating. Reception offered to move us to another room when we complained about the noise but a 10.30 at night after a very busy day it was too much hassle to move. Within minutes of the spa bath stopping their was a dripping pipe behind the wall ( maybe the reason for the smell down stairs) that dripped very loudly for the rest of the night. The noise from people coming and going from the town bar/restaurant area was also unusually loud.Unfortunately not much sleep this night.
hotel_response:
First and foremost, I would like to thank you for bringing your concerns to my attention – any feedback whether it be good or bad is welcome and helps us retain and keep our standards to all guests satisfaction.  Any negative feedback is taken extremely seriously and I thank you for taking the time to let us know your concerns.
The 'wet carpet' issue you have outlined was from our conference room air-con unit which leaked, which has now been rectified (including carpet cleaning).
As for the noise issues you have commented on, I truly do believe this was a one off incident; however I have now put guidelines in place to ensure that all hallways are checked by our staff members who are onsite 24 hours per day. 
I hope your latest stay at Ventura Inn & Suites doesn’t stop you from returning in the future.  We greatly value your patron.  
Once again I am very sorry for the inconvience and I look forward to seeing you again soon.

title: Good location for town
text: This was an alternative to the Novotel hotel in town since the Novotel was full and asking around NZD400 per room per night. Decided to try Ventura Inn as an alternative and was very happy with the room. Lots of parking available and the staff were friendly (however not very efficient). The location was good, easy to walk home after a night out in town, but I would also comment that the breakfast spread was not special, not a reason to wake up for. Also, even on a very hot weekend, the pool was not nice or enticing enough to go for a splash. Although in saying this, all in all, I think I would use the Venture over the Novotel now.

title: Pleasant motel and convenient for town centre
text: Stayed here for two nights with my wife and 26 year old son. Spacious and clean rooms with free, fast wifi. Pleasant and helpful staff. Plenty of parking spaces. Within walking distance of some great bars and restaurants. Would stay here again and recommend to friends.

title: Good accommodation and friendly staff
text: Good accommodation and friendly staff. The breakfast was included, the rooms were clean, and complimentary high-speed Internet wireless access was provided. This is a great location within walking distance to supermarket and restaurants.

title: Very tidy & good value
text: Would definately stay here again. The staff were friendly and helpful & the room was tidy and clean. Breakfast was included in the room rate and was very good with lots of choice. There is onsite parking available also.

title: A very pleasant experience
text: My husband and I have stayed here 3 or 4 times before and believe it is great value for money.The fresh,clean units are so appreciated and the breakfast ( which you can have in bed if you like ) is such a bonus. We love staying here.

title: Good experience
text: Pleasant accomodation, friendly staff.  Great location, within walking distance to supermarket, cafes, and restaurants.  We enjoyed the breakfast, the rooms were clean and tidy, however we found the beds uncomfortable and the gym was lacking.  Would consider staying there again.

title: Very good value
text: My wife and I stayed at the Ventura for two nights while we were having a couple of rooms redecorated at our property. The staff were very friendly, which always helps on arrival, and the rooms were clean and spacious. Surprisingly quiet being so close to the city centre. We had free under cover parking and this along with the free wifi and free continental breakfast made the hotel very good value. Would definitely stay again.

title: Great
text:
We have stayed here twice now and we like it as it is easy to find. staff are frendly and helpful. rooms are tidy and clean. good walking distance from town. Breakfast is great love all the pastrys. 
will definitely stay here again if we are in hamilton.

title: Great location
text: We stayed here so we could walk to the theatre to see a live show. Great location, central to nice restaurants, great service, great staff with reception manned 24 hours. Breakfast was included in the cost and very nice. Will stay again

title: Peaceful Stay
text:
We have attended Parachute Music Festival in Hamilton for the last five years. This is the first time we have stayed at Ventura and it was the best decision ever. We will definitely stay here again. The staff are incredibly helpful and friendly and our room was lovely...very tidy and clean. The complimentary breakfast was a well appreciated plus. My daughter (3 1/2) had wanted to swim in the pool but we didn't have time during the weekend. I asked the staff if we could have a swim as I checked out and they were fine with that, even supplying us with a towel.
The Inn has a lovely decor and has a very peaceful feeling about it. The fact it is so close to Mystery Creek was a plus for us too. The previous years we had had to drive through town which added time to what can seem a long drive each evening. Will definitely book in for next year!
hotel_response: Thank you very much for the positive feedback.  We are extremely glad you enjoyed your stay with Ventura Inn & Suites; we look forward to seeing you again :)

title: Very friendly and courteous staff
text:
We were there for a convention and the breakfast really helped which was one less worry. Neat room and good place to stay. Would choose to stay there again if opportunity arise.

Located conveniently to all the main city restaurants and supermarkets.

title: Hamilton
text: breakfast run severely short of  items on a monday morning at 8.30am...hotel a bit too expensive for what has to offer. Small gym, with 3 machines, 1 broken, the other in suspicious conditions. staff ok, no complains, rooms were clean but a bit crumped for 4 people as advertised. missing a towel set for the fourth guest in the room. not enough sugar for coffee, only three litle bags looking like "recycled"...

title: Good Value
text: Had to spend two nights in Hamilton,Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. Chose Ventura because of its location. Very pleased with our room, clean and comfortable. The complimentary breakfast was excellent and made it good value. Staff pleasant and helpful. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Top Marks
text: Was in Hamilton for a golf weekend with some mates. Chose Ventura as was handy to golf courses and some local bars. Clean comfy rooms and friendly staff. Good free breakfast free - however would be good to get some bacon and eggs. Found a local cafe across the road for that. Surprised to see they had a pool (little on the small though). Overall good stay - definitely stay again next time in the Tron.

title: Dewy time
text: From the moment we stepped into the hotel the greeting was excellent from the receptionist to every staff member we interacted with, we enjoyed our 3day stay, the rooms were immaculate and very comfortable and cosy, the showers were awesome, complimentary breakfast and the lovely pool to cool off in topped off a wonderful town. Thank you and well done we will definitely come again!

title: awesome place to stay
text:
on entering reception we got immediate attention and the receptionist went out of her way to accommodate us even when we asked for help 
the breakfast was what we will come back again for and being so handy to everything in town Well done Ventura
hotel_response: Many thanks for your kind review.  We greatly value your patron & we look forward to hosting you again next time you are staying in Hamilton :)

title: Great place to stay with outstanding staff
text: We are frequent visitors to Hamilton and this is our venue of choice. Try the one in Rotorua too. They are both excellent. Staff are friendly and extremely helpful. We will be back again. Love the pool and the complimentary breakfast.

title: Excellent value
text: Great location; staff were very friendly and helpful (one of them suggested something for us to do on Christmas Day); free breakfast with lots of variety (great for families); free WiFi; free parking (and lots of it). Rooms were decent, large, and clean. Definitely excellent value for money.

title: Good value
text: We spent one night at the Ventura Inn. It's in a good location near cafes and a supermarket. The rooms were nice and clean. The staff were really friendly. Continental Breakfast is included and there is a nice variety of cereals, bread, pastries and juices. It's a hotel I'd recommend!

title: Good location with friendly helpfull staff
text: We stayed in December in a basic room which was clean and of reasonable size. The motel offered good facilities and we enjoyed a confortable overnight stay and satisfying breakefast in the forecourt the next morning as part of the package. Apart from noise from the car park on site and building worksite nearby at 7.00 am, it was a pleasant stay.

title: Good place to stay in Hamilton
text: Good location close to CBD yet not within the noisy areas. Staff very pleasant and attentive, and really has everything needed for a short stay. Complimentary breakfast is a nice feature. Ample parking.

title: Affordable and comfortable
text: Was pleasantly suprised with the quality of this room considering the price.  Room was spacious and had all the basic amenities.  Couldnt believe the choice of food at the breakfast buffet considering it was built into the room price.  Much nicer than some large chain hotels who make you pay $25. Would I stay there again, absolutely!

title: Good Location, Nice rooms
text:
Staff were friendly, room was a reasonable size, beds very soft (too soft for me but won't hold that against them!). The free wifi & breakfast were a real hit. Great continental breakfast came with the room which we were very happy with.
Criticisms - booked a room for three but had to go to reception to get a third towel, the complementary tea/coffee was very minimal and only for two - if you book & pay for three you expect the room to be set up for three. 
Cleaning left alot to be desired and it was such a shame that the stay was spoiled by this - would have been very happy to stay here again if it hadn't been for this.
The toilets in the lobby were filthy, rubbish all over the floor, grimey sinks with dirty marks all over them. The bathroom in the room seemed ok, and only just ok, with the bathmat still being damp & shower curtain marked, went to use the toilet brush provided to find it covered in faecal matter - just disgusting.
Loved the breakfast, it was the quietest motel/hotel room I have ever had in Hamilton, and I have stayed in quite a few, but the lack of cleanliness really put me off.

title: Good value for money
text: We stayed for one night at the Ventura Inn and Suites and we had an enjoyable experience. The room was slightly dated, but it was spacious and clean. The service was friendly and helpful and we were made to feel welcome. The complimentary breakfast was nothing spectacular but it was nice and very reasonable considering the price we paid for our room. I would recommend this to people who want a inexpensive and reliable place to stay. I would probably stay here again.
hotel_response:
First and foremost, I would like to thank you for bringing your concerns to my attention – any feedback whether it be good or bad is welcome and helps us retain and keep our standards to all guests satisfaction.  Any negative feedback is taken extremely seriously and I thank you for taking the time to let us know your concerns.

We have discussed the cleanliness issues you mentioned as a team to avoid this happening again while looking at alternate options available.  Once again I would like to express that this is not our usual protocol and hygiene and cleanliness is something that we all take VERY seriously.

I hope your latest stay at Ventura Inn & Suites doesn’t stop you from returning in the future.  We greatly value your patron.

title: Convenient and Friendly
text: Picked this online as we were looking for something cheap and cheerful for a gorup travelling to Hamilton to attend a wedding. Was expecting something very basic for the price, and was very pleasently surprised.  The rooms were clean and tidy and the staff very helpul. Appreciated the continental breakfast too.  Only slight disapointment was the fitness room, which had 2 of the 4  pieces of equipment out of order. Ventura is handily placed just a couple of blocks from the main shopping streets. Would definitely stay there again.

title: Convenient location
text: The staff were great, the location was convenient, short walk to city centre and loads of restaurants. The breakfast in the morning was good, not so good coffee. Room was clean and comfortable. Beds good.

title: Value for money
text: Spent a couple of nights here. The reception staff very friendly and helpful. Good room but it smelt probably because of smokers - had to buy air freshener. Bed comfortable and bath/shower OK. Good location being only a couple of blocks from restaurants. Continental breakfast OK but not great. Overall happy and felt it was good value for money.

title: Clean and reasonably priced
text: This was a good place to stay for a night on our way back up to Auckland. Pretty standard hotel with a free continental breakfast in the morning. Short walk into town which was handy for dinner. Pretty good value for money.

title: Clean and comfortable
text:
For our one night stay, we found this hotel to be pretty clean and comfortable.  The room was clean and the establishment was quite tidy.  For the price paid, it was very reasonable for what we did get (room and breakfast).  Location was great, as we could walk to restaurants around the CBD.  

We'd consider staying here again.

title: Clean and tidy
text: Had to stop for the night in The tron, this hotel is nicely priced, clean and tidy. Would stay again.

title: No Dissappointment to be found here.
text:
Reservation desk on phone helpful, staff from reception to cleaners were all extremely helpful.
This stay was only 3 nights  but it seemed longer as no traffic noise to wake me up.Situated in a cul de sac means no boy racers to be heard.Continental breakfast is more than a box of weet-bix and milk and toast.On this occasion there was 3 types of cereals,fresh and canned fruit,toast and crumpets,yoghurt,muffins and danishes and tea and coffee.All inclusive on this stay as well as bottle of lindeur bubbly and $10 skycity food/beverage voucher per night.(Stay and Play Package)
Staying in queen spa room,had new samsung 32'' flat screen LCD which is more than adequate.(Room 220)
Free car parking and easy walking distance to CBD.
If weather is not the best , or it is late, there is a free shuttle to casino( run by others) that will pick up and drop off to hotels.

Extremely happy with stay and establishment......i recommend Ventura Inn Hamilton giving it 2 big thumbs up and happy smiliey  face.

title: Great value
text:
Clean, spacious and comfortable. Free parking. Swimming pool would have been good if we had the weather!!
Continental breakfast very good.
We used as overnight stop but would be good for longer stay in Hamilton.
Cheap and cheerful.

title: Clean friendly and well priced
text: Well priced motel style facilities including a laundry room, rooms are clean and spacious with very helpful staff. It also has self-catering suites for families or longer stay residents, but the staff also allow you to use their kitchen and microwave if you are in a normal room. Reception has DVD players that you can borrow and a large video collection - all free . The motel is a 3 minute walk from the excellent Hood Street for restaurants and bars, 2 minute walk to the Waikato river, 5 minute walk to the beautiful lake, and two supermarkest just across the road. Breakfast is basic, as is the fitness suite (only three machines - and very creaky!).

title: Value for Money
text:
We had a deluxe studio with a king bed which was well decorated and spacious. A plentiful and fresh continental breakfast (complimentary) was served in a pleasant area from 06.30 to 10.00am.The whole place looked very clean and well maintained,there was free internet in the lobby and free on site parking which was a bonus.
It was within easy walking distance of restaurant,offices and shops and I would not hesitate to stay here again.I thought it represented very good value.

title: Good value
text: We have stayed here several times and are always pleased.  The room is always clean and quiet.  Breakfast is included and good.  Within walking distance of all the good restaurants.

title: Excellent Service, Great Value
text:
Venture Inn was a great for a quick over-night stay.  
The room was clean, surprisingly quiet and not too cramped for two adults/two children (who slept on the pull-out-sofa-bed in living room).  Only (very minor) negative would be that the pool was not heated so our children were too cold to stay in for long but they are used to heated pool at home.  Overall, would definately stay here again.

title: Great value and location.
text: We stayed two nights in January, one on our way to Whangarei from Wellington and one on our way home. The room was clean with a queen bed and a single. The location is great, very easy to get to coming from the north or south. Close to the Hamilton Gardens which was one of the reasons in choosing this hotel. Nice complimentary breakfast in the morning. Good free parking, some parking undercover, great in the rain!

title: Excellent value for money for a top location
text: Room and bathroom was spacious and clean though simply furnished.  Free car parking with under cover spaces greatly appreciated. Supermarkets situated just a quick stroll away and great bars and restaurants just a few minutes walk. Lovely to have the ability to sleep with windows open to get fresh air. Very little street noise (even numbered room - 106).  Would definitely stay again.

title: Good value for money and excellent service
text:
We book this hotel at the last minute and were very pleasantly surprised by both the hotel itself and service. The rooms were reasonably sized and tidy for an overnight stay. Easy access and close to town and the rates included a continental breakfast.

Service from reception deserves special mention. Ruby was particularly helpful and very patient when answering all our questions.

title: Cannot fault the Ventura
text: We chose this based on other reviews, and so glad we did. A good Continental breakfast included in the $115 price, really happy with room (the air  con is so quiet you don't know that it's on!), staff were lovely. All in all a really good choice, great value for money and would stay again without hesitation. Pool is added bonus.

title: GREAT DEAL
text:
We enjoyed our two night stay at Ventura on New Year Eve and day atfer. We got a deal on the internet for a Studio King with Spa which included free continental breakfast, bottle of bubble, free shuttle to Casino and $10.00 voucher to spend on drinks or food all for $135 for one night and $125.00 for next night.
We thought this was great value as the breakfast was excellent and the location was central.
Room was big enought and bed comfortable.  It's such a shame that they let themselves down badly with the linen, towels were badly worn and need replacing and bedspread torn and curtains dirty.  Lots of parking with some undercover which was great as we were able to pack and unpack the car without getting wet as it teamed with rain most of the time we were their.
Would definately stay here again and hope that the Management will renew the towels.  It seems picky but you pick up on these things when on holiday.

title: Decent Stay
text:
Based on my travels elsewhere in the world this hotel worked out to be reasonable in terms of presentation.
The room was decent enough although attention to the details were a little lacking as the bed cover was torn on the corner plus in general, the room was not really finished well.  None the less it was fine – I am probably a little picky.
Reception was friendly and welcoming.  The morning breakfast was decent and the general location very good – close enough to the center of town if you needed to walk.  Of note - there was ample parking which you did not have to pay for.
Wireless access was free in the lobby as was a small business center with a slow computer.
All in, the stay in Hamilton at this location is just fine – price is decent for what you get.

title: Well away from Motel alley!
text:
I opted for Ventura because I detest the Motel Mile in Hamilton, full of soul~less motor~lodges which have no feel of the town about them... and my previously favourite hotel in mid~city Hamilton was booked out. 

It was a good choice.  Nothing spectacular about this place, nor any downside to it either.  All the amenities you might expect.  Nice sized quiet room, good sized bathroom, clean and cosy, and an inexpensive cab ride away from the bus station and/or central city activities (restaurants, nightclubs, river walk etc.)  East to walk for those inclined to do so, too.

title: Spacious rooms - quick and friendly check in
text:
This facility does not have a resturant, however this is not a negative because  they offer a well stocked continental brekafast with good choices.  Also, they are located in the CBD where there's ample of wonderful cafe's and resturants that are easily accessible, case in point being Valentines Family Resturant which is right next door!  

We had a convey of 3 cars so it was a great start to see lots of parking upon our arrival.  This meant we could park safely and untangle our luggage that had been spread across the vehicles.  Check in was easy, and they were well prepared for the two seperate groups within our party.  I've found that some reception areas get confused the booking relates to a group.  Not so with these guys.  Very professional and organised.

We booked the luxury rooms and these were spacious and came with a spa bath.  Bathroom is also spacious and you can actually bend forward, fling your hair over to blow dry without banging your head on the mirror!!  Rooms were clean and tastefully decorated. 

The lift is a little small, so if you're a family of five, you'll need to take two trips.  Otherwise the stairwell is spacious and easy to navigate, even with a bag.  

Overall a great stay, and we would definately stay here again.

title: ***GREAT STAY***
text: Received Excellent Customer Service... Rooms were Spotless & Clean... Great Breakfast Included... Will Be Back!!!

title: Hamilton Stopover
text:
Cheap and handy to the central business district of Hamilton.  Staff were helpful.  
Bed was okay. Room was clean, but we stayed there specifically to make use of the laundry facilities after two weeks of travelling around New Zealand.   Upon booking in advised that the washing machine had "broken down" and they were not providing us with a replacement machine, nor were they allowing us to use their own machine.   Not good service I'm sorry.  Had I been managing that hotel, i would have had a replacement washine machine installed for my guests
hotel_response:
Good Afternoon,
Thank you for your review.
I'd like to start by apologising for the 'break down' of our guest washing machine.  It was one of those unforeseen things & the machine needed to be taken off-site by a contractor.  The machine was off-site for two days which I apologise for.  Yes, we do have a commercial washing machine but it is not designed for small loads sorry.  Our reception team sourced where the nearest laundry mat was (maps were provided at reception), as well as offering guests our dry-cleaning option.
Once again, I am very sorry for the inconvience caused during your stay with us.

title: Pleasantly Surprised - great value, great stay
text:
Booked this on the web through one of the discount brokers. My 12yo and I stayed for two separate stays, 3 nights in total. Rooms were fine: a double and single bed in the room. Neat and clean room and bathroom. Sky TV with the normal motel channels (not the full set but adequate). 
Common areas all very neat and clean.
Buffet Continental breakfast in common area included. Cereal, toast and jam, pastries, fruit. More than adequate. 
Free paper also.
There is internet available but I didnt use it.

title: Excellent value and clean as a whistle
text:
We use Ventura whenever we're in Rotorua, Hamilton or at Auckland Airport.
Great value for money - with a buffet continental breakfast included.
Always clean and well maintained units.

title: Basic but reasonable
text: Stayed for 2 nights in the Venture hotel in Hamilton.Very basic accommodation but clean ,quite and very good rate

title: Nice Place To Stay In Hamilton
text: Smart motel just off a main road near the centre of Hamilton. A short walk to the shops and restaurants of which there was plenty of choice. Good value as rate included a nice breakfast buffet although internet was not free. We received a very friendly welcome  and when our spa bath didn't work ( and looked like it hadn't for some time) our bill was reduced without good grace and an apology. Would definitely stay here again and would recommend as a good overnight stay.

title: Average
text: Room furnishings were a little outdated. Bathroom was clean and Breakfast was very good

title: home away from home
text: we have stayed at ventura hamilton 5x now and will continue to go back.  its warm friendly relaxed feel is what makes it our home away from home. the location is good, just a strole to the main st, plenty of free parking, plus the complimentary all you can eat continential buffet is just perfect for starting the day.

title: Good value, ideal location and really friendly, helpful staff
text:
I travel a lot for work, but this stay was a long holiday weekend back to our old hometown to visit family and friends. Selected Ventura Inn and Suites based on the tripadvisor reviews, previous experience with Ventura at Auckland airport, location and cheap price which included a simple continental breakfast.
The hotel was super quiet so we slept really well, easy walking distance to the restaurant area and right by the main highway out of Hamilton to the South, which gave very easy access to Cambridge and Te Awamutu. Parking is good and all but one night were able to park our convertable Saab undercover, which was an unexpected bonus
The staff were amongst the most friendly and helpful I have ever come accross in any hotel
Rooms are pretty basic, but good value for money, we opted for a kingsize which I would recommend. Flat screen TV with sky movies.
Definitely woudl stay here again.

title: Excellent Value for money stayed there twice
text: Stayed for 4 nights in total on 2 separate occasions, very good value for money, clean and reliable excellent breakfast.

title: Excellent budget hotel in good location....
text: We stayed at the Ventura Inn & Suites from 4/1/11 for 3 nights.  The room was clean and comfortable.  Noise was minimal.  Our rental car was parked on site for free.  We were lucky to have a room away from the occasionally busy road behind the hotel which fronts a quiet cul-de-sac.  Linen was spotless and pillows soft.  Towels were fluffy and we loved the Jacuzzi bath and powerful shower with a good spray pattern.  The continental breakfast was fresh with a wide selection.  Coffee was delicious.  What more can you ask ?   We had booked the Holiday Inn Auckland Airport for the next evening and wondered if we should have booked the Ventura there too.  Such was our experience that we will definitely consider this brand again.  It took us 10 minutes stroll to the busy Victoria Street where there were many F&B outlets.  The 'swimming pool' was nothing more than a pool for kids to have a splash and a plunge in, so don't expect a flashy pool terrace.  Staff were very helpful and pleasant.

title: Lovely continental buffet breakfast included
text:
We stayed here with our teenage son for 1 night in motel room accommodation during our North Island trip at the beginning of January. The room was basic with 1 single & 1 double bed, bathroom & small table to eat at. 

FOR - the gorgeous continental buffet breakfast included in the price ... we'll be looking to stay at Ventura Inns worldwide if they all offer this same kind of breakfast. Friendly, helpful staff & the close proximity to a supermarket. 

AGAINST - a hole was found in the facecloth & dirt mark found on a towel, the curtain of our room also had a hole in it ... which wasn't very impressive. 

Great value short stay accommodation without going overboard.

title: All good.
text:
Rooms are spacious , clean and its really affordable , in a great location
- like we walked to the main restaruant stip in town and took minutes . 
Breakfast was continental but generous and had some nice touches , fresh fruit etc.
Like most of the other reviews there is nothing to complain about here at all. 
Slightly a wee bit worn in places but all good.
The blond sunny gal on reception was really lovely and welcoming, good feeling place to stay.
There is a sign up at the hotel saying

title: Excellent city centre inn with caring staff
text: Stayed 2 nights from 17/10/10.  I would say this was a gem of a hotel.  Excellent staff, both front of house and housekeeping.  When we arrived (very early from the Auckland/Hamilton Overlander train, I was very unwell but they managed to pull out all the stops and get our room ready well before time for which very many thanks).  Spacious, very clean standard suite has lots of thoughtful small touches like showerhat, extra good quality towels, they could see the tissues were running out and had left an additional pack (unusual I find in hotels these days).  Small things but ones which make a stay more pleasurable.  There was a drinks/snacks machine on each floor which I noticed was kept stocked up regularly.  Small, good laundry. Cost of broadband was modest. Walking distance from some popular (with the locals) restaurants, several takeaway places like a place doing roast dinners which you can pick up and take back to eat. Pack & Save is visible from the hotel but Countdown, which is better, is only a very short walk away.  If you need a hire car then AVIS and Thrifty are just around the corner about 2 mins walk away.  Hamilton is a very good stay if you want to do a day trip to Rotorua (we hired a car for the day).  Tip if coming in on Overlander: once the train departs the station will close down completely so if you need a taxi either make sure you have had one already ordered or ask the train staff to call you up one as it is unlikely there will be any taxis there at the station when you arrive and the centre, and this hotel, are a 30 min walk away (uphill).  This hotel could only be improved with an electric hotplate and power outlet in the  bedroom.

title: Enjoyable stay in Hamilton CBD
text: I have stayed at all 3 venturas and would definity stay at Hamilton again.  Staff were very friendly and professional.  Great selection of a contentinal free buffet breakfast included in the room cost.  I found the hotel to be very quiet considering its CBD location.  A quick 5-10 minute to central shops and cafes.  Clean swimming facilities for our family to swim in.

title: Great Place to Stay in Hamilton CBD
text: My colleagues and I stayed at Ventura as we were attending a conference being held there.  The conference itself was well organised and included free car parking which was a bonus.  The staff were very friendly and professional - nothing seemed to be a problem.  The rooms were very clean and contain modern decor.  The hotel itself didn’t have a restaurant however its location is very handy to the city centre (5 minute walk max).  Breakfast was a buffet continental with many options to choose from.  All in all it was a great place to stay and I will defiantly be back next time I am in Hamilton.

title: Good Choice In Hamilton
text:
This place is newish and has a good quiet location about 10 minutes walk from the city centre.
Rooms are comfortable and clean and their is ample free off street parking available around the hotel.
Included in the room tariff is continental breakfast with enough choices to satisfy most people.Also their is a basic gym and a basic swimming pool/plunge pool for guests to use.
For about NZ$110 a night for a standard room we found this place pretty good value and would stay their again if in Hamilton.

title: pleasant break
text: stayed for three nights,could only get a standard studio the first night but had a deluxe studio for the remaining two nights.it was 99.00dollars first night then 110.00dollars per night for the deluxe(king bed and spa bath)everything was spotless and as new,staff were helpful and pleasant even though they were busy.only a couple of blocks to the shopping.Valentines is next door which must be o.k as it was packed every night as it was school holidays.only one thing I noticed that maybe the police put up their witnesses there during the week as the courthouse is on the corner.

title: Cheap but pleasant
text:
Stayed at this place at a cost of NZ $109 per night including breakfast. The room had a double bed and a single bed although there was only 2 of us. It was a basic studio with acceptable decor, TV, Fridge and coffee making facilities. Breakfast which was included in the price is a continental breakfast and if you want to, you can take it up your room to have it. The pool is more like a large outdoor tub rather than a proper pool although we didnt use it. The gym contained about 4 machines and once again we didnt use it. There is ample car parking on site.
Check in is at 1400 and check out was at 11. Since we arrived early and checked out late, they could not give us the room but we happy to hold onto our luggage.
It is about 10 mins walk to the main street for restaurants and bars and less than 5 mins walk from 2 supermarkets and ideally located to the highway.
Overall for the price and location, it is exceptionally good value and therefore i can recommend this place in hamilton

title: Beware- significant problems here
text:
Great location, and reasonable prices, this looked good on the website. The rooms are basic but adequate given the price range. 

HOWEVER..... the sheets on my bed had not been changed since the last guest! They were extremely crumpled, and I found about 6 long hairs (not mine) in the bed. This was strange as the bed was otherwise made, and the bathroom was immaculately clean. The receptionist changed the sheets immediately on being notified, but there was no explanation or apology.

The second night I had to change room as there was a knocking pipe in the ceiling above my room. The receptionist quickly offered me a change of room, and this room was absolutely fine.

title: Location is Key for Us
text:
This is our second stay at Quest on Ward in 6 months. It's now like our second home due mainly to its excellent town centre urban location. Easy access to all amenities, both on foot and by car. Good daily room servicing. Excellent privacy and cleanliness. Can choose to eat out or take in using the kitchen facilities if required.

Some recommendation for improvements:

(1) Fix/upgrade the beds: double bed (mattress) in Room "310 - WAR" was sloping to the left, the mattress was too soft; double size mattress in Room "214 - WAR" is too soft.

(2) Bedroom needs own air conditioning unit.

(3) Optional: Would be great to have covered access between hotel and carpark.

I'm dropping the rating from 4 stars to 3 stars to see if any of my recommended improvements are considered by the time we're next there.

title: Wierd on Ward
text:
Stayed for a couple of nights on business.
The receptionist seemed a little flustered and wanted to check we were ok with the room - as they’d had to chemically clean it. The room was fine, no smells or anything. But it was a shabby, especially compared to other review pictures.
The whole place is converted office space, which always leads to some quirks.
We had a ‘suite’ but the living area was uncomfortable- small area, small hard couch, little and limited choice tv.
Room was fine, bed was comfy, kitchen was well equipped and appreciated.
Choice in Hamilton is limited, wouldn’t recommend but may end up staying again.

title: "Second home" visit
text:
Although Hamilton is our "second home" and we've been there often enough, this was the first time we stayed at Quest on Ward, chosen after much prior online research. We had a one bedroom apartment in the centre of town, within walking distance to all the usual amenities and eating places. Nice apartment with daily room servicing. We did not want anything upmarket or too budget. This suited us to the ground and would recommend it to those who want this kind of urban location. We ate out all the time or buy takeaways to enjoy our downloaded movies in-room on TV screen.

Improvements suggested:

(1) Sheltered access to the covered car park out the back.

(2) King size mattress; ours felt smaller and was sloping to one side.

(3) Need air condition unit in the bedroom.

Enjoy.

title: Worst place I’ve ever been to
text: Terrible and parking is even worse. Absolutely rude you have to pre-pay and you’re not even guaranteed apart. My car almost got towed while I was staying there and management is impossible to reach. Not happy would never recommend this place.

title: Terrible staff!
text:
Terrible staff who accused me of not returning the keys which is a lie. Ive asked them to check their cameras as I 100% returned keys. I got home and they charged me for them.

The email sent was very rude. Our family and friends will never use there services again.

Stay clear

title: Unfriendly Apartment
text: I book their premise through booking.com. They canceled my booking without any call on the day i have checked in around 2pm 24th of May which i suppose to checked in. When i reached the premise, it closed.There is no receiptionist there. So i press the intercom button and the guy told me there is no such booking and hung up my call. I called repeatedly for a good 30 minutes and they keep asking me to wait and the line just went dead until i decided to change my hotel with my sons. It was really terrible experience. How could they just cancel my booking on the DAY i suppose to check in even when i did not tell them. Worst, they charged my credit card. If you are arriving later than 7pm, don;t even bother to book at this premise

title: Need some renovation no breakfast served
text: The rooms consist of a living room with kitchen and a separate sleeping room. The style is a old fashioned and the rooms need urgently a renovation. For breakfast we had to step outside. Not recommended for business trips.

title: Neat central cbd location.
text: I needed accommodation in the cbd, and Quest on Ward fit the bill nicely, nicely appointed with kitchen, and a washer/drier. There was a balcony, and off street parking behind the building. Across the road from the main shopping mall. And only minutes to restaurants, pubs, theatres and the bus station. The concierge was very accommodating as well. Would stay again.

title: Good place in Downtown Hamilton
text: The location was great for what we needed. We had a private tour guide for the 3 days we stayed so we were able to grab dinner the night we had available and grab breakfast at the mall or cafe's before leaving. Do not go for the continental breakfast it is NOT included (as it is here in USA) and it was terrible. We did not even touch it. The space was good and there is a washer dryer which was helpful for us due to the adventure filled days we had planned. AC and Wifi worked well. A good value place to stay.

title: Place to stay in downtown Hamilton!
text: Very convenient, spacious and even had a mini-balcony.  Close to shopping and the bus terminal.  Fully furnished including a kitchen and a combination washer dryer in the suite which was suitable for small loads.  Concierge was very friendly and helpful.

title: Pretty good.
text: Wonderful helpful reception staff and spotlessly clean well appointed accomodation. On the down side the bed was not very comgortable and pillows so very hard. Not a good sleep and nothing much to watch on the TV with no Sky!. I would go again if I really needed central city accom......but would definately at least take my own pillows!

title: All we needed
text: Very clean, well appointed and central to eats etc in Hamilton. Roomy and modern. Parking is close by and quite accessible. Bit noisy in early hours with council road sweeper so don’t leave balcony doors open

title: Adequate with a few niggling issues!
text: Had a one night stay here and loved the location.  Whilst the room was nice and clean and a good size the decor was very dark.  There was a broken shower shelf fixture and no shelving for your toilet or hooks to hang your clothing.  It was nice to have the tiny balcony but it was at the back of the building overlooking a car park.  Liked being able to park our rental vehicle in a secure building next door but checkin process was hampered by not being able to park anywhere because tradies working behind the building were using guest car parking.  Would have been nice to have Sky TV channels but having free internet was good.  I must commend the hospitality of the young man at reception who went out of his way to be of assistance.

title: Hamilton
text: We have stayed in other Quest properties in NZ and have found them modern, clean and comfortable, but not this one in Hamilton. We had a room at the back overlooking the car park, which was dark and dreary. There was no comfortable seating, only 2 dining chairs and the pillows were old and lumpy with 1 very thin excuse for a pillow in the wardrobe as an alternative. The bathroom was a cavern with an old drain in the middle of the floor and the shower tray had a small hole in it. On arrival we asked for the continental breakfast package and was told they had run out and that we could go to one of the local cafes for breakfast. Not too much of a problem, but not what we expected. The good points were that it was within walking distance of restaurants for dinner and you could get secure parking if requested.

title: Wonderful
text: What a great hotel.  Receptionist guy was so very friendly and helpful.  Clean large and convenient hotel with large comfy rooms and everything you need for a stay in Hamilton.  Very highly recommended.  Parking can be obtained undercover at $14 per day or you can hope you get a park outside in the alley.

title: Great Stay
text: Lovely easy to book hotel in the Heart of Hamilton.  Booked a car park, prompt reply confirming availability and email instructions on where the carp park was situated.  Easy to spot the hotel signage on the street, the gentleman on reception was professional, easy to deal with, we were in a hurry.  He explained they also had secure parking and since we were going out, recommend we use this when we returned.  We were running late for a wedding. The studio room, was spacious, clean and very welcoming.  Bathroom was great, also very spacious.   When we returned, the instructions to the secured car park was easy to follow.  Checkout was quick and easy.  I would definitely stay here again.

title: Well located with washer dryer and kitchen
text: All Quest properties are not equal.  They are franchised and thus the difference. Location in Hamilton is excellent -washer dryer in each unit and kitchenette which is great.  No tv in bedroom - front desk didn't have any converters.  Front desk tried very hard to be helpful.

title: Great location and accomodation.
text: Booked a studio but were upgraded to a one bedroom.  It was very nice.  We stayed there for two nights and loved the location as we were not driving a car.  Close to bus station and plenty of shops and restaurants.  We used the washing machine and drying rack provided.  Beds were comfortable.  Front desk staff were very professional and friendly at the same time.  Ate out so did not use the kitchen much but it looked to have everything you could possibly need.

title: Good Location
text:
We stayed here for two nights. I highly recommend you opt for parking when booking. Otherwise who knows where you'll end up. The location was within a short walking distance to shops and restaurants. Ruben and Joe at the front desk were very friendly and helpful. When asked, Ruben provided good places to eat. They both also tried to help us with an issue we had at another Quest location. 

The 1-Bedroom apartment we stayed in was on the 3rd floor. It was a little small but adequate. We had to be creative on where to put our luggage. The room was clean and very quite. The furniture fit the space but again on the smaller side and not really good for relaxing in the evenings. It would have been better if the bedroom had a TV in the room so we could have stretched out to relax a bit at the end of our long days.  Otherwise we had no issues. If we are ever in Hamilton again we would consider staying here because it is centrally located but would defiantly opt for a larger room to give us some space.

title: Excelent location, can't fault it.
text:
My partner and myself stayed here for three nights.

The access is very easy and the hotel is very central. The first night we arrived there were no available spaces for our rental and there were no parking spaces available on the road right in front of the hotel. We had to park overnight in the mall carpark right opposite the hotel. The next morning when we went to pick the car park, we found a massive scratch on it and it was clear that the car was bumped at some point whilst there. Obviously - and I cant stress this enough - nothing to do with the hotel but keep it in mind if there are no hotel spaces available. 

During our stay there we met with two different members of stuff manning reception and they were both very friendly and helpful. 

The room was very spacious, with good storage space, well accessorised kitchen, a washing machine/dryer and  - what I thought was a brilliant touch - heated blankets underneath the bottom sheet on the bed. The TV had a very good variety of movies to watch and there was also in the fridge a small basket of breakfast food, like bread slices, jam butter and fresh fruit. There is also wifi, which in our case was included in the price of the room. 

My only small criticism would be the lack of towel hooks/rail - there was only one towel rail in our bathroom which we could place our bath towels to dry however there was nothing to hand a had towel and as a result we had to either place it by the sink or drape it over the top of the shower cabin. 

All in all, an excellent place to stay for a few nights and will most definitely book it again if we found ourselves in Hamilton.

title: Amazing stay
text:
I have been travelling around Australia for the ashes and eventually here at Hamilton , I was amazed at the facilities and what quest has to offer,  even a heated towel rail in the bathroom, it was home from home experience, all the staff were amazing from the maids to the guys on the desk, this is my first review since I have been away and have stayed at great hotels, but this was amazing, i just had to review it, I am also staying at Quest on Hobson in Aukland, I am very much looking forward to staying there!!

Thank you guys
Gary M
Room 318

title: Handy Location, Lovely Staff
text:
