We stayed one night here travelling through to Rotorua. We were given a disabled access room on Level 1 (room 118, I think?).  Everything was clean and in good working order.  Our room overlooked the back of the hotel car park and had a little juliette balcony.  Had some protective birds give me a quick swoop which was funny!

Car parking is easy at drop off in the back lane and the secure parking nearby was great. We walked around town and did some of the touristy things.  Recommend the museum and Hamilton Gardens - both are great and free!

title: All good in room 313 :-)
text: This was only a studio room, but it had a massive bathroom which was a pleasant surprise.  The living area and kitchen were pleasant and the bed was very comfortable.  The shower had great water pressure.  This room was very quiet, despite it being Saturday night in the Tron ;-)

title: Position perfect, apartment fine...
text:
I had some issues initially - BUT these were with booking.com - when I phoned Quest on Ward the reception - Joe - was so helpful. I had been trying to extend our stay by 1 night, and still did not have confirmation of our parking space through the booking.com website. all was sorted by Joe, Thank you very much Joe.
On arrival check in was fine, we had to double park to unload the car - again reception was so helpful, it was raining and Kenneth came out and helped, whilst we parked the car he got everything up into the room - Thank you Kenneth. Our secure parking was in a car park behind the building, a key was required; and in comparison to Auckland was extremely well priced.
The apartment - 1 bedroom - was good all facilities, no real view (over the car park), comfortable, with enough cooking facilities, washer/dryer. Apartment was serviced so bins were emptied every day, and bed made.
We were just round the corner from Victoria St - with its excellent choice of bars and restaurants. even an internet place nearby on Victoria St.

title: Perfect bade
text:
I have just left New Zealand for Australia & if my next accommodation is half as good as Quest I’ll be very happy. 
My stay was for a total of 29 nights as I was work in Hamilton, I found the whole procedure of check-in smooth & friendly, I had a choice of secure parking or yawing the parking bays at the rear of the hotel, I had the latter & had no problems at all. 
The 1 bedroom apartment I had was spacious, very clean & well stocked with essentials. 
Location is perfect for discovering all the pubs/restaurants on Victoria Street as it’s less than 2mins away but off the main road so not too noisy although you do get a little noise if your on the front of the hotel. 
Check-out smooth & friendly again. 
All in all a great place to stay & would 100% stay again when I return.

title: Not a quest normal standard
text:
I booked room direct from the website here a month before my visit. Requested for secured car park along with the booking. Rang twice to ask about the confirmation email of the booking about both room and car park as I still didnt recieve one. So I get it after 2 phone call on different occasion. Here is the worst part come. Rang again in the morning on the actual staying day and ask about the direction to car park as we were arriving late outside of hours. The female receptionist then told me that the direction will be in the envelope along the room key in the safe box for late check in procedure. So I asked again that this booking will be fine and no problem when we arrive as I know we will arrive quiet late and don't want to get stuck in middle of the night in Hamilton. So come to arriving to hotel around midnite. We proceed to check in, went into room. Voila no parking instruction. Called the night manager and she basicly just said its full that we need to book in advance. Okay. I guess A Month is not advance enough. So we resulted to call Skycity to ask if they willing to take casual parking as that is the only place
 that open 24/7.  My point is I get it carpark is such a small concern but the reason why we spesifically ask for it because we were driving from south island carrying our important belonging in our car to move to Auckland rather than just leaving it with the movers. So the reception in the morning told me they will investigate and find out what happen. After about an hour he leave a voicemail to say that he will discounted my bill at 15%. Uhm thats about $20 which is the cost of the parking in Skycity. Thanks. It was quiet an interesting walk too from hotel to Skycity there and back in middle of the night  of Hamilton.

title: Average
text: Check in on public holiday was easy and quick as reception was unstaffed. Our secure parking that was prebooked was definitely not secure as just parked in a lane behind hotel. The apartments we had were interconnected and very clean but extremely dated and carpets and sofas needed a good clean as covered in stains. We were only there one night to split our journey up traveling north so didn’t use any of the kitchen facilities. Our room at the front we heard trucks around 6am with reversing beepers going but our daughters room at the back was very quiet. Convenient location with Gloria Jeans directly underneath and subway and shopping Centre across road. Not to the standard of previous Quest hotels we have stayed at so a little disappointing.

title: Relaxing Stay, Clean and Tidy with Free Movie!
text:
We stayed in an 1-bedroom apartment for 1 night as we stopped over Hamilton during the weekend. The apartment was in central location close to shopping mall and eateries. A big bonus for us was the free movies on top of our regular channels. 

The apartment was very clean and tidy and the pull-out bed was perfect for our young kid. The apartment comes with a complete kitchen with laundry facility. 

The receptionist was polite and helpful.

title: Central city apartment
text:
We stayed one night mid-week, as we had a function to attend. The location is great for walking to local restaurants. Secure parking is available for an additional charge of $12. Wifi was free.
The apartment consisted of a separate bedroom (quite small) with a queen bed that had a very soft mattress, which resulted in a bit of "roll together". There was a combined kitchen/living room with a dining table, couch and TV. The kitchen was functional with a small oven, 2 elements, and a dishdrawer dishwasher.
The bathroom was quite spacious with a corner shower (plenty of pressure) and a small vanity unit. There was also a washing machine.
The only downside was that our apartment was on the Ward St side, and streetworks started up at 6am. As there isn't any double glazing, it was rather noisy!
I imagine it would be OK to stay here for a few days if you were working in the city, but get a quieter room!.

title: Average
text: Good location but the room was average at best. They don’t have anyone working after 5 on the weekends so checking in was a little stressful. The room was a good size but the bed was loud and uncomfortable. Our bathroom was big but the shower was so mall so it just seemed like a ton of wasted space. Water pressure was amazing though.

title: Quest Hotel on Ward in Hamilton
text:
This hotel comes with a car parking option, you need to arrange this with the concierge first and they will then give you an electronic key we had car park 5 really close tot he entrance and round the back of the hotel we stayed in room 211 for 4 nights from End of September till beginning of October 2017.
The accommodation was clean and fresh and was nice especially after a hard days physical work, as we were renovating a rental so had really grimy areas to  contend with

title: So conveniently located
text: Located right next to the shopping centre and a few minutes walk to the main street, this location was perfect for us.  We had lovely apartment style room with separate bedroom, lounge and kitchen.  Our teenage boys were thrilled to have the adjoining apartment laid out the same as ours but with twin beds.

title: Excellent base for exploring Hamilton + nearby
text: Rooms are clean, spacey and the kitchen is fully equipped. It is perfect for independent travellers: within walking distance of the city centre, near a mall and with parking available. It's worth mentioning that the hotel is pretty new and it showed. Great wifi as well. It'd definitely stay here again.

title: Great location
text: We enjoyed our stay at Quest on Ward and would stay here again.  After hours instructions were easy to follow.  Location is great for eating out.  The only negative was the couch - my goodness it was uncomfortable.

title: Quest on Ward - great location
text: Excellent service on arrival and departure. It's not the Ritz, but its not meant to be. Well priced, functional and cosy. Parking is good also and close to a modern shopping centre. 4th time I have stayed there.

title: Perfectly functional
text: Great position within walking distance to the town centre, Starbucks right downstairs, well maintained, clean and fuss-free. Not what I would call a romantic getaway spot but certainly a great functional base.

title: Plenty of room, Clean and tidy
text:
I was booked into this accommodation by my employer.  Located close to the shopping mall and just off Victoria Street (main restaurant street) it is conveniently located.

A three story facility, the reception is quite small but clean and tidy.  The office manager while I was there was Joe, who handled two earlier guests with ease before checking me in.  He was very professional and had my file ready for me to complete and sign, saving time at checkin

My room was on the third floor and was easier to access using the lift.  The lift was quite comical as it slowed down as it reached the third floor and seemed stationary for at least 10 seconds before the doors opened, leaving another quest and me wondering if we were stuck.  

I was used to small hotel rooms with ensuite so was pleasantly surprised with the size of the room.  The door opened onto a dining area, with full stocked kitchen to the right and lounge area/tv/work desk at the far end by the window.  Off to the right was a utility area incorporating a washing machine/dryer and ironing facilities behind a door in a large bathroom area with toilet/corner shower/basin and  towels on a towel rail.  The bathroom is pleasantly large.  Off the lounge end of the first room was a separate bedroom with a king size bed, and wardrobe.

The views from the window were of the street below and a building opposite.  However, as I was there for work I don't tend to worry about views.

I picked up the ticket for free wifi (150mb I think) with an alternative of $10 for unlimited access.  I found I used it on one device then wanted to log out and use on another device but the transfer didn't work as expected.  However, as I use my phone for tethering my iPad and MacBook usually it wasn't a big deal to use my own internet access.  Good 4G coverage via Vodafone.

I would have rated this place 4.5/5 but two small things
1. There was a metal plate on the floor behind the door when I arrived.  I put it on the table when I left.
2. Internet wasn't perfect - small thing but could be frustrating for those who rely on supplied internet services when staying.

I did enjoy the apartment style and if I was staying 3 or more nights I would have used the kitchen to make my evening meal.  I miss simple meals when I travel.

The Quest on Ward in just off Victoria Street, a main thoroughfare loaded with plenty of great places to eat.  I've been surprised and delighted to find so many fine places to eat, all of a good standard and some being top quality.

I would be quite happy to stay here again.

title: Spacious in a Good Central Location
text: This hotel offers real value; it is spacious including a separate living area and even a washer and dryer in each unit.  There is a functional work area and this hotel would be especially attractive for longer stays.  The hotel is centrally located in easy working distance of restaurants with a grocery store about a fifteen minute walk away.  If you are driving, you should definitely consider paying for secured self parking.  Parking is extremely difficult in the central city and the hotel’s parking garage is easy to use and well worth the NZ$10 daily charge.  The front desk isn’t always staffed and this can cause delays in checking in and out of the hotel.
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind feedback, we really appreciate your comments. Certainly the fully equipped apartments with washer and dryer are quite unique our guests tell us they love the convenience and cost savings. While the front desk isn't always manned before 7am after 7pm we are available 24hours, just use the phone on the reception and we will be with you straight away. Thanks again and we do hope that we will see you again in the near future. Larry

title: great service at reception
text:
Joe at the front desk provided one of the best check-in experiences I have ever had. He was well organised, gave us clear and concise instructions and all the information we needed, made checking in a breeze.
The room was good - had everything we needed for our stay and was clean & tidy. The location of the apartments was excellent, right in the CBD and walking distance from lots of shops and bars/ restaurants.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, we are really fortunate to have such a great team, they do work exceptionally hard to ensure all of our guests experience the best possible service. We are also fortunate to be in such a great location, close enough to the fantastic range of shops, restaurants and bars while being in such a lovely quiet position. We do hope to see you again in the not too distant future.

title: Great Rooms
text: Great room, comfortable and with good amount of space. Would book again in this great location to the entertainment areas. Facilities in the room were adequate and service from front desk was hospitable.
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind feedback, it is really appreciated. We are really fortunate to have such a terrific team. Our apartments are fully equipped and our guests tell us regularly that they love having the washing machines and dryers in the apartment especially that it saves time and money.

title: STAY IN HAMILTON FOR WEDDING
text:
We found the manager very helpful and friendly and the parking was close buy for bags and luggage.
the rooms are very tidy and large enough to feel relaxed and everything is in walking distance so very happy with the place.
hotel_response:
Thank you for your feedback, your comments are really appreciated. We do hope that you will come back to see us again soon.
All the best.

title: Great little hotel
text: Great location. Close to everything you need. Starbucks downstairs. Free movies - amazing range. Clean. Perfect for business travellers. Couldn't do enough to make things easy and welcoming. I'll stay there again.
hotel_response: Thank you Wayne, your feedback is really appreciated. We are really proud of our team, they work hard to ensure all of our guests receive the best possible experience. We look forward to hopefully seeing you again in the not too distant future. Kind regards Larry

title: Great room
text:
I hadn't stayed here before but would definitely stay again.  Room was small but we'll appointed and ideal for a short or longer stay. 
Once the work on Ward st is finished any concerns walking down the rd will be a thing of the past too
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, we do appreciate your comments. Ward Street is such a terrific location as our guests are close enough to all the shops, restaurants and bars while being in a wonderful quiet position.

title: Great staff, great room, great stay
text: We stayed overnight at the Quest on Ward after a wedding in town. The booking staff were very happy to help us with an early check in on the day, so we could drop our gear off and get ready for the wedding in time. They upgraded our room as well - which was awesome. The single bedroom suite was spacious, well laid out and very clean and well kept. Comfortable bed and very little noise at night, even on a Saturday night in the middle of town - good double glazing or good location or a mix of both! We will definitely be staying here again, excellent value for money and a great experience. Highly recommend.
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, we are really pleased that you enjoyed your stay with us. We always love hosting wedding parties, our team are always so passionate about delivering a fantastic service to ensure our guests receive the best possible experience.

title: Excellent!!
text: Great place and central location. Close to food court and off street parking, Recommend all to stay at the Quest as the rooms are clean and tidy.Staff are very helpful and they go that extra mile to make your stay a good one A+A+A+
hotel_response: Thank you for your fantastic review, we are fortunate to have such a great team who are focused on ensuring guests have a great experience. We are pleased that you enjoyed your stay with us and do hope that we will see you again in the near future.

title: Spacious, fresh and well located
text: We called only an hour before arrival and although they didn’t have the room we requested, they quickly offered an upgrade for the same money.  Parking was a little difficult but that was probably exacerbated for us by wet weather – never good when you’re trying to get bags out of the car.  Reception was super friendly and helpful, full of information and careful to make sure we had everything we needed.  Beds are comfortable, bathroom and kitchen are both large, washing/ironing facilities are available in the apartment and the little balcony provided an open air feel.  It was a very comfortable night and a lovely way to finish our NZ adventure.
hotel_response: Thank you for your kind review, unfortunately the weather was particularly bad during your stay, I am pleased that it didn't put a dampener on your stay and we are really pleased that you enjoyed your time with us. Hopefully we will see you again soon. Kind regards Larry

title: Great location
text: The quest on ward was in a great location for shops bars and restaurants, room was good size and comfortable we got the room at a cheap rate on line so worth looking out for deals, we will stay there again!! Last note make sure you book a secure car park it's $10 a night but worth it for peace of mind
hotel_response: Thank you for your feedback, we often have special deals which make for an excellent value weekend getaway. Feel free to call us and we will see what we can do for your next stay with us.

title: Great value & location
text:
We stayed in a one bedroom apartment, which is located in the centre of the city with easy walking distance to numerous restaurants and shops. The two gentlemen we met at reception were both very friendly and helpful.  Unfortunately we were disappointed to walk in and be hit with the very strong smell of cigarette smoke. I don't understand how a cleaner can not notice this when cleaning the room and at least spray to help dissipate the smell. We did mention this at reception and they apologised but did not offer to change our room. The carpet in our apartment had a few stains and could do with steam cleaning.

We thought it may be noisy but it was surprisingly quiet at night and conveniently located very close to a Starbucks for toasties and coffee for breakfast.  We were happy to pay the additional $10 a night for security parking as we had a hire car, but there was ample street parking in the evening.

Our room was clean and well maintained but we expected a Queen bed and were given a Double. Also my husband was disappointed to not have a sport channel on the TV as we thought they had SKY TV.

However all the positives far outweighed the negatives and we we got a great value hotel for 2 nights and would definitely stay here again.
hotel_response:
Thank you for the feedback, it is important to us. We do have a no smoking policy throughout the hotel and we have notices in each room explaining this, although very rare it is disappointing when this is ignored, unfortunately we may have been fully booked at the time of your stay as otherwise we would have certainly moved you to another apartment. 

We have two hotels here in Hamilton at Quest on Ward we have an amazing digital channel with 100's of the latest movies which guests can watch on demand, while Quest Hamilton situated on London Street has Sky TV. This provides options to suit a wider variety of tastes.

Of course if you have any personal preferences prior to staying just let us know and we will do what we can to accommodate.

title: Keil
text: Really like staying here. Friendly helpful staff. Central location handy to everything. Safe lockup carpark. Clean and tidy rooms. I stay here often and will continue to do so. Excellent shopping in the vicinity. Great restaurants and cafes.

title: I was please to stop here for a night
text:
I stopped here to break up a bus trip.  The apartment was clean, spacious and nicer than most other accommodations I have booked.  Would definitely stop here again.

The room had a nice kitchen and cloths washer that was handy.

title: Great apartments for business travelers and tourists alike
text: I am an advocate for the Quest apartments - they are always clean, spacious, modern, comfortable and generally located in the centre of cities.  Quest on Ward is bang in the centre of Hamilton's CBD - cafes and shopping are all at the entrance to the hotel.  Each room has a small balcony overlooking the street.  Car parking is in a secure building at the rear of the Quest.  The only difficulty is checking in if you have a car - you have to find a short stay car park in Ward Street to enable you to check in at reception, get your keys and then park the car.  The reception staff are friendly and helpful.

title: Holiday
text: Very friendly customer service and a nice place to stay plus it's quiet n naturally calm ...love the place just a heads up on parking whereby u gotta pay every $10 a day to secure your car ....apart from that I loved the hotel and the room was just amazing ....

title: Good business hotel
text: Stayed here while in Hamilton on a business trip, very nice well appointed room. I would have given 5/5 but for two issues. Charging for WiFi at this price point is no longer acceptable and the parking facilities were a pain. Parking should be clearly stated when booking and not when arriving at the hotel. other than this the stay was very pleasant. Would not stay here again as I found equivalent accomodation with free wifi and parking.

title: Exceptional Value for money
text: This property is modern, well maintained, has all the requirements for a good comfortable stay. Good amenities, washer, dryer, provisions supplied. Great WiFi, unlimited. Fantastic reception staff, Joe is amazing.

title: Girls weekend
text: Awesome place to stay, helpful and friendly service. Booking was made easy. Walking distance to shops and restaurants. We really enjoyed our stay and would go back again . Thank you to Joe and the team at the Quest on Ward.

title: Great Value & Location
text:
Excellently located in close proximity to the Casino,Restaurants and shopping centre.
Room more than adequate with lounge /ktchenette area & bedroom.Parking on street free for the time of our stay.  Great value !!

title: Very happy!
text: Had a lovely one bedroom on the third floor. Room was very clean and had plenty of room for two. Quiet and so close to everything. Staff were happy to help where they could. Will definitely stay again.

title: Overnight stay in Hamilton CBD
text: Only stayed one night in this centrally located apartment, walking distance to shops and restaurants, Starbucks on the corner and Subway across the road if you don't want to walk anywhere. Car parking available at a cost and has to be booked in advance, located at the rear of the main entrance. Staff were friendly, but not available 24/7, not that this was a problem. The apartment was 1 bedroom with a small lounge but sufficient for the 2 of us. Fully self contained and modern furnishings. Very clean and couldn't fault the presentation. Very small 1 person balcony available for smokers, just don't look down if you suffer from vertigo. Overall was very pleased with this apartment.

title: Girls weekend
text: Awesome place to spend a weekend away. Walking distance to shopping, restaurant and pubs. Clean and tidy apartments and lovely service on arrival. Thanks so much to Joe and the team at The Quest on Ward ,Hamilton , cheers

title: feels like a backpackers
text:
We only stayed 1 night before flying back to Australia. We had a 1 bedroom apartment and the beds were really small and the sheets smelled really off. Either was not laundered well or it smelled like it was already used. It put us off our sleep. Disappointing since we loved the Quest in Rotorua Central.
The parking on the street was free after 3pm till 9am.

title: Functional
text: Stayed 5 days whilst working in Hamilton.  Novotel usually my preferred place to stay but was booked out. Has everything you need  including small kitchenette plus washer/dryer which was useful. Small double bed, awful pillows average comfort. Small 2  seater sofa ,not somewhere that was comfy to spend the evening on. 2 hours free wifi but the guy on reception did give me free unlimited for my stay which was appreciated. Very friendly staff,central location,cheap and safe parking. Not luxury and bit worn and tired,but does the job. Would still stay at Novotel next time.

title: Clean and with good location
text: Good location for this hotel. The rooms were very clean and the additional space was handy. There are many shops and restaurants around and easy to park. The staff provides good services and the rates are usually reasonable.

title: Our stay
text:
up to the usual high standard we now expect from Quest on Ward.
Had on street entertainment with the  fire brigade arriving to a false alarm across the road.
Quiet and comfortable with genuine friendly hosts

title: Great location
text: Clean & tidy apartment. Helpful reception staff. Very close to shops, restaurants & museum. It's a good idea to pay an extra $10.00 to have a reserved, secure car parking space behind the apartment building. We stayed in Room 310 which we were told is the best apartment! It has a small balcony overlooking Ward Street. For a city centre location it wasn't too noisy at night. Would happily stay there again.

title: Definitely pay for parking
text: What a great location - extremely close to Central Place shopping centre, cinema and a very convenient Starbucks.  The street seems to be filled with loading zones and metered parking so paying extra for use of parking building worth it in my opinion, as we walked most places.  Apartment was spacious and clean and the staff were very friendly and helpful.  It's a little more in price than some places but was so worth it.

title: Very nice place
text: Great location. Nicely furnished. Very spacious. Big bathroom. Nice kitchen. Free movies. Secure parking. Secure entrance. Quiet. Friendly staff. Clean. We really enjoyed our stay here. Spent 2 weeks in paihia, one day in Auckland and then the last 2 nights of our honeymoon here. We had an evening dinner and tour at Hobbiton booked and wanted to stay half way between there and Auckland. We were extremely happy with this place. And, Hobbiton was awesome, dinner there was amazing.

title: QUEST on POINT
text: Excellent location, close to all ameneties and opposite Centre Place. Everything you need is in walking distance. A Flash apartment for the 3 of us, with the latest movies and free Wi-Fi. Joe the receptionist is very friendly.

title: Waste of time
text:
Booked on line gave details and get there and they want a bond for the room $100/night on top of payment
Extremely hard to get a park even to check in 
This is the worst hotel I've had anything to do with 
Don't even think of staying service is key and the hotels policies need to be disclosed in the booking process 
Gutted at their policies 
Didn't stay 😡

title: Actually quite good
text:
Just a one night stay whilst in Hamilton on business.

The Quest on Ward can be a bit hard to find as the reception area is set amongst shop fronts on Ward Street. Thank goodness for GPS.  Check in was quick and efficient and my bag was taken to my room whilst I parked my hire vehicle in the secure parking at the back of the hotel.

My room was spacious and clean and tidy. Cooking facilities in the room were not used. 
I had a very good nights sleep which when on a hectic business trip is a real bonus. 

Checkout was again handled very well. The hotel staff are very friendly and went out of their way to help out.

title: Absolutely Love Everything!
text: From the very beginning when I first contacted Quest on Ward, Josh has been brilliant to work with. He rang me the morning of my stay to inform that my room would be ready early, if I would like arrive earlier, the room was beautiful,  tidy and very spacious! I would totally recommend Quest on Ward to family, friends and anyone that is staying one night to one month!

title: Fantastic!
text: My husband and I had planned a rare date night and I booked a very reasonably priced room at quest on ward. Room we were expecting was actually a suite, lovely and clean, bed was so comfortable and service superb!
hotel_response: Dear tracyandkiri, thank you for choosing Quest on Ward and for taking the time to write a review for us. This really helps our potential guests see truly what we offer. I am glad to hear that you and your husband enjoyed your rare date night. There are always plenty of new restaurants and great places to come and see here in Hamilton so be sure to let us know when you are planning your next trip and ask one of our friendly reception staff for new recommendations with activities and food & dining places here in Hamilton. Thank you once again and see you soon. Kind regards, Joe

title: Not bad
text: The hotel is walking distance to restaurants & bars in Hamilton. Ok place to crash for the night, nothing fancy. The hallways and stairwell stunk of cigarette smoke. Joe on reception was friendly and accommodating.

title: Top Spot
text:
Great service. Tidy spacious room. Great location. Secure parking. Close to shops.
Free view TV. New furniture. Couch a bit hard, but no big issue. You will have to pay $10 for limitless wifi and $10 parking.
hotel_response: Dear shelleylongGoldCoast, thank you for staying with us at Quest on Ward and for taking your time to write a review about your stay. This really helps us in letting other travellers know what we offer and where we are in the CBD. We are glad to hear that you got to experience most of what we have to offer. See you next time and thank you, once again, for choosing Quest on Ward. Kind regards, Joe

title: Excellent  Weekend Stay
text: Arrived at hotel and very helpful reception with information on locality. Good secure car park. Room very clean and comfortable. Central location so easy walking for town and river. Would book again if in Hamilton.
hotel_response: Dear K N, thank you very much for staying with Quest on Ward and for your review. Our wonderful location means you can leave you car behind and walk everywhere. The walks up or down the river are a great chance to enjoy the mighty Waikato River. I would be more than happy to give you more recommendations and other local tips next time you visit. We look forward to having you stay with us again. Thank you for choosing Quest on Ward.

title: Very good spacious apartment
text: My husband and I recently stayed here for two nights and were very impressed with the apartment and the guy on the front desk.  The check in was good and the wifi and parking were sorted out quickly. The parking is in a secure car park which you need a key fob to get in and out of and only costs $10 per night. The 1 bedroom apartment was very clean, a great size with good amenities, a well equipped kitchen and a washer/dryer. It is right in the centre of Hamilton so the casino is just around the corner and the shopping centre with cinema is directly across the road. I would definitely stay here again if I was visiting this area.
hotel_response: Dear Sarah H, thank you for choosing Quest on Ward and for taking the time to write a review for us. This really helps our potential guests see truly what we offer and where we are. Skycity has recently opened two new additions to their food places : Eat burger and The Local Taphouse, both a definite must-try. Of course, there are always plenty more new restaurants and places to visit in Hamilton so we can suggest and update you next time. We hope to be of service to you again sometime, and thank you again for choosing Quest on Ward. Kind regards, Joe

title: GREAT FACILITIES
text: Everything you need, including kitchen and laundry. Staff very friendly and helpful, staff member came to room after we checked in even though it was after hrs to make sure we were settled.  Clean unit. Very close to shops, restaurants and bars.
hotel_response: Dear Anne G, thank you very much for writing a review for Quest on Ward. I am glad to hear that you, like many others, found that our location is great and very central. we are also happy to hear that you like the facilities including the kitchens and laundry facilities in the room. Thank you for choosing Quest on Ward and we are looking forward to seeing you soon.

title: Good place to stay in central location
text: After staying in a horrible and expensive dive in Auckland the Quest on Ward was such a refreshing change.  Room was good and location terrific. Parking was a little tricky on the weekend but a car park was not too far away.
hotel_response: Dear AndrewStein, thank you for choosing Quest on Ward and for taking the time to write a review for us. I am glad that you enjoyed your stay with us, and it was good to meet you and it is great that you enjoyed our location and facilities in the room. We hope to be of service to you again sometime. Kind regards, Joe

title: Very comfortable
text: Very clean and pleasant and well equipped  room in central location. Comfortable bed. No free parking and minimal facilities e.g. cafe etc/ reception closes early. Would have been better if it had extra channels on the TV, a bigger screen and possibly a proper coffee maker.

title: Great price for facilities
text: Quiet. Has an oven which is rare and awesome.  Staff helpful and parking only $10. Rooms a bit dark but better then too bright. Ask for the free WiFi as its not advertised. Shower is good and air conditioning is manual adjust and works really well.
hotel_response: Dear David, thank you very much for your time to review Quest on Ward after your stay.  As we are a apartment hotel,  we have full kitchen with oven, stove top, dishwasher; laundry; and spacious bathrooms in each apartment room. I am glad to hear that you got to experience most of what we have to offer. See you next time and thank you for choosing Quest on Ward again. Kind regards, Joe

title: Perfect CBD Accommodation option in Hamilton
text:
Great location being in Ward Street, closest option to Transport Centre, Centre Place Shopping Centre across the road, Starbucks, Subway and lots of restaurants within the Mall and 2 cinemas (Hoyts on Metro or Lido), a short 5 min walk to Casino or 10 mins to bars and more restaurants.  I had a One bedroom unit on level3, a nice quiet room, loved the option that I could cook or not having a kitchenette and that their was a washing machine/drier in the bathroom (great for those travelling). Have a look at the information book provided, Ming City was a great option for dinner.
Also I had such a great sleep that I actually was able to sleep in until 9am, comfortable bed and environment. Free street parking from 6pm to 8am or only $10 for secured parking.
The staff are also the highlight, nice and friendly so I hope you get the opportunity to book with them.. Thank you Quest on Ward!
hotel_response: Dear rachrachnz. Thank you for staying with us at Quest on Ward and for writing a detailed review from your experience. This really helps our potential guests see truly what we offer. Apartment hotels are definitely becoming a new trend with travellers due to the facilities each apartment room offers (full kitchen with oven, stove top, dishwasher; laundry; and spacious bathrooms) without having to leave the room. Our location is also one of the things our guests love about us since we are very central and everything is within reach without needing your car. I am glad to hear that you got to experience most of what we have to offer. I would be more than happy to give you more recommendations and other local tips next time you visit. Thank you once again and see you soon.

title: Fantastic stay
text: My husband and I came down for a weekend getaway and had a great stay. Great set up, friendly staff, clean and spacious and so close to everything  - definitely will be back to enjoy the hospitality again..
hotel_response:
Dear Kelly. Thank you for choosing Quest on Ward and for taking the time to write a review for us. This really helps us in letting other travellers know what we offer and where we are in the CBD. I am glad to hear that you and your husband enjoyed your weekend getaway. There are always plenty of new restaurants and great places to come and see here in Hamilton so be sure to let us know when you are planning your next getaway and we can offer you our new recommendations. 
See you next time and thank you, once again, for choosing Quest on Ward.

title: Excellent location and accomodation
text: We had a concert to go to at claudelands showground, quest on ward was great walking distance for many different places for tea and then a very easy walk to the show.  The rooms we booked, inter connecting, were very comfortable and private. A+
hotel_response: Dear Sharena50. Thank you for staying with us at Quest on Ward and for taking your time to write a review about your stay. It is great to hear that we helped make your visit to Hamilton and concert experience better. Do let us know when you are coming back to Hamilton. Hamilton has plenty more to offer. We look forward to having you stay with us again. Thank you for choosing Quest on Ward.

title: Very comfortable,well placed accomodation
text:
My wife and I stayed for one night only,but what a pleasure.The staff were extremely helpful and friendly,really felt a genuine desire to make our stay as good as possible.The appartment was spacious and very well equipped.Very comfortable bed and nice and quiet , although very centrally located.Would definitely
Stay there again.
hotel_response: Dear Clive. Thank you for staying with us at Quest on Ward and thank you for taking the time to write about your stay. I am glad to hear that you really enjoyed your stay with us. I hope you were able to visit all the things Hamilton and nearby towns have to offer. If not, definitely make sure to come back and possibly even stay longer - we would love to tell you the local secrets of where the best places are here in Hamilton. Thank you for choosing Quest on Ward. see you next time.

title: Really Good
text:
Stayed 5 days. This place had everything we needed and was close to everything, right in the middle of the city. Nothing fancy but good value for money. There was not one extra thing I could have asked for.  
Staff were fabulous , always welcoming, friendly and extra helpful and we received an upgrade on arrival. I wouldn't think twice about booking here again, we had no problems with housekeeping, they were very helpful and friendly. .Wi fi was good, secure parking good. Our outlook was alleyways but super quiet! Very clean.
hotel_response: Dear uptightoutasight. Thank you for staying with us at Quest on Ward and for taking your time to write a review about your recent stay with us. I am glad to hear that you enjoyed your time. Next time you are back for your next visit, make sure to ask one of our friendly reception staff for new recommendations with activities and food & dining places here in Hamilton. Looking forward to seeing you soon.

title: Its a Winner!
text: Quest on Ward is the perfect place to stay in the Hamilton CBD. Within easy walking distance to shopping outlets, bars, cafes and  restaurants, and of course, the Casino. Full facilities in the units, great staff and friendly service. My husband and I have stayed here several times, as a lone couple and also with different groups of friends. We will stay here anytime we are in Hamilton. Its a sure winner for us!!
hotel_response: Dear Shayne and Tarn. Thank you for staying with us once again at Quest on Ward and thank you for writing a review for your most recent stay. It was really good to see you once again and to welcome the rest of your group. I am glad to hear that you enjoy your every stay with us. It is always such a delight to have you and your friends whenever you visit. Skycity has recently opened two new additions to their food places : Eat burger and The Local Taphouse, both a definite must-try. Of course, there are always plenty more new restaurants and places to visit in Hamilton so we can suggest and update you next time. The team and I are looking forward to your next visit. Once again, thank you for choosing Quest on Ward.

title: Nice place
text: Suited us being smack in the middle of the city.  Only down side was our apartment looked in to a dingy back ally and parking was in the same ally.  Lovely rooms though and good facilities especially for a long stay with dishwasher and washer/dryer in the room.  Bed was a bit hard for my tastes.  I've stayed in Quest apartments before and this wasn't the best one.  Guy at front desk was lovely and very helpful.
hotel_response: Dear Stavey H.  Thank you for your time to write about your stay in Hamilton with us. Kenneth and Joe  enjoyed having you stay.  Being so central is a huge advantage for our guests but being city central also means a city view too.  There are so many parks and river walks close by that it is great to enjoy all that Hamilton can offer.  Did you enjoy any of the fantastic breakfast places ?  Mavis and Co are famous in town and recently opened close by us.   The River Kitchen down Victoria Street is another firm favorite.  come back soon!  We hope to welcome you again.  regards Robert

title: Beautiful, great-value, and right in the city
text:
These well-appointed apartments are located in the heart of Hamilton, just a block from the River Walk (and three from the famous Riff Raff Statue). Entire apartment complexes with large soft beds, comfy couches, and compact kitchenettes make for the best value we could find in the city. 

Word of warning- to save costs (and give staff well-deserved rest) the front desk isn't on duty past office hours. This is fine if you're not a needy hotel resident but something to be aware of if you need another towel at 2 in the morning.
hotel_response: Dear CStantis.  thank you very much for staying with us and for your review. Our wonderful location means you can leave you car behind and walk everywhere. The walks up or down the river are a great chance to enjoy the mighty Waikato River.  Being a apartment hotel, the kitchens and laundry facilities in every room do prove a life saver for travelers. We hope to be of service to you again sometime.  regards Robert

title: Eco cleaning that's so good the rooms still dirty
text:
The front desk staff are friendly and helpful. They couldn't do enough. 

When I arrived on Sunday night there was a sign in the elevator that states there is no cleaning on a Sunday... Which I guess explains the food on the carpet under the table or crumbs in the lounge area - but doesn't explain why it was there 2 days later. 

Used face cloths I left on the shower floor will still there the next day... Wrappers for soap etc. were left on basin. 

The bed was not made appropriately on any day I was there. 

I was in a room that had 2 air con units and a duct vent on the outside - so not a restful sleep. 

TV in the room (not lounge) had hardly any channels. 

When you open the curtains in the lounge anyone in the parking garage can look in. There are no sheers. 

If I'm picky - I feel that the decision to not use Warm White Eco light bulbs made the room feel harsh, cold and uninviting. 

These apartments are in a good location.
hotel_response: Dear clintonfg.  Thank you for choosing Quest on Ward for your recent stay in Hamilton. Kenneth and Joe enjoyed having you stay and getting to know you.  I am sorry to hear of your concerns with your room. This is not our usual standard and we have made sure to follow up with all staff to share your thoughts and feedback. We do have the best location in the heart of the CBD and close to everything.  The best part is we are not located in the entertainment precinct, so we are away from that noisy area.  We value your comments and I am sure you will enjoy your next stay with us.  Thanks for noticing our Eco cleaning.  It is important to us that we are not using harmful chemicals which is great for any sensitive noses as well.  We look forward to being of service.  regards  Robert

title: Housekeeping Alert
text:
The nicely appointed 1 bedroom was great for a night away and was in a good quiet location of ward st which is a side st off the main strip.
The let down was that apart from the beds having fresh sheets and new bin liners I don't think house keeping had vacuumed or wiped down any surfaces for some time. Attention needs to be made to cleaning splatter marks and finger marks off the walls. I did mention it to the Chap on reception when we left who said he would raise it with house keeping. If they lift their game it will be good to see and we would stay again.
hotel_response:
Dear FrancesJH,

Thank you for staying with us at Quest on Ward and for taking the time to write a review. After receiving your comments, we are now investigating what happened to that room and are working with the housekeeping team to ensure that these things are not missed again. I would like to apologise for this incident. 

We enjoyed having you stay with us. Do let us know next time you are planing to visit Hamilton. There are always new cafes and restaurants opening nearby. Again, thank you very choosing Quest on Ward. See you next time!

Regards,

Kenneth
Assistant Manager

title: Great little hotel
text:
Pulled up and started looking for a hotel online and came across Quest. Great rate very happy with single room apartment and the service officer rostered. on was fantastic.

Can see from the comments its one of those hidden little gems. Highly recommended if all the staff are like this
hotel_response: Dear Paul B. Thank you for staying with us at Quest on Ward on your visit to Hamilton. We enjoyed having you stay with us. I am glad to hear that our staff were also able to help you in enjoying your stay even more. You are absolutely right, we are in a way one of those "hidden little gems" and reviews like yours definitely help others in finding us. Next time you're planning to stay in Hamilton, do let us know, we always give discounted rate and deals for direct bookings. See you next time! Kenneth, Quest on Ward.

title: Central, simple but comfortable
text: Great location (right in the middle of town, walking distance to shopping, casino, restaurants, etc), but was very quiet. I was here for 1 x night on business. Great sized apartment with full kitchen, laundry and the biggest bathroom. Quiet and convenient.
hotel_response: Dear KrisBB. Thank you for taking the time to write a review for Quest on Ward. We really enjoy hearing our guests having a great time here with us and in Hamilton. as you have already found, there are plenty of nearby cafes and restaurants as well as shopping malls nearby due to the very convenient location. Plenty more things to try here in the CBD of Hamilton so do let us know when you are back and we can give you more of our local tips and suggestions. Until next time. Kenneth, Quest on Ward.

title: The Worst of Twenty Three
text:
We recently returned from a two month trip that included stays in 23 different hotels.  Staying at Quest on Ward was definitely our worst experience.  We arrived at around 2:00 pm to find the front door open, but no one on the desk (there was a sign stating that staff was helping other guests and a number to dial in case of emergency).  Since we weren't in a hurry, we decided to wait.  After about 15 to 20 minutes, we felt we had waited long enough and called the number listed on the sign (I might add that the lobby is very small and narrow with only one chair so you can't really sit and wait comfortably).  Almost immediately after dialing, a very nice man arrived at the front desk, checked us in and explained the parking procedures.  We went to move the car and retrieve our bags, returning to find an empty lobby once more.  After settling into the room, we headed out to find food and, again, the front door was wide open but the reception desk was unmanned.  It would have been nice to be able to ask for  a restaurant recommendation but, more importantly, there seems to be a safety issue here, with anyone having total access to all floors of the hotel.  
Our room was located at the end of a long corridor and, parked directly outside our door, were two large fold-away beds (they were there for our entire stay).  I'm sure it must be difficult to make room for these large objects, but it made us feel as though we were staying in a forgotten storage area.  On first glance, our room looked very large, with a big kitchen and a huge bathroom.  But, when we actually tried to "live" in the room, we found out how impractical it was.  The bed is squeezed into a narrow alcove with only enough room on each side for a tiny bedside table.  We found a luggage rack in the closet, but then couldn't find a place against a wall to put it.  It ended up in the kitchen, with our other two bags balanced on a small desk and a tiny kitchen table.  If you go by square footage, the bathroom is gigantic, but it contains only a toilet, a small shower and a tiny sink and vanity.  There is no counter space to put even a small shaving kit or cosmetic bag, and there isn't even a single hook on the walls to hang up a towel or robe.  
There are signs all over the hotel advising that there is no housekeeping service on the weekends or holidays.  We were there mid-week and the only "housekeeping" we saw was the top cover on our bed was smoothed out and the garbage cans were emptied.  The kitchen floor was sticky, the counters were grimy and there were unpleasant smells in both the kitchen and bathroom.  Someone had gone through the room and spackled or patched what we assumed were either holes or scuffs on all of the walls, but they had never re-painted the patches or the walls (the same thing was evident in the hallways).  It gave the hotel a shabby, un-cared for look.
We were a little panicked by our stay here because our very next hotel was going to be Quest on Ward's sister hotel in Rotarua and we were worried we were going to have another negative experience.  We didn't need to worry, though, because the Quest Hotel in Rotarua was just beautiful.  It's very odd that two hotels from the same chain could be so different.
hotel_response: Dear R and S M.  Thank you for choosing Quest properties for your visit to New Zealand.  Quest has 35 properties in NZ and Fiji and about 140 all over Australia.  Always a great options with kitchens and laundry facilities. I am sorry to hear your disappointment in certain aspects of your stay however.  We have noted your feedback and appreciate you have taken the time to tell us about it. We operate a cozy small property of only 29 apartments in the central CBD and from time to time our reception staff do need to go up to help other guests.  I am sorry you had to wait, but please use the phone available for immediate assistance next time.  we do have 2 room types, the studio and the One Bedroom apartment.  Both have full facilites but the Studio does not have the separate living and bedroom that the 1 Bedroom apartment does have.  Saying that, even our studios are huge compared with near by hotels.  Perhaps your next visit you would prefer a One Bedroom apartment as the studio is perfect for an individual on a short visit.  We note your housekeeping comments also and will ensure these are improved upon.  It is wonderful of you to take the time to explore all around New Zealand.  I hope you have many lovely memories of your holiday to keep and to share.  warm regards  Robert

title: Quiet and clean in city
text:
Stayed for a couple of days on business. The property was consistent with other serviced apartments I've stayed in by Quest - it was well appointed, clean and had plenty of space. Handy location for cafes for breakfast etc, parking was available but I didn't need it. The price was good, the room was quiet and everything I needed. Would be good for a longer stay if required as it had a basic kitchen plus washer and dryer in the room. Would stay again no problem.

Wifi was available but only for a price so didn't use it - there is free Wifi in Hamilton CBD and also at Starbucks below the apartments.
hotel_response: Dear honie99. Thank you for taking the time to write a review for Quest on Ward. It is nice to hear that, like many other loyal Quest travelers, you enjoyed the spacious apartments that we have and the very convenient location that our property is located. There are always new restaurants and cafes popping up in the area as well as more stores being added to the shopping mall across the road so next time you are in Hamilton, be sure to check them out. -Kenneth (on behalf of Robert H).

title: Impressed
text: Quest really doesn't disappoint me ever. Whenever on a business trip,  prefer to choose this as have always had good experience staying in these apartments.  Be in Auckland,  Wellington and this time Hamilton. Good size rooms,  free movies,  good collection of movies,  good central location and absolute value for money.
hotel_response: Dear Kiran. Thank you for taking the time to writie a review for Quest on Ward. I am glad to hear that you enjoyed your stay with us, just like you have with any other Quests that you have been to. I am also pleased to hear that you enjoyed the movies we offer during our promotion with the free movies (usually from $2.99 per movie) that is running for a short time. We constantly update our collection of pay-per-view movies so next time you are visiting us, make sure to check them out. -Kenneth (on behalf of Robert H).

title: Very good basic accommodation in central city
text: Our room had all the amenities - kitchen, separate bedroom, bathroom, laundry, lounge, quiet and effective air conditioning, TVs etc - but first impressions were disappointing because it was all just basic and the lobby area is very small. Once we got over the first impression then everything was fine. It is located a few metres from Victoria Street (Main street) and over the road from a large shopping mall. Plenty of restaurants nearby. The front desk operates during the daytime with an intercom system working at night. We chose the secure parking ($10 per night) which was a good idea. The secure parking is at the rear of the hotel but be careful if you leave early (before the front desk is occupied) because you need the tag on your room key to get access to the secure parking. TV channels included the free-to-air NZ channels and about a dozen foreign TV channels including Chinese, France, RT, NTV, BNTV, MISTV, KTV, Bethel TV, Southern Sudan and others. However no sport channels or business channels.
hotel_response: Dear adesso2636. thank you very much for taking the time to write a detailed review for Quest on ward. I am very pleased to hear that you enjoyed your stay with us. you will be glad to know that we have mentioned your concern regarding TV channels to our provider and that they are looking into expanding the number of channels that we have and increase the number of business channels we have (besides France24 and EuroNews). -Kenneth (on behalf of Robert H).

title: Great Apartments
text: Well positioned, well equipped and very clean with super helpful staff make this a very enjoyable stay and great value for money. The rooms are excellent and we had a really relaxing stay so we say it's worth a visit for sure if you want some good central accommodation.
hotel_response: Dear nowtouringnz. Thank you very much for taking the time to write a review for Quest on Ward. We are very pleased to hear that you enjoyed your relaxing stay with us during your visit to Hamilton. See you again next time! -Kenneth (on behalf of Robert H).

title: Good Value
text: Good basic accommodation. Clean, quiet with a fantastic location if you want to be in central Hamilton. The room is at the same level of a typical NZ motel, suitable for purpose but not luxurious. Plenty of great restaurants within walking distance as well as the Centreplace shopping mall on your doorstep. Professional but not overly friendly management. Good secure parking option. Definitely recommend.
hotel_response: Dear triflow. Thank you very much for writing a review for Quest on Ward. I am glad to hear that you, like many others, found that our location is great and very central. Hamilton is constantly opening new cafes and restaurants so be sure to ask one of our front desk staff for some new recommendations and local tips on your next trip to Hamilton -Kenneth (on behalf of Robert H).

title: Nice Centrally located accommodation
text:
Nice modern clean apartments - centrally located - handy for shopping and restaurants. Front desk very helpful and accommodating and found us connected rooms even though we only booked the night before. I would probably go for the secure parking if I stayed again the alley round he back where I parked looked sketchy but no problems.

Short walk to river and the victoria street where all bars and restaurants are
hotel_response: Dear Enj0yTravelN0w. Thank you for taking the time to write a review for Quest on Ward. Even though your stay with us was brief, we hope that you enjoyed your stay with us. We would love to have your family again with us on your next visit to Hamilton. -Kenneth (on behalf of Robert H).

title: spacious budget apartment in excellent inner city location
text:
This is a somewhat minimalist apartment hotel, right in the heart of the central city, above Starbucks, across the road from the largest inner-city shopping mall, and just a two minute walk from the Novotel, Ibis, and Skycity casino.
A taxi to Claudelands Event Centre across the river only took 5 minutes and cost $12
In the evening we walked to the restaurant precinct on South Victoria Street.
There is paid parking, in a parking structure behind the hotel, although the parking instructions are so complicated that the receptionist felt the need to lock reception and valet the car for us!
The apartment was spacious, although as is typical with budget business apartments, the decor and furniture was functional rather than comfortable and welcoming.
The bed was firm but comfortable, there was a tiny Juliet balcony overlooking the street, and the apartment came equipped with a spacious kitchenette and laundry facilities in the bathroom.
Wifi was pretty slow.
The apartment had a heat pump which warmed things up very quickly.
A pretty minimal breakfast package was offered for $12 - although I would recommend going downstairs to Starbucks for a better deal.
There is also a good food court directly across the road inside the Centerplace shopping mall.
We would happily stay here again.
hotel_response: Dear Kiwi-Frequent-Flier. Thank you very much for taking the time to write a detailed review for Quest on Ward. I am glad to hear that your time with us was a good one and that you would be visiting us again. Hamilton is constantly changing and adding more things to the CBD so I am sure that you would be happy to discover more cafes and restaurants that are going to be only a few minutes walk from our property. See you soon! -Kenneth (on behalf of Robert H).

title: Have stayed here many times
text:
Working on a project in Hamilton Quest on Ward became my 2nd home.

Robert is an amazing host, he really would go out of his way to make sure my stays were always comfortable and the rooms were always spotless.

I have stayed in rooms on all floors and have been in Studios and 1 bedroom apartments. For a single traveler both of these room types are fine.

Parking is down a side street behind the apartments but are easy to find, I rarely parked in the locked garage and my car was always safe.

Kenneth and Joseph are now the hosts for Ward St and are amazing. Robert has taught them both well.

I highly recommend these apartments. It was nice to have a kitchen/dining area and also a balcony. The bathrooms are very large and have a washer/dryer and laundry powder is also provided. Located across from Centre Place made this venue very handy.
hotel_response: Dear talulah32. Thank you for taking the time to write a review about us! I'm very glad to hear that we have been like a 2nd home for you. Robert and the rest of us in the team have enjoyed having you here as our regular and will definitely miss having you around. Hopefully we will see you again some time soon. If you even feel homesick, you know where to find us! Kind regards, Kenneth (on behalf of Robert).

title: Thanks for making Hamilton better
text: Such a pleasure to have large, clean, well furnished and appointed rooms right in the centre of town. We struggle to find even a scungy place during Fieldays; Quest saved us this year. Right next to Starbucks in the middle of the night action in town.
hotel_response:
Dear David T. Thank you for taking your time to write a review about us! I am very pleased to here that we could help make your Hamilton trip a better one. It is always nice to know when you have made a positive impact on someone's stay. Hopefully we will see you again some time soon. Once again, thank you for taking your time to do a review and thanks for choosing Quest on Ward.
Regards, Kenneth (on behalf of Robert)

title: Scary start but once in good apartments
text: Two of us (both women) arrived at 9.30pm in the freezing cold and had to ask to be let in through an intercom system. There were 3 men drinking on the ground beside the door and the 'voice' through the intercom asked for our full names, where the car was parked and gave the code to get into the security box to get the keys for our rooms before letting us into the door. The  doors were then released and we were able to access the security box in an unattended foyer - keys in an envelope along with other envelopes. The doors stayed open for some time. At any point, we could have been mugged or followed to our rooms. Noone else on the street. Rooms had the windows open when we got in (really cold) and the air con remote had no screen able to be displayed. The TV in my bedroom had 2 channels with an elongated screen. The rooms themselves were well appointed and clean.
hotel_response:
Dear  Tricia. Thank you for taking your time to write a review for Quest on Ward. I am sorry to hear about the 3 men you have mentioned in your review. I understand your concern regarding safety and we have reported these people you mentioned to the City Safe patrol in Hamilton who patrol the streets after-hours. As for your concerns regarding the TV in the bedroom, we are still currently in the process of upgrading our TVs and TV systems in the bedroom hence the basic channels. I am happy to see the room tip you have left as well regarding requesting the location of your room. We understand that everyone has different preferences and so we encourage people to let us know if they would like their rooms to be located on a higher or a lower floor so that we can arrange that for them if possible. We hope to see you again in the future and thank you for choosing Quest on Ward.
Regards, Kenneth M. (on behalf of Robert)

title: They Contacted Me
text:
When I stayed at this hotel, I had not long written a review (Little America, Flagstaff) and said how disappointed I was when the hotel did not make an effort to contact me when I had left something behind.

At Quest on Ward I experienced just the opposite and it was appreciated. Not too long after checking out I received an email about items left in the clothes drier ,,, I collected them the next day. The manager said they do this because guests might still be in the area, even having breakfast just along the street.

How thoughtful !!

My apartment had absolutely everything. Was spacious. Was very presentable. Could not be more central. The tariff was attuned to the market on the day; being a quite Sunday evening in Hamilton, I was offered a good deal.

I was generally impressed.
hotel_response: Dear Murray H. Thank you for writing a review to us and for choosing Quest on Ward! I am glad that you have enjoyed your 1 night stay with us. We hope to see you again in the future and maybe even for a longer stay. Again, thank you for taking your time to write a review. See you next time! Regards, Kenneth M. - Assistant Manager (on behalf of Robert, the Manager).

title: Not again
text: Whilst the hosts were very helpful this apartment was noisy, small and needs a renovation. The bed was uncomfortable, air conditioning from the lounge did not go through to the bedroom yet you couldn't keep windows open because of the noise from the streets below in the early hours of the morning. Dirty towels were left in the bottom of a broom cupboard, paint off the walls...not a great experience!

title: Great stay
text: Lovely staff, clean and tidy. Excellent after hours service, handy to town and everything you need.  Would stay again, only thing we would stay two nights to get the full benefit and value for money and maybe rest staying the next floor up. We had room 119 on level one.
hotel_response: Dear King0903.  We enjoyed having you visit Hamilton and thank you for choosing Quest on Ward.  1 night is definitely not enough for a break away as there is lots to do in our area.  Victoria Street South has great places to dine at night and the wonderful Browser's Books is open until 9 pm.  I hope you enjoyed one of the many excellent breakfast places close by for a leisurely late morning Sunday Brunch.  We are happy to extend the use of our car park until after lunch on a Sunday so you can stroll, eat, shop and maybe eat some-more!   Thanks again and see you soon.  regards Robert and Chern.

title: Good rooms and great service
text:
Quest on Ward is well located and also well equipped. The standout for us was the great service from the Manager on duty. You don't necessarily expect an apartment hotel to have a high service level but the manager couldn't have done any more to help.
We did find the hotel extremely difficult to find as Ward Street is split by a pedestrian precinct. Added to that the signage and entrance are very small and easily missed. A clearer description of where to look would help.
hotel_response: Dear Chris.  We really enjoyed your visit recently and so glad you found us!   Ward Street has been cut in half by the wonderful new Centre Place Mall which still seems to confuse the car navigator systems, so it is best to drive in from the Victoria Street side.  We are next to the Starbucks and parking is behind us in Ward Lane.  Good news is we will be getting some new signage soon which will make it easier to see us also. Thank you for the feedback and choosing Quest on Ward.  Save travels     Robert and Chern

title: Excellent
text:
Self sufficient apartments centrally located in Hamilton city. 
Shopping Stores – K Mart and The Warehouse (Walking distance)
Grocery Super Market- ( Countdown and Pak n Save – about 1.5 km)
All major restaurants –(Hood St. , Victoria St. and Alexander St.– Walking distance)
Subway – across the road
Burger King and Pita Pit – Walking distance
Best Value for money. Staff very friendly.
hotel_response: Dear acute_traveller_39.  It seems you explored all the shops, restaurants, boutiques and Malls surrounding us.  We are happy to see you loved our location in the heart of the city and enjoyed your stay with us.  With day light saving time at the moment, magic evening walks along the river or around the lake really add a lovely end to the day.  Hamilton is a great base to explore the region as you have found.  warm regards Robert and Chern

title: What a surprise
text: Even with a GPS it is hard to find and we were lucky to get a park outside. They have their own car park but it is too far to carry your bags. The room was nice with a view of the car park. But such friendly service made it worth while.
hotel_response: Dear eBigAl250.   It is great you found Quest on Ward for your Hamilton stop over and we thank you for your review. Ward Street is cut in half by the Centre Place Mall which means the best approach is from Victoria Street side and there we are, next to Starbucks!  We enjoyed your visit and hope to be of service again some day.  regards Robert and Chern

title: Top location! Top management!
text: We (4 adults) found ourselves travelling to Hamilton at short notice, and during the Christmas Holiday time and chose the Quest guided by the TA comments and were not disappointed!  There was a minor issue with our booking but we were impressed with the way Robert, the manager showed us the various options and found something that suited us.  The location is right in the centre of town adjacent to a modern mall- lots of shops with everything you need here.  At night it was quiet and we requested rooms at the back of the hotel away from the street and these did not disappoint.  The rooms are large and well appointed- we have stayed at a competing property nearby and found the Quest rooms to be nicer, and, with the very personal service of Robert the manager, with no doubt we would stay at the Quest again.  Wifi and parking were great.  I stupidly locked myself out of the room and Robert had to come back after hours to let me into the room- he seemed to take it all in his stride and I was most grateful!  Congratulations Team Quest on a great product!  We will be returning!
hotel_response: Dear Drurolnz.  We were happy to be of service last week for your visit to sunny Hamilton. Now you have found Hamilton's best location we look forward to seeing you return again as one of the many members of the Quest on Ward extended family.  Next time you may get time to explore Browser's Books in Victoria Street with a great selection of rare, interesting and topical books.  It is hard to visit without finding some must have treasure.  see you again soon, regards Robert and Chern.

title: Excellent accommodation
text: Quest on Ward was an excellent choice for a recent 4 day business stay in Hamilton. An ideal central CBD location, very comfortable, well appointed and spacious apartments; reliable wi-fi; easy access to good cafes; and outstanding service from staff. I've stayed elsewhere in Hamilton on other business trips, but Quest on Ward is by far the best all-round value for money. The front desk staff couldn't have been more helpful - even cheerfully couriering home to me a charger and cables I'd left behind. Highly recommended.
hotel_response: Dear MWG_NZ.  Wonderful to see you enjoyed your stay with us supporting your busy few days in Hamilton.  Levin is not so far away so we look forward to welcoming you back again when you next need the central CBD accommodation at Quest on Ward.  warm regards Robert and Chern

title: Great location
text: What a great location if you want restaurants and shopping on tap. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Room had everything you could need although the couch was a little uncomfortable after a while. Bed was very comfy. And very quiet considering it is located in the middle of the CBD.
hotel_response: Dear caley66.  Thank you for choosing Quest on Ward once again. We enjoyed having you visit with us last week and it is great to see you enjoyed our most central location.  With the Mall surrounding us and loads of cafes so close by, it is easy to leave the car and wander around. Did you try the Milk and Honey coffee shop up on the 5th floor above I - Site?  a great little secret place for a coffee and a view over the river to the hills in the distance. We look forward to your next visit.  best regards Robert and Chern

title: Nice and clean
text:
A nice and clean unit with plenty of room in the bathroom, nice comfy bed, good stove and fridge freezer. Place was tidy and clean, reception staff pleasant.

Very central, would stay again. No Street noise, lots of eating places nearby.
hotel_response: Hello Cameronkerr.  thank you very much for your time to review Quest on Ward after your stay.  It is great to see you enjoyed your break away.  If you come again after April, there is a great vintage steam and diesel tramway up in the bush above Huntly.  It operates the first Sunday April to December each year and is great for young and old.  There is lots to explore in this area apart from the great shopping and food to be found at our doorstep.  see you again soon.  Robert and Chern

title: Return to Quest on Ward
text: Four years ago I spent an enjoyable two weeks at the Quest on Ward. I was delighted to discover on my recent return there that it was still as good. Staff went out of their way to make my stay as comfortable as possible, and nothing was too much trouble. The accommodation is clean and relatively spacious, with self-catering facilities available. The location is very convenient, though it was sad to see the effect that the opening of an out-of-town shopping centre has had on many of the small shops around Ward Street that were thriving four years ago. Ward Street can be a bit noisy first thing in the morning, so if you are a light sleeper you might want to go for a room at the rear of the property. Despite that, I would definitely stay there on a future business trip.
hotel_response: Dear JRKernow.  We are happy to see you enjoyed your return to Quest on Ward after 4 years!  We  were delighted to meet you this visit and thank you for choosing us for your accommodation needs.    It was a busy time for you with your work schedule, but I hope you had some time to enjoy the evening walks by the river and some great restaurants here in the central city.  Did you find 'Milk and Honey' the coffee place up on the 5th floor above the tourist information centre?  a little gem with views to boot!  We hope to see you again, perhaps before another 4 years passes?  regards Robert

title: Fantastic, the staff really do their very best to take care of you.
text: From the first phone call through to checking out every effort was made to accommodate us and our little boy. Excellent location in the middle of town but far enough away from bars that you don't get street noise. This is now our go to place to stay whenever we are in Hamilton, highly recommend it!
hotel_response: Dear Megs.  It was lovely to have your family stay with us in the heart of Hamilton. As you have noted, we are close to EVERYTHING but nice and quiet at night.  Summer is on the way so I hope you get a chance to return and enjoy the wonderful parks along the river and by the Lake. Perfect for families. See you again for more adventures in the Waikato region. regards Robert

title: Best in town
text:
Loved this place.  The owner and his staff were super helpful super efficient and super nice.
Everything was perfect from the moment we rang to book to the moment we left.
The location is great right in the centre of town. The fit out of the apartment is super good. We will be back next year for sure. 

Sent from my iPad great
hotel_response: Hi Val.  What a busy week you had! We were happy to welcome you and get to know you over the 8 days you were here. Having the interconnecting apartments meant each of you had plenty of space but could also easily spent time together when you wanted. We are looking forward to catching up again next year.  all the best, Robert

title: A++ for this Service Apartment
text: Spent 2nites there, Room was cozy and clean, and in a convenient location which is in the central with malls, restaurants and cafes around. The owner has been a great host, friendly and helpful, always ready to make us feel at home. Highly recommended.
hotel_response: Dear Younga_Chin   We enjoyed having you stay with us last week and getting to know you. It is good to see that you had a great stay in Hamilton also. Did you get to visit the Zeelong Tea Plantation on the northern outskirts of Hamilton? it is a lovely place to walk around and also enjoy their wonderful Oolong Tea and Tiffin morning tea.  Hope you get to visit with us again soon. regards Robert

title: Everything needed and more.
text:
Love the place, amazing rooms with both a homely and modern feel right in the heart of Hamilton. Friendly service with a smile.

Reviews have to be at least 200 words (?) so I will give a play-by-play of our experience. Called up prior to arriving to discuss parking ($10 per day behind the building off the street) and was greeted by a friendly male voice who had everything sorted in no time. Arrived and parked behind the building in a free quest spot then went inside to book the parking and drop bags off in our room. Was greeted by name (must not have been too many people staying that day or remaining to arrive) and everything was smooth and straightforward, then headed out to the city to enjoy our stay. 

Overall very painless pleasant experience with no hiccups along the way and would stay at quest once again.
hotel_response: Dear Walkingblindly.  We are happy to see you enjoyed your stay last month with us here in Hamilton. As we are a smaller sized property we generally get to know our guests pretty well in a short time and we were glad to get to know you also. Hamilton is a great base for exploring this region.  I hope you got to visit Hobbiton which is only 40 mins away. Zeelong, NZ's only tea plantation is about 15 minutes away also.  A very interesting and beautiful place. There's lots more to do so we hope to see you again soon.  regards  Robert

title: fantastic service
text:
only spent one night with my partner and friends here but the rooms were really great, they were super clean and the customer service was great =)
right in the center of town with pubs and restaurants on one side and a shopping mall on the other.
really enjoyed my night there.
the cleaners in the morning as we were leaving were really lovely aswell and wished us a safe journey home that day =)
hotel_response: Dear Sarah.  It is great to see you enjoyed your weekend break away to Hamilton. Being so central to shopping and cafes does make Quest on Ward an ideal home base. We enjoyed having you stay with us and hope to see you again soon.  Regards Robert

title: Wonderful 1st Experience of Hamilton
text: Nice and close to the Claudelands event centre. Very central to many varied and wonderful places to dine. Great host!! Very accommodating. Comfortable beds and great water pressure. Wonderful access to the mall which is not too busy which was really refreshing.
hotel_response: Dear WestCoastRTLB.  We are happy to see you enjoyed your time in Hamilton and with us at the Quest on Ward.
