It was great to have you all here for the conference and to get to know you for the few days you were here. We would be happy to welcome you again some time for a holiday perhaps!    best regards  Robert

title: Friendly professional staff
text:
Nice friendly team and very close to all Restaurants and entertainment.  Beds were comfortable.
Noise level from the car park was a little noisy, but overall good value for money. Watched the Rugby and the sports bar.
hotel_response: Dear Sheree w.  Thank you for your review and for choosing Quest on Ward recently.  Being a small property, we do enjoy getting to know our guests which is not so easy in larger places. It is great to see you slept well as we know you had a very busy schedule.  We hope to be of service again another time here in the heart of Hamilton.  regards Robert

title: Great staff but to many technical issues
text: Location was easy to get to and close for shopping, dining out and evening drinks. Sadly Friday night in Hamilton is very loud and on the first flour with no double glazed windows my travel buddy got woken 4-5 times. I didn't sleep the first night with an uncomfortable hard bed (they kindly added an extra layer) and my bedroom was either to cold or to hot as the AC was in the living area. Price was good for 2 bedroom apartment which was actually 2x1 bedroom apartments. Internet wasn't working on arrival bad despite asking for movies online it was never repaired so we didn't get to watch any. Staff we're very accommodating and apologetic. Place was clean. If you were heading for a big night out or a week night stay it might be more suitable.
hotel_response: Hello April.  We appreciate your time to write a review, thank you!  It is great to see that you enjoyed our weekend staff Kenneth and our wonderful location and of  course how large the interconnecting apartments are.  I am sorry to see you found the bed too hard.  Beds are very personal and from time to time we do get someone who prefers a harder bed or in your case a softer bed.  We do have toppers for those who love a soft bed so it is always really helpful to let the hotel know in advance so we can prepare.  I was wondering about the noise you encountered.  Ward Street is connecting to the main street and as such is usually pretty quiet.  There are no pubs or bars in our area at all.  Perhaps there were people walking home from other areas but never the less, I am sorry to hear you found the noises of a  city disturbing.  We certainly thank you for staying and hope to be of service again another time you are visiting lovely Hamilton.   warm regards  Robert and the team.

title: Great place to stay with kids
text: We stayed here for a week with our two little girls in a 2 bedroom apartment. It was perfect place to stay with kids. The 2 bedroom apartments are 2 one bedroom ones joined together, so there was  loads of space, 2 kitchens, 2 sitting rooms, 2 bathrooms... The girls loved watching a movie in the big bed, the washer and dryers in the apartment are so handy and the kitchen is big enough and equipped enough to cook a meal in. This place was perfect for us. Really quiet, super convenient location, great beds and friendly staff.
hotel_response: Dear Becky W.  Thank you for bringing your family to stay at the Quest on Ward recently. Our 2 bedroom set up is certainly fantastic for families as it gives 2 x One bedrooms interconnecting with double space and double facilities. Glad you loved it! Did you get to take the family to the Classics Car Museum?  It is really worth a visit and one of the many good family activities in Hamilton. We look forward to being of service again in the future.  regards Robert

title: Great service, parking terrible
text:
All staff encountered were professional and friendly, providing excellent service. This would be a good place to stay for corporate travel where you only had one bag. With children in tow, transporting bags from the rear parking (in a building away from the apartments) to the front door was cumbersome. (You also have to carry your gear past everybody sitting in Starbucks). There is no short term parking out the front, so if it's raining, it's very impractical. This is the first apartment I've ever stayed in without access from a car park to the building, or at the very least, access from the rear of the building.
The room was pleasant and clean. I like a firm bed but it was uncomfortably so. An egg carton type foam mattress topper available from the Warehouse would leave the bed firm but more comfortable. There was no pen supplied and I forgot to take the review form so couldn't make this suggestion.
The room was well equipped with a dishwasher and laundry, but lacked little things I'd expect from a high rated property like scissors and or a bowl to store any leftover food.
The T.V signal is non existent in the bedroom most of the time and kept dropping out in the lounge area. We were halfway through a movie and it kept freezing up, which was really annoying. 
The street sweeper as mentioned earlier is really noisy and comes by at around 6.00 am in the morning so sleeping in is impossible. On the flip side of that, it makes a good alarm clock.
Staff try their best to accommodate families, but it isn't the best choice for them. For corporate travel, it's ideal.
hotel_response: Dear 4JAW.   Thank you very much for your detailed review.  Quest properties are great for corporate travellers for sure but we also love families to visit. Our interconnecting apartments are huge and offer 2 bedrooms with 2 living areas, 2  bathrooms and kitchens. We have the best location in town but that does mean parking is a premium in any city location. My suggestion is to use the loading zone directly opposite our front door for unloading your belongings if there are many bags to bring in.  Ward street is in the heart of the city, so it can be busy indeed but that is part of the fun of being so close to all the shops and cafes. We really enjoyed having your family here with us and thank you once again for staying and for taking the time to review Quest on Ward.  regards  Robert

title: Great location - great value
text: Had a night here to break up the drive back to Aukland from Napier. As all other reviewers have mentioned Robert is exceptional in his professionalism and check - in was seamless  and friendly. Our room was exactly what you would expect from a Quest .......well equipped clean and pleasant. The street noise is a bit of a worry but if you stay in the CBD it's to be expected and it's not something management can control. Hamilton was a pleasant surprise and definitely worth a look if you are travelling in the area. All in all an enjoyable, if only a quick visit.
hotel_response: Dear Clearclearclear    We are happy that you found us and discovered how great Hamilton is also.  It is a good stopover to break a journey, but also a great place to explore the region.  Waitomo Caves, Hobbiton, Raglan surf beaches, Sanctuary Mountain and wonderful gardens and river walks.  Our restaurants are also very good so there are lots of reasons to stay a day or two in this area.  Thank you for staying with us and for your review.  We hope to welcome you back again some day to the Waikato.  regards  Robert

title: Great stay
text:
We stayed there 31st May as a group of 11 for one night, everything that we asked for was supplied without any hesitation, we enjoyed the stay and we will be back to stay again not a problem. Deco great, outlook great, warm and comfortable well suited our needs.
Nothing was a problem. Thank you Robert you were great to work with, your communication with us was over the moon, many thanks to you, cheers Sheryl and Don
hotel_response: Hi Sheryl and Don.  Thank you for bringing you group of 11 to stay last weekend.  We enjoyed having you here and and were glad to be a small part of your big celebration.  It is always great to have a family gathering and also a short break away from home.  Where better than  the heart of Hamilton?  We will see you for the next event or even just an escape for a night or two.  regards Robert

title: Highly recommended for quality and friendliness
text:
My friend and I stayed here for two night s in May 2014.

I think it was Robert on reception who was extremely friendly and helpful, despite the mayhem of some renovations being done to the property! He remained cool, calm and collected throughout!

Although the bedding configuration in the original room was wrong, we were quickly moved to another room and Robert went out of his way to personally make up our beds (he told us he wasn't very good at making beds but he rates up there with the best!)

The unit was spacious and spotlessly clean. Very comfortable. Not much choice for TV watching, but that wasn't our reson for being there, so not a major deal for us. 

The property is walking distance to shopping, restaurants and bars.
hotel_response: Dear Lisa T.   I am glad that you enjoyed your stay at the Quest on Ward last month. It was good to meet you both and it is great that you enjoyed our location and facilities. Usually we are pretty good at making sure the room set up is right, but  thanks for your patience on that day.  There are lots of conferences in Hamilton and with our central city location, it is an easy walk everywhere, including Claudlands Event Centre, as you found out. We look forward to welcoming you here again sometime.  regards  Robert (the apprentice bed maker)

title: Excellent accomodation, location and staff
text: We stayed at Quest on Ward for 3 weeks while visiting family and would highly recommend staying here. Location and room were excellent with everything you would need for an enjoyable stay and Robert was very friendly and helpful. Was everything we could have wished for and more!!
hotel_response: Dear Alison A.   We enjoyed having you visit with us here in the heart of Hamilton city and support your son during his last few weeks of his course. Hamilton is a great central point to explore the caves, beaches, thermal and cultural areas, Hobbiton and national parks all just a day trip from our comfortable and warm serviced apartments. Thank you for choosing Quest on Ward and for becoming part of our family of guests here.  regards Robert

title: Fantastic location for business traveller
text:
Great location - walk across the road to the coffee club for breakfast each morning before work, then around is a large array of restaurants to chose from at night, it is also very close to the river which I walked along each night before dinner.

The staff were very friendly & extremely helpful & went out of their way to make our stay pleasant.

Well appointed and spacious room.
hotel_response: Dear theluddys.  We appreciate your time to review your stay at Quest on Ward.  It was great to welcome you and it is good to see you enjoyed your time in Hamilton. Our super central loctation cannot be beaten for shopping, cafes and entertainment too - all 1 street from Victoria Street, so it is much quieter at night than most city properties. We do hope to be of service to you again soon.  Regards Robert

title: Great value, great location
text: A friend and I booked a studio room . It was really spacious and had full kitchen facilities. The service was really nice and it's so close to the shopping and restaurants in hamilton. Parking is a bit of a mission but cheap and ok given it's right in town.
hotel_response: Dear Theluddys.  It is great to hear you enjoyed your weekend break to the happening heart of Hamilton city. Our lovely Studio apartments have the same full facilities as the One Bedroom apartments with Kitchens and laundry facilities and a balcony of course. Perfect for a short stay or longer and interesting to note that these our smallest apartments are still bigger in size than the many of the hotels in the surrounding area.  A weekend break with great food and some retail therapy is just what the doctor ordered!  Come and enjoy Centre Place Mall, the Casino and loads of cafes all within a stroll of our front door. regards Robert

title: Excellent location and modern apartment
text:
Stayed two nights in Quest on Ward and was very impressed.  The apartment was clean, modern, quiet for its location right in the heart of the city and warm.  The apartment had natural light, washing/dryer machine for long stays and excellent apartment facilities.  The parking for the car is in a close but security tight parking lot so its best to pull up outside the apartment, unload then park the car.

I would stay again and if you like shopping its a dream location.  The windows are double glazed so keeps in the warmth and sound out.

Excellent accommodation.
hotel_response: Dear BuddyNZ. We are happy to read that you enjoyed your stay in Hamilton and Quest on Ward was part of the great experience here. For anyone looking for a great base to explore Hobbiton, the Waitomo Caves, Sanctuary Mountain and many beautiful parks, Hamilton is hard to beat. Retail therapy and wonderful cafes are also good for the soul ! We look forward to seeing you again soon.   regards  Robert

title: Fantastic service and accommodation
text:
After a rather hectic day - and the unexpected need of accommodation - i found this little gem after being turned awag (or ignored) by the bigger chains. Robert (the owner) greater me on arrival and checked me in efficiently and told me all the things i needed to know.  The room was spacious - all the amenities I required including a washer/dryer.
Would definitely recommend
hotel_response:
Thank you for your review and finding us here in the heart of the city - Ward Street  You had certainly had a rough day and we were happy to be of service and some sanctuary. We hope all is going well now for you and hope to see you again sometime.  regards
Robert

title: Excellent accommodation
text: Quick and efficient check in and check out.  Great room and spacious.  We especially liked the separate room and able to watch the tv privately in the bedroom as well as in the lounge.  Really appreciated having a kitchen to cook in and a large fridge for our use.  Was most impressed to find a washing machine and dryer in the bathroom.  Very useful.  I liked being able to let ourselves in with a special swipe button.  Access to the hotel is quite easy, once you know how.  outside parking at the entrance to the hotel.  Only a couple of buildings from Victoria St on Ward to  the left if heading towards Te Rapa direction.  Bank directly across the road, and the 24hour dining also.  Very convenient to pop in before heading back to your room.  We would definitely stay again.
hotel_response: Dear Rona.  We are glad you found our home away from home in the heart of Hamilton.  We enjoyed your visit and saw you could leave the car and walk to great food and shopping all around us. A great break away for the weekend!  see you again soon,  regards Robert

title: Nice room. Good location. Friendly service
text:
My fiancé and I recently visited Hamilton and stayed here for four nights. The room was not large, but very tidy and nice. The small kitchenette allowed us to cook our known meals. We also had access to our own washer.

The manager was very helpful and friendly and the cleaning service was top notch. If there are dirty plates and cutlery, the service puts them in the dishwasher. Fresh towels are made available whenever they are required.

The motel is centrally located and great for accessing the centre of the city. It can get a little noisy, but that's to be expected. Parking is available, but a little inconvenient to get to. The motel has only one entrance/exit and the car park must be accessed by walking around the corner behind the building.

The rate is quite reasonable. We would happily stay here again.
hotel_response: Dear Oods_From_Orange    We enjoyed your visit to the heart of Hamilton and the Quest on Ward. Thank you for sharing your time with us over the last few days. It is great to see you found our location and facilities suited your needs and made your stay comfortable and convenient. With everything close this is a wonderful base to explore the city and the Waitkato region. We hope to see you again someday for more adventures in Hamilton.  regards Robert

title: Great accommodation but noisy.
text:
We stayed at the Quest on Ward for 4 nights. The apartments were clean and very comfortable.
Robert the owner went out of his way to be helpful. The only criticism we had was thew amount of noise coming from Ward Street during the night. We had to leave the windows open as it was quite stuffy and humid. I would suggest to Robert that a ceiling fan in the bedroom would help as the windows could be kept closed. Or maybe he could investigate double glazing for the street front windows. But all in all a pleasant stay.
hotel_response: Hi Joe. Thanks for your review and for staying with us. Glad you found our little place to be friendly and comfortable. Summer time in Hamilton can get humid you are correct. We all love the fresh air with the window open but next time you might consider using  the Air con in the room. It also has dehumidifier settings which are my favorite. Cool and dry and sleep like a baby! Our street is a busy day time street and a no through road at night so not much traffic. Normal city noises like cleaners can be heard, but with your window closed your sanctuary is peaceful and quiet!  Come again soon, Perth is not so far away..    :-)      Robert

title: Best stay everytime A++++
text:
I have stayed at The Quest in Ward twice now snd refuse to go anywhere else.

Location is so central just a walk to many restaurants, Starbucks is outside the door and the mall is across the road,  which was great for me and the kids. 

Cant wait for the next visit. 

Rayna W
hotel_response: Hi Rayna. It was great to catch up with you again! We are glad to see you enjoyed your stay and love our super central location.  We are looking forward to see you next time in Hamilton.  Regards Robert

title: Good location, friendly staff, small bedroom!
text: Stayed here for 2 nights and couldn't have asked for a better location. The staff we're friendly and very helpful, the room was fine but I could the bedroom a bit small, certainly couldn't keep 2 suitcases in here as well as people!
hotel_response: Dear Jillian.  Thank you for choosing Quest on Ward for recent visit. Glad you loved our prime location and service. We were happy to get to know you during your stay. The Raglan beaches and Bridal Veil Falls are beautiful this time of year so I hope you had time to explore.  We hope to see you again sometime soon.   regards Robert

title: Central location
text: Great location but very difficult to find - make sure you get good directions before arrival. Manager was lovely - very helpful, friendly and plenty of ideas for suitable restaurants and activities. Rooms were great - clean and spacious. Bit of a problem with the washing machine but it was sorted quickly and efficiently. Would definitely go back there.
hotel_response: Hello Anne.  We enjoyed meeting you and your husband and it is good to know you enjoyed your break in Hamilton. it would be our pleasure to be of service to you both again when next you are in the wonderful Waikato region.  I am sure we can find more adventures for you here.  regards Robert

title: Awesome!!
text: We booked a studio & were upgraded to a one bedroom which was in excellent condition.  The staff were wonderful - very welcoming, helpful & friendly.  The location is awesome right in the middle of town, with a Starbucks coffee shop underneath, straight across the road from Centre Place mall & just down the road from the pubs & casino.  Being located on Ward street is great, it's just off Victoria street & is relatively quiet.  Car parking was very handy & secure.
hotel_response: Dear EAB08    We appreciate your time to write a review and it is great to see you enjoyed your time in Hamilton. Come for another weekend escape again soon.  regards Robert

title: Weekend on Ward St
text: We stayed in a one bedroom suite and it was spacious, modern and well appointed. Ground plunger coffee, not instant, was appreciated. The location is great for travellers wanting to be in the heart of Hamilton City. It's right by the recently revamped Centre Place mall and the Wintec city campus. Friendly and efficient service. I really like this style of accomodation as you are left to your own devices and can self cater but the service is there if required.
hotel_response: Hello Erikka.  Lots of people are finding Hamilton is becoming a great weekend away for food and shopping.  As you experienced, we could not have a better location to enjoy cafes, bars, boutiques and river walks too!  A happening, central, home away from home that is nice an quiet at night. We are happy to hear you enjoyed your stay and feel sure we will see you again soon.  all the best, Robert

title: Excellent service
text: I found the room to be excellent, modern and clean. The service provided was outstanding and I was made very welcome and all my needs were quickly attended to. Would highly recommend Quest on Ward if staying in Hamilton.
hotel_response: Hi Leanne.  We so enjoyed your short visit with us here in the heart of the city. There is lots more to do in our area so we hope to be of service to you again soon.  warm regards Robert

title: Outstanding service and welcome
text: Robert and his team could not have done more to make our stay easier. Good rooms, a great location with easy parking and nothing too much trouble. We look forward to returning again next year, just wish we could have stayed longer this time.
hotel_response: Dear Ann.  After a year it was great to see you again. We do feel like our guests become friends so it is good to catch up with you. Glad you enjoyed "Chim Choo Ree" restaurant in their fabulous new site in the old Brewery. See you again next January!  warm regards Robert

title: westcoaster
text: very central. safe. friendly and helpful staff. close to everything - restaurants, bus station, shops, malls, etc. I enjoyed the variety of tv channels that they have got. I will definitely go back. Thanks.
hotel_response: Hello Westcoaster!  thank you for visiting from Greymouth. I am sure you found Hamilton to be a lovely break away with lots to do in our region. Next time come and visit 'Maungatautari" or Sanctuary Mountain.  This mountain has been fenced off so there are no predators.  The birds and wildlife have thrived making it a unique place to see New Zealand in such a beautiful setting.  Google search it and you will be sure to want to visit! There is lots more to do also so see you again soon in the wonderful Waikato.  regards Robert

title: great location, value for money and excellent service
text: Quest on Ward is centrally located near shops, eateries and the river walk. The service is excellent and the Manager most helpful.  Car Parking is very reasonably priced.  We would certainly return to stay at Quest on Ward.
hotel_response: Dear Fiona.  Thank you for choosing Quest on Ward for your base while here in Hamilton. It is great to see that you enjoyed your stay and found everything at your fingertips in our super central location. We did enjoy  getting to know you and look forward to your return someday.  regards Robert

title: Very nice, clean and in center of city
text: After hunting a lot for hotels at night finally we found this one. This place is in center of Hamilton just on the back side of centre place. Its really hard to find nice place just in city where everything is on walking distance.Very clean and peaceful. Robert was really nice.
hotel_response: Hi Baljit. Yes you stumbled upon Hamilton's best kept secret and we were so glad to meet you. We do have the best location but our reception area is easy to miss!  Just remember to turn into Ward Street from the Victoria Street end and we are about 150 meters along on the left just before the Starbucks.  Now you have found us...  come again soon, we are waiting.  warm regards Robert

title: Great Staff
text: Staff friendly and more than helpfull, Located right in CBD, I had a one bedroom apartment was roomy clean and tidy. Stayed on a Saturday night was not noisy plenty of eateries and entertainment close by.
hotel_response: Dear Imike55.  There are lots of good places to stay in Hamilton so we really appreciate your choice to stay at Quest on Ward.  We  do value your comments in this review.  Did you get to try "Milk and Honey" a great coffee spot 5 floors up above the I- Site near by us with lovely views towards the river.  Chern and I look forward to your next visit to the heart of Hamilton and being of service again.  regards  Robert

title: well situated and good value for money
text: We have stayed here several times because of the situation right in the middle of the downtown area,the car parking at reasonable cost,and the excellent facilities including a full kitchen,dishwasher and air con.Great value at $119 per night plus $10 car parking.lots of restaurantsless than 10 minutes walk from the hotel.
hotel_response: Dear Mr Chappell.  It is always good to see you here in Hamilton for your short breaks away.  You are certainly correct about our enviably central location with everything just moments away. Our perfect Ward Street location is busy in the day but a quiet  street at night.  thank you for your review and see you again soon.  regards Robert

title: Friendly staff and brilliant location
text: The staff at Quest were amazing and friendly. They bent over backwards to accommodate almost any request. In our case, they helped us to organise a baby sitter so we could have a night out. The location is perfect, being right in the CBD. There were shops everywhere, huge varieties of places to eat, and a Hoyts Cinema within 100m. Everything was accessible from here, including beaches just 45 mins away (such as Raglan). The apartment was huge with almost everything anyone could require in terms of amenities. We have few complaints. The first being that the movies didn't work on the TV. We were assisted by staff but we couldn't get any of the pay movies (action, comedy etc) to work. I'm sure this will be sorted quickly. The only other complaint we have is the floor cleaning detergent the hotel uses makes the floor really slippery. Our first few showers felt dangerous and this was an uncomfortable feeling with two young kids. I suggest they switch brands.
hotel_response:
Dear Tristan.  We miss having your family around! It was good to have met up with you all.  We are glad to see you found our interconnecting apartments spacious and comfortable - perfect for families. Thank you for the feedback - as you saw we have about 200 movies on our system with many recent releases to enjoy.  The set up had a problem with it being interconnecting apartments as it is set to recognize single room numbers.  That is being resolved right now and I am sorry that you missed out on this for your family.  The other point about finding the floor in the bathroom got slippery when wet.  Great news on this is that we are in the process of converting our property to being CHEMICAL FREE with our special cleaning process.  At this point we have transitioned one of our floors only, but plan to extend this throughout all our apartments.  I am sure we all would be happy to have less chemicals in our lives but still have shiny clean rooms.   We are really happy with this change and look forward to your comments when you experience it next time you visit paradise Hamilton!   Perth is not so far away    ;-)       
regards  Robert

title: WONDERFUL
text: It was our 1st time staying at the QUEST ON WARD and it was more than what we had expected, Robert was so friendly and made sure our stay was awesome he was very helpful with restaurants and places to go, we will definitely stay here again and recommend to others
hotel_response: Dear Tania P.  It is good to hear you enjoyed your break away to Hamilton and that Quest on Ward suited your needs.  We did enjoy meeting you and hope you found all the wonderful features of this lovely region.  There is lots more to see on your next visit!  warm regards Robert

title: Quest on ward reveiw
text:
Stylish, well-stocked room, multiple facilities. Felt like a home away from home. Wonderful service and friendly staff. Very well priced, definitely looking forward to staying here again. 
The only negative thing was that we had to wash the dishes before we used them since they weren't cleaned properly.
hotel_response: Hello Avad005.   I really appreciate your time to review your stay with us and glad to see you enjoyed our facilities and brilliant location in the heart of Hamilton.  It is important to feel at home and I am happy to see you felt this way.  We felt at home with you too!  Our friendly guests such as yourselves really make our day. I note with concern about the cleanliness of your china ware.  We do pride ourselves in having a clean and friendly facility and we will track down what happened on this occasion.   You know where we are and we are looking forward to see you again.  warm regards Robert

title: Central CBD
text:
Right in the centre of Hamilton, close to everything.
We had a one bedroom apartment,seperate bedroom, ensuite, lounge kitchen area. Spacious clean and very comfortable,with all mod cons a lot better than a motel room.
hotel_response: Hi John W.  We are happy that you found our friendly serviced apartments in the heart of Hamilton to be the perfect base while in this region. The new refurbished Centre Place Mall opened in October and is proving popular for shoppers and the cafes in the area are a great way to watch the world go by.  Thank you for staying with us - come back soon and explore all the Waikato has to offer.  regards Robert

title: Loved everything!!
text:
From the time I booked the room in advance to the day we checked out the staff were fantastic and very helpful. The room was beautiful and had everything we needed.
The location was perfect, just across the road to Centre Place where there was great shopping and a food court. Sky City was just around the corner so we had plenty of entertainment and choices for some where to eat.
The only thing was the rooms werent serviced on a Sunday, as we were staying the weekend it would have been nice but it was no major.
The carpark was very close to.

Overall 5 out of 5
hotel_response: Dear Amber Rose E.  Wow, it is great to see you loved your visit to Hamilton and Quest on Ward.   Did you get to try Theobroma for breakfast? Wonderful Eggs Benedict to be sure. Hobbition is only 40 minutes away so make sure to visit again and explore the area more.  We do recommend Sanctuary Mountain - Maungatautari for a day trip. The mountain is fenced off so no predators can come in and so the wildlife is abundant and varied. A very special place and a great day out. It was good to meet us with you and I hope we can be of service to you again soon.  regards Robert

title: Great place to Stay!
text: Great place to stay being central in Hamilton and close to plenty of restaurants etc. Check in was a breeze and the secure parking was well worth the added cost. The Directors Robert and Chern were sensational and nothing was to much trouble (thanks for the offer of free beer!!) and the young guy (whose name i didn't catch) was equally as good. I was working night shift and the cleaning crew did all they could to accommodate this and it was much appreciated. I would recommend to anyone thinking of staying in Hamilton to try here...
hotel_response: Dear Thedickos1    thank you for making Quest on Ward your home for almost 2 weeks! Although you were very busy and working overnight, we were glad to get to know you and enjoyed your company here in the happening heart of  Hamilton.   You noted how easy the after hours check in was for you.  We are always happy to email a confirmation with details of the process for those who are visiting with us for the first time and arriving late. It is good to know you achieved your business targets in Hamilton and we are happy to have been a small part supporting  your busy period here.  till next time, warm regards Robert

title: Great place to stay!
text: Two of us stayed in a one bedroom apartment.  Even though i did not draw the straw for the bedroom, the fold up bed was so comfortable and being in the lounge was completely quiet and worked a treat. The spacious bathroom was well equipped with washer/dryer and iron/ironing board which i love on a holiday.  The kitchen was well equipped as well as we like to cater for ourselves some of the time.  Loved the way it was quiet to stay but just walk out of reception and shops, restaurants etc were right there.  Robert or any of the staff were so prompt with any requests we had. Nothing was too much trouble!  Loved the friendliness and "at home" feel of the whole place.  Would stay again for sure!
hotel_response: Hello Wendy A. We really enjoyed having you visit with us recently and are very happy to hear our spacious 1 bedroom apartments met all your needs so well. Did you get a chance to visit HOBBITON or the Waitomo Caves? Hamilton is a great place to explore the region including beautiful parks, hot pools, rugged west coast surf beaches too. I know you told me you found some wonderful cafes close by and of course the new redeveloped Centre Place Mall is next door! Seems like you should be back again some time soon to enjoy our facilities and magic location. warm regards, Robert

title: Good Room But Check-In Uncessarily Difficult
text:
We were travelling on business and arriving in Hamilton late. We had arranged for undercover parking for our car as well as internet to be included (actually this was part of the offer when we booked). When we arrived,vreception was closed, but there's a button you press outside a door on the street. We spoke to someone on the intercom who gave instructions about going inside (once they'd released the main door) and punching a code into a small safe in the lobby in order to access an envelope with our room key.  We did this but alas found that we had a room key but no key to get into the garage parking. We unloaded the bags from our car (fortunately finding parking in the main street) then went up to the room and made some calls. Not only hadn't they left a garage key but they also hadn't provided an internet code. We found out that for arrivals after 7pm (when the reception closes), even if you've arrange undercover parking, they don't make it available because they say there's too much to explain about the parking and how to then exit the parking area so they only do it in person. It seems the hotel has had people calling police thinking they were stuck in the carpark because they didn't realise you had to walk to the end of the carpark area in order to get out.  This was very odd as we did advise we were arriving late when organising the parking.

Initially we were advised to just park in the lane behind the hotel but we had too many valuable things in the car to want to park in a dark lane in the middle of Hamilton - which is why we'd arranged the parking in the first place.  The person we spoke to on the phone, then said they'd come to the hotel (from home) and sort it out and give us parking access. So we waited and they came (only about 10 minutes) and provided the parking access and explained how to exit the parking station - actually not that difficult at all - and they could have put the instructions in the envelope with our room key and garage access key - goodness knows why they don't just do this.

Then another couple of calls were made and finally we received the Internet code- but then only one code suitable for one device. We had a discussion as the deal we took on the hotel offered free wifi - with no mention that it only applied to one device per room. We had to argue the point until they agreed they hadn't stated any conditions around the 'free internet' offer so we were given a second code. So instead of being able to arrive and check in and get online (this was a business trip), it took about an hour all up of unnecessary hold ups for things that we'd pre-arranged. 

Once inside our one-bedroom suite it was fine. The bedroom was small but had a comfortable bed and good wardrobe, and it was nice to have a desk and sofa area - as well as a kitchen. It was also useful to have a laundry which we did use (although it's very complicated set of instructions to use the washer/dryer). The bathroom was fine - however I always get frustrated when there's a sink with absolutely no space to put one's amenities - so a shelf would have been helpful. But generally the suite was clean and fine - the only issues being the lack of bathroom shelf space and the dreadful lighting! 

On a more positive note, the location is in the heart of Hamilton, there's a Starbucks just next door and the next morning the man at Reception (who was very friendly and helpful) advised us where to find a good place for breakfast - in an arcade across the road where we had delicious Eggs Benedict and good coffee!  

Would I stay here again? No - and simply because I don't want to have to go through an hour of messing around late at night because what we'd arranged hadn't been sorted. Also the car-parking location doesn't make it easy when you're unloading and loading up bags. Also the internet issues were just a pain in the neck - so be wary of a 'free internet' offer if you have two devices.
hotel_response: Dear MIW Sing. Thank you for a extensive and detailed review. I met up with you at night and also in the morning so I do remember you well. We are glad that you tried us out on this visit to Hamilton and the Eggs Benedict are surely delicious!. I am naturally very sorry to hear that your arrival after a busy day was not as smooth as you deserve. After hours check in and parking are set up as to  not be too complicated, but as we have 2 parking areas we do usually allocate the closer position behind our building so we can assist and explain in person instructions for the second car parking area if required when we meet up subsequently.  We appreciate your comments and thank you for assisting us with your perspective - this is very valuable to us!   I have updated your profile on our system here so that we understand your needs as busy professionals at the end of a long day. I am confident you will find Quest on Ward to be just what you need to support your accommodation requirements in future.  warm regards Robert (not the Eggs Benedict Chef!)

title: Brilliant place to stay !!
text:
Three of us had rooms booked at Quest on Ward while we attended a conference. Lovely rooms, quiet with excellent facilities within each room. The Franchise Directors were brilliant! Out going, keen to help in any way they could. Robert gave us use of his loading trolley for 2 days to move a large number of boxes around at the conference. Well sorted charge backs for a number of restaurants. I travel most weeks and I must admit to being a little jaded as far as accommodation and expectations - Quest on Ward was a wonderful experience. I will only be booking at Quest on Ward when I am back in Hamilton. I will go so far as to ensure it is placed at the top of the list for our companies internal booking forms and will recommend it to one and all. My thanks to the Quest on Ward team.
Catherine
hotel_response: Hi Catherine. Wow! You three had a really busy week here at the conference but I am happy to see that in some small ways we could support your needs. Some people come to stay because we have the best location in Hamilton, but for busy people like yourselves,  I am glad you were able to achieve all you needed to do and also had a very successful conference. Not to forget getting a little sleep in between all that you had to do.We enjoyed meeting you and will be here next time you need a comfortable refuge in the heart of Hamilton city. The amazing new shopping mall opens 17th Oct 2013 so perhaps you should spoil yourselves and come back for some retail therapy soon!  warm regards Robert

title: Nice place to stay
text:
I stayed here while my mother was in Hamilton hospital. The accommodation was recommended and the owners/directors were just fantastic, going out of their way to help us out.  
The rooms were clean and modern, the bathroom was good and the bed was comfy. It is just off the main street, within walking distance to restaurants. 
So if you are visiting or on business, this is a very nice place to stay.
hotel_response: Hello Melissa,  we were glad to be of service to you and your family and happy to see you found our accommodation and location to suit your needs so well.  Thank you for staying and your kind review.  We are always here should you need us again.  warm regards Robert

title: Fabulous Service!
text:
We arrived late at Quest on Ward after a long day at Waikato Hospital with my mother in law. Robert was amazing! found us a great room, parking, good advise for dinner and was just genuinely interested in our day and showed compassion for our experience with mum in law not being well.

The room was great, spacious, and the bed oh so comfy! Only a short walk to the main street where there was an incredible choice of eateries including The River Cafe (a must) and Mexico (always great).

Would definitely recommend Quest on Ward.
hotel_response: Dear Tamzin S.  We are so glad you found us that evening and that Quest on Ward could provide some well needed home comforts after a long day at the hospital. It is great to hear that you found our place to be a good experience over all and you could then focus on the important things at that time.  I hope all is well with your family and that we can be of service again when ever you need us.  warm regards, Robert

title: We will stay again
text: We stayed one Friday night in August. We actually couldn't find it at first and rang Robert; it turned out we were looking on the wrong side of the street (it's on the same side as Starbucks). Robert was so helpful and lovely and understanding when we realised we still had the keys with us the next day!  The apartment was warm and clean and lovely. The view was terrible - onto the back of buildings and carparks - but this meant it was quiet. Due to a little mishap we had to use the washing machine/dryer which did its job well. Shower was great. Bed comfortable. Kitchen well-equipped. A minor quibble: I would have difficulty staying here on my own as I am short and disabled, and I would have trouble reaching some of the kitchen cupboards. Location is wonderful - just a walk across Ward St and into Centreplace to go to dine in Bryce St and then to the Lido Cinema. We plan to stay there again.
hotel_response: Hello Sylphie.   We are happy to read you enjoyed your stay with us in our lovely apartments in the heart of Hamilton city. It is a super comfortable and cozy place to be and close to everything as you noticed. Views may not be so exciting in any city environment but the bonus is so many cafes and boutiques, shops and entertainment options (great you enjoyed the wonderful Lido Cinema!) surrounding us.  Park the car and stroll to everything!  Just to note, we do have special mobility access apartments with lower kitchen cupboards as well as easy access bathroom facilities. Just let us know for next time for your comfort.  We are waiting to welcome you again for your next short break to Hamilton.  best regards, Robert

title: Clean, tidy and central
text: Brilliant place to stay if you are visiting central Hamilton.  Close to mall, casino and a load of different eateries.  Very clean and tidy.  Friendly staff.  A+. Rooms large and the separate bedroom from lounge area is a plus.
hotel_response: Dear Noacy.  It is great to read your review and hear that you had a terrific experience at the Quest on Ward.  Our location is hard to beat, for boutiques, cafes, the conference venues and wonderful river walks it is all just a few steps away.  We enjoyed having you stay with us and hope to see you again soon.  Regards Robert

title: Great Service with a smile
text:
I have been travelling to Hamilton on business regularly this year.  After staying at a number of hotels and then at the Quest on Ward, I can say that I will not be booking any other accommodation in Hamilton.  Robert and his team are fantastic making you feel special and part of the furniture.
The rooms are all a good size, clean, well equipped and quiet.  The location excellent as its right in the middle of town within walking distance to cafes, restaurants and bars.
hotel_response: Dear Donz39. It is great to see that you have found us quietly perched above this central place in the city and that you are enjoying becoming part of the Quest on Ward family.  We enjoy your visits too. With your busy work schedule, it is good we can provide a peaceful haven each time you visit Hamilton. See you again soon.  Regards Robert

title: Will be booking there again.
text:
I booked a one bedroom apartment for a business trip. They were very abliging with a late checkout on last day, and generally made the whole stay very easy and personal. As I was using the apartment for meetings, it was great to be able to shut off the bedroom and bathroom and have a nice space for this. Robert even assisted by calling me with each new attendee for the meetings as they arrived.
It is very handy to restaurants etc, and will be booking there again on my next visit.
hotel_response: Dear P_Arnst.   It is great to see you enjoyed your time at Quest on Ward and chose to use us for your accommodation needs whilst on business in Hamilton. You certainly had a busy schedule and long days and we are glad to have been able to support you in a small way.  We will be happy to welcome you again very soon.  warm regards Robert

title: Great Location
text: We stayed in this location twice within 2 weeks during our driving trip around north island, booked online and got a great deal on a 1 bedroom apartment which was a good size with full kitchen. We picked this location and property for the laundry facilities and the location in CBD  - as we were able to walk around town without getting in the car. We had great service from Robert who takes pride in his business and was very helpful with all our requests and questions.  Very quiet too which was great.
hotel_response: Dear GC Purple. Thank you for staying with us at the beginning and end of your holiday in this region. We enjoyed hearing of your adventures and discoveries and it is great to see that you enjoyed your stay with us in this very central but quiet location. There is lots to do within an hour of Hamilton so perhaps you can visit again and we can help you stay busy for a couple more days. You remember some of the great cafes near us to keep you energized as you venture forth. Nerang is not so far away so we do hope to see you again sometime. warm regards Robert

title: Great location, would stay here again.
text:
I booked our room over the phone and the Manager, Robert, was great. We arrived late and the out of hours service for checking in worked fine. 
We were upgraded to a one bed apartment which was a good space with a very well equipped kitchen. It was spotlessly clean. Location was excellent. Walking distance to lots of bars, eateries, shops. Disappointing that wifi came at an extra cost. Would stay here again though.
hotel_response: Dear Lorna. We enjoyed your visit with us at Quest on Ward in the happening heart of Hamilton. The exciting new shopping malls are taking shape and it will be great to have even more cafes, boutiques and activities surounding us. Did you get to visit Brower's books?  A great place to find all sorts of collectables, old and new books and only a short stroll from here. Do the river walk first and browse a while on the way back. We look forward to your next weekend escape to Hamilton.  regards Robert

title: Haven in the Heart of Hamilton
text: Here is a reasonably priced, clean and comfortable tourist apartment in the middle of Hamilton. My single apartment had a separate double-bed room, kitchen/lounge, & bathroom. Handy to shops, river walks, the casino and the vibrant Victoria St cafe/restaurant precinct. The elevator is a slow throwback (use the stairs), but the staff were extremely friendly and helpful.
hotel_response: Dear Keith C.  We are happy to read that you enjoyed your stay here in the heart of Hamilton city. It is surely a haven here nestled in the bustling city. Great you got to enjoy the cafes and river walks. We are also very central for day trips to Hobbiton and Waitomo Caves and many other great adventures. Did you get to visit Maungatautari? An amazing natural reserve about an hour from here. Really worth a visit next time you spend a day or two in Hamilton. regards Robert

title: Very nice place and excellent location
text: We stayed for 3 nights and thought it was a very nice place to stay.  The location is very central and you can easily walk to the restaurants or along the river.  We were upgraded from a studio to a one bedroom apartment for free, which was nice! The room was well equipped with a kitchen and laundry.  We were on the street-side of the building, and there was quite a lot of noise from at night, but it would probably not be too bad if you slept with the window closed.  The staff were really nice.
hotel_response: Dear Debbie,  It is good to see you enjoyed your stay in Hamilton recently.  We are glad you found our location to be central to everything from great restaurants to shopping malls and of course the river walk is only a few steps away.  Did you get time to visit Hobbiton and the Waitomo Caves? Both are just a short drive away. Hamilton is a great base for enjoying this region. As you have commented, with the window open you can hear the sounds of the city from time to time but is it lovely and quiet with the windows shut.  We did enjoy having you stay with us and look forward to being of service to you again some time soon.  regards Robert

title: barrym
text: This hotel is centrally located in the city. The facilities and decor are all of a good standard although on the night I stayed there was an offensive/over powering odor in the kitchen area which seemed to be strong detergent smell? Not sure but very unpleasant.  The bedroom is a little on the tight side but adequate. The hosts were just outstanding, nothing was a trouble.. The secure parking is adjacent behind the main building not sure about personal security if parking a car late at night. I would return there should the occasion  arise.
hotel_response: Hello Barry.  We were happy to welcome you and I am glad to see that overall you enjoyed your experience here. You are right that we have a wonderful location in the heart of the city. Cafes and boutiques all around. We enjoy being so close to the river with it's lovely walk winding around to Hamilton Gardens! I will check on the chemical smell you mentioned. We try to balance cleanliness and freshness in our apartments and perhaps there was some issue that day. We are lucky to be one of the only places in this area with balconies, so there is usually an abundance of fresh air to enjoy while watching the world go by.  The Hamilton Show is on next weekend, why not drop by with the family and treat yourself.  I am looking forward to see you again Barry.   regards Robert

title: Clean and tidy. Friendly staff
text: Stayed at Quest on Ward last week and found it clean and tidy, with friendly staff. Location is good - 100 metres from Victoria Street. I will come again. Roadworks nearby ceased in the evening so there wa no problem with noise
hotel_response:
Dear Johnnythehat255118
We are glad to see you enjoyed your stay with us and found our wonderful location in the heart of the city to be close to the cafes, boutiques and malls.  Not sure if you had time to enjoy the wonderful river walks along the Waikato River, just a few minutes from us.  A lot of conference attendees at Claudlands stay with us also as it is an easy walk across the river to the event centre and our spacious, well equipped apartments support a busy visit or a relaxed holiday.  We are looking forward to welcome you again when you are next up from Christchurch.  regards Robert

title: Nice
text: We arrived in Hamilton on a Sunday around 5 pm and we was worried about it because all the serviced apartments are closed at that time , they usually close at 4 pm , but we were very lucky meeting Robert that was there and helped us a lot . Very kind , gentle , friendly and helpful . He even wanted to help us with our luggage . The apartment is spacious , well located, near the restaurants , near the park and it is very clean too . It also has laundry facilities that is very convenient . A nice place to stay .
hotel_response: Dear Liz, thank you for staying with us on Sunday night. We are happy that you are enjoying being in NZ so much. As you can see one night is not long enough to see everything in and around Hamilton as we are a great, central location for Hobbiton, Waitomo Caves, thermal spas and day trips to the beach or Rotorua and of course Hamilton Gardens.  Visit us again soon, we are waiting to welcome you.  warm regards, Robert

title: A real find
text: We were visiting our son for five weeks and used this as our base, travelling away for a few days then returning. It has an excellent location in the centre of Hamilton very close to the shops and excellent restaurants. The apartment was spotless, very well equipped, including air conditioning, and everything worked. However, what really made our stay outstanding was the warmth and helpfulness of Robert, our host. Nothing was too much trouble for him and he really added to our stay.
hotel_response: Dear Ann.  We are so glad you enjoyed making Quest on Ward your home base for your adventures over the New Zealand summer. You both managed to see so much of this beautiful country.  We were always happy to be greeted with your cheerful smiles and tales of your experiences.  With family now in this area, we look forward to seeing you and Les again on your next visit.  warm regards from the heart of Hamilton.   Robert

title: Excellent Service, Well equipped Serviced Apartment, Great Location!
text:
We made a last minute booking at Quest on Ward while on a road trip through NZ - having stayed in Quest Apartments in Australia we were looking for a comfortable place to stay the night with the facilities you would expect at Quest apartment. The Quest on Ward did not disappoint! From the moment I sent a booking via email, the host, Robert was accommodating and made us feel really welcome. 

The Quest on Ward would be in one of the best locations in Hamilton - its right in the Hub of the city centre, with easy parking and walking distance to shops and dozens of restaurants and cafes. For Coffee addicts there is also a Starbucks next door downstairs on street level - Perfect!

After a very hectic road trip through NZ we were looking for some home comforts which the quest provided. The room (we had a one bedroom balcony room) was very spacious, immaculately clean, the bathroom was large which was a nice change from the usual hotel room sized bathrooms! The kitchen was equipped with a decent sized frig/freezer, a dishwasher and stove-top. We were even able to wash and dry our clothes overnight in the washer/dryer which was a bonus!

I would recommend the Quest on Ward as your first choice for accommodation in Hamilton - whether you are travelling for business, holidays or just a quick stopover the Quest on Ward ticks all the boxes! Thank you Robert for going the extra mile to ensure we enjoyed our stay!
hotel_response:
Dear Juliafg

thank you for your time to review the Quest on Ward, Hamilton all about your recent stay. We were glad to meet you and be of service and delighted to hear you enjoyed your stay. One night is never enough in the Hamilton areathough.  A few more days and you could have visited Hobbiton or the Waitomo Caves just a short drive from here or the rugged surf beaches of Raglan.  Hamilton has great cafes and boutiques and a wonderful river walk to enjoy.  Do come again soon, we are waiting!  Regards Robert

title: Excellent Hotel
text:
Chose to stay at Quest over 2 nights in January as a stopover hotel and it was worth every penny. The rooms were meticulate and housekeeping service superb. The location was spot on as there were many restaurants to choose from within walking distance. We booked two rooms - interconnecting (217 & 218) and facilities in both rooms were great.
The GM, Robert Hunter is still working on to find the best internet provider as when we were there, we had problems with the internet connection.
Overall experience was excellent and would not hesitate to recommend this hotel to anyone.
hotel_response:
Dear rtsrtk

We enjoyed having you stay with us in one of our 2 bedroom apartments last month. As you experienced, our 2 BR apartments are huge with 2 bathrooms and 2 complete living areas as well as the 2 bedrooms of course.  I am very happy to hear you had a great stay with us. Good news on the internet, our existing high speed broadband ( cable ) is still doing a speedy great job, but the WiFi you hoped for should be in place within a matter of days. Add this to our impossible to beat location in the heart of the city and you have the perfect base for business or leisure.  I'm looking forward to welcome you again some time soon.  Regards Robert

title: Really excellent
text: We spent two weeks at the well equipped apartments at Quest on Ward and it was an extremely pleasant experience from start to finish. The one bedroomed apartment was very comfortable and well equipped and Robert and Chern made us feel completely at home, even to the point of sharing with us some homemade cookies!  In our opinion, it was one of the elements that made our time in NZ such a great experience overall. The location is very central and there are plenty of bars and restaurants within easy walking distance. It was blissfully quiet too - even on New Year's Eve, when the restaurants and bars stay open well into the evening.  We couldn't really fault it and that is largely down to the exceptional service and attention offered by Robert and Chern. Thank you both for making our first trip to New Zealand such a great experience!
hotel_response:
Hello Mary

We so enjoyed your cheerful smile each morning as you set off on a new adventure in the countryside surrounding Hamilton.  You both certainly kept busy visiting Hobbiton, the Waitomo Caves, Rotorua, Raglan beaches, Lake Taupo, and twice over to the wonderful beaches around Tauranga.  With everything a comfortable day trip from us we were happy to be your base during your visit.  Being in the heart of the city we are a short stroll to cafes and boutiques and the mall next door is very convenient.  Yet you noted  how "quiet" it is here at night which is so important for busy holiday makers or business people alike.  Thank you both for staying with us.  We hope to have a opportunity to be of service to you again sometime.  warm regards  Robert and Chern

title: Exceptional service
text:
Stayed recently at this hotel and from the minute I stepped through the door I was made to feel at home. The hosts Robert and Chern run a good ship, right from checking in to checking out everything I could have wanted was made available.

The room was well presented, clean, tidy and well appointed.

Robert and Chern's knowledge of the area, restaurants and shops made the stay all the more pleasant.

I'll certainly be staying here again.
hotel_response:
Dear Graeme

We are glad you found Quest on Ward for your recent business trip to Hamilton and enjoyed your visit with us.  Being in the heart of the city we are in an envied position for shopping, cafes, entertainment and fashion all to compliment your busy lifestyle and work responsibilities.  We enjoyed having you stay with us and look forward to seeing you again in 2013.  

warm regards 

Robert

title: Definitely worth considering
text:
Management were hugely helpful at the Quest on Ward both prior to my stay and while I was there. I stayed in a studio, which is well set up for a short-term stay (e.g. three nights), although for anything much longer you'd probably want the next room up. The kitchen facilities are good, and the bathroom is fantastic, and includes a washer/drier should you need one.
My only real niggle is that the TV is set up high on the wall, which makes it difficult to watch if you're not actually in the bed, and there was a bit of a lack of comfortable seating. However, I can see that this is because the space has instead been used for business-traveller facilities like a desk, and this was only really an issue because I didn't go out at all in the evenings.
If you're looking for central self-contained accommodation, definitely consider the Quest on Ward.
hotel_response:
Dear Westie_Traveller

We were very happy to welcome you to the best kept secret in the heart of Hamilton - Quest on Ward.  I am glad you enjoyed your stay with us and note your high level of  satisfaction with facilities and service here.  Our studio apartments have full kitchen and laundry facilities along with a balcony which offer more space than costlier hotels in the area.  As you have said, for 2 people or a longer stay of course a 1 bedroom apartment gives even more space to relax (or work), and feels like home.  Our central location means the wonderful cafes, bars and restaurants of Victoria Street down to Hood Street are a gentle stroll away, and with the mall next door there is plenty to keep visitors occupied without even needing a car.  
Did you get a change to visit Hobbiton?  Many people are making us a base for their adventures to see the movie set, or venture on to the Waitomo caves, all within an easy drive from here.  
Business or pleasure we are happy to welcome you again sometime to the Quest on Ward.

warm regards

Robert

title: Home away from home
text: On arrival I found the managers to be very friendly and professional.  The room was huge and it was great to have my own washing machine and dryer as I had been on the road for a while and finally caught up with getting laundry done, but in my own time. The heat pump was a blessing. I walked to the bars and shared a cab back and it was great that there were no noisy bars down that end of town. The lobby/lounge area on our floor outside the lifts gave it a unique flair. I loved having a tv in the lounge and one in the bedroom. However just to bring it to your attention, whilst watching tv in bed, my remote would also turn the tv on in my lounge too. I also appreciated the secured parking spaces. I would definitely recommend to professionals who do quite a lot of travel and just need to enjoy stretching out in a spacious apartment instead of a poky studio hotel room,and at a reasonable price.
hotel_response:
Dear Bjandco

It is great to hear you enjoyed your stay here at Quest on Ward Hamilton and I really appreciate your detailed review.  We are certainly in the heart of the city with everything at your finger tips, yet I am sure you loved having a nice peaceful apartment to come home to.  For professionals or leisure travelers it makes a big difference to have the added space and facilities of our apartments and the balcony is also a great extra here.  We are glad you made use of our inroom washing machine and dryer and I hope you got to cook up a storm in our fully equipped kitchen.  
I look forward to welcoming you again sometime soon here in Hamilton.

regards

Robert

title: Excellent choice.  Great location.  Value for money.
text:
If your looking for a great location that offers easy walking distance to shops, malls, restaurants, cafes and pubs then I would higly recommend staying at the Quest on Ward.  You will be spolit for choice.  Park the car and get out and explore.  The apartments are spacious, clean and offer so much more than a hotel.  The extra space, household utilities and less foot traffic is a bonus.      

This was my first stay at the Quest on Ward and we'll definately stay again.  The write up on the website is true.  Robert was a great host, really helpful and polite.  Excellent stay, thank you.
hotel_response:
Dear Jacs123

Thank you for your time to review Quest on Ward.  I am happy to see you really enjoyed your stay here with us and plan to visit again.  It is true, our apartments are spacious and fully fitted out with kitchen, washing machine and dryer and loads of space to relax.  If convenience, cleanliness and a home away from home is what you want, Quest on Ward is a fantastic option.
thanks again, and see you soon

Robert

title: clean and convenient.  better than a hotel!
text: Loved the space of a bedroom separate from the living area.  Had my own kitchen and laundry facilities which made the experience feel like home.  Probably the best area to stay in Hamilton as it has shopping malls next door with so many places to eat around the area.  Seems like centre of the business area too as most of the bigger buildings and offices are located within a block of the Quest.  Have stayed in hotels before and would not go back to the small rooms.  Looking forward to visit again.  Nice friendly service too.

title: Pleasantly Surprised
text: Was booked in to these apartments for the first time, as the place I usually stay in was booked out.  I arrived on a Saturday evening at 6pm to find reception closed - I had to ring a buzzer which took a while to be answered.  When I asked about where to park my car, I was told I needed to pre-book a car park - which I hadn't been told by the travel agent who did the booking.  The lady then called the duty manager while I waiting outside in the cold, with my car double parked on the street.  The manager took about 10 minutes to come down, but organised a park for me and explained everything I needed to know.  Once I got to my room, I was pleasantly surprised!  For the amount charged, I expected a studio apartment, but got a 1 bedroom with full kitchen, laundry etc.  Was very tidy and modern.  Comfortable bed too, but only one spare pillow.  Bathroom very nice, with plenty of towels.  Only stayed one night, but wouldn't hesitate to stay again - this time pre-booking the carpark, although very hard to find somewhere to park the car on the street while you go in to get the carpark access token.

title: fantastic
text:
Brilliant location, quiet, clean and spacious.  Very helpful managers who go out of their way to ensure your every need is met.  Washing machine, dryer etc.  Just great - I will be staying there again.
It is in the centre of town down a side street.  Note that it is in the first part of the street which is one way - it is on the left.  There is an excellent cafe called Domaine around the corner and if Starbucks is your thing there is one almost just outside the door.

title: Would recommend highly
text: The welcome was warm and informative. The apartment was a good size and spotless and equipped with everything you would need. The only gripe is the bed was a bit too firm and only one spare pillow. Great central location with heaps of choice for dining out.

title: OK for Long Stay, but for Short Term a Hotel is More Comfortable
text: The reception staff at this apartment hotel are lovely and very helpful. But, the rooms are a bit tired, there is no wireless, the internet is expensive, they charge for parking and there is not good lighting in the rooms. For a long stay where you can get groceries and don't want to eat out each night, this makes sense but otherwise, I'd stay in a hotel (like the Novotel) next time.

title: A nice place to stay
text: The Quest on Ward was a nice place to stay. The room was spacious and nicely decorated with a comfy bed and clean bathroom.  A great hotel for a short trip to Hamilton.

title: Great location, great price and so clean
text: My husband and I booked the Quest on Ward at the last minute. It's location is great as it is close to restaurants, movies and shops. Being right in the middle of down town I was worried that it would be noisey but we didn't hear a squeak. Has to have been the cleanest accommodation we have stayed in. Will definately stay there again.

title: Central modern apartments, reasonably priced stay
text:
We stayed here 1night on an impromptu weekend in Hamilton. Modern serviced apartment right in the CBD. You can park your car behind the building ($10 extra for overnight) and walk to the casino, etc, very central. Professional service right from the word go, booked by phoning their 0800 number and was able to get the same discounted rate as advertised on the internet and the guy reserved us a carpark at the same time. Very reasonably priced stay. We got a spacious 1 bedroom apt facing the city on the third floor. Modern furniture, leather couch, full kitchen with dishwasher, Sky.

Liked: 2nd TV in the bedroom, your own washing machine / dryer with powder sachets included (we didnt use it but handy for those who need it). 

Disliked: bed was a bit too hard for my liking, couldnt find any wine glasses (just coffee mugs and tea cups). Dustpan was greasy (not cleaned from previous person). 

There is no swimming pool or spa. Bear in mind reception closes at 4pm on the weekends, after that there is swipe key entry.

title: Great Location & Comfortable Stay
text: Stayed here for one night as went to the rugby international.  Great place, very roomy and comfortable beds.  Bathroom had disabled access so very spacious.  I would stay here again.  Nice and central too.  Bedroom not open to street noise so nice and quiet.

title: Nothing wrong, but nothing great
text:
TripAdvisor doesn't have a rating between "average" and "very good".  They should have 3.5 stars for "good", which is how I'd classify this property.

I spent two nights in a 1 bedroom apartment.  I was quoted a rate by email which looked good, until I received a follow up email telling me the previous rate was incorrect as I was staying on a "special event" weekend.  The new rate was almost double.  Fortunately I was then offered a 3rd rate in between the previous two!  In a strange set of circumstances the rate I paid at this property was identical to the rate I paid the previous night at the 5-star SkyCity Grand hotel in Auckland.  The two properties are poles apart, so I'd rate the value here as quite low - at least on event weekends.

Check in staff were friendly and helpful - my booked carpark hadn't been arranged - but they quickly fixed it up.  The room itself was comfortable but a little stark.  Low-voltage flourescent lighting dominates and the lounge room feels a bit like a caravan park cabin at night.  I left the lights off.  The bed was comfortable, the bathroom was serviceable.  There was no full-length mirror anywhere in the room which I found odd.  Tea and coffee facilities included sachets of plunger coffee which was a nice touch, as were the full canisters of salt and pepper in the kitchen cupboards.

The location is very good, right in the heart of Hamilton, which as a town has little going for it aside from Waikato Stadium.  It's very hard to find though, reception is just a shop-front and signage is poor.  It's next to Starbucks if you're looking.

title: Great value - Clean and top location!
text:
I stayed in these apartments for one night and was pleasantly surprised by the value for money. The studio room was extremely clean and modern and had a kitchen, large bathroom with washer/dryer cupboard, flatscreen TV with SKY and internet cable access (charged). The kitchen even had a small dishwasher.
The apartments are very central to Hamilton, with heaps of shopping and cafes right on your doorstep. 
Reception is closes in the evening and unfortunately the guests below me were very loud during the night. The staff were very apologetic when I informed them the next day and apparently there is a phone number you can ring and they will deal immediately with noisy neighbours. 
My room also looked out onto a multi-level car park so you may want to ask for a room with a view of the street if one is available. Parking is in the alley behind the hotel and you need to pre-book this at a cost of $10 or your wheels may get clamped.
Overall, the rooms were great value, clean and modern.

title: Nice inner city place.
text:
We stayed one night in 1 bedroom suite. Nice and large, clean, well equipped. Loved the washer/dryer. 

Starbucks is just 5 steps round the corner, big mall right across the road, bars and restaurants & casino 1 minute walk. A great place to stay if you want to be in the middle of things.

Despite being inner city, night noise was not a problem....BUT....the curtains failed to black  out inner city lighting...which made for a not so great sleep. Otherwise I'd reccomend.

title: Central location
text:
we stayed one night in a 1 bedroom unit, hotel is right in the heart of the CBD with a mall, cinema, shops and 3 coffee chains (Esquires, Starbucks and Robert Harris)  all within 50 metres, hotel only opened Dec 07, rooms are well appointed, clean and spacious, with flat screen tvs (small/mid size in lounge and small in bedroom).  Full size kichen also.

Ward Street is a thoroughfare between 2 main streets but there was not a lot of night time noise.

Unfortunately reception did not appear to have any brochures on the area other than on other hotels within the Quest chain, would have been good to be able to pick up brochures or maps at reception.

The only downside to the hotel is parking, the hotel has secure car parking for an additional $10 per night which you need to arrange in advance, this is recommended as I dont think I would like to leave my car parked on the streets overnight.

Be careful where you park when checking in, there is an area behind the hotel with allocated parking for the hotel and other businesses however in the time we took to check in (literally 5 minutes) our car was clamped, which can incur a $60 fee, the boy in charge of the clamping loiters around the area but does not advise you not to park there and is very zealous and a little power crazy, although we managed to avoid the charge as we were staying at the hotel.

Overall aside from parking issues would definitely recommend staying at quest.
